剂.en: Although this dose of medicine is very bitter, its effect is good.
He needs a shot of stimulant.

半场.en: We played well in the first half.
They overtook us in the second half.

半场.zh: 半场休息的时候，教练说了一些话。
半场.en: During halftime, the coach said a few words.

半场.zh: 虽然上半场输了，但下半场我们赢了。
半场.en: Although we lost the first half, we won the second half.

半场.zh: 这场球赛半场比分是2比1。
半场.en: The halftime score of this match was 2 to 1.

主义.zh: 他这个人没什么主义，见风使舵。
主义.en: He has no principles, just goes with the flow.

主义.zh: 我们反对那种极端的主义。
虽然他说的头头是道，但我不同意他的主义。
主义.en: Although he sounds convincing, I don't agree with his ideology.

主义.zh: 资本主义和社会主义是两种不同的主义。
主义.en: Capitalism and socialism are two different ideologies.

声明.en: The company issued a statement today.

声明.zh: 他声明自己跟这件事无关。
声明.en: He declared that he has nothing to do with this matter.

声明.zh: 那个声明听起来很正式，但没什么实质内容。
声明.en: That statement sounds very formal, but it has no real substance.

声明.zh: 政府需要就这个问题做出公开声明。
声明.en: The government needs to make a public statement on this issue.

声明.zh: 我们等他的声明等了好几天，结果他只说了句不知道。
声明.en: We waited for his statement for days, but in the end he just said he didn't know.

码.en: This QR code can't be scanned.

码.zh: 他每天在电脑上码字，写小说。
码.en: He types away on the computer every day, writing novels.

码.zh: 你记住了支付码吗？别忘了。
码.en: Did you remember the payment code? Don't forget.

惊.en: He was startled and almost fell.

惊.zh: 听到那个声音，她惊得说不出话来。
惊.en: Upon hearing that sound, she was too shocked to speak.
Don't be so jumpy, speak slowly.

惊.zh: 我没想到会在这儿见到你，真是又惊又喜。
惊.en: I didn't expect to see you here, it's a pleasant surprise.

情报.zh: 他们从敌人那里获取了情报。
情报.en: They obtained intelligence from the enemy.

情报.zh: 情报部门正在分析这些数据。
情报.en: The intelligence department is analyzing this data.

情报.zh: 他因为出卖情报被判了刑。
情报.en: He was sentenced for selling intelligence.

情报.zh: 如果情报准确的话，我们应该马上行动。
情报.en: If the intelligence is accurate, we should act immediately.

护.en: She uses hand cream to protect her skin.
Don't defend him, let him do it himself.

护.zh: 法律应该保护消费者的权益。
护.en: The law should protect consumers' rights.

护.zh: 这个护身符是我奶奶给我的。
护.en: This amulet was given to me by my grandmother.

护.zh: 虽然他很凶，但她还是护着弟弟。
护.en: Although he is very fierce, she still protects her younger brother.

眼神.zh: 我从他的眼神里看到了失望。
眼神.en: I saw disappointment in his eyes.

眼神.zh: 他们交换了一下眼神，就明白了。
眼神.en: They exchanged a look and understood.

眼神.zh: 他用那种奇怪的眼神看着我，让我很不舒服。
眼神.en: He looked at me with that strange expression, making me very uncomfortable.

眼神.zh: 虽然她没说话，但她的眼神已经说明了一切。
眼神.en: Although she didn't speak, her eyes said it all.

计.zh: 这个计划需要大家配合。

计.en: He is very scheming, you need to be careful.

计.zh: 总计下来，我们花了五千块。
计.en: In total, we spent five thousand yuan.

计.zh: 为了生计，他每天都加班到很晚。
计.en: To make a living, he works late overtime every day.

精.zh: 她是个非常精明的商人。
精.en: She is a very shrewd businesswoman.

精.zh: 这瓶酒精浓度很高，小心使用。
精.en: This bottle of alcohol has a high concentration, use it carefully.

精.zh: 虽然他年纪小，但做事很精。
精.en: Although he is young, he is very sharp in doing things.

毁.zh: 别因为一时冲动毁了自己的前途。
毁.en: Don't ruin your future because of a momentary impulse.

毁.zh: 那个车祸毁了整个家庭。
毁.en: That car accident destroyed the entire family.

毁.zh: 如果他不道歉，他们之间的友谊就毁了。
毁.en: If he doesn't apologize, their friendship will be ruined.

斗.zh: 他们俩为了小事斗了一下午。
斗.en: The two of them fought for a whole afternoon over a small matter.

斗.zh: 这只狗很凶，总爱跟别的狗斗。
斗.en: This dog is very aggressive and always likes to fight with other dogs.

斗.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但他斗得非常顽强。
斗.en: Although he lost the match, he fought very tenaciously.

斗.zh: 我们得团结起来，不能内斗。
斗.en: We need to unite and cannot fight among ourselves.

战士.zh: 战士们日夜守护着边疆。
战士.en: The soldiers guard the border day and night.

战士.zh: 这位老战士给我们讲了当年的故事。
战士.en: This veteran soldier told us stories from back then.

战士.zh: 每个战士都带着坚定的目光走上战场。
战士.en: Every soldier went to the battlefield with a determined look.

战士.zh: 虽然战争结束了，但战士们的牺牲不会被忘记。
战士.en: Although the war is over, the soldiers' sacrifices will not be forgotten.

装置.zh: 消防装置需要定期检查。
装置.en: The fire-fighting equipment needs regular inspection.

装置.zh: 他们安装了一个新的警报装置。
装置.en: They installed a new alarm device.

装置.zh: 这个简易装置用来测量温度。
装置.en: This simple device is used to measure temperature.

装置.zh: 因为装置失灵，整个系统都停了。
装置.en: Because the device malfunctioned, the whole system stopped.

赌.zh: 他赌了一晚上，结果把钱全输光了。
赌.en: He gambled all night and ended up losing all his money.

赌.zh: 我不喜欢赌博，风险太大了。
赌.en: I don't like gambling, the risk is too high.

赌.zh: 她赌气说再也不理他了。
赌.en: She said in a fit of pique that she would never talk to him again.

赌.zh: 他们赌明天会不会下雨。
赌.en: They are betting on whether it will rain tomorrow.

蒙.en: Cover your eyes and guess who I am.

蒙.zh: 别想蒙我，我什么都知道了。
蒙.en: Don't try to fool me, I know everything.
He covered his face with a cloth.

蒙.zh: 一开始我有点蒙，后来才明白。
蒙.en: At first I was a bit confused, but later I understood.

发射.zh: 卫星将在明天凌晨发射。
发射.en: The satellite will be launched early tomorrow morning.

发射.zh: 发射中心的工作人员都很紧张。
发射.en: The staff at the launch center are all very nervous.

发射.zh: 他们成功发射了一枚新型导弹。
发射.en: They successfully launched a new type of missile.

发射.zh: 因为天气不好，发射时间推迟了。
发射.en: Because of bad weather, the launch time was delayed.

穿着.en: You look great in what you're wearing today.

穿着.zh: 她穿着一条红色的裙子。
穿着.en: She is wearing a red dress.
In winter, pay attention to wearing warm clothes.
His attire is always very casual.

穿着.zh: 虽然穿着朴素，但她的气质很好。
穿着.en: Although dressed simply, she has a good temperament.

界.en: He is very famous in the music industry.

界.zh: 各界人士都来参加了会议。
界.en: People from all walks of life attended the meeting.
This river is the border between the two countries.

界.zh: 科学界对这个发现非常兴奋。
界.en: The scientific community is very excited about this discovery.

偏.en: This dish tastes a bit too salty.
I insist on going, no one can stop me.

偏.zh: 她说话总是偏激，容易得罪人。
偏.en: She always speaks extreme, easily offending people.

偏.zh: 别偏听偏信，要自己判断。
偏.en: Don't listen only to one side; judge for yourself.

置.zh: 这事你先别管，先置之不理。
置.en: Don't worry about this for now, just ignore it.

置.zh: 我在客厅置了一个书架。
置.en: I placed a bookshelf in the living room.

置.zh: 公司需要置办一批办公设备。
置.en: The company needs to purchase a batch of office equipment.

置.zh: 他把自己置身事外，不想掺和。
置.en: He kept himself out of the matter, not wanting to get involved.

告.en: He was sued for owing money.

告.zh: 别到处告状，先自己解决。
告.en: Don't go tattling everywhere; solve it yourself first.

告.zh: 如果你不还钱，我就去告你。
告.en: If you don't pay back, I'll sue you.

告.zh: 这件事我已经告诉老师了。
告.en: I've already told the teacher about this matter.

牺牲.en: He sacrificed a lot of time.

牺牲.zh: 为了家人，他愿意牺牲一切。
牺牲.en: For his family, he's willing to sacrifice everything.
This kind of sacrifice is not worth it.

牺牲.zh: 她牺牲了自己的休息时间来帮助同事。
牺牲.en: She sacrificed her own break time to help a colleague.

牺牲.zh: 如果没人愿意牺牲，这个项目就完不成。
牺牲.en: If no one is willing to sacrifice, this project won't get done.

选举.en: There's a presidential election this year.
We elected him as class monitor.

选举.zh: 这次选举的结果让人意外。
选举.en: The result of this election was surprising.

选举.zh: 在选举之前，候选人要发表演讲。
选举.en: Before the election, candidates have to give speeches.

选举.zh: 因为选举不公平，很多人抗议。
选举.en: Because the election was unfair, many people protested.

武装.zh: 政府要求解除所有非法武装。
武装.en: The government demands the disarmament of all illegal armed groups.

武装.zh: 虽然对方有武装，但我们不怕。
武装.en: Although the other side is armed, we are not afraid.

对付.zh: 我们得想个办法对付他。
对付.en: We need to think of a way to deal with him.

对付.zh: 对付这种问题，需要耐心。
对付.en: To deal with this kind of problem, you need patience.

对付.zh: 如果你不知道怎么对付，就问我。
对付.en: If you don't know how to handle it, just ask me.

惹.en: He caused a lot of trouble.

惹.zh: 我不想惹事，所以没说话。
惹.en: I didn't want to cause trouble, so I kept quiet.
You can't afford to provoke that kind of person.

天堂.zh: 大家都说死后会上天堂。
天堂.en: Everyone says you'll go to heaven after death.

天堂.zh: 对她来说，这个花园就是天堂。
天堂.en: For her, this garden is paradise.
Do you believe there's a heaven?

天堂.zh: 如果每天都能这么开心，那简直就是天堂。
天堂.en: If I could be this happy every day, that would be heaven.

也就是说.zh: 他迟到了，也就是说他没赶上飞机。
也就是说.en: He was late, which means he missed the plane.

也就是说.zh: 明天放假，也就是说你不用上班。
也就是说.en: Tomorrow is a holiday, meaning you don't have to work.

也就是说.zh: 她没回复，也就是说她不感兴趣。
也就是说.en: She didn't reply, which means she's not interested.

也就是说.zh: 你已经成年了，也就是说你要为自己的行为负责。
也就是说.en: You are an adult now, meaning you must take responsibility for your actions.

屁股.en: He fell down and his butt hurts.
Don't sit too long, your bottom will hurt.

屁股.zh: 小孩子调皮，屁股挨了打。
屁股.en: The kid was mischievous and got spanked on the bottom.
You've got something dirty on your butt.

屁股.zh: 因为坐太久，我的屁股都麻了。
屁股.en: Because I sat too long, my butt went numb.

火箭.zh: 孩子们都喜欢玩火箭玩具。
火箭.en: Kids all love playing with rocket toys.

火箭.zh: 中国最近发射了一枚火箭。
如果天气好，我们就能看到火箭升空。
火箭.en: If the weather is good, we can see the rocket lift off.

注射.en: I need to get a vaccine injection today.

注射.zh: 医生建议他每天注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
注射.en: The doctor advised him to inject insulin daily to control blood sugar.

注射.zh: 你注射完以后记得按压一会儿。
注射.en: After you get the injection, remember to press it for a while.

注射.zh: 因为怕疼，她一直不敢去注射。
注射.en: Because she fears pain, she never dared to get an injection.

注射.zh: 这个药需要静脉注射，不能口服。
注射.en: This medicine needs intravenous injection, not oral.

肿瘤.zh: 他检查出来有良性肿瘤。
肿瘤.en: He was diagnosed with a benign tumor.

肿瘤.zh: 医生说她肚子里的肿瘤是良性的，不用太担心。
肿瘤.en: The doctor said the tumor in her belly is benign, no need to worry too much.

肿瘤.zh: 肿瘤早期发现的话，治愈率很高。
肿瘤.en: If a tumor is discovered early, the cure rate is high.

肿瘤.zh: 虽然他得了肿瘤，但心态一直很好。
肿瘤.en: Although he has a tumor, he has always maintained a good attitude.

肿瘤.zh: 这种肿瘤手术切除后还要定期复查。
肿瘤.en: After surgical removal of this type of tumor, regular check-ups are needed.

核.en: This peach pit is too big.

核.zh: 我们国家一直在发展核能技术。
核.en: Our country has been developing nuclear energy technology.

核.zh: 问题的核心里在于沟通。
核.en: The core of the problem lies in communication.

核.zh: 如果你不吃核，就直接扔掉吧。
核.en: If you don't eat the pit, just throw it away.

核.zh: 核电站的建设需要严格的安全标准。
核.en: The construction of nuclear power plants requires strict safety standards.

海军.en: His brother serves in the navy.

海军.zh: 中国海军近年发展得非常快。
海军.en: The Chinese navy has developed very rapidly in recent years.

海军.zh: 海军士兵每天都要进行训练。
虽然他想加入海军，但视力不合格。
海军.en: Although he wants to join the navy, his eyesight doesn't meet the requirements.

海军.zh: 这次演习动用了多艘海军舰艇。
海军.en: This exercise deployed multiple naval vessels.

起诉.en: He decided to sue that company.

起诉.zh: 因为合同纠纷，他们准备起诉对方。
起诉.en: Due to a contract dispute, they are preparing to sue the other party.

起诉.zh: 如果你不还钱，我就会起诉你。
起诉.en: If you don't repay the money, I will sue you.

起诉.zh: 虽然证据不足，他还是坚持起诉。
起诉.en: Although the evidence is insufficient, he still insisted on suing.

起诉.zh: 这个案子起诉了两年才开庭。
起诉.en: This case was filed two years ago before it went to trial.

拳.zh: 他练了十年拳击，拳法很厉害。
拳.en: He has practiced boxing for ten years; his punching skills are impressive.

拳.zh: 因为生气，他捏紧了拳头。
拳.en: Because he was angry, he clenched his fist.

拳.zh: 太极拳是一种缓慢的拳术。
拳.en: Tai Chi is a slow form of martial art.

结局.zh: 这个电影的结局很感人。
结局.en: The ending of this movie is very touching.

结局.zh: 谁也没想到故事的结局会是这样。
结局.en: No one expected the story's ending to be like this.

结局.zh: 不管结局如何，我们都要努力。
结局.en: No matter what the outcome, we must work hard.

结局.zh: 虽然过程很艰难，但结局还算圆满。
结局.en: Although the process was difficult, the outcome was fairly satisfactory.

结局.zh: 他早就预料到了这个结局。
结局.en: He had long predicted this outcome.

创.zh: 他创下了新的世界纪录。
创.en: He set a new world record.

创.zh: 伤口创面很大，需要缝合。
创.en: The wound area is large and needs stitches.

创.zh: 我们决定创办一家新公司。
创.en: We decided to start a new company.

竟.zh: 我没想到她竟会说出这样的话。
竟.en: I didn't expect she would actually say such things.

竟.zh: 这么简单的问题，你竟不会？
竟.en: Such a simple question, you actually don't know?

竟.zh: 虽然大家都反对，他竟坚持己见。
竟.en: Although everyone opposed, he actually insisted on his own opinion.

竟.zh: 那本书竟卖了一百万册。
竟.en: That book actually sold a million copies.

醒来.en: I woke up at seven in the morning.

醒来.zh: 他醒来后发现自己在医院里。
醒来.en: He woke up and found himself in the hospital.

醒来.zh: 孩子半夜醒来哭了好久。
醒来.en: The child woke up in the middle of the night and cried for a long time.

醒来.zh: 因为做了噩梦，她突然醒来。
醒来.en: Because of a nightmare, she suddenly woke up.
We'll set off after you wake up.

致.zh: 这封信是致全体员工的。
致.en: This letter is addressed to all employees.

致.zh: 因为天气不好，导致航班延误了。
致.en: Because of bad weather, the flight was delayed.

致.zh: 我特致此函，表示我们诚挚的歉意。
致.en: I am writing this letter specially to express our sincere apologies.

战略.en: The company formulated a new strategy.

战略.zh: 战略合作对我们很重要。
战略.en: Strategic cooperation is very important to us.

战略.zh: 我们需要调整市场战略来应对竞争。
战略.en: We need to adjust our market strategy to deal with competition.

战略.zh: 这个战略计划已经讨论过很多次了。
战略.en: This strategic plan has been discussed many times.

战略.zh: 虽然短期有风险，但长期来看这是个好战略。
战略.en: Although there are short-term risks, in the long run this is a good strategy.

天使.zh: 谢谢你，你真是我的天使。
天使.en: Thank you, you are truly my angel.

天使.zh: 这家公司获得了天使投资。
他画了一个带翅膀的天使在云端。
天使.en: He drew an angel with wings in the clouds.

天使.zh: 虽然她不是天使，但她非常善良。
天使.en: Although she is not an angel, she is very kind.

老大.zh: 家里老大总是照顾弟弟妹妹。
老大.en: The eldest child at home always takes care of the younger siblings.
He is the boss among this group.

老大.zh: 我问老大这件事怎么办，他说先等等。
老大.en: I asked the boss what to do about this, and he said to wait first.

老大.zh: 他们叫那个黑帮头目老大。

专辑.zh: 她花了两年时间制作这张专辑。
专辑.en: She spent two years making this album.

专辑.zh: 专辑里我最喜欢第三首歌。
专辑.en: In the album, my favorite is the third song.

专辑.zh: 虽然专辑很贵，但我还是收藏了。
专辑.en: Although the album was expensive, I still collected it.

稳.zh: 这个桌子不稳，要修一下。
稳.en: This table is not stable; it needs to be fixed.

稳.zh: 虽然市场波动大，但这家公司很稳。
稳.en: Although the market is volatile, this company is very stable.

稳.zh: 你先把心态放稳，再慢慢想办法。
稳.en: First calm down your mindset, then slowly figure out a solution.

幕.en: She hid behind the scenes and refused to come out.

幕.zh: 这部电影有三幕，每一幕都很精彩。
幕.en: This movie has three acts, each one is wonderful.

幕.zh: 虽然幕已经关了，但观众还在鼓掌。
幕.en: Although the curtain has closed, the audience is still applauding.

失踪.en: That child has been missing for two days.

失踪.zh: 警方正在调查失踪案件。
失踪.en: The police are investigating the missing person case.

失踪.zh: 她失踪之前没有任何异常。
失踪.en: Before she disappeared, there was nothing unusual.

失踪.zh: 虽然报了警，但失踪的人还没找到。
失踪.en: Although the police were called, the missing person hasn't been found yet.

执法.en: The police are enforcing the law.
Law enforcement officers must be fair.

执法.zh: 他因为妨碍执法被拘留了。
执法.en: He was detained for obstructing law enforcement.

执法.zh: 这次执法行动很成功，抓了很多人。
执法.en: This law enforcement operation was very successful; they caught many people.

执法.zh: 虽然执法严格，但犯罪率还是很高。
执法.en: Although law enforcement is strict, the crime rate is still high.

监控.en: There is a surveillance camera at the door.

监控.zh: 他一直在监控我的手机。
监控.en: He has been monitoring my phone.

监控.zh: 这栋楼装了新的监控系统。
监控.en: This building has installed a new monitoring system.

监控.zh: 虽然装了监控，但小偷还是进来了。
监控.en: Although surveillance cameras were installed, the thief still got in.

监控.zh: 公司用监控来保证员工的安全。
监控.en: The company uses monitoring to ensure employee safety.

抢劫.zh: 他因为抢劫被判了三年。
抢劫.en: He was sentenced to three years for robbery.

抢劫.zh: 昨天那个抢劫案，警察很快就抓住了嫌疑人。
抢劫.en: The police quickly caught the suspect in that robbery case yesterday.

抢劫.zh: 晚上一个人走夜路容易遇到抢劫。
抢劫.en: Walking alone at night is easy to encounter robbery.

抢劫.zh: 他不仅抢劫了银行，还打伤了保安。
抢劫.en: He not only robbed the bank but also injured the security guard.

卫星.zh: 中国发射了一颗新卫星。
卫星电视在农村也很常见了。
卫星.en: Satellite TV is also common in rural areas.
Weather forecasts rely on satellite data.

卫星.zh: 虽然卫星很先进，但维护成本也很高。
卫星.en: Although satellites are very advanced, maintenance costs are also high.

蛮.zh: 这家店的东西蛮便宜的。
蛮.en: The things in this store are quite cheap.

蛮.zh: 他这个人蛮有意思的，说话很幽默。
蛮.en: He is quite interesting, speaks very humorously.

蛮.zh: 今天天气蛮好的，我们去散步吧。
蛮.en: The weather is quite nice today, let's go for a walk.

蛮.zh: 虽然路有点远，但风景蛮漂亮的。
蛮.en: Although the road is a bit far, the scenery is quite beautiful.
The dish you made is quite tasty.

猛.zh: 这辆车开得特别猛，吓了我一跳。
猛.en: This car drove very fiercely, startling me.

猛.zh: 他学习很猛，一晚上背了一百个单词。
猛.en: He studies very intensely, memorized 100 words in one night.

猛.zh: 虽然他很猛，但也要注意安全。
猛.en: Although he is very aggressive, he also needs to pay attention to safety.

治安.en: The public security here is very good.

治安.zh: 最近治安不太好，大家晚上少出门。
治安.en: Recently public security is not good, everyone go out less at night.

治安.zh: 治安问题关系到每个人的安全。
治安.en: Public security issues relate to everyone's safety.

治安.zh: 因为治安变好了，所以晚上可以放心散步。
治安.en: Because public security has improved, so we can walk at night with confidence.
Strengthening public security is very important.

完毕.zh: 所有准备工作都完毕，我们可以开始了。
完毕.en: All preparations are complete, we can start.
The meeting is over, let's adjourn.

完毕.zh: 等他收拾完毕，我们就出发。
完毕.en: After he finishes packing, we will set off.

踏.zh: 不要踏草坪，小草也有生命。
踏.en: Don't step on the lawn, the grass also has life.
He set foot on a path of no return.

踏.zh: 既然已经踏上了这条路，就要坚持到底。
踏.en: Since you have set foot on this path, you must persist to the end.
Be careful not to step on empty air.

监狱.zh: 监狱里的生活非常艰苦。
监狱.en: Life in prison is very hard.

监狱.zh: 他因为偷窃坐了三年监狱。
监狱.en: He served three years in prison for theft.

监狱.zh: 虽然监狱很可怕，但改造好了也能重新做人。
监狱.en: Although prison is scary, if reformed one can become a new person.

监狱.zh: 监狱不是解决问题的方法。
监狱.en: Prison is not the solution to problems.

运作.zh: 这台机器的运作原理很简单。
运作.en: The operating principle of this machine is very simple.

运作.zh: 只要资金到位，项目就能顺利运作。
运作.en: As long as funds are in place, the project can operate smoothly.

判.en: The judge sentenced him as guilty.
This match was judged a draw.

判.zh: 他因为诈骗被判了五年。
判.en: He was sentenced to five years for fraud.

判.zh: 经过讨论，我们判他胜出。
判.en: After discussion, we judged him the winner.
The referee awarded a penalty kick.

炸弹.zh: 警察在广场发现了一个炸弹。
炸弹.en: The police found a bomb in the square.

炸弹.zh: 电影里炸弹爆炸的场景特别震撼。
炸弹.en: The bomb explosion scene in the movie was especially shocking.

炸弹.zh: 虽然他说是玩笑，但带炸弹上飞机可不行。
炸弹.en: Although he said it was a joke, bringing a bomb onto a plane is not allowed.

炸弹.zh: 他们用炸弹炸开了那扇铁门。
炸弹.en: They blew open that iron door with a bomb.

孤单.en: He lives alone and feels lonely.

孤单.zh: 孤单的时候我就听听音乐。
孤单.en: When I feel lonely, I listen to music.

孤单.zh: 在陌生的城市里，她觉得很孤单。
孤单.en: In an unfamiliar city, she felt very lonely.

孤单.zh: 养只猫吧，这样你就不会那么孤单了。
孤单.en: Get a cat, so you won't feel so lonely.

孤单.zh: 虽然朋友很多，但有时候我还是会感到孤单。
孤单.en: Although I have many friends, sometimes I still feel lonely.

宗教.en: What religion do you believe in?

宗教.zh: 每个人都有自己的宗教自由。
宗教.en: Everyone has their own freedom of religion.

宗教.zh: 这个国家有很多种不同的宗教。
宗教.en: This country has many different religions.

宗教.zh: 宗教仪式通常很庄重，大家都很安静。
宗教.en: Religious ceremonies are usually very solemn, and everyone is quiet.

宗教.zh: 她虽然不信宗教，但很尊重别人的信仰。
宗教.en: Although she doesn't believe in any religion, she respects others' beliefs.

房地产.en: Real estate prices have gone up recently.
He works at a real estate company.

房地产.zh: 投资房地产需要很多钱。
房地产.en: Investing in real estate requires a lot of money.

房地产.zh: 房地产经纪人带我们看了好几套房子。
房地产.en: The real estate agent showed us several houses.

房地产.zh: 虽然房地产很赚钱，但风险也不小。
房地产.en: Although real estate is profitable, the risks are also not small.

持.zh: 他们持枪抢劫了那家银行。
持.en: They robbed that bank while holding guns.

持.zh: 虽然大家都不支持，但他仍然持自己的看法。
持.en: Although no one supports him, he still holds his own opinion.

吼.en: The lion let out a loud roar.
He shouted so much that his voice went hoarse.

吼.zh: 观众对着裁判大吼表示不满。
吼.en: The audience shouted at the referee to express their dissatisfaction.

吼.zh: 老板一吼，所有人都不敢说话了。
吼.en: As soon as the boss yelled, everyone dared not speak.

汁.en: There is a lot of meat juice in the soup.
Squeeze lemon juice onto the fish.
Drinking some tomato juice is good for health.

汁.zh: 做饭的时候别忘了加一点蚝油汁。
汁.en: When cooking, don't forget to add a little oyster sauce juice.

皆.zh: 此地禁止吸烟，违者皆罚。
皆.en: No smoking here; violators will all be fined.

皆.zh: 他们皆来自同一个地方。
皆.en: They all come from the same place.
All who pass the exam will receive a certificate.

皆.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但队员们皆无怨言。
皆.en: Although conditions were tough, none of the team members complained.

善.en: Doing good deeds brings good rewards.

善.zh: 善意的谎言有时候是需要的。
他虽然不善言辞，但是很热心。
善.en: Although he is not good at talking, he is very warm-hearted.

善.zh: 我们要善于发现别人的优点。
善.en: We should be good at discovering others' strengths.

当事人.en: The party concerned is not present.

当事人.zh: 这件事只有当事人最清楚。
当事人.en: Only the person involved knows this matter best.

当事人.zh: 法官让当事人双方各自发言。
当事人.en: The judge let both parties concerned speak.

当事人.zh: 作为当事人，你应该亲自来处理。
当事人.en: As the party concerned, you should handle it in person.

当事人.zh: 虽然你不是当事人，但也可以提供线索。
当事人.en: Although you are not the person involved, you can still provide clues.

开口.zh: 他犹豫了半天才开口说话。
开口.en: He hesitated for a long time before speaking.

开口.zh: 虽然我想帮忙，但不敢开口问。
开口.en: Although I want to help, I don't dare to ask.
This bottle of soda is hard to open.

开口.zh: 她每次见我都先开口打招呼。
开口.en: She greets me first every time she sees me.

恶.en: He is very mean, always bullies others.
Evil is repaid with evil, good with good.
What you're doing is too wicked.

恶.zh: 因为他心里有恶，所以总做坏事。
恶.en: Because he has evil in his heart, he always does bad things.
Don't be so mean, speak nicely.

伴.en: I raised a dog for company.

伴.zh: 因为她是我的伴，所以我信任她。
伴.en: Because she is my companion, I trust her.
During the trip he became my companion.

伴.zh: 一个人太孤单，我想找个伴。
伴.en: Being alone is too lonely, I want to find a companion.
It's fun only when there's a companion to play with.

注定.en: This matter is destined to fail.
We are destined to be together.
He is destined to be a celebrity.

注定.zh: 虽然努力了，但结果早已注定。
注定.en: Although I worked hard, the result was already fated.

注定.zh: 有些事是注定的，强求不来。
注定.en: Some things are fated, cannot be forced.

诉讼.zh: 这家公司面临多起诉讼。

诉讼.en: The litigation process is very long.

诉讼.zh: 她因为合同纠纷提起了诉讼。
诉讼.en: She filed a lawsuit due to a contract dispute.

诉讼.zh: 诉讼费很高，他有点犹豫。
诉讼.en: The lawsuit fees are high, he is a bit hesitant.

惨.zh: 因为他没准备好，所以输得很惨。
惨.en: Because he wasn't prepared, he lost badly.
This movie's ending is very tragic.
Don't cry, it's not that bad.

毒品.en: The harm of taking drugs is great.
Police seized a large amount of drugs.
He was arrested for drug trafficking.

毒品.zh: 毒品会毁掉一个人的一生。
毒品.en: Drugs can ruin a person's life.
Stay away from drugs, cherish life.

联邦.en: The US is a federal country.

联邦.zh: 因为这是联邦的要求，所以我们必须做。
联邦.en: Because this is a federal requirement, we must do it.

联邦.zh: 这个州和联邦法律有冲突。
联邦.en: This state conflicts with federal law.

联邦.zh: 联邦调查局正在调查此案。
联邦.en: The FBI is investigating this case.

联邦.zh: 在联邦制下，各州有自主权。

董事会.en: He was just elected to the board.

董事会.zh: 虽然董事会决定裁员，但员工很反对。
董事会.en: Although the board decided to lay off, employees strongly oppose.

董事会.zh: 董事会对这个方案有分歧。
董事会.en: The board has differences on this plan.

董事会.zh: 董事长主持了董事会会议。
董事会.en: The chairman chaired the board meeting.

堂.en: We have a class in the afternoon.
Let's go to the cafeteria for lunch.

堂.zh: 因为这座教堂有一百多年历史，所以很有名。
堂.en: Because this church has over 100 years of history, it's very famous.

堂.zh: 酒店的礼堂可以办婚礼。
堂.en: The hotel's hall can hold weddings.
Wait for me in the lobby for a moment.

港.en: I went for a walk by the harbor.

港.zh: 这个港的货物吞吐量很大。
港.en: This port has a huge cargo throughput.
He lives on the Hong Kong Island side.

港.zh: 虽然天气不好，但船还是准时到了港。
港.en: Although the weather was bad, the ship still arrived at the port on time.

港.zh: 最近港口的贸易量增加了不少。
港.en: Recently, the trade volume at the port has increased quite a bit.

寻.en: He's looking for a job everywhere.

寻.zh: 她寻了很久才找到那家店。
寻.en: She searched for a long time before finding that shop.

寻.zh: 既然你决定了，就不要再寻别的机会了。
寻.en: Since you've decided, don't look for other opportunities.

寻.zh: 为了寻一个答案，他翻遍了所有资料。
寻.en: To find an answer, he went through all the materials.

作战.en: The soldiers are preparing to fight.

作战.zh: 这场作战计划需要仔细研究。
作战.en: This battle plan needs careful study.

作战.zh: 虽然敌人很强，但我们还是要坚持作战。
作战.en: Although the enemy is strong, we still have to keep fighting.

作战.zh: 在战争中，作战策略往往决定胜负。
作战.en: In war, combat strategy often determines victory or defeat.

豪华.en: He drives a luxury sports car.

豪华.zh: 那个宴会非常豪华，来了很多名人。
豪华.en: That banquet was extremely lavish, with many celebrities attending.

豪华.zh: 虽然房子很豪华，但他觉得住着不舒服。
豪华.en: Although the house is luxurious, he doesn't feel comfortable living in it.

豪华.zh: 她喜欢豪华的东西，但也会考虑性价比。
豪华.en: She likes luxurious things, but she also considers value for money.

改革开放.zh: 改革开放让中国变化很大。
改革开放.en: Reform and opening up has brought great changes to China.

改革开放.zh: 他出生在改革开放之后。
改革开放.en: He was born after the reform and opening up.

改革开放.zh: 改革开放以来，经济快速发展。
改革开放.en: Since the reform and opening up, the economy has developed rapidly.

改革开放.zh: 很多人都受益于改革开放的政策。
改革开放.en: Many people have benefited from the policies of reform and opening up.

改革开放.zh: 没有改革开放，就没有今天的繁荣。
改革开放.en: Without reform and opening up, there would be no prosperity today.

独.en: There is only one old tree here.

独.zh: 她性格很独，不爱跟人交往。
独.en: She has a very solitary personality and doesn't like to socialize.

独.zh: 虽然大家都有意见，但他独持己见。
独.en: Although everyone had opinions, he alone stuck to his own view.

独.zh: 在这个团队里，他的想法独树一帜。
独.en: In this team, his ideas are unique and distinctive.

判决.en: The court has made a judgment.

判决.zh: 他对判决结果不满意，决定上诉。
判决.en: He was unsatisfied with the verdict and decided to appeal.

判决.zh: 经过长时间审理，法官终于宣布了判决。
判决.en: After a long trial, the judge finally announced the verdict.

判决.zh: 判决书下来后，双方都没有异议。
判决.en: After the verdict was issued, neither side had any objections.

被告.en: The defendant is the person in red clothes.

被告.zh: 律师在法庭上为被告辩护。
被告.en: The lawyer defended the defendant in court.

被告.zh: 原告和被告都到了法庭。
被告.en: Both the plaintiff and the defendant arrived at the court.

被告.zh: 虽然证据不足，但被告还是被判有罪。
被告.en: Although the evidence was insufficient, the defendant was still found guilty.

佛.en: This Buddha statue is very tall.
I go to the temple to worship Buddha on weekends.
She has a Buddha statue enshrined at home.
Many people go to the Buddha hall to pray for blessings.

甩.en: He wants to shake off that tag-along.

甩.zh: 因为价格太高，他甩手不买了。
甩.en: Because the price was too high, he backed out and didn't buy it.

甩.zh: 在转弯的时候，他猛地一甩方向盘。
甩.en: He jerked the steering wheel sharply when turning.

基于.en: Only draw conclusions based on facts.

基于.zh: 基于你的建议，我们改了计划。
基于.en: Based on your suggestion, we changed the plan.

基于.zh: 基于当前情况，我觉得应该等等看。
基于.en: Based on the current situation, I think we should wait and see.

基于.zh: 这个决定是基于数据分析的。
基于.en: This decision is based on data analysis.

基于.zh: 基于大家的意见，我们选了这个方案。
基于.en: Based on everyone's opinions, we chose this plan.

乖.en: The baby is very well-behaved today.
Be good and don't cause trouble.

乖.zh: 如果你乖，我就给你买糖。
乖.en: If you behave, I'll buy you candy.

乖.zh: 这只小狗非常乖，从来不叫。
乖.en: This puppy is very well-behaved and never barks.

乖.zh: 她虽然年纪小，但特别乖。
乖.en: Although she is young, she is especially well-behaved.

逮捕.zh: 警方经过调查，终于逮捕了嫌疑人。
逮捕.en: After investigation, the police finally arrested the suspect.

逮捕.zh: 那个罪犯在边境被逮捕。
逮捕.en: That criminal was arrested at the border.

逮捕.zh: 如果没有证据，就不能逮捕他。
逮捕.en: If there is no evidence, he cannot be arrested.

瓦.en: The tile on the roof fell off.

瓦.zh: 这台机器功率是五百瓦。
瓦.en: This machine has a power of 500 watts.
Ancient people used tiles to build houses.

瓦.zh: 因为瓦片质量差，所以房子容易漏雨。
瓦.en: Because the tiles are of poor quality, the house is prone to leaking.

瓦.zh: 灯泡的瓦数太高会烧坏电路。
瓦.en: If the wattage of the bulb is too high, it will damage the circuit.

杀手.zh: 电影里的杀手最后被抓了。
杀手.en: The killer in the movie was eventually caught.

杀手.zh: 警方正在追捕那个职业杀手。
杀手.en: The police are pursuing that professional killer.

杀手.zh: 他是一名退役的雇佣杀手。
如果你得罪他，他会派杀手来找你。
杀手.en: If you offend him, he will send a killer after you.

依.en: In my opinion, this matter is not urgent.

依.zh: 你依他的意思做就行了。
依.en: Just do it according to his wishes.

依.zh: 我们不能凡事都依别人。
依.en: We can't rely on others for everything.
According to the law, he should compensate.

依.zh: 虽然有点难，但我还是依原计划进行。
依.en: Although it's a bit difficult, I still proceed according to the original plan.

轿车.en: He wants to buy a new car.

轿车.zh: 这辆轿车的性能非常好。
因为油价上涨，他改开轿车了。
轿车.en: Because gas prices rose, he switched to driving a sedan.

轿车.zh: 我们开着轿车去郊外野餐。
轿车.en: We drove the car to the countryside for a picnic.

防守.zh: 这场比赛的防守很关键。
防守.en: Defense in this game is crucial.

防守.zh: 因为对方防守太严，所以我们进不了球。
防守.en: Because the opponent's defense is too tight, we can't score.

防守.zh: 在篮球比赛中，防守和进攻同样重要。
防守.en: In basketball, defense and offense are equally important.

防守.zh: 他们需要更好的防守策略。

审判.en: This case will be tried next week.
The court conducted a trial for him.

审判.zh: 法官宣布审判结果时，全场安静。
审判.en: When the judge announced the verdict, the whole room fell silent.

审判.zh: 审判过程必须公开透明。
审判.en: The trial process must be open and transparent.

审判.zh: 虽然审判结束了，但他还是不服。
审判.en: Although the trial is over, he still disagrees.

标.en: This product has no price tag.

标.zh: 他在地图上标了一个点。
标.en: He marked a point on the map.

标.zh: 我们公司今年要拿下这个标。
标.en: Our company wants to win this bid this year.

标.zh: 考试时，请把答案标清楚。
标.en: During the exam, please mark your answers clearly.

标.zh: 虽然标价很高，但他还是买了。
标.en: Although the marked price was high, he still bought it.

发型.en: Your new hairstyle is very pretty.

发型.zh: 我今天换了个发型，但是妈妈不喜欢。
发型.en: I changed my hairstyle today, but Mom doesn't like it.

发型.zh: 因为要面试，所以我特意打理了发型。
发型.en: Because I have an interview, I specially fixed my hairstyle.

发型.zh: 她每次都换不同的发型，真厉害。
发型.en: She changes to a different hairstyle every time, amazing.

折磨.en: Toothache tortured me all night, I couldn't sleep at all.

折磨.zh: 虽然训练很折磨，但坚持下来就有效果。
折磨.en: Although training is torturous, if you persist you'll see results.

慈善.zh: 这家公司捐了很多钱给慈善机构。

慈善.zh: 慈善活动需要大家的支持。
