登陆.zh: 这款新游戏刚登陆中国，很多人都在玩。
登陆.en: This new game just launched in China, and many people are playing it.

灵感.zh: 他写歌的灵感来自生活。
灵感.en: His inspiration for writing songs comes from life.

灵感.zh: 我没有灵感，一个字都写不出来。
灵感.en: I have no inspiration; I can't write a single word.

灵感.zh: 散步的时候她突然来了灵感。
灵感.en: She suddenly got inspiration while taking a walk.

灵感.zh: 画家需要到处旅游才能找到灵感。
灵感.en: Painters need to travel around to find inspiration.

灵感.zh: 他看了那部电影后灵感爆发，连写了好几首诗。
灵感.en: After watching that movie, his inspiration exploded, and he wrote several poems in a row.

假装.zh: 他假装没看见我，直接走过去了。
假装.en: He pretended not to see me and walked right past.

假装.zh: 别假装你很懂，其实你一点都不明白。
假装.en: Don't pretend you know it well; you don't understand at all.

假装.zh: 她假装很开心，其实心里很难过。
假装.en: She pretended to be happy, but was actually very sad inside.

假装.zh: 孩子假装睡着了，等妈妈走了就爬起来玩。
假装.en: The child pretended to be asleep, and got up to play after mom left.

假装.zh: 他假装打电话来避开那个尴尬的场面。
假装.en: He pretended to make a phone call to avoid that awkward situation.

边缘.zh: 他站在悬崖边缘，看起来很危险。
边缘.en: He stood at the edge of the cliff, looking very dangerous.

边缘.zh: 她的生活一直处于贫困边缘。
边缘.en: Her life has been on the edge of poverty.

边缘.zh: 那张桌子边缘有点锋利，小心割手。
边缘.en: The edge of that table is a bit sharp; be careful not to cut your hand.

边缘.zh: 这部手机屏幕边缘有一点裂了。
边缘.en: There's a small crack on the edge of this phone screen.

边缘.zh: 他在社会边缘挣扎了很久，最后终于找到了工作。
边缘.en: He struggled on the edge of society for a long time, and finally found a job.

敬.zh: 我敬你一杯，祝我们合作愉快。
敬.en: I toast to you; wish us a pleasant cooperation.

敬.zh: 他对长辈非常敬，大家都夸他懂礼貌。
敬.en: He is very respectful to elders; everyone praises him for his manners.

敬.zh: 敬礼的时候要站直，不能乱动。
敬.en: When saluting, you must stand straight and not move around.

敬.zh: 他敬了我一根烟，我没好意思拒绝。
敬.en: He offered me a cigarette, and I was too embarrassed to refuse.

敬.zh: 这家店的老板很会敬客人，服务特别好。
敬.en: The boss of this shop knows how to show respect to guests; the service is excellent.

别墅.zh: 他们去年买了一套海边别墅，周末常去住。
别墅.en: They bought a seaside villa last year and often go there on weekends.

别墅.zh: 虽然别墅很大，但他还是觉得不方便。
别墅.en: Although the villa is very big, he still finds it inconvenient.

别墅.zh: 朋友家的别墅装修得特别漂亮。
别墅.en: My friend's villa is decorated very beautifully.

别墅.zh: 我想租一栋别墅办派对，可是价格太高了。
别墅.en: I want to rent a villa for a party, but the price is too high.

高潮.zh: 电影的高潮部分很精彩。
高潮.en: The climax of the movie is very exciting.

高潮.zh: 比赛在最后十分钟达到了高潮。
高潮.en: The game reached its climax in the last ten minutes.

高潮.zh: 这首歌的高潮部分我特别喜欢。
高潮.en: I really like the climax of this song.

高潮.zh: 故事慢慢推进，直到高潮出现。
高潮.en: The story slowly progresses until the climax appears.

高潮.zh: 虽然前面有点无聊，但高潮部分让人印象深刻。
高潮.en: Although the beginning was a bit boring, the climax was impressive.

钻石.zh: 她戴了一颗大钻石戒指。
钻石.en: She wore a big diamond ring.

钻石.zh: 钻石是世界上最硬的物质之一。
钻石.en: Diamond is one of the hardest substances in the world.

钻石.zh: 他把钻石藏在保险柜里。
钻石.en: He hid the diamond in the safe.

钻石.zh: 这块钻石价值连城，很多人都想买。
钻石.en: This diamond is priceless, and many people want to buy it.

钻石.zh: 虽然钻石很漂亮，但她觉得没有必要买。
钻石.en: Although the diamond is very beautiful, she thinks it's unnecessary to buy.

直升机.en: The helicopter is hovering in the air.

直升机.zh: 他们坐直升机去看风景，感觉特别棒。
直升机.en: They took a helicopter to see the scenery, and it felt amazing.

直升机.zh: 救援人员用直升机运送伤员。
直升机.en: Rescuers used a helicopter to transport the injured.

直升机.zh: 我从来没有坐过直升机，有点害怕。
直升机.en: I have never been on a helicopter, and I'm a bit scared.

直升机.zh: 因为交通太堵，他直接叫了一架直升机去机场。
直升机.en: Because the traffic was too heavy, he directly called a helicopter to go to the airport.

有意.zh: 他有意迟到，让大家等他。
有意.en: He intentionally arrived late to make everyone wait for him.

有意.zh: 她有意避开这个话题，不想讨论。
有意.en: She intentionally avoided this topic and didn't want to discuss it.

有意.zh: 如果你有意参加，请提前报名。
有意.en: If you intend to participate, please register in advance.

有意.zh: 他有意开玩笑，没想到大家都当真了。
有意.en: He meant it as a joke, but unexpectedly everyone took it seriously.

磨.en: He is sharpening the knife, preparing to cook.
Coffee beans need to be freshly ground to be aromatic.

磨.zh: 他磨了很久才把石头磨平。
磨.en: He ground for a long time before smoothing the stone.

磨.zh: 虽然磨破了皮，他还是坚持跑完了。
磨.en: Even though he got a friction blister, he still insisted on finishing the run.

统治.zh: 这个王朝统治了将近三百年。
统治.en: This dynasty ruled for nearly three hundred years.

统治.zh: 他在比赛中完全统治了对手。
统治.en: He completely dominated his opponent in the match.

统治.zh: 人民无法忍受他的残酷统治，最终起义了。
统治.en: The people couldn't stand his cruel rule and finally revolted.

统治.zh: 这家公司统治了市场多年，现在遇到了挑战。
统治.en: This company has dominated the market for years, but now faces challenges.

统治.zh: 虽然他的统治结束了，但影响依然存在。
统治.en: Although his rule has ended, the influence still remains.

甜蜜.zh: 回忆起那些甜蜜的时光，她笑了。
甜蜜.en: Recalling those sweet times, she smiled.

甜蜜.zh: 这对情侣在朋友圈里晒甜蜜的合影。
甜蜜.en: This couple posted sweet photos together on social media.

甜蜜.zh: 虽然偶尔吵架，但大部分时间都很甜蜜。
甜蜜.en: Although they occasionally argue, most of the time it's very sweet.

甜蜜.zh: 她做了一顿甜蜜的晚餐，庆祝结婚纪念日。
甜蜜.en: She made a sweet dinner to celebrate their wedding anniversary.

回应.en: He didn't respond to my question.

回应.zh: 请尽快回应对方的邮件。
回应.en: Please respond to the other party's email as soon as possible.

回应.zh: 面对质疑，他做出了明确的回应。
回应.en: Faced with doubts, he gave a clear response.

回应.zh: 我发了好几条消息，她都没有回应。
回应.en: I sent several messages, but she didn't respond at all.

回应.zh: 虽然心里不高兴，但他还是礼貌地回应了。
回应.en: Although he was unhappy inside, he still responded politely.

不可思议.zh: 他做出了不可思议的事情。
她能在一分钟内记住那么多数字，太不可思议了。
不可思议.en: She can memorize so many numbers in one minute, it's incredible.

不可思议.zh: 虽然听起来不可思议，但这是真的。
不可思议.en: Although it sounds unbelievable, it's true.

不可思议.zh: 那个魔术师的表演让人感到不可思议。
不可思议.en: That magician's performance made people feel incredulous.

宁愿.en: I prefer to sleep at home.

宁愿.zh: 她宁愿自己走路也不打车。
宁愿.en: She would rather walk than take a taxi.

宁愿.zh: 他宁愿少吃点也要省钱买书。
宁愿.en: He would rather eat less to save money for books.

宁愿.zh: 如果是我，我宁愿选那个小的。
宁愿.en: If it were me, I would choose the smaller one instead.

宁愿.zh: 虽然很累，但我宁愿加班做完再走。
宁愿.en: Although very tired, I prefer to finish the overtime work before leaving.

联赛.en: The league has started this year.
He goes to every league game.

联赛.zh: 这个球队在联赛里排名第三。
联赛.en: This team ranks third in the league.

联赛.zh: 因为受伤，他错过了整个联赛。
联赛.en: He missed the entire league due to injury.

联赛.zh: 上次联赛他们输了，但这次很有机会赢。
联赛.en: They lost the last league, but this time they have a good chance to win.

拼命.en: Don't push yourself too hard, take a break.

拼命.zh: 为了考试他拼命复习了一个月。
拼命.en: He studied desperately for a month for the exam.

拼命.zh: 虽然很难，但他还是拼命跑到了终点。
拼命.en: Although it was tough, he still ran desperately to the finish line.

拼命.zh: 她拼命地喊，可惜没人听见。
拼命.en: She shouted desperately, but unfortunately no one heard her.

上演.en: A new play is on tonight.
This movie will be released next Friday.

上演.zh: 话剧在市中心剧院上演了一个月。
上演.en: The play ran at the downtown theater for a month.

上演.zh: 听说那场悲剧又要重新上演了。
上演.en: I heard that tragedy is going to be restaged.

上演.zh: 每年春节都有很多好戏在电视上上演。
上演.en: Every Spring Festival, many good shows are broadcast on TV.

骨折.en: The doctor said my arm is fractured.

骨折.zh: 从楼梯上摔下来，结果骨折了。
骨折.en: He fell down the stairs and ended up with a fracture.

骨折.zh: 她骨折后在家养了三个月。
骨折.en: After the fracture, she recovered at home for three months.

骨折.zh: 虽然只是轻微骨折，但也要好好休息。
骨折.en: Although it's just a minor fracture, you still need to rest well.

渣.en: Don't throw away the leftover dregs in the bowl.
Coffee grounds can be used to deodorize.

渣.zh: 他做事总留一堆渣，太不负责任了。
渣.en: He always leaves a mess when doing things, so irresponsible.

渣.zh: 别看他人模人样的，其实就是个渣。
渣.en: Don't be fooled by his decent appearance; he's actually a jerk.

保佑.en: Bless you with a safe journey.

保佑.zh: 菩萨保佑我的家人健康。
保佑.en: May Buddha bless my family with health.

保佑.zh: 考试前她求神保佑她及格。
保佑.en: Before the exam, she prayed to the gods to bless her with passing grades.

保佑.zh: 希望老天保佑，明天别下雨。
保佑.en: Hopefully heaven will bless us and keep it from raining tomorrow.

切除.zh: 医生建议切除这个囊肿。
切除.en: The doctor recommended removing this cyst.

切除.zh: 手术后，他的胆囊被切除了。
切除.en: After the surgery, his gallbladder was removed.

切除.zh: 虽然风险大，但必须切除那一部分。
切除.en: Although risky, that part must be excised.

切除.zh: 她因为癌症切除了一个肾。
切除.en: She had a kidney removed due to cancer.

欺负.zh: 在学校里，他一直被欺负。
欺负.en: He was always bullied at school.

欺负.zh: 你这么大个子欺负小孩，不害臊吗？
欺负.en: A big guy like you bullying a kid, aren't you ashamed?

欺负.zh: 她告诉我不要怕，有人欺负就找老师。
欺负.en: She told me not to be afraid, and to go to the teacher if someone bullies me.

逃避.zh: 他总是用玩游戏来逃避压力。
逃避.en: He always uses playing games to escape stress.

逃避.zh: 遇到困难就逃避，这可不是办法。
逃避.en: Running away when facing difficulties is not a solution.

逃避.zh: 与其逃避责任，不如勇敢面对。
逃避.en: Rather than shirking responsibility, it's better to face it bravely.

级别.zh: 虽然他的级别不高，但工作经验很丰富。
级别.en: Although his level is not high, his work experience is very rich.

级别.zh: 我们公司的工资级别是按能力分的。
级别.en: Our company's salary levels are based on ability.
Your level is one grade higher than mine.

级别.zh: 这次考试难度相当于初级级别。
级别.en: The difficulty of this exam is equivalent to the elementary level.

癌症.zh: 癌症早期发现的话，治愈率很高。
癌症.en: If cancer is detected early, the cure rate is high.
She passed away due to cancer.

癌症.zh: 虽然癌症很可怕，但现代医学进步很快。
癌症.en: Although cancer is scary, modern medicine is advancing quickly.

献.zh: 很多志愿者愿意献出自己的力量。
献.en: Many volunteers are willing to offer their strength.
She offered love to the disaster area.

献.zh: 不仅献了钱，还献了时间。
献.en: Not only donated money, but also donated time.
He dedicated his life to the country.

意志.zh: 没有坚强的意志很难成功。
意志.en: Without strong will, it's hard to succeed.

意志.zh: 虽然很累，但他靠意志坚持下来了。
意志.en: Although very tired, he persevered with willpower.

意志.zh: 这件事考验了大家的意志。

飞船.en: This spaceship will fly to Mars.

飞船.zh: 科学家正在设计新的飞船。
飞船.en: Scientists are designing a new spaceship.

飞船.zh: 如果飞船成功着陆，那将是个奇迹。
飞船.en: If the spaceship lands successfully, that will be a miracle.

飞船.zh: 飞船上的宇航员在太空行走。
飞船.en: The astronauts on the spaceship are spacewalking.

孤儿.zh: 这家孤儿院收留了很多孤儿。
孤儿.en: This orphanage takes in many orphans.
She grew up in an orphanage from childhood.

孤儿.zh: 虽然他是孤儿，但性格很开朗。
孤儿.en: Although he is an orphan, his personality is very cheerful.

孤儿.zh: 很多孤儿需要社会的关爱。
孤儿.en: Many orphans need love from society.

与此同时.zh: 他吃饭，与此同时看电视。
与此同时.en: He eats, and at the same time watches TV.

与此同时.zh: 公司正在发展，与此同时也要注意风险。
与此同时.en: The company is developing, and at the same time we must pay attention to risks.

与此同时.zh: 他在学习，与此同时还在工作。
与此同时.en: He is studying, and at the same time he is also working.

与此同时.zh: 我走路，与此同时听音乐。
与此同时.en: I walk, and at the same time listen to music.

与此同时.zh: 经济在增长，与此同时环境问题也在加剧。
与此同时.en: The economy is growing, and at the same time environmental problems are worsening.

无论如何.en: No matter what, I have to go.

无论如何.zh: 无论如何，我都会支持你。
无论如何.en: No matter what, I will support you.

无论如何.zh: 虽然很困难，但无论如何我们得完成。
无论如何.en: Although very difficult, we have to finish no matter what.
No matter what, you have to try.

正当.en: Just when I went out, it rained.

正当.zh: 正当他准备发言，手机突然响了。
正当.en: Just when he was about to speak, his phone suddenly rang.

正当.zh: 因为正当理由，他请了假。
正当.en: Because of a legitimate reason, he took leave.

正当.zh: 正当她高兴的时候，坏消息来了。
正当.en: Just when she was happy, bad news came.

清除.zh: 电脑需要清除病毒才能正常运行。
清除.en: The computer needs to clear viruses to run normally.

清除.zh: 他们清除了路上的障碍。
清除.en: They cleared the obstacles on the road.

清除.zh: 如果不及时清除，问题会越来越严重。
清除.en: If not cleared in time, the problem will get worse.

清除.zh: 这次行动清除了所有隐患。
清除.en: This operation cleared all hidden dangers.

挣扎.zh: 虽然很累，但她还是拼命挣扎着站起来。
挣扎.en: Although very tired, she still struggled to stand up.

挣扎.zh: 你不要再挣扎了，没用的。
他挣扎了很久，最后还是放弃了。
挣扎.en: He struggled for a long time, and finally gave up.

挣扎.zh: 小鱼在水里挣扎了几下就死了。
挣扎.en: The little fish struggled a few times in the water and then died.

器官.en: The human body has many organs.

器官.zh: 他捐出了自己的器官，救了三条命。
器官.en: He donated his organs and saved three lives.

器官.zh: 因为器官衰竭，他必须马上做手术。
器官.en: Because of organ failure, he must have surgery immediately.

器官.zh: 这起器官移植手术非常成功。
器官.en: This organ transplant surgery was very successful.

器官.zh: 喝酒太多对肝脏这个器官伤害很大。
器官.en: Drinking too much is very harmful to the liver organ.

分裂.zh: 他们因为意见不同，团队最后分裂成了两派。
分裂.en: Because of differing opinions, the team eventually split into two factions.

分裂.zh: 如果大家继续争吵，公司就可能会分裂。
分裂.en: If everyone continues to argue, the company might split.

分裂.zh: 细胞分裂是生物生长的过程。
分裂.en: Cell division is a process of biological growth.

分裂.zh: 她不想看到家庭分裂，所以一直忍让。
分裂.en: She didn't want to see the family split apart, so she kept giving in.

空军.zh: 这次演习，空军派出了最新型的战斗机。
空军.en: In this exercise, the air force deployed the newest fighter jets.

空军.zh: 因为天气不好，空军的飞行计划取消了。
空军.en: Because of bad weather, the air force's flight plan was canceled.
The air force base is very far from the city.

空军.zh: 你见过空军的飞行表演吗？
空军.en: Have you ever seen an air force airshow?

报复.zh: 她被人欺负了，所以想办法报复回去。
报复.en: She was bullied, so she found a way to retaliate.

报复.zh: 如果对方道歉，我就不会报复了。
报复.en: If the other party apologizes, I won't retaliate.

报复.zh: 这种报复行为只会让事情更糟。
报复.en: This kind of retaliatory behavior will only make things worse.

报复.zh: 他用散布谣言的方式来报复前女友。
报复.en: He used spreading rumors as a way to get revenge on his ex-girlfriend.

纤维.en: Eating more fiber is good for health.

纤维.zh: 这种布料是用合成纤维做的，不容易皱。
纤维.en: This fabric is made of synthetic fiber and is not easy to wrinkle.

纤维.zh: 因为缺少膳食纤维，他最近经常便秘。
纤维.en: Because of lack of dietary fiber, he has been constipated often recently.

纤维.zh: 肌肉纤维在运动后需要恢复。
纤维.en: Muscle fibers need to recover after exercise.

纤维.zh: 碳纤维材料非常轻而且坚固。
纤维.en: Carbon fiber material is very light and strong.

护理.zh: 手术后，病人需要精心的护理才能恢复。
护理.en: After surgery, the patient needs careful nursing to recover.

护理.zh: 虽然护理工作很辛苦，但她很喜欢。
护理.en: Although nursing work is very hard, she likes it very much.

护理.zh: 皮肤护理是很多女生的日常功课。
护理.en: Skin care is a daily routine for many girls.

护理.zh: 她在养老院做老人护理。
护理.en: She does elderly care at a nursing home.

采.en: He went to the mountains to gather herbs.

采.zh: 秋天的时候，农民忙着采果子。
采.en: In autumn, farmers are busy picking fruits.

采.zh: 如果你有时间，可以跟我们一起采蘑菇。
采.en: If you have time, you can come with us to pick mushrooms.

采.zh: 这片矿区采了很多年，资源快枯竭了。
采.en: This mining area has been mined for many years, resources are nearly depleted.

采.zh: 她喜欢采野花装点房间。
采.en: She likes picking wild flowers to decorate the room.

提议.zh: 他在会议上提议改变工作时间。
提议.en: He proposed changing the working hours at the meeting.

提议.zh: 因为大家都没有意见，所以他的提议通过了。
提议.en: Since nobody had objections, his proposal was passed.

提议.zh: 这个提议听起来不错，但执行起来很难。
提议.en: This proposal sounds good, but it's difficult to implement.

提议.zh: 她提议周末一起去郊游。
提议.en: She proposed going on a weekend outing together.

保守.zh: 对于新技术，他持比较保守的态度。
保守.en: He holds a relatively conservative attitude towards new technologies.

保守.zh: 虽然保守一点可以避免风险，但也会错失机会。
保守.en: Although being conservative can avoid risks, it also misses opportunities.

保守.zh: 他保守秘密，谁都没有说。
保守.en: He kept the secret and didn't tell anyone.

保守.zh: 这家公司的经营策略一直很保守。
保守.en: This company's business strategy has always been conservative.

当晚.zh: 我们当晚在酒店里聊了很久。
当晚.en: We chatted for a long time in the hotel that evening.

当晚.zh: 当晚的天气不太好，所以我没出门。
当晚.en: The weather that evening wasn't good, so I didn't go out.

当晚.zh: 虽然当晚很累，但我还是坚持完成了工作。
当晚.en: Although I was very tired that evening, I still insisted on finishing the work.
The party that evening was wonderful.

抗议.zh: 居民们对新建工厂表示强烈抗议。
抗议.en: The residents expressed strong protest against the new factory.

抗议.zh: 由于政策不公，很多人走上街头抗议。
抗议.en: Because the policy was unfair, many people took to the streets to protest.
Workers protested that wages were too low.

抗议.zh: 抗议活动持续了整整三天。
抗议.en: The protest lasted three full days.

取决于.zh: 成功与否取决于你的努力程度。
取决于.en: Success depends on how hard you work.

取决于.zh: 明天的出行取决于天气情况。
取决于.en: Tomorrow's outing depends on the weather.

取决于.zh: 价格取决于材料和质量。
取决于.en: The price depends on the material and quality.

取决于.zh: 能不能买到票取决于你什么时候去。
取决于.en: Whether you can buy a ticket depends on when you go.

轮胎.zh: 我昨天去换了一个新轮胎。
轮胎.en: I went to change a new tire yesterday.

轮胎.zh: 因为轮胎破了，我们只好停在路边。
轮胎.en: Because the tire burst, we had to stop by the roadside.
This tire brand is very good.

监管.zh: 食品安全需要严格的监管。
如果没有有效的监管，市场会乱套。
监管.en: Without effective supervision, the market will be chaotic.

监管.zh: 监管机构正在调查此事。
监管.en: The regulatory agency is investigating the matter.

条例.zh: 这项条例主要针对环境污染问题。
条例.en: This regulation mainly targets environmental pollution.

条例.zh: 根据公司条例，员工不能迟到。
条例.en: According to company regulations, employees cannot be late.

条例.zh: 我们需要遵守交通条例。
条例.en: We need to obey traffic regulations.

条例.zh: 这些条例明年开始生效。
条例.en: These regulations take effect next year.

监视.zh: 警方用摄像头监视那个区域。
监视.en: The police use cameras to monitor that area.

监视.zh: 他虽然被监视，但还是找到了机会逃跑。
监视.en: Although he was under surveillance, he still found a chance to escape.

监视.zh: 医院对病人的病情进行实时监视。
监视.en: The hospital monitors the patient's condition in real time.

蜜.zh: 他说话像抹了蜜一样甜。
蜜.en: He speaks as sweet as if coated with honey.

蜜.zh: 蜜蜂采花蜜，然后酿成蜂蜜。
蜜.en: Bees gather nectar from flowers, then make honey.

蜜.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯蜂蜜水。
蜜.en: I drink a glass of honey water every morning.

蜜.zh: 他们的关系现在如胶似蜜。
蜜.en: Their relationship is now like glue and honey — very close.

焦.en: He's been feeling very anxious lately.

焦.zh: 因为比赛快开始了，他越来越焦。
焦.en: Because the game is about to start, he is getting more and more anxious.
Don't stir-fry the vegetables until burnt.

焦.zh: 这件事让他焦得睡不着觉。
焦.en: This matter makes him so anxious he can't sleep.

担保.zh: 你需要找一个担保人才能贷款。
担保.en: You need a guarantor to get a loan.

担保.zh: 如果出了问题，我担保会负责。
担保.en: If something goes wrong, I guarantee to take responsibility.

担保.zh: 他能担保这笔交易安全吗？
担保.en: Can he guarantee the safety of this transaction?

担保.zh: 朋友为我担保，我才租到了房子。
担保.en: My friend guaranteed for me, so I was able to rent the apartment.

麻.zh: 吃了这个药，舌头有点麻。
麻.en: After taking this medicine, my tongue feels a bit numb.

麻.zh: 她今天穿了一件麻的衬衫，挺舒服的。
麻.en: She wore a linen shirt today, it's quite comfortable.

麻.zh: 你脸上长了好多麻子，别用手挤。
麻.en: You have a lot of pimples on your face, don't pick at them.

麻.zh: 因为太辣了，我的嘴唇都麻了，而且胃也不舒服。
麻.en: Because it was too spicy, my lips went numb, and my stomach also feels uncomfortable.

麻.zh: 他做事总是很麻利，从来不拖泥带水。
麻.en: He always works quickly and efficiently, never dragging things out.

候选人.zh: 这次选举有三个候选人。
候选人.en: There are three candidates in this election.

候选人.zh: 那位候选人今天来我们社区演讲了。
候选人.en: That candidate came to our community to give a speech today.

候选人.zh: 作为总统候选人，他需要争取更多年轻选民的支持。
候选人.en: As a presidential candidate, he needs to win more support from young voters.

候选人.zh: 虽然她不是最受欢迎的候选人，但她提出的政策很实在。
候选人.en: Although she is not the most popular candidate, the policies she proposed are very practical.

候选人.zh: 我还没决定投给哪个候选人，因为他们都有优缺点。
候选人.en: I haven't decided which candidate to vote for yet, because they all have strengths and weaknesses.

绑.en: He tied the rope to the tree.

绑.zh: 歹徒把他绑了起来，然后抢走了钱包。
绑.en: The thug tied him up and then stole his wallet.
Your shoelace is loose, tie it tightly quickly.

绑.zh: 她头发太长，打球时得绑起来，不然会影响视线。
绑.en: Her hair is too long; she has to tie it up when playing ball, otherwise it will affect her vision.

绑.zh: 他把受伤的手指用布条简单绑了一下，然后去医院。
绑.en: He simply bandaged his injured finger with a cloth strip and then went to the hospital.

告知.zh: 请提前告知我们你的到达时间。
告知.en: Please inform us of your arrival time in advance.

告知.zh: 他通过邮件告知全体员工会议延期。
告知.en: He informed all employees by email that the meeting was postponed.

告知.zh: 我已经告知过他了，但他还是忘了带文件。
告知.en: I already told him, but he still forgot to bring the documents.

告知.zh: 如果你改变主意，请及时告知我，我好做其他安排。
告知.en: If you change your mind, please let me know in time so I can make other arrangements.

告知.zh: 医生告知患者术后需要休息两周，并且不能剧烈运动。
告知.en: The doctor informed the patient that he needs to rest for two weeks after the surgery and cannot engage in strenuous exercise.

阴谋.zh: 这个阴谋最后被警察发现了。
阴谋.en: This conspiracy was finally discovered by the police.

阴谋.zh: 他总觉得同事在搞阴谋对付他。
阴谋.en: He always feels that his colleagues are plotting against him.

阴谋.zh: 电影里讲述了一个关于政治阴谋的复杂故事。
阴谋.en: The movie tells a complex story about political conspiracy.

阴谋.zh: 如果不是有人提前泄露了消息，他们的阴谋可能就成功了。
阴谋.en: If someone hadn't leaked the information in advance, their conspiracy might have succeeded.

保卫.zh: 我们要保卫自己的家园。
保安在门口保卫着大楼的安全。
保卫.en: The security guard is protecting the safety of the building at the entrance.

保卫.zh: 为了保护环境，我们必须保卫森林和河流。
保卫.en: To protect the environment, we must defend forests and rivers.

保卫.zh: 他志愿参军，就是为了保卫人民的和平生活。
保卫.en: He volunteered to join the army in order to defend the peaceful lives of the people.

无辜.zh: 这场战争伤害了很多无辜的平民。
无辜.en: This war has hurt many innocent civilians.

无辜.zh: 警方后来找到了证据，证明他完全无辜。
无辜.en: The police later found evidence proving that he is completely innocent.

无辜.zh: 别把火发在我身上，我可是无辜的。
无辜.en: Don't take your anger out on me; I am innocent.

无辜.zh: 虽然他被指控偷窃，但我们都相信他是无辜的，只是被冤枉了。
无辜.en: Although he was accused of theft, we all believe he is innocent and was just wrongly accused.

磅.en: This piece of meat weighs two pounds.
Please weigh one pound of apples for me.

磅.zh: 他的体重从一百八十磅降到了一百六十磅。
磅.en: His weight dropped from 180 pounds to 160 pounds.

磅.zh: 这个包裹大概有十磅，寄到国外运费不便宜。
磅.en: This package is about ten pounds; shipping it abroad is not cheap.

磅.zh: 我在超市买了两磅牛肉和一磅虾，准备晚上做火锅。
磅.en: I bought two pounds of beef and one pound of shrimp at the supermarket, preparing to make hot pot tonight.

谎言.en: Everything he said was a lie.

谎言.zh: 你为什么要用谎言欺骗我？
谎言.en: Why did you deceive me with lies?

谎言.zh: 一个谎言往往需要更多谎言去圆。
谎言.en: One lie often requires more lies to cover it up.

谎言.zh: 她终于承认了之前说的那些都是谎言，并向大家道歉。
谎言.en: She finally admitted that everything she said before were lies and apologized to everyone.

谎言.zh: 在面试中不要说谎，因为谎言很容易被拆穿，而且会毁掉你的信誉。
谎言.en: Don't lie in an interview, because lies are easily exposed and can ruin your credibility.

背叛.zh: 他最信任的朋友背叛了他。
背叛.en: His most trusted friend betrayed him.

背叛.zh: 背叛是一种很伤人的行为。
背叛.en: Betrayal is a very hurtful act.

背叛.zh: 她无法原谅丈夫的背叛，决定离婚。
背叛.en: She cannot forgive her husband's betrayal and decided to divorce.

背叛.zh: 在关键时刻，他竟然背叛了团队，投靠了对手。
背叛.en: At a critical moment, he actually betrayed the team and defected to the opponent.

背叛.zh: 如果你背叛了我的信任，那我们之间的友谊也就到此为止了。
背叛.en: If you betray my trust, then our friendship will end here.

声称.en: He claims he never went there.

声称.zh: 公司声称产品完全没问题，但我不太信。
声称.en: The company claims the product is totally fine, but I don't quite believe it.

声称.zh: 她声称自己亲眼看到了整个过程。
声称.en: She claims she saw the whole process with her own eyes.

声称.zh: 别听他声称的话，都是假的。
声称.en: Don't listen to his claims; they're all false.

声称.zh: 政府声称会尽快解决这个问题。
声称.en: The government claims it will solve this problem as soon as possible.

帝国.en: The Roman Empire was once very powerful.

帝国.zh: 这个游戏里你要建立一个帝国。
帝国.en: In this game, you need to build an empire.

帝国.zh: 他梦想着创造一个商业帝国。
帝国.en: He dreams of creating a business empire.

帝国.zh: 那个帝国在历史上只存在了很短的时间。
帝国.en: That empire only existed for a very short time in history.

帝国.zh: 虽然帝国已经灭亡，但文化影响还在。
帝国.en: Although the empire has fallen, its cultural influence remains.

介入.en: Don't get involved in their business.

介入.zh: 警察介入后，情况才稳定下来。
介入.en: Only after the police intervened did the situation stabilize.

介入.zh: 我不想介入你们的争吵，你自己解决吧。
介入.en: I don't want to meddle in your argument; solve it yourself.

介入.zh: 如果矛盾继续升级，公司可能会介入。
介入.en: If the conflict continues to escalate, the company might intervene.

介入.zh: 他主动介入调解，帮助双方达成协议。
介入.en: He took the initiative to intervene and mediate, helping both sides reach an agreement.

片子.zh: 昨天看了一个很好看的片子。
片子.en: Yesterday I watched a very good movie.

片子.zh: 这个片子太长了，我差点睡着。
片子.en: This movie is too long, I almost fell asleep.

片子.zh: 医生让我去拍个片子看看。
片子.en: The doctor told me to go get an X-ray.

片子.zh: 他们正在拍一个新片子，听说很有名。
片子.en: They are shooting a new film; I heard it's very famous.

片子.zh: 你推荐的片子我都看完了。
片子.en: I've finished watching all the movies you recommended.

股份.zh: 他买了这家公司的股份。
股份.en: He bought shares of this company.

股份.zh: 股份价格今天涨了不少。
股份.en: The stock price went up a lot today.

股份.zh: 我们商量一下怎么分配股份。
股份.en: Let's discuss how to distribute the shares.

股份.zh: 他拥有百分之三十的股份，是最大股东。
股份.en: He owns 30% of the shares and is the largest shareholder.

股份.zh: 公司上市后，股份就变得很有价值。
股份.en: After the company went public, the shares became very valuable.

开工.zh: 工厂已经开工了，工人都在忙。
开工.en: The factory has started operations; workers are all busy.

开工.zh: 他们选了个好日子开工。
开工.en: They picked an auspicious day to start work.

开工.zh: 因为资金问题，开工时间推迟了。
开工.en: Due to funding issues, the start of construction has been delayed.

开工.zh: 新学校下个月开工，预计两年后建成。
开工.en: The new school will break ground next month and is expected to be completed in two years.

低调.zh: 明星出席活动时尽量保持低调。
低调.en: Celebrities try to keep a low profile when attending events.

低调.zh: 我喜欢低调的生活，不想引人注意。
低调.en: I like a low-key life and don't want to attract attention.

低调.zh: 他虽然很有钱，但一直很低调。
低调.en: Although he is very rich, he has always been low-key.

低调.zh: 公司这次宣传非常低调，没有大张旗鼓。
低调.en: The company's promotion this time was very low-key, without any fanfare.

光荣.zh: 光荣属于那些努力奋斗的人。
光荣.en: Glory belongs to those who work hard.

光荣.zh: 我们以他为光荣，他是我们的榜样。
光荣.en: We are proud of him; he is our role model.

凶手.en: The killer escaped after committing the crime.

凶手.zh: 凶手是谁？到现在还没查出来。
凶手.en: Who is the murderer? It hasn't been found out yet.

凶手.zh: 那个案子一直没破，凶手还在逍遥法外。
凶手.en: That case has never been solved; the murderer is still at large.

凶手.zh: 法官判了凶手终身监禁。
凶手.en: The judge sentenced the murderer to life imprisonment.

卡车.en: There is a big truck on the road.

卡车.zh: 卡车司机开了整整一夜。
卡车.en: The truck driver drove all night.
They loaded the goods onto the truck.

卡车.zh: 前方发生卡车追尾事故，堵车了。
卡车.en: There was a rear-end collision involving a truck ahead, causing a traffic jam.

卡车.zh: 这辆卡车能拉十吨货，非常实用。
卡车.en: This truck can carry ten tons of cargo; it's very practical.

时装.en: This fashion piece is very beautiful.

时装.zh: 我最近迷上了时装设计。
时装.en: I've recently become obsessed with fashion design.

时装.zh: 她每个季度都会买最新款的时装。
时装.en: She buys the latest fashion every season.

时装.zh: 虽然时装变化很快，但我只挑经典款。
时装.en: Although fashion changes quickly, I only pick classic styles.

时装.zh: 这家店的时装风格很适合年轻人。
时装.en: This store's fashion style is very suitable for young people.

优.en: He got an A on this exam.

优.zh: 这家酒店的服务质量很优，值得推荐。
优.en: The service quality of this hotel is excellent, worth recommending.

优.zh: 我们公司一直追求优的品质。
优.en: Our company always pursues excellent quality.

优.zh: 虽然价格有点高，但产品确实是优。
优.en: Although the price is a bit high, the product is indeed excellent.

优.zh: 他的表现优，大家都很满意。
优.en: His performance was excellent, everyone was very satisfied.

筹.en: We need to raise a sum of money.

筹.zh: 他们正在筹办一场大型音乐会。
筹.en: They are organizing a large concert.
He is in charge of fundraising for this event.

筹.zh: 因为资金不够，所以我们要想办法筹。
筹.en: Because the funds are insufficient, we need to find a way to raise money.
He is holding a handful of chips.

辐射.zh: 太阳的辐射对皮肤有害。
辐射.en: The sun's radiation is harmful to the skin.

辐射.zh: 这座城市的商业辐射力很强。
辐射.en: This city's commercial influence is very strong.

辐射.zh: 虽然辐射看不见，但它会影响健康。
辐射.en: Although radiation is invisible, it can affect health.

辐射.zh: 他们检测了工厂附近的辐射水平。
辐射.en: They tested the radiation levels near the factory.

功.en: This success is due to the team.

功.zh: 他在这次任务中立了大功。
功.en: He made a great contribution in this mission.
Practicing kung fu needs a lot of patience.

功.zh: 虽然很辛苦，但最后还是有功的。
功.en: Although it was hard, in the end there is merit.

趴.en: He lies on the ground reading.

趴.zh: 周末我们去朋友家开趴。
趴.en: On the weekend we go to a friend's house for a party.
The puppy likes to lie on my lap.

趴.zh: 因为太累了，他直接趴床上睡着了。
趴.en: Because he was too tired, he just lay on the bed and fell asleep.

趴.zh: 别趴着写作业，对眼睛不好。
趴.en: Don't lie down while doing homework, it's bad for your eyes.

赌博.zh: 他因为赌博输了很多钱。
赌博.en: He lost a lot of money because of gambling.
Gambling is very harmful to people.

赌博.zh: 虽然他想戒掉赌博，但一直没成功。
赌博.en: Although he wants to quit gambling, he hasn't succeeded.

赌博.zh: 这家网络赌博平台被查封了。
赌博.en: This online gambling platform was shut down.

到位.zh: 准备工作做得非常到位。
到位.en: The preparation work was done very thoroughly.
His performance movements are very precise.

到位.zh: 虽然时间紧，但大家的配合很到位。
到位.en: Although time is tight, everyone's cooperation is very good.

到位.zh: 资金还没到位，项目要推迟。
到位.en: The funds have not yet arrived, the project will be delayed.

涉嫌.zh: 这家公司涉嫌非法集资。
涉嫌.en: This company is suspected of illegal fundraising.

涉嫌.zh: 多名官员涉嫌贪污被调查。
涉嫌.en: Multiple officials are under investigation for suspected corruption.

涉嫌.zh: 她涉嫌参与了一起诈骗案。
涉嫌.en: She is suspected of participating in a fraud case.

股东.en: He is the major shareholder of the company.

股东.zh: 股东大会将在下周召开。
股东.en: The shareholders' meeting will be held next week.

股东.zh: 股东们对分红方案不满意。
股东.en: The shareholders are not satisfied with the dividend plan.

股东.zh: 因为公司亏损，股东们都很着急。
股东.en: Because the company is losing money, the shareholders are very anxious.

股东.zh: 他通过收购股份成为了股东。
股东.en: He became a shareholder by acquiring shares.

残酷.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但这就是残酷的事实。
残酷.en: Although we lost the game, this is the cruel truth.

残酷.zh: 残酷的战争让很多人失去了家。
残酷.en: The cruel war made many people lose their homes.

残酷.zh: 在竞争中，残酷的淘汰是不可避免的。
残酷.en: In competition, cruel elimination is inevitable.

治愈.zh: 这部电影很治愈，看完心情好多了。
治愈.en: This movie is very healing; I felt much better after watching it.

治愈.zh: 她养了一只猫，觉得很治愈。
治愈.en: She keeps a cat and finds it very therapeutic.

治愈.zh: 医生的任务就是治愈病人。
治愈.en: A doctor's job is to cure patients.

戳.en: Don't poke me with a pen.

戳.zh: 他生气地戳了一下桌子。
他戳了戳我的背，提醒我该走了。
戳.en: He poked my back to remind me it's time to go.

曝光.zh: 这个丑闻被媒体曝光了。
曝光.en: This scandal was exposed by the media.

曝光.zh: 在阳光下曝光太久对皮肤不好。
曝光.en: Exposing your skin to sunlight for too long is bad for your skin.
The camera exposure time needs to be adjusted properly.

浑身.en: He was so scared that his whole body trembled.
So tired that my whole body aches.
Got caught in the rain, my whole body is soaked.
She was so excited that her whole body felt hot.

宪法.zh: 宪法是国家的根本大法。
宪法.en: The constitution is the fundamental law of the country.

宪法.zh: 每个公民都应该遵守宪法和法律。
宪法.en: Every citizen should abide by the constitution and laws.

宪法.zh: 修改宪法需要严格的程序。
宪法.en: Amending the constitution requires strict procedures.

宪法.zh: 他们讨论宪法的修改问题。
宪法.en: They discussed the issue of amending the constitution.

尽情.en: Have fun to your heart's content tonight.

尽情.zh: 在派对上，大家可以尽情跳舞。
尽情.en: At the party, everyone can dance as much as they like.
Enjoy the food to your heart's content.

尽情.zh: 放假了，我要尽情睡懒觉。
尽情.en: It's a holiday, I'm going to sleep in as much as I want.

尽情.zh: 他们尽情欢笑，忘记了烦恼。
尽情.en: They laughed heartily, forgetting their worries.

防御.en: The team's defensive ability is very strong.
We need to be well-prepared for defense.

防御.zh: 面对攻击，他们采取了防御措施。
防御.en: Facing the attack, they took defensive measures.

防御.zh: 这堵墙是用来防御敌人的。
防御.en: This wall is used to defend against enemies.

赛车.zh: 赛车比赛非常刺激，很多人爱看。
赛车.en: Car races are very exciting; many people love to watch.
He is a race car driver.

赛车.zh: 这辆赛车速度很快，但很难操控。
赛车.en: This race car is very fast but hard to control.

人格.zh: 他的人格魅力吸引了很多朋友。
人格.en: His personal charm attracted many friends.

人格.zh: 侮辱别人的人格是不对的。
在困难中，他展现了坚强的人格。
人格.en: In difficulties, he showed a strong character.

腐败.zh: 因为腐败问题，很多官员被调查了。
腐败.en: Because of corruption, many officials have been investigated.

腐败.zh: 这个公司的腐败行为让顾客很失望。
腐败.en: This company's corrupt behavior disappoints customers.

腐败.zh: 如果政府不打击腐败，经济就会出问题。
腐败.en: If the government doesn't fight corruption, the economy will have problems.

杀害.zh: 那个凶手残忍地杀害了无辜的人。
杀害.en: That murderer cruelly killed innocent people.

杀害.zh: 虽然他是无意，但还是杀害了小动物。
杀害.en: Although he didn't mean to, he still killed a small animal.

杀害.zh: 警察正在调查这起杀害案件。
杀害.en: The police are investigating this murder case.

忠诚.en: He is very loyal to the country.

忠诚.zh: 因为忠诚，他得到了老板的信任。
忠诚.en: Because of his loyalty, he gained his boss's trust.

忠诚.zh: 这只狗对主人非常忠诚。
忠诚.en: This dog is very loyal to its owner.

忠诚.zh: 无论发生什么，他都保持对朋友的忠诚。
忠诚.en: No matter what happens, he remains loyal to his friends.
Loyalty is the foundation of friendship.

发作.en: His old illness flared up again.

发作.zh: 她一听到这个消息，脾气就发作了。
发作.en: As soon as she heard the news, her temper flared up.

发作.zh: 我的胃病最近经常发作。
发作.en: My stomach illness often flares up recently.

发作.zh: 如果情绪不好，哮喘容易发作。
发作.en: If your emotions are bad, asthma can easily flare up.
Don't let him have an attack.

震撼.en: The earthquake shook the whole city.

震撼.zh: 他的演讲震撼了所有人。
这幅画的美震撼了我的心灵。
震撼.en: The beauty of this painting shook my soul.

震撼.zh: 因为震撼太强，他一直没说话。
震撼.en: Because the shock was too strong, he remained silent.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于天气不好，我们取消了计划。
鉴于.en: In view of the bad weather, we canceled the plan.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于他的表现，公司给他加薪。
鉴于.en: Considering his performance, the company gave him a raise.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于大家都同意，我们就这么决定了。
鉴于.en: Given that everyone agrees, we have decided this way.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于情况紧急，他立刻出发了。
鉴于.en: In view of the emergency, he set off immediately.
Considering you were late, salary will be deducted.

局势.zh: 因为局势不稳，很多人选择离开这里。
局势.en: Because the situation is unstable, many people choose to leave.

局势.zh: 政府努力控制局势，避免发生冲突。
局势.en: The government is trying to control the situation to avoid conflict.

隧道.zh: 开车经过隧道的时候要小心。
隧道.en: Be careful when driving through the tunnel.
The light in the tunnel is dim.

隧道.zh: 工人们正在修建一条新的海底隧道。
隧道.en: Workers are building a new undersea tunnel.

隧道.zh: 隧道出口有警察，所以很安全。
隧道.en: There are police at the tunnel exit, so it's very safe.

债.en: He still owes a lot of debt.

债.zh: 为了还债，他每天打好几份工。
债.en: To pay off debt, he works several jobs every day.
When will this debt be repaid?

债.zh: 如果你借钱不还，就会欠下人情债。
债.en: If you borrow money and don't repay, you'll owe a favor debt.
The debt is growing bigger and bigger.

尚未.zh: 我尚未决定要不要去旅行。
尚未.en: I have not yet decided whether to travel.
She has not yet finished her homework.

尚未.zh: 虽然通知发了，但尚未得到回复。
尚未.en: Although the notice was sent, no reply has been received yet.
The answer has not yet been announced.

指数.en: The stock market index went up today.

指数.zh: 这个城市的空气污染指数很高。
指数.en: This city's air pollution index is very high.

指数.zh: 最近物价指数一直在上升，生活成本变高了。
指数.en: The price index has been rising recently, making the cost of living higher.

指数.zh: 你知道今年的幸福指数排名吗？
指数.en: Do you know this year's happiness index ranking?

指数.zh: 因为空气质量差，今天的紫外线指数特别高。
指数.en: Because the air quality is poor, today's UV index is especially high.

提名.en: He was nominated for Best Actor.

提名.zh: 这部电影获得了五项提名。
她因为出色的表现被提名年度员工。
提名.en: She was nominated for Employee of the Year because of her outstanding performance.

提名.zh: 今年的奥斯卡提名名单已经公布了。
提名.en: This year's Oscar nomination list has been announced.

提名.zh: 虽然被提名了，但他觉得自己赢不了。
提名.en: Although he was nominated, he doesn't think he can win.

耐.zh: 他这个人很耐得住寂寞。
耐.en: He is a person who can withstand loneliness.

耐.zh: 这种手机电池很耐用，一天都不用充电。
耐.en: This type of phone battery is very durable; you don't need to charge it all day.

耐.zh: 虽然工作很累，但他很耐压，从不抱怨。
耐.en: Although the work is tiring, he handles pressure well and never complains.

鹰.en: An eagle is flying in the sky.
An eagle's eyes are very sharp.

鹰.zh: 他养了一只鹰，天天带它出去飞。
鹰.en: He keeps an eagle and takes it out to fly every day.

鹰.zh: 那个标志上画着一只展翅的鹰。
鹰.en: That logo has an eagle with spread wings.

鹰.zh: 虽然鹰是猛禽，但也可以被训练。
鹰.en: Although eagles are birds of prey, they can still be trained.

流氓.en: Don't pay attention to that hoodlum.

流氓.zh: 大街上遇到流氓，一定要报警。
流氓.en: If you encounter a hooligan on the street, be sure to call the police.

流氓.zh: 这个软件有流氓行为，总弹广告。
流氓.en: This software has rogue behavior; it always pops up ads.

流氓.zh: 虽然他看起来像流氓，但其实人很好。
流氓.en: Although he looks like a ruffian, he is actually a nice person.

影像.zh: 他的影像还留在我的记忆里。
影像.en: His image still remains in my memory.

影像.zh: 医生看了CT影像后说没有问题。
影像.en: After looking at the CT images, the doctor said there was no problem.

影像.zh: 这部电影的影像效果非常震撼。
影像.en: The visual effects of this movie are very stunning.

影像.zh: 因为影像模糊，我认不出那个人是谁。
影像.en: Because the image was blurry, I couldn't recognize who that person was.

略.zh: 他略加思考就回答了问题。
略.en: He answered the question after a brief thought.

略.zh: 你只需要略看一下这个报告就行。
略.en: You just need to glance over this report.

略.zh: 因为时间不够，我们只能略谈一下重点。
略.en: Because we're short on time, we can only briefly discuss the main points.

竞选.en: The election campaign starts next month.

竞选.zh: 他在竞选演讲中承诺减税。
竞选.en: He promised tax cuts in his campaign speech.

竞选.zh: 为了竞选成功，他到处拉票。
竞选.en: To win the election, he is canvassing everywhere.

竞选.zh: 虽然竞选很激烈，但他依然有信心。
竞选.en: Although the election race is fierce, he still has confidence.

理智.zh: 在那种情况下，很难保持理智。
理智.en: In that situation, it's hard to stay rational.

理智.zh: 虽然很生气，但他还是理智地处理了问题。
理智.en: Although he was very angry, he still handled the problem rationally.

理智.zh: 理智一点，别冲动做决定。
理智.en: Be rational, don't make a decision impulsively.

风暴.zh: 风暴过后，到处一片狼藉。
风暴.en: After the storm, everything was in a mess.

风暴.zh: 因为风暴预警，学校停课一天。
风暴.en: Because of the storm warning, school was closed for a day.

风暴.zh: 他们被困在风暴里，等了很久才获救。
风暴.en: They were trapped in the storm and waited a long time before being rescued.

扁.en: This tire is flat; we need to change it.

扁.zh: 他用锤子把铁皮敲扁了。
扁.en: He hammered the iron sheet flat.

扁.zh: 那个盒子被压得扁扁的。
扁.en: That box was squashed completely flat.

扁.zh: 虽然我鼻子有点扁，但我觉得没什么。
扁.en: Although my nose is a bit flat, I don't think it's a big deal.

扁.zh: 你把它捏扁了就没法用了。
扁.en: If you squeeze it flat, it won't be usable anymore.

撤.en: Quickly clear the things off the table.

撤.zh: 他们决定从那个地区撤兵。
撤.en: They decided to withdraw troops from that area.

撤.zh: 会议取消了，通知已经撤回了。
撤.en: The meeting was canceled, and the notice has been withdrawn.

撤.zh: 这个项目因为资金问题被撤了。
撤.en: This project was canceled due to funding issues.

撤.zh: 如果没人报名，我们只能撤掉这个活动。
撤.en: If no one signs up, we'll have to cancel this event.

着手.zh: 我们得着手准备明天的会议。
着手.en: We need to start preparing for tomorrow's meeting.

着手.zh: 他打算下周着手写论文。
着手.en: He plans to start writing his thesis next week.

着手.zh: 既然计划定了，就赶紧着手吧。
着手.en: Since the plan is set, let's get started right away.

着手.zh: 公司决定从下月开始着手改革。
着手.en: The company decided to begin reforms starting next month.

着手.zh: 等资料到齐了，我们再着手处理这个问题。
着手.en: Once all the materials arrive, we'll start dealing with this issue.

指望.en: Don't count on him arriving on time.

指望.zh: 我指望这次考试能通过。
指望.en: I'm hoping to pass this exam.

指望.zh: 他总指望别人帮忙，自己不努力。
指望.en: He always relies on others for help instead of working hard himself.

指望.zh: 这家店生意不好，全指望周末多卖点。
指望.en: This shop's business is bad; it's all counting on selling more on weekends.

指望.zh: 你指望天气变好，不如自己带把伞。
指望.en: Rather than hoping for good weather, you'd better bring an umbrella yourself.

搭档.zh: 我们俩搭档做这个项目很默契。
搭档.en: The two of us work very well together on this project.

搭档.zh: 你想找个什么样的搭档？
搭档.en: What kind of partner are you looking for?

搭档.zh: 虽然他是新来的，但和他搭档还挺愉快。
搭档.en: Although he is new, partnering with him has been quite pleasant.

搭档.zh: 这次比赛，我的搭档临时有事来不了。
搭档.en: For this competition, my partner can't make it because of something urgent.

使命.zh: 完成这个使命是我的责任。
使命.en: Completing this mission is my responsibility.

使命.zh: 这家公司的使命是服务社区。
使命.en: This company's mission is to serve the community.

使命.zh: 他带着使命去偏远地区支教。
使命.en: He went to teach in remote areas with a sense of mission.

使命.zh: 作为医生，救死扶伤是我们的使命。
使命.en: As doctors, saving lives and healing the wounded is our mission.

使命.zh: 他们觉得保护环境是每个人共同的使命。
使命.en: They believe protecting the environment is a shared mission for everyone.

议会.en: The parliament passed the new bill.

议会.zh: 议员们在议会里激烈争论。
议会.en: The members debated fiercely in parliament.

议会.zh: 明天的议会会议将讨论预算问题。
议会.en: Tomorrow's parliamentary session will discuss the budget.

议会.zh: 这个决定必须经过议会批准才能生效。
议会.en: This decision must be approved by parliament before it takes effect.

议会.zh: 因为议会意见不统一，改革推迟了。
议会.en: Because the parliament couldn't reach a consensus, the reform was delayed.

残忍.en: What he did was too cruel.
Don't be so cruel to animals.

残忍.zh: 这个故事里有很多残忍的情节。
残忍.en: This story has many cruel plots.

残忍.zh: 他残忍地拒绝了她的请求，一点同情心都没有。
残忍.en: He cruelly rejected her request without any sympathy.

残忍.zh: 虽然现实很残忍，但我们还是要勇敢面对。
残忍.en: Although reality is cruel, we still have to face it bravely.

倒霉.zh: 他出门就下雨，太倒霉了。
倒霉.en: It rained as soon as he left home; that's so unlucky.

倒霉.zh: 丢了钱包又赶上堵车，真是倒霉透顶。
倒霉.en: Lost my wallet and hit traffic jam—it's the worst luck.

倒霉.zh: 别总觉得自己倒霉，心态放好一点。
倒霉.en: Don't always think you're unlucky; have a better attitude.

倒霉.zh: 他最近特别倒霉，工作丢了还生了病。
倒霉.en: He's been especially unlucky lately—lost his job and got sick.

傻瓜.zh: 别把自己当傻瓜，其实你挺聪明的。
傻瓜.en: Don't think of yourself as a fool; you're actually quite smart.

傻瓜.zh: 只有傻瓜才会相信这种话。
傻瓜.en: Only a fool would believe that kind of talk.

傻瓜.zh: 他有时候像个傻瓜，但关键时刻很靠谱。
傻瓜.en: Sometimes he acts like a fool, but he's reliable in critical moments.

傻瓜.zh: 别做傻瓜了，这么明显的骗局你都看不出来？
傻瓜.en: Don't be a fool—can't you see such an obvious scam?

追踪.en: The police are tracking the thief.

追踪.zh: 我用手机追踪快递，看它到哪儿了。
追踪.en: I track the delivery on my phone to see where it is.

追踪.zh: 因为丢了钱包，我急忙用定位追踪它的下落。
追踪.en: Because I lost my wallet, I quickly used GPS to track its location.

追踪.zh: 别想追踪我，我早就跑了。
追踪.en: Don't try to track me, I've already run away.

追踪.zh: 猎犬追踪了猎物一整夜，最后终于找到了。
追踪.en: The hound tracked the prey all night and finally found it.

保密.en: This matter must be kept secret.

保密.zh: 公司要求我们保密这次的新产品设计。
保密.en: The company requires us to keep the new product design confidential.

保密.zh: 医生有义务对病人的信息保密。
保密.en: Doctors are obligated to keep patient information confidential.

保密.zh: 这件事你一定要保密，千万别告诉别人。
保密.en: You must keep this a secret, don't tell anyone.

保密.zh: 如果我们不保密，计划就会失败。
保密.en: If we don't keep it secret, the plan will fail.

致命.zh: 如果处理不好，这个错误可能是致命的。
致命.en: If not handled properly, this mistake could be fatal.

致命.zh: 他被刺中了致命部位，当场死亡。
致命.en: He was stabbed in a fatal area and died on the spot.

致命.zh: 车祸虽然不严重，但差点造成致命伤。
致命.en: Although the car accident wasn't serious, it almost caused fatal injuries.

致命.zh: 这种疾病的致命率很高，要小心预防。
致命.en: This disease has a high fatality rate, so be careful to prevent it.

反抗.en: He doesn't dare to resist anymore.

反抗.zh: 面对不公，很多人选择勇敢反抗。
反抗.en: Facing injustice, many people choose to resist bravely.

反抗.zh: 尽管被压迫，他们还是坚决反抗。
反抗.en: Despite being oppressed, they still resolutely resist.

反抗.zh: 孩子到了青春期就容易反抗父母。
反抗.en: Children tend to rebel against their parents when they reach puberty.

反抗.zh: 如果政府做得太过分，人民会起来反抗。
反抗.en: If the government goes too far, the people will rise up in resistance.

赞助.zh: 很多公司愿意赞助体育比赛来提高知名度。
赞助.en: Many companies are willing to sponsor sports events to increase their visibility.

赞助.zh: 我们要找赞助商，不然办不了活动。
赞助.en: We need to find a sponsor, otherwise we can't hold the event.

赞助.zh: 他赞助了一个贫困学生上学。
赞助.en: He sponsored a poor student to go to school.

赞助.zh: 如果你愿意赞助我们的项目，我们会很感激。
赞助.en: If you are willing to sponsor our project, we would be very grateful.

资助.zh: 这个基金会资助了很多科研项目。
资助.en: This foundation has funded many research projects.

资助.zh: 如果没有资助，我可能就辍学了。
资助.en: Without financial support, I might have dropped out of school.

资助.zh: 他们用资助的钱买了新设备。
资助.en: They used the grant money to buy new equipment.

资助.zh: 公司愿意资助这个项目，但要求回报。
资助.en: The company is willing to fund this project, but asks for returns.

难怪.zh: 他天天熬夜，难怪精神不好。
难怪.en: He stays up late every day, no wonder he's not in good spirits.

难怪.zh: 原来你生病了，难怪脸色这么差。
难怪.en: So you're sick, no wonder your complexion is so bad.

难怪.zh: 这道菜这么辣，难怪你吃不了。
难怪.en: This dish is so spicy, no wonder you can't eat it.

难怪.zh: 他平时不复习，难怪考试不及格。
难怪.en: He doesn't usually review, no wonder he failed the exam.

包围.zh: 敌人从四面八方包围了我们。
包围.en: The enemy surrounded us from all sides.

包围.zh: 她被粉丝们包围得走不了路。
包围.en: She was so surrounded by fans that she couldn't move.

包围.zh: 整个城市被浓雾包围，什么都看不见。
包围.en: The whole city was surrounded by thick fog, and nothing could be seen.

包围.zh: 我们被问题包围，需要一一解决。
包围.en: We are surrounded by problems and need to solve them one by one.

玉.en: This piece of jade is very valuable.

玉.zh: 她戴了一个玉手镯，看起来很漂亮。
玉.en: She is wearing a jade bracelet, and it looks very beautiful.
Ancient people believed that jade could ward off evil.

玉.zh: 这个玉雕的工艺非常精细，价格不菲。
玉.en: The craftsmanship of this jade carving is very fine, and the price is high.

玉.zh: 他送给我一块玉，作为生日礼物。
玉.en: He gave me a piece of jade as a birthday gift.

隔离.en: The patient needs to be isolated.

隔离.zh: 因为疫情，很多城市实行了隔离措施。
隔离.en: Because of the pandemic, many cities implemented quarantine measures.

隔离.zh: 他们被隔离在岛上，无法与外界联系。
隔离.en: They were isolated on the island, unable to contact the outside world.

隔离.zh: 如果你从国外回来，需要自我隔离十四天。
隔离.en: If you come back from abroad, you need to self-isolate for fourteen days.

隔离.zh: 为了安全，我们把有症状的人隔离起来了。
隔离.en: For safety, we have isolated the symptomatic people.

人性.zh: 人性很复杂，不能简单看表面。
人性.en: Human nature is very complex; you can't just look at the surface.

人性.zh: 这部电影探讨了人性中的善与恶。
人性.en: This movie explores the good and evil in human nature.

人性.zh: 他总说人性本善，但我有点怀疑。
人性.en: He always says human nature is inherently good, but I'm a bit skeptical.

人性.zh: 在灾难面前，人性的弱点会暴露出来。
人性.en: In the face of disaster, the weaknesses of human nature are exposed.

人性.zh: 我觉得人性既有光明也有黑暗的一面。
人性.en: I think human nature has both a bright side and a dark side.

人选.zh: 这个职位的人选还没定下来。
人选.en: The candidate for this position hasn't been decided yet.

人选.zh: 她是最合适的人选，大家都很支持。
人选.en: She is the most suitable candidate, and everyone supports her.

人选.zh: 我们需要尽快确定新经理的人选。
人选.en: We need to confirm the candidate for the new manager as soon as possible.

人选.zh: 这次比赛的人选是从全校选拔出来的。
人选.en: The candidates for this competition were selected from the whole school.

人选.zh: 如果找不到合适的人选，我们可能会推迟项目。
人选.en: If we can't find a suitable candidate, we might postpone the project.

美妙.en: The melody of this song is really wonderful.

美妙.zh: 我们度过了一个美妙的夜晚。
美妙.en: We spent a wonderful evening together.

美妙.zh: 清晨的鸟叫声听起来很美妙。
美妙.en: The sound of birds in the early morning sounds wonderful.

美妙.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但结果很美妙。
美妙.en: Although the process was tough, the result was wonderful.

美妙.zh: 她弹奏的钢琴曲带给我一种美妙的感觉。
美妙.en: The piano piece she played gave me a wonderful feeling.

作风.en: His work style is very rigorous.

作风.zh: 领导必须改变官僚作风。
作风.en: Leaders must change their bureaucratic style.

作风.zh: 她作风正派，大家都很信任她。
作风.en: She is upright in her style, and everyone trusts her.

作风.zh: 这家公司的管理作风太保守了。
作风.en: This company's management style is too conservative.

作风.zh: 如果作风不务实，团队很难取得好成绩。
作风.en: If the style is not pragmatic, it's hard for the team to achieve good results.

出血.zh: 他手指破了，一直在出血。
出血.en: He cut his finger and it's been bleeding.

出血.zh: 这次手术出血不多，很顺利。
出血.en: There wasn't much bleeding during the surgery; it went smoothly.

出血.zh: 你鼻子出血了，快把头仰起来。
出血.en: Your nose is bleeding; tilt your head back quickly.

出血.zh: 为了办这场婚礼，他真是大出血了。
出血.en: He really bled money for this wedding.

出血.zh: 如果内部出血不止，必须马上送医院。
出血.en: If internal bleeding doesn't stop, we must send him to the hospital immediately.

情侣.en: That couple is walking in the park.
Valentine's Day is full of couples everywhere.

情侣.zh: 他们是最让人羡慕的一对情侣。
情侣.en: They are the most enviable couple.

情侣.zh: 这家餐厅很适合情侣约会。
情侣.en: This restaurant is very suitable for a couple's date.

情侣.zh: 虽然吵过架，但他们还是甜蜜的情侣。
情侣.en: Although they had a fight, they are still a sweet couple.

本事.zh: 他真有本事，什么都会修。
本事.en: He is really capable; he can fix anything.
If you don't have the ability, don't brag.

本事.zh: 她的本事是能让大家都开心。
本事.en: Her skill is being able to make everyone happy.

本事.zh: 靠自己的本事赚钱，心里才踏实。
本事.en: Only by earning money with your own ability can you feel at ease.

本事.zh: 如果你想成功，就得培养真本事。
本事.en: If you want to succeed, you need to cultivate real skills.

纯粹.zh: 他的动机很纯粹，就是想帮忙。
纯粹.en: His motive is very pure; he just wants to help.

纯粹.zh: 这纯粹是个误会，你别多想。
纯粹.en: This is purely a misunderstanding; don't overthink it.

纯粹.zh: 我喜欢这种纯粹的友谊，不掺杂利益。
纯粹.en: I like this kind of pure friendship, without any interests mixed in.

纯粹.zh: 她笑起来的样子很纯粹，像个孩子。
纯粹.en: The way she smiles is very pure, like a child.

纯粹.zh: 这不是故意刁难，纯粹是规则要求。
纯粹.en: This isn't intentional trouble-making; it's purely a requirement of the rules.

缠.zh: 绳子缠在一起了，解不开。
缠.en: The ropes are tangled and can't be undone.

缠.zh: 他整天缠着我要买新手机。
缠.en: He keeps pestering me all day to buy a new phone.

缠.zh: 这个问题缠了我好几天，终于解决了。
缠.en: This problem has been bothering me for days, and finally it's solved.

缠.zh: 伤口用绷带缠了几圈，防止感染。
缠.en: The wound was wrapped with a bandage a few times to prevent infection.

废.zh: 这个手机已经废了，不能用了。
废.en: This phone is broken; it can't be used anymore.

废.zh: 他废了好大劲才把门打开。
废.en: He put in a lot of effort to open the door.

废.zh: 这张旧桌子废了，不如扔掉。
废.en: This old table is ruined; might as well throw it away.

废.zh: 如果再不锻炼，你的身体就废了。
废.en: If you don't exercise anymore, your body will be ruined.

潮.en: This piece of clothing is trendy.
The tide at the seaside rises quickly.

潮.zh: 她穿得很潮，大家都看她。
潮.en: She dresses very fashionably, and everyone looks at her.

潮.zh: 今天天气太潮了，感觉不舒服。
潮.en: The weather is too humid today, it feels uncomfortable.

英镑.en: The pound sterling's exchange rate is very high right now.
He paid fifty pounds in cash.

英镑.zh: 这张机票花了我三百英镑。
英镑.en: This plane ticket cost me three hundred pounds.

英镑.zh: 英镑和人民币的汇率一直在变。
英镑.en: The exchange rate between the pound and the renminbi keeps changing.

押.en: He pawned his watch to borrow money.
You have to pay a deposit when renting a house.
The police took him away under escort.

押.zh: 他把房子押给银行换了贷款。
押.en: He mortgaged the house to the bank to get a loan.

服务器.zh: 公司租了一台新服务器。
服务器.en: The company rented a new server.

服务器.zh: 这个网站服务器不稳定。
我们的数据都存在服务器上。
服务器.en: All our data is stored on the server.

服务器.zh: 服务器需要定期维护才能正常运行。
服务器.en: The server needs regular maintenance to run properly.

困境.en: The company has fallen into a difficult situation.
He is in a serious financial predicament now.
I helped him get out of the difficult situation.

困境.zh: 失业让他陷入了生活困境。
困境.en: Unemployment plunged him into a difficult living situation.

困境.zh: 面对困境，他选择了坚持。
困境.en: Facing the predicament, he chose to persevere.

短暂.en: He made a brief stop in Beijing.

短暂.zh: 他们有一段短暂的恋情。
虽然生命短暂，但要活得精彩。
短暂.en: Although life is short, we should live it splendidly.

评审.en: The experts are conducting the review.
This plan needs to be reviewed.

评审.zh: 我是这次比赛的评审之一。
评审.en: I am one of the judges for this competition.

评审.zh: 评审过程非常严格，大家都紧张。
评审.en: The review process was very strict, everyone was nervous.

鹿.en: There are deer in the park.
The children are feeding the deer.
I saw a herd of deer on the mountain.

鹿.zh: 不要指鹿为马，要实事求是。
鹿.en: Don't call a deer a horse; be practical and realistic.

数据库.en: We need to establish a database.

数据库.zh: 程序员在维护公司数据库。
数据库.en: The programmer is maintaining the company's database.

数据库.zh: 数据库出了问题，所有记录都丢失了。
数据库.en: Something went wrong with the database, and all records were lost.

担.zh: 这件事由我来承担后果。
担.en: I will bear the consequences of this matter.

担.zh: 他担着一桶水走了很远。
担.en: He carried a bucket of water a long way.

出手.zh: 这件衣服我打算出手了。
出手.en: I plan to sell this piece of clothing.

出手.zh: 他出手太快了，我根本没看清。
出手.en: His move was too fast, I didn't see it at all.

出手.zh: 他打算把股票出手，然后去旅游。
出手.en: He plans to sell the stocks and then go traveling.

出手.zh: 这次比赛他第一次出手就赢了。
出手.en: In this competition, he won on his first move.

保姆.zh: 保姆每天下午来接孩子。
保姆.en: The nanny picks up the child every afternoon.

保姆.zh: 她找了一个很靠谱的保姆，所以很放心。
保姆.en: She found a reliable nanny, so she feels at ease.

保姆.zh: 现在的保姆工资比以前高了不少。
保姆.en: Nowadays nanny salaries are much higher than before.

保姆.zh: 保姆不在家的时候，我自己做饭。
保姆.en: When the nanny is not home, I cook myself.

颁奖.en: Tomorrow the school will give awards.

颁奖.zh: 颁奖典礼在晚上八点开始。
他获奖后，老师亲自给他颁奖。
颁奖.en: After he won the prize, the teacher personally presented the award.

颁奖.zh: 这次颁奖活动来了很多名人。
颁奖.en: Many celebrities came to this award event.

颁奖.zh: 颁奖的时候，大家都鼓掌了。
颁奖.en: When the awards were given, everyone applauded.

刑事.zh: 这不是民事案件，是刑事案件。
刑事.en: This is not a civil case, it's a criminal case.

刑事.zh: 他因为刑事犯罪被判了三年。
刑事.en: He was sentenced to three years for criminal offense.

刑事.zh: 这个律师专门处理刑事案子。
刑事.en: This lawyer specializes in criminal cases.

刑事.zh: 刑事调查需要很长时间，而且很复杂。
刑事.en: Criminal investigation takes a long time and is very complicated.

刑事.zh: 如果你涉嫌刑事犯罪，一定要找律师。
刑事.en: If you are suspected of a criminal offense, be sure to get a lawyer.

兹.en: It is hereby scheduled to have a meeting next week.

兹.zh: 兹介绍我校学生李明到你处实习。
兹.en: Hereby we introduce our student Li Ming to intern at your company.

兹.zh: 兹因公司业务调整，决定裁员。
兹.en: Hereby due to company business adjustment, we decide to lay off.

兹.zh: 兹证明张三在本公司工作三年。
兹.en: Hereby certify that Zhang San has worked at this company for three years.

兹.zh: 兹事体大，我们需要慎重考虑。
兹.en: This matter is significant, we need to consider carefully.

锁定.zh: 他把门锁定了，防止小偷。
锁定.en: He locked the door to prevent thieves.

锁定.zh: 我用密码锁定了手机屏幕。
锁定.en: I locked the phone screen with a password.

锁定.zh: 警方已经锁定了嫌疑人。
锁定.en: The police have locked on the suspect.

锁定.zh: 他们锁定了胜局，所以提前庆祝了。
锁定.en: They secured the victory, so they celebrated early.

地狱.zh: 他经历了地狱般的痛苦。
工作压力大得让人感觉像在地狱。
地狱.en: Work pressure is so high it feels like hell.

地狱.zh: 地狱和天堂只在一念之间。
地狱.en: Hell and heaven are just a thought apart.

地狱.zh: 他觉得自己从地狱里爬了出来。
地狱.en: He felt he crawled out of hell.

消.en: After taking the medicine, the fever went away.

消.zh: 他消了消气，然后开始说话。
消.en: He calmed down and then started speaking.

消.zh: 我用这个软件消掉了照片里的痘痘。
消.en: I used this software to remove pimples from the photo.

消.zh: 别担心，他的怒气很快就消了。
消.en: Don't worry, his anger will soon dissipate.

举报.zh: 有人举报了这家公司偷税。
举报.en: Someone reported this company for tax evasion.

举报.zh: 你可以匿名举报违法行为。
举报.en: You can anonymously report illegal activities.

举报.zh: 他举报了邻居的噪音问题，结果被报复了。
举报.en: He reported the neighbor's noise problem and ended up being retaliated against.

气息.en: There is a smell of alcohol on his breath.

气息.zh: 春天来了，空气里有花香的气息。
气息.en: Spring has come, there is the scent of flowers in the air.

气息.zh: 她的身上散发出一种优雅的气息。
这个城市充满了古老的气息。
气息.en: This city is full of an ancient atmosphere.

气息.zh: 他气息微弱，需要马上抢救。
气息.en: His breathing is weak, needs immediate rescue.

潜在.zh: 这个市场潜在需求很大。
潜在.en: There is huge potential demand in this market.

潜在.zh: 虽然他现在表现一般，但潜在的实力不可忽视。
潜在.en: Although his performance is average now, his potential strength cannot be ignored.

潜在.zh: 我们要注意潜在的风险，提前做好预防。
潜在.en: We need to pay attention to potential risks and take precautions in advance.

潜在.zh: 别小看这个孩子，他潜在的学习能力非常强。
潜在.en: Don't underestimate this child; his potential learning ability is very strong.

演绎.zh: 这个故事被演绎成了电影。
演绎.en: This story was adapted into a movie.

演绎.zh: 根据这些线索，我们可以演绎出事情的真相。
演绎.en: Based on these clues, we can deduce the truth of the matter.

演绎.zh: 她把这个角色演绎得非常生动，观众都很喜欢。
演绎.en: She portrayed the role very vividly, and the audience loved it.

演绎.zh: 逻辑推理需要一步步演绎，不能跳过任何环节。
演绎.en: Logical reasoning requires step-by-step deduction; you can't skip any step.

真理.zh: 真理往往掌握在少数人手里。
真理.en: Truth is often in the hands of a few.

真理.zh: 时间会证明谁站在真理的一边。
真理.en: Time will prove who stands on the side of truth.

真理.zh: 虽然他说的很难听，但那确实是真理。
真理.en: Although what he said was hard to hear, it was indeed the truth.

灌.en: Pour me a glass of water.

灌.zh: 昨天大雨把菜地都灌了。
灌.en: Yesterday's heavy rain flooded the vegetable field.
He was drunk and forced me to drink.

灌.zh: 这个热水瓶灌满要多久？
灌.en: How long does it take to fill this thermos?

灌.zh: 你别再给他灌那些没用的道理了。
灌.en: Stop pouring those useless lessons into him.

震.en: His speech shook the entire audience.
The thunder was so loud it hurt my ears.

震.zh: 虽然地震不大，但大家还是跑了出来。
震.en: Although the earthquake wasn't strong, everyone still ran out.

吻合.zh: 他的说法和证据并不吻合。
吻合.en: His statement does not match the evidence.

吻合.zh: 检查结果和医生的诊断完全吻合。
吻合.en: The test results are completely consistent with the doctor's diagnosis.

吻合.zh: 你的故事跟他的版本不太吻合，到底谁在说谎？
吻合.en: Your story doesn't quite match his version; who is lying?

随机.zh: 这个号码是随机生成的。
问卷是随机发放的，结果比较客观。
随机.en: The questionnaires were distributed randomly, so the results are relatively objective.

随机.zh: 他做事很随机，没有计划。
随机.en: He does things very randomly, without any plan.

随机.zh: 虽然测试是随机的，但我觉得有问题。
随机.en: Although the test was random, I think there's a problem.

生理.en: This is a normal physiological phenomenon.

生理.zh: 他最近生理上有点不舒服。
生理.en: He's been feeling a bit unwell physiologically lately.

生理.zh: 熬夜会影响你的生理时钟。
生理.en: Staying up late will affect your biological clock.

生理.zh: 除了心理问题，他还有生理上的障碍。
生理.en: Besides psychological issues, he also has physiological obstacles.

拜托.en: I'm leaving this matter to you.

拜托.zh: 拜托你帮我看一下孩子。
拜托.en: Please help me watch the child for a bit.

拜托.zh: 拜托，别在公众场合大声说话。
拜托.en: Please, don't speak loudly in public places.

拜托.zh: 这次真的拜托你了，一定帮忙啊！
拜托.en: I'm really counting on you this time; you have to help!

滋味.en: The taste of failure is really unpleasant.

滋味.zh: 他尝到了生活的酸甜苦辣各种滋味。
滋味.en: He has tasted all the flavors of life - sweet, sour, bitter, spicy.

滋味.zh: 离开家乡后，我才知道思念是什么滋味。
滋味.en: After leaving my hometown, I finally knew what longing feels like.

滋味.zh: 这种巧克力的滋味很特别，你试试看。
滋味.en: This chocolate has a very special taste; give it a try.

人间.zh: 虽然人间有苦，但也有很多快乐。
人间.en: Although there is suffering in the world, there is also much happiness.

人间.zh: 他看起来不像是人间的人。
人间.en: He doesn't look like someone from this world.
This is the hustle and bustle of life.

人间.zh: 人间处处有真情，只要你用心去感受。
人间.en: There is true feeling everywhere in the world, as long as you feel it with your heart.

审查.en: The documents need to be reviewed.

审查.zh: 因为内容敏感，所以必须严格审查。
审查.en: Because the content is sensitive, it must be strictly reviewed.

审查.zh: 审查制度让很多电影无法上映。
审查.en: The censorship system prevents many movies from being released.

审查.zh: 他在审查这份合同时发现了一个错误。
审查.en: He found a mistake while reviewing this contract.

丝毫.zh: 他的态度丝毫没变，还是那么固执。
丝毫.en: His attitude hasn't changed one bit; he's still that stubborn.

丝毫.zh: 尽管很累，他丝毫没抱怨。
丝毫.en: Although very tired, he didn't complain at all.

丝毫.zh: 她做事非常认真，丝毫不会马虎。
丝毫.en: She does things very seriously, without the slightest carelessness.

挖掘.en: They are excavating an ancient tomb.

挖掘.zh: 这个记者擅长挖掘新闻背后的真相。
挖掘.en: This journalist is good at digging out the truth behind the news.

挖掘.zh: 如果公司想发展，就要挖掘人才。
挖掘.en: If the company wants to develop, it must unearth talent.

挖掘.zh: 我们需要挖掘更多历史资料来支持这个理论。
挖掘.en: We need to dig up more historical materials to support this theory.

权威.en: He is an authority in this field.

权威.zh: 这篇文章引用了很多权威数据。
权威.en: This article cites a lot of authoritative data.

权威.zh: 虽然他是权威，但他的话也不一定全对。
权威.en: Although he is an authority, what he says is not necessarily completely correct.

权威.zh: 我们不能盲目相信权威。
这个报告需要经过权威机构的认证。
权威.en: This report needs to be certified by an authoritative organization.

债务.en: He owes a lot of debt.

债务.zh: 公司因为债务问题不得不申请破产。
债务.en: The company had to file for bankruptcy due to debt issues.

债务.zh: 如果你不按时还债，债务会越来越多。
债务.en: If you don't repay on time, the debt will grow.

债务.zh: 他们用了五年时间才还清所有债务。
债务.en: It took them five years to pay off all the debt.

谱.zh: 科学家用光谱来分析物质成分。

凡.en: Every path leaves traces; don't think no one knows.

尊严.en: He turned down that job for the sake of dignity.

下手.en: I don't know where to start.

下手.en: To make this dish, you should start by washing the vegetables.

见识.en: This trip broadened my horizons a lot.

见识.en: He has a lot of experience and everyone listens to him.

见识.en: Reading more can increase your knowledge.

见识.en: You're so young, you should go out and see the world.

见识.en: Although he didn't go to college, he has a wide range of knowledge.

宰.en: This shop is too shady; it specifically rips off tourists.

宰.en: Don't go to that market; they'll rip anyone off.

宰.en: He was ruthless and killed the fish with one blow.

交叉.zh: 双手交叉放在胸前，看起来很不友好。

交叉.en: The cross-pollination of knowledge from different fields can lead to new discoveries.

电台.zh: 我喜欢听电台的深夜节目。

电台.en: We use the two-way radio to contact the team ahead.

电台.zh: 这家电台的新闻播报很及时。
电台.en: This radio station's news broadcasts are very timely.

可笑.en: He actually believed that kind of talk; how laughable.

可笑.zh: 你别觉得可笑，我说的是真的。
可笑.en: Don't think it's laughable; what I said is true.

可笑.en: A bunch of adults arguing over such a trivial matter is just ridiculous.

顶级.zh: 他用了顶级的食材做菜。

顶级.en: She always wanted to become a top athlete.

顶级.en: This phone has top-tier photography features.

动脉.en: Highways are the main arteries of a city.

动脉.en: The doctor said he has a slight problem with one artery.

动脉.en: If the arteries harden, you need to pay attention to your diet.

多年来.zh: 多年来他都没换过工作。

继.zh: 他继父亲之后接管了公司。
继.en: He took over the company after his father.

继.zh: 你先把作业做完，然后再继续看电视。
继.en: Finish your homework first, then you can continue watching TV.

疫苗.en: The flu vaccine is in short supply now.

疫苗.zh: 打了疫苗之后，我胳膊有点疼。
疫苗.en: After getting the vaccine, my arm hurts a bit.

疫苗.zh: 医生建议每年都打一次流感疫苗。
疫苗.en: Doctors recommend getting a flu vaccine every year.

疫苗.zh: 虽然疫苗很安全，但有些人还是有反应。
疫苗.en: Although the vaccine is very safe, some people still have reactions.

喉咙.zh: 你喉咙不舒服就多喝热水。
喉咙.en: If your throat is uncomfortable, drink more hot water.

喉咙.zh: 他大喊了一声，喉咙都哑了。
喉咙.en: He shouted loudly and his throat went hoarse.

喉咙.zh: 吃这个药能缓解喉咙发炎的症状。
喉咙.en: Taking this medicine can relieve the symptoms of throat inflammation.

喉咙.zh: 因为唱歌太多，我的喉咙现在很干。
喉咙.en: Because I sang too much, my throat is very dry now.

矿.zh: 他在煤矿里工作了很多年。
矿.en: He worked in a coal mine for many years.

矿.zh: 这座山里有丰富的铁矿资源。
矿.en: There are abundant iron ore resources in this mountain.

矿.zh: 以前这里是个金矿，后来废弃了。
矿.en: This used to be a gold mine, but later it was abandoned.

矿.zh: 开矿对环境的影响很大，需要谨慎。
矿.en: Mining has a big impact on the environment, so caution is needed.

身子.en: He has a weak body and often gets sick.

身子.zh: 坐久了，起来活动活动身子。
身子.en: After sitting for a long time, get up and move your body.

身子.zh: 她怀孕后身子越来越重了。
身子.en: After getting pregnant, her body became heavier.

身子.zh: 冬天要注意保暖，别冻着身子。
身子.en: In winter, keep warm and don't let your body catch cold.

军官.zh: 那个军官在指挥士兵训练。
军官.en: That officer is commanding the soldiers in training.

军官.zh: 年轻军官刚被派到边疆去。
军官.en: The young officer was just sent to the border.

军官.zh: 军官和士兵的关系很融洽。
军官.en: The relationship between officers and soldiers is very harmonious.

军官.zh: 这次演习中，军官们表现得很专业。
军官.en: During this exercise, the officers performed very professionally.

意愿.en: Whether to go or not depends on your willingness.

意愿.zh: 他没有这个意愿参加聚会。
意愿.en: He has no intention of attending the party.

意愿.zh: 我会尊重你的个人意愿。
意愿.en: I will respect your personal wishes.

意愿.zh: 如果大家意愿一致，我们就开始行动。
意愿.en: If everyone's wishes are consistent, we'll start taking action.

意愿.zh: 她表达了想换个工作的意愿。
意愿.en: She expressed her willingness to change jobs.

隐瞒.en: He hid his grades from his parents.

隐瞒.zh: 你隐瞒真相只会让事情更糟。
隐瞒.en: Hiding the truth will only make things worse.

隐瞒.zh: 公司不能对员工隐瞒重要信息。
隐瞒.en: The company cannot conceal important information from employees.

隐瞒.zh: 为了不让她担心，他隐瞒了自己的病情。
隐瞒.en: In order not to worry her, he concealed his illness.

工会.en: He works at the labor union.

工会.zh: 工会帮工人争取了更好的待遇。
工会.en: The union helped workers get better benefits.

工会.zh: 老板和工会代表正在谈判。
工会.en: The boss and union representatives are negotiating.

工会.zh: 如果你有问题，可以找工会帮忙。
工会.en: If you have a problem, you can ask the union for help.

工会.zh: 工会组织了这次抗议活动。

织.zh: 奶奶织了一条围巾给我。
织.en: Grandma knitted a scarf for me.
This piece of cloth is handwoven.
A spider is weaving a web in the corner.

织.zh: 她花了一个月才织完这件衣服。
织.en: It took her a month to finish knitting this garment.

征服.zh: 这部电影征服了无数观众的心。
征服.en: This movie conquered the hearts of countless audiences.

征服.zh: 要征服这个市场，我们得先了解客户需求。
征服.en: To conquer this market, we must first understand customer needs.
Her singing conquered the whole audience.

征服.zh: 他们用耐心和智慧征服了所有困难。
征服.en: They conquered all difficulties with patience and wisdom.

陈述.zh: 请你陈述一下你的观点。
他在法庭上陈述了事实。
陈述.en: He stated the facts in court.

陈述.zh: 她陈述得很清楚，大家都明白了。
陈述.en: She stated it very clearly, so everyone understood.

陈述.zh: 这份报告陈述了公司的财务状况。
陈述.en: This report states the company's financial situation.

陈述.zh: 你再重复一遍刚才的陈述。

精英.en: He is an elite employee of the company.

精英.zh: 这个学校培养了很多社会精英。
精英.en: This school has cultivated many social elites.

精英.zh: 只有精英才能参加这个比赛？
精英.en: Only elites can participate in this competition?

精英.zh: 精英教育不一定适合每个孩子。
精英.en: Elite education is not necessarily suitable for every child.

精英.zh: 他们组成了一个精英团队来解决问题。
精英.en: They formed an elite team to solve the problem.

垫.en: Can you help me pay the money in advance?

垫.zh: 在桌子底下垫一张纸，它就不晃了。
垫.en: Put a piece of paper under the table, and it won't wobble.

垫.zh: 他先把书垫在桌子底下。
垫.en: He first put a book under the table.

垫.zh: 我忘带钱包了，你先帮我垫上，回头还你。
垫.en: I forgot my wallet, you pay for me first, I'll return it later.

垫.zh: 你先把钱垫出来，我之后给你。
垫.en: You advance the money first, and I'll give it to you later.

席.zh: 因为他升职了，所以今晚摆席庆祝。
席.en: Because he got promoted, so tonight a feast is held to celebrate.
He drank a lot at the feast.

席.zh: 我们准备了十桌席招待客人。
席.en: We prepared ten tables of feast to entertain guests.
At the feast, there were only the two of us.

确切.zh: 我需要一个确切的答案。
他说的消息不确切，别信。
确切.en: The news he said is not accurate, don't believe it.

确切.zh: 你能否给我一个确切的地址？
确切.en: Can you give me the exact address?

确切.zh: 这个消息的来源很确切，放心吧。
确切.en: The source of this news is very reliable, rest assured.

不惜.zh: 他不惜一切代价也要成功。
不惜.en: He will succeed at all costs.

不惜.zh: 为了孩子，父母不惜辛苦工作。
不惜.en: For the children, parents spare no effort working hard.

不惜.zh: 她不惜花大价钱买那个包。
不惜.en: She didn't hesitate to spend a lot of money on that bag.

不惜.zh: 为了保护环境，政府不惜投入巨资。
不惜.en: To protect the environment, the government spares no expense.

不惜.zh: 他为了目标不惜牺牲休息时间。
不惜.en: He doesn't hesitate to sacrifice rest time for his goal.

揭晓.en: The result will be announced tomorrow.
The answer to the riddle is finally revealed.

揭晓.zh: 大奖的获得者还没有揭晓。
揭晓.en: The winner of the grand prize has not been announced yet.

揭晓.zh: 比赛结束后，评委揭晓了最终成绩。
揭晓.en: After the game, the judges announced the final scores.

揭晓.zh: 等所有证据都到齐了，真相自然会揭晓。
揭晓.en: When all the evidence is gathered, the truth will naturally be revealed.

发誓.en: I swear I will never be late again.

发誓.zh: 虽然他不相信我，但我发誓这是真的。
发誓.en: Although he doesn't believe me, I swear this is true.

发誓.zh: 她发誓说这件事不是她做的。
发誓.en: She swore that she didn't do this.

发誓.zh: 他对我发誓一定会回来。
发誓.en: He swore to me that he would definitely come back.

永不.en: He promised to never leave me.
I will never forget this friendship.

永不.zh: 无论发生什么，我们永不分离。
永不.en: No matter what happens, we will never separate.

永不.zh: 他发誓永不背叛自己的国家。
永不.en: He swore to never betray his own country.

安心.zh: 你放心，我会安心工作的。
安心.en: Don't worry, I will work with peace of mind.

安心.zh: 把事情交给他，大家都很安心。
安心.en: Everyone feels at ease leaving things to him.

安心.zh: 孩子病了，我实在没法安心上班。
安心.en: My child is sick, I really can't focus on work.

安心.zh: 既然已经检查过了，你就安心睡觉吧。
安心.en: Since it's already checked, just sleep peacefully.

安心.zh: 钱虽然不多，但够用了，我也算安心了。
安心.en: Although the money isn't much, it's enough, so I feel relieved.

坏事.zh: 他一时冲动就干了坏事。
坏事.en: He did something bad in a moment of impulse.

坏事.zh: 这事你千万别告诉他，不然会坏事的。
坏事.en: Don't tell him about this, or it will ruin things.

坏事.zh: 虽然他做了坏事，但已经道歉了。
坏事.en: Although he did something bad, he already apologized.
Staying up late is bad for the skin.

犯规.zh: 裁判说他犯规，所以罚了一个点球。
犯规.en: The referee said he fouled, so a penalty kick was given.
Cheating on an exam is breaking the rules.

犯规.zh: 如果你再犯规，就会被罚下场。
犯规.en: If you foul again, you'll be sent off.
You can't break the rules when playing cards.

缩.zh: 他看到危险就缩了回去。
缩.en: He shrank back when he saw danger.

缩.zh: 天太冷，他把脖子缩了起来。
缩.en: It's too cold, he shrunk his neck in.

缩.zh: 因为害怕，他缩在角落里不敢动。
缩.en: Because of fear, he huddled in the corner and didn't dare move.

缩.zh: 经济不好，公司开始缩编。
缩.en: The economy is bad, the company started downsizing.

婚纱.en: Her wedding dress is very beautiful.

婚纱.zh: 我们明天去试婚纱，你要一起来吗？
婚纱.en: We are going to try on wedding dresses tomorrow, do you want to come?

婚纱.zh: 这件婚纱是定做的，花了不少钱。
婚纱.en: This wedding dress is custom-made and cost a lot.

婚纱.zh: 虽然婚纱很贵，但她很喜欢。
婚纱.en: Although the wedding dress was expensive, she really liked it.
The wedding photos turned out especially well.

困惑.en: I am very confused about this question.

困惑.zh: 他的回答让我更加困惑了。
困惑.en: His answer made me even more confused.
Facing the choice, he looked confused.

困惑.zh: 虽然我努力了，但还是感到很困惑。
困惑.en: Although I tried hard, I still feel confused.
The new policy is a bit confusing.

盛大.zh: 公司举办了盛大的庆祝活动。
盛大.en: The company held a grand celebration.

盛大.zh: 这个节日有盛大的游行。
盛大.en: This festival has a grand parade.

盛大.zh: 不仅规模盛大，而且气氛非常好。
盛大.en: Not only was it grand in scale, but the atmosphere was also very good.

盛大.zh: 开幕式非常盛大，来了很多名人。
盛大.en: The opening ceremony was very grand, many celebrities came.

共和国.zh: 法国是一个历史悠久的共和国。
共和国.en: France is a republic with a long history.

共和国.zh: 这个共和国成立才三十年。
共和国.en: This republic was founded only thirty years ago.

共和国.zh: 虽然是个共和国，但权力却很集中。
共和国.en: Although it is a republic, power is very concentrated.

共和国.zh: 我们热爱我们的共和国。

平民.en: He is just a common person.

平民.zh: 这场战争伤害了很多平民。
平民的生活其实很不容易。
平民.en: The life of common people is actually not easy.

平民.zh: 无论是官员还是平民，都应该遵守法律。
平民.en: Whether officials or common people, everyone should obey the law.

平民.zh: 作为平民，我们更关心物价。
平民.en: As ordinary people, we care more about prices.

数码.en: I like using a digital camera.

数码.zh: 现在很多人都用数码产品了。
数码.en: Now many people use digital products.

数码.zh: 这个数码设备操作很简单。
数码.en: This digital device is very easy to operate.

数码.zh: 虽然数码产品便宜，但更新太快。
数码.en: Although digital products are cheap, they get updated too fast.

数码.zh: 数码时代给我们带来了很多便利。
数码.en: The digital age has brought us a lot of convenience.

空白.zh: 他的记忆里有一段空白。
空白.en: There is a blank in his memory.

空白.zh: 考试时别留空白，尽量写点东西。
空白.en: Don't leave blanks on the exam; try to write something.

空白.zh: 我们讨论了很久，但最后结论还是空白。
空白.en: We discussed for a long time, but the final conclusion is still blank.

空白.zh: 虽然你填了表格，但姓名那一栏还是空白的。
空白.en: Although you filled out the form, the name column is still blank.

天赋.en: He has a great talent for music.

天赋.zh: 这孩子从小就展现了绘画天赋。
天赋.en: This child has shown a talent for painting since a young age.

天赋.zh: 光靠天赋不够，还得努力才行。
天赋.en: Talent alone is not enough; you also need to work hard.

天赋.zh: 虽然她天赋很高，但从不骄傲。
天赋.en: Although she is very talented, she never gets arrogant.

天赋.zh: 每个人都有自己的天赋，只是还没发现而已。
天赋.en: Everyone has their own talent; it's just that they haven't discovered it yet.

疗法.zh: 医生建议他换一种疗法。
疗法.en: The doctor suggested he switch to another therapy.

疗法.zh: 除了吃药，还有一些物理疗法可以选择。
疗法.en: Besides taking medicine, there are also some physical therapies to choose from.

疗法.zh: 这种新疗法虽然贵，但效果显著。
疗法.en: Although this new therapy is expensive, the results are remarkable.

疗法.zh: 他试了很多疗法，最后才找到适合自己的。
疗法.en: He tried many therapies before finally finding one that suits him.

同胞.en: We are all siblings from the same parents.

同胞.zh: 海外同胞纷纷捐款支援灾区。
同胞.en: Compatriots overseas have donated money to support the disaster area.

同胞.zh: 两岸同胞应该多交流合作。
同胞.en: Compatriots across the strait should communicate and cooperate more.

同胞.zh: 他虽然不是亲兄弟，但待我如同胞。
同胞.en: Although he is not my biological brother, he treats me like a sibling.

同胞.zh: 在这个困难时期，同胞们互相帮助显得特别重要。
同胞.en: During this difficult time, it is especially important for compatriots to help each other.

故.en: He took leave for no reason.

故.zh: 不知何故，他今天没来上班。
故.en: For some unknown reason, he didn't come to work today.

故.zh: 他故意迟到，就是想引起注意。
故.en: He deliberately arrived late just to get attention.

故.zh: 故地重游，让他感慨万千。
故.en: Revisiting the old place made him feel a myriad of emotions.

故.zh: 他故步自封，不愿意接受新想法。
故.en: He is complacent and unwilling to accept new ideas.

变形.en: The door frame is deformed and won't close.
These shoes will deform after wearing them for a long time.

变形.zh: 金属受热以后容易变形。
变形.en: Metal tends to deform when heated.

变形.zh: 他的脸因为愤怒而变形了。
虽然椅子看起来不错，但坐久了就会变形。
变形.en: Although the chair looks good, it will deform after sitting on it for a long time.

无力.en: I'm so tired that my whole body is weak.

无力.zh: 他无力承担这么高的费用。
无力.en: He is unable to afford such high costs.

无力.zh: 面对这种情况，我感到很无力。
无力.en: Faced with this situation, I feel very helpless.

无力.zh: 她无力地靠在墙上，喘着气。
无力.en: She leaned weakly against the wall, gasping for breath.

无力.zh: 政府虽然想帮忙，但财力有限，显得无力。
无力.en: Although the government wants to help, its limited financial resources make it seem powerless.

地步.en: How did you end up in this situation?

地步.zh: 事情发展到不可收拾的地步。
地步.en: Things have developed to an uncontrollable extent.

地步.zh: 他居然穷到了借钱度日的地步。
地步.en: He has actually become so poor that he lives by borrowing money.

地步.zh: 两人吵到了要离婚的地步，真可惜。
地步.en: They argued to the point of divorce; what a pity.

地步.zh: 如果你再不努力，就会落到被淘汰的地步。
地步.en: If you don't work hard, you'll end up being eliminated.

占领.en: The enemy army occupied that city.

占领.zh: 这个品牌很快占领了市场。
占领.en: This brand quickly captured the market.

占领.zh: 他们用了三个月占领了整个区域。
占领.en: They took three months to occupy the entire area.

占领.zh: 新技术的出现占领了传统行业的份额。
占领.en: The emergence of new technology has taken market share from traditional industries.

占领.zh: 虽然对方实力很强，但我们还是占领了优势位置。
占领.en: Although the opponent is very strong, we still occupied a favorable position.

驾车.zh: 她学驾车已经三个月了。
驾车.en: She has been learning to drive for three months.

驾车.zh: 长途驾车要注意休息，别疲劳驾驶。
驾车.en: When driving long distances, you should rest and avoid fatigued driving.

驾车.zh: 虽然下雨路滑，但他仍然小心地驾车前行。
驾车.en: Although the road was slippery from rain, he still drove carefully.

顺着.en: I climbed up along the ladder.

顺着.zh: 你顺着风的方向开船，会省油。
顺着.en: If you sail in the direction of the wind, it saves fuel.

顺着.zh: 他顺着我说的话想了想，觉得有道理。
顺着.en: He thought along the lines of what I said and felt it made sense.

扬.en: The wind lifted the sand up.
This brand has become famous overseas.
He raised the national flag high.

悲哀.zh: 听到这个消息，她流下了悲哀的眼泪。
悲哀.en: Hearing the news, she shed sad tears.

悲哀.zh: 人生最大的悲哀莫过于失去希望。
悲哀.en: The greatest sorrow in life is losing hope.

悲哀.zh: 虽然结局是悲哀的，但过程很美好。
悲哀.en: Although the ending is sad, the process was beautiful.

欢呼.en: The whole venue cheered and jumped for joy.

欢呼.zh: 进球后，球迷们大声欢呼。
欢呼.en: After the goal, the fans cheered loudly.

欢呼.zh: 他们为胜利欢呼，也为失败加油。
欢呼.en: They cheered for victory and also encouraged each other in defeat.

欢呼.zh: 一听到放假的消息，大家立刻欢呼起来。
欢呼.en: As soon as they heard the news of the holiday, everyone immediately cheered.

阳性.en: This word is a masculine noun.

阳性.zh: 如果是阳性，就要马上隔离。
阳性.en: If it's positive, you need to isolate immediately.

阳性.zh: 检查报告显示阳性，需要进一步治疗。
阳性.en: The test report shows positive, and further treatment is needed.

阳性.zh: 他的阳性结果让全家都很担心。
阳性.en: His positive result made the whole family very worried.

壮.en: He drank a glass of liquor to bolster his courage.

壮.zh: 年轻人要多锻炼才能身体壮。
壮.en: Young people need to exercise more to be physically strong.

壮.zh: 他壮着胆子走进了黑屋子。
壮.en: He plucked up his courage and walked into the dark room.

辞.en: She said goodbye to her boss.
I don't know how to phrase it.

辞.zh: 他辞职以后自己创业了。
辞.en: After resigning, he started his own business.

辞.zh: 他辞别了家人，去了远方。
辞.en: He bid farewell to his family and went far away.

审.en: The judge is trying the case.

审.zh: 这个项目需要领导审批。
审.en: This project needs approval from the leader.

审.zh: 你先审一下这份合同，有问题再改。
审.en: First review this contract; if there are issues, then revise it.

倒数.en: Everyone count down together: ten, nine, eight...

倒数.zh: 新年前夜，所有人一起倒数。
倒数.en: On New Year's Eve, everyone counts down together.

说道.en: The teacher said, 'You must work hard.'

说道.zh: 朋友说道：“我们一起走吧。”

地带.en: The tropical rainforest zone has a humid climate.
This zone was once a battlefield.

地带.zh: 城市中心地带房价很高。
地带.en: Housing prices in the central area of the city are very high.

地带.zh: 因为靠近边境，那个地带检查很严格。
地带.en: Because it is close to the border, inspections in that zone are very strict.

及其.zh: 老师及其学生们都来了。
及其.en: The teacher and his students all came.

及其.zh: 这本书及其作者都很有名。
及其.en: This book and its author are both very famous.

及其.zh: 网络及其便利，但也带来问题。
及其.en: The internet is very convenient, but it also brings problems.

及其.zh: 公司及其员工都在努力。
及其.en: The company and its employees are all working hard.

及其.zh: 技术及其应用改变了很多行业。
及其.en: Technology and its applications have changed many industries.

准则.en: We must follow the code of conduct.

准则.zh: 道德准则是做人的底线。
准则.en: Moral principles are the bottom line for being a person.

准则.zh: 公司有严格的招聘准则。
准则.en: The company has strict hiring standards.

准则.zh: 这个准则适用于所有情况。
准则.en: This principle applies to all situations.

准则.zh: 虽然准则很明确，但执行起来很难。
准则.en: Although the guidelines are clear, implementing them is difficult.

报酬.en: The pay for this job is very high.

报酬.zh: 他付出很多，但报酬很少。
报酬.en: He put in a lot of effort, but the reward was very little.

报酬.zh: 你应该得到合理的报酬。
志愿者不一定要求物质报酬。
报酬.en: Volunteers don't necessarily ask for material rewards.

报酬.zh: 因为项目复杂，公司给了双倍报酬。
报酬.en: Because the project was complex, the company gave double the compensation.

可疑.zh: 警察发现了一个可疑人物。
可疑.en: The police found a suspicious person.

可疑.zh: 她的话前后矛盾，十分可疑。
可疑.en: Her words are contradictory, which is very suspicious.

可疑.zh: 虽然表面正常，但总觉得可疑。
可疑.en: Although it seems normal on the surface, it still feels suspicious.

丫头.zh: 这丫头真聪明，考试又得了第一。
丫头.en: This girl is really smart; she got first place in the exam again.

丫头.zh: 我家丫头今年五岁，刚上幼儿园。
丫头.en: My little girl is five years old and just started kindergarten.
Hey, girl, come help me out.

丫头.zh: 虽然这丫头调皮，但很可爱。
丫头.en: Although this girl is naughty, she's very cute.
Who is that girl? She looks unfamiliar.

搅.zh: 用勺子搅一下汤，别糊了。
搅.en: Stir the soup with a spoon so it doesn't burn.

搅.zh: 别搅和了，这事跟你没关系。
搅.en: Stop meddling; this has nothing to do with you.

搅.zh: 他进来搅乱了整个会议。
搅.en: He came in and disrupted the whole meeting.

搅.zh: 你要是再搅局，我们就没法合作了。
搅.en: If you keep causing trouble, we won't be able to cooperate.

搅.zh: 把鸡蛋和面粉搅匀再下锅。
搅.en: Stir the eggs and flour evenly before putting them in the pan.

极限.zh: 这是我的极限了，跑不动了。
极限.en: This is my limit; I can't run anymore.

极限.zh: 他喜欢挑战极限运动，比如跳伞。
极限.en: He likes extreme sports like skydiving.

极限.zh: 耐心已经到了极限，别再烦我了。
极限.en: My patience has reached its limit; don't bother me anymore.

极限.zh: 虽然很累，但还没到极限。
极限.en: Although I'm very tired, I haven't reached my limit yet.

极限.zh: 这个产品的性能接近极限了。
极限.en: The performance of this product is approaching its limit.

讽刺.zh: 这话真讽刺，他居然帮了对手。
讽刺.en: That's really ironic; he ended up helping his opponent.

讽刺.zh: 他讽刺了我一句，我没理他。
讽刺.en: He made a sarcastic remark at me, but I ignored him.

讽刺.zh: 结局很讽刺，坏蛋反而成了英雄。
讽刺.en: The ending is ironic; the villain became a hero instead.

讽刺.zh: 不要用那种讽刺的语气跟长辈说话。
讽刺.en: Don't speak to elders with that sarcastic tone.

讽刺.zh: 最讽刺的是，他以为自己赢了。
讽刺.en: The most ironic thing is that he thought he had won.

赐.zh: 请赐我一个机会，我一定好好表现。
赐.en: Please grant me a chance; I will perform well.

赐.zh: 这是上天赐给我们的礼物，要珍惜。
赐.en: This is a gift bestowed upon us by heaven; we should cherish it.

赐.zh: 请赐教，晚辈还有很多不懂的。
赐.en: Please enlighten me; I still have a lot I don't understand.

赐.zh: 皇帝赐他一座宅子作为奖赏。
赐.en: The emperor bestowed a mansion upon him as a reward.

赐.zh: 感谢你赐予我力量和勇气。
赐.en: Thank you for granting me strength and courage.

星座.zh: 你的星座是什么？我猜你是狮子座。
星座.en: What is your zodiac sign? I guess you're Leo.

星座.zh: 我不相信星座，但觉得好玩儿。
星座.en: I don't believe in zodiac signs, but I find them fun.

星座.zh: 射手座是我的星座，性格很开朗。
星座.en: Sagittarius is my sign; my personality is very outgoing.

星座.zh: 星座运势说今天运气好，我试试看。
星座.en: The horoscope says my luck is good today; I'll give it a try.

星座.zh: 虽然我不信星座，但朋友总爱聊这个。
