星座.en: Although I don't believe in zodiac signs, my friends always love to talk about them.

违背.zh: 做人不能违背自己的良心。
违背.en: A person should not go against their own conscience.

违背.zh: 他违背了当初的诺言，大家都很失望。
违背.en: He broke his promise, and everyone was disappointed.

违背.zh: 这样做违背了法律，小心被抓。
违背.en: Doing this violates the law; be careful you don't get caught.

违背.zh: 请不要违背我的意愿，我自己做主。
违背.en: Please don't go against my wishes; I'll make my own decisions.

违背.zh: 如果你违背合同，要承担赔偿。
违背.en: If you violate the contract, you will have to pay compensation.

呕吐.zh: 他吃坏东西了，一直呕吐。
呕吐.en: He ate something bad and has been vomiting.

呕吐.zh: 坐车时晕车容易导致呕吐。
呕吐.en: Getting carsick while riding can easily cause vomiting.

呕吐.zh: 因为喝了太多酒，他呕吐了一夜。
呕吐.en: Because he drank too much, he vomited all night.

呕吐.zh: 这种药的副作用包括恶心和呕吐。
呕吐.en: The side effects of this medicine include nausea and vomiting.

呕吐.zh: 闻到那股味道，他差点呕吐出来。
呕吐.en: Upon smelling that odor, he almost threw up.

原告.zh: 原告要求被告赔偿损失。
原告.en: The plaintiff demands compensation from the defendant.

原告.zh: 法官问原告有没有新的证据。
原告.en: The judge asked the plaintiff if there was any new evidence.

原告.zh: 原告和被告都请了律师。
原告.en: Both the plaintiff and the defendant have hired lawyers.

原告.zh: 虽然原告有证据，但被告否认了。
原告.en: Although the plaintiff has evidence, the defendant denies it.

原告.zh: 原告在法庭上陈述了事情的经过。
原告.en: The plaintiff recounted the incident in court.

美容.zh: 她每周都去美容院做护理。
美容.en: She goes to the beauty salon for treatments every week.

美容.zh: 这家美容店口碑很好，生意火爆。
美容.en: This beauty shop has a good reputation and is very popular.

美容.zh: 美容可以让人更自信，但不能过度。
美容.en: Beauty treatments can make people more confident, but not excessively.

美容.zh: 他开了一家美容院，专门做皮肤管理。
美容.en: He opened a beauty salon that specializes in skincare.

美容.zh: 虽然美容费用高，但效果很明显。
美容.en: Although beauty treatments are expensive, the results are very noticeable.

糖尿病.zh: 他得了糖尿病，要控制饮食。
糖尿病.en: He has diabetes and needs to control his diet.

糖尿病.zh: 我奶奶有糖尿病，每天都要打胰岛素。
糖尿病.en: My grandmother has diabetes and needs to take insulin every day.

糖尿病.zh: 糖尿病虽然不能根治，但好好管理也能正常生活。
糖尿病.en: Although diabetes cannot be cured, with good management you can still live a normal life.

糖尿病.zh: 你最近瘦了很多，要不要去查查有没有糖尿病？
糖尿病.en: You've lost a lot of weight lately. Do you want to check if you have diabetes?

糖尿病.zh: 医生说我血糖偏高，再不注意就会得糖尿病。
糖尿病.en: The doctor said my blood sugar is high, and if I don't pay attention, I'll get diabetes.

揍.en: If you keep making trouble, I'll hit you!

揍.zh: 他小时候不听话，经常被爸爸揍。
揍.en: He was disobedient as a child and often got spanked by his dad.

揍.zh: 别以为你人多我就怕你，你敢动手我就揍回去。
揍.en: Don't think I'm afraid of you just because you have more people. If you lay a hand on me, I'll fight back.

揍.zh: 那个小混混被人揍了一顿，再也不敢来惹事了。
揍.en: That thug got beaten up and never dared to cause trouble again.

揍.zh: 我只是轻轻推了他一下，他又没受伤，你何必非要揍他？
揍.en: I only gave him a gentle push, and he wasn't hurt—why do you have to hit him?

分成.zh: 这笔钱我们俩分成三份。
分成.en: Let's divide this money into three parts between the two of us.

分成.zh: 公司每年年底都会给员工分成。
分成.en: The company gives employees profit shares at the end of every year.

分成.zh: 我们几个朋友一起做生意，利润按出资比例分成。
分成.en: A few friends and I are doing business together, and we split the profits according to our investment ratios.

分成.zh: 这个蛋糕分成八块，每人一块。
分成.en: Cut this cake into eight pieces, one for each person.

分成.zh: 合作之前一定要说好怎么分成，免得以后吵架。
分成.en: Before cooperating, you must agree on how to split the profits to avoid arguments later.

性命.zh: 在这危急时刻，保命要紧，性命攸关啊！
性命.en: In this critical moment, saving your life is what matters—it's a matter of life and death!

性命.zh: 做这种危险的工作，一不小心就可能搭上性命。
性命.en: Doing this dangerous job, one slip-up could cost you your life.

性命.zh: 虽然钱很重要，但跟性命比起来就不算什么了。
性命.en: Although money is important, it's nothing compared to life.

性命.zh: 医生拼尽全力才救回他的性命。
性命.en: The doctor did everything possible to save his life.

糊涂.zh: 他越听越糊涂，完全不知道老师在讲什么。
糊涂.en: The more he listened, the more confused he got, and he had no idea what the teacher was saying.

糊涂.zh: 你别装糊涂，明明知道这件事是错的。
糊涂.en: Don't play dumb—you clearly know this is wrong.

糊涂.zh: 我爷爷年纪大了，有时候会犯糊涂，走丢了。
糊涂.en: My grandfather is old and sometimes gets confused and wanders off.

糊涂.zh: 平时挺聪明的一个人，怎么一谈恋爱就变糊涂了？
糊涂.en: Usually such a smart person—how come he becomes so muddled when he falls in love?

慌.zh: 一看考试成绩，他就慌了。
慌.en: As soon as he saw his exam results, he panicked.

慌.zh: 遇到紧急情况千万别慌，先打电话报警。
慌.en: When you encounter an emergency, don't panic—first call the police.
She was extremely panicked; her wallet was lost.

慌.zh: 听到这个消息，我心里有点慌，不知道该怎么办。
慌.en: Hearing this news, I felt a bit flustered and didn't know what to do.

同步.en: We need to keep in step with each other.

同步.zh: 这个软件可以同步手机和电脑的数据。
同步.en: This software can sync data between your phone and computer.

同步.zh: 大家动作同步一点，不然会撞到。
同步.en: Everyone move in sync, or we'll bump into each other.

同步.zh: 他的想法总是跟时代不同步，太落伍了。
同步.en: His ideas are always out of sync with the times—he's too outdated.

同步.zh: 开会时，演讲者的PPT和讲解必须同步，否则观众会懵。
同步.en: During a meeting, the presenter's slides and explanation must be synchronized, or the audience will get confused.

何必.en: Why do you have to be so serious?

何必.zh: 既然不喜欢，何必勉强自己？
何必.en: Since you don't like it, why force yourself?

何必.zh: 为了一点小事吵架，何必呢？
何必.en: Fighting over a small matter—why bother?

何必.zh: 他都不领情，你又何必白费力气？
何必.en: He doesn't appreciate it anyway, so why waste your effort?

何必.zh: 这件衣服也不贵，你想买就买，何必犹豫半天？
何必.en: This piece of clothing isn't expensive either—if you want to buy it, just buy it. Why hesitate for so long?

麻醉.zh: 牙医给我局部麻醉，一点也不疼。
麻醉.en: The dentist gave me local anesthesia, so it didn't hurt at all.

麻醉.zh: 这种药可以麻醉神经，但副作用很大。
麻醉.en: This medicine can numb the nerves, but it has strong side effects.

麻醉.zh: 他总是用酒精来麻醉自己，逃避现实。
麻醉.en: He always uses alcohol to numb himself and escape reality.

麻醉.zh: 手术前麻醉师会先跟你沟通，确保剂量合适。
麻醉.en: Before the surgery, the anesthesiologist will talk to you to make sure the dosage is appropriate.

团伙.zh: 那个盗窃团伙被警方一网打尽。
团伙.en: That burglary gang was completely rounded up by the police.

团伙.zh: 这几个年轻人组成一个团伙，专门骗老人。
团伙.en: These few young people formed a gang that specifically scams the elderly.

团伙.zh: 他误入了一个犯罪团伙，现在后悔莫及。
团伙.en: He accidentally joined a criminal gang and now regrets it deeply.

团伙.zh: 警方盯了那个团伙很久，终于收网了。
团伙.en: The police had been watching that gang for a long time and finally made the arrests.

团伙.zh: 他们是一个有组织的诈骗团伙，受害者遍布全国。
团伙.en: They are an organized fraud gang, and their victims are all over the country.

审理.zh: 法院审理了这起合同纠纷。
审理.en: The court heard this contract dispute.

审理.zh: 因为证据不足，审理被推迟了。
审理.en: The trial was postponed due to insufficient evidence.

审理.zh: 审理结束后，法官宣布了下周宣判。
审理.en: After the trial ended, the judge announced the verdict for next week.

审理.zh: 他们要求公开审理，但法院没同意。
审理.en: They requested a public trial, but the court disagreed.

共识.zh: 大家在这个问题上还没有共识。
共识.en: Everyone has not yet reached a consensus on this issue.

共识.zh: 经过讨论，双方终于有了共识。
共识.en: After discussion, both sides finally reached a consensus.

共识.zh: 虽然分歧很大，但最终我们还是形成了共识。
共识.en: Although differences were large, we eventually formed a consensus.

共识.zh: 他们缺乏共识，所以合作很难推进。
共识.en: They lack a consensus, so cooperation is hard to advance.

内在.zh: 这个问题有内在的逻辑。
内在.en: This issue has an inherent logic.

内在.zh: 产品的内在质量比外观更重要。
内在.en: The intrinsic quality of the product is more important than its appearance.

内在.zh: 你要了解一个人的内在，不能只看表面。
内在.en: You need to understand a person's inner self, not just the surface.

内在.zh: 虽然外表一样，但这两款手机的内在配置完全不同。
内在.en: Although they look the same, the internal configurations of these two phones are completely different.

抵押.en: He used his house as collateral.

抵押.zh: 因为还不上钱，他的车被抵押了。
抵押.en: Because he couldn't repay the money, his car was repossessed.

抵押.zh: 这套房子已经抵押给银行了。
抵押.en: This house has already been mortgaged to the bank.

抵押.zh: 如果你要借这么多钱，必须提供足够的抵押。
抵押.en: If you want to borrow this much money, you must provide sufficient collateral.

曲线.zh: 图表上的曲线显示销量在上升。
曲线.en: The curve on the chart shows sales are rising.

曲线.zh: 为了解决这个问题，他采用了曲线救国的方式。
曲线.en: To solve this problem, he adopted a roundabout approach.

曲线.zh: 学习需要耐心，有时候走点曲线反而更快。
曲线.en: Learning requires patience; sometimes taking a detour is actually faster.

伪装.en: He disguised himself as a police officer.

伪装.zh: 别再伪装了，我知道你在说谎。
伪装.en: Stop pretending, I know you're lying.

伪装.zh: 他的善良只是一种伪装。
伪装.en: His kindness was just a facade.

伪装.zh: 在野外，动物会伪装来保护自己。
伪装.en: In the wild, animals use camouflage to protect themselves.

伪装.zh: 虽然她表面很坚强，但那都是伪装出来的。
伪装.en: Although she seems strong on the surface, it's all pretended.

喘.en: He ran until he was panting.
Don't rush, catch your breath first.

喘.zh: 爬完楼梯，她喘得说不出话。
喘.en: After climbing the stairs, she was too breathless to speak.

喘.zh: 天气太热了，连狗都在树下喘。
喘.en: It's so hot that even the dog is panting under the tree.

喘.zh: 他喘着粗气，好像刚跑完马拉松。
喘.en: He was breathing heavily, as if he had just finished a marathon.

吸毒.en: Drug abuse is harmful to health.
He was arrested for drug use.

吸毒.zh: 吸毒会毁掉一个人的生活。
吸毒.en: Drug abuse can ruin a person's life.

吸毒.zh: 很多明星因为吸毒而前途尽毁。
吸毒.en: Many celebrities have ruined their careers due to drug use.

吸毒.zh: 政府正在严厉打击吸毒和贩毒行为。
吸毒.en: The government is cracking down on drug use and trafficking.

独家.en: Our store has an exclusive recipe.

独家.zh: 这家媒体拿到了独家采访权。
独家.en: This media outlet obtained exclusive interview rights.

独家.zh: 这个品牌的产品是独家代理的。
独家.en: This brand's products are exclusively distributed.

独家.zh: 他们推出了一个独家优惠活动，只限今天。
独家.en: They launched an exclusive promotion, only available today.

任意.zh: 他任意修改了合同内容。
任意.en: He arbitrarily modified the contract content.

任意.zh: 你不能任意指责别人，要有证据。
任意.en: You can't arbitrarily blame others; you need evidence.

任意.zh: 在字典里，你可以查到任意一个词的用法。
任意.en: In the dictionary, you can look up the usage of any word.

开除.en: He was fired by the company.

开除.zh: 因为迟到太多，学校开除了他。
开除.en: The school expelled him for being late too often.

开除.zh: 如果这次再犯错误，老板可能会开除你。
开除.en: If you make this mistake again, the boss might fire you.

开除.zh: 她虽然工作很努力，但最后还是被开除了。
开除.en: Although she worked very hard, she was eventually fired.

开除.zh: 听说那个球员因为打架被球队开除了。
开除.en: I heard that player was kicked off the team for fighting.

墓.en: We go to sweep the tomb during Qingming.

墓.zh: 这座墓已经有一千多年了。
墓.en: This tomb is over a thousand years old.
He placed a bouquet of flowers in front of the grave.

墓.zh: 那个古老的墓里发现了很多文物。
墓.en: Many artifacts were found in that ancient tomb.

墓.zh: 虽然墓很偏僻，但每年都有人来祭拜。
墓.en: Although the tomb is remote, people come to worship every year.

陷.en: The car got stuck in the mud.
His foot sank into the sand.
Don't fall into this kind of scam.

陷.zh: 她越想越深，陷进了自己的思绪中。
陷.en: The more she thought, the deeper she got trapped in her own thoughts.

陷.zh: 我们小心点，免得陷进沼泽里。
陷.en: Let's be careful so we don't sink into the swamp.

废话.en: Stop with the nonsense, get to the point.
He said a lot of nonsense.
Who wants to listen to this kind of nonsense?

废话.zh: 你少说废话，直接回答我。
废话.en: Stop your nonsense and answer me directly.

废话.zh: 如果没什么有用的，就别讲废话了。
废话.en: If you have nothing useful, don't talk nonsense.

激光.en: Lasers are very precise in surgery.

激光.zh: 他用激光笔指着屏幕说。
激光.en: He pointed at the screen with a laser pointer.

激光.zh: 这家公司专门生产激光设备。
激光.en: This company specializes in manufacturing laser equipment.

激光.zh: 虽然激光很厉害，但也要注意安全。
激光.en: Although lasers are powerful, you still need to be careful with safety.

国务院.en: The State Council released a new policy.

国务院.zh: 他在国务院工作很多年了。
国务院.en: He has worked at the State Council for many years.
The meeting room of the State Council is very large.

国务院.zh: 听说国务院要改一些规定。
国务院.en: I heard the State Council is going to change some regulations.

国务院.zh: 国务院的发言人今天回答了记者的问题。
国务院.en: The spokesperson of the State Council answered reporters' questions today.

抖.en: He was shivering from the cold.
Don't shake your leg, it doesn't look good.
She was so scared that her hands kept trembling.

抖.zh: 你把衣服抖一抖再挂起来。
抖.en: Shake out the clothes before hanging them up.

抖.zh: 虽然他很紧张，但声音没有抖。
抖.en: Although he was nervous, his voice didn't tremble.

时空.en: Sci-fi movies often talk about time travel.

时空.zh: 他穿越时空回到了古代。
时空.en: He traveled through time and space back to ancient times.
The concept of space-time is very abstract.

时空.zh: 科学家在研究时空扭曲的可能性。
时空.en: Scientists are studying the possibility of space-time distortion.

时空.zh: 如果有时空机器，你想去哪里？
时空.en: If there were a time-space machine, where would you want to go?

损.en: Stop it, is it fun to insult people?

损.zh: 这场雨对庄稼损了不少。
损.en: This rain caused quite a bit of damage to the crops.

损.zh: 虽然是个玩笑，但听起来有点损。
损.en: Although it was a joke, it sounded a bit mean.

霜.en: A layer of frost formed on the ground.
There was frost on the window in the morning.
After Frost Descent, the weather gets colder.

霜.zh: 这种植物怕霜，冬天要搬进屋里。
霜.en: This plant is afraid of frost, so it needs to be moved indoors in winter.

霜.zh: 虽然霜很好看，但菜地里的菜都被冻坏了。
霜.en: Although the frost looks beautiful, the vegetables in the field were all frozen.

流血.en: He's bleeding, call an ambulance quickly!

流血.zh: 吵架的时候他打破了杯子，手流血了。
流血.en: When they were arguing, he broke the cup and his hand bled.

流血.zh: 如果伤口一直流血，就要去医院包扎。
流血.en: If the wound keeps bleeding, you need to go to the hospital for bandaging.

流血.zh: 打仗时很多人流血牺牲，我们要珍惜和平。
流血.en: Many people shed blood and sacrificed in war; we should cherish peace.

应急.en: Is there an emergency kit in the car?

应急.zh: 遇到火灾要按应急按钮。
应急.en: In case of fire, press the emergency button.

应急.zh: 停电了，我们得用应急灯照明。
应急.en: The power went out, so we have to use an emergency light for illumination.

应急.zh: 公司有应急方案，遇到问题不用慌。
应急.en: The company has an emergency plan, so there's no need to panic when problems arise.

应急.zh: 这个应急通道平时不能随便占用。
应急.en: This emergency exit cannot be casually blocked under normal circumstances.

八卦.en: Don't always gossip about other people's private matters.

八卦.zh: 她特别爱听明星的八卦新闻。
八卦.en: She really loves listening to celebrity gossip news.

八卦.zh: 你们在聊什么八卦？也跟我说说。
八卦.en: What gossip are you chatting about? Tell me too.

八卦.zh: 八卦一下，听说小王要辞职了？
八卦.en: Just gossiping a bit — I heard Xiao Wang is going to quit?

八卦.zh: 网上那些八卦消息很多都是假的。
八卦.en: A lot of those gossip stories online are fake.

是非.zh: 他这个人总爱搬弄是非。
是非.en: He is always fond of stirring up trouble.

是非.zh: 这件事的是非对错很难说清楚。
是非.en: The rights and wrongs of this matter are hard to clarify.

是非.zh: 工作里要少管闲事，免得卷入是非。
是非.en: At work, mind your own business to avoid getting involved in disputes.

是非.zh: 做人要明辨是非，不能随波逐流。
是非.en: A person should tell right from wrong and not just go with the flow.

言论.zh: 自由言论不代表可以乱说话。
言论.en: Freedom of speech doesn't mean you can say whatever you want.

言论.zh: 他的不当言论引起了大家的不满。
言论.en: His inappropriate remarks caused widespread dissatisfaction.

言论.zh: 在公众场合发表言论要谨慎一些。
言论.en: When expressing opinions in public, you should be a bit more cautious.

无敌.zh: 他觉得自己无敌，结果输了比赛。
无敌.en: He thought he was invincible, but ended up losing the match.

无敌.zh: 无敌是多么寂寞，但也要继续努力。
无敌.en: Being unmatched is lonely, but you still have to keep working hard.

无敌.zh: 她英语口语无敌好，怎么学的？
无敌.en: Her spoken English is incredibly good — how did she learn?

昏迷.en: He was in a coma for three days.

昏迷.zh: 车祸后他一直昏迷不醒。
昏迷.en: After the car accident, he remained unconscious.

昏迷.zh: 老人突然昏迷，家人赶紧送医院。
昏迷.en: The old man suddenly fell unconscious, and his family quickly took him to the hospital.

昏迷.zh: 病人从昏迷中醒过来，大家都松了口气。
昏迷.en: The patient woke up from the coma, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

昏迷.zh: 因为缺氧，他在水里昏迷过去了。
昏迷.en: Due to lack of oxygen, he passed out underwater.

运转.en: The company has been running well recently.

运转.zh: 地球围绕太阳运转，这是常识。
运转.en: The Earth revolves around the sun — that's common knowledge.

运转.zh: 心脏停止运转人就活不了了。
运转.en: If the heart stops working, a person can't survive.

运转.zh: 这个系统日夜不停地运转，不能出错。
运转.en: This system runs day and night without stopping and must not make mistakes.

官司.en: He is in the middle of a lawsuit.

官司.zh: 因为合同纠纷，他们惹上了官司。
官司.en: Due to a contract dispute, they got tangled up in a lawsuit.

官司.zh: 这起官司打了三年才结束。
官司.en: This lawsuit dragged on for three years before ending.

官司.zh: 为了赔偿问题，双方打起了官司。
官司.en: Over the compensation issue, both sides filed a lawsuit.

官司.zh: 打官司又费钱又费时间，最好和解。
官司.en: Filing a lawsuit costs both money and time; it's best to settle out of court.

没收.en: The phone was confiscated by the teacher.

没收.zh: 警察没收了他的非法所得。
没收.en: The police confiscated his illegal gains.

没收.zh: 考试作弊的话，试卷会被没收。
没收.en: If you cheat on the exam, your paper will be confiscated.

没收.zh: 海关没收了那些违禁物品。
因为违规停车，他的驾照被没收了。
没收.en: Because of illegal parking, his driver's license was confiscated.

辉煌.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但结果非常辉煌。
辉煌.en: Although the process was hard, the result was very glorious.

辉煌.zh: 这座城市曾经有过辉煌的历史。
辉煌.en: This city once had a glorious history.

辉煌.zh: 在那次比赛中，他取得了辉煌的成绩。
辉煌.en: He achieved glorious results in that competition.

辉煌.zh: 我们公司的辉煌离不开每个人的努力。
辉煌.en: Our company's glory depends on everyone's hard work.

嫩.en: This piece of meat is very tender.

嫩.zh: 春天的时候，树上的嫩芽特别可爱。
嫩.en: In spring, the tender buds on the trees are especially cute.

嫩.zh: 她皮肤很嫩，像婴儿一样。
嫩.en: Her skin is very soft, like a baby's.

嫩.zh: 这道菜里的豆腐又嫩又滑。
嫩.en: The tofu in this dish is tender and smooth.

嫩.zh: 这种草刚长出来的时候特别嫩。
嫩.en: This kind of grass is especially tender when it first grows.

流浪.zh: 他从小就流浪街头，没有家。
流浪.en: He has been wandering the streets since childhood, without a home.

流浪.zh: 很多流浪狗需要我们的帮助。
流浪.en: Many stray dogs need our help.

流浪.zh: 他决定结束流浪的生活，找一份稳定工作。
流浪.en: He decided to end his wandering life and find a stable job.

流浪.zh: 虽然流浪很自由，但也很辛苦。
流浪.en: Although wandering is free, it is also very hard.

沙滩.en: Let's go to the beach to play.

沙滩.zh: 昨天我们在沙滩上捡了很多贝壳。
沙滩.en: Yesterday we picked up many shells on the beach.

沙滩.zh: 沙滩上人很多，大家都在晒太阳。
沙滩.en: There were many people on the beach, all sunbathing.

沙滩.zh: 我喜欢在沙滩上散步，听海浪的声音。
沙滩.en: I like to walk on the beach and listen to the sound of the waves.

沙滩.zh: 那片沙滩的沙子又细又软，特别舒服。
沙滩.en: The sand on that beach is fine and soft, very comfortable.

手枪.zh: 警察从嫌疑人身上搜出一把手枪。
手枪.en: The police found a pistol on the suspect.

手枪.zh: 电影里那个人用手枪打碎了玻璃。
手枪.en: In the movie, that person broke the glass with a pistol.

手枪.zh: 这把手枪是假的，别害怕。
手枪.en: This pistol is fake, don't be scared.

手枪.zh: 他偷偷藏了一把手枪在抽屉里。
手枪.en: He secretly hid a pistol in the drawer.

感恩.en: We need to learn to be grateful.

感恩.zh: 因为你的帮助，我真的很感恩。
感恩.en: Because of your help, I am really grateful.

感恩.zh: 感恩节的时候，家里会做很多好吃的。
感恩.en: On Thanksgiving, our family makes a lot of delicious food.

感恩.zh: 他对生活充满感恩，每天都很开心。
感恩.en: He is full of gratitude for life and is happy every day.

感恩.zh: 虽然经历了很多困难，但我依然感恩现在拥有的一切。
感恩.en: Although I have experienced many difficulties, I am still grateful for everything I have now.

良心.zh: 他做这种事，良心不会痛吗？
良心.en: Doesn't his conscience hurt when he does things like this?

良心.zh: 那个老板没有良心，欠员工工资。
良心.en: That boss has no conscience, owing wages to employees.

良心.zh: 他凭良心说，自己并没有做错。
良心.en: He said truthfully, based on his conscience, that he didn't do anything wrong.

良心.zh: 如果还有点良心，就赶紧把钱还给他。
良心.en: If you still have a little conscience, return the money to him quickly.

火炬.en: The Olympic torch relay has started.

火炬.zh: 他手里举着火炬，跑向终点。
火炬.en: He held the torch in his hand and ran toward the finish line.

火炬.zh: 那支火炬在黑暗中照亮了道路。
火炬.en: That torch lit up the road in the darkness.

火炬.zh: 点火仪式上，火炬被点燃了。
火炬.en: During the lighting ceremony, the torch was lit.

火炬.zh: 虽然下着雨，火炬还是顺利传递到了下一站。
火炬.en: Although it was raining, the torch was still successfully passed to the next stop.

出卖.zh: 为了钱，他出卖了自己的灵魂。
出卖.en: For money, he sold his soul.

出卖.zh: 那个人把公司的机密出卖给了竞争对手。
出卖.en: That person sold the company's secrets to competitors.

出卖.zh: 她觉得自己被最好的朋友出卖了。
出卖.en: She felt betrayed by her best friend.

出卖.zh: 如果你出卖我，我们以后就不是朋友了。
出卖.en: If you betray me, we won't be friends anymore.

发布会.en: There is a new product launch tomorrow.

发布会.zh: 他们在发布会上展示了最新款手机。
发布会.en: They showcased the latest phone at the press conference.

发布会.zh: 发布会现场来了很多记者。
发布会.en: Many journalists came to the press conference.

发布会.zh: 因为疫情，发布会改成了线上直播。
发布会.en: Because of the pandemic, the press conference was changed to an online live stream.

发布会.zh: 那家公司的发布会总是很精彩。
发布会.en: That company's press conferences are always very exciting.

梦幻.zh: 她穿了一条梦幻的裙子去参加派对。
梦幻.en: She wore a dreamy dress to the party.

梦幻.zh: 虽然房间不大，但灯光让它看起来很梦幻。
梦幻.en: Although the room is small, the lighting makes it look dreamy.

梦幻.zh: 这部电影的场面特别梦幻，像在童话里。
梦幻.en: The scenes in this movie are especially dreamy, like in a fairy tale.

梦幻.zh: 我小时候总幻想一个梦幻的生日派对。
梦幻.en: When I was a child, I always fantasized about a dreamy birthday party.

鲜血.en: There is blood on the ground.

鲜血.zh: 他用自己的鲜血救了那个孩子。
鲜血.en: He used his own blood to save that child.

鲜血.zh: 看到受伤的人流出鲜血，她吓得大叫。
鲜血.en: Seeing the injured person bleeding, she screamed in fright.

鲜血.zh: 战士们为了祖国流下了宝贵的鲜血。
鲜血.en: Soldiers shed precious blood for the motherland.

鲜血.zh: 这部电影里有很多鲜血的画面，不适合小孩。
鲜血.en: This movie has many bloody scenes, not suitable for children.

魔术.zh: 那个魔术师把兔子变成了鸽子。
魔术.en: That magician turned a rabbit into a dove.

魔术.zh: 我小时候最喜欢看魔术表演，觉得特别神奇。
魔术.en: When I was a child, I loved watching magic shows, finding them especially amazing.

魔术.zh: 虽然我知道魔术是假的，但还是觉得很精彩。
魔术.en: Although I know magic is fake, I still find it wonderful.

魔术.zh: 她学会了一个简单的魔术，想在聚会上表演。
魔术.en: She learned a simple magic trick and wants to perform it at the party.

与众不同.en: His ideas are different from others.

与众不同.zh: 她总是穿得与众不同，很有个性。
与众不同.en: She always dresses differently, very unique.

与众不同.zh: 因为他的观点与众不同，所以常常被人讨论。
与众不同.en: Because his views are different from others, they are often discussed.

与众不同.zh: 这家餐厅的装修风格与众不同，吸引了很多客人。
与众不同.en: This restaurant's decoration style is unique, attracting many customers.

与众不同.zh: 我喜欢做一些与众不同的事情，这样才能进步。
与众不同.en: I like to do things differently from others; only then can I make progress.

地毯.zh: 客厅的地毯是白色的，很难打理。
地毯.en: The living room carpet is white, hard to maintain.

地毯.zh: 她新买了一块地毯放在床边，脚踩上去很舒服。
地毯.en: She bought a new rug and placed it by the bed; it feels very comfortable underfoot.

地毯.zh: 每次吸尘的时候，我都得把地毯掀起来清理下面。
地毯.en: Every time I vacuum, I have to lift the carpet to clean underneath.

地毯.zh: 这块地毯是从印度带回来的，花纹很特别。
地毯.en: This carpet was brought back from India; the pattern is very special.

甜美.zh: 她笑起来的样子特别甜美。
这首歌的旋律很甜美，让人听了心情变好。
甜美.en: The melody of this song is very sweet; it makes people feel better after listening.

甜美.zh: 虽然生活很苦，但她一直保持甜美的笑容。
甜美.en: Although life is hard, she always maintains a sweet smile.

甜美.zh: 我记得小时候吃的糖果特别甜美，现在找不到那种味道了。
甜美.en: I remember the candies I ate as a child were especially sweet; I can't find that taste now.

受害人.en: He is the victim of the accident.

受害人.zh: 警方正在保护受害人的隐私。
受害人.en: The police are protecting the victim's privacy.

受害人.zh: 在这次事件中，受害人得到了很多人的同情和帮助。
受害人.en: In this incident, the victim received a lot of sympathy and help from people.

受害人.zh: 律师在法庭上为受害人争取了赔偿。
受害人.en: The lawyer fought for compensation for the victim in court.

受害人.zh: 只有找到证据，才能还受害人一个公道。
受害人.en: Only by finding evidence can justice be done for the victim.

乐园.zh: 孩子们在乐园里玩得很开心。
乐园.en: The children had a great time in the amusement park.

乐园.zh: 这个水上乐园夏天特别热闹，很多人来玩。
乐园.en: This water park is especially lively in summer; many people come to play.

乐园.zh: 对我来说，图书馆就是知识的乐园。
乐园.en: For me, the library is a paradise of knowledge.

乐园.zh: 他答应周末带她去游乐园玩，她高兴极了。
乐园.en: He promised to take her to the amusement park on the weekend; she was extremely happy.

吓人.zh: 半夜听到敲门声，真的很吓人。
吓人.en: Hearing a knock on the door in the middle of the night is really scary.

吓人.zh: 虽然故事有点吓人，但我还是忍不住听完了。
吓人.en: Although the story is a bit scary, I couldn't help but finish listening.

吓人.zh: 那条狗突然冲出来，把我吓了一大跳，太吓人了。
吓人.en: That dog suddenly rushed out, giving me a big scare; it was so frightening.

吓人.zh: 别讲这么吓人的故事，小孩会做噩梦的。
吓人.en: Don't tell such scary stories; children will have nightmares.

光芒.zh: 她眼中闪耀着自信的光芒。
光芒.en: Her eyes shone with the light of confidence.

光芒.zh: 黎明时分，第一缕光芒照进窗户，非常温暖。
光芒.en: At dawn, the first ray of light shines through the window, very warm.

光芒.zh: 虽然蜡烛的光芒很微弱，但在黑暗中已经很珍贵了。
光芒.en: Although the candlelight is very faint, it is already precious in the darkness.

光芒.zh: 他的才华像光芒一样，无论在哪里都能被看见。
光芒.en: His talent is like radiance; it can be seen wherever he is.

海滩.zh: 昨天我在海滩捡了很多漂亮的贝壳。
海滩.en: Yesterday I picked up many beautiful shells at the beach.

海滩.zh: 这个海滩的沙子又细又软。
海滩.en: The sand on this beach is fine and soft.

海滩.zh: 虽然天气很热，但海滩上还是有很多人。
海滩.en: Although it's very hot, there are still many people on the beach.

海滩.zh: 他们决定在海滩上举行婚礼。
海滩.en: They decided to hold the wedding on the beach.

额外.zh: 老板给了我额外的奖金。
额外.en: The boss gave me an extra bonus.

额外.zh: 如果你加班，公司会支付额外的工资。
额外.en: If you work overtime, the company will pay extra wages.

额外.zh: 我们需要额外的时间来完成这个项目。
额外.en: We need extra time to finish this project.
He bought an extra bottle of water.

钢铁.en: This bridge is built of steel.

钢铁.zh: 钢铁工业是国家的支柱产业。
钢铁.en: The steel industry is a pillar industry of the country.

钢铁.zh: 虽然钢铁很坚硬，但也会生锈。
钢铁.en: Although steel is very hard, it can also rust.
He has a will of steel.

钢铁.zh: 这家公司主要生产钢铁产品。
钢铁.en: This company mainly produces steel products.

压抑.zh: 工作压力让我感到特别压抑。
压抑.en: Work pressure makes me feel especially oppressed.

压抑.zh: 虽然他心里很压抑，但他还是笑着面对大家。
压抑.en: Although he felt very oppressed inside, he still faced everyone with a smile.

压抑.zh: 这个地方的气氛太压抑了。
压抑.en: The atmosphere here is too oppressive.

压抑.zh: 她压抑着内心的愤怒，没有说话。
压抑.en: She suppressed her inner anger and did not speak.

伪造.zh: 这个人因为伪造护照被判了刑。
伪造.en: This person was sentenced for forging a passport.

伪造.zh: 如果伪造签名，你会惹上大麻烦。
伪造.en: If you forge a signature, you will get into big trouble.

伪造.zh: 他们试图伪造证据来陷害他。
伪造.en: They tried to forge evidence to frame him.

召集.en: Please convene a meeting as soon as possible.

召集.zh: 经理召集所有员工讨论新计划。
召集.en: The manager called all employees to discuss the new plan.

召集.zh: 因为情况紧急，他立刻召集了救援队。
召集.en: Because the situation was urgent, he immediately assembled the rescue team.

召集.zh: 我们需要召集志愿者帮忙。
召集.en: We need to gather volunteers to help.

召集.zh: 他召集了朋友来庆祝生日。
召集.en: He gathered friends to celebrate his birthday.

亲眼.en: I saw it with my own eyes.

亲眼.zh: 他亲眼目睹了那场事故的发生。
亲眼.en: He witnessed the accident with his own eyes.

亲眼.zh: 如果不亲眼看到，我绝对不会相信。
亲眼.en: If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I would never believe it.
Have you ever seen snow with your own eyes?
I want to see the Great Wall with my own eyes.

骚扰.zh: 他因为电话骚扰邻居被报警了。
骚扰.en: He was reported to the police for harassing his neighbor by phone.

骚扰.zh: 虽然她多次警告，但他继续骚扰她。
骚扰.en: Although she warned him many times, he continued to harass her.

骚扰.zh: 网络骚扰是一种违法行为。
骚扰.en: Online harassment is an illegal act.

骚扰.zh: 这个号码经常打骚扰电话。
骚扰.en: This number often makes nuisance calls.

花样.zh: 这家餐厅的菜花样很多，味道也不错。
花样.en: This restaurant's dishes have a lot of variety and taste good too.

花样.zh: 他不仅会唱歌，还会很多花样的舞蹈。
花样.en: He not only sings, but also knows many fancy dance moves.

花样.zh: 这种蛋糕的花样很漂亮。
花样.en: The pattern on this cake is very beautiful.

亲手.en: I made this with my own hands.

亲手.zh: 他亲手把礼物交给了老师。
亲手.en: He personally handed the gift to the teacher.

亲手.zh: 虽然很累，但他亲手为家人做了晚餐。
亲手.en: Although tired, he personally made dinner for his family.
I want to plant a tree with my own hands.

亲手.zh: 她亲手缝了一件衣服送给妈妈。
亲手.en: She sewed a piece of clothing with her own hands to give to her mother.

激活.zh: 下载以后，你需要激活才能使用这个软件。
激活.en: After downloading, you need to activate it to use the software.

激活.zh: 如果你还没激活会员，那就没法看最新视频。
激活.en: If you haven't activated your membership yet, then you can't watch the latest videos.

激活.zh: 新手机到手后，第一件事就是激活SIM卡。
激活.en: The first thing after getting a new phone is to activate the SIM card.

激活.zh: 激活这个功能需要输入验证码。
激活.en: Activating this feature requires entering a verification code.

上诉.zh: 如果对判决不满意，你有权在十五天内上诉。
上诉.en: If you are not satisfied with the verdict, you have the right to appeal within fifteen days.

上诉.zh: 虽然输了官司，但他还是选择上诉到最高法院。
上诉.en: Although he lost the lawsuit, he still chose to appeal to the Supreme Court.

上诉.zh: 律师建议他不要上诉，因为胜算不大。
上诉.en: The lawyer advised him not to appeal because the odds of winning are low.

上诉.zh: 这个案子正在上诉过程中。
上诉.en: This case is currently in the appeal process.

未经.zh: 这些照片未经本人同意就被发到网上了。
未经.en: These photos were posted online without the person's consent.

未经.zh: 因为未经许可使用了他的作品，所以被告了。
未经.en: Because his work was used without permission, he was sued.

未经.zh: 未经处理的污水直接排放会污染河流。
未经.en: Untreated sewage discharged directly will pollute the river.

未经.zh: 未经核实的信息不要随便转发。

憋.en: I'm about to suffocate (or hold it in too long).

憋.zh: 他憋了一肚子话，终于忍不住说了出来。
憋.en: He had a lot to say but held it in, and finally couldn't help blurting it out.

憋.zh: 因为憋着不笑，他的脸都红了。
憋.en: Because he held back from laughing, his face turned red.
Don't hold your pee, go to the bathroom.

憋.zh: 在电梯里憋住气，等到了外面再呼吸。
憋.en: Hold your breath in the elevator, and breathe when you get outside.

摊.en: She spread the books out on the table.

摊.zh: 街边有个卖煎饼的小摊，生意特别好。
摊.en: There's a small stall selling pancakes on the street, and business is great.

摊.zh: 这件事摊到谁头上都会觉得倒霉。
摊.en: If this matter falls on anyone, they would feel unlucky.

摊.zh: 钱大家平摊吧，别一个人出。
摊.en: Let's split the money equally, don't pay it all by yourself.

摊.zh: 他一个人摆摊卖水果，从早忙到晚。
摊.en: He runs a fruit stall by himself, busy from morning till night.

环球.en: He plans to travel around the world.

环球.zh: 这家公司提供环球快递服务，三天就能到。
环球.en: This company offers global express delivery, and it can arrive in three days.

环球.zh: 虽然环球一圈很累，但是能看到不同风景。
环球.en: Although traveling around the world is tiring, you can see different scenery.

环球.zh: 环球影城是很多电影迷的梦想之地。
环球.en: Universal Studios is a dream destination for many movie fans.

环球.zh: 这个节目报道环球新闻，很受欢迎。
环球.en: This program covers global news and is very popular.

任命.en: The boss appointed a new manager.

任命.zh: 董事会任命他为公司首席执行官，大家都没想到。
任命.en: The board appointed him as CEO of the company, and no one expected it.

任命.zh: 由于前主管辞职，公司紧急任命了接班人。
任命.en: Because the previous supervisor resigned, the company urgently appointed a successor.

任命.zh: 这份任命书下周一才会生效。
任命.en: This appointment letter will take effect next Monday.

任命.zh: 他被任命为项目负责人后，工作更努力了。
任命.en: After he was appointed project leader, he worked even harder.

轰.en: There was a loud boom outside.

轰.zh: 赛车引擎轰隆隆地响，震得耳朵疼。
轰.en: The racing car engine roared, making ears hurt.

轰.zh: 他把那些闹事的人轰出了酒吧。
轰.en: He drove those troublemakers out of the bar.

轰.zh: 烟花轰的一下飞上天，特别漂亮。
轰.en: The firework shot up into the sky with a boom, very beautiful.

轰.zh: 别轰我走，我还有话要说。
轰.en: Don't drive me away, I still have something to say.

撤离.zh: 因为台风要来了，政府让沿海居民撤离到安全地带。
撤离.en: Because a typhoon is coming, the government ordered coastal residents to evacuate to safe areas.

撤离.zh: 火灾发生时，大家有序撤离，没有造成伤亡。
撤离.en: When the fire broke out, everyone evacuated in an orderly manner, and there were no casualties.

撤离.zh: 军队接到命令，从边境撤离。
撤离.en: The army received orders to withdraw from the border.

撤离.zh: 撤离路线已经规划好了，别慌张。
撤离.en: The evacuation route has been planned, don't panic.

无情.en: He is a very ruthless person.

无情.zh: 时间无情，转眼间我们都老了。
无情.en: Time is merciless, and in the blink of an eye we've grown old.

无情.zh: 虽然她说了很无情的话，但我知道她心里难受。
无情.en: Although she said very heartless words, I know she was hurting inside.

无情.zh: 竞争是残酷无情的，不努力就会被淘汰。
无情.en: Competition is cruel and merciless; if you don't work hard, you'll be eliminated.

无情.zh: 大自然有时候很无情，一场地震毁掉一切。
无情.en: Nature can be ruthless sometimes; an earthquake destroys everything.

为人.en: He is a very upright person.

为人.zh: 虽然她为人低调，但大家都尊重她。
为人.en: Although she is low-key, everyone respects her.

为人.zh: 为人父母不容易，要操心很多事。
为人.en: Being a parent is not easy; you have to worry about many things.

为人.zh: 他为人处世很圆滑，所以朋友很多。
为人.en: He is very smooth in social interactions, so he has many friends.

为人.zh: 我觉得为人真诚比什么都重要。
为人.en: I think being sincere is more important than anything else.

开场.zh: 演讲的开场很精彩，吸引了所有人。
开场.en: The opening of the speech was wonderful and attracted everyone.

开场.zh: 比赛开场不久，他们就进了一个球。
开场.en: Shortly after the game started, they scored a goal.

开场.zh: 今天会议的开场有点乱，后来才进入正题。
开场.en: The opening of today's meeting was a bit chaotic, then it got to the point.

开场.zh: 演出开场前，我们最好先确认一下音响。
开场.en: Before the show starts, we'd better check the sound system first.

容忍.en: I cannot tolerate this kind of behavior.

容忍.zh: 为了和平，双方都选择了暂时容忍。
容忍.en: For the sake of peace, both sides chose to tolerate temporarily.

容忍.zh: 他容忍了同事多年的刁难，最终辞职了。
容忍.en: He tolerated his colleague's harassment for years and finally quit.

容忍.zh: 虽然心里不舒服，但她还是容忍了孩子的吵闹。
容忍.en: Although she felt uncomfortable, she still tolerated the children's noise.

容忍.zh: 公司对违规行为零容忍，一旦发现立即处理。
容忍.en: The company has zero tolerance for violations; once found, it handles them immediately.

权益.zh: 我们要保护消费者权益。
权益.en: We need to protect consumer rights.

权益.zh: 员工有权了解自己的合法权益。
权益.en: Employees have the right to know their own legal rights.

权益.zh: 这个合同保障了双方的权益。
权益.en: This contract protects the rights and interests of both parties.

权益.zh: 如果权益受到侵害，可以寻求法律援助。
权益.en: If your rights are infringed, you can seek legal assistance.

权益.zh: 他们一直在为妇女权益而奋斗。
权益.en: They have been fighting for women's rights.

邀.en: She invited me to sing karaoke.

邀.zh: 明天我邀了几个朋友来家里吃火锅。
邀.en: Tomorrow I have invited a few friends over for hotpot.

邀.zh: 他主动邀我一起参加那个比赛。
邀.en: He actively invited me to join that competition together.

邀.zh: 虽然我邀了他，但他拒绝了。
邀.en: Although I invited him, he refused.

邀.zh: 周末要不要邀同事们去爬山？
邀.en: Shall we invite colleagues to go hiking this weekend?

防护.en: Take protective measures when going out.

防护.zh: 工地上的工人都戴着防护装备。
防护.en: The workers on the construction site are all wearing protective gear.

防护.zh: 疫情期间，个人防护很重要。
防护.en: During the pandemic, personal protection is very important.

防护.zh: 这种防护服可以阻挡大部分细菌。
防护.en: This type of protective suit can block most bacteria.

防护.zh: 除了戴口罩，还要注意眼部防护。
防护.en: In addition to wearing a mask, you should also pay attention to eye protection.

丸.en: This kind of Chinese medicine pill tastes very bitter.

丸.zh: 他吞了一颗大药丸，差点噎住。
丸.en: He swallowed a large pill and almost choked.

丸.zh: 小朋友不喜欢吃丸药，更喜欢糖浆。
丸.en: Children don't like taking pills; they prefer syrup.

丸.zh: 医生开了几种丸，让我饭后服用。
丸.en: The doctor prescribed several kinds of pills for me to take after meals.

坚信.en: I firmly believe he will come.

坚信.zh: 虽然失败了，但她坚信自己能成功。
坚信.en: Although she failed, she firmly believed she could succeed.

坚信.zh: 我一直坚信努力就会有回报。
坚信.en: I have always firmly believed that hard work pays off.

坚信.zh: 他坚信正义最终会胜利。
坚信.en: He firmly believes that justice will ultimately prevail.

坚信.zh: 不论别人怎么说，我都坚信自己的选择。
坚信.en: No matter what others say, I firmly believe in my own choice.

折腾.en: Stop fooling around and go to sleep.

折腾.zh: 他折腾了一上午，终于把车修好了。
折腾.en: He fiddled around for the whole morning and finally fixed the car.

折腾.zh: 孩子一直哭闹，折腾得我一夜没睡。
折腾.en: The child kept crying and fussing, keeping me up all night.

折腾.zh: 搬家太折腾人了，我以后再也不想搬家了。
折腾.en: Moving is too troublesome; I never want to move again.

折腾.zh: 他总爱折腾新花样，结果每次都不成功。
折腾.en: He always likes to try new gimmicks, but it never works out.

寻常.zh: 在寻常的日子里，也能发现小确幸。
寻常.en: On ordinary days, you can also find small happiness.

寻常.zh: 对她来说，这种礼物很寻常。
寻常.en: For her, this kind of gift is very common.

寻常.zh: 他做了一件不寻常的事，让所有人都惊讶了。
寻常.en: He did something unusual that surprised everyone.

寻常.zh: 虽然外表看起来很寻常，但内心却很有才华。
寻常.en: Although the appearance looks very ordinary, inside he is very talented.

侮辱.zh: 他当众侮辱我，我觉得很没面子。
侮辱.en: He insulted me in public, and I felt very embarrassed.

侮辱.zh: 这种侮辱的话我不接受。
侮辱.en: I don't accept this kind of insulting words.

侮辱.zh: 虽然他很生气，但没有用侮辱的语言。
侮辱.en: Although he was angry, he didn't use insulting language.

一早.en: I have to leave early in the morning.

一早.zh: 她一早起床就去了菜市场。
一早.en: She got up early and went to the market.
Let's set off early tomorrow morning.

一早.zh: 因为要赶飞机，我一早就醒了。
一早.en: Because I had to catch a flight, I woke up early.
It rained early in the morning.

许可证.zh: 开这家店需要营业执照和许可证。
许可证.en: To open this shop you need a business license and a permit.
You can't drive without a license.

许可证.zh: 他申请了三个月才拿到许可证。
许可证.en: He applied for three months before getting the permit.

致力于.en: He is devoted to public welfare.

致力于.zh: 这家公司致力于开发环保产品。
致力于.en: This company is committed to developing eco-friendly products.

致力于.zh: 她一直致力于教育事业。
致力于.en: She has always been devoted to education.

致力于.zh: 科学家们致力于研究新技术来改善生活。
致力于.en: Scientists are devoted to researching new technologies to improve life.
I am committed to losing weight.

扮.en: She dressed up as a clown.

扮.zh: 万圣节我扮成鬼，把朋友吓坏了。
扮.en: On Halloween I dressed as a ghost and scared my friends.
He played a hero in the movie.

扮.zh: 我不想再扮好人，太累了。
扮.en: I don't want to play the good guy anymore, it's too tiring.

意图.zh: 他说这些话的意图很明显，就是想让我道歉。
意图.en: His intention in saying these words is obvious, he just wants me to apologize.

意图.zh: 虽然她没明说，但我们都猜到了她的意图。
意图.en: Although she didn't say it explicitly, we all guessed her intention.

火焰.en: The flame is burning very high.

火焰.zh: 消防员迅速扑灭了火焰。
火焰.en: The firefighters quickly extinguished the flames.
The flame is very bright in the dark.

火焰.zh: 因为火焰很大，所以大家都很害怕。
火焰.en: Because the flame was big, everyone was very scared.
Don't get close to the flame.

恶意.zh: 她说这话带着恶意，大家都不高兴。
恶意.en: She said this with malice, and everyone was unhappy.
This comment is full of malice.

恶意.zh: 虽然别人劝他，但他还是怀疑那是恶意。
恶意.en: Although others advised him, he still suspected it was malice.

盼.zh: 她天天盼着能收到录取通知书。
盼.en: She hopes every day to receive the admission letter.
Everyone looks forward to the New Year.

盼.zh: 自从他离开，我就一直盼他平安。
盼.en: Since he left, I have been hoping for his safety.

上司.en: My boss is not in today.

上司.zh: 跟上司请假需要提前三天。
上司.en: Asking your boss for leave requires three days' notice.
The boss is in a bad mood today.

上司.zh: 虽然我不喜欢这个上司，但工作还得做。
上司.en: Although I don't like this boss, I still have to work.

高贵.zh: 他说话的样子特别高贵。
高贵.en: His way of speaking is particularly noble.

高贵.zh: 虽然她出身不高，但行为很高贵。
高贵.en: Although she was born low, her behavior is noble.

高贵.zh: 那只天鹅看起来高贵又优雅。
高贵.en: That swan looks noble and elegant.

荣幸.zh: 能参加这个活动是我的荣幸。
荣幸.en: It's my honor to attend this event.
He feels honored to be invited.
I'm so honored that you say that.

荣幸.zh: 能和你合作是我的荣幸。
荣幸.en: It's my honor to cooperate with you.

蜂蜜.en: She likes to drink honey water.

蜂蜜.zh: 面包上涂点蜂蜜很好吃。
蜂蜜.en: It's delicious to spread some honey on bread.
This bottle of honey was given by a friend.

蜂蜜.zh: 蜂蜜可以润喉，我经常喝。
蜂蜜.en: Honey can soothe the throat, so I often drink it.

怨.en: He has resentment in his heart.
He can only blame himself for this.
She blamed me for not telling her earlier.

怨.zh: 既然已经这样了，就别再怨了。
怨.en: Since it's already like this, don't complain anymore.

处境.en: He is in a very difficult situation now.

处境.zh: 你要考虑一下别人的处境。
虽然处境不好，但他没有放弃。
处境.en: Although the situation is bad, he didn't give up.

创伤.zh: 小时候的经历给他留下了创伤。
创伤.en: Childhood experiences left him with trauma.

创伤.zh: 她需要时间来治愈情感创伤。
创伤.en: She needs time to heal emotional trauma.

创伤.zh: 战争给很多人带来深深的创伤。
创伤.en: War brought deep trauma to many people.

发言人.zh: 发言人没有回答这个问题。
发言人.en: The spokesperson did not answer this question.

发言人.zh: 政府发言人召开了记者会。
发言人.en: The government spokesperson held a press conference.

发言人.zh: 发言人表示会尽快处理此事。
发言人.en: The spokesperson said they would handle this matter as soon as possible.

发言人.zh: 我们需要一个正式的发言人。

说谎.zh: 我知道他说谎，但没有拆穿他。
说谎.en: I know he lied, but I didn't expose him.

回想.zh: 请你回想一下当时的情况。
回想.en: Please try to recall the situation at that time.

回想.zh: 每当我回想那件事，就很难过。
回想.en: Whenever I recall that incident, I feel sad.

回想.zh: 他闭着眼睛回想过去的细节。
回想.en: He closed his eyes and recalled the details of the past.

回想.zh: 多年后回想起来，才明白他的用意。
回想.en: Looking back years later, I understood his intention.

警官.en: That police officer is very responsible.
The police officer is handling the case.
A police officer came over to ask for directions.

警官.zh: 警官告诉我们要注意安全。
警官.en: The police officer told us to be careful.

警官.zh: 他报警后，警官很快就到了。
警官.en: After he called the police, the officer arrived quickly.

幕后.en: Who is the mastermind behind the scenes?

幕后.zh: 其实很多明星的幕后生活和我们想的不一样。
幕后.en: Actually, many celebrities' behind-the-scenes lives are different from what we think.

幕后.zh: 这部电影的幕后团队非常专业。
幕后.en: The behind-the-scenes team of this movie is very professional.

幕后.zh: 虽然台前很精彩，但幕后付出了很多努力。
幕后.en: Although the stage is wonderful, a lot of effort was put in behind the scenes.

幕后.zh: 他在幕后做了很多工作。
幕后.en: He did a lot of work behind the scenes.

沮丧.zh: 这次考试没考好，他特别沮丧。
沮丧.en: He didn't do well in this exam, he's especially frustrated.

沮丧.zh: 虽然失败了，但我并不沮丧。
沮丧.en: Although I failed, I'm not frustrated.

沮丧.zh: 因为工作不顺利，他最近很沮丧。
沮丧.en: Because work isn't going well, he's been very frustrated lately.

倒下.zh: 经过长时间的战斗，他终于倒下了。
倒下.en: After a long fight, he finally collapsed.

倒下.zh: 别让一棵树倒下就放弃整片森林。
倒下.en: Don't give up the whole forest because one tree falls.

倒下.zh: 如果他不休息，很快就会倒下。
倒下.en: If he doesn't rest, he'll collapse soon.

发掘.en: The archaeological team excavated an ancient tomb.

发掘.zh: 这个项目发掘了很多优秀的年轻人才。
发掘.en: This project unearthed many outstanding young talents.

发掘.zh: 我们要学会发掘自己的潜力。
发掘.en: We need to learn to discover our own potential.

发掘.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但发掘出的文物非常珍贵。
发掘.en: Although the process was hard, the artifacts excavated are very precious.

储备.en: We need to store up grain.

储备.zh: 公司储备了大量资金来应对市场变化。
储备.en: The company has reserved a large amount of funds to deal with market changes.

储备.zh: 动物会在冬天前储备食物。
因为能源紧张，政府要求大家储备一些物资。
储备.en: Because of energy shortage, the government asks everyone to reserve some supplies.
He has a rich reserve of knowledge.

通报.en: The teacher announced the exam results.

通报.zh: 公司内部通报了最新的销售业绩。
通报.en: The company internally announced the latest sales performance.

通报.zh: 虽然问题不大，但还是要通报一下。
通报.en: Although the problem isn't big, we still need to report it.
The reported results will be announced tomorrow.

占用.zh: 他的工作占用了大量私人时间。
占用.en: His work takes up a lot of personal time.

占用.zh: 因为会议占用了整个下午，所以我没时间吃饭。
占用.en: Because the meeting took up the whole afternoon, I didn't have time to eat.

占用.zh: 这桌子占用了太多地方。
占用.en: This table takes up too much space.

出路.en: He can't find a way out.

出路.zh: 这个行业如果不转型，很难找到出路。
出路.en: If this industry doesn't transform, it's hard to find a way out.
We need to think of another way out.

出路.zh: 虽然暂时困难，但总会有出路的。
出路.en: Although temporarily difficult, there will always be a way out.
You need to find a way out yourself.

炖.zh: 妈妈用小火慢慢炖了一锅鸡汤。
炖.en: Mom slowly simmered a pot of chicken soup on low heat.

炖.zh: 牛肉要炖久一点才好吃。
炖.en: Beef needs to be stewed longer to be tasty.

炖.zh: 如果时间够，还可以炖得更烂。
炖.en: If time permits, you can stew it even softer.

肝脏.zh: 他的肝脏检查结果不太好。
肝脏.en: His liver test results are not very good.

肝脏.zh: 肝脏是人体重要的代谢器官。
肝脏.en: The liver is an important metabolic organ in the human body.

肝脏.zh: 因为长期熬夜，他的肝脏功能变差了。
肝脏.en: Because of staying up late for a long time, his liver function deteriorated.
Liver diseases should be detected early.

盲目.en: He blindly followed the trend and bought stocks.

盲目.zh: 不要盲目相信网上说的。
盲目.en: Don't blindly believe what you see online.

盲目.zh: 她因为盲目自信，结果吃了大亏。
盲目.en: Because of blind confidence, she ended up suffering a big loss.

盲目.zh: 做事不能太盲目，要多想想后果。
盲目.en: Don't act too blindly; think about the consequences more.

盲目.zh: 他虽然很努力，但方向盲目，所以没成功。
盲目.en: Although he worked very hard, his direction was blind, so he didn't succeed.

迟早.en: This will sooner or later have problems.
You'll have to face reality sooner or later.

迟早.zh: 别着急，他迟早会想通的。
迟早.en: Don't worry, he'll figure it out sooner or later.

迟早.zh: 如果你不努力，迟早会被淘汰的。
迟早.en: If you don't work hard, you'll be eliminated sooner or later.

迟早.zh: 这件事迟早会暴露，不如早点坦白。
迟早.en: This will sooner or later be exposed, so you might as well confess early.

充.zh: 手机没电了，我得充一下。
充.en: My phone is dead, I need to charge it.

充.zh: 他充内行，其实什么都不懂。
充.en: He pretends to be an expert, but actually knows nothing.

充.zh: 这个气球充了气就能飞起来。
充.en: After inflating this balloon, it can fly.

充.zh: 别充胖子，量力而行就好。
充.en: Don't pretend to be rich; just act within your means.

充.zh: 虽然他是新手，但总爱充老大指挥别人。
充.en: Although he is a beginner, he always likes to act like a boss and order others around.

伴侣.zh: 好的伴侣能让你更幸福。
伴侣.en: A good partner can make you happier.

伴侣.zh: 他是我生活中的最佳伴侣。
伴侣.en: He is the best partner in my life.

伴侣.zh: 找到合适的伴侣不容易，要珍惜。
伴侣.en: Finding a suitable partner isn't easy, so cherish it.

伴侣.zh: 他们不仅是夫妻，还是事业上的伴侣。
伴侣.en: They are not only spouses but also partners in career.

伴侣.zh: 养一只狗当伴侣，可以缓解孤独感。
伴侣.en: Keeping a dog as a companion can relieve feelings of loneliness.

瞒.zh: 你别瞒我了，我都知道了。
瞒.en: Don't hide it from me, I already know.

瞒.zh: 她瞒着家人偷偷去旅行。
瞒.en: She secretly went traveling without telling her family.

瞒.zh: 这种事瞒得了一时，瞒不了一世。
瞒.en: You can hide this kind of thing for a while, but not forever.

瞒.zh: 他瞒着老板请了三天假，结果被发现了。
瞒.en: He took three days off behind his boss's back, and ended up getting caught.

瞒.zh: 虽然他想瞒住真相，但还是被查出来了。
瞒.en: Although he wanted to hide the truth, it was still found out.

自主.en: Children need to learn to be independent.

自主.zh: 这个国家强调自主发展。
我希望你能自主做出决定。
自主.en: I hope you can make decisions independently.

自主.zh: 大学教育应该培养学生自主思考的能力。
自主.en: University education should cultivate students' ability to think independently.

自主.zh: 他不喜欢被安排，更喜欢自主创业。
自主.en: He doesn't like being arranged, but prefers to start his own business.

公车.en: I take the bus to work every day.
The bus is here, get on quickly!
The bus during morning rush hour is especially crowded.

公车.zh: 因为路上堵车，公车晚点了很久。
公车.en: Because of traffic jams, the bus was delayed for a long time.

公车.zh: 虽然公车便宜，但时间不太灵活。
公车.en: Although the bus is cheap, the schedule is not very flexible.

交代.zh: 你交代的事情我办好了。
交代.en: I've handled the matter you told me to do.

交代.zh: 他向警察交代了所有细节。
交代.en: He confessed all the details to the police.

交代.zh: 临走前，他交代我要照顾好猫。
交代.en: Before leaving, he instructed me to take good care of the cat.

交代.zh: 老板交代的任务，我们必须按时完成。
交代.en: We must complete the task the boss assigned on time.

交代.zh: 这件事你最好跟领导交代清楚，免得误会。
交代.en: You'd better explain this clearly to the boss to avoid misunderstandings.

步伐.zh: 加快步伐，我们要迟到了。
步伐.en: Speed up your pace, we're going to be late.

步伐.zh: 他步伐稳健地走进会场。
步伐.en: He walked into the meeting room with a steady pace.

步伐.zh: 社会发展的步伐越来越快。
步伐.en: The pace of social development is getting faster.

步伐.zh: 我们要跟上时代的步伐，不断学习。
步伐.en: We need to keep pace with the times and keep learning.

步伐.zh: 虽然困难很多，但改革的步伐不会停止。
步伐.en: Although there are many difficulties, the pace of reform will not stop.

宽容.en: One should be a bit more tolerant.
He is very lenient with others.

宽容.zh: 夫妻之间需要互相宽容。
宽容.en: Couples need to be tolerant of each other.

宽容.zh: 宽容待人，别太计较小事。
宽容.en: Be tolerant with others, don't be too fussy about small things.

宽容.zh: 虽然她犯了错，但大家应该宽容对待她。
宽容.en: Although she made a mistake, everyone should treat her with leniency.

美人.zh: 电影里的那位美人让人难忘。
美人.en: That beauty in the movie is unforgettable.

美人.zh: 虽然她是美人，但性格也很温柔。
美人.en: Although she is a beauty, her personality is also very gentle.

美人.zh: 这位美人不仅长得好看，还很有才华。
美人.en: This beauty is not only good-looking but also very talented.

美人.zh: 他为了追求那个美人花了不少心思。
美人.en: He put a lot of effort into pursuing that beauty.

香烟.en: Smoking cigarettes is not allowed in public places.

香烟.zh: 他最近开始戒烟，连香烟都不碰了。
香烟.en: He recently started quitting smoking and won't even touch a cigarette.

香烟.zh: 虽然香烟对身体不好，但很多人还是戒不掉。
香烟.en: Although cigarettes are bad for health, many people still can't quit.

香烟.zh: 他递给我一根香烟，我拒绝了。
香烟.en: He handed me a cigarette, but I refused.

强行.zh: 别强行改变别人的想法。
强行.en: Don't force others to change their minds.

强行.zh: 他试图强行插队，结果被大家批评。
强行.en: He tried to cut in line forcibly, and ended up being criticized by everyone.

强行.zh: 虽然她不同意，但他还是强行抱了她。
强行.en: Although she disagreed, he still forcibly hugged her.

强行.zh: 如果没有人同意，就不能强行通过这个方案。
强行.en: If no one agrees, you can't force this plan through.

手脚.zh: 他手脚很快，一下子做完了。
手脚.en: He is quick with his hands and feet, finishing it in no time.

手脚.zh: 小心点，别让人动了手脚。
手脚.en: Be careful, don't let anyone tamper with things.

手脚.zh: 他手脚冰凉，可能生病了。
手脚.en: His hands and feet are cold; he might be sick.

手脚.zh: 她手脚麻利，十分钟就收拾好了房间。
手脚.en: She is dexterous and cleaned up the room in ten minutes.

手脚.zh: 有人在这台机器上做了手脚，导致它坏了。
手脚.en: Someone tampered with this machine, causing it to break.

普通人.en: I am just an ordinary person.

普通人.zh: 普通人也能做出不平凡的事。
普通人.en: Ordinary people can also do extraordinary things.

普通人.zh: 他虽然是名人，但生活得像普通人一样。
普通人.en: Although he is a celebrity, he lives like an ordinary person.

普通人.zh: 对普通人来说，买房确实不容易。
普通人.en: For ordinary people, buying a house is really not easy.

普通人.zh: 她觉得自己是个普通人，没什么特别的。
普通人.en: She thinks she is an ordinary person, nothing special.

姿态.en: He apologized with a humble attitude.

姿态.zh: 公司需要调整姿态来应对市场变化。
姿态.en: The company needs to adjust its stance to respond to market changes.

姿态.zh: 她保持高姿态，不愿低头认错。
姿态.en: She kept a high posture, unwilling to humble herself and admit fault.

姿态.zh: 谈判时双方都要有合作的姿态。
姿态.en: Both parties need to have a cooperative attitude during negotiations.

响起.zh: 音乐响起时，大家开始跳舞。
响起.en: When the music started, everyone began to dance.

响起.zh: 当他上台时，掌声响起了很久。
响起.en: When he went on stage, applause rang out for a long time.

响起.zh: 电话铃声响起，他赶紧接听。
响起.en: The phone rang, and he quickly answered it.

朝着.zh: 我们朝着目标努力前进，虽然很辛苦。
朝着.en: We move forward towards the goal, even though it's hard.
Sunlight streamed in through the window.

朝着.zh: 他朝着大海大喊了一声，然后转身离开。
朝着.en: He shouted towards the sea, then turned and left.

经费.zh: 我们需要申请更多经费。
经费.en: We need to apply for more funds.

经费.zh: 因为经费有限，活动只能简化。
经费.en: Because the budget is limited, the event has to be simplified.

经费.zh: 这笔经费主要用于购买设备。
经费.en: This budget is mainly used for purchasing equipment.

经费.zh: 学校把大部分经费花在了图书馆上。
经费.en: The school spent most of its budget on the library.

社交.en: He is very good at socializing.

社交.zh: 社交活动让她感到疲惫。
社交.en: Social activities make her feel exhausted.

社交.zh: 现代人越来越依赖社交媒体。
社交.en: Modern people rely more and more on social media.

社交.zh: 因为他不太喜欢社交，所以很少参加聚会。
社交.en: Because he doesn't like socializing much, he rarely attends parties.

社交.zh: 在社交场合，要保持礼貌和微笑。
社交.en: In social situations, you should maintain politeness and a smile.

通往.zh: 这条小路通往一片美丽的森林。
通往.en: This path leads to a beautiful forest.

通往.zh: 如果你一直往前走，这条路就会通往市中心。
通往.en: If you keep walking straight, this road leads to the city center.

通往.zh: 虽然这条路很难走，但它通往山顶的风景。
通往.en: Although this road is hard to walk, it leads to the mountain top scenery.

通往.zh: 我们终于找到了通往城堡的秘密通道。
通往.en: We finally found the secret passage leading to the castle.

随身.en: I carry my phone with me.

随身.zh: 出门的时候记得随身带把雨伞。
随身.en: Remember to bring an umbrella with you when you go out.

随身.zh: 她随身携带了一个小包，里面装着必需品。
随身.en: She carries a small bag with essentials.

随身.zh: 因为要出差，他随身只带了一个行李箱。
随身.en: Because he's on a business trip, he only brought one suitcase with him.

随身.zh: 这些重要的文件最好随身保管。
随身.en: It's best to keep these important documents with you.

幼稚.zh: 这种幼稚的想法不适合成年人。
幼稚.en: Such childish ideas are not suitable for adults.
Don't be so childish, be realistic.

幼稚.zh: 虽然她年纪不小了，但行为还是很幼稚。
幼稚.en: Although she's not young, her behavior is still very childish.

幼稚.zh: 我小时候觉得这种动画片很有趣，现在觉得很幼稚。
幼稚.en: I thought this cartoon was fun as a child, but now I find it childish.

走私.zh: 警察破获了一个大型走私团伙。
走私.en: The police cracked a large smuggling ring.

走私.zh: 因为关税太高，有些人选择走私商品。
走私.en: Because tariffs are too high, some people choose to smuggle goods.

走私.zh: 他们通过边境走私了大量的黄金。
走私.en: They smuggled a large amount of gold across the border.

诈骗.zh: 他因为网络诈骗被判了三年刑。
诈骗.en: He was sentenced to three years for online fraud.
This kind of scam is very common.

诈骗.zh: 如果你接到陌生人的转账要求，很可能就是诈骗。
诈骗.en: If you receive a transfer request from a stranger, it's likely fraud.

诈骗.zh: 他们利用虚假广告进行诈骗。
诈骗.en: They used false advertising to commit fraud.

尽头.zh: 走到走廊的尽头就能看到出口。
尽头.en: Walk to the end of the corridor and you'll see the exit.

尽头.zh: 他们的耐心已经到尽头了。
尽头.en: Their patience has reached its limit.

尽头.zh: 虽然困难很多，但总会有尽头的。
尽头.en: Although there are many difficulties, there will always be an end.

尽头.zh: 这本书的最后一章写到了故事的尽头。
尽头.en: The last chapter of this book reaches the end of the story.

挽救.zh: 我们需要尽快挽救这段关系。
挽救.en: We need to quickly save this relationship.

挽救.zh: 消防员成功挽救了被困的小孩。
挽救.en: The firefighters successfully rescued the trapped child.

挽救.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但我们还是尽力挽救了公司。
挽救.en: Although time was tight, we still did our best to save the company.

挽救.zh: 他的一番话挽救了他们的友谊。

扩张.zh: 这家企业计划向海外市场扩张。
扩张.en: This company plans to expand into overseas markets.

扩张.zh: 过度扩张可能导致资金问题。
扩张.en: Excessive expansion may lead to financial problems.

扩张.zh: 因为市场需求增加，他们不得不扩张生产线。
扩张.en: Because market demand increased, they had to expand the production line.

扩张.zh: 帝国的扩张往往伴随着战争。
扩张.en: The expansion of empires often accompanies war.

眼下.en: At present, the most important thing is health.

眼下.zh: 眼下的经济形势不太好。
眼下.en: The current economic situation is not good.

眼下.zh: 他眼下没有时间做别的事。
眼下.en: He currently has no time to do other things.

眼下.zh: 虽然眼下很困难，但我们要坚持。
眼下.en: Although it's difficult at present, we must persist.

眼下.zh: 眼下这个项目需要尽快完成。
眼下.en: This project needs to be completed as soon as possible.

歧视.en: The company strictly prohibits gender discrimination.

歧视.zh: 这种歧视行为是不可接受的。
虽然法律禁止歧视，但现实中仍然存在。
歧视.en: Although the law prohibits discrimination, it still exists in reality.

歧视.zh: 他因为年龄歧视而失去了工作。
歧视.en: He lost his job because of age discrimination.

放过.zh: 你放过我吧，我真的知道错了。
放过.en: Let me go, I really know I was wrong.

放过.zh: 这次就放过你，下次别这样了。
放过.en: I'll let you off this time, don't do it again.

放过.zh: 他求了半天，老板才放过他。
放过.en: He begged for a long time before the boss let him off.

放过.zh: 既然她已经道歉了，你就放过她吧。
放过.en: Since she already apologized, just let her go.

放过.zh: 别为这点小事计较了，放过自己也放过别人。
放过.en: Don't fuss over such small things; let yourself and others off.

润.zh: 这个面霜很润，冬天用刚好。
润.en: This cream is very moisturizing, perfect for winter.

润.zh: 你声音有点干，喝点水润润嗓子。
润.en: Your voice sounds a bit dry, drink some water to moisten your throat.

润.zh: 他说话很润，大家都爱听。
润.en: He speaks smoothly, everyone likes to listen.

润.zh: 最近天气太干燥，皮肤不够润。
润.en: The weather has been too dry lately, my skin isn't moist enough.

润.zh: 把这块木头打磨一下，再上点油就润了。
润.en: Polish this piece of wood and apply some oil, then it will be smooth.

无意.en: I didn't mean to offend you, don't be angry.

无意.zh: 她无意中发现了那封信。
他是无意说漏嘴的，你别怪他。
无意.en: He accidentally let it slip, don't blame him.

无意.zh: 虽然我无意打扰，但还是想问一下进度。
无意.en: Although I don't mean to disturb, I still want to ask about the progress.

无意.zh: 他无意参加这次聚会，所以找了个借口没来。
无意.en: He didn't intend to attend this party, so he made an excuse not to come.

裂.en: There's a crack in the cup.
It's so cold in winter that the water pipes have cracked.

裂.zh: 这块玻璃被石头砸裂了。
裂.en: This piece of glass was cracked by a stone.

裂.zh: 墙面裂了好几条纹，得找人修修。
裂.en: The wall has several cracks, someone needs to fix it.

裂.zh: 他用力一掰，木板就从中间裂开了。
裂.en: He snapped it hard, and the wood split right down the middle.

效力.zh: 这个药效力很强，别吃太多。
效力.en: This medicine is very potent, don't take too much.

效力.zh: 他在那家公司效力了十年。
效力.en: He served that company for ten years.

效力.zh: 这种清洁剂的效力能持续一整天。
效力.en: The effectiveness of this cleaner can last all day.

效力.zh: 虽然效力不大，但总比没有好。
效力.en: Although the effect isn't great, it's better than nothing.

效力.zh: 他曾经为国家队效力，拿过不少奖牌。
效力.en: He once played for the national team and won many medals.

除此之外.zh: 我只点了咖啡，除此之外没有别的。
除此之外.en: I only ordered coffee, besides that nothing else.

除此之外.zh: 他工作很努力，除此之外他待人也很真诚。
除此之外.en: He works very hard, and besides that, he is also sincere with people.

除此之外.zh: 这家店只卖面包，除此之外也卖一些蛋糕。
除此之外.en: This shop only sells bread, but besides that, they also sell some cakes.

除此之外.zh: 你需要带身份证和护照，除此之外别忘了带照片。
除此之外.en: You need to bring your ID and passport, besides that don't forget to bring photos.

除此之外.zh: 他擅长画画，除此之外他对音乐也很感兴趣。
除此之外.en: He is good at painting, and apart from that, he is also very interested in music.

侵略.zh: 历史上的侵略战争造成了巨大伤害。
侵略.en: The wars of aggression in history caused great harm.

侵略.zh: 他们反对任何形式的侵略行为。
侵略.en: They oppose any form of aggressive act.

侵略.zh: 这片土地曾经被外国侵略过很多次。
侵略.en: This land was invaded by foreign countries many times.

侵略.zh: 侵略者的野心最终被正义的力量打败了。
侵略.en: The ambition of the invaders was ultimately defeated by the forces of justice.

腹部.zh: 他腹部受了伤，得赶紧去医院。
腹部.en: He was injured in the abdomen and needs to go to the hospital quickly.

腹部.zh: 最近腹部老是疼，不知道怎么回事。
腹部.en: My abdomen has been hurting lately, I don't know what's wrong.

腹部.zh: 做仰卧起坐可以锻炼腹部肌肉。
腹部.en: Doing sit-ups can exercise the abdominal muscles.

腹部.zh: 她怀孕了，腹部已经明显鼓起来了。
腹部.en: She is pregnant, and her belly is already noticeably bulging.

腹部.zh: 医生用手轻轻按压他的腹部，问他疼不疼。
腹部.en: The doctor gently pressed his abdomen and asked if it hurt.

宣称.zh: 这家公司宣称产品绝对安全。
宣称.en: This company claims that the product is absolutely safe.

宣称.zh: 政府宣称将在明年完成这项工程。
宣称.en: The government announced that it will complete this project next year.

宣称.zh: 他宣称这是他的原创作品，但有人怀疑。
宣称.en: He claimed that this was his original work, but some people doubt it.

宣称.zh: 尽管对方宣称已经赢了，但我们还要继续努力。
宣称.en: Although the other side claimed they had won, we still need to keep trying.

威力.en: The power of a typhoon is unimaginable.

威力.zh: 别小看这小小的药丸，它的威力可不小。
威力.en: Don't underestimate this tiny pill; its potency is considerable.

威力.zh: 大自然的力量威力无穷，人类要敬畏它。
威力.en: The power of nature is limitless; humans should revere it.

威力.zh: 这款新武器的威力比之前多了好几倍。
威力.en: The power of this new weapon is several times greater than before.

别说.zh: 别说这个了，我们换个话题吧。
别说.en: Don't talk about this anymore, let's change the topic.

别说.zh: 他连中文都不会说，别说写汉字了。
别说.en: He can't even speak Chinese, let alone write characters.

别说.zh: 这件事你别说出去，知道吗？
别说.en: Don't tell anyone about this, okay?

别说.zh: 别说你不喜欢，其实大家都看得出来。
别说.en: Don't say you don't like it; actually everyone can tell.

别说.zh: 别说我没提醒你，明天要下雨。
别说.en: Don't say I didn't warn you; it's going to rain tomorrow.

施工.zh: 这栋楼施工了两年才完工。
施工.en: This building took two years of construction to complete.

施工.zh: 因为施工，这条路暂时封闭了。
施工.en: Because of construction, this road is temporarily closed.

施工.zh: 施工的时候一定要注意安全。
施工.en: You must pay attention to safety during construction.

施工.zh: 他们正在施工，所以噪音很大。
施工.en: They are under construction, so the noise is loud.

勿.en: Please do not smoke in the elevator.

勿.zh: 这个警告牌说“请勿靠近”。
勿.en: This warning sign says 'Do not approach'.

激素.en: This hormone is harmful to the body.

激素.zh: 医生让我少用含激素的药。
激素.en: The doctor told me to use less medicine containing hormones.

激素.zh: 激素水平异常会导致很多问题。
激素.en: Abnormal hormone levels can cause many problems.

激素.zh: 她因为激素分泌失调长痘了。
激素.en: She got acne because of a hormone imbalance.

激素.zh: 不要乱吃含激素的保健品。
激素.en: Don't randomly take health supplements containing hormones.

隆重.en: The wedding was held very grandly.

隆重.zh: 学校举行了隆重的毕业典礼。
隆重.en: The school held a grand graduation ceremony.

隆重.zh: 这次会议开得非常隆重。
隆重.en: This meeting was conducted very ceremoniously.

隆重.zh: 他们用隆重的方式欢迎了新领导。
隆重.en: They welcomed the new leader in a grand way.

隆重.zh: 虽然仪式很隆重，但我觉得太正式了。
隆重.en: Although the ceremony was grand, I found it too formal.

破裂.en: The water pipe burst because of aging.

破裂.zh: 谈判破裂后，双方都很失望。
破裂.en: After the negotiations broke down, both sides were disappointed.

破裂.zh: 玻璃杯掉在地上破裂了。
破裂.en: The glass fell on the ground and shattered.

破裂.zh: 因为信任破裂，他们分手了。
破裂.en: They broke up because trust was broken.

废物.en: How should we deal with this waste?
Don't throw waste into the river.

废物.zh: 工厂把废物排进了大海。
废物.en: The factory discharged waste into the sea.

废物.zh: 他觉得自己是个废物，很自卑。
废物.en: He thinks he's worthless and feels very inferior.

迷失.zh: 他在森林里迷失了方向。
迷失.en: He lost his direction in the forest.

迷失.zh: 我迷失在人生的十字路口。
迷失.en: I am lost at the crossroads of life.

迷失.zh: 在陌生的城市里，我们差点迷失。
迷失.en: In the unfamiliar city, we almost got lost.

迷失.zh: 他迷失在网络游戏里无法自拔。
迷失.en: He is lost in online games and can't extricate himself.

体制.zh: 现在的医疗体制有很多问题。
体制.en: The current medical system has many problems.

体制.zh: 不同国家的政治体制不一样。
体制.en: Different countries have different political systems.

体制.zh: 他们想打破旧体制建立新秩序。
体制.en: They want to break the old system and establish a new order.

守护.zh: 警察守护着这个城市的安全。
守护.en: The police guard the safety of this city.

守护.zh: 我们要守护好我们的家园。
守护.en: We must protect our home well.

守护.zh: 他一直守护着这个秘密。
守护.en: He has always kept this secret.

守护.zh: 狗狗会守护主人，非常忠诚。
守护.en: Dogs will guard their owners; they are very loyal.

协商.en: We need to have a good negotiation.

协商.zh: 双方协商了很久，终于达成了协议。
协商.en: The two sides negotiated for a long time and finally reached an agreement.

协商.zh: 这件事需要跟客户再协商，不能急。
协商.en: This matter needs to be discussed with the client again, we can't rush it.

协商.zh: 虽然大家意见不同，但通过协商还是找到了解决办法。
协商.en: Although everyone had different opinions, we still found a solution through negotiation.

协商.zh: 如果协商不成功，我们可能就要走法律程序了。
协商.en: If the negotiation fails, we may have to go through legal proceedings.

视野.en: Reading more can broaden your horizons.

视野.zh: 站在山顶上，视野特别好。
视野.en: Standing on the mountaintop, the view is especially good.

视野.zh: 出国留学让我的视野变得更宽广了。
视野.en: Studying abroad has broadened my horizons.

视野.zh: 这份工作让我接触了很多不同的人，视野也打开了。
视野.en: This job has allowed me to meet many different people and opened up my horizons.

视野.zh: 他只看自己的专业书，视野太窄了，应该多看看别的领域。
视野.en: He only reads books in his own field; his vision is too narrow; he should look at other areas.

委员.en: He is a committee member of our community.

委员.zh: 这次会议所有委员都要参加。
委员.en: All committee members must attend this meeting.

委员.zh: 政协委员提出了很多有用的建议。
委员.en: The CPPCC members put forward many useful suggestions.

委员.zh: 作为委员，他负责监督项目的进展。
委员.en: As a committee member, he is responsible for overseeing the project's progress.

委员.zh: 委员们投票通过了新的规章制度。
委员.en: The committee members voted to pass the new regulations.

蹦.en: Don't jump on the bed, it will break.

蹦.zh: 他一听到好消息就高兴得蹦了起来。
蹦.en: He jumped up happily as soon as he heard the good news.

蹦.zh: 在蹦床上蹦了半小时，他累得满头大汗。
蹦.en: After jumping on the trampoline for half an hour, he was exhausted and sweating.

蹦.zh: 兔子一蹦一跳地跑了，特别可爱。
蹦.en: The rabbit hopped away, very cute.

雷达.zh: 机场的雷达系统很先进。
雷达.en: The airport's radar system is very advanced.

雷达.zh: 蝙蝠靠超声波来当雷达用。
雷达.en: Bats use ultrasound as a kind of radar.

雷达.zh: 这辆车的倒车雷达坏了，得修一下。
雷达.en: The reversing radar on this car is broken; it needs to be fixed.

雷达.zh: 虽然天气很糟，但雷达还是能准确地追踪飞机。
雷达.en: Even though the weather was bad, the radar could still track the plane accurately.

样品.zh: 这个样品是免费提供的。
样品.en: This sample is provided for free.

样品.zh: 我们需要先看样品再决定要不要订货。
样品.en: We need to see a sample first before deciding whether to order.

样品.zh: 新产品的样品已经寄到客户手里了。
样品.en: The sample of the new product has been delivered to the client.

样品.zh: 这批样品的质量跟正式产品不太一样。
样品.en: The quality of these samples is not quite the same as the final product.

关节.en: My knee joint hurts a bit.

关节.zh: 老年人要注意保护关节。
关节.en: Elderly people should pay attention to protecting their joints.

关节.zh: 跑步之前最好活动一下关节。
关节.en: It's best to warm up your joints before running.

关节.zh: 他打球扭到了手腕关节，肿得很厉害。
关节.en: He sprained his wrist joint while playing ball, and it's very swollen.

关节.zh: 天气一变冷，他的关节就酸得不行。
关节.en: When the weather turns cold, his joints ache terribly.

边界.en: This river is the border between the two countries.

边界.zh: 小区南边的边界有一排树。
边界.en: There is a row of trees along the southern boundary of the community.

边界.zh: 我们要尊重彼此的个人边界。
边界.en: We need to respect each other's personal boundaries.

边界.zh: 无人机的飞行不能越过军事区的边界。
边界.en: Drones cannot fly beyond the boundary of the military zone.

边界.zh: 两个村的边界一直有争议，最近终于解决了。
边界.en: The boundary between the two villages had been disputed for a long time, but it was finally resolved recently.

嫌疑.en: He is suspected of committing the crime.

嫌疑.zh: 警察带走了几个有嫌疑的人。
嫌疑.en: The police took away several suspects.

嫌疑.zh: 他最近的行为很可疑，大家都有点嫌疑他。
嫌疑.en: His recent behavior is very suspicious; everyone is a bit suspicious of him.

嫌疑.zh: 虽然证据不足，但他还是摆脱不了嫌疑。
嫌疑.en: Although the evidence is insufficient, he still can't shake off the suspicion.

波动.en: Stock prices have been very volatile recently.

波动.zh: 这个地区的房价一直有波动。
波动.en: Housing prices in this area have been fluctuating.

波动.zh: 因为疫情，全球的经济都出现了波动。
波动.en: Due to the pandemic, the global economy has experienced fluctuations.

波动.zh: 汇率波动对我们的出口生意影响很大。
波动.en: Exchange rate fluctuations have a big impact on our export business.

海盗.zh: 那些海盗抢了很多金子。
海盗.en: Those pirates stole a lot of gold.

海盗.zh: 我们小时候最喜欢玩海盗船的游戏。
海盗.en: When we were kids, we loved playing pirate ship games.

海盗.zh: 电影里的海盗虽然凶恶，但也有自己的原则。
海盗.en: Although the pirates in the movie are fierce, they also have their own principles.

海盗.zh: 听说这片海域最近有海盗出没，渔民都不敢出海了。
海盗.en: I heard that pirates have been active in these waters recently, so fishermen dare not go out to sea.

海盗.zh: 如果遇到海盗，千万不要反抗，保命要紧。
海盗.en: If you encounter pirates, never resist; saving your life is the priority.

往事.zh: 那些往事就不要再提了。
往事.en: Don't mention those past events anymore.

往事.zh: 一看到这张照片，我就想起了许多往事。
往事.en: Seeing this photo reminds me of many past events.

往事.zh: 虽然往事有些痛苦，但也是我成长的一部分。
往事.en: Although some past events are painful, they are also part of my growth.

往事.zh: 他总爱跟我们聊起大学时的往事，每次都笑得很开心。
往事.en: He always loves to talk about his college memories with us, laughing happily every time.

往事.zh: 往事如烟，与其纠结过去不如好好把握现在。
往事.en: Past events are like smoke; instead of dwelling on the past, it's better to seize the present.

与否.zh: 成功与否并不重要，重要的是你尽力了。
与否.en: Whether you succeed or not is not important; what matters is that you did your best.

与否.zh: 这件事的对错与否，我们得好好讨论一下。
与否.en: Whether this matter is right or wrong, we need to discuss it carefully.

与否.zh: 他是否同意与我们合作，取决于条件的好坏与否。
与否.en: Whether he agrees to cooperate with us depends on the conditions being good or not.

与否.zh: 考试通过与否，直接影响到你能不能毕业。
与否.en: Whether you pass the exam or not directly affects whether you can graduate.

与否.zh: 不管结果好坏与否，我们都得勇敢面对。
与否.en: Regardless of whether the result is good or bad, we have to face it bravely.

传言.en: That's just a rumor, don't take it seriously.

传言.zh: 公司要裁员的传言，让大家都人心惶惶。
传言.en: The rumor that the company is going to lay off employees has everyone worried.

传言.zh: 有人说他移民了，但这只是传言，没有证据。
传言.en: Some say he has emigrated, but that's just a rumor without evidence.

传言.zh: 传言未必是假的，但我们在核实之前不能轻信。
传言.en: Rumors aren't necessarily false, but we shouldn't believe them without verification.

传言.zh: 最近关于明星离婚的传言越来越多，也不知道哪个是真的。
传言.en: Recently, there have been more and more rumors about the celebrity's divorce, and I don't know which one is true.

何况.zh: 他连自己都照顾不好，何况照顾别人呢？
何况.en: He can't even take care of himself, let alone take care of others.

何况.zh: 下雨天路都这么难走，何况是大雪天呢？
何况.en: The road is already hard to walk on in rainy weather, let alone in heavy snow.

何况.zh: 这道题连老师都觉得难，何况是我们这些学生呢？
何况.en: Even the teacher finds this problem difficult, let alone us students.

何况.zh: 你平时工作那么忙，何况还要带孩子，肯定很累吧。
何况.en: You're usually so busy with work, let alone having to take care of the kids; it must be very tiring.

何况.zh: 他英语说得这么流利，何况他还自学了法语和德语。
何况.en: He speaks English so fluently, and on top of that, he has also taught himself French and German.

传闻.zh: 关于他的传闻，我听过很多版本。
传闻.en: I've heard many versions of the rumors about him.

传闻.zh: 虽然只是传闻，但我们也得留意一下。
传闻.en: Although it's just a rumor, we still need to pay attention.

传闻.zh: 传闻说他要辞职，但本人还没有出来澄清。
传闻.en: Rumors say he is going to resign, but he hasn't come out to clarify yet.

传闻.zh: 有时候传闻传得太离谱，反而没人当真了。
传闻.en: Sometimes rumors become so absurd that no one takes them seriously anymore.

简称.zh: 北大是北京大学的简称。
简称.en: Beida is the short form of Peking University.

简称.zh: 我们公司全称太长，一般都用简称。
简称.en: Our company's full name is too long, so we generally use the abbreviation.

简称.zh: GDP是国内生产总值的简称，你懂吗？
简称.en: GDP is the abbreviation for gross domestic product, do you understand?

简称.zh: 很多人把人工智能简称为AI，说起来更方便。
简称.en: Many people abbreviate artificial intelligence as AI, which is more convenient to say.

简称.zh: 这种病毒的学名很难记，所以大家习惯用它的简称。
简称.en: The scientific name of this virus is hard to remember, so people are used to using its abbreviation.

发泄.zh: 他打球是为了发泄压力。
发泄.en: He plays ball to relieve stress.

发泄.zh: 心情不好的时候，我喜欢唱歌发泄一下。
发泄.en: When I'm in a bad mood, I like to sing to let off steam.

发泄.zh: 别把情绪发泄在无辜的人身上。
发泄.en: Don't vent your emotions on innocent people.

发泄.zh: 他喝醉了就开始乱骂人，纯粹是在发泄不满。
发泄.en: He starts cursing randomly when he's drunk, purely venting his dissatisfaction.

发泄.zh: 运动是一种很好的发泄方式，比生闷气强多了。
发泄.en: Exercise is a great way to vent, much better than sulking.

预言.zh: 很多人不相信这个预言，觉得太夸张了。
预言.en: Many people don't believe this prophecy, thinking it's too exaggerated.

预言.zh: 科学家预言未来几十年地球温度会继续上升。
预言.en: Scientists predict that the Earth's temperature will continue to rise in the coming decades.

预言.zh: 古书里有一个关于世界末日的预言，但没人知道真假。
预言.en: There is a prophecy about the end of the world in an ancient book, but no one knows if it's true.

预言.zh: 如果他能预言股市涨跌，早就发财了，哪还会在这儿打工。
预言.en: If he could predict stock market fluctuations, he would have gotten rich long ago, not be working here.

失控.en: The car suddenly went out of control.

失控.zh: 他的情绪完全失控，大喊大叫起来。
失控.en: His emotions completely got out of control, and he started shouting.

失控.zh: 大火蔓延得太快，火势已经失控了。
失控.en: The fire spread too quickly, and the situation has gotten out of control.

失控.zh: 如果公司成本继续失控，可能就要倒闭了。
失控.en: If the company's costs continue to spiral out of control, it might go bankrupt.

失控.zh: 玩网络游戏很容易让人时间失控，不知不觉就玩到深夜。
失控.en: Playing online games can easily make you lose track of time, and before you know it, it's late at night.

噪音.zh: 楼上的噪音吵得我睡不着。
噪音.en: The noise from upstairs kept me from sleeping.

噪音.zh: 这里的噪音太大了，我们换个地方吧。
噪音.en: The noise here is too loud; let's change places.

噪音.zh: 虽然噪音很大，但他还是专心看书。
噪音.en: Although the noise was loud, he still focused on reading.

噪音.zh: 隔壁装修的噪音从早到晚没停过。
噪音.en: The renovation noise next door never stopped from morning to night.

噪音.zh: 为了减少噪音，小区规定晚上十点后不许施工。
噪音.en: To reduce noise, the community rules ban construction after 10 p.m.

出动.zh: 警察出动了很多人来找那个孩子。
出动.en: The police dispatched many people to look for that child.

出动.zh: 消防队一接到火警就立即出动。
出动.en: The fire brigade dispatched immediately upon receiving the fire alarm.

出动.zh: 这次演习出动了三架直升机和两艘船。
出动.en: This exercise deployed three helicopters and two boats.

出动.zh: 如果情况恶化，我们会出动更多人手。
出动.en: If the situation worsens, we will dispatch more personnel.

出动.zh: 听说他们全家都出动了，就为了找那只猫。
出动.en: I heard the whole family turned out just to find that cat.

妥协.zh: 我们不能在这种原则问题上妥协。
妥协.en: We cannot compromise on matters of principle like this.

妥协.zh: 经过谈判，双方都做了一些妥协。
妥协.en: After negotiations, both sides made some compromises.

妥协.zh: 他虽然不服气，最后还是妥协了。
妥协.en: Although he was unconvinced, he finally compromised.

妥协.zh: 为了达成协议，老板不得不向工会妥协。
妥协.en: To reach an agreement, the boss had to compromise with the union.

妥协.zh: 如果你们各退一步，互相妥协一下，这事就好办了。
妥协.en: If each of you gives a little and compromises, this matter will be easy to handle.

宁静.en: The park is especially peaceful in the early morning.

宁静.zh: 我喜欢在宁静的夜晚听音乐。
宁静.en: I like listening to music on quiet nights.

宁静.zh: 这个村子远离城市，生活很宁静。
宁静.en: This village is far from the city; life is very tranquil.

宁静.zh: 她需要一段宁静的时间来思考未来。
宁静.en: She needs some quiet time to think about her future.

宁静.zh: 虽然外面很吵，但图书馆里依然一片宁静。
宁静.en: Although it's noisy outside, the library remains perfectly peaceful.

瞪.zh: 他瞪了我一眼，什么也没说。
瞪.en: He gave me a glare and said nothing.
Don't stare; speak calmly if you have something to say.

瞪.zh: 她气得瞪大眼睛看着我。
瞪.en: She was so angry that she stared at me with wide eyes.

瞪.zh: 老师一瞪眼，全班立刻安静了。
瞪.en: The teacher gave a glare, and the whole class immediately quieted down.

瞪.zh: 小男孩瞪着橱窗里的玩具，不肯走。
瞪.en: The little boy stared at the toy in the window and refused to leave.

来回.en: He walked back and forth several times.

来回.zh: 从家到公司来回要两个小时。
来回.en: It takes two hours round trip from home to the office.

来回.zh: 别来回开关门，冷气都跑掉了。
来回.en: Don't open and close the door repeatedly; the cold air will escape.

来回.zh: 他来回看了好几遍那封信，才放下心。
来回.en: He read that letter back and forth several times before feeling relieved.

来回.zh: 我们来回讨论了很久，最后还是没结果。
来回.en: We discussed it back and forth for a long time, but still got no result.

终结.en: The match ended in a draw.

终结.zh: 这段感情最终以分手终结。
终结.en: This relationship ultimately ended in a breakup.

终结.zh: 战争终结后，人们终于回到了家乡。
终结.en: After the war ended, people finally returned to their hometowns.

终结.zh: 这本书的结局很意外，终结得有点突然。
终结.en: The ending of this book was surprising; it ended rather abruptly.

终结.zh: 再长的旅行也有终结的一天。
终结.en: Even the longest journey has a day of ending.

可恶.en: Darn, I forgot to bring my keys again.

可恶.zh: 他居然说这种话，太可恶了。
可恶.en: He actually said something like that—how despicable!

可恶.zh: 那个小偷专偷老人的钱，真是可恶至极。
可恶.en: That thief specifically steals from old people—absolutely detestable.

可恶.zh: 最可恶的是他做了错事还死不承认。
可恶.en: The most infuriating thing is that he did wrong and still refused to admit it.

泡沫.en: This glass of beer is full of foam.

泡沫.zh: 那个投资项目最后变成了泡沫。
泡沫.en: That investment project eventually turned into a bubble.

泡沫.zh: 经济泡沫破裂后，很多人失去了工作。
泡沫.en: After the economic bubble burst, many people lost their jobs.

泡沫.zh: 孩子喜欢在浴缸里玩泡沫。
泡沫.en: Kids like to play with bubbles in the bathtub.

谴责.zh: 各国都谴责这种暴力行为。
谴责.en: All countries condemned this violent act.

谴责.zh: 他的言论遭到了网友的强烈谴责。
谴责.en: His remarks were strongly condemned by netizens.

谴责.zh: 联合国发表声明谴责袭击事件。
谴责.en: The UN issued a statement condemning the attack.

谴责.zh: 我们谴责一切形式的歧视和偏见。
谴责.en: We condemn all forms of discrimination and prejudice.

谴责.zh: 虽然很多人谴责他，但他觉得自己没错。
谴责.en: Although many people condemned him, he felt he was not wrong.

分歧.en: There is no disagreement between us.

分歧.zh: 虽然大家有分歧，但最后还是达成了共识。
分歧.en: Although everyone had differences, in the end we reached consensus.

分歧.zh: 这件事上的分歧让他很头疼。
分歧.en: The disagreement on this matter gave him a headache.

分歧.zh: 他们的分歧越来越大了。
因为意见分歧，会议推迟了。
分歧.en: Because of differing opinions, the meeting was postponed.

烟花.en: Set off fireworks on New Year's Eve.

烟花.zh: 烟花在夜空中绽放，很美。
烟花.en: Fireworks bloom in the night sky, very beautiful.

烟花.zh: 每年春节我们都去广场看烟花表演。
烟花.en: Every Spring Festival we go to the square to watch the fireworks show.

烟花.zh: 虽然烟花很漂亮，但要注意安全。
烟花.en: Although fireworks are very beautiful, we need to pay attention to safety.

纠缠.en: He was entangled by debt for a long time.

纠缠.zh: 这件事一直纠缠着他，让他睡不好觉。
纠缠.en: This matter has been bothering him, making it hard for him to sleep.
Those two are always entangled and unclear.

纠缠.zh: 如果你不解释清楚，他会一直纠缠下去。
纠缠.en: If you don't explain clearly, he will keep pestering.

海报.zh: 教室里贴满了电影海报。
海报.en: The classroom is covered with movie posters.

海报.zh: 他花了一下午设计活动的海报。
海报.en: He spent an afternoon designing the poster for the event.

海报.zh: 海报上写着演唱会时间。
海报.en: The poster says the concert time.

海报.zh: 因为海报设计得很吸引人，所以很多学生都来报名。
海报.en: Because the poster design was attractive, many students signed up.

机密.zh: 机密的文件不能随便给别人看。
机密.en: Confidential documents cannot be shown to others casually.

机密.zh: 他因为泄露了国家机密而被捕了。
机密.en: He was arrested for leaking state secrets.

机密.zh: 虽然他是老员工，但也无权查看这些机密信息。
机密.en: Although he is a senior employee, he is not authorized to view this confidential information.

绳子.zh: 他用绳子把箱子捆好了。
绳子.en: He tied the box with a rope.

绳子.zh: 爬山的时候一定要带一根结实的绳子。
绳子.en: When climbing a mountain, you must bring a sturdy rope.

绳子.zh: 绳子断了，东西掉了一地。
绳子.en: The rope broke, and things fell all over.

绳子.zh: 如果你找不到绳子，可以用胶带代替。
绳子.en: If you can't find a rope, you can use tape instead.

剧情.zh: 电影剧情很吸引人，我看得入迷了。
剧情.en: The movie plot is very engaging; I was hooked.

剧情.zh: 虽然剧情有点老套，但演员演得很好。
剧情.en: Although the plot is a bit cliché, the actors performed well.

剧情.zh: 因为剧情反转太多，观众都惊呆了。
剧情.en: Because there were too many plot twists, the audience was stunned.

灿烂.en: The sun is shining bright, perfect to go out.

灿烂.zh: 烟花在夜空中绽放，灿烂夺目。
灿烂.en: Fireworks bloom in the night sky, brilliant and dazzling.

灿烂.zh: 虽然生活不总是一帆风顺，但我们要保持灿烂的笑容。
灿烂.en: Although life is not always smooth, we should keep a bright smile.

自行.zh: 这个问题要你自行解决。
自行.en: You need to solve this problem on your own.

自行.zh: 如果不确定如何使用，请自行查阅说明书。
自行.en: If unsure how to use, please consult the manual yourself.

自行.zh: 由于时间有限，大家需要自行安排行程。
自行.en: Due to limited time, everyone needs to arrange their own itinerary.

拘留.zh: 警方依法拘留了嫌疑人。
拘留.en: The police detained the suspect according to law.

拘留.zh: 酒后驾驶会被处以行政拘留。
拘留.en: Drunk driving can result in administrative detention.

拘留.zh: 虽然他只是初犯，但还是被拘留了十五天。
拘留.en: Although it was his first offense, he was still detained for 15 days.

孕妇.en: That pregnant woman needs to rest.

孕妇.zh: 我姐姐是孕妇，她每天都吃很多水果。
孕妇.en: My sister is pregnant, she eats a lot of fruit every day.

孕妇.zh: 虽然她是孕妇，但她还是坚持工作。
孕妇.en: Although she is pregnant, she still insists on working.

孕妇.zh: 孕妇在公交车上应该有人让座。
孕妇.en: Pregnant women should be offered seats on the bus.

孕妇.zh: 医生建议孕妇多喝牛奶补钙。
孕妇.en: Doctors advise pregnant women to drink more milk for calcium.

怀着.en: She has to go to work while pregnant.

怀着.zh: 我们怀着激动的心情等待结果。
怀着.en: We are waiting for the results with excitement.

怀着.zh: 他怀着感恩的心帮助别人。
怀着.en: He helps others with a grateful heart.

怀着.zh: 我怀着忐忑不安的心情去了考场。
怀着.en: I went to the exam hall with an uneasy feeling.

怀着.zh: 她怀着对未来的憧憬努力学习。
怀着.en: She studies hard with hope for the future.

腔.en: He speaks with a bit of a Shandong accent.
This child's singing style is very pleasant.
My nasal cavity is inflamed, it's very uncomfortable.

腔.zh: 他满腔热情地投入工作。
腔.en: He threw himself into work with full enthusiasm.

腔.zh: 你别用这种腔调跟我说话。
腔.en: Don't talk to me in that tone.

复合.en: They broke up and then got back together.

复合.zh: 这种复合维生素片很有效。
复合.en: This multivitamin tablet is very effective.

复合.zh: 这个词是复合词，由两个词组成。
复合.en: This word is a compound word, made up of two words.

复合.zh: 经过治疗，他的骨折慢慢复合了。
复合.en: After treatment, his fracture slowly healed.

复合.zh: 他们复合后感情更好了。
复合.en: After they got back together, their relationship improved.

切断.en: Please cut off the power before repairing.

切断.zh: 洪水切断了村庄的道路。
切断.en: The flood cut off the village's roads.

切断.zh: 他切断了和过去的联系。
切断.en: He severed ties with the past.

切断.zh: 我们要切断敌人的补给线。
切断.en: We need to cut off the enemy's supply lines.

切断.zh: 别切断电话，我还没说完。
切断.en: Don't hang up, I'm not finished yet.

下场.en: He did bad things and ended up miserably.

下场.zh: 赌博的人一般没有好下场。
下场.en: People who gamble usually come to no good end.
This is what happens when you lie.

下场.zh: 如果继续这样，你的下场会很糟糕。
下场.en: If you keep this up, you'll end up badly.

下场.zh: 我看他迟早会落得个悲惨下场。
下场.en: I think he will eventually meet a tragic end.

匹配.zh: 这个零件和那个不匹配。
匹配.en: This part doesn't match that one.

匹配.zh: 我们需要找一款匹配的软件。
匹配.en: We need to find a compatible software.

匹配.zh: 他的能力和职位不匹配。
匹配.en: His ability doesn't match the position.

气象.zh: 今天的气象预报说会下雨。
气象.en: Today's weather forecast says it will rain.
He works at the meteorological bureau.

气象.zh: 这座山的气象变化很大。
气象.en: The weather on this mountain changes dramatically.
The new year has arrived, everything takes on a new look.

气象.zh: 气象卫星可以预测台风。

傲.en: He is too arrogant, no one likes him.

傲.zh: 虽然成绩好，但他一点也不傲。
傲.en: Although he has good grades, he is not arrogant at all.
She is a very proud girl.
He is as proud as a peacock.
One should not be too proud; be humble.

介意.en: Do you mind if I smoke?
I don't mind waiting a while.
He minds when others say he is short.
Do you mind opening the window?

介意.zh: 她介意男朋友迟到，所以生气了。
介意.en: She minded that her boyfriend was late, so she got angry.

编号.en: Please write the serial number here.

编号.zh: 这个产品的编号是多少？
我忘了订单编号，需要查一下。
编号.en: I forgot the order number and need to check it.

编号.zh: 你记得上次会议的文件编号吗？
编号.en: Do you remember the document number from the last meeting?

编号.zh: 因为编号重复，系统报错了，我们得重新分配。
编号.en: Because the numbers are duplicated, the system reported an error and we have to reassign them.

一体.zh: 这个设计是机壳和屏幕一体的。
