一体.en: This design integrates the case and the screen.

一体.zh: 公司各部门应该形成一体。
一体.en: All departments of the company should be unified.

一体.zh: 他们俩配合默契，仿佛一体。
一体.en: The two of them work in perfect harmony, as if one body.

一体.zh: 只要大家团结一体，就没有克服不了的困难。
一体.en: As long as everyone is united as one, there is no difficulty that cannot be overcome.

原地.zh: 他吓得站在原地不敢动。
原地.en: He was so scared that he stood still, not daring to move.

原地.zh: 教练让我们原地跑步五分钟。
原地.en: The coach had us jog in place for five minutes.

原地.zh: 遇到危险时，最好先原地观察。
原地.en: When in danger, it's best to first observe from where you are.

原地.zh: 如果迷路了，就原地休息，等我来接你。
原地.en: If you get lost, just stay put and rest, and wait for me to pick you up.

辩.en: I don't want to argue with you.
They argued for a long time without any result.

辩.zh: 你辩不过他，还是算了吧。
辩.en: You can't out-argue him, just give up.
What's there to argue about this?

辩.zh: 我们来辩一辩这个问题，看谁更有道理。
辩.en: Let's debate this issue and see who makes more sense.

巧合.en: We arrived at the same time — what a coincidence.

巧合.zh: 巧合的是，我们居然同一天生日。
巧合.en: Coincidentally, we actually have the same birthday.

巧合.zh: 世界上有很多无法解释的巧合。
巧合.en: There are many unexplainable coincidences in the world.

巧合.zh: 如果不是巧合，那一定是有人在背后安排。
巧合.en: If it's not a coincidence, then someone must have arranged it behind the scenes.

古怪.zh: 那个老人脾气有点古怪。
古怪.en: That old man has a somewhat eccentric temper.

古怪.zh: 这件事听起来太古怪了。
她最近总是穿一些古怪的衣服。
古怪.en: Lately she always wears some weird clothes.

古怪.zh: 虽然他的想法很古怪，但有时候还挺有道理。
古怪.en: Even though his ideas are strange, sometimes they actually make sense.

岩石.zh: 海边有很多黑色的岩石。
岩石.en: There are many black rocks by the seaside.

岩石.zh: 登山时要注意脚下的岩石。
岩石.en: When climbing, be careful of the rocks underfoot.

岩石.zh: 科学家在研究这些古老的岩石。
岩石.en: Scientists are studying these ancient rocks.

岩石.zh: 因为岩石太滑，我差点摔了一跤。
岩石.en: Because the rocks were too slippery, I almost fell.

裹.zh: 外面太冷，把自己裹严实了。
裹.en: It's too cold outside, wrap yourself up tightly.

裹.zh: 她把伤口用绷带裹了好几层。
裹.en: She wrapped the wound with several layers of bandage.

裹.zh: 这个寿司是用海苔裹的。
裹.en: This sushi is wrapped in seaweed.

裹.zh: 要是觉得冷，就多裹一条围巾出门。
裹.en: If you feel cold, wrap an extra scarf around yourself before going out.

克隆.en: Dolly the cloned sheep is very famous.

克隆.zh: 科学家成功克隆了一只猫。
现在克隆技术越来越成熟了。
克隆.en: Cloning technology is becoming more and more mature now.

克隆.zh: 克隆人一直是个有争议的话题。
克隆.en: Human cloning has always been a controversial topic.

克隆.zh: 虽然克隆动物很常见，但克隆人类仍被禁止。
克隆.en: Although cloning animals is common, cloning humans is still prohibited.

皱.zh: 这件衬衫皱了，得熨一下。
皱.en: This shirt is wrinkled; it needs to be ironed.
If the paper is wrinkled, it's not good for writing.

皱.zh: 她笑得太多，眼角都皱了。
皱.en: She laughs so much that the corners of her eyes are wrinkled.

豹.zh: 猎豹是陆地上最快的动物。
豹.en: Cheetahs are the fastest animals on land.

豹.zh: 虽然豹很凶猛，但是它们也怕狮子。
豹.en: Although leopards are fierce, they are also afraid of lions.

豹.zh: 我在动物园看到一只黑色的豹。
豹.en: I saw a black leopard at the zoo.

豹.zh: 豹的斑点花纹非常漂亮。
豹.en: The spots and patterns of a leopard are very beautiful.

流泪.en: She was so moved that she shed tears.

流泪.zh: 看到电影结局我忍不住流泪。
流泪.en: I couldn't help crying when I saw the ending of the movie.

流泪.zh: 他一边流泪一边讲述自己的经历。
流泪.en: He told his story while shedding tears.

流泪.zh: 孩子摔倒了，疼得直流泪。
流泪.en: The child fell down and cried from the pain.

流泪.zh: 虽然他很坚强，但听到这个消息还是流泪了。
流泪.en: Although he is strong, he still shed tears upon hearing the news.

直至.en: He worked until late at night.

直至.zh: 这条路一直走直至尽头。
直至.en: Walk straight along this road until the end.

直至.zh: 我一直在等他，直至天黑才离开。
直至.en: I kept waiting for him and didn't leave until dark.

直至.zh: 他们聊天直至凌晨三点。
直至.en: They chatted until three in the morning.

直至.zh: 因为堵车，我们直至晚上八点才到家。
直至.en: Because of the traffic jam, we didn't get home until 8 p.m.

出身.en: He comes from a poor family.
She was born into a family of musicians.

出身.zh: 无论出身如何，只要努力就能成功。
出身.en: No matter what your background is, as long as you work hard, you can succeed.

出身.zh: 很多人因为出身不好而自卑。
出身.en: Many people feel inferior because of their poor family background.

出身.zh: 虽然他出身普通，但靠自己的努力成了老板。
出身.en: Although he came from an ordinary family, he became a boss through his own efforts.

何处.zh: 请问此处何处可以停车？
何处.en: Excuse me, where can I park here?

何处.zh: 我不知道他此刻身在何处。
何处.en: I don't know where he is right now.

何处.zh: 无论你身在何处，我都会想念你。
何处.en: No matter where you are, I will miss you.

何处.zh: 如果迷路了，你要知道何处可以求助。
何处.en: If you get lost, you need to know where you can ask for help.

头号.zh: 这家餐厅是城里头号热门。
头号.en: This restaurant is the hottest spot in town.

头号.zh: 她是我们公司的头号销售员。
头号.en: She is the top salesperson in our company.

头号.zh: 健康是人生的头号大事。
头号.en: Health is the number one priority in life.

头号.zh: 因为表现优异，他成了头号种子选手。
头号.en: Because of his outstanding performance, he became the top seed player.

王国.en: There is a magical kingdom in the fairy tale.

王国.zh: 他梦想建立一个自己的王国。
王国.en: He dreams of building his own kingdom.

王国.zh: 狮子是草原王国的国王。
王国.en: The lion is the king of the grassland kingdom.

王国.zh: 虽然国家不大，但人民把这里当作幸福的王国。
王国.en: Although the country is small, the people regard it as a kingdom of happiness.

墨.en: The ink bottle was knocked over.
My fountain pen is out of ink.
He dipped a brush in ink to write big characters.
Ink stains are hard to wash clean.

墨.zh: 如果不小心洒了墨，衣服就毁了。
墨.en: If you accidentally spill ink, the clothes will be ruined.

丢掉.en: I threw away the old clothes.

丢掉.zh: 他匆匆忙忙丢掉了钥匙。

丢掉.en: You can only make progress if you get rid of bad habits.

丢掉.zh: 因为搬家，我丢掉了很多不用的东西。
丢掉.en: Because of moving, I threw away a lot of unused things.

动静.zh: 大家安静，听对面房间的动静。
动静.en: Everyone be quiet and listen to the sounds from the room opposite.

动静.zh: 这件事闹出了很大动静。
动静.en: This matter caused a big stir.

动静.zh: 如果听到任何动静，请马上通知我。
动静.en: If you hear any movement or sound, please notify me immediately.

授予.zh: 公司授予他最佳员工奖。
授予.en: The company awarded him the best employee prize.

授予.zh: 学校授予毕业证书的时候特别隆重。
授予.en: It was very grand when the school conferred the graduation certificates.

授予.zh: 虽然他没参赛，组委会还是授予他特别荣誉。
授予.en: Although he didn't compete, the committee still awarded him a special honor.

授予.zh: 这次比赛授予冠军一辆新车。
授予.en: This competition awards the champion a new car.

授予.zh: 老师授予我优秀学生称号后，我特别开心。
授予.en: After the teacher conferred the title of outstanding student on me, I was really happy.

赴.en: He is going to Shanghai for a meeting tomorrow.

赴.zh: 我今晚要赴一个重要的约会。
赴.en: I have an important date to go to tonight.

赴.zh: 因为工作原因，他不得不赴国外出差。
赴.en: Due to work reasons, he has to go abroad on a business trip.

赴.zh: 虽然天气不好，她还是决定赴约。
赴.en: Even though the weather is bad, she still decided to go to the appointment.

赴.zh: 她赴美国留学后很少回来。
赴.en: After she went to the US to study, she rarely comes back.

下令.en: The boss gave an order to work overtime tomorrow.

下令.zh: 政府下令关闭所有酒吧。
下令.en: The government ordered all bars to close.

下令.zh: 总经理刚刚下令，所有人必须戴口罩。
下令.en: The general manager just ordered everyone to wear masks.

下令.zh: 因为情况紧急，上级下令立即撤离。
下令.en: Because the situation was urgent, the superiors ordered an immediate evacuation.

直觉.zh: 我的直觉告诉我这件事有问题。
直觉.en: My intuition tells me there's something wrong with this.

直觉.zh: 她靠直觉做出了正确的选择。
直觉.en: She relied on intuition to make the right choice.

直觉.zh: 虽然没什么证据，但我直觉觉得他是好人。
直觉.en: Although there's no evidence, my gut feeling says he's a good person.

直觉.zh: 我本来想选A，但直觉说选B，结果对了。
直觉.en: I originally wanted to choose A, but intuition said choose B, and it turned out right.
Intuition is very accurate; you should trust it.

诊所.en: I went to the clinic downstairs.

诊所.zh: 这家诊所的医生看病很细心。
诊所.en: The doctors at this clinic are very thorough.

诊所.zh: 因为只是小感冒，我就去了附近的小诊所。
诊所.en: Since it was just a minor cold, I went to a small clinic nearby.

诊所.zh: 如果觉得不舒服，就去诊所看看。
诊所.en: If you feel unwell, go to the clinic and get checked.

诊所.zh: 诊所开门了吗？我想拿点药。
诊所.en: Is the clinic open? I want to get some medicine.

掐.zh: 时间掐得刚刚好，我们没迟到。
掐.en: We timed it perfectly and weren't late.

掐.zh: 虽然想说话，但他把电话掐断了。
掐.en: Although he wanted to talk, he hung up the phone.

掐.zh: 你掐一下我的胳膊试试。

前线.en: He volunteered to go to the front line.

前线.zh: 这些物资要尽快送到前线。
前线.en: These supplies need to be sent to the front line as soon as possible.

前线.zh: 新闻记者在前线报道最新战况。
前线.en: The news reporter is reporting the latest battle situation from the front line.

前线.zh: 虽然危险，但他还是选择留在前线。
前线.en: Even though it's dangerous, he still chose to stay on the front line.

前线.zh: 前线需要支援，快派人过去。
前线.en: The front line needs reinforcements; send people over quickly.

忠实.en: He is very loyal to his work.
This dog is very faithful to its owner.

忠实.zh: 作为忠实粉丝，他每场演唱会都去。
忠实.en: As a loyal fan, he goes to every concert.

忠实.zh: 虽然他离开公司了，但依然忠实于原来的老板。
忠实.en: Although he left the company, he is still loyal to his former boss.

忠实.zh: 忠实的朋友很难得，要珍惜。
忠实.en: A loyal friend is hard to come by; you should cherish them.

亲近.en: She easily gets close to people.
Those two have a very close relationship.

亲近.zh: 我想跟新同事多亲近亲近。
亲近.en: I want to get closer to my new colleagues.

亲近.zh: 虽然性格不同，但他们越走越亲近。
亲近.en: Although their personalities are different, they are getting closer and closer.

亲近.zh: 别跟我太亲近，保持距离。
亲近.en: Don't get too close to me; keep your distance.

延.en: The holiday was extended by three days.
The performance was postponed for a week.

延.zh: 因为下雨，活动延到明天再办。
延.en: Because of rain, the event has been postponed to tomorrow.

延.zh: 虽然大家都反对，但他还是把截止日期延了。
延.en: Even though everyone opposed it, he still extended the deadline.

延.zh: 时间延了，我们不用那么急。
延.en: The time has been extended; we don't need to be in such a hurry.

战役.zh: 他为了升职，打了一场硬仗，就像一场个人战役。
战役.en: He fought a tough battle for promotion, like a personal campaign.

战役.zh: 公司为了上市打了一场没有硝烟的战役。
战役.en: The company fought a war without gunpowder to go public.

战役.zh: 虽然我们赢了这场战役，但损失也很惨重。
战役.en: Although we won this battle, the losses were also heavy.

战役.zh: 那场战役之后，整个城市都变成了废墟。
战役.en: After that battle, the whole city turned into ruins.

缓.en: Let's slow down and talk later.

缓.zh: 医生让他缓一缓再下床。
缓.en: The doctor told him to take it easy before getting out of bed.

缓.zh: 车速太慢了，你稍微缓一下油门。
缓.en: The car is going too slow; ease up on the accelerator a little.

缓.zh: 为了缓和他尴尬的心情，我开了个玩笑。
缓.en: To ease his awkward mood, I made a joke.

缓.zh: 这件事先缓一缓，等我们有空再处理。
缓.en: Let's put this matter on hold and deal with it when we have time.

坦白.zh: 他坦白了自己犯下的错误。
坦白.en: He confessed to the mistake he made.

坦白.zh: 坦白说，我不太喜欢这种工作。
坦白.en: To be honest, I don't really like this kind of work.

坦白.zh: 如果你坦白交代，我们可以从轻处理。
坦白.en: If you confess honestly, we can give you a lighter punishment.

坦白.zh: 他最终向警方坦白了一切，心里轻松多了。
坦白.en: He finally confessed everything to the police and felt much more relieved.

社会主义.zh: 我们国家走的是社会主义道路。
社会主义.en: Our country follows the socialist path.

社会主义.zh: 社会主义的核心价值观你知道吗？
社会主义.en: Do you know the core values of socialism?

社会主义.zh: 他一直坚信社会主义能带领人民走向共同富裕。
社会主义.en: He always believed that socialism can lead the people to common prosperity.

社会主义.zh: 小时候课本上总说社会主义是最高理想。
社会主义.en: When I was a child, textbooks always said socialism is the highest ideal.

掩护.en: You guys go first, I'll cover you.

掩护.zh: 他用书包掩护自己，免得被砸到。
掩护.en: He used his schoolbag as cover to avoid being hit.

掩护.zh: 这场雨正好掩护了我们潜入大楼的行动。
掩护.en: The rain just happened to cover our infiltration into the building.

掩护.zh: 在队友的掩护下，他成功投篮得分。
掩护.en: Under his teammate's cover, he successfully made the shot and scored.

胎儿.zh: 孕妇要多补充营养，对胎儿发育好。
胎儿.en: Pregnant women should take more nutrients, which is good for fetal development.

胎儿.zh: 医生通过B超检查胎儿的健康状况。
胎儿.en: The doctor checks the fetus's health through an ultrasound.

胎儿.zh: 吸烟对胎儿的影响非常大，准妈妈一定要戒烟。
胎儿.en: Smoking has a huge impact on the fetus, so expectant mothers must quit.

胎儿.zh: 她怀孕五个月了，胎儿踢她的时候她特别开心。
胎儿.en: She is five months pregnant, and she is especially happy when the fetus kicks her.

虐待.zh: 那个孩子长期被父母虐待，太可怜了。
虐待.en: That child has been abused by his parents for a long time, so pitiful.

虐待.zh: 虐待老人是违法的行为。
虐待.en: Abusing the elderly is an illegal act.

虐待.zh: 他因为虐待囚犯被判了刑。
虐待.en: He was sentenced for abusing prisoners.

虐待.zh: 听说那家公司的员工经常被老板言语虐待。
虐待.en: I heard that the employees of that company are often verbally abused by the boss.

政权.en: The regime is very stable now.

政权.zh: 历史上的政权更迭往往伴随着战争。
政权.en: Historical regime changes are often accompanied by war.

政权.zh: 这个政权得到了大多数民众的支持。
政权.en: This regime has the support of the majority of the people.

政权.zh: 新政权上台后，推出一系列改革措施。
政权.en: After the new regime came to power, it introduced a series of reform measures.

政权.zh: 他们试图用暴力推翻现政权，但没有成功。
政权.en: They tried to overthrow the current regime by violence but failed.

宣言.en: They issued a declaration of independence.

宣言.zh: 这份宣言表达了他们的决心。
公司在年会上宣读了新的企业宣言。
宣言.en: The company read out a new corporate declaration at the annual meeting.

宣言.zh: 他的竞选宣言很吸引人，但能不能做到是另外一回事。
宣言.en: His campaign declaration is very attractive, but whether he can deliver is another matter.

宣言.zh: 在签署和平宣言之前，双方还在激烈争吵。
宣言.en: Before signing the peace declaration, the two sides were still arguing fiercely.

瘾.zh: 打游戏上瘾可不是什么好事。
瘾.en: Getting addicted to playing games is not a good thing.

瘾.zh: 她戒了酒，但咖啡瘾还是戒不掉。
瘾.en: She quit drinking, but she can't kick the coffee addiction.

瘾.zh: 玩手机上瘾会影响学习和睡眠。
瘾.en: Addiction to playing on the phone can affect studying and sleep.

瘾.zh: 我最近对奶茶上瘾了，每天都想喝一杯。
瘾.en: I've been addicted to milk tea lately; I want a cup every day.

窒息.zh: 房间里太闷了，感觉要窒息。
窒息.en: The room is so stuffy, I feel like I'm suffocating.

窒息.zh: 这种压力真的让人窒息，我快受不了了。
窒息.en: This kind of pressure is really suffocating, I can't stand it anymore.

窒息.zh: 他被浓烟呛得几乎窒息，幸好及时被救了出来。
窒息.en: He was almost suffocated by the thick smoke, but luckily was rescued in time.

窒息.zh: 虽然空气很新鲜，但他说那种压抑的气氛让他感到窒息。
窒息.en: Although the air was fresh, he said the oppressive atmosphere made him feel suffocated.

窒息.zh: 如果你一直把自己关在房间里，不出去走走，迟早会窒息的。
窒息.en: If you keep locking yourself in your room and never go out, you'll eventually suffocate.

漆.en: This door was just painted, don't touch it.

漆.zh: 家里装修，漆的味道特别大。
漆.en: The house is being renovated, the smell of paint is very strong.

漆.zh: 他买了一罐黑漆，打算把旧书架翻新一下。
漆.en: He bought a can of black paint, planning to refurbish the old bookshelf.

漆.zh: 虽然漆还没干，但他已经急着把画挂上去了。
漆.en: Even though the paint isn't dry yet, he's already eager to hang the painting.

漆.zh: 工人说这种环保漆没什么异味，刷完就能住人。
漆.en: The worker said this eco-friendly paint has no smell and you can move in right after painting.

赞美.zh: 老师赞美了他今天的表现。
赞美.en: The teacher praised his performance today.

赞美.zh: 她听到别人的赞美，心里很开心。
赞美.en: She felt happy when she heard others' praise.

赞美.zh: 大家都赞美这家的菜很好吃，我下次还要来。
赞美.en: Everyone praised the food here as delicious, I'll come again next time.

赞美.zh: 虽然他很害羞，但收到那么多赞美还是很高兴。
赞美.en: Although he was very shy, he was still very happy to receive so much praise.

赞美.zh: 不要只等着别人的赞美，你自己也要学会肯定自己。
赞美.en: Don't just wait for others' praise, you also need to learn to affirm yourself.

虚假.zh: 他的笑容很虚假，一看就是装的。
虚假.en: His smile was very fake, obviously put on.

虚假.zh: 这些广告里的承诺太虚假了，不能信。
虚假.en: The promises in these ads are too false, can't be trusted.

虚假.zh: 我觉得他说的理由很虚假，一定在骗人。
虚假.en: I think the reason he gave is very false, he must be lying.

虚假.zh: 在这个圈子里，虚假的友谊比真心的多得多。
虚假.en: In this circle, fake friendships far outnumber genuine ones.

虚假.zh: 如果一个人总是表现得很虚假，时间久了大家都会发现的。
虚假.en: If a person always acts fake, everyone will find out over time.

永久.zh: 这不是永久的，只是暂时的。
永久.en: This is not permanent, just temporary.

永久.zh: 他们想把这段友谊变成永久的。
永久.en: They want to make this friendship permanent.

永久.zh: 这张照片会永久保存在我的手机里。
永久.en: This photo will be permanently saved in my phone.

永久.zh: 他说要给你永久的幸福，可我不太信。
永久.en: He said he wants to give you eternal happiness, but I don't really believe it.

永久.zh: 虽然世界上没有什么是永久的，但美好的回忆可以留很久。
永久.en: Although nothing in the world is permanent, good memories can last a long time.

强势.zh: 她性格很强势，没人敢反对。
强势.en: She has a very strong personality, no one dares to oppose her.

强势.zh: 在谈判中，对方表现得很强势。
强势.en: During the negotiation, the other side acted very assertively.

强势.zh: 虽然他平时很强势，但遇到老婆就没辙了。
强势.en: Although he is usually very domineering, he is helpless when it comes to his wife.

强势.zh: 公司里那个部门太强势了，其他部门都得让着他们。
强势.en: That department in the company is too aggressive, other departments have to give in to them.

强势.zh: 强势的领导有时候能推动事情，但也容易让人不舒服。
强势.en: A strong leader can sometimes push things forward, but it's also easy to make people uncomfortable.

伸手.en: Don't reach out to touch that thing.
He reached out trying to hold my hand.

伸手.zh: 遇到困难时，她从不轻易向人伸手求助。
伸手.en: When encountering difficulties, she never easily reaches out to ask for help.

伸手.zh: 小孩子看到好吃的就伸手去抓，拦都拦不住。
伸手.en: When kids see something tasty, they just reach out to grab it, can't stop them.

伸手.zh: 他伸手从口袋里拿出钱包，付了钱就走了。
伸手.en: He reached into his pocket, took out his wallet, paid, and left.

一瞬间.zh: 那一瞬间，我什么都忘了。
一瞬间.en: In that instant, I forgot everything.

一瞬间.zh: 飞机起飞的一瞬间，我的心跳加快了。
一瞬间.en: The moment the plane took off, my heartbeat sped up.

一瞬间.zh: 就在他转身的一瞬间，她看到了他眼里的泪。
一瞬间.en: Just as he turned around, she saw the tears in his eyes.

一瞬间.zh: 有时候改变命运的就是那一瞬间的决定。
一瞬间.en: Sometimes it's the decision in that one instant that changes your fate.

一瞬间.zh: 烟花爆炸的一瞬间，整个天空都被照亮了。
一瞬间.en: The moment the fireworks exploded, the whole sky was lit up.

种族.zh: 我们学校有很多不同的种族。
种族.en: There are many different races in our school.

种族.zh: 他写了一本书，讨论种族平等的问题。
种族.en: He wrote a book discussing the issue of racial equality.

种族.zh: 虽然种族不同，但他们成了最好的朋友。
种族.en: Although they are of different races, they became best friends.

种族.zh: 在这个国家，各种族的人都能和平相处。
种族.en: In this country, people of all races can live together peacefully.

扭曲.zh: 他的脸因为疼痛而扭曲了。
镜子里的影像看起来扭曲了。
扭曲.en: The image in the mirror looks distorted.

扭曲.zh: 他故意扭曲事实，想骗大家。
扭曲.en: He deliberately twisted the facts to fool everyone.

扭曲.zh: 有些新闻报道会扭曲真相，不能全信。
扭曲.en: Some news reports distort the truth, you can't believe them all.

扭曲.zh: 这个雕塑的形状很扭曲，给人一种奇怪的感觉。
扭曲.en: The shape of this sculpture is very twisted, giving off a strange feeling.

人情.en: I don't want to owe anyone a favor.

人情.zh: 因为人情关系，他得到了这个工作。
人情.en: Because of personal connections, he got this job.

人情.zh: 在中国，人情往来是很正常的事情。
人情.en: In China, exchanging favors is very normal.

人情.zh: 办这种事得懂点人情世故。
人情.en: To handle this, you need to know a bit about social etiquette.

民办.en: This is a private primary school.

民办.zh: 他选择去民办学校读书。
民办.en: He chose to study at a private school.

民办.zh: 虽然民办，但教学质量很高。
民办.en: Although privately run, the teaching quality is high.

民办.zh: 民办医院的收费比公立医院贵。
民办.en: Private hospitals charge more than public ones.

民办.zh: 现在很多民办教育机构做得不错。
民办.en: Many private educational institutions are doing well now.

编剧.zh: 那部电影的编剧得了奖。
编剧.en: The screenwriter of that movie won an award.

编剧.zh: 我和编剧讨论了一下剧情。
编剧.en: I discussed the plot with the screenwriter.

编剧.zh: 因为编剧写得好，这部剧很火。
编剧.en: Because the script was well-written, this show became popular.

处方.zh: 医生给我开了一个处方。
处方.en: The doctor gave me a prescription.

处方.zh: 没有处方不能买这种药。
处方.en: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription.

处方.zh: 她拿着处方去药房拿药。
处方.en: She took the prescription to the pharmacy to get medicine.

处方.zh: 这种药是处方药，不能乱吃。
处方.en: This is a prescription drug, you can't take it casually.

碰上.en: I ran into him on the road.

碰上.zh: 今天早上我碰上了堵车。
碰上.en: I ran into a traffic jam this morning.

碰上.zh: 没想到会在这儿碰上你。
碰上.en: I didn't expect to run into you here.

碰上.zh: 她最近碰上了很多麻烦事。
碰上.en: She's been running into a lot of troubles recently.

碰上.zh: 因为碰上下雨，我们没去公园。
碰上.en: Because we encountered rain, we didn't go to the park.

安定.zh: 我们需要一个安定的环境。
社会安定对发展很重要。
安定.en: Social stability is important for development.

安定.zh: 他工作安定之后才结了婚。
安定.en: He got married only after he had a stable job.

安定.zh: 这个城市一直很安定，很少出事。
安定.en: This city has always been stable, rarely incidents.

默契.en: We two have a good tacit understanding.
They cooperate with great tacit understanding.

默契.zh: 多年的搭档让他们有了默契。
默契.en: Years of partnership gave them tacit understanding.

默契.zh: 虽然没说话，但彼此很默契。
默契.en: Although no words were spoken, they had tacit understanding.

默契.zh: 这种默契不是一天两天能培养的。
默契.en: This kind of tacit understanding can't be cultivated in a day or two.

续.en: Our contract needs to be renewed.
He plans to renew the lease on this house.

续.zh: 电影还有第二部续集吗？
续.en: Does the movie have a second sequel?
The membership expired, need to renew.

续.zh: 如果你不续，服务就会停止。
续.en: If you don't renew, the service will stop.

礼服.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的礼服。
礼服.en: She wore a beautiful formal gown.
You need to wear formal attire to attend a wedding.

礼服.zh: 他买了一套新的西装礼服。
礼服.en: He bought a new suit and formal wear.

礼服.zh: 因为场合正式，大家都穿了礼服。
礼服.en: Because the occasion was formal, everyone wore formal attire.

舔.en: The kitten is licking its fur.
Don't lick your fingers, it's unhygienic.

舔.zh: 她小心翼翼地舔了舔嘴唇。

耗.zh: 这个项目耗了我很多精力。
耗.en: This project consumed a lot of my energy.

耗.zh: 虽然耗了不少钱，但效果很好。
耗.en: Although it cost a lot, the result is good.

耗.zh: 他耗了一整天也没做完。
耗.en: He spent a whole day and still didn't finish.

一线.en: There's still a ray of hope.

一线.zh: 他是一名一线医护人员。
一线.en: He is a frontline medical worker.

一线.zh: 这个城市只剩一线生机。
一线.en: This city only has a slim chance of survival.

一线.zh: 虽然很难，但还有一线机会。
一线.en: Although it's hard, there is still a glimmer of opportunity.
First-tier city housing prices are too high.

智商.zh: 这个测试能测出你的智商。
智商.en: This test can measure your IQ.

智商.zh: 虽然他智商高，但情商很低。
智商.en: Although he has high IQ, his EQ is low.

智商.zh: 她总觉得自己智商不够。
智商.en: She always feels her IQ is insufficient.

漫.en: The sky full of snowflakes is beautiful.

漫.zh: 因为雨太大，河水都漫到路上了。
漫.en: Because the rain was heavy, the river overflowed onto the road.
This road is long and winding.

片段.zh: 我只看了一些片段就哭了。
片段.en: I only watched some clips and cried.
The fragments in memory are blurry.

片段.zh: 虽然只是片段，但已经很好看了。
片段.en: Although it's just a clip, it's already very good.

片段.zh: 他把生活片段拍成了视频。
片段.en: He turned fragments of life into a video.

骗人.zh: 他经常骗人，没人相信他。
骗人.en: He often lies, no one believes him.
This kind of advertisement is all deceptive.

骗人.zh: 虽然他说得很真，但我觉得他在骗人。
骗人.en: Although he sounds convincing, I think he's lying.
Stop lying, I know the truth.

温泉.en: Let's go soak in hot springs.

温泉.zh: 这家温泉酒店环境很好。
温泉.en: This hot spring hotel has a great environment.
Hot springs are good for the body.

温泉.zh: 因为太累了，所以泡了温泉很舒服。
温泉.en: Because I was too tired, soaking in the hot spring felt great.
Enjoying hot springs in winter is the best.

副作用.zh: 吃太多止痛药会有副作用。
副作用.en: Taking too much painkiller can have side effects.

副作用.zh: 副作用包括头晕和恶心。
副作用.en: Side effects include dizziness and nausea.

副作用.zh: 虽然效果不错，但副作用也很大。
副作用.en: Although the effect is good, the side effects are also great.

副作用.zh: 医生说这个副作用会慢慢消失。
副作用.en: The doctor said this side effect will gradually disappear.

追逐.zh: 孩子们在操场上互相追逐。
追逐.en: The children are chasing each other on the playground.
He has always been chasing fame and wealth.

追逐.zh: 虽然很累，但他们还在追逐目标。
追逐.en: Although very tired, they are still pursuing their goals.
The police are chasing the thief.

归来.zh: 等到春天归来，我们再出发。
归来.en: Wait until spring returns, we'll set off again.

归来.zh: 游子归来总是让人感动。
归来.en: The return of a wanderer is always touching.

归来.zh: 虽然在外多年，但他终于归来了。
归来.en: Although he was away for years, he finally returned.

归来.zh: 鸟儿每年都会归来筑巢。
归来.en: Birds come back every year to build nests.

奇妙.zh: 他讲了一个奇妙的故事，大家都听入迷了。
奇妙.en: He told a wonderful story, and everyone was mesmerized.

奇妙.zh: 虽然听起来很奇妙，但这件事是真的。
奇妙.en: Although it sounds amazing, this matter is true.

奇妙.zh: 大自然的奇妙之处在于它的变化。
奇妙.en: The wonder of nature lies in its changes.

奇妙.zh: 那次旅行给了我奇妙的体验。
奇妙.en: That trip gave me a wonderful experience.

奴隶.zh: 在古代，奴隶没有任何自由和权利。
奴隶.en: In ancient times, slaves had no freedom or rights.

奴隶.zh: 他不想成为金钱的奴隶，所以选择了简单生活。
奴隶.en: He didn't want to be a slave to money, so he chose a simple life.

奴隶.zh: 这部电影讲述了奴隶反抗的故事。
奴隶.en: This movie tells a story of slave rebellion.

奴隶.zh: 奴隶们辛苦劳动，却得不到回报。
奴隶.en: The slaves worked hard but got no reward.

上方.zh: 这个按钮在上方，你按一下试试。
上方.en: This button is above, try pressing it.

上方.zh: 既然上方已经同意了，我们就开始执行吧。
上方.en: Since the higher authorities have agreed, let's start implementing.

上方.zh: 图片的上方有一条河流。
上方.en: At the top of the picture there is a river.
He put the book on the upper shelf.

干预.zh: 政府不应该干预市场的自由运作。
干预.en: The government should not intervene in the free operation of the market.

干预.zh: 因为父母过度干预，孩子变得没有主见。
干预.en: Because parents interfere excessively, the child becomes indecisive.

干预.zh: 医生决定不干预，让身体自然恢复。
干预.en: The doctor decided not to intervene and let the body recover naturally.

干预.zh: 这件事不需要外人干预。
干预.en: This matter doesn't need outsiders to intervene.

卧.en: He lay on the bed resting.

卧.zh: 卧铺车厢很安静，适合睡觉。
卧.en: The sleeper carriage is very quiet, suitable for sleeping.

卧.zh: 他卧病在床，所以没来上班。
卧.en: He is sick in bed, so he didn't come to work.
The cat lay on the windowsill basking in the sun.

争执.en: The two of them are arguing.

争执.zh: 为了这点小事争执不值得。
争执.en: It's not worth arguing over such a small matter.

争执.zh: 虽然我们有争执，但最后还是和好了。
争执.en: Although we had a dispute, we eventually made up.

争执.zh: 不要再争执了，我们好好谈一谈。
这场争执持续了很长时间。
争执.en: This dispute lasted a long time.

集会.zh: 他们在广场上举行了一场和平集会。
集会.en: They held a peaceful rally in the square.

集会.zh: 因为疫情，集会的人数受到了限制。
集会.en: Because of the pandemic, the number of people at gatherings was restricted.

集会.zh: 学生们集会抗议不合理的政策。
集会.en: The students assembled to protest unreasonable policies.

集会.zh: 集会上很多人都发表了演讲。
集会.en: Many people gave speeches at the assembly.

剧组.en: The production team finished filming today.

剧组.zh: 这个剧组的演员都很专业。
剧组.en: The actors in this crew are all very professional.

剧组.zh: 虽然剧组经费紧张，但他们还是拍出了好作品。
剧组.en: Although the crew had tight budget, they still made a good work.

剧组.zh: 他加入了那个电影的剧组。
剧组.en: He joined the film crew of that movie.

剧组.zh: 剧组正在外地取景拍摄。
剧组.en: The crew is shooting on location elsewhere.

无知.zh: 无知并不可怕，可怕的是不去学习。
无知.en: Ignorance is not scary; what's scary is not learning.

无知.zh: 由于对法律的无知，他犯了错。
无知.en: Due to ignorance of the law, he made a mistake.

无知.zh: 这句话暴露了他的无知。
我们不能嘲笑别人的无知。

剥夺.en: He was deprived of his rights.

剥夺.zh: 法律不能剥夺公民的基本自由。
剥夺.en: The law cannot deprive citizens of basic freedoms.

剥夺.zh: 因为犯罪，他被剥夺了政治权利终身。
剥夺.en: Because of crime, he was deprived of political rights for life.

剥夺.zh: 战争剥夺了很多人的幸福生活。
剥夺.en: War deprived many people of their happy lives.

剥夺.zh: 不要剥夺孩子玩耍的时间。
剥夺.en: Don't deprive children of their play time.

橡胶.en: This tire is made of rubber.

橡胶.zh: 橡胶手套用久了容易破。
橡胶.en: Rubber gloves tend to break after long use.

橡胶.zh: 因为下雨，操场的橡胶跑道有点滑。
橡胶.en: Because it rained, the rubber track on the playground is a bit slippery.

橡胶.zh: 我小时候最喜欢玩橡胶泥，可以捏成各种形状。
橡胶.en: When I was little, I loved playing with rubber clay; I could shape it into all kinds of forms.

橡胶.zh: 虽然橡胶弹性很好，但太阳晒久了也会老化。
橡胶.en: Although rubber has good elasticity, it also ages if left in the sun for too long.

万分.en: I am extremely grateful for your help.

万分.zh: 听到这个消息，他万分激动。
万分.en: Hearing this news, he was extremely excited.

万分.zh: 考试结果出来时，她万分紧张。
万分.en: When the exam results came out, she was extremely nervous.

万分.zh: 丢了钱包以后，他万分后悔没有小心保管。
万分.en: After losing his wallet, he regretted deeply not taking better care of it.

万分.zh: 虽然旅途很辛苦，但看到美景时我还是万分开心。
万分.en: Although the journey was tough, I was still extremely happy when I saw the beautiful scenery.

指向.en: The sign points to the right.
He pointed his finger at the sky.
The arrow points toward the exit.

指向.zh: 所有的证据都指向同一个嫌疑人。
指向.en: All the evidence points to the same suspect.

指向.zh: 老师用激光笔指向黑板上的公式，让我们注意看。
指向.en: The teacher pointed the laser pen at the formula on the blackboard and told us to pay attention.

私下.en: He lent me some money privately.

私下.zh: 这件事你别公开说，尽量私下解决。
私下.en: Don't talk about this publicly; try to resolve it privately.

私下.zh: 她私下告诉我她打算辞职了。
私下.en: She told me privately that she plans to resign.

私下.zh: 虽然表面和气，但他们私下其实有很多矛盾。
私下.en: Although they appear friendly on the surface, they actually have many conflicts privately.

协定.en: The two sides signed a trade agreement.

协定.zh: 这个协定有效期是三年。
协定.en: This agreement is valid for three years.

协定.zh: 他们按照协定来分配利润。
协定.en: They distribute profits according to the agreement.

协定.zh: 如果违反协定，就需要赔偿违约金。
协定.en: If the agreement is violated, penalty fees must be paid.

协定.zh: 经过多次谈判，两国终于达成了气候协定。
协定.en: After many rounds of negotiations, the two countries finally reached a climate agreement.

旗帜.en: The square was full of flags.

旗帜.zh: 他高举旗帜走在队伍前面。
旗帜.en: He held the flag high and walked at the front of the team.

旗帜.zh: 这家公司以创新为旗帜，吸引了很多人才。
旗帜.en: This company uses innovation as its banner and attracts many talented people.

旗帜.zh: 奥运会上，每个国家都有自己的旗帜。
旗帜.en: At the Olympics, every country has its own flag.

旗帜.zh: 虽然失败了，但他仍然是团队的旗帜人物。
旗帜.en: Even though he failed, he is still the flag-bearer of the team.

悬.en: The painting is still hanging on the wall.

悬.zh: 这个案子一直悬着没解决。
悬.en: This case has been hanging unresolved.

悬.zh: 灯悬在天花板下面，摇摇晃晃的。
悬.en: The lamp hangs under the ceiling, wobbling.

悬.zh: 他悬在半空中，让人看了十分担心。
悬.en: He was suspended in midair, which made people very worried.

悬.zh: 因为证据不足，这个问题的结论还悬而未决。
悬.en: Due to insufficient evidence, the conclusion on this issue remains up in the air.

水准.en: The standard of this restaurant is very high.

水准.zh: 他的英文水准比我好多了。
水准.en: His English level is much better than mine.

水准.zh: 这次比赛的水准比去年高了不少。
水准.en: The level of this competition is much higher than last year's.

水准.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但产品质量水准并不低。
水准.en: Although the price is cheap, the quality standard of the product is not low.

水准.zh: 要想提升生活水准，就得努力工作多赚钱。
水准.en: To improve living standards, you have to work hard and earn more money.

纯洁.zh: 孩子的心灵是最纯洁的。
这段感情非常纯洁，没有任何功利心。
纯洁.en: This relationship is very pure, with no ulterior motives.

纯洁.zh: 他们之间的友谊纯洁得像白雪一样。
纯洁.en: The friendship between them is as pure as white snow.

纯洁.zh: 虽然社会很复杂，但我还是希望保持一颗纯洁的心。
纯洁.en: Although society is complicated, I still hope to keep a pure heart.

柜台.en: She is queuing in front of the counter.

柜台.zh: 酒店前台柜台二十四小时有人值班。
柜台.en: The hotel front desk counter is staffed 24 hours.

柜台.zh: 他把东西放在柜台上，然后付了钱。
柜台.en: He put the items on the counter and then paid.

柜台.zh: 因为柜台太矮，客人必须弯下腰才能签字。
柜台.en: Because the counter was too low, guests had to bend over to sign.

揭露.zh: 记者揭露了公司的丑闻。
揭露.en: The journalist exposed the company's scandal.

揭露.zh: 虽然很难，但他还是决定揭露这个秘密。
揭露.en: Although it was hard, he still decided to reveal the secret.

揭露.zh: 这部电影揭露了社会的黑暗面。
揭露.en: This movie exposes the dark side of society.

揭露.zh: 我们需要更多的证据来揭露他的谎言。
揭露.en: We need more evidence to expose his lies.

吩咐.en: Mom told me to come home early.

吩咐.zh: 老板吩咐秘书准备会议材料。
吩咐.en: The boss instructed the secretary to prepare meeting materials.

吩咐.zh: 他吩咐完就离开了，也不等我们回答。
吩咐.en: He finished giving instructions and left without waiting for our reply.

吩咐.zh: 我已经按照你的吩咐做了所有事情。
吩咐.en: I've done everything according to your instructions.

吩咐.zh: 爷爷吩咐我们要好好照顾自己。
吩咐.en: Grandpa told us to take good care of ourselves.

导航.en: The GPS is broken; we are lost.

导航.zh: 我用手机导航找到了这家餐厅。
导航.en: I used my phone's navigation to find this restaurant.

导航.zh: 开车的时候最好用导航，不然容易走错路。
导航.en: It's best to use navigation when driving, or you might easily go the wrong way.

导航.zh: 这个导航软件更新后好用多了。
导航.en: This navigation app is much better after the update.

导航.zh: 导航提示前方有堵车，我们换条路吧。
导航.en: The navigation says there's a traffic jam ahead; let's take another route.

强劲.en: The wind is very strong today.

强劲.zh: 中国经济保持着强劲的增长。
虽然市场竞争很激烈，但这家公司依然表现强劲。
强劲.en: Although the market competition is fierce, this company still performs strongly.

强劲.zh: 这款发动机动力非常强劲，适合越野。
强劲.en: This engine is very powerful, suitable for off-roading.

强劲.zh: 他的演讲得到了观众强劲的掌声。
强劲.en: His speech received strong applause from the audience.

挽回.en: I want to salvage this relationship.

挽回.zh: 他已经犯了错，很难挽回了。
挽回.en: He has already made a mistake; it's hard to redeem.

挽回.zh: 公司推出新策略来挽回失去的市场份额。
挽回.en: The company launched a new strategy to recover lost market share.

挽回.zh: 虽然比分落后，但他们努力挽回局面。
挽回.en: Although they were behind in score, they tried to turn the situation around.

挽回.zh: 说出去的话就像泼出去的水，很难挽回。
挽回.en: Words spoken are like water spilled; it's hard to take back.

庆幸.en: I am very grateful to have met you.

庆幸.zh: 虽然考试没考好，但我庆幸自己尽力了。
庆幸.en: Although I didn't do well on the exam, I'm glad I tried my best.

庆幸.zh: 他庆幸自己及时赶上了最后一班车。
庆幸.en: He was glad he caught the last bus in time.

庆幸.zh: 我们都庆幸这场雨没在比赛时下。
庆幸.en: We were all glad that the rain didn't fall during the game.

三角.zh: 他们三人的关系很复杂，像个三角。
三角.en: Their relationship among the three is complicated, like a triangle.

三角.zh: 在几何课上，我们学习了三角形的面积公式。
三角.en: In geometry class, we learned the formula for the area of a triangle.

三角.zh: 这个地方被称为三角地带，治安不太好。
三角.en: This area is called the triangle zone; public security is not good.

三角.zh: 她买了一个三角形状的蛋糕。

条约.en: The two countries signed a peace treaty.

条约.zh: 这个条约已经生效了二十年。
条约.en: This treaty has been in effect for 20 years.

条约.zh: 根据条约规定，双方都不能在此区域驻军。
条约.en: According to the treaty, neither side can station troops in this area.

条约.zh: 这条约的谈判过程非常艰难。
条约.en: The negotiation process for this treaty was very difficult.

条约.zh: 他们违反了条约的条款，需要承担后果。
条约.en: They violated the terms of the treaty and need to bear the consequences.

享.zh: 他们坐在沙滩上享阳光。
享.en: They sat on the beach enjoying the sun.

享.zh: 他只想享乐，不想负责任。
享.en: He only wants to enjoy pleasure, not take responsibility.

享.zh: 这家餐厅的菜可以免费享。
享.en: The dishes at this restaurant can be enjoyed for free.

享.zh: 辛苦了一天，现在终于能享安静了。
享.en: After a hard day, now I can finally enjoy some quiet.
She hopes she can enjoy a long life.

陆军.zh: 这次演习包括了陆军和空军的配合。
陆军.en: This exercise included coordination between the army and air force.

陆军.zh: 他父亲曾经在陆军服役了二十年。
陆军.en: His father served in the army for 20 years.

陆军.zh: 陆军部队已经到达了指定位置。
陆军.en: The army troops have arrived at the designated location.

恐慌.en: People were very panicked in the early days of the epidemic.

恐慌.zh: 虽然股市大跌，但投资者没有恐慌。
恐慌.en: Although the stock market crashed, investors did not panic.

恐慌.zh: 恐慌情绪在人群中蔓延开来。
恐慌.en: Panic began to spread through the crowd.

旺.en: Barbecue stalls are especially popular in summer.

旺.zh: 因为节假日，商场里人气很旺。
旺.en: Because of the holiday, the mall is bustling with people.
The fire is getting stronger, call the police quickly.

旺.zh: 虽然经济不景气，但这家公司业绩仍然很旺。
旺.en: Although the economy is sluggish, this company's performance is still strong.

连锁.zh: 那家连锁超市明天开业。
这个连锁店在全国都有分店。
连锁.en: This chain store has branches all over the country.

连锁.zh: 因为一个失误，引发了连锁反应。
连锁.en: A single mistake triggered a chain reaction.

连锁.zh: 我喜欢去连锁餐厅吃饭，因为味道比较稳定。
连锁.en: I like to eat at chain restaurants because the taste is consistent.

连锁.zh: 这家连锁酒店的服务质量参差不齐。
连锁.en: The service quality of this chain hotel is uneven.

辩论.zh: 他们俩在辩论谁对谁错。
辩论.en: Those two are debating who is right and who is wrong.
This debate competition was very exciting.

辩论.zh: 虽然大家观点不同，但辩论后更清楚了。
辩论.en: Although everyone had different views, it became clearer after the debate.

辩论.zh: 我喜欢看辩论节目，能学到很多。
辩论.en: I like watching debate shows; I can learn a lot.

辩论.zh: 在辩论中，要学会尊重对方的意见。
辩论.en: In a debate, you need to learn to respect the other side's opinion.

税收.en: If taxes are too high, companies may move abroad.

税收.zh: 每个公民都有依法纳税的义务，税收用于公共建设。
税收.en: Every citizen has the obligation to pay taxes according to law, and tax revenue is used for public construction.

税收.zh: 改革税收制度可以提高经济效率。
税收.en: Reforming the tax system can improve economic efficiency.

清单.zh: 出发前请核对行李清单，别漏了东西。
清单.en: Before departure, please check the luggage list, don't miss anything.

清单.zh: 我列了一个清单，然后按照清单去准备。
清单.en: I made a list, and then prepared according to the list.

清单.zh: 工程师需要一份设备维护清单。
清单.en: The engineer needs a list of equipment maintenance.

清单.zh: 她把待办事项都写在清单上。
清单.en: She wrote all the to-do items on the list.

明智.zh: 现在放弃这个计划是明智的选择。
明智.en: Giving up this plan now is a wise choice.

明智.zh: 既然情况变了，那么改变策略才是明智的。
明智.en: Since the situation has changed, changing strategy is wise.

明智.zh: 他劝我出国留学，我觉得这个建议很明智。
明智.en: He advised me to study abroad, I think this advice is very wise.

明智.zh: 在投资之前做足功课是非常明智的。
明智.en: Doing thorough research before investing is very wise.

铅.en: The lead in this pencil is too soft.

铅.zh: 铅是有毒的重金属，要小心处理。
铅.en: Lead is a toxic heavy metal, so handle it carefully.

铅.zh: 他小时候总喜欢咬铅笔的铅。
铅.en: He used to like biting the lead of pencils when he was young.

铅.zh: 虽然铅很重，但可以用来做防护。
铅.en: Although lead is heavy, it can be used for protection.

铅.zh: 油漆里含铅，所以不能乱扔。
铅.en: The paint contains lead, so don't throw it away carelessly.

非凡.zh: 这次演出展现了非凡的创意。
虽然她很年轻，但已经取得了非凡成就。
非凡.en: Although she is very young, she has already achieved extraordinary things.

非凡.zh: 那座建筑的设计非凡，吸引了很多游客。
非凡.en: The design of that building is extraordinary, attracting many tourists.

非凡.zh: 她的才华非凡，大家都佩服。
非凡.en: Her talent is extraordinary, and everyone admires her.

刊登.zh: 这篇报道刊登在头版了。
刊登.en: This report was published on the front page.

刊登.zh: 杂志刊登了他的获奖照片。
刊登.en: The magazine published his award-winning photo.

刊登.zh: 因为内容敏感，报社决定不刊登那篇文章。
刊登.en: Because the content was sensitive, the newspaper decided not to publish that article.

刊登.zh: 他的小说被刊登在文学期刊上。
刊登.en: His novel was published in a literary journal.

刊登.zh: 广告刊登后，效果非常好。
刊登.en: After the ad was published, the results were very good.

泄露.en: Don't leak the password to others.

泄露.zh: 公司机密被内部人员泄露了。
泄露.en: The company's secrets were leaked by an insider.

泄露.zh: 如果提前泄露剧情，观众就没兴趣了。
泄露.en: If the plot is leaked in advance, the audience will lose interest.

泄露.zh: 这条消息不小心泄露到了网上。
泄露.en: This news was accidentally leaked online.

泄露.zh: 他因为泄露客户资料被开除了。
泄露.en: He was fired for leaking client information.

无耻.zh: 骗子用无耻的手段骗走了老人的钱。
无耻.en: The scammer used shameless methods to cheat the old man out of his money.

无耻.zh: 他竟然抄袭别人的作品，真是无耻。
无耻.en: He even plagiarized someone else's work; it's really shameless.

无耻.zh: 他们无耻地否认了事实。
这种无耻的谎言没人会相信。
无耻.en: No one will believe such a shameless lie.

诱人.zh: 这个蛋糕看起来好诱人。
高薪的工作机会很诱人。
诱人.en: The high-paying job opportunity is very attractive.

诱人.zh: 虽然价格诱人，但质量不好。
诱人.en: Although the price is tempting, the quality is not good.

诱人.zh: 橱窗里摆满了诱人的商品。
诱人.en: The window display is full of tempting products.

诱人.zh: 那个诱人的旅游广告让我心动了。
诱人.en: That tempting travel ad made my heart flutter.

冷漠.en: He is very indifferent to other people's affairs.

冷漠.zh: 社会上的冷漠现象让人心寒。
冷漠.en: The indifference in society is disheartening.

冷漠.zh: 她冷漠的态度伤透了我的心。
冷漠.en: Her cold attitude broke my heart.

冷漠.zh: 虽然她表面冷漠，内心却很热情。
冷漠.en: Although she appears cold on the surface, she is warm inside.

冷漠.zh: 面对求助，路人表现得非常冷漠。
冷漠.en: Faced with the plea for help, the passersby acted very coldly.

预备.en: Hurry up and get ready; we're going to be late.

预备.zh: 比赛前要好好预备体能。
预备.en: You need to prepare your physical strength well before the game.

预备.zh: 如果预备不充分，考试会紧张。
预备.en: If you don't prepare sufficiently, you'll be nervous during the exam.

预备.zh: 老师让我们预备明天的演讲。
预备.en: The teacher told us to prepare for tomorrow's speech.

预备.zh: 预备好了再出发，别着急。
预备.en: Get ready before you set out; don't rush.

忘掉.en: Forget the past and start over.

忘掉.zh: 他努力想忘掉那段痛苦的回忆。
忘掉.en: He tried hard to forget that painful memory.

忘掉.zh: 因为太忙，我忘掉了我们的约定。
忘掉.en: Because I was too busy, I forgot our appointment.

忘掉.zh: 别忘掉带钥匙，不然进不了门。
忘掉.en: Don't forget to bring the keys, otherwise you won't be able to get in.

卡通.zh: 这部卡通电影很受欢迎。
卡通.en: This cartoon movie is very popular.

卡通.zh: 他房间里贴满了卡通人物的贴纸。
卡通.en: His room is covered with stickers of cartoon characters.

卡通.zh: 虽然卡通是给小孩看的，但大人们也爱看。
卡通.en: Although cartoons are for kids, adults enjoy watching them too.

卡通.zh: 周末我们一起去看了场卡通片。
卡通.en: We went to see a cartoon movie together on the weekend.

圈子.zh: 他最近换了新的朋友圈子。
圈子.en: He recently changed to a new circle of friends.

圈子.zh: 你的生活圈子太小了，要多认识些人。
圈子.en: Your social circle is too small; you need to meet more people.

圈子.zh: 她在这个圈子里混了很多年，大家都认识她。
圈子.en: She's been in this circle for many years, and everyone knows her.

圈子.zh: 如果你想创业，最好先进入那个行业圈子。
圈子.en: If you want to start a business, it's best to first enter that industry circle.

圈子.zh: 我不太喜欢那种爱攀比的圈子，觉得没意思。
圈子.en: I don't really like that kind of competitive circle; I find it boring.

天地.zh: 这里真是孩子们的快乐天地。
天地.en: This is truly a happy world for children.

天地.zh: 他觉得自己闯出了一片新天地。
天地.en: He feels he has carved out a new world for himself.

天地.zh: 周末去山里走走，感觉天地都变大了。
天地.en: Going for a walk in the mountains on weekends makes me feel the world has expanded.

天地.zh: 在城市里待久了，特别想去一个没有人的天地放松一下。
天地.en: After staying in the city for so long, I really want to go to a deserted place to relax.

天地.zh: 虽然我们观点不同，但聊起来仍然觉得天地广阔。
天地.en: Even though we have different views, talking still makes me feel the world is vast.

厌倦.zh: 我开始厌倦这种重复的生活了。
厌倦.en: I'm starting to get tired of this repetitive life.

厌倦.zh: 他对这份工作已经厌倦了，想换个环境。
厌倦.en: He's already bored with this job and wants to change his environment.

厌倦.zh: 每天坐地铁上下班，我真的厌倦了。
厌倦.en: Taking the subway to and from work every day, I'm really fed up.

厌倦.zh: 她厌倦了城市的喧嚣，决定搬去乡下住。
厌倦.en: She's tired of the city's noise and decided to move to the countryside.

厌倦.zh: 如果你对现状感到厌倦，为什么不试着做点新的事情呢？
厌倦.en: If you feel tired of the current situation, why not try doing something new?

手册.zh: 这本员工手册你仔细看看。
手册.en: Take a close look at this employee handbook.

手册.zh: 出门前我翻了一下旅行手册。
手册.en: I flipped through the travel guide before going out.

手册.zh: 公司印了新的安全手册，每个人都要学。
手册.en: The company printed a new safety manual, and everyone has to study it.

手册.zh: 这本使用手册写得不太清楚，我看了半天也没懂。
手册.en: This user manual isn't written clearly; I read it for a long time and still didn't understand.

手册.zh: 新手可以先参考这本入门手册，然后再自己摸索。
手册.en: Beginners can refer to this introductory manual first, and then figure things out on their own.

进出.zh: 这个门口进出的人很多。
进出.en: There are many people going in and out of this door.

进出.zh: 他每天进出办公室都要刷卡。
进出.en: He has to swipe his card every time he enters or leaves the office.

进出.zh: 小区有保安，陌生人不能随便进出。
进出.en: The neighborhood has security; strangers can't freely come and go.

进出.zh: 这台机器记录着每个进出的人的信息。
进出.en: This machine records the information of everyone coming in and out.

进出.zh: 因为疫情，进出商场都要测体温。
进出.en: Because of the pandemic, you have to take your temperature when entering and leaving the mall.

转化.en: Heat energy can be converted into electrical energy.

转化.zh: 他的愤怒慢慢转化成了动力。
转化.en: His anger slowly transformed into motivation.

转化.zh: 设计师把旧厂房转化成了艺术区。
转化.en: The designer converted the old factory into an art district.

转化.zh: 负面情绪如果不能及时转化，会影响健康。
转化.en: If negative emotions aren't transformed in time, it can affect your health.

转化.zh: 这家公司成功地把线上流量转化成了实际销售额。
转化.en: This company successfully converted online traffic into actual sales.

奔驰.en: That Benz sports car is really beautiful.

奔驰.zh: 路上有一辆奔驰停在那里。
奔驰.en: There's a Benz parked on the road.

奔驰.zh: 他攒了好几年的钱，终于买了辆奔驰。
奔驰.en: He saved up for several years and finally bought a Benz.

奔驰.zh: 虽然奔驰车很贵，但开起来确实舒服。
奔驰.en: Although Benz cars are expensive, they are indeed comfortable to drive.

体贴.zh: 你做事真体贴，连咖啡都帮我泡好了。
体贴.en: You're so thoughtful; you even made coffee for me.

体贴.zh: 这家酒店的服务非常体贴周到。
体贴.en: The service at this hotel is very attentive and thoughtful.

体贴.zh: 他看起来很粗心，但其实对家人很体贴。
体贴.en: He seems careless, but he's actually very considerate to his family.

体贴.zh: 她生病的时候，他的体贴让她特别感动。
体贴.en: When she was sick, his thoughtfulness moved her deeply.

生效.en: The new rule has already taken effect.

生效.zh: 保险从付款那天开始生效。
生效.en: The insurance takes effect from the day of payment.

生效.zh: 协议签完字之后马上就生效吗？
生效.en: Does the agreement take effect immediately after signing?

生效.zh: 请注意，这个优惠券的生效日期是下个月一号。
生效.en: Please note that this coupon's effective date is the first of next month.

服饰.zh: 这家店卖各种民族服饰。
服饰.en: This shop sells various ethnic costumes.

服饰.zh: 她很喜欢研究古代的服饰。
服饰.en: She really likes studying ancient clothing.

服饰.zh: 今年流行的服饰风格很复古。
服饰.en: This year's popular clothing style is very retro.

服饰.zh: 这家公司的服饰设计很有创意。
服饰.en: This company's clothing designs are very creative.

服饰.zh: 参加晚宴的时候，要注意服饰搭配得体。
服饰.en: When attending a dinner party, pay attention to proper outfit coordination.

名誉.en: He cares a lot about his reputation.

名誉.zh: 这件事影响了公司的名誉。
名誉.en: This incident affected the company's reputation.

名誉.zh: 虽然她赢了比赛，但名誉受到了损害。
名誉.en: Although she won the match, her reputation was damaged.

名誉.zh: 为了名誉，他决定公开道歉。
名誉.en: For the sake of his reputation, he decided to apologize publicly.

名誉.zh: 一个人的名誉比金钱更重要。
名誉.en: A person's reputation is more important than money.

垂.en: The willow branches hang down to the water surface.

垂.zh: 他垂着头，看起来很失落。
垂.en: He hung his head, looking very disappointed.

垂.zh: 因为太累了，他的胳膊垂了下来。
垂.en: Because he was too tired, his arm drooped down.

垂.zh: 她的眼泪顺着脸颊垂下来。
垂.en: Her tears rolled down her cheeks.

垂.zh: 那颗熟透的果子垂在枝头。
垂.en: That ripe fruit hangs from the branch.

退役.zh: 这位运动员退役后当了教练。
退役.en: This athlete became a coach after retiring.

退役.zh: 因为伤病，他不得不提前退役。
退役.en: Because of injuries, he had to retire early.

退役.zh: 虽然退役了，但他每天还是坚持训练。
退役.en: Although he retired, he still insists on training every day.

兑现.zh: 老板承诺加薪，但还没兑现。
兑现.en: The boss promised a raise but hasn't delivered yet.

兑现.zh: 你可以去银行兑现这张支票。
兑现.en: You can cash this check at the bank.

兑现.zh: 如果他兑现了诺言，我就原谅他。
兑现.en: If he keeps his promise, I will forgive him.

兑现.zh: 这个优惠券明天就过期了，快去兑现吧。
兑现.en: This coupon expires tomorrow, go redeem it quickly.
Making a promise is easy, keeping it is hard.

肌肤.zh: 这款乳液对干性肌肤很好。
肌肤.en: This lotion is good for dry skin.

肌肤.zh: 夏天要注意保护肌肤，避免晒伤。
肌肤.en: In summer, you should protect your skin to avoid sunburn.

肌肤.zh: 因为过敏，她的肌肤变得很敏感。
肌肤.en: Because of allergies, her skin has become very sensitive.
Drinking more water is good for the skin.

拳头.en: He clenched his fist, very angry.

拳头.zh: 这个产品是公司的拳头产品。
拳头.en: This product is the company's flagship product.
He was so angry that he pounded the table with his fist.

拳头.zh: 如果你不服气，我们可以比划比划拳头。
拳头.en: If you're not convinced, we can go a few rounds with our fists.

拳头.zh: 虽然个子小，但他的拳头很有力。
拳头.en: Although he is small, his fists are very powerful.

遵循.zh: 我们都要遵循交通规则。
遵循.en: We all must follow traffic rules.

遵循.zh: 你应该遵循医生的建议。
遵循.en: You should follow the doctor's advice.

遵循.zh: 只有遵循自然规律，才能减少灾害。
遵循.en: Only by following nature's laws can we reduce disasters.

遵循.zh: 他从来不遵循公司的流程。
遵循.en: He never follows the company's procedures.

遵循.zh: 遵循传统并不意味着拒绝创新。
遵循.en: Following tradition does not mean rejecting innovation.

抗生素.zh: 抗生素只对细菌感染有效。
抗生素.en: Antibiotics are only effective against bacterial infections.

抗生素.zh: 因为乱吃抗生素，他的身体产生了耐药性。
抗生素.en: Because he took antibiotics indiscriminately, his body developed resistance.

抗生素.zh: 这种抗生素的副作用很大。
抗生素.en: This antibiotic has serious side effects.

下属.en: As a leader, you should care about your subordinates.

下属.zh: 他把任务分配给了下属。
下属.en: He assigned the tasks to his subordinates.

下属.zh: 虽然他是下属，但提出的建议很有价值。
下属.en: Although he is a subordinate, the suggestions he made are very valuable.

英勇.zh: 消防员的行为非常英勇。
英勇.en: The firefighters' actions were very brave.

英勇.zh: 面对危险，他表现得十分英勇。
英勇.en: In the face of danger, he behaved very bravely.

英勇.zh: 虽然敌人很强大，但他们依然英勇作战。
英勇.en: Although the enemy was strong, they still fought valiantly.

英勇.zh: 这个故事讲述了一位英勇的战士。
英勇.en: This story tells of a brave warrior.

人权.zh: 每个人都要尊重别人的人权。
人权.en: Everyone must respect others' human rights.

人权.zh: 虽然我们国家很安全，但也要保护人权。
人权.en: Although our country is very safe, we also need to protect human rights.

人权.zh: 他为了人权问题去抗议了。
人权.en: He went to protest for human rights issues.

人权.zh: 我在新闻里听到关于人权的讨论。
人权.en: I heard a discussion about human rights in the news.

出版社.en: This publishing house is very famous.

出版社.zh: 我写了一本书，想找一家出版社出版。
出版社.en: I wrote a book and want to find a publishing house to publish it.

出版社.zh: 他在这家出版社工作了十年。
出版社.en: He has worked at this publishing house for ten years.

出版社.zh: 因为那家出版社的编辑很专业，所以我选择了他们。
出版社.en: Because the editors at that publishing house are very professional, I chose them.

出版社.zh: 出版社最近推出了很多新书。
出版社.en: The publishing house recently released many new books.

喜悦.en: His face is full of joy.

喜悦.zh: 听到这个消息，她心里充满了喜悦。
喜悦.en: Hearing this news, her heart was filled with joy.

喜悦.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但成功后的喜悦是无法形容的。
喜悦.en: Although the process was tough, the joy after success is indescribable.

喜悦.zh: 孩子的笑声带给我很大的喜悦。
喜悦.en: The child's laughter brings me great joy.

喜悦.zh: 大家一起分享这份喜悦吧。

大气.zh: 今天的大气污染很严重。
大气.en: Today's air pollution is very serious.
He is a very generous person.

大气.zh: 虽然这个设计很简单，但是看起来很大气。
大气.en: Although this design is simple, it looks very grand.

大气.zh: 我们要保护地球的大气层。
大气.en: We need to protect the Earth's atmosphere.

大气.zh: 这家餐厅的装修非常大气。
大气.en: The decoration of this restaurant is very grand.

引用.zh: 他在文章里引用了很多数据。
引用.en: He cited a lot of data in his article.

引用.zh: 如果你要引用别人的话，记得注明来源。
引用.en: If you want to quote someone else, remember to cite the source.

引用.zh: 这句话是引用自一本著名的书。
引用.en: This sentence is quoted from a famous book.

引用.zh: 老师让我们引用一些例子来支持观点。
引用.en: The teacher asked us to cite some examples to support the argument.

查明.en: The police are finding out the cause.

查明.zh: 我们需要查明事情的真相。
查明.en: We need to ascertain the truth of the matter.

查明.zh: 经过调查，他们终于查明了事故的原因。
查明.en: After investigation, they finally found out the cause of the accident.

查明.zh: 这件事还没查明，不要乱说。
查明.en: This matter hasn't been clarified yet, don't speak randomly.

查明.zh: 医生正在查明他的病因。
查明.en: The doctor is finding out the cause of his illness.

一手.en: He is holding coffee in one hand.

一手.zh: 这个项目是他一手策划的。
一手.en: This project was wholly planned by him.

一手.zh: 虽然他很忙，但还是亲手一手包办了所有事情。
一手.en: Although he is busy, he still personally handled everything.

怪异.zh: 那个地方有一种怪异的安静。
怪异.en: That place has a strange kind of quiet.

怪异.zh: 虽然看起来有点怪异，但其实很好吃。
怪异.en: Although it looks a bit weird, it's actually delicious.

怪异.zh: 我听到了一阵怪异的响声。
她今天穿了一身怪异的衣服。
怪异.en: She wore a weird outfit today.

认证.zh: 他拿到了教师资格认证。
认证.en: He got a teacher qualification certification.

认证.zh: 因为要登录系统，所以必须先进行身份认证。
认证.en: Because you need to log into the system, you must first authenticate your identity.

作弊.zh: 他因为作弊被老师抓住了。
作弊.en: He was caught by the teacher for cheating.

作弊.zh: 如果你作弊的话，就会被取消成绩。
作弊.en: If you cheat, your results will be cancelled.

作弊.zh: 他用小纸条作弊，结果被发现了。
作弊.en: He cheated using a small note and got caught.

蜡烛.zh: 停电的时候，我点了两根蜡烛。
蜡烛.en: When the power went out, I lit two candles.

蜡烛.zh: 生日蛋糕上插满了蜡烛。
蜡烛.en: The birthday cake was full of candles.

蜡烛.zh: 虽然蜡烛很便宜，但用起来很浪漫。
蜡烛.en: Although candles are cheap, using them is romantic.

蜡烛.zh: 她把蜡烛吹灭，然后许了个愿。
蜡烛.en: She blew out the candle and then made a wish.

惊奇.zh: 听到这个消息，大家都感到很惊奇。
惊奇.en: Hearing this news, everyone felt very surprised.

惊奇.zh: 他的变化让我非常惊奇。
惊奇.en: His change made me very surprised.

惊奇.zh: 我本来以为很简单，结果却让人惊奇。
惊奇.en: I originally thought it was simple, but the result was surprising.

惊奇.zh: 孩子惊奇地看着魔术师的表演。
惊奇.en: The child watched the magician's performance in amazement.

可悲.zh: 他为了钱背叛朋友，真是可悲。
可悲.en: He betrayed his friends for money, truly pathetic.

可悲.zh: 看到老人无人照顾，我觉得很可悲。
可悲.en: Seeing the old man with no one to take care of him, I felt it was pitiful.

可悲.zh: 虽然他很聪明，但最后却落得可悲的下场。
可悲.en: Although he was smart, he ended up with a pitiful outcome.

可悲.zh: 这种可悲的局面是谁造成的？

精神病.zh: 那家医院专门治疗精神病患者。
精神病.en: That hospital specializes in treating psychiatric patients.

精神病.zh: 你别骂他是精神病，这不礼貌。
精神病.en: Don't call him crazy, that's impolite.

精神病.zh: 如果一个人有精神病，我们应该帮助他而不是嘲笑他。
精神病.en: If a person has a mental illness, we should help him instead of mocking him.

精神病.zh: 他最近行为怪异，像是得了精神病。
精神病.en: He's been acting strangely lately, as if he has a mental illness.

厌恶.zh: 他厌恶虚伪的人，所以朋友不多。
厌恶.en: He detests hypocritical people, so he doesn't have many friends.

厌恶.zh: 这种欺骗行为让人厌恶。
厌恶.en: This kind of deceitful behavior is disgusting.

厌恶.zh: 虽然她表面上客气，但内心其实很厌恶他。
厌恶.en: Although she was polite on the surface, she actually detested him inside.

厌恶.zh: 我对这种浪费食物的行为感到厌恶。
厌恶.en: I feel disgusted by this kind of food waste.

从来不.zh: 他从来不迟到，今天却例外了。
从来不.en: He is never late, but today was an exception.

从来不.zh: 奶奶从来不坐飞机，她害怕。
从来不.en: Grandma never takes planes, she's scared.

从来不.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我从来不抱怨。
从来不.en: Although work is very busy, I never complain.

从来不.zh: 她从来不跟我说实话，这让我很生气。
从来不.en: She never tells me the truth, which makes me very angry.

和尚.zh: 寺庙里住着几十个和尚。
和尚.en: There are dozens of monks living in the temple.

和尚.zh: 虽然他是和尚，但他也会用手机。
和尚.en: Although he is a monk, he also uses a mobile phone.

和尚.zh: 一个老和尚教我们打坐。
和尚.en: An old monk taught us how to meditate.

警车.en: Several police cars are parked on the street.

警车.zh: 听到警车的声音，大家都很紧张。
警车.en: Hearing the sound of police cars, everyone got nervous.

警车.zh: 因为发生了车祸，所以来了两辆警车。
警车.en: Because there was a car accident, two police cars arrived.

警车.zh: 他看见警车就赶紧躲起来了。
警车.en: He saw the police car and quickly hid.

偿还.en: I will repay the money I owe.

偿还.zh: 他努力工作是为了偿还债务。
偿还.en: He works hard in order to repay his debts.

偿还.zh: 银行贷款需要按时偿还。
偿还.en: Bank loans need to be repaid on time.

偿还.zh: 如果他无法偿还，就会面临法律后果。
偿还.en: If he cannot repay, he will face legal consequences.
I will repay this money over three years.

验.en: Going to the hospital for a blood test requires fasting.
Have you checked the ID card?

验.zh: 把货物验清楚，然后再签字。
验.en: Inspect the goods clearly, then sign.

验.zh: 这个产品需要验三次才能出厂。
验.en: This product needs to be inspected three times before leaving the factory.

炫耀.en: He always likes to show off.

炫耀.zh: 她买了个新包，到处炫耀。
炫耀.en: She bought a new bag and shows it off everywhere.

炫耀.zh: 他虽然很有钱，但从不炫耀。
炫耀.en: Although he is rich, he never shows off.

炫耀.zh: 别在我面前炫耀你的成绩了。
炫耀.en: Stop showing off your grades in front of me.

炫耀.zh: 他炫耀自己会弹钢琴，其实只会一点点。
炫耀.en: He shows off that he can play piano, but actually only a little.

人身.zh: 外出旅游要保护好人身安全。
人身.en: When traveling, protect your personal safety.

人身.zh: 因为最近不太平，所以我们要注意人身安全。
人身.en: Because it's not peaceful recently, we need to pay attention to personal safety.

人身.zh: 这种保险包括人身伤害赔偿。
人身.en: This insurance covers personal injury compensation.

一旁.zh: 她把礼物放在一旁，先去做饭。
一旁.en: She put the gift aside and cooked first.

一旁.zh: 我不说话，只是一旁静静地看着。
一旁.en: I didn't speak, just quietly watched from the side.
The cat squats aside basking in the sun.

一旁.zh: 他坐在一旁，什么也没说。
一旁.en: He sat aside and said nothing.

停电.zh: 因为台风，整个小区都停电了。
停电.en: Because of the typhoon, the whole neighborhood lost power.

停电.zh: 如果停电，我们就点蜡烛。
停电.en: If the power goes out, we'll light candles.

停电.zh: 昨天停电，我手机没电了。
停电.en: Yesterday there was a power outage, and my phone died.

停电.zh: 停电的时候千万别用电梯。
停电.en: Don't use the elevator during a power outage.

后台.zh: 演出结束后，我们去后台见演员。
后台.en: After the show ended, we went backstage to see the actors.

后台.zh: 这个软件的后台系统需要更新。
后台.en: The backend system of this software needs an update.

自在.zh: 一个人在家，感觉特别自在。
自在.en: Alone at home, I feel especially at ease.

自在.zh: 虽然环境陌生，但他很快就自在起来。
自在.en: Although the environment was unfamiliar, he soon became comfortable.
Wearing loose clothes is most comfortable.
He speaks very naturally, not nervous.

啃.en: He is gnawing on a bone.
The puppy likes to gnaw on bone toys.

啃.zh: 他一边看电视，一边啃玉米。
啃.en: He gnaws on corn while watching TV.
Don't bite your nails, it's unhygienic.

啃.zh: 他花了一下午才把那个硬面包啃完。
啃.en: He spent an afternoon gnawing through that hard bread.

寺.en: We go to the temple to worship Buddha.

寺.zh: 这座寺有一千多年的历史。
寺.en: This temple has over a thousand years of history.

寺.zh: 因为下雨，所以寺里的游客很少。
寺.en: Because of the rain, there are few tourists in the temple.

寺.zh: 他每个月都去寺里烧香。
寺.en: He goes to the temple to burn incense every month.
There is a big tree at the temple gate.

帐篷.en: We are setting up the tent.

帐篷.zh: 露营的时候一定要带帐篷。
帐篷.en: When camping, you must bring a tent.

帐篷.zh: 如果下雨，帐篷可能会漏水。
帐篷.en: If it rains, the tent might leak.
This tent can sleep four people.

帐篷.zh: 我们买了一个新帐篷，准备去露营。
帐篷.en: We bought a new tent and are planning to go camping.

低估.zh: 我低估了这次考试的难度。
低估.en: I underestimated the difficulty of this exam.

低估.zh: 虽然她年纪小，但你不能低估她的能力。
低估.en: Although she is young, you cannot underestimate her ability.

低估.zh: 我们低估了市场的需求。

缘故.en: I don't know what the reason is.

缘故.zh: 因为天气的缘故，航班取消了。
缘故.en: Because of the weather, the flight was canceled.
No one knows the reason she cried.

缘故.zh: 这件事很复杂，但主要缘故是他太粗心。
缘故.en: This matter is very complicated, but the main reason is that he was too careless.

缘故.zh: 他离开公司，缘故谁都不清楚。
缘故.en: He left the company; no one knows the reason.

话语.zh: 听到这些话语，我忍不住哭了。
话语.en: Hearing these words, I couldn't help crying.

话语.zh: 你刚才的话语是什么意思？
话语.en: What do you mean by your words just now?

话语.zh: 虽然话语不多，但句句都重要。
话语.en: Although there are not many words, every sentence is important.

偏偏.en: I went to find him, but he happened to be out.

偏偏.zh: 我们都想去看电影，可偏偏下雨了。
偏偏.en: We all wanted to go to a movie, but it just had to rain.

偏偏.zh: 你偏偏要这么做，我也没办法。
偏偏.en: You insist on doing this, and I can't do anything about it.

偏偏.zh: 偏偏在这个时候出问题。
偏偏.en: Of all times, a problem occurs right now.

偏偏.zh: 我本来想坐公交，偏偏没赶上。
偏偏.en: I originally planned to take the bus, but I just missed it.

上映.zh: 这部电影什么时候上映？
新片下周上映，我很期待。
上映.en: The new film is releasing next week; I'm looking forward to it.

上映.zh: 那部电影已经上映一个月了。
上映.en: That movie has been out for a month now.

上映.zh: 虽然宣传很多，但上映后反响一般。
上映.en: Although there was a lot of promotion, the reception after release was mediocre.

上映.zh: 听说那部大片会在暑期档上映。
上映.en: I heard that big blockbuster will be released in the summer season.

统统.en: All of you get out of here!

统统.zh: 这些垃圾统统都要清理掉。
统统.en: All this garbage needs to be cleaned up.
The money and ID cards were all stolen.

统统.zh: 不要客气，这些统统送给你。
统统.en: Don't be polite; all these are for you.

主编.zh: 主编让我修改这篇文章。
主编.en: The editor-in-chief asked me to revise this article.

主编.zh: 他当了十年主编，经验丰富。
主编.en: He has been the editor-in-chief for ten years and is very experienced.

主编.zh: 今天主编不在，你可以放松一点。
主编.en: The editor-in-chief is not in today; you can relax a bit.

主编.zh: 虽然主编要求高，但大家都很尊重他。
主编.en: Although the editor-in-chief has high demands, everyone respects him.

要命.en: This job is exhausting to death.

要命.zh: 他说话慢得要命，急死人了。
要命.en: He talks so slowly it's killing me, so frustrating.

要命.zh: 这两天忙得要命，连觉都没睡好。
要命.en: These two days have been crazy busy; I haven't even slept well.
It hurts like hell; call a doctor quickly.

颤抖.en: He was so angry that his hands were trembling.

颤抖.zh: 听到这个消息，她声音颤抖。
颤抖.en: Upon hearing this news, her voice trembled.
I was so cold that my whole body was shaking.

颤抖.zh: 老人用颤抖的手接过那封信。
颤抖.en: The old man took the letter with trembling hands.

颤抖.zh: 因为害怕，他的腿一直在颤抖。
颤抖.en: Because of fear, his legs were trembling continuously.

打倒.zh: 他一拳就把对手打倒了。
打倒.en: He knocked down his opponent with one punch.
We must defeat the bad guys.

打倒.zh: 别想打倒我，我没那么脆弱。
打倒.en: Don't think you can knock me down; I'm not that fragile.

打倒.zh: 他被人从背后打倒，摔得不轻。
打倒.en: He was knocked down from behind and fell quite hard.

打倒.zh: 谁敢欺负你，我就打倒谁。
打倒.en: Whoever bullies you, I'll knock them down.

董事.en: He is a board member of the company.

董事.zh: 今天董事会选举新董事。
董事.en: Today the board of directors elects a new director.

董事.zh: 作为董事，他要参与公司重大决策。
董事.en: As a director, he needs to participate in major company decisions.

董事.zh: 虽然他是董事，但很少来开会。
董事.en: Although he is a director, he rarely comes to meetings.

解剖.en: The doctor is dissecting a frog.

解剖.zh: 他对这个问题进行了深入解剖。
解剖.en: He performed an in-depth analysis of this issue.

解剖.zh: 因为要了解病因，医生决定解剖尸体。
解剖.en: In order to understand the cause of the disease, the doctor decided to dissect the corpse.

解剖.zh: 这节课我们学习了解剖人体的基本知识。
解剖.en: In this class we learned the basics of human anatomy.

解剖.zh: 虽然我很害怕，但还是认真看了解剖过程。
解剖.en: Even though I was scared, I still carefully watched the dissection process.

风情.en: This place has a very exotic vibe.

风情.zh: 她穿着旗袍，展现了十足的中国风情。
风情.en: She wore a cheongsam, showing off full Chinese charm.

风情.zh: 这个小镇保留了古老的民族风情。
风情.en: This small town preserves ancient ethnic customs.

风情.zh: 虽然这里不大，但到处充满了浪漫风情。
风情.en: Even though it's not big, it's full of romantic charm everywhere.

风情.zh: 你去过云南吗？那里少数民族风情特别浓郁。
风情.en: Have you been to Yunnan? The ethnic minority culture there is very rich.

雕塑.zh: 广场中央有一个巨大的抽象雕塑。
雕塑.en: There is a huge abstract sculpture in the center of the square.

雕塑.zh: 他花了一年时间雕塑这尊佛像。
雕塑.en: He spent a year sculpting this Buddha statue.

雕塑.zh: 因为热爱艺术，他决定学习雕塑专业。
雕塑.en: Because he loves art, he decided to major in sculpture.

雕塑.zh: 如果你有时间，可以去美术馆看看那些雕塑作品。
雕塑.en: If you have time, you can go to the art museum to see those sculptures.

国防.zh: 这些年国家的国防力量越来越强。
国防.en: The country's defense capabilities have been getting stronger over the years.

国防.zh: 他毕业后选择去国防部门工作。
国防.en: After graduation, he chose to work in the national defense department.

国防.zh: 虽然现在是和平年代，但我们不能忽视国防建设。
国防.en: Even though it's peacetime, we cannot neglect defense construction.

国防.zh: 每个公民都有义务为国防贡献力量。
国防.en: Every citizen has the duty to contribute to national defense.

搜查.en: The police are searching the room.

搜查.zh: 海关人员仔细搜查了每个行李箱。
搜查.en: The customs officers carefully searched every suitcase.

搜查.zh: 他们接到举报后立刻展开了搜查行动。
搜查.en: They immediately launched a search operation after receiving a tip.

搜查.zh: 因为怕被搜查，他把东西藏到了地下室。
搜查.en: Afraid of being searched, he hid the things in the basement.

搜查.zh: 如果没有搜查令，他们不能随便进入民宅。
搜查.en: Without a search warrant, they can't just enter private homes.

核武器.zh: 那个国家正在秘密研制核武器。
核武器.en: That country is secretly developing nuclear weapons.

核武器.zh: 国际社会呼吁全面禁止核武器。
核武器.en: The international community calls for a complete ban on nuclear weapons.

核武器.zh: 虽然核武器威力巨大，但使用它会带来灾难。
核武器.en: Although nuclear weapons are extremely powerful, using them would bring disaster.

核武器.zh: 各国应该共同努力减少核武器数量。
核武器.en: All countries should work together to reduce the number of nuclear weapons.

罢工.zh: 因为工资太低，地铁员工决定罢工。
罢工.en: Because wages are too low, the subway employees decided to strike.

罢工.zh: 这次罢工持续了整整一个星期。
罢工.en: This strike lasted a whole week.

罢工.zh: 虽然罢工影响了交通，但大家理解工人的要求。
罢工.en: Although the strike affected traffic, everyone understood the workers' demands.

罢工.zh: 公司如果不加薪，工人们就会继续罢工。
罢工.en: If the company doesn't raise wages, the workers will continue to strike.

着想.en: You should think about his interests.

着想.zh: 父母总是为孩子着想，自己却省吃俭用。
着想.en: Parents always think of their children, but scrimp and save themselves.

着想.zh: 我们应该从长远利益着想。
着想.en: We should consider the long-term interests.

着想.zh: 既然你爱他，就要多为他着想。
着想.en: Since you love him, you should think more about him.

着想.zh: 做这个决定时，你有没有为大家着想？
着想.en: When making this decision, did you consider everyone's interests?

颁发.zh: 市长亲自为获奖者颁发了奖章。
颁发.en: The mayor personally awarded medals to the winners.

颁发.zh: 公司每年都会颁发优秀员工奖。
颁发.en: The company awards an outstanding employee prize every year.

颁发.zh: 因为成绩优异，他被颁发了奖学金。
颁发.en: Because of his excellent grades, he was awarded a scholarship.

颁发.zh: 如果你完成培训，我们会颁发结业证书。
颁发.en: If you complete the training, we will issue a certificate of completion.

腾.zh: 他腾出一天时间来陪我逛街。
腾.en: He freed up a day to go shopping with me.

腾.zh: 房间里东西太多，腾不出地方放桌子。
腾.en: There are too many things in the room, can't clear space for a table.

腾.zh: 因为要搬家，我们得先腾出空箱子。
腾.en: Because we're moving, we need to free up some empty boxes first.

腾.zh: 飞机在天空中腾空而起。
腾.en: The plane soared into the sky.

呼吁.zh: 环保组织呼吁大家减少使用塑料。
呼吁.en: Environmental groups appeal to everyone to reduce plastic use.

呼吁.zh: 因为污染严重，所以政府呼吁市民绿色出行。
呼吁.en: Because pollution is serious, the government calls on citizens to travel green.

呼吁.zh: 他呼吁公司改善员工福利。
呼吁.en: He appealed to the company to improve employee benefits.

呼吁.zh: 学校呼吁家长配合教育孩子。
呼吁.en: The school calls on parents to cooperate in educating children.

铝.en: This can is made of aluminum.

铝.zh: 铝是一种轻便的金属材料。
铝.en: Aluminum is a lightweight metal material.

铝.zh: 虽然铝很轻，但它的强度也不错。
铝.en: Although aluminum is light, its strength is also good.

铝.zh: 厨房里的铝箔纸可以用很久。
铝.en: Aluminum foil in the kitchen can last a long time.

铝.zh: 旧铝罐可以回收再利用。
铝.en: Old aluminum cans can be recycled and reused.

支配.zh: 情绪常常支配我们的决定。
如果被欲望支配，人就会失去理智。
支配.en: If dominated by desire, people will lose reason.

支配.zh: 这个国家由独裁者支配。
支配.en: This country is ruled by a dictator.

支配.zh: 时间支配着我们的日常生活。

堕落.en: He step by step descends into depravity.

堕落.zh: 吸毒会让人的生活变得堕落。
堕落.en: Drug addiction can make one's life degenerate.

堕落.zh: 因为交上了坏朋友，他渐渐堕落了。
堕落.en: Because he made bad friends, he gradually degenerated.

堕落.zh: 那个明星成名后就堕落了。
堕落.en: That star degenerated after becoming famous.

堕落.zh: 堕落的人生不值得羡慕。
堕落.en: A depraved life is not worth envying.

解救.zh: 消防员从火场中解救出一只小猫。
解救.en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the fire.

解救.zh: 如果没有及时解救，他可能会淹死。
解救.en: If not rescued in time, he might have drowned.

解救.zh: 志愿者解救了很多流浪狗。
医生成功解救了病人的生命。
解救.en: The doctor successfully saved the patient's life.

妥.zh: 你放心，我会把一切都安排妥。
妥.en: Rest assured, I will arrange everything properly.

妥.zh: 既然大家都同意，这件事就算妥了。
妥.en: Since everyone agrees, this matter is considered settled.

妥.zh: 你的答复不够妥，再想想。
妥.en: Your reply is not proper enough, think again.

几率.en: The chance of winning is very low.

几率.zh: 这种病治愈的几率有多大？
几率.en: What is the probability of curing this disease?

几率.zh: 虽然几率很小，但我还是想试试。
几率.en: Although the probability is small, I still want to try.
The chance of rain today is high.

几率.zh: 他成功的几率比其他人高。
几率.en: His probability of success is higher than others.

歹徒.en: The gangster was caught by police.

歹徒.zh: 两个歹徒抢劫了银行后逃走了。
歹徒.en: Two gangsters robbed the bank and fled.

歹徒.zh: 因为歹徒有武器，警察不敢轻举妄动。
歹徒.en: Because the gangsters had weapons, the police dared not act rashly.

歹徒.zh: 市民勇敢地与歹徒搏斗。
歹徒.en: Citizens bravely fought with the gangster.

歹徒.zh: 那些歹徒最终受到了法律的惩罚。
歹徒.en: Those gangsters ultimately received punishment from the law.

野蛮.zh: 历史上有很多野蛮的战争行为。
野蛮.en: There were many barbaric war acts in history.

野蛮.zh: 虽然他们看起来很野蛮，但其实很善良。
野蛮.en: Although they look barbaric, they are actually kind.

野蛮.zh: 野蛮的行为不能被接受。
文明社会不应该有野蛮的竞争。
野蛮.en: Civilized society should not have barbaric competition.

分解.zh: 化学老师教我们如何分解水分子。
分解.en: The chemistry teacher taught us how to decompose water molecules.

分解.zh: 如果食物没有被分解，就会在胃里堆积。
分解.en: If food is not broken down, it will accumulate in the stomach.

分解.zh: 这个方程式可以分解成几个步骤。
分解.en: This equation can be broken down into several steps.

敞开.zh: 他敞开心扉，跟我们聊了很多。
敞开.en: He opened his heart and talked with us a lot.

敞开.zh: 窗户敞开着，风吹进来很舒服。
敞开.en: The window is wide open, the wind blows in comfortably.

敞开.zh: 如果你愿意敞开胸怀，就能交到更多朋友。
敞开.en: If you are willing to open your heart, you can make more friends.

敞开.zh: 超市的门每天都敞开着。
敞开.en: The supermarket door is wide open every day.

代理人.zh: 这个代理人帮我们处理了所有合同。
代理人.en: This agent helped us handle all the contracts.

代理人.zh: 因为我不在国内，所以委托了代理人来签字。
代理人.en: Because I'm not in the country, I entrusted an agent to sign.

代理人.zh: 保险代理人推荐了这款产品。
代理人.en: The insurance agent recommended this product.

代理人.zh: 公司的法律代理人明天会来开会。
代理人.en: The company's legal agent will come to the meeting tomorrow.

巨星.zh: 这位巨星在演唱会上唱了五首歌。
巨星.en: This superstar sang five songs at the concert.

巨星.zh: 虽然他是巨星，但为人非常谦虚。
巨星.en: Although he is a superstar, he is very humble.

巨星.zh: 好莱坞巨星经常被狗仔队跟踪。
巨星.en: Hollywood superstars are often followed by paparazzi.

巨星.zh: 这颗巨星在乐坛影响了几代人。
巨星.en: This superstar has influenced generations in the music industry.

名声.zh: 这家公司因为产品质量差而名声受损。
名声.en: This company's reputation suffered because of poor product quality.

名声.zh: 他不仅有钱，而且名声也很好。
名声.en: He not only has money, but also has a good reputation.

名声.zh: 名声再大也要脚踏实地。
名声.en: No matter how big the fame, one must stay grounded.

名声.zh: 她为了名声付出了很多努力。
名声.en: She paid a lot of effort for fame.

挪.en: Please move the chair a bit.

挪.zh: 他把桌子往左边挪了挪，腾出空间。
挪.en: He moved the table a bit to the left to free up space.

挪.zh: 如果太挤了，你可以把箱子挪到那边去。
挪.en: If it's too crowded, you can move the box over there.
Don't move that vase, it's easy to break.

挪.zh: 我挪了挪身子，让她坐下。
挪.en: I shifted my body to let her sit down.

丑闻.zh: 那个政客因为丑闻被迫辞职了。
丑闻.en: That politician was forced to resign because of a scandal.

丑闻.zh: 虽然丑闻被曝光了，但他否认一切指控。
丑闻.en: Although the scandal was exposed, he denied all accusations.

丑闻.zh: 娱乐圈的丑闻总是很快传开。
丑闻.en: Scandals in the entertainment industry always spread quickly.

丑闻.zh: 这家公司被卷入了财务丑闻。
丑闻.en: This company was involved in a financial scandal.

卸.zh: 请把车上的行李卸下来。
卸.en: Please unload the luggage from the car.

卸.zh: 他卸了电池，然后换了新的。
卸.en: He removed the battery and then replaced it with a new one.

卸.zh: 这个工人一天要卸很多箱子。
卸.en: This worker has to unload many boxes in a day.

卸.zh: 卸完妆再睡觉对皮肤好。
卸.en: Removing makeup before sleeping is good for the skin.

潜艇.zh: 海军潜艇在深海里执行任务。
潜艇.en: Navy submarines carry out missions in the deep sea.

潜艇.zh: 因为潜艇能潜到很深，所以很难被发现。
潜艇.en: Because submarines can dive very deep, they are hard to detect.
There is a nuclear submarine in the movie.

潜艇.zh: 这艘潜艇可以连续航行三个月。
潜艇.en: This submarine can sail continuously for three months.

公关.zh: 公司需要请一个公关团队来处理危机。
公关.en: The company needs to hire a PR team to handle the crisis.

公关.zh: 如果我们不做好公关，客户会失去信任。
公关.en: If we don't do good PR, clients will lose trust.

公关.zh: 他是一名公关经理，经常和媒体打交道。
公关.en: He is a PR manager who often deals with the media.

公关.zh: 这家餐厅的公关做得很好，经常上热搜。
公关.en: This restaurant's PR is very good, often trending.

以至于.zh: 他太忙以至于没时间吃饭。
以至于.en: He is so busy that he has no time to eat.

以至于.zh: 她昨天哭得太厉害，以至于眼睛都肿了。
以至于.en: She cried so hard yesterday that her eyes were swollen.

以至于.zh: 这个游戏太好玩了，以至于我玩了一整天。
以至于.en: This game is so fun that I played it all day.

以至于.zh: 问题太复杂，以至于没人能解决。
以至于.en: The problem is so complex that no one can solve it.

以至于.zh: 他讲得太快，以至于我完全听不懂。
以至于.en: He spoke so fast that I couldn't understand at all.

业绩.zh: 因为去年业绩不错，公司给我们发了奖金。
业绩.en: Because last year's performance was good, the company gave us bonuses.

业绩.zh: 这个季度的业绩比上个季度差了很多。
业绩.en: This quarter's performance is much worse than last quarter's.

业绩.zh: 虽然业绩不太好，但他还是很努力。
业绩.en: Although the performance is not great, he is still working hard.

直线.zh: 最近房价直线上升，大家都很担心。
直线.en: Recently housing prices have risen sharply, and everyone is worried.

直线.zh: 飞机沿着直线飞行，节省时间。
直线.en: The plane flies along a straight line to save time.
The straight-line distance is very short.

直线.zh: 如果你走直线，十分钟就能到。
直线.en: If you go straight, you can get there in ten minutes.

指南.zh: 我买了一本中文学习指南，很适合初学者。
指南.en: I bought a Chinese learning guide; it's very suitable for beginners.

指南.zh: 这本指南里有详细的地图。
旅游指南上推荐了好几个景点。
指南.en: The travel guide recommends several scenic spots.

指南.zh: 虽然指南很详细，但我还是迷路了。
指南.en: Although the guide is very detailed, I still got lost.

融.zh: 这两种文化慢慢融合在一起。
融.en: These two cultures gradually blended together.
The company needs to raise a large sum of money.
The sugar dissolved in the water.

融.zh: 因为温度太高，冰淇淋很快就融化了。
融.en: Because the temperature was too high, the ice cream melted quickly.

澄清.zh: 他澄清了刚才的误会，大家才放心。
澄清.en: He cleared up the misunderstanding just now, and only then did everyone feel at ease.
This matter needs to be clarified as soon as possible.

澄清.zh: 虽然他说了谎，但后来他澄清了事实。
澄清.en: Although he lied, he later clarified the facts.

大不了.zh: 大不了重新做一次，没什么好担心的。
大不了.en: At worst we'll do it again; there's nothing to worry about.

大不了.zh: 这件事大不了就损失点钱。
大不了.en: At worst, this matter will just cost some money.
At worst, we'll go again tomorrow.

大不了.zh: 如果考试没通过，大不了再考一次。
大不了.en: If I don't pass the exam, at worst I'll take it again.

裂缝.en: There is a crack on the wall.

裂缝.zh: 因为地震，地面出现了很多裂缝。
裂缝.en: Because of the earthquake, many cracks appeared on the ground.

裂缝.zh: 这个裂缝需要马上修补。
裂缝.en: This crack needs to be repaired immediately.

裂缝.zh: 虽然裂缝不大，但漏水问题很严重。
裂缝.en: Although the crack is not big, the water leakage problem is serious.

外星人.zh: 电影里的外星人长得特别奇怪。
外星人.en: The aliens in the movie look very strange.

外星人.zh: 虽然很多人不信，但我认为外星人一定有。
外星人.en: Although many people don't believe, I think aliens definitely exist.

上空.zh: 城市上空飘着很多云彩。
上空.en: Many clouds are floating over the city.
A rainbow appeared in the sky overhead.

上空.zh: 因为雾太大，上空什么都看不见。
上空.en: Because the fog was too heavy, nothing could be seen overhead.

境界.en: His level of attainment is very high.

境界.zh: 只有不断学习，才能提高自己的境界。
境界.en: Only by continuous learning can you improve your own realm.

境界.zh: 艺术家的境界一般人很难达到。
境界.en: The realm of an artist is hard for ordinary people to reach.

境界.zh: 虽然很难，但他修炼到了更高的境界。
境界.en: Although it was difficult, he cultivated to a higher realm.

伤痕.zh: 他手上的伤痕是小时候留下的。
伤痕.en: The scar on his hand was left from childhood.

伤痕.zh: 那次事故后，她心里留下了深深的伤痕。
伤痕.en: After that accident, she had deep scars in her heart.

伤痕.zh: 虽然伤痕已经好了，但我还是觉得疼。
伤痕.en: Although the wound has healed, I still feel pain.

伤痕.zh: 这道伤痕看起来挺深的，要不要去医院？
伤痕.en: This scar looks quite deep, should we go to the hospital?

伤痕.zh: 每次看到那道伤痕，他就会想起那场车祸。
伤痕.en: Every time he sees that scar, he remembers that car accident.

生育.en: She doesn't want to have children too early.

生育.zh: 现在很多年轻人对生育这件事很犹豫。
生育.en: Many young people are hesitant about having children nowadays.

生育.zh: 国家鼓励生育，但养孩子成本太高了。
生育.en: The country encourages childbirth, but the cost of raising a child is too high.

生育.zh: 生育孩子是一个家庭的大事，要慎重考虑。
生育.en: Having a child is a big deal for a family and needs careful consideration.

生育.zh: 她生育后恢复得很快，身材也保持得很好。
生育.en: She recovered quickly after giving birth and kept her figure well.

泄漏.en: A gas leak is very dangerous.

泄漏.zh: 公司机密如果泄漏，后果很严重。
泄漏.en: If company secrets leak out, the consequences are serious.

泄漏.zh: 水管泄漏了，快叫人来修。
泄漏.en: The water pipe is leaking, call someone to fix it quickly.

泄漏.zh: 他因为泄漏了商业信息被开除了。
泄漏.en: He was fired for leaking business information.

泄漏.zh: 这个网站泄漏了用户数据，大家都在骂它。
泄漏.en: This website leaked user data, and everyone is criticizing it.

行使.en: You have the right to exercise your right to vote.

行使.zh: 警察在行使正当防卫时也要注意分寸。
行使.en: Police must also exercise restraint when using self-defense.

行使.zh: 他滥用职权，没有合法行使权力。
行使.en: He abused his power and did not exercise it legally.

行使.zh: 每个公民都可以依法行使自己的权利。
行使.en: Every citizen can exercise their rights according to law.

行使.zh: 法官在法庭上行使审判权，必须公正。
行使.en: When exercising judicial power in court, a judge must be fair.

撤退.zh: 前方有危险，我们得赶紧撤退。
撤退.en: There's danger ahead, we need to retreat quickly.

撤退.zh: 因为敌人太强，他们只好选择撤退。
撤退.en: Because the enemy was too strong, they had to choose to retreat.

撤退.zh: 老板说市场不行了，让我们尽快撤退。
撤退.en: The boss said the market is bad and told us to retreat as soon as possible.

撤退.zh: 比赛中他们一度领先，最后还是撤退了。
撤退.en: They were leading in the game for a while but eventually retreated.

悲惨.zh: 他的一生过得非常悲惨，让人同情。
悲惨.en: He lived a very miserable life, which makes people sympathize.

悲惨.zh: 虽然结局很悲惨，但电影拍得很好。
悲惨.en: Although the ending is tragic, the movie was made very well.

悲惨.zh: 看到那些流浪狗吃不上饭，我觉得很悲惨。
悲惨.en: Seeing those stray dogs with no food, I feel it's very pitiful.

悲惨.zh: 战争带来的悲惨后果，我们永远不能忘记。
悲惨.en: We must never forget the tragic consequences brought by war.

早日.zh: 我们要早日完成这个项目。
早日.en: We need to complete this project as soon as possible.

早日.zh: 他希望能早日见到失散多年的亲人。
早日.en: He hopes to see his long-lost relatives soon.

早日.zh: 既然决定了，就早日行动吧。
早日.en: Since you've decided, just take action early.

早日.zh: 医生说只要好好休息，就能早日出院。
早日.en: The doctor said that as long as you rest well, you can be discharged early.

动用.zh: 为了救灾，政府动用了大量资源。
动用.en: To provide disaster relief, the government mobilized a lot of resources.

动用.zh: 他动用了所有关系才找到这份工作。
动用.en: He used all his connections to find this job.

动用.zh: 公司决定动用储备金来度过难关。
动用.en: The company decided to use the reserve funds to get through the crisis.

动用.zh: 在紧急情况下，可以动用应急基金。
动用.en: In an emergency, you can use the contingency fund.

粉碎.en: The cup fell to the ground and shattered.

粉碎.zh: 他的梦想被现实粉碎了。
粉碎.en: His dreams were shattered by reality.

粉碎.zh: 警察粉碎了一个犯罪团伙。
粉碎.en: The police smashed a criminal gang.

粉碎.zh: 他用力一摔，把手机屏幕摔得粉碎。
粉碎.en: He threw it hard, smashing the phone screen to pieces.

撒谎.zh: 小孩子撒谎是不好的习惯。
撒谎.en: Lying is a bad habit for children.

撒谎.zh: 他经常撒谎，大家都不相信他了。
撒谎.en: He often lies, so no one believes him anymore.

撒谎.zh: 如果你撒谎，后果会很严重。
撒谎.en: If you lie, the consequences will be serious.

撒谎.zh: 她为了不挨骂，只好撒谎说作业写完了。
撒谎.en: To avoid getting scolded, she had to lie and say she finished her homework.

忧郁.en: He has been very melancholy lately.

忧郁.zh: 听到这个消息，她变得特别忧郁。
忧郁.en: After hearing this news, she became especially depressed.

忧郁.zh: 别总是那么忧郁，开心一点吧。
忧郁.en: Don't always be so gloomy, cheer up a bit.

忧郁.zh: 他忧郁的眼神让我很担心。
忧郁.en: His melancholy eyes made me very worried.

忧郁.zh: 虽然天气很好，但他还是很忧郁。
忧郁.en: Although the weather is nice, he is still very down.

虚拟.zh: 现在很多人在虚拟世界里交朋友。
虚拟.en: Now many people make friends in the virtual world.

虚拟.zh: 虚拟现实技术越来越成熟了。
虚拟.en: Virtual reality technology is becoming more and more mature.

虚拟.zh: 他分不清虚拟和现实的区别。
虚拟.en: He can't tell the difference between virtual and reality.

虚拟.zh: 这个虚拟账号已经被封了。
虚拟.en: This virtual account has already been banned.

昏.zh: 他工作太累，居然昏了过去。
昏.en: He was so tired from work that he actually fainted.

昏.zh: 别站那么久，小心昏了啊。
昏.en: Don't stand for so long, careful you might faint.

昏.zh: 他一整天没喝水，有点昏。
昏.en: He hasn't had water all day and feels a bit lightheaded.

昏.zh: 虽然睡了很久，但我还是觉得很昏。
昏.en: Even though I slept a long time, I still feel very groggy.

收养.zh: 这对夫妻决定收养一个孤儿。
收养.en: This couple decided to adopt an orphan.
She was adopted by someone since she was little.

收养.zh: 收养孩子需要很多手续。
收养.en: Adopting a child requires a lot of paperwork.

收养.zh: 虽然他们不富裕，但还是收养三个孩子。
收养.en: Although they are not wealthy, they still adopt three children.

掀起.zh: 这部电影掀起了讨论热潮。
掀起.en: This movie sparked a wave of discussion.

掀起.zh: 他掀起了盖子，里面是空的。
掀起.en: He lifted the lid, and it was empty inside.

掀起.zh: 改革掀起了新的经济浪潮。
掀起.en: The reform set off a new economic wave.

掀起.zh: 因为这件事，网上掀起了很大的争议。
掀起.en: Because of this incident, it sparked a huge controversy online.

界限.en: There are boundaries between friends too.

界限.zh: 工作和生活之间要有明确的界限。
界限.en: There should be clear boundaries between work and life.

界限.zh: 这条马路就是两市的界限。
界限.en: This road is the boundary between the two cities.

界限.zh: 说话要注意分寸，别越过界限。
界限.en: When speaking, be mindful of boundaries and don't cross the line.

界限.zh: 虽然关系好，但还是要保持界限。
界限.en: Even though the relationship is good, you still need to maintain boundaries.

前所未有.zh: 今年我们遇到了前所未有的挑战。
前所未有.en: This year we have encountered unprecedented challenges.

前所未有.zh: 这种技术的发展速度前所未有。
前所未有.en: The development speed of this technology is unprecedented.

前所未有.zh: 他获得了前所未有的成功。
因为疫情，全球经历了前所未有的危机。
前所未有.en: Because of the pandemic, the world experienced an unprecedented crisis.

品位.zh: 这家餐厅的装修很有品位。
品位.en: The decoration of this restaurant is very tasteful.
His taste in choosing clothes is really high.

品位.zh: 一个人的品位体现在细节里。
品位.en: A person's taste is reflected in the details.

品位.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但这家店商品很有品位。
品位.en: Although the prices are cheap, the products in this store have great taste.

旋律.en: The melody of this song is very beautiful.

旋律.zh: 我特别喜欢这首曲子的旋律。
旋律.en: I really like the melody of this piece of music.

旋律.zh: 这个旋律让我想起了小时候。
旋律.en: This melody reminds me of my childhood.

旋律.zh: 虽然歌词一般，但旋律特别好听。
旋律.en: Although the lyrics are average, the melody is especially nice.

旋律.zh: 轻快的旋律让人心情变好。
旋律.en: A cheerful melody makes people feel better.

固执.en: He is a very stubborn person.

固执.zh: 她固执地坚持自己的意见。
固执.en: She stubbornly insisted on her own opinion.

固执.zh: 别那么固执，听听别人的建议。
固执.en: Don't be so stubborn, listen to others' suggestions.

固执.zh: 虽然大家都反对，他还是固执己见。
固执.en: Although everyone opposed, he still stubbornly stuck to his views.

固执.zh: 他的固执让我们都很头疼。
固执.en: His stubbornness gives us all a headache.

刻意.zh: 她今天打扮得这么漂亮，是刻意的吗？
刻意.en: Did she dress up so nicely today on purpose?

刻意.zh: 我没有刻意去讨好老板，只是做好自己的事。
刻意.en: I didn't deliberately try to please the boss; I just did my own work.

刻意.zh: 他刻意放慢了脚步，等着后面的朋友赶上来。
刻意.en: He deliberately slowed down to wait for the friend behind to catch up.

刻意.zh: 照片拍得很自然，看起来一点都不刻意。
刻意.en: The photo looks very natural, not staged at all.

刻意.zh: 虽然她嘴上说不介意，但我总觉得她是刻意在回避这个话题。
