刻意.en: Although she said she didn't mind, I always felt she was deliberately avoiding the topic.

摩擦.zh: 这两个零件之间摩擦太大，需要加点润滑油。
摩擦.en: There's too much friction between these two parts; we need to add some lubricant.

摩擦.zh: 同事之间有点摩擦很正常，关键是好好沟通。
摩擦.en: It's normal to have some friction between colleagues; the key is to communicate well.

摩擦.zh: 轮胎和地面摩擦发出吱吱的声音。
摩擦.en: The tires made a squeaking sound from rubbing against the ground.

摩擦.zh: 他们俩因为工作分配问题产生了一些摩擦。
摩擦.en: They had some friction over the distribution of work.

摩擦.zh: 如果你觉得鞋底太滑，可以试试增加和地面的摩擦。
摩擦.en: If you think the soles are too slippery, you can try to increase the friction with the ground.

淘.zh: 妈妈在厨房里淘米准备做饭。
淘.en: Mom is washing the rice in the kitchen to prepare the meal.

淘.zh: 我周末喜欢去旧货市场淘点有意思的东西。
淘.en: I like to go to the flea market on weekends to hunt for interesting things.

淘.zh: 他在河边淘金，希望能找到一点金子。
淘.en: He is panning for gold by the river, hoping to find some.

淘.zh: 这家店东西不多，但仔细淘还是能发现好货。
淘.en: This shop doesn't have much stuff, but if you look carefully you can still find good items.

淘.zh: 小时候我们常去小溪里淘螃蟹，特别好玩。
淘.en: When we were kids, we often went to the creek to catch crabs; it was a lot of fun.

源头.zh: 这条河的源头在深山里。
源头.en: The source of this river is deep in the mountains.

源头.zh: 我们要从源头解决问题，不能只治标不治本。
源头.en: We need to solve the problem at its source, not just treat the symptoms.

源头.zh: 很多疾病的源头是不健康的饮食习惯。
源头.en: The source of many diseases is unhealthy eating habits.

源头.zh: 如果你想知道这个消息的源头，可以去问一下发布者。
源头.en: If you want to know the source of this news, you can ask the person who released it.

源头.zh: 追溯文化的源头，有时候能帮助我们理解现代的生活方式。
源头.en: Tracing the origins of culture can sometimes help us understand modern ways of life.

一度.zh: 他一度想放弃这个项目，但最后还是坚持下来了。
一度.en: He once wanted to give up this project, but he finally stuck with it.

一度.zh: 今天气温一度升到了三十八度，非常热。
一度.en: Today the temperature once rose to 38 degrees; it was very hot.

一度.zh: 他们俩的关系一度很紧张，后来慢慢缓和了。
一度.en: Their relationship was once very tense, but it gradually eased.

一度.zh: 这款手机在市场上一度很受欢迎，现在热度降了。
一度.en: This phone was once very popular in the market, but now the hype has died down.

一度.zh: 他一度以为自己拿错了行李，后来才发现只是颜色相似。
一度.en: He once thought he had picked up the wrong luggage, but later realized they were just similar in color.

察觉.zh: 我没有察觉到他有什么不对劲。
察觉.en: I didn't notice anything wrong with him.

察觉.zh: 猫非常警觉，一点声音都能察觉到。
察觉.en: Cats are very alert; they can detect even the slightest sound.

察觉.zh: 直到走进房间，我才察觉到自己忘带钥匙了。
察觉.en: I didn't realize I had forgotten my keys until I walked into the room.

察觉.zh: 她说话的语气变了，我立刻就察觉到了。
察觉.en: Her tone of voice changed, and I noticed it immediately.

察觉.zh: 虽然他说没事，但从他的表情我能察觉到他很累。
察觉.en: Although he said he was fine, I could tell from his expression that he was very tired.

宁可.zh: 我宁可走路，也不坐这么挤的公交车。
宁可.en: I would rather walk than take such a crowded bus.

宁可.zh: 他宁可自己省钱，也要给孩子报最好的补习班。
宁可.en: He would rather save money himself than not enroll his child in the best tutoring class.

宁可.zh: 宁可多花点时间，也要把质量做好。
宁可.en: I'd rather spend more time to ensure good quality.

宁可.zh: 她宁可一个人待着，也不愿参加无聊的聚会。
宁可.en: She would rather be alone than attend a boring party.

宁可.zh: 宁可相信这世界上好人多，也不要总是疑神疑鬼。
宁可.en: Better to believe that most people in the world are good than to be always suspicious.

侧面.en: Seen from the side, this building is very narrow.

侧面.zh: 我们可以从侧面了解一下他的为人。
侧面.en: We can learn about his character from a different angle.

侧面.zh: 这张照片拍的是她的侧面，很漂亮。
侧面.en: This photo shows her profile; it's very beautiful.

侧面.zh: 侧面打听了一下，听说他们公司最近要裁员。
侧面.en: I made some indirect inquiries and heard that their company is going to lay off staff soon.

侧面.zh: 他只说了正面的事情，侧面的问题我们得另外问。
侧面.en: He only talked about the positive side; we'll have to ask about the other aspects separately.

萝卜.zh: 今晚打算用萝卜炖排骨。
萝卜.en: I plan to stew pork ribs with radish tonight.

萝卜.zh: 这个萝卜又大又甜，生吃也很好吃。
萝卜.en: This radish is big and sweet; it's tasty even eaten raw.

萝卜.zh: 萝卜青菜各有所爱，你喜欢什么口味？
萝卜.en: Everyone has their own preferences; what flavor do you like?

萝卜.zh: 奶奶在菜园里种了一些萝卜和小白菜。
萝卜.en: Grandma planted some radishes and bok choy in the vegetable garden.

萝卜.zh: 超市的萝卜正在打折，我买了三斤。
萝卜.en: The radishes at the supermarket are on sale, so I bought three pounds.

内阁.zh: 新内阁成员名单已经公布了。
内阁.en: The list of new cabinet members has been announced.

内阁.zh: 内阁会议今天下午召开，讨论经济政策。
内阁.en: The cabinet meeting is held this afternoon to discuss economic policies.

内阁.zh: 他曾经担任过内阁秘书，经验很丰富。
内阁.en: He used to serve as a cabinet secretary and is very experienced.

内阁.zh: 因为丑闻，内阁中有两位部长辞职了。
内阁.en: Due to the scandal, two ministers in the cabinet resigned.

内阁.zh: 内阁正在就教育改革方案进行辩论，结果还不确定。
内阁.en: The cabinet is debating the education reform plan, and the outcome is still uncertain.

局部.zh: 今天只是局部下雨，其他地方都是晴天。
局部.en: Today it's only raining locally, other places are sunny.

局部.zh: 这件事影响到局部利益，但不是全部。
局部.en: This matter affects local interests, but not all.

局部.zh: 医生说我皮肤上的问题只是局部的，不用担心。
局部.en: The doctor said the problem on my skin is only local, don't worry.

局部.zh: 虽然整体看起来不错，但局部细节还需要改进。
局部.en: Although overall it looks good, local details still need improvement.

局部.zh: 这个项目先做一个局部测试，然后再全面推广。
局部.en: This project will first do a partial test, then promote it fully.

黑客.en: My computer was attacked by a hacker.

黑客.zh: 那个黑客入侵了公司的系统。
黑客.en: That hacker broke into the company's system.

黑客.zh: 很多黑客利用漏洞获取用户信息。
黑客.en: Many hackers exploit vulnerabilities to get user info.

黑客.zh: 他是一名黑客，但从来不干违法的事。
黑客.en: He is a hacker, but never does anything illegal.

黑客.zh: 最近有个黑客组织攻击了好几个大网站。
黑客.en: Recently a hacker group attacked several big websites.

渗透.zh: 这种文化已经开始渗透到年轻人的生活里。
渗透.en: This culture has begun to permeate into young people's lives.

渗透.zh: 他们试图渗透进那个组织。
渗透.en: They tried to infiltrate that organization.

渗透.zh: 因为外墙防水不好，湿气慢慢渗透进来了。
渗透.en: Because the exterior wall waterproofing is poor, moisture gradually seeped in.

渗透.zh: 商家想让广告渗透到每一个角落。
渗透.en: Businesses want ads to permeate every corner.

付费.zh: 这个软件需要付费才能用。
付费.en: You need to pay to use this software.
I don't like paying to watch videos.

付费.zh: 很多app都有免费版和付费版。
付费.en: Many apps have free and paid versions.

付费.zh: 我们选择付费会员，因为可以享受更多服务。
付费.en: We chose the paid membership because we can enjoy more services.

付费.zh: 虽然有些功能是免费的，但高级功能必须付费。
付费.en: Although some features are free, advanced features require payment.

塌.zh: 地震的时候很多房子都塌了。
塌.en: Many houses collapsed during the earthquake.

塌.zh: 这个山洞顶部塌了一块石头。
塌.en: A stone collapsed from the top of this cave.

塌.zh: 因为地基不稳，那栋楼慢慢塌了下去。
塌.en: Because the foundation was unstable, that building slowly collapsed.

塌.zh: 不要靠墙站，这面墙看起来快要塌了。
塌.en: Don't stand against the wall, this wall looks like it's about to collapse.

俗.en: I think his jokes are vulgar.

俗.zh: 虽然这花很俗气，但大家都喜欢。
俗.en: Although this flower is very common, everyone likes it.

俗.zh: 这个电影情节太俗，一看开头就知道结局。
俗.en: This movie plot is too cliché, you know the ending as soon as you see the beginning.

俗.zh: 他说话方式有点俗，但人其实很好。
俗.en: His way of speaking is a bit vulgar, but he's actually a good person.

裁决.zh: 这个案件的裁决结果很公正。
裁决.en: The ruling result of this case is very fair.

裁决.zh: 我们等了好几个月才等到最终裁决。
裁决.en: We waited several months to get the final ruling.

裁决.zh: 仲裁员对双方的争议进行了裁决。
裁决.en: The arbitrator made a ruling on the dispute between both parties.

裁决.zh: 虽然不服裁决，但他们还是接受了。
裁决.en: Although they disagree with the ruling, they still accepted it.

使者.zh: 他作为和平使者去了那个国家。
使者.en: He went to that country as a peace envoy.

使者.zh: 古代皇帝经常派出使者去其他国家。
使者.en: Ancient emperors often sent envoys to other countries.

使者.zh: 她是友谊的使者，促进了两国交流。
使者.en: She is an envoy of friendship, promoting exchanges between the two countries.

使者.zh: 这封信是使者亲自送来的。
使者.en: This letter was delivered personally by the envoy.

使者.zh: 我们派了一位特殊使者去谈判。
使者.en: We sent a special envoy to negotiate.

决议.zh: 大会通过了几项重要决议。
决议.en: The conference passed several important resolutions.

决议.zh: 这项决议得到了全体成员的支持。
决议.en: This resolution received support from all members.

决议.zh: 董事会就新项目做出了决议。
决议.en: The board made a resolution regarding the new project.

决议.zh: 虽然反对声音很大，但决议最终还是通过了。
决议.en: Although there were loud objections, the resolution was eventually passed.

决议.zh: 我们需要尽快就这个问题做出决议。
决议.en: We need to make a resolution on this issue as soon as possible.

期盼.en: I am looking forward to your arrival.
Children look forward to the New Year.

期盼.zh: 全家人都在期盼好消息。
期盼.en: The whole family is hoping for good news.

期盼.zh: 我们期盼了很久，终于等到了这一天。
期盼.en: We hoped for a long time, and finally this day came.

期盼.zh: 她期盼着能考上理想的大学。
期盼.en: She hopes to get into her ideal university.

把手.zh: 开车时一定要握紧方向盘把手。
把手.en: When driving, make sure to hold the steering wheel handle firmly.

把手.zh: 我用力拉了拉抽屉把手，打不开。
把手.en: I pulled the drawer handle hard, but it wouldn't open.

把手.zh: 你扶住把手，我帮你开门。
把手.en: Hold the handle, and I'll open the door for you.

把手.zh: 因为把手太滑，我没抓住，摔了一跤。
把手.en: Because the handle was too slippery, I didn't hold it and fell.

余.zh: 这顿饭吃不完，余下的明天再吃。
余.en: We can't finish this meal; we'll eat the leftovers tomorrow.
I only have fifty dollars left.

余.zh: 他工作之余喜欢看电影。
余.en: In his spare time from work, he likes watching movies.

余.zh: 这次考试我考了九十余分。
余.en: I scored over ninety points on this exam.

余.zh: 既然大家都没意见，余下的事就交给你了。
余.en: Since no one has any objections, I'll leave the rest to you.

过错.zh: 这不是你的过错，别自责。
过错.en: This isn't your fault; don't blame yourself.

过错.zh: 他承认了自己的过错，并道歉了。
过错.en: He admitted his mistake and apologized.

过错.zh: 每个人都会犯错，重要的是从过错中学习。
过错.en: Everyone makes mistakes; what matters is learning from them.

过错.zh: 因为我的过错，导致项目延期了。
过错.en: Because of my fault, the project was delayed.

过错.zh: 这个过错虽然小，但影响很大。
过错.en: Although this mistake is small, it has a big impact.

软弱.zh: 他性格太软弱了，总是被人欺负。
软弱.en: His character is too weak; he's always being bullied.

软弱.zh: 面对困难，我们不能表现得软弱。
软弱.en: Faced with difficulties, we cannot appear weak.

软弱.zh: 她虽然外表坚强，内心却很软弱。
软弱.en: Although she looks strong on the outside, she's weak inside.

软弱.zh: 你越是软弱，别人就越得寸进尺。
软弱.en: The weaker you are, the more others will take advantage of you.

软弱.zh: 软弱不是缺点，但要有底线。
软弱.en: Weakness isn't a flaw, but you must have boundaries.

和解.en: The two of them finally reconciled.

和解.zh: 经过调解，双方达成了和解。
和解.en: After mediation, both sides reached a settlement.

和解.zh: 我希望我们能尽快和解，别再吵架了。
和解.en: I hope we can reconcile soon and stop arguing.

和解.zh: 如果不主动和解，矛盾只会越来越深。
和解.en: If you don't initiate reconciliation, the conflict will only deepen.

和解.zh: 和解需要双方都有诚意。
和解.en: Reconciliation requires sincerity from both sides.

抑郁.zh: 他最近压力很大，有点抑郁。
抑郁.en: He's been under a lot of pressure lately and feels a bit depressed.

抑郁.zh: 长期抑郁会影响身体健康。
抑郁.en: Long-term depression can affect your physical health.

抑郁.zh: 她因为工作不顺心，整个人变得很抑郁。
抑郁.en: Because work wasn't going well, she became very depressed.

抑郁.zh: 如果你感到抑郁，记得找朋友聊聊天。
抑郁.en: If you feel depressed, remember to talk to a friend.

抑郁.zh: 抑郁并不可怕，可怕的是不去面对。
抑郁.en: Depression is not scary; what's scary is not facing it.

解散.zh: 队伍解散了，大家各自回家。
解散.en: The team disbanded, and everyone went home.

解散.zh: 公司因为经营不善，不得不解散。
解散.en: The company had to dissolve due to poor management.

解散.zh: 会议结束后，大家就解散了。
解散.en: After the meeting ended, everyone dispersed.

解散.zh: 他们决定解散乐队，各自发展。
解散.en: They decided to break up the band and go their separate ways.

解散.zh: 如果这个组织不合法，警方会勒令它解散。
解散.en: If this organization is illegal, the police will order it to disband.

装扮.zh: 万圣节那天，大家都装扮成鬼怪。
装扮.en: On Halloween, everyone dressed up as monsters.

装扮.zh: 为了参加晚会，她精心装扮了一番。
装扮.en: To attend the party, she carefully dressed up.

装扮.zh: 他装扮成服务员，混进了会场。
装扮.en: He disguised himself as a waiter and sneaked into the venue.

装扮.zh: 不要光注重外在装扮，内心更重要。
装扮.en: Don't just focus on external dressing; the inner self is more important.

良.en: This is a good opportunity; you should seize it.

良.zh: 他良心发现，主动自首了。
良.en: His conscience struck, and he turned himself in.

良.zh: 这家店信誉良好，回头客很多。
良.en: This store has a good reputation and many repeat customers.
Good medicine tastes bitter; good advice is hard to hear.

良.zh: 经过良好训练，他的技能提升很快。
良.en: After good training, his skills improved quickly.

严密.zh: 这个计划很严密，没有漏洞。
严密.en: This plan is very tight and has no loopholes.

严密.zh: 他们设置了严密的监控系统。
严密.en: They set up a strict surveillance system.

严密.zh: 因为安全措施严密，所以没出事故。
严密.en: Because the safety measures were thorough, there were no accidents.

严密.zh: 警方严密监视着嫌疑人的一举一动。
严密.en: The police are closely monitoring the suspect's every move.

严密.zh: 我们需要一个更严密的方案来应对风险。
严密.en: We need a more rigorous plan to deal with the risks.

排斥.zh: 这种材料不会被身体排斥。
排斥.en: This material won't be rejected by the body.

排斥.zh: 因为性格不合，他们互相排斥对方。
排斥.en: Because their personalities don't match, they reject each other.

排斥.zh: 我并不是故意排斥你，只是需要时间适应。
排斥.en: I don't mean to exclude you, I just need time to adjust.

排斥.zh: 虽然大家表面上客气，但心里都在排斥他。
排斥.en: Although everyone is polite on the surface, they all reject him inwardly.

长相.zh: 这对双胞胎长相一模一样。
长相.en: The twins look exactly the same.

长相.zh: 我第一眼就被他的长相吸引了。
长相.en: I was attracted by his looks at first sight.

长相.zh: 虽然她长相普通，但性格特别讨人喜欢。
长相.en: Although she looks ordinary, her personality is very likable.

长相.zh: 你光看长相是看不出来他有多厉害的。
长相.en: You can't tell how capable he is just by his appearance.

报仇.zh: 他等了十年才找到报仇的机会。
报仇.en: He waited ten years to find an opportunity for revenge.

报仇.zh: 这部电影讲的是一个关于报仇的故事。
报仇.en: This movie tells a story about revenge.

报仇.zh: 如果你再欺负她，我会帮她报仇的。
报仇.en: If you bully her again, I will help her get revenge.

报仇.zh: 他不只是想报仇，更想让对方付出代价。
报仇.en: He doesn't just want revenge, he wants to make the other party pay.

收缩.en: This fabric shrinks when it gets wet.

收缩.zh: 经济收缩导致很多人失业。
收缩.en: Economic contraction caused many people to lose their jobs.

收缩.zh: 因为温度降低，金属开始收缩。
收缩.en: Because the temperature dropped, the metal began to contract.

收缩.zh: 他快速收缩了一下手臂，表示拒绝。
收缩.en: He quickly contracted his arm to show refusal.

帖子.zh: 他在论坛上发了一个求助帖子。
帖子.en: He posted a help-seeking post on the forum.

帖子.zh: 我看了她的帖子，觉得写得很真诚。
帖子.en: I read her post and thought it was written sincerely.

帖子.zh: 如果你有问题，可以在这条帖子下面留言。
帖子.en: If you have questions, you can leave a comment below this post.

帖子.zh: 那个帖子的评论太多了，我翻都翻不完。
帖子.en: That post has so many comments, I can't even scroll through them all.

牌照.en: His car's license plate is from Beijing A.

牌照.zh: 这家公司还没拿到营业执照的牌照。
牌照.en: This company hasn't obtained its business license yet.

牌照.zh: 新车上路之前必须先办牌照。
牌照.en: You must get a license plate for a new car before driving it.

牌照.zh: 因为没挂牌照，他的车被交警扣了。
牌照.en: His car was impounded by traffic police because it had no license plate.

牌照.zh: 虽然申请了，但牌照到现在还没批下来。
牌照.en: Although applied, the license plate hasn't been approved yet.

搜寻.zh: 警察在搜寻失踪的孩子。
搜寻.en: The police are searching for the missing child.

搜寻.zh: 我到处搜寻都没找到钥匙。
搜寻.en: I searched everywhere but didn't find the keys.

搜寻.zh: 救援队正在废墟中搜寻幸存者。
搜寻.en: The rescue team is searching for survivors in the ruins.

搜寻.zh: 他在网上搜寻各种美食攻略。
搜寻.en: He searched online for various food guides.

搜寻.zh: 如果资料丢了，你就得重新搜寻一遍。
搜寻.en: If the data is lost, you'll have to search all over again.

抚养.zh: 父母有抚养子女的义务。
抚养.en: Parents have the obligation to raise their children.

抚养.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他坚持自己抚养女儿。
抚养.en: Although he is very busy with work, he insists on raising his daughter himself.

抚养.zh: 离婚后，孩子由母亲抚养。
抚养.en: After the divorce, the child is raised by the mother.

抚养.zh: 他每个月都会给前妻抚养费。
抚养.en: He pays child support to his ex-wife every month.

万能.zh: 他以为自己万能，什么都懂。
万能.en: He thinks he's all-powerful and knows everything.

万能.zh: 万能钥匙能打开大部分门锁。
万能.en: A master key can open most door locks.

万能.zh: 别指望用一种万能的方法解决所有问题。
万能.en: Don't expect to solve all problems with one universal method.

万能.zh: 虽然这个工具号称万能，但实际效果一般。
万能.en: Although this tool is touted as all-purpose, its actual effect is so-so.

宠.en: Grandparents especially dote on their grandson.

宠.zh: 你不要太宠孩子，不然会惯坏的。
宠.en: Don't spoil the child too much, or he'll be spoiled.

宠.zh: 虽然家里条件一般，但他还是很宠女朋友。
宠.en: Although the family's financial situation is average, he still dotes on his girlfriend.

宠.zh: 那只狗被主人宠得无法无天。
宠.en: That dog is so spoiled by its owner that it runs wild.

较量.zh: 他俩在棋局上较量了一下午。
较量.en: The two of them competed on the chessboard for the whole afternoon.
Don't try to compete with him; he's too strong.

较量.zh: 这次比赛是实力与智慧的较量，大家都非常期待。
较量.en: This competition is a contest of strength and wisdom, and everyone is looking forward to it.

较量.zh: 他们虽然嘴上不说，但心里一直在暗暗较量。
较量.en: Although they don't say it out loud, they have been secretly competing in their hearts.

较量.zh: 如果你想赢，就得在细节上跟他好好较量一下。
较量.en: If you want to win, you'll have to really compete with him on the details.

重返.zh: 他决定重返校园继续读书。
重返.en: He decided to return to campus to continue his studies.

重返.zh: 退休后，他想重返故乡生活。
重返.en: After retirement, he wants to return to his hometown to live.

重返.zh: 她伤愈后重返赛场，赢得了掌声。
重返.en: After recovering from her injury, she returned to the arena and won applause.

重返.zh: 这次重返老家的感觉跟以前完全不一样了。
重返.en: This time returning to my hometown feels completely different from before.

重返.zh: 他离开公司两年后，又重返原来的岗位。
重返.en: He left the company two years ago and then returned to his original position.

谣言.zh: 别信那些谣言，都是假的。
谣言.en: Don't believe those rumors; they're all false.

谣言.zh: 网上最近有很多关于他的谣言。
谣言.en: There have been a lot of rumors about him online recently.

谣言.zh: 这个消息是谣言，大家不要乱传。
谣言.en: This news is a rumor; everyone don't spread it.

谣言.zh: 老板出来澄清了谣言，大家才放心。
谣言.en: The boss came out and clarified the rumors, and then everyone felt relieved.

谣言.zh: 她因为受不了那些谣言，最后选择了辞职。
谣言.en: Because she couldn't stand those rumors, she finally chose to resign.

非得.en: Do you have to go right now?

非得.zh: 他非得自己试试才甘心。
非得.en: He insisted on trying it himself before he would give up.

非得.zh: 这件事你非得亲自跑一趟才行。
非得.en: For this matter, you really have to go there in person.

非得.zh: 你不用非得听他的，可以自己做决定。
非得.en: You don't have to listen to him; you can make your own decision.

非得.zh: 为了赶上飞机，我们非得五点起床不可。
非得.en: To catch the flight, we absolutely have to get up at five.

探测.zh: 科学家正用仪器探测火星。
探测.en: Scientists are using instruments to probe Mars.

探测.zh: 他们用雷达探测地下是否有水。
探测.en: They use radar to detect whether there is water underground.

探测.zh: 这艘船能探测深海里的矿物资源。
探测.en: This ship can detect mineral resources in the deep sea.

探测.zh: 仪器显示，这次探测的结果比预想的要好。
探测.en: The instruments show that the results of this detection are better than expected.

探测.zh: 他们先探测了一下温度，发现很适合施工。
探测.en: They first detected the temperature and found it very suitable for construction.

位子.zh: 他给我留了一个好位子。
位子.en: He saved a good seat for me.

位子.zh: 公司里那个位子一直空着没有人。
位子.en: That position in the company has been vacant with no one in it.

位子.zh: 你来得太晚了，好位子都被别人占了。
位子.en: You came too late; all the good seats have been taken by others.

位子.zh: 他为了抢到这个位子，提前两小时就去排队了。
位子.en: In order to grab this seat, he went to queue up two hours early.

演戏.en: She has loved acting since she was a child.

演戏.zh: 别在我面前演戏了，我知道真相。
演戏.en: Stop putting on an act in front of me; I know the truth.

演戏.zh: 他在那部电影里演戏很自然。
演戏.en: He acted very naturally in that movie.

演戏.zh: 他们俩在台上演戏，台下观众看得津津有味。
演戏.en: The two of them were acting on stage, and the audience watched with great interest.

演戏.zh: 我分不清她是在说真话还是在演戏。
演戏.en: I can't tell whether she is telling the truth or just acting.

零件.en: This machine is missing one part.

零件.zh: 他帮我把自行车零件换好了。
零件.en: He helped me replace the bicycle parts.

零件.zh: 这些零件是从德国进口的，质量很好。
零件.en: These parts are imported from Germany and are of good quality.

零件.zh: 你把所有零件都拆下来，然后按顺序放好。
零件.en: Take all the parts apart and then put them in order.

零件.zh: 修电脑的时候，一定要小心那些小零件别弄丢了。
零件.en: When repairing the computer, be careful not to lose those small parts.

夺冠.en: Their team finally won the championship.

夺冠.zh: 她这次比赛的目标就是夺冠。
夺冠.en: Her goal in this competition is to win the championship.

夺冠.zh: 这位选手连续两年夺冠，实力非常强。
夺冠.en: This player has won the championship for two consecutive years, showing great strength.

夺冠.zh: 虽然对手很强，但他们还是成功夺冠了。
夺冠.en: Although the opponents were strong, they still successfully won the championship.

夺冠.zh: 夺冠之后，他激动得流下了眼泪。
夺冠.en: After winning the championship, he was so excited that tears came to his eyes.

自尊.en: He cares a lot about his self-esteem.

自尊.zh: 你那样说话太伤他的自尊了。
自尊.en: Speaking like that really hurts his self-esteem.

自尊.zh: 人活着不能没有自尊心。
她虽然穷，但自尊心很强，从不求人。
自尊.en: Although she is poor, she has strong self-esteem and never asks for help.

自尊.zh: 你这样做是为了维护自己的自尊，还是为了别人？
自尊.en: Are you doing this to protect your own self-esteem or for others?

瘫痪.en: He is paralyzed in bed and cannot move.

瘫痪.zh: 这次罢工导致整个系统瘫痪了。
瘫痪.en: This strike caused the entire system to shut down.

瘫痪.zh: 她因为车祸而双腿瘫痪，但依然很乐观。
瘫痪.en: She became paralyzed in both legs due to a car accident, but remains very optimistic.

瘫痪.zh: 网络瘫痪后，我们什么都做不了。
瘫痪.en: After the network went down, we couldn't do anything.

瘫痪.zh: 那个国家的经济几乎瘫痪，政府正在想办法。
瘫痪.en: That country's economy is almost paralyzed, and the government is trying to find a solution.

雇佣.zh: 公司雇佣了二十个新员工。
雇佣.en: The company hired twenty new employees.

雇佣.zh: 他雇佣了一个保姆来照顾孩子。
雇佣.en: He hired a nanny to take care of the children.

雇佣.zh: 这家工厂雇佣了很多外来务工人员。
雇佣.en: This factory employs many migrant workers.

雇佣.zh: 虽然工资不高，但老板还是雇佣了他。
雇佣.en: Although the salary is not high, the boss still hired him.

雇佣.zh: 我们决定雇佣一位专业律师来处理这个案子。
雇佣.en: We decided to hire a professional lawyer to handle this case.

光辉.en: The sun emits a brilliant radiance.
His life was full of glory.

光辉.zh: 这座建筑在灯光下显得格外光辉。
光辉.en: This building looks especially radiant under the lights.

光辉.zh: 她是我们学校的光辉榜样。
光辉.en: She is a shining example in our school.

光辉.zh: 那些英雄的事迹永远散发着光辉。
光辉.en: The deeds of those heroes forever radiate glory.

上报.zh: 这件事必须上报给经理。
上报.en: This matter must be reported to the manager.

上报.zh: 他及时上报了事故的情况。
上报.en: He reported the accident situation in a timely manner.
Please report the data to headquarters.

上报.zh: 如果发现异常，要立即上报。
上报.en: If you find any abnormality, report it immediately.

上报.zh: 公司要求每月上报一次销售业绩。
上报.en: The company requires monthly reporting of sales performance.

低下.zh: 这里的社会地位很低下。
低下.en: Social status here is very low.
He lowered his head, not daring to look at the teacher.

低下.zh: 由于技术低下，产品质量一直不好。
低下.en: Due to low technology, the product quality has always been poor.

低下.zh: 虽然收入低下，但他生活得很满足。
低下.en: Although his income is low, he lives contentedly.

迫使.en: The heavy rain forced the game to be canceled.

迫使.zh: 经济压力迫使他去找工作。
迫使.en: Financial pressure forced him to look for a job.

迫使.zh: 老板的要求迫使他加班到很晚。
迫使.en: The boss's demands forced him to work late.

迫使.zh: 这场灾难迫使许多人离开了家乡。
迫使.en: This disaster forced many people to leave their hometowns.

阴性.zh: 她的核酸检测结果是阴性。
阴性.en: Her nucleic acid test result is negative.

阴性.zh: 医生说是阴性，不用太担心。
阴性.en: The doctor said it's negative, no need to worry too much.

阴性.zh: 血检报告显示所有指标都是阴性。
阴性.en: The blood test report shows all indicators are negative.

阴性.zh: 虽然症状很像，但最终结果是阴性。
阴性.en: Although the symptoms are very similar, the final result was negative.

阴性.zh: 她做了两次检查，一次阳性一次阴性。
阴性.en: She took two tests, one positive and one negative.

钙.en: Drinking more milk can supplement calcium.

钙.zh: 医生说我缺钙，让我多吃点豆制品。
钙.en: The doctor said I am calcium deficient and told me to eat more soy products.

钙.zh: 钙片不能吃太多，否则对身体不好。
钙.en: You can't take too many calcium tablets, otherwise it's bad for your health.

钙.zh: 老年人容易骨质疏松，需要多补充钙。
钙.en: Elderly people are prone to osteoporosis and need to supplement more calcium.

钙.zh: 这种水含钙量很高，喝多了可能会结石。
钙.en: This water has a high calcium content; drinking too much may cause stones.

放射.zh: 医生用放射疗法治疗癌症。
放射.en: Doctors use radiation therapy to treat cancer.

放射.zh: 放射科每天接待很多病人。
放射.en: The radiology department receives many patients every day.

放射.zh: 这种材料会放射出有害物质。
他们正在检查放射源是否安全。
放射.en: They are checking whether the radiation source is safe.

高尔夫球.zh: 周末我们去打高尔夫球吧。
高尔夫球.en: Let's go play golf this weekend.

高尔夫球.zh: 这个高尔夫球场非常漂亮。
高尔夫球.en: This golf course is very beautiful.

高尔夫球.zh: 他花了很多钱买高尔夫球杆。
高尔夫球.en: He spent a lot of money buying golf clubs.

高尔夫球.zh: 虽然高尔夫球看起来简单，但很难打好。
高尔夫球.en: Although golf looks simple, it's hard to play well.

容器.zh: 这个容器装不下那么多水。
容器.en: This container can't hold that much water.

容器.zh: 把剩菜放进密封容器里。
容器.en: Put the leftovers into a sealed container.

容器.zh: 她用玻璃容器来装香料，既美观又实用。
容器.en: She uses glass containers for spices, which are both beautiful and practical.

容器.zh: 如果容器不干净，食物很容易变坏。
容器.en: If the container is not clean, the food will easily spoil.

容器.zh: 实验室里有很多不同形状的塑料容器。
容器.en: There are many plastic containers of different shapes in the lab.

敷.zh: 脸上敷一片面膜会舒服很多。
敷.en: Applying a sheet mask on your face will feel much more comfortable.

敷.zh: 她每天敷眼膜来消除黑眼圈。
敷.en: She applies an eye mask every day to get rid of dark circles.

敷.zh: 扭伤后最好立刻敷冰块，可以消肿。
敷.en: It's best to apply ice immediately after a sprain to reduce swelling.

敷.zh: 医生让我敷药膏，但不要揉搓。
敷.en: The doctor told me to apply the ointment but not to rub it in.

敷.zh: 因为皮肤太干，我最近天天敷补水面膜。
敷.en: Because my skin is too dry, I've been applying hydrating masks every day recently.

欣慰.zh: 看到孩子进步，父母感到很欣慰。
欣慰.en: Seeing the child's progress, the parents felt very relieved and pleased.

欣慰.zh: 老师为学生的成绩感到欣慰。
欣慰.en: The teacher was gratified by the students' results.

欣慰.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但结果让我很欣慰。
欣慰.en: Although the process was very hard, the result made me feel relieved.

欣慰.zh: 她欣慰地笑了，因为大家都支持她。
欣慰.en: She smiled with relief because everyone supported her.

欣慰.zh: 听到他安全的消息，我心里总算欣慰了。
欣慰.en: Hearing the news that he was safe, I finally felt relieved.

末日.zh: 别总说世界末日，那是电影里的情节。
末日.en: Don't always talk about the end of the world; that's just a movie plot.

末日.zh: 有人预言末日会在今年到来。
末日.en: Some people predict that doomsday will come this year.

末日.zh: 那场战争对他们来说就像末日一样恐怖。
末日.en: That war was as terrifying as the apocalypse for them.

末日.zh: 如果真有末日，你最想做什么？
末日.en: If there really were a doomsday, what would you most want to do?

末日.zh: 他总是一副末日即将来临的悲观样子。
末日.en: He always has a pessimistic look as if the end of the world is coming.

鄙视.en: His kind of behavior makes people despise him.

鄙视.zh: 不要鄙视别人的努力，哪怕结果不好。
鄙视.en: Don't look down on others' efforts, even if the results are not good.

鄙视.zh: 我最鄙视那种在背后说闲话的人。
鄙视.en: I most despise those who gossip behind others' backs.

鄙视.zh: 他鄙视一切虚伪和不诚实的行为。
鄙视.en: He despises all hypocritical and dishonest behavior.

鄙视.zh: 虽然有人鄙视他的出身，但他靠实力证明了自己。
鄙视.en: Although some people looked down on his background, he proved himself through his abilities.

元首.zh: 多个国家的元首出席了这次峰会。
元首.en: Heads of state from many countries attended this summit.

元首.zh: 元首的演讲通过电视向全国直播。
元首.en: The head of state's speech was broadcast live nationwide on television.

元首.zh: 两国元首在会议上达成重要共识。
元首.en: The two heads of state reached important consensus at the meeting.

元首.zh: 这位元首年轻时曾是一名律师。
元首.en: This head of state used to be a lawyer when he was young.

元首.zh: 按照传统，元首会在新年发表贺词。
元首.en: According to tradition, the head of state will deliver a New Year's message.

苍白.zh: 他脸色苍白，像是生病了。
苍白.en: His face was pale, as if he was sick.

苍白.zh: 听到那个消息，她的脸一下子变得苍白。
苍白.en: Hearing that news, her face instantly turned pale.

苍白.zh: 月光下，他的皮肤显得特别苍白。
苍白.en: Under the moonlight, his skin looked especially pale.

苍白.zh: 他的解释很苍白，根本没人相信。
苍白.en: His explanation was weak and unconvincing; no one believed it at all.

苍白.zh: 她苍白地笑了笑，然后转身离开了。
苍白.en: She gave a pale smile and then turned and left.

纱.en: A layer of white gauze is hung on the window.

纱.zh: 她穿着纱裙，看起来像仙女一样。
纱.en: She wore a gauze skirt and looked like a fairy.

纱.zh: 这种纱很薄，适合做夏天的窗帘。
纱.en: This kind of gauze is very thin and suitable for summer curtains.

纱.zh: 她用一块纱把礼物包了起来，特别精致。
纱.en: She wrapped the gift with a piece of gauze, which was very delicate.

纱.zh: 风轻轻吹动纱帘，带来一丝凉意。
纱.en: The wind gently blew the gauze curtain, bringing a hint of coolness.

阶级.zh: 不同阶级的人观念差异很大。
阶级.en: People from different classes have very different concepts.

阶级.zh: 现代社会阶级流动性比以前强多了。
阶级.en: Social mobility in modern society is much stronger than before.

阶级.zh: 这本书分析了工人阶级的生活状况。
阶级.en: This book analyzes the living conditions of the working class.

阶级.zh: 他不喜欢用阶级来划分人群，觉得不公平。
阶级.en: He doesn't like to divide people by class, thinking it's unfair.

阶级.zh: 历史上，统治阶级和被压迫阶级的矛盾常常爆发战争。
阶级.en: In history, conflicts between the ruling class and the oppressed class often led to war.

头晕.zh: 我今天早上起来有点头晕。
头晕.en: I felt a bit dizzy when I got up this morning.

头晕.zh: 坐车时间长了容易头晕。
头晕.en: Sitting in a car for a long time can easily make you dizzy.

头晕.zh: 她发烧了，一直说头晕恶心。
头晕.en: She has a fever and keeps saying she feels dizzy and nauseous.

头晕.zh: 别转那么多圈，否则会头晕的。
头晕.en: Don't spin around that many times, or you'll get dizzy.

头晕.zh: 我最近工作太累，经常头晕眼花。
头晕.en: I've been too tired from work lately, often dizzy and seeing spots.

中途.en: I fell asleep halfway through the movie.

中途.zh: 他中途接了个电话就离开了。
中途.en: He took a call midway and left.

中途.zh: 虽然中途下起了大雨，但我们还是坚持跑完了。
中途.en: Although it started raining heavily halfway, we still insisted on finishing the run.

中途.zh: 我们中途在服务区休息了十分钟。
中途.en: We stopped for ten minutes at a service area midway.

中途.zh: 她中途退学去创业了，现在很成功。
中途.en: She dropped out of school halfway to start a business, and now she's very successful.

映.en: The sunset glow reddened half the sky.
The lake surface reflects the willow trees on the shore.

映.zh: 阳光透过窗户映在地板上，特别好看。
映.en: Sunlight streams through the window and reflects on the floor, looking really beautiful.

映.zh: 这座山倒映在湖水中，像一幅画。
映.en: This mountain is reflected in the lake, like a painting.

映.zh: 灯光映在他脸上，显得很温柔。
映.en: The lamplight reflected on his face, making him look very gentle.

独一无二.zh: 这件礼物是独一无二的，我很喜欢。
独一无二.en: This gift is one of a kind, I really like it.

独一无二.zh: 在这个世界上，每个人都是独一无二的存在。
独一无二.en: In this world, everyone is a unique existence.

独一无二.zh: 他设计的这款鞋子独一无二，不会撞款。
独一无二.en: The shoes he designed are unique, no one else will have the same style.

独一无二.zh: 虽然很贵，但它的设计独一无二，值得买。
独一无二.en: Although it's expensive, its design is unique and worth buying.

经受.zh: 这座老桥经受了百年风雨。
经受.en: This old bridge has weathered a hundred years of wind and rain.

经受.zh: 在创业过程中，他经受了不少挫折和打击。
经受.en: During the entrepreneurial process, he experienced many setbacks and blows.

经受.zh: 这种材料能经受高温，不会变形。
经受.en: This material can withstand high temperatures without deforming.

经受.zh: 他们的友谊经受了时间的考验，依然牢固。
经受.en: Their friendship has withstood the test of time and remains strong.

亮相.en: The new actor made his debut today.

亮相.zh: 他穿着西装亮相红毯，很帅气。
亮相.en: He appeared on the red carpet in a suit, looking very handsome.

亮相.zh: 新产品在展会上首次亮相，吸引了很多人。
亮相.en: The new product made its first appearance at the exhibition, attracting many people.

亮相.zh: 她在发布会上亮相，宣布了新的合作。
亮相.en: She appeared at the press conference and announced a new collaboration.

亮相.zh: 这辆车在车展一亮相就获得了大量订单。
亮相.en: As soon as this car was unveiled at the auto show, it received a large number of orders.

懒得.en: I'm too lazy to cook today.

懒得.zh: 他懒得起床，直接请假了。
懒得.en: He was too lazy to get up, so he just took a leave.

懒得.zh: 我懒得去超市，就在网上买了菜。
懒得.en: I was too lazy to go to the supermarket, so I bought groceries online.

懒得.zh: 她懒得解释，直接走开了。
懒得.en: She was too lazy to explain and just walked away.

懒得.zh: 周末懒得动，就在家看了一天剧。
懒得.en: I was too lazy to move on the weekend, so I stayed home watching dramas all day.

捐献.en: He donated a lot of books.

捐献.zh: 她决定捐献自己的头发给癌症病人。
捐献.en: She decided to donate her hair to cancer patients.

捐献.zh: 很多人主动捐献物资，帮助灾区人民。
捐献.en: Many people voluntarily donated supplies to help the people in the disaster area.

捐献.zh: 他捐献了一笔钱给希望小学。
捐献.en: He donated a sum of money to a Hope Primary School.

捐献.zh: 器官捐献可以挽救很多生命。
捐献.en: Organ donation can save many lives.

接手.en: You will take over this project.

接手.zh: 他接手了这家公司后，业绩提升很快。
接手.en: After he took over this company, performance improved quickly.

接手.zh: 等上一任经理退休后，我才会接手他的工作。
接手.en: I will only take over his work after the previous manager retires.

接手.zh: 我不想接手这个烂摊子。
接手.en: I don't want to take over this mess.

接手.zh: 她接手了球队的训练，队员都很配合。
接手.en: She took over the team's training, and the players were very cooperative.

即可.en: After payment, it can be shipped immediately.

即可.zh: 你输入密码，门即可打开。
即可.en: Enter the password, and the door will open right away.

即可.zh: 只要完成这个任务，即可获得奖励。
即可.en: As long as you complete this task, you can get the reward.

即可.zh: 扫描二维码即可加入群聊。
即可.en: Scan the QR code to join the group chat.

即可.zh: 把材料准备好，提交即可通过审核。
即可.en: Prepare the materials, submit them, and you can pass the review.

小品.zh: 春节晚会上有个小品让我笑了一晚上。
小品.en: There was a sketch at the Spring Festival Gala that made me laugh all night.

小品.zh: 他自编自演了一个小品，在比赛中得了第一名。
小品.en: He wrote and performed a sketch himself and won first place in the competition.

小品.zh: 这个小品讽刺了职场里的不公平现象。
小品.en: This sketch satirizes unfair phenomena in the workplace.

小品.zh: 学校文艺汇演的小品都是学生自己写的。
小品.en: The sketches at the school's cultural performance were all written by the students themselves.

线条.zh: 这件衣服的线条很流畅。
线条.en: The lines of this clothing are very smooth.

线条.zh: 他画的人物线条特别细腻。
线条.en: The lines of the characters he draws are especially delicate.

线条.zh: 我喜欢简单线条的设计，看起来很干净。
线条.en: I like designs with simple lines; they look very clean.

线条.zh: 虽然线条很复杂，但整体效果却非常和谐。
线条.en: Although the lines are very complex, the overall effect is very harmonious.

线条.zh: 她的脸上出现了细小的皱纹线条，但依然很美。
线条.en: Fine wrinkle lines appeared on her face, but she is still beautiful.

栽.zh: 他在花园里栽了一棵苹果树。
栽.en: He planted an apple tree in the garden.

栽.zh: 你别栽赃给我，这事跟我没关系。
栽.en: Don't frame me; this has nothing to do with me.

栽.zh: 昨天我不小心栽了一个大跟头。
栽.en: Yesterday I accidentally took a big fall.

栽.zh: 她栽了几盆花放在窗台上，特别好看。
栽.en: She planted several pots of flowers on the windowsill; they look especially nice.

栽.zh: 如果再不努力，你就等着栽跟头吧。
栽.en: If you don't work hard anymore, just wait to fail.

取胜.zh: 这场比赛他们靠防守取胜。
取胜.en: They won this game by relying on defense.

取胜.zh: 要想取胜，必须付出更多的努力。
取胜.en: To win, you must put in more effort.

取胜.zh: 我们队最终以两分之差险胜取胜。
取胜.en: Our team finally won by a narrow margin of two points.

取胜.zh: 虽然对手很强，但我们还是靠团队合作取胜了。
取胜.en: Although the opponent was strong, we still won through teamwork.

取胜.zh: 取胜的关键不在于个人能力，而在于配合。
取胜.en: The key to winning is not individual ability, but coordination.

联手.zh: 这两家公司联手开发新产品。
联手.en: These two companies joined forces to develop new products.

联手.zh: 我们联手一定能打败他们。
联手.en: If we join hands, we will definitely defeat them.

联手.zh: 警方和社区联手加强治安管理。
联手.en: The police and the community joined forces to strengthen security management.

联手.zh: 他们几个小公司联手对抗大企业，效果不错。
联手.en: Several small companies teamed up to fight the big corporation, and the effect was good.

联手.zh: 只有大家联手合作，这个项目才能顺利完成。
联手.en: Only if everyone cooperates together can this project be completed smoothly.

遗体.zh: 英雄的遗体被运回家乡安葬。
遗体.en: The hero's remains were transported back to his hometown for burial.

遗体.zh: 警方在现场发现了多具遗体。
遗体.en: The police found multiple bodies at the scene.

遗体.zh: 家属决定将遗体捐献给医学研究。
遗体.en: The family decided to donate the remains to medical research.

遗体.zh: 遗体告别仪式将在明天上午举行。
遗体.en: The farewell ceremony for the remains will be held tomorrow morning.

遗体.zh: 虽然遗体已经火化，但他的精神永远留在我们心中。
遗体.en: Although the remains have been cremated, his spirit will forever remain in our hearts.

残留.zh: 盘子上还有残留的油渍。
残留.en: There are still residual oil stains on the plate.

残留.zh: 这个水果上有农药残留，要洗干净再吃。
残留.en: There are pesticide residues on this fruit; wash it before eating.

残留.zh: 火灾后，空气中残留着一股焦味。
残留.en: After the fire, a burnt smell lingered in the air.

残留.zh: 虽然清理了很多遍，地板上还是残留了一些污渍。
残留.en: Although cleaned many times, some stains still remained on the floor.

残留.zh: 这段感情虽然结束了，但我心里还残留着一点不舍。
残留.en: Although this relationship is over, a little reluctance still lingers in my heart.

震动.zh: 地震让整栋楼剧烈震动。
震动.en: The earthquake caused the entire building to shake violently.

震动.zh: 这个消息震动了整个行业。
震动.en: This news shook the entire industry.

震动.zh: 手机在桌上震动了一下，吓了我一跳。
震动.en: The phone vibrated on the table, startling me.

震动.zh: 他敲了一下门，整面墙都在震动。
震动.en: He knocked on the door, and the whole wall vibrated.

震动.zh: 爆炸产生的震动把几公里外的玻璃都震碎了。
震动.en: The vibration from the explosion shattered glass several kilometers away.

角逐.zh: 两队将在决赛中激烈角逐。
角逐.en: The two teams will fiercely compete in the finals.

角逐.zh: 今年的冠军角逐非常精彩。
角逐.en: This year's championship competition is very exciting.

角逐.zh: 他们为了这个职位展开了长期角逐。
角逐.en: They engaged in a long-term competition for this position.

角逐.zh: 在这场商业角逐中，谁能抢先一步谁就赢。
角逐.en: In this business competition, whoever takes the lead first will win.

角逐.zh: 尽管角逐很激烈，但他们始终保持公平竞争。
角逐.en: Although the competition was fierce, they always maintained fair play.

特权.zh: 他利用特权给自己谋好处。
特权.en: He used his privileges to gain benefits for himself.

特权.zh: 在这个公司，高层员工有一些特殊特权。
特权.en: In this company, senior employees have some special privileges.

特权.zh: 我不喜欢那种处处炫耀特权的人。
特权.en: I don't like people who flaunt their privileges everywhere.

特权.zh: 法律面前人人平等，没有人能享受特权。
特权.en: Everyone is equal before the law; no one can enjoy privileges.

特权.zh: 虽然他是老板的儿子，但他从不要求任何特权。
特权.en: Although he is the boss's son, he never asks for any privileges.

可不是.zh: 他可不是一般人，很有背景。
可不是.en: He is not an ordinary person; he has quite a background.

可不是.zh: 这事儿可不是闹着玩的，你小心点。
可不是.en: This is not a joke; be careful.

可不是.zh: 可不是嘛，我也觉得这个方案有问题。
可不是.en: Exactly, I also think there's a problem with this plan.

可不是.zh: 她可不是那种会在背后说人坏话的人。
可不是.en: She is not the kind of person who would speak ill of others behind their backs.

可不是.zh: 你这样说可不行，这可不是对待朋友的方式。
可不是.en: You can't say that; this is not the way to treat a friend.

巨额.zh: 这家公司获得了巨额融资。
他们为了巨额奖金拼命工作。
巨额.en: They work hard for a huge bonus.

巨额.zh: 他因为没有还清巨额贷款，所以房子被银行收走了。
巨额.en: Because he didn't pay off the huge loan, the bank took his house.

口水.en: He drools when he sees delicious food.

口水.zh: 小孩子睡觉时经常流口水。
别把口水喷到别人脸上。
口水.en: Don't spray saliva on other people's faces.
He was so greedy that he drooled.

口水.zh: 听到这个笑话，他笑得口水都出来了。
口水.en: Hearing this joke, he laughed so hard that saliva came out.

热带.en: Tropical regions are hot all year round.
She went on vacation to a tropical country.

热带.zh: 热带雨林里有很多动物。
热带.en: There are many animals in the tropical rainforest.

热带.zh: 因为气候变暖，热带风暴越来越多了。
热带.en: Because of global warming, tropical storms are becoming more frequent.

遮.en: Cover your eyes with your hand.
He covered his face with a hat.
The curtain is too thin to block the light.

遮.zh: 因为树太大了，遮住了整个窗户。
遮.en: Because the tree is too big, it blocks the entire window.

战友.zh: 我们是一起当兵的战友。
战友.en: We were comrades-in-arms who served together.
The bond between comrades-in-arms is deep.

战友.zh: 他经常和战友聚会喝酒。
战友.en: He often gathers with his comrades-in-arms to drink.

战友.zh: 虽然转业了，我和战友还保持联系。
战友.en: Although we have been discharged, I still keep in touch with my comrades-in-arms.

蘑菇.en: There are many poisonous mushrooms in the forest.
She picked a basket of mushrooms.

蘑菇.zh: 下雨后草地上会长出蘑菇。
蘑菇.en: Mushrooms grow on the grass after rain.

蘑菇.zh: 别吃那种颜色的蘑菇，可能有毒。
蘑菇.en: Don't eat that colored mushroom; it might be poisonous.

飞往.en: I am flying to Shanghai on business tomorrow.
She flew to Europe for a trip.

飞往.zh: 因为天气不好，飞往海南的航班取消了。
飞往.en: Because of bad weather, the flight to Hainan was canceled.

时髦.zh: 现在流行什么时髦发型？
时髦.en: What fashionable hairstyles are popular now?

时髦.zh: 他喜欢追求时髦的东西。
时髦.en: He likes to pursue fashionable things.

时髦.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但她打扮得很时髦。
时髦.en: Although she is older, she dresses very fashionably.

音响.en: This sound system has great audio quality.
He turned the sound system up to maximum volume.
The newly bought sound system has good sound quality.

音响.zh: 晚上别开音响，邻居会投诉。
音响.en: Don't turn on the sound system at night, the neighbors will complain.

音响.zh: 因为音响太便宜，所以音质很差。
音响.en: Because the sound system was too cheap, the sound quality is very poor.

急性.en: The acute pain made him unbearable.

急性.zh: 医生诊断是急性阑尾炎。
因为没及时治疗，急性病变成了慢性病。
急性.en: Because it wasn't treated in time, the acute illness became chronic.

钞票.zh: 他掏出一张钞票付了钱。
钞票.en: He took out a banknote and paid.

钞票.zh: 现在很多人都不带钞票，直接用手机支付。
钞票.en: Nowadays many people don't carry banknotes and just pay with their phones.

钞票.zh: 这张钞票有点旧，但还能用。
钞票.en: This banknote is a bit old, but it's still usable.

钞票.zh: 虽然钱包里有几张钞票，但他还是选了刷卡。
钞票.en: Although there were a few banknotes in his wallet, he still chose to swipe his card.

钞票.zh: 她小心地把这些钞票放进信封里。
钞票.en: She carefully put these banknotes into the envelope.

虽说.zh: 虽说有点累，但我很开心。
虽说.en: Although a bit tired, I'm very happy.

虽说.zh: 他虽说是个新手，但学得很快。
虽说.en: He is a beginner, it's true, but he learns quickly.

虽说.zh: 虽说天气不好，我们还是决定出去玩。
虽说.en: Even though the weather is bad, we still decided to go out and have fun.

虽说.zh: 这道菜虽说看起来不怎么样，味道却非常好。
虽说.en: This dish, though it doesn't look great, tastes excellent.

虽说.zh: 虽说他平时话不多，但关键时刻总能给出好建议。
虽说.en: Although he usually doesn't talk much, he always gives good advice at critical moments.

风云.zh: 商场如战场，风云变幻莫测。
风云.en: The business world is like a battlefield, full of unpredictable changes.

风云.zh: 他年纪轻轻就经历了人生不少风云。
风云.en: He has experienced quite a lot of ups and downs in life at a young age.

风云.zh: 那个年代，国家正处在风云激荡之中。
风云.en: In that era, the country was in the midst of turbulent times.

风云.zh: 别看现在风平浪静，说不定明天就会风云突变。
风云.en: Don't think it's all calm now; who knows, it might change suddenly tomorrow.

风云.zh: 他在公司里也算个风云人物，大家都认识他。
风云.en: He's something of a big shot in the company; everyone knows him.

徘徊.en: He paced back and forth at the door for a long time.

徘徊.zh: 我在两个选择之间徘徊不定。
那只猫在垃圾桶旁边徘徊，想找点吃的。
徘徊.en: The cat lingered near the trash can, looking for something to eat.

徘徊.zh: 她的成绩一直在及格线附近徘徊，让人担心。
徘徊.en: Her grades keep hovering around the passing line, which is worrisome.

徘徊.zh: 虽然心里犹豫，他还是在十字路口徘徊了好一会儿才决定方向。
徘徊.en: Though hesitant inside, he lingered at the crossroads for a while before deciding which way to go.

显现.zh: 雨过天晴，彩虹渐渐显现出来。
显现.en: After the rain, a rainbow gradually appeared.

显现.zh: 这个问题在测试中显现出来了。
显现.en: This problem showed up during the test.

显现.zh: 用这个药后，效果很快就会显现。
显现.en: After using this medicine, the effect will show quickly.

显现.zh: 随着时间推移，他的真实性格慢慢显现。
显现.en: As time goes by, his true character gradually emerges.

显现.zh: 她脸上的笑容显现出内心的喜悦。
显现.en: The smile on her face revealed the joy in her heart.

雇员.zh: 这家公司有五百多名雇员。
雇员.en: This company has over five hundred employees.

雇员.zh: 作为一名老雇员，他非常熟悉公司的流程。
雇员.en: As a veteran employee, he is very familiar with the company's procedures.

雇员.zh: 雇主应该尊重每一位雇员的隐私。
雇员.en: Employers should respect the privacy of every employee.

雇员.zh: 新来的雇员还需要一段时间适应环境。
雇员.en: The new employees still need some time to adapt to the environment.

雇员.zh: 虽然公司裁员了，但核心雇员都留了下来。
雇员.en: Although the company laid off staff, the core employees all stayed.

净化.zh: 空气净化器可以净化房间里的灰尘。
净化.en: An air purifier can clean the dust in the room.

净化.zh: 喝了这杯水，感觉身心都被净化了。
净化.en: After drinking this glass of water, I feel my body and mind have been purified.

净化.zh: 这个过滤器能有效净化水质。
净化.en: This filter can effectively purify the water quality.

净化.zh: 森林里的空气能净化人的心灵。
净化.en: The air in the forest can purify one's soul.

净化.zh: 他们用特殊技术净化了受污染的土壤。
净化.en: They used special technology to purify the contaminated soil.

马桶.zh: 马桶堵了，快去叫维修师傅。
马桶.en: The toilet is clogged; go call a maintenance guy quickly.

马桶.zh: 他每次上厕所都把马桶坐垫掀起来。
马桶.en: He always lifts the toilet seat every time he uses the bathroom.

马桶.zh: 新买的马桶冲水声音特别小。
马桶.en: The newly bought toilet has a very quiet flush.

马桶.zh: 请记得用完马桶后冲水。
马桶.en: Please remember to flush the toilet after using it.

马桶.zh: 这个马桶盖坏了，得换个新的。
马桶.en: This toilet lid is broken; we need to replace it with a new one.

演示.zh: 老师给我们演示了实验步骤。
演示.en: The teacher demonstrated the experiment steps to us.

演示.zh: 这个软件怎么用？你能演示一遍吗？
演示.en: How do you use this software? Can you demonstrate it once?

演示.zh: 他在会议上演示了新产品的功能。
演示.en: He demonstrated the features of the new product at the meeting.

演示.zh: 你光说不行，最好直接演示给我看。
演示.en: Just talking isn't enough; you'd better show me directly.

演示.zh: 为了让客户理解，销售员反复演示了操作流程。
演示.en: To help the customer understand, the salesperson repeatedly demonstrated the operation process.

迷惑.en: This question puzzles me a lot.

迷惑.zh: 他说的那些话很迷惑人，别上当。
迷惑.en: What he said is very misleading; don't fall for it.

迷惑.zh: 她一脸迷惑地看着我，不知道我在说什么。
迷惑.en: She looked at me with a puzzled expression, not knowing what I was talking about.

迷惑.zh: 广告有时会故意迷惑消费者。
我刚开始学古文时，对那些句式感到很迷惑。
迷惑.en: When I first started learning classical Chinese, I felt very confused by those sentence structures.

黎明.zh: 我们在黎明出发，去看日出。
黎明.en: We set off at dawn to watch the sunrise.

黎明.zh: 黎明时分，城市慢慢醒来了。
黎明.en: At dawn, the city slowly wakes up.

黎明.zh: 虽然黎明还没到，但他已经起床准备了。
黎明.en: Although dawn hasn't arrived yet, he has already gotten up to prepare.

黎明.zh: 她喜欢在黎明时跑步，因为空气很新鲜。
黎明.en: She likes running at dawn because the air is fresh.

步入.en: He stepped into the meeting hall.
She stepped into a new work environment.

步入.zh: 随着音乐响起，新人步入礼堂。
步入.en: As the music started, the newlyweds stepped into the hall.

步入.zh: 当你步入社会后，会发现很多事情不一样。
步入.en: When you step into society, you'll find many things are different.

步入.zh: 我慢慢步入老年，开始关注健康了。
步入.en: I am slowly stepping into old age and starting to care about health.

屠杀.zh: 那次屠杀让很多人失去了生命。
屠杀.en: That massacre caused many people to lose their lives.

屠杀.zh: 战争中的大屠杀令人痛心。
屠杀.en: The massacre during the war is heartbreaking.

屠杀.zh: 他提到历史上的屠杀，语气很沉重。
屠杀.en: When he mentioned the massacre in history, his tone was very heavy.

屠杀.zh: 我们不能忘记那次惨无人道的屠杀。
屠杀.en: We must not forget that inhumane massacre.

屠杀.zh: 虽然过去了很多年，但那次屠杀的记忆依然清晰。
屠杀.en: Although many years have passed, the memory of that massacre remains clear.

琢磨.zh: 他一直在琢磨怎么解决这个问题。
琢磨.en: He has been thinking about how to solve this problem.

琢磨.zh: 你琢磨琢磨，这个方案行不行？
琢磨.en: Think it over, is this plan feasible?

琢磨.zh: 我琢磨了半天，也没想明白他为什么生气。
琢磨.en: I pondered for a long time but still couldn't figure out why he was angry.

琢磨.zh: 咱们一起琢磨一下，怎么提高效率。
琢磨.en: Let's think together about how to improve efficiency.

致敬.en: This film pays tribute to the classics.

致敬.zh: 我们向所有医护人员致敬。
致敬.en: We pay tribute to all medical staff.

致敬.zh: 他用这首歌向自己的偶像致敬。
致敬.en: He used this song to pay tribute to his idol.

致敬.zh: 在追悼会上，大家默默致敬，表达哀思。
致敬.en: At the memorial, everyone paid silent tribute to express their grief.

表态.en: You need to state your position.
The boss stated his position at the meeting.

表态.zh: 她明确表态支持这个计划。
表态.en: She clearly stated her support for this plan.

表态.zh: 大家都等他表态，他却一直不说话。
表态.en: Everyone was waiting for him to state his position, but he kept silent.

表态.zh: 关于这件事，领导还没有正式表态。
表态.en: Regarding this matter, the leader hasn't officially stated his position yet.

心声.zh: 这首歌说出了我的心声。
心声.en: This song expresses my true feelings.

心声.zh: 他的话代表了大家的心声。
心声.en: His words represent everyone's true feelings.

心声.zh: 请听听孩子们的心声吧。
心声.en: Please listen to the children's inner voices.

心声.zh: 我希望你能理解我的真实心声。
心声.en: I hope you can understand my true feelings.

心声.zh: 她终于鼓起勇气，把心声说了出来。
心声.en: She finally gathered the courage to speak her true feelings.

预见.en: No one can foresee the future.

预见.zh: 你能预见这件事的结果吗？
预见.en: Can you foresee the outcome of this matter?

预见.zh: 科学无法预见所有自然灾害。
预见.en: Science cannot foresee all natural disasters.

预见.zh: 虽然无法预见明天，但我们可以做好准备。
预见.en: Although we cannot foresee tomorrow, we can prepare.

双胞胎.en: This pair of twins look very alike.

双胞胎.zh: 双胞胎姐妹的爱好完全不同。
双胞胎.en: The twin sisters have completely different hobbies.

双胞胎.zh: 我们班有一对双胞胎兄弟。
双胞胎.en: Our class has a pair of twin brothers.

双胞胎.zh: 虽然他们是双胞胎，但性格差别很大。
双胞胎.en: Although they are twins, their personalities are very different.

殴打.en: He was beaten up by someone.

殴打.zh: 因为一点小事，他们互相殴打。
殴打.en: Over a trivial matter, they beat each other up.

殴打.zh: 目击者看到一群人在街头殴打一个人。
殴打.en: Witnesses saw a group of people beating a person on the street.

殴打.zh: 他因为参与殴打被警察带走了。
殴打.en: He was taken away by the police for participating in the beating.

支票.zh: 他开了一张支票给我，但金额不对。
支票.en: He wrote me a check, but the amount was wrong.

支票.zh: 我用支票付了房租，很方便。
支票.en: I paid the rent with a check, it's very convenient.

支票.zh: 这张支票已经过期了，不能用了。
支票.en: This check has expired and cannot be used.

支票.zh: 虽然我没有现金，但我可以给你开张支票。
支票.en: Although I don't have cash, I can write you a check.

宝石.zh: 她在珠宝店买了一块蓝宝石。
宝石.en: She bought a sapphire at the jewelry store.

宝石.zh: 这块宝石价值连城，非常珍贵。
宝石.en: This gem is priceless and very precious.

宝石.zh: 我生日时，他送了我一颗红宝石戒指。
宝石.en: For my birthday, he gave me a ruby ring.

宝石.zh: 虽然它看起来像宝石，其实是假的。
宝石.en: Although it looks like a gem, it's actually fake.

领土.zh: 两国因为领土问题发生了争执。
领土.en: The two countries had a dispute over territory.

领土.zh: 任何国家都不能侵犯别国的领土。
领土.en: No country can violate another country's territory.

领土.zh: 这片领土自古以来就属于我们。
领土.en: This territory has belonged to us since ancient times.

领土.zh: 他们为了扩大领土，发动了战争。
领土.en: They started a war to expand their territory.

生前.en: He loved painting before his death.
My grandfather was a doctor before he passed away.

生前.zh: 这位作家生前写了很多小说。
生前.en: This writer wrote many novels before his death.

生前.zh: 她生前捐了很多钱给慈善机构。
生前.en: She donated a lot of money to charities before she died.

生前.zh: 虽然他在生前并不出名，但死后作品却火了。
生前.en: Although he wasn't famous before his death, his works became popular after.

下落.zh: 警察正在调查他的下落。
下落.en: The police are investigating his whereabouts.

下落.zh: 那只猫的下落不明，我很担心。
下落.en: The cat's whereabouts are unknown, I'm worried.

下落.zh: 他失踪三天了，至今没有下落。
下落.en: He has been missing for three days with no trace yet.

下落.zh: 如果你有她的下落，请马上告诉我。
下落.en: If you have any news of her whereabouts, please tell me immediately.

无能为力.en: I can't do anything about this.

无能为力.zh: 面对这种情况，我们真的无能为力。
无能为力.en: Faced with this situation, we really can't do anything.

无能为力.zh: 虽然我想帮你，但实在无能为力。
无能为力.en: Although I want to help you, I really can't.

无能为力.zh: 病情太严重了，医生也感到无能为力。
无能为力.en: The illness is too severe, even the doctors feel helpless.

无能为力.zh: 他对自己的坏习惯感到无能为力，改不了。
无能为力.en: He feels powerless about his bad habits and can't change them.

老人家.zh: 这位老人家今年九十岁了。
老人家.en: This elderly person is ninety years old this year.

老人家.zh: 老人家身体还挺硬朗的。
老人家.en: The elderly person is still quite strong.

老人家.zh: 多陪陪老人家，他们会很开心。
老人家.en: Spend more time with the elderly, they will be very happy.

老人家.zh: 虽然老人家年纪大了，但记性非常好。
老人家.en: Although the elderly person is old, his memory is excellent.

跳跃.zh: 孩子们在沙发上跳跃玩耍。
跳跃.en: The children are jumping on the sofa playing.

跳跃.zh: 他的思维跳跃很快，让人跟不上。
跳跃.en: His thoughts jump quickly, hard to follow.

跳跃.zh: 这只青蛙从一片叶子跳跃到另一片。
跳跃.en: This frog jumps from one leaf to another.

跳跃.zh: 虽然她年纪大了，但依然喜欢跳跃运动。
跳跃.en: Although she is old, she still likes jumping exercises.

坠.en: He accidentally fell off the building.

坠.zh: 那颗流星从天空坠向地面。
坠.en: That meteor fell from the sky toward the ground.

坠.zh: 飞机坠毁后，救援队立刻赶到现场。
坠.en: After the plane crashed, rescue teams arrived immediately.

坠.zh: 她手里的杯子突然坠到地上，摔碎了。
坠.en: The cup in her hand suddenly fell to the ground and shattered.

本性.en: It's easy to change rivers and mountains but hard to change one's nature.

本性.zh: 人有时候会暴露自己的本性。
本性.en: People sometimes reveal their true nature.

本性.zh: 虽然他想装得严厉，但本性还是温柔的。
本性.en: Although he tries to act stern, his nature is still gentle.

本性.zh: 在压力之下，一个人的本性很容易体现出来。
本性.en: Under pressure, a person's true nature is easily shown.

相识.en: We have known each other for ten years.

相识.zh: 他们俩是在图书馆相识的。
相识.en: They met each other in the library.

相识.zh: 虽然我们相识不久，但感觉像老朋友一样。
相识.en: Although we haven't known each other long, it feels like old friends.

相识.zh: 她和我相识于一次旅行，后来成了最好的朋友。
相识.en: She and I met on a trip and later became best friends.

相识.zh: 既然已经相识，不如加个微信保持联系吧。
相识.en: Since we've already met, why not add each other on WeChat to stay in touch?

不可避免.zh: 随着年龄增长，身体变化不可避免。
不可避免.en: As we age, physical changes are inevitable.

不可避免.zh: 这次谈判虽然艰难，但冲突不可避免。
不可避免.en: Although this negotiation is tough, conflict is unavoidable.

不可避免.zh: 既然选择了创业，风险就是不可避免的。
不可避免.en: Since you chose to start a business, risk is unavoidable.

不可避免.zh: 他们俩性格不合，吵架几乎成了不可避免的事。
不可避免.en: Their personalities clash, so arguments have become almost inevitable.

惯例.en: Having tea before a meeting is a custom.

惯例.zh: 我们公司每周一都有早会惯例。
惯例.en: Our company has a routine morning meeting every Monday.

惯例.zh: 按照惯例，新年第一天要穿红色衣服。
惯例.en: According to tradition, you wear red on the first day of the new year.

惯例.zh: 虽然老板说不强制，但大家还是按惯例加班。
惯例.en: Even though the boss said it's not mandatory, everyone still works overtime as per usual.

惯例.zh: 这种送礼的惯例在老一辈人里很常见，年轻人不太讲究。
惯例.en: This custom of giving gifts is common among older generations; young people don't pay much attention to it.

荒唐.zh: 别相信那些荒唐的谣言。
他居然说地球是平的，真荒唐。
荒唐.en: He actually said the earth is flat—how absurd.

荒唐.zh: 电影里的情节虽然荒唐，但还挺好笑的。
荒唐.en: The plot in the movie is absurd, but it's still funny.

荒唐.zh: 你居然为这种事生气，我觉得挺荒唐的。
荒唐.en: You're actually angry about this? I think it's pretty ridiculous.

必定.zh: 明天必定下雨，记得带伞。
必定.en: It will definitely rain tomorrow; remember to bring an umbrella.

必定.zh: 只要你努力，结果必定不会太差。
必定.en: As long as you work hard, the result will definitely not be too bad.

必定.zh: 他这么认真准备，考试必定能通过。
必定.en: He prepared so seriously; he will definitely pass the exam.

必定.zh: 这件事如果处理不好，必定会引起很大的麻烦。
必定.en: If this matter is not handled well, it will definitely cause big trouble.

事宜.zh: 关于合同的事宜，我们明天再谈。
事宜.en: Regarding the contract matters, we'll talk tomorrow.

事宜.zh: 入住酒店的相关事宜都在邮件里写了。
事宜.en: All matters related to checking into the hotel are written in the email.

事宜.zh: 你负责安排这次会议的接待事宜。
事宜.en: You are responsible for arranging the reception matters for this meeting.

事宜.zh: 请假的事宜我已经和经理沟通过了。
事宜.en: I have already communicated with the manager about the leave matters.

弦.zh: 他拉小提琴时，弦音很优美。
弦.en: When he plays the violin, the string sound is very beautiful.

弦.zh: 这根弦太松了，需要调一下。
弦.en: This string is too loose; it needs tuning.

弦.zh: 比赛时他紧张得心弦都绷紧了。
弦.en: During the competition, he was so nervous that his heartstrings were tight.

弦.zh: 你说话别那么冲，容易让人绷紧神经弦。
弦.en: Don't speak so sharply; it easily puts people on edge.

迫不及待.en: He can't wait to see her.

迫不及待.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地拆开了礼物。
迫不及待.en: The children couldn't wait to open the presents.

迫不及待.zh: 电影一上映，我就迫不及待去看了。
迫不及待.en: As soon as the movie came out, I couldn't wait to go see it.

迫不及待.zh: 听到放假的消息，他迫不及待收拾行李回家。
迫不及待.en: Upon hearing the news of the holiday, he couldn't wait to pack his bags and go home.

迫不及待.zh: 她迫不及待地分享了自己的旅行经历。
迫不及待.en: She couldn't wait to share her travel experiences.

囚犯.zh: 监狱里囚犯每天都要劳动。
囚犯.en: Prisoners in the jail have to do labor every day.

囚犯.zh: 这名囚犯因为表现良好提前获释。
囚犯.en: This prisoner was released early for good behavior.

囚犯.zh: 电影里囚犯们策划了一次越狱。
囚犯.en: In the movie, the prisoners planned a prison break.

囚犯.zh: 法官判处这名囚犯二十年有期徒刑。
囚犯.en: The judge sentenced this prisoner to twenty years in prison.

虚伪.zh: 她表面客气，其实很虚伪。
虚伪.en: She is polite on the surface, but actually very hypocritical.

虚伪.zh: 他那些虚伪的夸奖，听着就难受。
虚伪.en: Those insincere compliments of his are hard to listen to.

虚伪.zh: 别对朋友说虚伪的话，真诚最重要。
虚伪.en: Don't say hypocritical things to friends; sincerity is the most important.

分泌.zh: 这种花会分泌甜甜的花蜜。
分泌.en: This kind of flower secretes sweet nectar.

分泌.zh: 运动后身体会分泌很多汗。
分泌.en: After exercise, the body secretes a lot of sweat.

分泌.zh: 她紧张的时候，胃里会分泌过多的胃酸。
分泌.en: When she's nervous, her stomach secretes too much gastric acid.

分泌.zh: 蜂蜜是蜜蜂分泌出来的，然后我们再收集。
分泌.en: Honey is secreted by bees, and then we collect it.

分泌.zh: 听说笑能让人分泌快乐的激素。
分泌.en: It's said that laughing can make people secrete happy hormones.

予以.en: The company decided to give him a reward.

予以.zh: 对这种情况，我们应当予以重视。
予以.en: We should pay attention to this situation.

予以.zh: 老师对学生的错误予以耐心指导。
予以.en: The teacher patiently guided the students regarding their mistakes.

予以.zh: 只要你有困难，政府会予以帮助。
予以.en: As long as you have difficulties, the government will provide help.

予以.zh: 他提出了很好的建议，领导予以了肯定。
予以.en: He made a good suggestion, and the leader gave affirmation.

触摸.zh: 他轻轻触摸了一下她的脸。
这个屏幕支持多点触摸。
盲人通过触摸来认识这个世界。
触摸.en: Blind people understand the world through touch.

触摸.zh: 她站在博物馆里，仿佛能触摸到历史的痕迹。
触摸.en: She stood in the museum, as if she could touch the traces of history.

好比.zh: 他跑得飞快，好比一阵风。
好比.en: He runs very fast, like a gust of wind.

好比.zh: 学习好比爬山，越往上越难。
好比.en: Learning is like climbing a mountain; the higher you go, the harder it gets.

好比.zh: 你对我发脾气，好比往伤口上撒盐。
好比.en: You losing your temper at me is like adding salt to a wound.

好比.zh: 这家餐厅的菜好吃得好比米其林大厨做的。
好比.en: The food at this restaurant is so delicious, it's like it was made by a Michelin chef.

起步.en: Learning piano is quite difficult at the start.

起步.zh: 这辆车起步很快，适合城市开。
起步.en: This car accelerates quickly from a start, suitable for city driving.

起步.zh: 公司起步的时候只有三个人。
起步.en: When the company started, there were only three people.

起步.zh: 如果你现在起步学英语，还来得及。
起步.en: If you start learning English now, it's still not too late.

余地.en: There is no room for negotiation on this matter.
When making plans, you should leave some leeway.

余地.zh: 他把话说死了，一点余地都不留。
余地.en: He spoke definitively, leaving no room for maneuver.

余地.zh: 预算已经用完了，没多少余地了。
余地.en: The budget is used up; there's not much leeway left.

余地.zh: 虽然很难，但还有挽回的余地。
余地.en: Although it's difficult, there is still room for recovery.

修正.en: I need to correct this mistake.

修正.zh: 地图上的路线已经修正过了。
修正.en: The route on the map has been corrected.

修正.zh: 他提出的方案我们得修正一下。
修正.en: The plan he proposed needs some correction.

修正.zh: 软件更新后会修正一些漏洞。
修正.en: After the software update, some bugs will be fixed.

修正.zh: 你的观点有点偏激，最好修正一下。
修正.en: Your viewpoint is a bit extreme; you'd better adjust it.

好心.zh: 别把别人的好心当成驴肝肺。
好心.en: Don't mistake someone's good intentions for bad.

好心.zh: 她好心提醒我，我却没当回事。
好心.en: She kindly reminded me, but I didn't take it seriously.

好心.zh: 你这份好心我领了，但不必了。
好心.en: I appreciate your kindness, but it's not necessary.
Sometimes even good intentions can lead to bad outcomes.

欺诈.en: This is an act of fraud.

欺诈.zh: 他因欺诈被判了三年刑。
欺诈.en: He was sentenced to three years in prison for fraud.

欺诈.zh: 我们绝不容忍任何欺诈。
欺诈.en: We will never tolerate any fraud.
Be careful of fraud when shopping online.

欺诈.zh: 该公司涉嫌欺诈，已被调查。
欺诈.en: The company is suspected of fraud and is under investigation.

扭转.en: We have to turn this situation around.

扭转.zh: 他用力一扭，就扭转了把手。
扭转.en: He gave a hard twist and turned the handle.

扭转.zh: 公司业绩下滑，需要想办法扭转。
扭转.en: The company's performance is declining; we need to find a way to reverse it.

扭转.zh: 教练在最后五分钟扭转了比赛。
扭转.en: The coach turned the game around in the last five minutes.

扭转.zh: 只要团结一致，就能扭转劣势。
扭转.en: As long as we unite, we can reverse the disadvantage.

狂热.zh: 那些狂热粉丝为了见偶像排了一整夜的队。
狂热.en: Those fanatical fans queued all night to see their idol.

狂热.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但他的狂热一点都没减少。
狂热.en: Although the weather was very cold, his enthusiasm didn't diminish at all.

狂热.zh: 这种狂热的风潮很快就过去了。
狂热.en: This kind of craze passed quickly.

狂热.zh: 他狂热地追求梦想，最后终于成功了。
狂热.en: He pursued his dream fanatically and finally succeeded.

硬币.en: I have a coin in my pocket.

硬币.zh: 他在自动售货机里投了两枚硬币。
硬币.en: He put two coins into the vending machine.

硬币.zh: 因为没零钱，我只好用硬币付了车费。
硬币.en: Because I had no change, I had to pay the fare with coins.

硬币.zh: 这枚旧硬币是从奶奶那里得到的。
硬币.en: This old coin was obtained from grandma.

硬币.zh: 孩子们在喷水池里扔了许多硬币许愿。
硬币.en: The children threw many coins into the fountain to make wishes.

压制.zh: 他努力压制住自己的怒火，没有发火。
压制.en: He tried hard to suppress his anger and didn't lose his temper.

压制.zh: 虽然想反驳，但他还是压制住了冲动。
压制.en: Although he wanted to refute, he still suppressed his impulse.

压制.zh: 这种新药可以压制癌细胞的生长。
压制.en: This new drug can suppress the growth of cancer cells.

压制.zh: 公司压制了员工的负面言论，不让大家讨论。
压制.en: The company suppressed employees' negative comments and didn't allow discussion.

香味.en: The aroma comes from the bakery.

香味.zh: 这种花的香味很淡，但闻起来很舒服。
香味.en: The fragrance of this flower is light but smells very comfortable.

香味.zh: 因为她喷了香水，所以身上总有一股香味。
香味.en: Because she wore perfume, she always has a fragrance on her.

香味.zh: 咖啡的香味让我精神一振。
香味.en: The aroma of coffee perked me up.

香味.zh: 厨房里飘出一股浓郁的烤肉香味，我肚子都饿了。
香味.en: A strong aroma of grilled meat wafted from the kitchen, making me hungry.

窜.en: A mouse scurried out of the hole.

窜.zh: 他突然从座位上窜起来，吓了我一跳。
窜.en: He suddenly jumped up from his seat, scaring me.

窜.zh: 因为房价猛窜，很多人都买不起房了。
窜.en: Because housing prices soared, many people can't afford to buy a house.

窜.zh: 一只野猫从草丛里窜了过去。
窜.en: A wild cat darted through the grass.

窜.zh: 听到警报声，所有人立刻窜出了大楼。
窜.en: Hearing the alarm, everyone immediately rushed out of the building.

前任.zh: 我现任老板比前任老板好很多。
前任.en: My current boss is much better than the previous one.

前任.zh: 虽然已经分手了，但她还和前任保持联系。
前任.en: Although they have broken up, she still keeps in touch with her ex.

前任.zh: 这位总统的前任政策更保守。
前任.en: The previous president's policies were more conservative.

前任.zh: 他在宴会上遇到了自己的前任，气氛有点尴尬。
前任.en: He met his ex at the party, and the atmosphere was a bit awkward.

沙龙.zh: 她常去美容沙龙做头发。
沙龙.en: She often goes to the beauty salon to do her hair.

沙龙.zh: 这个文学沙龙每周五晚上都会举办讨论会。
沙龙.en: This literary salon holds discussions every Friday evening.

沙龙.zh: 虽然我不太喜欢社交，但我还是参加了那个艺术沙龙。
沙龙.en: Although I don't like socializing very much, I still attended that art salon.

沙龙.zh: 他们在家办了一个小型音乐沙龙。
沙龙.en: They held a small music salon at home.

沙龙.zh: 这家沙龙的服务很好，所以顾客非常多。
沙龙.en: The service at this salon is very good, so there are many customers.

志愿.zh: 我妹妹在养老院做志愿工作。
志愿.en: My sister does volunteer work at a nursing home.

志愿.zh: 他填报了三个大学志愿，第一是北大。
志愿.en: He filled in three college preferences, first is Peking University.

志愿.zh: 因为想帮助别人，他加入了志愿救援队。
志愿.en: Because he wanted to help others, he joined the volunteer rescue team.

志愿.zh: 她的志愿是当一名医生。
志愿.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor.

志愿.zh: 这次活动需要很多志愿人员，我们都报名了。
志愿.en: This event needs many volunteers, and we all signed up.

依照.en: According to the law, you have to pay tax.

依照.zh: 请依照说明书上的步骤来操作机器。
依照.en: Please operate the machine according to the steps in the manual.

依照.zh: 如果依照他的计划，我们下周就能完成。
依照.en: If we follow his plan, we can finish next week.

依照.zh: 依照约定，我下午三点去接你。
依照.en: According to the agreement, I will pick you up at 3 pm.

依照.zh: 考试成绩会依照评分标准来判定，不会偏袒任何人。
依照.en: Test scores will be judged according to the grading criteria and won't favor anyone.

备受.en: He suffered a lot of criticism.

备受.zh: 这部电影备受好评，很多人推荐去看。
备受.en: This movie is highly praised; many people recommend watching it.

备受.zh: 虽然备受质疑，但他依然坚持自己的观点。
备受.en: Although he was questioned a lot, he still stuck to his point of view.

备受.zh: 她备受宠爱，从小就过着优越的生活。
备受.en: She is very much loved and has lived a privileged life since childhood.

备受.zh: 那个新演员因为演技差而备受观众的嘲笑。
备受.en: That new actor was ridiculed by the audience because of his poor acting.

头顶.en: There is a little bird on top of his head.

头顶.zh: 阳光照在头顶，感觉好热。
头顶.en: The sun is shining on my head, it feels so hot.

头顶.zh: 她戴了一顶帽子遮住头顶。
头顶.en: She wore a hat to cover her head.

头顶.zh: 虽然头顶有压力，但他还是坚持下来了。
头顶.en: Although there was pressure on his head, he still persevered.

头顶.zh: 他头顶的头发越来越少，已经开始秃了。
头顶.en: The hair on top of his head is getting less and less, he's starting to go bald.

住处.en: Is your residence far from the company?

住处.zh: 我还没找到合适的住处。
住处.en: I haven't found a suitable place to live yet.

住处.zh: 他搬到了一个新的住处，环境很好。
住处.en: He moved to a new residence with a nice environment.

住处.zh: 因为工作原因，我需要临时找个住处。
住处.en: Due to work reasons, I need to find temporary accommodation.

住处.zh: 这个住处虽然小，但住起来很舒服。
住处.en: This place is small, but it's very comfortable to live in.

推翻.en: They want to overturn this plan.

推翻.zh: 他推翻了自己的结论，重新开始研究。
推翻.en: He overturned his own conclusion and started research anew.

推翻.zh: 如果证据不足，法院可能会推翻判决。
推翻.en: If the evidence is insufficient, the court may overturn the verdict.

推翻.zh: 革命者试图推翻旧政权，建立新政府。
推翻.en: The revolutionaries tried to overthrow the old regime and establish a new government.

疏散.zh: 地震后，居民被疏散到安全地带。
疏散.en: After the earthquake, residents were evacuated to safe areas.

疏散.zh: 听到警报声，人群开始有序疏散。
疏散.en: Upon hearing the alarm, the crowd began to evacuate in an orderly manner.

疏散.zh: 消防员正在疏散大楼里的人。
疏散.en: The firefighters are evacuating the people in the building.

疏散.zh: 因为台风来了，学校提前疏散了所有学生。
疏散.en: Because the typhoon is coming, the school evacuated all students early.

境内.zh: 这些产品只在境内销售。
境内.en: These products are only sold domestically.

境内.zh: 境外游客在境内要遵守法律。
境内.en: Overseas tourists must abide by laws within the country.

境内.zh: 这个湖泊位于国家公园境内。
境内.en: This lake is located within the national park.

境内.zh: 境内有些地区还保留着古老的传统。
境内.en: Some areas within the country still retain ancient traditions.

境内.zh: 他自驾游遍了中国境内大部分省份。
境内.en: He traveled by car through most provinces within China.

煤气.en: My gas stove at home is broken.

煤气.zh: 这个月煤气费比上个月高。
煤气.en: The gas bill this month is higher than last month.

煤气.zh: 做饭时别忘了关煤气阀门。
煤气.en: Don't forget to turn off the gas valve when cooking.

煤气.zh: 如果闻到煤气味，立刻打开窗户通风。
煤气.en: If you smell gas, open the windows immediately for ventilation.

庆典.en: There is a large celebration on National Day.

庆典.zh: 学校举行了一百周年庆典。
庆典.en: The school held its centennial celebration.

庆典.zh: 庆典上放了很多烟花，非常漂亮。
庆典.en: There were many fireworks at the celebration, very beautiful.

庆典.zh: 他邀请了所有朋友参加婚礼庆典。
庆典.en: He invited all his friends to the wedding celebration.

庆典.zh: 庆典结束后，大家一起合影留念。
庆典.en: After the celebration ended, everyone took a group photo as a souvenir.

光彩.en: Her face is full of radiance.

光彩.zh: 这件事让他觉得很光彩。
光彩.en: This matter made him feel very glorious.

光彩.zh: 钻石在灯光下闪闪发光，十分光彩。
光彩.en: The diamond sparkled under the light, very dazzling.

光彩.zh: 他获得了冠军，为学校增添了光彩。
光彩.en: He won the championship, adding glory to the school.

光彩.zh: 虽然失败了，但他们的表现依然很光彩。
光彩.en: Although they failed, their performance was still honorable.

造就.zh: 他的努力造就了今天的成功。
造就.en: His hard work created today's success.

造就.zh: 这个学校造就了许多优秀人才。
造就.en: This school has cultivated many outstanding talents.

造就.zh: 好的习惯能造就一个更好的人生。
造就.en: Good habits can create a better life.

造就.zh: 失败并不可怕，它能造就更坚强的你。
造就.en: Failure is not scary; it can forge a stronger you.

隐形.zh: 这种病毒是隐形的，看不见。
隐形.en: This virus is invisible, cannot be seen.

隐形.zh: 隐形飞机很难被雷达发现。
隐形.en: Stealth aircraft are hard to detect by radar.

隐形.zh: 他在网上用的是隐形身份。
隐形.en: He uses an anonymous identity online.

隐形.zh: 有些伤害是隐形的，但影响却很大。
隐形.en: Some harm is invisible, but its impact is huge.

大局.en: We must consider the overall situation.

大局.zh: 虽然细节有分歧，但大局是好的。
大局.en: Although there are differences in details, the overall situation is good.

大局.zh: 这件事影响大局，不能随便处理。
大局.en: This matter affects the overall situation and cannot be handled casually.

大局.zh: 从大局来看，这个方案更合理。
大局.en: From an overall perspective, this plan is more reasonable.

大局.zh: 他只看眼前利益，不顾大局。
大局.en: He only cares about immediate gains and ignores the overall situation.

人手.en: The company has been short-staffed recently.

人手.zh: 这个项目需要增加人手。
如果人手不足，我们可以请临时工。
人手.en: If we are short-staffed, we can hire temporary workers.

人手.zh: 周末活动的人手安排好了吗？
人手.en: Has the staffing for the weekend event been arranged?

人手.zh: 我们店里人手少，得自己多干点。
人手.en: Our shop is understaffed, so we have to do more ourselves.

暂.en: The meeting is tentatively scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.

暂.zh: 由于天气原因，航班暂缓起飞。
暂.en: Due to weather conditions, the flight is temporarily delayed.

暂.zh: 我们暂不讨论这个问题。
暂.en: We will not discuss this issue for now.
This plan has not been approved yet for now.

暂.zh: 请你暂留片刻，他马上回来。
暂.en: Please stay for a moment; he'll be right back.

滥用.zh: 抗生素滥用会导致耐药性。
滥用.en: Antibiotic abuse can lead to drug resistance.

滥用.zh: 他因为滥用公款被开除了。
滥用.en: He was fired for misusing public funds.

滥用.zh: 网络用语被滥用，失去了原意。
滥用.en: Internet slang is overused and loses its original meaning.

滥用.zh: 政府禁止滥用食品添加剂。
滥用.en: The government prohibits the abuse of food additives.

冻结.zh: 因为涉嫌洗钱，他的资产被冻结了。
冻结.en: His assets were frozen because of suspected money laundering.

冻结.zh: 公司决定冻结所有招聘。
冻结.en: The company decided to freeze all hiring.

冻结.zh: 他们打算冻结股价，防止波动。
冻结.en: They plan to freeze the stock price to prevent fluctuations.

冻结.zh: 天气太冷，水管都冻结了。
冻结.en: It's so cold that the water pipes have frozen.

愈合.zh: 骨折大概需要三个月愈合。
愈合.en: A fracture usually takes about three months to heal.

愈合.zh: 这种药能帮助皮肤快速愈合。
愈合.en: This medicine can help the skin heal quickly.

愈合.zh: 心理创伤也需要时间愈合。
愈合.en: Psychological trauma also needs time to heal.

愈合.zh: 手术后伤口愈合得很好，没有感染。
愈合.en: The wound healed well after surgery, with no infection.

草坪.zh: 公园的草坪修剪得很整齐。
草坪.en: The lawn in the park is neatly trimmed.

草坪.zh: 孩子们在草坪上踢足球。
草坪.en: The children are playing soccer on the lawn.

草坪.zh: 草坪需要定期浇水，否则会枯黄。
草坪.en: The lawn needs regular watering, otherwise it will turn yellow.

草坪.zh: 他们坐在草坪上野餐，享受阳光。
草坪.en: They sat on the lawn for a picnic, enjoying the sunshine.

营造.zh: 我们要营造良好的学习氛围。
营造.en: We need to create a good learning atmosphere.

营造.zh: 公司努力营造轻松的工作环境。
营造.en: The company strives to create a relaxed working environment.

营造.zh: 他说话风趣，善于营造轻松的气氛。
营造.en: He speaks humorously and is good at creating a light-hearted atmosphere.

营造.zh: 通过绿化，营造出舒适的生活空间。
营造.en: Through greening, a comfortable living space is created.

营造.zh: 这种布置能营造浪漫的感觉。
营造.en: This arrangement can create a romantic feeling.

越过.en: He easily jumped over the obstacle.

越过.zh: 如果你想成功，必须越过许多困难。
越过.en: If you want to succeed, you must overcome many difficulties.

越过.zh: 汽车越过山坡，看到了大海。
越过.en: The car went over the hill and saw the sea.

越过.zh: 我们越过森林，终于到了目的地。
越过.en: We crossed the forest and finally reached our destination.

侦探.en: The detective quickly found a clue.

侦探.zh: 这位侦探经验丰富，破了很多案子。
侦探.en: This detective is experienced and has solved many cases.

侦探.zh: 他们雇了一个侦探来调查这件事。
侦探.en: They hired a detective to investigate this matter.

动摇.zh: 这件事让我们的信任动摇了。
不管遇到什么困难，他的信念都没有动摇。
动摇.en: No matter what difficulties he encountered, his faith never wavered.

动摇.zh: 听到这个消息，她有点动摇，但还是决定坚持下去。
动摇.en: After hearing the news, she wavered a bit but still decided to persevere.

动摇.zh: 风太大，树都开始动摇了。
动摇.en: The wind was so strong that the trees began to shake.

稍后.zh: 您稍等一下，我稍后就来。
稍后.en: Please wait a moment, I'll be right there.

稍后.zh: 先别着急，稍后会有通知的。
稍后.en: Don't worry, there will be a notice later.

稍后.zh: 我们稍后出发，你先收拾好行李。
稍后.en: We'll leave later; you pack your luggage first.

丢人.en: Failing the exam is so embarrassing.
Making a fool of yourself in public is really embarrassing.

丢人.zh: 这点小事都做不好，你不觉得丢人吗？
丢人.en: Can't even handle such a small matter, aren't you embarrassed?

丢人.zh: 比赛输了虽然丢人，但至少我们尽力了。
丢人.en: Although losing the game is embarrassing, at least we did our best.

怀里.en: She held the child in her arms.
The cat curled up in its owner's arms.

怀里.zh: 他把钱包紧紧揣在怀里。
怀里.en: He tucked the wallet tightly into his chest.

怀里.zh: 看到妈妈，小女孩一下子扑进她怀里。
怀里.en: Seeing her mother, the little girl threw herself into her arms.

怀里.zh: 他怀里抱着一个很大的盒子，看起来挺重的。
怀里.en: He was holding a big box in his arms, and it looked quite heavy.

挠.en: A mosquito bit me, it's so itchy, I want to scratch.
Stop scratching, the more you scratch, the itchier it gets.

挠.zh: 猫很喜欢让人挠它的下巴。
挠.en: Cats love it when people scratch their chins.

挠.zh: 他挠了挠胳膊，发现是被虫子咬了。
挠.en: He scratched his arm and found it was bitten by a bug.

公务.en: He is on a business trip.

公务.zh: 这是公务，不能随便透露。
公务.en: This is official business and cannot be disclosed casually.

公务.zh: 最近公务繁忙，没时间休息。
公务.en: I've been busy with official business recently and have no time to rest.

公务.zh: 他穿着一身西装，看起来很像是去办公务。
公务.en: He was in a suit, looking like he was going on official business.

公务.zh: 虽然今天是周末，但他还是要去处理一些公务。
公务.en: Although it's the weekend, he still has to deal with some official business.

来访.zh: 总统将于下周一正式来访。
来访.en: The president will make an official visit next Monday.

来访.zh: 来访的客人里有一位很有名的作家。
来访.en: Among the visiting guests, there was a very famous writer.

来访.zh: 如果你来访，提前告诉我一声。
来访.en: If you come to visit, let me know in advance.

穆斯林.zh: 他是一位虔诚的穆斯林。
这个社区住了很多穆斯林。
穆斯林.en: Many Muslims live in this community.

穆斯林.zh: 每年斋月，穆斯林都会白天禁食。
穆斯林.en: Every year during Ramadan, Muslims fast during the day.

穆斯林.zh: 我有个穆斯林朋友，他每天要做五次礼拜。
穆斯林.en: I have a Muslim friend who prays five times a day.

口音.en: Judging by his accent, he seems to be from the north.

口音.zh: 她说普通话带有南方口音。
口音.en: She speaks Mandarin with a southern accent.

口音.zh: 虽然他有口音，但说话很清楚。
口音.en: Although he has an accent, he speaks very clearly.

口音.zh: 她的英语口音很地道，几乎听不出来是外国人。
口音.en: Her English accent is very authentic, almost impossible to tell she's a foreigner.

稀.en: The trees in this forest are sparse.

稀.zh: 天上星星很稀，可能明天要下雨。
稀.en: The stars in the sky are sparse; it might rain tomorrow.

稀.zh: 这种植物在野外已经很稀少了。
稀.en: This kind of plant has become very rare in the wild.

稀.zh: 他头发越来越稀，快秃了。
稀.en: His hair is getting thinner and thinner; he's almost bald.

乱七八糟.zh: 他的书包里乱七八糟，什么都有。
乱七八糟.en: His bag is a mess, with everything in it.

乱七八糟.zh: 因为昨晚没收拾，现在家里乱七八糟的。
乱七八糟.en: Because I didn't tidy up last night, the house is a mess now.

乱七八糟.zh: 这篇文章写得乱七八糟，我看不懂。
乱七八糟.en: This article is written in a mess; I can't understand it.

乱七八糟.zh: 虽然整理过，但桌上还是乱七八糟。
乱七八糟.en: Even though I tidied up, the desk is still messy.

贫穷.en: He has been poor since childhood.

贫穷.zh: 那个地区非常贫穷，很多人吃不饱。
贫穷.en: That area is very poor; many people don't have enough to eat.

贫穷.zh: 虽然家里贫穷，但他很努力。
贫穷.en: Although his family is poor, he works hard.

贫穷.zh: 因为贫穷，他不得不辍学打工。
贫穷.en: Because of poverty, he had to drop out of school and work.

贫穷.zh: 贫穷不是缺点，关键要看心态。
贫穷.en: Poverty is not a flaw; the key is one's attitude.

判处.zh: 法院判处他三年有期徒刑。
判处.en: The court sentenced him to three years in prison.

判处.zh: 因为证据不足，法官没有判处他。
判处.en: Due to insufficient evidence, the judge did not sentence him.

判处.zh: 法官判处他十年监禁，但他不服。
判处.en: The judge sentenced him to ten years in prison, but he appealed.

判处.zh: 这起案件最终判处了主犯无期徒刑。
判处.en: This case finally sentenced the main offender to life imprisonment.

英俊.zh: 那个演员十分英俊，很多粉丝喜欢。
英俊.en: That actor is very handsome; many fans like him.

英俊.zh: 他不仅英俊，而且很有才华。
英俊.en: He is not only handsome but also very talented.

英俊.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他依然英俊。
英俊.en: Although he is older, he is still handsome.

英俊.zh: 照片里的他看起来非常英俊。
英俊.en: He looks very handsome in the photo.

行列.en: He stands in the line of the queue.

行列.zh: 这家公司已经进入世界五百强行列。
行列.en: This company has entered the ranks of the world's top 500.

行列.zh: 她努力想进入优秀学生的行列。
行列.en: She strives to join the ranks of outstanding students.

行列.zh: 因为成绩突出，他加入了奖学金获得者的行列。
行列.en: Because of his outstanding grades, he joined the ranks of scholarship winners.

行列.zh: 这种产品已经退出市场行列了。
行列.en: This product has withdrawn from the market ranks.

变异.zh: 这种基因变异会导致疾病。
变异.en: This genetic mutation can cause disease.

变异.zh: 环境变化可能引起生物变异。
变异.en: Environmental changes can cause biological mutations.

变异.zh: 虽然变异很小，但影响很大。
变异.en: Although the mutation is small, the impact is great.

变异.zh: 科学家正在研究这种新的变异类型。
变异.en: Scientists are studying this new type of mutation.

电线.zh: 小心那些掉在地上的电线。
电线.en: Be careful of those wires lying on the ground.

电线.zh: 工人正在修理损坏的电线。
电线.en: Workers are repairing the damaged wires.

电线.zh: 因为电线老化，所以需要更换。
电线.en: Because the wires are aging, they need to be replaced.

电线.zh: 小鸟站在电线上很危险。
电线.en: It's dangerous for a bird to stand on a wire.

麻痹.zh: 他因为中毒导致全身麻痹。
麻痹.en: He became paralyzed all over due to poisoning.

麻痹.zh: 不要因为成绩好就麻痹大意。
麻痹.en: Don't be complacent just because you get good grades.

麻痹.zh: 虽然伤口不大，但那只手一直麻痹。
麻痹.en: Although the wound is small, that hand has been numb.

麻痹.zh: 长期熬夜会让神经麻痹。
麻痹.en: Long-term sleep deprivation can numb the nerves.

制裁.zh: 那个国家遭到了国际社会的制裁。
制裁.en: That country has faced international sanctions.

制裁.zh: 经济制裁对普通人影响很大。
制裁.en: Economic sanctions have a big impact on ordinary people.

制裁.zh: 因为违反协议，他们被制裁了。
制裁.en: Because they violated the agreement, they were sanctioned.

制裁.zh: 制裁不是解决问题的唯一办法。
制裁.en: Sanctions are not the only way to solve the problem.

日程.zh: 请把明天的日程发给我。
我的日程安排得满满的。
因为出差，所以我的日程改变了。
日程.en: Because of a business trip, my schedule has changed.

日程.zh: 会议日程已经确定了，不能改。
日程.en: The meeting agenda has been set and cannot be changed.

招募.en: The company is recruiting new employees.

招募.zh: 这次志愿者招募活动需要很多人手。
招募.en: This volunteer recruitment activity needs a lot of people.

招募.zh: 他们通过网上招聘平台招募技术人员。
招募.en: They recruit technical staff through online recruitment platforms.

招募.zh: 虽然招募条件很严格，但还是有很多人报名。
招募.en: Although the recruitment conditions are very strict, many people still signed up.

招募.zh: 学校招募了一批优秀的老师来教课。
招募.en: The school recruited a group of excellent teachers to teach.

预感.en: I have a bad feeling about this.

预感.zh: 她预感今天会下雨，所以带了伞。
预感.en: She had a feeling it would rain today, so she brought an umbrella.

预感.zh: 我的预感告诉我这次考试会很难。
预感.en: My intuition tells me this exam will be very hard.

预感.zh: 虽然他什么也没说，但我预感他可能要辞职。
预感.en: Although he didn't say anything, I have a feeling he might resign.

预感.zh: 这种奇怪的预感让我心里很不安。
预感.en: This strange premonition makes me feel very uneasy.

绅士.zh: 那位绅士主动给老人让座。
绅士.en: That gentleman offered his seat to an elderly person.

绅士.zh: 做一名绅士要懂得尊重女性。
绅士.en: To be a gentleman, you need to know how to respect women.

绅士.zh: 他虽然很有钱，但不是那种绅士作风。
绅士.en: Although he is very rich, he doesn't have that gentlemanly style.

绅士.zh: 在公共场合，绅士应该保持礼貌和风度。
绅士.en: In public, a gentleman should maintain politeness and composure.

引领.zh: 这个品牌一直引领着时尚潮流。
引领.en: This brand has been leading the fashion trends.

引领.zh: 她的演讲引领大家思考人生意义。
引领.en: Her speech led everyone to think about the meaning of life.

引领.zh: 因为技术领先，这家公司引领行业发展。
引领.en: Because of its leading technology, this company guides the industry's development.

引领.zh: 老师引领学生探索科学奥秘。
引领.en: The teacher guided the students to explore the mysteries of science.

开张.zh: 这家餐厅开张第一天就排起了长队。
开张.en: This restaurant had a long line on its first day of business.

开张.zh: 我们的小店下周正式开张营业。
开张.en: Our small shop will officially open for business next week.

开张.zh: 虽然刚开张，但生意已经非常好了。
开张.en: Although it just opened, business is already very good.

开张.zh: 开张那天老板请来了舞狮表演。
开张.en: On opening day, the boss invited a lion dance performance.

抗拒.zh: 我无法抗拒美食的诱惑。
抗拒.en: I can't resist the temptation of delicious food.

抗拒.zh: 她抗拒不了男朋友的请求，还是答应了。
抗拒.en: She couldn't resist her boyfriend's request and agreed after all.

抗拒.zh: 很多人对改变有本能的抗拒心理。
抗拒.en: Many people have an instinctive resistance to change.

抗拒.zh: 明知道熬夜不好，但我还是抗拒不了手机的吸引。
抗拒.en: I know staying up late is bad, but I still can't resist the attraction of my phone.

抗拒.zh: 这种药物能有效抗拒病毒入侵。
抗拒.en: This medicine can effectively resist viral invasion.

评判.zh: 裁判会根据选手的表现来评判分数。
评判.en: The judges will score based on the contestants' performance.

评判.zh: 他的评判标准非常严格。
评判.en: His judging criteria are very strict.

评判.zh: 我们不应该只看表面就评判一个人的好坏。
评判.en: We shouldn't judge a person's character just by appearance.

评判.zh: 这场比赛由三位专家共同评判。
评判.en: This competition is judged jointly by three experts.

不堪.en: This sound is simply unbearable to listen to.

不堪.zh: 他的生活已经不堪重负了。
不堪.en: His life is already overwhelmed by heavy burdens.

不堪.zh: 那部电影的情节不堪一击。
不堪.en: The plot of that movie is flimsy and untenable.

不堪.zh: 因为工作压力太大，他感到疲惫不堪。
不堪.en: Because the work pressure was too great, he felt extremely exhausted.

不堪.zh: 她的态度让我觉得不堪忍受。
不堪.en: Her attitude makes me feel intolerable.

别扭.en: These shoes feel uncomfortable to wear.

别扭.zh: 我和他之间气氛有点别扭。
别扭.en: The atmosphere between him and me is a bit awkward.

别扭.zh: 你这样说让人觉得很别扭。
别扭.en: Saying it like that makes people feel awkward.

别扭.zh: 虽然大家表面上很和气，但私下里关系很别扭。
别扭.en: Although everyone is friendly on the surface, their relationship is quite awkward in private.

别扭.zh: 第一次穿西装，总感觉浑身不自在很别扭。
别扭.en: The first time wearing a suit, I always feel uncomfortable and awkward all over.

大片.en: There's a blockbuster movie showing recently.

大片.zh: 这部科幻大片的特效非常震撼。
大片.en: The special effects of this sci-fi blockbuster are very impressive.

大片.zh: 每年暑假都有很多好莱坞大片。
大片.en: Every summer there are many Hollywood blockbusters.

大片.zh: 虽然票价很贵，但这部大片值得一看。
大片.en: Although the ticket price is expensive, this blockbuster is worth watching.

大片.zh: 国产大片近年来进步很快。
大片.en: Domestic blockbusters have made rapid progress in recent years.

轰炸.zh: 敌人又轰炸了这座城市。
轰炸.en: The enemy bombed this city again.

轰炸.zh: 我手机被广告短信轰炸了。
轰炸.en: My phone was bombarded with advertisement texts.
