轰炸.zh: 他们连续轰炸了三天，然后撤退了。
轰炸.en: They bombed for three consecutive days and then retreated.

轰炸.zh: 别再轰炸我的微信了，我一会儿回你。
轰炸.en: Stop bombarding my WeChat, I'll reply to you later.

轰炸.zh: 虽然敌军轰炸很猛，但我们还是守住了阵地。
轰炸.en: Although the enemy bombing was fierce, we still held our position.

指标.zh: 这个月的指标还没完成。
指标.en: This month's target hasn't been met yet.

指标.zh: 老板给我们定了很高的销售指标。
指标.en: The boss set very high sales targets for us.

指标.zh: 如果指标达不到，奖金就没了。
指标.en: If the target isn't met, the bonus is gone.

指标.zh: 她每天都盯着业绩指标，压力很大。
指标.en: She keeps an eye on the performance indicators every day, under a lot of pressure.

指标.zh: 虽然指标很难，但大家都努力去完成。
指标.en: Although the target is tough, everyone is working hard to achieve it.

盏.en: There is a desk lamp on the table.

盏.zh: 夜晚的城市亮起一盏盏路灯。
盏.en: At night, the city lights up one streetlamp after another.

盏.zh: 他买了一盏新的吊灯挂在客厅。
盏.en: He bought a new chandelier and hung it in the living room.

盏.zh: 这盏油灯虽然旧，但还能用。
盏.en: This oil lamp, though old, still works.

盏.zh: 因为停电了，我们只好点一盏蜡烛。
盏.en: Because the power went out, we had to light a candle.

揉.en: The dough needs to be kneaded until smooth.
My back hurts, can you rub it for me?

揉.zh: 她揉着太阳穴，看起来很难受。
揉.en: She was rubbing her temples, looking very uncomfortable.

揉.zh: 先把纸揉成一团，再扔进垃圾桶。
揉.en: First crumple the paper into a ball, then throw it into the trash.

感性.en: She is a very emotional person.

感性.zh: 做决定不能太感性，也要理性分析。
感性.en: When making decisions, you can't be too emotional; you also need rational analysis.

感性.zh: 这首歌让我觉得很感性，差点哭了。
感性.en: This song made me feel very emotional; I almost cried.

感性.zh: 感性的人容易共情，但也容易受伤。
感性.en: Emotional people empathize easily but also get hurt easily.

感性.zh: 他虽然很理性，但在爱情里却变得很感性。
感性.en: Although he is very rational, he becomes very emotional in love.

探险.en: They went exploring in the forest.

探险.zh: 这部电影讲的是深海探险的故事。
探险.en: This movie is about deep-sea exploration.

探险.zh: 探险之前要做好充分的准备。
探险.en: Before exploring, you need to make thorough preparations.

探险.zh: 他从小就喜欢探险，长大后当了探险家。
探险.en: He loved exploring since childhood, and grew up to become an explorer.

探险.zh: 虽然探险很危险，但很多人还是愿意尝试。
探险.en: Although exploration is dangerous, many people are still willing to try it.

正经.zh: 他是个很正经的人，不爱开玩笑。
正经.en: He is a very serious person and doesn't like joking.

正经.zh: 这家店看起来不正经，我们还是别去了。
正经.en: This shop looks shady; we'd better not go in.

正经.zh: 他虽然平时很搞笑，但工作起来非常正经。
正经.en: Although he's usually funny, he's very serious when working.

完蛋.zh: 如果考试不及格，我就完蛋了。
完蛋.en: If I fail the exam, I'm screwed.

完蛋.zh: 手机掉水里了，完蛋，数据都没了。
完蛋.en: My phone fell into water; it's done for, all the data is gone.

完蛋.zh: 她发现男朋友骗了她，觉得感情完蛋了。
完蛋.en: She found out her boyfriend lied to her and felt the relationship was over.

完蛋.zh: 再这样下去，公司真的要完蛋了。
完蛋.en: If this continues, the company will really be finished.

呼唤.en: Mom is calling me to come home.

呼唤.zh: 他在远处呼唤我的名字。
呼唤.en: He called my name from afar.

呼唤.zh: 大自然在呼唤我们去保护它。
呼唤.en: Nature is calling us to protect it.

呼唤.zh: 虽然很累，但责任在呼唤他继续前进。
呼唤.en: Although tired, duty was calling him to move forward.

呼唤.zh: 她站在山顶大声呼唤，山谷里传来回音。
呼唤.en: She stood on the mountaintop shouting, and an echo came back from the valley.

主力.en: He is the main player on the team.

主力.zh: 这次任务的主力是技术部。
主力.en: The main force for this task is the tech department.

主力.zh: 主力队员受伤了，比赛不好打。
主力.en: The key player is injured, so the game will be tough.

主力.zh: 公司的主力产品销量一直很稳定。
主力.en: The company's flagship product has stable sales.

主力.zh: 虽然他是替补，但实力不输主力。
主力.en: Although he is a substitute, his strength is no less than the starters.

盈利.en: The company made a profit this year.

盈利.zh: 虽然成本很高，但我们还是盈利了。
盈利.en: Even though costs were high, we still made a profit.
This store makes a good profit every month.

盈利.zh: 盈利不是我们唯一的目标。
盈利.en: Profit is not our only goal.

盈利.zh: 他们想尽办法让企业盈利。
盈利.en: They tried every way to make the company profitable.

顶尖.zh: 这所大学拥有顶尖的科研设备。
顶尖.en: This university has top-notch research equipment.

顶尖.zh: 虽然他成绩很好，但还不是顶尖水平。
顶尖.en: Although his grades are good, he is not yet at the top level.

顶尖.zh: 这家公司聘请了顶尖设计师。
要成为顶尖运动员需要很多努力。
顶尖.en: Becoming a top athlete requires a lot of effort.

传媒.en: The media industry changes very fast.

传媒.zh: 现在很多年轻人选择在传媒领域工作。
传媒.en: Many young people now choose to work in the media field.

传媒.zh: 随着传媒发展，信息传播更快了。
传媒.en: With the development of media, information spreads faster.

传媒.zh: 他毕业后进了传媒公司。
传媒.en: After graduation, he joined a media company.

放置.en: Please put the books away properly.

放置.zh: 这个花瓶要放置在安全的地方。
放置.en: This vase should be placed in a safe place.

放置.zh: 如果你不经常使用，可以放置到柜子里。
放置.en: If you don't use it often, you can put it in the cabinet.

放置.zh: 不要将贵重物品随意放置。
放置.en: Don't leave valuables lying around casually.

放置.zh: 机器需要放置在通风处。
放置.en: The machine needs to be placed in a ventilated area.

选民.zh: 这次选举的选民人数比往年多。
选民.en: The number of voters in this election is higher than previous years.

选民.zh: 虽然选民很多，但投票率不高。
选民.en: Although there are many voters, the turnout is not high.

选民.zh: 候选人都想争取选民支持。
选民.en: All candidates want to win voter support.
The voters' opinions are very important.

入手.zh: 解决这个问题需要从调查入手。
入手.en: Solving this problem requires starting with an investigation.

入手.zh: 首先，我们要从市场分析入手。
入手.en: First, we need to start with market analysis.

入手.zh: 学习一门语言要从听力入手。
入手.en: Learning a language should start with listening.

入手.zh: 不知道从哪里入手才好。
入手.en: I don't know where to start.

确信.en: I am convinced that he is right.

确信.zh: 我确信这件事一定能成功。
确信.en: I am convinced that this will definitely succeed.

确信.zh: 虽然证据不足，但我确信他没说谎。
确信.en: Although the evidence is insufficient, I am convinced he didn't lie.
He is convinced that he will win.

确信.zh: 我们确信这个计划可行。
确信.en: We are convinced that this plan is feasible.

销毁.en: These documents need to be destroyed.

销毁.zh: 公司决定销毁所有过期产品。
销毁.en: The company decided to destroy all expired products.

销毁.zh: 因为涉及机密，必须立即销毁。
销毁.en: Because it involves confidential information, it must be destroyed immediately.

销毁.zh: 警方销毁了查获的假货。
销毁.en: The police destroyed the counterfeit goods they seized.

销毁.zh: 不要随意销毁重要资料。

况且.zh: 路太远，况且天气又不好，还是别去了。
况且.en: The road is too far, and besides, the weather is bad, so better not go.

况且.zh: 他经验不足，况且态度也不认真。
况且.en: He lacks experience, and moreover, his attitude is not serious.

况且.zh: 产品价格高，况且质量一般。
况且.en: The product price is high, and besides, the quality is average.

况且.zh: 我累了，况且明天还要早起。
况且.en: I'm tired, and besides, I have to get up early tomorrow.

车间.zh: 工人们在车间里忙碌着。
车间.en: The workers are busy in the workshop.

车间.zh: 虽然车间很热，但大家都很努力。
车间.en: Although the workshop is very hot, everyone is working hard.

车间.zh: 这个车间主要生产汽车零件。
车间.en: This workshop mainly produces car parts.

车间.zh: 他每天在车间工作八小时。
车间.en: He works eight hours a day in the workshop.

丰厚.zh: 他因为工作努力得到了丰厚的奖励。
丰厚.en: He received a generous reward for working hard.

丰厚.zh: 虽然工作辛苦，但年终奖很丰厚。
丰厚.en: Although the work is hard, the year-end bonus is generous.

丰厚.zh: 这家公司提供的待遇非常丰厚。
丰厚.en: The benefits offered by this company are very generous.

丰厚.zh: 我们收到了丰厚的捐赠。

口径.zh: 双方的口径要统一，不能有矛盾。
口径.en: The two sides' statements must be consistent, with no contradictions.

口径.zh: 虽然大家说法不同，但官方口径一致。
口径.en: Although people say different things, the official version is consistent.
This pipe's diameter is too small.

口径.zh: 我们需要先确定产品的口径。
口径.en: We need to determine the product specifications first.

通告.zh: 公司发了一个关于放假安排的通告。
通告.en: The company issued a notice about holiday arrangements.

通告.zh: 由于天气原因，机场发布了延误通告。
通告.en: Due to weather conditions, the airport issued a delay notice.

通告.zh: 你看到学校的通告了吗？
通告.en: Did you see the school's announcement?

通告.zh: 这个通告需要大家签字确认。
通告.en: This notice requires everyone's signature for confirmation.

资本主义.zh: 在资本主义社会里，市场竞争很激烈。
资本主义.en: In capitalist society, market competition is fierce.

资本主义.zh: 虽然资本主义有其优势，但也存在贫富差距问题。
资本主义.en: Although capitalism has its advantages, there is also the problem of the wealth gap.

资本主义.zh: 他研究资本主义经济体系。
资本主义.en: He studies the capitalist economic system.

资本主义.zh: 我们课本里讲到了资本主义的发展史。
资本主义.en: Our textbook covers the history of capitalism.

付款.zh: 我们支持微信和支付宝付款。
付款.en: We support WeChat and Alipay payments.

付款.zh: 如果逾期不付款，会被收取滞纳金。
付款.en: If payment is not made on time, late fees will be charged.

忍耐.en: You need to learn to endure.

忍耐.zh: 他对噪音的忍耐已经到了极限。
忍耐.en: His tolerance for noise has reached its limit.

忍耐.zh: 虽然环境很糟糕，但他一直在忍耐。
忍耐.en: Although the environment is terrible, he has been enduring it.

忍耐.zh: 忍耐不是软弱，而是一种智慧。
忍耐.en: Endurance is not weakness, but a kind of wisdom.

忍耐.zh: 我实在忍耐不了这种高温了。
忍耐.en: I really can't stand this high temperature anymore.

奖杯.zh: 这个奖杯是我们团队共同努力的结果。
奖杯.en: This trophy is the result of our team's joint efforts.

奖杯.zh: 因为表现优异，他们获得了冠军奖杯。
奖杯.en: Because of their outstanding performance, they received the championship trophy.
The trophy is placed in the display cabinet.

奖杯.zh: 你见过那个金色的奖杯吗？
奖杯.en: Have you seen that golden trophy?

破碎.zh: 他的心像破碎的镜子一样无法复原。
破碎.en: His heart, like a broken mirror, cannot be restored.

破碎.zh: 因为不小心，他把杯子弄得破碎了。
破碎.en: Because of carelessness, he shattered the cup.

破碎.zh: 梦想破碎了，但他没有放弃。
破碎.en: The dream shattered, but he did not give up.

破碎.zh: 破碎的镜子反射出奇怪的光。
破碎.en: The broken mirror reflects strange light.

除去.en: Except for him, everyone has arrived.

除去.zh: 除去周末，我们还有五天时间准备。
除去.en: Excluding weekends, we still have five days to prepare.

除去.zh: 除去吃饭的时间，他一直在工作。
除去.en: Apart from meal times, he has been working all the time.
After deducting costs, the profit is not much.

恐龙.zh: 我小时候特别喜欢看恐龙动画片。
恐龙.en: When I was young, I especially liked watching dinosaur cartoons.

恐龙.zh: 虽然恐龙已经消失了，但人们对它们的研究从未停止。
恐龙.en: Although dinosaurs have disappeared, research on them has never stopped.

恐龙.zh: 博物馆里有很多恐龙化石。
恐龙.en: There are many dinosaur fossils in the museum.

恐龙.zh: 这只恐龙玩具是送给你弟弟的。
恐龙.en: This dinosaur toy is for your little brother.

通宵.en: I worked overtime all night last night.

通宵.zh: 为了赶项目，他们通宵都没睡。
通宵.en: To catch up on the project, they didn't sleep all night.

通宵.zh: 如果我通宵复习，明天考试应该没问题。
通宵.en: If I study all night, tomorrow's exam should be fine.

通宵.zh: 通宵打游戏对身体不好。
通宵.en: Playing games all night is bad for your health.

通宵.zh: 我们几个朋友通宵聊天，结果天都亮了。
通宵.en: A few friends and I chatted all night, and eventually dawn came.

值钱.zh: 虽然这枚硬币很旧，但不怎么值钱。
值钱.en: Although this coin is very old, it's not very valuable.

值钱.zh: 他觉得知识比金钱更值钱。
值钱.en: He thinks knowledge is more valuable than money.

值钱.zh: 这些古董字画都挺值钱的，你要小心保管。
值钱.en: These antique calligraphies are quite valuable, you should take care of them.

值钱.zh: 不值钱的东西就别留着了。
值钱.en: Don't keep things that are not valuable.

理会.en: Don't pay attention to what he said.

理会.zh: 我跟他打招呼，他根本没理会我。
理会.en: I greeted him, but he completely ignored me.

理会.zh: 这种谣言不需要理会，过几天就没了。
理会.en: No need to pay attention to this kind of rumor; it'll be gone in a few days.

理会.zh: 她从来不理会别人的看法。
理会.en: She never pays attention to others' opinions.

理会.zh: 如果你不理会他的感受，他会很难过的。
理会.en: If you don't acknowledge his feelings, he will be very sad.

南瓜.en: I bought a big pumpkin today.

南瓜.zh: 万圣节的时候，我们会在南瓜上刻脸。
南瓜.en: On Halloween, we carve faces on pumpkins.

南瓜.zh: 南瓜汤很好喝，你要不要尝尝？
南瓜.en: Pumpkin soup is very tasty, would you like to try it?

南瓜.zh: 她把南瓜切成小块，然后放进锅里煮。
南瓜.en: She cut the pumpkin into small pieces, then put them into the pot to cook.

发热.en: The child has a slight fever.

发热.zh: 手机用久了会发热，要让它休息一下。
发热.en: If you use your phone for a long time, it will heat up; let it rest for a bit.

发热.zh: 她因为发热，今天没去上班。
发热.en: She didn't go to work today because she had a fever.

发热.zh: 你额头很烫，是不是在发热？快去量体温。
发热.en: Your forehead is very hot, are you having a fever? Go take your temperature.

抵制.zh: 大家都在抵制这个品牌。
为了环保，他们决定抵制一次性塑料制品。
抵制.en: For environmental protection, they decided to boycott disposable plastic products.

抵制.zh: 我们要坚决抵制任何不公平的行为。
抵制.en: We must firmly resist any unfair behavior.

抵制.zh: 很多消费者因为质量问题开始抵制那家公司。
抵制.en: Many consumers started boycotting that company due to quality issues.

抵制.zh: 抵制没用，不如改进品质。
抵制.en: Boycotting is useless, better to improve quality.

境地.zh: 如果再不努力，你会陷入更困难的境地。
境地.en: If you don't work harder, you will fall into a more difficult situation.

境地.zh: 公司现在处于非常尴尬的境地。
境地.en: The company is now in a very awkward situation.

境地.zh: 她把自己弄到了无法挽回的境地，真可惜。
境地.en: She put herself in an irredeemable situation, what a pity.
This kind of situation makes people very uncomfortable.

贪婪.zh: 贪婪的人永远不知道满足。
因为贪婪，他失去了所有朋友。
贪婪.en: Because of greed, he lost all his friends.

贪婪.zh: 贪婪是很多犯罪行为的根源。
贪婪.en: Greed is the root of many criminal acts.

贪婪.zh: 别那么贪婪，分一点给大家。
贪婪.en: Don't be so greedy, share some with everyone.

逆.en: Walking against the wind is tiring.

逆.zh: 大家都反对他，他却逆着潮流做决定。
逆.en: Everyone opposed him, but he made a decision against the trend.
Honest advice is hard to hear but good for conduct.

逆.zh: 在高速公路上逆行非常危险。
逆.en: Driving the wrong way on the highway is very dangerous.
Sailing against the current, you either advance or retreat.

得罪.en: I don't want to offend anyone.

得罪.zh: 你刚才那句话得罪了不少同事。
得罪.en: That remark you just made offended many colleagues.

得罪.zh: 就算说得对，也别轻易得罪人。
得罪.en: Even if you're right, don't easily offend people.

得罪.zh: 他因为得罪了老板，被调到了偏远部门。
得罪.en: Because he offended the boss, he was transferred to a remote department.
Be careful with your words, don't offend clients.

跨越.zh: 这座桥跨越了山谷，连接了两个村庄。
跨越.en: This bridge spans the valley, connecting two villages.

跨越.zh: 虽然困难很多，但他还是跨越了障碍。
跨越.en: Although there were many difficulties, he still overcame the obstacles.

跨越.zh: 他们计划用一年时间跨越沙漠。
跨越.en: They plan to cross the desert in one year.

保重.en: You should take care of your health.

保重.zh: 出门在外，记得多喝水，好好保重。
保重.en: When you're away from home, remember to drink more water and take good care of yourself.

保重.zh: 虽然工作忙，但也要注意保重。
保重.en: Although work is busy, you still need to take care.

保重.zh: 你走了以后，要经常打电话，保重自己。
保重.en: After you leave, call often and take care of yourself.

保重.zh: 大家都希望你保重，早点回来。
保重.en: Everyone hopes you take care and come back soon.

奢侈.zh: 对普通人来说，每天吃海鲜是一种奢侈。
奢侈.en: For ordinary people, eating seafood every day is a luxury.

奢侈.zh: 虽然有钱，但他不喜欢过奢侈的生活。
奢侈.en: Although he is rich, he doesn't like living a luxurious life.
Buying luxury goods should be within one's means.

奢侈.zh: 在这种时候，谈享受太奢侈了。
奢侈.en: At a time like this, talking about enjoyment is too extravagant.

信件.zh: 现在很少有人用手写信件了，都用电子邮件。
信件.en: Nowadays few people write letters by hand, they all use email.

信件.zh: 因为地址不对，那封信件被退回来了。
信件.en: Because the address was wrong, that letter was returned.

信件.zh: 请把这份信件转交给经理。
信件.en: Please forward this letter to the manager.

奇特.zh: 他有一副奇特的眼镜，能变色。
奇特.en: He has a peculiar pair of glasses that can change color.

奇特.zh: 虽然看起来奇特，但这款设计很实用。
奇特.en: Although it looks peculiar, this design is very practical.

奇特.zh: 奇特的风景吸引了很多游客。
奇特.en: The unique scenery attracted many tourists.
That bird's call is very strange.

严峻.zh: 环保问题面临严峻的挑战。
由于疫情，经济形势变得很严峻。
严峻.en: Due to the pandemic, the economic situation has become very severe.

严峻.zh: 老师用严峻的眼神看着他。
严峻.en: The teacher looked at him with a stern expression.

严峻.zh: 我们必须面对严峻的现实。

巷.en: He lives in a small alley.

巷.zh: 这条巷子很深，两边都是老房子。
巷.en: This alley is very deep, with old houses on both sides.

巷.zh: 虽然巷子窄，但车还能开进去。
巷.en: Although the alley is narrow, cars can still drive in.
There is a snack shop at the entrance of the alley.
Walking out of the alley is the main road.

平稳.en: The plane is flying very smoothly.

平稳.zh: 今年的经济增长很平稳。
平稳.en: This year's economic growth is very stable.

平稳.zh: 虽然天气不好，但航班还是平稳降落了。
平稳.en: Although the weather was bad, the flight still landed smoothly.
His life has always been stable.

平稳.zh: 开车时要保持车速平稳。
平稳.en: When driving, keep the speed steady.

粪.zh: 农民用牛粪做肥料种菜。
粪.en: Farmers use cow dung as fertilizer to grow vegetables.

粪.zh: 因为狗粪没清理，小区环境变差了。
粪.en: Because dog feces weren't cleaned, the community environment got worse.

粪.zh: 这个味道像是粪的味道。
粪.en: This smell is like the smell of feces.
Ancient people used manure to water the fields.

框.en: This picture frame is very beautiful.

框.zh: 他把照片放进了相框里。
框.en: He put the photo into the picture frame.

框.zh: 如果框太大，照片就会掉出来。
框.en: If the frame is too big, the photo will fall out.
The window frame needs to be replaced.

框.zh: 设计时要注意不要超出这个框。
框.en: When designing, pay attention not to exceed this frame.

惯.en: I am used to using my right hand.

惯.zh: 因为父母太惯他，他变得很任性。
惯.en: Because his parents spoil him too much, he became very willful.
I am already used to this kind of weather.

惯.zh: 他惯着弟弟，什么都给买。
惯.en: He spoils his younger brother and buys him everything.

舆论.zh: 这件事引发了舆论关注。
政府很重视舆论的反馈。
舆论.en: The government pays great attention to public opinion feedback.

舆论.zh: 舆论一边倒地批评那个明星。
舆论.en: Public opinion overwhelmingly criticized that star.

舆论.zh: 因为舆论的影响，公司改变了决定。
舆论.en: Because of the influence of public opinion, the company changed its decision.

侦察.en: They are scouting the enemy situation.
The reconnaissance plane flew over that area.

侦察.zh: 警察用无人机进行侦察。
他负责侦察敌人的动向。
侦察.en: He is responsible for scouting the enemy's movements.

侦察.zh: 侦察结束后，他们报告了情况。
侦察.en: After the reconnaissance ended, they reported the situation.

预告.en: There will be rain tomorrow, the forecast says.
The movie trailer is really exciting.

预告.zh: 这个节目预告吸引了很多人。
预告.en: This show's preview attracted many people.

预告.zh: 虽然预告说会迟到，我们还是等了。
预告.en: Although the notice said it would be late, we still waited.

禁区.en: This is a military restricted area.
Don't enter the forbidden zone while climbing.

禁区.zh: 这个自然保护区有些地方是禁区。
禁区.en: Some parts of this nature reserve are restricted areas.

禁区.zh: 因为那是禁区，所以我们不能去。
禁区.en: Because that is a restricted area, we cannot go.
He sneaked into the forbidden zone.

身影.zh: 我看见一个熟悉的身影。
他的身影消失在黑暗中。
身影.en: His figure disappeared into the darkness.

身影.zh: 妈妈的身影让我感到很安心。
身影.en: Mom's figure makes me feel very reassured.

身影.zh: 我远远地认出了他的身影。
身影.en: I recognized his figure from afar.

身影.zh: 虽然天色已暗，我还是看到了她的身影。
身影.en: Although it was already dark, I still saw her figure.

倾斜.en: The tower is a bit tilted.

倾斜.zh: 地面倾斜了，水往低处流。
倾斜.en: The ground is slanted, water flows to low places.

倾斜.zh: 因为地基不稳，房子开始倾斜。
倾斜.en: Because the foundation is unstable, the house started to tilt.
He leaned his body to listen to me.

事迹.zh: 我们学习了英雄的事迹。
事迹.en: We learned about the hero's deeds.

事迹.zh: 老师讲了许多烈士的事迹。
事迹.en: The teacher told many stories of martyrs' deeds.

事迹.zh: 那些平凡人的事迹同样值得敬佩。
事迹.en: The deeds of those ordinary people are equally admirable.

事迹.zh: 因为他的感人事迹，大家都很尊敬他。
事迹.en: Because of his touching deeds, everyone respects him.

晚间.en: Let's go for a walk in the evening.
He is used to working in the evening.

晚间.zh: 虽然晚间很冷，他还是出门了。
晚间.en: Although it was cold in the evening, he still went out.

黑白.en: He can't distinguish right from wrong.

黑白.zh: 电影是黑白的，但很好看。
黑白.en: The movie is black-and-white, but very good to watch.

黑白.zh: 这件事不能只看黑白，要有灰色地带。
黑白.en: This matter cannot be seen only in black and white; there are gray areas.

黑白.zh: 他把照片调成了黑白模式。
黑白.en: He switched the photo to black-and-white mode.

物资.en: The disaster area urgently needs a large amount of supplies.

物资.zh: 他们把物资分发给村民。
物资.en: They distributed the supplies to the villagers.

物资.zh: 因为道路中断，物资运不进去。
物资.en: Because the road is cut off, supplies cannot be transported in.

物资.zh: 公司捐赠了一批医疗物资给医院。
物资.en: The company donated a batch of medical supplies to the hospital.

物资.zh: 虽然物资充足，但运输还是个大问题。
物资.en: Although supplies are sufficient, transportation is still a big problem.

时段.en: The road is very congested during this time period.
Please choose a meal time slot for reservation.
The subway is especially crowded during peak hours.

时段.zh: 每个时段只接待十位客人。
时段.en: Each time slot only accommodates ten guests.

时段.zh: 如果你在这个时段出门，可能会遇到堵车。
时段.en: If you go out during this time period, you might encounter traffic jams.

招牌.zh: 这家店的招牌菜是烤鸭。
招牌.en: This restaurant's signature dish is roast duck.

招牌.zh: 老板把旧招牌换了个新的。
招牌.en: The boss replaced the old signboard with a new one.

招牌.zh: 这家咖啡馆的招牌咖啡味道不错。
招牌.en: The signature coffee at this café tastes good.

招牌.zh: 虽然店不大，但招牌已经很出名了。
招牌.en: Although the shop is small, the signboard is already very famous.

价值观.zh: 每个人都有自己的价值观。
家庭教育影响孩子的价值观。
价值观.en: Family education influences a child's values.

价值观.zh: 如果价值观不同，很难长期合作。
价值观.en: If values differ, it's hard to cooperate long-term.

价值观.zh: 我觉得现代社会的价值观变得更多元了。
价值观.en: I think the values of modern society have become more diverse.

迄今为止.en: So far, everything is going smoothly.

迄今为止.zh: 这是我迄今为止看过最好的电影。
迄今为止.en: This is the best movie I have seen so far.

迄今为止.zh: 迄今为止，他还没有回复我。
迄今为止.en: Up to now, he hasn't replied to me yet.

迄今为止.zh: 这个项目是迄今为止最大的一个。
迄今为止.en: This project is the largest one so far.

迄今为止.zh: 迄今为止，我们一共收到了五百份申请。
迄今为止.en: Up to now, we have received a total of five hundred applications.

支柱.en: Agriculture is the pillar of the country.
He is the financial pillar of the family.

支柱.zh: 旅游业是这座小城的支柱产业。
支柱.en: Tourism is the pillar industry of this small town.

支柱.zh: 这几根支柱支撑着整个屋顶。
支柱.en: These few pillars support the entire roof.

支柱.zh: 如果没有支柱产业，经济发展会很困难。
支柱.en: Without pillar industries, economic development would be very difficult.

异议.en: I have an objection to this proposal.

异议.zh: 如果有异议，请在会上提出来。
异议.en: If you have any objections, please raise them at the meeting.

异议.zh: 尽管有异议，他还是坚持自己的决定。
异议.en: Despite objections, he still insisted on his decision.

异议.zh: 大家一致同意，没有任何异议。
异议.en: Everyone agreed unanimously without any objections.

一心.en: He is single-mindedly set on making a lot of money.
She is completely devoted to her work.
If everyone is of one mind, things become easier to handle.
He is only focused on playing games.

一心.zh: 既然选择这条路，就要一心走下去。
一心.en: Since you chose this path, you must go on with full concentration.

宣告.zh: 总统宣告全国进入紧急状态。
宣告.en: The president declared a state of emergency nationwide.

宣告.zh: 这项新政策宣告了旧时代的结束。
宣告.en: This new policy proclaimed the end of an old era.

宣告.zh: 公司宣告破产后，员工都很失望。
宣告.en: After the company declared bankruptcy, the employees were very disappointed.

一头.zh: 他一头雾水，完全没听懂。
一头.en: He was completely confused and didn't understand at all.

一头.zh: 小猫一头钻进沙发底下。
一头.en: The kitten burrowed under the sofa.

一头.zh: 他跑得太快，差点一头撞到门上。
一头.en: He ran so fast that he almost bumped his head into the door.

变革.en: The company is undergoing a major change.

变革.zh: 这次技术变革对我们的生活方式影响很大。
变革.en: This technological change has a big impact on our lifestyle.

变革.zh: 虽然变革带来了挑战，但也有很多机会。
变革.en: Although change brings challenges, it also brings many opportunities.

变革.zh: 社会变革需要每个人的努力。
这家企业经历了一场彻底的变革。
变革.en: This enterprise experienced a thorough transformation.

空虚.zh: 虽然赚了很多钱，但他还是觉得很空虚。
空虚.en: Although he made a lot of money, he still feels very empty.

空虚.zh: 退休后，他因为没事做而感到空虚。
空虚.en: After retirement, he feels empty because he has nothing to do.

空虚.zh: 这种生活让我觉得特别空虚。
空虚.en: This kind of life makes me feel particularly empty.

空虚.zh: 空虚的感觉总是会在深夜袭来。
空虚.en: The feeling of emptiness always comes at night.

责任感.en: He has a strong sense of responsibility.

责任感.zh: 作为团队领导，责任感对他来说很重要。
责任感.en: As a team leader, a sense of responsibility is very important to him.

责任感.zh: 虽然工作很累，但责任感让他坚持下来。
责任感.en: Although the work is tiring, his sense of responsibility keeps him going.

责任感.zh: 父母要培养孩子的责任感。
责任感.en: Parents should cultivate a sense of responsibility in children.

责任感.zh: 缺乏责任感的人很难得到信任。
责任感.en: People lacking a sense of responsibility are hard to trust.

代言人.zh: 她是这个品牌的代言人。
很多明星都愿意做产品的代言人。
代言人.en: Many celebrities are willing to be product endorsers.

代言人.zh: 因为人气高，他被选为代言人。
代言人.en: Because he is very popular, he was chosen as the spokesperson.

代言人.zh: 我们要找一位合适的代言人。
代言人.en: We need to find a suitable spokesperson.

代言人.zh: 这个代言人的形象跟产品很不符合。
代言人.en: This spokesperson's image doesn't match the product at all.

喇叭.zh: 他在车里放了一个大喇叭。
喇叭.en: He put a big loudspeaker in the car.

喇叭.zh: 虽然喇叭声音很大，但大家都听不清楚。
喇叭.en: Although the loudspeaker sound is loud, everyone can't hear clearly.

喇叭.zh: 这个喇叭的质量太差了。
喇叭.en: The quality of this horn is too poor.

喇叭.zh: 他用喇叭通知大家开会。
喇叭.en: He used a loudspeaker to notify everyone of the meeting.

露面.zh: 他很少在公众场合露面。
虽然邀请了他，但他一直没露面。
露面.en: Although he was invited, he never showed up.

露面.zh: 她这次露面是为了宣传新电影。
露面.en: This appearance of hers is to promote the new movie.

露面.zh: 大明星一露面就被粉丝围住了。
露面.en: As soon as the big star appeared, he was surrounded by fans.

免得.en: Leave early so as not to be late.

免得.zh: 把地址写下来，免得一会儿忘了。
免得.en: Write down the address so you don't forget later.

免得.zh: 你最好带把伞，免得突然下雨。
免得.en: You'd better bring an umbrella so that you won't get caught in sudden rain.

免得.zh: 小声说话，免得吵醒孩子。
免得.en: Speak softly so as not to wake the child.
Remember to lock the door to prevent thieves.

暗中.en: He observed secretly for a long time.

暗中.zh: 有人在暗中帮助她，但她不知道。
暗中.en: Someone is secretly helping her, but she doesn't know.

暗中.zh: 虽然在表面上很友好，但他暗中做了手脚。
暗中.en: Although friendly on the surface, he secretly tampered with things.

暗中.zh: 警察暗中跟踪那个嫌疑人。
暗中.en: The police secretly followed the suspect.

坚守.zh: 疫情期间，医护人员始终坚守岗位。
坚守.en: During the pandemic, medical staff always held their posts.

坚守.zh: 尽管困难重重，他们仍然坚守阵地。
坚守.en: Despite numerous difficulties, they still held their ground.

坚守.zh: 我们要坚守诚信这个底线。
坚守.en: We must hold fast to the bottom line of integrity.

坚守.zh: 他坚守了这个承诺很多年。
坚守.en: He kept this promise for many years.

计较.zh: 他是个很大方的人，从不计较小事。
计较.en: He is a generous person, never fussing about small things.

计较.zh: 虽然吃了亏，但他没有计较。
计较.en: Although he suffered a loss, he didn't fuss about it.

计较.zh: 在利益面前，有些人会斤斤计较。
计较.en: In front of benefits, some people will haggle over every ounce.

计较.zh: 她总是计较别人对她的看法。
计较.en: She always cares too much about others' opinions of her.

贩卖.zh: 他因为贩卖毒品被抓了。
贩卖.en: He was arrested for trafficking drugs.

贩卖.zh: 这个市场贩卖各种新鲜水果。
贩卖.en: This market sells all kinds of fresh fruit.

贩卖.zh: 虽然贩卖盗版书违法，但还是有人做。
贩卖.en: Although selling pirated books is illegal, some people still do it.

贩卖.zh: 警察最近破获了一个贩卖人口的团伙。
贩卖.en: The police recently busted a human trafficking gang.

贩卖.zh: 他靠贩卖二手手机赚了不少钱。
贩卖.en: He made a lot of money selling second-hand phones.

无能.en: He is really an incompetent person.

无能.zh: 老板骂他无能，因为他什么都不会做。
无能.en: The boss scolded him for being incompetent because he couldn't do anything.

无能.zh: 面对困难，他感到自己很无能。
无能.en: Faced with difficulties, he felt very incompetent.

无能.zh: 如果不是他无能，项目早就完成了。
无能.en: If it weren't for his incompetence, the project would have been completed long ago.

无能.zh: 大家都觉得这个经理太无能了。
无能.en: Everyone thinks this manager is too incompetent.

至此.zh: 会议至此，大家都有点累了。
至此.en: The meeting has gone this far, and everyone is a bit tired.

至此.zh: 他虽然努力，但运气至此都不太好。
至此.en: Although he worked hard, his luck hasn't been good up to this point.

至此.zh: 事情发展到至此，我们已经没有退路了。
至此.en: Things have developed to this point, and we have no way back.

至此.zh: 至此，我才明白他的真正意图。
至此.en: Only at this point did I understand his real intention.

产物.en: This is a product of technology.
Art is a product of its time.

产物.zh: 这个发明是多年研究的产物。
产物.en: This invention is the product of years of research.

产物.zh: 网络文化是技术发展的自然产物。
产物.en: Internet culture is a natural product of technological development.

产物.zh: 矛盾往往是沟通不畅的产物。
产物.en: Conflict is often the product of poor communication.

关掉.en: Remember to turn off the lights before sleeping.
I turned off my phone to focus on work.

关掉.zh: 他关掉空调，因为觉得太冷了。
关掉.en: He turned off the air conditioner because he felt too cold.

关掉.zh: 出门时别忘了关掉电脑和路由器。
关掉.en: Don't forget to turn off the computer and router when you leave.

耀眼.zh: 她的笑容耀眼得像太阳。
耀眼.en: Her smile is as dazzling as the sun.

耀眼.zh: 舞台上的灯光太耀眼了。
耀眼.en: The lights on stage are too dazzling.

耀眼.zh: 这颗钻石在阳光下格外耀眼。
耀眼.en: This diamond is especially dazzling in the sunlight.

耀眼.zh: 虽然成绩耀眼，但他依然很谦虚。
耀眼.en: Although his achievements are dazzling, he remains very humble.

慢性.zh: 这种慢性疼痛折磨了他很多年。
慢性.en: This chronic pain has tortured him for many years.

慢性.zh: 慢性压力对健康的影响很大。
慢性.en: Chronic stress has a big impact on health.

慢性.zh: 医生说他得的是慢性胃炎，要注意饮食。
慢性.en: The doctor said he has chronic gastritis and needs to watch his diet.

富翁.zh: 那个富翁住在山顶别墅里。
富翁.en: That wealthy man lives in a hilltop villa.

富翁.zh: 他虽然是个富翁，但生活很节俭。
富翁.en: Although he is a millionaire, he lives frugally.

富翁.zh: 一夜之间，他变成了百万富翁。
很多富翁都是从零开始打拼的。
富翁.en: Many wealthy people started from scratch.

蒸.en: I like to steam fish to eat.

蒸.zh: 把包子放在锅里蒸十分钟。
蒸.en: Put the buns in the pot and steam them for ten minutes.
She is steaming rice in the kitchen.

蒸.zh: 如果用蒸的方式做菜，营养不会流失太多。
蒸.en: If you cook by steaming, the nutrients won't be lost too much.

流畅.zh: 这个游戏的动画非常流畅。
流畅.en: The animations in this game are very smooth.

流畅.zh: 虽然稿子很长，但他读得很流畅。
流畅.en: Although the script was long, he read it very fluently.

流畅.zh: 她的钢琴弹得流畅而动听。
流畅.en: She plays the piano smoothly and melodiously.

流畅.zh: 网络视频播放很流畅，没有卡顿。
流畅.en: The online video plays smoothly without any stuttering.

崛起.zh: 这个城市最近崛起得很快。
崛起.en: This city has risen very quickly recently.

崛起.zh: 经济崛起后，人们的生活变好了。
崛起.en: After the economic rise, people's lives improved.

崛起.zh: 他靠自己的努力在行业里崛起了。
崛起.en: He rose in the industry through his own efforts.

崛起.zh: 新科技公司崛起，让老企业很有压力。
崛起.en: The rise of new tech companies puts a lot of pressure on old businesses.

崛起.zh: 虽然起步晚，但他最终还是崛起了。
崛起.en: Although he started late, he eventually rose up.

点子.en: Did you come up with any good ideas?

点子.zh: 我有个点子，可以省很多时间。
点子.en: I have an idea that can save a lot of time.

点子.zh: 大家讨论了半天，也没想出点子来。
点子.en: We discussed for a long time but still couldn't come up with an idea.

点子.zh: 他点子多，每次开会都能提新方案。
点子.en: He has a lot of ideas and always proposes new plans at meetings.

苍蝇.en: There's a fly in the room.

苍蝇.zh: 苍蝇在食物上飞来飞去。
苍蝇.en: The flies are flying around on the food.

苍蝇.zh: 夏天苍蝇太多了，真烦人。
苍蝇.en: There are too many flies in summer; it's really annoying.

苍蝇.zh: 他用手一拍，就把苍蝇打死了。
苍蝇.en: He clapped his hands and killed the fly.

苍蝇.zh: 厨房门没关好，飞进来好几只苍蝇。
苍蝇.en: The kitchen door wasn't closed properly, and several flies flew in.

平面.en: This tabletop is a flat surface.

平面.zh: 画要在平面上才能画好。
平面.en: You need a flat surface to draw well.

平面.zh: 设计师用了很多平面图形。
平面.en: The designer used many flat shapes.

平面.zh: 这块玻璃表面不平，不是个完美的平面。
平面.en: This piece of glass is uneven; it's not a perfect flat surface.

平面.zh: 虽然画在平面上，但看起来很有立体感。
平面.en: Although it's drawn on a flat surface, it looks very three-dimensional.

过头.en: Don't take the joke too far.

过头.zh: 他话说得过头，有点伤人。
过头.en: He went overboard with his words, which hurt a bit.

过头.zh: 运动过头对身体反而不好。
过头.en: Exercising too much is actually bad for your health.

过头.zh: 我昨天睡过头了，上班迟到了。
过头.en: I overslept yesterday and was late for work.

煤矿.en: His father works at a coal mine.

煤矿.zh: 煤矿事故这两年少了很多。
煤矿.en: Coal mine accidents have decreased a lot in the past two years.

煤矿.zh: 因为不安全，这家煤矿被关了。
煤矿.en: This coal mine was shut down because it was unsafe.

煤矿.zh: 小城靠着煤矿发展起来的，现在资源快没了。
煤矿.en: The small town developed thanks to the coal mine, but now the resources are almost gone.

葬礼.en: I'm going to a funeral tomorrow.
Everyone was very sad at the funeral.
His funeral was held very simply.

葬礼.zh: 她没赶上奶奶的葬礼，很遗憾。
葬礼.en: She missed her grandmother's funeral, which was a pity.

葬礼.zh: 虽然葬礼结束了，但大家还沉浸在悲伤里。
葬礼.en: Although the funeral was over, everyone was still immersed in sorrow.

包袱.en: Don't make the bundle too heavy.

包袱.zh: 她心里有很多包袱，放不下。
包袱.en: She has a lot of burdens in her heart that she can't let go.

包袱.zh: 这个相声演员包袱抖得真好。
包袱.en: This crosstalk performer delivered the punchline really well.

包袱.zh: 为了轻装上阵，他把旧包袱都扔了。
包袱.en: In order to travel light, he threw away all the old bundles.

窗帘.en: These curtains have a really nice color.

窗帘.zh: 风一吹，窗帘就飘起来了。
窗帘.en: The curtains float up when the wind blows.

窗帘.zh: 我挑了一款遮光窗帘，睡觉更香了。
窗帘.en: I chose a blackout curtain, so I sleep better.

窗帘.zh: 窗帘脏了，得拆下来洗一洗。
窗帘.en: The curtains are dirty; I need to take them down and wash them.

引人注目.zh: 这幅画放这里太引人注目了。
引人注目.en: This painting is too conspicuous here.

引人注目.zh: 他穿了一件红色外套，特别引人注目。
引人注目.en: He wore a red coat, which was especially eye-catching.

引人注目.zh: 那个广告牌设计得很引人注目。
引人注目.en: That billboard is designed to be very eye-catching.

引人注目.zh: 他的演讲虽然简短，却很引人注目。
引人注目.en: Although his speech was short, it was very eye-catching.

诸位.en: Everyone, please be quiet for a moment.

诸位.zh: 今天诸位能来，我很开心。
诸位.en: I'm very happy that all of you could come today.

诸位.zh: 诸位有什么意见，尽管提出来。
诸位.en: If any of you have opinions, feel free to raise them.

诸位.zh: 这个问题，诸位觉得该怎么处理？
诸位.en: How do you all think we should handle this issue?

诸位.zh: 我先简单说几句，然后请诸位轮流发言。
诸位.en: I'll speak briefly first, then please take turns to speak.

发脾气.en: Don't lose your temper so easily.

发脾气.zh: 他今天心情不好，一直在发脾气。
发脾气.en: He's in a bad mood today and has been losing his temper.

发脾气.zh: 你跟她好好说，别发脾气。
发脾气.en: Talk to her nicely, don't get angry.

发脾气.zh: 孩子一哭，他就忍不住发脾气。
发脾气.en: When the child cries, he can't help but lose his temper.

发脾气.zh: 虽然他很生气，但最后还是忍住没发脾气。
发脾气.en: Although he was very angry, he managed to hold back and not lose his temper.

改装.zh: 这家店专门做汽车改装。
改装.en: This shop specializes in car modifications.

改装.zh: 我想把厨房改装成更现代化的样子。
改装.en: I want to remodel the kitchen into a more modern style.

改装.zh: 他花了很多钱改装音响系统。
改装.en: He spent a lot of money upgrading the sound system.

改装.zh: 因为旧房格局不好，我们找人重新改装了。
改装.en: Because the layout of the old house was bad, we hired someone to remodel it.

缴.zh: 月底前必须把房租缴了。
缴.en: The rent must be paid before the end of the month.

缴.zh: 他忘了缴水电费，结果被停了。
缴.en: He forgot to pay the utility bills, and they got cut off.

缴.zh: 每年这个时候都要缴房产税。
缴.en: Every year at this time, we have to pay property tax.

缴.zh: 我们公司刚缴完上一季度的营业税。
缴.en: Our company just paid the business tax for last quarter.

核实.zh: 我们需要核实他的身份信息。
核实.en: We need to verify his identity information.

核实.zh: 你先核实一遍，没问题再发出去。
核实.en: Check it over first, and only send it out if there are no issues.

核实.zh: 因为金额很大，财务又核实了好几遍。
核实.en: Because the amount was large, the finance department checked it several more times.

乡下.zh: 乡下空气比城里好多了。
乡下.en: The air in the countryside is much better than in the city.

乡下.zh: 他每年夏天都回乡下老家。
乡下.en: He goes back to his hometown in the countryside every summer.

乡下.zh: 虽然乡下生活方便，但习惯了就好。
乡下.en: Although life in the countryside is not as convenient, you'll get used to it.

乡下.zh: 小时候我常去乡下外婆家，那里有很多好玩的东西。
乡下.en: When I was little, I often went to my grandma's house in the countryside; there were many fun things there.

咽.en: He swallowed too fast and choked.
I can't swallow this mouthful of rice.

咽.zh: 她忍着眼泪，把委屈都咽进肚里。
咽.en: She held back her tears and swallowed all the grievances.

咽.zh: 喉咙疼得厉害，连喝水都咽得很困难。
咽.en: My throat hurts so much that even drinking water is hard to swallow.

冷冻.en: The meat should be stored frozen.

冷冻.zh: 这些饺子可以冷冻起来。
冷冻食品拿出来要先解冻。
冷冻.en: Frozen food needs to be thawed first before taking it out.

冷冻.zh: 他买了一个大冰箱专门放冷冻的东西。
冷冻.en: He bought a big refrigerator specifically for frozen items.

冷冻.zh: 如果一次吃不完，剩下的可以放冷冻室。
冷冻.en: If you can't finish it all at once, you can put the leftovers in the freezer.

胜负.en: The outcome of the match is hard to predict.

胜负.zh: 这场球赛的胜负很重要。
胜负.en: The result of this ball game is very important.

胜负.zh: 他不看重胜负，只在乎过程。
胜负.en: He doesn't care about winning or losing, only about the process.

胜负.zh: 胜负已定，我们明年再来。
胜负.en: The outcome is already decided; we'll come back next year.

胜负.zh: 虽然我们输了，但胜负不是最重要的。
胜负.en: Although we lost, winning or losing is not the most important thing.

畸形.en: This fetus has a developmental deformity.

畸形.zh: 长期用错误姿势会导致脊柱畸形。
畸形.en: Long-term use of incorrect posture can lead to spinal deformity.

畸形.zh: 这种植物长出了畸形的叶子。
畸形.en: This plant has grown deformed leaves.

畸形.zh: 畸形的社会观念需要改变。
畸形.en: Distorted social concepts need to change.

畸形.zh: 医生说他天生就有心脏畸形，但不太影响生活。
畸形.en: The doctor said he was born with a heart deformity, but it doesn't affect his life much.

鸽子.en: That pigeon is on the roof.

鸽子.zh: 广场上有很多鸽子，孩子们都很开心。
鸽子.en: There are many pigeons in the square, and the children are very happy.

鸽子.zh: 我每天都会喂楼下的鸽子。
鸽子.en: I feed the pigeons downstairs every day.

鸽子.zh: 鸽子是和平的象征，大家都很喜欢它们。
鸽子.en: Pigeons are a symbol of peace, and everyone likes them.

鸽子.zh: 你看，那只白色的鸽子飞走了！
鸽子.en: Look, that white pigeon flew away!

发财.zh: 他最近发财了，买了一辆新车。
发财.en: He recently got rich and bought a new car.

发财.zh: 很多人想发财，但不容易。
发财.en: Many people want to get rich, but it's not easy.

发财.zh: 发财以后，他变得很骄傲。
发财.en: After getting rich, he became very arrogant.

发财.zh: 你发财了可别忘了老朋友啊。
发财.en: Don't forget your old friends when you get rich.

往常.en: He usually gets up at seven.

往常.zh: 今天路上特别堵，跟往常不一样。
往常.en: The traffic is especially bad today, unlike usual.

往常.zh: 往常这个时候，他已经在公司了。
往常.en: Usually at this time, he is already at the office.

往常.zh: 她往常不怎么说话，今天话很多。
往常.en: She usually doesn't talk much, but today she talked a lot.

往常.zh: 往常都是妈妈做饭，今天换成爸爸了。
往常.en: Usually Mom cooks, but today it's Dad's turn.

隐蔽.zh: 他把钱藏在了一个隐蔽的地方。
隐蔽.en: He hid the money in a hidden place.

隐蔽.zh: 那个山洞非常隐蔽，很少有人发现。
隐蔽.en: That cave is very hidden, and few people have found it.

隐蔽.zh: 我们的计划必须隐蔽，不能让别人知道。
隐蔽.en: Our plan must be kept hidden; we can't let others know.

隐蔽.zh: 他隐蔽在树丛后面，没被人看到。
隐蔽.en: He hid behind the bushes and wasn't seen.

救济.zh: 洪水过后，很多灾民得到了救济。
救济.en: After the flood, many victims received relief.

救济.zh: 我们应该救济那些生活困难的人。
救济.en: We should help those who are struggling in life.

救济.zh: 他拿出自己的钱来救济穷人。
救济.en: He took out his own money to aid the poor.

复苏.en: The economy has started to recover.
Spring has come, and everything is reviving.

复苏.zh: 经过抢救，他的心脏终于复苏了。
复苏.en: After rescue efforts, his heart finally restarted.

复苏.zh: 这棵老树在春雨后又复苏了。
复苏.en: This old tree revived again after the spring rain.

糊.en: The dish is burnt from stir-frying.
He pasted the wall with paste.

糊.zh: 你闻闻，是不是有什么糊了？
这面包烤糊了，不能吃了。
糊.en: This bread is burnt from baking; it's inedible.

终生.en: He never married in his life.
This matter is unforgettable to him for life.

终生.zh: 她立志终生从事教育事业。
终生.en: She is determined to dedicate her life to education.

终生.zh: 学习是一生的事，应该终生学习。
终生.en: Learning is a lifelong matter; one should keep learning throughout life.

终生.zh: 那次事故给他留下了终生的遗憾。
终生.en: That accident left him with lifelong regret.

跑车.en: He drives a red sports car.
That sports car is really fast.

跑车.zh: 他梦想拥有一辆自己的跑车。
跑车.en: He dreams of owning his own sports car.

跑车.zh: 跑车虽然好，但是太费油了。
跑车.en: Sports cars are good, but they use too much fuel.

跑车.zh: 他在赛道上开跑车，非常刺激。
跑车.en: He drives a sports car on the track; it's very thrilling.

竞技.en: He participated in a competitive event.

竞技.zh: 电子竞技现在非常流行。
竞技场上，每个人都很努力。
竞技.en: In the competition arena, everyone works hard.

竞技.zh: 他从小就喜欢竞技运动，比如跑步和游泳。
竞技.en: He has liked competitive sports since childhood, such as running and swimming.

专栏.zh: 虽然这个专栏很受欢迎，但我很少看。
专栏.en: Although this column is very popular, I rarely read it.

专栏.zh: 她每周都会写一篇专栏文章。
专栏.en: She writes a column article every week.

专栏.zh: 我最近发现了一个很有趣的专栏，推荐给你。
专栏.en: I recently found a very interesting column, recommend it to you.

分辨.en: Can you tell real from fake?

分辨.zh: 在黑暗中，我很难分辨方向。
分辨.en: In the dark, it's hard for me to tell directions.

分辨.zh: 虽然它们长得很像，但我能分辨出来。
分辨.en: Although they look alike, I can tell them apart.
He can't distinguish the two flavors.

分辨.zh: 我们需要学会分辨好人和坏人。
分辨.en: We need to learn to distinguish good people from bad people.

贵宾.zh: 今天公司来了几位重要贵宾。
贵宾.en: Today a few important VIPs came to the company.

贵宾.zh: 因为他们是贵宾，所以我们要好好招待。
贵宾.en: Because they are VIPs, we need to treat them well.
The VIP passage is on the right.

贵宾.zh: 他作为贵宾参加了那个开幕式。
贵宾.en: He attended that opening ceremony as a VIP.

实体.en: Does this store have a physical store?

实体.zh: 网上购物方便，但实体店体验更好。
实体.en: Online shopping is convenient, but physical store experience is better.

实体.zh: 虽然他是虚拟偶像，但没有实体。
实体.en: Although he is a virtual idol, he has no physical body.
This company is an independent entity.

实体.zh: 很多品牌现在都开始做实体和线上结合。
实体.en: Many brands now start combining physical and online.

诺言.zh: 他曾经许下诺言，但从来没做到。
诺言.en: He once made a promise but never fulfilled it.

诺言.zh: 既然你说了诺言，就要负责到底。
诺言.en: Since you made a promise, you must be responsible to the end.

诺言.zh: 我永远记得他对我许下的那个诺言。
诺言.en: I will always remember the promise he made to me.

迷恋.en: He is obsessed with video games.

迷恋.zh: 她迷恋那个歌手已经很多年了。
迷恋.en: She has been infatuated with that singer for many years.

迷恋.zh: 虽然我知道迷恋不好，但我控制不住。
迷恋.en: Although I know being obsessed is bad, I can't control it.
Don't be overly obsessed with appearance.

迷恋.zh: 他因为迷恋赌博，最后输光了家产。
迷恋.en: Because he was obsessed with gambling, he eventually lost his entire fortune.

赞扬.zh: 大家纷纷赞扬她的勇敢行为。
虽然得到了赞扬，但他并没有骄傲。
赞扬.en: Although he received praise, he didn't become proud.

赞扬.zh: 在会议上，经理公开赞扬了团队的贡献。
赞扬.en: At the meeting, the manager publicly praised the team's contribution.

筹集.zh: 为了建学校，他们筹集了很多资金。
筹集.en: To build a school, they raised a lot of funds.

筹集.zh: 因为项目需要钱，所以我们得想办法筹集。
筹集.en: Because the project needs money, we have to find a way to raise it.

筹集.zh: 他们通过义卖活动筹集了五千元。
筹集.en: They raised 5,000 yuan through a charity sale.

借用.zh: 他借用别人的名义做了这件事。
借用.en: He did this using someone else's name.

借用.zh: 如果你没有，我可以借用一下你的电脑。
借用.en: If you don't have one, I can borrow your computer for a bit.
This phrase is borrowed from the ancients.

借用.zh: 他借用生病这个理由请假了。
借用.en: He used the excuse of being sick to take leave.

派遣.zh: 政府派遣了医疗队到灾区。
派遣.en: The government dispatched a medical team to the disaster area.

派遣.zh: 因为工作需要，他被派遣到了分公司。
派遣.en: Because of work needs, he was dispatched to the branch office.

派遣.zh: 学校派遣了几位老师去参加培训。
派遣.en: The school dispatched several teachers to attend training.

揪.zh: 他揪着那个小偷的衣领不放。
揪.en: He grabbed the thief's collar and wouldn't let go.

揪.zh: 虽然她很想揪他耳朵，但还是忍住了。
揪.en: Although she really wanted to pull his ear, she finally held back.

揪.zh: 我揪了一下自己的脸，确认不是做梦。
揪.en: I pinched my own face to confirm it wasn't a dream.

揪.zh: 妈妈揪了揪我的袖子，让我别再说下去。
揪.en: Mom tugged my sleeve, telling me not to continue talking.

首饰.zh: 我姐姐买了一些新首饰准备在婚礼上戴。
首饰.en: My sister bought some new jewelry to wear at the wedding.

首饰.zh: 虽然这些首饰很贵，但她还是毫不犹豫地买了。
首饰.en: Although these jewelry pieces are expensive, she bought them without hesitation.

首饰.zh: 你把首饰收好，别弄丢了。
首饰.en: Put your jewelry away, don't lose it.

首饰.zh: 这家店的首饰款式很时尚，价格也合理。
首饰.en: The jewelry styles in this store are very fashionable and the prices are reasonable.

锡.en: This box is made of tin.

锡.zh: 以前很多家庭用锡纸来包裹食物。
锡.en: In the past, many families used tin foil to wrap food.

锡.zh: 因为锡比较软，所以容易加工成各种形状。
锡.en: Because tin is relatively soft, it's easy to process into various shapes.

锡.zh: 他收藏了一些锡制的玩具士兵。
锡.en: He collects some tin toy soldiers.

锡.zh: 锡这种金属在工业上用途很广。
锡.en: This metal, tin, has a wide range of industrial uses.

深受.zh: 他的新书深受读者喜爱，销量非常高。
深受.en: His new book is deeply loved by readers, with very high sales.

深受.zh: 虽然这个节目制作简单，但深受观众好评。
深受.en: Although this show is simply produced, it is deeply praised by the audience.

深受.zh: 她深受老师的影响，决定当一名教师。
深受.en: She was deeply influenced by her teacher and decided to become a teacher.

深受.zh: 这款手机深受年轻人欢迎，因为性价比高。
深受.en: This mobile phone is very popular among young people because of its high cost performance.

不容.zh: 他的态度非常强硬，不容别人反驳。
不容.en: His attitude is very tough, not allowing others to refute.

不容.zh: 安全问题是重中之重，不容忽视。
不容.en: Safety issues are the top priority and cannot be ignored.

不容.zh: 这个事实不容否认，我们必须面对。
不容.en: This fact cannot be denied; we must face it.

不容.zh: 时间不容浪费，我们得赶紧出发。
不容.en: Time cannot be wasted; we need to leave quickly.

强盗.zh: 昨晚有几个强盗闯进了那家珠宝店。
强盗.en: Last night, several robbers broke into that jewelry store.

强盗.zh: 虽然强盗很凶，但警察很快就抓住了他们。
强盗.en: Although the robbers were fierce, the police caught them quickly.

强盗.zh: 这些强盗专挑偏僻的地方作案。
强盗.en: These robbers specifically choose remote places to commit crimes.

强盗.zh: 电影里演的是一个强盗改邪归正的故事。
强盗.en: The movie tells a story of a robber turning over a new leaf.

临近.en: Approaching the New Year, the home is busy.

临近.zh: 临近春节，街上到处都是人了。
临近.en: Approaching the Spring Festival, the streets are full of people.

临近.zh: 因为临近毕业，大家都在忙着找工作。
临近.en: Because graduation is approaching, everyone is busy looking for jobs.

临近.zh: 那家超市临近我家，买东西很方便。
临近.en: That supermarket is close to my house, so shopping is very convenient.

临近.zh: 临近山顶时，我们停下来休息了一会儿。
临近.en: When we were near the mountain top, we stopped to rest for a while.

架子.en: The books are all on the shelf.

架子.zh: 他这个人就爱摆架子，对谁都爱理不理的。
架子.en: He likes to put on airs, ignoring everyone.

架子.zh: 虽然他是领导，但从不摆架子，大家都很喜欢他。
架子.en: Although he is a leader, he never puts on airs, so everyone likes him.

架子.zh: 我把衣服挂在架子上了，你拿去吧。
架子.en: I hung the clothes on the rack, you can take them.

架子.zh: 这个架子有点不稳，要小心别碰倒。
架子.en: This shelf is a bit unstable, be careful not to knock it over.

一如既往.en: I will support you as always.

一如既往.zh: 他对工作一如既往地认真负责，从未松懈。
一如既往.en: He is as conscientious and responsible towards work as always, never slackening.

一如既往.zh: 虽然遇到了困难，但他一如既往地坚持了下来。
一如既往.en: Although he encountered difficulties, he persisted as always.

一如既往.zh: 这家餐厅的服务质量一如既往地好。
一如既往.en: The service quality of this restaurant is as good as always.

一如既往.zh: 我们之间的关系一如既往，没有改变。
一如既往.en: The relationship between us is as before, unchanged.

安宁.en: This place is very peaceful, suitable for rest.

安宁.zh: 他总是不停地吵闹，让家里不得安宁。
安宁.en: He keeps making noise, making the family restless.

安宁.zh: 因为战争，这个国家的人们失去了安宁的生活。
安宁.en: Because of the war, the people of this country have lost their peaceful life.

安宁.zh: 希望世界永远保持和平与安宁。
安宁.en: I hope the world will always maintain peace and tranquility.

安宁.zh: 她需要一段安宁的日子来调整心情。
安宁.en: She needs a period of peace to adjust her mood.

时不时.en: I go see her every now and then.

时不时.zh: 他工作很忙，但时不时也会抽空锻炼身体。
时不时.en: He is busy with work, but he also finds time to exercise every now and then.

时不时.zh: 北京时不时会下点雨，记得带伞。
时不时.en: Beijing gets rain from time to time, remember to bring an umbrella.

时不时.zh: 虽然我们不在一个城市，但时不时还是会视频聊天。
时不时.en: Although we are not in the same city, we still video chat from time to time.
She gets headaches now and then.

卷入.en: I don't want to get involved in this quarrel.

卷入.zh: 他因为朋友的事被卷入了麻烦。
卷入.en: He was drawn into trouble because of his friend's matter.

卷入.zh: 这件事我不小心卷入了。
卷入.en: I accidentally got involved in this matter.

卷入.zh: 如果不想卷入是非，最好少管闲事。
卷入.en: If you don't want to get involved in gossip, it's best to mind your own business.
She was involved in that scandal.

契约.zh: 我们签了一份三年的租赁契约。
契约.en: We signed a three-year rental contract.
After the contract expires, it can be renewed.

契约.zh: 虽然契约已经签了，但双方还在商量细节。
契约.en: Although the contract has been signed, both parties are still discussing details.
Breaching the contract requires paying liquidated damages.

携手.en: The two companies join hands to cooperate.

携手.zh: 我们要携手共创美好未来。
携手.en: We must join hands to create a better future.

携手.zh: 他们携手走过了二十年。
携手.en: They walked hand in hand for twenty years.

携手.zh: 只要大家携手努力，就没有克服不了的困难。
携手.en: As long as everyone works together, there is no difficulty that cannot be overcome.
The couple faced difficulties hand in hand.

倾诉.en: She wants to find someone to confide her worries.

倾诉.zh: 他经常向朋友倾诉工作上的烦恼。
倾诉.en: He often pours out his work troubles to friends.

倾诉.zh: 倾诉之后，她感觉轻松多了。
倾诉.en: After pouring out her heart, she felt much lighter.

倾诉.zh: 虽然我们不太熟，但她却愿意向我倾诉秘密。
倾诉.en: Although we are not very familiar, she is willing to confide secrets to me.
Don't bottle up your worries, talk them out.

海湾.zh: 他们开车去海湾看日落。
海湾.en: They drove to the bay to watch the sunset.
There are many fishing boats near the bay.

海湾.zh: 因为海湾污染严重，鱼越来越少了。
海湾.en: Because the bay is heavily polluted, fish are becoming fewer.
The water in the bay is very clear.

情愿.en: She would rather quit than be bullied.

情愿.zh: 为了孩子，他情愿自己吃苦。
情愿.en: For his children, he is willing to suffer hardship himself.

情愿.zh: 如果可以选择，我情愿从来没认识过他。
情愿.en: If I could choose, I would rather never have known him.
No one is willing to do such a thing.

头衔.zh: 虽然头衔好听，但实际工作很累。
头衔.en: Although the title sounds good, the actual work is tiring.

头衔.zh: 她获得了“最佳员工”的头衔。
他不喜欢别人用头衔称呼他，更愿意大家叫名字。
头衔.en: He doesn't like being addressed by his title; he prefers people to call him by his name.

心事.en: She looks like she has something on her mind.

心事.zh: 他把所有心事都告诉了妈妈。
心事.en: He told all his worries to his mother.
Don't hide your worries in your heart.

心事.zh: 虽然她嘴上不说，但我知道她有心事。
心事.en: Although she doesn't say it, I know she has something on her mind.

心事.zh: 工作上的心事让他失眠。
心事.en: Work worries keep him awake at night.

依法.en: We must act according to law.

依法.zh: 他们依法维护自己的权益。
依法.en: They protect their rights according to law.

依法.zh: 一切违法行为都会依法处理。
依法.en: All illegal acts will be dealt with according to law.

依法.zh: 如果公司不依法缴纳社保，员工可以投诉。
依法.en: If the company does not pay social insurance according to law, employees can complain.

依法.zh: 依法纳税是公民的义务。
依法.en: Paying taxes according to law is a citizen's duty.

肢体.en: His body language is very expressive.

肢体.zh: 这次事故导致他肢体受伤。
肢体.en: This accident caused him to injure his limbs.

肢体.zh: 舞蹈演员的肢体非常柔软。
虽然她肢体不太方便，但还是坚持自己走路。
肢体.en: Although she has limited mobility in her limbs, she still insists on walking by herself.

肢体.zh: 警察通过肢体动作示意我们停车。
肢体.en: The police officer signaled us to stop using body gestures.

捕捉.zh: 摄影师捕捉到了最美的瞬间。
捕捉.en: The photographer captured the most beautiful moment.

捕捉.zh: 猫在捕捉老鼠时非常专注。
捕捉.en: Cats are very focused when catching mice.

捕捉.zh: 他的眼睛善于捕捉细节。
捕捉.en: His eyes are good at catching details.

捕捉.zh: 记者想要捕捉到当事人的真实反应。
捕捉.en: The reporter wanted to capture the real reaction of the person involved.

捕捉.zh: 虽然光线很暗，相机还是捕捉到了画面。
捕捉.en: Although the light was very dim, the camera still captured the image.

出演.en: She will play the lead female role.

出演.zh: 这部电影由多位明星出演。
他第一次出演就获得了好评。
出演.en: He received good reviews the first time he performed.

出演.zh: 因为档期冲突，他无法出演这个话剧。
出演.en: Due to scheduling conflicts, he cannot perform in this play.

出演.zh: 我听说你弟弟要出演一个广告，真的吗？
出演.en: I heard your younger brother is going to appear in a commercial, really?

筋.en: He strained a muscle in his calf.

筋.zh: 老张做事总喜欢钻牛角筋。
筋.en: Old Zhang always likes to be stubborn about trivial details.

筋.zh: 运动前一定要活动开，不然容易抽筋。
筋.en: You must warm up before exercising, or you might get a cramp.

筋.zh: 这道菜用的是牛筋，炖得很烂。
筋.en: This dish uses beef tendon, and it's stewed until very tender.

遇难.zh: 他在那场车祸中遇难了。
遇难.en: He died in that car accident.

遇难.zh: 遇难者的家属非常悲痛。
遇难.en: The families of the victims are very grief-stricken.

遇难.zh: 救援队正在全力寻找遇难者。
遇难.en: The rescue team is doing its best to search for the victims.

遇难.zh: 虽然飞机失事，但只有少数乘客遇难。
遇难.en: Although the plane crashed, only a few passengers died.

过不去.en: This road is too narrow; cars can't get through.

过不去.zh: 他心里一直过不去这个坎。
过不去.en: He just can't get over this hurdle in his heart.

过不去.zh: 别为这点小事跟自己过不去。
过不去.en: Don't be so hard on yourself over such a small thing.

过不去.zh: 前面在修桥，我们暂时过不去。
过不去.en: They're repairing the bridge ahead, so we can't get through for now.

过不去.zh: 你要是觉得过不去，就跟他道个歉吧。
过不去.en: If you feel it's hard to move on, just apologize to him.

肇事.en: The driver who caused the accident fled.
The police are tracking down the person responsible.

肇事.zh: 这起事故的肇事原因还在调查中。
肇事.en: The cause of this accident is still under investigation.

肇事.zh: 他酒后开车肇事，撞伤了好几个人。
肇事.en: He caused an accident while driving drunk, injuring several people.
The perpetrator has already been detained.

气势.en: This song is magnificent and powerful.

气势.zh: 军队排着整齐的队伍，气势非凡。
气势.en: The army marched in neat formation, showing extraordinary momentum.

气势.zh: 虽然人不多，但他们的气势压倒了对方。
气势.en: Although there were few people, their momentum overwhelmed the other side.

气势.zh: 这座山看起来很有气势，我很想爬上去。
气势.en: This mountain looks very imposing; I really want to climb it.

斩.en: He cut the branch off with one swing.
Wu Song killed the tiger with his sword.

斩.zh: 游戏中他使用技能斩杀了敌人。
斩.en: In the game, he used a skill to slay the enemy.

斩.zh: 项目经理决定斩掉这个不赚钱的项目。
斩.en: The project manager decided to cut this unprofitable project.

斩.zh: 他快刀斩乱麻，解决了所有问题。
斩.en: He cut the Gordian knot and solved all the problems quickly.

车道.zh: 高速公路上有三条车道。
车道.en: There are three lanes on the highway.

车道.zh: 自行车不能上机动车道。
车道.en: Bicycles are not allowed on motor vehicle lanes.

车道.zh: 因为施工，最左边的车道被封了。
车道.en: Due to construction, the leftmost lane is closed.

猎人.zh: 那个猎人打了一只野兔，但没抓到鹿。
猎人.en: That hunter shot a hare but didn't catch a deer.

猎人.zh: 猎人告诉我，他最喜欢冬天去山上打猎。
猎人.en: The hunter told me he likes going hunting in the mountains in winter best.
The hunter is in the forest.

猎人.zh: 虽然他是猎人，但他从不杀小动物。
猎人.en: Although he is a hunter, he never kills small animals.

丢脸.zh: 在朋友面前唱歌跑调，让他很丢脸。
丢脸.en: Singing off-key in front of friends made him lose face.

丢脸.zh: 考试不及格，他觉得太丢脸了。
丢脸.en: Failing the exam, he felt it was too shameful.
Don't do things that bring shame.

丢脸.zh: 虽然他没做好，但也不至于这么丢脸吧。
丢脸.en: Although he didn't do well, it shouldn't be so embarrassing.

慎重.zh: 做这个决定之前，你得慎重一点。
慎重.en: Before making this decision, you need to be more cautious.

慎重.zh: 他做事很慎重，从不冲动。
慎重.en: He is very careful in doing things and never acts impulsively.

慎重.zh: 因为这件事很重要，所以我们要慎重处理。
慎重.en: Because this matter is very important, we need to handle it cautiously.

医务.en: He works in the medical office.

医务.zh: 学校的医务处每天都有医生值班。
医务.en: The school's medical department has a doctor on duty every day.

医务.zh: 受伤后，他立刻去了医务中心。
医务.en: After getting injured, he immediately went to the medical center.

医务.zh: 如果他感觉不舒服，就去医务室看看。
医务.en: If he feels unwell, go to the medical room and check.

水管.en: The water pipe at home is broken.

水管.zh: 我请工人来修厨房的水管了。
水管.en: I asked a worker to fix the kitchen water pipe.

水管.zh: 冬天水管容易冻裂，要小心。
水管.en: In winter, water pipes easily freeze and crack, so be careful.

水管.zh: 因为水管破了，所以地板都湿了。
水管.en: Because the water pipe burst, the floor is all wet.

虚弱.zh: 生病之后，他变得非常虚弱。
虚弱.en: After being sick, he became very weak.

虚弱.zh: 老人年纪大了，特别虚弱。
虚弱.en: The old man is elderly and particularly frail.
She speaks with a weak voice.

虚弱.zh: 虽然他很虚弱，但他还是坚持工作。
虚弱.en: Although he is very weak, he still insists on working.

火花.zh: 打火石一撞就出现了小小的火花。
火花.en: When the flint was struck, small sparks appeared.

火花.zh: 爱情的火花需要慢慢培养。
火花.en: The spark of love needs to be nurtured slowly.
The spark flashed and went out.

火花.zh: 如果不小心，火花可能引起火灾。
火花.en: If you're not careful, sparks could cause a fire.

集装箱.en: There are many containers at the dock.

集装箱.zh: 这艘船装满了彩色的集装箱。
集装箱.en: This ship is full of colorful containers.

集装箱.zh: 工人用起重机来搬运集装箱。
集装箱.en: Workers use cranes to move containers.

集装箱.zh: 因为集装箱太大，所以卡车装不下。
集装箱.en: Because the container is too big, the truck can't load it.

全力以赴.zh: 为了这次比赛，他全力以赴地训练。
全力以赴.en: For this competition, he trained with all his might.

全力以赴.zh: 大家全力以赴，终于完成了任务。
全力以赴.en: Everyone gave their full effort and finally completed the task.

全力以赴.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但我们还是要全力以赴。
全力以赴.en: Although time is tight, we still have to give it our all.

航天.zh: 中国的航天事业发展得非常快。
航天.en: China's space industry is developing very fast.

航天.zh: 航天员在太空里做科学实验。
航天.en: Astronauts do scientific experiments in space.

航天.zh: 如果航天技术再进步，我们就能去火星了。
航天.en: If space technology advances further, we can go to Mars.

猜想.zh: 我猜想他今天不会来了。
猜想.en: I guess he won't come today.

猜想.zh: 别瞎猜想，事情没那么复杂。
猜想.en: Don't guess randomly, it's not that complicated.

猜想.zh: 大家都在猜想谁会是最后的赢家。
猜想.en: Everyone is guessing who will be the final winner.

猜想.zh: 根据这些线索，我猜想凶手可能是那个司机。
猜想.en: Based on these clues, I suspect the murderer might be that driver.

猜想.zh: 虽然我不确定，但我猜想她应该会同意这个计划。
猜想.en: Although I'm not sure, I guess she will agree to this plan.

协作.zh: 这两个部门需要加强协作。
协作.en: These two departments need to strengthen collaboration.

协作.zh: 通过紧密协作，我们提前完成了任务。
协作.en: Through close collaboration, we finished the task ahead of schedule.

协作.zh: 这次项目要求大家互相协作才能成功。
协作.en: This project requires everyone to collaborate with each other to succeed.

协作.zh: 只有各部门之间良好协作，公司才能发展得更好。
协作.en: Only with good collaboration between departments can the company develop better.

无线电.en: He is listening to the radio broadcast.

无线电.zh: 老式无线电现在很少见了。
登山队用无线电保持联系。
无线电.en: The mountaineering team uses radio to stay in touch.

无线电.zh: 无线电信号在这片山区很不稳定。
无线电.en: Radio signals are very unstable in this mountainous area.

无线电.zh: 虽然有了手机，但无线电在紧急情况下仍然很有用。
无线电.en: Although we have cell phones, radios are still very useful in emergencies.

大队.zh: 消防大队很快到达了现场。
大队.en: The fire brigade arrived at the scene quickly.

大队.zh: 今天有一大队游客来参观。
大队.en: A large group of tourists came to visit today.

大队.zh: 他带领大队人马去支援灾区了。
大队.en: He led a large team to support the disaster area.

大队.zh: 交警大队正在调查这起事故的原因。
大队.en: The traffic police brigade is investigating the cause of this accident.

资讯.en: This piece of news is very fresh.

资讯.zh: 我喜欢看科技类的资讯。
资讯.en: I like to read tech-related news.

资讯.zh: 手机推送的资讯太多了，有点烦。
资讯.en: There's too much news pushed on the phone, it's a bit annoying.

资讯.zh: 这个网站每天更新最新的财经资讯。
资讯.en: This website updates the latest financial news every day.

资讯.zh: 如果你想了解留学资讯，可以关注这个公众号。
资讯.en: If you want to know about study abroad information, you can follow this public account.

对准.en: The gun was aimed at the target.

对准.zh: 请把天线对准信号塔的方向。
对准.en: Please point the antenna toward the signal tower.

对准.zh: 他准对准了那颗星星观察了很久。
对准.en: He aimed at that star and observed it for a long time.

对准.zh: 演讲时，你要学会对准观众的目光。
对准.en: When giving a speech, you should learn to meet the audience's gaze.

蹭.en: The cat is rubbing against the wall.
He always likes to use his friend's WiFi for free.

蹭.zh: 我不小心蹭到了墙上的油漆。
蹭.en: I accidentally scraped against the paint on the wall.

蹭.zh: 她蹭了一下肩膀，示意我往前走。
蹭.en: She nudged my shoulder, signaling me to go ahead.

误导.en: This kind of statement will mislead people.

误导.zh: 假新闻很容易误导公众的判断。
误导.en: Fake news can easily mislead public judgment.

误导.zh: 他故意提供错误信息来误导调查。
误导.en: He deliberately provided false information to mislead the investigation.

误导.zh: 如果不仔细核实，这些数据可能会误导你的结论。
误导.en: If you don't verify carefully, these data might mislead your conclusion.

孤立.en: Don't try to isolate your opponent.

孤立.zh: 那个国家在国际上很孤立。
孤立.en: That country is very isolated internationally.

孤立.zh: 她因为性格内向而被孤立了。
孤立.en: She was isolated because of her introverted personality.

孤立.zh: 如果我们孤立这个问题，就无法找到真正的解决方案。
孤立.en: If we isolate this problem, we won't be able to find a real solution.

器材.en: My photography equipment is very expensive.

器材.zh: 这些健身器材有点旧了。
器材.en: These fitness equipment are a bit old.

器材.zh: 实验室需要一批新的器材。
器材.en: The lab needs a batch of new equipment.

器材.zh: 请把户外器材收拾好放回仓库。
器材.en: Please put away the outdoor equipment and return it to the warehouse.

器材.zh: 他花了很多钱买专业的音乐器材。
器材.en: He spent a lot of money on professional music equipment.

航行.en: The ship is sailing at sea.

航行.zh: 这次航行我们遇到了大风浪。
航行.en: We encountered strong winds and waves on this voyage.

航行.zh: 飞机航行时请系好安全带。
航行.en: Please fasten your seatbelt during the flight.

航行.zh: 他们准备航行到对岸的小岛。
航行.en: They are preparing to sail to the island across the shore.

航行.zh: 虽然天气不好，但我们还是决定继续航行。
航行.en: Although the weather was bad, we still decided to continue sailing.

无穷.zh: 他的耐心似乎无穷无尽。
这本书给了我无穷的灵感。
无穷.en: This book gave me endless inspiration.

无穷.zh: 面对无穷的困难，他从未放弃。
无穷.en: Faced with endless difficulties, he never gave up.

无穷.zh: 我们要珍惜时间，因为潜力是无穷的。
无穷.en: We should cherish time, because potential is infinite.

大选.en: The general election will be held next month.

大选.zh: 这次大选的结果影响很大。
大选.en: The result of this election has a big impact.

大选.zh: 很多年轻人第一次参加大选投票。
大选.en: Many young people are voting in the election for the first time.

大选.zh: 大选结束后，新总统会马上上任。
大选.en: After the election ends, the new president will take office immediately.

大选.zh: 虽然大选竞争很激烈，但选民都很理性。
大选.en: Although the election race is fierce, voters are very rational.

前辈.en: Thanks for the guidance from all the seniors.

前辈.zh: 在公司里，前辈们对我帮助很大。
前辈.en: In the company, the seniors have helped me a lot.

前辈.zh: 前辈，请问这个项目怎么处理？
前辈.en: Senior, may I ask how to handle this project?

前辈.zh: 作为新人，我们要多向前辈学习。
前辈.en: As newcomers, we should learn more from our seniors.

红灯.en: There's a red light ahead, stop quickly.

红灯.zh: 过马路时一定要看红灯。
红灯.en: When crossing the road, you must look at the red light.

红灯.zh: 红灯亮了，他马上踩了刹车。
红灯.en: The red light came on, and he immediately hit the brakes.

红灯.zh: 这个路口红灯时间特别长。
红灯.en: The red light at this intersection is especially long.

红灯.zh: 虽然红灯已经亮了，但他还是冲了过去。
红灯.en: Although the red light was already on, he still rushed through.

打发.en: How to pass the time on weekends?
He was idly passing the afternoon.

打发.zh: 别老玩手机打发时间，出去走走。
打发.en: Don't always use your phone to kill time; go out for a walk.

打发.zh: 他随便找了个理由把孩子打发了。
打发.en: He casually found an excuse to send the child away.

打发.zh: 我靠看书打发漫长的旅途。
打发.en: I rely on reading to pass the long journey.

牢牢.zh: 我们要牢牢记住这个教训。
牢牢.en: We must firmly remember this lesson.

牢牢.zh: 她的这句话我牢牢刻在心里。
牢牢.en: Her words are firmly engraved in my heart.

牢牢.zh: 虽然很累，但他还是牢牢地握住了方向盘。
牢牢.en: Although very tired, he still firmly held the steering wheel.

收音机.zh: 爷爷每天早上听收音机。
收音机.en: Grandpa listens to the radio every morning.

收音机.zh: 收音机里正在播放新闻。
收音机.en: News is playing on the radio.

收音机.zh: 这个收音机坏了，需要修理。
收音机.en: This radio is broken and needs repair.

收音机.zh: 以前很多人靠收音机了解世界。
收音机.en: In the past, many people relied on the radio to learn about the world.

难以置信.zh: 他居然考了满分，真难以置信。
难以置信.en: He actually got a perfect score, truly unbelievable.

难以置信.zh: 面对难以置信的结果，他愣住了。
难以置信.en: Faced with the unbelievable result, he was stunned.

难以置信.zh: 这件事听起来难以置信，但确实是真的。
难以置信.en: This sounds unbelievable, but it's indeed true.

难以置信.zh: 她竟然在一天内完成了所有工作，简直难以置信。
难以置信.en: She actually finished all the work in one day, simply unbelievable.

起草.zh: 这个文件由我负责起草。
起草.en: I am responsible for drafting this document.

起草.zh: 法律草案需要反复起草和修改。
起草.en: Legal drafts need repeated drafting and revision.

起草.zh: 他们一起起草了活动方案。
起草.en: They drafted the event plan together.

起草.zh: 虽然初稿已经起草完，但还要审核。
起草.en: Although the first draft is completed, it still needs review.

麻木.zh: 他的腿坐久了都麻木了。
麻木.en: His legs went numb after sitting for too long.

麻木.zh: 看到那么多惨状，他已经麻木了。
麻木.en: After seeing so many tragedies, he became numb.

麻木.zh: 我对这种噪音已经麻木了，根本睡不着。
麻木.en: I'm already numb to this noise, I can't sleep at all.

麻木.zh: 医生说我手指麻木是因为神经压迫。
麻木.en: The doctor said my numb fingers are due to nerve compression.

麻木.zh: 长期做重复的工作，人会变得麻木。
麻木.en: Doing repetitive work for a long time makes people become numb.

重伤.en: He was seriously injured in a car accident.

重伤.zh: 那个重伤的人被立刻送进了手术室。
重伤.en: The seriously injured person was immediately sent to the operating room.

重伤.zh: 虽然受了重伤，但他还是坚持完成了比赛。
重伤.en: Although he was seriously injured, he still insisted on finishing the race.

重伤.zh: 这种武器足以造成重伤。
重伤.en: This kind of weapon can cause serious injury.

重伤.zh: 他重伤住院后，公司才意识到安全的重要性。
重伤.en: Only after he was hospitalized with serious injuries did the company realize the importance of safety.

青蛙.en: There are many frogs in the pond.

青蛙.zh: 青蛙吃害虫，对农民很有帮助。
青蛙.en: Frogs eat pests and are very helpful to farmers.

青蛙.zh: 小时候我常在田里抓青蛙玩。
青蛙.en: When I was a kid, I often caught frogs in the fields for fun.

青蛙.zh: 青蛙的叫声在夏天特别响亮。
青蛙.en: The croaking of frogs is especially loud in summer.

青蛙.zh: 他不小心踩到了一只青蛙，吓了一跳。
青蛙.en: He accidentally stepped on a frog and got a fright.

葱.en: I like to add some scallions when cooking.

葱.zh: 葱姜蒜是中国人炒菜必备的调料。
葱.en: Scallions, ginger, and garlic are essential seasonings for Chinese stir-fry.

葱.zh: 妈妈让我去超市买一把葱。
葱.en: Mom asked me to buy a bunch of scallions at the supermarket.

葱.zh: 你闻闻，这碗面里是不是放了葱花？
葱.en: Smell it, is there chopped scallion in this bowl of noodles?

葱.zh: 葱不仅能调味，还能预防感冒。
葱.en: Scallions not only add flavor but also help prevent colds.

出面.zh: 这件事需要经理出面解决。
出面.en: This matter needs the manager to step forward and handle it.

出面.zh: 他从来不愿意出面处理麻烦事。
出面.en: He never wants to personally step in to deal with troublesome matters.

出面.zh: 既然你不行，那就让我出面吧。
出面.en: Since you can't do it, let me handle it personally.

出面.zh: 村长出面调解了两家的矛盾。
出面.en: The village chief stepped in to mediate the conflict between the two families.

出面.zh: 老板不出面，员工们都很着急。
出面.en: The boss didn't show up, and the employees were all anxious.

收视率.zh: 这个节目的收视率很高。
收视率是衡量电视节目成功的重要指标。
收视率.en: Ratings are an important indicator of a TV program's success.

收视率.zh: 为了提高收视率，他们请了很多明星。
收视率.en: To boost ratings, they invited many celebrities.

收视率.zh: 这部剧的收视率一直排在第一名。
收视率.en: This drama's ratings have consistently ranked first.

收视率.zh: 虽然口碑不好，但收视率却很高。
收视率.en: Although its reputation is bad, its ratings are high.

料到.en: I had long expected that he would be late.

料到.zh: 谁也没料到事情会发展成这样。
料到.en: No one expected things to turn out like this.
Did you anticipate it would rain today?

料到.zh: 他完全没料到老板会突然辞职。
料到.en: He completely didn't expect the boss to suddenly resign.

料到.zh: 我料到你会不同意，所以准备了B计划。
料到.en: I anticipated you would disagree, so I prepared a Plan B.

整合.zh: 我们需要整合所有资源。
整合.en: We need to integrate all resources.

整合.zh: 公司正在整合两个部门的业务。
整合.en: The company is integrating the operations of two departments.

整合.zh: 通过整合数据，我们发现了新规律。
整合.en: By integrating data, we discovered new patterns.

整合.zh: 这个软件可以把不同文件整合在一起。
整合.en: This software can integrate different files into one.

整合.zh: 整合后的团队效率提升了很多。
整合.en: After integration, the team's efficiency improved a lot.

出众.zh: 在面试中，他的表现十分出众。
出众.en: His performance in the interview was extremely outstanding.

出众.zh: 她出众的外表和气质吸引了很多人。
出众.en: Her outstanding appearance and temperament attracted many people.

出众.zh: 虽然成绩一般，但她的领导能力出众。
出众.en: Although her grades are average, her leadership skills are outstanding.

出众.zh: 你需要在人群中显得出众才能被记住。
出众.en: You need to stand out in a crowd to be remembered.

反感.en: I strongly dislike this kind of behavior.

反感.zh: 大家对这种广告都很反感。
反感.en: Everyone is disgusted with this type of advertisement.

反感.zh: 他说话的方式让人特别反感。
反感.en: The way he talks is especially off-putting.

反感.zh: 不知道为什么，我对那个新同事很反感。
反感.en: I don't know why, but I really dislike that new colleague.

反感.zh: 如果总是抱怨，别人会对你产生反感。
反感.en: If you always complain, others will develop a dislike for you.

营救.en: The rescue operation is very dangerous.

营救.zh: 因为天气不好，营救行动延迟了。
营救.en: Because of bad weather, the rescue operation was delayed.

营救.zh: 警察连夜营救了被困在火场里的人。
营救.en: The police rescued people trapped in the fire overnight.

营救.zh: 如果不及时营救，他可能会有生命危险。
营救.en: If not rescued in time, he might be in danger of his life.

照样.en: He goes to work as usual.
Even though the weather is bad, he still goes running.

照样.zh: 虽然失败了，他照样很有信心。
照样.en: Although he failed, he is still very confident.

照样.zh: 不管别人怎么说，她照样坚持自己的决定。
照样.en: No matter what others say, she still insists on her decision.

照样.zh: 他生病了，但照样完成了作业。
照样.en: He was sick, but he still finished his homework.

餐桌.en: There are flowers on the dining table.
He wiped the dining table clean.

餐桌.zh: 我们一家人围在餐桌前吃饭。
餐桌.en: Our whole family sits around the dining table to eat.

餐桌.zh: 晚餐后，大家帮忙收拾餐桌。
餐桌.en: After dinner, everyone helps clear the dining table.

餐桌.zh: 今天的餐桌上摆满了我爱吃的菜。
餐桌.en: Today's dining table is full of my favorite dishes.

沉浸.en: He is immersed in the music.
She is immersed in her work.

沉浸.zh: 他完全沉浸在这本书的故事里。
沉浸.en: He is completely immersed in the story of this book.

沉浸.zh: 因为太沉浸了，他没听到电话铃声。
沉浸.en: Because he was too immersed, he didn't hear the phone ring.

沉浸.zh: 她沉浸在自己的世界里，不理别人。
沉浸.en: She is immersed in her own world and ignores others.

从头.en: He plans to learn from scratch.

从头.zh: 因为错了，他只好从头再来。
从头.en: Because he made a mistake, he had to start over.

从头.zh: 这个故事我听了两遍，还想从头再听。
从头.en: I've listened to this story twice, and I still want to hear it from the beginning again.

从头.zh: 电影太无聊，我从头睡到尾。
从头.en: The movie was so boring that I slept from start to finish.

客房.en: The guest room is on the second floor.
Please tidy up the guest room.

客房.zh: 客人来了，我带他们去客房。
客房.en: The guests have arrived; I'll take them to the guest room.

客房.zh: 我们家有三间客房，都能住人。
客房.en: Our house has three guest rooms, all of which can accommodate people.

客房.zh: 如果朋友来住，可以安排到客房。
客房.en: If a friend comes to stay, we can arrange for them to sleep in the guest room.

怀抱.en: She holds the child in her arms.
She holds onto her dreams and works hard.

怀抱.zh: 在父亲的怀抱里，孩子停止了哭泣。
怀抱.en: In his father's embrace, the child stopped crying.

怀抱.zh: 他怀抱着一只受伤的小狗。
怀抱.en: He is holding an injured puppy in his arms.

野兽.en: There are wild beasts in the forest.
At night, wild beasts come out to look for food.

野兽.zh: 他害怕野兽，不敢一个人进山。
野兽.en: He is afraid of wild beasts and dares not go into the mountains alone.

野兽.zh: 动物园里的野兽都被关在笼子里。
野兽.en: The wild beasts in the zoo are all kept in cages.

当心.en: Be careful when crossing the street.

当心.zh: 开车的时候一定要当心。
当心.en: You must be careful when driving.

当心.zh: 当心别被烫到了，水很热。
当心.en: Be careful not to get scalded; the water is very hot.

当心.zh: 你一个人在家，要当心陌生人。
当心.en: You're home alone, so be careful of strangers.

水源.en: The water source here is very clean.
We found a new water source.

水源.zh: 这条河是城市的主要水源。
水源.en: This river is the city's main water source.

水源.zh: 因为污染，附近的水源已经不能喝了。
水源.en: Due to pollution, the nearby water source is no longer drinkable.

水源.zh: 他们保护水源，不让工厂排污水。
水源.en: They protect the water source and don't allow factories to discharge wastewater.

同感.en: I also have the same feeling.

同感.zh: 关于这个问题，我跟你很有同感。
同感.en: About this issue, I really agree with you.

同感.zh: 虽然他的想法不常见，但我居然有同感。
同感.en: Although his idea is uncommon, I actually share the same feeling.

同感.zh: 看完那部电影，我们俩都很有同感。
同感.en: After watching that movie, we both felt the same way.

同感.zh: 你说得太对了，我完全有同感。
同感.en: You are absolutely right; I completely agree.

操心.zh: 妈妈总是为我的健康操心。
操心.en: Mom always worries about my health.

操心.zh: 虽然你已经长大了，但父母还是会操心。
操心.en: Although you've grown up, parents still worry.

操心.zh: 他为公司的事操心得睡不着觉。
操心.en: He worries about company matters so much he can't sleep.

操心.zh: 你一个人在外地，我怎么能不操心？
操心.en: You're alone far away, how can I not worry?

学业.zh: 最近我因为学业压力很大，经常熬夜。
学业.en: Lately I've been under a lot of academic pressure and often stay up late.

学业.zh: 虽然学业很忙，但我还是抽空去运动。
学业.en: Although studies are busy, I still make time to exercise.

学业.zh: 毕业以后，他要继续深造学业。
学业.en: After graduation, he will continue his academic studies.

学业.zh: 你要把精力放在学业上，别总玩游戏。
学业.en: You should focus your energy on your studies and stop playing games all the time.

总的来说.zh: 总的来说，这次旅行很愉快，就是有点累。
总的来说.en: Overall, this trip was very enjoyable, just a bit tiring.

总的来说.zh: 虽然有些小问题，但总的来说我们很满意。
总的来说.en: Although there were some small issues, overall we are quite satisfied.

总的来说.zh: 总的来说，他的表现比我预期的要好。
总的来说.en: Overall, his performance was better than I expected.

总的来说.zh: 总的来说，现在的年轻人比以前更独立了。
总的来说.en: Overall, young people today are more independent than before.

轰动.zh: 他的新书在出版后引起了巨大轰动。
轰动.en: His new book caused a huge sensation after publication.

轰动.zh: 因为那个事件太轰动了，所以大家都在讨论。
轰动.en: Because that incident was so sensational, everyone is talking about it.

轰动.zh: 那部电影在上映时轰动一时，现在却没人记得了。
轰动.en: That movie caused a sensation when it was released, but now no one remembers it.

轰动.zh: 他的一番话在会场里引起了轰动。
轰动.en: His remarks caused a stir in the meeting hall.

苦难.en: He has experienced too much suffering.

苦难.zh: 那些年，他们一家人共同度过了许多苦难。
苦难.en: In those years, their family went through many hardships together.

苦难.zh: 虽然生活充满了苦难，但他依然乐观。
苦难.en: Although life is full of suffering, he remains optimistic.

苦难.zh: 只有经历过苦难的人，才更懂得珍惜。
苦难.en: Only those who have experienced suffering know better how to cherish things.

苦难.zh: 这本书讲述了一个关于苦难与希望的故事。
苦难.en: This book tells a story about suffering and hope.

撬.en: Don't pry the door with tools.

撬.zh: 他用一根铁棍把箱子撬开了。
撬.en: He pried open the box with an iron bar.

撬.zh: 如果你打不开，可以试着用螺丝刀撬一下。
撬.en: If you can't open it, try prying it with a screwdriver.
The thief damaged the window by prying it open.

撬.zh: 这个盖子太紧了，我怎么也撬不开。
撬.en: This lid is too tight; I can't pry it open no matter what.

演技.zh: 这部电影里的演员演技都非常出色。
演技.en: The actors in this movie all have outstanding acting skills.

演技.zh: 虽然他是新人，但演技已经很自然了。
演技.en: Although he is a newcomer, his acting is already very natural.

演技.zh: 她的演技让我完全忘了她是在演戏。
演技.en: Her acting made me completely forget she was acting.

演技.zh: 大家都很认可他在那部剧里的演技。
演技.en: Everyone highly recognizes his acting in that drama.

猛烈.en: The wind is blowing very fiercely.

猛烈.zh: 他们遭到了猛烈的攻击，损失惨重。
猛烈.en: They suffered a fierce attack with heavy losses.

猛烈.zh: 因为火势太猛烈，消防员暂时无法靠近。
猛烈.en: Because the fire was too fierce, firefighters couldn't approach for a while.

猛烈.zh: 这场比赛双方的攻势都很猛烈。
猛烈.en: In this match, both sides' attacks were very fierce.

猛烈.zh: 他猛烈地敲门，好像有什么急事。
猛烈.en: He knocked on the door fiercely, as if something urgent happened.

裁.en: This piece of clothing needs to be altered.

裁.zh: 公司效益不好，又要裁一批人。
裁.en: The company's performance is poor; they will lay off another batch of people.
She cut a piece of paper with scissors.

裁.zh: 这场比赛的主裁很有经验。
裁.en: The main referee of this match is very experienced.

管家.en: He is the housekeeper of our home.

管家.zh: 这家酒店的管家服务非常周到。
管家.en: The butler service at this hotel is very attentive.

管家.zh: 她像管家一样什么都管。
管家.en: She manages everything like a housekeeper.

管家.zh: 我请了一个管家来帮忙整理房间。
管家.en: I hired a housekeeper to help tidy up the room.

管家.zh: 虽然他是管家，但我和他关系很好。
管家.en: Although he is the butler, I have a good relationship with him.

好坏.en: Can't tell good from bad for this thing.

好坏.zh: 买东西之前要看清楚好坏。
好坏.en: Before buying, you need to see clearly whether it's good or bad.
A person's goodness or badness can't be judged by appearance only.

好坏.zh: 他不管好坏全都收下了。
好坏.en: He accepted everything regardless of good or bad.

好坏.zh: 这件事情的好坏现在还说不准。
好坏.en: The good or bad of this matter can't be determined yet.

有待.en: This problem remains to be solved.

有待.zh: 我们的计划还有待进一步完善。
有待.en: Our plan still needs further improvement.

有待.zh: 真相有待警方进一步调查。
有待.en: The truth needs further investigation by the police.
His ability still needs to be tested.

缝合.en: The doctor is stitching the wound.

缝合.zh: 这件衣服的裂口需要缝合一下。
缝合.en: The tear in this clothes needs to be stitched.
The stitching after surgery is very good.
He stitched the hole with needle and thread.

缝合.zh: 伤口缝合后要小心感染。
缝合.en: After the wound is stitched, be careful of infection.

手动.zh: 这台机器可以手动操作。
手动.en: This machine can be operated manually.

手动.zh: 手动挡的车开起来更有感觉。
手动.en: A manual transmission car feels more engaging to drive.

手动.zh: 我习惯用手动模式拍照。
手动.en: I'm used to using manual mode for photography.

手动.zh: 如果你不想自动清洗，可以手动清洁。
手动.en: If you don't want automatic cleaning, you can clean manually.

示威.en: Workers took to the streets to protest.

示威.zh: 他们举行了一次和平示威。
示威者要求政府改善待遇。
示威.en: The protesters demanded the government improve treatment.

示威.zh: 学校附近有示威活动，别走那条路。
示威.en: There is a protest near the school, don't take that road.

示威.zh: 虽然示威合法，但要注意安全。
示威.en: Although demonstration is legal, pay attention to safety.

歌舞.en: The square is full of song and dance—peaceful prosperity.

歌舞.zh: 这场歌舞表演非常精彩。
歌舞.en: This song and dance performance is very wonderful.
She has liked singing and dancing since childhood.
There is a song and dance program at the evening party.

视角.en: Look at the problem from another perspective.

视角.zh: 从不同视角分析这个案例。
视角.en: Analyze this case from different perspectives.

视角.zh: 这部电影用了孩子的视角。
视角.en: This film used a child's perspective.

视角.zh: 站在他的视角，我能理解他的决定。
视角.en: From his perspective, I can understand his decision.

迷信.zh: 不要迷信那些算命先生的话。
迷信.en: Don't be superstitious about those fortune tellers' words.

迷信.zh: 很多老年人还保留着迷信思想。
迷信.en: Many elderly people still retain superstitious thoughts.

迷信.zh: 她迷信风水，搬家都要看日子。
迷信.en: She is superstitious about feng shui and even checks dates for moving house.

议.en: After deliberation, the plan was approved.

慷慨.zh: 虽然他自己也不富裕，但他对朋友总是很慷慨。
慷慨.en: Although he is not rich himself, he is always generous to friends.

慷慨.zh: 这次捐款他非常慷慨，捐了一大笔钱。
慷慨.en: He was very generous in this donation, donating a large sum.

慷慨.zh: 因为她很慷慨，所以大家都喜欢她。
慷慨.en: Because she is generous, everyone likes her.

慷慨.zh: 她慷慨地把自己的笔记借给了我。
慷慨.en: She generously lent me her notes.

烦躁.zh: 天气太热了，让人觉得很烦躁。
烦躁.en: The weather is too hot, making people feel irritable.

烦躁.zh: 他因为工作压力大，最近总是很烦躁。
烦躁.en: Because of high work pressure, he has been very irritable lately.

烦躁.zh: 孩子一直哭，弄得我特别烦躁。
烦躁.en: The child keeps crying, making me extremely irritable.

烦躁.zh: 别烦躁了，我们慢慢想办法。
烦躁.en: Don't be irritable, we'll figure it out slowly.

巨型.zh: 广场上立着一个巨型的雕塑。
巨型.en: There is a giant sculpture standing in the square.

巨型.zh: 虽然这个商场是巨型的，但人并不多。
巨型.en: Although this mall is huge, there aren't many people.

巨型.zh: 他们打算造一艘巨型的游轮。
巨型.en: They plan to build a giant cruise ship.

巨型.zh: 这个巨型蛋糕够一百个人吃。
巨型.en: This giant cake is enough for 100 people.

壮观.zh: 从山顶看下去，整个城市的景色非常壮观。
壮观.en: Looking down from the mountaintop, the view of the whole city is magnificent.

壮观.zh: 虽然瀑布很高，但不如我想象中那么壮观。
壮观.en: Although the waterfall is high, it's not as spectacular as I imagined.

壮观.zh: 阅兵式的场面特别壮观。
壮观.en: The military parade scene was particularly spectacular.

壮观.zh: 这座建筑的宏伟结构让人感到壮观。
壮观.en: The grand structure of this building makes people feel awe.

逢.zh: 每逢过年，我们全家都会聚在一起。
逢.en: Every time the New Year comes, our whole family gathers.

逢.zh: 只要逢到周末，他就去爬山。
逢.en: Whenever the weekend comes, he goes hiking.

逢.zh: 他这个人逢人便笑，很友善。
逢.en: He smiles at everyone he meets, very friendly.
We two really met on a narrow path.

好说.en: This matter is easy to handle.

好说.zh: 你请客的话，那就好说了。
好说.en: If you treat, then it's easy.

好说.zh: 只要价格合适，什么都好说。
好说.en: As long as the price is right, everything is negotiable.

好说.zh: 他这个人很随和，什么都好说。
好说.en: He is an easygoing person, everything is easy to discuss.

对策.zh: 针对这个问题，我们需要想一个对策。
对策.en: Regarding this problem, we need to think of a countermeasure.

对策.zh: 如果情况再恶化，我们得赶紧制定对策。
对策.en: If the situation worsens, we need to quickly formulate a countermeasure.

对策.zh: 他们的对策是降价促销。
对策.en: Their countermeasure is to lower prices for promotion.

对策.zh: 面对竞争对手，公司必须有应对对策。
对策.en: Facing competitors, the company must have countermeasures.

扰乱.zh: 他的发言严重扰乱了会议的正常进行。
扰乱.en: His speech seriously disrupted the normal progress of the meeting.

扰乱.zh: 因为有人扰乱秩序，活动被迫取消了。
扰乱.en: Because someone disrupted order, the event was forced to cancel.

扰乱.zh: 噪音扰乱了我们的休息。
这些谣言扰乱了大家的判断。

社团.zh: 我们学校的社团活动非常丰富多样。
社团.en: Our school's club activities are very rich and diverse.

社团.zh: 虽然社团很多，但我只选了一个。
社团.en: Although there are many clubs, I only chose one.

社团.zh: 这个社团每周五都有例会。
社团.en: This club has a regular meeting every Friday.

社团.zh: 加入社团可以认识很多朋友。
社团.en: Joining a club can help you meet many friends.

渡过.zh: 在大家努力下，公司终于渡过了经济危机。
渡过.en: With everyone's effort, the company finally got through the economic crisis.

渡过.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但我们还是渡过了那个冬天。
渡过.en: Although the process was hard, we still got through that winter.

渡过.zh: 他靠坚强的意志渡过了难关。
渡过.en: He relied on strong will to get through the difficulty.

渡过.zh: 他们一起渡过了那段最艰难的日子。
渡过.en: They together got through that most difficult time.

阵地.zh: 敌人猛烈进攻，我们的阵地依然稳固。
阵地.en: Despite the enemy's fierce attack, our position remained stable.

阵地.zh: 他在阵地上坚守了三天三夜。
阵地.en: He held the position for three days and three nights.

阵地.zh: 因为天气太差，部队暂时撤离了前沿阵地。
阵地.en: Because the weather was too bad, the troops temporarily withdrew from the front-line position.

阵地.zh: 这场辩论中，双方都守住了自己的阵地。
阵地.en: In this debate, both sides held their ground.

转悠.zh: 他没事就爱在街上转悠。
转悠.en: He likes to stroll around the streets when he has nothing to do.

转悠.zh: 你们去商场转悠一圈，我在这儿等你们。
转悠.en: You guys take a stroll around the mall, and I'll wait for you here.

转悠.zh: 昨晚我在小区里转悠，碰到了一只流浪猫。
转悠.en: Last night I was wandering around the neighborhood and ran into a stray cat.

转悠.zh: 别光在门口转悠，进来坐坐吧。
转悠.en: Don't just hang around the door; come in and sit down.

手头.en: I'm a bit short on cash right now.

手头.zh: 他手头的工作还没做完。
手头.en: He hasn't finished the work at hand.

手头.zh: 你手头有零钱吗？借我十块。
手头.en: Do you have any change on you? Lend me ten yuan.

手头.zh: 最近手头项目太多了，忙不过来。
手头.en: I have too many projects on my hands lately, so I can't handle them all.

手头.zh: 虽然手头不宽裕，但他还是捐了五百块。
