手头.en: Although he wasn't well off financially, he still donated five hundred yuan.

测验.en: How did you do on this test?

测验.zh: 老师把测验卷子发下来了。
测验.en: The teacher handed back the test papers.

测验.zh: 为了准备期末测验，我每天晚上都在复习。
测验.en: To prepare for the final test, I review every night.

测验.zh: 这次数学测验比上次难多了，我差点没写完。
测验.en: This math test was much harder than the last one; I almost didn't finish it.

溅.en: The water splashed all over me.
Be careful not to splash oil on yourself.

溅.zh: 他踩到水坑，泥溅到了裤子上。
溅.en: He stepped in a puddle, and mud splashed onto his pants.

溅.zh: 炒菜的时候，热油溅到了我手上。
溅.en: While stir-frying, hot oil splashed onto my hand.

溅.zh: 雨下得很大，车子开过时溅起了很高的水花。
溅.en: It was raining heavily, and the car splashed up a lot of water as it drove by.

资深.zh: 这个项目由资深工程师带队。
资深.en: This project is led by a senior engineer.

资深.zh: 她在公司里属于资深的销售经理。
资深.en: She is a senior sales manager in the company.

资深.zh: 那位资深教授退休后还在指导研究生。
资深.en: That senior professor is still advising graduate students after retirement.

资深.zh: 作为资深玩家，他对这款游戏了如指掌。
资深.en: As a seasoned player, he knows this game inside out.

缓缓.zh: 他缓缓站起身，走向门口。
缓缓.en: He slowly stood up and walked toward the door.
The river flows slowly through the village.

缓缓.zh: 太阳缓缓落下，天边一片通红。
缓缓.en: The sun slowly set, and the horizon was all red.

缓缓.zh: 她深呼吸一下，然后缓缓把话说了出来。
缓缓.en: She took a deep breath and then slowly spoke the words.

确诊.en: The doctor confirmed it was a cold.

确诊.zh: 她确诊后就开始治疗了。
确诊.en: She started treatment after being diagnosed.

确诊.zh: 经过检查，他被确诊为高血压。
确诊.en: After examination, he was diagnosed with high blood pressure.

确诊.zh: 还好及时确诊，病情没有恶化。
确诊.en: Luckily, it was diagnosed in time, and the condition didn't get worse.

确诊.zh: 医生确诊他得了肺炎，建议住院观察。
确诊.en: The doctor diagnosed him with pneumonia and recommended hospitalization for observation.

崇高.zh: 老师有崇高的职业精神。
崇高.en: Teachers have a noble professional spirit.

崇高.zh: 为了崇高的目标，他愿意付出一切。
崇高.en: He is willing to give everything for a noble goal.

崇高.zh: 我们要学习他那种崇高的品德。
崇高.en: We should learn from his noble character.

崇高.zh: 虽然工作平凡，但她的精神非常崇高。
崇高.en: Although her job is ordinary, her spirit is very noble.

特质.en: He has the qualities of a leader.

特质.zh: 这种布料有一种特殊的质感特质。
特质.en: This fabric has a special texture quality.

特质.zh: 自信是她最明显的特质。
特质.en: Confidence is her most obvious trait.

特质.zh: 每个地区的人都有不同的文化特质。
特质.en: People from each region have different cultural traits.

特质.zh: 作为设计师，你要善于发现每种材料的独特特质。
特质.en: As a designer, you need to be good at discovering the unique traits of each material.

做生意.zh: 如果你想过好日子，就得学会怎么做生意。
做生意.en: If you want a good life, you need to learn how to do business.

做生意.zh: 她虽然年纪小，但做生意特别厉害。
做生意.en: Although she is young, she is very good at doing business.

做生意.zh: 隔壁老王做生意亏了不少钱，现在改行开出租车了。
做生意.en: Old Wang next door lost a lot of money in business, and now he has switched to driving a taxi.

届时.en: Please arrive on time at that time.

届时.zh: 会议定在下周二，届时我会通知大家。
届时.en: The meeting is scheduled for next Tuesday; I will notify everyone at that time.

届时.zh: 如果天气不好，活动将延期，届时另行通知。
届时.en: If the weather is bad, the event will be postponed, and we will notify you separately at that time.

届时.zh: 新店开业那天会有很多优惠，届时你一定要来啊。
届时.en: There will be many discounts on the opening day of the new store; you must come at that time.

届时.zh: 你们先把资料准备好，届时我们直接开始讨论。
届时.en: You prepare the materials first, and we'll start the discussion directly at that time.

寝室.en: There are four people living in our dormitory.

寝室.zh: 晚上十点后寝室就熄灯了。
寝室.en: The lights in the dormitory are turned off after ten at night.

寝室.zh: 因为室友打呼噜，我经常在寝室睡不好觉。
寝室.en: Because my roommate snores, I often can't sleep well in the dormitory.

寝室.zh: 她喜欢把寝室布置得温馨一点，所以买了很多小装饰。
寝室.en: She likes to make the dormitory cozy, so she bought a lot of small decorations.

密封.zh: 请把食物密封好再放进冰箱。
密封.en: Please seal the food well before putting it in the fridge.

密封.zh: 买了袋新咖啡，但没有密封条，很容易受潮。
密封.en: I bought a new bag of coffee, but it doesn't have a seal strip, so it's easy to get damp.

密封.zh: 这种密封袋可以用来保存照片和重要文件。
密封.en: This kind of airtight bag can be used to store photos and important documents.

密封.zh: 如果窗户不密封，冬天屋里会很冷。
密封.en: If the windows are not airtight, the house will be very cold in winter.

高明.en: His medical skills are very superb.

高明.zh: 你别觉得自己有多高明，其实大家都看出来了。
高明.en: Don't think you are so clever; actually, everyone has figured it out.

高明.zh: 虽然这个办法不高明，但至少能解决问题。
高明.en: Although this method is not brilliant, it can at least solve the problem.

高明.zh: 他说话做事都很高明，从不让人难堪。
高明.en: He is very tactful in speaking and acting, never making others feel embarrassed.

获悉.en: I just learned of this news.

获悉.zh: 获悉你生病了，我们都很担心。
获悉.en: When we learned that you were sick, we were all very worried.

获悉.zh: 从朋友那儿获悉她结婚了，我吓了一跳。
获悉.en: When I learned from a friend that she got married, I was shocked.

获悉.zh: 警方获悉嫌疑人已逃往外地，立刻展开了追捕。
获悉.en: After learning that the suspect had fled to another city, the police immediately launched a pursuit.

获悉.zh: 我们是在昨天召开的会议上获悉项目被取消的。
获悉.en: We learned at yesterday's meeting that the project had been canceled.

疤.en: He has a scar on his face.
This scar is from a fall when I was a child.

疤.zh: 伤口好了以后可能会留疤，要注意护理。
疤.en: After the wound heals, it may leave a scar, so you need to take care of it.

疤.zh: 她腿上那条疤很深，穿裙子时总想遮住。
疤.en: The scar on her leg is very deep, and she always wants to cover it when wearing a skirt.

疤.zh: 虽然手术很成功，但心里那道疤却一直没好。
疤.en: Although the surgery was successful, the scar in my heart has never healed.

胆子.zh: 你胆子真大，敢一个人去爬山。
胆子.en: You are really brave to go hiking alone.

胆子.zh: 他胆子越来越大，现在居然敢跟老板顶嘴了。
胆子.en: He is getting bolder and bolder; now he even dares to talk back to the boss.

胆子.zh: 别怕，胆子是练出来的，多试几次就好了。
胆子.en: Don't be afraid; courage is built through practice, and it will be fine after a few more tries.

胆子.zh: 那小孩胆子小得连一只蚂蚁都怕。
胆子.en: That child is so timid that he is even afraid of an ant.

叼.en: The dog took my shoe away in its mouth.
The cat ran off with a mouse in its mouth.

叼.zh: 他嘴里叼着根烟，站在门口等人。
叼.en: He stood at the door waiting for someone with a cigarette in his mouth.

叼.zh: 小鸟叼来一根树枝，准备搭窝。
叼.en: The bird brought a twig in its mouth, ready to build a nest.

叼.zh: 你看见那只乌鸦叼走了我的钥匙吗？
叼.en: Did you see that crow take my keys in its mouth?

堵塞.zh: 因为车子太多，高速路口堵塞了半个小时。
堵塞.en: Because there were too many cars, the highway entrance was congested for half an hour.

堵塞.zh: 你应该定期清理水管，避免堵塞。
堵塞.en: You should regularly clean the pipes to avoid blockages.

堵塞.zh: 上班高峰期地铁站也会堵塞，最好早点出门。
堵塞.en: The subway station also gets congested during rush hour, so it's best to leave early.

分明.en: Day and night are clearly different.

分明.zh: 其实这件事分明不是他的错。
分明.en: Actually, this matter is clearly not his fault.

分明.zh: 虽然他不承认，但我们都分明看到是他做的。
分明.en: Although he didn't admit it, we all clearly saw that it was him who did it.

分明.zh: 这个问题分明很简单，你怎么不会？
分明.en: This question is clearly very simple, how come you don't know?

料理.en: He is very good at managing household chores.

料理.zh: 这些食材可以用来料理一顿大餐。
料理.en: These ingredients can be used to cook a big meal.

料理.zh: 她不仅会做饭，还擅长料理花园。
料理.en: She not only can cook, but also is good at tending the garden.

料理.zh: 如果你不会料理生活，很容易变得一团糟。
料理.en: If you don't know how to manage your life, it can easily become a mess.

礼品.zh: 我买了一盒礼品送给她。
礼品.en: I bought a gift box for her.

礼品.zh: 这家礼品店的东西很精致。
礼品.en: The items in this gift shop are very delicate.

礼品.zh: 他收到的礼品里有一本书。
礼品.en: Among the gifts he received, there was a book.

礼品.zh: 因为不知道选什么，我只好随便挑了一份礼品。
礼品.en: Because I didn't know what to choose, I just picked a gift randomly.

礼品.zh: 过节的时候，他给每个朋友都准备了不同的礼品。
礼品.en: During the holiday, he prepared different gifts for each friend.

填补.en: He needs to fill this vacancy.

填补.zh: 这些钱可以填补一部分损失。
填补.en: This money can fill part of the loss.

填补.zh: 我们得找人来填补这个职位。
填补.en: We need to find someone to fill this position.

填补.zh: 这本书填补了该领域的研究空白。
填补.en: This book fills a research gap in this field.

填补.zh: 虽然预算不够，但他想办法填补了差额。
填补.en: Although the budget was insufficient, he found a way to make up the difference.

起伏.zh: 这条路起伏不平，开车要小心。
起伏.en: This road is bumpy and uneven, drive carefully.

起伏.zh: 股市的起伏让投资者很焦虑。
起伏.en: The fluctuations in the stock market make investors anxious.

起伏.zh: 尽管人生有起伏，但他始终乐观。
起伏.en: Although life has ups and downs, he remains optimistic.

起伏.zh: 远处的山脉连绵起伏，非常壮观。
起伏.en: The distant mountains stretch and undulate, very spectacular.

手掌.en: There is a mole on her palm.

手掌.zh: 我用手掌接住了掉下来的钥匙。
手掌.en: I caught the falling keys with my palm.

手掌.zh: 他生气时，手掌攥得紧紧的。
手掌.en: When he got angry, his palm was clenched tightly.

手掌.zh: 你把手掌贴在墙上，看看能不能摸到顶。
手掌.en: Press your palm against the wall and see if you can reach the top.

否决.zh: 董事会否决了这个方案。
因为一票之差，建议被否决了。
否决.en: By a margin of one vote, the suggestion was rejected.

否决.zh: 经理否决了加薪的请求，大家很失望。
否决.en: The manager rejected the request for a raise, and everyone was disappointed.

否决.zh: 虽然多数人同意，但主席还是否决了决议。
否决.en: Although the majority agreed, the chairman still vetoed the resolution.

中止.en: The match was suspended due to heavy rain.
Both parties agreed to terminate the contract.

中止.zh: 由于技术问题，节目被迫中止播出。
中止.en: Due to technical issues, the program was forced to stop broadcasting.

中止.zh: 他决定中止这次旅行，提前回家。
中止.en: He decided to cut the trip short and go home early.

中止.zh: 如果情况恶化，我们会立即中止合作。
中止.en: If the situation worsens, we will immediately suspend the cooperation.

移交.en: He handed over the work to a colleague.

移交.zh: 警方已将案件移交给法院。
移交.en: The police have transferred the case to the court.

移交.zh: 离职前需要把所有文件移交清楚。
移交.en: Before leaving, you need to hand over all documents clearly.

移交.zh: 新经理上任后，旧经理把权力正式移交了。
移交.en: After the new manager took office, the old manager formally transferred the authority.

移交.zh: 这些设备要移交给下一个部门使用。
移交.en: These equipment are to be handed over to the next department for use.

挑衅.zh: 这种挑衅行为很不礼貌。
挑衅.en: This kind of provocative behavior is very rude.

挑衅.zh: 面对对方的挑衅，他保持了冷静。
挑衅.en: Facing the other side's provocation, he remained calm.

挑衅.zh: 他说的那句话明显是在挑衅。
挑衅.en: What he said was clearly provocative.

挑衅.zh: 虽然对方不断挑衅，但他始终没有出手。
挑衅.en: Although the other side kept provoking, he never struck back.

功劳.zh: 这次成功全靠大家的功劳。
功劳.en: This success is all due to everyone's contribution.

功劳.zh: 他从不把功劳都抢到自己身上。
功劳.en: He never takes all the credit for himself.

功劳.zh: 虽然功劳不大，但我也尽力了。
功劳.en: Although the contribution is not big, I did my best.

功劳.zh: 老板在会议上表扬了你的功劳。
功劳.en: The boss praised your contributions in the meeting.

功劳.zh: 要不是你帮忙，我哪有这份功劳？
功劳.en: Without your help, how could I have this credit?

有幸.en: I was fortunate to meet that master.

有幸.zh: 如果你有幸被选中，一定要好好把握。
有幸.en: If you are fortunate enough to be selected, make sure to seize the opportunity.

有幸.zh: 我有幸参观了他们的实验室，收获很大。
有幸.en: I had the honor to visit their lab and gained a lot.

有幸.zh: 虽然竞争激烈，但我有幸得到了这份工作。
有幸.en: Although the competition was fierce, I was fortunate to get this job.

复发.zh: 医生说要防止旧伤复发。
复发.en: The doctor said to prevent the old injury from recurring.

复发.zh: 她吃了药以后，症状没有再复发。
复发.en: After taking the medicine, her symptoms did not recur.

复发.zh: 如果问题复发，请及时联系我们。
复发.en: If the problem recurs, please contact us promptly.

复发.zh: 他戒烟三年了，但担心咳嗽会复发。
复发.en: He has quit smoking for three years, but worries that the cough might relapse.

丛林.en: They got lost in the jungle.

丛林.zh: 热带丛林的动物种类非常多。
丛林.en: There are many animal species in the tropical jungle.

丛林.zh: 穿越那片丛林花了他们整整三天。
丛林.en: It took them three full days to cross that jungle.

丛林.zh: 为了保护丛林，政府禁止乱砍乱伐。
丛林.en: To protect the jungle, the government banned illegal logging.

丛林.zh: 如果你在丛林里过夜，一定要做好防蚊措施。
丛林.en: If you stay overnight in the jungle, be sure to take mosquito precautions.

演变.zh: 这种文化已经演变成新的形式。
演变.en: This culture has evolved into a new form.

演变.zh: 语言随着时间慢慢演变，变得不一样了。
演变.en: Language slowly evolves over time and becomes different.

演变.zh: 从简单到复杂，这个过程就是演变。
演变.en: From simple to complex, this process is evolution.

演变.zh: 经过几百年的演变，这个节日有了新的意义。
演变.en: After centuries of evolution, this festival has taken on new meaning.

精华.zh: 这本书是古代思想的精华。
精华.en: This book is the essence of ancient thought.

精华.zh: 他只提取了植物的精华部分。
精华.en: He only extracted the essential part of the plant.

精华.zh: 这部小说是作者多年心血的精华。
精华.en: This novel is the essence of the author's years of hard work.

精华.zh: 我们要学会吸收外国文化的精华。
精华.en: We should learn to absorb the essence of foreign cultures.

精华.zh: 虽然篇幅短，但每篇文章都是精华。
精华.en: Although short in length, each article is full of essence.

反射.zh: 水面反射出美丽的倒影。
反射.en: The water surface reflects a beautiful reflection.

反射.zh: 声音在空房间里反射得厉害。
反射.en: Sound reflects strongly in an empty room.

反射.zh: 医生检查了你的膝跳反射，很正常。
反射.en: The doctor checked your knee-jerk reflex; it's normal.

反射.zh: 他说话很快，完全是条件反射。
反射.en: He speaks very fast; it's completely a conditioned reflex.

火热.en: The sun is scorching hot outside in summer.

火热.zh: 他们俩的感情正处于火热期。
火热.en: Their relationship is in a passionate period.

火热.zh: 这部电视剧最近销售得火热。
火热.en: This TV series has been selling like hotcakes recently.

火热.zh: 他火热地追求了她半年，终于成功了。
火热.en: He passionately pursued her for half a year and finally succeeded.

火热.zh: 虽然天气火热，但大家还是坚持工作。
火热.en: Although the weather is scorching, everyone still persists in working.

膨胀.zh: 他的肚子越来越膨胀了。
膨胀.en: His stomach is getting more and more bloated.

膨胀.zh: 经济泡沫一旦膨胀到极点就会破灭。
膨胀.en: Once an economic bubble expands to its peak, it will burst.

膨胀.zh: 因为物价膨胀，大家的生活成本增加了。
膨胀.en: Due to price inflation, everyone's cost of living has increased.

膨胀.zh: 金属加热后体积会膨胀，这是物理现象。
膨胀.en: When metal is heated, its volume expands; this is a physical phenomenon.

更改.en: The plan has already been changed.

更改.zh: 因为天气原因，我们更改了出发时间。
更改.en: Due to weather, we changed the departure time.

更改.zh: 他决定更改自己的生活方式，开始健身。
更改.en: He decided to change his lifestyle and start working out.

更改.zh: 如果你要更改订单，请尽快联系我们。
更改.en: If you need to change the order, please contact us as soon as possible.

丙.en: I got a C this time.
He got a C grade on the exam.

丙.zh: 如果你考了丙，就要补考。
丙.en: If you get a C, you'll have to take a makeup exam.

丙.zh: 这次比赛他得了丙，所以没进决赛。
丙.en: He got a C in this competition, so he didn't make it to the finals.

缺席.zh: 因为生病，他缺席了今天的会议。
缺席.en: He was absent from today's meeting because he was sick.

缺席.zh: 如果你缺席，一定要提前请假。
缺席.en: If you're going to be absent, be sure to ask for leave in advance.

缺席.zh: 老师点名时发现有人缺席。
缺席.en: The teacher found someone absent when taking attendance.

缺席.zh: 昨天开会他缺席了，组长很不高兴。
缺席.en: He was absent from yesterday's meeting, and the team leader was very unhappy.

标本.zh: 实验室里有很多植物标本。
标本.en: There are many plant specimens in the lab.
This specimen is very well preserved.

标本.zh: 因为他喜欢收集标本，所以去了博物馆。
标本.en: He went to the museum because he likes collecting specimens.

标本.zh: 老师让我们带一个昆虫标本过来。
标本.en: The teacher asked us to bring an insect specimen.

伤势.zh: 医生仔细检查了他的伤势。
伤势.en: The doctor carefully examined his injury.
His injury has gotten much better.

伤势.zh: 虽然他的伤势很重，但他坚持训练。
伤势.en: Although his injury was severe, he insisted on training.

伤势.zh: 因为伤势太重，他只能在家休养。
伤势.en: Because his injury was too serious, he could only rest at home.

挑起.en: He lifted the load and left.

挑起.zh: 这个人总喜欢挑起争端。
挑起.en: This person always likes to provoke disputes.

挑起.zh: 如果你再挑起矛盾，大家都会不高兴。
挑起.en: If you provoke conflict again, everyone will be unhappy.

挑起.zh: 他挑起了一个很难回答的问题。
挑起.en: He brought up a very difficult question.

皱纹.en: She has wrinkles on her face.

皱纹.zh: 妈妈的眼角出现了皱纹。
皱纹.en: Mom has wrinkles appearing at the corners of her eyes.
This piece of clothing has a lot of wrinkles.

皱纹.zh: 虽然她年纪不大，但眼角已经有皱纹了。
皱纹.en: Although she's not old, she already has wrinkles at the corners of her eyes.

皱纹.zh: 因为经常晒太阳，他脸上皱纹越来越多。
皱纹.en: Because he often basks in the sun, he has more and more wrinkles on his face.

拌.en: Mom made a bowl of cold dish.

拌.zh: 因为时间不够，他只是简单拌了一下沙拉。
拌.en: Because there wasn't enough time, he just quickly tossed the salad.

拌.zh: 我先把调料拌进去，然后再煮面条。
拌.en: I'll mix in the seasoning first, then cook the noodles.

机动.zh: 他开了一辆机动三轮车。
这个计划很机动，可以随时调整。
机动.en: This plan is flexible and can be adjusted anytime.

机动.zh: 因为路上可能堵车，我们要留出机动时间。
机动.en: Because there might be traffic jams, we need to leave flexible time.

机动.zh: 公司给员工安排了机动工作时间。
机动.en: The company arranged flexible working hours for employees.

幻觉.en: Don't believe him, that's an illusion.

幻觉.zh: 因为没休息好，所以出现了幻觉。
幻觉.en: Because he didn't rest well, he had hallucinations.

幻觉.zh: 他发烧时产生了幻觉，一直说胡话。
幻觉.en: When he had a fever, he hallucinated and kept talking nonsense.

幻觉.zh: 他总说自己有幻觉，但医生说他很健康。
幻觉.en: He always says he has hallucinations, but the doctor says he's healthy.

过滤.en: This water needs to be filtered.

过滤.zh: 网上的信息要过滤一下。
过滤.en: You need to filter the information online.

过滤.zh: 我用过滤器把水过滤了一遍。
过滤.en: I filtered the water using a filter.

过滤.zh: 因为自来水不干净，所以我们要过滤了再喝。
过滤.en: Because the tap water isn't clean, we need to filter it before drinking.

过滤.zh: 你最好把油过滤一下再炒菜。
过滤.en: You'd better filter the oil before stir-frying.

偏见.en: He has a prejudice against me.
Don't look at the problem with bias.

偏见.zh: 虽然她并不了解我，但总是用偏见对待我。
偏见.en: Even though she doesn't know me, she always treats me with prejudice.

偏见.zh: 这种偏见已经影响了他的判断。
偏见.en: This kind of bias has already affected his judgment.

偏见.zh: 我们需要消除对女性的职场偏见。
偏见.en: We need to eliminate workplace prejudice against women.

攀.en: Don't compare yourself to other people's lives.

攀.zh: 他们正在攀爬那座高山。
攀.en: They are climbing that high mountain.

攀.zh: 他总想攀上有钱人交朋友。
攀.en: He always wants to climb up and make friends with rich people.

攀.zh: 爬藤蔓时，小心别攀断了。
攀.en: When climbing the vine, be careful not to break it.

气愤.en: This kind of unfairness makes people angry.

气愤.zh: 老板的责骂让他感到既委屈又气愤。
气愤.en: The boss's scolding made him feel both wronged and angry.

气愤.zh: 虽然我很气愤，但还是保持了冷静。
气愤.en: Although I was very angry, I still kept calm.

阶层.zh: 不同阶层的人想法不同。
阶层.en: People from different social classes think differently.
He comes from the middle class.

阶层.zh: 这个城市的房价把很多底层阶层的人挤走了。
阶层.en: The housing prices in this city have pushed many lower-class people away.

阶层.zh: 教育能帮助人们跨越阶层。
阶层.en: Education can help people cross social classes.

阶层.zh: 虽然我们属于不同阶层，但可以成为朋友。
阶层.en: Although we belong to different classes, we can still be friends.

抽屉.en: There are keys in the drawer.
Please put the documents in the drawer.

抽屉.zh: 我翻遍了所有抽屉也找不到那个钱包。
抽屉.en: I searched through all the drawers but couldn't find that wallet.

抽屉.zh: 这个抽屉有点卡，拉的时候要用点力。
抽屉.en: This drawer is a bit stuck, you need to pull it with some force.

抽屉.zh: 她把照片藏在最下面那个抽屉里。
抽屉.en: She hid the photos in the bottommost drawer.

会场.en: The meeting hall is full of people.
Please keep the meeting hall quiet.

会场.zh: 明天的会议在二楼会场举行。
会场.en: Tomorrow's meeting will be held in the hall on the second floor.

会场.zh: 因为设备故障，会场临时换了地方。
会场.en: Due to equipment failure, the venue was changed at the last minute.

会场.zh: 他提前一小时到会场做准备。
会场.en: He arrived at the venue an hour early to prepare.

知觉.zh: 她的手冻得没有知觉了。
知觉.en: Her hands were so cold that she lost all sensation.

知觉.zh: 突然的撞击让他一时失去了知觉。
知觉.en: The sudden impact caused him to lose consciousness temporarily.

知觉.zh: 虽然还有知觉，但他动弹不得。
知觉.en: Although he still had consciousness, he couldn't move.

审核.en: This report needs to be reviewed.

审核.zh: 请把资料交给经理审核一下。
审核.en: Please give the materials to the manager for review.

审核.zh: 经过严格审核，他的申请通过了。
审核.en: After strict review, his application was approved.

审核.zh: 公司每年都会审核一次员工绩效。
审核.en: The company reviews employee performance once a year.

飞翔.en: Birds are flying in the sky.

飞翔.zh: 风筝在风中快乐地飞翔。
飞翔.en: The kite is happily soaring in the wind.

飞翔.zh: 虽然飞机看起来很重，但它能在天上飞翔。
飞翔.en: Although the plane looks heavy, it can fly in the sky.

飞翔.zh: 她张开双臂，想像鸟一样飞翔。
飞翔.en: She spread her arms, imagining flying like a bird.

零售.en: He is in the retail business.

零售.zh: 这家店只做零售，不批发。
零售.en: This store only does retail, not wholesale.
Online retail is becoming more and more popular.

零售.zh: 我们既做批发也做零售，但零售利润更高。
零售.en: We do both wholesale and retail, but retail has higher profit margins.

敏锐.zh: 我奶奶虽然年纪大，但耳朵还是那么敏锐。
敏锐.en: Even though my grandmother is old, her hearing is still so sharp.

敏锐.zh: 作为一名记者，他有着敏锐的新闻嗅觉。
敏锐.en: As a journalist, he has a keen news sense.

敏锐.zh: 她对色彩非常敏锐，总能搭配得很好。
敏锐.en: She is very sensitive to colors and always matches them well.

敏锐.zh: 敏锐的投资者能提前发现市场变化。
敏锐.en: Sharp investors can detect market changes early.

附加.zh: 这个套餐有附加服务吗？
附加.en: Does this package have additional services?

附加.zh: 买机票时还要付附加的燃油费。
附加.en: When buying a plane ticket, you also have to pay an additional fuel surcharge.

附加.zh: 合同里有一条附加条款，你要仔细看看。
附加.en: There is an additional clause in the contract; you need to read it carefully.

附加.zh: 除了基本工资，还有额外的附加津贴。
附加.en: Besides the basic salary, there is also an extra allowance.

附加.zh: 如果你选这个颜色，需要附加一点费用。
附加.en: If you choose this color, there will be an extra charge.

粗糙.zh: 这双袜子摸起来很粗糙。
他做的手工太粗糙了，我不满意。
粗糙.en: His handmade work is too rough; I'm not satisfied.

粗糙.zh: 长期干农活，他的手变得很粗糙。
粗糙.en: After years of farm work, his hands have become very rough.

粗糙.zh: 虽然是粗糙的木料，但打磨后也能很光滑。
粗糙.en: Even though the wood is rough, it can become smooth after sanding.

粗糙.zh: 这道菜的口感有点粗糙，不够细腻。
粗糙.en: The texture of this dish is a bit rough, not delicate enough.

税务.zh: 每年四月我们要报税务报表。
税务.en: Every April we have to file tax returns.

税务.zh: 他们公司请了一个税务顾问。
税务.en: Their company hired a tax consultant.

税务.zh: 因为税务政策变了，我们要重新计算。
税务.en: Because the tax policy changed, we need to recalculate.

税务.zh: 他考了税务师资格证，现在在税务局工作。
税务.en: He passed the tax agent qualification exam and now works at the tax bureau.

破解.zh: 警方终于破解了这起悬案。
破解.en: The police finally solved this unsolved case.

破解.zh: 这个软件需要破解才能用吗？
破解.en: Does this software need to be cracked before it can be used?

破解.zh: 我想了很久，还是没破解那个谜题。
破解.en: I thought about it for a long time, but still couldn't solve that puzzle.

破解.zh: 工程师成功破解了技术难题，大家都很高兴。
破解.en: The engineer successfully solved the technical problem, and everyone was very happy.

冷却.en: The soup is too hot; let it cool down first.

冷却.zh: 电脑风扇负责给主机冷却。
冷却.en: The computer fan is responsible for cooling the main unit.

冷却.zh: 他们之间的感情需要冷却一段时间。
冷却.en: Their relationship needs some time to cool off.

冷却.zh: 等机器完全冷却后再进行维修。
冷却.en: Wait until the machine has completely cooled down before doing repairs.

冷却.zh: 热恋过后，感情会慢慢冷却下来。
冷却.en: After the passionate stage, feelings gradually cool down.

化验.en: The doctor told me to get a blood test.
The water quality test report is out.

化验.zh: 病人需要再做一次化验才能确诊。
化验.en: The patient needs to have another test before a diagnosis can be confirmed.

化验.zh: 食品化验结果证明没有有害物质。
化验.en: The food test results prove there are no harmful substances.

化验.zh: 如果你怀疑食物中毒，可以拿样品去化验。
化验.en: If you suspect food poisoning, you can take a sample for testing.

暗杀.en: The president survived an assassination attempt.

暗杀.zh: 这个组织策划了暗杀行动。
暗杀.en: This organization planned an assassination operation.

暗杀.zh: 他被暗杀的消息震惊了全国。
暗杀.en: The news of his assassination shocked the whole country.

暗杀.zh: 历史上有很多著名的暗杀事件。
暗杀.en: There are many famous assassinations in history.

暗杀.zh: 安保人员成功阻止了针对大使的暗杀。
暗杀.en: Security personnel successfully prevented the assassination attempt on the ambassador.

坦诚.zh: 我们坦诚地谈了一次，误会解开了。
坦诚.en: We had an honest talk, and the misunderstanding was resolved.

坦诚.zh: 坦诚相待是友谊的基础。
坦诚.en: Treating each other honestly is the foundation of friendship.

坦诚.zh: 他坦诚自己犯了一个错误。
坦诚.en: He honestly admitted that he made a mistake.

坦诚.zh: 虽然他的话不好听，但非常坦诚。
坦诚.en: Even though his words were unpleasant, they were very honest.

无私.zh: 他无私地帮助了很多人。
这种无私的精神值得学习。
无私.en: This selfless spirit is worth learning from.

无私.zh: 一位无私的志愿者每天来照顾老人。
无私.en: A selfless volunteer comes every day to take care of the elderly.

无私.zh: 她无私的付出，让整个社区都感动了。
无私.en: Her selfless dedication moved the entire community.

劫持.zh: 虽然劫持事件很危险，但警方很快就解决了。
劫持.en: Although the hijacking incident was dangerous, the police quickly resolved it.

劫持.zh: 那架飞机被恐怖分子劫持了。
劫持.en: That plane was hijacked by terrorists.

劫持.zh: 他因为劫持人质被判了刑。
劫持.en: He was sentenced for kidnapping hostages.

劫持.zh: 电影里有一段精彩的劫持戏。
劫持.en: There's a wonderful hijacking scene in the movie.

平行.zh: 平行线的距离永远不会改变。
平行.en: The distance between parallel lines never changes.

平行.zh: 他的工作和生活是平行的，从不交叉。
平行.en: His work and life are parallel, never intersecting.

平行.zh: 这两条道路平行延伸了十公里。
平行.en: These two roads extend parallel for ten kilometers.

皮带.zh: 我昨天买了一条新皮带。
皮带.en: I bought a new belt yesterday.

皮带.zh: 虽然皮带很贵，但质量很好。
皮带.en: Although the belt is expensive, the quality is good.

皮带.zh: 这条皮带是用真皮做的。
皮带.en: This belt is made of real leather.

皮带.zh: 他系着一条黑色皮带参加面试。
皮带.en: He wore a black belt to the interview.

声誉.zh: 这家公司的声誉在行业内很高。
声誉.en: This company's reputation is very high in the industry.

声誉.zh: 因为他的声誉受损，很多客户都离开了。
声誉.en: Because his reputation was damaged, many clients left.

声誉.zh: 声誉需要很长时间才能建立。
声誉.en: Reputation takes a long time to build.

声誉.zh: 网上购物很注重商家声誉。
声誉.en: Online shopping pays great attention to merchant reputation.

相伴.en: They accompany each other for life.

相伴.zh: 这只小狗一直相伴在我身边。
相伴.en: This little dog has been accompanying me all along.

相伴.zh: 虽然家人不能常相伴，但感情依然深厚。
相伴.en: Although family cannot always be together, the feelings remain deep.

相伴.zh: 音乐和咖啡是相伴的享受。
相伴.en: Music and coffee are a matched enjoyment.

相伴.zh: 他们相伴走过许多风雨。
相伴.en: They have gone through many storms together.

人造.zh: 人造卫星在太空中运行。
虽然人造花很漂亮，但没有香味。
人造.en: Although artificial flowers are beautiful, they have no fragrance.

人造.zh: 很多食物都含人造色素。
人造钻石和真钻石很难区分。
人造.en: Artificial diamonds and real diamonds are hard to distinguish.

蚊子.zh: 因为蚊子太多，我不得不点蚊香。
蚊子.en: Because there are too many mosquitoes, I have to light mosquito coils.

蚊子.zh: 他用手拍死了一只蚊子。
蚊子.en: He killed a mosquito with his hand.

现任.zh: 现任总统正在访问邻国。
现任.en: The current president is visiting a neighboring country.

现任.zh: 虽然他是前任，但现任也做得不错。
现任.en: Although he is the predecessor, the current one is also doing well.

现任.zh: 现任老板对员工很严格。
现任.en: The current boss is very strict with employees.

现任.zh: 我们需要和现任负责人沟通。
现任.en: We need to communicate with the current person in charge.

亲生.zh: 虽然他们是养父母，但对他像亲生一样。
亲生.en: Although they are foster parents, they treat him like their own.

亲生.zh: 因为不是亲生的，他总觉得有些隔阂。
亲生.en: Because he is not biological, he always feels some distance.

亲生.zh: 亲生父母和养父母都爱他。
亲生.en: Both biological parents and adoptive parents love him.

亲生.zh: 她不知道自己的亲生母亲是谁。
亲生.en: She doesn't know who her biological mother is.

胡说.zh: 他总是在胡说，没人相信他。
胡说.en: He always talks nonsense, no one believes him.

胡说.zh: 如果你胡说八道，别人会生气。
胡说.en: If you talk nonsense, others will get angry.

胡说.zh: 他胡说了一个理由来搪塞。
胡说.en: He made up a nonsense excuse to brush it off.

胡说.zh: 网上有很多胡说八道的文章。
胡说.en: There are many nonsense articles online.

根源.zh: 这个问题的根源是什么？
根源.en: What is the root cause of this problem?

根源.zh: 很多矛盾的根源在于沟通不足。
根源.en: The root of many conflicts lies in poor communication.

根源.zh: 我们要找到问题的根源才能解决它。
根源.en: We need to find the root of the problem to solve it.

根源.zh: 他总说贫穷是犯罪的根源，但我不这么认为。
根源.en: He always says poverty is the root of crime, but I don't think so.

根源.zh: 其实，不信任才是他们争吵的根源。
根源.en: Actually, distrust is the root cause of their arguments.

席位.zh: 这次会议为每位代表预留了专属席位。
席位.en: This meeting has reserved exclusive seats for each delegate.

席位.zh: 由于座位不够，他只好站着，没有席位。
席位.en: Since there weren't enough seats, he had to stand, without a place.

席位.zh: 这个餐厅有二十个席位，需要提前预订。
席位.en: This restaurant has twenty seats, reservations are needed in advance.

席位.zh: 他在议会中赢得了一个重要席位。
席位.en: He won an important seat in the parliament.

妄想.zh: 他总妄想一夜暴富，却不肯努力。
妄想.en: He always vainly hopes to get rich overnight, but refuses to work hard.

妄想.zh: 别妄想了，这件事根本不可能成功。
妄想.en: Stop deluding yourself, this thing is utterly impossible to succeed.

妄想.zh: 那种不切实际的妄想只会浪费你的时间。
妄想.en: That kind of unrealistic delusion will only waste your time.

妄想.zh: 虽然大家都说不可能，但他依然抱着妄想。
妄想.en: Although everyone says it's impossible, he still clings to his delusion.

玩耍.en: The children are playing in the park.

玩耍.zh: 周末我带孩子去海边玩耍，他们很开心。
玩耍.en: On weekends I take the kids to the beach to play, and they are very happy.

玩耍.zh: 玩耍的时候要注意安全，别受伤了。
玩耍.en: When playing, pay attention to safety and don't get hurt.

玩耍.zh: 他们一边玩耍一边唱歌，非常快乐。
玩耍.en: They play and sing at the same time, very happy.

玩耍.zh: 这只小狗很喜欢和小朋友一起玩耍。
玩耍.en: This little dog really likes to play with children.

笼罩.zh: 整个城市笼罩在雾霾中。
笼罩.en: The whole city is shrouded in smog.

笼罩.zh: 悲伤的气氛笼罩着整个家庭。
笼罩.en: A sad atmosphere enveloped the entire family.

笼罩.zh: 乌云笼罩着天空，快要下雨了。
笼罩.en: Dark clouds cover the sky, it's about to rain.

笼罩.zh: 恐惧笼罩着每个人的心头，无人敢出声。
笼罩.en: Fear enveloped everyone's heart, no one dared to speak.

笼罩.zh: 在胜利的喜悦中，失败的阴影不再笼罩他们。
笼罩.en: In the joy of victory, the shadow of failure no longer hangs over them.

卓越.zh: 他是一位卓越的科学家。
她在比赛中展现了卓越的才华和领导力。
卓越.en: She displayed outstanding talent and leadership in the competition.

卓越.zh: 只有付出卓越的努力，才能获得非凡的成就。
卓越.en: Only by making outstanding efforts can you achieve extraordinary results.

卓越.zh: 这个团队以卓越的服务赢得了客户信任。
卓越.en: This team won customer trust with excellent service.

卓越.zh: 卓越不是天生的，而是靠后天不断练习出来的。
卓越.en: Excellence is not innate, but comes from continuous practice.

保养.zh: 皮肤保养很重要，尤其是夏天要注意防晒。
保养.en: Skin care is very important, especially sun protection in summer.

保养.zh: 我每个月都会去健身房，顺便保养一下身体。
保养.en: I go to the gym every month and take care of my body while I'm at it.

保养.zh: 这台机器用了十年，因为保养得好，还很新。
保养.en: This machine has been used for ten years, but because it's well-maintained, it still looks new.

保养.zh: 保养头发需要用合适的洗发水和护发素。
保养.en: To maintain hair, you need to use suitable shampoo and conditioner.

全局.zh: 我们要从全局考虑问题。
全局.en: We need to think about problems from the overall perspective.

全局.zh: 做决策时，不能只看到局部而忽略了全局。
全局.en: When making decisions, you can't only see the parts and ignore the whole.

全局.zh: 他作为经理，必须把握全局，协调各部门。
全局.en: As a manager, he must grasp the big picture and coordinate departments.

全局.zh: 虽然这件事很小，但它会影响全局的走向。
全局.en: Although this matter is small, it will affect the direction of the whole situation.

全局.zh: 只看眼前利益，往往会影响全局的发展。
全局.en: Only looking at immediate gains often affects the overall development.

减速.en: Please slow down and drive carefully.

减速.zh: 前面有学校，司机必须减速行驶。
减速.en: There is a school ahead, drivers must slow down.

减速.zh: 经济增速放缓，我们需要主动减速调整。
减速.en: Economic growth is slowing, we need to proactively decelerate and adjust.

减速.zh: 他开车太快，遇到路口才突然减速，很危险。
减速.en: He drives too fast and only suddenly slows down at intersections, which is dangerous.

减速.zh: 跑步时突然减速容易拉伤肌肉，要注意。
减速.en: Sudden deceleration while running can easily strain muscles, so be careful.

响应.zh: 他的提议得到了积极响应。
响应.en: His proposal received a positive response.

响应.zh: 政府号召大家节约用水，市民纷纷响应。
响应.en: The government called on everyone to save water, and citizens responded actively.

响应.zh: 这个活动一发布，就吸引了很多人响应报名。
响应.en: As soon as this event was announced, it attracted many people to sign up in response.

响应.zh: 他们迅速响应了客户的投诉，并解决了问题。
响应.en: They quickly responded to the customer's complaint and solved the problem.

响应.zh: 在紧急情况下，快速响应是至关重要的。
响应.en: In emergency situations, a quick response is crucial.

瀑布.zh: 我们去山上看了那个大瀑布，非常壮观。
瀑布.en: We went to the mountain to see that big waterfall, it was spectacular.

瀑布.zh: 瀑布的声音很大，像打雷一样。
瀑布.en: The sound of the waterfall is loud, like thunder.

瀑布.zh: 夏天的时候，瀑布旁边很凉快。
瀑布.en: In summer, it's very cool next to the waterfall.

瀑布.zh: 从远处看，瀑布就像一条白布。
瀑布.en: From afar, the waterfall looks like a white cloth.

动员.zh: 学校动员我们参加志愿者活动。
动员.en: The school mobilized us to volunteer.

动员.zh: 公司动员全体员工捐款。
动员.en: The company mobilized all employees to donate.

动员.zh: 为了这次活动，他动员了很多朋友。
动员.en: For this event, he mobilized many friends.

动员.zh: 政府动员大家节约用水，效果不错。
动员.en: The government mobilized everyone to save water, and the effect was good.

顾虑.en: He has a lot of worries.

顾虑.zh: 你别有太多顾虑，放心去做吧。
顾虑.en: Don't have too many worries, just go ahead and do it.

顾虑.zh: 我顾虑的是时间不够用。
顾虑.en: What I worry about is that there's not enough time.

顾虑.zh: 她犹豫不决，因为顾虑太多。
顾虑.en: She hesitated because she had too many concerns.

顾虑.zh: 做决定之前，要消除所有顾虑。
顾虑.en: Before making a decision, you should eliminate all concerns.

监护.zh: 父母有责任监护未成年子女。
监护.en: Parents have a duty to supervise their minor children.
The hospital monitors the patient's condition.

监护.zh: 监护权归了妈妈，爸爸很不高兴。
监护.en: Custody was awarded to the mom, and the dad was very unhappy.

监护.zh: 她负责监护这个项目的进展。
监护.en: She is responsible for overseeing the progress of this project.

鳄鱼.zh: 动物园里有一只大鳄鱼。
鳄鱼.en: There is a big crocodile in the zoo.

鳄鱼.zh: 鳄鱼在水里一动不动，像块木头。
鳄鱼.en: The crocodile is motionless in the water, like a piece of wood.
He bought a crocodile leather bag.

鳄鱼.zh: 我看过一部关于鳄鱼的电影。
鳄鱼.en: I've seen a movie about crocodiles.

恐吓.zh: 他用言语恐吓我，我很害怕。
恐吓.en: He threatened me with words, and I was very scared.
If you receive a threatening letter, you should call the police.

恐吓.zh: 这种恐吓行为是违法的。
恐吓.en: This kind of threatening behavior is illegal.

恐吓.zh: 别怕，他只是虚张声势地恐吓。
恐吓.en: Don't be afraid, he's just bluffing and threatening.

混凝土.zh: 这座桥是用混凝土建的。
混凝土.en: This bridge is built with concrete.

混凝土.zh: 工人们正在搅拌混凝土。
混凝土凝固之后非常坚固。
混凝土.en: After concrete sets, it's very strong.

混凝土.zh: 现代建筑大多用钢筋混凝土。
混凝土.en: Modern buildings mostly use reinforced concrete.

百合.zh: 我买了一束百合放在客厅。
百合.en: I bought a bouquet of lilies and put them in the living room.
The scent of lilies is very elegant.

百合.zh: 这个花园种了很多百合。
百合.en: This garden has many lilies planted.

百合.zh: 送百合代表纯洁的友谊。

诚意.zh: 你要拿出诚意来谈合作。
诚意.en: You need to show sincerity to discuss cooperation.

诚意.zh: 这点礼物代表我的诚意。
诚意.en: This small gift represents my sincerity.

诚意.zh: 没有诚意的人很难交到朋友。
诚意.en: People without sincerity find it hard to make friends.
When apologizing, you must be sincere.

理所当然.zh: 他觉得自己成功是理所当然的。
理所当然.en: He thinks his success is taken for granted.

理所当然.zh: 不要把别人的帮助当成理所当然。
理所当然.en: Don't take others' help for granted.

理所当然.zh: 父母的爱不是理所当然的。
理所当然.en: Parents' love is not something to be taken for granted.

理所当然.zh: 理所当然的事也要懂得感恩。
理所当然.en: Even things taken for granted should be appreciated.

痰.zh: 他咳嗽的时候痰特别多。
痰.en: When he coughs, he has a lot of phlegm.

痰.zh: 医生让我检查一下痰的颜色。
痰.en: The doctor asked me to check the color of my phlegm.

痰.zh: 虽然痰很多，但是吃了药好多了。
痰.en: Although there is a lot of phlegm, after taking medicine it's much better.

痰.zh: 你嗓子里的痰要咳出来。
痰.en: You need to cough out the phlegm in your throat.

必将.en: Hard work will certainly bring rewards.

必将.zh: 如果我们坚持，必将成功。
必将.en: If we persist, we will certainly succeed.

必将.zh: 这个项目必将影响整个行业。
必将.en: This project will certainly affect the entire industry.

必将.zh: 虽然困难很多，但最终必将克服。
必将.en: Although there are many difficulties, we will certainly overcome them eventually.

必将.zh: 他的才华必将被更多人认可。
必将.en: His talent will certainly be recognized by more people.

数额.zh: 请核对一下数额是否正确。
数额.en: Please check if the amount is correct.

数额.zh: 银行转账的数额不能超过限额。
数额.en: The amount of bank transfer cannot exceed the limit.

数额.zh: 他们谈了很久才定下数额。
数额.en: They talked for a long time before settling the amount.

数额.zh: 每个月的捐款数额不一样。
数额.en: The donation amount each month is different.

部件.zh: 这个机器少了一个部件。
部件.en: This machine is missing a component.

部件.zh: 电脑的各个部件都要定期清洁。
部件.en: All components of the computer need regular cleaning.

部件.zh: 你买零件的时候要确认部件型号。
部件.en: When buying parts, you need to confirm the component model.

部件.zh: 这个部件坏了，需要换新的。
部件.en: This component is broken and needs a new one.

部件.zh: 组装这个玩具需要很多小部件。
部件.en: Assembling this toy requires many small parts.

火腿.zh: 我早餐喜欢吃火腿三明治。
火腿.en: I like ham sandwiches for breakfast.
The ham in the supermarket is on sale.

火腿.zh: 他在冰箱里放了一根火腿。
火腿.en: He put a ham in the fridge.

火腿.zh: 妈妈做的火腿炒饭特别香。
火腿.en: Mom's ham fried rice is especially fragrant.

火腿.zh: 这个火腿是意大利进口的。
火腿.en: This ham is imported from Italy.

悲痛.zh: 听到这个消息，他非常悲痛。
悲痛.en: Hearing this news, he was very grieved.
We need to turn grief into strength.
She was so grieved that she couldn't speak.

悲痛.zh: 在悲痛中，家人互相支持。
悲痛.en: In grief, family members support each other.

悲痛.zh: 虽然悲痛，但我们还是要继续生活。
悲痛.en: Although grieved, we still have to continue living.

所属.zh: 这个文件是哪个部门所属？
所属.en: Which department does this document belong to?
Please fill in your affiliated unit.

所属.zh: 这些物品的所属权不明确。
所属.en: The ownership of these items is unclear.

所属.zh: 他所属的团队赢得了比赛。
所属.en: The team he belongs to won the competition.

所属.zh: 我们得查明这些资料的所属机构。
所属.en: We need to find out the institution to which these materials belong.

潇洒.zh: 他穿着一件风衣，看起来很潇洒。
潇洒.en: He wears a trench coat and looks very dashing.

潇洒.zh: 她做事很潇洒，从不拖泥带水。
潇洒.en: She does things in a free-spirited way, never indecisive.

潇洒.zh: 我喜欢他那种潇洒的生活态度。
潇洒.en: I like his carefree attitude towards life.

潇洒.zh: 虽然老了，他依然很潇洒。
潇洒.en: Although old, he is still dashing.

潇洒.zh: 他潇洒地挥了挥手就走了。
潇洒.en: He waved his hand gracefully and left.

了结.zh: 我们得尽快了结这个案子。
了结.en: We need to settle this case as soon as possible.

了结.zh: 他想用和平方式了结这场纠纷。
了结.en: He wants to settle this dispute peacefully.

了结.zh: 她希望这件事能顺利了结。
了结.en: She hopes this matter can be settled smoothly.

了结.zh: 了结一段感情并不容易。
了结.en: Ending a relationship is not easy.

车型.en: This car model is very popular.
What car model do you like?

车型.zh: 不同车型的耗油量不一样。
车型.en: Different car models have different fuel consumption.

车型.zh: 他最近换了一辆新车型。
车型.en: He recently changed to a new car model.

车型.zh: 销售员给我介绍了三种车型。
车型.en: The salesperson introduced three car models to me.

倒计时.zh: 还有三天倒计时，大家都很紧张。
倒计时.en: With three days left in the countdown, everyone is very nervous.

倒计时.zh: 虽然倒计时还没结束，但我们已经准备好了。
倒计时.en: Although the countdown isn't over yet, we are already prepared.

倒计时.zh: 手机上的倒计时提醒我考试快到了。
倒计时.en: The countdown on my phone reminds me that the exam is coming soon.

倒计时.zh: 新年倒计时的时候，我们都在欢呼。
倒计时.en: During the New Year countdown, we were all cheering.

狡猾.zh: 他太狡猾了，每次都能骗过别人。
狡猾.en: He's so sly that he manages to fool others every time.

狡猾.zh: 因为对手很狡猾，所以我们得多加小心。
狡猾.en: Because the opponent is very cunning, we need to be extra careful.
Don't trust him, he's especially crafty.

狡猾.zh: 那个狡猾的家伙居然逃过了检查。
狡猾.en: That sly guy actually managed to evade the inspection.

闪烁.zh: 远处的灯光不停闪烁，好像在说话。
闪烁.en: The lights in the distance keep flickering, as if they are talking.

闪烁.zh: 他的眼睛闪烁着泪光，但没哭出来。
闪烁.en: His eyes sparkled with tears, but he didn't cry.

闪烁.zh: 别闪烁其词，直接告诉我答案。
闪烁.en: Don't evade the question, just tell me the answer directly.

闪烁.zh: 信号灯闪烁了几下就灭了。
闪烁.en: The signal light flickered a few times and then went out.

卵.en: These fish eggs are very small.

卵.zh: 母鸡每天都会下一个卵。
卵.en: The hen lays one egg every day.

卵.zh: 虽然卵很小，但里面营养丰富。
卵.en: Although the eggs are small, they are rich in nutrients.
Butterflies lay their eggs on leaves.

卵.zh: 乌龟的卵埋在沙子里孵化。
卵.en: Turtle eggs are buried in the sand to hatch.

可信.zh: 我觉得他说的话不太可信。
可信.en: I think what he said is not very trustworthy.

可信.zh: 因为来源不明确，所以信息不可信。
可信.en: Because the source is unclear, the information is not credible.

可信.zh: 要找可信的人合作才行。
可信.en: We need to find trustworthy people to cooperate with.

可信.zh: 数据必须来自可信的渠道。
可信.en: The data must come from reliable channels.

通行证.zh: 没有通行证就不能进入这个区域。
通行证.en: You cannot enter this area without a pass.

通行证.zh: 虽然我有通行证，但还是要检查。
通行证.en: Even though I have a pass, I still need to be checked.

通行证.zh: 这张通行证只能使用一次。
通行证.en: This pass can only be used once.

秘诀.zh: 保持快乐的秘诀就是别想太多。
秘诀.en: The secret to staying happy is not to overthink.

秘诀.zh: 如果你想成功，秘诀就是坚持。
秘诀.en: If you want to succeed, the secret is perseverance.

秘诀.zh: 这道菜的秘诀在于火候。
秘诀.en: The secret to this dish lies in the heat control.

揭.en: He uncovered the truth of the matter.

揭.zh: 记者揭发了公司的违法行为。
揭.en: The journalist exposed the company's illegal activities.

揭.zh: 她轻轻揭下脸上的面膜。
揭.en: She gently peeled off the face mask.

同盟.en: The two countries formed a military alliance.

同盟.zh: 因为共同利益，他们组成了同盟。
同盟.en: Because of common interests, they formed an alliance.

同盟.zh: 这次行动需要所有同盟的配合。
同盟.en: This operation requires the cooperation of all allies.

挑剔.en: He is very picky about food.

挑剔.zh: 虽然她很挑剔，但做事很认真。
挑剔.en: Although she is very picky, she is very serious about her work.

挑剔.zh: 别那么挑剔，差不多就行了。
挑剔.en: Don't be so picky, it's good enough.

挑剔.zh: 挑剔的顾客往往更难满足。
挑剔.en: Picky customers are often harder to satisfy.

器械.zh: 这个器械很重，我搬不动。
器械.en: This equipment is very heavy, I can't move it.

器械.zh: 他每天去健身房用器械练肌肉。
器械.en: He goes to the gym every day to use the equipment to build muscle.

器械.zh: 医生用特殊的器械给我检查了牙齿。
器械.en: The doctor used special instruments to check my teeth.

器械.zh: 虽然这台器械看起来很复杂，但操作起来很简单。
器械.en: Although this equipment looks complicated, it's simple to operate.

器械.zh: 我买了一些健身器械放在家里，方便随时锻炼。
器械.en: I bought some fitness equipment to keep at home for convenience to exercise at any time.

触动.zh: 这部电影触动了很多人的内心。
触动.en: This movie touched many people's hearts.

触动.zh: 她的一番话触动了我，让我重新思考人生。
触动.en: Her words touched me and made me rethink life.

触动.zh: 每次看到那张老照片，我都会被触动。
触动.en: Every time I see that old photo, I am moved.

内幕.zh: 没人知道这件事的内幕。
内幕.en: No one knows the inside story of this matter.

内幕.zh: 他揭露了公司的内幕交易。
内幕.en: He revealed the company's insider trading.

内幕.zh: 这本书讲了很多娱乐圈的内幕。
内幕.en: This book reveals a lot of inside stories of the entertainment industry.

内幕.zh: 如果你想知道内幕，就得去找知道真相的人。
内幕.en: If you want to know the inside story, you have to find someone who knows the truth.

内幕.zh: 新闻记者花了两年时间调查这个事件的内幕。
内幕.en: The journalist spent two years investigating the inside story of this incident.

历程.en: The journey of growing up is hard.

历程.zh: 他分享了自己的创业历程。
这段学习历程让我收获很多。
历程.en: This learning journey has brought me a lot.

历程.zh: 从失败到成功，他经历了漫长的历程。
历程.en: From failure to success, he went through a long journey.

历程.zh: 回顾过去十年的历程，我觉得自己没有白活。
历程.en: Looking back on the journey of the past ten years, I feel I haven't lived in vain.

望远镜.en: I use a telescope to look at stars.
His telescope can see very far.

望远镜.zh: 这个望远镜是天文爱好者必备的工具。
望远镜.en: This telescope is a must-have tool for astronomy enthusiasts.

望远镜.zh: 爸爸送给我一个望远镜，让我观察鸟。
望远镜.en: Dad gave me a telescope so I could observe birds.

望远镜.zh: 虽然望远镜很贵，但他还是买了。
望远镜.en: Although the telescope was expensive, he still bought it.

要紧.en: This is very important, don't delay.

要紧.zh: 身体最要紧，其他都是小事。
要紧.en: Health is the most important, everything else is trivial.

要紧.zh: 你先忙要紧的事，我的不急。
要紧.en: You take care of the urgent matters first, mine is not urgent.

要紧.zh: 这次考试很要紧，你一定要认真准备。
要紧.en: This exam is very important, you must prepare carefully.

重申.en: I reiterate my point of view.
The teacher reiterated the exam rules.

重申.zh: 政府重申了环保政策的重要性。
重申.en: The government reiterated the importance of environmental policies.

重申.zh: 为了避免误会，我再次重申我的立场。
重申.en: To avoid misunderstanding, I reiterate my position again.

重申.zh: 他在会议上重申了公司对员工权益的保障。
重申.en: He reiterated the company's guarantee of employee rights at the meeting.

庙.en: We went to the temple to burn incense.

庙.zh: 这座庙有一千多年历史了。
庙.en: This temple has a history of over a thousand years.

庙.zh: 每年春节，庙里都挤满了人。
庙.en: Every Spring Festival, the temple is packed with people.

庙.zh: 他经常去庙里拜佛，祈求平安。
庙.en: He often goes to the temple to worship Buddha and pray for peace.

庙.zh: 虽然庙不大，但香火很旺。
庙.en: Although the temple is not big, it has many worshippers.

神情.zh: 她脸上露出惊讶的神情。
神情.en: A surprised expression appeared on her face.

神情.zh: 看到成绩时，他神情轻松了很多。
神情.en: When he saw the results, his expression relaxed a lot.

神情.zh: 尽管他嘴上说没事，但神情出卖了他。
神情.en: Although he said it was fine, his expression betrayed him.

神情.zh: 老师看着试卷，神情变得越来越凝重。
神情.en: The teacher looked at the test paper, and his expression became increasingly grave.

棺材.zh: 老人给自己准备了棺材。
棺材.en: The old man prepared a coffin for himself.

棺材.zh: 他去世后，家人买了一副棺材。
棺材.en: After he passed away, his family bought a coffin.

棺材.zh: 在葬礼上，棺材被鲜花包围着。
棺材.en: At the funeral, the coffin was surrounded by flowers.

棺材.zh: 听说那口棺材是用上等木材做的。
棺材.en: I heard that coffin is made of high-quality wood.

棺材.zh: 虽然棺材很昂贵，但为了体面，他们还是买了。
棺材.en: Although the coffin was expensive, they still bought it for dignity.

俘虏.zh: 这些俘虏被关在营地外面。
俘虏.en: These captives are held outside the camp.

俘虏.zh: 战争结束后，所有俘虏都被释放了。
俘虏.en: After the war ended, all prisoners were released.

俘虏.zh: 他宁愿战死也不愿当俘虏。
俘虏.en: He would rather die fighting than become a prisoner.

俘虏.zh: 虽然做了俘虏，但他一直保持镇定。
俘虏.en: Although he was taken captive, he remained calm all along.

信誉.en: This store has a good reputation.

信誉.zh: 他说谎太多，已经没信誉了。
信誉.en: He lies too much and has no credibility anymore.

信誉.zh: 我们公司非常看重商业信誉。
信誉.en: Our company values business reputation very much.

信誉.zh: 如果你不还钱，你的信誉会受影响。
信誉.en: If you don't pay back the money, your credit will be affected.

信誉.zh: 因为信誉差，他很难再借到钱。
信誉.en: Because of his poor credit, it's hard for him to borrow money again.

耻辱.en: This is a disgrace to the whole family.
He feels failure is a kind of shame.

耻辱.zh: 那次作弊成了他毕生的耻辱。
耻辱.en: That cheating incident became a lifelong shame for him.

耻辱.zh: 不要把别人的善意当成耻辱。
耻辱.en: Don't treat others' kindness as a humiliation.

耻辱.zh: 虽然输了比赛，但并不是耻辱。
耻辱.en: Although we lost the game, it's not a disgrace.

初次.en: This is my first time coming to Beijing.
Nice to meet you for the first time.

初次.zh: 她初次上台演讲时非常紧张。
初次.en: She was very nervous when giving a speech for the first time.

初次.zh: 初次尝试做这道菜，味道还不错。
初次.en: The first time I tried making this dish, it tasted pretty good.

初次.zh: 虽然初次合作，但我们配合得很默契。
初次.en: Although it's our first collaboration, we worked together very smoothly.

镇定.en: His tone of voice was very calm.

镇定.zh: 虽然着火了她还是很镇定。
镇定.en: Even though there was a fire, she remained very calm.

镇定.zh: 警察让他镇定下来，慢慢说发生了什么。
镇定.en: The police told him to calm down and slowly explain what happened.

镇定.zh: 在大家慌乱的时候，只有他一个人镇定自若。
镇定.en: When everyone was panicking, only he remained composed.

租赁.zh: 他们公司主要做汽车租赁业务。
租赁.en: Their company mainly does car rental business.

租赁.zh: 签订租赁合同前要仔细阅读条款。
租赁.en: Read the terms carefully before signing the lease contract.

租赁.zh: 短期租赁比长期租赁贵一些。
租赁.en: Short-term rental is a bit more expensive than long-term rental.

租赁.zh: 因为只是来旅游，所以我们选择租赁自行车。
租赁.en: Since we're just traveling, we chose to rent bicycles.

破案.en: This case is very difficult to solve.

破案.zh: 他是一名优秀的破案专家。
破案.en: He is an excellent crime-solving expert.

破案.zh: 如果没有目击者，破案会非常困难。
破案.en: Without witnesses, solving the case would be very difficult.

规章.en: You must follow the company's rules.

规章.zh: 这些规章适用于所有人。

规章.en: Violating the rules will result in punishment.

规章.zh: 学校的规章要求穿校服上课。
规章.en: School regulations require wearing uniforms to class.

规章.zh: 虽然规章很严格，但都是为了安全。
规章.en: Even though the rules are strict, they are all for safety.

施展.zh: 他终于有机会施展才华。
施展.en: He finally got a chance to display his talent.

施展.zh: 这里空间太小，施展不开。
施展.en: The space here is too small to move freely.

施展.zh: 他在比赛中充分施展了自己的技能。
施展.en: He fully displayed his skills in the competition.

施展.zh: 新工作让他能施展抱负。
施展.en: The new job allows him to realize his ambitions.

施展.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但他仍然施展了全部本领。
施展.en: Although conditions were tough, he still exerted all his abilities.

丧生.en: Three people died in the car accident.

丧生.zh: 地震中丧生的人数还在增加。
丧生.en: The number of deaths in the earthquake is still rising.

丧生.zh: 他在救援行动中不幸丧生。
丧生.en: He unfortunately lost his life in the rescue operation.

丧生.zh: 洪水过后，有数十人丧生。
丧生.en: After the flood, dozens of people lost their lives.

山谷.en: We went to play in the valley.

山谷.zh: 这个山谷的风景很美，很多人来拍照。
山谷.en: The scenery in this valley is beautiful, many people come to take photos.

山谷.zh: 山谷里有一条小河，水很清澈。
山谷.en: There is a small river in the valley, the water is very clear.

山谷.zh: 虽然山谷里很安静，但我还是听到了鸟叫声。
山谷.en: Although the valley is very quiet, I still heard bird calls.
On both sides of the valley are high mountains.

平淡.zh: 我更喜欢平淡的日子，不太喜欢刺激。
平淡.en: I prefer plain days, I don't like excitement too much.

平淡.zh: 虽然这道菜味道平淡，但是很健康。
平淡.en: Although this dish tastes bland, it is very healthy.

平淡.zh: 这部电影剧情太平淡了，我看到一半就想走。
平淡.en: The plot of this movie was too dull, I wanted to leave halfway through.

高压.en: High voltage electricity is very dangerous.

高压.zh: 最近工作压力很大，我一直处在高压状态。
高压.en: Lately work pressure is high, I've been in a high-pressure state.

高压.zh: 因为高压锅煮饭快，所以我经常用它。
高压.en: Because the pressure cooker cooks rice quickly, I often use it.

高压.zh: 这种高压环境让人受不了。
高压政策引起了很多人的不满。
高压.en: The high-pressure policy caused many people's dissatisfaction.

管用.zh: 你试试那个药膏，听说特别管用。
管用.en: Try that ointment, I heard it's especially effective.

管用.zh: 虽然简单，但这个工具真的很管用。
管用.en: Although simple, this tool is really useful.

管用.zh: 我妈说喝姜茶对感冒管用，我就喝了一杯。
管用.en: My mom said drinking ginger tea is effective for colds, so I had a cup.

推理.zh: 我喜欢看推理小说，特别烧脑。
推理.en: I like reading mystery novels, they really make you think.

推理.zh: 他推理了半天，终于找到了答案。
推理.en: He reasoned for a long time, and finally found the answer.

推理.zh: 根据现有的证据，我们可以推理出凶手是谁。
推理.en: Based on the existing evidence, we can deduce who the murderer is.

礼仪.zh: 在公司里，你要注意基本的商务礼仪。
礼仪.en: In the company, you need to pay attention to basic business etiquette.

礼仪.zh: 因为她学过礼仪，所以行为举止很得体。
礼仪.en: Because she studied etiquette, her behavior is very proper.

礼仪.zh: 参加婚礼时，穿什么衣服也有礼仪要求。
礼仪.en: When attending a wedding, there are also etiquette requirements for what to wear.

潜水.zh: 在群里你总是潜水，也不说话。
潜水.en: In the group you always lurk and never speak.

潜水.zh: 虽然我没考到潜水证，但还是很想试试。
潜水.en: Although I haven't gotten my diving certificate, I still really want to try.
He dove to the sea floor.

潜水.zh: 潜水的时候要特别注意安全，不能一个人去。
潜水.en: When diving, you need to pay special attention to safety, you can't go alone.

多半.zh: 这个班的学生多半是女生，男生很少。
多半.en: The students in this class are mostly girls, very few boys.

多半.zh: 因为下雨，聚会多半会取消。
多半.en: Because of the rain, the party will most likely be cancelled.

多半.zh: 他说的那些话，我多半都不信。
多半.en: Most of what he said, I don't believe.

深情.zh: 这首歌表达了对恋人的深情，很感人。
深情.en: This song expresses deep feelings for a lover, very touching.

深情.zh: 在婚礼上，他深情地念了一首诗给新娘。
深情.en: At the wedding, he affectionately recited a poem to the bride.

唠叨.zh: 我妈总爱唠叨我，让我多穿衣服。
唠叨.en: My mom always nags me to wear more clothes.

唠叨.zh: 虽然我知道她是为我好，但她的唠叨让我很烦。
唠叨.en: Although I know she means well, her nagging annoys me.

唠叨.zh: 每次回家，奶奶都会唠叨半天，说各种事情。
唠叨.en: Every time I go home, grandma nags for a long time, talking about various things.

新手.zh: 虽然他以前是新手，但现在很厉害。
新手.en: Although he was a beginner before, he is very good now.

新手.zh: 公司招了很多新手来帮忙的。
新手.en: The company hired many beginners to help.

新手.zh: 作为新手，他犯了不少错误。
新手.en: As a beginner, he made many mistakes.

新手.zh: 新手学东西快，但容易忽略细节。
新手.en: Beginners learn quickly, but they easily overlook details.

简短.zh: 因为时间有限，所以发言要简短。
简短.en: Because time is limited, the speech should be brief.

简短.zh: 老师要求我们写得简短一点。
简短.en: The teacher asked us to write a bit more briefly.

简短.zh: 这篇作文虽然简短，但内容很丰富。
简短.en: Although this composition is brief, its content is rich.

简短.zh: 请用简短的语言说明一下情况。
简短.en: Please explain the situation in brief language.

风尚.zh: 这种穿搭风格很符合现代风尚。
风尚.en: This style of dressing is very much in line with modern trends.

风尚.zh: 虽然复古风尚又回来了，但我更喜欢简约。
风尚.en: Although the retro trend is back, I prefer minimalist style.

风尚.zh: 时尚界每年都会推出新的风尚来。
风尚.en: The fashion industry launches new trends every year.

风尚.zh: 这家店的装修风格引领了当地风尚。
风尚.en: The decoration style of this store leads the local trend.

转播.en: There is a live broadcast of the ball game tonight.

转播.zh: 我们通过电视转播看了开幕式。
转播.en: We watched the opening ceremony through a TV broadcast.

转播.zh: 因为网络问题，转播卡住了。
转播.en: Because of network issues, the broadcast froze.

转播.zh: 这场比赛会有现场的转播吗？
转播.en: Will there be a live broadcast of this match?

转播.zh: 广播电台转播了新闻的内容。
转播.en: The radio station relayed the news content.

积蓄.zh: 我把所有积蓄都用来买房子了。
积蓄.en: I used all my savings to buy a house.

积蓄.zh: 为了将来，年轻人应该早点开始积蓄。
积蓄.en: For the future, young people should start saving early.

积蓄.zh: 虽然他积蓄不多，但生活得很开心。
积蓄.en: Although he doesn't have much savings, he lives happily.

积蓄.zh: 这笔积蓄是他多年辛苦赚来的。
积蓄.en: This savings was earned through years of hard work.

管辖.zh: 这个城市由市政府直接管辖。
管辖.en: This city is under the direct jurisdiction of the city government.
The police's jurisdiction is very large.

管辖.zh: 因为管辖区域不同，所以不能处理。
管辖.en: Because the jurisdictions are different, it cannot be handled.

管辖.zh: 这个案件属于法院的管辖范围。
管辖.en: This case falls under the court's jurisdiction.

坟墓.en: He placed flowers in front of the grave.
We go to clean the graves during Qingming Festival.

坟墓.zh: 那座坟墓已经有百年历史了。
坟墓.en: That tomb has a history of a hundred years.

坟墓.zh: 虽然坟墓很老旧，但维护得很好。
坟墓.en: Although the tomb is very old, it is well maintained.

坟墓.zh: 墓地里的坟墓排列得很整齐。
坟墓.en: The graves in the cemetery are arranged very neatly.

衰竭.en: The doctor said his heart has failed.

衰竭.zh: 因为器官衰竭，他住进了医院。
衰竭.en: Because of organ failure, he was admitted to the hospital.

衰竭.zh: 长期疲劳会导致身体的衰竭。
衰竭.en: Long-term fatigue can lead to physical exhaustion.

衰竭.zh: 虽然他已衰竭，但依然坚持工作。
衰竭.en: Although he was exhausted, he still insisted on working.

苦恼.en: He has been very troubled lately.
He didn't do well on the exam, and he is very upset.

苦恼.zh: 因为工作压力大，他一直很苦恼。
苦恼.en: Because of work pressure, he has been very distressed.

苦恼.zh: 她为孩子教育的问题感到苦恼。
苦恼.en: She feels distressed about the issue of her child's education.

苦恼.zh: 虽然生活条件不错，但他还是有很多苦恼。
苦恼.en: Although living conditions are good, he still has many worries.

团聚.en: Spring Festival is a time for reunion.

团聚.zh: 多年没见的亲人终于团聚了。
团聚.en: The relatives who haven't seen each other for years finally reunited.

团聚.zh: 虽然大家都很忙，但过节时一定要团聚。
团聚.en: Although everyone is busy, they must gather during the holidays.

团聚.zh: 这次的团聚让我们都很开心。
团聚.en: This reunion made us all very happy.

丑陋.zh: 这个建筑物外表很丑陋。
丑陋.en: The exterior of this building is very ugly.

丑陋.zh: 虽然她外表丑陋，但内心很美。
丑陋.en: Although she looks ugly, she has a beautiful heart.

丑陋.zh: 那部电影里的怪物非常丑陋。
丑陋.en: The monster in that movie is extremely ugly.

丑陋.zh: 因为他的行为太丑陋，大家都不喜欢他。
丑陋.en: Because his behavior is too ugly, everyone dislikes him.

充当.en: This time I'll act as the driver.

充当.zh: 在游戏中，他充当了队长的角色。
充当.en: In the game, he played the role of the captain.

充当.zh: 这块木板可以充当桌子。
充当.en: This wooden board can serve as a table.

充当.zh: 为了完成任务，他自愿充当向导。
充当.en: To complete the task, he volunteered to act as a guide.

遍布.en: This place is covered with trash.
His phone is covered in scratches.

遍布.zh: 这个城市遍布咖啡馆和餐厅。
遍布.en: This city is full of cafes and restaurants.

遍布.zh: 世界各地遍布他的粉丝。
遍布.en: His fans are all over the world.

遍布.zh: 因为下雨，地面上遍布水洼。
遍布.en: Because of the rain, the ground is covered with puddles.

泥土.en: My hands are all covered in dirt.
After the rain, the soil is very wet.
The children are playing in the dirt.

泥土.zh: 花盆里的泥土需要换新的。
泥土.en: The soil in the flower pot needs to be replaced.

泥土.zh: 鞋子上沾满了泥土，我只好刷干净。
泥土.en: My shoes are covered in mud, so I have to scrub them clean.

修补.en: My grandfather can repair old furniture.
She mended the hole with a needle and thread.

修补.zh: 虽然衣服破了，但修补一下还能穿。
修补.en: Although the clothes are torn, they can still be worn after mending.

抚摸.zh: 她温柔地抚摸婴儿的脸。
抚摸.en: She gently stroked the baby's face.

抚摸.zh: 他轻轻地抚摸那只受伤的小鸟。
抚摸.en: He gently stroked the injured little bird.

颈部.en: Looking down for a long time is bad for the neck.

颈部.zh: 按摩颈部可以缓解疲劳。
颈部.en: Massaging the neck can relieve fatigue.

颈部.zh: 他扭伤了颈部，需要休息。
颈部.en: He sprained his neck and needs to rest.

光滑.zh: 这块石头摸起来很光滑。

光滑.en: The road is too slippery, easy to fall.
Her hair is black and smooth.

光滑.zh: 经过打磨，木板表面变得非常光滑。
光滑.en: After polishing, the surface of the wood became very smooth.

同伙.zh: 警察正在追捕他的同伙。
同伙.en: The police are chasing his accomplice.

同伙.zh: 他和同伙一起策划了这次抢劫。
同伙.en: He and his accomplice planned this robbery together.

同伙.zh: 那个小偷和他的同伙逃跑了。
同伙.en: That thief and his accomplice ran away.

同伙.zh: 他不想供出同伙，所以一直沉默。
同伙.en: He didn't want to reveal his accomplice, so he remained silent.

发抖.en: That puppy is trembling with fear.
The old man's hands trembled with excitement.

发抖.zh: 她站在寒风中浑身发抖。
发抖.en: She stood in the cold wind, trembling all over.

发抖.zh: 听到这个消息，他气得浑身发抖。
发抖.en: Hearing the news, he was so angry that his whole body trembled.

衷心.en: I sincerely thank you for your help.

衷心.zh: 她衷心祝福我们新婚快乐。
衷心.en: She sincerely wishes us a happy marriage.

衷心.zh: 我们衷心希望你能早日康复，回到大家身边。
衷心.en: We sincerely hope you recover soon and return to us.

衷心.zh: 尽管有分歧，我仍衷心祝愿你成功。
衷心.en: Despite differences, I still sincerely wish you success.

司令.zh: 司令下令部队立刻出发。
司令.en: The commander ordered the troops to set off immediately.

司令.zh: 那位司令在战场上非常勇敢。
司令.en: That commander was very brave on the battlefield.

司令.zh: 司令昨天召开了紧急会议，讨论下一步计划。
司令.en: The commander held an emergency meeting yesterday to discuss the next plan.

司令.zh: 大家都很尊敬这位老司令。
因为情况紧急，司令直接命令我们撤退。
司令.en: Because the situation was urgent, the commander directly ordered us to retreat.

若干.zh: 关于此事，有若干细节需要确认。
若干.en: Regarding this matter, there are several details that need to be confirmed.

若干.zh: 我们讨论了若干方案，最后选了一个。
若干.en: We discussed several options and finally chose one.

若干.zh: 若干年后，我们再次相遇。
若干.en: Several years later, we met again.

若干.zh: 由于若干原因，会议推迟了。
若干.en: Due to several reasons, the meeting was postponed.

电报.zh: 那年头，人们靠电报联系。
电报.en: In those days, people communicated by telegram.

电报.zh: 父亲发电报说后天到家，让我们去接他。
电报.en: Father sent a telegram saying he would be home the day after tomorrow, asking us to pick him up.

电报.zh: 电报在战争时期非常重要。
电报.en: Telegrams were very important during wartime.

电报.zh: 虽然现在有手机，但电报曾经是主要通讯方式。
电报.en: Although we have mobile phones now, telegrams were once the main means of communication.

揭示.zh: 他的行为揭示了内心的想法。
揭示.en: His actions revealed his inner thoughts.

揭示.zh: 调查报告揭示了公司存在的严重问题。
揭示.en: The investigation report revealed serious problems in the company.

揭示.zh: 这部电影揭示了社会黑暗的一面。
揭示.en: This movie reveals the dark side of society.

揭示.zh: 随着调查深入，更多细节被揭示出来。
揭示.en: As the investigation deepened, more details were revealed.

标语.en: There are many slogans posted on the wall.

标语.zh: 这条标语写得很有气势。
标语.en: This slogan is written with great momentum.

标语.zh: 校园里到处是鼓励学习的标语，比如“好好学习天天向上”。
标语.en: The campus is full of slogans encouraging study, like 'Study hard and make progress every day'.

标语.zh: 选举期间，候选人到处贴标语。
标语.en: During the election, candidates put up slogans everywhere.

标语.zh: 虽然标语很醒目，但人们不一定记得住内容。
标语.en: Although the slogans are eye-catching, people don't necessarily remember the content.

批判.zh: 老师没有直接批判他，而是耐心引导。
批判.en: The teacher didn't directly criticize him, but guided him patiently.

批判.zh: 这篇文章批判了社会上的不良风气。
批判.en: This article criticizes the unhealthy trends in society.

批判.zh: 在会议上，大家对他的方案进行了严厉批判。
批判.en: At the meeting, everyone severely criticized his proposal.

筑.en: The workers are building a road.

筑.zh: 小鸟在树上筑了一个巢。
筑.en: The bird built a nest in the tree.

筑.zh: 为了防洪，大家齐心协力筑堤坝。
筑.en: To prevent floods, everyone worked together to build a dam.

筑.zh: 他们用石头筑起了一道墙。
筑.en: They built a wall out of stones.

筑.zh: 燕子筑巢需要很多草和泥。
筑.en: Swallows need a lot of grass and mud to build their nests.

追赶.en: He desperately chased the car ahead.

追赶.zh: 我们要努力追赶先进水平。
追赶.en: We must strive to catch up with advanced levels.

追赶.zh: 小狗在公园里追赶蝴蝶，玩得很开心。
追赶.en: The puppy chased butterflies in the park, having a great time.

追赶.zh: 时间紧迫，我们必须加快步伐追赶进度。
追赶.en: Time is tight; we must speed up to catch up with the schedule.

追赶.zh: 虽然起步晚，但我们有信心追赶上来。
追赶.en: Although we started late, we are confident we can catch up.

阵营.en: The two camps are evenly matched.

阵营.zh: 在这次辩论中，两个阵营的观点截然不同。
阵营.en: In this debate, the views of the two camps are completely different.

阵营.zh: 选举前，各阵营都在积极拉票。
阵营.en: Before the election, each camp was actively canvassing for votes.

阵营.zh: 虽然属于不同阵营，但他们私下是朋友。
阵营.en: Although they belong to different camps, they are friends in private.

难堪.zh: 他的话让我在同学面前很难堪。
难堪.en: His words made me very embarrassed in front of classmates.

难堪.zh: 虽然我知道他是好意，但那个问题还是让我很难堪。
难堪.en: Although I know he meant well, that question still made me feel awkward.

难堪.zh: 她不小心说漏了嘴，气氛一下子变得很难堪。
难堪.en: She accidentally let something slip, and the atmosphere suddenly became very awkward.

难堪.zh: 别在公共场合让他难堪。

武力.en: They use force to solve problems.

武力.zh: 国家之间应该通过对话解决争端，而不是依靠武力。
武力.en: Countries should resolve disputes through dialogue, not rely on military force.

武力.zh: 如果谈判失败，他们可能会动用武力。
武力.en: If negotiations fail, they might resort to force.

武力.zh: 他反对任何形式的武力威胁。
武力.en: He opposes any form of threat of force.

武力.zh: 警察没有使用武力就控制了局面。
武力.en: The police controlled the situation without using force.

演说.zh: 那位政治家在广场上发表了两个小时的演说。
演说.en: That politician gave a two-hour speech in the square.

演说.zh: 虽然他准备得很充分，但演说时还是有点紧张。
演说.en: Although he prepared thoroughly, he was still a bit nervous during the speech.

演说.zh: 听众被他的演说深深打动了。
演说.en: The audience was deeply moved by his speech.

演说.zh: 她每年都会做一次毕业演说。
演说.en: She gives a graduation speech every year.

激起.zh: 那句话激起了我的兴趣。
他的行为激起了大家的愤怒和不满。
激起.en: His behavior stirred up everyone's anger and dissatisfaction.

激起.zh: 这部电影不仅激起了观众的共鸣，还引发了社会讨论。
激起.en: This movie not only aroused resonance among the audience but also sparked social discussion.

激起.zh: 这场争论激起了很多人的反对意见。
激起.en: This debate stirred up many people's opposing views.

纳税人.zh: 纳税人有权知道钱的去向。
纳税人.en: Taxpayers have the right to know where the money goes.

纳税人.zh: 政府应该用纳税人的钱做更有意义的事情。
纳税人.en: The government should use taxpayers' money for more meaningful things.

纳税人.zh: 虽然纳税人的负担不轻，但公共设施确实需要资金。
纳税人.en: Although the burden on taxpayers is not light, public facilities indeed need funding.

纳税人.zh: 每一个纳税人都应该关心国家财政。
纳税人.en: Every taxpayer should care about national finances.

纳税人.zh: 纳税人每年都要按时报税。
纳税人.en: Taxpayers must file taxes on time every year.

野心.zh: 那个商人有扩张市场的野心。
野心.en: That businessman has an ambition to expand the market.

野心.zh: 虽然他很有野心，但做事还算稳妥。
野心.en: Although he is very ambitious, he is still steady in his actions.

野心.zh: 野心有时候能推动人进步，但也会带来风险。
野心.en: Ambition can sometimes drive progress, but it also brings risks.

野心.zh: 她的野心是成为公司总裁。
野心.en: Her ambition is to become the company president.

纳税.zh: 每个人都应该依法纳税。
纳税.en: Everyone should pay taxes according to law.

纳税.zh: 这家公司每年都按时纳税，信誉很好。
纳税.en: This company pays taxes on time every year and has good reputation.

纳税.zh: 如果你不纳税，可能会面临罚款甚至法律制裁。
纳税.en: If you don't pay taxes, you may face fines or even legal sanctions.

纳税.zh: 纳税是每个公民应尽的义务。
纳税.en: Paying taxes is an obligation of every citizen.

纳税.zh: 他最近在忙着处理纳税申报的事。
纳税.en: He's been busy dealing with tax filing recently.

炼.en: This piece of iron needs to be refined again.

炼.zh: 他在高温下炼钢，工作环境很艰苦。
炼.en: He refines steel under high temperature; the working environment is tough.

炼.zh: 不仅身体要炼，意志也要炼。
炼.en: Not only the body needs to be tempered, but also the will.

炼.zh: 这些油是经过多次提炼的。
炼.en: This oil has been refined many times.

炼.zh: 他用了十年时间炼成了一手好字。
炼.en: He spent ten years honing his calligraphy skills.

关照.en: Please take good care of my younger brother.

关照.zh: 第一次来这个城市，希望各位多多关照。
关照.en: It's my first time in this city; I hope everyone will look after me.

关照.zh: 如果你先办完了，记得关照我一声。
关照.en: If you finish first, remember to give me a heads-up.
Thank you for taking care of me.

关照.zh: 在项目上，他关照了新人很多。
关照.en: He looked after the newcomers a lot on the project.

变更.en: Is there any change in the plan?

变更.zh: 公司决定变更产品的设计方案。
变更.en: The company decided to change the product's design plan.

变更.zh: 因为天气原因，航班时间发生了变更。
变更.en: Due to weather, the flight schedule has changed.

变更.zh: 我们需要提前通知客户关于价格的变更。
变更.en: We need to inform customers in advance about the price change.

变更.zh: 地址变更后要记得更新注册信息。
变更.en: After changing the address, remember to update the registration information.

配置.zh: 新车的配置包括导航和天窗。
配置.en: The new car's features include navigation and a sunroof.

配置.zh: 公司正在配置新的服务器来提升效率。
配置.en: The company is deploying new servers to improve efficiency.

配置.zh: 虽然房间小，但家具配置得很合理。
配置.en: Although the room is small, the furniture is arranged very reasonably.

配置.zh: 游戏对电脑配置要求太高了，我的笔记本跑不动。
配置.en: The game has too high requirements for computer specs, my laptop can't run it.

天鹅.en: There are a few swans swimming on the lake.

天鹅.zh: 她喜欢看天鹅优雅地游泳。
天鹅.en: She likes watching swans swim gracefully.

天鹅.zh: 白天鹅和黑天鹅都是保护动物。
天鹅.en: Both white swans and black swans are protected animals.

天鹅.zh: 公园里那只天鹅受伤了，工作人员正在照顾它。
天鹅.en: That swan in the park was injured, and the staff are taking care of it.

天鹅.zh: 芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》非常经典，我看了好几次。
天鹅.en: The ballet show 'Swan Lake' is very classic, I have watched it several times.

断裂.zh: 地震导致水管断裂，路面全是水。
断裂.en: The earthquake caused water pipes to burst, and the road was full of water.

断裂.zh: 别用力拉，不然链条会断裂的。
断裂.en: Don't pull too hard, or the chain will break.

断裂.zh: 这个老化的桥梁出现了断裂的迹象，需要立即维修。
断裂.en: This aging bridge shows signs of cracking and needs immediate repair.

断裂.zh: 他因为长期劳累，跟腱突然断裂了，现在正在康复中。
断裂.en: Due to long-term fatigue, his Achilles tendon suddenly ruptured, and he is now recovering.

止血.en: Quickly use the gauze to stop the bleeding!

止血.zh: 伤口不深，按一会儿就能止血。
止血.en: The wound is not deep; pressing for a while will stop the bleeding.

止血.zh: 如果流血不止，止血带可以暂时止血。
止血.en: If the bleeding won't stop, a tourniquet can temporarily stop the bleeding.

止血.zh: 他划伤了手指，我赶紧找创可贴帮他止血。
止血.en: He cut his finger, and I quickly found a band-aid to help him stop the bleeding.

油漆.zh: 这扇门需要重新刷油漆。
油漆.en: This door needs to be repainted.

油漆.zh: 油漆味太冲了，先别进去。
油漆.en: The paint smell is too strong, don't go in yet.

油漆.zh: 他们买了环保油漆来装修儿童房。
油漆.en: They bought eco-friendly paint to renovate the children's room.

油漆.zh: 我不小心把油漆弄到衣服上了，很难洗掉。
油漆.en: I accidentally got paint on my clothes, and it's hard to wash off.

油漆.zh: 工人正在给外墙喷油漆，估计后天就能完工。
油漆.en: The workers are spray-painting the exterior wall, and it should be finished the day after tomorrow.

古董.zh: 他爷爷收藏了很多古董。
古董.en: His grandfather collects a lot of antiques.

古董.zh: 这个花瓶是明朝的古董，很值钱。
古董.en: This vase is a Ming Dynasty antique, very valuable.

古董.zh: 古董市场里真假混卖，不懂行的人很容易被骗。
古董.en: In the antique market, genuine and fake items are mixed, so people who don't know the trade can easily be cheated.

古董.zh: 我虽然不懂古董，但觉得这个盘子挺好看的。
古董.en: Although I don't know about antiques, I think this plate is quite beautiful.

古董.zh: 他把家里的一件古董捐给了博物馆。
古董.en: He donated an antique from his home to the museum.

金字塔.zh: 埃及金字塔是世界奇迹。
金字塔.en: The Egyptian pyramids are a world wonder.

金字塔.zh: 他们去埃及参观了最大的金字塔。
金字塔.en: They went to Egypt to visit the largest pyramid.

金字塔.zh: 关于金字塔是怎么建的，一直有很多猜测。
金字塔.en: There have always been many speculations about how the pyramids were built.

金字塔.zh: 虽然没亲眼见过，但我对金字塔的历史很感兴趣。
金字塔.en: Although I haven't seen it with my own eyes, I am very interested in the history of the pyramids.

金字塔.zh: 导游告诉我们金字塔里面有复杂的通道和墓室。
金字塔.en: The tour guide told us that there are complex passages and burial chambers inside the pyramid.

反弹.zh: 球撞到墙后反弹回来了。
反弹.en: The ball hit the wall and bounced back.
There has been a rebound in prices.

反弹.zh: 股市反弹了，今天涨了不少。
反弹.en: The stock market rebounded, rising a lot today.

反弹.zh: 减肥后不注意饮食，体重很容易反弹。
反弹.en: After losing weight, if you don't pay attention to your diet, your weight can easily bounce back.

反弹.zh: 他用力把球拍向地面，球高高反弹起来。
反弹.en: He hit the ball hard against the ground, and it bounced up high.

懂事.zh: 她虽然年纪小，但很懂事。
懂事.en: Although she is young, she is very mature.

懂事.zh: 你该懂事了，别再让父母操心了。
懂事.en: You should be more sensible and stop worrying your parents.

懂事.zh: 他们家老大特别懂事，总会帮忙照顾弟弟妹妹。
懂事.en: The eldest child in their family is especially sensible and always helps take care of the younger siblings.

懂事.zh: 以前我不懂事，总跟妈妈顶嘴，现在想想很后悔。
懂事.en: I used to be immature and always talked back to my mom; now when I think about it, I regret it.

奋力.en: He ran forward with all his might.

奋力.zh: 消防员奋力救出了被困的人。
奋力.en: The firefighters made a great effort to rescue the trapped people.

奋力.zh: 比赛最后几秒，他奋力投篮，球进了！
奋力.en: In the last few seconds of the game, he shot with all his strength, and the ball went in!

奋力.zh: 尽管很累，他还是奋力爬上了山顶。
奋力.en: Although very tired, he still struggled to climb to the top of the mountain.

奋力.zh: 她奋力推开那扇沉重的门，终于进到了房间里。
奋力.en: She pushed open that heavy door with great effort, and finally got into the room.

追随.en: I decided to follow in his footsteps.

追随.zh: 很多人选择追随那位著名的科学家。
追随.en: Many people choose to follow that famous scientist.
She will always pursue her dreams.

追随.zh: 虽然困难很多，但我还是选择追随内心。
追随.en: Although there are many difficulties, I still choose to follow my heart.

追随.zh: 自从她追随那位老师以后，进步很快。
追随.en: Since she followed that teacher, she has improved quickly.

代号.zh: 这次任务我们每个人都用了一个代号。
代号.en: For this mission, each of us used a code name.
Do you know his code name?

代号.zh: 因为这是机密，所以大家都用代号交流。
代号.en: Because this is confidential, everyone communicates using code names.

代号.zh: 行动开始前，请记住你的代号。
代号.en: Before the operation starts, please remember your code name.

调解.zh: 邻居吵架后，居委会来调解。
调解.en: After the neighbors quarreled, the neighborhood committee came to mediate.

调解.zh: 虽然双方都不让步，但还是需要有人调解。
调解.en: Although both sides are not giving in, someone still needs to mediate.

调解.zh: 我建议找第三方来调解这个问题。
调解.en: I suggest finding a third party to mediate this issue.

绯闻.zh: 那个明星的绯闻传得沸沸扬扬。
绯闻.en: That star's scandal is spreading like wildfire.
She doesn't want to get involved in scandals.

绯闻.zh: 虽然公司否认了，但绯闻还是影响了他的形象。
绯闻.en: Although the company denied it, the scandal still affected his image.

绯闻.zh: 媒体经常报道明星的绯闻。
绯闻.en: The media often reports on celebrities' scandals.

可耻.en: This kind of behavior is too shameful.

可耻.zh: 你居然做出这种事，真可耻！
可耻.en: You actually did such a thing, truly shameful!

可耻.zh: 如果作弊被发现，那会非常可耻。
可耻.en: If cheating is discovered, it will be very shameful.

可耻.zh: 利用别人的信任是可耻的行为。
可耻.en: Taking advantage of others' trust is a shameful act.

微妙.en: The atmosphere is a bit subtle.

微妙.zh: 他们之间的关系很微妙。
微妙.en: The relationship between them is very subtle.
There is a subtle meaning in these words.

微妙.zh: 虽然他说得轻描淡写，但我觉得事情很微妙。
微妙.en: Although he spoke lightly, I think the matter is very subtle.

微妙.zh: 这个问题的答案非常微妙，需要仔细思考。
微妙.en: The answer to this question is very subtle and requires careful thought.

幸亏.zh: 幸亏带了伞，不然就淋湿了。
幸亏.en: Fortunately I brought an umbrella, otherwise I would have gotten wet.

幸亏.zh: 幸亏我提前准备了，所以考试很顺利。
幸亏.en: Fortunately I prepared in advance, so the exam went smoothly.

幸亏.zh: 幸亏警察及时赶到，才没有出大事。
幸亏.en: Fortunately the police arrived in time, so nothing serious happened.

反省.zh: 犯错了就要反省自己的行为。
反省.en: If you make a mistake, you should reflect on your own behavior.
He is in the process of self-reflection.

反省.zh: 经过这次失败，他深刻反省了自己的问题。
反省.en: After this failure, he deeply reflected on his own problems.

反省.zh: 我建议你冷静下来好好反省一下。
反省.en: I suggest you calm down and reflect carefully.

皇上.zh: 皇上命令我们立刻出发。
皇上.en: The emperor ordered us to depart immediately.

皇上.zh: 因为皇上病了，所以朝会取消了。
皇上.en: Because the emperor is ill, the court meeting is cancelled.

皇上.zh: 皇上很喜欢这个大臣提的建议。
皇上.en: The emperor really likes the suggestion made by this minister.

本色.zh: 在困难面前才能看出一个人的本色。
本色.en: In the face of difficulties, you can see a person's true colors.
He maintained the true character of a soldier.

本色.zh: 虽然环境变了，但他依然保持自己的本色。
本色.en: Although the environment has changed, he still maintains his true nature.

本色.zh: 这部电影展现了导演的本色。
本色.en: This film shows the director's true style.

鉴别.zh: 你能帮我鉴别一下这个包是真的吗？
鉴别.en: Can you help me authenticate if this bag is real?

鉴别.zh: 专家通过气味就能鉴别茶叶的好坏。
鉴别.en: Experts can distinguish tea quality by smell alone.

鉴别.zh: 我买古董的时候，总是找老师傅帮忙鉴别。
鉴别.en: When I buy antiques, I always ask an old master to help identify them.

鉴别.zh: 鉴别真伪需要专业的知识和经验。
鉴别.en: Identifying authenticity requires professional knowledge and experience.

鉴别.zh: 这款软件可以用指纹来鉴别用户身份。
鉴别.en: This software can identify users by fingerprint.

意想不到.zh: 今天收到了一个意想不到的礼物。
意想不到.en: I received an unexpected gift today.

意想不到.zh: 他的突然辞职让我们大家都意想不到。
意想不到.en: His sudden resignation took all of us by surprise.

意想不到.zh: 这次旅行中发生了很多意想不到的事。
意想不到.en: Many unexpected things happened during this trip.

意想不到.zh: 这个结果真是意想不到，我本来以为会输的。
意想不到.en: This result is truly unexpected; I thought we would lose.

意想不到.zh: 意想不到的情况打乱了我们的计划。
意想不到.en: An unexpected situation disrupted our plans.

背面.en: The date is written on the back of the photo.

背面.zh: 请把合同翻到背面看看条款。
背面.en: Please turn the contract over and look at the terms on the back.

背面.zh: 硬币的背面刻着一朵花。
背面.en: A flower is engraved on the back of the coin.

背面.zh: 他悄悄在纸条背面写了句话。
背面.en: He quietly wrote a sentence on the back of the note.

背面.zh: 这张卡的背面有签名条，别忘了签。
背面.en: There's a signature strip on the back of this card, don't forget to sign it.

恰恰相反.zh: 你猜错了，实际情况恰恰相反。
恰恰相反.en: You guessed wrong; the actual situation is exactly the opposite.

恰恰相反.zh: 大家都以为他会生气，但他恰恰相反。
恰恰相反.en: Everyone thought he would be angry, but he was exactly the opposite.

恰恰相反.zh: 很多人觉得减肥容易，恰恰相反，非常难。
恰恰相反.en: Many people think losing weight is easy; on the contrary, it's very hard.

恰恰相反.zh: 我原以为南方冬天暖和，结果恰恰相反。
恰恰相反.en: I originally thought winters in the south were warm, but it turned out exactly the opposite.

恰恰相反.zh: 他的回答不是肯定，而是恰恰相反。
恰恰相反.en: His answer was not affirmative, but exactly the opposite.

直径.zh: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。
直径.en: The diameter of this circle is ten centimeters.

直径.zh: 测量一下树干的直径吧。
直径.en: Measure the diameter of the tree trunk.

直径.zh: 管道直径太小，水流不顺畅。
直径.en: The pipe diameter is too small, the water flow is not smooth.

直径.zh: 太阳的直径大约是地球的109倍。
直径.en: The sun's diameter is about 109 times that of Earth.

直径.zh: 这个蛋糕的直径有三十厘米，够十个人吃。
直径.en: This cake has a diameter of thirty centimeters, enough for ten people.

过往.zh: 别总想着过往，要向前看。
过往.en: Don't always dwell on the past; look forward.

过往.zh: 过往的教训让我学会了谨慎。
过往.en: Past lessons have taught me to be cautious.

过往.zh: 他经常回忆过往的美好时光。
过往.en: He often recalls the good times of the past.

过往.zh: 对于过往的错误，我已经不再后悔。
过往.en: I no longer regret past mistakes.

过往.zh: 这家餐厅的生意不如过往那么好了。
过往.en: This restaurant's business is not as good as before.

换取.en: He exchanges his labor for money.

换取.zh: 我拿旧手机换取了二百块钱。
换取.en: I exchanged my old phone for two hundred yuan.

换取.zh: 为了换取自由，他付出了巨大代价。
换取.en: He paid a huge price to gain freedom.

换取.zh: 你可以用积分换取礼物。
换取.en: You can exchange points for gifts.

换取.zh: 她用耐心和爱心换取了孩子们的信任。
换取.en: She earned the children's trust with patience and love.

忽悠.zh: 你别忽悠我，我了解情况。
忽悠.en: Don't fool me, I know the situation.

忽悠.zh: 那个销售员又在忽悠客户了。
忽悠.en: That salesperson is fooling customers again.

忽悠.zh: 他忽悠我说那个产品很便宜，结果很贵。
忽悠.en: He fooled me saying that product was cheap, but it turned out expensive.

忽悠.zh: 别信他的，他就是在忽悠你。
忽悠.en: Don't believe him; he's just fooling you.

忽悠.zh: 我被忽悠买了一堆没用的东西。
忽悠.en: I was tricked into buying a bunch of useless stuff.

心血.zh: 这个作品凝聚了很多心血。
心血.en: This work embodies a lot of painstaking effort.

心血.zh: 他花了三年心血写了这本书。
心血.en: He spent three years of hard work writing this book.
Our parents' efforts must not be wasted.

心血.zh: 这些成果是他多年心血换来的。
心血.en: These achievements were won through years of his hard work.

心血.zh: 我们不能辜负老师的一片心血。
心血.en: We must not let down the teacher's painstaking efforts.

忧虑.en: His health makes me very worried.

忧虑.zh: 对于未来的工作，我有些忧虑。
忧虑.en: I have some worries about my future job.

忧虑.zh: 她总是为小事感到忧虑。
忧虑.en: She always worries about small things.

忧虑.zh: 经济形势不好，很多人充满忧虑。
忧虑.en: The economic situation is bad, and many people are full of worry.

忧虑.zh: 虽然问题很多，但不必过度忧虑。
忧虑.en: Although there are many problems, there's no need to worry excessively.

显而易见.zh: 这个问题答案显而易见，不用多说。
显而易见.en: The answer to this question is obvious, no need to say more.

显而易见.zh: 她最近心情不好，显而易见是因为工作压力太大。
显而易见.en: She's been in a bad mood lately, obviously because of too much work pressure.

显而易见.zh: 虽然他没明说，但显而易见他不想去那家餐厅。
显而易见.en: Although he didn't say it outright, it's obvious he doesn't want to go to that restaurant.

显而易见.zh: 这种做法的风险显而易见，所以我们最好换个方案。
显而易见.en: The risk of this approach is obvious, so we'd better change the plan.

防卫.en: Self-defense does not constitute a crime.

防卫.zh: 遇到危险时，要学会用正确的方式防卫自己。
防卫.en: When in danger, learn to defend yourself in the right way.

防卫.zh: 这个国家的军队加强了边境防卫。
防卫.en: The country's military has strengthened border defense.

防卫.zh: 虽然是防卫，但他下手太重了，还是要负责。
防卫.en: Although it was defense, he struck too hard and still has to take responsibility.

养老金.en: He receives a pension every month.

养老金.zh: 养老金不够用，他又找了份兼职。
养老金.en: The pension isn't enough, so he found a part-time job.

养老金.zh: 很多人担心以后拿不到养老金。
养老金.en: Many people worry that they won't get a pension in the future.

养老金.zh: 政府计划提高养老金的发放标准。
养老金.en: The government plans to raise the pension payment standard.

养老金.zh: 她退休后靠养老金生活，日子过得很节俭。
养老金.en: After retirement, she lives on her pension and lives very frugally.

预先.en: We booked the hotel in advance.

预先.zh: 如果预先知道会下雨，我就带伞了。
预先.en: If I had known it would rain, I would have brought an umbrella.

预先.zh: 做任何事之前，预先做好准备总没错。
预先.en: Before doing anything, it's never wrong to prepare in advance.

预先.zh: 他预先通知了所有人，所以大家都没迟到。
预先.en: He notified everyone in advance, so no one was late.

人气.zh: 这家咖啡馆突然人气下降，因为换了老板。
人气.en: This café's popularity suddenly dropped because the owner changed.

人气.zh: 为了提升人气，他们请了明星来宣传。
人气.en: To boost popularity, they invited a celebrity to promote.

人气.zh: 虽然菜一般，但服务好，所以人气一直不错。
人气.en: Although the food is average, the service is good, so it remains popular.

墓地.zh: 每到清明，墓地附近都很拥挤。
墓地.en: Every Qingming Festival, the area around the cemetery is very crowded.

墓地.zh: 他们把老人葬在山上那块墓地。
墓地.en: They buried the old man in that cemetery on the hill.

墓地.zh: 这里原来是农田，后来改成了公共墓地。
墓地.en: This place was originally farmland, later converted into a public cemetery.

遗失.zh: 这份文件很重要，不能遗失。
遗失.en: This document is very important; it cannot be lost.

遗失.zh: 他在旅途中遗失了护照，只好去大使馆。
遗失.en: He lost his passport during the trip and had to go to the embassy.

遗失.zh: 如果你遗失了银行卡，要立刻挂失。
遗失.en: If you lose your bank card, report the loss immediately.

遗失.zh: 老人遗失了钱包，幸好有人捡到送回了。
遗失.en: The old man lost his wallet, but luckily someone found it and returned it.

公式.en: He memorized the math formula wrong.

公式.zh: 老师要求我们熟练掌握这个公式。
公式.en: The teacher asked us to master this formula.

公式.zh: 成功没有固定公式，但努力是必须的。
公式.en: There is no fixed formula for success, but hard work is necessary.

公式.zh: 这道题用那个公式十分钟就能解出来。
公式.en: This problem can be solved in ten minutes using that formula.

看样子.en: It looks like it's going to rain.

看样子.zh: 看样子你很有经验，不如你带队吧。
看样子.en: It seems you have a lot of experience; why don't you lead the team?

看样子.zh: 她已经三天没来上班了，看样子是辞职了。
看样子.en: She hasn't come to work for three days; it looks like she quit.

看样子.zh: 虽然他说没事，但看样子他还是很在意。
看样子.en: Although he said it's fine, it looks like he still cares.

侵害.zh: 我们要防止害虫侵害庄稼。
侵害.en: We need to prevent pests from damaging crops.

侵害.zh: 任何侵害他人隐私的行为都是违法的。
侵害.en: Any act of infringing on others' privacy is illegal.

侵害.zh: 公司被起诉侵害了员工的合法权益。
侵害.en: The company was sued for infringing on employees' legal rights.

侵害.zh: 如果受到侵害，一定要保留证据并报警。
侵害.en: If you are violated, be sure to keep evidence and call the police.

表白.zh: 他在毕业典礼上鼓起勇气表白。
表白.en: He gathered courage to confess at the graduation ceremony.

表白.zh: 虽然很紧张，但他还是表白了。
表白.en: Although very nervous, he still confessed.
She decided to confess on WeChat.
This confession moved me a lot.

患有.zh: 她患有严重的失眠症，每晚都睡不好。
患有.en: She suffers from severe insomnia and can't sleep well every night.

患有.zh: 因为患有高血压，他不敢吃太咸。
患有.en: Because he has high blood pressure, he dares not eat too salty.
This cat has a skin disease.

患有.zh: 很多人患有近视却不戴眼镜。
患有.en: Many people have myopia but don't wear glasses.

带头.en: The manager leads by working overtime.

带头.zh: 他总是带头参加环保活动。
带头.en: He always takes the lead in environmental activities.

带头.zh: 如果没人带头，大家都不敢行动。
带头.en: If no one takes the lead, everyone dares not act.

带头.zh: 班长带头捐款帮助同学。
带头.en: The class monitor led the donation to help classmates.

带头.zh: 这次改革需要有人带头。
带头.en: This reform needs someone to lead.

四肢.zh: 冬天我的四肢总是冰凉。
四肢.en: In winter, my limbs are always cold.

四肢.zh: 他摔了一跤，四肢都受伤了。
四肢.en: He fell and hurt all four limbs.

四肢.zh: 四肢无力可能是生病了。
四肢.en: Weak limbs might mean being sick.

四肢.zh: 做瑜伽能锻炼四肢协调。
四肢.en: Doing yoga can train limb coordination.

酥.en: Her fried chicken is crispy outside and tender inside.
Not only crisp, but also very fragrant.

酥.zh: 听到他的话，我骨头都酥了。
酥.en: Hearing his words, my bones tingled.
