不用说.en: Needless to say, you know it.

不用说.zh: 他那么努力，不用说肯定能考上。
不用说.en: He works so hard; needless to say, he will pass the exam.

不用说.zh: 不用说，她一定会来帮忙的。
不用说.en: Needless to say, she will definitely come to help.

不用说.zh: 这家店的东西质量好，不用说价格也很合理。
不用说.en: The quality of this store's goods is good, and needless to say, the price is also reasonable.
Needless to say, this trip was great.

烹饪.zh: 他报名了一个烹饪课程提高厨艺。
烹饪.en: He signed up for a cooking class to improve his skills.

烹饪.zh: 虽然烹饪很麻烦，但很有乐趣。
烹饪.en: Although cooking is troublesome, it's fun.

烹饪.zh: 现代烹饪工具让做饭更方便。
烹饪.en: Modern cooking tools make cooking more convenient.

接通.zh: 我试了好几次才接通客服。
接通.en: I tried several times before connecting to customer service.

接通.zh: 虽然信号不好，但最后还是接通了。
接通.en: Although the signal was bad, it got connected finally.
Please put me through to the general manager.

接通.zh: 接通电源后，机器开始运转。
接通.en: After connecting the power, the machine started running.

陶瓷.en: This ceramic cup is very expensive.

陶瓷.zh: 景德镇的陶瓷闻名世界。
陶瓷不仅坚硬，而且耐高温。
陶瓷.en: Ceramics are not only hard but also heat-resistant.

陶瓷.zh: 她收藏了很多陶瓷艺术品。
陶瓷碗容易碎，要小心拿。
陶瓷.en: Ceramic bowls break easily; handle with care.

监察.en: The discipline inspection commission is responsible for supervision.

监察.zh: 公司设有监察部门防止腐败。
监察.en: The company has a supervision department to prevent corruption.

监察.zh: 因为缺乏监察，项目出现了问题。
监察.en: Due to lack of supervision, the project had problems.

监察.zh: 监察人员定期检查设备安全。

讨好.en: He always likes to curry favor with the boss.

讨好.zh: 她为了升职，一直在讨好领导。
讨好.en: She has been ingratiating herself with the leaders in order to get promoted.

讨好.zh: 他虽然不喜欢讨好别人，但为了合作也只能这样。
讨好.en: Although he doesn't like to flatter others, he has to do so for cooperation.

讨好.zh: 你别再讨好他了，没用的。
讨好.en: Stop trying to please him, it's useless.

讨好.zh: 我觉得讨好别人不如做好自己。
讨好.en: I think it's better to be yourself than to curry favor with others.

发火.zh: 他因为一点小事就发火，真让人受不了。
发火.en: He gets angry over small things, it's really unbearable.

发火.zh: 我先跟他道歉，他就不再发火了。
发火.en: I apologized to him first, and then he stopped being angry.

发火.zh: 老板今天又发火了，大家都很紧张。
发火.en: The boss lost his temper again today, everyone is nervous.

发火.zh: 你发火也没用，事情已经发生了。
发火.en: Getting angry is useless; it's already happened.

丰满.zh: 这个季节的水果特别丰满多汁。
丰满.en: Fruits this season are especially plump and juicy.

丰满.zh: 虽然她个子不高，但体型很丰满。
丰满.en: Although she is not tall, her body is well-rounded.

丰满.zh: 画中的人物画得十分丰满。
丰满.en: The figures in the painting are drawn very plumply.

丰满.zh: 她的脸蛋圆圆的，看起来很丰满。
丰满.en: Her face is round, looking very full.

任职.zh: 她在银行任职已经五年了。
任职.en: She has been working at the bank for five years.

任职.zh: 他毕业后就去国外任职，很少回来。
任职.en: After graduation, he went to work abroad and rarely returns.
May I ask where you work?

任职.zh: 她任职期间工作非常努力。
任职.en: She worked very hard during her tenure.

创始人.en: He is the founder of the company.

创始人.zh: 这位创始人白手起家，非常不容易。
创始人.en: This founder started from scratch, it was very tough.

创始人.zh: 虽然创始人已经退休了，但大家还是很尊敬他。
创始人.en: Although the founder has retired, everyone still respects him.

创始人.zh: 苹果公司的创始人很有名。
创始人.en: The founder of Apple is very famous.

创始人.zh: 我们的创始人经常来公司开会。
创始人.en: Our founder often comes to the company for meetings.

任性.zh: 他因为任性，错过了很多好机会。
任性.en: Because of his capriciousness, he missed many good opportunities.

任性.zh: 虽然她有点任性，但心地很善良。
任性.en: Although she is a bit willful, she has a kind heart.

任性.zh: 小孩子任性的时候很难管。
任性.en: Children are hard to manage when they are being willful.

任性.zh: 你不能再这么任性下去了。
任性.en: You can't go on being this willful.

提早.zh: 今天会议提早了半小时开始。
提早.en: Today's meeting started half an hour early.

提早.zh: 因为要下雨，我们提早结束了活动。
提早.en: Because it was going to rain, we ended the activity early.

提早.zh: 他每天提早到公司上班。
提早.en: He arrives at the office early every day.

玄.zh: 他说的那些道理太玄了，我听不懂。
玄.en: The principles he talks about are too profound, I can't understand them.

玄.zh: 虽然听起来很玄，但其实是科学。
玄.en: Although it sounds mysterious, it's actually science.
Don't always say such cryptic things.

玄.zh: 这个魔术表演很玄，大家都看呆了。
玄.en: This magic show was amazing, everyone was stunned.

帮手.zh: 他找了几个帮手一起搬家。
帮手.en: He found a few helpers to move house together.

帮手.zh: 因为人手不够，我又叫了两个帮手。
帮手.en: Because we were short-handed, I called two more helpers.

帮手.zh: 这个任务需要两个帮手才能完成。
帮手.en: This task requires two helpers to complete.

仿.zh: 他买了一个仿的名牌包，很便宜。
仿.en: He bought a fake designer bag, very cheap.

仿.zh: 虽然说是仿的，但质量还不错。
仿.en: Although it's said to be a copy, the quality is not bad.
This kind of fake shoes won't last long.

仿.zh: 你别贪便宜买仿的东西。
仿.en: Don't be cheap and buy counterfeit items.

以致.zh: 他连续熬夜，以致病倒了。
以致.en: He stayed up late for several days, leading to him falling ill.

以致.zh: 她没听劝告，以致错过了机会。
以致.en: She didn't listen to advice, thus missing the opportunity.

以致.zh: 工作太忙，以致我没时间陪家人。
以致.en: Work was too busy, so I had no time to spend with family.

以致.zh: 司机疲劳驾驶，以致发生了严重事故。
以致.en: The driver was fatigued and caused a serious accident.

以致.zh: 他投资失败，以致欠了一大笔债。
以致.en: His investment failed, resulting in a large debt.

化身.en: He is practically the embodiment of justice.

化身.zh: 这个角色是善良的化身。
化身.en: This character is the incarnation of kindness.

化身.zh: 她在这个故事里化身成一只蝴蝶。
化身.en: In this story, she transforms into a butterfly.

化身.zh: 佛祖化身成普通人来帮助百姓。
化身.en: The Buddha incarnated as an ordinary person to help the people.

化身.zh: 在游戏里，你可以化身任何角色。
化身.en: In the game, you can incarnate as any character.

蒸发.en: The water evaporated under the sun.

蒸发.zh: 他的钱像水一样蒸发了。
高温让地面的水分很快蒸发掉。
蒸发.en: The high temperature caused the ground moisture to evaporate quickly.

蒸发.zh: 那个计划不知怎么就蒸发了。
蒸发.en: That plan somehow evaporated into thin air.

蒸发.zh: 酒精在室温下会慢慢蒸发。
蒸发.en: Alcohol will slowly evaporate at room temperature.

编排.en: This dance is choreographed really well.

编排.zh: 她负责晚会的节目编排。
编排.en: She is in charge of the program arrangement for the party.

编排.zh: 老师精心编排了明天的课程。
编排.en: The teacher carefully arranged tomorrow's lesson plan.

编排.zh: 他们编排了一个搞笑的小品。
编排.en: They put together a funny skit.

编排.zh: 导演在编排动作时花了很多心思。
编排.en: The director put a lot of thought into choreographing the moves.

实地.en: Let's go do a field inspection.

实地.zh: 科学家实地测量了冰川的厚度。
实地.en: Scientists measured the glacier's thickness on site.

实地.zh: 这个项目需要实地调研才能决定。
实地.en: This project requires field research to decide.

实地.zh: 公司派她实地了解客户需求。
实地.en: The company sent her to understand customer needs on the ground.

立体.zh: 这个画看起来是立体的。
电影用3D技术做出立体效果。
立体.en: The movie uses 3D technology to create a stereoscopic effect.

立体.zh: 我们需要一个立体的解决方案。
他塑造的角色很立体，不单一。
立体.en: The character he created is multi-layered, not one-dimensional.

立体.zh: 公园里有立体的绿化景观。
立体.en: There is a three-dimensional greening landscape in the park.

精明.en: She is very shrewd in business.
That old man is really clever.

精明.zh: 精明的人不会犯这种错误。
精明.en: A shrewd person wouldn't make this kind of mistake.

精明.zh: 他虽然年轻，但做事很精明。
精明.en: Although he's young, he is very astute in his work.
Don't underestimate him, he's very sharp.

滑稽.zh: 小丑表演了一段滑稽节目。
滑稽.en: The clown performed a funny act.

滑稽.zh: 他说话的语气特别滑稽。
滑稽.en: His tone of voice is especially amusing.

滑稽.zh: 这个笑话太滑稽了，笑了半天。
滑稽.en: This joke is so hilarious, I laughed for a long time.

滑稽.zh: 剧情虽然滑稽，但背后有深意。
滑稽.en: The plot is comical, but there is deeper meaning behind it.

高涨.en: Oil prices have started to surge again recently.

高涨.zh: 比赛结束后，欢呼声高涨。
高涨.en: After the game ended, cheers rose high.

高涨.zh: 物价高涨让老百姓生活压力变大。
高涨.en: Rising prices are putting more pressure on ordinary people's lives.

高涨.zh: 随着节日临近，消费热情高涨。
高涨.en: As the holiday approaches, consumer enthusiasm is soaring.

善意.en: He helped me out of goodwill.
Her words are full of kindness.

善意.zh: 我们应当用善意对待每个人。
善意.en: We should treat everyone with goodwill.

善意.zh: 虽然批评激烈，但出发点全是善意。
善意.en: Although the criticism was harsh, the intention was entirely well-meaning.

宗旨.zh: 我们的宗旨是服务客户。
宗旨.en: Our tenet is to serve customers.

宗旨.zh: 这个公司的宗旨一直没变。
宗旨.en: This company's mission has never changed.

宗旨.zh: 虽然业务扩展了，但我们的宗旨仍然以质量为本。
宗旨.en: Although the business has expanded, our principle still prioritizes quality.

宗旨.zh: 他们成立的宗旨是帮助贫困儿童。
宗旨.en: The purpose of their establishment is to help poor children.

宗旨.zh: 如果大家都能遵守这个宗旨，工作会顺利很多。
宗旨.en: If everyone can follow this principle, work will go much smoother.

上游.zh: 这条河的上游水质很好。
上游.en: The water quality in the upper reaches of this river is very good.

上游.zh: 我们要努力爬到行业上游。
上游.en: We must strive to reach the upper echelons of the industry.

上游.zh: 住在上游的居民要注意保护水源。
上游.en: Residents living upstream should pay attention to protecting the water source.

上游.zh: 他在公司里一直处于上游水平，很少落后。
上游.en: He has always been at an upper level in the company, rarely falling behind.

上游.zh: 由于上游工厂排污，下游的鱼都死了很多。
上游.en: Because the upstream factories discharged pollutants, many fish downstream died.

上任.en: He just took office as the manager yesterday.

上任.zh: 新领导上任后改了规矩。
上任.en: The new leader changed the rules after taking office.

上任.zh: 这位校长上任才三个月，学校就有很大变化。
上任.en: This principal has only been in office for three months, but the school has changed a lot.

上任.zh: 听说新局长下周一上任，大家都挺期待。
上任.en: I heard the new director will take office next Monday, and everyone is quite looking forward to it.

上任.zh: 她上任之前做了很多准备工作。
上任.en: She did a lot of preparation work before taking office.

探望.zh: 明天我去医院探望朋友。
探望.en: Tomorrow I will go to the hospital to visit a friend.

探望.zh: 她每周都去探望独居的父母。
探望.en: She visits her elderly parents living alone every week.

探望.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是抽空探望了老师。
探望.en: Although he was busy with work, he still took time to visit his teacher.

探望.zh: 过年时我们回老家探望亲戚。
探望.en: During the Chinese New Year, we go back to our hometown to visit relatives.

探望.zh: 这孩子很久没探望奶奶了，奶奶很想他。
探望.en: This child hasn't visited his grandma for a long time, and she misses him very much.

举止.zh: 公共场合要注意举止文明。
举止.en: In public places, one should pay attention to civilized behavior.

举止.zh: 她今天的举止有点奇怪，不知道怎么了。
举止.en: Her behavior today is a bit strange; I wonder what's wrong.

举止.zh: 面试时你的举止会给考官留下印象。
举止.en: Your demeanor during the interview will leave an impression on the examiner.

举止.zh: 虽然他很生气，但举止依然保持礼貌。
举止.en: Although he was very angry, he still maintained polite behavior.

聘.en: The company hired a new accountant.

聘.zh: 他们打算聘我去当顾问。
聘.en: They plan to hire me as a consultant.

聘.zh: 这所学校聘了很多外教。
聘.en: This school has hired many foreign teachers.

聘.zh: 他被聘为项目经理后，工作更努力了。
聘.en: After being hired as the project manager, he worked even harder.

聘.zh: 如果公司聘你，你会接受吗？
聘.en: If the company hires you, will you accept?

忠于.zh: 他一直忠于自己的理想。
忠于.en: He has always been loyal to his ideals.
Dogs are very loyal to their owners.

忠于.zh: 作为军人，必须忠于国家。
忠于.en: As a soldier, one must be loyal to the country.

忠于.zh: 她忠于丈夫，从没想过背叛。
忠于.en: She is loyal to her husband and has never thought of cheating.

忠于.zh: 虽然环境变了，但他依然忠于最初的承诺。
忠于.en: Although the circumstances have changed, he is still loyal to his original promise.

胜任.en: He is competent for this job.

胜任.zh: 我觉得你不胜任这个职位。
胜任.en: I don't think you are qualified for this position.

胜任.zh: 她经验丰富，完全能胜任经理。
胜任.en: She has rich experience and is fully competent as a manager.

胜任.zh: 经过培训后，他应该能胜任了。
胜任.en: After training, he should be able to handle the job.

胜任.zh: 如果连简单任务都不胜任，就很难升职。
胜任.en: If you can't even handle simple tasks, it's hard to get promoted.

下跌.en: Recently, housing prices have been continuously falling.

下跌.zh: 因为经济不好，他的收入下跌了很多。
下跌.en: Because the economy is bad, his income has dropped a lot.

下跌.zh: 这个品牌的口碑一直在下跌，没人买了。
下跌.en: The reputation of this brand has been declining, and no one is buying it.

下跌.zh: 虽然销量下跌，但他们没有裁员。
下跌.en: Although sales have dropped, they didn't lay off employees.

荒谬.zh: 他居然信了那么荒谬的话。
荒谬.en: He actually believed such an absurd remark.

荒谬.zh: 别跟我讲这些荒谬的理由。
荒谬.en: Don't give me these absurd excuses.

荒谬.zh: 我觉得他的提议荒谬得可笑。
荒谬.en: I think his proposal is ridiculously absurd.

荒谬.zh: 有些人竟然认为地球是平的，这太荒谬了。
荒谬.en: Some people actually think the earth is flat; that's just absurd.

替换.zh: 如果你不喜欢这个颜色，可以随时替换。
替换.en: If you don't like this color, you can replace it anytime.

替换.zh: 他替换了受伤的队友上场。
替换.en: He replaced the injured teammate on the field.

替换.zh: 密码要定期替换才安全。
替换.en: Passwords should be replaced regularly to be safe.

拓展.en: We want to expand overseas markets.

拓展.zh: 公司今年计划拓展新的业务领域。
拓展.en: The company plans to expand into new business areas this year.

拓展.zh: 阅读可以拓展你的视野。
这门课帮助我拓展了人脉。
拓展.en: This course helped me expand my network.

拓展.zh: 我们需要拓展更多的客户资源。
拓展.en: We need to expand more customer resources.

回馈.zh: 我们会根据用户的回馈改进产品。
回馈.en: We will improve the product based on user feedback.

回馈.zh: 这个活动是对社会的回馈。
回馈.en: This event is a return to society.
Customers feedback that the quality is good.

回馈.zh: 做了好事，自然会有回馈。
回馈.en: Do good deeds, and there will naturally be returns.

浓缩.zh: 这本书把历史浓缩成一百页。
浓缩.en: This book condenses history into a hundred pages.

浓缩.zh: 这个调料是浓缩的，要加水。
浓缩.en: This seasoning is concentrated, need to add water.

浓缩.zh: 这部电影把几十年的故事浓缩在两小时里。
浓缩.en: This movie condenses decades of story into two hours.

放映.zh: 电影院正在放映一部科幻片。
放映.en: The cinema is showing a sci-fi movie.
Please turn off your phone before the screening.

虚构.zh: 他虚构了一个人物来写小说。
虚构.en: He created a fictional character to write a novel.

虚构.zh: 新闻里说的事情不是虚构的。
虚构.en: The thing in the news is not fictional.

虚构.zh: 很多电视剧都是虚构的情节。
虚构.en: Many TV series have fictional plots.

肥皂.en: Give me a bar of soap.
You should use soap when washing hands.

肥皂.zh: 这个肥皂的香味很好闻。
肥皂.en: The scent of this soap is nice.

肥皂.zh: 我买了一盒肥皂和洗发水。
肥皂.en: I bought a box of soap and shampoo.

活儿.zh: 他干完活儿就回家休息了。
活儿.en: He finished the work and went home to rest.

活儿.zh: 今天的活儿不多，很快做完。
活儿.en: Not much work today, will finish quickly.

活儿.zh: 这个活儿需要两个人一起干。
活儿.en: This job requires two people to do together.

活儿.zh: 你手头的活儿做完了吗？
活儿.en: Have you finished the work at hand?

贪.zh: 他因为贪小便宜吃了大亏。
贪.en: He suffered big loss because of being greedy for small gains.

贪.zh: 这个人很贪，什么都想要。
贪.en: This person is very greedy, wants everything.
Greedy for more but can't chew it all.

果断.en: He is very decisive in doing things.
Faced with opportunity, be decisive to seize it.

果断.zh: 她果断地拒绝了那个提议。
领导很果断，很快就做了决定。
果断.en: The leader is very decisive, made a decision quickly.

果断.zh: 犹豫不决不如果断行动。
果断.en: Hesitating is not as good as acting decisively.

失效.zh: 这张优惠券已经失效了。
因为密码输错太多次，银行卡失效了。
失效.en: Because the password was entered incorrectly too many times, the bank card became invalid.

失效.zh: 虽然买了新药，但旧药还没失效。
失效.en: Although I bought new medicine, the old one hasn't expired yet.

失效.zh: 合同下个月就失效了，记得续签。
失效.en: The contract expires next month, remember to renew it.

失效.zh: 这台机器的保修期已经失效了，修要花钱。
失效.en: The warranty for this machine has expired, so repairs will cost money.

平原.zh: 这片平原很适合种小麦。
平原.en: This plain is very suitable for growing wheat.

平原.zh: 飞机飞过平原时，能看到整齐的农田。
平原.en: When the plane flew over the plain, you could see neat farmlands.

平原.zh: 因为平原交通方便，所以很多城市建在那里。
平原.en: Because plains have convenient transportation, many cities are built there.

平原.zh: 华北平原是中国重要的粮食产区。
平原.en: The North China Plain is an important grain-producing area in China.

平原.zh: 虽然山区风景美，但平原住起来更舒服。
平原.en: Although the mountain scenery is beautiful, living on the plain is more comfortable.

振奋.zh: 这个好消息让大家很振奋。
振奋.en: This good news made everyone excited.

振奋.zh: 听到中国队赢了，所有人都特别振奋。
振奋.en: Hearing that the Chinese team won, everyone felt especially inspired.

振奋.zh: 虽然比赛很艰难，但结果让人振奋。
振奋.en: Although the game was tough, the result was inspiring.

振奋.zh: 领导的话很振奋人心，大家干劲十足。
振奋.en: The leader's words were very inspiring, and everyone was full of energy.

振奋.zh: 看到孩子们进步这么快，老师感到非常振奋。
振奋.en: Seeing the children improve so quickly, the teacher felt very encouraged.

卑鄙.en: He is too despicable to do this.

卑鄙.zh: 为了赢比赛就用卑鄙的手段，真让人看不起。
卑鄙.en: Using despicable means to win the game is really looked down upon.

卑鄙.zh: 虽然他很聪明，但总是用卑鄙的方法。
卑鄙.en: Although he is smart, he always uses despicable methods.

卑鄙.zh: 这种卑鄙的行为会毁掉他的名声。
卑鄙.en: This kind of despicable behavior will ruin his reputation.

卑鄙.zh: 我们绝对不能容忍这种卑鄙的勾当。
卑鄙.en: We absolutely cannot tolerate this kind of despicable deed.

耳光.zh: 他生气地打了我一耳光。
吵架的时候，她忍不住给了他一耳光。
耳光.en: During the quarrel, she couldn't help but give him a slap.

耳光.zh: 虽然他说的话很难听，但你也不能打耳光。
耳光.en: Although what he said was harsh, you shouldn't slap him.

耳光.zh: 当众被人打耳光，他觉得很丢脸。
耳光.en: Being slapped in public, he felt very humiliated.

耳光.zh: 小时候不听话，爸爸会打我耳光。
耳光.en: When I was little and misbehaved, my dad would slap me.

披露.zh: 调查报告披露了很多内幕。
披露.en: The investigation report disclosed many inside stories.

披露.zh: 记者在发布会上披露了公司的违法行为。
披露.en: The journalist disclosed the company's illegal acts at the press conference.

披露.zh: 虽然公司想隐瞒，但媒体还是披露了真相。
披露.en: Although the company tried to hide it, the media still disclosed the truth.

披露.zh: 这份文件披露了政府的一些秘密计划。
披露.en: This document disclosed some secret plans of the government.

披露.zh: 他匿名向报社披露了贪腐的证据。
披露.en: He anonymously disclosed evidence of corruption to the newspaper.

判定.en: The doctor determined he had a cold.

判定.zh: 法官根据证据判定被告有罪。
判定.en: The judge determined the defendant guilty based on evidence.

判定.zh: 因为证据不足，法院无法判定他有罪。
判定.en: Because of insufficient evidence, the court cannot determine whether he is guilty.

判定.zh: 我们需要更多信息才能判定对错。
判定.en: We need more information to determine right from wrong.

判定.zh: 专家判定这幅画是假的。
判定.en: The expert determined that this painting is a fake.

务必.en: You must arrive on time tomorrow.

务必.zh: 出门前务必检查窗户和煤气。
务必.en: Before going out, be sure to check the windows and gas.

务必.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但你务必完成报告。
务必.en: Although time is tight, you must finish the report.

务必.zh: 这件事很重要，你务必记住。
务必.en: This matter is very important, you must remember it.

务必.zh: 开会时务必带上你的笔记本。
务必.en: Be sure to bring your notebook to the meeting.

惊叹.zh: 大家都对他的画技惊叹不已。
惊叹.en: Everyone marveled at his painting skills.

惊叹.zh: 看到城市夜景，游客们发出惊叹。
惊叹.en: Seeing the night view of the city, tourists exclaimed in admiration.

惊叹.zh: 虽然看过照片，但亲眼看到还是让人惊叹。
惊叹.en: Although I had seen photos, seeing it in person still made me marvel.

惊叹.zh: 他的魔术表演让全场观众惊叹。
惊叹.en: His magic performance amazed the entire audience.

惊叹.zh: 这座建筑的设计令人惊叹。
惊叹.en: The design of this building is astonishing.

拥护.zh: 大多数市民拥护这项新政策。
拥护.en: Most citizens support this new policy.

拥护.zh: 因为他为百姓做事，大家都拥护他当村长。
拥护.en: Because he works for the people, everyone supports him as village head.

拥护.zh: 虽然改革有困难，但很多人仍然拥护。
拥护.en: Although reform is difficult, many people still support it.

拥护.zh: 这位领导人深受人民拥护。
拥护.en: This leader is deeply supported by the people.

拥护.zh: 我们坚决拥护公司的决定。
拥护.en: We firmly support the company's decision.

首脑.en: Heads of state from various countries gathered together.

首脑.zh: 这次会议有很多国家首脑参加。
首脑.en: Many heads of state attended this meeting.

首脑.zh: 虽然首脑们意见不同，但最后还是达成了协议。
首脑.en: Although the leaders had different opinions, they finally reached an agreement.

首脑.zh: 那位首脑在演讲中强调了合作的重要性。
首脑.en: That head of state emphasized the importance of cooperation in his speech.

首脑.zh: 作为首脑，他必须做出艰难的决定。
首脑.en: As a leader, he has to make tough decisions.

意料.en: This is completely beyond my expectations.

意料.zh: 他辞职的消息在意料之中。
意料.en: The news of his resignation was expected.

意料.zh: 虽然结果出乎意料，但大家都能接受。
意料.en: Although the result was unexpected, everyone could accept it.

意料.zh: 这件事的发展完全在意料之外。
意料.en: The development of this matter is completely unexpected.

意料.zh: 意料之中的是，她提出了反对意见。
意料.en: As expected, she raised an objection.

僵硬.zh: 他说话的方式太僵硬了。
僵硬.en: His way of speaking is too rigid.

僵硬.zh: 因为坐得太久，我的腿变得僵硬。
僵硬.en: Because I sat too long, my legs became stiff.

僵硬.zh: 她虽然想打招呼，但笑容很僵硬。
僵硬.en: Although she wanted to say hello, her smile was stiff.

僵硬.zh: 谈判陷入僵局，双方态度都很僵硬。
僵硬.en: The negotiations reached a deadlock, and both sides were very rigid.

空前.en: This exhibition was unprecedented in its success.

空前.zh: 今年的经济增速是空前的。
空前.en: This year's economic growth rate is unprecedented.

空前.zh: 由于技术突破，公司迎来了空前发展。
空前.en: Due to technological breakthroughs, the company has experienced unprecedented development.

空前.zh: 这场音乐会吸引了空前的观众人数。
空前.en: This concert attracted an unprecedented number of audiences.

空前.zh: 虽然竞争空前激烈，但我们还是赢了。
空前.en: Although the competition was unprecedentedly fierce, we still won.

董事长.zh: 我们董事长今天不在公司。
董事长.en: Our chairman is not in the company today.

董事长.zh: 董事长在会议上提出了新方案。
董事长.en: The chairman proposed a new plan at the meeting.

董事长.zh: 因为董事长出差，会议推迟了。
董事长.en: Because the chairman is on a business trip, the meeting was postponed.

董事长.zh: 董事长要求各部门提高效率。
董事长.en: The chairman asked all departments to improve efficiency.

董事长.zh: 作为董事长，他经常要处理各种紧急事务。
董事长.en: As the chairman, he often has to handle various urgent matters.

油画.en: I like this oil painting the most.

油画.zh: 她花了一个月完成这幅油画。
油画.en: She spent a month completing this oil painting.

油画.zh: 虽然油画很贵，但他还是买了。
油画.en: Although the oil painting was expensive, he still bought it.

油画.zh: 这幅油画色彩非常丰富，让人印象深刻。
油画.en: This oil painting has very rich colors and is impressive.

油画.zh: 他在美术馆里欣赏了一下午的油画。
油画.en: He spent an afternoon admiring oil paintings in the art museum.

旺盛.zh: 这棵树的生长势头非常旺盛。
旺盛.en: This tree's growth momentum is very vigorous.

旺盛.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他的食欲依然旺盛。
旺盛.en: Although he is old, his appetite is still strong.

旺盛.zh: 夏天草木生长旺盛，到处都是绿色。
旺盛.en: In summer, plants grow vigorously, and greenery is everywhere.

旺盛.zh: 由于市场需求旺盛，公司加班加点生产。
旺盛.en: Due to strong market demand, the company is working overtime to produce.

进场.en: The audience has started to enter the venue.

进场.zh: 比赛开始前，球员们陆续进场。
进场.en: Before the game started, the players entered the field one after another.

进场.zh: 因为还没到时间，我们暂时不能进场。
进场.en: Because it's not time yet, we can't enter for now.

进场.zh: 演出快开始了，请大家抓紧时间进场。
进场.en: The show is about to start, please hurry and enter the venue.

进场.zh: 他进场时看到很多人已经在等他了。
进场.en: When he entered, he saw many people already waiting for him.

克制.en: You need to control your emotions.

克制.zh: 虽然很生气，但他还是克制住了。
克制.en: Although he was very angry, he managed to restrain himself.

克制.zh: 面对诱惑，她很难克制自己。
克制.en: Facing temptation, she finds it hard to restrain herself.

克制.zh: 他努力克制住想笑的冲动。
克制.en: He tried hard to suppress the urge to laugh.

克制.zh: 在公共场合，我们要学会克制自己的行为。
克制.en: In public, we should learn to restrain our behavior.

包容.en: We need to learn to be tolerant of others.

包容.zh: 作为领导，你应该包容不同的意见。
包容.en: As a leader, you should be inclusive of different opinions.

包容.zh: 虽然她犯错了，但朋友依然包容了她。
包容.en: Although she made a mistake, her friend still forgave her.

包容.zh: 这座城市非常包容，接纳了来自各地的人。
包容.en: This city is very inclusive, accepting people from all over.

包容.zh: 包容是一种美德，能让人际关系更和谐。
包容.en: Tolerance is a virtue that can make interpersonal relationships more harmonious.

驳回.zh: 老板驳回了我的加薪请求。
驳回.en: The boss rejected my raise request.

驳回.zh: 因为证据不足，法官驳回了这个案子。
驳回.en: Because of insufficient evidence, the judge dismissed the case.

驳回.zh: 他们驳回了我们的提议，但我们还会再试。
驳回.en: They rejected our proposal, but we will try again.

无形.en: This kind of pressure is invisible.

无形.zh: 爱是无形的，但能感受到。
无形.en: Love is intangible, but you can feel it.

无形.zh: 无形的手推动着市场变化。
无形.en: An invisible hand drives market changes.

无形.zh: 虽然他帮了我，但那种帮助是无形的。
无形.en: Although he helped me, that kind of help was intangible.

无形.zh: 空气无形，却对我们很重要。
无形.en: Air is invisible, yet it is very important to us.

方针.en: We must stick to this policy.
The company's policy is very clear.

方针.zh: 政府制定了新的经济方针。
方针.en: The government has formulated new economic policies.

方针.zh: 按照教育方针，学校改进了课程。
方针.en: According to the educational policy, the school improved the curriculum.

方针.zh: 这个方针是经过讨论才确定的。
方针.en: This policy was only finalized after discussion.

张扬.en: He has a very flamboyant personality.
Don't be too showy, keep a low profile.

张扬.zh: 他喜欢张扬自己的成就。
张扬.en: He likes to flaunt his achievements.

张扬.zh: 她做事从不张扬，但很靠谱。
张扬.en: She never shows off when doing things, but she is very reliable.

张扬.zh: 虽然他很优秀，但从不张扬。
张扬.en: Although he is excellent, he never boasts.

不肯.en: Is he willing to come? No, he won't.

不肯.zh: 无论怎么说，他都不肯道歉。
不肯.en: No matter what I say, he refuses to apologize.

不肯.zh: 她不肯接受我的帮助，坚持自己来。
不肯.en: She refused to accept my help and insisted on doing it herself.

不肯.zh: 因为害怕失败，所以他一直不肯尝试。
不肯.en: Because he is afraid of failure, he has always been unwilling to try.

风味.en: This dish has a lot of local flavor.

风味.zh: 我喜欢当地的饮食风味。
风味.en: I like the local food flavor.

风味.zh: 这家餐馆的川菜风味很正。
风味.en: The Sichuan cuisine flavor at this restaurant is very authentic.

风味.zh: 每个地方都有自己独特的风味小吃。
风味.en: Every place has its own unique local snacks.

风味.zh: 虽然做法简单，但保留了传统风味。
风味.en: Although the method is simple, it retains the traditional flavor.

档次.zh: 产品档次不同，价格也不一样。
档次.en: Products of different grades have different prices.

档次.zh: 他总喜欢买高档次的品牌。
档次.en: He always likes to buy high-end brands.

档次.zh: 这件衣服看起来档次不低，其实很便宜。
档次.en: This piece of clothing looks high-end, but it's actually very cheap.

档次.zh: 虽然价格高，但它的档次确实不一样。
档次.en: Although the price is high, its grade is indeed different.

歌剧.en: There is an opera performance tonight.

歌剧.zh: 她是一位著名的歌剧演员。
歌剧.en: She is a famous opera singer.

歌剧.zh: 虽然歌剧很高雅，但我也能欣赏。
歌剧.en: Although opera is very refined, I can still appreciate it.

歌剧.zh: 我买了两张歌剧票，你要一起去吗？
歌剧.en: I bought two opera tickets, do you want to go together?

让步.en: I won't give in this time.

让步.zh: 在谈判中，我们让步了很多。
让步.en: We made a lot of concessions during the negotiation.

让步.zh: 为了达成协议，他不得不让步。
让步.en: In order to reach an agreement, he had to give in.

让步.zh: 虽然他很固执，但最后也只能让步。
让步.en: Although he is very stubborn, in the end he had to compromise.

士气.zh: 经理的话鼓舞了大家的士气。
士气.en: The manager's words boosted everyone's morale.

士气.zh: 虽然连输两场，但球队的士气没降。
士气.en: Although they lost two games in a row, the team's morale didn't drop.

士气.zh: 为了提高士气，公司组织了团建活动。
士气.en: To boost morale, the company organized team-building activities.

过日子.zh: 我们小两口过日子挺简单的。
过日子.en: Our little couple lives a pretty simple life.

过日子.zh: 她一个人带着孩子，过日子很不容易。
过日子.en: She raises a child alone, and making a living is really tough.

过日子.zh: 虽然工资不高，但我们会精打细算过日子。
过日子.en: Although the salary is low, we budget carefully to get by.

听从.en: You should follow the teacher's advice.

听从.zh: 他不肯听从劝告，结果吃了大亏。
听从.en: He refused to heed the advice and ended up suffering big losses.

听从.zh: 在紧急情况下，必须听从指挥员的命令。
听从.en: In an emergency, you must obey the commander's orders.

听从.zh: 我本来想自己干，但还是听从了大家的意见。
听从.en: I originally wanted to do it myself, but I still listened to everyone's opinion.

听从.zh: 孩子如果从小不听从父母的话，长大容易走弯路。
听从.en: If a child doesn't obey their parents from a young age, they may easily go astray when they grow up.

不同寻常.zh: 她身上有种不同寻常的气质。
这个案子不同寻常，警方正在深入调查。
不同寻常.en: This case is unusual, and the police are conducting an in-depth investigation.

不同寻常.zh: 他能在三分钟内解开这个谜题，真是不同寻常。
不同寻常.en: He can solve this puzzle in three minutes, which is truly extraordinary.

不同寻常.zh: 虽然外表普通，但他的经历却不同寻常。
不同寻常.en: Although he looks ordinary, his experiences are extraordinary.

推断.zh: 根据指纹，警方推断小偷是从窗户进来的。
推断.en: Based on fingerprints, the police deduced that the thief entered through the window.

推断.zh: 从她疲惫的眼神，我推断她昨晚没睡好。
推断.en: From her tired eyes, I inferred that she didn't sleep well last night.

推断.zh: 科学家通过化石推断出恐龙的生活习性。
推断.en: Scientists inferred the living habits of dinosaurs from fossils.

推断.zh: 他说话吞吞吐吐的，我推断他心里有鬼。
推断.en: He was hesitant when speaking, so I inferred that he had a guilty conscience.

领养.zh: 他们打算领养一个孩子。
领养.en: They plan to adopt a child.

领养.zh: 这对夫妻领养了一只流浪狗。
领养.en: The couple adopted a stray dog.

领养.zh: 许多家庭愿意领养孤儿，给他们一个温暖的家。
领养.en: Many families are willing to adopt orphans and give them a warm home.

领养.zh: 领养手续比较复杂，但为了孩子他们不怕麻烦。
领养.en: The adoption process is quite complicated, but they don't mind the trouble for the child.

领养.zh: 她从小被领养，长大后才知道了自己的身世。
领养.en: She was adopted as a child and only learned about her origins when she grew up.

货运.en: This truck is for freight transport.

货运.zh: 疫情期间，货运行业受到了很大影响。
货运.en: During the pandemic, the freight industry was greatly affected.

货运.zh: 我们公司主要经营国内长途货运业务。
货运.en: Our company mainly operates long-distance domestic freight services.

货运.zh: 因为航班取消，很多国际货运改走铁路了。
货运.en: Because flights were canceled, a lot of international freight switched to rail.

货运.zh: 这批货运到上海需要三天时间，不过运费很便宜。
货运.en: It takes three days for this shipment to reach Shanghai, but the freight charge is very cheap.

遗弃.zh: 那个婴儿被遗弃在公园的长椅上。
遗弃.en: That baby was abandoned on a park bench.

遗弃.zh: 遗弃老人是违法的，也会受到良心谴责。
遗弃.en: Abandoning the elderly is illegal and will also bring guilt.

遗弃.zh: 她因为受不了压力，竟然遗弃了才三个月大的孩子。
遗弃.en: Unable to bear the pressure, she actually abandoned her three-month-old child.

遗弃.zh: 这只流浪狗以前被人遗弃过，所以很怕生。
遗弃.en: This stray dog was once abandoned by someone, so it's very shy.

芝麻.zh: 撒点芝麻在面包上更香。
芝麻.en: Sprinkling some sesame on the bread makes it more fragrant.
Although sesame is small, it is rich in nutrients.

芝麻.zh: 他这个人总是捡了芝麻丢西瓜——分不清轻重。
芝麻.en: He always picks up sesame seeds and loses the watermelon — he can't tell what's important.

芝麻.zh: 奶奶用芝麻和花生做了一种特别的糖。
芝麻.en: Grandma made a special candy with sesame and peanuts.

正直.zh: 做人要正直，不能耍小聪明。
正直.en: One must be honest and upright, not play petty tricks.

正直.zh: 虽然正直有时候会吃亏，但长远来看值得。
正直.en: Although being upright sometimes causes losses, it's worth it in the long run.

正直.zh: 她因为性格正直，在单位里很受尊敬。
正直.en: Because of her upright character, she is highly respected at work.

正直.zh: 法官必须保持正直，公正地审理每一个案件。
正直.en: Judges must remain upright and fairly hear every case.

平息.zh: 警察很快平息了这场冲突。
平息.en: The police quickly quelled the conflict.

平息.zh: 他深呼吸了几次，试图平息心中的怒火。
平息.en: He took a few deep breaths, trying to calm his anger.

平息.zh: 政府出台政策来平息民众的抗议。
平息.en: The government introduced policies to quell public protests.

平息.zh: 等大家的情绪平息下来，我们再好好谈这件事。
平息.en: After everyone's emotions calm down, we'll talk about this properly.

狭窄.zh: 他的想法很狭窄，不愿意接受新观点。
狭窄.en: His thinking is very narrow; he is unwilling to accept new ideas.

狭窄.zh: 因为走廊很狭窄，两个人并排走很困难。
狭窄.en: Because the hallway is narrow, it's hard for two people to walk side by side.

狭窄.zh: 这个房间虽然空间狭窄，但布置得很温馨。
狭窄.en: Although this room is cramped, it is decorated warmly.

狭窄.zh: 我们穿过一条狭窄的小巷才到达目的地。
狭窄.en: We passed through a narrow alley before reaching our destination.

敬意.en: I am full of respect for my teacher.

敬意.zh: 他对长辈总是保持敬意。
敬意.en: He always maintains respect for his elders.

敬意.zh: 虽然我们观点不同，但我依然对他表示敬意。
敬意.en: Although our views differ, I still express respect for him.

敬意.zh: 在这个仪式上，大家向英雄表达了深深的敬意。
敬意.en: At this ceremony, everyone expressed deep respect for the hero.

敬意.zh: 他对艺术家的敬意体现在他认真学习的态度上。
敬意.en: His respect for artists is reflected in his earnest learning attitude.

变换.zh: 我们需要变换一下策略。
变换.en: We need to change our strategy a bit.

变换.zh: 他经常变换发型，看起来总是不一样。
变换.en: He often changes his hairstyle, so he always looks different.

变换.zh: 随着季节变换，树叶的颜色也在变化。
变换.en: As the seasons change, the color of the leaves also changes.

变换.zh: 如果比赛形势变换，我们就得调整计划。
变换.en: If the game situation shifts, we will have to adjust our plan.

布局.zh: 这个房间的布局很合理。
布局.en: The layout of this room is very reasonable.

布局.zh: 网页的布局需要重新设计。
布局.en: The layout of the webpage needs to be redesigned.

布局.zh: 他们讨论了办公区的布局方案。
布局.en: They discussed the layout plan for the office area.

布局.zh: 因为空间有限，我们只能改变室内布局。
布局.en: Because space is limited, we can only change the interior layout.

布局.zh: 这个花园的布局非常有创意，吸引了很多游客。
布局.en: The layout of this garden is very creative, attracting many visitors.

贪污.en: He was sentenced to prison for corruption.

贪污.zh: 贪污是严重的违法行为。
贪污.en: Corruption is a serious illegal act.

贪污.zh: 政府严厉打击官员贪污。
贪污.en: The government strictly cracks down on official corruption.

贪污.zh: 那个项目因为贪污问题被暂停了。
贪污.en: That project was suspended due to corruption issues.

贪污.zh: 他举报了公司内部的贪污行为。
贪污.en: He reported the corruption within the company.

自如.zh: 在台上演讲，他表现得非常自如。
自如.en: Speaking on stage, he performed very naturally.

自如.zh: 她能用英语自如地交流。
自如.en: She can communicate fluently in English.

自如.zh: 虽然压力很大，他依然应对自如。
自如.en: Although under great pressure, he still handled it with ease.

自如.zh: 经过练习，他弹钢琴已经得心应手，非常自如。
自如.en: After practice, he plays the piano with great proficiency and ease.

雇主.en: My employer trusts me a lot.

雇主.zh: 她找到了一位新的雇主。
雇主应该为员工提供保险。
雇主.en: Employers should provide insurance for employees.

雇主.zh: 如果雇主不按时发工资，员工可以投诉。
雇主.en: If the employer does not pay wages on time, employees can file a complaint.

雇主.zh: 他是一名负责任的雇主，经常关心员工福利。
雇主.en: He is a responsible employer who often cares about employee welfare.

峡谷.zh: 我们开车穿过了那个峡谷。
站在峡谷边上，我感到很震撼。
峡谷.en: Standing at the edge of the canyon, I felt very awestruck.

峡谷.zh: 峡谷里有一条清澈的河流。
峡谷.en: There is a clear river in the canyon.

峡谷.zh: 因为峡谷地形险峻，徒步旅行非常危险。
峡谷.en: Because the canyon terrain is steep, hiking is very dangerous.

沐浴.zh: 沐浴在阳光下，感觉真舒服。
沐浴.en: Basking in the sunlight feels really comfortable.

沐浴.zh: 孩子沐浴后换上了干净的衣服。
沐浴.en: The child put on clean clothes after bathing.

沐浴.zh: 春天的花园里，花朵沐浴在细雨中。
沐浴.en: In the spring garden, the flowers are bathed in the drizzle.

沐浴.zh: 她喜欢在周末泡个热水澡，享受沐浴的时光。
沐浴.en: She likes to take a hot bath on weekends and enjoy the bathing time.

受理.zh: 这个案子法院已经受理了。
受理.en: The court has accepted this case.

受理.zh: 他们不受理这种类型的申请。
受理.en: They do not accept this type of application.

受理.zh: 银行受理贷款申请需要三个工作日。
受理.en: It takes three business days for the bank to process a loan application.

受理.zh: 因为材料不全，他们拒绝受理我的请求。
受理.en: Because the documents were incomplete, they refused to accept my request.

吉利.zh: 春节贴对联是为了讨个吉利。
吉利.en: Posting couplets during Spring Festival is to seek good luck.

吉利.zh: 他们选了个吉利的日子结婚。
吉利.en: They chose an auspicious day for their wedding.

吉利.zh: 虽然我不迷信，但听到喜鹊叫还是觉得挺吉利的。
吉利.en: Although I'm not superstitious, hearing magpies chirp still feels quite lucky.

吉利.zh: 开业那天放鞭炮，图个吉利热闹。
吉利.en: Setting off firecrackers on the opening day is for good luck and festivity.

重现.zh: 这个画面一直在我的脑海里重现。
重现.en: This scene keeps replaying in my mind.

重现.zh: 经过修复，古老的壁画终于重现了光彩。
重现.en: After restoration, the ancient murals finally regained their splendor.

重现.zh: 如果你不改变方法，同样的错误还会重现。
重现.en: If you don't change your approach, the same mistakes will happen again.

重现.zh: 科学家试图在实验室里重现那次化学反应的过程。
重现.en: Scientists are trying to recreate the process of that chemical reaction in the lab.

微波炉.en: Heat up the rice in the microwave.

微波炉.zh: 我家的微波炉坏了，得买个新的。
微波炉.en: Our microwave is broken; we need to buy a new one.

微波炉.zh: 微波炉加热很快，但要注意别用金属容器。
微波炉.en: Microwaves heat up quickly, but be careful not to use metal containers.

微波炉.zh: 她上班前用微波炉热了杯牛奶就匆匆出门了。
微波炉.en: She heated a cup of milk in the microwave before rushing out to work.

微波炉.zh: 虽然微波炉很方便，但加热不均匀的时候还是得翻一下。
微波炉.en: Although microwaves are very convenient, you still need to stir the food when it heats unevenly.

紊乱.en: His daily routine is very irregular.

紊乱.zh: 长期熬夜会导致内分泌紊乱。
紊乱.en: Staying up late for a long time can cause endocrine disorders.

紊乱.zh: 最近工作压力大，我的生物钟全紊乱了。
紊乱.en: Work has been stressful lately, and my biological clock is completely out of whack.

紊乱.zh: 医生说他肠胃功能紊乱，需要调理饮食。
紊乱.en: The doctor said his gastrointestinal function is disordered and he needs to adjust his diet.

紊乱.zh: 因为这场地震，整个城市的交通系统都陷入了紊乱。
紊乱.en: Because of the earthquake, the entire city's transportation system fell into chaos.

废墟.en: This place used to be ruins.

废墟.zh: 地震过后，城市变成了一片废墟。
废墟.en: After the earthquake, the city turned into a pile of ruins.

废墟.zh: 救援队在废墟下找到了一名幸存者。
废墟.en: The rescue team found a survivor under the rubble.

废墟.zh: 站在古城的废墟上，能感受到历史的厚重感。
废墟.en: Standing on the ruins of the ancient city, you can feel the weight of history.

废墟.zh: 虽然整栋楼已成废墟，但里面的一些物品居然完好无损。
废墟.en: Although the whole building is in ruins, some items inside are surprisingly intact.

萎缩.en: His muscles are beginning to atrophy.

萎缩.zh: 经济萎缩导致很多人失业。
萎缩.en: Economic contraction has led to many job losses.

萎缩.zh: 长期不运动，肌肉会逐渐萎缩。
萎缩.en: If you don't exercise for a long time, your muscles will gradually shrink.

萎缩.zh: 因为干旱，这片地区的农业产量严重萎缩。
萎缩.en: Due to drought, agricultural output in this area has severely shrunk.

萎缩.zh: 公司业务萎缩，老板不得不考虑裁员来节省开支。
萎缩.en: The company's business is shrinking, and the boss has to consider layoffs to cut costs.

扶持.en: The government supports small and medium-sized enterprises.

扶持.zh: 这个项目得到了国家的资金扶持。
扶持.en: This project received financial support from the state.

扶持.zh: 新手创业需要有人扶持一把，才能走得更稳。
扶持.en: New entrepreneurs need someone to give them a helping hand to go more steadily.

扶持.zh: 虽然公司遇到了困难，但合作伙伴愿意扶持我们渡过难关。
扶持.en: Although the company is in trouble, our partners are willing to support us through the hard times.

真情.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

真情.zh: 他用真情打动了她的心。
真情.en: He moved her heart with genuine feelings.

真情.zh: 那封信里字字都是真情流露。
真情.en: Every word in that letter was an outpouring of true emotion.

真情.zh: 在这个社会里，能遇到真情实意的人不容易。
真情.en: In this society, it's not easy to meet someone sincere.

真情.zh: 虽然他们相处时间不长，但彼此都付出了真情。
真情.en: Although they haven't known each other long, they both gave their true feelings.

人品.en: He has a very good character.

人品.zh: 看一个人要看人品，不能只看外表。
人品.en: To judge a person, look at their character, not just their appearance.

人品.zh: 她经常在背后说人坏话，人品真不行。
人品.en: She often talks behind people's backs; her character is really bad.

人品.zh: 面试的时候，老板特别看重应聘者的人品。
人品.en: During the interview, the boss especially values the candidate's character.

人品.zh: 虽然他的能力很强，但人品有问题，大家都不愿意跟他合作。
人品.en: Although he is very capable, he has issues with his character, so nobody wants to work with him.

平和.en: He has a very gentle temper.
It's important to keep a calm mindset.

平和.zh: 这个茶的味道比较平和，不苦不涩。
平和.en: This tea has a mild flavor, neither bitter nor astringent.

平和.zh: 虽然发生了争执，但他说话的语气依然很平和。
平和.en: Although there was an argument, the tone of his voice remained calm.

平和.zh: 我喜欢山里那种平和安静的生活，没有城市的喧嚣。
平和.en: I love the peaceful and quiet life in the mountains, without the noise of the city.

稍稍.zh: 你稍稍休息一下，我们马上出发。
稍稍.en: Rest a bit, and we'll leave soon.

稍稍.zh: 虽然天气很热，但稍稍吹点风就舒服多了。
稍稍.en: Although the weather is hot, a little breeze makes it much more comfortable.

稍稍.zh: 这道菜稍稍有点辣，你能接受吗？
稍稍.en: This dish is a little spicy, can you handle it?

稍稍.zh: 我稍稍改变了一下计划，别介意。
稍稍.en: I changed the plan a little, don't mind.

沉迷.zh: 他沉迷于网络小说，连饭都顾不上吃。
沉迷.en: He is addicted to web novels, not even having time to eat.

沉迷.zh: 如果沉迷手机，就会影响学习和工作。
沉迷.en: If you are addicted to your phone, it will affect your study and work.

沉迷.zh: 她沉迷画画，每天都画到很晚。
沉迷.en: She is immersed in painting and draws until very late every day.

沉迷.zh: 年轻人不要沉迷享乐，要努力奋斗。
沉迷.en: Young people shouldn't indulge in pleasure; they should strive hard.

票房.en: This movie has a high box office.

票房.zh: 今年的春节档票房比去年好很多。
票房.en: This year's Spring Festival box office is much better than last year's.

票房.zh: 虽然口碑一般，但票房却出奇地好。
票房.en: Although word-of-mouth is average, the box office is surprisingly good.

票房.zh: 票房成功不代表电影质量好。
票房.en: Box office success doesn't mean the movie is of good quality.
The director pays close attention to box office results.

反驳.zh: 他的观点不太对，我忍不住反驳了几句。
反驳.en: His point was not quite right, and I couldn't help but refute a few sentences.

反驳.zh: 虽然她想反驳，但还是忍住了。
反驳.en: Although she wanted to argue back, she held herself back.

反驳.zh: 老师没有反驳学生的意见，而是耐心解释。
反驳.en: The teacher didn't contradict the student's opinion but explained patiently.

反驳.zh: 你反驳之前最好先查查资料。
反驳.en: You'd better check the facts before you refute.

重量级.zh: 这次会议来了很多重量级嘉宾。
重量级.en: Many heavyweight guests came to this meeting.

重量级.zh: 虽然他是重量级人物，但说话很平易近人。
重量级.en: Although he is a heavyweight figure, he speaks in a very approachable way.

重量级.zh: 这部电影邀请了几位重量级演员。
重量级.en: This movie invited several heavyweight actors.

重量级.zh: 这个项目需要一个重量级的负责人。
重量级.en: This project needs a heavyweight person in charge.

去向.en: Where did he go? His whereabouts are unknown.

去向.zh: 公司正在调查资金去向。
去向.en: The company is investigating the whereabouts of the funds.

去向.zh: 因为没人知道他的去向，大家都很担心。
去向.en: Since no one knows his whereabouts, everyone is very worried.

去向.zh: 警察在查那辆车的去向。
去向.en: The police are checking the whereabouts of that car.
Her whereabouts have always been a mystery.

开办.zh: 他们开办了一家小公司。
今年学校开办了新的课程。
开办.en: The school started new courses this year.

开办.zh: 由于资金不足，开办计划暂时搁置了。
开办.en: Due to insufficient funds, the plan to open was put on hold temporarily.

开办.zh: 她决定开办一个培训班。
开办.en: She decided to start a training class.

开办.zh: 这家店是去年开办的，生意不错。
开办.en: This store was opened last year, and business is pretty good.

脱颖而出.en: He stood out in the competition.

脱颖而出.zh: 经过层层选拔，他终于脱颖而出。
脱颖而出.en: After rounds of selection, he finally stood out.

脱颖而出.zh: 虽然竞争激烈，但她还是脱颖而出了。
脱颖而出.en: Although the competition was fierce, she still stood out.

脱颖而出.zh: 这个设计师的作品在展览中脱颖而出。
脱颖而出.en: This designer's work stood out in the exhibition.

脱颖而出.zh: 要想脱颖而出，必须付出更多努力。
脱颖而出.en: To stand out, you must put in more effort.

亮点.zh: 这场演出有很多亮点，尤其是灯光效果。
亮点.en: This show has many highlights, especially the lighting effects.

亮点.zh: 虽然整体一般，但有几个亮点值得关注。
亮点.en: Although overall it's average, there are a few highlights worth noting.

亮点.zh: 他的演讲亮点在最后的提问环节。
亮点.en: The highlight of his speech was the Q&A session at the end.

亮点.zh: 这个产品的最大亮点是价格便宜。
亮点.en: The biggest highlight of this product is its low price.

牵挂.en: I am very worried about my parents.

牵挂.zh: 出门在外，最牵挂的就是家人。
牵挂.en: When away from home, what I worry about most is my family.

牵挂.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但心里一直牵挂着孩子。
牵挂.en: Although work is busy, I've always had my child on my mind.

牵挂.zh: 她牵挂远方的朋友，经常打电话。
牵挂.en: She worries about her friends far away and calls them often.

牵挂.zh: 这份牵挂让我无法安心工作。
牵挂.en: This worry keeps me from working peacefully.

不理.zh: 我叫了他好几次，他都不理我。
不理.en: I called him several times, but he ignored me.

不理.zh: 他生气的时候，谁都不理。
不理.en: When he's angry, he ignores everyone.

不理.zh: 你为什么不理那个问题？
不理.en: Why don't you address that question?

火山.zh: 火山爆发的时候，天空都黑了。
火山.en: When the volcano erupted, the sky turned dark.

火山.zh: 虽然火山很危险，但景色很美。
火山.en: Although volcanoes are dangerous, the scenery is beautiful.

火山.zh: 我们坐直升机去看火山口。
火山.en: We took a helicopter to see the crater.

环绕.zh: 音乐环绕在房间的每个角落。
环绕.en: Music fills every corner of the room.

环绕.zh: 公园被小河环绕，所以很安静。
环绕.en: The park is surrounded by a small river, so it's very quiet.

环绕.zh: 孩子们环绕在老师身边听故事。
环绕.en: Children surrounded the teacher listening to stories.

驱逐.zh: 因为闹事，他被驱逐出酒吧。
驱逐.en: Because he caused trouble, he was kicked out of the bar.

驱逐.zh: 这只狗总是驱逐陌生人。
驱逐.en: This dog always drives away strangers.

驱逐.zh: 警察用武力驱逐了抗议的人群。
驱逐.en: The police used force to disperse the protesters.

补助.zh: 这个月我拿到了住房补助。
补助.en: I received housing allowance this month.

补助.zh: 因为收入低，他申请了政府补助。
补助.en: Because his income is low, he applied for government subsidies.
The company gives employees transportation subsidies.

补助.zh: 我们需要更多的补助来支持教育事业。
补助.en: We need more subsidies to support education.

踹.en: Don't kick the door, use the key.

踹.zh: 他生气了，就踹了桌子一脚。
踹.en: He got angry and kicked the table.

踹.zh: 那个小偷被警察踹倒了。
踹.en: The thief was kicked down by the police.

踹.zh: 我做梦时不小心踹到了墙。
踹.en: I accidentally kicked the wall while dreaming.

苛刻.zh: 他对员工的要求很苛刻。
苛刻.en: He has very strict demands on employees.

苛刻.zh: 虽然老板很苛刻，但工资高。
苛刻.en: Although the boss is very demanding, the salary is high.

苛刻.zh: 这个合同条款有点苛刻。
苛刻.en: The terms of this contract are a bit harsh.

苛刻.zh: 她对自己的孩子特别苛刻，从不表扬。
苛刻.en: She is especially strict with her own children, never praising them.

不知不觉.zh: 天黑了，不知不觉已经过了一下午。
不知不觉.en: It got dark, unconsciously an afternoon passed.

不知不觉.zh: 他一边走路一边玩手机，不知不觉走过了站。
不知不觉.en: He walked while playing on his phone, unconsciously walked past the stop.

不知不觉.zh: 时间过得真快，不知不觉就老了。
不知不觉.en: Time flies, without realizing we've grown old.

不知不觉.zh: 我们聊得太开心，不知不觉就到了半夜。
不知不觉.en: We talked so happily that without realizing it was midnight.

梳.zh: 每天早上我都要梳头十分钟。
梳.en: Every morning I comb my hair for ten minutes.

梳.zh: 洗完澡之后，她一边梳头一边听音乐。
梳.en: After showering, she combed her hair while listening to music.

梳.zh: 孩子不会自己梳头发，需要妈妈帮忙。
梳.en: The child can't comb his own hair, needs mom's help.

裁定.zh: 法官对这个案件做出了裁定。
裁定.en: The judge made a ruling on this case.

裁定.zh: 因为证据不足，裁定他无罪。
裁定.en: Because of insufficient evidence, the ruling was not guilty.

裁定.zh: 这个裁定引起了很大的争议。
董事会明天会对这个提案做出裁定。
裁定.en: The board will make a decision on this proposal tomorrow.

圆形.zh: 我喜欢圆形的镜子，因为它看起来更柔和。
圆形.en: I like round mirrors because they look softer.
The circle you drew is not quite round.

圆形.zh: 那个公园里有一个很大的圆形花坛。
圆形.en: There is a very large round flower bed in that park.

圆形.zh: 虽然他说是圆形，但我看着像椭圆。
圆形.en: Although he said it's round, to me it looks like an oval.

再现.zh: 这部电影再现了古代的生活。
再现.en: This film reproduces the life of ancient times.

再现.zh: 他希望能再现当年的辉煌。
再现.en: He hopes to recreate the glory of the past.

再现.zh: 通过技术，我们再现了恐龙的模样。
再现.en: Through technology, we recreated the appearance of dinosaurs.

再现.zh: 如果条件合适，这种景象可能会再次再现。
再现.en: If conditions are right, this scene might happen again.

再现.zh: 画家试图在画布上再现那片风景。
再现.en: The painter tried to reproduce that landscape on the canvas.

责怪.zh: 别责怪他，他已经尽力了。
责怪.en: Don't blame him; he already did his best.

责怪.zh: 这件事不能全责怪你一个人。
责怪.en: This can't be blamed entirely on you alone.

责怪.zh: 她责怪老公没有提前告诉她。
责怪.en: She blamed her husband for not telling her in advance.

责怪.zh: 如果出了问题，大家都会互相责怪。
责怪.en: If something goes wrong, everyone will blame each other.

责怪.zh: 我知道错了，你就别责怪我了。
责怪.en: I know I was wrong, so please don't blame me.

尽早.en: You need to finish your homework as early as possible.

尽早.zh: 医生建议他尽早去医院检查。
尽早.en: The doctor advised him to go to the hospital for a check-up as soon as possible.

尽早.zh: 为了赶上飞机，我们得尽早出发。
尽早.en: To catch the plane, we have to depart as early as possible.

尽早.zh: 如果你有什么问题，请尽早告诉我。
尽早.en: If you have any questions, please tell me as soon as possible.

尽早.zh: 他们希望尽早达成协议，以免夜长梦多。
尽早.en: They hope to reach an agreement as soon as possible to avoid further complications.

对照.en: Please revise the translation against the original text.

对照.zh: 把这两个方案放在一起对照一下。
对照.en: Put these two plans together and compare them.

对照.zh: 对照去年的数据，今年进步了很多。
对照.en: Compared with last year's data, this year has improved a lot.

对照.zh: 你可以对照说明书来安装这个设备。
对照.en: You can refer to the manual to install this device.

对照.zh: 如果拿这两张照片对照，就能发现不同之处。
对照.en: If you compare these two photos, you can spot the differences.

纳入.zh: 这个建议被纳入了计划。
纳入.en: This suggestion was incorporated into the plan.

纳入.zh: 公司决定把新业务纳入管理体系。
纳入.en: The company decided to incorporate the new business into the management system.

纳入.zh: 我们要把这些细节纳入考虑范围。
纳入.en: We need to take these details into consideration.

纳入.zh: 政府准备将该项目纳入今年的预算。
纳入.en: The government plans to include this project in this year's budget.

纳入.zh: 如果通过投票，这项条款就会被纳入法律。
纳入.en: If it passes the vote, this clause will be incorporated into the law.

辨认.zh: 你能辨认出这是谁的字吗？
辨认.en: Can you identify whose handwriting this is?

辨认.zh: 在黑暗中很难辨认方向。
辨认.en: It's hard to tell directions in the dark.

辨认.zh: 警察让目击者辨认嫌疑人。
辨认.en: The police asked the witness to identify the suspect.

辨认.zh: 经过仔细辨认，他才认出那是他老朋友。
辨认.en: After careful examination, he recognized that it was his old friend.

辨认.zh: 虽然照片很模糊，但我还能辨认出她的样子。
辨认.en: Although the photo is blurry, I can still make out her appearance.

备忘录.en: Did you remember to write the memo?

备忘录.zh: 我记在备忘录上了，不会忘的。
备忘录.en: I wrote it in my memo, so I won't forget.

备忘录.zh: 请把会议要点整理成一份备忘录。
备忘录.en: Please compile the meeting key points into a memo.

备忘录.zh: 他发了一份备忘录提醒大家注意截止日期。
备忘录.en: He sent a memo reminding everyone about the deadline.

备忘录.zh: 如果领导同意，我会把备忘录发给所有人。
备忘录.en: If the boss agrees, I'll send the memo to everyone.

奖项.zh: 这部电影赢得了好几个重要奖项。
奖项.en: This movie won several important awards.

奖项.zh: 公司每年都会设立新的奖项鼓励员工。
奖项.en: The company sets up new awards every year to encourage employees.

奖项.zh: 这个奖项是颁发给最有贡献的员工的。
奖项.en: This award is given to the most contributing employee.

奖项.zh: 虽然他没拿到奖项，但他并不在意。
奖项.en: Although he didn't get the award, he doesn't care.

家教.zh: 她周末请了家教来补数学。
家教.en: She hired a tutor on weekends to help with math.

家教.zh: 现在的家教一个小时要两百块。
家教.en: Nowadays, a tutor costs two hundred yuan per hour.

家教.zh: 他做家教已经三年了，经验丰富。
家教.en: He has been tutoring for three years and is very experienced.

家教.zh: 因为成绩不好，妈妈给他请了一个家教。
家教.en: Because his grades were poor, his mother hired a tutor for him.

天性.en: Children love to play; it's their nature.

天性.zh: 他天性善良，总爱帮助别人。
天性.en: He is kind by nature and always likes to help others.

天性.zh: 猫天性好奇，对什么东西都想闻一闻。
天性.en: Cats are naturally curious; they want to sniff everything.

天性.zh: 虽然她天性害羞，但在朋友面前还是很放得开。
天性.en: Although she is shy by nature, she is still very relaxed around friends.

天性.zh: 我觉得冒险不是他的天性，他更喜欢安稳的生活。
天性.en: I think adventure is not in his nature; he prefers a stable life.

悬崖.en: There's a cliff ahead, be careful.

悬崖.zh: 他们站在悬崖边上拍照。
悬崖.en: They stood on the edge of the cliff to take photos.

悬崖.zh: 车子差一点就掉下悬崖了。
悬崖.en: The car almost fell off the cliff.

悬崖.zh: 他看悬崖下面，腿都软了。
悬崖.en: He looked down the cliff and his legs went weak.

悬崖.zh: 登山时我们绕过了一个很陡的悬崖。
悬崖.en: While climbing, we went around a very steep cliff.

埋怨.en: He always complains that the salary is too low.

埋怨.zh: 她埋怨老板没给她涨工资。
埋怨.en: She complained that the boss didn't give her a raise.

埋怨.zh: 出了事不要互相埋怨，先想办法解决。
埋怨.en: Don't blame each other when something happens; first think of a way to solve it.

埋怨.zh: 因为下雨，他埋怨天气预报不准。
埋怨.en: Because it rained, he complained that the weather forecast was inaccurate.

冷战.zh: 他们俩在冷战，谁也不理谁。
冷战.en: The two of them are in a cold war; they ignore each other.

冷战.zh: 冷战持续了好几天，家里气氛很尴尬。
冷战.en: The cold war lasted several days, and the atmosphere at home was awkward.

冷战.zh: 我不想跟你冷战，我们好好谈谈行吗？
冷战.en: I don't want to have a cold war with you; can we talk it out?

冷战.zh: 冷战时期，美苏两国关系非常紧张。
冷战.en: During the Cold War, the relationship between the US and the Soviet Union was very tense.

冷战.zh: 每次吵架后他们都冷战，这次我想主动和好。
冷战.en: Every time they argue, they go into a cold war; this time I want to make up first.

住户.en: The new resident is very friendly.

住户.zh: 小区住户们都在抱怨停车位不够。
住户.en: The residents in the community are all complaining about insufficient parking spaces.

住户.zh: 物业挨家挨户通知住户交水电费。
住户.en: The property management goes door to door to notify residents to pay utility bills.

住户.zh: 因为疫情，很多住户都待在家里不出门。
住户.en: Because of the pandemic, many residents stay at home and don't go out.

轨迹.en: The trajectory of stars is very beautiful.

轨迹.zh: 他的人生轨迹发生了巨大变化。
轨迹.en: The trajectory of his life has changed dramatically.

轨迹.zh: 手机可以记录你的运动轨迹。
轨迹.en: Your phone can record your movement轨迹.

轨迹.zh: 科学家正在研究这颗彗星的运行轨迹。
轨迹.en: Scientists are studying the orbit of this comet.

轨迹.zh: 自从毕业以后，我们俩的轨迹就完全不同了。
轨迹.en: Since graduation, our paths have been completely different.

指点.zh: 他经常指点我该怎么学英语。
指点.en: He often gives me pointers on how to learn English.

指点.zh: 爷爷喜欢指点别人下棋。
指点.en: Grandpa likes to give advice to others when playing chess.

指点.zh: 在老师的指点下，我的画进步了很多。
指点.en: With the teacher's guidance, my painting has improved a lot.

指点.zh: 你要是迷路了，可以找路人指点方向。
指点.en: If you get lost, you can ask a passerby for directions.

行情.en: How is the housing market recently?

行情.zh: 他做了十年的股票行情分析。
行情.en: He has been analyzing stock market trends for ten years.

行情.zh: 现在猪肉行情不太好，价格跌了很多。
行情.en: The pork market is not doing well right now; prices have dropped a lot.

行情.zh: 你得先了解行情，再决定要不要投资。
行情.en: You need to understand the market first before deciding whether to invest.

行情.zh: 我打听了一下二手车的行情，比想象中便宜。
行情.en: I asked about the market for used cars; it's cheaper than I imagined.

整洁.zh: 保持办公室整洁很重要。
整洁.en: Keeping the office clean and tidy is important.

整洁.zh: 这家餐厅虽然小，但非常整洁。
整洁.en: This restaurant is small but very clean and tidy.

整洁.zh: 他穿得总是很整洁，给人印象很好。
整洁.en: He always dresses neatly, giving a good impression.

整洁.zh: 孩子们把教室打扫得干干净净，非常整洁。
整洁.en: The children cleaned the classroom thoroughly, making it very tidy.

过失.zh: 他因为工作过失被开除了。
过失.en: He was fired due to a work error.

过失.zh: 这次事故不是你的过失，别太自责。
过失.en: This accident is not your fault; don't blame yourself too much.

过失.zh: 公司领导承认了管理上的过失。
过失.en: The company leaders admitted to management errors.

过失.zh: 在比赛中，他一个小小的过失导致了全队失败。
过失.en: In the game, one small mistake on his part led to the whole team's defeat.

先锋.en: He is the pioneer of our team.

先锋.zh: 在这次探险中，先锋队最先出发。
先锋.en: In this expedition, the vanguard set off first.

先锋.zh: 虽然年纪不大，但他已经是科技领域的先锋了。
先锋.en: Although young, he is already a pioneer in the tech field.

先锋.zh: 作为行业的先锋，他们一直引领创新。
先锋.en: As pioneers in the industry, they have been leading innovation.

先锋.zh: 先锋精神就是敢于第一个尝试。
先锋.en: The pioneer spirit is about daring to be the first to try.

常人.en: Ordinary people all know this principle.

常人.zh: 这件事对常人来说太难了。
常人.en: This matter is too difficult for ordinary people.

常人.zh: 虽然他是明星，但生活跟常人一样。
常人.en: Although he is a star, his life is the same as ordinary people.

常人.zh: 常人的想法往往比较简单直接。
常人.en: Ordinary people's thoughts are often simple and straightforward.

常人.zh: 这种痛苦非常人所能忍受。
常人.en: This kind of pain is not something ordinary people can endure.

搅拌.zh: 做蛋糕时要把鸡蛋和面粉搅拌均匀。
搅拌.en: When making a cake, you need to mix eggs and flour evenly.

搅拌.zh: 先把调料倒进去，然后搅拌五分钟。
搅拌.en: First pour in the seasoning, then stir for five minutes.

饲料.en: This feed is for the pigs.

饲料.zh: 由于饲料涨价，养殖成本提高了。
饲料.en: Due to the rise in feed prices, farming costs have increased.
This type of feed is well-balanced in nutrition.

饲料.zh: 鸡饲料里不能加太多盐。
饲料.en: You can't add too much salt to chicken feed.

同等.zh: 男女应该享有同等的权利。
同等.en: Men and women should enjoy equal rights.

同等.zh: 虽然学历不同，但能力同等重要。
同等.en: Although education levels differ, ability is equally important.

同等.zh: 同等条件下，经验更受重视。
同等.en: Under equal conditions, experience is more valued.

同等.zh: 他们给的待遇是同等水平的。
同等.en: The treatment they offer is at the same level.

极力.en: I strongly recommend that you go.

极力.zh: 尽管困难，她还是极力坚持。
极力.en: Despite the difficulties, she tried her best to persist.
The boss tried very hard to keep him.

极力.zh: 为了完成任务，他极力争取支持。
极力.en: In order to complete the task, he did his utmost to gain support.

儒家.en: Confucian thought has a profound influence.

儒家.zh: 虽然时代变了，儒家文化仍有价值。
儒家.en: Although times have changed, Confucian culture still has value.

儒家.zh: 儒家学说在古代中国占主导地位。
儒家.en: Confucian doctrine dominated in ancient China.

除外.zh: 周日除外，我们每天都开门。
除外.en: Except for Sundays, we are open every day.

除外.zh: 所有商品，特价品除外，都打八折。
除外.en: All products, except for special offers, are 20% off.
Except for the boss, no one dares to speak.

除外.zh: 我什么都能吃，香菜除外。
除外.en: I can eat anything except cilantro.

除外.zh: 考试时，字典除外，其他东西都不能带。
除外.en: During the exam, except for a dictionary, nothing else is allowed.

拣.en: Help me pick through the vegetables.

拣.zh: 从这些衣服里拣几件好的。
拣.en: Pick out a few good ones from these clothes.
Pick the important ones to say first.

拣.zh: 他慢慢拣出需要的零件。
拣.en: He slowly picked out the parts he needed.

递交.en: Please submit the application to the front desk.

递交.zh: 昨天，我递交了所有材料。
递交.en: Yesterday, I submitted all the materials.

递交.zh: 经过修改后，我们递交了最终方案。
递交.en: After revisions, we submitted the final plan.
Remember to sign when submitting documents.

倒塌.zh: 地震后很多房子都倒塌了。
倒塌.en: After the earthquake, many houses collapsed.

倒塌.zh: 因为暴雨，那座桥突然倒塌了。
倒塌.en: Because of the heavy rain, that bridge suddenly collapsed.

倒塌.zh: 要不是工人及时加固，这堵墙早就倒塌了。
倒塌.en: If the workers hadn't reinforced it in time, this wall would have collapsed long ago.

倒塌.zh: 仓库倒塌压坏了里面的货物。
倒塌.en: The warehouse collapsed and crushed the goods inside.

附属.en: This is an affiliated primary school.

附属.zh: 这所大学有好几所附属医院。
附属.en: This university has several affiliated hospitals.

附属.zh: 虽然只是附属机构，但他们的工作很重要。
附属.en: Although it's just an affiliated institution, their work is very important.

附属.zh: 这个附属文件需要签字。
附属.en: This attached document needs to be signed.

附属.zh: 公司把原来的部门变成了附属子公司。
附属.en: The company turned the original department into a subsidiary.

屈服.zh: 在压力面前他选择了屈服。
屈服.en: He chose to yield in the face of pressure.

屈服.zh: 虽然敌人威胁他，但他没有屈服。
屈服.en: Although the enemy threatened him, he did not yield.

屈服.zh: 她为了家人不得不向现实屈服。
屈服.en: She had to yield to reality for her family.

捍卫.zh: 他勇敢地捍卫了自己的权利。
即使没人支持，他依然捍卫真理。
捍卫.en: Even if no one supports him, he still defends the truth.

捍卫.zh: 军人誓死捍卫国家领土。
捍卫.en: Soldiers swear to defend the nation's territory.

捍卫.zh: 她站出来捍卫那些无法发声的人。
捍卫.en: She stood up to defend those who cannot speak.

点火.en: He struck a match to light a fire.

点火.zh: 因为风大，点火时一定要小心。
点火.en: Because it's windy, be careful when lighting a fire.

点火.zh: 这个装置可以自动点火。
他们在野外露营时用打火机点火。
点火.en: When camping in the wild, they used a lighter to start a fire.

订购.zh: 他在网上订购了一台冰箱。
如果你现在订购，可以享受折扣。
订购.en: If you order now, you can enjoy a discount.

订购.zh: 公司每个月订购大量办公用品。
订购.en: The company orders a large amount of office supplies every month.

订购.zh: 我们已经在餐厅订购了明天的午餐。
订购.en: We have already ordered tomorrow's lunch at the restaurant.

急于.en: He is in a hurry to go home.

急于.zh: 别急于做决定，先考虑清楚。
急于.en: Don't be eager to make a decision; think it over first.

急于.zh: 虽然他很急于成功，但还是要慢慢来。
急于.en: Although he is eager to succeed, he still needs to take it slow.

急于.zh: 她急于证明自己的能力。
急于.en: She is anxious to prove her ability.

急于.zh: 老板急于找到解决问题的办法。
急于.en: The boss is eager to find a solution to the problem.

不算.en: That matter is not considered his fault.

不算.zh: 虽然有点贵，但也不算太离谱。
不算.en: Although it's a bit expensive, it's not really too outrageous.

不算.zh: 这点钱不算多，你别客气。
不算.en: This amount of money is not much; don't be polite.

不算.zh: 他考了八十分，在班里不算差。
不算.en: He scored 80, which is not bad in the class.

雪山.en: We're going to see the snowy mountain.

雪山.zh: 远处的雪山在阳光下闪闪发光。
雪山.en: The distant snowy mountain sparkles in the sunlight.

雪山.zh: 虽然很冷，但雪山的美景值得一看。
雪山.en: Although it's very cold, the beautiful view of the snowy mountain is worth seeing.

雪山.zh: 这座雪山是登山者的梦想。
雪山.en: This snowy mountain is a dream for climbers.

雪山.zh: 从山顶望去，雪山连绵不断。
雪山.en: Looking from the mountaintop, the snowy mountains stretch endlessly.

毫不犹豫.zh: 她毫不犹豫地跳进水里救人。
毫不犹豫.en: She jumped into the water to save someone without hesitation.

毫不犹豫.zh: 听到求救声，他毫不犹豫冲了出去。
毫不犹豫.en: Upon hearing the cry for help, he rushed out without hesitation.

毫不犹豫.zh: 我毫不犹豫选择了这份工作。
毫不犹豫.en: I chose this job without hesitation.

毫不犹豫.zh: 在关键时刻，他毫不犹豫做出了决定。
毫不犹豫.en: At the critical moment, he made a decision without hesitation.

沸腾.en: The water is boiling; turn off the heat.

沸腾.zh: 听到这个消息，整个会场都沸腾了。
沸腾.en: Hearing this news, the entire venue erupted.

沸腾.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但我的热血在沸腾。
沸腾.en: Although it's very cold, my blood is boiling.

沸腾.zh: 比赛一开始，观众席就立刻沸腾起来。
沸腾.en: As soon as the game started, the stands immediately burst into excitement.

沸腾.zh: 他演讲的时候，台下掌声不断，气氛都沸腾了。
沸腾.en: During his speech, the applause from the audience was nonstop, and the atmosphere was electrified.

满怀.zh: 他满怀信心地走进了考场。
满怀.en: He walked into the exam room full of confidence.

满怀.zh: 她满怀希望，觉得这次一定能成功。
满怀.en: She was full of hope, feeling that she would surely succeed this time.

满怀.zh: 面对未来，我们满怀期待。
满怀.en: Facing the future, we are full of anticipation.

满怀.zh: 虽然遇到了困难，但他依旧满怀热情。
满怀.en: Although he encountered difficulties, he still remained full of enthusiasm.

满怀.zh: 我满怀感激地收下了这份礼物。
满怀.en: I accepted this gift with a heart full of gratitude.

君子.zh: 他是个君子，从不背后说人坏话。
君子.en: He is a gentleman; he never speaks ill of others behind their backs.
A gentleman's word is his bond.

君子.zh: 在这种事上，他表现得很有君子风度。
君子.en: In this matter, he behaved with gentlemanly grace.

君子.zh: 虽然两人有矛盾，但他还是以君子之礼相待。
君子.en: Even though they had a conflict, he still treated him with gentlemanly courtesy.

君子.zh: 真正的君子不会因为利益而违背原则。
君子.en: A true gentleman will not violate his principles for the sake of profit.

势头.zh: 这场雨势头不小，估计要下很久。
势头.en: This rain is quite heavy; it's probably going to last a long time.

势头.zh: 他的事业发展势头很好，蒸蒸日上。
势头.en: His career is developing with good momentum, growing day by day.

势头.zh: 我们要抓住这个好势头，继续努力。
势头.en: We need to seize this good momentum and keep working hard.

势头.zh: 虽然对手来势汹汹，但我方的势头更猛。
势头.en: Although the opponent came fiercely, our momentum was even stronger.

势头.zh: 最近这股创业的势头很旺，很多人都辞职了。
势头.en: Recently, this trend of starting businesses is very strong; many people have quit their jobs.

拎.zh: 他拎着两袋水果上楼了。
拎.en: He carried two bags of fruit upstairs.

拎.zh: 你帮我拎一下这个箱子，太重了。
拎.en: Help me carry this suitcase; it's too heavy.

拎.zh: 她出门时只拎了一个小包。
拎.en: She only took a small bag when she went out.

拎.zh: 他一手拎着公文包，一手打电话。
拎.en: He was carrying a briefcase in one hand and talking on the phone in the other.

拎.zh: 超市打折，她拎了一大堆东西回来。
拎.en: The supermarket had a sale, so she carried back a whole bunch of stuff.

小心翼翼.zh: 他小心翼翼地端着那杯热茶。
小心翼翼.en: He carefully held that cup of hot tea.

小心翼翼.zh: 过马路时，她小心翼翼地看着两边。
小心翼翼.en: When crossing the street, she carefully looked both ways.

小心翼翼.zh: 他小心翼翼地拆开礼物包装，生怕弄坏。
小心翼翼.en: He carefully unwrapped the gift, afraid of damaging it.

小心翼翼.zh: 医生小心翼翼地处理伤口，生怕病人疼。
小心翼翼.en: The doctor carefully treated the wound, afraid of causing the patient pain.

小心翼翼.zh: 虽然时间很紧，他还是小心翼翼地完成了所有步骤。
小心翼翼.en: Although time was tight, he still carefully completed all the steps.

风采.zh: 她在舞台上的风采令人难忘。
风采.en: Her elegance on stage was unforgettable.

风采.zh: 这位老教授风采依旧，说话很有力量。
风采.en: This old professor still has his charm; his speech is very powerful.

风采.zh: 比赛中，选手们展示了各自的风采。
风采.en: During the competition, the contestants each showed their own style.

风采.zh: 他穿上西装后，整个人都显得很有风采。
风采.en: After putting on a suit, he looked very elegant.

风采.zh: 我们要保持积极向上的精神风貌，展现当代青年的风采。
风采.en: We need to maintain a positive and uplifting spirit, showcasing the style of contemporary youth.

插手.zh: 这件事你别插手，我自己能处理。
插手.en: Don't meddle in this; I can handle it myself.

插手.zh: 他总爱插手别人的家务事。
插手.en: He always likes to interfere in other people's family matters.

插手.zh: 如果没人插手，这个项目早就完了。
插手.en: If no one had intervened, this project would have been finished long ago.

插手.zh: 这是他们公司内部的事，我们不好插手。
插手.en: This is an internal matter of their company; we shouldn't get involved.

插手.zh: 领导插手之后，整个方案都变了样。
插手.en: After the leader got involved, the whole plan changed completely.

直奔.en: After school, he went straight home.

直奔.zh: 下了飞机，我们直奔宾馆。
直奔.en: After getting off the plane, we went straight to the hotel.
Without a word, he went straight to the point.

直奔.zh: 早上八点，她准时出门，直奔公司。
直奔.en: At eight in the morning, she left on time and went straight to the company.

直奔.zh: 听说那家店打折，她们直奔过去抢购。
直奔.en: Having heard that store had a sale, they went straight there to snap up bargains.

合伙.zh: 他们合伙开了一家小餐馆。
合伙.en: They partnered to open a small restaurant.

合伙.zh: 你们两个合伙骗我，是不是？
合伙.en: You two teamed up to trick me, didn't you?

合伙.zh: 我和朋友合伙做生意，但没成功。
合伙.en: I went into business with a friend as partners, but it didn't work out.

合伙.zh: 三个人合伙买了一套房，每人出一部分钱。
合伙.en: Three people chipped in together to buy a house, each paying a portion.

合伙.zh: 他们合伙算计我，想让我出丑。
合伙.en: They conspired together to set me up, trying to make me look bad.

前台.zh: 你去前台问一下房卡的事。
前台.en: Go ask the front desk about the room card.

前台.zh: 我们到了酒店，先去前台办入住。
前台.en: We arrived at the hotel, first go to the front desk to check in.

前台.zh: 前台说下午三点才能进房间。
前台.en: The front desk said we can't enter the room until 3 PM.

前台.zh: 你把行李先寄存在前台吧，这样方便逛街。
前台.en: Leave your luggage at the front desk first, it'll be easier to go shopping.

前台.zh: 他正在前台跟服务员说需要换房间，因为太吵了。
前台.en: He is at the front desk telling the staff he needs to change rooms because it's too noisy.

全心全意.zh: 他全心全意支持我的决定。
她全心全意照顾生病的母亲。
全心全意.en: She takes care of her sick mother wholeheartedly.

全心全意.zh: 只要全心全意去做，事情总会成功的。
全心全意.en: As long as you do it wholeheartedly, things will eventually succeed.

全心全意.zh: 他全心全意地爱着那个女孩，但对方却并不在意。
全心全意.en: He loved that girl wholeheartedly, but she didn't care.

全心全意.zh: 我打算全心全意投入这个项目，争取年底前完成。
全心全意.en: I plan to devote myself wholeheartedly to this project and aim to finish it before the end of the year.

驾驭.zh: 新手很难驾驭这种大型摩托车。
驾驭.en: Beginners find it hard to handle this kind of large motorcycle.

驾驭.zh: 她能够轻松驾驭各种复杂的演讲场合。
驾驭.en: She can easily handle all kinds of complex speaking situations.

驾驭.zh: 虽然天气不好，但他还是稳稳地驾驭了这艘船。
驾驭.en: Even though the weather was bad, he still steered the boat steadily.

驾驭.zh: 学会驾驭自己的情绪对每个人来说都很重要。
驾驭.en: Learning to control your own emotions is important for everyone.

共鸣.zh: 他的演讲引起了大家的共鸣。
这首歌让我产生强烈的共鸣。
共鸣.en: This song strongly resonates with me.

共鸣.zh: 我们在这件事上很容易产生共鸣。
共鸣.en: We easily resonate on this matter.

共鸣.zh: 她的经历和我的很像，所以特别有共鸣。
共鸣.en: Her experience is very similar to mine, so I especially resonate with it.

共鸣.zh: 那部电影讲述了一个平凡家庭的故事，让观众深感共鸣。
共鸣.en: That movie tells the story of an ordinary family, deeply resonating with the audience.

假冒.en: He bought a counterfeit designer bag.

假冒.zh: 这家店卖假冒化妆品，被查了。
假冒.en: This store was caught selling fake cosmetics.

假冒.zh: 假冒身份证是违法的行为。
假冒.en: Using a fake ID is illegal.

假冒.zh: 网上有很多假冒的保健品，你要小心。
假冒.en: There are a lot of counterfeit health products online, you need to be careful.

假冒.zh: 他假冒警察去骗钱，最后被抓了。
假冒.en: He pretended to be a police officer to scam money, and was finally caught.

乞丐.en: That beggar is sitting by the roadside.
There's a beggar begging on the street.
He gave some change to the beggar.

乞丐.zh: 很多乞丐其实并不是真的需要帮助。
乞丐.en: Many beggars actually don't really need help.

乞丐.zh: 在地铁站经常能看到一些年老的乞丐。
乞丐.en: You can often see some elderly beggars in subway stations.

高空.en: Working at high altitude is very dangerous.

高空.zh: 飞机在高空飞行时很稳定。
高空.en: The plane is very stable when flying at high altitude.

高空.zh: 高空抛物是违法的，你知道吗？
高空.en: Throwing things from height is illegal, you know?

高空.zh: 他喜欢高空跳伞那种刺激的感觉。
高空.en: He loves the thrill of high-altitude skydiving.

高空.zh: 高空缆车上的风景特别美，但恐高的人会害怕。
高空.en: The view from the high-altitude cable car is especially beautiful, but people afraid of heights might be scared.

敬请.zh: 敬请期待我们的新产品。
敬请.en: Please look forward to our new product.

敬请.zh: 活动将在下周五举行，敬请光临。
敬请.en: The event will be held next Friday, please come.

敬请.zh: 详细内容请看附件，敬请查阅。
敬请.en: Please see the attachment for details, kindly check.

敬请.zh: 本店即将开业，敬请各位新老顾客多多支持。
敬请.en: Our store is about to open, please kindly support us, both new and old customers.

敬请.zh: 如果您有任何疑问，敬请随时与我们联系。
敬请.en: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

放纵.en: You can't be too indulgent with children.

放纵.zh: 他今天放纵自己大吃一顿。
放纵.en: He indulged himself in a big meal today.

放纵.zh: 放纵的生活对健康不好。
放纵.en: An indulgent lifestyle is bad for health.

放纵.zh: 她决定周末放纵一下，什么工作都不管。
放纵.en: She decided to let loose this weekend and ignore all work.

放纵.zh: 父母如果过分放纵孩子，反而会害了他们。
放纵.en: If parents over-indulge their children, it will actually harm them.

申报.zh: 你需要申报这些物品吗？
申报.en: Do you need to declare these items?

申报.zh: 入境时一定要如实申报。
申报.en: You must declare truthfully when entering the country.

申报.zh: 公司每年都要申报纳税。
申报.en: The company has to file tax returns every year.

申报.zh: 他忘记申报收入，被罚了款。
申报.en: He forgot to declare his income and was fined.

申报.zh: 出国旅游带太多现金必须向海关申报。
申报.en: If you bring too much cash when traveling abroad, you must declare it to customs.

冒充.en: He was caught pretending to be a policeman.

冒充.zh: 有人冒充银行客服打电话骗钱，大家要小心。
冒充.en: Some people impersonate bank customer service to call and scam money, everyone should be careful.

冒充.zh: 别冒充专家，不懂就是不懂。
冒充.en: Don't pretend to be an expert; if you don't know, you don't know.

冒充.zh: 他虽然冒充了富二代，但最后还是被揭穿了。
冒充.en: Although he pretended to be a rich second-generation, he was eventually exposed.
He used fake documents to impersonate a student.

流失.en: The company's brain drain is serious.

流失.zh: 因为工资太低，很多员工流失到其他公司去了。
流失.en: Because the salary is too low, many employees have been lost to other companies.

流失.zh: 水土流失让这片地没法种庄稼了。
流失.en: Soil erosion makes this land unable to grow crops.

流失.zh: 如果再不改善工作环境，优秀人才会继续流失。
流失.en: If the work environment is not improved, excellent talents will continue to drain away.
Moisture loss is bad for the skin.

高雅.zh: 这家餐厅的装修风格很高雅，适合约会。
高雅.en: The decoration style of this restaurant is very elegant, suitable for a date.

高雅.zh: 虽然价格贵，但确实很高雅。
高雅.en: Although the price is expensive, it is indeed very elegant.

高雅.zh: 他喜欢高雅的艺术，比如古典音乐和芭蕾舞。
高雅.en: He likes elegant arts, such as classical music and ballet.

来源于.zh: 他说的消息来源于一个可靠的内部人士。
来源于.en: The news he told came from a reliable insider.

来源于.zh: 很多成语来源于古代故事。
来源于.en: Many idioms come from ancient stories.

来源于.zh: 因为他的灵感来源于生活，所以作品特别真实。
来源于.en: Because his inspiration comes from life, his works are especially real.

来源于.zh: 这个想法来源于一次旅行。
来源于.en: This idea came from a trip.

事态.zh: 我们需要尽快控制事态，避免更多人受伤。
事态.en: We need to control the situation as soon as possible to avoid more injuries.

事态.zh: 事态的发展超出了我们的预料。
事态.en: The development of the situation exceeded our expectations.

事态.zh: 如果事态继续恶化，政府可能会采取更强硬的措施。
事态.en: If the situation continues to worsen, the government may take tougher measures.

驱动.zh: 这个软件是由人工智能技术驱动的。
驱动.en: This software is driven by artificial intelligence technology.
The car is driven by the engine.

驱动.zh: 因为利益的驱动，很多人选择了冒险。
驱动.en: Driven by interests, many people chose to take risks.

驱动.zh: 内在驱动比外在压力更有效。
驱动.en: Internal drive is more effective than external pressure.

恶性.en: He has a malignant brain tumor.

恶性.zh: 这种恶性循环让穷人越来越穷。
恶性.en: This vicious cycle makes the poor get poorer.

恶性.zh: 恶性竞争对行业发展不利。
恶性.en: Vicious competition is harmful to industry development.

恶性.zh: 如果不及早治疗，这个肿瘤可能会变成恶性。
恶性.en: If not treated early, this tumor may become malignant.

担当.zh: 作为领导，他应该担当起这个责任。
担当.en: As a leader, he should take on this responsibility.
If there is a problem, you should bear it.

担当.zh: 既然答应了，就一定要担当到底。
担当.en: Since you promised, you must see it through.
He doesn't dare to take responsibility.

差错.zh: 这个实验必须非常小心，一有差错就前功尽弃。
差错.en: This experiment must be very careful; once there is a mistake, all previous efforts are wasted.

差错.zh: 因为计算上的差错，整个项目都延期了。
差错.en: Because of a computational error, the entire project was delayed.

罐头.zh: 超市里的水果罐头正在打折，很便宜。
罐头.en: The canned fruits in the supermarket are on sale, very cheap.

罐头.zh: 打开罐头之前要检查有没有漏气。
罐头.en: Before opening the can, you should check if there is any leakage.

罐头.zh: 虽然罐头方便，但新鲜蔬菜更健康。
罐头.en: Although canned food is convenient, fresh vegetables are healthier.
This can of food has expired.

风度.zh: 虽然输了比赛，但他依然保持了风度。
风度.en: Although he lost the match, he still maintained his composure.

风度.zh: 她的风度让人印象深刻。
风度.en: Her elegance left a deep impression on people.

风度.zh: 不管遇到什么事，他都能保持风度。
风度.en: No matter what happens, he can always keep his grace.

风度.zh: 这位老师说话很有风度，学生都很喜欢。
风度.en: This teacher speaks with such charm that the students all like him.

比不上.zh: 你的厨艺比不上我妈做的菜。
比不上.en: Your cooking can't compare to the dishes my mom makes.

比不上.zh: 虽然他很努力，但还是比不上天赋选手。
比不上.en: Although he works hard, he still can't match up to talented players.

比不上.zh: 这个品牌的质量比不上那个。
比不上.en: The quality of this brand can't compare to that one.

比不上.zh: 现在的手机功能，以前的根本比不上。
比不上.en: The features of today's phones are something the old ones simply can't compete with.

救治.en: The doctor did his best to treat the patient.

救治.zh: 他被及时救治，现在已经脱离危险。
救治.en: He received timely treatment and is now out of danger.

救治.zh: 因为救治及时，他的命保住了。
救治.en: Because the treatment was timely, his life was saved.

救治.zh: 救援队正在救治灾区伤员。
救治.en: The rescue team is treating the injured in the disaster area.

救治.zh: 这种病很难救治，要早点发现。
救治.en: This illness is hard to treat; it needs to be detected early.

方向盘.en: He gripped the steering wheel tightly.

方向盘.zh: 开车的时候不能松开方向盘。
方向盘.en: You can't let go of the steering wheel while driving.

方向盘.zh: 她一边打电话一边转方向盘，太危险了。
方向盘.en: She was turning the steering wheel while on the phone—too dangerous.
This car's steering wheel is very light.

方向盘.zh: 新手司机容易把方向盘打得太多。
方向盘.en: New drivers tend to over-turn the steering wheel.

板块.en: The Earth has multiple tectonic plates.

板块.zh: 这个板块的股票最近涨得很好。
板块.en: Stocks in this sector have been rising well recently.

板块.zh: 由于板块碰撞，这里发生了地震。
板块.en: Due to plate collision, an earthquake occurred here.
There's an entertainment section in the news.

板块.zh: 公司分为好几个业务板块。
板块.en: The company is divided into several business segments.

接纳.zh: 这个学校每年接纳很多新生。
接纳.en: This school admits many new students every year.

接纳.zh: 虽然他有缺点，但大家还是接纳了他。
接纳.en: Although he has flaws, people still accepted him.

接纳.zh: 她很难接纳别人的批评。
接纳.en: She finds it hard to accept criticism from others.

接纳.zh: 这个组织接纳了来自不同国家的人。
接纳.en: This organization accepts people from different countries.

归属.en: I found a sense of belonging.

归属.zh: 这个问题的归属还不清楚。
归属.en: The attribution of this issue is still unclear.

归属.zh: 如果找不到归属，人会觉得不安。
归属.en: If you can't find a sense of belonging, you'll feel uneasy.

归属.zh: 这件艺术品的归属是博物馆。
归属.en: This artwork belongs to the museum.

归属.zh: 他对这个团队有很强的归属感。
归属.en: He has a strong sense of belonging to this team.

动感.en: His dance moves are full of energy.

动感.zh: 虽然音乐很动感，但他跳得不太好。
动感.en: Although the music is dynamic, he doesn't dance very well.

动感.zh: 这个视频的动感效果很棒。
动感.en: The dynamic effect of this video is amazing.

动感.zh: 她喜欢动感的运动，比如跑步。
动感.en: She enjoys dynamic exercises, like running.

棘手.zh: 他遇到了一件棘手的事情。
因为情况复杂，所以处理起来很棘手。
棘手.en: Because the situation is complex, it's thorny to handle.

棘手.zh: 棘手的问题需要慢慢解决。
棘手.en: Tricky problems need to be solved slowly.

尖锐.zh: 这把刀非常尖锐，小心使用。
尖锐.en: This knife is very sharp; use it carefully.

尖锐.zh: 虽然他的话很尖锐，但都是为了我好。
尖锐.en: Although his words were harsh, they were all for my own good.

尖锐.zh: 她尖锐地批评了公司的制度。
尖锐.en: She sharply criticized the company's system.

尖锐.zh: 尖锐的声音让人不舒服。

休克.zh: 他突然休克了，幸好医生在旁边。
休克.en: He suddenly went into shock; luckily, a doctor was nearby.

休克.zh: 那次事故后，他因为失血过多而休克了。
休克.en: After that accident, he went into shock due to excessive blood loss.

休克.zh: 如果病人休克，要立刻叫救护车。
休克.en: If a patient goes into shock, call an ambulance immediately.

休克.zh: 她看到那个场面直接休克过去了，真吓人。
休克.en: She went into shock on seeing that scene—it was really scary.

休克.zh: 休克的时候身体会失去知觉，需要及时抢救。
休克.en: When in shock, the body loses consciousness and needs timely rescue.

宽松.zh: 这件衣服很宽松，穿着舒服。
宽松.en: This piece of clothing is very loose and comfortable to wear.

宽松.zh: 学校的政策最近变得比较宽松了。
宽松.en: The school's policies have become relatively relaxed recently.

宽松.zh: 虽然规则很宽松，但大家还是自觉遵守。
宽松.en: Although the rules are relaxed, everyone still follows them voluntarily.

宽松.zh: 他喜欢穿宽松的裤子，这样活动方便。
宽松.en: He likes to wear loose pants, as they make moving around easy.

宽松.zh: 父母对我的管束越来越宽松了，我也长大了。
宽松.en: My parents' control over me has been getting looser, and I've grown up too.

削弱.zh: 这次失败削弱了他们的信心。
长期不锻炼会削弱你的体力。
削弱.en: Not exercising for a long time will weaken your physical strength.

削弱.zh: 因为天气恶劣，军队的实力被大大削弱了。
削弱.en: Because of the bad weather, the army's strength was greatly weakened.

削弱.zh: 这种药物可能会削弱免疫系统的功能。
削弱.en: This medication might weaken the function of the immune system.

削弱.zh: 如果公司裁员，团队的凝聚力就会被削弱。
削弱.en: If the company lays off staff, the team's cohesion will be weakened.

虔诚.zh: 他是一个虔诚的佛教徒。
她每天虔诚地祈祷，希望家人平安。
虔诚.en: She prays devoutly every day, wishing for her family's safety.

虔诚.zh: 那些信徒非常虔诚，经常去寺庙烧香。
虔诚.en: Those believers are very devout and often go to the temple to burn incense.

虔诚.zh: 虽然很忙，但他仍然保持虔诚的信仰。
虔诚.en: Although he is very busy, he still maintains a devout faith.

虔诚.zh: 老人用虔诚的眼神看着神像，默默许愿。
虔诚.en: The old man looked at the statue with devout eyes and silently made a wish.

宣读.en: The teacher read out the exam results.

宣读.zh: 会议上，主席宣读了新的规章制度。
宣读.en: At the meeting, the chairperson read out the new rules and regulations.

宣读.zh: 法官在法庭上庄严地宣读了判决书。
宣读.en: The judge solemnly read out the verdict in court.

宣读.zh: 他站起来宣读了获奖名单，大家都很激动。
宣读.en: He stood up and read out the list of winners; everyone was very excited.

宣读.zh: 校长宣读了表彰决定，并对优秀学生表示祝贺。
宣读.en: The principal read out the commendation decision and congratulated the outstanding students.

着眼.en: We need to focus on the future.

着眼.zh: 做决定时要着眼于长期发展。
着眼.en: When making decisions, we should focus on long-term development.

着眼.zh: 公司应该着眼于客户的需求来改进产品。
着眼.en: The company should focus on customer needs to improve products.

着眼.zh: 既然着眼于大局，这些小细节就别太计较了。
着眼.en: Since we're focusing on the big picture, don't be too bothered by these small details.

着眼.zh: 他们着眼于国际市场，制定了新的计划。
着眼.en: They focused on the international market and formulated a new plan.

牢固.en: This knot is tied very firmly.

牢固.zh: 我们的友谊非常牢固，不会轻易改变。
牢固.en: Our friendship is very solid and won't change easily.

牢固.zh: 他把梯子固定得很牢固，不会倒下来。
牢固.en: He secured the ladder firmly so it won't fall down.

牢固.zh: 虽然经历了很多困难，但他们的关系依然牢固。
牢固.en: Although they have been through many difficulties, their relationship is still solid.

牢固.zh: 地基要打得牢固，房子才能建得高。
牢固.en: The foundation must be laid firmly so that the house can be built tall.

恨不得.zh: 我恨不得马上回家睡觉。
恨不得.en: I wish I could go home and sleep right now.

恨不得.zh: 他气得恨不得打人，但还是忍住了。
恨不得.en: He was so angry he could hit someone, but he held back.

恨不得.zh: 看到美食，她恨不得一口气全吃完。
恨不得.en: Seeing the delicious food, she wished she could eat it all in one go.

恨不得.zh: 我恨不得每天都能放假，可惜不可能。
恨不得.en: I wish I could have a holiday every day, but unfortunately it's impossible.

恨不得.zh: 他恨不得立刻飞到她身边，但机票卖完了。
恨不得.en: He wished he could fly to her side immediately, but the plane tickets were sold out.

亲热.zh: 小狗见到主人就亲热地扑上去。
亲热.en: The puppy affectionately pounces on its owner when it sees him.

亲热.zh: 这对情侣在公共场合太亲热了，让人尴尬。
亲热.en: This couple is too affectionate in public, which is embarrassing.

亲热.zh: 虽然很久没见，但他们一见面就很亲热地聊天。
亲热.en: Although they haven't seen each other for a long time, they chatted affectionately as soon as they met.

亲热.zh: 她亲热地拉着朋友的手，有说有笑地走进来。
亲热.en: She affectionately took her friend's hand and walked in chatting and laughing.

分量.en: This piece of meat is generous in weight.

分量.zh: 他的意见在会议上很有分量。
分量.en: His opinion carries a lot of weight in the meeting.

分量.zh: 这些话虽然不多，但每句都很有分量。
分量.en: Although these words are few, every sentence carries weight.

分量.zh: 你要称一下这个包裹的分量，看超重没。
分量.en: You need to weigh this package to see if it's overweight.

分量.zh: 作为老员工，他说话的分量自然比别人重。
分量.en: As a veteran employee, his words naturally carry more weight than others'.

兑换.zh: 我想去银行兑换人民币。
兑换.en: I want to go to the bank to exchange RMB.

兑换.zh: 这些积分可以兑换礼品。
兑换.en: These points can be exchanged for gifts.

兑换.zh: 在机场兑换外币汇率不太划算。
兑换.en: The exchange rate for foreign currency at the airport is not very good.

兑换.zh: 我用美元兑换了欧元，然后就去旅行了。
兑换.en: I exchanged US dollars for euros, and then went on a trip.

兑换.zh: 你记得带上护照才能兑换旅行支票。
兑换.en: Remember to bring your passport to exchange traveler's checks.

遗留.zh: 这个项目遗留了不少问题。
遗留.en: This project has left behind many problems.

遗留.zh: 祖先遗留给我们很多宝贵的文化。
遗留.en: Our ancestors left us a lot of valuable culture.

遗留.zh: 房间里遗留了一些旧家具。
遗留.en: Some old furniture was left behind in the room.

遗留.zh: 因为时间不够，我们只能把遗留的工作明天再做。
遗留.en: Because we ran out of time, we can only do the leftover work tomorrow.

遗留.zh: 历史上遗留的边界问题到现在还没解决。
遗留.en: The boundary issues left over from history have not been resolved yet.

露天.zh: 露天市场卖的东西很新鲜。
露天.en: Things sold at the open-air market are very fresh.

露天.zh: 虽然天气很热，但他们还是坚持在露天演出。
露天.en: Even though it was very hot, they still insisted on performing outdoors.

露天.zh: 我们找了个露天咖啡馆坐下来聊天。
露天.en: We found an outdoor café and sat down to chat.

巨头.en: This company is a tech giant.

巨头.zh: 互联网巨头们都在争抢市场份额。
巨头.en: Internet giants are all competing for market share.

巨头.zh: 那个地产巨头又买了一块地。
巨头.en: That real estate giant bought another piece of land.

巨头.zh: 媒体巨头控制了很多新闻渠道。
巨头.en: Media giants control many news channels.

巨头.zh: 虽然他是行业巨头，但为人很低调。
巨头.en: Although he is a giant in the industry, he is very low-key.

赢家.en: Who is the winner of this game?

赢家.zh: 她觉得自己是人生的赢家。
赢家.en: She considers herself a winner in life.

赢家.zh: 最后的大赢家拿到了十万奖金。
赢家.en: The ultimate winner got a prize of 100,000.

赢家.zh: 做生意不只看输赢，有时候输家也能变成赢家。
赢家.en: In business, it's not just about winning or losing; sometimes losers can become winners.

赢家.zh: 这次竞标我们公司是唯一的赢家。
赢家.en: Our company was the only winner in this bidding.

简洁.zh: 他的演讲非常简洁有力。
简洁.en: His speech was very concise and powerful.

简洁.zh: 写文章时尽量用简洁的语言。
简洁.en: Try to use concise language when writing articles.

简洁.zh: 我喜欢这种简洁的风格，不花哨。
简洁.en: I like this concise style, not flashy.

简洁.zh: 报告要写得简洁一些，别啰嗦。
