简洁.en: The report should be written more concisely, don't ramble.

大肆.en: They are大肆 promoting the new product.

大肆.zh: 这家公司大肆招聘新员工。
大肆.en: This company is massively hiring new employees.

大肆.zh: 媒体大肆报道了这个丑闻。
大肆.en: The media widely reported this scandal.

大肆.zh: 他们大肆庆祝胜利，结果引起了邻居的不满。
大肆.en: They celebrated the victory extravagantly, which caused dissatisfaction among the neighbors.

亲友.zh: 周末我邀请亲友来吃饭。
亲友.en: I invited relatives and friends over for dinner this weekend.

亲友.zh: 他的亲友都支持他的决定。
亲友.en: His relatives and friends all support his decision.

亲友.zh: 结婚那天来了很多亲友。
亲友.en: Many relatives and friends came on the wedding day.

亲友.zh: 因为疫情，我们只能通过网络和亲友联系。
亲友.en: Because of the pandemic, we could only contact relatives and friends online.

亲友.zh: 他生病时，所有的亲友都来看望他。
亲友.en: When he was sick, all his relatives and friends came to visit him.

悬念.en: This movie has a lot of suspense.

悬念.zh: 故事的结尾留下了悬念。
悬念.en: The end of the story left a cliffhanger.

悬念.zh: 比赛结果直到最后还有悬念。
悬念.en: The outcome of the game remained in suspense until the end.

悬念.zh: 导演很擅长制造悬念，观众都很紧张。
悬念.en: The director is good at creating suspense, and the audience was very tense.

悬念.zh: 这本书的悬念设置得太巧妙了。
悬念.en: The suspense in this book is set up so cleverly.

水手.zh: 水手们正在甲板上工作。
水手.en: The sailors are working on the deck.

水手.zh: 老水手讲了很多航海故事。
水手.en: The old sailor told many sailing stories.

水手.zh: 他小时候的梦想是当一名水手。
水手.en: His childhood dream was to become a sailor.

水手.zh: 水手们在大风中把帆降了下来。
水手.en: The sailors lowered the sails in the strong wind.

微型.en: This micro camera is very expensive.

微型.zh: 我买了一个微型无人机，但它飞得不高。
微型.en: I bought a micro drone, but it doesn't fly high.

微型.zh: 微型芯片在现代电子设备中很常见。
微型.en: Microchips are very common in modern electronic devices.

微型.zh: 虽然它是个微型投影仪，但画质还不错。
微型.en: Although it's a micro projector, the picture quality is not bad.

微型.zh: 他收藏了很多微型模型，比如小汽车和房子。
微型.en: He collects many miniature models, like small cars and houses.

反响.en: The new movie got a very good reception.

反响.zh: 他的演讲引起了强烈的反响。
反响.en: His speech provoked a strong reaction.

反响.zh: 老板的决定在员工中产生了很大的反响。
反响.en: The boss's decision caused a big reaction among the employees.

反响.zh: 这首歌一发布就获得了不错的反响。
反响.en: As soon as the song was released, it received a good response.

反响.zh: 虽然广告的反响不错，但销量没怎么增加。
反响.en: Although the ad got a good response, sales didn't increase much.

销.en: He went to the company today to report back from leave.

销.zh: 这种手机在市场上销得很快。
销.en: This type of phone sells quickly in the market.

销.zh: 你必须先把旧账号销了才能注册新账号。
销.en: You must cancel the old account first before registering a new one.

销.zh: 她销了那笔订单因为缺货。
销.en: She canceled that order because it was out of stock.

祖父.en: My grandfather is eighty years old this year.

祖父.zh: 我的祖父以前是个老师，他教数学。
祖父.en: My grandfather was a teacher; he taught math.

祖父.zh: 祖父常常给我讲他年轻时的故事。
祖父.en: Grandfather often tells me stories about his youth.

祖父.zh: 每年春节我们都会去祖父家团聚。
祖父.en: Every Spring Festival we go to grandfather's house for a reunion.

祖父.zh: 祖父年轻的时候去过很多国家旅行。
祖父.en: When my grandfather was young, he traveled to many countries.

眨眼.zh: 时间过得真快，一眨眼就毕业了。
眨眼.en: Time flies; in the blink of an eye, we graduated.

眨眼.zh: 别眨眼，不然你就错过那个镜头了。
眨眼.en: Don't blink, or you'll miss that shot.

眨眼.zh: 她眨了眨眼，表示她明白了。
眨眼.en: She blinked to show she understood.

眨眼.zh: 他盯着屏幕好久都不眨眼，眼睛都酸了。
眨眼.en: He stared at the screen for a long time without blinking, and his eyes got sore.

掉头.zh: 因为走错路了，我们得掉头回去。
掉头.en: Because we took the wrong road, we had to turn around and go back.

掉头.zh: 这条街太窄了，车子很难掉头。
掉头.en: This street is too narrow; it's hard for cars to make a U-turn.

掉头.zh: 他听到后面有人叫他，赶紧掉头看了一眼。
掉头.en: He heard someone call him from behind, so he quickly turned his head to look.

寂静.zh: 深夜的街道十分寂静，只能听到风声。
寂静.en: The street in the dead of night was very quiet; only the wind could be heard.

寂静.zh: 考试的时候，整个考场寂静无声。
寂静.en: During the exam, the entire exam hall was silent.

寂静.zh: 图书馆里非常寂静，大家都在专心看书。
寂静.en: The library was very quiet; everyone was focusing on reading.

寂静.zh: 他走进那片寂静的森林，心里有点害怕。
寂静.en: He walked into that silent forest, feeling a little scared.

职权.en: This is within his scope of authority.

职权.zh: 经理滥用职权，被公司开除了。
职权.en: The manager abused his authority and was fired by the company.

职权.zh: 每个员工都应该清楚自己的职权。
职权.en: Every employee should be clear about their own authority.

职权.zh: 他利用职权帮朋友走了个后门。
职权.en: He used his authority to pull strings for a friend.

职权.zh: 这件事超出了我的职权，需要请示上级。
职权.en: This matter is beyond my authority; I need to consult my superior.

伦理.zh: 做科学研究必须遵守伦理规范。
伦理.en: Doing scientific research must follow ethical norms.

伦理.zh: 医生要面对很多伦理方面的难题。
人工智能的发展带来了新的伦理问题。
伦理.en: The development of artificial intelligence brings new ethical issues.

伦理.zh: 他们讨论了很久，关于克隆技术的伦理争议。
伦理.en: They discussed for a long time the ethical controversy about cloning technology.

反过来.en: Looking at it from the opposite side, it's different.

反过来.zh: 你如果反过来想，其实没那么糟糕。
反过来.en: If you think about it the other way around, it's actually not that bad.

反过来.zh: 先把纸板反过来，再涂胶水。
反过来.en: First turn the cardboard over, then apply glue.

反过来.zh: 他帮了我很多，反过来我也应该帮他。
反过来.en: He helped me a lot; in turn, I should help him too.

反过来.zh: 别只看到缺点，反过来看看它的优点。
反过来.en: Don't only see the flaws; on the contrary, look at its strengths.

身价.en: His market value has increased several times.

身价.zh: 这个球星的身价已经过亿了。
身价.en: This star player's worth has exceeded a hundred million.

身价.zh: 自从获奖以后，她的身价一下子提高了。
身价.en: Since winning the award, her value has shot up.

身价.zh: 虽然他现在身价很高，但生活还是很低调。
身价.en: Although he is very valuable now, he still lives a low-key life.

身价.zh: 你知不知道那个演员现在的身价是多少？
身价.en: Do you know what that actor's current asking price is?

畏惧.zh: 不要畏惧困难，勇敢面对就好。
畏惧.en: Don't be afraid of difficulties, just face them bravely.

畏惧.zh: 她从小就畏惧狗，看到狗就躲。
畏惧.en: She has been afraid of dogs since childhood, hiding when she sees one.

畏惧.zh: 如果总是畏惧变化，就永远无法进步。
畏惧.en: If you always fear change, you'll never make progress.

畏惧.zh: 在黑暗里行走，他心里不禁有些畏惧。
畏惧.en: Walking in the dark, he couldn't help feeling a bit fearful.

振作.en: You need to pull yourself together.

振作.zh: 失败一次没关系，振作精神再来。
振作.en: It doesn't matter to fail once; cheer up and try again.

振作.zh: 他最近情绪很低落，我劝他振作一点。
振作.en: He's been feeling down lately, so I advised him to perk up a bit.

振作.zh: 虽然遇到了挫折，但他很快就振作起来了。
振作.en: Although he encountered setbacks, he soon pulled himself together.

振作.zh: 听到这个消息后，他整个人都振作了。
振作.en: After hearing the news, he perked up completely.

莫非.en: Could it be that you know him?

莫非.zh: 他这么晚还没回来，莫非出什么事了？
莫非.en: He hasn't come back so late—could something have happened?

莫非.zh: 你一直盯着我看，莫非我脸上有东西？
莫非.en: You've been staring at me—could there be something on my face?

莫非.zh: 她今天没来上班，莫非是生病了？
莫非.en: She didn't come to work today—could she be sick?

莫非.zh: 那个包看起来很像我的，莫非是别人拿错了？
莫非.en: That bag looks a lot like mine—could someone have taken the wrong one?

城墙.en: This city wall is very ancient.
We climbed up the city wall to watch the sunset.

城墙.zh: 西安的城墙保存得很完整。
城墙.en: Xi'an's city wall is very well preserved.

城墙.zh: 站在城墙上，能看到整个老城区的风景。
城墙.en: Standing on the city wall, you can see the scenery of the entire old town.

城墙.zh: 以前城墙是用来防御敌人进攻的。
城墙.en: In the past, city walls were used to defend against enemy attacks.

驯.en: This lion is hard to tame.

驯.zh: 驯鹰是一种古老的传统。
他花了三个月才驯服那只野狼。
驯.en: It took him three months to tame that wild wolf.

驯.zh: 马戏团的动物都是经过长期驯练的。
驯.en: Circus animals are all trained through long-term taming.

冲洗.zh: 伤口要用清水冲洗干净。
冲洗.en: Rinse the wound thoroughly with clean water.

冲洗.zh: 厕所堵了，多冲洗几次试试。
冲洗.en: The toilet is clogged; try flushing it a few more times.

冲洗.zh: 拍完胶片后，他立刻去店里冲洗。
冲洗.en: After finishing the film roll, he immediately went to the shop to develop it.

冲洗.zh: 下雨后，路面被雨水冲洗得很干净。
冲洗.en: After the rain, the road was washed clean by the rainwater.

接替.en: Who will take over for you?

接替.zh: 他下个月接替经理的职位。
接替.en: He will take over the manager position next month.

接替.zh: 老大爷退休后，他儿子接替了工作。
接替.en: After the old man retired, his son took over the job.

接替.zh: 因为临时有事，我找朋友接替我值班。
接替.en: Because something came up, I asked a friend to cover my shift.

接替.zh: 等新人熟悉流程后，再让他接替你的任务。
接替.en: After the newcomer gets familiar with the process, let him take over your tasks.

下台.en: He was forced to step down.

下台.zh: 总统下台后，国家局势很混乱。
下台.en: After the president stepped down, the country's situation became chaotic.

下台.zh: 这个领导因为丑闻而下台了。
下台.en: This leader stepped down due to a scandal.

下台.zh: 如果再不改进，这个经理迟早要下台。
下台.en: If he doesn't improve, this manager will eventually be removed from his position.

当着.zh: 你别当着大家的面骂她。
当着.en: Don't scold her in front of everyone.
He lied right in front of me.

当着.zh: 你愿意当着所有人的面再说一遍吗？
当着.en: Would you be willing to say it again in front of everyone?

当着.zh: 他当着孩子的面抽烟，这样很不好。
当着.en: He smokes in front of the children, which is really bad.

当着.zh: 我当着全公司的面感谢了他的帮助。
当着.en: I thanked him for his help in front of the whole company.

宫殿.zh: 他们去北京参观了故宫宫殿群。
宫殿.en: They went to Beijing to visit the Forbidden City palace complex.

宫殿.zh: 虽然宫殿很漂亮，但是门票太贵了。
宫殿.en: Although the palace is beautiful, the tickets are too expensive.

宫殿.zh: 小时候我总觉得宫殿里住着公主。
宫殿.en: When I was a child, I always thought a princess lived in the palace.

宫殿.zh: 宫殿前面有一个巨大的广场。
宫殿.en: There is a huge square in front of the palace.

遗嘱.zh: 爷爷的遗嘱里把房子留给了叔叔。
遗嘱.en: In Grandpa's will, the house was left to Uncle.

遗嘱.zh: 律师宣读了那份遗嘱的内容。
遗嘱.en: The lawyer read out the contents of that will.

遗嘱.zh: 立遗嘱之前要仔细考虑清楚。
遗嘱.en: You should think carefully before making a will.

遗嘱.zh: 他去世后，家人发现了他的遗嘱。
遗嘱.en: After he passed away, his family found his will.

现行.zh: 现行法律不允许这样做。
现行.en: The current law does not allow this.

现行.zh: 按照现行规定，我们需要重新申请。
现行.en: According to the current regulations, we need to reapply.

现行.zh: 这个现行方案还需要修改。
现行.en: This current plan still needs revision.

现行.zh: 现行教育体制有很多问题。
现行.en: The current education system has many problems.

现行.zh: 虽然现行政策有利，但也要考虑长远。
现行.en: Although the current policy is beneficial, we must also consider the long term.

申领.en: I want to apply for a new card.

申领.zh: 他正在申领失业保险金。
申领.en: He is applying for unemployment insurance benefits.

申领.zh: 申领护照需要带身份证。
申领.en: To apply for a passport, you need to bring your ID card.

申领.zh: 在网上申领健康码很方便。
申领.en: It's convenient to apply for a health code online.

申领.zh: 他们去税务局申领发票。
申领.en: They went to the tax bureau to apply for an invoice.

整顿.en: The company is rectifying its discipline.

整顿.zh: 政府决定整顿房地产市场。
整顿.en: The government decided to regulate the real estate market.

整顿.zh: 经过整顿，校园环境好多了。
整顿.en: After the reorganization, the campus environment has improved a lot.

整顿.zh: 这个部门需要彻底整顿一下。
整顿.en: This department needs a thorough clean-up.

整顿.zh: 他们整顿了仓库里的货物。
整顿.en: They reorganized the goods in the warehouse.

不为人知.en: This matter is unknown to people.

不为人知.zh: 他的真实身份一直不为人知。
不为人知.en: His true identity has always been unknown.

不为人知.zh: 那个秘密至今仍然不为人知。
不为人知.en: That secret remains unknown to this day.

不为人知.zh: 她做的好事很多都不为人知。
不为人知.en: Many of the good things she did are unknown.

不为人知.zh: 在那些不为人知的角落里，还有人在努力。
不为人知.en: In those unknown corners, there are still people working hard.

仙女.en: She looks a lot like a fairy.

仙女.zh: 童话里的仙女帮助了那个小女孩。
仙女.en: The fairy in the fairy tale helped that little girl.

仙女.zh: 仙女在传说中总是很善良。
仙女.en: Fairies are always very kind in legends.

仙女.zh: 她穿上白裙子就像仙女下凡。
仙女.en: When she wears a white dress, she looks like a fairy descending to the mortal world.

仙女.zh: 虽然她是仙女，但她也有烦恼。
仙女.en: Although she is a fairy, she also has worries.

从容.zh: 面对困难，她总是很从容。
从容.en: Facing difficulties, she is always calm.

从容.zh: 他从容地走过了独木桥。
从容.en: He walked across the single-plank bridge calmly.

从容.zh: 演讲时他表现得非常从容不迫。
从容.en: He appeared very calm and unhurried during the speech.

从容.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但他依然很从容。
从容.en: Although time is tight, he remains very calm.

艰巨.zh: 我们要完成一项艰巨的工程。
艰巨.en: We need to complete a formidable project.

艰巨.zh: 克服这些困难是艰巨的挑战。
艰巨.en: Overcoming these difficulties is a formidable challenge.

艰巨.zh: 实现梦想需要付出艰巨的努力。
艰巨.en: Realizing your dreams requires tremendous effort.

艰巨.zh: 虽然工作艰巨，但他从不退缩。
艰巨.en: Although the work is arduous, he never backs down.

电信.zh: 电信公司推出了新套餐。
电信.en: The telecom company launched a new plan.

电信.zh: 现在电信技术发展很快。
电信.en: Telecom technology is developing very fast now.

电信.zh: 他在电信行业工作了很多年。
电信.en: He has worked in the telecommunications industry for many years.

电信.zh: 中国电信是四大运营商之一。
电信.en: China Telecom is one of the four major carriers.

电信.zh: 电信诈骗越来越多了，要小心。
电信.en: Telecom fraud is increasing, so be careful.

缺口.en: This cup has a small chip.

缺口.zh: 因为道路有个大缺口，所以车辆得绕行。
缺口.en: Because there is a big gap in the road, vehicles have to detour.

缺口.zh: 墙上有个缺口，我们可以从那里出去。
缺口.en: There's a gap in the wall; we can get out from there.

缺口.zh: 这次预算出现了很大的缺口。
缺口.en: This time the budget has a big gap.

缺口.zh: 虽然缺口不大，但是看起来很不安全。
缺口.en: Although the gap is not big, it looks very unsafe.

疲倦.zh: 工作了一整天，他感到非常疲倦。
疲倦.en: After working all day, he felt extremely tired.

疲倦.zh: 如果你疲倦了，就休息一下吧。
疲倦.en: If you're tired, just take a rest.

疲倦.zh: 尽管身体很疲倦，但他还是坚持完成了任务。
疲倦.en: Although his body was weary, he still insisted on finishing the task.

疲倦.zh: 连续熬夜让我越来越疲倦。
疲倦.en: Staying up late continuously makes me more and more tired.

钱财.zh: 他为了钱财不惜出卖朋友。
钱财.en: He would betray his friends for money.

钱财.zh: 我们要把钱财用在有意义的地方。
钱财.en: We should use money in meaningful places.

钱财.zh: 虽然钱财很重要，但健康更重要。
钱财.en: Although money is important, health is more important.

钱财.zh: 她从来不在乎钱财，只在乎感情。
钱财.en: She never cares about money, only about feelings.

难关.en: We will definitely get through the difficulty.
This exam is a big challenge.

难关.zh: 在大家的帮助下，他终于克服了难关。
难关.en: With everyone's help, he finally overcame the difficulty.

难关.zh: 虽然遇到了很多难关，但他没有放弃。
难关.en: Although he encountered many difficulties, he did not give up.

难关.zh: 只要团结一致，什么难关都不怕。
难关.en: As long as we unite, no difficulty is scary.

有望.en: This surgery is likely to succeed.
He is hopeful to win the championship.

有望.zh: 如果努力的话，你很有望考上大学。
有望.en: If you work hard, you are very likely to get into college.

有望.zh: 这种新药有望治愈这种疾病。
有望.en: This new drug is likely to cure the disease.

有望.zh: 虽然伤势严重，但他有望完全康复。
有望.en: Although the injury is serious, he is likely to fully recover.

峰会.en: There is an important summit tomorrow.

峰会.zh: 各国领导人在峰会上讨论了气候问题。
峰会.en: Leaders from various countries discussed climate issues at the summit.

峰会.zh: 这次峰会吸引了全球媒体的关注。
峰会.en: This summit attracted global media attention.

峰会.zh: 因为峰会，市中心的交通非常拥挤。
峰会.en: Because of the summit, traffic in the city center is very congested.

峰会.zh: 虽然峰会只有两天，但影响很大。
峰会.en: Although the summit only lasted two days, its impact is huge.

镇静.zh: 遇到危险时要保持镇静。

镇静.en: His tone of voice was very calm.

镇静.zh: 虽然情况紧急，但他非常镇静。
镇静.en: Although the situation was urgent, he was very calm.

镇静.zh: 她深吸一口气，努力让自己镇静下来。
镇静.en: She took a deep breath and tried to calm herself down.

镇静.zh: 在大家都很慌乱的时候，只有他一个人镇静自若。
镇静.en: When everyone was panicking, only he remained calm and composed.

遥控.en: The TV remote control can't be found.

遥控.zh: 这个玩具车可以用遥控操作。
遥控.en: This toy car can be operated by remote control.

遥控.zh: 他用遥控打开了车库门。
遥控.en: He opened the garage door with the remote.

遥控.zh: 因为遥控没电了，所以只能手动开关。
遥控.en: Because the remote's battery is dead, we can only switch it manually.

遥控.zh: 新买的无人机遥控距离很远。
遥控.en: The newly bought drone has a very long remote control range.

顽固.en: He is a very stubborn person.

顽固.zh: 虽然他很顽固，但最后还是妥协了。
顽固.en: Although he was stubborn, he finally compromised.

顽固.zh: 这种老毛病特别顽固，很难根治。
顽固.en: This chronic problem is especially stubborn and hard to cure.

顽固.zh: 他是个顽固的人，不管别人怎么说都不听。
顽固.en: He is a stubborn person who won't listen no matter what others say.

散布.zh: 花园里散布着很多玫瑰。
散布.en: Many roses are scattered in the garden.

散布.zh: 有人在网上散布假消息。
散布.en: Someone is spreading fake news online.

散布.zh: 因为有人散布恐慌，导致很多人抢购物资。
散布.en: Because someone spread panic, many people rushed to buy supplies.

散布.zh: 森林里散布着许多小木屋，非常安静。
散布.en: Many small cabins are scattered in the forest, very quiet.

赶往.en: I am hurrying to the airport.

赶往.zh: 因为堵车，我们得赶紧赶往火车站。
赶往.en: Because of traffic jam, we have to hurry to the train station.
He rushed to the disaster area overnight to help.

赶往.zh: 接到电话后，她立刻赶往医院。
赶往.en: After receiving the call, she immediately rushed to the hospital.

赶往.zh: 如果你现在赶往公司，也许还能赶上会议。
赶往.en: If you rush to the company now, you might still catch the meeting.

搓.zh: 妈妈在搓衣服，我在旁边帮忙。
搓.en: Mom is scrubbing clothes, and I'm helping beside her.

搓.zh: 他用力搓了搓脸，想让自己清醒。
搓.en: He rubbed his face vigorously to wake himself up.

搓.zh: 搓澡的时候别太用力，会伤皮肤。
搓.en: Don't scrub too hard when bathing, it can hurt your skin.
Grandma taught me how to knead glutinous rice balls.

份额.zh: 这家公司的市场份额今年增长了不少。
份额.en: This company's market share has grown a lot this year.

份额.zh: 每个股东都能分到相应的份额。
份额.en: Each shareholder can get the corresponding share.

份额.zh: 虽然我们努力了，但份额还是被对手抢走了。
份额.en: Although we tried hard, our share was still taken by competitors.

份额.zh: 为了扩大份额，他们推出了新产品。
份额.en: To expand the market share, they launched new products.

愣.zh: 听到这个消息，他愣了半天说不出话。
愣.en: After hearing this news, he was stunned for a long time and couldn't speak.
Don't just stand there in a daze, come help quickly!

愣.zh: 她愣愣地看着窗外，不知道在想什么。
愣.en: She stared blankly out the window, not knowing what she was thinking.

愣.zh: 我愣住是因为没想到他会这么回答。
愣.en: I was stunned because I didn't expect him to answer like that.

颗粒.en: There are many granules on the ground.

颗粒.zh: 这种药是颗粒状的，用水冲服。
颗粒.en: This medicine is in granular form, take it with water.

颗粒.zh: 沙漠里的沙颗粒非常细小。
颗粒.en: The sand particles in the desert are very fine.

颗粒.zh: 下雨后，空气中悬浮着很多灰尘颗粒。
颗粒.en: After rain, there are many dust particles suspended in the air.

颗粒.zh: 这个咖啡机磨出来的咖啡颗粒很均匀。
颗粒.en: The coffee grounds from this machine are very uniform.

宝藏.zh: 孩子们在玩游戏，寻找传说中的宝藏。
宝藏.en: The children are playing a game, looking for the legendary treasure.

宝藏.zh: 历史书里有很多人类智慧的宝藏。
宝藏.en: History books contain many treasures of human wisdom.

宝藏.zh: 这座古墓里发现了大量的金银宝藏。
宝藏.en: A large amount of gold and silver treasures were discovered in this ancient tomb.

宝藏.zh: 对他来说，知识和经验才是真正的宝藏。
宝藏.en: For him, knowledge and experience are the real treasures.

惭愧.zh: 考试没考好，我实在很惭愧。
惭愧.en: I didn't do well on the exam, I'm really ashamed.

惭愧.zh: 看到别人的努力，自己却偷懒，真是惭愧。
惭愧.en: Seeing others' hard work while I'm lazy, it's really embarrassing.

惭愧.zh: 他惭愧地低下了头，不敢看妈妈。
惭愧.en: He lowered his head in shame, not daring to look at his mother.

惭愧.zh: 你帮了我这么多，我却没感谢你，真是惭愧。
惭愧.en: You helped me so much, but I didn't thank you, I'm really ashamed.

构思.en: He is conceiving a new novel.

构思.zh: 这个故事的构思非常巧妙，让人意想不到。
构思.en: The conception of this story is very clever, unexpected.

构思.zh: 我花了一个星期来构思这个方案。
构思.en: I spent a week conceiving this plan.

构思.zh: 作家需要时间来构思人物的性格。
构思.en: Writers need time to conceive a character's personality.

构思.zh: 在动笔之前，先把整个大纲构思清楚。
构思.en: Before writing, first conceive the whole outline clearly.

海绵.zh: 用海绵擦桌子，比抹布干净多了。
海绵.en: Using a sponge to wipe the table is much cleaner than a rag.

海绵.zh: 这块海绵太硬了，需要泡一泡。
海绵.en: This sponge is too hard, it needs to be soaked.

海绵.zh: 孩子喜欢玩海绵，觉得软软的很有趣。
海绵.en: Kids like to play with sponges, they feel soft and interesting.

海绵.zh: 海绵城市理念可以缓解城市内涝。
海绵.en: The sponge city concept can mitigate urban waterlogging.

增添.en: This adds atmosphere to the festival.

增添.zh: 家里养了花，增添了不少生气。
增添.en: Having flowers at home adds a lot of vitality.

增添.zh: 新来的同事给团队增添了活力。
增添.en: The new colleague added vitality to the team.

增添.zh: 下雨天，一杯热茶能增添不少温暖。
增添.en: On a rainy day, a cup of hot tea adds a lot of warmth.

增添.zh: 为了增添趣味，他讲了一个笑话。
增添.en: To add some fun, he told a joke.

暧昧.en: Their relationship is a bit ambiguous.

暧昧.zh: 他说话的语气很暧昧，我搞不懂。
暧昧.en: His tone was very vague, I can't figure it out.

暧昧.zh: 他们之间那种暧昧的气氛让人很不舒服。
暧昧.en: That ambiguous atmosphere between them makes people very uncomfortable.

暧昧.zh: 虽然他们没有明说，但那种暧昧的态度谁都看得出来。
暧昧.en: Although they didn't say it outright, everyone could see that ambiguous attitude.

暧昧.zh: 她不喜欢这种暧昧的关系，所以直接问清楚了。
暧昧.en: She doesn't like this kind of ambiguous relationship, so she asked directly to clarify.

灭亡.zh: 如果再不保护环境，很多物种都会灭亡。
灭亡.en: If we don't protect the environment, many species will become extinct.

灭亡.zh: 历史上很多强大的帝国最后都走向了灭亡。
灭亡.en: In history, many powerful empires eventually headed toward destruction.

灭亡.zh: 他们想要阻止这个文化的灭亡，但已经太晚了。
灭亡.en: They wanted to prevent the demise of this culture, but it was already too late.

弥漫.en: The room is filled with a fragrance.

弥漫.zh: 整个城市都弥漫着紧张的气氛。
弥漫.en: The whole city was filled with a tense atmosphere.

弥漫.zh: 大火之后，浓烟弥漫了好几天。
弥漫.en: After the big fire, thick smoke lingered for several days.

弥漫.zh: 因为雾气弥漫，开车的时候要特别小心。
弥漫.en: Because the fog is pervasive, you need to be especially careful when driving.

弥漫.zh: 咖啡的香气弥漫在空气中，让人觉得很放松。
弥漫.en: The aroma of coffee permeated the air, making people feel very relaxed.

配件.zh: 我在网上买了手机配件。
这台电脑的配件很难找到。
配件.en: Parts for this computer are hard to find.

配件.zh: 他开了一家店，专门卖汽车配件。
配件.en: He opened a shop that specializes in selling car parts.

配件.zh: 虽然原装配件很贵，但质量确实更好。
配件.en: Although original parts are expensive, the quality is indeed better.

尊贵.en: He thinks he is very noble.

尊贵.zh: 这家餐厅只接待尊贵的会员。
尊贵.en: This restaurant only serves distinguished members.

尊贵.zh: 他说话的样子好像在强调自己身份尊贵。
尊贵.en: The way he talks seems to emphasize his noble status.

尊贵.zh: 虽然他很尊贵，但为人却很随和。
尊贵.en: Although he is very distinguished, he is actually quite easygoing.

木板.en: There's a wooden plank on the floor.

木板.zh: 他拿木板做了一张桌子。
木板.en: He used a wooden board to make a table.

木板.zh: 这个木板太薄了，一踩就断。
木板.en: This wooden board is too thin, it breaks as soon as you step on it.

木板.zh: 因为地板不平，他垫了一块木板。
木板.en: Because the floor was uneven, he put a wooden board under it.

木板.zh: 他把几块木板拼在一起，做成了一个书架。
木板.en: He put several wooden boards together to make a bookshelf.

辩解.zh: 他一直在为自己的行为辩解。
辩解.en: He has been defending his actions.

辩解.zh: 你不用辩解，我们都明白。
辩解.en: You don't need to explain yourself, we all understand.

辩解.zh: 虽然他想辩解，但事实摆在眼前。
辩解.en: Although he wanted to defend himself, the facts were right there.

辩解.zh: 她越是辩解，别人就越怀疑她。
辩解.en: The more she tried to justify herself, the more people suspected her.

缸.en: The vat is out of water.
He keeps a tank of goldfish.
This vat is too big to move.

缸.zh: 他把米都倒进缸里储存起来。
缸.en: He poured all the rice into the vat for storage.

缸.zh: 因为缸破了，水流了一地。
缸.en: Because the vat was broken, water spilled all over the floor.

如意.en: What if this matter doesn't go as desired?
Life can't always go as one wishes.

如意.zh: 虽然结果不怎么样，但还算如意。
如意.en: Although the result wasn't great, it was still satisfactory.

摔跤.en: Children often fall when learning to walk.

摔跤.zh: 他喜欢看奥运会的摔跤比赛。
摔跤.en: He likes watching wrestling matches in the Olympics.

摔跤.zh: 因为路上结了冰，她一不留神就摔跤了。
摔跤.en: Because the road was icy, she fell down when she wasn't paying attention.

摔跤.zh: 虽然摔跤很疼，但他马上爬起来继续跑。
摔跤.en: Although falling hurt a lot, he got up immediately and kept running.

退回.zh: 快递员让我把包裹退回给卖家。
退回.en: The courier asked me to return the package to the seller.

退回.zh: 这张支票无效，银行会退回。
退回.en: This check is invalid; the bank will return it.

退回.zh: 如果质量有问题，你可以申请退回。
退回.en: If there is a quality issue, you can apply for a return.

退回.zh: 他退回了我送的礼物，让我很难过。
退回.en: He returned the gift I gave him, which made me sad.

退回.zh: 因为地址写错了，信件被退回发件人那里。
退回.en: Because the address was written wrong, the letter was returned to the sender.

紧迫.zh: 时间紧迫，我们得抓紧了。
紧迫.en: Time is pressing; we need to hurry.

紧迫.zh: 这个问题很紧迫，必须马上解决。
紧迫.en: This issue is very urgent and must be solved immediately.

紧迫.zh: 经济形势紧迫，公司决定裁员。
紧迫.en: The economic situation is urgent, and the company decided to lay off staff.

紧迫.zh: 虽然任务紧迫，但他还是先吃了饭。
紧迫.en: Although the task was urgent, he still ate first.

紧迫.zh: 医生的表情告诉我，情况非常紧迫。
紧迫.en: The doctor's expression told me that the situation was very critical.

促成.en: He was the one who facilitated this cooperation.

促成.zh: 政府的政策促成了经济的快速发展。
促成.en: The government's policies led to rapid economic development.

促成.zh: 经过多次谈判，他们终于促成了协议。
促成.en: After many negotiations, they finally brokered an agreement.

促成.zh: 一场大雨促成了他们的相识。
促成.en: A heavy rain brought about their acquaintance.

促成.zh: 老师的鼓励促成了他对学习的热爱。
促成.en: The teacher's encouragement fostered his love for learning.

领队.en: The team leader is leading the way ahead.

领队.zh: 这次旅行我们请了一个很有经验的领队。
领队.en: For this trip, we hired a very experienced tour leader.

领队.zh: 领队说，明天早上六点集合。
领队.en: The team leader said we will gather at six tomorrow morning.

领队.zh: 作为领队，他负责整个团队的安全。
领队.en: As the team leader, he is responsible for the safety of the whole team.

领队.zh: 登山队需要一个熟悉路线的领队。
领队.en: The mountaineering team needs a leader who knows the route well.

贯穿.zh: 这条公路贯穿整个城市。
贯穿.en: This highway runs through the entire city.

贯穿.zh: 爱心贯穿了这部电影的主题。
贯穿.en: Love runs through the theme of this movie.

贯穿.zh: 一条小河贯穿了我们的村庄。
贯穿.en: A small river cuts through our village.

贯穿.zh: 他的演讲贯穿了环保的理念。
贯穿.en: His speech was permeated with the concept of environmental protection.

贯穿.zh: 这个理念贯穿了他所有的作品。
贯穿.en: This idea runs through all of his works.

大家庭.zh: 我们班就像一个大家庭。
大家庭.en: Our class is like a big family.

大家庭.zh: 她出生在一个温暖的大家庭里。
大家庭.en: She was born into a warm big family.

大家庭.zh: 公司提倡员工之间要像大家庭一样相处。
大家庭.en: The company encourages employees to get along like a big family.

大家庭.zh: 在社区这个大家庭里，大家互帮互助。
大家庭.en: In the big family of the community, everyone helps each other.

大家庭.zh: 虽然来自不同地方，但这里让我们感觉是个大家庭。
大家庭.en: Although we come from different places, here it feels like a big family.

一无所有.zh: 他刚来这里时一无所有。
一无所有.en: When he first came here, he had nothing.

一无所有.zh: 一场火灾让他变得一无所有。
一无所有.en: A fire left him with nothing.

一无所有.zh: 虽然一无所有，但他依然很乐观。
一无所有.en: Although he had nothing, he was still very optimistic.

一无所有.zh: 她一无所有，却拥有最真诚的朋友。
一无所有.en: She had nothing, yet she had the most sincere friends.

一无所有.zh: 从一无所有到身家过亿，他用了十年。
一无所有.en: It took him ten years to go from having nothing to being worth over a hundred million.

规格.zh: 请按照规格要求来制作。
规格.en: Please make it according to the specification requirements.

规格.zh: 这次会议的规格比以往都高。
规格.en: The level of this meeting is higher than before.

规格.zh: 不同的型号有不同的规格。
我们需要确认一下装修材料的规格。
规格.en: We need to confirm the specifications of the decoration materials.

高血压.en: People with high blood pressure should eat less salt.

高血压.zh: 医生建议他每天测量高血压。
高血压.en: The doctor advised him to measure his blood pressure daily.

高血压.zh: 长期压力大容易导致高血压。
高血压.en: Long-term high stress can easily lead to high blood pressure.

高血压.zh: 除了吃药，控制饮食也能缓解高血压。
高血压.en: Besides taking medicine, controlling diet can also alleviate high blood pressure.

走近.en: Approach him slowly, don't scare him.

走近.zh: 她走近窗边，看着外面的雨。
走近.en: She walked over to the window and looked at the rain outside.

走近.zh: 当我走近那个花园时，闻到一股花香。
走近.en: When I got closer to the garden, I smelled a floral fragrance.

走近.zh: 他走近我，小声说了一个秘密。
走近.en: He came close to me and whispered a secret.

走近.zh: 走近一看，原来那只鸟受伤了。
走近.en: Upon closer look, it turned out that bird was injured.

思绪.en: My thoughts are messy, I can't calm down.

思绪.zh: 他坐在窗前，思绪飘到了很远的地方。
思绪.en: He sat by the window, his thoughts drifting far away.

思绪.zh: 音乐让我思绪万千，想起了很多往事。
思绪.en: The music made my thoughts flood, reminding me of many past events.

思绪.zh: 写文章的时候，如果思绪断了就很难接上。
思绪.en: When writing an article, it's hard to reconnect if the train of thought is broken.

思绪.zh: 我努力整理思绪，但脑子里还是一团乱麻。
思绪.en: I tried to organize my thoughts, but my mind was still a tangled mess.

振动.zh: 手机振动了，你看看是谁。
振动.en: The phone vibrated, check who it is.

振动.zh: 地震时能感觉到地面明显的振动。
振动.en: During an earthquake, you can feel obvious vibrations in the ground.

振动.zh: 洗衣机脱水时振动很大，得放平它。
振动.en: The washing machine vibrates a lot during spin cycle; it needs to be leveled.

振动.zh: 他把手机调成振动模式，开会时不会吵到别人。
振动.en: He set his phone to vibrate mode so it won't disturb others during the meeting.

振动.zh: 这种机器的振动频率太高，长期使用对耳朵不好。
振动.en: This machine's vibration frequency is too high; long-term use is bad for your ears.

宣扬.zh: 他到处宣扬自己的观点。
宣扬.en: He publicizes his own opinions everywhere.

宣扬.zh: 公司最近在宣扬环保理念，做了很多活动。
宣扬.en: The company has been promoting environmental concepts recently and held many events.

宣扬.zh: 不要随便宣扬别人的隐私，这是基本礼貌。
宣扬.en: Don't casually publicize others' privacy; that's basic courtesy.

宣扬.zh: 虽然他的想法不错，但没必要那么高调地宣扬。
宣扬.en: Even though his idea is good, there's no need to publicize it so loudly.

宣扬.zh: 媒体不应该过度宣扬暴力内容。
宣扬.en: The media shouldn't excessively promote violent content.

牵扯.en: I don't want to get involved.

牵扯.zh: 这件事牵扯到了好几个部门。
他说的每一句话都牵扯到很多利益关系。
牵扯.en: Every word he says involves many interest relationships.

牵扯.zh: 你最好别牵扯太多人进来，不然会很难处理。
牵扯.en: You'd better not involve too many people, or it'll be hard to handle.

牵扯.zh: 这个案子牵扯的金额很大，警察很重视。
牵扯.en: This case involves a large amount of money, so the police are taking it seriously.

显示器.en: The monitor is broken; I need to replace it.

显示器.zh: 他把显示器调亮了一点，眼睛舒服多了。
显示器.en: He brightened the monitor a bit, and his eyes felt much better.

显示器.zh: 这个显示器的分辨率很高，看视频很清晰。
显示器.en: This monitor has a high resolution; watching videos is very clear.

显示器.zh: 工作的时候最好用两个显示器，效率会高很多。
显示器.en: It's best to use two monitors at work; it's much more efficient.

显示器.zh: 我的显示器最近老闪屏，不知道哪里出了问题。
显示器.en: My monitor has been flickering lately; I don't know what's wrong.

斗志.zh: 尽管输了比赛，他们的斗志依然不减。
斗志.en: Even though they lost the game, their fighting spirit didn't diminish.

斗志.zh: 领导的讲话鼓舞了大家的斗志。
斗志.en: The leader's speech boosted everyone's morale.

斗志.zh: 遇到困难时，要保持斗志，不能轻易放弃。
斗志.en: When facing difficulties, you must maintain your fighting spirit and not give up easily.

斗志.zh: 那场胜利彻底点燃了全队的斗志。
斗志.en: That victory completely ignited the team's fighting spirit.

如一.en: He is consistent in how he treats people.

如一.zh: 这家店的服务质量十年如一。
如一.en: This store's service quality has been consistent for ten years.

如一.zh: 她做事表里如一，从不虚伪。
如一.en: She is consistent in her actions and words, never hypocritical.

如一.zh: 不管外面怎么变，他对家人的关爱始终如一。
如一.en: No matter how things change outside, his love for his family remains the same.

如一.zh: 教练要求队员们在训练和比赛中态度如一。
如一.en: The coach requires the players to have a consistent attitude in training and games.

喝彩.zh: 他的表演赢得了全场的喝彩。
喝彩.en: His performance won cheers from the entire audience.

喝彩.zh: 进球的那一刻，球迷们发出了震天的喝彩。
喝彩.en: At the moment of the goal, the fans let out deafening cheers.

喝彩.zh: 虽然只是小成功，但我们也应该为彼此喝彩。
喝彩.en: Even though it's just a small success, we should still cheer for each other.

喝彩.zh: 他为队友的出色表现大声喝彩。
喝彩.en: He cheered loudly for his teammate's excellent performance.

致使.en: The rain caused the game to be postponed.

致使.zh: 操作不当致使机器损坏。
致使.en: Improper operation caused the machine to break down.

致使.zh: 长期的忽视致使病情加重。
致使.en: Long-term neglect caused the illness to worsen.

致使.zh: 交通堵塞致使他迟到了一个小时。
致使.en: The traffic jam caused him to be an hour late.

致使.zh: 他没有及时回复邮件，致使对方取消了订单。
致使.en: He didn't reply to the email in time, which caused the other party to cancel the order.

凭着.en: He made the decision based on intuition.

凭着.zh: 她凭着努力考上了好大学。
凭着.en: She got into a good university through hard work.

凭着.zh: 我凭着这张票可以免费入场。
凭着.en: With this ticket, I can enter for free.

凭着.zh: 他凭着多年的经验解决了这个难题。
凭着.en: He solved this difficult problem relying on years of experience.

凭着.zh: 她凭着出色的口才说服了所有人。
凭着.en: She convinced everyone with her excellent eloquence.

序.en: The opening sequence of the movie is very short.

序.zh: 你先看一下这本书的序吧。
序.en: First take a look at the preface of this book.

序.zh: 按时间顺序排列，不要打乱序。
序.en: Arrange in chronological order, don't mess up the sequence.

序.zh: 他做事很有条理，每一步都有序。
序.en: He is very organized in doing things, every step has order.

序.zh: 会议开始前，主持人先介绍了议程的序。
序.en: Before the meeting started, the host first introduced the order of the agenda.

埋伏.zh: 他们在树林里设了埋伏。
埋伏.en: They set an ambush in the woods.
Be careful, there might be an ambush.

埋伏.zh: 警察提前埋伏在小区周围抓小偷。
埋伏.en: The police ambushed around the neighborhood in advance to catch the thief.

埋伏.zh: 敌人中了我们的埋伏，损失惨重。
埋伏.en: The enemy fell into our ambush and suffered heavy losses.

埋伏.zh: 别埋伏在那吓我，快出来吧。
埋伏.en: Don't hide there to scare me, come out now.

结算.zh: 吃完饭我们直接结算了。
结算.en: After the meal, we settled the bill directly.

结算.zh: 月底公司会统一结算工资。
结算.en: The company will settle salaries uniformly at the end of the month.

结算.zh: 你可以在线结算订单，很方便。
结算.en: You can settle the order online, it's very convenient.

结算.zh: 因为汇率波动，结算时多付了一点。
结算.en: Due to exchange rate fluctuations, we paid a bit more during settlement.

结算.zh: 我们先把这笔账结算清楚，再谈合作。
结算.en: Let's settle this account clearly first, then talk about cooperation.

引诱.zh: 别用零食引诱孩子吃饭。
引诱.en: Don't use snacks to lure the child into eating.

引诱.zh: 他试图用高薪引诱我跳槽。
引诱.en: He tried to entice me to change jobs with a high salary.

引诱.zh: 这些优惠券就是为了引诱顾客消费。
引诱.en: These coupons are meant to lure customers into spending.

引诱.zh: 狐狸用花言巧语引诱乌鸦唱歌。
引诱.en: The fox used sweet talk to lure the crow into singing.

引诱.zh: 警方设局引诱嫌疑人露面。
引诱.en: The police set a trap to lure the suspect out.

格式.en: The format of this document is wrong.

格式.zh: 请按照标准格式填写表格。
格式.en: Please fill out the form according to the standard format.

格式.zh: 图片的格式是jpg，可以上传。
格式.en: The image format is jpg, you can upload it.

格式.zh: 你发的邮件格式有点乱，调整一下。
格式.en: The format of the email you sent is a bit messy, adjust it.

格式.zh: 虽然内容一样，但不同格式的效果差别很大。
格式.en: Although the content is the same, different formats have very different effects.

不经意.zh: 我经过时不经意看了他一眼。
不经意.en: I gave him an inadvertent glance as I passed by.

不经意.zh: 她不经意间发现了一个秘密。
他说话时不经意的动作显得很自然。
不经意.en: His inadvertent movements while speaking seemed very natural.

不经意.zh: 有时候不经意的小事反而让人印象深刻。
不经意.en: Sometimes inadvertent little things leave a deep impression.

调度.en: The bus dispatch is very reasonable.

调度.zh: 他负责整个项目的资源调度。
调度.en: He is responsible for the resource allocation of the entire project.

调度.zh: 因为天气原因，航班调度需要临时调整。
调度.en: Due to weather, flight scheduling needs temporary adjustments.

调度.zh: 调度员正在指挥车辆有序进出。
调度.en: The dispatcher is directing vehicles to enter and exit in an orderly manner.

调度.zh: 系统能自动调度工作任务，提高效率。
调度.en: The system can automatically dispatch work tasks, improving efficiency.

看台.en: The stands were full of spectators.

看台.zh: 我们买了看台第一排的票。
看台.en: We bought tickets for the first row of the stands.

看台.zh: 比赛太激烈了，看台上的欢呼声震耳欲聋。
看台.en: The game was so intense, the cheers from the stands were deafening.

看台.zh: 他站在看台上给球员加油。
看台.en: He stood in the stands cheering for the players.

看台.zh: 新体育馆的看台可以容纳两万人。
看台.en: The stands of the new stadium can hold twenty thousand people.

燃油.en: Fuel has gone up in price again recently.

燃油.zh: 飞机起飞前必须加满燃油。
燃油.en: The plane must have a full tank of fuel before takeoff.

燃油.zh: 船上的燃油快用完了，需要补给。
燃油.en: The ship is almost out of fuel and needs resupply.

燃油.zh: 因为燃油不足，他们被迫中途降落。
燃油.en: Due to insufficient fuel, they were forced to make an intermediate landing.

审视.zh: 他仔细审视了这份合同。
我们需要重新审视这个方案。
审视.en: We need to re-examine this plan.

审视.zh: 她审视着镜子里的自己，有点不自信。
审视.en: She scrutinized herself in the mirror, feeling a bit insecure.

审视.zh: 法官用审视的目光看着证人。
审视.en: The judge looked at the witness with a scrutinizing gaze.

审视.zh: 在做出决定之前，最好先审视一下各种可能性。
审视.en: Before making a decision, it's best to first examine all possibilities.

半数.zh: 半数同学都选了那门课。
半数.en: Half of the classmates chose that course.

半数.zh: 这次考试的及格率还不到半数，大家得加油了。
半数.en: The passing rate for this exam was less than half, everyone needs to work harder.

半数.zh: 公司半数员工是远程办公。
半数.en: Half of the company's employees work remotely.

半数.zh: 虽然报名人数很多，但实际到场的不到半数。
半数.en: Although many people signed up, less than half actually showed up.

半数.zh: 因为半数成员都不同意这个方案，所以我们只能重新讨论。
半数.en: Since half of the members disagreed with this plan, we had to discuss it again.

表彰.en: The school commended the outstanding students.

表彰.zh: 公司每年都会召开大会表彰业绩突出的员工。
表彰.en: The company holds a meeting every year to commend employees with outstanding performance.

表彰.zh: 他被表彰为年度最佳员工。
表彰.en: He was commended as the employee of the year.

表彰.zh: 这次表彰活动不仅肯定了大家的努力，也激励了更多人。
表彰.en: This commendation event not only affirmed everyone's efforts but also inspired more people.

表彰.zh: 虽然他没有得到公开表彰，但大家都心里感激他。
表彰.en: Although he didn't receive a public commendation, everyone was grateful to him in their hearts.

过瘾.zh: 周末去爬山，出了一身汗，感觉特别过瘾。
过瘾.en: Hiking on the weekend, sweating a lot, felt especially satisfying.

过瘾.zh: 这部电影看得真不过瘾。
过瘾.en: This movie was not satisfying to watch at all.

过瘾.zh: 我喜欢打篮球，每次投进三分球都觉得特别过瘾。
过瘾.en: I like playing basketball; every time I make a three-pointer, it feels especially satisfying.

过瘾.zh: 虽然游戏玩得很过瘾，但第二天上班还是有点累。
过瘾.en: Although the game was very satisfying, I was still a bit tired going to work the next day.

前夕.zh: 圣诞节前夕，街上很热闹。
前夕.en: On Christmas Eve, the streets are very lively.

前夕.zh: 考试前夕，他还在熬夜复习。
前夕.en: On the eve of the exam, he was still staying up late to study.

前夕.zh: 婚礼前夕，她紧张得睡不着。
前夕.en: On the eve of the wedding, she was too nervous to sleep.

前夕.zh: 项目截止前夕，整个团队都在加班加点。
前夕.en: On the eve of the project deadline, the whole team was working overtime.

前夕.zh: 因为明天就要出发，所以旅行前夕我一直在收拾行李。
前夕.en: Because we are leaving tomorrow, I have been packing my luggage on the eve of the trip.

赎.zh: 她把当掉的首饰都赎回来了。
赎.en: She redeemed all the jewelry she had pawned.
This money is used to ransom people.

赎.zh: 他想办法筹钱，把抵押的房子赎了回来。
赎.en: He found a way to raise money and redeemed the mortgaged house.

赎.zh: 虽然赎金很高，但他还是决定把朋友赎出来。
赎.en: Although the ransom was high, he still decided to redeem his friend.

养活.en: He supports his family by farming.

养活.zh: 这份工资勉强能养活他自己，但存不下钱。
养活.en: This salary barely supports himself, but he can't save money.

养活.zh: 她一个人养活两个孩子。
在城市里养活的成本越来越高，很多人选择回老家。
养活.en: The cost of living in the city is getting higher and higher, many people choose to go back to their hometown.

养活.zh: 虽然工作很辛苦，但为了养活家人，他从不抱怨。
养活.en: Although the work is hard, in order to support his family, he never complains.

抗争.zh: 人民在为自己的权利抗争。
抗争.en: The people are struggling for their rights.

抗争.zh: 历史上有很多人为自由而抗争。
抗争.en: In history, many people struggled for freedom.
He has been fighting against illness.

抗争.zh: 面对不公，我们应该勇敢抗争，而不是沉默。
抗争.en: Facing injustice, we should bravely resist, not remain silent.

抗争.zh: 虽然抗争的过程很艰难，但他们从未放弃希望。
抗争.en: Although the process of resistance was difficult, they never gave up hope.

得益于.en: He benefited from his parents' help.

得益于.zh: 这项技术的进步得益于多年的研究。
得益于.en: The advancement of this technology benefits from years of research.

得益于.zh: 我的成功得益于朋友的支持。
得益于.en: My success benefits from friends' support.

得益于.zh: 公司的发展得益于团队的努力和市场的机遇。
得益于.en: The company's development benefits from the team's efforts and market opportunities.

得益于.zh: 因为得益于良好的教育背景，他找工作非常顺利。
得益于.en: Because he benefited from a good educational background, he found a job very smoothly.

电网.en: The power grid is being upgraded recently.

电网.zh: 暴风雨过后，电网受损严重，很多地方停电了。
电网.en: After the storm, the power grid was severely damaged, and many places lost power.
The safety of the power grid is very important.

电网.zh: 随着新能源发展，电网也需要相应调整。
电网.en: With the development of new energy, the power grid also needs corresponding adjustments.

电网.zh: 虽然电网已经修复，但部分地区供电还不稳定。
电网.en: Although the power grid has been repaired, power supply in some areas is still unstable.

师范.en: She got into a normal university.

师范.zh: 读师范专业的学生毕业后大多当了老师。
师范.en: Most students who study normal (teacher-training) majors become teachers after graduation.

师范.zh: 这所师范学校历史很悠久。
师范.en: This normal school has a long history.

师范.zh: 他选择师范是因为喜欢教书育人。
师范.en: He chose the normal (teacher-training) track because he likes teaching and educating people.

师范.zh: 虽然师范专业很辛苦，但看到学生进步就很有成就感。
师范.en: Although the normal (teacher-training) major is very hard, seeing students improve brings a sense of achievement.

友善.en: He is very friendly to people.

友善.zh: 虽然他是领导，但态度非常友善。
友善.en: Although he is a leader, his attitude is very friendly.

友善.zh: 我邻居的狗狗特别友善，从来不叫。
友善.en: My neighbor's dog is very friendly and never barks.

友善.zh: 她友善地提醒我别忘了带伞。
友善.en: She kindly reminded me not to forget my umbrella.

友善.zh: 在新公司里，大家都很友善，让我很快就适应了。
友善.en: In the new company, everyone is very friendly, so I adapted quickly.

出走.en: He left because of a quarrel.

出走.zh: 青少年出走的问题越来越严重。
出走.en: The problem of teenagers running away is getting more serious.

出走.zh: 她一时冲动就离家出走了。
出走.en: She impulsively ran away from home.

出走.zh: 那只猫出走三天后又自己回来了。
出走.en: That cat ran away for three days and then came back on its own.

出走.zh: 老王的孩子出走以后，他每天都在找。
出走.en: After Old Wang's child ran away, he searched every day.

浮现.en: The past emerges before my eyes.

浮现.zh: 看到这张照片，记忆慢慢浮现。
浮现.en: Seeing this photo, memories slowly emerge.

浮现.zh: 她的笑容总浮现在我心里。
浮现.en: Her smile always appears in my heart.

浮现.zh: 一提到故乡，很多画面就浮现出来。
浮现.en: Whenever mentioning hometown, many images emerge.

浮现.zh: 虽然他走了，但那些回忆还是会偶尔浮现。
浮现.en: Although he left, those memories still occasionally emerge.

兴奋剂.zh: 兴奋剂对身体的危害很大。
兴奋剂.en: Stimulants are very harmful to the body.

兴奋剂.zh: 他因为服用兴奋剂被禁赛了。
兴奋剂.en: He was banned for taking stimulants.

兴奋剂.zh: 咖啡虽然不是兴奋剂，但也能提神。
兴奋剂.en: Although coffee is not a stimulant, it can also refresh.

兴奋剂.zh: 体育比赛中严禁使用任何兴奋剂。
兴奋剂.en: The use of any stimulants is strictly prohibited in sports competitions.

站立.en: He stood at the door waiting for me.
If you stand too long, your back will hurt.
She stood unsteadily and almost fell.

站立.zh: 老师让我们全部站起来，站立了五分钟。
站立.en: The teacher made us all stand up and stand for five minutes.

惊慌.zh: 他听到消息后非常惊慌。
惊慌.en: He was very alarmed after hearing the news.
Everyone ran out the door in panic.

惊慌.zh: 孩子走丢了，她惊慌失措。
惊慌.en: The child got lost; she was panic-stricken.

惊慌.zh: 虽然情况紧急，但不要惊慌，冷静处理。
惊慌.en: Although the situation is urgent, don't panic; handle it calmly.

测定.en: We need to measure the water temperature.
Before the experiment, we must measure the data.

测定.zh: 他们用仪器测定了空气质量。
测定.en: They measured the air quality with instruments.

测定.zh: 医生测定了他的血压和心率。
测定.en: The doctor measured his blood pressure and heart rate.

测定.zh: 这块土地的酸碱度需要精确测定。
测定.en: The pH of this land needs to be precisely measured.

肥料.en: This fertilizer is easy to use.
Growing vegetables requires adding some fertilizer.
The farmer spreads fertilizer in the field.

肥料.zh: 有机肥料比化学肥料更环保。
肥料.en: Organic fertilizer is more environmentally friendly than chemical fertilizer.

肥料.zh: 如果肥料放太多，反而会伤害植物。
肥料.en: If you put too much fertilizer, it will actually harm the plants.

执照.zh: 这家店的营业执照很新。
执照.en: The business license of this shop is very new.

执照.zh: 开车时必须随身携带执照。
执照.en: You must carry your license with you when driving.

执照.zh: 他因为没有执照被罚款了。
执照.en: He was fined for not having a license.

执照.zh: 办这个执照需要很多手续和证件。
执照.en: Getting this license requires many procedures and documents.

滋润.en: This lotion moisturizes the skin very well.
She lives a very comfortable life.

滋润.zh: 多喝水能让皮肤更滋润。
滋润.en: Drinking more water can make skin more moist.

滋润.zh: 这个面霜用起来很滋润，不油腻。
滋润.en: This cream feels very moisturizing, not greasy.

寄托.zh: 我把希望寄托在你身上。
寄托.en: I place my hopes on you.

寄托.zh: 她把全部感情都寄托在宠物身上。
寄托.en: She places all her emotions on her pet.

寄托.zh: 虽然父母把期望寄托在我身上，但我有自己的想法。
寄托.en: Although my parents place their expectations on me, I have my own ideas.

寄托.zh: 这部小说寄托了作者对故乡的思念。
寄托.en: This novel embodies the author's longing for his hometown.

寄托.zh: 我们不要把快乐寄托在别人身上。
寄托.en: We shouldn't place our happiness on others.

手术室.en: The door of the operating room closed.

手术室.zh: 他已经在手术室里待了三个小时。
手术室.en: He has been in the operating room for three hours.

手术室.zh: 因为情况紧急，我们立刻把他送进了手术室。
手术室.en: Because the situation was urgent, we immediately sent him into the operating room.

手术室.zh: 手术室外面，她的家人正在焦急地等待。
手术室.en: Outside the operating room, her family is anxiously waiting.

手术室.zh: 护士推着病人进了手术室。
手术室.en: The nurse pushed the patient into the operating room.

趁着.en: While you're young, go out and travel more.

趁着.zh: 趁着打折，我们买了很多东西。
趁着.en: Taking advantage of the sale, we bought a lot of things.

趁着.zh: 你趁着他还没走，赶紧把东西给他。
趁着.en: While he hasn't left yet, hurry and give him the stuff.

趁着.zh: 趁着今天天气好，我们去公园散步吧。
趁着.en: Since the weather is nice today, let's go for a walk in the park.

趁着.zh: 他趁着大家不注意，偷偷溜走了。
趁着.en: He sneaked away while nobody was paying attention.

歉意.zh: 他因为迟到表达了深深的歉意。
歉意.en: He expressed deep apology for being late.

歉意.zh: 虽然他已经表示了歉意，但我还是有点生气。
歉意.en: Although he has already expressed his apology, I am still a bit angry.

歉意.zh: 他带着歉意对我说了声对不起。
歉意.en: He said sorry to me with an apologetic tone.

报答.en: I want to repay your help.

报答.zh: 他发誓要报答父母的养育之恩。
报答.en: He swore to repay his parents' nurturing kindness.

报答.zh: 你对我这么好，我该怎么报答你呢？
报答.en: You've been so good to me, how can I repay you?

报答.zh: 他用自己的成功报答了老师的教导。
报答.en: He repaid his teacher's guidance with his own success.

报答.zh: 我报答不了你对我的恩情。
报答.en: I can't repay the kindness you've shown me.

灯泡.en: The light bulb is broken, let's replace it.
This light bulb isn't bright enough.

灯泡.zh: 家里的灯泡突然不亮了，我得去买新的。
灯泡.en: The light bulb at home suddenly went out, I have to buy a new one.
He stood under the light bulb reading a book.

灯泡.zh: 因为灯泡太亮，她戴上了墨镜。
灯泡.en: Because the light bulb was too bright, she put on sunglasses.

捂.en: He is lying in bed holding his stomach.

捂.zh: 因为太冷，她捂紧了外套。
捂.en: Because it was too cold, she tightened her coat around herself.

捂.zh: 他捂住嘴，不让自己笑出声来。
捂.en: He covered his mouth to keep from laughing out loud.
She covered her face and started crying.

可观.zh: 他赚了一笔可观的奖金。
虽然成本很高，但利润还是相当可观的。
可观.en: Although the cost is high, the profit is still quite considerable.

可观.zh: 展览吸引了可观数量的游客。
可观.en: The exhibition attracted a considerable number of visitors.

可观.zh: 她的存款已经达到一个可观的数字。
可观.en: Her savings have reached a considerable figure.

脱落.en: His hair is starting to fall out.

脱落.zh: 墙上的油漆一块块地脱落。
脱落.en: The paint on the wall is peeling off in pieces.

脱落.zh: 因为缺乏营养，她的牙齿开始脱落。
脱落.en: Due to lack of nutrition, her teeth are starting to fall out.
In autumn, leaves fall off one after another.

脱落.zh: 他手上的皮因受伤而脱落。
脱落.en: The skin on his hand peeled off due to injury.

拿手.zh: 妈妈的拿手菜是红烧肉。
拿手.en: Mom's specialty dish is braised pork.

拿手.zh: 你最拿手的是什么运动？
拿手.en: What sport are you best at?

拿手.zh: 虽然他什么都会，但最拿手的还是画画。
拿手.en: Although he can do everything, his best skill is still drawing.

拿手.zh: 这道菜是厨师最拿手的，你一定要尝尝。
拿手.en: This dish is the chef's specialty; you must try it.

核桃.zh: 早上吃几个核桃对大脑有好处。
核桃.en: Eating a few walnuts in the morning is good for the brain.

核桃.zh: 他买了一袋核桃，准备做蛋糕。
核桃.en: He bought a bag of walnuts to make a cake.

核桃.zh: 虽然核桃很营养，但是也不能吃太多。
核桃.en: Although walnuts are nutritious, you can't eat too many.
This walnut cracker is very useful.

收敛.en: You need to restrain yourself a bit.

收敛.zh: 他的脾气最近收敛了很多。
收敛.en: His temper has restrained a lot recently.
This medicine has an astringent effect.

收敛.zh: 如果他不收敛态度，大家都会讨厌他。
收敛.en: If he doesn't restrain his attitude, everyone will hate him.

点评.zh: 他在网上写了一篇餐厅点评。
点评.en: He wrote a restaurant review online.

点评.zh: 老师对作文进行了点评。
点评.en: The teacher commented on the essay.

点评.zh: 因为他点评很客观，所以大家都信服。
点评.en: Because his comments are objective, everyone is convinced.

点评.zh: 这部电影的点评都不错。
点评.en: The reviews of this movie are all good.

募捐.en: They are fundraising for the disaster area.

募捐.zh: 公司组织了一次募捐活动。
募捐.en: The company organized a fundraising event.
The donation box is placed at the door.

募捐.zh: 虽然募捐金额不大，但心意很足。
募捐.en: Although the donation amount is small, the intention is strong.

募捐.zh: 他主动提出要帮忙募捐。
募捐.en: He offered to help with fundraising.

傲慢.zh: 傲慢的态度让他失去了很多朋友。
傲慢.en: His arrogant attitude made him lose many friends.

傲慢.zh: 她说话时带着傲慢的语气。
傲慢.en: She speaks with an arrogant tone.

傲慢.zh: 虽然他很有能力，但傲慢让人不舒服。
傲慢.en: Although he is very capable, his arrogance makes people uncomfortable.

开阔.en: The view here is very broad.
Reading more can broaden your horizons.

开阔.zh: 如果你去旅行，就能开阔心胸。
开阔.en: If you travel, you can broaden your mind.

开阔.zh: 他把房间的窗户改大了，让空间更开阔。
开阔.en: He enlarged the window to make the space more open.

脉搏.zh: 跑步后他的脉搏跳得很快。
脉搏.en: After running, his pulse beats fast.
The pulse is normal, no need to worry.

脉搏.zh: 虽然脉搏微弱，但还有生命迹象。
脉搏.en: Although the pulse is weak, there are still signs of life.
You need to learn to take your own pulse.

掰.en: He broke the cookie in half.
Don't break it with your hands, use a knife.

掰.zh: 他掰下一块巧克力给我。
掰.en: He broke off a piece of chocolate for me.

掰.zh: 因为面包太硬，他掰了半天才弄开。
掰.en: Because the bread was too hard, he struggled to break it apart.

选项.zh: 试卷上有四个选项让你选。
选项.en: There are four options on the test paper for you to choose.
There are too many options on the menu.

选项.zh: 如果这个选项不行，就换另一个。
选项.en: If this option doesn't work, switch to another.

选项.zh: 我们讨论了所有可能的选项。

阻力.zh: 空气阻力会影响汽车速度。
反对的声音成了主要阻力。
阻力.en: The opposing voices became the main obstruction.

阻力.zh: 虽然遇到很多阻力，但他们没放弃。
阻力.en: Although they encountered a lot of resistance, they didn't give up.

阻力.zh: 他在前进中感受到了阻力。
阻力.en: He felt resistance in his progress.

全方位.zh: 这个方案需要全方位考虑市场、技术和资金。
全方位.en: This plan needs comprehensive consideration of market, technology, and funds.

全方位.zh: 公司要对员工进行全方位培训。
全方位.en: The company should conduct comprehensive training for employees.

全方位.zh: 虽然预算有限，但我们要确保全方位覆盖。
全方位.en: Although the budget is limited, we must ensure comprehensive coverage.

全方位.zh: 这个系统能全方位监控车辆运行。
全方位.en: This system can comprehensively monitor vehicle operation.

车轮.zh: 汽车车轮在泥地里打滑。
车轮.en: The car wheels were slipping in the mud.

车轮.zh: 这辆车的车轮需要换个新的。
车轮.en: This car's wheels need to be replaced with new ones.

车轮.zh: 因为路面不平，车轮颠簸得很厉害。
车轮.en: Because the road is uneven, the wheels are bumping badly.

车轮.zh: 火车车轮与铁轨摩擦发出刺耳的声音。
车轮.en: The train wheels rubbing against the tracks made a piercing sound.

缘分.en: We have a lot of fate.

缘分.zh: 能在这里遇到你，真是缘分啊。
缘分.en: To meet you here is really fate.

缘分.zh: 缘分这种事谁也说不清楚。
缘分.en: Things like fate, no one can explain clearly.

缘分.zh: 虽然我们相隔很远，但缘分让我们相遇。
缘分.en: Although we are far apart, fate brought us together.

缘分.zh: 你觉得两个人在一起靠的是缘分还是努力？
缘分.en: Do you think two people being together depends on fate or effort?

搏斗.zh: 警察与歹徒展开了激烈的搏斗。
搏斗.en: The police engaged in a fierce struggle with the gangster.

搏斗.zh: 他为了生存与海浪搏斗。
搏斗.en: He struggled against the waves to survive.

搏斗.zh: 虽然受伤了，但他仍然坚持搏斗到底。
搏斗.en: Although injured, he still insisted on fighting to the end.

搏斗.zh: 病魔面前，他要和家人一起搏斗。
搏斗.en: In the face of illness, he has to fight together with his family.

腐烂.zh: 这些蔬菜放在冰箱里太久，已经开始腐烂。
腐烂.en: These vegetables have been in the fridge too long and have started to rot.

腐烂.zh: 如果不及时处理，这些垃圾会腐烂发臭。
腐烂.en: If not handled in time, this garbage will rot and stink.

腐烂.zh: 木材长期受潮容易腐烂。
腐烂.en: Wood that is damp for a long time easily rots.

足迹.en: There are footprints in the snow.

足迹.zh: 探险家的足迹遍布世界各地。
足迹.en: The explorer's footprints are all over the world.

足迹.zh: 警察在现场发现了可疑的足迹。
足迹.en: The police found suspicious footprints at the scene.

足迹.zh: 虽然岁月流逝，但他在我们心中留下的足迹不会消失。
足迹.en: Although time passes, the footprints he left in our hearts will not disappear.

足迹.zh: 我们要沿着先辈的足迹继续前进。
足迹.en: We must continue to advance along the footprints of our predecessors.

照料.en: She takes care of the child.

照料.zh: 他每天都要照料院子里的花草。
照料.en: He has to take care of the flowers and plants in the yard every day.
The patient needs someone to take care of them.

照料.zh: 因为父母工作忙，奶奶负责照料我的生活。
照料.en: Because parents are busy with work, grandma is responsible for taking care of my life.

照料.zh: 这家养老院的老人得到很好的照料。
照料.en: The elderly in this nursing home receive good care.

怨恨.en: He has resentment in his heart.

怨恨.zh: 他对这件事一直心存怨恨。
怨恨.en: He has been holding resentment about this matter.

怨恨.zh: 争吵只会增加彼此的怨恨。
虽然表面上和好了，但内心还有怨恨。
怨恨.en: Although they made up on the surface, there is still resentment inside.

粪便.zh: 宠物的粪便要及时清理。
粪便.en: Pet feces should be cleaned up promptly.

粪便.zh: 肥料通常是用粪便做的。
粪便.en: Fertilizer is usually made from feces.

粪便.zh: 如果不及时清理，粪便会产生难闻的气味。
粪便.en: If not cleaned in time, feces will produce a bad smell.

粪便.zh: 科学家研究大象的粪便来了解它们的健康。
粪便.en: Scientists study elephant feces to understand their health.

飞跃.zh: 近年来科技有了飞跃式的进步。
飞跃.en: In recent years, technology has made a leap forward.

飞跃.zh: 这个城市实现了历史性飞跃。
飞跃.en: This city has achieved a historic leap.

飞跃.zh: 通过不断努力，他的成绩有了飞跃。
飞跃.en: Through continuous effort, his grades have made a leap.

飞跃.zh: 运动员飞跃栏杆的一刻非常精彩。
飞跃.en: The moment the athlete leaped over the hurdle was very exciting.

合唱.en: Our class won first place in chorus.

合唱.zh: 她喜欢参加合唱团，因为大家一起唱歌很开心。
合唱.en: She likes joining the choir because singing together is fun.

合唱.zh: 这次合唱比赛要求每个队唱两首歌。
合唱.en: This chorus competition requires each team to sing two songs.

合唱.zh: 虽然排练很累，但是合唱的效果特别好。
合唱.en: Although rehearsals are tiring, the chorus effect is especially good.

合唱.zh: 他俩合唱了一首情歌，大家都鼓掌了。
合唱.en: The two of them sang a love song in duet, everyone applauded.

冷酷.zh: 老板对员工非常冷酷，从不关心他们的感受。
冷酷.en: The boss is very cold-hearted to employees, never caring about their feelings.

冷酷.zh: 虽然他外表冷酷，但其实内心很温柔。
冷酷.en: Although he looks cold-hearted, he is actually gentle inside.

冷酷.zh: 这部电影里的反派角色特别冷酷无情。
冷酷.en: The villain in this movie is especially cold and ruthless.

冷酷.zh: 别用那种冷酷的眼神看我。
冷酷.en: Don't look at me with that cold-hearted expression.

开拓.en: The company wants to open up new markets.

开拓.zh: 他们计划开拓海外业务，需要更多资金。
开拓.en: They plan to expand overseas business and need more funds.

开拓.zh: 只有不断创新，才能开拓更广阔的发展空间。
开拓.en: Only by continuous innovation can we open up broader development space.

开拓.zh: 这位科学家开拓了一个全新的研究领域。
开拓.en: This scientist pioneered a completely new research field.

开拓.zh: 年轻人应该勇于开拓自己的未来。
开拓.en: Young people should dare to open up their own future.

办事处.en: The office is on the second floor.

办事处.zh: 我们公司在上海设了一个办事处，方便联系客户。
办事处.en: Our company set up an office in Shanghai to facilitate contacting clients.

办事处.zh: 因为总部在北京，所以这里只是临时办事处。
办事处.en: Because the headquarters is in Beijing, this is just a temporary office.

办事处.zh: 他明天要去办事处办点手续。
办事处.en: Tomorrow he needs to go to the office to handle some formalities.

办事处.zh: 这个办事处负责处理本地事务。
办事处.en: This office is responsible for handling local affairs.

风筝.zh: 周末公园里很多人在放风筝，天气特别好。
风筝.en: Many people are flying kites in the park on weekends, the weather is great.

风筝.zh: 虽然风不大，但风筝还是飞起来了。
风筝.en: Although the wind is not strong, the kite still flew up.

风筝.zh: 小时候我最喜欢自己动手做风筝。
风筝.en: When I was little, I loved making kites by myself.

风筝.zh: 风筝线断了，它越飞越远。
风筝.en: The kite string broke, and it flew farther and farther away.

要好.en: The two of them are very close.

要好.zh: 从小我们就很要好，到现在还是好朋友。
要好.en: We have been close since childhood and are still good friends now.

要好.zh: 虽然性格不同，但我们一直很要好。
要好.en: Although our personalities differ, we have always been close.

要好.zh: 他们最近闹矛盾，没有以前那么要好了。
要好.en: They recently had a conflict and are not as close as before.
Who is your best friend in class?

怀旧.zh: 听这首歌让我很怀旧，想起很多小时候的事。
怀旧.en: Listening to this song makes me nostalgic, reminding me of many childhood things.

怀旧.zh: 虽然时代变了，但老人家还是很怀旧。
怀旧.en: Although times have changed, the elderly are still very nostalgic.

怀旧.zh: 这家餐厅装修得很怀旧，像八十年代的样子。
怀旧.en: This restaurant is decorated in a nostalgic style, like the 1980s.

怀旧.zh: 别总是怀旧，多看看未来吧。
怀旧.en: Don't always be nostalgic; look more to the future.

神仙.zh: 传说这座山里住着一位神仙，能实现愿望。
神仙.en: Legend says an immortal lives in this mountain who can grant wishes.

神仙.zh: 如果能天天度假，那简直就是神仙日子！
神仙.en: If I could vacation every day, that would be an immortal's life!

神仙.zh: 你做饭这么好吃，简直是神仙下凡！
神仙.en: You cook so deliciously, you're like an immortal descending to earth!

一连串.en: He asked a series of questions.

一连串.zh: 最近发生了一连串奇怪的事情，让人很不安。
一连串.en: Recently a series of strange events happened, making people uneasy.

一连串.zh: 因为一连串的失误，我们输掉了比赛。
一连串.en: Due to a series of mistakes, we lost the match.

一连串.zh: 她收到了一连串的祝福短信。
一连串.en: She received a string of blessing text messages.

一连串.zh: 电影里有一连串精彩的打斗场面。
一连串.en: The movie has a series of exciting fight scenes.

逃亡.en: He began a life of fleeing.

逃亡.zh: 罪犯逃亡了好几年，最后还是被抓到了。
逃亡.en: The criminal fled for several years but was finally caught.

逃亡.zh: 因为战争，很多人不得不逃亡到国外。
逃亡.en: Because of the war, many people had to flee abroad.

逃亡.zh: 这部小说讲的是一个逃亡者的故事。
逃亡.en: This novel tells the story of a fugitive.

逃亡.zh: 逃亡的路上，他遇到了很多困难。
逃亡.en: On the road of escape, he encountered many difficulties.

抽签.en: We draw lots to decide who goes.

抽签.zh: 因为奖品太少，所以大家只能抽签选一个人。
抽签.en: Because there are too few prizes, everyone can only draw lots to choose one person.
Before the match, we need to draw lots to form groups.

抽签.zh: 如果你不想抽签，我们可以轮流做。
抽签.en: If you don't want to draw lots, we can take turns.

无须.zh: 这件事你无须亲自来，打个电话就行。
无须.en: You don't need to come in person for this matter; just make a phone call.

无须.zh: 既然已经解决了，就无须再提了。
无须.en: Since it's already resolved, there's no need to mention it again.

无须.zh: 我们无须等到明天，现在就可以开始。
无须.en: We don't need to wait until tomorrow; we can start now.

抛开.en: Let's set aside this problem first.

抛开.zh: 我们抛开成见，好好谈一谈。
抛开.en: Let's put aside prejudices and have a good talk.

抛开.zh: 如果你能抛开过去，未来会更好。
抛开.en: If you can put aside the past, the future will be better.

抛开.zh: 他决定抛开所有顾虑，勇敢追求梦想。
抛开.en: He decided to set aside all concerns and bravely pursue his dreams.

柔和.zh: 她的声音非常柔和，让人觉得很舒服。
柔和.en: Her voice is very gentle, making people feel comfortable.

柔和.zh: 虽然她生气，但语气还是很柔和。
柔和.en: Although she was angry, her tone was still gentle.

柔和.zh: 傍晚的阳光柔和地洒在湖面上。
柔和.en: The evening sunlight softly falls on the lake surface.

迫害.zh: 历史上很多人因为信仰不同而遭受迫害。
迫害.en: In history, many people suffered persecution because of different beliefs.

迫害.zh: 如果不能容忍异见，就容易产生迫害。
迫害.en: If you cannot tolerate dissenting opinions, persecution is likely to occur.
This kind of persecution is unjust.

迫害.zh: 我们反对任何形式的政治迫害。
迫害.en: We oppose any form of political persecution.

退缩.en: He never backs down when facing difficulties.

退缩.zh: 面对挑战时，很多人会选择退缩而不是坚持。
退缩.en: When facing challenges, many people choose to back off rather than persist.

退缩.zh: 如果你总是退缩，就永远无法成功。
退缩.en: If you always retreat, you will never succeed.
Don't back out at the last moment.

退缩.zh: 他在辩论中一被反驳就退缩了。
退缩.en: He shrank back as soon as he was refuted in the debate.

谅解.zh: 这件事是我做错了，请求你的谅解。
谅解.en: I was wrong in this matter; I ask for your understanding.

谅解.zh: 因为事出突然，所以希望大家能互相谅解。
谅解.en: Because it happened suddenly, I hope everyone can understand each other.

谅解.zh: 如果你能谅解他的苦衷，就不会生气了。
谅解.en: If you can understand his difficulties, you won't be angry.

补给.zh: 探险队在山里断了粮，急需补给。
补给.en: The expedition team ran out of food in the mountains and urgently needed supplies.

补给.zh: 因为路途遥远，补给车三天才能到一次。
补给.en: Because the journey is long, supply trucks can only arrive once every three days.

补给.zh: 他们在沙漠中失去了补给线，情况非常危险。
补给.en: They lost the supply line in the desert, and the situation was very dangerous.

颠倒.en: You wore it backwards, upside down.

颠倒.zh: 他把照片拿颠倒了，自己都没发现。
颠倒.en: He held the photo upside down without noticing.

颠倒.zh: 不要颠倒因果，要先弄清楚原因。
颠倒.en: Don't reverse cause and effect; first figure out the reason.

颠倒.zh: 他因为太累，把时间都颠倒了，白天睡觉晚上工作。
颠倒.en: Because he was too tired, he reversed his schedule, sleeping during the day and working at night.

无从.en: This matter is hard to start on.

无从.zh: 资料太少了，我们无从判断真相。
无从.en: There is too little information; we have no way to judge the truth.

无从.zh: 如果没有任何线索，警方也无从查起。
无从.en: If there is no clue, the police also have no way to investigate.

无从.zh: 他无从解释自己的行为。
无从.en: He had no way to explain his behavior.

无从.zh: 面对这么多选择，我无从决定该买哪个。
无从.en: Facing so many choices, I have no way to decide which to buy.

夜班.en: I'm working the night shift tonight.

夜班.zh: 因为要上夜班，所以我下午先睡了一觉。
夜班.en: Because I have the night shift, I took a nap in the afternoon.

夜班.zh: 夜班很辛苦，但工资高一些。
夜班.en: The night shift is hard, but the pay is a bit higher.
She doesn't like working night shifts.

夜班.zh: 连续上了三天夜班，他看起来非常累。
夜班.en: After three consecutive night shifts, he looks very tired.

辛勤.zh: 经过多年的辛勤努力，他终于成功了。
辛勤.en: After years of hard work, he finally succeeded.

辛勤.zh: 虽然工作很辛苦，但他一直辛勤付出。
辛勤.en: Although the work is hard, he has been putting in diligent effort.
Thank you for your hard work.

粗暴.zh: 对待孩子不能太粗暴，要有耐心。
粗暴.en: You can't be too rough with children; you need patience.

粗暴.zh: 那个人的态度非常粗暴。
粗暴.en: That person's attitude is very rude.

粗暴.zh: 如果服务员态度粗暴，我会投诉。
粗暴.en: If the waiter's attitude is rude, I will complain.

天线.zh: 屋顶上装了一个新的卫星天线。
天线.en: A new satellite antenna was installed on the roof.
The phone's antenna signal is poor.

天线.zh: 为了收看到更多频道，他调整了天线方向。
天线.en: To receive more channels, he adjusted the antenna direction.
The antenna was blown off by the wind.

风流.en: He was quite dashing in his youth.

风流.zh: 大家都说他是个风流才子。
风流.en: Everyone says he is a romantic talent.

风流.zh: 她的风流韵事传遍了公司。
风流.en: Her romantic affairs spread throughout the company.

风流.zh: 虽然他很风流，但对待感情很认真。
风流.en: Although he is a ladies' man, he takes relationships seriously.

皇室.en: The British royal family is very famous.

皇室.zh: 很多游客喜欢参观皇室宫殿。
皇室.en: Many tourists like to visit royal palaces.

皇室.zh: 他研究皇室历史很多年了。
皇室.en: He has studied royal history for many years.

皇室.zh: 皇室的婚礼总是吸引全球目光。
皇室.en: Royal weddings always attract global attention.
The Japanese royal family has many rules.

海峡.en: The Taiwan Strait is very wide.

海峡.zh: 他们坐船穿过了马六甲海峡。
海峡.en: They crossed the Malacca Strait by boat.

海峡.zh: 海峡两岸的交流越来越频繁。
海峡.en: Cross-strait exchanges are becoming more frequent.

海峡.zh: 由于天气不好，海峡渡轮暂停了。
海峡.en: Due to bad weather, the strait ferry has been suspended.

海峡.zh: 这条海峡连接两个大洋。

主宰.zh: 在比赛中，他完全主宰了局势。
主宰.en: In the game, he completely dominated the situation.

主宰.zh: 科技正在主宰我们的生活。
他不想被任何人主宰自己的选择。
主宰.en: He doesn't want anyone to dominate his choices.

光顾.zh: 这家老店，很多名人经常光顾。
光顾.en: Many celebrities often patronize this old shop.

光顾.zh: 因为服务好，顾客们经常光顾这家餐厅。
光顾.en: Because of good service, customers often visit this restaurant.

成天.en: He plays games all day long.

成天.zh: 别成天抱怨，想想怎么解决问题。
成天.en: Don't complain all day; think about how to solve the problem.

成天.zh: 她成天忙着工作，没时间休息。
成天.en: She is busy with work all day, no time to rest.

成天.zh: 成天坐在电脑前对身体不好。
成天.en: Sitting in front of the computer all day is bad for health.
What are you doing all day?

疑虑.en: I still have some doubts in my heart.

疑虑.zh: 他对这个计划一直有很多疑虑。
疑虑.en: He has always had many doubts about this plan.

疑虑.zh: 虽然她嘴上说没事，但眼神里充满了疑虑。
疑虑.en: Although she said she was fine, her eyes were full of doubt.

疑虑.zh: 你要是有任何疑虑，随时可以来找我聊聊。
疑虑.en: If you have any doubts, feel free to come and chat with me anytime.

疑虑.zh: 老板的疑虑终于消除了，因为数据证明了方案的可行性。
疑虑.en: The boss's doubts finally disappeared because the data proved the feasibility of the plan.

情不自禁.zh: 听到这个消息，她情不自禁地哭了起来。
情不自禁.en: Hearing this news, she couldn't help but cry.

情不自禁.zh: 看到那么美的风景，我情不自禁地拍了很多照片。
情不自禁.en: Seeing such beautiful scenery, I couldn't help taking many photos.

情不自禁.zh: 他唱得太好了，观众们情不自禁地跟着节奏拍手。
情不自禁.en: He sang so well that the audience couldn't help clapping along with the rhythm.

情不自禁.zh: 虽然知道不该吃太多，但面对甜点我还是情不自禁地多拿了一块。
情不自禁.en: Although I knew I shouldn't eat too much, facing the dessert I still couldn't help taking another piece.

苏醒.zh: 春天来了，大地慢慢苏醒。
苏醒.en: Spring has come, and the earth is slowly awakening.

苏醒.zh: 手术后两个小时，病人苏醒过来了。
苏醒.en: Two hours after the surgery, the patient woke up.

苏醒.zh: 在医生的努力下，昏迷了三天的老人终于苏醒了。
苏醒.en: With the doctor's efforts, the old man who had been in a coma for three days finally regained consciousness.

苏醒.zh: 当我苏醒时，发现自己躺在医院的病床上，周围都是家人。
苏醒.en: When I woke up, I found myself lying in a hospital bed, surrounded by family.

解雇.en: He was fired by the company.

解雇.zh: 老板因为经济不好解雇了很多员工。
解雇.en: The boss laid off many employees because of the bad economy.

解雇.zh: 她工作一直很努力，没想到最后还是被解雇了。
解雇.en: She had been working very hard, but unexpectedly she was still fired in the end.

解雇.zh: 如果老板继续随意解雇人，公司很快就没有人了。
解雇.en: If the boss keeps firing people arbitrarily, the company will soon have no one left.

解雇.zh: 虽然他没有犯大错，但公司为了节省开支还是解雇了他。
解雇.en: Although he didn't make a big mistake, the company still fired him to save costs.

隐患.en: This circuit has a hidden danger.

隐患.zh: 旧楼里的消防设施存在很多隐患。
隐患.en: There are many hidden dangers in the fire protection facilities of the old building.

隐患.zh: 如果不及时修理，这辆车的刹车隐患会越来越大。
隐患.en: If not repaired in time, the hidden danger of the car's brakes will get bigger and bigger.

隐患.zh: 虽然现在看起来没问题，但长期这样工作会给健康埋下隐患。
隐患.en: Although it seems fine now, working like this for a long time will lay hidden dangers to your health.

隐患.zh: 政府正在检查全市的燃气管道，排除所有可能的安全隐患。
隐患.en: The government is inspecting the city's gas pipelines to eliminate all possible safety hazards.

郑重.zh: 这件事需要你郑重地考虑一下。
郑重.en: This matter requires you to consider it seriously.

郑重.zh: 在婚礼上，他们郑重地向对方许下了承诺。
郑重.en: At the wedding, they solemnly made promises to each other.

郑重.zh: 老师郑重地提醒我们，考试作弊的后果很严重。
郑重.en: The teacher earnestly reminded us that the consequences of cheating on exams are very serious.

郑重.zh: 虽然只是个小仪式，但每个参与的人都表现得非常郑重。
郑重.en: Although it was just a small ceremony, everyone who participated behaved very solemnly.

建筑师.en: My older brother is an architect.

建筑师.zh: 这位建筑师设计了很多漂亮的房子。
建筑师.en: This architect has designed many beautiful houses.

建筑师.zh: 年轻的建筑师花了三年时间来完成这个项目。
建筑师.en: The young architect spent three years completing this project.

建筑师.zh: 作为一名建筑师，他不仅要考虑美观，还要考虑实用性。
建筑师.en: As an architect, he has to consider not only aesthetics but also practicality.

建筑师.zh: 那座著名的博物馆是由一位法国建筑师设计的，吸引了无数游客。
建筑师.en: That famous museum was designed by a French architect, attracting countless tourists.

坦率.zh: 坦率地说，我不太喜欢这个方案。
坦率.en: Frankly speaking, I don't really like this plan.

坦率.zh: 她是一个坦率的人，从不拐弯抹角。
坦率.en: She is a frank person, never beating around the bush.

坦率.zh: 虽然我欣赏他的坦率，但有时候他的话确实让人很难接受。
坦率.en: Although I appreciate his frankness, sometimes his words are indeed hard to accept.

坦率.zh: 在朋友面前，我们可以坦率地表达自己的想法，不用怕得罪人。
坦率.en: In front of friends, we can frankly express our thoughts without fear of offending anyone.

烈士.zh: 这座碑是为了纪念烈士。
烈士.en: This monument is to commemorate the martyrs.

烈士.zh: 每年清明节，学校都会组织学生去扫烈士墓。
烈士.en: Every year on Qingming Festival, the school organizes students to sweep the martyrs' graves.

烈士.zh: 那些为国家牺牲的烈士，永远活在我们心中。
烈士.en: Those martyrs who sacrificed for the country will always live in our hearts.

烈士.zh: 老爷爷讲起他父亲作为烈士的故事，眼里闪着泪光。
烈士.en: The old grandfather told the story of his father as a martyr, with tears glistening in his eyes.

烈士.zh: 虽然很多烈士没有留下名字，但他们的精神值得我们永远铭记。
烈士.en: Although many martyrs left no names, their spirit is worth remembering forever.

笼子.en: The bird is in the cage.

笼子.zh: 这只兔子需要一个大一点的笼子。
笼子.en: This rabbit needs a larger cage.

笼子.zh: 他给宠物买了一个漂亮的笼子。
笼子.en: He bought a beautiful cage for his pet.

笼子.zh: 把笼子门关好，不然小狗会跑出来。
笼子.en: Close the cage door properly, otherwise the puppy will run out.

笼子.zh: 这个笼子太小了，动物在里面很难活动。
笼子.en: This cage is too small for the animals to move around inside.

逃生.en: Stay calm and escape during a fire.

逃生.zh: 如果发生地震，我们应该马上从安全通道逃生。
逃生.en: If an earthquake happens, we should immediately escape through the emergency exit.

逃生.zh: 他跳窗逃生，结果受了伤。
逃生.en: He escaped by jumping out of the window, and ended up injured.

逃生.zh: 虽然火势很大，但大家都成功逃生了。
逃生.en: Although the fire was huge, everyone managed to escape successfully.

逃生.zh: 这部电影讲的是如何从监狱逃生。
逃生.en: This movie is about how to escape from prison.

阐述.zh: 请你阐述一下你的观点。
阐述.en: Please elaborate on your point of view.

阐述.zh: 他在会议上详细阐述了公司的未来计划。
阐述.en: He elaborated in detail on the company's future plans at the meeting.

阐述.zh: 因为时间有限，他只简要阐述了问题。
阐述.en: Because time was limited, he only briefly explained the issue.

阐述.zh: 老师要求我们阐述对环保的看法。
阐述.en: The teacher asked us to explain our views on environmental protection.

阐述.zh: 这部著作阐述了人类文明的起源。
阐述.en: This work expounds on the origins of human civilization.

轮廓.en: The outline of the mountain is very clear.

轮廓.zh: 在黑暗中，我只能看到远处的建筑物轮廓。
轮廓.en: In the dark, I could only see the outline of the buildings in the distance.

轮廓.zh: 虽然看不清细节，但大致的轮廓还是能辨认出来。
轮廓.en: Although I couldn't see the details, I could still make out the general outline.

轮廓.zh: 画家先用铅笔画出轮廓。
轮廓.en: The artist first sketched the outline with a pencil.

轮廓.zh: 他身材的轮廓在夕阳下显得特别好看。
轮廓.en: The silhouette of his figure looked especially nice in the sunset.

喜好.zh: 我根据自己的喜好选择了这个专业。
喜好.en: I chose this major based on my own preferences.

喜好.zh: 除了音乐，他最大的喜好就是旅行。
喜好.en: Besides music, his biggest hobby is traveling.
What hobbies do you usually have?

喜好.zh: 她的喜好很广泛，从画画到运动都喜欢。
喜好.en: Her interests are wide-ranging, from painting to sports.

夜总会.en: They went to the nightclub to dance.

夜总会.zh: 这家夜总会的音乐太吵了，我不喜欢。
夜总会.en: The music at this nightclub is too loud, I don't like it.

夜总会.zh: 虽然他已经累了，但还是陪朋友去了夜总会。
夜总会.en: Although he was already tired, he still went to the nightclub with his friend.

夜总会.zh: 夜总会晚上十点才开门。
夜总会.en: The nightclub doesn't open until ten at night.

夜总会.zh: 他在这家夜总会工作了好几年。
夜总会.en: He worked at this nightclub for several years.

蒜.en: Adding some garlic when stir-frying makes it more fragrant.

蒜.zh: 我每次做蒜蓉虾都会放很多蒜。
蒜.en: Every time I make garlic shrimp, I put in a lot of garlic.

蒜.zh: 如果你不喜欢蒜味，可以少放一点。
蒜.en: If you don't like the taste of garlic, you can put in a little less.

蒜.zh: 切蒜的时候小心别切到手指。
蒜.en: Be careful not to cut your fingers when chopping garlic.
The garlic at the supermarket is on sale today.

门槛.zh: 这个工作的门槛太高了，我可能不符合条件。
门槛.en: The entry requirements for this job are too high; I probably don't qualify.

门槛.zh: 虽然技术门槛低，但竞争也很激烈。
门槛.en: Although the technical barrier is low, the competition is still fierce.

门槛.zh: 你别站在门槛上，快进来。
门槛.en: Don't stand on the doorstep, come in quickly.

门槛.zh: 他跨过门槛走进了院子。
门槛.en: He stepped over the threshold and entered the courtyard.

晚期.en: His illness is already in the late stage.

晚期.zh: 这种癌症在晚期很难治愈。
晚期.en: This type of cancer is very difficult to cure in the late stage.

晚期.zh: 虽然发现时已经是晚期，但他仍然积极治疗。
晚期.en: Although it was already in the late stage when discovered, he still actively sought treatment.

晚期.zh: 晚期资本主义有很多问题。
他的作品属于晚期风格。
晚期.en: His works belong to the late period style.

妥善.zh: 我们会妥善处理你的投诉。
妥善.en: We will handle your complaint properly.

妥善.zh: 如果你能妥善安排时间，就能完成任务。
妥善.en: If you can arrange your time properly, you'll be able to finish the task.

妥善.zh: 这些问题必须妥善解决。
妥善.en: These problems must be resolved properly.

妥善.zh: 他妥善地把文件归档了。

痴呆.en: Elderly people are prone to dementia.

痴呆.zh: 她奶奶患了老年痴呆，经常忘记事情。
痴呆.en: Her grandmother has Alzheimer's and often forgets things.

痴呆.zh: 虽然得了痴呆，但他的家人一直细心照顾。
痴呆.en: Although he has dementia, his family has been taking careful care of him.

痴呆.zh: 这种药可以缓解痴呆的症状。
痴呆.en: This medicine can alleviate the symptoms of dementia.

痴呆.zh: 痴呆患者需要更多的关爱和耐心。
痴呆.en: Patients with dementia need more care and patience.

一无所知.zh: 我对电脑编程一无所知。
一无所知.en: I know nothing about computer programming.

一无所知.zh: 他对我做的事一无所知，还一直夸我。
一无所知.en: He knows nothing about what I did and keeps praising me.

一无所知.zh: 她对那个秘密一无所知，所以我没告诉她。
一无所知.en: She knows nothing about that secret, so I didn't tell her.

一无所知.zh: 他在这件事上完全一无所知，别问他了。
一无所知.en: He knows absolutely nothing about this matter, so don't ask him.

一无所知.zh: 我对他的过去一无所知，我们才认识几天。
一无所知.en: I know nothing about his past; we only met a few days ago.

试探.zh: 他用一个问题试探我的想法。
试探.en: He used a question to probe my thoughts.

试探.zh: 我想试探一下他对这个计划的支持度。
试探.en: I want to test his level of support for this plan.

试探.zh: 你别再试探我了，直接说吧。
试探.en: Stop testing me, just say it directly.

试探.zh: 她轻轻试探了一下，发现他并不反对。
试探.en: She gently probed and found he wasn't opposed.

壮大.zh: 公司通过招聘新人来壮大自己。
壮大.en: The company expands itself by hiring new people.

壮大.zh: 随着会员增多，这个组织越来越壮大了。
壮大.en: As membership increases, this organization is getting stronger.

壮大.zh: 他们计划壮大自己的势力，为竞选做准备。
壮大.en: They plan to strengthen their influence to prepare for the election.

壮大.zh: 音乐节吸引了更多人，声威逐渐壮大。
壮大.en: The music festival attracted more people, and its prestige gradually grew.

骚乱.en: A riot broke out on the street.

骚乱.zh: 警察迅速控制了这场骚乱。
骚乱.en: The police quickly brought this riot under control.

骚乱.zh: 由于物价上涨，一些地区出现了骚乱。
骚乱.en: Due to rising prices, riots have occurred in some areas.

骚乱.zh: 骚乱过后，政府加强了安全措施。
骚乱.en: After the riot, the government strengthened security measures.

骚乱.zh: 球迷骚乱导致比赛被取消。
骚乱.en: The fan riot caused the match to be canceled.

收据.zh: 我找不到昨天的收据了。
你要保留收据才能退货。
收据.en: You need to keep the receipt to be able to return the item.

收据.zh: 他递给我收据，然后让我签字。
收据.en: He handed me the receipt and then asked me to sign.

收据.zh: 收据上的金额和实际付款不符。
收据.en: The amount on the receipt doesn't match the actual payment.

底层.en: He lives on the ground floor of the apartment.

底层.zh: 这个软件底层设计得很优化。
底层.en: The underlying design of this software is very optimized.

底层.zh: 他来自社会底层，靠努力改变了命运。
底层.en: He comes from the bottom of society and changed his fate through hard work.

底层.zh: 底层人民的生活条件需要改善。
底层.en: The living conditions of the bottom class need improvement.

底层.zh: 系统底层的代码被修改了。
底层.en: The code at the bottom layer of the system has been modified.

自以为是.zh: 你这种自以为是的态度让人反感。
自以为是.en: This self-righteous attitude of yours is off-putting.

自以为是.zh: 他总是自以为是地批评别人。
自以为是.en: He always criticizes others in a self-righteous way.

自以为是.zh: 自以为是的人通常听不进建议。
自以为是.en: Self-righteous people usually don't take advice.

自以为是.zh: 她自以为是，结果犯了大错。
自以为是.en: She was self-righteous and ended up making a big mistake.

颁布.en: The government promulgated a new law.

颁布.zh: 新条例将于下月颁布实施。
颁布.en: The new regulations will be promulgated and implemented next month.

颁布.zh: 为了环保，国家颁布了限塑令。
颁布.en: For environmental protection, the country issued a plastic restriction order.

颁布.zh: 学校颁布了新的校规来规范学生行为。
颁布.en: The school issued new rules to regulate student behavior.

颁布.zh: 政策颁布后，引起了广泛讨论。
颁布.en: After the policy was promulgated, it sparked widespread discussion.

钩子.en: Hang the clothes on the hook.

钩子.zh: 他用力拉了一下钩子，门就开了。
钩子.en: He pulled the hook hard, and the door opened.

钩子.zh: 这个钩子太松了，挂不住东西。
钩子.en: This hook is too loose, it can't hold things.

钩子.zh: 钓鱼的钩子很小，需要小心使用。
钩子.en: Fishing hooks are very small, so you need to use them carefully.

钩子.zh: 故事开头有一个钩子，吸引读者继续看。
钩子.en: The story has a hook at the beginning to keep readers engaged.

饲养.en: He raises cattle and sheep in the countryside.

饲养.zh: 我们饲养了一只小狗，非常可爱。
饲养.en: We have a little dog that is very cute.

饲养.zh: 饲养动物需要耐心和责任心。
饲养.en: Raising animals requires patience and a sense of responsibility.

饲养.zh: 他靠饲养家禽来维持生计。
饲养.en: He makes a living by raising poultry.

饲养.zh: 她学习了很多关于饲养宠物的知识。
饲养.en: She learned a lot about pet care.

诚恳.zh: 虽然她批评了我，但态度很诚恳。
诚恳.en: Although she criticized me, her attitude was very sincere.

诚恳.zh: 因为他的诚恳，大家都愿意和他合作。
诚恳.en: Because of his sincerity, everyone is willing to cooperate with him.

假定.zh: 我们假定明天不下雨，就去爬山。
假定.en: Let's assume it won't rain tomorrow, then we'll go hiking.

假定.zh: 假定他来了，我们怎么办？
假定.en: Suppose he comes, what should we do?

假定.zh: 如果假定这个方案可行，那我们就开始。
假定.en: If we assume this plan is feasible, then let's start.

假定.zh: 你先别假定结果，等调查完再说。
假定.en: Don't assume the outcome yet, wait until after the investigation.

女婿.en: My daughter's son-in-law is very filial.

女婿.zh: 她家女婿经常帮忙做家务。
女婿.en: Her son-in-law often helps with housework.

女婿.zh: 虽然他是女婿，但和亲儿子一样。
女婿.en: Although he is a son-in-law, he is like a biological son.

女婿.zh: 我姐姐的女婿是个很有能力的工程师。
女婿.en: My sister's son-in-law is a very capable engineer.

匿名.en: Someone donated money anonymously to the school.

匿名.zh: 我不想匿名，就直接说了。
匿名.en: I don't want to be anonymous, so I just said it directly.

匿名.zh: 因为害怕报复，他选择了匿名举报。
匿名.en: Because he feared retaliation, he chose to report anonymously.

匿名.zh: 在网上匿名发言是很常见的事。
匿名.en: Posting anonymously online is a very common thing.

凝聚.en: Everyone needs to unite their strength.

凝聚.zh: 这个活动凝聚了所有人的心血。
凝聚.en: This event has gathered the efforts of everyone.

凝聚.zh: 团队凝聚在一起才能成功。
凝聚.en: Only when the team sticks together can they succeed.

凝聚.zh: 通过这次比赛，我们凝聚了更多的友情。
凝聚.en: Through this competition, we have built up more friendship.

凝聚.zh: 水蒸气冷却后会凝聚成小水滴。
凝聚.en: Water vapor condenses into small droplets when cooled.

编制.en: This organization has a large staffing quota.

编制.zh: 我们正在编制明年的预算。
编制.en: We are compiling next year's budget.
The company's staffing quota is already full.

编制.zh: 虽然编制紧张，但还是要招人。
编制.en: Although the staffing is tight, we still need to hire people.

编制.zh: 他负责编制员工培训手册。
编制.en: He is responsible for compiling the employee training manual.

宽敞.zh: 新家的客厅比旧家宽敞多了。
宽敞.en: The living room in the new house is much more spacious than the old one.

宽敞.zh: 教室虽然不大，但很宽敞。
宽敞.en: The classroom is not big, but it's very spacious.

宽敞.zh: 因为路面宽敞，所以开车很舒服。
宽敞.en: Because the road is wide, driving is very comfortable.

宽敞.zh: 我们找了一个宽敞的地方野餐。
宽敞.en: We found a spacious place for a picnic.

恩怨.en: There are no grudges between us.
He is clear about gratitude and grudges.

恩怨.zh: 过去的事就忘了，别记着恩怨。
恩怨.en: Forget about the past, don't hold grudges.

恩怨.zh: 虽然我们有恩怨，但现在是合作伙伴。
恩怨.en: Although we have grudges, we are now business partners.

恩怨.zh: 他不想把私人恩怨带到工作上来。
恩怨.en: He doesn't want to bring personal grudges into work.

面貌.zh: 城市的面貌发生了很大变化。
面貌.en: The city's appearance has changed a lot.

面貌.zh: 他的面貌和以前不一样了。
面貌.en: His appearance is different from before.

面貌.zh: 经过改革，公司的面貌焕然一新。
面貌.en: After the reform, the company took on a brand new look.

面貌.zh: 从面貌上看，他像个四十岁的人。
面貌.en: Judging by his appearance, he looks like a forty-year-old.

专程.en: I came specially to see you.

专程.zh: 他专程从北京飞到上海参加会议。
专程.en: He flew specially from Beijing to Shanghai to attend the meeting.
You don't need to make a special trip.

专程.zh: 虽然很远，但他还是专程来了。
专程.en: Although it was far, he still came specially.

专程.zh: 为了感谢你，我专程准备了礼物。
专程.en: To thank you, I specially prepared a gift.

分红.en: The company gave out quite a bit of dividends this year.

分红.zh: 因为业绩好，年底分红比去年多了一倍。
分红.en: Because of good performance, the year-end bonus was double last year's.

分红.zh: 他抱怨说分红太少了，根本不值得加班。
分红.en: He complained that the bonus was too small, not worth working overtime at all.

分红.zh: 如果利润达标，我们就能分到一笔可观的分红。
分红.en: If profits meet the target, we'll get a considerable dividend.

冷笑.zh: 他听完只是冷笑了一声。
冷笑.en: He just let out a cold laugh after hearing that.

冷笑.zh: 别对别人冷笑，很不礼貌。
冷笑.en: Don't sneer at others; it's very rude.

冷笑.zh: 他那种冷笑让人觉得很不舒服。
冷笑.en: That kind of sneer from him makes people very uncomfortable.

冷笑.zh: 听到这个荒唐的理由，他忍不住冷笑起来。
冷笑.en: Hearing that ridiculous excuse, he couldn't help laughing coldly.

预示.en: Dark clouds indicate that it's going to rain.

预示.zh: 最近的经济数据预示情况可能会好转。
预示.en: Recent economic data suggests that the situation might improve.

预示.zh: 专家说，这种迹象预示着一场金融风暴即将来临。
预示.en: Experts say this sign foreshadows an impending financial storm.

预示.zh: 虽然没有任何预示，但灾难还是发生了。
预示.en: Although there was no warning, the disaster still happened.

奔波.zh: 他每天奔波于家和公司之间。
奔波.en: He shuttles between home and the office every day.

奔波.zh: 为了这份工作，我奔波了好几个城市。
奔波.en: For this job, I traveled around several cities.

奔波.zh: 父母为了我们奔波了一辈子，很辛苦。
奔波.en: Our parents have been running around all their lives for us; it's very hard.

奔波.zh: 他四处奔波，终于找到了失散多年的亲人。
奔波.en: He rushed around everywhere and finally found his long-lost relatives.

奔波.zh: 我不想再这样奔波下去了，想稳定下来。
奔波.en: I don't want to keep rushing around like this; I want to settle down.

备份.en: Remember to back up important files.

备份.zh: 我每天都会做数据备份。
备份.en: I do a data backup every day.

备份.zh: 手机照片最好同步备份到云盘。
备份.en: It's best to sync and backup phone photos to the cloud drive.

备份.zh: 因为没做备份，电脑坏了以后所有资料都丢了。
备份.en: Because I didn't make a backup, all my data was lost after the computer broke down.

备份.zh: 他建议在更新系统之前先创建一个完整的备份。
备份.en: He suggested creating a full backup before updating the system.

偏僻.zh: 他住在一个偏僻的小山村。
偏僻.en: He lives in a remote small mountain village.

偏僻.zh: 那条路很偏僻，晚上一个人走不安全。
偏僻.en: That road is very remote; it's unsafe to walk alone at night.

偏僻.zh: 虽然地方偏僻，但风景特别好。
偏僻.en: Although the place is remote, the scenery is especially beautiful.

偏僻.zh: 我们找了一家偏僻的餐厅，环境很安静。
偏僻.en: We found a secluded restaurant, and the environment was very quiet.

真空.zh: 外面噪音太大，房间里像真空一样安静。
