真空.en: The noise outside is too loud, but the room is as quiet as a vacuum.

真空.zh: 科学课上，老师展示了真空环境下的实验。
真空.en: In science class, the teacher demonstrated an experiment in a vacuum environment.

真空.zh: 他退休后感觉生活突然进入了真空状态。
真空.en: After retiring, he felt his life suddenly entered a vacuum state.

亲身.zh: 亲身感受一下才知道好不好。
亲身.en: You only know if it's good by experiencing it yourself.

亲身.zh: 他亲身讲述了那次冒险的经历。
亲身.en: He personally recounted the experience of that adventure.

亲身.zh: 只有亲身试过，才能理解其中的困难。
亲身.en: Only by trying it yourself can you understand the difficulties involved.

亲身.zh: 她亲身参与了这个项目，对细节非常熟悉。
亲身.en: She personally participated in this project and is very familiar with the details.

小提琴.zh: 这把小提琴的音色很好。
小提琴.en: This violin has a very good tone.

小提琴.zh: 他每天练习两个小时的小提琴。
小提琴.en: He practices the violin for two hours every day.

小提琴.zh: 交响乐里，小提琴是非常重要的乐器。
小提琴.en: In an orchestra, the violin is a very important instrument.

小提琴.zh: 我小时候学过小提琴，但后来放弃了。
小提琴.en: I learned the violin when I was little, but I gave it up later.

原型.en: This character has a real-life prototype.

原型.zh: 小说的主人公原型是他的祖父。
原型.en: The protagonist of the novel is based on his grandfather.

原型.zh: 电影里的怪物是根据传说中的生物作为原型设计的。
原型.en: The monster in the movie was designed based on a legendary creature as its prototype.

原型.zh: 设计师展示了新产品的手工原型。
原型.en: The designer showed the handmade prototype of the new product.

原型.zh: 在软件开发中，先做原型再修改会节省很多时间。
原型.en: In software development, making a prototype first and then modifying it saves a lot of time.

核对.zh: 请核对一下你的名字和号码。
核对.en: Please check your name and number.

核对.zh: 出发前我们得核对一下行李数量。
核对.en: We need to check the number of luggage before departure.

核对.zh: 他仔细核对了每一笔账目，没发现错误。
核对.en: He carefully checked every account and found no errors.

核对.zh: 我把发票和订单核对了一遍，金额对不上。
核对.en: I checked the invoice against the order, and the amount doesn't match.

核对.zh: 如果你不确定信息是否准确，最好再核对一次。
核对.en: If you're not sure whether the information is accurate, you'd better check it again.

坟.en: We went to sweep the graves on the mountain at Qingming.

坟.zh: 那座老坟已经很久没人来看了。
坟.en: No one has visited that old grave for a long time.

坟.zh: 村里人都知道那块地以前是一片坟场。
坟.en: Everyone in the village knows that piece of land used to be a cemetery.

坟.zh: 他每年都会回老家给祖坟添土。
坟.en: He goes back to his hometown every year to add soil to the ancestral graves.

坟.zh: 听说那片坟地要迁走，因为要修高速公路。
坟.en: I heard that cemetery is going to be relocated because a highway is being built.

领悟.zh: 他很快就领悟了这道题的思路。
领悟.en: He quickly grasped the approach to this problem.

领悟.zh: 听了老师的话，我领悟到了自己的不足。
领悟.en: After listening to the teacher, I realized my own shortcomings.

领悟.zh: 有些道理要到一定年龄才能真正领悟。
领悟.en: Some truths can only be truly understood at a certain age.

领悟.zh: 她读了很多书，但没领悟书里的深层含义。
领悟.en: She read many books, but didn't grasp the deeper meaning in them.

领悟.zh: 直到自己当了父母，我才领悟当年爸妈的辛苦。
领悟.en: Only after becoming a parent myself did I understand how hard my parents worked back then.

前不久.en: He changed jobs not long ago.

前不久.zh: 前不久我们还在咖啡馆见过面。
前不久.en: We met at the coffee shop not long ago.

前不久.zh: 那部电影前不久才上映，口碑很好。
前不久.en: That movie was released not long ago and has great reviews.

前不久.zh: 我前不久买了一台新电脑，用着挺顺手的。
前不久.en: I bought a new computer not long ago, and it works very smoothly.

前不久.zh: 她前不久因为生病请了一个月的假，现在恢复得不错。
前不久.en: She took a month off not long ago because of illness, and now she's recovering well.

安抚.zh: 他轻轻拍拍孩子，想安抚他。
安抚.en: He gently patted the child to calm him down.

安抚.zh: 妈妈用温柔的语气安抚了哭闹的宝宝。
安抚.en: Mom used a gentle tone to soothe the crying baby.

安抚.zh: 领导出面安抚了员工的不满情绪。
安抚.en: The leader stepped in to appease the employees' discontent.

安抚.zh: 宠物在害怕的时候，主人需要及时安抚它们。
安抚.en: When pets are scared, owners need to comfort them in time.

安抚.zh: 他送了一束花给她，想安抚她受伤的心情。
安抚.en: He gave her a bouquet of flowers to soothe her hurt feelings.

废除.zh: 这条旧规定已经被废除了。
废除.en: This old rule has already been abolished.

废除.zh: 很多国家废除了死刑制度。
废除.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty system.

废除.zh: 政府决定废除这项不合理的收费项目。
废除.en: The government decided to abolish this unreasonable fee item.

废除.zh: 这些不平等条约早在几十年前就被废除了。
废除.en: These unequal treaties were abolished decades ago.

废除.zh: 公司废除了打卡制度，改为灵活办公。
废除.en: The company abolished the clock-in system and switched to flexible work.

扣除.zh: 迟到一次要扣除十块钱。
扣除.en: Ten yuan will be deducted for each time you're late.

扣除.zh: 这个月的水电费直接从工资里扣除了。
扣除.en: This month's utility bills were directly deducted from the salary.

扣除.zh: 他因为违反规定被扣除了当月奖金。
扣除.en: He had his monthly bonus deducted for violating the rules.

扣除.zh: 如果你退货，商家会扣除一部分手续费。
扣除.en: If you return the goods, the merchant will deduct a part of the handling fee.

扣除.zh: 考试作弊被发现的话，成绩会被直接扣除。
扣除.en: If you're caught cheating on an exam, your score will be directly deducted.

素材.zh: 我需要一些写文章的素材。
素材.en: I need some material for writing an article.

素材.zh: 摄影师在山里拍了很多自然素材。
素材.en: The photographer took a lot of natural素材 in the mountains.

素材.zh: 这部电影的素材来源于真实案件。
素材.en: This movie's素材 comes from a real case.

素材.zh: 设计师收集了很多中国传统图案作为素材。
素材.en: The designer collected many traditional Chinese patterns as素材.

素材.zh: 写小说之前，他花了一年时间积累生活素材。
素材.en: Before writing the novel, he spent a year accumulating life素材.

催眠.zh: 这个声音太单调了，简直能催眠。
催眠.en: This sound is too monotonous, it's practically hypnotic.

催眠.zh: 她用催眠的方法帮我缓解了焦虑。
催眠.en: She used hypnosis to help me relieve my anxiety.

催眠.zh: 有的医生会用催眠来治疗失眠患者。
催眠.en: Some doctors use hypnosis to treat patients with insomnia.

催眠.zh: 电视上那个催眠表演特别神奇，观众都睡着了。
催眠.en: That hypnosis show on TV was amazing; the audience all fell asleep.

催眠.zh: 据说催眠可以帮人回忆起被遗忘的童年往事。
催眠.en: It's said that hypnosis can help people recall forgotten childhood memories.

伺候.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，需要人伺候。
伺候.en: Grandma is old and needs to be taken care of.

伺候.zh: 他生病那段时间，我一直在床边伺候他。
伺候.en: During his illness, I was taking care of him by the bedside.

伺候.zh: 这家店的老板脾气很大，很难伺候。
伺候.en: The boss of this store has a bad temper and is hard to please.

伺候.zh: 她每天都得伺候家里的几只宠物，很忙。
伺候.en: She has to take care of several pets at home every day, which is very busy.

伺候.zh: 在酒店工作，伺候客人要很有耐心。
伺候.en: Working in a hotel, you need a lot of patience to attend to guests.

丢弃.en: Don't discard garbage on the roadside.

丢弃.zh: 他丢弃了旧手机，换了个新的。
丢弃.en: He discarded his old phone and got a new one.

丢弃.zh: 因为搬家，我们丢弃了很多不用的东西。
丢弃.en: Because we moved, we discarded a lot of unused stuff.

丢弃.zh: 这个习惯不好，不要随意丢弃食物。
丢弃.en: This habit is bad, don't casually discard food.

丢弃.zh: 如果你丢弃了朋友，你会后悔的。
丢弃.en: If you discard a friend, you'll regret it.

出人意料.zh: 这次考试出人意料地简单。
虽然大家都觉得会输，但出人意料地赢了。
出人意料.en: Although everyone thought we would lose, we unexpectedly won.

出人意料.zh: 他的决定出人意料，连家人都没想到。
出人意料.en: His decision was unexpected; even his family didn't expect it.

掏钱.en: He took out money and bought a cup of coffee.
Every time we eat, she pays.

掏钱.zh: 朋友有困难时，他主动掏钱帮忙。
掏钱.en: When a friend is in trouble, he voluntarily pays to help.

掏钱.zh: 别总让别人掏钱，自己也要付。
掏钱.en: Don't always let others pay; you should pay too.

掏钱.zh: 虽然不情愿，但最后还是掏钱了。

鼻涕.zh: 感冒的时候鼻涕特别多。
鼻涕.en: When you have a cold, you have a lot of snot.

鼻涕.zh: 孩子哭得满脸都是鼻涕。
鼻涕.en: The child cried so much his face was covered with snot.

鼻涕.zh: 因为鼻炎，他总是不停地擤鼻涕。
鼻涕.en: Because of rhinitis, he keeps blowing his nose.

融洽.en: The family gets along very harmoniously.

融洽.zh: 新同事很快就和大家融洽地相处了。
融洽.en: The new colleague quickly got along harmoniously with everyone.

融洽.zh: 只要大家互相理解，团队就能保持融洽。
融洽.en: As long as everyone understands each other, the team can stay harmonious.

融洽.zh: 虽然性格不同，但他们相处得非常融洽。
融洽.en: Although their personalities differ, they get along very harmoniously.

搭乘.en: I take the subway to work.
They took a plane to Shanghai.

搭乘.zh: 因为时间紧，我们搭乘了出租车。
搭乘.en: Because time was tight, we took a taxi.

搭乘.zh: 你可以搭乘公交车或打车去那里。
搭乘.en: You can take a bus or a taxi to go there.

搭乘.zh: 这次旅行我们计划搭乘火车而不是飞机。
搭乘.en: For this trip we plan to take a train instead of a plane.

切割.en: Cut the bread with a knife.

切割.zh: 机器可以精准切割金属。
切割.en: The machine can precisely cut metal.

切割.zh: 切割的时候要小心别伤到手。
切割.en: When cutting, be careful not to hurt your hand.

切割.zh: 这块肉需要切割成小块才能煮。
切割.en: This piece of meat needs to be cut into small pieces to cook.

切割.zh: 因为板材太大，我们需要先切割再搬运。
切割.en: Because the board is too big, we need to cut it first before moving.

潜能.en: Children's potential needs to be developed.

潜能.zh: 只要你努力，就能发挥出自己的潜能。
潜能.en: As long as you work hard, you can unleash your potential.

潜能.zh: 教练发现了他的运动潜能。
潜能.en: The coach discovered his athletic potential.

潜能.zh: 不要低估自己的潜能，试试看吧。
潜能.en: Don't underestimate your own potential; give it a try.

徒步.en: He walks to work every day.

徒步.zh: 周末我们打算去山里徒步。
徒步.en: We plan to go hiking in the mountains this weekend.

徒步.zh: 因为路不远，我们选择了徒步过去。
徒步.en: Because the road is not far, we chose to walk there.

徒步.zh: 徒步虽然累，但能看到很美的风景。
徒步.en: Although hiking is tiring, you can see very beautiful scenery.

邮政.en: I go to the post office to send a letter.
Postal services are very convenient now.

邮政.zh: 他通过邮政寄了一个包裹给我。
邮政.en: He sent a package to me via postal service.

邮政.zh: 虽然现在用微信多，但邮政仍然重要。
邮政.en: Although we use WeChat a lot now, postal service is still important.

邮政.zh: 这个老邮政局已经有上百年历史了。
邮政.en: This old post office has a history of over a hundred years.

天桥.zh: 前面有座天桥，我们走那边吧。
天桥.en: There's a pedestrian bridge ahead, let's go that way.

天桥.zh: 这个天桥晚上灯光很漂亮。
天桥.en: This overpass has beautiful lights at night.

天桥.zh: 因为马路太宽，所以建了天桥方便行人。
天桥.en: Because the road is too wide, they built an overpass for pedestrians.

天桥.zh: 天桥下面经常有人摆摊卖东西。
天桥.en: People often set up stalls under the overpass to sell things.

天桥.zh: 从天桥上看风景，视野很开阔。
天桥.en: Looking at the scenery from the overpass, the view is wide.

迁.zh: 他们公司下个月要迁到新地址。
迁.en: Their company will move to a new address next month.

迁.zh: 因为拆迁，他们全家都迁走了。
迁.en: Because of demolition, their whole family moved away.

迁.zh: 古代很多部落因为战争而迁居他处。
迁.en: In ancient times, many tribes migrated elsewhere due to war.

迁.zh: 我们把仓库迁到了郊区。
迁.en: We moved the warehouse to the suburbs.

迁.zh: 要是空气质量不好，建议迁到南方生活。
迁.en: If the air quality is bad, it's recommended to move to the south to live.

拼搏.zh: 他为了梦想拼搏了好多年。
拼搏.en: He struggled for his dream for many years.

拼搏.zh: 虽然很累，但我们还是要继续拼搏。
拼搏.en: Although very tired, we still have to keep striving.

拼搏.zh: 这场比赛中他们拼搏到了最后一刻。
拼搏.en: In this game, they fought until the last moment.

拼搏.zh: 没有拼搏精神，很难取得成功。
拼搏.en: Without a fighting spirit, it's hard to achieve success.

化解.zh: 他们之间的矛盾终于化解了。
化解.en: The conflict between them finally resolved.

化解.zh: 这个笑话化解了现场的尴尬气氛。
化解.en: This joke defused the awkward atmosphere.

化解.zh: 通过沟通，我们化解了误会。
化解.en: Through communication, we resolved the misunderstanding.

化解.zh: 政府出台政策化解经济危机。
化解.en: The government introduced policies to resolve the economic crisis.

化解.zh: 如果及时道歉，就能化解很多麻烦。
化解.en: If you apologize in time, you can resolve many troubles.

完好.zh: 快递包装完好，没有问题。
完好.en: The package is intact, no problem.

完好.zh: 虽然地震了，但这座古塔依然完好。
完好.en: Although there was an earthquake, this ancient pagoda remains intact.

完好.zh: 这些瓷器保存得十分完好。
完好.en: These porcelain pieces are very well preserved.

完好.zh: 他的身体在事故后竟然完好无损。
完好.en: His body was surprisingly intact after the accident.

完好.zh: 检查一下设备是否完好。
完好.en: Check if the equipment is in good condition.

任期.en: The president's term is four years.

任期.zh: 他在任期内做了很多改革。
任期.en: He made many reforms during his term.

任期.zh: 下个月他的任期就要结束了。
任期.en: His term will end next month.

任期.zh: 校长任期满了之后，学校选了新校长。
任期.en: After the principal's term expired, the school chose a new principal.

任期.zh: 有些国家规定任期不能超过两届。
任期.en: Some countries stipulate that terms cannot exceed two terms.

围墙.zh: 学校周围有高高的围墙。
围墙.en: There are high walls around the school.

围墙.zh: 他们拆掉了老旧的围墙。
围墙.en: They tore down the old wall.
A row of trees was planted outside the wall.

围墙.zh: 因为围墙太矮，小偷很容易翻进来。
围墙.en: Because the wall is too low, thieves can easily climb over.

围墙.zh: 这座别墅的围墙是白色的，很好看。
围墙.en: The wall of this villa is white and looks nice.

好歹.zh: 好歹他也是个医生，能帮上忙。
好歹.en: At least he is a doctor, he can help.

好歹.zh: 不管好歹，你先试试再说。
好歹.en: Whether good or bad, try it first.

好歹.zh: 他不知道好歹，总惹人生气。
好歹.en: He doesn't know good from bad, always makes people angry.

好歹.zh: 既然来了，好歹吃顿饭再走吧。
好歹.en: Since you're here, at least have a meal before leaving.

好歹.zh: 做人要懂好歹，别总抱怨。
好歹.en: One should know what's good for them, don't always complain.

凸.zh: 地图上凸起的部分就是山脉。
凸.en: The raised parts on the map are mountain ranges.

凸.zh: 他的眼睛有点凸，像金鱼一样。
凸.en: His eyes are somewhat bulging, like a goldfish.

凸.zh: 这种设计在表面形成凸点。
凸.en: This design creates raised dots on the surface.

凸.zh: 因为路面凸起，车辆经过时很颠簸。
凸.en: Because the road surface is bumpy, vehicles are very bumpy when passing.

航海.en: He wanted to be a navigator since childhood.

航海.zh: 航海需要丰富的经验和知识。
航海.en: Navigation requires rich experience and knowledge.

航海.zh: 古代航海靠指南针和星星辨别方向。
航海.en: Ancient navigation relied on compass and stars to determine direction.

航海.zh: 虽然航海很危险，但他依然热爱。
航海.en: Although sailing is dangerous, he still loves it.

航海.zh: 这次航海计划因为天气原因推迟了。
航海.en: This sailing trip was postponed due to weather.

排行榜.en: This ranking list is very accurate.

排行榜.zh: 排行榜上他是第一，但我觉得一般。
排行榜.en: He is first on the ranking list, but I think it's just okay.

排行榜.zh: 你听过这个游戏排行榜吗？
排行榜.en: Have you heard of this game ranking list?

排行榜.zh: 我经常看音乐排行榜，知道最近什么歌火。
排行榜.en: I often check the music charts, so I know which songs are popular recently.

排行榜.zh: 这个排行榜每周更新一次。
排行榜.en: This ranking list updates once a week.

美满.zh: 他们一家人的生活非常美满幸福。
美满.en: Their family life is very happy and harmonious.

美满.zh: 虽然钱不多，但他们的日子过得很美满。
美满.en: Although they don't have much money, their life is very happy.

美满.zh: 我们都希望有一个美满的结局。
美满.en: We all hope for a happy ending.
This is truly a happy story.

绽放.zh: 春天来了，满园的樱花都绽放了。
绽放.en: Spring has come, and all the cherry blossoms in the garden are blooming.

绽放.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但梅花依然绽放。
绽放.en: Although the weather is very cold, the plum blossoms still bloom.
Her smile bloomed on her face.

绽放.zh: 晚上灯光绽放，整个城市很漂亮。
绽放.en: At night, the lights bloom, and the whole city is beautiful.

法制.en: We need to strengthen the legal system.

法制.zh: 一个国家的法制健全很重要。
法制.en: A country's legal system being sound is very important.

法制.zh: 如果法制不完善，社会就会出问题。
法制.en: If the legal system is not complete, society will have problems.

法制.zh: 法制教育应该从小开始。
法制.en: Legal education should start from childhood.

法制.zh: 现代社会离不开健全的法制体系。
法制.en: Modern society cannot do without a sound legal system.

转型.zh: 很多传统企业都需要数字化转型。
转型.en: Many traditional enterprises need digital transformation.

转型.zh: 如果不能成功转型，这个工厂可能会倒闭。
转型.en: If it cannot successfully transform, this factory might close down.

转型.zh: 经济转型期会遇到很多困难。
转型.en: During the economic transformation period, many difficulties will be encountered.

暴躁.en: He has a very irritable temper.

暴躁.zh: 你别这么暴躁，好好说话。
暴躁.en: Don't be so irritable, speak nicely.

暴躁.zh: 因为他最近压力大，所以变得很暴躁。
暴躁.en: Because he has been under a lot of pressure lately, he has become very irritable.

暴躁.zh: 这个司机开车太暴躁了。
遇到暴躁的人，最好别跟他争论。
暴躁.en: When encountering an irritable person, it's best not to argue with him.

埋葬.zh: 这座山下面埋葬着很多英雄。
埋葬.en: Under this mountain are buried many heroes.

埋葬.zh: 如果不好好处理，这些记忆就会被埋葬。
埋葬.en: If not handled properly, these memories will be buried.

埋葬.zh: 他把秘密永远埋葬在心里。
埋葬.en: He buried the secret in his heart forever.

协同.zh: 两个部门协同完成了这个项目。
协同.en: The two departments collaborated to complete the project.

协同.zh: 只有大家协同努力，才能把事做好。
协同.en: Only if everyone collaborates and works hard, can things be done well.

协同.zh: 这个软件支持多用户协同编辑。
协同.en: This software supports multi-user collaborative editing.

痴迷.en: He is very obsessed with games.

痴迷.zh: 她非常痴迷于中国传统文化。
痴迷.en: She is very obsessed with traditional Chinese culture.

痴迷.zh: 虽然他很痴迷跑步，但也注意休息。
痴迷.en: Although he is obsessed with running, he also pays attention to rest.

痴迷.zh: 这种痴迷程度有点夸张了。
痴迷.en: This level of obsession is a bit exaggerated.

痴迷.zh: 她从小就痴迷画画，现在成了画家。
痴迷.en: She has been obsessed with drawing since childhood, and now she's an artist.

紧接着.zh: 下课了，紧接着就是考试。
紧接着.en: Class ended, and immediately after was the exam.

紧接着.zh: 我们吃完饭，紧接着就去散步了。
紧接着.en: We finished eating, and immediately after went for a walk.

紧接着.zh: 第一声雷响后，紧接着就是闪电。
紧接着.en: After the first thunder, immediately after came lightning.

初衷.en: My original intention is very simple.

初衷.zh: 虽然他后来改变了做法，但初衷还是好的。
初衷.en: Although he later changed his approach, his original intention was good.

初衷.zh: 别忘了我们做这件事的初衷。
初衷.en: Don't forget our original intention for doing this.

初衷.zh: 创业的初衷是为了帮助更多人，而不是赚钱。
初衷.en: The original intention of starting a business is to help more people, not to make money.

丝绸.zh: 丝绸之路在古代连接了中国和欧洲。
丝绸.en: The Silk Road connected China and Europe in ancient times.

丝绸.zh: 妈妈送了我一件丝绸衬衫。
丝绸.en: Mom gave me a silk shirt.

丝绸.zh: 我喜欢穿丝绸睡衣，因为很舒服。
丝绸.en: I like to wear silk pajamas because they are very comfortable.
Silk is a specialty of China.

配偶.en: What does your spouse do for work?

配偶.zh: 申请签证时需要填写配偶的信息。
配偶.en: When applying for a visa, you need to fill in your spouse's information.

配偶.zh: 他正在和配偶商量搬家的事。
配偶.en: He is discussing the move with his spouse.

配偶.zh: 如果你有配偶，可以一起参加这个活动。
配偶.en: If you have a spouse, you can attend this event together.

中立.zh: 在这次争论中，我选择保持中立的态度。
中立.en: In this argument, I choose to remain neutral.
Neutral countries do not participate in wars.

中立.zh: 作为裁判，我必须公平中立地做出判断。
中立.en: As a referee, I must make fair and neutral judgments.

好奇心.zh: 出于好奇心，他打开了那个盒子。
好奇心.en: Out of curiosity, he opened that box.

好奇心.zh: 我对这个世界充满好奇心。
好奇心.en: I am full of curiosity about this world.

好奇心.zh: 好奇心驱使我去学习新的知识。
好奇心.en: Curiosity drives me to learn new knowledge.
Her curiosity got her into trouble.

灭绝.zh: 很多动物因为人类活动而面临灭绝。
灭绝.en: Many animals face extinction due to human activities.

灭绝.zh: 这种语言正在慢慢灭绝。
灭绝.en: This language is slowly becoming extinct.

灭绝.zh: 如果不保护环境，许多物种都会灭绝。
灭绝.en: If we don't protect the environment, many species will become extinct.

延误.zh: 因为天气原因，火车延误了两个小时。
延误.en: Due to weather, the train was delayed by two hours.

延误.zh: 对不起，我们的会议被延误了。
延误.en: Sorry, our meeting has been delayed.

延误.zh: 如果继续这样，项目的进度会延误。
延误.en: If it continues like this, the project's progress will be delayed.

截然不同.zh: 这两种文化的习惯截然不同，很难适应。
截然不同.en: The customs of these two cultures are completely different, hard to adapt to.

截然不同.zh: 我的观点和你截然不同。
截然不同.en: My opinion is completely different from yours.

截然不同.zh: 虽然他们是兄弟，但想法却截然不同。
截然不同.en: Although they are brothers, their ideas are completely different.

截然不同.zh: 昨天和今天天气截然不同。
截然不同.en: Yesterday's weather was completely different from today's.

入场.zh: 比赛开始前半小时可以入场。
入场.en: You can enter half an hour before the game starts.
Please show your ID when entering.

入场.zh: 由于人数太多，入场需要排队。
入场.en: Because there are too many people, you need to queue for admission.

容纳.zh: 这个教室能容纳五十人。
容纳.en: This classroom can hold fifty people.

容纳.zh: 新体育馆可以容纳两万名观众。
容纳.en: The new gym can accommodate 20,000 spectators.

容纳.zh: 这个杯子太小，容纳不了那么多水。
容纳.en: This cup is too small to hold that much water.

容纳.zh: 我们的房子最多容纳四个人居住。
容纳.en: Our house can accommodate up to four people to live in.

容纳.zh: 停车场能容纳一百辆车。
容纳.en: The parking lot can hold 100 cars.

无条件.zh: 他无条件支持我的决定。
公司无条件接受了退货要求。
无条件.en: The company accepted the return request unconditionally.

无条件.zh: 父母的爱是无条件的，不管孩子怎么样。
无条件.en: Parents' love is unconditional, no matter what the child does.

无条件.zh: 只要你肯努力，我就无条件帮你。
无条件.en: As long as you are willing to work hard, I will help you unconditionally.

无条件.zh: 这个协议要求双方无条件遵守规则。
无条件.en: This agreement requires both parties to unconditionally follow the rules.

言行.en: His words and actions are inconsistent.

言行.zh: 老师教育我们要言行一致。
言行.en: The teacher taught us to match our words with deeds.

言行.zh: 作为领导，你的言行会影响很多人。
言行.en: As a leader, your words and actions affect many people.

言行.zh: 她言行举止都很得体，让人舒服。
言行.en: Her words, actions, and mannerisms are very appropriate and comfortable.

言行.zh: 虽然他说得很好，但言行才是关键。
言行.en: Although he speaks well, it's his actions that matter.

老远.en: I saw you from far away.

老远.zh: 他住得老远，每天开车上班。
老远.en: He lives far away and drives to work every day.

老远.zh: 老远就闻到饭菜香了，好饿啊。
老远.en: I smelled the food from afar, I'm so hungry.

老远.zh: 别跑老远去买，附近就有超市。
老远.en: Don't go far to buy it, there's a supermarket nearby.

老远.zh: 虽然学校在老远的地方，但他从不迟到。
老远.en: Even though the school is far away, he is never late.

开动.zh: 菜都上齐了，我们开动吧。
开动.en: All the dishes are served, let's dig in.
The machine makes a lot of noise after starting.

开动.zh: 等所有人都到了我们再开动吃饭。
开动.en: We'll start eating only after everyone arrives.

揽.en: He hugged the child in his arms.

揽.zh: 她揽了很多任务，忙不过来。
揽.en: She took on too many tasks and can't handle them all.

揽.zh: 别什么都往自己身上揽。
老板把责任都揽到自己头上了。
揽.en: The boss took all the responsibility on himself.

体能.en: His physical fitness is very good.
Physical training is three times a week.
Your physical fitness is poor, you need to exercise more.

体能.zh: 这次比赛对体能要求很高。
体能.en: This competition has high demands on physical fitness.

体能.zh: 虽然年龄大了，但他体能还保持得不错。
体能.en: Although he is older, he still maintains good physical fitness.

饭碗.en: Be careful not to drop the rice bowl.

饭碗.zh: 现在这工作就是我的饭碗。
饭碗.en: This job is my livelihood now.

饭碗.zh: 公司裁员，很多人的饭碗没了。
饭碗.en: The company laid off staff, many people lost their jobs.

饭碗.zh: 铁饭碗的时代已经过去了。
饭碗.en: The era of the iron rice bowl (stable job) is over.

爪子.en: A cat's claws are very sharp.

爪子.zh: 别把手伸进笼子，小心它的爪子。
爪子.en: Don't put your hand in the cage, watch out for its claws.
The puppy scratched the door with its paws.

爪子.zh: 她指甲留得跟爪子一样长。
爪子.en: Her nails are as long as claws.

爪子.zh: 熊的爪子力量很大，能一掌拍碎东西。
爪子.en: A bear's claws are very powerful and can smash things with one swipe.

公然.en: Some people were arguing openly on the street.

公然.zh: 这件事他公然否认，大家都不信。
公然.en: He openly denied it, but no one believed him.

公然.zh: 他们公然挑战权威，后果很严重。
公然.en: They openly challenged authority, and the consequences were serious.

公然.zh: 虽然大家都知道不对，但没人敢公然反对。
公然.en: Although everyone knows it's wrong, no one dares to openly oppose it.

洗礼.en: There is a baptism ceremony at the church today.

洗礼.zh: 这场战斗让他经历了血的洗礼。
洗礼.en: This battle gave him a baptism of blood.

洗礼.zh: 新员工都要经历严格的洗礼才能上岗。
洗礼.en: New employees must go through a strict baptism before starting work.

洗礼.zh: 经过这次挫折的洗礼，他成熟了很多。
洗礼.en: After going through this setback baptism, he became much more mature.

一回事.zh: 他说的和做的根本不是一回事。
一回事.en: What he says and what he does are completely different.

一回事.zh: 我以为很简单，结果根本不是一回事。
一回事.en: I thought it was simple, but it turned out to be totally not the same thing.

一回事.zh: 爱情和婚姻不是一回事，你得明白。
一回事.en: Love and marriage are not the same thing, you need to understand.

扣押.zh: 海关扣押了这批货物进行查验。
扣押.en: Customs detained this batch of goods for inspection.

扣押.zh: 因为欠债，他的车被法院扣押了。
扣押.en: Because of debt, his car was seized by the court.

扣押.zh: 他们非法扣押了人质，警方正在介入。
扣押.en: They illegally detained hostages, and the police are intervening.

扣押.zh: 如果你不交罚款，你的证件会被扣押三个月。
扣押.en: If you don't pay the fine, your documents will be detained for three months.

富豪.zh: 那个富豪捐了很多钱给学校。
富豪.en: That billionaire donated a lot of money to the school.

富豪.zh: 他出生在富豪家庭，但自己也很努力。
富豪.en: He was born into a wealthy family, but he also works hard himself.

富豪.zh: 这个城市住着不少顶级富豪。
富豪.en: This city is home to quite a few top-tier billionaires.

富豪.zh: 富豪们常常有专门的理财团队。
富豪.en: Billionaires often have dedicated financial management teams.

富豪.zh: 他虽然是个富豪，但生活非常低调。
富豪.en: Although he is a billionaire, he lives a very low-key life.

洞穴.en: This cave is very deep, be careful.

洞穴.zh: 探险队发现了一个古老的洞穴。
洞穴.en: The expedition discovered an ancient cave.

洞穴.zh: 下雨的时候，我们躲进了一个小洞穴。
洞穴.en: When it rained, we took shelter in a small cave.

洞穴.zh: 洞穴里有蝙蝠，别吓到它们。
洞穴.en: There are bats in the cave, don't scare them.

洞穴.zh: 他们花了三天时间才走出那个洞穴。
洞穴.en: It took them three days to get out of that cave.

胀.en: Eating too much will make your stomach bloated.

胀.zh: 这只气球越吹越大，快要胀破了。
胀.en: This balloon is getting bigger and bigger, about to burst.

胀.zh: 泡在水里太久，手指会胀起来。
胀.en: If you soak in water too long, your fingers will swell up.

胀.zh: 他喝了太多碳酸饮料，感觉胃胀得难受。
胀.en: He drank too many carbonated drinks and felt uncomfortable with a bloated stomach.

胀.zh: 木板受潮后容易发胀变形。
胀.en: Wooden boards are prone to swelling and deforming when damp.

要害.en: To hit a snake, you must hit its vital spot.

要害.zh: 这句话说到了问题的要害。
要害.en: This sentence hit the crux of the problem.

要害.zh: 防守时一定要保护好自己的要害部位。
要害.en: When defending, you must protect your vital areas.

要害.zh: 他一下就指出了计划的要害所在。
要害.en: He immediately pointed out the key flaw in the plan.

要害.zh: 谈判时，我们抓住了对方的要害。
要害.en: During the negotiation, we seized the opponent's weak point.

坚实.zh: 他们之间有着坚实的友谊。
他的理论基础很坚实，不用太担心。
坚实.en: His theoretical foundation is very solid, no need to worry too much.

坚实.zh: 经过多年努力，公司打下了坚实的发展基础。
坚实.en: After years of effort, the company has laid a solid foundation for development.

坚实.zh: 我们要用坚实的证据来证明这个观点。
坚实.en: We need to use solid evidence to prove this point.

醒目.zh: 她穿了一件醒目的红裙子。
醒目.en: She wore a striking red dress.

醒目.zh: 广告要做得醒目才能吸引顾客。
醒目.en: Advertisements need to be eye-catching to attract customers.

醒目.zh: 他把重要信息用醒目的字体标出来了。
醒目.en: He marked the important information in a prominent font.

醒目.zh: 在人群中，那个高个子男生特别醒目。
醒目.en: In the crowd, that tall boy was particularly noticeable.

组装.zh: 他花了一上午才把电脑组装好。
组装.en: It took him the whole morning to assemble the computer.

组装.zh: 这款家具需要自己组装，很简单。
组装.en: This piece of furniture needs to be assembled by yourself, it's very simple.

组装.zh: 工人正在车间里组装机器零件。
组装.en: Workers are assembling machine parts in the workshop.

组装.zh: 按照说明书，我们很快就把模型组装起来了。
组装.en: Following the instructions, we quickly assembled the model.

向来.en: I have never liked spicy food.
This shop has always had good business.

向来.zh: 她向来是个乐观的人，很少抱怨。
向来.en: She has always been an optimistic person and rarely complains.

向来.zh: 他向来对工作认真负责，所以老板很信任他。
向来.en: He has always been serious and responsible about his work, so his boss trusts him a lot.

投机.zh: 股票投机风险很大，你要小心。
投机.en: Stock speculation is very risky, you need to be careful.

投机.zh: 他总想投机取巧，结果吃了大亏。
投机.en: He always tries to cut corners, and ended up suffering big losses.

投机.zh: 我们第一次见面就很投机，像老朋友一样。
投机.en: We hit it off from the first meeting, like old friends.

投机.zh: 虽然这次合作很投机，但合同还是要仔细签。
投机.en: Although this collaboration is very agreeable, we still need to sign the contract carefully.

打通.en: I got through to him on the phone.

打通.zh: 这条路打通之后，交通方便多了。
打通.en: After this road was opened up, transportation became much more convenient.

打通.zh: 他靠关系打通了所有环节。
打通.en: He used his connections to smooth out all the steps.

打通.zh: 用这个软件可以一键打通多个平台。
打通.en: With this software you can connect multiple platforms with one click.

打通.zh: 虽然试了好几次，但我终于打通了客服电话。
打通.en: Although I tried several times, I finally got through to customer service.

黄昏.zh: 我们喜欢在黄昏时散步。
黄昏.en: We like to go for a walk at dusk.

黄昏.zh: 黄昏时分，天边出现了红色的晚霞。
黄昏.en: At dusk, red sunset clouds appeared at the horizon.

黄昏.zh: 等到黄昏再出去吧，现在太热了。
黄昏.en: Let's go out at dusk, it's too hot now.

黄昏.zh: 每个黄昏，他都会在阳台上喝一杯茶。
黄昏.en: Every dusk, he would drink a cup of tea on the balcony.

戒烟.zh: 戒烟很难，但是对健康好。
戒烟.en: Quitting smoking is hard, but it's good for your health.
The doctor advised him to quit smoking immediately.

戒烟.zh: 为了孩子，她终于戒烟了。
戒烟.en: For the sake of her child, she finally quit smoking.

戒烟.zh: 如果戒烟成功，你会感觉身体好很多。
戒烟.en: If you succeed in quitting smoking, you'll feel much better physically.

交付.en: This project will be delivered tomorrow.

交付.zh: 请先交付百分之三十的定金。
因为疫情，交付日期推迟了一个月。
交付.en: Due to the pandemic, the delivery date was postponed by a month.

交付.zh: 他们按时交付了所有产品，客户很满意。
交付.en: They delivered all the products on time, and the client was very satisfied.

有所不同.zh: 每个人的想法有所不同。
这两个版本的设计有所不同。
有所不同.en: The designs of these two versions are different.

有所不同.zh: 结果和我们的预期有所不同。
有所不同.en: The result is different from what we expected.

有所不同.zh: 虽然看起来很像，但细节上有所不同。
有所不同.en: Although they look very similar, the details are different.

有所不同.zh: 他的态度和以前有所不同，好像更积极了。
有所不同.en: His attitude is different from before; he seems more positive.

展望.zh: 他对未来有很好的展望。
展望.en: He has a good outlook on the future.

展望.zh: 我们在会上展望了明年的计划。
展望.en: At the meeting, we looked ahead to next year's plans.

展望.zh: 展望市场趋势，我们需要调整策略。
展望.en: Looking ahead at market trends, we need to adjust our strategy.

展望.zh: 这次会议主要展望了公司未来的发展方向。
展望.en: This meeting mainly looked ahead at the company's future development direction.

情结.zh: 这部电影有一种怀旧情结。
情结.en: This movie has a nostalgic complex.

情结.zh: 每个人心里都有自己的情结。
情结.en: Everyone has their own complex in their heart.

情结.zh: 她的恋父情结影响了她的恋爱观。
情结.en: Her Electra complex affected her view on romance.

情结.zh: 虽然离开了家乡，但他对故乡有很深的情结。
情结.en: Although he left his hometown, he has a deep emotional attachment to it.

知名度.zh: 这个品牌的知名度还不够。
知名度.en: This brand's popularity is not enough yet.

知名度.zh: 提高知名度需要时间和努力。
知名度.en: Improving popularity requires time and effort.

知名度.zh: 明星的知名度直接影响他们的收入。
知名度.en: A celebrity's popularity directly affects their income.

知名度.zh: 他靠实力和作品提升了知名度，而不是靠炒作。
知名度.en: He raised his popularity through talent and works, not through hype.

仪表.en: The dashboard on the car is broken.

仪表.zh: 面试时要注意你的仪表。
仪表.en: You should pay attention to your appearance during the interview.

仪表.zh: 这个仪表能显示温度和时间。
仪表.en: This instrument displays temperature and time.

仪表.zh: 他不仅仪表不凡，而且谈吐优雅。
仪表.en: He not only has an impressive appearance but also speaks elegantly.

庄严.en: The flag-raising ceremony is very solemn.
His tone of voice is very solemn.

庄严.zh: 在庄严的国歌声中，大家起立致敬。
庄严.en: Everyone stood up in respect during the solemn national anthem.

庄严.zh: 这座纪念碑显得十分庄严。
虽然气氛很庄严，但他还是忍不住笑了。
庄严.en: Although the atmosphere was very solemn, he still couldn't help laughing.

蹬.zh: 他用力一蹬就跳过去了。
蹬.en: He gave a hard push with his foot and jumped over.
Don't kick off the blanket, you'll catch a cold easily.

蹬.zh: 她蹬着高跟鞋走路很稳。
蹬.en: She walks very steadily in high heels.

蹬.zh: 他蹬了一下地面，滑板就往前冲。
蹬.en: He pushed off the ground once, and the skateboard shot forward.

蹬.zh: 我骑自行车时不小心蹬空了。
蹬.en: I accidentally pedaled in the air while riding my bike.

集结.en: The troops are assembling on the square.

集结.zh: 粉丝们在机场集结等她。
集结.en: The fans gathered at the airport waiting for her.

集结.zh: 我们明天早上八点在门口集结。
集结.en: We will assemble at the gate at 8 o'clock tomorrow morning.

集结.zh: 为了救援，志愿者们迅速集结起来。
集结.en: Volunteers quickly gathered together for the rescue.

集结.zh: 等所有人集结完毕，我们就出发。
集结.en: Once everyone has assembled, we will set off.

主人公.zh: 这本书的主人公很勇敢。
主人公.en: The protagonist of this book is very brave.

主人公.zh: 电影的主人公是个普通教师。
主人公.en: The protagonist of the movie is an ordinary teacher.

主人公.zh: 读者都很喜欢故事里的主人公。
主人公.en: Readers all really like the protagonist in the story.

主人公.zh: 小说主人公的经历让我很感动。
主人公.en: The protagonist's experiences in the novel moved me deeply.

主人公.zh: 这个角色的塑造让主人公更加真实。
主人公.en: The characterization makes the protagonist more real.

冷淡.en: His attitude toward me is very cold.

冷淡.zh: 这家店的服务太冷淡了。
冷淡.en: The service at this shop is too cold and indifferent.

冷淡.zh: 她最近对什么事都很冷淡。
冷淡.en: She has been indifferent to everything lately.

冷淡.zh: 虽然我主动打招呼，但他反应很冷淡。
冷淡.en: Although I greeted him first, his response was very cold.

冷淡.zh: 别因为一次失败就对梦想冷淡下来。
冷淡.en: Don't become indifferent to your dreams because of one failure.

吉祥物.zh: 熊猫是这次活动的吉祥物。
吉祥物.en: The panda is the mascot of this event.

吉祥物.zh: 孩子们很喜欢那个可爱的吉祥物。
吉祥物.en: The children really like that cute mascot.

吉祥物.zh: 奥运会的吉祥物设计得很有创意。
吉祥物.en: The Olympic mascot was designed very creatively.

吉祥物.zh: 这只吉祥物在开幕式上跳了舞。
吉祥物.en: This mascot danced at the opening ceremony.

吉祥物.zh: 我们公司也打算设计一个专属吉祥物。
吉祥物.en: Our company also plans to design an exclusive mascot.

草案.zh: 公司已经通过了初步草案。
草案.en: The company has approved the initial draft.

草案.zh: 他们正在讨论新法律的草案。
草案.en: They are discussing the draft of the new law.

草案.zh: 草案里写明了具体的要求。
草案.en: The draft specifies the detailed requirements.

草案.zh: 等草案定稿后，我们再开会讨论。
草案.en: After the draft is finalized, we will hold a meeting to discuss it.

取暖.en: In winter, we need to keep warm.
Everyone gathered around the stove to keep warm.
In the north, they rely on heating to keep warm.

取暖.zh: 他搓着手取暖，嘴里哈着白气。
取暖.en: He rubbed his hands to keep warm, puffing white mist.

取暖.zh: 没有空调，我们只能用热水袋取暖。
取暖.en: Without air conditioning, we can only use hot water bottles to keep warm.

过关.en: I passed the exam this time.
You need to be careful to pass the level (or pass through the checkpoint).
This security checkpoint is hard to get through.

过关.zh: 只要努力，你一定能过关。
过关.en: As long as you work hard, you will surely pass.

过关.zh: 他连闯三个关卡才顺利过关。
过关.en: He went through three checkpoints before successfully passing.

所作所为.en: I understand what you have done.

所作所为.zh: 他的所作所为让人失望。
你要为自己的所作所为负责。
所作所为.en: You need to be responsible for what you have done.

所作所为.zh: 大家对他的所作所为议论纷纷。
所作所为.en: Everyone is talking about what he has done.

所作所为.zh: 回忆过去的所作所为，他感到后悔。
所作所为.en: Looking back on what he did in the past, he felt regret.

珍藏.zh: 我把老照片都珍藏在一个盒子里。
珍藏.en: I keep old photos treasured in a box.

珍藏.zh: 虽然不贵，但我一直珍藏着你送的礼物。
珍藏.en: Although not expensive, I have always treasured the gift you gave me.

珍藏.zh: 因为很有纪念意义，所以我把这枚邮票珍藏起来了。
珍藏.en: Because it has great commemorative meaning, I have treasured this stamp.

抵御.zh: 多穿衣服可以抵御寒冷。
抵御.en: Wearing more clothes can resist the cold.

抵御.zh: 我们需要采取措施来抵御病毒的传播。
抵御.en: We need to take measures to resist the spread of the virus.

抵御.zh: 这道城墙曾经用来抵御外敌。
抵御.en: This city wall was once used to defend against foreign enemies.

抵御.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但我们可以靠运动来抵御寒冷。
抵御.en: Although the weather is very cold, we can rely on exercise to resist the cold.

抵御.zh: 喝姜茶有助于抵御感冒。
抵御.en: Drinking ginger tea helps resist colds.

失利.zh: 由于准备不足，球队在决赛中失利了。
失利.en: Due to insufficient preparation, the team lost in the finals.

失利.zh: 他因为一次失利就放弃了梦想。
失利.en: He gave up his dream because of one failure.

失利.zh: 虽然上一局失利了，但大家并没有气馁。
失利.en: Although we lost the last round, everyone was not discouraged.

失利.zh: 投资失利让他损失了不少钱。
失利.en: The investment failure cost him a lot of money.

安稳.en: My life now is very stable.

安稳.zh: 她找到了一份安稳的工作，不用再担心了。
安稳.en: She found a stable job, no need to worry anymore.

安稳.zh: 这个国家一直保持着安稳的局面。
安稳.en: This country has maintained a stable situation.

安稳.zh: 虽然收入不高，但日子过得很安稳。
安稳.en: Although the income is low, life is very stable.

安稳.zh: 孩子睡得特别安稳，一点声音都没吵醒他。
安稳.en: The child slept very peacefully, no sound woke him up.

流露.zh: 她的话语中流露出对家乡的思念。
流露.en: Her words revealed longing for her hometown.

流露.zh: 他的眼神流露出一丝不安。
流露.en: His eyes revealed a trace of unease.

流露.zh: 虽然他没说出来，但表情已经流露出了不满。
流露.en: Although he didn't say it, his expression already revealed dissatisfaction.

流露.zh: 在谈话中，他自然流露出对艺术的热爱。
流露.en: During the conversation, he naturally revealed his love for art.

扑克.en: Let's play poker on the weekend.

扑克.zh: 他们几个人围在一起玩扑克牌。
扑克.en: A few of them gathered around to play poker.

扑克.zh: 我不太会打扑克，但可以学。
扑克.en: I'm not very good at playing poker, but I can learn.

扑克.zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们只能在家里打扑克。
扑克.en: Because it rained, we could only play poker at home.

扑克.zh: 这副扑克牌是我爷爷留下的。
扑克.en: This deck of poker cards was left by my grandfather.

别看.en: Don't be fooled by how small this place is, it has everything.

别看.zh: 别看他不爱说话，其实他特别热心。
别看.en: Don't be fooled by his quietness, he is actually very warm-hearted.

别看.zh: 别看这道菜简单，味道特别好。
别看.en: Don't be fooled by how simple this dish is, it tastes great.

别看.zh: 别看手机很便宜，功能却很强大。
别看.en: Don't be fooled by how cheap the phone is, its functions are actually powerful.

别看.zh: 别看天气这么好，下午可能会下雨。
别看.en: Don't be fooled by such good weather, it might rain in the afternoon.

冤枉.zh: 这件事真不是我做的，你别冤枉好人。
冤枉.en: I really didn't do this, don't wrong a good person.

冤枉.zh: 被冤枉的感觉很不好受。
冤枉.en: The feeling of being wronged is very unpleasant.

冤枉.zh: 虽然不是我干的，但他们还是冤枉了我。
冤枉.en: Although I didn't do it, they still wronged me.

冤枉.zh: 花这么多钱买这个，我觉得太冤枉了。
冤枉.en: Spending so much money on this, I feel it's such a waste.

信贷.zh: 这个银行提供信贷服务。
很多年轻人依赖信贷来买房子。
信贷.en: Many young people rely on credit to buy houses.

信贷.zh: 信贷利率最近又提高了。
信贷.en: Credit interest rates have risen again recently.

信贷.zh: 如果你信用良好，申请信贷就容易很多。
信贷.en: If you have good credit, it's much easier to apply for credit.

信贷.zh: 他们公司专门做小额信贷业务。
信贷.en: Their company specializes in micro-credit business.

生机.en: In spring, everything is full of vitality.

生机.zh: 这片废墟中竟然长出了小苗，充满了生机。
生机.en: In this ruin, a small seedling has actually grown, full of vitality.

生机.zh: 他的一番话给了我们一线生机。
生机.en: His words gave us a glimmer of hope.

生机.zh: 虽然环境恶劣，但植物依然展现出顽强的生机。
生机.en: Although the environment is harsh, the plants still show tenacious vitality.

生机.zh: 这场改革给经济带来了新的生机。
生机.en: This reform brought new vitality to the economy.

陷害.zh: 她设计陷阱陷害竞争对手。
陷害.en: She set a trap to frame her competitor.

陷害.zh: 别相信他，他可能会陷害你。
陷害.en: Don't trust him, he might frame you.

陷害.zh: 我们得找出是谁在陷害他。
陷害.en: We need to find out who is framing him.

陷害.zh: 他因为被陷害而失去了工作。
陷害.en: He lost his job because he was framed.

追溯.zh: 这个传统可以追溯到古代。
追溯.en: This tradition can be traced back to ancient times.

追溯.zh: 我们追溯了事故的起因。
追溯.en: We traced the cause of the accident.

追溯.zh: 这条河的历史能追溯到很久以前。
追溯.en: The history of this river can be traced back a long time.

追溯.zh: 如果你想追溯家族根源，可以查族谱。
追溯.en: If you want to trace your family roots, you can check the genealogy.

追溯.zh: 科学家追溯了病毒的传播路径。
追溯.en: Scientists traced the transmission path of the virus.

体谅.zh: 他很体谅别人，从不抱怨。
体谅.en: He is very considerate of others and never complains.

体谅.zh: 虽然累，但我也体谅你的辛苦。
体谅.en: Although I'm tired, I also understand your hard work.

体谅.zh: 多体谅一下你的父母吧。
体谅.en: Be more understanding towards your parents.

体谅.zh: 作为朋友，我们要互相体谅。
体谅.en: As friends, we need to be considerate of each other.

自卫.zh: 她学过自卫术以防万一。
自卫.en: She learned self-defense just in case.

自卫.zh: 法律上，自卫行为是允许的。
面对危险，他本能地采取了自卫。
自卫.en: Facing danger, he instinctively acted in self-defense.

自卫.zh: 自卫不等于暴力，要适度。
自卫.en: Self-defense is not the same as violence; it should be moderate.

自责.zh: 别自责了，这不是你的错。
自责.en: Don't blame yourself, it's not your fault.

自责.zh: 他因为失误而深深自责。
自责.en: He deeply blamed himself for the mistake.
Excessive self-blame is bad for your health.
She blamed herself for not taking good care of the child.

尾声.en: The movie is nearing its end.

尾声.zh: 比赛到了尾声，观众很激动。
尾声.en: The game was nearing its end, and the audience was excited.

尾声.zh: 这本书的尾声写得很好。
尾声.en: The epilogue of this book is well written.

尾声.zh: 会议进入尾声时，他提出了建议。
尾声.en: As the meeting drew to a close, he made a suggestion.

尾声.zh: 演出尾声，全体演员上台谢幕。
尾声.en: At the end of the performance, all the actors came on stage for the curtain call.

一举.en: He plans to win the championship in one go.

一举.zh: 这个方案一举解决了两个问题。
一举.en: This plan solved two problems at once.

一举.zh: 她一举成名，成为了明星。
一举.en: She became famous overnight and became a star.

一举.zh: 我们想一举完成所有任务。
一举.en: We want to complete all tasks in one stroke.

一举.zh: 这个投资让他一举赚了百万。
一举.en: This investment made him a million in one shot.

聋.zh: 老人有点聋，说话要大点声。
聋.en: The old man is a bit deaf; you need to speak louder.
Deaf people communicate using sign language.

聋.zh: 这声音大得能把人震聋。
聋.en: This sound is loud enough to deafen a person.

聋.zh: 他虽然聋，但生活很积极。
聋.en: Although he is deaf, he lives a very positive life.

脸颊.en: The cold wind made his cheeks ache.

脸颊.zh: 她笑起来脸颊上有两个酒窝。
脸颊.en: When she smiles, she has two dimples on her cheeks.

脸颊.zh: 泪水顺着他的脸颊流下来。

惊醒.en: I was startled awake by thunder.

惊醒.zh: 孩子半夜惊醒，哭了起来。
惊醒.en: The child woke up with a start in the middle of the night and started crying.

惊醒.zh: 一点声音就能把她惊醒。
惊醒.en: A tiny sound can startle her awake.
He had a nightmare and suddenly woke up with a start.

惊醒.zh: 闹钟没响，他自然惊醒的。
惊醒.en: The alarm didn't go off; he woke up naturally.

破灭.en: Hope was shattered in an instant.
That plan fell through long ago.

破灭.zh: 因为投资失败，他的发财梦彻底破灭了。
破灭.en: Because of the failed investment, his dream of getting rich was completely shattered.

破灭.zh: 虽然努力了很久，但最后希望还是破灭了。
破灭.en: Although he tried hard for a long time, in the end his hope still shattered.

藏身.en: Couldn't find a place to hide.

藏身.zh: 这只猫喜欢在沙发后面藏身。
藏身.en: This cat likes to hide behind the sofa.

藏身.zh: 警察来了，他赶紧找个地方藏身。
藏身.en: The police came, and he quickly found a place to hide.

藏身.zh: 为了不被发现，他只能在桥洞下藏身一夜。
藏身.en: In order not to be found, he could only hide under the bridge for the night.

祖母.en: My grandmother is eighty years old this year.
The food my grandmother cooks is delicious.
I'm going to visit my grandmother this weekend.

祖母.zh: 祖母小时候经常给我讲故事。
祖母.en: My grandmother often told me stories when I was little.

祖母.zh: 虽然祖母年纪大了，但她每天还坚持散步。
祖母.en: Although my grandmother is old, she still insists on walking every day.

高山.en: There is a high mountain in the distance.
The air on the high mountain is very fresh.

高山.zh: 他们爬上了那座高山，看到了云海。
高山.en: They climbed that high mountain and saw a sea of clouds.

高山.zh: 虽然高山很陡，但他还是坚持登顶了。
高山.en: Although the high mountain was steep, he still insisted on reaching the summit.

缓和.zh: 我们需要缓和一下紧张的关系。
缓和.en: We need to ease the tense relationship.

缓和.zh: 吃了药以后，他的疼痛缓和了很多。
缓和.en: After taking the medicine, his pain eased a lot.

缓和.zh: 双方谈话后，矛盾终于缓和了。
缓和.en: After the two sides talked, the conflict finally eased.

缓和.zh: 虽然天气还很冷，但风已经缓和了一些。
缓和.en: Although the weather is still cold, the wind has eased a bit.

戒备.zh: 她对陌生人总是很戒备。
戒备.en: She is always wary of strangers.

戒备.zh: 因为出了事，小区加强了戒备。
戒备.en: Because of an incident, the neighborhood has tightened security.

戒备.zh: 虽然对方看起来很友善，但他仍然保持戒备。
戒备.en: Although the other person seemed friendly, he still remained vigilant.

芽.en: Tender shoots emerge from the soil.
The buds on this tree grow very fast.

芽.zh: 春天来了，树上长出了新芽。
芽.en: Spring has come, and new buds have grown on the trees.

芽.zh: 我种的花生已经冒出小芽了。
芽.en: The peanuts I planted have already sprouted small buds.

报销.en: Keep the receipt; it can be reimbursed.
He got the taxi fare reimbursed.

报销.zh: 出差产生的费用公司会报销。
报销.en: The company will reimburse expenses incurred on business trips.

报销.zh: 如果你买了药品，记得找财务报销。
报销.en: If you bought medicine, remember to ask finance for reimbursement.

皇宫.en: This is the ancient emperor's palace.

皇宫.zh: 游客们参观了那个皇宫。
皇宫里有很多珍贵的文物。
皇宫.en: There are many precious artifacts in the palace.

皇宫.zh: 虽然皇宫很大，但住起来并不舒服。
皇宫.en: Although the palace is huge, it's not comfortable to live in.

正宗.en: The dishes he cooks taste very authentic.

正宗.zh: 我们找一家正宗的兰州拉面馆吧。
正宗.en: Let's find an authentic Lanzhou noodle restaurant.

正宗.zh: 这家店卖的茶叶是正宗的西湖龙井。
正宗.en: The tea sold at this shop is authentic West Lake Longjing.

正宗.zh: 虽然价格贵一点，但正宗的意大利披萨确实好吃。
正宗.en: Although the price is a bit higher, authentic Italian pizza is really delicious.

结晶.en: This is the crystallization of wisdom.

结晶.zh: 这个项目是他们多年努力的结晶。
结晶.en: This project is the fruit of their years of hard work.
The crystallization process of salt is very interesting.

结晶.zh: 虽然过程很辛苦，但最后的结晶让我们很满意。
结晶.en: Although the process was tough, the final result made us very satisfied.

结晶.zh: 糖在冷却后形成了结晶。
结晶.en: The sugar formed crystals after cooling.

嘉年华.en: There's a carnival event this weekend.

嘉年华.zh: 我们全家去年暑假去了水上嘉年华。
嘉年华.en: Our whole family went to a water carnival last summer.

嘉年华.zh: 因为下雨，嘉年华推迟了一天。
嘉年华.en: The carnival was postponed by a day because of the rain.

嘉年华.zh: 这个嘉年华有各种游乐设施和美食。
嘉年华.en: This carnival has all kinds of rides and food.

嘉年华.zh: 嘉年华的游行队伍非常壮观。
嘉年华.en: The carnival parade is very spectacular.

范畴.en: This is not within my scope.

范畴.zh: 研究范畴包括经济学和社会学。
范畴.en: The research scope includes economics and sociology.

范畴.zh: 如果你想讨论这个话题，它其实超出了我们的讨论范畴。
范畴.en: If you want to discuss this topic, it's actually beyond the scope of our discussion.

范畴.zh: 这个问题不在法律范畴内。
范畴.en: This issue is not within the legal realm.

范畴.zh: 公司的业务范畴正在扩大。
范畴.en: The company's business scope is expanding.

想方设法.en: He is trying every possible way to make money.

想方设法.zh: 为了完成任务，他们想方设法找到了解决办法。
想方设法.en: To complete the task, they tried every means and found a solution.

想方设法.zh: 虽然困难重重，但我们还是想方设法克服了。
想方设法.en: Although there were many difficulties, we still found a way to overcome them.

想方设法.zh: 她总是想方设法逃避责任。
想方设法.en: She always tries every way to shirk responsibility.

想方设法.zh: 老师想方设法让学生们对学习感兴趣。
想方设法.en: The teacher tried every possible way to get students interested in learning.

索赔.zh: 我们需要向保险公司索赔。
索赔.en: We need to file a claim with the insurance company.

索赔.zh: 事故发生后，他立即向公司提出了索赔要求。
索赔.en: After the accident, he immediately filed a claim with the company.

索赔.zh: 因为货物受损，我们不得不向卖家索赔。
索赔.en: Because the goods were damaged, we had to claim compensation from the seller.

索赔.zh: 索赔流程很复杂，需要提供很多证明。
索赔.en: The claims process is very complicated and requires a lot of documentation.

索赔.zh: 她因为航班延误成功索赔了五百元。
索赔.en: She successfully claimed 500 yuan for the flight delay.

自负.zh: 自负的性格让他失去了很多朋友。
自负.en: His conceited personality caused him to lose many friends.

自负.zh: 虽然他有能力，但过于自负导致团队合作失败。
自负.en: Although he is capable, being too arrogant led to the failure of teamwork.

自负.zh: 自负的人往往听不进别人的建议。
自负.en: Arrogant people often don't listen to others' advice.

自负.zh: 你别那么自负，虚心一点比较好。
自负.en: Don't be so conceited; it's better to be humble.

逼近.zh: 期末考试越来越逼近了，我得抓紧复习。
逼近.en: The final exam is getting closer, I have to study hard.

逼近.zh: 随着冬天的逼近，天气变得越来越冷。
逼近.en: As winter approaches, the weather gets colder and colder.

逼近.zh: 危险正在逼近，我们要小心。
逼近.en: Danger is approaching, we need to be careful.

逼近.zh: 他的分数已经逼近满分了。
逼近.en: His score is already close to full marks.

违章.en: He violated traffic rules while driving.

违章.zh: 因为违章停车，他被罚了两百块钱。
违章.en: He was fined 200 yuan for illegal parking.

违章.zh: 如果你违章驾驶，不仅会被罚款还会扣分。
违章.en: If you drive illegally, you'll not only be fined but also get points deducted.

违章.zh: 这个建筑有违章搭建的部分。
违章.en: This building has parts that were constructed illegally.

违章.zh: 交通违章记录会影响你的保险费用。
违章.en: Traffic violation records can affect your insurance premium.

牢记.zh: 我们要牢记历史教训，避免重蹈覆辙。
牢记.en: We must keep the historical lessons in mind to avoid repeating mistakes.

牢记.zh: 虽然过去了很久，但他依然牢记着老师的教诲。
牢记.en: Although a long time has passed, he still remembers the teacher's teachings.

牢记.zh: 出门前请牢记带上身份证。
牢记.en: Please remember to bring your ID card before going out.

牢记.zh: 这些安全规则必须牢记在心。
牢记.en: These safety rules must be kept firmly in mind.

特制.en: This is a specially made cake.

特制.zh: 这款特制的香水只在限量版中出售。
特制.en: This specially made perfume is only sold in limited editions.

特制.zh: 因为他的特殊要求，工厂为他特制了一个模型。
特制.en: Due to his special request, the factory made a custom model for him.

特制.zh: 这把吉他是由名家特制的。
特制.en: This guitar was specially made by a master craftsman.

特制.zh: 运动鞋是特制的，适合长时间跑步。
特制.en: The sneakers are specially made for long-distance running.

分担.zh: 既然大家都有空，不如一起分担这个任务。
分担.en: Since everyone is free, why not share this task together.

分担.zh: 她主动提出要分担我的工作压力。
分担.en: She proactively offered to share my work pressure.

分担.zh: 夫妻之间应该互相分担家庭开支。
分担.en: Couples should share family expenses with each other.

分担.zh: 你不用一个人扛着，我们可以分担你的烦恼。
分担.en: You don't have to carry it alone; we can share your worries.

计时.zh: 这个停车场是按小时计时的。
计时.en: This parking lot charges by the hour.

计时.zh: 我们计时看看谁跑得快。
计时.en: Let's time it to see who runs faster.

计时.zh: 做这个实验需要精确计时。
他一边工作一边计时，效率很高。
计时.en: He works while timing, and it's very efficient.

手艺.zh: 这位老师傅的手艺非常好。
手艺.en: This old master's craftsmanship is very good.

手艺.zh: 这家店的手艺是祖传的。
手艺.en: This shop's craftsmanship is passed down through generations.

手艺.zh: 她做的手工包全凭自己的手艺。
手艺.en: Her handmade bags rely entirely on her own skill.

手艺.zh: 虽然机器很发达，但传统手艺还是值得保留。
手艺.en: Although machines are advanced, traditional craftsmanship is still worth preserving.

追问.en: Don't press further; I don't want to say.

追问.zh: 警察一直在追问他的行踪。
追问.en: The police kept pressing him about his whereabouts.

追问.zh: 她追问了好几次，我才告诉她真相。
追问.en: She pressed several times before I told her the truth.

追问.zh: 对于这个秘密，无论怎么追问她都不开口。
追问.en: Regarding this secret, no matter how much she was pressed, she wouldn't speak.

追问.zh: 孩子总是追问为什么，让父母很头疼。
追问.en: Kids always ask why repeatedly, giving parents a headache.

双向.zh: 我们之间的沟通应该是双向的。
双向.en: Communication between us should be two-way.

双向.zh: 这个协议是双向约束的。
双向.en: This agreement is binding on both sides.

双向.zh: 双向收费让消费者很不满。
双向.en: Two-way charging makes consumers very unhappy.

双向.zh: 好的友谊需要双向付出。

危及.zh: 这种行为会危及你的安全。
危及.en: This behavior will endanger your safety.

危及.zh: 环境污染危及整个生态系统。
危及.en: Environmental pollution endangers the entire ecosystem.

危及.zh: 他酒后驾车，险些危及路人。
危及.en: He drove drunk, nearly endangering pedestrians.

危及.zh: 这个决定可能危及公司的未来。
危及.en: This decision may jeopardize the company's future.

危及.zh: 如果再不采取措施，疫情会危及更多人。
危及.en: If no measures are taken, the epidemic will endanger more people.

芭蕾.en: She has studied ballet since childhood.
There is a ballet performance tonight.
Ballet dancers' toes hurt a lot.

芭蕾.zh: 我喜欢看芭蕾，但自己跳不了。
芭蕾.en: I like watching ballet, but I can't dance it myself.

芭蕾.zh: 她为了练芭蕾，每天都要拉伸。
芭蕾.en: To practice ballet, she stretches every day.

阴暗.zh: 不要躲在阴暗的角落里。
阴暗.en: Don't hide in the dark corner.

阴暗.zh: 这部电影的色调很阴暗。
阴暗.en: The color tone of this movie is very dark.

阴暗.zh: 他内心阴暗的一面很少人知道。
阴暗.en: Few people know the dark side of his heart.

不予.zh: 对于不合理的要求，我们不予理会。

不予.en: The company decided not to hire.

不予.zh: 对于这种谣言，我们不予置评。
不予.en: We will not comment on such rumors.

不予.zh: 如果你不配合，我们将不予退款。
不予.en: If you don't cooperate, we will not refund.

堡垒.zh: 这座古城堡曾经是坚固的堡垒。
堡垒.en: This ancient castle was once a strong fortress.

堡垒.zh: 在敌人面前，我们要筑起精神的堡垒。
堡垒.en: In front of the enemy, we must build a spiritual fortress.

堡垒.zh: 这个公司是行业的堡垒。
堡垒.en: This company is a stronghold of the industry.

堡垒.zh: 堡垒往往从内部被攻破。
堡垒.en: Fortresses are often breached from within.

堡垒.zh: 他们躲在堡垒里不敢出来。
堡垒.en: They hide in the fortress and dare not come out.

领会.en: Did you understand what I meant?

领会.zh: 他听了半天也没能领会这个笑话的笑点。
领会.en: He listened for a long time but still couldn't grasp the joke's punchline.

领会.zh: 如果你仔细读，就能领会作者的想法。
领会.en: If you read carefully, you can comprehend the author's thoughts.

领会.zh: 虽然我没说清楚，但你应该能领会重点。
领会.en: Although I didn't make it clear, you should be able to grasp the main point.

领会.zh: 老师讲得很慢，确保大家都领会了。
领会.en: The teacher spoke very slowly to make sure everyone understood.

敲诈.zh: 那家伙用秘密照片敲诈了她一大笔钱。
敲诈.en: That guy extorted a large sum of money from her using secret photos.

敲诈.zh: 报警吧，别让敲诈的人得逞。
敲诈.en: Call the police, don't let the extortionist succeed.

敲诈.zh: 如果你不给他钱，他就会继续敲诈你。
敲诈.en: If you don't give him money, he will continue to extort you.

敲诈.zh: 这种敲诈行为在法律上是很严重的。
敲诈.en: This kind of extortion is very serious in the eyes of the law.

举措.zh: 公司推出了一系列新的管理举措来提高效率。
举措.en: The company launched a series of new management measures to improve efficiency.

举措.zh: 政府的举措得到了大家的支持。
举措.en: The government's measures have gained everyone's support.

举措.zh: 因为情况紧急，所以我们必须采取更严厉的举措。
举措.en: Because the situation is urgent, we must take stricter measures.

举措.zh: 这些环保举措让城市变得更干净了。
举措.en: These environmental measures have made the city cleaner.

美德.zh: 尊老爱幼是中华民族的传统美德。
美德.en: Respecting the elderly and cherishing the young are traditional virtues of the Chinese nation.

美德.zh: 他乐于助人，具备很多美德。
美德.en: He is willing to help others and possesses many virtues.

美德.zh: 虽然善良是美德，但也要学会保护自己。
美德.en: Although kindness is a virtue, you also need to learn to protect yourself.

美德.zh: 在现在这个社会，节俭仍然是一种值得提倡的美德。
美德.en: In today's society, frugality is still a virtue worth promoting.

欢快.zh: 孩子们在操场上欢快地跑来跑去。
欢快.en: The children are running around happily on the playground.

欢快.zh: 餐厅里播放着欢快的音乐，气氛很好。
欢快.en: The restaurant is playing cheerful music, and the atmosphere is great.

欢快.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但大家的心情却很欢快。
欢快.en: Although the weather is very cold, everyone's mood is very cheerful.

欢快.zh: 她说话的语气总是那么欢快，让人听了就开心。
欢快.en: Her tone of voice is always so cheerful that it makes people happy to hear it.

参照.en: Please refer to the instruction manual for operation.

参照.zh: 你可以参照这个模板来写你的报告。
参照.en: You can refer to this template to write your report.

参照.zh: 我们参照了去年的数据来制定计划。
参照.en: We referred to last year's data to make the plan.

参照.zh: 如果不懂，就参照那个例子来做。
参照.en: If you don't understand, just refer to that example.

参照.zh: 参照其他国家的方法，我们改进了流程。
参照.en: By referring to methods from other countries, we improved the process.

蜜月.zh: 这对新婚夫妇选择了巴厘岛作为蜜月目的地。
蜜月.en: The newlyweds chose Bali as their honeymoon destination.

蜜月.zh: 蜜月旅行一定要好好规划。
蜜月.en: Honeymoon trips must be well planned.

蜜月.zh: 虽然蜜月很短，但回忆很美好。
蜜月.en: Although the honeymoon was short, the memories are wonderful.

蜜月.zh: 他们结婚后直接开始工作，没去度蜜月。
蜜月.en: After getting married, they started working right away and didn't go on a honeymoon.

摇摆.en: The branches sway in the wind.

摇摆.zh: 风太大了，树枝不停地摇摆。
摇摆.en: The wind is too strong; the branches keep swaying.

摇摆.zh: 他的立场一直在摇摆，让人无法信任。
摇摆.en: His position has been wavering, making it hard to trust him.

摇摆.zh: 虽然她有点摇摆，但最后还是做了决定。
摇摆.en: Although she was a bit indecisive, she finally made a decision.

摇摆.zh: 这个秋千摇摆得很高，孩子们很喜欢。
摇摆.en: This swing sways very high, and the kids love it.

优越.zh: 这个地段地理位置很优越，交通方便。
优越.en: This location has a superior geographical position with convenient transportation.

优越.zh: 她总觉得自己比别人优越，让人不舒服。
优越.en: She always feels superior to others, which makes people uncomfortable.

优越.zh: 虽然他家境优越，但他从不炫耀。
优越.en: Although his family background is privileged, he never shows off.

优越.zh: 这款产品的性能相对优越，价格也高一些。
优越.en: The performance of this product is relatively superior, and the price is also higher.

下一代.en: We need to plan for the next generation.

下一代.zh: 父母总是希望下一代能过得比自己好。
下一代.en: Parents always hope that the next generation will live better than themselves.

下一代.zh: 科技的发展会影响下一代的生活方式。
下一代.en: The development of technology will affect the lifestyle of the next generation.

下一代.zh: 如果我们不保护环境，下一代就会受苦。
下一代.en: If we don't protect the environment, the next generation will suffer.

下一代.zh: 这是给下一代使用的教材，编写要更用心。
下一代.en: This is a textbook for the next generation, so it needs to be written more carefully.

开朗.en: She has a very cheerful personality.

开朗.zh: 他开朗的笑容让人觉得很温暖。
开朗.en: His bright smile makes people feel warm.

开朗.zh: 虽然遇到困难，但他依然保持开朗的心态。
开朗.en: Although he encountered difficulties, he still maintained an optimistic mindset.

开朗.zh: 她是个开朗的女孩，朋友很多。
开朗.en: She is an outgoing girl with many friends.

开朗.zh: 你的开朗性格帮我们解决了很多问题。
开朗.en: Your cheerful personality helped us solve a lot of problems.

哨.en: As soon as the whistle blew, the game started.

哨.zh: 他站在哨位上一动不动。
哨.en: He stood motionless at his post.

哨.zh: 听到哨音，大家都集合了。

哨.en: The police officer blew his whistle to signal a stop.

受害.zh: 这次地震让很多人受害。
受害.en: Many people suffered in this earthquake.

受害.zh: 无辜的百姓常常在战争中受害。
受害.en: Innocent civilians often suffer in wars.

受害.zh: 如果你不注意安全，可能会受害。
受害.en: If you don't pay attention to safety, you might get hurt.

受害.zh: 受害的家庭得到了政府的帮助。
受害.en: The affected families received help from the government.

受害.zh: 她受害的经历让人同情。
受害.en: Her victimization experience makes people sympathetic.

危急.zh: 在危急时刻，他保持了冷静。
危急.en: He stayed calm in the critical moment.

危急.zh: 病人的病情突然变得危急起来。
危急.en: The patient's condition suddenly became critical.

危急.zh: 遇到危急情况要立刻报警。
危急.en: In an emergency, call the police immediately.

危急.zh: 他们面临危急的考验，但没有放弃。
危急.en: They faced a critical test, but they didn't give up.

着迷.en: He is very obsessed with games.

着迷.zh: 这部电影让我着迷不已。
她从小就对音乐着迷，现在成了歌手。
着迷.en: She has been fascinated by music since childhood, and now she became a singer.

着迷.zh: 你为什么对那个电视剧这么着迷？
着迷.en: Why are you so hooked on that TV series?

着迷.zh: 他对足球着迷到了废寝忘食的地步。
着迷.en: He is so obsessed with soccer that he forgets to eat and sleep.

复原.zh: 这幅画经过修复已经复原了。
复原.en: This painting has been restored after repair.

复原.zh: 经过几个月的治疗，他终于完全复原。
复原.en: After months of treatment, he finally fully recovered.
The city gradually recovered after the earthquake.

复原.zh: 这个古董被复原成原来的样子。
复原.en: This antique was restored to its original appearance.

随即.zh: 听到消息，她随即出发了。
随即.en: Upon hearing the news, she set off immediately.

随即.zh: 老师说完，随即让我们开始练习。
随即.en: The teacher finished speaking and then had us start practicing.

随即.zh: 他拿起电话，随即拨了一个号码。
随即.en: He picked up the phone and immediately dialed a number.

随即.zh: 会议结束后，他随即赶往机场。
随即.en: After the meeting ended, he rushed to the airport right away.

字眼.zh: 他说的每个字眼都很刻薄。
字眼.en: Every word he said was very harsh.

字眼.zh: 这个词是个敏感字眼，最好别用。
字眼.en: This word is a sensitive term; better not use it.

字眼.zh: 文章中出现的字眼需要仔细斟酌。
字眼.en: The wording in the article needs careful consideration.

字眼.zh: 她不喜欢“胖”这个字眼，所以别这么说。
字眼.en: She doesn't like the word 'fat', so don't say it.

做主.en: You make the decision on this matter.

做主.zh: 家里的事都是我妈做主。
做主.en: My mom makes all the decisions at home.

做主.zh: 我们没办法做主，需要问老板。
做主.en: We can't decide; we need to ask the boss.

做主.zh: 自己的事情要自己做主。
做主.en: You should make your own decisions about your own affairs.

做主.zh: 在婚姻大事上，父母不该完全替孩子做主。
做主.en: On major issues like marriage, parents shouldn't make all the decisions for their children.

通缉.en: He is being wanted by the police.

通缉.zh: 警方已经通缉了这个嫌疑人。
通缉.en: The police have issued a wanted notice for this suspect.

通缉.zh: 那个逃犯现在被全国通缉。
通缉.en: That fugitive is now wanted nationwide.

通缉.zh: 通缉令贴满了大街小巷。
通缉.en: Wanted posters were plastered all over the streets.

通缉.zh: 看到通缉犯的照片后，他立刻报了警。
通缉.en: After seeing the wanted criminal's photo, he immediately called the police.

文凭.zh: 找工作的时候，文凭不是唯一的条件。
文凭.en: When looking for a job, a diploma is not the only requirement.

文凭.zh: 他虽然没文凭，但技术特别好。
文凭.en: Although he doesn't have a diploma, his skills are really good.

文凭.zh: 现在很多公司都看重实际能力，不只是看文凭。
文凭.en: Now many companies value actual ability, not just a diploma.

文凭.zh: 她为了拿个高文凭，每天熬夜学习。
文凭.en: She stays up late studying every day in order to get a higher diploma.

小路.en: Taking the small path can get to the park faster.

小路.zh: 天黑了，别走那条小路，不安全。
小路.en: It's dark, don't take that small path, it's not safe.

小路.zh: 他喜欢骑自行车穿过城市里的小路。
小路.en: He likes to ride his bike through the small paths in the city.

小路.zh: 虽然小路不太好走，但风景特别漂亮。
小路.en: Although the small path isn't easy to walk on, the scenery is especially beautiful.

捎.en: Bring me a bottle of water.

捎.zh: 你去超市的话，顺便捎点水果回来。
捎.en: If you go to the supermarket, bring some fruit back on the way.

捎.zh: 我明天去上海，可以给你捎东西。
捎.en: I'm going to Shanghai tomorrow, I can bring things for you.

捎.zh: 他让我捎句话给你，说晚上一起吃饭。
捎.en: He asked me to pass a message to you, saying to have dinner together tonight.

捎.zh: 你要是路过快递站，麻烦帮我捎个包裹。
捎.en: If you pass by the express station, please help me pick up a package.

无非.en: He just wants to be lazy.

无非.zh: 这件事无非就是多花点时间。
无非.en: This matter is nothing more than spending a bit more time.

无非.zh: 她说的那些话，无非是在找借口。
无非.en: The things she said are nothing but making excuses.

无非.zh: 你担心的那些问题，无非都是小事。
无非.en: The problems you're worried about are nothing but small things.

无非.zh: 他解释了半天，无非就是想证明自己没错。
无非.en: He explained for a long time, just trying to prove he was not wrong.

总额.zh: 这次购物总额超过一千块。
总额.en: The total amount of this shopping trip is over a thousand yuan.

总额.zh: 账单上的总额跟我算的不一样。
总额.en: The total on the bill is different from what I calculated.

总额.zh: 今年公司捐款总额比去年多了一倍。
总额.en: This year the company's total donation amount is double that of last year.

总额.zh: 你先把每个项目的花费加起来，再看总额。
总额.en: First add up the expenses for each project, then check the total amount.

启程.en: The plane departed early in the morning.

启程.zh: 他收拾好行李，准备启程去北京。
启程.en: He packed his luggage and is ready to set off for Beijing.
We'll set off after the rain stops.

启程.zh: 这次旅行我打算从上海启程，先去杭州。
启程.en: For this trip, I plan to start from Shanghai and go to Hangzhou first.

提拔.zh: 老板打算提拔你做组长。
提拔.en: The boss plans to promote you to team leader.

提拔.zh: 她工作很努力，终于被提拔了。
提拔.en: She works very hard and finally got promoted.

提拔.zh: 这次提拔的人选还没定下来。
提拔.en: The candidates for this promotion haven't been decided yet.

提拔.zh: 如果这次不提拔我，我就考虑换工作。
提拔.en: If I don't get promoted this time, I'll consider changing jobs.

趁机.en: He took the opportunity to slip away.

趁机.zh: 打折的时候，她趁机买了很多东西。
趁机.en: During the sale, she took the chance to buy a lot of things.

趁机.zh: 老师转身写黑板，他就趁机说话。
趁机.en: When the teacher turned to write on the blackboard, he took the chance to talk.

趁机.zh: 你应该趁机好好休息一下。
趁机.en: You should take the opportunity to have a good rest.

趁机.zh: 趁着天气好，我们趁机去爬山吧。
趁机.en: Since the weather is nice, let's take the chance to go hiking.

劝说.zh: 她一直在劝说父母同意她去留学。
劝说.en: She has been persuading her parents to agree to let her study abroad.

劝说.zh: 朋友劝说他别辞职，但他不听。
劝说.en: Friends advised him not to quit, but he didn't listen.

劝说.zh: 经过再三劝说，他终于答应了。
劝说.en: After repeated persuasion, he finally agreed.

劝说.zh: 你不用再劝说了，他已经决定了。
劝说.en: You don't need to persuade anymore; he's already made up his mind.

随心所欲.en: He does things as he pleases.

随心所欲.zh: 结了婚就不能那么随心所欲了。
随心所欲.en: After getting married, you can't be so carefree.

随心所欲.zh: 放假的时候，我想随心所欲地玩。
随心所欲.en: During the holiday, I want to do whatever I want.

随心所欲.zh: 他虽然有钱，但也不能随心所欲地花。
随心所欲.en: Although he has money, he can't spend it as he pleases.

随心所欲.zh: 在这个公司，你不能随心所欲，得守规矩。
随心所欲.en: In this company, you can't do as you please; you have to follow the rules.

皮革.zh: 这件皮衣是真正的皮革。
皮革.en: This leather jacket is real leather.

皮革.zh: 他喜欢买皮革制品，比如皮带和钱包。
皮革.en: He likes to buy leather products, like belts and wallets.

皮革.zh: 这种皮革很软，做沙发很舒服。
皮革.en: This kind of leather is very soft, making comfortable sofas.

皮革.zh: 虽然价格贵，但皮革耐用，所以很多人还是选择它。
皮革.en: Although it's expensive, leather is durable, so many people still choose it.

皮革.zh: 我昨天去了皮革市场，买了一个背包。
皮革.en: I went to the leather market yesterday and bought a backpack.

绰号.zh: 我们班每个人都有个有趣的绰号。
绰号.en: Everyone in our class has an interesting nickname.

绰号.zh: 因为跑得快，大家给他起了个绰号“闪电”。
绰号.en: Because he runs fast, everyone gave him the nickname 'Lightning'.

绰号.zh: 我不喜欢那个绰号，听上去有点伤人。
绰号.en: I don't like that nickname; it sounds a bit hurtful.

绰号.zh: 虽然他有绰号，但大家还是习惯叫他的名字。
绰号.en: Although he has a nickname, everyone still calls him by his real name.

图纸.en: This blueprint is drawn very clearly.

图纸.zh: 工程师正在修改图纸上的尺寸。
图纸.en: The engineer is modifying the dimensions on the blueprint.

图纸.zh: 按照图纸施工，就不会出问题。
图纸.en: If you build according to the drawings, there won't be problems.

图纸.zh: 他把图纸收好了，以免弄丢。
图纸.en: He put the drawings away neatly to avoid losing them.

图纸.zh: 因为图纸有错误，我们得重新设计一遍。
图纸.en: Because the drawings had errors, we had to redesign everything.

矣.en: It's too late for regrets now.
After hearing your words, I understand.
This matter is over, no need to mention it again.

矣.zh: 你若再不改，将来悔之晚矣。
矣.en: If you don't change, you'll regret it too late in the future.

病床.en: He is resting in the hospital bed.
There's a glass of water next to the hospital bed.

病床.zh: 医院里病床很紧张，需要提前预约。
病床.en: Hospital beds are scarce; you need to book in advance.

病床.zh: 他住院期间，每天都有人来病床前看他。
病床.en: During his hospitalization, people came to visit him at his bedside every day.

病床.zh: 病床上的老人虽然虚弱，但精神很好。
病床.en: The elderly man in the hospital bed was weak but in good spirits.

观望.zh: 他在一旁观望，没有参与。
观望.en: He stood by and watched, not participating.

观望.zh: 大家都在观望，等别人先行动。
观望.en: Everyone is waiting and seeing, waiting for someone else to act first.

观望.zh: 对于新政策，许多人持观望态度。
观望.en: Many people are taking a wait-and-see attitude towards the new policy.

观望.zh: 别只是观望，你也该试试。
观望.en: Don't just watch; you should give it a try too.

观望.zh: 他观望了很久，最后决定不买了。
观望.en: He watched for a long time and finally decided not to buy.

告诫.en: Mom warned me not to play with fire.

告诫.zh: 老师告诫大家考试要诚实。
告诫.en: The teacher admonished everyone to be honest on the exam.
He cautioned me to be careful on the road.

告诫.zh: 虽然我听过很多次告诫，但还是犯了错。
告诫.en: Even though I had heard the warning many times, I still made a mistake.

告诫.zh: 专家的告诫很有道理，我们应该记在心里。
告诫.en: The expert's advice makes a lot of sense; we should keep it in mind.

妖怪.zh: 这个动画片里有很多妖怪。
妖怪.en: There are many monsters in this cartoon.

妖怪.zh: 小时候我怕黑，总觉得有妖怪。
妖怪.en: When I was little, I was afraid of the dark, always thinking there were monsters.

妖怪.zh: 传说那座山里住着一只妖怪。
妖怪.en: Legend says a monster lives in that mountain.

妖怪.zh: 他讲了一个关于妖怪的故事，孩子们都吓坏了。
妖怪.en: He told a story about a monster, and the kids were terrified.

妖怪.zh: 别自己吓自己，世界上根本没有妖怪。
妖怪.en: Don't scare yourself; there are no monsters in the world.

政党.zh: 这个政党赢得了很多选票。
政党.en: This political party won a lot of votes.

政党.zh: 不同政党有不同的主张。
政党.en: Different political parties have different platforms.

政党.zh: 他加入了一个新的政党，想为社会做点事。
政党.en: He joined a new political party, wanting to do something for society.

政党.zh: 在这次选举中，两个政党竞争非常激烈。
政党.en: In this election, the two political parties are competing fiercely.

政党.zh: 政党之间应该互相尊重，而不是互相攻击。
政党.en: Political parties should respect each other instead of attacking each other.

译.en: Please translate this passage into English.

译.zh: 这个软件能自动译出多种语言。
译.en: This software can automatically translate multiple languages.

译.zh: 我花了一周时间才译完那篇文章。
译.en: It took me a week to finish translating that article.

译.zh: 虽然她译得很快，但准确性更高。
译.en: Although she translates quickly, her accuracy is even higher.

商讨.zh: 我们商讨一下明天的计划。
双方正在商讨合作细节。
商讨.en: Both sides are discussing the details of cooperation.

商讨.zh: 他们商讨了很久，终于达成共识。
商讨.en: They discussed for a long time and finally reached a consensus.

商讨.zh: 关于这个问题，我们需要和客户好好商讨。
商讨.en: We need to discuss this issue thoroughly with the client.

商讨.zh: 如果你有不同意见，我们可以坐下来商讨。
商讨.en: If you have different opinions, we can sit down and talk.

凶残.en: That wolf's eyes are very fierce.

凶残.zh: 他凶残地对待自己的敌人。
电影里的怪物太凶残了，我都不敢看。
凶残.en: The monster in the movie was too ferocious, I didn't dare watch.

凶残.zh: 历史书上记载了很多凶残的战争。
凶残.en: History books record many brutal wars.

口香糖.en: Give me a piece of chewing gum.
Spit out the gum after chewing it.
You can't chew gum on the subway.

口香糖.zh: 他嘴里嚼着口香糖，看起来很轻松。
口香糖.en: He was chewing gum and looked very relaxed.

口香糖.zh: 这个牌子的口香糖味道不错。
口香糖.en: This brand of chewing gum tastes good.

绞.en: She racked her brains for the answer.

绞.zh: 绳子绞在一起了，解不开。
绞.en: The ropes are twisted together and can't be untied.

绞.zh: 这台机器能把布绞成碎片。
绞.en: This machine can shred cloth into pieces.

绞.zh: 古代有一种刑罚叫绞刑。
绞.en: In ancient times, there was a punishment called hanging.

踪迹.en: Can't find any trace of him.
There are animal tracks in the snow.

踪迹.zh: 警察在森林里发现了一些踪迹。
踪迹.en: The police found some traces in the forest.

踪迹.zh: 那个失踪的人至今没有踪迹。
踪迹.en: There is still no trace of the missing person.

踪迹.zh: 我一路追踪，但还是失去了他的踪迹。
踪迹.en: I followed all the way, but still lost his trail.

沉思.en: Don't disturb him, he's deep in thought.

沉思.zh: 她沉思了一会儿，然后做出了决定。
沉思.en: She pondered for a while and then made a decision.

沉思.zh: 面对这个问题，我们需要沉思片刻。
沉思.en: Facing this issue, we need to ponder for a moment.

沉思.zh: 他坐在窗前沉思人生意义。
沉思.en: He sat by the window pondering the meaning of life.

受贿.en: He was fired for taking bribes.

受贿.zh: 很多腐败案件都涉及受贿。
如果你发现有人受贿，可以举报。
受贿.en: If you find someone taking bribes, you can report it.

内存.en: My phone doesn't have enough memory.

内存.zh: 你最好清理一下内存，不然会很卡。
内存.en: You'd better clear some memory, or it will lag.

内存.zh: 游戏太吃内存了，我打算升级。
内存.en: The game takes up too much memory, I plan to upgrade.

内存.zh: 她买了一个大内存的手机来存照片。
内存.en: She bought a phone with large memory to store photos.

参军.en: He joined the army last year.
Joining the army can build physical fitness.

参军.zh: 很多年轻人选择大学毕业后参军。
参军.en: Many young people choose to join the army after college.

参军.zh: 如果你有参军意愿，可以先去咨询一下。
参军.en: If you're interested in joining the army, you can go and ask first.

热潮.zh: 创业热潮吸引了很多年轻人。
热潮.en: The startup boom attracts many young people.

热潮.zh: 这股旅游热潮持续了整个夏天。
热潮.en: This travel craze lasted the whole summer.

热潮.zh: 随着经济发展，出国留学掀起热潮。
热潮.en: With economic development, studying abroad has become a craze.

热潮.zh: 大家都在讨论AI热潮会持续多久。
热潮.en: Everyone is discussing how long the AI boom will last.

精密.zh: 他们用了精密的仪器来测量。
精密.en: They used precise instruments to measure.

精密.zh: 这个零件需要精密加工，不能有误差。
精密.en: This part requires precision machining; there can be no error.

精密.zh: 他写了一份精密的计划，但执行起来很难。
精密.en: He wrote a detailed plan, but executing it is difficult.

精密.zh: 因为实验要求精密控制温度，所以我们用了新设备。
精密.en: Because the experiment requires precise temperature control, we used new equipment.

质问.zh: 记者对总统提出了激烈的质问。
质问.en: The reporter asked the president a sharp question.

质问.zh: 面对老师的质问，他一句话也说不出来。
质问.en: Facing the teacher's questioning, he couldn't say a word.

质问.zh: 他不但没有道歉，反而反过来质问我们。
质问.en: He not only didn't apologize, but instead turned around and questioned us.

质问.zh: 我受不了他总是用那种语气质问我的私事。
质问.en: I can't stand him always questioning my private affairs in that tone.

掠夺.zh: 他们掠夺了村庄的粮食。
殖民者疯狂掠夺当地的资源。
掠夺.en: The colonists ruthlessly plundered local resources.

掠夺.zh: 战争期间，很多文物被掠夺到国外。
掠夺.en: During the war, many cultural relics were looted and taken abroad.

掠夺.zh: 这个公司通过不正当手段掠夺了市场份额。
掠夺.en: This company plundered market share through unfair means.

掠夺.zh: 历史上，侵略者不仅杀人放火，还掠夺了大量财富。
掠夺.en: Historically, invaders not only killed and burned, but also plundered a huge amount of wealth.

剥削.en: The boss is exploiting the workers.

剥削.zh: 以前农民受到地主的残酷剥削。
剥削.en: In the past, peasants were cruelly exploited by landlords.

剥削.zh: 他觉得这份工作剥削了太多个人时间。
剥削.en: He feels this job exploits too much of his personal time.

剥削.zh: 虽然工资低，但公司还在变相剥削我们的加班。
剥削.en: Although the salary is low, the company is still exploiting our overtime in a disguised way.

剥削.zh: 我们要抵制任何形式的剥削，包括对廉价劳动力的压榨。
剥削.en: We must resist any form of exploitation, including the squeezing of cheap labor.

编造.zh: 他编造了一个很离谱的故事。
编造.en: He made up a very outrageous story.

编造.zh: 为了逃避责任，他编造了不在场证明。
编造.en: To avoid responsibility, he fabricated an alibi.

编造.zh: 那些谣言都是他们编造出来的，你千万别信。
编造.en: Those rumors were all fabricated by them; don't believe them.

编造.zh: 如果他没有证据，那就是在编造事实来误导大家。
编造.en: If he has no evidence, then he is fabricating facts to mislead everyone.

坦然.zh: 面对失败，她表现得非常坦然。
坦然.en: Facing failure, she appeared very composed.

坦然.zh: 既然问心无愧，就能坦然面对一切质疑。
坦然.en: Since you have a clear conscience, you can face all doubts with ease.

坦然.zh: 他坦然地说出真相，没有任何隐瞒。
坦然.en: He calmly told the truth without any concealment.

坦然.zh: 虽然很多人批评他，但他依然坦然地做自己。
坦然.en: Although many people criticized him, he still calmly stayed true to himself.

间断.en: The rain hasn't stopped at all.

间断.zh: 他学习很努力，从不间断。
间断.en: He studies very hard, never letting up.

间断.zh: 这里的网络信号经常间断，很烦人。
间断.en: The network signal here often cuts out, which is annoying.

间断.zh: 我坚持每天跑步，除非生病，否则不会间断。
间断.en: I insist on running every day; unless I'm sick, I won't stop.

间断.zh: 因为疫情，物资供应出现了间断，大家都很担心。
间断.en: Due to the pandemic, there was a disruption in the supply of materials, and everyone was worried.

细腻.zh: 这个演员的表演非常细腻。
细腻.en: This actor's performance is very nuanced.

细腻.zh: 他画了一幅细腻的风景画，细节特别丰富。
细腻.en: He painted a delicate landscape with particularly rich details.

细腻.zh: 虽然是男生，但他的心思特别细腻，很会照顾人。
细腻.en: Even though he's a guy, his thoughts are very delicate, and he's good at taking care of people.

细腻.zh: 她说话的语气很细腻，让人听了觉得很舒服。
细腻.en: Her tone of voice is very subtle, making people feel comfortable when listening.

跟不上.en: I can't keep up with his speed.

跟不上.zh: 年纪大了，体力跟不上了。
跟不上.en: Getting older, I can't keep up physically.

跟不上.zh: 老师讲得太快，我跟不上课堂进度。
跟不上.en: The teacher speaks too fast; I can't keep up with the class.

跟不上.zh: 现在科技发展太快，老年人常常跟不上变化。
跟不上.en: Technology develops so fast now that elderly people often can't keep up with changes.

跟不上.zh: 他说的那些专业术语我完全跟不上，只能点头。
跟不上.en: I can't keep up with all those technical terms he used; I could only nod.

控告.en: He sued his neighbor in court.

控告.zh: 受害者决定正式控告对方。
控告.en: The victim decided to formally accuse the other party.

控告.zh: 因为没有证据，他的控告被驳回了。
控告.en: Due to lack of evidence, his accusation was dismissed.

控告.zh: 如果公司不赔偿，我们就去劳动局控告他们。
控告.en: If the company doesn't compensate, we'll go to the labor bureau to sue them.

控告.zh: 虽然控告过程很漫长，但他为了正义坚持到底。
控告.en: Although the legal process is long, he persisted for the sake of justice.

晋升.zh: 因为业绩好，他很快晋升了。
晋升.en: Because of good performance, he got promoted quickly.
The company's promotion system is fair.

晋升.zh: 她晋升后，工作压力更大了。
晋升.en: After her promotion, the work pressure became greater.

晋升.zh: 虽然他很努力，但晋升机会不多。
晋升.en: Although he works hard, there aren't many promotion opportunities.

蜡.en: The floor is very shiny after waxing.
This kind of wax can prevent moisture.

蜡.zh: 如果你用蜡擦车，车会很亮。
蜡.en: If you wax the car, it will be shiny.

蜡.zh: 她买了一盒蜡笔给孩子画画。
蜡.en: She bought a box of crayons for the child to draw.

典范.zh: 这个项目成了行业典范。
典范.en: This project has become an industry model.

典范.zh: 她不仅学习好，还是品德典范。
典范.en: She not only studies well but is also a moral role model.

典范.zh: 这种教育方式值得作为典范推广。
典范.en: This educational approach is worth promoting as a model.

典范.zh: 很多公司都把这家企业当作管理典范。
典范.en: Many companies regard this enterprise as a management model.

隐身.zh: 这种技术能让飞机隐身。
隐身.en: This technology can make planes stealth.

隐身.zh: 虽然他在群里，但一直隐身。
隐身.en: Although he is in the group, he has been invisible.

隐身.zh: 我需要隐身一下，不想被打扰。
隐身.en: I need to be invisible for a while; I don't want to be disturbed.

隐身.zh: 在古代传说中，有些人会隐身术。
隐身.en: In ancient legends, some people knew the art of invisibility.

溶解.zh: 这种粉末能快速溶解于水。
溶解.en: This powder can quickly dissolve in water.

溶解.zh: 因为水温高，盐溶解得更快。
溶解.en: Because the water temperature is high, the salt dissolves faster.

溶解.zh: 药物需要先溶解才能服用。
溶解.en: The medicine needs to be dissolved before taking.

溶解.zh: 在化学实验中，我们要观察固体如何溶解。
溶解.en: In chemistry experiments, we observe how solids dissolve.

划算.en: This price is a good deal.
Buying the large package is more cost-effective.

划算.zh: 虽然贵一点，但质量好，还是划算。
划算.en: Although it's a bit expensive, the quality is good, so it's still worthwhile.

划算.zh: 你觉得这趟旅行划算吗？
划算.en: Do you think this trip is worth it?

划算.zh: 如果经常用，买会员卡很划算。
划算.en: If you use it often, buying a membership card is worthwhile.

栏目.zh: 这个电视栏目每周更新一次。
栏目.en: This TV program updates once a week.

栏目.zh: 除了新闻，还有娱乐栏目。
栏目.en: Besides news, there are also entertainment columns.

栏目.zh: 报纸上的健康栏目很有用。
栏目.en: The health column in the newspaper is very useful.

栏目.zh: 她负责网站的时尚栏目，很受欢迎。
栏目.en: She is in charge of the website's fashion column, which is very popular.

矫正.en: He needs to straighten his teeth.

矫正.zh: 矫正视力可以戴眼镜或做手术。
矫正.en: To correct vision, you can wear glasses or have surgery.

矫正.zh: 因为姿势不对，他需要矫正坐姿。
矫正.en: Because his posture is wrong, he needs to correct his sitting posture.

矫正.zh: 这种仪器能矫正孩子的驼背。
矫正.en: This device can correct a child's hunched back.

矫正.zh: 老师帮他矫正了发音错误。
矫正.en: The teacher helped him correct his pronunciation mistakes.

疏忽.zh: 因为疏忽，他犯了一个大错。
疏忽.en: Because of negligence, he made a big mistake.

疏忽.zh: 虽然只是小疏忽，但后果很严重。
疏忽.en: Although it was just a small oversight, the consequences were serious.

疏忽.zh: 工作要认真，不能有疏忽。
疏忽.en: Work must be taken seriously; there can be no negligence.

疏忽.zh: 他因为疏忽大意丢了重要文件。
疏忽.en: He lost important documents due to carelessness.

执着.en: He is very persistent about his dream.

执着.zh: 她执着地追求自己的理想。
虽然失败了很多次，但他依然很执着。
执着.en: Although he failed many times, he is still persistent.

执着.zh: 这种执着的精神值得学习。
执着.en: This persistent spirit is worth learning from.

执着.zh: 他对这件事太过执着，影响了生活。
执着.en: He is too obsessed with this matter, and it has affected his life.

半岛.zh: 这个半岛的风景特别美。
半岛.en: The scenery on this peninsula is especially beautiful.

半岛.zh: 我们坐船去了那个小半岛。
半岛.en: We took a boat to that small peninsula.

半岛.zh: 虽然只是个半岛，但这里的气候很舒服。
半岛.en: Although it's just a peninsula, the climate here is very comfortable.

半岛.zh: 朝鲜半岛的局势一直很受关注。
半岛.en: The situation on the Korean Peninsula has always been closely watched.

半岛.zh: 沿着半岛的海岸线开车，能看到很多小渔村。
半岛.en: Driving along the peninsula's coastline, you can see many small fishing villages.

脑筋.en: You need to use your brain on this matter.

脑筋.zh: 她脑筋灵活，总能想出好办法。
脑筋.en: She has a flexible mind and can always come up with good ideas.

脑筋.zh: 最近工作太累，我脑筋都有点不好使了。
脑筋.en: I've been so tired from work lately that my brain isn't working well.

脑筋.zh: 如果你多动脑筋，这道题其实不难。
脑筋.en: If you use your brain a little more, this problem is actually not difficult.

粉末.en: Coffee powder spilled all over the table.
This medicine is in powder form.

粉末.zh: 洗衣粉溶化后变成白色粉末。
粉末.en: After dissolving, the laundry detergent turns into a white powder.

粉末.zh: 她把坚果打成粉末，用来做蛋糕。
粉末.en: She ground the nuts into powder to use in the cake.

粉末.zh: 地上有一些可疑的白色粉末。
粉末.en: There is some suspicious white powder on the ground.

衰退.zh: 经济衰退影响了很多人。
衰退.en: The economic recession has affected many people.

衰退.zh: 年纪大了以后，体力会慢慢衰退。
衰退.en: As you get older, your physical strength will gradually decline.

衰退.zh: 虽然公司业绩衰退，但老板还没裁员。
衰退.en: Although the company's performance is declining, the boss hasn't laid anyone off yet.

衰退.zh: 这个地区的传统手工业正在衰退。
衰退.en: The traditional handicraft industry in this region is declining.

结识.zh: 我在旅行中结识了很多朋友。
结识.en: I made many friends during my travels.

结识.zh: 通过这次活动，我结识了一位老板。
结识.en: Through this event, I got to know a boss.

结识.zh: 他很擅长在聚会上结识新朋友。
结识.en: He is very good at meeting new people at parties.

结识.zh: 我们是在网上认识的，后来才在现实中结识。
结识.en: We met online, and only later got to know each other in real life.

结识.zh: 如果你多参加社交活动，很容易结识志同道合的人。
结识.en: If you attend more social events, it's easy to meet like-minded people.

缺失.en: This report is missing a few pages.

缺失.zh: 孩子的教育不能缺失爱。
缺失.en: A child's education cannot lack love.

缺失.zh: 因为缺失经验，他犯了很多错。
缺失.en: Because he lacked experience, he made many mistakes.

缺失.zh: 这台机器的零件有缺失，所以不能用了。
缺失.en: This machine is missing some parts, so it can't be used.

缺失.zh: 钙质缺失会导致骨质疏松。
缺失.en: Calcium deficiency can lead to osteoporosis.

呻吟.zh: 病人躺在床上不停地呻吟。
呻吟.en: The patient kept moaning in bed.

呻吟.zh: 外面风很大，窗户发出呻吟般的声音。
呻吟.en: The wind is strong outside, and the window makes groaning sounds.

呻吟.zh: 虽然他很疼，但他强忍着没有呻吟。
呻吟.en: Although he was in great pain, he held back and didn't groan.

呻吟.zh: 老旧的木门一开就发出沉重的呻吟。
呻吟.en: The old wooden door let out a heavy groan as it opened.

号称.en: This shop claims to be a century-old establishment.

号称.zh: 他号称自己一天能写一万字。
号称.en: He claims he can write ten thousand words a day.

号称.zh: 这款产品号称是最先进的。
号称.en: This product claims to be the most advanced.

号称.zh: 虽然号称免费，但最后还是要收费。
号称.en: Although it's advertised as free, in the end you still have to pay.

号称.zh: 这座城市号称“花园城市”，确实很漂亮。
号称.en: This city is known as the 'Garden City', and it really is beautiful.

讨价还价.zh: 在市场买东西可以讨价还价。
讨价还价.en: You can bargain when buying things at the market.

讨价还价.zh: 他花了一个小时跟老板讨价还价。
讨价还价.en: He spent an hour haggling with the boss.

讨价还价.zh: 如果你不讨价还价，可能会买贵了。
讨价还价.en: If you don't bargain, you might end up paying too much.

讨价还价.zh: 虽然价格标了，但我们还是讨价还价了半天。
讨价还价.en: Although the price was marked, we still haggled for a long time.

流淌.zh: 汗水从他的额头流淌下来。
眼泪无声地在她脸上流淌。
流淌.en: Tears silently streamed down her face.

流淌.zh: 这条小溪日夜不停地流淌，滋养着两岸的农田。
流淌.en: This stream flows ceaselessly day and night, nourishing the farmland on both sides.

流淌.zh: 时间在不知不觉中流淌，转眼一年就过去了。
流淌.en: Time flows by imperceptibly, and in the blink of an eye a year has passed.

雕刻.zh: 这件雕刻作品花了他整整三个月。
雕刻.en: This carving piece took him a full three months.

雕刻.zh: 虽然雕刻很费时间，但他乐在其中。
雕刻.en: Although carving is time-consuming, he enjoys it.

雕刻.zh: 我喜欢看师傅雕刻玉石。
雕刻.en: I like watching the master carving jade.

雕刻.zh: 他用雕刻刀在石头上刻了一朵花。
雕刻.en: He used a carving knife to carve a flower on the stone.

奏效.zh: 医生开的药很快就奏效了。
奏效.en: The medicine the doctor prescribed worked quickly.

奏效.zh: 虽然试了很多办法，但都没有奏效。
奏效.en: Although we tried many methods, none worked.
Your suggestion was very effective, thanks.

奏效.zh: 那套营销策略在市场上完全不奏效。
奏效.en: That marketing strategy was completely ineffective in the market.

挥霍.zh: 别把时间挥霍在玩游戏上。
他挥霍完了家产，现在很后悔。
挥霍.en: He squandered all the family property and now regrets it.
Young people shouldn't waste their youth.

挥霍.zh: 她挥霍无度，信用卡都刷爆了。
挥霍.en: She spends recklessly and maxed out her credit cards.

主权.zh: 这个问题涉及国家的主权完整。
主权.en: This issue involves the integrity of national sovereignty.

主权.zh: 虽然谈判艰难，但主权问题没有让步。
主权.en: Although negotiations were tough, there was no compromise on sovereignty.

主权.zh: 中国坚决反对任何侵犯主权的行为。
