主权.en: China firmly opposes any infringement of sovereignty.

干部.zh: 这次会议所有干部都要参加。
干部.en: All cadres must attend this meeting.

干部.zh: 虽然他是干部，但一点架子都没有。
干部.en: Although he is a cadre, he has no airs at all.

干部.zh: 老张当了二十年干部，经验丰富。
干部.en: Old Zhang has been a cadre for twenty years and is very experienced.

脱身.en: It's hard for him to get away.
She made an excuse to get away.

脱身.zh: 他想脱身，但被朋友拉住了。
脱身.en: He wanted to leave, but his friend held him back.

脱身.zh: 会议结束后，他终于脱身去见女朋友。
脱身.en: After the meeting ended, he finally got away to meet his girlfriend.

构建.en: We are building a new system.

构建.zh: 构建和谐社会是我们的目标。
构建.en: Building a harmonious society is our goal.

构建.zh: 他花了很多时间构建这个模型。
构建.en: He spent a lot of time constructing this model.

构建.zh: 虽然困难，但我们仍需构建信任。
构建.en: Although it's difficult, we still need to build trust.

构建.zh: 这个框架构建得很合理，运行稳定。
构建.en: This framework is well constructed and runs stably.

恼火.en: This matter made me very angry.
Don't get angry, listen to my explanation.

恼火.zh: 看到结果，老板恼火得拍桌子。
恼火.en: Seeing the result, the boss was so angry he slapped the table.

恼火.zh: 虽然她没说什么，但我能看出她很恼火。
恼火.en: Although she didn't say anything, I could tell she was very annoyed.

归宿.en: He found his place in life.

归宿.zh: 流浪多年的他，终于有了归宿。
归宿.en: After years of wandering, he finally had a home.

归宿.zh: 落叶总要有个归宿，人也一样。
归宿.en: Fallen leaves always have a resting place, and so do people.

归宿.zh: 婚姻不一定是女人的唯一归宿。
归宿.en: Marriage is not necessarily a woman's only destination.

凳子.en: He is sitting on a stool reading.

凳子.zh: 教室里缺几张凳子，你去搬点。
凳子.en: The classroom is short a few stools, go get some.

凳子.zh: 虽然凳子不高，但坐着挺舒服。
凳子.en: Although the stool is not high, it is quite comfortable to sit on.

马力.zh: 这辆车的马力很大，开起来很爽。
马力.en: This car has a lot of horsepower and drives really well.

马力.zh: 发动机的马力不够，爬坡很费劲。
马力.en: The engine doesn't have enough horsepower, so climbing hills is hard.

马力.zh: 虽然马力大，但油耗也高，你得考虑清楚。
马力.en: Although it has high horsepower, the fuel consumption is also high, so you need to think carefully.

马力.zh: 他买了一台马力超强的摩托车。
马力.en: He bought a motorcycle with extremely strong horsepower.

马力.zh: 厂家说这匹马有八百马力，实际开起来感觉没那么猛。
马力.en: The manufacturer says this car has 800 horsepower, but it doesn't feel that powerful when driving.

争端.zh: 他们俩为了钱又起了争端。
争端.en: The two of them had another dispute over money.

争端.zh: 这场边界争端持续了好几年。
争端.en: This border dispute has lasted for several years.

争端.zh: 为了避免争端，最好提前把规则说清楚。
争端.en: To avoid disputes, it's best to clarify the rules in advance.

争端.zh: 公司内部因为资源分配问题爆发了争端。
争端.en: A dispute broke out inside the company over resource allocation.

争端.zh: 他们通过谈判解决了土地争端，双方都让了一步。
争端.en: They resolved the land dispute through negotiation, with both sides making concessions.

人道.zh: 这样做太不人道了，我们不能接受。
人道.en: This is too inhumane; we cannot accept it.

人道.zh: 他们向灾区提供了人道援助。
人道.en: They provided humanitarian aid to the disaster area.

人道.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但至少要做到基本的人道。
人道.en: Although conditions are tough, at least basic humanity must be maintained.

人道.zh: 人道主义精神是我们应该坚持的原则。
人道.en: The spirit of humanitarianism is a principle we should uphold.

人道.zh: 对待动物也要讲人道，不能虐待它们。
人道.en: We should also be humane to animals and not mistreat them.

明朗.en: The weather today is especially clear and bright.

明朗.zh: 他的态度已经很明朗了，我们别再问了。
明朗.en: His attitude is already very clear; let's not ask anymore.

明朗.zh: 局势明朗之后，大家才松了一口气。
明朗.en: Only after the situation became clear did everyone breathe a sigh of relief.

明朗.zh: 她笑起来的样子特别明朗，让人心情很好。
明朗.en: When she smiles, she looks particularly bright and cheerful, which lifts people's spirits.

明朗.zh: 虽然现在还不确定，但未来会慢慢明朗起来的。
明朗.en: Although it's uncertain now, the future will gradually become clearer.

不屑.zh: 他对这种小把戏不屑一顾。
不屑.en: He disdains this kind of trick and pays no attention.
She scorns to argue with that kind of person.

不屑.zh: 大家都觉得他太狂了，对谁都不屑。
不屑.en: Everyone thinks he's too arrogant and looks down on everyone.

不屑.zh: 虽然别人觉得这工作很丢脸，但他从不不屑去做。
不屑.en: Although others think this job is shameful, he never disdains to do it.

不屑.zh: 他嘴上说不屑争辩，其实心里很在意。
不屑.en: He says he scorns to argue, but actually he cares a lot inside.

叛逆.zh: 这孩子到了叛逆期，特别难管。
叛逆.en: This child is going through a rebellious phase and is very hard to manage.

叛逆.zh: 他年轻的时候很叛逆，现在成熟多了。
叛逆.en: He was very rebellious when he was young, but now he's much more mature.

叛逆.zh: 她对父母的管教越来越叛逆了。
叛逆.en: She is becoming more and more rebellious against her parents' discipline.

叛逆.zh: 这部小说讲的是一个叛逆少女的故事。
叛逆.en: This novel tells the story of a rebellious teenage girl.

叛逆.zh: 很多青少年叛逆是为了引起家长的关注。
叛逆.en: Many teenagers become rebellious in order to get their parents' attention.

辨别.zh: 你能辨别这两种颜色吗？
辨别.en: Can you distinguish between these two colors?
He has difficulty distinguishing truth from lies.

辨别.zh: 我们需要学会辨别哪些信息是可靠的。
辨别.en: We need to learn to distinguish which information is reliable.

辨别.zh: 在黑暗中，我无法辨别方向。
辨别.en: In the dark, I couldn't tell which direction was which.

辨别.zh: 这两种药味道很像，但仔细辨别还是有区别的。
辨别.en: These two medicines taste very similar, but if you distinguish carefully, there is still a difference.

一眼.en: I liked her at first sight.

一眼.zh: 他一眼就看出了这不是真货。
一眼.en: He recognized at a glance that this wasn't genuine.

一眼.zh: 她往人群里看了一眼，就找到了朋友。
一眼.en: She took one glance into the crowd and found her friend.

一眼.zh: 你一眼就能看出来，他是个经验丰富的老手。
一眼.en: You can tell at a glance that he is an experienced veteran.

一眼.zh: 虽然只看了他一眼，但我记住了他的样子。
一眼.en: Although I only glanced at him once, I remembered his face.

铭记.zh: 我会永远铭记你的恩情。
铭记.en: I will forever remember your kindness.

铭记.zh: 这段历史值得我们每个人铭记。
铭记.en: This history is worth remembering by every one of us.

铭记.zh: 老师的话我一直铭记在心，从没忘记过。
铭记.en: I have always kept the teacher's words engraved in my heart and never forgotten them.

铭记.zh: 我们要铭记那些为和平牺牲的英雄。
铭记.en: We should remember the heroes who sacrificed for peace.

铭记.zh: 虽然事情过去很久了，但他仍然铭记着那次教训。
铭记.en: Although the event happened a long time ago, he still remembers that lesson vividly.

责备.zh: 他因为迟到被老板责备了。
责备.en: He was reproached by the boss for being late.

责备.zh: 我知道错了，你别再责备我了。
责备.en: I know I was wrong, please stop blaming me.

责备.zh: 她责备自己当初没有坚持意见。
责备.en: She blamed herself for not sticking to her opinion at the time.

责备.zh: 虽然大家都有责任，但他一个人承担了所有责备。
责备.en: Although everyone had some responsibility, he took all the blame alone.

奢望.en: Becoming a star is my unrealistic hope.

奢望.zh: 她从不奢望别人的帮助。
奢望.en: She never harbors unrealistic expectations for others' help.

奢望.zh: 现在能吃饱饭就是最大的奢望了。
奢望.en: Having enough to eat is the biggest luxury hope now.

奢望.zh: 虽然很苦，但我没奢望过谁会可怜我。
奢望.en: Though it's tough, I never expected anyone to pity me.

奢望.zh: 他奢望一夜暴富，结果被骗了。
奢望.en: He had the unrealistic hope of getting rich overnight, and ended up being scammed.

严谨.en: He is very meticulous in his work.
This report is written very rigorously.

严谨.zh: 德国人给人的印象是严谨又守时。
严谨.en: Germans give the impression of being rigorous and punctual.

严谨.zh: 老师要求我们实验步骤必须严谨。
严谨.en: The teacher requires that our experimental procedures be rigorous.

严谨.zh: 虽然他很严谨，但偶尔也会开开玩笑。
严谨.en: Although he is very meticulous, he occasionally jokes around.

丰盛.en: She cooked a table full of abundant dishes.

丰盛.zh: 过年时家里总会准备丰盛的年饭。
丰盛.en: During Chinese New Year, the family always prepares a lavish New Year's meal.

丰盛.zh: 自助餐种类丰盛，我吃了好多。
丰盛.en: The buffet had a rich variety, and I ate a lot.

丰盛.zh: 虽然只是家常便饭，但他觉得比丰盛大餐更温馨。
丰盛.en: Although it was just a simple home-cooked meal, he found it warmer than a lavish feast.

申办.zh: 我们正在申办明年的马拉松。
申办.en: We are bidding to host next year's marathon.

申办.zh: 他成功申办了去日本的签证。
申办.en: He successfully applied for a visa to Japan.

申办.zh: 这所大学申办了一个国际会议。
申办.en: This university has applied to host an international conference.

申办.zh: 申请材料不全，申办被驳回了。
申办.en: The application was rejected because the documents were incomplete.

申办.zh: 为了申办奥运会，城市投入了大量资金。
申办.en: In order to bid for the Olympics, the city invested a huge amount of money.

庄园.zh: 这个庄园已经有上百年历史了。
庄园.en: This manor has a history of over a hundred years.

庄园.zh: 周末我们去郊外的庄园度假。
庄园.en: On weekends we go to a countryside estate for vacation.

庄园.zh: 他继承了家族在法国的一座庄园。
庄园.en: He inherited a family estate in France.

庄园.zh: 庄园里种满了葡萄树，用来酿酒。
庄园.en: The estate is planted with grapevines for wine-making.

庄园.zh: 以前这里是贵族住的庄园，现在改成了博物馆。
庄园.en: This used to be a manor where nobles lived, and now it's turned into a museum.

茅台.zh: 今晚我们要开一瓶茅台庆祝。
茅台.en: Tonight we're going to open a bottle of Moutai to celebrate.

茅台.zh: 茅台是中国最著名的白酒之一。
茅台.en: Moutai is one of China's most famous liquors.

茅台.zh: 这瓶茅台是他收藏了好多年的。
茅台.en: This bottle of Moutai has been in his collection for many years.

茅台.zh: 客人来了，他特意拿出茅台招待。
茅台.en: When the guests arrived, he specially brought out Moutai to entertain them.

冲刺.zh: 最后一百米他全力冲刺。
冲刺.en: He sprinted with all his might in the last hundred meters.

冲刺.zh: 考试前大家都在做最后的冲刺。
冲刺.en: Everyone is making a final sprint before the exam.

冲刺.zh: 这个项目到了冲刺阶段，不能放松。
冲刺.en: This project is at the final sprint stage, so we can't let up.

冲刺.zh: 他冲刺的时候不小心摔倒了。
虽然很累，但为了达标，还得再冲刺一下。
冲刺.en: Although very tired, we still need to sprint a bit more to meet the target.

刻苦.zh: 小时候家里穷，他过得很刻苦。
刻苦.en: His family was poor when he was young, so he lived a hard life.

刻苦.zh: 只有刻苦训练才能拿到冠军。
刻苦.en: Only through hard training can you win the championship.

刻苦.zh: 她刻苦钻研了三年，终于有了成果。
刻苦.en: She studied assiduously for three years and finally got results.

刻苦.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但他一直很刻苦努力。
刻苦.en: Although conditions were tough, he always worked hard and diligently.

后勤.zh: 他负责公司的后勤工作。
后勤.en: He is in charge of the company's logistics.

后勤.zh: 比赛的后勤保障做得很好。
后勤.en: The logistical support for the competition was excellent.

后勤.zh: 后勤部门需要采购一批新的办公用品。
后勤.en: The logistics department needs to purchase a batch of new office supplies.

后勤.zh: 这次活动规模大，后勤压力不小。
后勤.en: This event is large in scale, so the logistical pressure is considerable.

后勤.zh: 部队的后勤补给线被切断了。
后勤.en: The army's logistical supply line was cut off.

往日.en: Don't bring up things from the past.

往日.zh: 看到这张照片，我想起了往日的时光。
往日.en: Seeing this photo reminds me of the old days.

往日.zh: 他往日不是这样的，现在变了。
往日.en: He wasn't like this in the past; he has changed now.

往日.zh: 往日这里很热闹，现在冷清多了。
往日.en: This place used to be very lively, but now it's much quieter.

往日.zh: 虽然往日辛苦，但现在回想起来都是宝贵的经历。
往日.en: Although the past was hard, looking back now it's all valuable experience.

老化.zh: 因为长时间暴晒，塑料会老化变脆。
老化.en: Because of prolonged sun exposure, plastic will age and become brittle.

老化.zh: 皮肤老化是自然现象，但我们可以保养。
老化.en: Skin aging is a natural phenomenon, but we can take care of it.

老化.zh: 如果你不保养，皮肤就会加速老化。
老化.en: If you don't take care, your skin will age faster.

老化.zh: 公司设备老化严重，需要更换。
老化.en: The company's equipment is severely aged and needs replacement.

议程.zh: 会议议程已经发到大家邮箱了。
议程.en: The meeting agenda has been sent to everyone's email.

议程.zh: 虽然议程很满，但我们还是按时完成了。
议程.en: Although the agenda was full, we still finished on time.

议程.zh: 他提议把这项议题加入议程。
议程.en: He proposed adding this topic to the agenda.

议程.zh: 明天的议程需要修改一下。
议程.en: Tomorrow's agenda needs a slight revision.

晒太阳.en: I like to sunbathe in the park.

晒太阳.zh: 周末我们去海边晒太阳吧。
晒太阳.en: Let's go to the beach to sunbathe this weekend.

晒太阳.zh: 虽然很热，但晒太阳对身体有好处。
晒太阳.en: Although it's hot, sunbathing is good for health.

晒太阳.zh: 猫喜欢在窗台上晒太阳。
晒太阳.en: Cats like to bask on the windowsill.

晒太阳.zh: 医生建议我多晒太阳补充维生素D。
晒太阳.en: The doctor advised me to sunbathe more to get vitamin D.

敬佩.zh: 大家都敬佩那位老师对学生的耐心。
敬佩.en: Everyone admires that teacher's patience with students.

敬佩.zh: 因为她坚持不懈，所以我非常敬佩她。
敬佩.en: Because she is persistent, I admire her very much.

敬佩.zh: 这种无私奉献的精神让人敬佩。
敬佩.en: This spirit of selfless dedication is admirable.

敬佩.zh: 我敬佩他能在困难中保持乐观。
敬佩.en: I admire that he can stay optimistic in difficulties.

宽恕.zh: 学会宽恕别人也是一种智慧。
宽恕.en: Learning to forgive others is also a kind of wisdom.

宽恕.zh: 虽然他很生气，但最终还是宽恕了她。
宽恕.en: Although he was very angry, he eventually forgave her.

宽恕.zh: 宽恕不等于忘记，而是放下。
宽恕.en: Forgiveness is not forgetting, but letting go.

宽恕.zh: 他请求大家宽恕他的鲁莽行为。
宽恕.en: He asked everyone to forgive his reckless behavior.

热衷.en: He is keen on collecting stamps.

热衷.zh: 很多年轻人热衷参加志愿者活动。
热衷.en: Many young people are enthusiastic about volunteer activities.

热衷.zh: 因为热衷摄影，他经常去旅行。
热衷.en: Because he is passionate about photography, he often travels.
She is very keen on fashion.

热衷.zh: 现在的小孩热衷玩手机游戏。
热衷.en: Nowadays kids are crazy about mobile games.

知己.zh: 人生能得一知己，非常幸运。
知己.en: To have a true friend in life is very lucky.

知己.zh: 虽然我们不常见面，但我们是知己。
知己.en: Although we don't see each other often, we are close friends.

知己.zh: 他是我唯一的知己，什么都聊。
知己.en: He is my only confidant; we talk about everything.

知己.zh: 找到一个懂你的知己不容易。
知己.en: It's not easy to find a confidant who understands you.

捣乱.zh: 课堂上总有几个学生喜欢捣乱。
捣乱.en: There are always a few students who like to cause trouble in class.

捣乱.zh: 如果你再捣乱，我就告诉老师。
捣乱.en: If you cause trouble again, I'll tell the teacher.

捣乱.zh: 小猫在房间里捣乱，把东西都弄倒了。
捣乱.en: The kitten is making mischief in the room, knocking things over.

捣乱.zh: 他们喝酒后开始捣乱，被保安赶走了。
捣乱.en: After drinking, they started causing trouble and were kicked out by security.

改名.en: He decided to change his name.

改名.zh: 因为名字不好听，她打算去改名。
改名.en: Because the name doesn't sound good, she plans to change it.

改名.zh: 很多明星出道前都会改名。
改名.en: Many stars change their names before debuting.

改名.zh: 改名需要到派出所办理手续。
改名.en: To change your name, you need to go to the police station to handle the procedures.

公共场所.en: Smoking is prohibited in public places.

公共场所.zh: 在公共场所应该保持安静。
公共场所.en: You should keep quiet in public places.

公共场所.zh: 虽然在公共场所可以戴口罩，但夏天很热。
公共场所.en: Although you can wear a mask in public places, it's hot in summer.

公共场所.zh: 我们要爱护公共场所的设施。
公共场所.en: We should take care of the facilities in public places.

公共场所.zh: 公共场所的卫生需要大家共同维护。
公共场所.en: The hygiene of public places requires everyone's joint maintenance.

堪称.zh: 这家餐厅的菜堪称一绝。
堪称.en: The dishes at this restaurant can be called unmatched.

堪称.zh: 他的画作堪称艺术品，很多人想买。
堪称.en: His paintings can be called artworks, and many people want to buy them.

堪称.zh: 这个地方的风景堪称仙境，美得让人不想走。
堪称.en: The scenery here can be called a fairyland, so beautiful that people don't want to leave.

堪称.zh: 她的歌声堪称天籁之音，听完让人很放松。
堪称.en: Her singing can be called the sound of nature, making people feel relaxed after listening.

堪称.zh: 虽然设备简单，但他们的表演堪称完美。
堪称.en: Although the equipment is simple, their performance can be called perfect.

过早.en: Don't jump to conclusions too early.

过早.zh: 现在谈结婚还过早，我们才认识半年。
过早.en: It's too early to talk about marriage now; we've only known each other for half a year.

过早.zh: 他过早地放弃了比赛，结果错过了机会。
过早.en: He gave up the competition too early, and as a result missed the opportunity.

过早.zh: 孩子学写字不要过早，否则可能影响手部发育。
过早.en: Don't let children learn to write too early, otherwise it may affect hand development.

过早.zh: 虽然天气转暖，但过早脱掉厚衣服容易感冒。
过早.en: Although the weather is getting warmer, taking off thick clothes too early can easily cause a cold.

着实.zh: 这个决定着实让人意外。
昨天那场雨着实不小，路上都积水了。
着实.en: The rain yesterday was really heavy; there was water on the roads.

着实.zh: 他考试没通过，着实难过了一阵子。
着实.en: He didn't pass the exam and was really sad for a while.

着实.zh: 这道菜的味道着实不错，连平时挑食的孩子都吃完了。
着实.en: The taste of this dish is really good; even the picky kid finished it.

着实.zh: 老板发火时，着实把大家都吓到了，因为平时他很温和。
着实.en: When the boss got angry, he really scared everyone, because he is usually gentle.

腹泻.zh: 我昨天吃坏肚子，腹泻了一整天。
腹泻.en: I ate something bad yesterday and had diarrhea all day.

腹泻.zh: 如果腹泻严重，记得多喝水补充电解质。
腹泻.en: If diarrhea is severe, remember to drink more water to replenish electrolytes.

腹泻.zh: 她每次旅行都会腹泻，可能是因为水土不服。
腹泻.en: She gets diarrhea every time she travels, probably because of the change in environment.

腹泻.zh: 医生建议腹泻期间别吃油腻的食物，要清淡饮食。
腹泻.en: The doctor advised not to eat greasy food during diarrhea and to have a light diet.

腹泻.zh: 孩子腹泻不止，我们赶紧带他去了医院。
腹泻.en: The child had persistent diarrhea, so we quickly took him to the hospital.

劣势.zh: 我们的劣势是经验不足。
劣势.en: Our disadvantage is lack of experience.

劣势.zh: 虽然起步晚是劣势，但我们可以更努力。
劣势.en: Although starting late is a disadvantage, we can work harder.

劣势.zh: 对手身高占优势，我们只能靠速度弥补劣势。
劣势.en: The opponents have an advantage in height; we can only make up for the disadvantage with speed.

劣势.zh: 在谈判中，信息不对称是我们的最大劣势。
劣势.en: In negotiations, information asymmetry is our biggest disadvantage.

劣势.zh: 他利用对方的地理劣势，成功赢得了比赛。
劣势.en: He took advantage of the opponent's geographical disadvantage and successfully won the game.

胶囊.zh: 这药是胶囊，吞服时别咬破。
胶囊.en: This medicine is in capsule form; don't bite it when swallowing.

胶囊.zh: 他每天吃一粒维生素胶囊，感觉身体好了不少。
胶囊.en: He takes one vitamin capsule every day and feels much better.

胶囊.zh: 胶囊咖啡机用起来很方便，适合上班族。
胶囊.en: Capsule coffee machines are very convenient and suitable for office workers.

胶囊.zh: 医生开了两种药，一种是胶囊，另一种是药片。
胶囊.en: The doctor prescribed two kinds of medicine, one is capsules and the other is tablets.

胶囊.zh: 这个胶囊外壳是植物做的，适合素食者服用。
胶囊.en: The shell of this capsule is made from plants, suitable for vegetarians to take.

逼迫.zh: 别逼迫他做不喜欢的事。
逼迫.en: Don't force him to do things he doesn't like.

逼迫.zh: 父母不断逼迫她结婚，让她很烦恼。
逼迫.en: Her parents kept pressuring her to get married, which made her very annoyed.

逼迫.zh: 在竞争的压力下，公司逼迫员工提高业绩。
逼迫.en: Under competitive pressure, the company forced employees to improve performance.

逼迫.zh: 他本来不想参加比赛，但教练一直逼迫他试试。
逼迫.en: He didn't want to participate in the competition originally, but the coach kept pressuring him to try.

喂养.en: She feeds stray cats every day.

喂养.zh: 母乳喂养对孩子健康更有利。
喂养.en: Breastfeeding is more beneficial for the child's health.

喂养.zh: 喂养宠物要注意营养均衡，不能只吃一种食物。
喂养.en: When feeding pets, pay attention to balanced nutrition; don't just give one kind of food.

喂养.zh: 邻居家的小孩不喜欢吃饭，需要耐心喂养。
喂养.en: The neighbor's child doesn't like to eat, so he needs to be fed patiently.

喂养.zh: 农场主用玉米和饲料喂养鸡鸭，保证肉质好。
喂养.en: The farmer feeds the chickens and ducks with corn and feed to ensure good meat quality.

溢.zh: 水溢出来了，快关水龙头。
溢.en: The water is overflowing; turn off the tap quickly.

溢.zh: 杯子太满，啤酒都溢到桌上了。
溢.en: The cup was too full; the beer overflowed onto the table.

溢.zh: 他对她的爱意简直要溢出来了。
溢.en: His love for her is practically overflowing.

溢.zh: 倒酒时别倒太满，小心溢出来弄脏桌布。
溢.en: When pouring wine, don't fill it too full; be careful not to overflow and stain the tablecloth.

溢.zh: 锅里煮粥时一定要看着火，不然很容易溢锅。
溢.en: When cooking porridge in the pot, you must watch the heat, otherwise it's easy to boil over.

运河.zh: 这条运河已经有一百多年历史了。
运河.en: This canal has a history of over a hundred years.

运河.zh: 古代运河主要用于运输粮食和货物。
运河.en: Ancient canals were mainly used to transport grain and goods.

运河.zh: 沿着运河散步，可以欣赏到两岸的风景。
运河.en: Walking along the canal, you can enjoy the scenery on both sides.

运河.zh: 政府打算拓宽这条运河，以方便更大的船只通过。
运河.en: The government plans to widen this canal to allow larger ships to pass through.

运河.zh: 京杭大运河是中国最长的人工运河，连接南北。
运河.en: The Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal is China's longest man-made canal, connecting the north and south.

不得已.zh: 不得已的情况下，我们只能取消活动。
不得已.en: In a situation where we have no alternative, we have to cancel the event.

不得已.zh: 虽然我很想帮忙，但实在是不得已才拒绝的。
不得已.en: Although I really want to help, I had no choice but to refuse.

不得已.zh: 要不是不得已，我也不会这么做。
不得已.en: If it weren't unavoidable, I wouldn't do this.

不得已.zh: 他是因为不得已才迟到的。
不得已.en: He was late because he had no choice.

框架.zh: 我们需要先搭好整体框架。
框架.en: We need to set up the overall framework first.

框架.zh: 公司的发展框架已经确定了，接下来就是细节。
框架.en: The company's development framework has been decided; next is the details.

框架.zh: 虽然框架没问题，但执行起来还有困难。
框架.en: Although the framework is fine, there are still difficulties in execution.

框架.zh: 写论文之前，先列一个大纲框架。
框架.en: Before writing the paper, first outline a framework.

巅峰.en: He is at the peak of his career.

巅峰.zh: 这座山的巅峰非常难登。
巅峰.en: The peak of this mountain is very hard to climb.

巅峰.zh: 这家公司在上世纪九十年代达到了巅峰。
巅峰.en: This company reached its peak in the 1990s.

巅峰.zh: 虽然他已经过了巅峰期，但实力依然很强。
巅峰.en: Although he has passed his peak, his strength is still great.

巅峰.zh: 他的表演在最后一段达到了情感巅峰。
巅峰.en: His performance reached an emotional peak in the final part.

断定.en: I can't be sure about this.

断定.zh: 你凭什么断定是他做的？
断定.en: What makes you conclude that he did it?

断定.zh: 在没有证据之前，不要随便断定结果。
断定.en: Don't arbitrarily conclude the result without evidence.

断定.zh: 虽然看起来很像，但我不能断定就是同一个人。
断定.en: Although it looks very similar, I can't conclude it's the same person.

断定.zh: 专家断定这次地震不会有更强余震。
断定.en: Experts concluded that there won't be stronger aftershocks from this earthquake.

复兴.zh: 他们致力于乡村经济的复兴。
复兴.en: They are dedicated to the revival of the rural economy.

复兴.zh: 经过几十年的努力，这座城市终于实现了工业复兴。
复兴.en: After decades of effort, this city finally achieved industrial revival.

复兴.zh: 虽然传统艺术一度衰落，但现在已经开始复兴了。
复兴.en: Although traditional art once declined, it has now begun to revive.

复兴.zh: 文艺复兴运动对欧洲影响很大。
复兴.en: The Renaissance movement had a great influence on Europe.

风趣.zh: 老师讲课非常风趣，大家都很喜欢。
风趣.en: The teacher lectures very wittily; everyone likes it.

风趣.zh: 他的风趣幽默让整个聚会气氛轻松了很多。
风趣.en: His wit and humor made the party atmosphere much lighter.

风趣.zh: 虽然话题很严肃，但他用风趣的方式表达出来。
风趣.en: Although the topic was very serious, he expressed it in a humorous way.

风趣.zh: 我喜欢和风趣的人聊天。
风趣.en: I like to chat with humorous people.

曲折.en: The plot of the story is very twisty.

曲折.zh: 他的职业生涯经历了不少曲折，最后终于成功了。
曲折.en: His career experienced many twists and turns, and finally succeeded.

曲折.zh: 虽然过程很曲折，但结果还算令人满意。
曲折.en: Although the process was tortuous, the result was still satisfactory.

曲折.zh: 这部电影的剧情曲折离奇，非常吸引人。
曲折.en: The plot of this movie is twisty and bizarre, very attractive.

离奇.zh: 他经历了一件离奇的事情。
警察正在调查这起离奇的失踪案。
离奇.en: The police are investigating this bizarre missing person case.

离奇.zh: 虽然听起来很离奇，但确实是真事。
离奇.en: Although it sounds bizarre, it is indeed true.

离奇.zh: 这部电影的结局非常离奇，出乎所有人意料。
离奇.en: The ending of this movie is very bizarre, surprising everyone.

复查.zh: 医生建议我下个月再来复查。
复查.en: The doctor advised me to come back for a follow-up check next month.

复查.zh: 考试成绩公布后，如果你有疑问可以申请复查。
复查.en: After the exam results are announced, if you have doubts you can apply for a re-check.

复查.zh: 虽然第一次检查没问题，但最好还是复查一遍。
复查.en: Although the first check was fine, it's best to do a re-check.

复查.zh: 他出院后每隔三个月复查一次。
复查.en: After being discharged from the hospital, he gets a follow-up check every three months.

王牌.zh: 他手里还有一张王牌没用。
王牌.en: He still has a trump card in hand not used yet.

王牌.zh: 这个产品是他们团队研发的王牌项目。
王牌.en: This product is the ace project developed by their team.

王牌.zh: 虽然对手很强，但我们还有自己的王牌。
王牌.en: Although the opponent is strong, we still have our own trump card.

王牌.zh: 在最后关头，他亮出了自己的王牌。
王牌.en: At the last moment, he revealed his trump card.

施行.zh: 新规定下个月开始施行。
施行.en: The new rule will be implemented next month.

施行.zh: 虽然政策已经通过，但要等到明年才施行。
施行.en: Although the policy has been passed, it won't be implemented until next year.

施行.zh: 这条法律在全国范围内施行。
他们正在讨论如何施行这个计划。
施行.en: They are discussing how to carry out this plan.

施行.zh: 由于条件不成熟，这个方案暂时无法施行。
施行.en: Due to immature conditions, this plan cannot be implemented for now.

停车位.en: There are too few parking spaces here.

停车位.zh: 我们找了半天才找到一个停车位。
停车位.en: We looked for a long time before finding a parking space.

停车位.zh: 商场底下有免费停车位吗？
停车位.en: Are there free parking spaces underneath the mall?

停车位.zh: 因为停车位紧张，他只好把车停在路边。
停车位.en: Because parking spaces were tight, he had to park on the street.

停车位.zh: 这个小区最近增加了不少新的停车位。
停车位.en: This residential area has recently added quite a few new parking spaces.

管子.zh: 你去买一根新管子换上。
管子.en: Go buy a new tube and replace it.

管子.zh: 洗手池下面的管子堵住了。
管子.en: The pipe under the sink is clogged.

管子.zh: 他用水管子浇花，结果水压太大。
管子.en: He watered the flowers with a hose, but the water pressure was too high.

管子.zh: 虽然管子看起来旧，但还能用。
管子.en: Although the pipe looks old, it still works.

混淆.zh: 他故意混淆是非，让大家看不清真相。
混淆.en: He deliberately confuses right and wrong, making it hard for everyone to see the truth.
I often mix up left and right directions.

混淆.zh: 由于颜色相近，很容易把这两种药混淆。
混淆.en: Because the colors are similar, it's easy to confuse these two medicines.

混淆.zh: 你这样说会混淆听众的理解。
混淆.en: Saying that will confuse the audience's understanding.

盛会.en: This is a grand music event.

盛会.zh: 全球各地的专家都来参加这次科技盛会。
盛会.en: Experts from all over the world came to this technology gala.

盛会.zh: 昨天的开幕式真是一场盛会。
盛会.en: Yesterday's opening ceremony was truly a grand event.

盛会.zh: 虽然天气不好，但这场文化盛会还是吸引了很多人。
盛会.en: Although the weather was bad, this cultural event still attracted many people.

盛会.zh: 每年春节这里都会举办一场美食盛会。
盛会.en: Every Spring Festival, a grand food festival is held here.

投稿.zh: 他经常给报社投稿写评论。
投稿.en: He often submits articles to the newspaper for commentary.

投稿.zh: 投稿截止日期是下周五。
投稿.en: The submission deadline is next Friday.

投稿.zh: 如果你有好的作品，欢迎向我们的平台投稿。
投稿.en: If you have good works, you are welcome to submit to our platform.

惊险.zh: 那次登山经历太惊险了。
惊险.en: That mountain climbing experience was too thrilling.

惊险.zh: 他做了一个惊险的动作，观众都吓坏了。
惊险.en: He performed a thrilling stunt that scared the audience.

惊险.zh: 虽然过程很惊险，但最后大家都没事。
惊险.en: Although the process was thrilling, everyone was safe in the end.

惊险.zh: 过山车虽然惊险，但很多人喜欢坐。
惊险.en: Although roller coasters are thrilling, many people enjoy riding them.

急剧.en: Housing prices have risen sharply recently.

急剧.zh: 由于市场需求急剧增加，公司开始大量招人。
急剧.en: Due to a sharp increase in market demand, the company started hiring a lot.

急剧.zh: 经济形势发生了急剧变化。
急剧.en: The economic situation underwent a drastic change.

迎合.en: He always likes to cater to his boss.

迎合.zh: 这个节目太迎合观众了。
迎合.en: This show panders too much to the audience.

迎合.zh: 她故意说这些话来迎合他。
迎合.en: She deliberately said these things to cater to him.

迎合.zh: 为了迎合市场，他们改了产品设计。
迎合.en: To cater to the market, they changed the product design.

迎合.zh: 虽然迎合别人能讨好，但也要有自己的主见。
迎合.en: Although catering to others can please them, you should also have your own opinions.

厌烦.zh: 他对这份工作感到厌烦。
厌烦.en: He feels fed up with this job.

厌烦.zh: 每天重复同样的事，谁都会厌烦。
厌烦.en: Doing the same thing every day, anyone would get bored.

厌烦.zh: 老师对学生的吵闹声感到很厌烦。
厌烦.en: The teacher was annoyed by the students' noise.

厌烦.zh: 虽然刚开始觉得有趣，但时间长了就厌烦了。
厌烦.en: Although it seemed fun at first, I got bored after a while.

交涉.zh: 我们去跟对方交涉一下。
交涉.en: Let's go negotiate with the other party.

交涉.zh: 双方交涉了很久，终于达成了协议。
交涉.en: The two sides negotiated for a long time and finally reached an agreement.

交涉.zh: 这件事需要你亲自去交涉才行。
交涉.en: This matter requires you to personally negotiate.

交涉.zh: 虽然交涉过程很复杂，但我们还是得到了满意的结果。
交涉.en: Although the negotiation process was very complicated, we still got a satisfactory result.

交涉.zh: 他在公司里专门负责交涉和协调工作。
交涉.en: He is specifically in charge of negotiation and coordination at the company.

均衡.zh: 均衡营养对孩子的成长很重要。
均衡.en: Balanced nutrition is very important for children's growth.

均衡.zh: 工作和休息需要保持均衡。
均衡.en: Work and rest need to be kept balanced.

均衡.zh: 为了健康，我每天都会吃一些水果和蔬菜来均衡饮食。
均衡.en: For health, I eat some fruits and vegetables every day to balance my diet.

均衡.zh: 这个地区的经济发展很不均衡，东部比西部快得多。
均衡.en: Economic development in this region is very unbalanced, with the east being much faster than the west.

教科书.zh: 教科书里的内容需要更新一下。
教科书.en: The content in the textbook needs to be updated.

教科书.zh: 他每次考试前都会把教科书复习一遍。
教科书.en: He reviews the textbook every time before an exam.

教科书.zh: 虽然教科书很厚，但里面的知识点讲得很清楚。
教科书.en: Although the textbook is very thick, the knowledge points are explained very clearly.

教科书.zh: 这套教科书是专门为外国学生编写的。
教科书.en: This set of textbooks is specially written for foreign students.

本意.en: My original intention was to help you.

本意.zh: 他本意不是要伤害你，只是说话太直接了。
本意.en: He didn't intend to hurt you, he just spoke too directly.

本意.zh: 虽然结果不好，但她的本意是希望我们更团结。
本意.en: Although the result wasn't good, her original intention was to hope we become more united.

本意.zh: 你误会了，我的本意并不是责怪任何人。
本意.en: You misunderstood; my original intention was not to blame anyone.

锋利.zh: 他的目光像刀一样锋利。
锋利.en: His gaze is as sharp as a knife.

锋利.zh: 那篇文章的言辞非常锋利，引起了争议。
锋利.en: The wording of that article was very sharp and caused controversy.

锋利.zh: 小心点，这块玻璃的边缘很锋利，容易划伤手。
锋利.en: Be careful, the edge of this glass is very sharp and can easily cut your hand.

锋利.zh: 他虽然年轻，但思维非常锋利，总能快速抓住问题的关键。
锋利.en: Although he is young, his thinking is very sharp, and he can always quickly grasp the key to a problem.

思索.zh: 我思索了很久才找到答案。
思索.en: I pondered for a long time before finding the answer.

思索.zh: 她低着头，似乎在思索什么重要的事情。
思索.en: She lowered her head, as if pondering something important.

思索.zh: 经过反复思索，他终于决定接受这个挑战。
思索.en: After repeated pondering, he finally decided to accept the challenge.

思索.zh: 我们需要思索一下未来的发展方向。
思索.en: We need to ponder the future direction of development.

夸大.zh: 他喜欢夸大自己的功劳。
夸大.en: He likes to exaggerate his own contributions.

夸大.zh: 广告总是夸大产品的效果。
夸大.en: Advertisements always exaggerate the effects of products.

夸大.zh: 虽然他很努力，但也不要夸大他的能力。
夸大.en: Although he works hard, don't exaggerate his abilities.

夸大.zh: 你把问题夸大了，其实没那么严重。
夸大.en: You're exaggerating the problem; actually, it's not that serious.

编织.zh: 奶奶用毛线编织了一条围巾。
编织.en: Grandma knitted a scarf with yarn.

编织.zh: 他们一起编织了一个美丽的梦境。
编织.en: They together wove a beautiful dream.

编织.zh: 这个故事是根据民间传说编织而成的。
编织.en: This story is woven based on folklore.

编织.zh: 她用各种颜色的线编织了一张漂亮的桌布。
编织.en: She wove a beautiful tablecloth with threads of various colors.

改良.zh: 土壤改良后，庄稼长得更好了。
改良.en: After the soil was improved, the crops grew better.

改良.zh: 经过多次改良，这款软件的运行速度更快了。
改良.en: After many improvements, this software runs faster.

改良.zh: 科学家正在改良玉米的品种，让它更耐旱。
改良.en: Scientists are improving the corn variety to make it more drought-resistant.

改良.zh: 他提出了一些改良方案来提升生产效率。
改良.en: He proposed some improvement plans to increase production efficiency.

渔船.en: The fishing boat has gone out to sea.

渔船.zh: 岸边停靠着许多小渔船。
渔船.en: Many small fishing boats are docked at the shore.

渔船.zh: 清晨，渔民们开着渔船去捕鱼。
渔船.en: In the early morning, fishermen drive their fishing boats to catch fish.

渔船.zh: 那艘渔船在风暴中失踪了。
渔船.en: That fishing boat went missing in the storm.

渔船.zh: 他的父亲一辈子都在渔船上工作。
渔船.en: His father worked on fishing boats his whole life.

驻扎.en: The troops are stationed in the mountains.

驻扎.zh: 他们在这个小村庄驻扎了三个月。
驻扎.en: They were stationed in this small village for three months.

驻扎.zh: 因为任务需要，我们驻扎在边境附近。
驻扎.en: Because of the mission, we are stationed near the border.

驻扎.zh: 那个营地驻扎了很多士兵。
驻扎.en: That camp is stationed with many soldiers.

驻扎.zh: 他们驻扎的地方离城市很远，所以生活很不方便。
驻扎.en: The place where they are stationed is far from the city, so life is very inconvenient.

盟友.zh: 他是我们最可靠的盟友。
盟友.en: He is our most reliable ally.

盟友.zh: 这次行动需要盟友的支持。
盟友.en: This operation needs the support of allies.

盟友.zh: 虽然我们是盟友，但也要保持警惕。
盟友.en: Although we are allies, we still need to stay vigilant.

盟友.zh: 我们的盟友国家给了很多帮助。
盟友.en: Our allied countries gave a lot of help.

盟友.zh: 在谈判中，我们和盟友一起提出了方案。
盟友.en: During the negotiations, we proposed a plan together with our allies.

正视.en: You need to face this problem squarely.

正视.zh: 我们必须正视自己的缺点。
正视.en: We must face our own shortcomings.

正视.zh: 只有正视现实，才能找到解决办法。
正视.en: Only by facing reality can we find a solution.

正视.zh: 他不敢正视自己的错误。
正视.en: He dare not face his own mistakes.

正视.zh: 公司需要正视市场竞争的压力。
正视.en: The company needs to face the pressure of market competition squarely.

投身.en: He devotes himself to environmental protection.

投身.zh: 很多年轻人投身到创业中。
投身.en: Many young people throw themselves into entrepreneurship.

投身.zh: 她决定投身教育行业，帮助更多孩子。
投身.en: She decided to devote herself to education to help more children.
For his ideals, he joined the revolution.

投身.zh: 我们鼓励大家投身公益活动。
投身.en: We encourage everyone to engage in public welfare activities.

重任.en: This task is a heavy responsibility on the shoulders.

重任.zh: 他肩负着公司发展的重任。
重任.en: He bears the heavy responsibility of the company's development.

重任.zh: 领导把重任交给了最信任的人。
重任.en: The leader entrusted the important task to the most trusted person.

重任.zh: 你知道这份重任有多重要吗？
重任.en: Do you know how important this heavy responsibility is?

重任.zh: 面对如此重任，他感到压力很大。
重任.en: Facing such a heavy responsibility, he feels a lot of pressure.

挤压.zh: 这个箱子被挤压变形了。
挤压.en: This box was crushed and deformed.

挤压.zh: 市场压力挤压了我们的利润。
地铁里人很多，我感觉被挤压得喘不过气。
挤压.en: There are so many people in the subway, I feel squeezed and can't breathe.

挤压.zh: 因为竞争激烈，小企业的生存空间被挤压。
挤压.en: Because of fierce competition, the living space of small businesses is squeezed.

施加.zh: 父母不该对孩子施加过多期望。
施加.en: Parents shouldn't put too much expectation on their children.

施加.zh: 他们试图施加影响，但效果不大。
施加.en: They tried to exert influence, but it had little effect.

施加.zh: 政府对外国公司施加了新的规定。
施加.en: The government imposed new regulations on foreign companies.

施加.zh: 你施加的暴力只会让事情更糟。
施加.en: The violence you exert will only make things worse.

处分.zh: 学校给了他一个严重处分。
处分.en: The school gave him a severe punishment.

处分.zh: 公司决定处分违反规定的员工。
处分.en: The company decided to discipline employees who violated the rules.

处分.zh: 如果不改正错误，可能会受到更重的处分。
处分.en: If you don't correct your mistakes, you may receive a heavier punishment.

得手.zh: 他们计划了很久，终于得手了。
得手.en: They planned for a long time and finally succeeded.

得手.zh: 虽然敌人狡猾，但我们还是没让他们得手。
得手.en: Although the enemy was cunning, we still didn't let them succeed.

得手.zh: 这次行动差点就让他得手了。
得手.en: He almost succeeded in this operation.

得手.zh: 得手之后，他得意洋洋地离开了。

镶.en: This diamond is set on the ring.
A famous painting is inlaid on the wall.

镶.zh: 她给衣服镶了一圈花边。
镶.en: She trimmed the dress with a circle of lace.

镶.zh: 这个手镯镶满了宝石，非常漂亮。
镶.en: This bracelet is studded with gems, very beautiful.

镶.zh: 在项链上镶一颗蓝宝石怎么样？
镶.en: How about setting a sapphire on the necklace?

私自.en: Don't enter my room without permission.

私自.zh: 他私自拿走了公司的文件，被发现后开除了。
私自.en: He took company documents without permission and was fired after being caught.

私自.zh: 私自修改合同是违法的。
私自.en: Modifying the contract without authorization is illegal.

私自.zh: 我觉得你应该先问一下，不要私自做决定。
私自.en: I think you should ask first, don't make decisions on your own.

私自.zh: 他私自用了我的电脑，结果把系统搞坏了。
私自.en: He used my computer without asking, and as a result messed up the system.

兼顾.en: It's hard to balance work and family.

兼顾.zh: 这个方案既要考虑成本，也要兼顾质量。
兼顾.en: This plan must consider cost and also balance quality.

兼顾.zh: 她一边上班一边带孩子，两边都兼顾得很好。
兼顾.en: She works and takes care of her child at the same time, balancing both well.

兼顾.zh: 学习和其他活动要兼顾好。
兼顾.en: You need to balance study and other activities.

兼顾.zh: 设计的时候要兼顾美观和实用。
兼顾.en: When designing, you need to balance aesthetics and functionality.

水域.en: Swimming is prohibited in this water area.

水域.zh: 渔民在这片水域捕鱼已经很多年了。
水域.en: Fishermen have been fishing in these waters for many years.

水域.zh: 保护水域环境对我们很重要。
水域.en: Protecting the water environment is important to us.

水域.zh: 因为污染，很多水域都不能再使用了。
水域.en: Because of pollution, many water areas can no longer be used.

水域.zh: 这条河流的水域面积很大，适合发展航运。
水域.en: This river's water area is very large, suitable for developing navigation.

配音.zh: 这个动画片的配音演员很厉害。
配音.en: The voice actors for this animation are amazing.

配音.zh: 我喜欢看原声电影，不太喜欢配音版。
配音.en: I like watching original language movies, not so much the dubbed version.

配音.zh: 配音的时候要注意情绪的表达。
配音.en: When dubbing, you need to pay attention to emotional expression.

配音.zh: 这款游戏的配音很专业，听起来很有代入感。
配音.en: The dubbing for this game is very professional, it sounds immersive.

高低.zh: 这条山路高低不平，很难走。
高低.en: This mountain path is uneven, hard to walk.

高低.zh: 他们两个的水平分不出高低。
高低.en: You can't tell who is better between the two of them in terms of skill.

高低.zh: 空调的温度高低可以自己调节。
高低.en: You can adjust the air conditioner's temperature high or low.

高低.zh: 音乐的音量高低要适中，不要吵到别人。
高低.en: The volume of the music should be moderate, not too loud to disturb others.

高低.zh: 这个季度的产量高低直接影响了公司的利润。
高低.en: The production volume this quarter directly affected the company's profit.

宏伟.zh: 他有一个宏伟的计划，想改变整个行业。
宏伟.en: He has a grand plan to change the entire industry.

宏伟.zh: 宏伟的目标需要一步步实现。
宏伟.en: Grand goals need to be achieved step by step.

宏伟.zh: 站在山顶看日出，景色十分宏伟壮观。
宏伟.en: Watching the sunrise from the mountaintop, the scenery is magnificent and spectacular.

宏伟.zh: 这个项目的宏伟蓝图得到了很多人的支持。
宏伟.en: The grand blueprint of this project has received a lot of support.

自然而然.zh: 时间久了，我们自然而然就熟了。
自然而然.en: After a long time, we naturally become familiar.

自然而然.zh: 只要你多练习，水平自然而然会提高。
自然而然.en: As long as you practice more, your skill will naturally improve.

自然而然.zh: 他很有天赋，唱歌自然而然就好听。
自然而然.en: He is very talented, so his singing naturally sounds good.

自然而然.zh: 好的习惯养成了，坏习惯自然而然就被改掉了。
自然而然.en: Once good habits are formed, bad habits are naturally eliminated.

自然而然.zh: 两个人相处久了，感情自然而然就深了。
自然而然.en: After two people spend a long time together, feelings naturally deepen.

过剩.zh: 现在粮食过剩，价格跌了。
过剩.en: Now there is a grain surplus, prices have fallen.

过剩.zh: 产能过剩会导致工厂减产。
过剩.en: Overcapacity will lead to factory production cuts.

过剩.zh: 社会上的劳动力过剩，找工作不容易。
过剩.en: There is a surplus of labor in society, finding a job is not easy.

过剩.zh: 这个城市的人口过剩，交通越来越拥挤。
过剩.en: This city has an excess population, traffic is getting more congested.

过剩.zh: 如果能源过剩，我们可以考虑出口一部分。
过剩.en: If there is an energy surplus, we can consider exporting some.

精髓.zh: 这本书的精髓在于它的思想。
精髓.en: The essence of this book lies in its ideas.

精髓.zh: 太极拳的精髓是刚柔并济。
精髓.en: The essence of Tai Chi is the combination of hardness and softness.

精髓.zh: 学习一门语言，要掌握它的文化精髓。
精髓.en: To learn a language, you need to grasp its cultural essence.

精髓.zh: 这个理论的精髓很难用几句话解释清楚。
精髓.en: The essence of this theory is hard to explain in just a few sentences.

精髓.zh: 传统手工艺的精髓在于工匠的专注和耐心。
精髓.en: The essence of traditional craftsmanship lies in the artisan's focus and patience.

改动.zh: 这个计划需要改动一下。
改动.en: This plan needs a little modification.

改动.zh: 老师对文章做了几处小改动。
改动.en: The teacher made a few small changes to the essay.

改动.zh: 设计方案经过多次改动后终于通过了。
改动.en: After many modifications, the design plan was finally approved.

改动.zh: 如果你要改动日程，请提前通知大家。
改动.en: If you want to change the schedule, please notify everyone in advance.

改动.zh: 这个软件的代码改动得比较多，可能需要重新测试。
改动.en: The code changes of this software are quite extensive, may need re-testing.

惦记.en: I always miss home when I'm away.

惦记.zh: 他出差的时候一直惦记着生病的妈妈。
惦记.en: When he was on a business trip, he kept worrying about his sick mom.

惦记.zh: 你一个人住，要记得惦记自己的身体。
惦记.en: You live alone, remember to take care of yourself.

惦记.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我还是惦记着你的生日。
惦记.en: Although work is busy, I still remember your birthday.

惦记.zh: 妈妈总是惦记我有没有吃早饭。
惦记.en: Mom always worries whether I've had breakfast.

岛屿.zh: 我们坐船去了一个无人居住的岛屿。
岛屿.en: We took a boat to an uninhabited island.

岛屿.zh: 太平洋上有许多小岛屿。
岛屿.en: There are many small islands in the Pacific Ocean.

岛屿.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去那个岛屿露营。
岛屿.en: If the weather is good, we'll go camping on that island.

岛屿.zh: 这个岛屿的居民主要靠捕鱼为生。
岛屿.en: The residents of this island mainly live by fishing.

茫茫.zh: 眼前是一片茫茫的大海。
茫茫.en: In front is a vast ocean.

茫茫.zh: 在茫茫的人海中，我一眼就认出了他。
茫茫.en: In the vast sea of people, I recognized him at a glance.

茫茫.zh: 冬天的草原显得一片茫茫。
茫茫.en: The winter grassland looks vast and boundless.

茫茫.zh: 因为大雾，周围全是茫茫的白雾，什么都看不见。
茫茫.en: Because of the heavy fog, everything around was vast white fog, couldn't see anything.

茫茫.zh: 他感到前途一片茫茫，不知道该怎么办。
茫茫.en: He felt his future was vast and uncertain, not knowing what to do.

敏捷.zh: 这位运动员的反应非常敏捷，就像一只豹子。
敏捷.en: This athlete's reaction is very quick, like a leopard.

敏捷.zh: 小猫的动作很敏捷，一下子就跳上了桌子。
敏捷.en: The kitten's movements are agile; it jumped onto the table in one go.

敏捷.zh: 虽然他年纪大了，但思维依然很敏捷。
敏捷.en: Although he is old, his thinking is still sharp.

敏捷.zh: 我们需要敏捷地应对市场的变化。
敏捷.en: We need to respond agilely to market changes.

禁忌.zh: 在有些文化里，用手指指人是一种禁忌。
禁忌.en: In some cultures, pointing at people is a taboo.

禁忌.zh: 吃饭的时候不要谈论禁忌话题。
禁忌.en: Don't talk about taboo topics during meals.

禁忌.zh: 如果你不了解对方的禁忌，最好少说话。
禁忌.en: If you don't know the other person's taboos, it's best to talk less.

禁忌.zh: 这些禁忌是祖辈传下来的，大家都很遵守。
禁忌.en: These taboos are passed down from ancestors, everyone follows them.

新奇.zh: 第一次去国外，什么都觉得很新奇。
新奇.en: First time abroad, everything felt novel.

新奇.zh: 他喜欢尝试新奇的食物。
新奇.en: He likes to try novel foods.

新奇.zh: 虽然手机已经不新奇了，但这款设计还是让人眼前一亮。
新奇.en: Although smartphones are nothing new, this design still catches the eye.

新奇.zh: 孩子们对新奇的玩具总是充满好奇。
新奇.en: Children are always curious about novel toys.

越发.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

越发.zh: 随着时间推移，他越发觉得后悔。
越发.en: As time goes by, he feels more and more regretful.

越发.zh: 听了他的话，我越发感到不安。
越发.en: After hearing his words, I felt increasingly uneasy.

越发.zh: 因为练习得少，她的舞跳得越发生疏了。
越发.en: Because she practiced little, her dancing became more and more rusty.

越发.zh: 这种材料越发光亮，看起来很高档。
越发.en: This material is increasingly shiny, looking high-end.

炭.zh: 我们去买一些炭来烧烤。
炭.en: Let's buy some charcoal for barbecue.

炭.zh: 冬天的时候，北方人喜欢用炭取暖。
炭.en: In winter, northerners like to use charcoal for heating.
This kind of charcoal burns without smoke.

炭.zh: 虽然炭火很旺，但还是要小心通风。
炭.en: Although the charcoal fire is strong, still be careful about ventilation.

炭.zh: 古代人用炭来画画，叫木炭画。
炭.en: Ancient people used charcoal for drawing, called charcoal drawing.

针灸.zh: 中医用针灸治疗很多种疾病。
针灸.en: Traditional Chinese medicine uses acupuncture to treat many diseases.

针灸.zh: 针灸对于缓解疼痛很有效。
针灸.en: Acupuncture is very effective for pain relief.

针灸.zh: 如果你怕疼，针灸可能不太适合你。
针灸.en: If you are afraid of pain, acupuncture might not suit you.

针灸.zh: 这家医院的针灸科很有名。
针灸.en: The acupuncture department of this hospital is very famous.

懒惰.zh: 懒惰的人很难取得成功。
懒惰.en: Lazy people find it hard to achieve success.

懒惰.zh: 我最近变得越来越懒惰了。
虽然他知道应该学习，但因为懒惰，总是拖延。
懒惰.en: Although he knows he should study, because of laziness, he always procrastinates.

懒惰.zh: 懒惰不是天生的，而是习惯养成的。
懒惰.en: Laziness is not innate, but formed by habits.

柴油.en: Diesel cars are more fuel-efficient than gasoline cars.

柴油.zh: 这台机器加的是柴油，不是汽油。
柴油.en: This machine uses diesel, not gasoline.

柴油.zh: 柴油价格又涨了，开卡车的人压力很大。
柴油.en: Diesel prices have gone up again, putting pressure on truck drivers.

柴油.zh: 虽然柴油车动力强，但噪音也比汽油车大。
柴油.en: Although diesel cars have strong power, they are also noisier than gasoline cars.

柴油.zh: 农村很多拖拉机都用柴油，因为便宜耐用。
柴油.en: Many tractors in rural areas use diesel because it's cheap and durable.

回首.zh: 回首往事，他觉得很惭愧。
回首.en: Looking back on the past, he feels very ashamed.

回首.zh: 她不敢回首那段痛苦的经历。
回首.en: She dares not look back on that painful experience.

回首.zh: 每一次回首，都让我更珍惜现在。
回首.en: Every time I look back, it makes me cherish the present more.

回首.zh: 他回首自己走过的路，觉得一切都很值得。
回首.en: He looks back on the path he has taken and feels it was all worth it.

回首.zh: 如果我们回首过去，就会发现很多教训值得吸取。
回首.en: If we look back at the past, we will find many lessons worth learning.

酗酒.en: Heavy drinking is very harmful to health.

酗酒.zh: 他因为酗酒失去了工作。
酗酒.en: He lost his job because of heavy drinking.

酗酒.zh: 医生警告他不能再酗酒了。
酗酒.en: The doctor warned him not to drink excessively anymore.

酗酒.zh: 酗酒不仅伤身，还会破坏家庭关系。
酗酒.en: Heavy drinking not only harms the body but also destroys family relationships.

酗酒.zh: 他以前酗酒很严重，后来靠毅力戒掉了。
酗酒.en: He used to be a heavy drinker, but later he quit through sheer willpower.

错觉.zh: 他以为她喜欢他，其实是错觉。
错觉.en: He thought she liked him, but it was an illusion.

错觉.zh: 人在沙漠里很容易产生错觉。
错觉.en: People can easily have illusions in the desert.

错觉.zh: 不要被表面的成功产生错觉。
错觉.en: Don't be misled by superficial success into having illusions.

错觉.zh: 有时候时间久了，很容易产生一种熟悉的错觉。
错觉.en: Sometimes, after a long time, it's easy to develop a false sense of familiarity.

陶醉.en: She is intoxicated by the music.

陶醉.zh: 面对美景，他完全陶醉了。
陶醉.en: Facing the beautiful scenery, he was completely enchanted.

陶醉.zh: 他陶醉在自己的成功中，忘了危险。
陶醉.en: He was so intoxicated by his own success that he forgot the danger.

陶醉.zh: 每次听到这首歌，我都陶醉其中。
陶醉.en: Every time I hear this song, I get lost in it.

陶醉.zh: 夜晚的星空让人陶醉，仿佛整个世界都安静了。
陶醉.en: The starry night sky is intoxicating, as if the whole world has fallen silent.

进出口.zh: 这个公司做进出口生意。
进出口.en: This company does import and export business.

进出口.zh: 进出口贸易今年增长很快。
进出口.en: Import and export trade has grown rapidly this year.

进出口.zh: 海关负责检查进出口货物。
进出口.en: Customs is responsible for inspecting import and export goods.

进出口.zh: 由于关税调整，进出口成本增加了不少。
进出口.en: Due to tariff adjustments, import and export costs have increased a lot.

进出口.zh: 他们公司主要做食品的进出口业务。
进出口.en: Their company mainly deals in the import and export of food products.

未免.zh: 你这样说未免太过分了。
未免.en: Saying that is a bit too much, isn't it?

未免.zh: 这样处理问题未免太草率了。
未免.en: Handling the problem this way is too rash.

未免.zh: 虽然他是好心，但做法未免欠考虑。
未免.en: Although he meant well, his approach was a bit thoughtless.

未免.zh: 你才学了三天就说自己会了，未免太自信了。
未免.en: You've only studied for three days and say you've mastered it—that's a bit overconfident.

池塘.en: There are many fish in the pond.

池塘.zh: 孩子们在池塘边捉蝌蚪。
池塘.en: The children are catching tadpoles by the pond.
The water in this pond is very clean.

池塘.zh: 夏天池塘里开满了荷花。
池塘.en: In summer, the pond is full of lotus flowers.

池塘.zh: 爷爷每天早晨都去池塘边散步。
池塘.en: Grandpa goes for a walk by the pond every morning.

名言.en: I like this quote the most.
"Time is money" is a famous saying.

名言.zh: 老师上课时常常引用名言。
名言.en: The teacher often quotes famous sayings in class.

名言.zh: 这句名言激励了我很多年。
名言.en: This famous saying has inspired me for many years.

名言.zh: 他写作文时喜欢用名言来开头。
名言.en: He likes to start his essays with a famous saying.

审批.en: The approval process is very complicated.

审批.zh: 领导已经审批了你的申请。
审批.en: The leader has already approved your application.

审批.zh: 审批结果要等一个星期才出来。
审批.en: The approval result won't be out for a week.

审批.zh: 所有文件必须经过审批才能使用。
审批.en: All documents must go through approval before they can be used.

示意.en: He gave me a meaningful look.

示意.zh: 老师示意大家安静下来。
示意.en: The teacher signaled everyone to quiet down.

示意.zh: 她对我示意了一下，我就明白了。
示意.en: She gave me a hint, and I understood right away.

示意.zh: 虽然他没说话，但用手势示意我过去。
示意.en: Although he didn't speak, he gestured for me to come over.

示意.zh: 服务员示意我们这边有位子，然后带我们走过去。
示意.en: The waiter indicated that there was a seat over here, and then led us over.

定居.en: They decided to settle in Beijing.

定居.zh: 我爸妈退休后想去南方定居。
定居.en: My parents want to settle down in the south after retirement.

定居.zh: 她嫁到国外以后就在那边定居了。
定居.en: After she married abroad, she settled there.

定居.zh: 我们本来只是旅游，结果喜欢上这里就定居了。
定居.en: We originally just traveled here, but ended up liking it so we settled down.

定居.zh: 因为工作原因，他在深圳定居了快十年。
定居.en: Due to work, he has been settled in Shenzhen for nearly ten years.

加紧.en: We need to speed up our preparations.
The construction team is speeding up the work.

加紧.zh: 考试快到了，你要加紧复习。
加紧.en: The exam is coming soon, you need to step up your review.

加紧.zh: 为了赶在雨季前完成，大家都很加紧干活。
加紧.en: In order to finish before the rainy season, everyone is working hard and fast.

加紧.zh: 虽然时间紧，但我们还是要加紧质量检查。
加紧.en: Although time is tight, we still need to intensify quality checks.

蓝图.zh: 他们画好了新家的蓝图。
蓝图.en: They drew up the blueprint for their new home.

蓝图.zh: 这是公司未来五年的发展蓝图。
蓝图.en: This is the blueprint for the company's development over the next five years.

蓝图.zh: 蓝图再好，也要靠大家一起努力实现。
蓝图.en: No matter how good the blueprint is, it still requires everyone's efforts to realize it.

蓝图.zh: 城市规划师在展示新区的蓝图。
蓝图.en: The urban planner is showing the blueprint of the new district.

蓝图.zh: 他们不仅有了构想，还把蓝图拿给专家看了。
蓝图.en: They not only had an idea, but also showed the blueprint to experts.

斑点.en: There are spots on this piece of clothing.

斑点.zh: 她的脸上长了一些斑点。
斑点.en: She has some spots on her face.

斑点.zh: 这种狗身上的斑点很特别。
斑点.en: The spots on this kind of dog are very distinctive.

斑点.zh: 那只猫是白色的，只有耳朵上有黑色斑点。
斑点.en: That cat is white, with black spots only on its ears.

斑点.zh: 因为咖啡洒了，桌布上留下好几个斑点。
斑点.en: Because the coffee spilled, several spots were left on the tablecloth.

修养.zh: 她平时注重自己的品德修养。
修养.en: She usually pays attention to her moral cultivation.

修养.zh: 多读书能提高个人修养。
修养.en: Reading more can improve one's personal cultivation.

修养.zh: 他虽然有钱，但缺乏基本的修养。
修养.en: Although he is rich, he lacks basic cultivation.

修养.zh: 病后他需要一段时间来休养身体，恢复修养。
修养.en: After the illness, he needs a period of rest to recuperate and recover his health.

病症.en: This kind of symptom/disease is very common.

病症.zh: 医生仔细分析了她的病症。
病症.en: The doctor carefully analyzed her symptoms.

病症.zh: 有些病症早期很难发现。
病症.en: Some symptoms are hard to detect in the early stage.

病症.zh: 她出现了发烧和咳嗽的病症。
病症.en: She developed symptoms of fever and cough.

病症.zh: 虽然病症相似，但病因可能完全不同。
病症.en: Although the symptoms are similar, the causes may be completely different.

首府.zh: 乌鲁木齐是新疆的首府。
首府.en: Urumqi is the capital of Xinjiang.

首府.zh: 各省的首府通常经济比较发达。
首府.en: The capitals of provinces are usually more economically developed.

首府.zh: 他们计划去西藏的首府拉萨旅游。
首府.en: They plan to travel to Lhasa, the capital of Tibet.

首府.zh: 这个州的首府虽然不大，但很安静。
首府.en: Although the capital of this state is not big, it is very quiet.

首府.zh: 去年首府举办了一个大型文化节，吸引了很多游客。
首府.en: Last year the capital held a large cultural festival that attracted many tourists.

帆船.en: There are many sailboats docked by the sea.

帆船.zh: 他们坐帆船出海看日落。
帆船.en: They went out to sea on a sailboat to watch the sunset.

帆船.zh: 因为没有风，帆船动得很慢。
帆船.en: Because there was no wind, the sailboat moved very slowly.

帆船.zh: 虽然帆船看起来浪漫，但操作起来不容易。
帆船.en: Although sailboats look romantic, they are not easy to operate.

无缘.en: I am not destined for this big prize.

无缘.zh: 他们俩最后无缘在一起。
无缘.en: The two of them ended up not being meant to be together.

无缘.zh: 这次比赛他因伤无缘参加。
无缘.en: He couldn't participate in this competition due to injury.

无缘.zh: 虽然很想去，但因为工作我无缘这次旅行。
无缘.en: Although I really wanted to go, I missed out on this trip because of work.

无缘.zh: 她喜欢画画，却无缘进入艺术学校。
无缘.en: She loves painting, but unfortunately didn't get into art school.

抑郁症.zh: 他最近被诊断出有抑郁症。
抑郁症.en: He was recently diagnosed with depression.

抑郁症.zh: 抑郁症让她觉得做什么都没意思。
抑郁症.en: Depression makes her feel like nothing is fun.

抑郁症.zh: 很多人对抑郁症的了解还不够，需要多宣传。
抑郁症.en: Many people still don't know enough about depression, so more awareness is needed.

抑郁症.zh: 她通过运动和心理咨询慢慢走出了抑郁症。
抑郁症.en: She gradually overcame depression through exercise and counseling.

抑郁症.zh: 如果朋友得了抑郁症，你要多陪陪他，别让他一个人。
抑郁症.en: If a friend has depression, you should spend more time with him and not leave him alone.

熄灭.en: The candle went out on its own.

熄灭.zh: 消防员很快把大火熄灭了。
熄灭.en: The firefighters quickly put out the big fire.

熄灭.zh: 灯突然熄灭了，我们只好摸黑走路。
熄灭.en: The lights suddenly went out, so we had to walk in the dark.

熄灭.zh: 抽完烟记得把烟头完全熄灭再扔掉。
熄灭.en: Remember to fully extinguish the cigarette butt before throwing it away after smoking.

熄灭.zh: 他心里的那团火一直没有熄灭，还在坚持梦想。
熄灭.en: The fire in his heart has never gone out; he's still pursuing his dream.

防火墙.zh: 电脑必须装防火墙才安全。
防火墙.en: A computer must have a firewall to be safe.

防火墙.zh: 公司新装了网络防火墙，防止黑客攻击。
防火墙.en: The company installed a new network firewall to prevent hacker attacks.

防火墙.zh: 这道防火墙是砖砌的，能挡住火势蔓延。
防火墙.en: This firewall is made of brick and can stop the fire from spreading.

防火墙.zh: 我的防火墙提示有一个可疑程序被阻止了。
防火墙.en: My firewall alerted that a suspicious program was blocked.

防火墙.zh: 虽然装了防火墙，但还是不要随便下载不明文件。
防火墙.en: Even with a firewall, you still shouldn't download unknown files casually.

补救.en: It's not too late to make up for it now.

补救.zh: 他赶紧发邮件道歉，想补救一下关系。
补救.en: He quickly sent an apology email to try to mend the relationship.

补救.zh: 这次失误太大了，很难补救。
补救.en: This mistake is too big to fix.

补救.zh: 项目出了问题，我们要想办法补救损失。
补救.en: The project had a problem, so we need to find a way to remedy the losses.

补救.zh: 虽然已经晚了，但至少可以做一些补救措施。
补救.en: Even though it's already late, at least we can take some remedial actions.

海啸.en: Tsunami is coming! Run to higher ground!

海啸.zh: 日本经常发生海啸，大家都很警惕。
海啸.en: Japan frequently has tsunamis, so everyone is very vigilant.

海啸.zh: 海啸过后，整个村庄都被毁了。
海啸.en: After the tsunami, the entire village was destroyed.

海啸.zh: 科学家正在研究怎么更早预测海啸。
海啸.en: Scientists are studying how to predict tsunamis earlier.

海啸.zh: 那次海啸的破坏力非常大，死了好多人。
海啸.en: That tsunami was extremely destructive and killed many people.

定论.en: There is no final conclusion on this matter yet.

定论.zh: 科学界对这个问题已经有了定论。
定论.en: The scientific community has reached a final conclusion on this issue.

定论.zh: 别急着下定论，再调查一下再说。
定论.en: Don't jump to a conclusion; investigate further first.

定论.zh: 关于谁对谁错，现在下定论太早了。
定论.en: It's too early to draw a final conclusion on who is right or wrong.

定论.zh: 经过多年研究，专家们终于给出了定论。
定论.en: After years of research, experts finally gave a definitive conclusion.

开辟.en: They opened up a new road.

开辟.zh: 公司打算开辟海外市场。
开辟.en: The company plans to open up overseas markets.

开辟.zh: 这片荒地被开辟成了公园。
开辟.en: This wasteland was turned into a park.

开辟.zh: 他辞职后自己开辟了一条创业的新路。
开辟.en: After quitting his job, he carved out a new path for his own business.

开辟.zh: 我们需要开辟更多渠道来推广产品。
开辟.en: We need to open up more channels to promote the product.

外号.zh: 我不太喜欢别人给我起外号。
外号.en: I don't really like others giving me nicknames.

外号.zh: 因为跑得快，同学们给他起了个外号叫“闪电”。
外号.en: Because he runs fast, his classmates gave him the nickname 'Lightning'.

外号.zh: 她那个外号是小时候邻居叫的，到现在还有人记得。
外号.en: That nickname of hers was given by neighbors when she was a child, and people still remember it.

外号.zh: 外号有时候很亲切，但也要看对方介不介意。
外号.en: Nicknames can sometimes be affectionate, but it depends on whether the other person minds.

狂欢节.zh: 狂欢节那天大家都穿上彩色衣服游行。
狂欢节.en: On carnival day, everyone wears colorful clothes and parades.

狂欢节.zh: 今年狂欢节我们打算去里约热内卢玩。
狂欢节.en: This year we plan to go to Rio de Janeiro for the carnival.

狂欢节.zh: 狂欢节结束后，街上到处都是彩纸和垃圾。
狂欢节.en: After the carnival, the streets were full of confetti and trash.

狂欢节.zh: 她为了参加狂欢节特意准备了一套夸张的服装。
狂欢节.en: She specially prepared an extravagant costume to join the carnival.

接见.en: The president received the foreign ambassador.

接见.zh: 今天下午校长会接见优秀学生代表。
接见.en: This afternoon the principal will receive outstanding student representatives.

接见.zh: 他作为公司代表被总理接见了。
接见.en: He was received by the prime minister as a company representative.

接见.zh: 接见过程中，双方讨论了合作的可能性。
接见.en: During the reception, both sides discussed the possibility of cooperation.

接见.zh: 这位明星在后台接见了几位幸运粉丝。
接见.en: The star received a few lucky fans backstage.

筹划.zh: 因为时间很紧，我们必须仔细筹划这次活动。
筹划.en: Because time is tight, we must plan this event carefully.

筹划.zh: 公司筹划了很久才推出新产品。
筹划.en: The company planned for a long time before launching the new product.

筹划.zh: 虽然筹划过程很复杂，但大家都很努力。
筹划.en: Although the planning process was complicated, everyone worked hard.

津贴.en: The company gives a transportation allowance every month.

津贴.zh: 除了基本工资，我们还有餐费津贴。
津贴.en: Besides the basic salary, we also have a meal allowance.

津贴.zh: 因为出差，他领了一笔津贴。
津贴.en: Because of the business trip, he received an allowance.

津贴.zh: 这个岗位有住房津贴吗？
津贴.en: Does this position come with a housing allowance?

津贴.zh: 政府给低收入家庭发放生活津贴。
津贴.en: The government distributes living allowances to low-income families.

胚胎.zh: 科学家在研究早期胚胎的发育过程。
胚胎.en: Scientists are studying the development process of early embryos.

胚胎.zh: 虽然胚胎很小，但已经开始形成器官。
胚胎.en: Although the embryo is very small, it has already started to form organs.

胚胎.zh: 胚胎干细胞研究有很多争议。
胚胎.en: Embryonic stem cell research is quite controversial.

胚胎.zh: 他们在实验室里培育了多个胚胎。
胚胎.en: They cultivated multiple embryos in the lab.

疗效.en: This medicine has good therapeutic effect.

疗效.zh: 医生说他需要观察几个疗程的疗效。
疗效.en: The doctor said he needs to observe the effect over several courses of treatment.

疗效.zh: 虽然副作用不大，但疗效也不明显。
疗效.en: Although the side effects are minor, the efficacy is not obvious either.

疗效.zh: 这种治疗方法疗效如何？
疗效.en: How effective is this treatment method?

疗效.zh: 很多病人反馈这款中药疗效显著。
疗效.en: Many patients report that this Chinese medicine has significant effects.

漂浮.en: Leaves are floating on the water.

漂浮.zh: 云朵像棉花糖一样漂浮在天空中。
漂浮.en: Clouds float in the sky like cotton candy.

漂浮.zh: 他躺在水面上，感觉身体在轻轻漂浮。
漂浮.en: He lay on the water, feeling his body gently float.

漂浮.zh: 海洋里漂浮着很多塑料垃圾。
漂浮.en: A lot of plastic waste is floating in the ocean.

漂浮.zh: 宇航员在太空站里体验失重漂浮的感觉。
漂浮.en: Astronauts experience the feeling of weightless floating in the space station.

革新.zh: 公司正在进行技术革新。
革新.en: The company is undertaking technological innovation.

革新.zh: 这次革新大大提高了生产效率。
革新.en: This innovation greatly improved production efficiency.

革新.zh: 虽然革新遇到阻力，但最终还是成功了。
革新.en: Although the reform encountered resistance, it eventually succeeded.

革新.zh: 教育领域也需要持续革新。
革新.en: The education sector also needs continuous innovation.

革新.zh: 他们通过管理革新降低了成本。
革新.en: They reduced costs through management innovation.

空洞.zh: 他的演讲虽然很长，但内容空洞。
空洞.en: His speech was long, but the content was empty.

空洞.zh: 因为缺乏数据，报告显得很空洞。
空洞.en: Because of a lack of data, the report seems hollow.

空洞.zh: 不要只讲空洞的口号，要有实际行动。
空洞.en: Don't just shout empty slogans; take concrete action.

空洞.zh: 这篇文章空洞无物，读起来没意思。
空洞.en: This article is devoid of content and boring to read.

声望.en: He has high prestige in academia.

声望.zh: 这家公司因为产品质量好而声望很高。
声望.en: This company has high prestige because of its good product quality.

声望.zh: 虽然年纪不大，但他在业内声望很高。
声望.en: Although young, he has high prestige in the industry.

声望.zh: 他的声望是通过多年努力积累的。
声望.en: His reputation was built through years of hard work.

声望.zh: 一位声望很高的教授来我们学校演讲。
声望.en: A highly prestigious professor came to give a lecture at our school.

呵护.en: Parents carefully care for their children.

呵护.zh: 我们要呵护地球的生态环境。
呵护.en: We must cherish the ecological environment of the Earth.

呵护.zh: 虽然工作忙，但她依然精心呵护家庭。
呵护.en: Although busy with work, she still takes good care of her family.

呵护.zh: 这种植物需要特别呵护才能成活。
呵护.en: This plant needs special care to survive.

呵护.zh: 在医生的精心呵护下，病人很快康复了。
呵护.en: Under the doctor's attentive care, the patient recovered quickly.

守候.en: She has been waiting by the door.

守候.zh: 志愿者守候在灾区，随时准备救援。
守候.en: Volunteers stand by in the disaster area, ready to rescue at any time.

守候.zh: 虽然夜色已深，他依然守候在病房外。
守候.en: Although the night is deep, he still keeps watch outside the ward.

守候.zh: 守候多年，她终于等到了好消息。
守候.en: After waiting for many years, she finally got good news.

守候.zh: 母亲守候在电话旁，等待儿子的来电。
守候.en: The mother waited by the phone, expecting her son's call.

深切.zh: 他对这次事故表示深切的哀悼。
深切.en: He expressed profound condolences for the accident.

深切.zh: 我们深切感受到大家的关心。
虽然事情过去了，但我仍然有深切的体会。
深切.en: Although it's over, I still have a profound understanding.

深切.zh: 这部电影让我对人生有了深切的思考。
深切.en: This movie made me think deeply about life.

路子.zh: 你得换个路子，才能解决问题。
路子.en: You need to change your approach to solve the problem.

路子.zh: 他路子很广，认识不少人。
路子.en: He has many connections and knows a lot of people.

路子.zh: 我觉得做销售是一条不错的路子。
路子.en: I think sales is a good path to take.

路子.zh: 既然这条路子走不通，我们就试试别的办法。
路子.en: Since this method doesn't work, let's try another way.

打量.en: He looked me up and down.

打量.zh: 她在门口打量了我好一会儿。
打量.en: She sized me up at the door for a while.

打量.zh: 你别老打量别人，不礼貌。
打量.en: Don't keep staring at others, it's rude.

打量.zh: 他仔细打量了一下那个陌生人。
打量.en: He carefully looked over that stranger.

打量.zh: 我打量了一下房间，发现布置得很温馨。
打量.en: I looked around the room and found it cozy.

反常.en: His behavior has been very unusual lately.

反常.zh: 这么早就睡觉，太反常了。
反常.en: Going to bed so early is really unusual.

反常.zh: 她平时很开朗，今天却一句话不说，有点反常。
反常.en: She's usually cheerful, but today she didn't say a word, which is a bit strange.

反常.zh: 这个月的气温非常反常，比往年高了很多。
反常.en: This month's temperature is very abnormal, much higher than previous years.

敬业.en: He is very dedicated to his work.

敬业.zh: 这位老师很敬业，经常加班。
敬业.en: This teacher is very dedicated and often works overtime.

敬业.zh: 作为一个医生，敬业是最重要的品质。
敬业.en: As a doctor, dedication is the most important quality.

敬业.zh: 虽然待遇不高，但他依然很敬业。
敬业.en: Although the pay isn't high, he is still very devoted.

敬业.zh: 大家都很佩服她那种敬业的精神。

视察.en: The leader came to inspect the work.

视察.zh: 市长今天下午要来我们学校视察。
视察.en: The mayor will visit our school this afternoon for an inspection.

视察.zh: 他们去工地视察了施工进度。
视察.en: They went to the construction site to inspect the progress.

视察.zh: 视察结束后，领导提出了几点建议。
视察.en: After the inspection, the leader made a few suggestions.

视察.zh: 公司高层每年都会来分公司视察一次。
视察.en: Senior management comes to inspect the branch once a year.

刷新.en: Refresh the webpage and take a look.

刷新.zh: 这位运动员再次刷新了世界纪录。
刷新.en: This athlete broke the world record again.

刷新.zh: 系统已经刷新了，数据都是最新的。
刷新.en: The system has been refreshed, and the data is all up to date.

刷新.zh: 他每天都会刷新自己的业绩。
刷新.en: He sets a new personal best in his performance every day.

一行.en: Our group of three set off.

一行.zh: 他写了一行诗，就停下了笔。
一行.en: He wrote one line of poetry and then stopped.

一行.zh: 公司一行十人参加了展会。
一行.en: A group of ten from the company attended the exhibition.

一行.zh: 请在这行下面再空一行。
一行.en: Please leave another blank line below this line.

一行.zh: 他们一行沿着山路往上走。
一行.en: Their group walked up along the mountain path.

慰问.en: We went to comfort the patient.

慰问.zh: 工会领导来慰问受灾职工。
慰问.en: Union leaders came to comfort the affected workers.

慰问.zh: 他送来了慰问信和慰问金。
慰问.en: He sent a letter of sympathy and consolation money.

慰问.zh: 虽然不能回家，但公司发了慰问品。
慰问.en: Even though I couldn't go home, the company gave out care packages.

慰问.zh: 每年春节，政府都会慰问困难家庭。
慰问.en: Every Spring Festival, the government visits and comforts needy families.

泛滥.en: Rumors are rampant on the internet lately.

泛滥.zh: 如果不控制，这种问题会泛滥成灾。
泛滥.en: If not controlled, this problem will become disastrously widespread.

泛滥.zh: 雨下得太久，导致河水泛滥。
泛滥.en: It rained for too long, causing the river to overflow.

泛滥.zh: 市场上假货泛滥，消费者很难分辨。
泛滥.en: The market is flooded with fake goods, making it hard for consumers to tell.

磁带.en: Can this cassette still be played?

磁带.zh: 我小时候听了很多英语磁带。
磁带.en: I listened to a lot of English tapes when I was a kid.

磁带.zh: 他把磁带放进录音机里，然后按了播放键。
磁带.en: He put the tape into the recorder and then pressed play.

磁带.zh: 现在很少有人用磁带了，大家都用手机听歌。
磁带.en: Nowadays few people use cassettes; everyone listens to music on their phones.

磁带.zh: 我找遍了整个屋子，都没找到那盘老磁带。
磁带.en: I searched the whole house but couldn't find that old cassette.

大意.zh: 他太大意了，把钥匙忘在门上。
大意.en: He was too careless and left the keys in the door.

大意.zh: 这篇文章的大意是什么？
大意.en: What is the main idea of this article?

大意.zh: 开车时千万别大意，容易出事故。
大意.en: Don't be careless while driving; accidents can easily happen.

大意.zh: 考试的时候，因为大意写错了名字，真可惜。
大意.en: During the exam, I carelessly wrote the wrong name—what a pity.

大意.zh: 你先说说这段对话的大意，我们再来讨论细节。
大意.en: First tell me the gist of this conversation, then we'll discuss the details.

麻将.en: They often play mahjong on weekends.

麻将.zh: 我不会打麻将，你教教我吧。
麻将.en: I don't know how to play mahjong; please teach me.

麻将.zh: 奶奶喜欢和邻居一起搓麻将。
麻将.en: Grandma likes to play mahjong with the neighbors.

麻将.zh: 昨晚打麻将打到半夜，今天早上起不来了。
麻将.en: We played mahjong until late last night and couldn't get up this morning.

麻将.zh: 麻将桌上四个人有说有笑，气氛很热闹。
麻将.en: The four people at the mahjong table were chatting and laughing, the atmosphere was lively.

毁坏.zh: 暴风雨毁坏了很多房屋。
他不小心毁坏了别人的电脑。
毁坏.en: He accidentally damaged someone else's computer.

毁坏.zh: 这种害虫会毁坏庄稼，农民很头疼。
毁坏.en: This kind of pest destroys crops, giving farmers a headache.

毁坏.zh: 虽然大火毁坏了森林，但动物们慢慢回来了。
毁坏.en: Although the fire destroyed the forest, the animals are slowly returning.

毁坏.zh: 故意毁坏公共设施是要负法律责任的。
毁坏.en: Deliberately destroying public property will result in legal liability.

会晤.en: The leaders of the two countries will meet tomorrow.

会晤.zh: 这次会晤主要讨论了贸易问题。
会晤.en: This meeting mainly discussed trade issues.

会晤.zh: 他们在酒店大堂进行了短暂的会晤。
会晤.en: They had a brief meeting in the hotel lobby.

会晤.zh: 记者们都在等着会晤结束后的新闻发布会。
会晤.en: The journalists are all waiting for the press conference after the meeting.

会晤.zh: 会晤期间，双方签署了合作协议。
会晤.en: During the meeting, the two sides signed a cooperation agreement.

动向.en: You need to pay attention to market trends.
His recent movements have been strange.

动向.zh: 警方正在密切监视嫌疑人的动向。
动向.en: The police are closely monitoring the suspect's movements.

动向.zh: 我们需要了解竞争对手的最新动向。
动向.en: We need to know the latest moves of our competitors.

动向.zh: 股市的动向很难预测，投资要小心。
动向.en: Stock market trends are hard to predict, so invest carefully.

焦急.zh: 孩子还没回家，妈妈很焦急。
焦急.en: The child hasn't come home yet; the mother is very anxious.

焦急.zh: 他焦急地在门口走来走去。
焦急.en: He paced anxiously at the door.

焦急.zh: 看到考试时间快到了，他变得非常焦急。
焦急.en: Seeing that the exam time was almost up, he became very anxious.

焦急.zh: 别太焦急，事情总会解决的。
焦急.en: Don't be too anxious; things will work out eventually.

顺其自然.en: When it comes to relationships, just let it be.

顺其自然.zh: 找工作别太急，顺其自然就好。
顺其自然.en: Don't rush to find a job; just take it as it comes.

顺其自然.zh: 既然已经尽力了，剩下的就顺其自然。
顺其自然.en: Since you've done your best, let nature take its course for the rest.

顺其自然.zh: 我劝他别强求，顺其自然反而更好。
顺其自然.en: I advised him not to force things; going with the flow is actually better.

顺其自然.zh: 计划赶不上变化，不如顺其自然地面对生活。
顺其自然.en: Plans can't keep up with changes; it's better to just go with the flow in life.

体面.zh: 这份工作收入不高，但很体面。
体面.en: This job doesn't pay much, but it's respectable.

体面.zh: 她希望大家都能体面地离开会场。
体面.en: She hopes everyone can leave the venue with dignity.

体面.zh: 就算输了，也要输得体面一点。
体面.en: Even if you lose, lose with some dignity.

体面.zh: 为了让孩子过得体面，他拼命工作。
体面.en: To give his child a decent life, he works hard.

胡乱.zh: 他胡乱写了几句话就交了。
胡乱.en: He scribbled a few sentences and handed it in.

胡乱.zh: 东西不要胡乱放，要找的时候找不到。
胡乱.en: Don't put things around randomly; you won't find them when you need them.

胡乱.zh: 他胡乱吃了几口饭就出门了。
胡乱.en: He ate a few bites hastily and went out.

胡乱.zh: 遇到问题要冷静，不能胡乱下结论。
胡乱.en: Stay calm when facing problems; don't jump to conclusions.

随时随地.zh: 你可以随时随地给我打电话。
随时随地.en: You can call me anytime, anywhere.

随时随地.zh: 有了手机，我们随时随地都能联系。
随时随地.en: With a mobile phone, we can stay in touch anytime, anywhere.

随时随地.zh: 他随时随地都在学习，特别用功。
随时随地.en: He studies anytime, anywhere, very hardworking.

随时随地.zh: 这个软件让你随时随地都能听音乐。
随时随地.en: This app lets you listen to music anytime, anywhere.

随时随地.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是抽空随时随地锻炼身体。
随时随地.en: Although he's busy with work, he still finds time to exercise anytime, anywhere.

自尊心.zh: 他自尊心很强，受不了批评。
自尊心.en: He has strong self-esteem and can't take criticism.

自尊心.zh: 别这么说她，她自尊心很脆弱。
自尊心.en: Don't say that to her; her self-esteem is very fragile.

自尊心.zh: 父母要多鼓励孩子，保护他们的自尊心。
自尊心.en: Parents should encourage their children more and protect their self-esteem.

自尊心.zh: 他虽然失败了，但自尊心让他不肯认输。
自尊心.en: Although he failed, his self-esteem wouldn't let him give up.

自尊心.zh: 我们开玩笑要注意分寸，不要伤了别人的自尊心。
自尊心.en: When joking, we need to be careful not to hurt someone's self-esteem.

下岗.zh: 他去年下岗了，现在在找新工作。
下岗.en: He was laid off last year and is now looking for a new job.

下岗.zh: 很多工厂倒闭，工人都下岗了。
下岗.en: Many factories closed down, and the workers were laid off.

下岗.zh: 下岗之后，他开了一家小店自己创业。
下岗.en: After being laid off, he opened a small shop and started his own business.

下岗.zh: 她因为公司裁员而下岗，心里很难受。
下岗.en: She was laid off due to company downsizing and felt very sad.

下岗.zh: 政府给下岗工人提供免费的技能培训。
下岗.en: The government provides free skills training for laid-off workers.

成品.en: This batch of finished products is of good quality.

成品.zh: 我们只卖成品，不卖原料。
成品.en: We only sell finished products, not raw materials.

成品.zh: 从原料到成品，需要好几道工序。
成品.en: From raw materials to finished products, it takes several processes.

成品.zh: 工厂正在检查最后的成品有没有问题。
成品.en: The factory is checking whether the final finished products have any issues.

成品.zh: 这些半成品还要加工才能变成成品。
成品.en: These semi-finished products still need processing to become finished products.

扩.en: This road will be expanded to four lanes.

扩.zh: 公司今年打算扩招员工。
扩.en: The company plans to expand recruitment this year.

扩.zh: 为了容纳更多学生，学校在扩建教学楼。
扩.en: To accommodate more students, the school is expanding the teaching building.

扩.zh: 这个软件可以帮你扩内存空间。
扩.en: This software can help you expand memory space.

扩.zh: 他们想把店铺扩到隔壁去。
扩.en: They want to expand the store into the next door.

暑期.en: Where do you plan to go during the summer vacation?

暑期.zh: 很多学生暑期都会去打工赚钱。
暑期.en: Many students work part-time during the summer break to earn money.

暑期.zh: 这个夏令营只开放暑期两个月。
暑期.en: This summer camp is only open for two months during the summer vacation.

暑期.zh: 暑期的机票比平时贵很多。
暑期.en: Airfare during the summer break is much more expensive than usual.

暑期.zh: 他参加了暑期支教活动，去了偏远山区。
暑期.en: He participated in a summer teaching volunteer program and went to a remote mountainous area.

牧场.zh: 这个牧场养了很多牛和羊。
牧场.en: This ranch raises many cows and sheep.

牧场.zh: 暑假我们一家去草原上的牧场玩了。
牧场.en: During summer vacation, our family went to a ranch on the grassland.

牧场.zh: 牧场的主人每天一大早就要起来挤牛奶。
牧场.en: The ranch owner has to get up early every morning to milk the cows.

牧场.zh: 因为干旱，今年牧场的草长得不好。
牧场.en: Because of the drought, the grass on the pasture didn't grow well this year.

牧场.zh: 他梦想着有一天能拥有自己的大牧场。
牧场.en: He dreams of one day owning his own big ranch.

嚷.zh: 他对着电话嚷了半天，特别生气。
嚷.en: He shouted into the phone for a long time, very angry.

嚷.zh: 你们在嚷什么呢？大老远就听见了。
嚷.en: What are you yelling about? I could hear you from far away.
The child fell down and was yelling in pain.

嚷.zh: 球迷们兴奋地嚷着，为主队加油。
嚷.en: The fans shouted excitedly, cheering for the home team.

凝固.zh: 水在零度以下会凝固成冰。
凝固.en: Water freezes into ice below zero degrees.
The oil has solidified and can't be poured out.

凝固.zh: 时间仿佛凝固在了这一刻。
凝固.en: Time seemed to freeze at this moment.

凝固.zh: 水泥凝固需要几个小时才能干透。
凝固.en: Cement needs a few hours to solidify and dry completely.

凝固.zh: 他脸上的笑容突然凝固了，看起来很尴尬。
凝固.en: The smile on his face suddenly froze, and he looked very embarrassed.

炒作.zh: 不要盲目相信网上的炒作。
这个明星靠炒作提高知名度。
炒作.en: This celebrity relies on hype to increase fame.

炒作.zh: 很多人觉得房价是被开发商炒作起来的。
炒作.en: Many people think housing prices are driven up by developers' hype.

炒作.zh: 这部电影没什么内容，全是炒作。
炒作.en: This movie has little content; it's all hype.

炒作.zh: 商家通过炒作限量版来吸引顾客购买。
炒作.en: Merchants use hype around limited editions to attract customers to buy.

磨损.zh: 这双鞋的鞋底磨损得很厉害了。
磨损.en: The soles of these shoes are very worn out.

磨损.zh: 机器的零件因为长期使用而磨损了。
磨损.en: The machine parts are worn out from long-term use.

磨损.zh: 虽然我平时很注意保养，但手机边缘还是有磨损。
磨损.en: Although I usually take good care of it, the edges of my phone are still worn.

磨损.zh: 轮胎磨损太严重的话，开车会很危险。
磨损.en: If the tires are too worn, driving can be dangerous.

磨损.zh: 这把椅子用了十年，边角都磨损了。
磨损.en: This chair has been used for ten years, and the corners are all worn.

意向.en: Do you have any intention of buying a house?

意向.zh: 他表达了合作的意向，但我们还没签约。
意向.en: He expressed an intention to cooperate, but we haven't signed the contract yet.

意向.zh: 我对这次旅行的意向不是很强烈。
意向.en: My inclination for this trip is not very strong.

意向.zh: 公司想先了解一下大家的意向再决定。
意向.en: The company wants to first understand everyone's intentions before deciding.

意向.zh: 她的意向很明确，就是想换个工作。
意向.en: Her intention is very clear: she just wants to change jobs.

源泉.en: Knowledge is the source of power.

源泉.zh: 爱情是他创作灵感的源泉。
源泉.en: Love is the source of his creative inspiration.

源泉.zh: 水是生命最重要的源泉之一。
源泉.en: Water is one of the most important sources of life.

源泉.zh: 家庭是他快乐的源泉，也是他努力的动力。
源泉.en: Family is the source of his happiness and also his motivation to work hard.

源泉.zh: 我们要保护水资源，因为那是生活的源泉。
源泉.en: We must protect water resources, because they are the source of life.

顺手.zh: 你下楼时顺手把垃圾带下去。
顺手.en: Take the trash downstairs when you go down.

顺手.zh: 这件事做得很顺手，没遇到什么麻烦。
顺手.en: This task went smoothly; I didn't run into any trouble.

顺手.zh: 我写这篇文章写得很顺手，一个小时就完成了。
顺手.en: I wrote this article very smoothly and finished it in an hour.

顺手.zh: 去超市的话，顺手帮我买瓶酱油。
顺手.en: If you're going to the supermarket, pick up a bottle of soy sauce for me while you're at it.

觉悟.en: His political awareness is very high.

觉悟.zh: 经历了这次失败，他终于觉悟了。
觉悟.en: After this failure, he finally became aware.

觉悟.zh: 年轻人要提高自己的思想觉悟。
觉悟.en: Young people should raise their ideological awareness.

觉悟.zh: 在大家的帮助下，他觉悟到自己错了。
觉悟.en: With everyone's help, he realized he was wrong.

觉悟.zh: 她觉悟到光靠抱怨是没用的，得行动起来。
觉悟.en: She realized that just complaining is useless; she needs to take action.

胶片.zh: 现在很少有人用胶片相机了。
胶片.en: Few people use film cameras nowadays.

胶片.zh: 这卷胶片还没拍完，不要打开。
胶片.en: This roll of film hasn't been used up yet; don't open it.

胶片.zh: 我喜欢胶片拍出来的那种质感。
胶片.en: I like the texture that film photography produces.

胶片.zh: 因为数码相机普及，胶片已经很难买到了。
胶片.en: Because digital cameras are widespread, film is already hard to find.

胶片.zh: 他收藏了很多老电影的原版胶片。
胶片.en: He has collected many original film reels of old movies.

细微.zh: 这两个颜色有细微的差别。
细微.en: There is a subtle difference between these two colors.

细微.zh: 细微之处才能看出一个人的品质。
细微.en: Only in the small details can you see a person's character.

细微.zh: 她观察得很仔细，连细微的变化都发现了。
细微.en: She observed very carefully and even noticed the subtle changes.

细微.zh: 声音太细微了，我几乎听不见。
细微.en: The sound was so subtle that I could barely hear it.

细微.zh: 在实验过程中，任何细微的误差都不能忽略。
细微.en: During the experiment, any slight error cannot be ignored.

夕阳.zh: 我们坐在海边看夕阳慢慢落下。
夕阳.en: We sat by the sea watching the sunset slowly descend.

夕阳.zh: 夕阳西下，天边染成了橙红色。
夕阳.en: The sun is setting, and the sky is dyed orange-red.

夕阳.zh: 虽然夕阳很美，但看到它总让人有点伤感。
夕阳.en: Although the sunset is beautiful, seeing it always makes one a bit melancholy.

夕阳.zh: 夕阳把整个天空染成了金黄色，特别漂亮。
夕阳.en: The sunset dyed the whole sky golden yellow—especially beautiful.

显眼.zh: 这个标志很显眼，一眼就看到了。
显眼.en: This sign is very conspicuous; you can see it at a glance.

显眼.zh: 你把东西放在显眼的地方，别藏起来。
显眼.en: Put the thing in a conspicuous place; don't hide it.

显眼.zh: 他穿了一件红色的外套，在人群中特别显眼。
显眼.en: He wore a red coat and was especially noticeable in the crowd.

显眼.zh: 这家店的招牌不够显眼，容易错过。
显眼.en: This shop's sign isn't conspicuous enough; it's easy to miss.

显眼.zh: 虽然他不喜欢引人注意，但个子太高还是很显眼。
显眼.en: Although he doesn't like to attract attention, being too tall still makes him stand out.

简易.en: The method for this dish is very simple.

简易.zh: 我们搭了一个简易的帐篷过夜。
简易.en: We set up a simple tent to spend the night.

简易.zh: 他写了一篇简易的教程，新手也能看懂。
简易.en: He wrote a simple tutorial that even beginners can understand.

简易.zh: 这种简易的拼图适合小孩子玩。
简易.en: This kind of simple puzzle is suitable for young children to play with.

简易.zh: 虽然是简易版本，但功能已经够用了。
简易.en: Although it's a simplified version, the functions are already sufficient.

欣喜.zh: 收到礼物后，她脸上露出欣喜的笑容。
欣喜.en: After receiving the gift, she showed a joyful smile.

欣喜.zh: 虽然很累，但看到孩子安全回来，她心里十分欣喜。
欣喜.en: Although very tired, seeing the child return safely, she was very happy.

欣喜.zh: 考试通过的消息让他欣喜若狂。
欣喜.en: The news of passing the exam made him ecstatic.

欣喜.zh: 大家为他的成功感到欣喜。
欣喜.en: Everyone felt joyful for his success.

吓唬.zh: 他喜欢讲鬼故事吓唬朋友。
吓唬.en: He likes telling ghost stories to scare friends.

吓唬.zh: 如果不想吓唬别人，就别突然大叫。
吓唬.en: If you don't want to scare others, don't suddenly shout.

吓唬.zh: 那只猫突然跳出来吓唬了我。
吓唬.en: That cat suddenly jumped out and scared me.

吓唬.zh: 你别拿假蛇吓唬我，我胆子小。
吓唬.en: Don't scare me with a fake snake, I'm timid.

一齐.zh: 我们一齐把桌子搬到楼下。
一齐.en: We moved the table downstairs together.

一齐.zh: 到了约定的时间，所有人一齐出发。
一齐.en: At the agreed time, everyone set off together.

一齐.zh: 同学们一齐回答老师的问题。
一齐.en: The classmates answered the teacher's question together.
Fireworks bloomed together in the sky.

温室.en: The flowers in the greenhouse bloomed.

温室.zh: 冬天时，我们把植物搬到温室里保暖。
温室.en: In winter, we move plants into the greenhouse to keep warm.

温室.zh: 虽然外面很冷，但温室里却很温暖。
温室.en: Although it's cold outside, it's warm inside the greenhouse.

温室.zh: 这个温室种了很多热带水果。
温室.en: This greenhouse grows many tropical fruits.

温室.zh: 温室效应导致全球变暖。
温室.en: The greenhouse effect causes global warming.

检察.en: The inspectors arrived at the scene.

检察.zh: 我们需要检察所有文件才能签字。
检察.en: We need to examine all documents before signing.

检察.zh: 如果发现问题，检察部门会立即处理。
检察.en: If problems are found, the inspection department will handle them immediately.
He is responsible for inspecting product quality.

检察.zh: 检察院对案件进行了详细检察。
检察.en: The procuratorate conducted a detailed inspection of the case.

宠爱.zh: 那只小猫得到了全家人的宠爱。
宠爱.en: That kitten got the whole family's affection.

宠爱.zh: 虽然父母宠爱她，但她一点也不骄纵。
宠爱.en: Although her parents dote on her, she is not spoiled at all.

宠爱.zh: 他是家里最小的孩子，备受宠爱。
宠爱.en: He is the youngest child in the family, much doted on.

宠爱.zh: 这只宠物狗被主人宠爱得不得了。
宠爱.en: This pet dog is extremely pampered by its owner.

摇晃.zh: 他喝了酒，走路有点摇晃。
摇晃.en: He drank alcohol and walked a bit unsteadily.

摇晃.zh: 因为地震，整栋楼都在摇晃。
摇晃.en: Because of the earthquake, the whole building was shaking.

摇晃.zh: 小女孩摇晃着妈妈的胳膊撒娇。
摇晃.en: The little girl shook her mother's arm acting spoiled.

摇晃.zh: 船在海上左右摇晃，让我很不舒服。
摇晃.en: The boat rocked left and right on the sea, making me uncomfortable.

失明.zh: 那位老人因为白内障几乎失明。
失明.en: The old man almost lost his sight due to cataracts.

失明.zh: 虽然她失明了，但生活依然很乐观。
失明.en: Although she is blind, she still lives very optimistically.
The car accident caused him to lose sight in his right eye.

失明.zh: 这只狗从小失明，但听力非常好。
失明.en: This dog has been blind since birth, but its hearing is very good.

栏杆.zh: 公园的栏杆被涂成了白色。
栏杆.en: The park's railing was painted white.

栏杆.zh: 过桥时请扶好栏杆，注意安全。
栏杆.en: When crossing the bridge, please hold the railing and be careful.
He climbed over the railing to pick up the ball.

栏杆.zh: 阳台的栏杆有点松了，需要修理。
栏杆.en: The balcony railing is a bit loose and needs repair.

兴致.en: He is not in the mood today.

兴致.zh: 大家兴致勃勃地讨论旅行计划。
兴致.en: Everyone discussed the travel plans with great enthusiasm.

兴致.zh: 原本我很有兴致，但天气不好就放弃了。
兴致.en: Originally I was very interested, but the weather was bad so I gave up.
She is in high spirits to sing.

兴致.zh: 这次活动没有引起大家的兴致。
兴致.en: This event didn't arouse everyone's interest.

累积.en: Experience needs to be accumulated slowly.

累积.zh: 他每天存钱，几年下来累积了不少。
累积.en: He saves money every day, and over a few years he has accumulated quite a bit.

累积.zh: 工作压力累积太多，对身体不好。
累积.en: Accumulating too much work stress is bad for your health.

累积.zh: 虽然每次只学一点，但累积起来就很多了。
累积.en: Although you only learn a little each time, it adds up to a lot.

累积.zh: 灰尘累积在电脑里会影响散热。
累积.en: Dust accumulating inside the computer affects heat dissipation.

静止.zh: 车子完全静止后才可以开门。
静止.en: You can only open the door after the car has come to a complete stop.

静止.zh: 画面突然静止了，原来是卡住了。
静止.en: The screen suddenly froze; turns out it was stuck.

静止.zh: 如果你一直静止不动，肌肉会僵硬。
静止.en: If you keep completely still, your muscles will get stiff.

静止.zh: 湖面一片静止，连波纹都没有。
静止.en: The lake surface was perfectly still, without even a ripple.

拴.zh: 他把马拴在树上，然后去休息。
拴.en: He tied the horse to a tree and then went to rest.
The rope isn't tied tightly, it could come loose easily.

拴.zh: 因为风大，所以要把帐篷拴牢固。
拴.en: Because the wind is strong, you need to secure the tent firmly.

拴.zh: 她把手提包拴在手腕上，防止被偷。
拴.en: She tied her handbag to her wrist to prevent theft.

拱.en: The pig roots the ground with its snout.
The kitten burrowed into the quilt to keep warm.

拱.zh: 桥拱很高，船可以轻松通过。
拱.en: The arch of the bridge is high, so boats can pass through easily.

拱.zh: 虽然路很窄，但拖拉机还是拱过去了。
拱.en: Although the road was narrow, the tractor still squeezed through.
He arched his back to try to scare someone.

荧光.zh: 这种鱼在黑暗里会发出荧光。
荧光.en: This kind of fish glows in the dark.

荧光.zh: 荧光棒是演唱会必备的。
荧光.en: Glow sticks are a must-have at concerts.

荧光.zh: 因为荧光涂料反光，所以夜间更安全。
荧光.en: Because the fluorescent paint reflects light, it's safer at night.

荧光.zh: 她用荧光色的指甲油，很显眼。
荧光.en: She wears fluorescent nail polish, which is very eye-catching.

观测.zh: 科学家用望远镜观测星空。
观测.en: Scientists use telescopes to observe the stars.

观测.zh: 这个站点专门观测地震。
观测.en: This station specializes in earthquake observation.

观测.zh: 如果连续观测几天，就能看出规律。
观测.en: If you observe continuously for a few days, you can see a pattern.

观测.zh: 她细心观测鸟类的活动，记录数据。
观测.en: She carefully observed the birds' activities and recorded data.

妒忌.zh: 看到朋友升职，他心里很妒忌。
妒忌.en: Seeing his friend get promoted, he felt very jealous.

妒忌.zh: 妒忌只会让自己不开心。
虽然嘴上不说，但她其实很妒忌。
妒忌.en: Although she doesn't say it, she is actually very jealous.

妒忌.zh: 别因为妒忌而说别人的坏话。
妒忌.en: Don't badmouth others out of jealousy.

到头来.en: In the end, it's still like this.

到头来.zh: 他忙了半天，到头来什么都没做成。
到头来.en: He was busy for a long time, but in the end he accomplished nothing.

到头来.zh: 别想太多，到头来只会更累。
到头来.en: Don't overthink it; in the end it will just make you more tired.

到头来.zh: 就算你再努力，到头来也可能失败。
到头来.en: Even if you try your best, you might still fail in the end.

到头来.zh: 我以为能省时间，到头来反而更慢了。
到头来.en: I thought it would save time, but it ended up being even slower.
