缕.en: A ray of sunlight shines in.
She has a strand of white hair on her head.
A wisp of smoke slowly dissipates.

缕.zh: 虽然只有一缕微风，但感觉凉快多了。
缕.en: Although there was only a gentle breeze, it felt much cooler.
He is holding a strand of silk thread in his hand.

发呆.zh: 上课不要发呆，要认真听讲。
发呆.en: Don't zone out in class; listen carefully.

发呆.zh: 她坐在窗前发呆，不知道在想什么。
发呆.en: She sat by the window staring blankly, not knowing what she was thinking.

发呆.zh: 因为太累了，他坐着就发呆。
发呆.en: Because he was so tired, he just sat there spacing out.

发呆.zh: 发呆有时候也是一种放松。
发呆.en: Sometimes zoning out is also a way to relax.

连同.en: I went together with a friend.

连同.zh: 他把书连同笔记本一起带来了。
连同.en: He brought the books along with the notebook.

连同.zh: 我把手机连同充电器都放进包里了。
连同.en: I put the phone together with the charger into the bag.

连同.zh: 不但要带证件，连同照片也要准备。
连同.en: Not only bring ID, but also photos along with it.

连同.zh: 这次事故连同之前的失误，让他很自责。
连同.en: This accident along with previous mistakes made him feel guilty.

输液.en: He has a cold, getting IV.

输液.zh: 医生说我需要输液三天才能好。
输液.en: The doctor said I need IV for three days to recover.

输液.zh: 输液的时候最好不要乱动。
输液.en: Better not move around during IV.

输液.zh: 因为发烧不退，所以只能输液治疗。
输液.en: Because the fever won't go down, so only IV treatment is possible.

输液.zh: 小朋友怕输液，一直哭闹。
输液.en: The child is afraid of IV, crying and fussing.

自卑.zh: 她因为长得矮而感到自卑。
自卑.en: She feels inferior because she is short.

自卑.zh: 不要总是自卑，你也很优秀。
自卑.en: Don't always be self-abased, you are also excellent.

自卑.zh: 虽然成绩好，但他还是很自卑。
自卑.en: Although his grades are good, he still feels inferior.

自卑.zh: 自卑心理会影响正常社交。
自卑.en: Inferiority complex can affect normal social interaction.

说到底.en: After all, it's a money problem.

说到底.zh: 说到底，学习要靠自己努力。
说到底.en: In the final analysis, studying depends on your own effort.

说到底.zh: 这件事说到底是你不对。
说到底.en: When it comes down to it, you are wrong.

说到底.zh: 不管怎么解释，说到底他就是不想去。
说到底.en: No matter how he explains, in the end he just doesn't want to go.

说到底.zh: 说到底，健康才是最重要的。
说到底.en: After all, health is the most important.

发电机.zh: 停电的时候，我们用发电机供电。
发电机.en: When the power goes out, we use a generator for electricity.

发电机.zh: 这台发电机声音太大了。
如果停电，柴油发电机就可以派上用场。
发电机.en: If power goes out, the diesel generator can be used.

发电机.zh: 工厂需要大型发电机来维持生产。
发电机.en: The factory needs a large generator to maintain production.

圈套.en: Watch out, this is a trap.

圈套.zh: 他设了个圈套让对手往里跳。
圈套.en: He set a trap for his opponent to fall into.

圈套.zh: 别上他的当，这是个圈套。
圈套.en: Don't be fooled by him, it's a trap.

圈套.zh: 虽然看起来很诱人，但其实是个圈套。
圈套.en: Although it looks tempting, it's actually a trap.

圈套.zh: 警察识破了骗子的圈套。
圈套.en: The police saw through the scammer's trap.

仲裁.en: They applied for arbitration to resolve.

仲裁.zh: 双方同意通过仲裁来解决纠纷。
仲裁.en: Both parties agreed to resolve the dispute through arbitration.

仲裁.zh: 仲裁结果具有法律效力。
仲裁.en: The arbitration result has legal effect.

仲裁.zh: 因为调解失败，只能走仲裁程序。
仲裁.en: Because mediation failed, they have to go through arbitration procedures.

仲裁.zh: 劳动仲裁是解决劳资纠纷的一种方式。
仲裁.en: Labor arbitration is one way to resolve labor disputes.

议题.zh: 会议的第一个议题是预算问题。
议题.en: The first agenda item is the budget issue.

议题.zh: 这个议题大家都很关心。
议题.en: Everyone is very concerned about this topic.

议题.zh: 除了主要议题，还有几个小问题要讨论。
议题.en: Besides the main topics, there are a few small issues to discuss.

议题.zh: 我们需要把议题提前通知大家。
议题.en: We need to notify everyone of the agenda in advance.

触犯.zh: 这种行为会触犯公司规定。
触犯.en: This behavior will violate company rules.

触犯.zh: 如果你不听劝告，就会触犯法规。
触犯.en: If you don't listen to advice, you will violate regulations.

触犯.zh: 他因为触犯校规被处分了。
触犯.en: He was disciplined because he violated school rules.

茫然.zh: 我问他问题，他茫然地看着我。
茫然.en: I asked him a question, and he looked at me blankly.

茫然.zh: 面对未来，我感到很茫然。
茫然.en: Facing the future, I feel at a loss.

茫然.zh: 虽然听了很久，但他还是茫然不解。
茫然.en: Although he listened for a long time, he was still bewildered and didn't understand.

茫然.zh: 在陌生的城市里，她茫然不知所措。
茫然.en: In a strange city, she was at a loss and didn't know what to do.

身躯.en: Her body is flexible, suitable for dancing.

身躯.zh: 老人身躯佝偻，慢慢走着。
身躯.en: The old man's body was stooped as he walked slowly.

身躯.zh: 因为长期锻炼，他的身躯变得非常结实。
身躯.en: Because of long-term exercise, his body has become very sturdy.

身躯.zh: 虽然身躯瘦小，但他力气很大。
身躯.en: Although his body is small and thin, he has great strength.

连锁店.en: This chain store has very good business.

连锁店.zh: 我们公司开了五家连锁店。
连锁店.en: Our company has opened five chain stores.

连锁店.zh: 我经常去那家连锁店买东西，因为价格便宜。
连锁店.en: I often go to that chain store to shop because the prices are cheap.

连锁店.zh: 虽然是个连锁店，但服务态度很差。
连锁店.en: Although it is a chain store, the service attitude is very bad.

连锁店.zh: 肯德基是全球知名的快餐连锁店。
连锁店.en: KFC is a world-famous fast food chain store.

留恋.en: I am very reluctant to leave here.

留恋.zh: 毕业时，大家都非常留恋校园的生活。
留恋.en: When we graduated, everyone was very reluctant to leave campus life.
He cherishes the mountains and rivers of his hometown.

留恋.zh: 因为在这里住了十年，所以我对这个城市很留恋。
留恋.en: Because I lived here for ten years, I am very reluctant to leave this city.

留恋.zh: 虽然走了，但我仍留恋那段时光。
留恋.en: Although I left, I still cherish that time.

一举一动.zh: 他的一举一动都很优雅。
一举一动.en: His every move is very elegant.

一举一动.zh: 老板的一举一动都被员工看在眼里。
一举一动.en: The boss's every move is noticed by the employees.

一举一动.zh: 父母的一举一动都会影响孩子的成长。
一举一动.en: Every move of parents will affect their children's growth.

一举一动.zh: 在面试时，你的一举一动都很重要。
一举一动.en: During an interview, your every move is very important.

一举一动.zh: 她的一举一动都透露出自信。

竭力.en: I will do my utmost to help him.

竭力.zh: 他竭力解释，但没人相信。
竭力.en: He tried his best to explain, but no one believed him.
The doctor did his utmost to save the patient.

竭力.zh: 虽然时间很短，但我们会竭力完成任务。
竭力.en: Although the time is very short, we will do our utmost to complete the task.
She did her utmost to hold back tears.

主妇.zh: 很多主妇每天要照顾孩子和做家务。
主妇.en: Many housewives take care of children and do housework every day.

主妇.zh: 虽然她是主妇，但她也有自己的兴趣爱好。
主妇.en: Although she is a housewife, she also has her own hobbies.

主妇.zh: 这位主妇做的菜很好吃。
主妇.en: The dishes made by this housewife are very delicious.

主妇.zh: 主妇们常常一起去超市买菜。
主妇.en: Housewives often go to the supermarket together to buy groceries.

阻挠.zh: 他们阻挠了这次计划的实施。
阻挠.en: They obstructed the implementation of this plan.

阻挠.zh: 由于政府的阻挠，项目无法进行。
阻挠.en: Due to government obstruction, the project cannot proceed.

阻挠.en: He tried to obstruct our meeting, but did not succeed.

阻挠.zh: 任何阻挠都不能改变我们的决定。
阻挠.en: No obstruction can change our decision.

迄今.en: Although I tried many times, so far I have not succeeded.

迄今.zh: 这项技术迄今仍在使用。
迄今.en: This technology is still in use to this day.

迄今.en: Up to now, he hasn't given me any news.

按键.zh: 遥控器上的按键有些失灵了。

按键.en: If the button doesn't respond, it might be that the battery is dead.

按键.zh: 电梯的按键很容易积灰。

关头.en: It has come to a critical moment.

关头.zh: 在这个关头，我们不能放弃。
关头.en: At this critical juncture, we cannot give up.

关头.zh: 生死关头，他选择了勇敢。
关头.en: At the moment of life and death, he chose bravery.

关头.zh: 每次关头他都表现得很好。
关头.en: He performs well at every critical moment.

伴奏.zh: 他弹吉他伴奏，我们大家一起合唱。
伴奏.en: He plays guitar accompaniment, and we all sing together.

伴奏.zh: 没有伴奏的话，这首歌听起来很单调。
伴奏.en: Without accompaniment, this song sounds very plain.

伴奏.zh: 虽然伴奏很简单，但整体效果很好。
伴奏.en: Although the accompaniment is simple, the overall effect is good.

伴奏.zh: 我用手机放伴奏然后练习唱歌。
伴奏.en: I play the accompaniment on my phone and then practice singing.

失灵.zh: 我的手机突然失灵了，不能开机。
失灵.en: My phone suddenly malfunctioned and won't turn on.

失灵.zh: 因为系统失灵，我们只能手动操作。
失灵.en: Because the system failed, we had to operate manually.

失灵.zh: 刹车失灵的时候别慌，慢慢减速。
失灵.en: When the brakes fail, don't panic; slow down gradually.

失灵.zh: 这个开关失灵了，怎么按都没反应。
失灵.en: This switch is broken; no matter how you press it, there's no response.

凝视.zh: 她凝视着那张旧照片，想起了很多事。
凝视.en: She stared at that old photo and remembered many things.

凝视.zh: 医生凝视着X光片，仔细检查。
凝视.en: The doctor gazed at the X-ray film, examining it carefully.

凝视.zh: 虽然她一直在凝视窗外，但什么也没看到。
凝视.en: Although she kept staring out the window, she didn't see anything.

凝视.zh: 别老凝视着我，怪吓人的。
凝视.en: Don't keep staring at me; it's creepy.

木偶.zh: 孩子们在玩木偶戏，笑得非常开心。
木偶.en: The kids are playing with puppets, laughing very happily.

木偶.zh: 那个木偶的表情特别生动。
木偶.en: That puppet's expression is especially vivid.

木偶.zh: 他像木偶一样，完全听别人指挥。
木偶.en: He's like a puppet, completely following others' orders.

木偶.zh: 这个木偶是用木头手工做的。
木偶.en: This puppet is handmade from wood.

无赖.zh: 那个无赖又在街上骗人了。
无赖.en: That scoundrel is cheating people on the street again.

无赖.zh: 别跟那种无赖打交道，没好处。
无赖.en: Don't deal with that kind of rogue; there's no benefit.

无赖.zh: 他虽然是个无赖，但对我还挺讲义气。
无赖.en: Although he's a rascal, he's still quite loyal to me.

无赖.zh: 遇到无赖的时候，最好别硬碰硬。
无赖.en: When you encounter a scoundrel, it's best not to confront them head-on.

诉说.en: He is pouring out his heart.

诉说.zh: 她向朋友诉说自己最近的烦恼。
诉说.en: She told her friend about her recent troubles.

诉说.zh: 老人诉说着当年打仗的故事。
诉说.en: The old man recounted stories of the war back then.

诉说.zh: 他一边流泪一边诉说心里的委屈。
诉说.en: He cried while pouring out the grievances in his heart.

诉说.zh: 这首歌诉说着爱情的美好。
诉说.en: This song tells of the beauty of love.

折叠.zh: 这个椅子可以折叠起来放旁边。
折叠.en: This chair can be folded up and put aside.

折叠.zh: 折叠好的被子放在床尾。
折叠.en: The folded quilt is placed at the foot of the bed.

折叠.zh: 因为空间太小，我买了折叠桌。
折叠.en: Because the space was too small, I bought a folding table.

折叠.zh: 注意不要折叠这张重要的文件。
折叠.en: Be careful not to fold this important document.

重型.zh: 工地上停了好几辆重型机械。
重型.en: Several heavy machines are parked at the construction site.

重型.zh: 这种重型武器威力非常大，杀伤力很强。
重型.en: This type of heavy weapon is extremely powerful and highly lethal.

重型.zh: 因为路太窄，重型货车过不去。
重型.en: Because the road is too narrow, the heavy truck can't get through.

重型.zh: 他开了一间重型设备租赁公司。
重型.en: He runs a heavy equipment rental company.

秘方.en: This is my family's secret recipe.

秘方.zh: 奶奶有一个炖汤的秘方，特别好喝。
秘方.en: Grandma has a secret recipe for stewed soup that's especially delicious.

秘方.zh: 这种药的秘方从来没有公开过。
秘方.en: The secret formula for this medicine has never been made public.

秘方.zh: 虽然我知道秘方，但我不打算告诉别人。
秘方.en: Although I know the secret recipe, I don't plan to tell anyone.

秘方.zh: 他花了很多钱买那个做生意的秘方。
秘方.en: He spent a lot of money to buy that secret formula for doing business.

帝国主义.zh: 帝国主义曾经侵略过很多国家。
老师今天讲了帝国主义的危害。
帝国主义.en: The teacher talked about the dangers of imperialism today.

帝国主义.zh: 虽然帝国主义不流行了，但影响还在。
帝国主义.en: Although imperialism is no longer in vogue, its influence remains.

帝国主义.zh: 这本书批判了帝国主义的扩张政策。
帝国主义.en: This book criticizes the expansionist policies of imperialism.

轻而易举.zh: 这件事对他来说轻而易举。
轻而易举.en: This matter is a piece of cake for him.

轻而易举.zh: 别以为减肥是轻而易举的事。
轻而易举.en: Don't think losing weight is an easy thing.

轻而易举.zh: 他轻而易举地解开了那个复杂的谜题。
轻而易举.en: He solved that complicated puzzle with ease.

轻而易举.zh: 虽然看起来很难，但其实做起来轻而易举。
轻而易举.en: Although it looks difficult, it's actually very easy to do.

轻而易举.zh: 她轻而易举地通过了考试，连书都没怎么翻。
轻而易举.en: She passed the exam effortlessly, barely even opening a book.

地段.en: Property prices in this area are very high.

地段.zh: 选餐厅要看地段好不好。
地段.en: Choosing a restaurant depends on whether the location is good.

地段.zh: 这家店地段不错，人流量很大。
地段.en: This shop has a good location with a lot of foot traffic.

地段.zh: 虽然地段偏了点，但房租便宜很多。
地段.en: Although the location is a bit remote, the rent is much cheaper.

地段.zh: 我们找房子的时候，地段是首要考虑的因素。
地段.en: When we look for a house, location is the primary factor to consider.

吹牛.en: He loves to brag the most.

吹牛.zh: 别听他吹牛，根本没那回事。
吹牛.en: Don't listen to his boasting; it's not true at all.

吹牛.zh: 吹牛又不犯法，但容易让人讨厌。
吹牛.en: Bragging is not illegal, but it easily makes people dislike you.

吹牛.zh: 他吹牛说自己一个月能赚十万块。
吹牛.en: He boasted that he could earn 100,000 yuan a month.

吹牛.zh: 你吹牛的样子真的很搞笑，大家都知道你做不到。
吹牛.en: The way you brag is really funny; everyone knows you can't do it.

掀.en: The wind blew the roof off.
He lifted the lid of the pot and took a look.
Don't flip the table; let's talk calmly.

掀.zh: 这场比赛掀起了全场的高潮。
掀.en: This game sparked the climax of the whole crowd.

掀.zh: 他用力一掀，把整个床垫都翻了过来。
掀.en: He gave a hard lift and flipped the entire mattress over.

盗版.en: Buying pirated books is actually not cost-effective.

盗版.zh: 这个游戏有盗版，但体验很差。
盗版.en: This game has a pirated version, but the experience is terrible.

盗版.zh: 现在打击盗版电影抓得很严。
盗版.en: Cracking down on pirated movies is very strict now.

盗版.zh: 虽然盗版便宜，但支持正版才是长久之道。
盗版.en: Although pirated versions are cheap, supporting genuine products is the long-term way.

脾.zh: 我脾虚，医生让我注意饮食。
脾.en: I have a weak spleen; the doctor told me to watch my diet.

脾.zh: 她的脾性很温和，从不发火。
脾.en: Her temperament is very gentle; she never loses her temper.

脾.zh: 中医说养脾要吃山药和红枣。
脾.en: Chinese medicine says to nourish the spleen by eating yams and red dates.

脾.zh: 你别总是发脾气，对身体和脾都不好。
脾.en: Don't always lose your temper; it's bad for your health and your spleen.

顾及.zh: 你也要顾及一下别人的面子。
顾及.en: You should also consider other people's face.

顾及.zh: 工作太忙，都顾不上顾及家庭了。
顾及.en: Work is too busy; I can't even take care of family matters.

顾及.zh: 他说话太直，从不顾及场合。
顾及.en: He speaks too bluntly and never considers the occasion.

顾及.zh: 做决定前要顾及所有人的意见，不能太自私。
顾及.en: Before making a decision, you need to consider everyone's opinions; don't be too selfish.

逼真.zh: 这个假花做得特别逼真。
逼真.en: This artificial flower looks extremely realistic.

逼真.zh: 他的演技很逼真，看得我哭了。
逼真.en: His acting is so realistic that it made me cry.

逼真.zh: 这幅画太逼真了，简直像照片一样。
逼真.en: This painting is so lifelike, it's just like a photo.

逼真.zh: 那个特效做得不够逼真，一眼就能看出来。
逼真.en: That special effect wasn't realistic enough; you could tell at a glance.

逼真.zh: 这个游戏画面非常逼真，让人有身临其境的感觉。
逼真.en: The graphics of this game are very realistic, giving you a sense of being there.

无偿.zh: 志愿者提供了无偿服务。
虽然是无偿的，但大家都很用心。
无偿.en: Although it's unpaid, everyone put in a lot of effort.

无偿.zh: 他们义务劳动，无偿为社区修路。
无偿.en: They worked as volunteers, repairing roads for the community for free.

世界级.zh: 他的水平已经是世界级了。
这家酒店提供世界级的服务。
我们想打造一个世界级的品牌。
世界级.en: We want to build a world-class brand.

世界级.zh: 虽然起步晚，但他们的目标是要做到世界级。
世界级.en: Although they started late, their goal is to become world-class.

当日.en: I received the express delivery on that same day.

当日.zh: 当日的事情你别再提了。
当日.en: Don't bring up what happened that day anymore.

当日.zh: 我们当日买完票就直接进场了。
当日.en: We bought the tickets and went straight in that same day.

当日.zh: 他虽然当日没来，但后来补了假。
当日.en: He didn't come that day, but he made up for it later.

当日.zh: 你记得当日我们第一次见面时你穿什么吗？
当日.en: Do you remember what you wore that day when we first met?

遵照.en: Please take the medicine according to the doctor's advice.
He paid the fine in accordance with the regulations.

遵照.zh: 我们得遵照合同办事，不能乱来。
遵照.en: We have to follow the contract and not act recklessly.

遵照.zh: 老师让我们遵照指示完成实验，结果很顺利。
遵照.en: The teacher told us to follow the instructions for the experiment, and it went smoothly.

遵照.zh: 你不用完全遵照我的方法，有自己的想法也可以。
遵照.en: You don't have to strictly follow my method; it's okay to have your own ideas.

花瓣.en: Petals fell all over the ground.
The petals of this flower are particularly thick.

花瓣.zh: 风吹过来，花瓣飘到了我的肩膀上。
花瓣.en: The wind blew, and petals drifted onto my shoulder.

花瓣.zh: 她喜欢把花瓣晒干后泡茶喝。
花瓣.en: She likes to dry the petals and then brew them into tea.

花瓣.zh: 虽然花瓣很美，但花期太短了。
花瓣.en: Although the petals are beautiful, the blooming period is too short.

性情.zh: 这匹马性情很烈，不好骑。
性情.en: This horse has a fierce temperament and is hard to ride.

性情.zh: 他性情大变，跟以前完全不一样了。
性情.en: His temperament changed drastically, completely different from before.

性情.zh: 养宠物要看它的性情，不然容易闹矛盾。
性情.en: When getting a pet, you need to consider its temperament, or conflicts may arise.

性情.zh: 她虽然表面冷淡，但其实性情很热情。
性情.en: Although she seems cold on the surface, she actually has a warm temperament.

豆子.en: He grabbed a handful of beans to feed the chickens.

豆子.zh: 超市的豆子今天打折，我买了好多。
豆子.en: The beans at the supermarket are on sale today, so I bought a lot.

豆子.zh: 我不小心把豆子撒了一地，捡了半天。
豆子.en: I accidentally spilled beans all over the floor and spent a long time picking them up.

豆子.zh: 虽然豆子营养好，但吃多了容易胀气。
豆子.en: Although beans are nutritious, eating too many can cause gas.

腺.en: His sweat glands are very developed.

腺.zh: 唾液腺发炎了，吃东西很疼。
腺.en: The salivary glands are inflamed, and it hurts to eat.

腺.zh: 医生说我甲状腺有点问题，需要复查。
腺.en: The doctor said there's a slight issue with my thyroid gland, and I need a follow-up.

腺.zh: 乳腺检查很重要，女性要定期做。
腺.en: Breast gland exams are very important; women should have them regularly.

腺.zh: 他因为泪腺堵塞，总是莫名其妙流眼泪。
腺.en: He often tears up for no reason because of a blocked tear duct gland.

羞愧.en: He lowered his head in shame.

羞愧.zh: 考试作弊被抓，她感到非常羞愧。
羞愧.en: She felt very ashamed when caught cheating on the exam.

羞愧.zh: 说谎之后，他心里一直很羞愧。
羞愧.en: After telling a lie, he felt ashamed inside for a long time.

羞愧.zh: 虽然她做了错事，但羞愧得不敢见人。
羞愧.en: Although she did something wrong, she was too ashamed to face anyone.

羞愧.zh: 他不但不羞愧，反而觉得自己很厉害。
羞愧.en: Not only did he feel no shame, but he actually thought he was great.

聘用.zh: 公司聘用了一位新经理。
聘用.en: The company hired a new manager.

聘用.zh: 他们决定聘用有经验的设计师。
聘用.en: They decided to hire an experienced designer.

聘用.zh: 聘用你之前我们需要做背景调查。
聘用.en: Before hiring you, we need to do a background check.

聘用.zh: 这家公司聘用员工很严格，要通过三轮面试。
聘用.en: This company is very strict about hiring, requiring three rounds of interviews.

聘用.zh: 虽然他没有高学历，但能力很强，所以被聘用了。
聘用.en: Although he doesn't have a high degree, he is very capable, so he was hired.

精品.en: This is the boutique item in the store.

精品.zh: 她只买精品，从不贪便宜。
精品.en: She only buys high-quality products and never goes for cheap stuff.

精品.zh: 这件衣服做工精细，算是精品了。
精品.en: This piece of clothing is finely made, truly a quality item.

精品.zh: 商场里有很多精品店，但价格都不便宜。
精品.en: There are many boutique stores in the mall, but the prices are not cheap.

精品.zh: 他虽然卖的是二手货，但件件都是精品。
精品.en: Although he sells second-hand items, every piece is a top-quality find.

小看.zh: 你小看我了，我会修电脑。
小看.en: You underestimate me; I can fix computers.

小看.zh: 他小看这道题的难度，结果做错了。
小看.en: He underestimated the difficulty of the problem and ended up getting it wrong.

小看.zh: 虽然她年纪小，但能力很强，千万别小看她。
小看.en: Although she is young, she is very capable; don't underestimate her.

小看.zh: 你总是小看别人，最后吃亏的是自己。
小看.en: You always look down on others, but in the end, you're the one who suffers.

快活.zh: 他每天下班后都过得很快活。
快活.en: He lives happily after work every day.

快活.zh: 虽然工作很累，但心里很快活。
快活.en: Although work is tiring, I feel happy inside.

快活.zh: 孩子们在公园里玩得快活极了。
快活.en: The kids are playing extremely happily in the park.

快活.zh: 周末和朋友一起吃饭，特别快活。
快活.en: Eating with friends on weekends is especially joyful.

负有.zh: 作为队长，他负有带领团队的任务。
负有.en: As captain, he has the task of leading the team.

负有.zh: 如果出了事故，公司要负有很大的法律责任。
负有.en: If an accident occurs, the company bears significant legal responsibility.

负有.zh: 警察负有保护市民安全的职责。
负有.en: Police have the duty to protect citizens' safety.

负有.zh: 每个公民都负有遵守法律的义务。
负有.en: Every citizen bears the obligation to obey the law.

莫过于.zh: 人生最大的幸福莫过于和家人在一起。
莫过于.en: The greatest happiness in life is nothing more than being with family.

莫过于.zh: 对他来说，最难受的事莫过于被人误解。
莫过于.en: For him, the most uncomfortable thing is nothing more than being misunderstood.

莫过于.zh: 考试前最紧张的时刻莫过于等待成绩。
莫过于.en: The most tense moment before an exam is nothing more than waiting for results.

莫过于.zh: 她认为最美的景色莫过于日出。
莫过于.en: She thinks the most beautiful scenery is nothing more than sunrise.

轻视.zh: 他因为轻视对方的实力而输掉了比赛。
轻视.en: He lost the match because he underestimated the opponent's strength.

轻视.zh: 虽然她年纪小，但你不能轻视她的能力。
轻视.en: Although she is young, you cannot underestimate her ability.

轻视.zh: 很多人常常轻视日常锻炼的重要性。
轻视.en: Many people often underestimate the importance of daily exercise.

轻视.zh: 工作不分贵贱，我们不应该轻视任何职业。
轻视.en: Jobs are not noble or humble; we should not look down on any profession.

当众.zh: 她不敢在会议上当众发言。
当众.en: She dares not speak in public at the meeting.

当众.zh: 如果你做错了，就当众承认错误。
当众.en: If you made a mistake, then admit it publicly.

当众.zh: 当众批评别人会让他很难堪。
当众.en: Criticizing someone in public will embarrass them.

当众.zh: 明星们常常当众秀恩爱。
当众.en: Celebrities often show affection in public.

好意.zh: 他虽然拒绝了我的好意，但我理解他。
好意.en: Although he refused my kindness, I understand him.

好意.zh: 她的一片好意，却被对方误解了。
好意.en: Her good intentions were misunderstood by the other party.

好意.zh: 我们不应该把别人的好意当成理所当然。
好意.en: We should not take others' kindness for granted.

好意.zh: 他接受了好意的帮助，并表示感谢。
好意.en: He accepted the kind help and expressed gratitude.

光泽.zh: 这种木材表面有一种自然的光泽。
光泽.en: This type of wood has a natural luster on its surface.

光泽.zh: 虽然用了很久，但这件皮衣仍然保持光泽。
光泽.en: Although used for a long time, this leather jacket still maintains its luster.

光泽.zh: 阳光照在湖面上，泛起一层银色的光泽。
光泽.en: Sunlight shines on the lake, causing a layer of silver luster.

光泽.zh: 珠宝的光泽吸引了所有人的目光。
光泽.en: The luster of the jewelry attracted everyone's attention.

演练.zh: 部队经常进行实战演练来提高战斗力。
演练.en: The military often conducts actual combat drills to improve combat effectiveness.

演练.zh: 如果演练顺利，比赛就不会出问题。
演练.en: If the rehearsal goes smoothly, the competition won't have problems.

演练.zh: 老师们在课堂前会先演练一遍教案。
演练.en: Teachers will rehearse the lesson plan once before class.

演练.zh: 紧急疏散演练对于学校来说非常重要。
演练.en: Emergency evacuation drills are very important for schools.

专卖店.zh: 这里有一家品牌专卖店。
专卖店.en: There is a brand specialty store here.

专卖店.zh: 我一般在官方专卖店买手机，质量有保障。
专卖店.en: I usually buy phones at the official specialty store; quality is guaranteed.

专卖店.zh: 虽然网上便宜，但专卖店的服务更好。
专卖店.en: Although online is cheaper, the specialty store service is better.

专卖店.zh: 这家运动品牌的专卖店最近在打折。
专卖店.en: This sports brand's specialty store is having a sale recently.

专卖店.zh: 他开了一家茶叶专卖店，生意很不错。
专卖店.en: He opened a tea specialty store, and business is quite good.

停顿.zh: 演出中间有一个短暂的停顿，观众都以为出错了。
停顿.en: There was a brief pause in the middle of the performance; the audience thought something went wrong.

停顿.zh: 因为机器故障，生产停顿了两个小时。
停顿.en: Due to a machine malfunction, production paused for two hours.

停顿.zh: 他停顿了一下，然后继续往下说。
停顿.en: He paused for a moment, then continued speaking.

停顿.zh: 学习不能经常停顿，否则容易忘记。
停顿.en: Studying cannot have frequent pauses, otherwise you easily forget.

呐喊.zh: 他呐喊了几声，没人回应。
呐喊.en: He shouted a few times, but no one responded.

呐喊.zh: 观众们一起呐喊，为球队加油。
呐喊.en: The audience shouted together to cheer for the team.

呐喊.zh: 他在山顶上呐喊，感觉特别痛快。
呐喊.en: He shouted on the mountaintop and felt especially relieved.

呐喊.zh: 虽然他很想呐喊，但为了不打扰别人还是忍住了。
呐喊.en: Although he really wanted to shout, he held back so as not to disturb others.

呐喊.zh: 听到这个消息，她忍不住呐喊出来。
呐喊.en: Upon hearing this news, she couldn't help but shout out.

相继.en: They left the room one after another.

相继.zh: 这几天，公司相继有人辞职。
相继.en: In the past few days, people at the company have resigned one after another.

相继.zh: 事故发生后，乘客们相继被救出来。
相继.en: After the accident, the passengers were rescued one after another.

相继.zh: 春天来了，各种花相继开放，非常漂亮。
相继.en: Spring has come, and various flowers have bloomed one after another, very beautiful.

相继.zh: 他们俩相继考上了名牌大学，家里人都很高兴。
相继.en: The two of them got into prestigious universities one after another, and the whole family was very happy.

发扬.en: We must carry forward this spirit.

发扬.zh: 公司一直发扬创新传统，做得不错。
发扬.en: The company has always carried forward the tradition of innovation and does well.

发扬.zh: 老师鼓励我们发扬自己的优点。
发扬.en: The teacher encouraged us to develop our own strengths.

发扬.zh: 在这个团队里，大家都努力发扬合作精神。
发扬.en: In this team, everyone works hard to promote a spirit of cooperation.

发扬.zh: 他不仅自己进步，还帮助别人，把好作风发扬下去了。
发扬.en: He not only improved himself but also helped others, passing on a good style.

纵容.en: Don't indulge children in spending money recklessly.

纵容.zh: 她总是纵容自己的坏习惯。
纵容.en: She always indulges her bad habits.

纵容.zh: 老板纵容下属迟到，大家都有样学样。
纵容.en: The boss tolerated subordinates being late, so everyone followed suit.

纵容.zh: 家长如果纵容孩子撒谎，以后就很难管教了。
纵容.en: If parents allow children to lie, it will be hard to discipline them later.

纵容.zh: 我们不能纵容这种不公平的行为，必须站出来说话。
纵容.en: We cannot condone this unfair behavior; we must speak up.

分化.zh: 这两个问题不能分化处理。
分化.en: These two issues cannot be treated separately.

分化.zh: 社会阶层的分化越来越明显。
分化.en: The differentiation of social classes is becoming more and more obvious.

分化.zh: 他们用计谋分化了我们的团队。
分化.en: They used tricks to divide our team.

分化.zh: 随着经济发展，贫富分化的问题需要引起重视。
分化.en: With economic development, the problem of wealth polarization needs attention.

分化.zh: 老师把学生分成几个小组，避免他们分化注意力。
分化.en: The teacher divided the students into several groups to avoid splitting their attention.

拖累.zh: 他的病拖累了整个家庭。
拖累.en: His illness dragged down the entire family.

拖累.zh: 这个项目进展慢，主要是因为几个人的拖累。
拖累.en: The slow progress of this project is mainly due to the drag of a few people.

拖累.zh: 她不想因为自己的错误拖累朋友。
拖累.en: She doesn't want to burden her friends because of her own mistakes.

拖累.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他不想拖累儿女，坚持自己住。
拖累.en: Although he is old, he doesn't want to be a burden to his children and insists on living alone.

饮水.en: Remember to drink more water every day.

饮水.zh: 这个饮水机坏了，需要修。
饮水.en: This water dispenser is broken and needs repairs.

饮水.zh: 野外活动一定要带上充足的饮水。
饮水.en: For outdoor activities, be sure to bring enough drinking water.

饮水.zh: 我们办公室新安装了直饮水系统。
饮水.en: Our office has newly installed a direct drinking water system.

饮水.zh: 医生建议我每天饮水至少两升，对身体好。
饮水.en: The doctor advised me to drink at least two liters of water a day, which is good for health.

算计.en: He always likes to scheme against others.

算计.zh: 你别算计我，我没那么好骗。
算计.en: Don't try to plot against me; I'm not that easy to fool.

算计.zh: 做生意要精打细算，但不能算计朋友。
算计.en: In business, you need to be careful with money, but you shouldn't scheme against friends.

算计.zh: 她心里一直在算计怎么花这笔钱。
算计.en: She has been calculating in her mind how to spend this money.

算计.zh: 那些整天算计别人的人，最后往往自己吃亏。
算计.en: Those who scheme against others all day often end up suffering themselves.

果真.en: What you said is indeed correct.

果真.zh: 果真下雨了，还好带了伞。
果真.en: It really rained; luckily I brought an umbrella.

果真.zh: 他果真没有来，我早就猜到了。
果真.en: He really didn't come; I had guessed that long ago.

果真.zh: 如果事情果真如此，那我们得重新计划。
果真.en: If things really are like this, then we need to replan.

果真.zh: 我试了一下那个方法，果真有效！
果真.en: I tried that method, and it really worked!

鞠躬.zh: 演出结束后，演员们集体鞠躬谢幕。
鞠躬.en: After the performance, the actors bowed together to take a curtain call.

鞠躬.zh: 在日本，初次见面时常常会鞠躬。
鞠躬.en: In Japan, people often bow when meeting for the first time.

孕育.en: The Yellow River gave birth to Chinese civilization.

孕育.zh: 这片土地孕育了许多优秀的人才。
孕育.en: This land has nurtured many excellent talents.

孕育.zh: 因为气候温暖，这里孕育了丰富的动植物。
孕育.en: Because the climate is warm, this place nurtures abundant plants and animals.

孕育.zh: 他们的爱情孕育了一个可爱的孩子。
孕育.en: Their love gave birth to a lovely child.

孕育.zh: 长时间的思考孕育出一个创新的方案。
孕育.en: Long periods of thinking gave birth to an innovative plan.

退学.zh: 因为家里没钱，他只好退学去打工。
退学.en: Because the family had no money, he had to drop out and work.

退学.zh: 虽然成绩很好，但他还是选择了退学创业。
退学.en: Although his grades were good, he still chose to drop out to start a business.
After dropping out, she learned beauty skills.

退学.zh: 学校规定，连续旷课两周就会被退学。
退学.en: School regulations say that if you are absent for two weeks in a row, you will be expelled.

悠闲.en: He lives a very leisurely life.

悠闲.zh: 周末我喜欢在公园里悠闲地散步。
悠闲.en: On weekends I like to take a leisurely stroll in the park.

悠闲.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他总能找到悠闲的时光。
悠闲.en: Although work is busy, he always finds leisurely time.

悠闲.zh: 退休后，老两口过着悠闲的生活。
悠闲.en: After retirement, the old couple live a leisurely life.

悠闲.zh: 她坐在咖啡馆里，一边喝咖啡一边悠闲地看书。
悠闲.en: She sat in the cafe, leisurely reading a book while drinking coffee.

依次.zh: 乘客们依次排队登上飞机。
依次.en: Passengers lined up in order to board the plane.

依次.zh: 先到先得，我们依次领取号码。
依次.en: First come first served, we collect numbers in order.

依次.zh: 老师依次叫同学们回答问题。
依次.en: The teacher called on students to answer questions in order.

依次.zh: 这些文件需要依次编号，方便查找。
依次.en: These documents need to be numbered sequentially for easy searching.

专职.zh: 他是公司里的专职翻译。
专职.en: He is the company's full-time translator.

专职.zh: 这个岗位需要一名专职的财务人员。
专职.en: This position requires a full-time financial staff.

专职.zh: 虽然他是兼职，但比专职还认真。
专职.en: Although he is part-time, he is more serious than full-time employees.

专职.zh: 她辞了专职工作，开始做自由职业。
专职.en: She quit her full-time job and started freelancing.

专职.zh: 学校里配备了专职的心理辅导老师。
专职.en: The school is equipped with full-time psychological counseling teachers.

照耀.en: The sun shines upon the earth.

照耀.zh: 月光照耀着宁静的湖面。
照耀.en: Moonlight shines on the calm lake surface.

照耀.zh: 当阳光照耀时，整个山谷都亮了起来。
照耀.en: When the sun shines, the whole valley lights up.

照耀.zh: 灯光照耀着舞台上的演员。
照耀.en: The lights shine on the actors on stage.

照耀.zh: 希望的光芒永远照耀着我们前进的道路。
照耀.en: The light of hope forever illuminates the path ahead of us.

知足.zh: 虽然钱不多，但他很知足。
知足.en: Although he doesn't have much money, he is very content.

知足.zh: 如果不懂得知足，再多的财富也不会快乐。
知足.en: If you don't know contentment, no amount of wealth will make you happy.

知足.zh: 她对自己的生活很知足，从不抱怨。
知足.en: She is very content with her life and never complains.

知足.zh: 知足常乐，这句话说得很有道理。
知足.en: Contentment brings happiness; this saying makes a lot of sense.

前沿.en: This is the cutting edge of technology.

前沿.zh: 他们公司一直站在人工智能的前沿。
前沿.en: Their company has always been at the forefront of AI.

前沿.zh: 为了保持竞争力，他们不断探索前沿技术。
前沿.en: To stay competitive, they continuously explore cutting-edge technology.

前沿.zh: 他在医学前沿研究中取得了重大突破。
前沿.en: He made a major breakthrough in frontier medical research.

前沿.zh: 这个实验室专门研究量子物理的前沿问题。
前沿.en: This lab specializes in frontier issues in quantum physics.

客机.zh: 一架大型客机从机场起飞了。
客机.en: A large passenger plane took off from the airport.

客机.zh: 因为天气不好，客机暂时无法降落。
客机.en: Because of bad weather, the passenger plane cannot land temporarily.

客机.zh: 客机上有三百多名乘客。
客机.en: There are over 300 passengers on the passenger plane.

客机.zh: 他第一次坐客机出差，有点紧张。
客机.en: He was a bit nervous on his first business trip by passenger plane.

适时.zh: 这场雨来得非常适时，救了庄稼。
适时.en: This rain came very timely, saving the crops.

适时.zh: 只有适时调整策略，才能应对市场变化。
适时.en: Only by timely adjusting strategies can we respond to market changes.

适时.zh: 她适时地出现，帮了我大忙。
适时.en: She appeared at just the right time and helped me a lot.

适时.zh: 家长应该适时鼓励孩子，而不是一味批评。
适时.en: Parents should encourage their children at the right time, not just criticize.

制约.zh: 这个规则制约了我们的行动。
因为天气不好，外出被制约了。
制约.en: Because the weather is bad, going out is restricted.

制约.zh: 我们得想办法突破制约。
制约.en: We need to find ways to break through the constraints.

加盟.en: He decided to join that company.
This store joined as a franchise this year.
Joining a franchise chain requires paying a fee.

加盟.zh: 我们球队新加盟了一位球员。
加盟.en: Our team has a new player who just joined.

加盟.zh: 如果你有兴趣，可以申请加盟。
加盟.en: If you are interested, you can apply to join.

凶猛.en: His tone of speech is very fierce.

凶猛.zh: 虽然敌人凶猛，但我们不怕。
凶猛.en: Although the enemy is fierce, we are not afraid.

这会儿.en: I don't have time right now.
He should be at home right now.

这会儿.zh: 这会儿正好有空，我们聊聊吧。
这会儿.en: I happen to be free right now, let's chat.

留心.en: You need to watch your step.
When crossing the street, watch out for cars.

留心.zh: 我留心观察了很长时间。
留心.en: I observed carefully for a long time.

留心.zh: 你得多留心周围的情况。
留心.en: You need to pay more attention to your surroundings.

留心.zh: 因为路上很滑，你要特别留心。
留心.en: Because the road is slippery, you need to be especially careful.

低谷.en: His career has entered a low point.
This period is a low point.
We need to get through the low point together.

低谷.zh: 公司正在经历经济低谷。
低谷.en: The company is experiencing an economic trough.

低谷.zh: 虽然现在处于低谷，但我们要坚持。
低谷.en: Although we are at a low point now, we must persist.

外貌.en: She cares a lot about her appearance.
Appearance is not the most important thing.
Do we need to judge by appearance?

外貌.zh: 虽然外貌变了，但他的性格没变。
外貌.en: Although his appearance changed, his personality hasn't.

如实.en: You must tell the truth as it is.

如实.zh: 如果你不如实说，后果会很严重。
如实.en: If you don't tell the truth, the consequences will be serious.

裁员.en: The company is laying off employees recently.
This round of layoffs has a big impact.

裁员.zh: 听到裁员的消息，大家都很紧张。
裁员.en: Hearing the news of layoffs, everyone is very nervous.

裁员.zh: 因为效益不好，公司不得不裁员。
裁员.en: Because of poor performance, the company had to lay off staff.

向着.en: You should work toward your goal.

向着.zh: 不管别人怎么说，我都向着你。
向着.en: No matter what others say, I am on your side.

风范.en: He really has the demeanor of a master.

风范.zh: 她做事很有领导风范，大家都佩服。
风范.en: She has great leadership style, and everyone admires her.

风范.zh: 他虽然年轻，但已经有几分学者风范了。
风范.en: Although he is young, he already has some scholar's demeanor.

风范.zh: 他的风范让我想起了当年的老校长。
风范.en: His manner reminds me of the old principal back then.

风范.zh: 在这种场合，你要注意自己的风范。
风范.en: On such occasions, you should watch your demeanor.

弟子.zh: 这些弟子都来自全国各地。
弟子.en: These disciples come from all over the country.

弟子.zh: 作为师父的弟子，他学得很认真。
弟子.en: As the master's disciple, he studies very diligently.

弟子.zh: 他收了好几个弟子，个个都很优秀。
弟子.en: He has taken several disciples, and every one of them is excellent.

弟子.zh: 师父对弟子们要求很严格，但也很关心他们。
弟子.en: The master is strict with his disciples, but he also cares about them a lot.

喷泉.zh: 公园里有个漂亮的喷泉。
喷泉.en: There is a beautiful fountain in the park.
The children are playing in the water by the fountain.

喷泉.zh: 晚上喷泉会亮起彩色的灯。
喷泉.en: The fountain lights up with colorful lights in the evening.

喷泉.zh: 这个广场的喷泉是去年新建的。
喷泉.en: The fountain in this square was newly built last year.

喷泉.zh: 喷泉的水花随着音乐节奏变化，很好看。
喷泉.en: The fountain's spray changes with the rhythm of the music, it's very beautiful.

断绝.zh: 他们俩已经断绝来往了。
断绝.en: They have already cut off contact.

断绝.zh: 我和他断绝了所有联系。
断绝.en: I severed all ties with him.

断绝.zh: 因为误会，两家断绝了关系。
断绝.en: Because of a misunderstanding, the two families broke off relations.

断绝.zh: 战争让那条道路彻底断绝了。
断绝.en: The war completely cut off that road.

断绝.zh: 他决定和过去断绝一切瓜葛。
断绝.en: He decided to sever all entanglements with the past.

贯彻.en: We need to implement this policy.

贯彻.zh: 公司一直贯彻安全第一的原则。
贯彻.en: The company has always implemented the principle of safety first.

贯彻.zh: 他做事能贯彻到底，从不半途而废。
贯彻.en: He can carry things through to the end and never gives up halfway.

贯彻.zh: 上级要求我们彻底贯彻新规定。
贯彻.en: Superiors require us to fully implement the new regulations.

贯彻.zh: 只有贯彻好这些措施，才能解决问题。
贯彻.en: Only by properly implementing these measures can we solve the problem.

谋生.en: He makes a living by performing.
Many people go to big cities to make a living.

谋生.zh: 为了谋生，他什么苦都吃过。
谋生.en: To make a living, he has endured all kinds of hardships.

谋生.zh: 现在谋生比以前容易多了。
谋生.en: Making a living now is much easier than before.

谋生.zh: 她靠自己的手艺谋生，活得很有尊严。
谋生.en: She makes a living with her own skills and lives with great dignity.

灵敏.en: Dogs have a very keen sense of smell.

灵敏.zh: 她耳朵灵敏，能听出细微的声音。
灵敏.en: Her ears are sharp; she can hear subtle sounds.

灵敏.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他的头脑依然很灵敏。
灵敏.en: Although he is old, his mind is still very sharp.

落下.en: He accidentally left the book behind.
He fell far behind during the race.

落下.zh: 雨点落下来，地面很快就湿了。
落下.en: Raindrops fell, and the ground quickly got wet.

落下.zh: 太阳落下了山，天色渐渐暗了。
落下.en: The sun set behind the mountains, and it gradually got dark.

名副其实.zh: 他真是个名副其实的专家。
名副其实.en: He is truly a worthy expert.

名副其实.zh: 这家店名副其实，东西很好吃。
名副其实.en: This shop lives up to its name; the food is delicious.

名副其实.zh: 她被称为学霸，名副其实。
名副其实.en: She is called a top student, and she deserves the title.

名副其实.zh: 他的成就让他成为名副其实的领袖。
名副其实.en: His achievements make him a true leader in every sense.

名副其实.zh: 这座山名副其实，风景美极了。
名副其实.en: This mountain lives up to its name; the scenery is stunning.

比起.zh: 比起跑步，我更喜欢游泳。
比起.en: Compared to running, I prefer swimming.

比起.zh: 比起昨天，今天暖和多了。
比起.en: Compared to yesterday, today is much warmer.

比起.zh: 比起大城市，小城市生活更轻松。
比起.en: Compared to big cities, life in small towns is more relaxed.

比起.zh: 比起他的成绩，我的就差远了。
比起.en: Compared to his grades, mine are far behind.

比起.zh: 比起那些困难，我们的问题不算什么。
比起.en: Compared to those difficulties, our problems are nothing.

妥当.zh: 我觉得这个方案还不够妥当，需要再改一下。
妥当.en: I think this plan is not yet proper enough and needs revision.

妥当.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但我们已经把事情处理得很妥当。
妥当.en: Although time is tight, we have handled things very properly.

妥当.zh: 你最好把文件放回原处，那样才妥当。
妥当.en: You'd better put the documents back where they were, that's proper.

妥当.zh: 他把所有细节都考虑得很妥当。
妥当.en: He considered all the details very properly.

裸露.zh: 这里的地面因为施工裸露出了水泥。
裸露.en: The ground here is exposed with concrete due to construction.

裸露.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但他还是裸露着上身跑步。
裸露.en: Although it was very cold, he still ran with his upper body exposed.

裸露.zh: 这些电线裸露在外很危险。
裸露.en: These wires exposed outside are very dangerous.

裸露.zh: 裸露的皮肤要涂防晒霜。

公约.zh: 各国都签署了这项公约。
公约.en: All countries have signed this convention.

公约.zh: 这个国际公约旨在保护海洋环境。
公约.en: This international convention aims to protect the marine environment.

公约.zh: 根据公约规定，每个国家都有责任减少污染。
公约.en: According to the convention, each country has the responsibility to reduce pollution.

公约.zh: 我们小区有个居民公约。
公约.en: Our community has a residents' pact.

公约.zh: 这项公约已经生效十年了。
公约.en: This convention has been in effect for ten years.

悬挂.en: A painting hangs on the wall.

悬挂.zh: 节日期间街道上悬挂了许多彩灯。
悬挂.en: During the festival, many colorful lights were hung on the streets.

悬挂.zh: 因为风很大，悬挂的广告牌被吹掉了。
悬挂.en: Because the wind was strong, the hanging billboard was blown off.

悬挂.zh: 她把衣服悬挂在阳台上晾干。
悬挂.en: She hung the clothes on the balcony to dry.

悬挂.zh: 那辆车上悬挂着一个幸运挂件。
悬挂.en: That car has a lucky pendant hanging from it.

拖欠.zh: 他拖欠了三个月的房租。
拖欠.en: He is three months behind on rent.

拖欠.zh: 公司因为资金问题拖欠了员工工资。
拖欠.en: The company owed employee wages due to financial issues.

拖欠.zh: 如果长期拖欠贷款，银行会收回房子。
拖欠.en: If you default on the loan for a long time, the bank will repossess the house.

拖欠.zh: 这个项目拖欠了很多工程款。
拖欠.en: This project owes a lot of construction payments.
Please don't default on the utility bills.

自发.zh: 小区居民自发组织了一次清洁活动。
自发.en: The community residents spontaneously organized a cleaning activity.

自发.zh: 虽然没有通知，但很多人自发前来帮忙。
自发.en: Although there was no notice, many people came spontaneously to help.

自发.zh: 他的发言是自发的，没有准备。
这种自发的爱心行为很感人。
自发.en: This kind of spontaneous act of kindness is touching.

垫底.en: He came in last on this exam.

垫底.zh: 公司业绩在行业内常年垫底。
垫底.en: The company's performance has been at the bottom of the industry for years.

垫底.zh: 虽然努力了，但成绩还是垫底。
垫底.en: Although he worked hard, his grades were still at the bottom.

垫底.zh: 在盒子里垫底一层报纸。
垫底.en: Line the bottom of the box with a layer of newspaper.

垫底.zh: 这个球队在联赛中垫底。
垫底.en: This team is at the bottom of the league.

滚动.en: The ball is rolling on the ground.

滚动.zh: 屏幕上的文字在滚动播放新闻。
滚动.en: The text on the screen is scrolling news.

滚动.zh: 因为路面不平，箱子一直滚动来滚动去。
滚动.en: Because the road is uneven, the box kept rolling around.

滚动.zh: 他用滚动的方式移动了那个大石头。
滚动.en: He moved that big rock by rolling it.

滚动.zh: 鼠标滚轮可以滚动网页。
滚动.en: The mouse wheel can scroll the webpage.

民用.zh: 这种技术原本是军用，现在转为民用。
民用.en: This technology was originally military, now converted to civilian use.

民用.zh: 虽然它是军用产品，但民用版本也很受欢迎。
民用.en: Although it is a military product, the civilian version is also very popular.

民用.zh: 民用建筑和军用建筑标准不同。
民用.en: Civilian and military buildings have different standards.

民用.zh: 这款车是民用版，性能没那么强。
民用.en: This car is the civilian version, with less powerful performance.

深沉.zh: 这部电影表达了一种深沉的情感。
深沉.en: This movie expresses a deep emotion.

深沉.zh: 他看起来很深沉，但实际上很幽默。
深沉.en: He looks profound, but in fact he is humorous.
The night is deep, with few stars.

深沉.zh: 她那双深沉的眼睛让人难忘。

民意.zh: 民意调查显示大家支持这个政策。
民意.en: The opinion poll shows that everyone supports this policy.

民意.zh: 政府应该多听听民意，再做决定。
民意.en: The government should listen more to public opinion before making decisions.

民意.zh: 他们根据民意调整了方案。
民意.en: They adjusted the plan based on public opinion.

民意.zh: 虽然民意有分歧，但最终还是通过了。
民意.en: Although public opinion was divided, it was ultimately passed.

惨重.zh: 工厂火灾造成的伤亡很惨重。
惨重.en: The factory fire caused heavy casualties.

惨重.zh: 由于管理不善，公司损失惨重。
惨重.en: Due to poor management, the company suffered heavy losses.

惨重.zh: 战争给人民带来了惨重的灾难。
惨重.en: War brought disastrous calamities to the people.

惨重.zh: 这次事故后果惨重，大家要吸取教训。
惨重.en: The consequences of this accident were disastrous; everyone must learn from it.

干劲.zh: 大家干劲满满，很快完成了任务。
干劲.en: Everyone was full of drive and quickly finished the task.

干劲.zh: 新来的同事干劲很足，值得学习。
干劲.en: The new colleague is very enthusiastic; worth learning from.

干劲.zh: 虽然很累，但他还是干劲不减。
干劲.en: Although very tired, his drive didn't decrease.

干劲.zh: 团队里每个人都干劲冲天，效率很高。
干劲.en: Everyone on the team is extremely motivated, and efficiency is high.

献血.en: He goes to donate blood every year.
Donating blood has no harm to the body.

献血.zh: 这次献血活动来了很多人。
献血.en: Many people came to this blood donation event.

献血.zh: 她为了帮助别人，主动去献血。
献血.en: She proactively donated blood to help others.

献血.zh: 如果你身体健康，可以试试献血。
献血.en: If you are healthy, you can try donating blood.

扣留.en: The police detained his driver's license.

扣留.zh: 因为违规，车辆被扣留了。
扣留.en: The vehicle was detained because of a violation.

扣留.zh: 海关扣留了一批可疑货物。
扣留.en: Customs detained a batch of suspicious goods.

扣留.zh: 他因证件不全被扣留了一夜。
扣留.en: He was detained overnight due to incomplete documents.

扣留.zh: 公司扣留工资是不合法的，你可以投诉。
扣留.en: It is illegal for a company to withhold wages; you can file a complaint.

超标.en: This car's emissions exceed the standard.

超标.zh: 食品添加剂超标会影响健康。
超标.en: Excessive food additives can affect health.

超标.zh: 他们发现水里重金属超标。
超标.en: They found heavy metals in the water exceed the standard.

超标.zh: 噪音超标，居民们很生气。
超标.en: The noise exceeded the standard, and the residents were very angry.

超标.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但食品添加剂可能超标。
超标.en: Although the price is cheap, the food additives might exceed the standard.

反面.en: Please look at the back side of this paper.

反面.zh: 硬币的反面有什么图案？
反面.en: What pattern is on the reverse side of the coin?

反面.zh: 这个案例是个反面教材。
反面.en: This case is a negative example.

反面.zh: 你不能只看一面，也要看反面。
反面.en: You can't just look at one side; you also need to look at the reverse.

反面.zh: 从反面想，这件事也有好处。
反面.en: Thinking from the opposite side, this matter also has benefits.

免除.en: He was exempted from this exam.

免除.zh: 公司免除了他的加班任务。
免除.en: The company exempted him from overtime tasks.

免除.zh: 只要你完成工作，就可以免除处罚。
免除.en: As long as you finish the work, you can be exempted from punishment.

免除.zh: 因为表现好，学校免除了他的学费。
免除.en: Because of good performance, the school waived his tuition.

免除.zh: 这些措施可以免除很多麻烦。
免除.en: These measures can avoid a lot of trouble.

调料.en: This dish has a lot of seasoning.

调料.zh: 超市里的调料种类很多。
调料.en: There are many kinds of seasonings in the supermarket.

调料.zh: 你做饭时喜欢用什么调料？
调料.en: What seasonings do you like to use when cooking?

调料.zh: 我买了一些新调料，准备试试。
调料.en: I bought some new seasonings and plan to try them.

调料.zh: 除了盐和酱油，还需要其他调料吗？
调料.en: Besides salt and soy sauce, do you need other seasonings?

掌管.en: He is in charge of the company's finances.
This department is managed by her.

掌管.zh: 他掌管着所有重要文件。
新经理来掌管这个项目。
掌管.en: The new manager came to take charge of this project.

掌管.zh: 虽然她年纪轻，但已经掌管大权了。
掌管.en: Although she is young, she already holds great power.

构想.zh: 他的构想虽然大胆，但很实用。
构想.en: His idea is bold but very practical.

构想.zh: 我一直在思考这个新的商业构想。
构想.en: I've been thinking about this new business concept.

构想.zh: 如果你同意这个构想，我们就开始执行。
构想.en: If you agree with this idea, we'll start implementing it.

构想.zh: 他们提出的构想需要进一步讨论。
构想.en: The idea they proposed needs further discussion.

下游.zh: 河流的下游污染很严重。
下游.en: The lower reaches of the river are heavily polluted.

下游.zh: 他们住在长江下游的一个小城市。
下游.en: They live in a small city in the lower reaches of the Yangtze River.

下游.zh: 下游的水质直接影响到农田灌溉。
下游.en: The water quality downstream directly affects farmland irrigation.

下游.zh: 虽然上游风景好，但下游更适合发展渔业。
下游.en: Although the upstream scenery is nice, the downstream area is more suitable for developing fisheries.

忌.zh: 他最忌别人提他的过去。
忌.en: He hates it when others bring up his past.

忌.zh: 忌生冷食物，医生叮嘱过。
忌.en: Avoid raw and cold food, as the doctor advised.

忌.zh: 我没什么忌讳，你随便问。
忌.en: I have no taboos, feel free to ask.

忌.zh: 既然你忌酒，那我们就喝茶吧。
忌.en: Since you avoid alcohol, let's just drink tea.

逝世.en: His grandfather passed away last year.

逝世.zh: 那位著名作家已于上月逝世。
逝世.en: That famous writer passed away last month.

逝世.zh: 听到他逝世的噩耗，我们都很难过。
逝世.en: We were all saddened to hear the news of his passing.

逝世.zh: 虽然他已经逝世多年，但人们仍然怀念他。
逝世.en: Although he passed away many years ago, people still remember him.

逝世.zh: 他的逝世对家人打击很大。
逝世.en: His passing was a huge blow to his family.

寡妇.zh: 那个寡妇独自抚养三个孩子。
寡妇.en: That widow raises three children on her own.

寡妇.zh: 村里有个寡妇，大家都帮她。
寡妇.en: There's a widow in the village, and everyone helps her.

寡妇.zh: 她当了寡妇后，生活很艰难。
寡妇.en: Life became very hard for her after she became a widow.

寡妇.zh: 虽然她是寡妇，但从来不抱怨。
寡妇.en: Even though she is a widow, she never complains.

沉着.en: He is very calm when faced with problems.

沉着.zh: 在危机时刻，他表现得非常沉着。
沉着.en: He acted very calmly during the crisis.

沉着.zh: 你要沉着应对，不要慌张。
沉着.en: You need to respond calmly and not panic.

沉着.zh: 她沉着地处理了这次突发事件。
沉着.en: She handled this emergency with composure.

沉着.zh: 虽然他内心紧张，但外表依然沉着。
沉着.en: Although he was nervous inside, he still appeared calm.

摸索.zh: 他们一直在摸索新的方法。
摸索.en: They have been exploring new methods.

摸索.zh: 没有经验，只能靠自己慢慢摸索。
摸索.en: With no experience, we have to figure it out slowly on our own.

摸索.zh: 经过多年摸索，终于找到了解决方案。
摸索.en: After years of trial and error, we finally found a solution.

摸索.zh: 在创业初期，我们边摸索边前进。
摸索.en: In the early stages of starting a business, we groped our way forward.

收买.zh: 用金钱收买人心是不道德的。
收买.en: Buying people's loyalty with money is unethical.

收买.zh: 那个官员被对手收买了。
收买.en: That official was bought off by his opponent.

收买.zh: 他试图收买证人，但失败了。
收买.en: He tried to bribe the witness but failed.

收买.zh: 如果你试图收买他，只会适得其反。
收买.en: If you try to bribe him, it will only backfire.

款项.zh: 这笔款项什么时候到账？
他已经收到了全部款项。
款项.en: He has received the full amount.

款项.zh: 公司需要筹集一笔巨额款项。
款项.en: The company needs to raise a huge sum of money.

款项.zh: 这笔款项将用于学校建设。
款项.en: This fund will be used for school construction.

款项.zh: 由于款项不足，项目被迫暂停。
款项.en: Due to insufficient funds, the project was suspended.

能耐.zh: 别小看他，他挺有能耐的。
能耐.en: Don't underestimate him; he's quite capable.

能耐.zh: 这点事都办不好，算什么能耐？
能耐.en: Can't even handle such a small matter—what kind of ability is that?

能耐.zh: 你要是真有能耐，就证明给大家看。
能耐.en: If you really have the ability, prove it to everyone.

好似.zh: 今天的天气好似夏天一样热。
好似.en: Today's weather seems as hot as summer.

好似.zh: 她好似什么都没发生似的，继续聊天。
好似.en: She continued chatting as if nothing had happened.
That sound is like a cat meowing.

好似.zh: 我们好似很久没见了，其实才两天。
好似.en: It seems we haven't seen each other for a long time, but it's only been two days.

通通.en: I don't want any of these things.
He donated all his old clothes.
All of you come over here!

通通.zh: 那些问题我通通回答了。
通通.en: I answered all of those questions.

通通.zh: 不管是贵的还是便宜的，通通打折。
通通.en: Whether expensive or cheap, everything is on sale.

风波.zh: 这场风波很快就过去了。
公司最近因为裁员闹了一场风波。
风波.en: The company recently stirred up a controversy over layoffs.

风波.zh: 他的一句话引起了不小的风波。
风波.en: His one remark caused quite a stir.
The family turmoil has finally settled.

风波.zh: 虽然网上有风波，但他并不在意。
风波.en: Although there is an uproar online, he doesn't care.

迈进.zh: 他一步步迈进理想中的大学。
迈进.en: He is stepping into his ideal university step by step.

迈进.zh: 公司迈进了一个全新的阶段。
迈进.en: The company has entered a brand new phase.
She confidently strode into the meeting hall.

迈进.zh: 我们要一起迈进美好的未来。
迈进.en: We will stride together into a bright future.

来历.zh: 你知道这件古董的来历吗？
来历.en: Do you know the origin of this antique?

来历.zh: 这个人来历不简单，大家要小心。
来历.en: This person has a complicated background; everyone should be careful.

来历.zh: 她的来历我一直很好奇。
来历.en: I've always been curious about her background.

来历.zh: 虽然来历复杂，但他人很好。
来历.en: Although his background is complicated, he is a good person.

仁慈.en: He is very kind to animals.
The judge's ruling was very merciful.

仁慈.zh: 老板虽然严格，但内心很仁慈。
仁慈.en: Although the boss is strict, he is kind-hearted.

仁慈.zh: 仁慈的人总是受人尊敬。
你对他仁慈，他未必领情。
仁慈.en: You are kind to him, but he may not appreciate it.

寻觅.en: He is looking for a new job.

寻觅.zh: 我一直在寻觅合适的房子。
寻觅.en: I've been searching for a suitable house.

寻觅.zh: 他们四处寻觅失踪的孩子。
寻觅.en: They are searching everywhere for the missing child.

寻觅.zh: 寻觅多年，终于找到了答案。
寻觅.en: After searching for years, I finally found the answer.

寻觅.zh: 在茫茫人海中寻觅一个懂你的人不容易。
寻觅.en: It's not easy to find someone who understands you in the vast crowd.

没完没了.zh: 她没完没了地抱怨，真烦人。
这个问题没完没了地讨论下去也没用。
没完没了.en: Discussing this problem endlessly is useless.

没完没了.zh: 别没完没了地玩游戏了。

废品.zh: 他把废品都卖给了回收站。
废品.en: He sold all the scrap to the recycling station.

废品.zh: 这个零件做出来是废品，不能用。
废品.en: This part turned out to be defective and cannot be used.

废品.zh: 废品回收可以保护环境。
废品.en: Recycling waste helps protect the environment.

废品.zh: 虽然有些是废品，但还能利用。
废品.en: Although some are waste, they can still be reused.

呼声.zh: 改革的呼声越来越强烈。
呼声.en: The call for reform is getting stronger.

呼声.zh: 社会对教育的呼声一直没停过。
呼声.en: Society's demand for education has never stopped.

呼声.zh: 无论呼声多大，政府都没回应。
呼声.en: No matter how loud the outcry, the government didn't respond.

盘旋.en: The eagle is circling in the sky.

盘旋.zh: 飞机在机场上空盘旋了几圈才降落。
盘旋.en: The plane circled over the airport a few times before landing.

盘旋.zh: 他手里拿着遥控器，让无人机在头顶盘旋。
盘旋.en: He held the remote control, making the drone hover overhead.

盘旋.zh: 我抬头看见一群鸟在楼顶盘旋。
盘旋.en: I looked up and saw a group of birds circling on the rooftop.

盘旋.zh: 因为天气不好，直升机只能在原地盘旋。
盘旋.en: Because of bad weather, the helicopter could only hover in place.

杂交.zh: 这种水稻是杂交出来的。
杂交.en: This type of rice is hybrid.

杂交.zh: 杂交水稻让产量提高了很多。
杂交.en: Hybrid rice has greatly increased yields.

杂交.zh: 科学家通过杂交培育出了新品种的玫瑰。
杂交.en: Scientists bred a new variety of rose through crossbreeding.

杂交.zh: 这只狗是杂交的，血统不纯。
杂交.en: This dog is a mix, not purebred.

杂交.zh: 虽然它们是杂交的，但味道反而更好。
杂交.en: Although they are hybrids, the taste is actually better.

开销.en: The expenses this month are too high.

开销.zh: 我们要控制一下日常开销。
开销.en: We need to control daily expenses.

开销.zh: 去旅行之前，最好先算好所有开销。
开销.en: Before traveling, it's best to calculate all expenses first.

开销.zh: 他每个月最大的开销就是房租。
开销.en: His biggest monthly expense is rent.

开销.zh: 为了减少开销，她开始自己做饭。
开销.en: To reduce expenses, she started cooking for herself.

一不小心.zh: 我一不小心把杯子打碎了。
他走路时一不小心摔了一跤。
开车的时候一不小心就会出事。
一不小心.en: If you're not careful while driving, an accident can happen.

一不小心.zh: 她一不小心说漏了嘴，大家都知道了。
一不小心.en: She accidentally let it slip, and now everyone knows.

一不小心.zh: 那个花瓶太贵了，一不小心就会碰倒。
一不小心.en: That vase is too expensive; it can be knocked over easily if you're not careful.

招数.zh: 他用了很多招数都没赢。
招数.en: He used many tricks but still didn't win.

招数.zh: 对付这种人，你得换点新招数。
招数.en: To deal with this kind of person, you need to try some new tactics.

招数.zh: 他的招数已经被我看穿了。
招数.en: I've already seen through his tricks.

招数.zh: 虽然他的招数很老套，但确实有效。
招数.en: Although his methods are old-fashioned, they are effective.

沉闷.zh: 会议室里的气氛很沉闷。
沉闷.en: The atmosphere in the meeting room is very dull.

沉闷.zh: 这部电影太沉闷了，我差点睡着。
沉闷.en: This movie is so boring that I almost fell asleep.

沉闷.zh: 他说话的方式很沉闷，没人爱听。
沉闷.en: His way of speaking is very tedious; nobody likes to listen.

沉闷.zh: 因为整天待在屋里，他觉得生活很沉闷。
沉闷.en: Because he stays indoors all day, he finds life very dull.

玩意儿.en: How do you use this thing?

玩意儿.zh: 他买了好多新玩意儿回家。
玩意儿.en: He bought a lot of new gadgets and brought them home.

玩意儿.zh: 那个小玩意儿是我从网上淘来的。
玩意儿.en: That little gadget is something I picked up online.

玩意儿.zh: 这些玩意儿不值钱，但很好玩。
玩意儿.en: These things aren't valuable, but they're fun.

玩意儿.zh: 你手里拿的是什么玩意儿？
玩意儿.en: What's that thing in your hand?

微不足道.zh: 他的贡献虽然微不足道，但很有意义。
微不足道.en: Although his contribution is trivial, it is meaningful.

微不足道.zh: 在这么大的项目里，我的工作微不足道。
微不足道.en: In such a big project, my work is insignificant.

微不足道.zh: 那些批评其实微不足道，不用在意。
微不足道.en: Those criticisms are actually trivial; don't worry about them.

微不足道.zh: 跟他的成功比起来，我的失败微不足道。
微不足道.en: Compared to his success, my failure is insignificant.

钦佩.en: I admire his courage very much.

钦佩.zh: 大家都钦佩她坚持不懈的精神。
他做的事让我特别钦佩。
钦佩.en: What he did makes me especially admire him.

钦佩.zh: 虽然我们是对手，但我仍然钦佩他的能力。
钦佩.en: Although we are opponents, I still admire his ability.

收支.en: Are income and expenses balanced this month?

收支.zh: 我们要记录每天的收支情况。
收支.en: We need to record daily income and expenses.

收支.zh: 因为开销太大，这个月收支不平衡了。
收支.en: Because expenses are too high, income and expenses are unbalanced this month.

收支.zh: 她每个月都会仔细计算家庭收支。
收支.en: She carefully calculates the family's income and expenses every month.

收支.zh: 虽然收入不高，但收支还算稳定。
收支.en: Although the income is not high, the balance of income and expenses is still stable.

反倒.zh: 我劝他别去，他反倒更想去了。
反倒.en: I advised him not to go, but he wanted to go even more.

反倒.zh: 本来想省时间，结果反倒更慢了。
反倒.en: Originally wanted to save time, but it turned out slower.

反倒.zh: 虽然下雨了，我们反倒更开心了。
反倒.en: Although it rained, we were even happier.

反倒.zh: 你越解释，他反倒越怀疑。
反倒.en: The more you explain, the more suspicious he becomes.

公益性.zh: 我们公司做了一个公益性的活动。
公益性.en: Our company did a public welfare activity.

公益性.zh: 公益性岗位虽然工资不高，但很有意义。
公益性.en: Public welfare jobs, though low-paid, are very meaningful.

公益性.zh: 这种公益性广告很打动人心。
公益性.en: This kind of public service ad touches people's hearts.

公益性.zh: 她一直在做公益性的工作，帮助贫困儿童。
公益性.en: She has been doing public welfare work, helping poor children.

华人.zh: 很多海外华人都会庆祝春节。
华人.en: Many overseas Chinese celebrate Spring Festival.
This store is run by a Chinese person.

华人.zh: 华人社区经常举办文化活动。
华人.en: Chinese communities often hold cultural events.

华人.zh: 我在国外认识了很多华人朋友。
华人.en: I met many Chinese friends abroad.

书记.en: Secretary Zhang came to our unit.
The secretary spoke at the meeting.
Our village secretary is a nice person.

书记.zh: 书记安排了下周的工作计划。
书记.en: The secretary arranged the work plan for next week.

书记.zh: 今天下午书记要跟大家一起开会。
书记.en: This afternoon the secretary will have a meeting with everyone.

拨款.zh: 政府拨款给学校建新楼。
拨款.en: The government allocated funds for the school to build a new building.

拨款.zh: 这笔拨款用于环保项目。
拨款.en: This allocation is for environmental projects.

拨款.zh: 拨款还没到账，项目暂时停了。
拨款.en: The funds haven't arrived yet, so the project is on hold.

拨款.zh: 我们申请了一笔科研拨款。
拨款.en: We applied for a research grant.

拨款.zh: 因为拨款不够，很多计划都取消了。
拨款.en: Because the allocation was insufficient, many plans were canceled.

渗.en: Rainwater seeps in through the wall cracks.
The wound started to ooze blood.

渗.zh: 油渗进了衣服里，很难洗掉。
渗.en: Oil seeped into the clothes, hard to wash out.

灌输.zh: 父母不要总是给孩子灌输压力。
灌输.en: Parents shouldn't always instill pressure on children.

灌输.zh: 这种思想从小就被灌输给他。
灌输.en: This idea was instilled in him from childhood.

灌输.zh: 媒体不应该向公众灌输错误观念。
灌输.en: Media should not instill wrong ideas into the public.

灌输.zh: 他一直在向孩子灌输独立的思想。
灌输.en: He has been instilling the idea of independence in his child.

蘸.en: He dipped bun in soup to eat.
Just dip a bit of soy sauce.
She dipped a cookie in milk.
Dip the brush in ink before writing.

突破口.zh: 我们需要找到一个突破口。
突破口.en: We need to find a breakthrough point.

突破口.zh: 这个问题可以从技术方面找突破口。
突破口.en: This problem can find a breakthrough from the technical side.

突破口.zh: 谈判陷入了僵局，急需一个突破口。
突破口.en: The negotiation is deadlocked, urgently needs a breakthrough.

突破口.zh: 他们把市场作为突破口来发展业务。
突破口.en: They took the market as a breakthrough to develop business.

突破口.zh: 寻找新的突破口是公司今年的重点。
突破口.en: Finding new breakthrough points is the company's focus this year.

敬礼.en: When seeing a teacher, you should salute.

敬礼.zh: 警察对市民敬礼表示感谢。
敬礼.en: The police officer saluted the citizen to express thanks.

敬礼.zh: 敬礼是一种表示尊重的动作。
敬礼.en: Saluting is a gesture of respect.

劣质.en: This charger is of poor quality.

劣质.zh: 劣质的鞋子穿两天就坏了。
劣质.en: Poor-quality shoes break after just two days of wear.

劣质.zh: 他买到了劣质的化妆品，脸都过敏了。
劣质.en: He bought low-quality cosmetics and his face broke out in an allergy.

劣质.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但劣质材料对身体有害。
劣质.en: Although the price is cheap, low-quality materials are harmful to health.

劣质.zh: 我网购了一件衣服，结果布料是劣质的，洗一次就缩水了。
劣质.en: I bought a dress online, but the fabric was poor quality and it shrunk after one wash.

透气.en: Open the window to let the room air out.

透气.zh: 夏天穿棉质的袜子比较透气。
透气.en: Cotton socks are more breathable in summer.

透气.zh: 这种运动鞋面料透气，跑步不会闷脚。
透气.en: These sneakers have breathable fabric, so your feet won't get stuffy while running.

透气.zh: 新买的床垫不透气，晚上睡觉总出汗。
透气.en: The new mattress is not breathable, and I always sweat at night.

容貌.en: He doesn't care about his own appearance.

容貌.zh: 虽然容貌普通，但她气质很好。
容貌.en: Although her looks are ordinary, she has great poise.

容貌.zh: 她随着年龄增长，容貌变化很大。
容貌.en: As she grew older, her appearance changed a lot.

容貌.zh: 他注重内在修养，而不是过分关注容貌。
容貌.en: He focuses on inner cultivation rather than paying excessive attention to appearance.

桨.en: This oar is a bit old.

桨.zh: 我们一人拿一支桨划船。
桨.en: Each of us took an oar to row the boat.

桨.zh: 船桨掉进水里，我们只好用手划。
桨.en: The oar fell into the water, so we had to paddle with our hands.

桨.zh: 租船的时候记得检查桨是不是完好。
桨.en: When renting a boat, remember to check whether the oars are in good condition.

容许.en: Please allow me to say a few words.

容许.zh: 时间不容许我们慢慢来。
容许.en: Time does not allow us to take it slowly.

容许.zh: 公司不容许员工在上班时间玩手机。
容许.en: The company does not allow employees to play with their phones during work hours.

容许.zh: 虽然我很想帮忙，但规矩不容许我这么做。
容许.en: Although I really want to help, the rules do not allow me to do so.

不由自主.zh: 看到美食，我不由自主地咽口水。
不由自主.en: Seeing the delicious food, I couldn't help swallowing.

不由自主.zh: 听到这个好消息，她不由自主地跳了起来。
不由自主.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't help jumping up.

不由自主.zh: 那首歌太好听了，我不由自主地跟着哼起来。
不由自主.en: That song was so beautiful that I couldn't help humming along.

不由自主.zh: 看到那个可怕的画面，他不由自主地往后退了一步。
不由自主.en: Seeing that terrifying scene, he involuntarily stepped back.

疼爱.en: It's normal for parents to love their children dearly.

疼爱.zh: 她特别疼爱自己的小女儿。
疼爱.en: She especially cherishes her youngest daughter.

疼爱.zh: 爷爷奶奶对孙子疼爱有加，什么都依着他。
疼爱.en: Grandparents dote on their grandson and give him everything he wants.

疼爱.zh: 虽然他很严厉，但心里其实很疼爱学生。
疼爱.en: Although he is strict, he actually cares deeply for his students.

鲜活.en: This fish is very fresh and alive.
The seafood at the supermarket isn't fresh enough.

鲜活.zh: 他讲的故事非常鲜活生动。
鲜活.en: The story he told was very vivid and lively.

鲜活.zh: 这些蔬菜从地里刚摘的，特别鲜活。
鲜活.en: These vegetables were just picked from the field, so they are exceptionally fresh.

鲜活.zh: 演员把角色演得很鲜活，观众都入戏了。
鲜活.en: The actor portrayed the role so vividly that the audience was fully immersed.

得力.zh: 多亏了得力的团队，项目才顺利完成。
得力.en: Thanks to the capable team, the project was completed smoothly.

得力.zh: 她虽然年轻，但办事很得力。
得力.en: Although she is young, she handles tasks very efficiently.

得力.zh: 公司新招的经理很得力，业绩提高了不少。
得力.en: The newly hired manager is very effective, and performance has improved significantly.

诽谤.zh: 她被人恶意诽谤，心情很糟。
诽谤.en: She was maliciously slandered and felt terrible.

诽谤.zh: 没有证据的话就是诽谤，小心吃官司。
诽谤.en: Words without evidence are slander; be careful about getting sued.

诽谤.zh: 明星经常要面对各种不实的诽谤。
诽谤.en: Celebrities often have to face all kinds of false slander.

先例.zh: 这事没先例，我们得小心点。
先例.en: There's no precedent for this, we need to be careful.

先例.zh: 他这么做，算是开了个坏先例。
先例.en: What he did set a bad precedent.

先例.zh: 如果这次让步，以后就会有很多先例。
先例.en: If we give in this time, there will be many precedents in the future.

先例.zh: 公司不允许这样做，因为没有先例可循。
先例.en: The company doesn't allow this because there's no precedent to follow.

先例.zh: 虽然没先例，但我们可以试试看，说不定能成功。
先例.en: Although there's no precedent, we can give it a try; it might work.

直达.en: This train goes directly to Beijing.

直达.zh: 有没有直达上海的航班？
直达.en: Is there a direct flight to Shanghai?

直达.zh: 坐地铁三号线可以直达那个商场。
直达.en: You can take Metro Line 3 directly to that mall.

直达.zh: 如果坐高铁，从这儿去广州能直达，不用换车。
直达.en: If you take the high-speed rail, you can go directly to Guangzhou from here without changing trains.

直达.zh: 虽然飞机更快，但我更喜欢坐直达火车，方便多了。
直达.en: Although the plane is faster, I prefer taking a direct train; it's much more convenient.

招待会.zh: 明天有个招待会，你去吗？
招待会.en: There's a reception tomorrow, are you going?

招待会.zh: 招待会上提供了很多小吃和饮料。
招待会.en: The reception offered many snacks and drinks.

招待会.zh: 公司年底会举办一个大型招待会。
招待会.en: The company will hold a large reception at the end of the year.

招待会.zh: 他在招待会上认识了几位新客户。
招待会.en: He met several new clients at the reception.

招待会.zh: 因为招待会取消了，我们只好改天再聚。
招待会.en: Since the reception was canceled, we had to get together another day.

譬如.zh: 我喜欢运动，譬如跑步和游泳。
譬如.en: I like sports, such as running and swimming.

譬如.zh: 很多水果对身体好，譬如苹果和香蕉。
譬如.en: Many fruits are good for health, such as apples and bananas.

譬如.zh: 你可以学一门新技能，譬如编程或者做饭。
譬如.en: You can learn a new skill, like programming or cooking.

譬如.zh: 周末可以去做些有趣的事，譬如爬山或看电影。
譬如.en: On weekends you can do fun things, such as hiking or watching movies.

譬如.zh: 如果遇到问题，可以找朋友帮忙，譬如问问他们的建议。
譬如.en: If you encounter a problem, you can ask friends for help, for example, get their advice.

吃亏.en: Don't let him suffer a loss.
If you're too honest, you're likely to get taken advantage of.

吃亏.zh: 他从来不让自己吃亏，总是精打细算。
吃亏.en: He never lets himself suffer a loss; he always calculates carefully.

论证.zh: 他花了很多时间论证自己的观点。
论证.en: He spent a lot of time arguing for his point of view.

论证.zh: 我们需要更多的证据来论证这个假设。
论证.en: We need more evidence to prove this hypothesis.

论证.zh: 在论文里，他详细论证了气候变化的影响。
论证.en: In the paper, he elaborated on the impact of climate change.

论证.zh: 如果论证不够充分，老师可能会让你重新写。
论证.en: If the argument is not sufficient, the teacher might ask you to rewrite it.

心胸.zh: 做人要心胸宽广，别计较小事。
心胸.en: One should be broad-minded and not fuss over small things.

心胸.zh: 她的心胸狭窄，很难跟人相处。
心胸.en: She is narrow-minded and hard to get along with.

心胸.zh: 如果心胸开阔一点，朋友会更多。
心胸.en: If you are a little more open-minded, you'll have more friends.

心胸.zh: 经历了这么多事，他的心胸比以前更宽广了。
心胸.en: After going through so much, he has become more broad-minded than before.

输血.en: He needs an emergency blood transfusion.

输血.zh: 医院里血库不够，呼吁大家来输血。
输血.en: The hospital's blood bank is low, calling on everyone to donate blood.

输血.zh: 输血前要检查血型是否匹配。
输血.en: Before a blood transfusion, you need to check if the blood type matches.

输血.zh: 这次手术可能需要大量输血，医生提前准备了。
输血.en: This surgery may require a large amount of blood transfusion; the doctor prepared in advance.

悼念.en: Everyone observed a moment of silence to mourn the deceased.

悼念.zh: 今天我们来悼念这位伟大的科学家。
悼念.en: Today we are here to mourn this great scientist.

悼念.zh: 他在网上发了一篇文章悼念他的朋友。
悼念.en: He posted an article online to mourn his friend.

悼念.zh: 每年清明，我们都会去墓园悼念祖先。
悼念.en: Every Qingming Festival, we go to the cemetery to mourn our ancestors.

悼念.zh: 虽然已经过去很久了，但他依然常常悼念他的妻子。
悼念.en: Although it has been a long time, he still often mourns his wife.

焚烧.en: They are burning leaves in the backyard.

焚烧.zh: 工厂非法焚烧废弃物，被罚款了。
焚烧.en: The factory was fined for illegally burning waste.

焚烧.zh: 焚烧秸秆会造成空气污染，政府已经禁止了。
焚烧.en: Burning straw causes air pollution, and the government has banned it.

焚烧.zh: 他把旧信件全部焚烧了，不想留下任何回忆。
焚烧.en: He burned all the old letters, not wanting to leave any memories.

察看.zh: 你先察看情况，再决定怎么做。
察看.en: You first examine the situation, then decide what to do.

察看.zh: 警察仔细察看了事故现场，然后记录了下来。
察看.en: The police carefully examined the accident scene and then made a record.

察看.zh: 虽然他已经察看了报告，但还是不太放心。
察看.en: Although he has already examined the report, he is still not reassured.

察看.zh: 医生需要察看病人的伤口，看有没有感染。
察看.en: The doctor needs to examine the patient's wound to see if there is an infection.

纽带.en: Friends are the bond of emotions.

纽带.zh: 这条公路是连接两个城市的纽带。
纽带.en: This highway is the bond connecting two cities.

纽带.zh: 音乐是沟通不同文化的纽带之一。
纽带.en: Music is one of the bonds that connect different cultures.

纽带.zh: 虽然两地相隔很远，但这条铁路成了他们的纽带。
纽带.en: Although the two places are far apart, this railway became their bond.

纽带.zh: 共同爱好成了他们友谊的纽带，让关系更紧密。
纽带.en: Common hobbies became the bond of their friendship, making the relationship tighter.

竭尽全力.en: He did his utmost to finish the work.

竭尽全力.zh: 为了这次考试，她竭尽全力复习。
竭尽全力.en: For this exam, she studied with all her might.

竭尽全力.zh: 虽然很累，但他依然竭尽全力帮助大家。
竭尽全力.en: Although very tired, he still spared no effort to help everyone.

竭尽全力.zh: 队员们竭尽全力争取最后的胜利，终于成功了。
竭尽全力.en: The team members did their utmost to strive for the final victory, and finally succeeded.

慢慢来.zh: 学习中文要慢慢来，不能着急。
慢慢来.en: Learning Chinese requires taking it slow, can't rush.

慢慢来.zh: 不用紧张，做事情慢慢来就好。
慢慢来.en: Don't be nervous, just take it slow when doing things.

慢慢来.zh: 你第一次开车，慢慢来，安全第一。
慢慢来.en: You're driving for the first time, take it slow, safety first.

慢慢来.zh: 虽然进度慢了，但大家劝他慢慢来，别压力太大。
慢慢来.en: Although progress is slow, everyone advised him to take it slow and not stress too much.

摆设.en: Don't treat important things as ornaments.
The decorations in the room are very delicate.

摆设.zh: 虽然这个摆设放在那里，但没人注意。
摆设.en: Although this decoration is placed there, no one notices it.

摆设.zh: 这些东西只是摆设，没有实际用处。
摆设.en: These things are just decorations, no practical use.

香料.zh: 做菜时加一点香料更好吃。
香料.en: Add a little spice when cooking, it tastes better.

香料.zh: 这家店的香料种类很多。
香料.en: This store has many kinds of spices.

香料.zh: 虽然香料很贵，但做咖喱必不可少。
香料.en: Although spices are expensive, they are indispensable for making curry.

香料.zh: 我买了一些香料，准备做印度菜。
香料.en: I bought some spices, planning to make Indian food.

得体.zh: 在正式场合说话要得体。
得体.en: In formal occasions, speech must be appropriate.

得体.zh: 他的言行举止都很得体。
得体.en: His words and actions are all very appropriate.

得体.zh: 虽然他很年轻，但处理事情非常得体。
得体.en: Although he is very young, he handles things very appropriately.

得体.zh: 你今天的发言很得体，大家都赞赏。
得体.en: Your speech today was very appropriate, everyone appreciated it.

对峙.en: The two teams confront each other, neither advancing.

对峙.zh: 双方在边界对峙了一整天。
对峙.en: The two sides confronted each other at the border all day.

对峙.zh: 警察与歹徒对峙了几个小时。
对峙.en: The police confronted the criminals for several hours.

对峙.zh: 虽然他们一直对峙，但最终和解了。
对峙.en: Although they were in confrontation all along, they finally reconciled.

对峙.zh: 两辆车在路中间对峙，谁也不让谁。
对峙.en: Two cars confronted each other in the middle of the road, neither yielding.

苗条.en: My younger sister is very slim.

苗条.zh: 她每天运动来保持苗条。
苗条.en: She exercises every day to stay slim.

苗条.zh: 虽然她吃很多，但还是很苗条。
苗条.en: Although she eats a lot, she is still very slim.

苗条.zh: 那条裙子很适合苗条的女生穿。
苗条.en: That dress is very suitable for slim girls to wear.

自立.en: Children should be independent after adulthood.
She has been very self-reliant since childhood.

自立.zh: 虽然家庭条件好，但他坚持自立生活。
自立.en: Although his family conditions are good, he insists on living independently.

自立.zh: 出国留学让他学会了自立。
自立.en: Studying abroad taught him to be self-reliant.

濒临.en: This company is on the verge of bankruptcy.

濒临.zh: 因为资金不足，那个项目濒临停工。
濒临.en: Because of insufficient funds, that project is on the verge of being suspended.

濒临.zh: 他濒临崩溃，但还是坚持了下来。
濒临.en: He was on the verge of a breakdown, but he still held on.

濒临.zh: 这种动物已经濒临灭绝了。
濒临.en: This species is already on the verge of extinction.

濒临.zh: 虽然我们濒临失败，但大家都没有放弃。
濒临.en: Although we were on the verge of failure, none of us gave up.

美化.zh: 这个软件可以美化照片。
他总是美化自己的过去。
美化.en: He always beautifies his own past.

美化.zh: 小区新种了很多花，美化了环境。
美化.en: The community planted many new flowers, beautifying the environment.

美化.zh: 如果只美化数据，问题迟早会暴露。
美化.en: If you only beautify the data, the problem will be exposed sooner or later.

美化.zh: 政府花了大量钱美化城市街道。
美化.en: The government spent a lot of money beautifying the city streets.

换成.en: Please change the dollars into RMB.

换成.zh: 我想把这张桌子换成大的。
换成.en: I want to change this table for a bigger one.

换成.zh: 如果你不满意，可以换成别的颜色。
换成.en: If you're not satisfied, you can change it to another color.

换成.zh: 我把旧手机换成了新款的。
换成.en: I changed my old phone for a new model.

换成.zh: 因为天气太热，我把长袖换成了短袖。
换成.en: Because it was too hot, I changed my long sleeves for short sleeves.

屏障.zh: 这座山是一道天然屏障。
屏障.en: This mountain is a natural barrier.

屏障.zh: 树林能起到防风屏障的作用。
屏障.en: The forest can serve as a wind barrier.

屏障.zh: 我们需要建立一道安全屏障。
屏障.en: We need to set up a security barrier.

屏障.zh: 虽然有了屏障，但风险还是存在。
屏障.en: Although there is a barrier, the risk still exists.

屏障.zh: 这道屏障挡住了大部分噪音。
屏障.en: This barrier blocks most of the noise.

煲.en: I used a clay pot to simmer a pot of congee.

煲.zh: 新买的电饭煲可以煲汤。
煲.en: The newly bought rice cooker can simmer soup.
She loves to chat on the phone for a long time.

煲.zh: 这个锅用来煲汤特别香。
煲.en: This pot is especially good for simmering soup, making it very fragrant.

偷懒.en: He always slacks off at work.
Don't be lazy, finish it quickly.

偷懒.zh: 老师不在的时候，有些学生就会偷懒。
偷懒.en: When the teacher is not around, some students will slack off.

偷懒.zh: 虽然很累，但他从不偷懒。
偷懒.en: Although he is very tired, he never slacks off.

偷懒.zh: 因为偷懒，他被老板批评了。
偷懒.en: Because he slacked off, he was criticized by the boss.

出资.en: He funded the construction of a school.

出资.zh: 这次活动由公司出资赞助。
出资.en: This event is sponsored by the company.

出资.zh: 几个朋友共同出资开了一家店。
出资.en: Several friends jointly invested in opening a shop.

出资.zh: 如果没人愿意出资，项目只能取消。
出资.en: If no one is willing to fund it, the project will have to be canceled.

出资.zh: 政府出资帮助灾区重建家园。
出资.en: The government provided funds to help rebuild homes in the disaster area.

厚道.en: That boss is very kind and honest.
One should be a bit more magnanimous.

厚道.zh: 他虽然有钱，但为人很厚道。
厚道.en: Although he is rich, he is very honest and kind.

厚道.zh: 他不厚道，总是占别人便宜。
厚道.en: He is not kind; he always takes advantage of others.

厚道.zh: 我觉得你这么做不太厚道。
厚道.en: I think what you're doing is not very magnanimous.

横向.zh: 我们需要进行横向比较。
横向.en: We need to make a horizontal comparison.

横向.zh: 这张图显示了横向数据变化。
横向.en: This chart shows the horizontal data changes.

横向.zh: 公司鼓励部门间的横向合作。
横向.en: The company encourages horizontal collaboration between departments.

横向.zh: 如果横向对比，这个产品更有优势。
横向.en: If we compare horizontally, this product has more advantages.

就职.en: He will start his new job at the new company tomorrow.
She works at a big bank.

就职.zh: 毕业以后，他立刻就职了。
就职.en: After graduation, he started working immediately.
The new president will take office next month.

就职.zh: 虽然拿到了就职通知，但他还在犹豫。
就职.en: Although he received the job offer, he is still hesitating.

好在.zh: 虽然迷路了，但好在我们带了指南针。
好在.en: Although we got lost, fortunately we brought a compass.

好在.zh: 车子坏了，好在前边就有修车店。
好在.en: The car broke down, but luckily there's a repair shop ahead.

好在.zh: 好在他及时赶到，不然就晚了。
好在.en: Fortunately he arrived in time, otherwise it would be too late.

升值.zh: 这套房子买了五年，已经升值不少。
升值.en: This house was bought five years ago and has appreciated a lot.

升值.zh: 货币升值对出口有影响。
因为需求量增加，这些收藏品很快就升值了。
升值.en: Because of increased demand, these collectibles have appreciated quickly.
Investing in gold can preserve and increase value.

专长.zh: 招聘时，我们看重应聘者的专长和经验。
专长.en: When recruiting, we value candidates' expertise and experience.

专长.zh: 每个人都有自己的专长。
虽然他不擅长社交，但他的技术专长很厉害。
专长.en: Although he is not good at socializing, his technical expertise is impressive.

高傲.zh: 她那种高傲的态度让大家都不喜欢。
高傲.en: Her arrogant attitude makes everyone dislike her.

高傲.zh: 高傲的人很难交到朋友。
高傲.en: Arrogant people find it hard to make friends.

高傲.zh: 虽然他有才华，但过于高傲，所以不受欢迎。
高傲.en: Although he is talented, he is too arrogant, so he is not popular.

孵化.zh: 这家公司专门做创业孵化项目。
孵化.en: This company specializes in startup incubation projects.

孵化.zh: 小鸡需要二十一天才能孵化出来。
孵化器为新企业提供办公空间和资金支持。
孵化.en: Incubators provide office space and financial support for new businesses.
Snake eggs hatch in the sand.

包扎.zh: 摔倒后，朋友帮我用绷带包扎了膝盖。
包扎.en: After falling, my friend bandaged my knee with a bandage.

包扎.zh: 因为伤口不大，我自己简单包扎了一下。
包扎.en: Because the wound was not big, I simply bandaged it myself.

冲浪.zh: 夏威夷是冲浪爱好者的天堂。
他周末经常去海边冲浪。
冲浪.en: He often goes surfing at the beach on weekends.

冲浪.zh: 虽然浪很大，但他还是坚持冲浪。
冲浪.en: Although the waves were big, he still insisted on surfing.

肩负.zh: 作为队长，他肩负着带领队伍获胜的责任。
肩负.en: As the captain, he shoulders the responsibility of leading the team to victory.

肩负.zh: 父母肩负养育子女的义务。
肩负.en: Parents bear the duty of raising children.

肩负.zh: 虽然压力很大，但他依然肩负起这个项目。
肩负.en: Although the pressure is great, he still shoulders this project.

肩负.zh: 每个人肩负不同的使命。

陈旧.zh: 公司用的是陈旧的系统，效率很低。
陈旧.en: The company uses outdated systems, efficiency is low.

陈旧.zh: 他住在一条陈旧的巷子里。
陈旧.en: He lives in an old alley.

陈旧.zh: 虽然款式陈旧，但这件衣服质量很好。
陈旧.en: Although the style is outdated, this piece of clothing is of good quality.

纪念碑.zh: 每年都有很多人去纪念碑前献花。
纪念碑.en: Every year many people go to lay flowers at the monument.

纪念碑.zh: 这个广场中央有一座纪念碑。
纪念碑.en: There is a monument in the center of this square.

纪念碑.zh: 为了纪念英雄，他们在公园里建了一座纪念碑。
纪念碑.en: To commemorate the heroes, they built a monument in the park.

纪念碑.zh: 我们在纪念碑前合影留念。
纪念碑.en: We took a group photo in front of the monument.

直视.en: Do you dare to look me straight in the eye?

直视.zh: 他不敢直视老板的眼睛。
直视.en: He didn't dare to look his boss in the eye.

直视.zh: 虽然她很紧张，但还是直视着考官回答问题。
直视.en: Although she was nervous, she still looked the examiner straight in the eye while answering.

直视.zh: 我们直视问题，才能找到解决办法。
直视.en: Only by facing the problem directly can we find a solution.

直视.zh: 在谈判中，他一直直视对方，显得很有信心。
直视.en: During the negotiation, he kept looking the other party straight in the eye, appearing very confident.

收留.zh: 邻居收留了一只流浪猫。
收留.en: The neighbor took in a stray cat.

收留.zh: 朋友收留了我一晚，让我很感动。
收留.en: My friend put me up for a night, and I was very touched.

收留.zh: 因为无家可归，好心的老人收留了他。
收留.en: Because he was homeless, a kind old man took him in.

收留.zh: 这家收留了很多需要帮助的人。
收留.en: This place has sheltered many people in need.

收留.zh: 如果你没地方去，我可以暂时收留你。
收留.en: If you have nowhere to go, I can put you up temporarily.

传单.en: He is handing out flyers on the street.

传单.zh: 我在地铁口接到一张健身房的传单。
传单.en: I got a flyer for a gym at the subway entrance.

传单.zh: 虽然传单上写得很吸引人，但我没兴趣。
传单.en: Although the flyer looked very appealing, I wasn't interested.

传单.zh: 传单上的优惠已经过期了。
传单.en: The offer on the flyer has already expired.

传单.zh: 他们把传单塞进每个信箱里。
传单.en: They stuffed a flyer into every mailbox.

偷看.zh: 他偷偷从门缝里偷看客厅的情况。
偷看.en: He secretly peeked through the door crack to see what was happening in the living room.

偷看.zh: 虽然老师说不能偷看，他还是忍不住瞟了一眼。
偷看.en: Although the teacher said not to peek, he couldn't help sneaking a glance.

偷看.zh: 小孩躲在窗帘后面偷看客人。
偷看.en: The child hid behind the curtain and peeked at the guests.

偷看.zh: 考试时偷看别人的答案是不对的。
偷看.en: Peeking at someone else's answers during an exam is wrong.

分割.en: Cut the cake into four pieces.

分割.zh: 这条马路把小区分割成了两部分。
分割.en: This road divides the neighborhood into two parts.

分割.zh: 为了公平，他们把财产分割好了才离开。
分割.en: To be fair, they divided up the property before leaving.

分割.zh: 时间被分割成很多小块，很难专注。
分割.en: Time is fragmented into many small pieces, making it hard to focus.

分割.zh: 我们需要分割任务，提高效率。
分割.en: We need to divide the tasks to improve efficiency.

耽搁.zh: 因为下雨，航班耽搁了三个小时。
耽搁.en: The flight was delayed for three hours because of rain.

耽搁.zh: 如果你不耽搁，我们就能按时完成。
耽搁.en: If you don't delay, we can finish on time.

耽搁.zh: 路上堵车，耽搁了不少功夫。
耽搁.en: The traffic jam on the way caused quite a delay.

耽搁.zh: 这件事不能再耽搁了，必须马上处理。
耽搁.en: This matter can't be delayed any longer; it must be dealt with immediately.

冰山.zh: 泰坦尼克号撞上了冰山。
这个问题只是冰山一角。
冰山.en: This problem is just the tip of the iceberg.

冰山.zh: 虽然表面平静，但下面藏着冰山一样的问题。
冰山.en: Although the surface is calm, there are problems like an iceberg hidden underneath.

冰山.zh: 水下的冰山比露出来的大得多。
冰山.en: The iceberg underwater is much larger than what's visible.

冰山.zh: 南极的冰山正在慢慢融化。
冰山.en: The icebergs in Antarctica are slowly melting.

烟火.en: We set off fireworks on New Year's Eve.

烟火.zh: 城市禁止燃放烟火，防止火灾。
烟火.en: The city bans fireworks to prevent fires.

烟火.zh: 虽然烟火很美，但污染空气。
烟火.en: Although fireworks are beautiful, they pollute the air.

烟火.zh: 远处升起了绚丽的烟火。
烟火.en: Colorful fireworks rose up in the distance.

烟火.zh: 他拍了烟火表演的照片发朋友圈。
烟火.en: He took photos of the fireworks display and posted them on social media.

表述.zh: 这个问题很难用简单的语言表述出来。
表述.en: This problem is hard to express in simple language.

表述.zh: 如果你能更准确地表述你的想法，大家就懂了。
表述.en: If you can express your ideas more accurately, everyone will understand.

表述.zh: 他的表述方式让人容易理解。
表述.en: His way of expressing things makes it easy to understand.

表述.zh: 我们需要一个更正式的表述来写报告。
表述.en: We need a more formal expression for writing the report.

回味.en: This dish has an endless aftertaste.

回味.zh: 旅行结束后，我还在回味那里的风景。
回味.en: After the trip ended, I was still savoring the scenery.

回味.zh: 虽然已经过去很久，但每次想起都让我回味不已。
回味.en: Although it's been a long time, every time I think of it, I can't help but savor the memory.

回味.zh: 喝一口茶，慢慢回味它的香气。
回味.en: Take a sip of tea and slowly savor its aroma.

回味.zh: 这部电影有很多细节值得回味。
回味.en: This movie has many details worth savoring.

顺畅.zh: 今天网络很顺畅，视频一点都不卡。
顺畅.en: Today the network is smooth, the video doesn't lag at all.

顺畅.zh: 我们沟通很顺畅，很快就达成了协议。
顺畅.en: Our communication was smooth, we reached an agreement quickly.

顺畅.zh: 虽然一开始有点问题，但后来一切都很顺畅。
顺畅.en: Although there were some problems at first, everything went smoothly later.

顺畅.zh: 这个流程设计得很顺畅，没有多余步骤。
顺畅.en: This process is designed smoothly with no extra steps.

棍子.en: He hit the dog with a stick.

棍子.zh: 别拿棍子指着人，这样很不礼貌。
棍子.en: Don't point a stick at people, it's very rude.

棍子.zh: 他捡起一根棍子，然后开始在地上画图。
棍子.en: He picked up a stick and then started drawing on the ground.

棍子.zh: 这根棍子太短了，够不到树上的果子。
棍子.en: This stick is too short to reach the fruit on the tree.

棍子.zh: 小孩子喜欢拿棍子当剑玩。
棍子.en: Kids like to use sticks as swords to play.

曙光.zh: 经过努力，我们终于看到了胜利的曙光。
曙光.en: After hard work, we finally saw the dawn of victory.

曙光.zh: 虽然现在很困难，但曙光就在前面，别放弃。
曙光.en: Although it's hard now, dawn is ahead, don't give up.

曙光.zh: 清晨的曙光洒在湖面上，特别美。
曙光.en: The morning dawn shines on the lake, especially beautiful.

曙光.zh: 他在黑暗中等待曙光，心里充满希望。
曙光.en: He waited for dawn in the dark, full of hope in his heart.

嫂子.zh: 我嫂子明天要出差，让我帮忙照顾孩子。
嫂子.en: My sister-in-law is going on a business trip tomorrow, asking me to help take care of the kids.

嫂子.zh: 因为嫂子是医生，所以她经常给我们健康建议。
嫂子.en: Because my sister-in-law is a doctor, she often gives us health advice.

嫂子.zh: 嫂子，你帮我看看这个衣服合不合适？
嫂子.en: Sister-in-law, can you check if this dress fits me?

嫂子.zh: 大哥和嫂子结婚十年了，感情一直很好。
嫂子.en: My elder brother and sister-in-law have been married for ten years, their relationship has always been good.

胸膛.en: He puffed out his chest, very confident.

胸膛.zh: 他用力拍了一下胸膛，说包在我身上。
胸膛.en: He slapped his chest and said, 'Leave it to me.'

胸膛.zh: 虽然受了伤，但他依然挺起胸膛往前走。
胸膛.en: Although injured, he still puffed out his chest and walked forward.

胸膛.zh: 她趴在丈夫的胸膛上，安静地睡着了。
胸膛.en: She lay on her husband's chest and fell asleep quietly.

胸膛.zh: 他的胸膛很宽，看起来很可靠。
胸膛.en: His chest is broad, looks very reliable.

带队.en: This time Teacher Zhang is leading the team.

带队.zh: 他带队去爬山，结果迷路了。
带队.en: He led a team to climb the mountain, but got lost.

带队.zh: 因为队长经验丰富，所以他带队我们很放心。
带队.en: Because the captain is experienced, we feel assured with him leading the team.

带队.zh: 她第一次带队比赛，心里有点紧张。
带队.en: She is leading a team in a competition for the first time, a bit nervous.

带队.zh: 明天学校组织春游，谁来带队？
带队.en: The school is organizing a spring outing tomorrow, who will lead the team?

血缘.zh: 虽然我们不是亲兄弟，但感情胜过血缘。
血缘.en: Although we are not biological brothers, our bond surpasses blood relation.

血缘.zh: 血缘很重要，但更重要的是一家人之间的感情。
血缘.en: Blood relation is important, but what's more important is the affection among family members.

血缘.zh: 他找到了失散多年的有血缘关系的亲人。
血缘.en: He found a blood relative he had been separated from for many years.

血缘.zh: 在法律上，收养的孩子和养父母没有血缘关系。
血缘.en: Legally, adopted children have no blood relationship with adoptive parents.

漫游.en: Roaming charges on the phone are too expensive.

漫游.zh: 他在欧洲漫游了一个月，去了很多城市。
漫游.en: He roamed around Europe for a month, visited many cities.

漫游.zh: 出国前记得开通国际漫游，不然手机没法用。
漫游.en: Remember to activate international roaming before going abroad, otherwise the phone won't work.

漫游.zh: 我喜欢在森林里漫游，感受大自然。
漫游.en: I like to roam in the forest, feel nature.

漫游.zh: 这个套餐包含免费漫游流量，很划算。
漫游.en: This package includes free roaming data, very cost-effective.

情调.en: This restaurant has a lot of ambiance.

情调.zh: 他们喜欢有情调的生活，经常买花布置家里。
