情调.en: They like a life with style, often buying flowers to decorate the home.

情调.zh: 虽然地方不大，但装饰得很有情调，让人感觉很舒服。
情调.en: Although the place is small, it's decorated with great taste, making people feel comfortable.

情调.zh: 情人节那天，他安排了一顿很有情调的晚餐。
情调.en: On Valentine's Day, he arranged a very romantic dinner.

情调.zh: 这条街上的咖啡馆情调都不错，适合约会。
情调.en: The cafes on this street all have nice ambiance, suitable for dates.

繁华.zh: 上海是一个繁华的大都市，吸引了很多年轻人。
繁华.en: Shanghai is a bustling metropolis, attracting many young people.

繁华.zh: 虽然城市很繁华，但我更喜欢安静的小镇。
繁华.en: Although the city is bustling, I prefer quiet small towns.

繁华.zh: 晚上八点，商业区依然灯火辉煌，非常繁华。
繁华.en: At 8 p.m., the commercial district is still brightly lit, very bustling.

繁华.zh: 他从小在繁华的市区长大，习惯了热闹。
繁华.en: He grew up in a bustling downtown area, used to the hustle and bustle.

上限.en: Is there an upper limit for this price?

上限.zh: 我们公司规定了加班时间不能超过上限。
上限.en: Our company has set an upper limit on overtime hours.

上限.zh: 虽然预算有上限，但我们还是尽量做到最好。
上限.en: Although the budget has an upper limit, we still try to do our best.

上限.zh: 他的能力好像没有上限。
上限.en: His ability seems to have no upper limit.

上限.zh: 每次考试分数都有上限，你不用担心考太高。
上限.en: Each exam has a maximum score, so you don't need to worry about scoring too high.

煽动.zh: 这种言论很容易煽动大家的情绪。
煽动.en: Such remarks easily stir up people's emotions.

煽动.zh: 他因为煽动暴力而被警察带走了。
煽动.en: He was taken away by police for inciting violence.

煽动.zh: 不要轻易相信那些煽动仇恨的话。
煽动.en: Don't easily believe words that incite hatred.

煽动.zh: 社交媒体上有人故意煽动对立。
煽动.en: On social media, some people deliberately incite opposition.

崇尚.zh: 这个民族一直崇尚和平与自然。
崇尚.en: This ethnic group has always upheld peace and nature.

崇尚.zh: 虽然现在科技发达，但很多人依然崇尚传统的生活方式。
崇尚.en: Although technology is advanced now, many people still advocate traditional lifestyles.

崇尚.zh: 她崇尚简约，家里东西很少。
崇尚.en: She advocates simplicity, so there's little stuff at home.

崇尚.zh: 学校应该崇尚诚信，而不是分数。
崇尚.en: Schools should advocate integrity, not just scores.

记性.zh: 我记性越来越差，总是忘东西。
记性.en: My memory is getting worse; I always forget things.

记性.zh: 他记性不好，所以出门前总会列个清单。
记性.en: He has a bad memory, so he always makes a list before going out.

记性.zh: 别考验我的记性，我记不住那么多人名。
记性.en: Don't test my memory; I can't remember so many names.

记性.zh: 老人家的记性有时候比年轻人还好。
记性.en: Old people's memory is sometimes better than young people's.

渺小.en: Humans are very tiny in the universe.

渺小.zh: 面对大自然，我们常常感到自己很渺小。
渺小.en: Facing nature, we often feel very insignificant.

渺小.zh: 虽然个体很渺小，但团结起来力量很大。
渺小.en: Although an individual is tiny, united strength is great.

渺小.zh: 别把问题看得太渺小，有时候小事也会变大。
渺小.en: Don't see the problem as too insignificant; sometimes small things become big.

渺小.zh: 在历史长河里，一个人的生命多么渺小。
渺小.en: In the long river of history, how small a person's life is.

姓氏.zh: 在中国，姓氏通常放在名字前面。
姓氏.en: In China, the surname usually goes before the given name.

姓氏.zh: 我们班有三个同学姓氏相同，都姓张。
姓氏.en: There are three classmates with the same surname in our class, all Zhang.

姓氏.zh: 很多古老的姓氏现在很少见了。
姓氏.en: Many ancient surnames are rarely seen now.

姓氏.zh: 她的姓氏很特别，我从来没听过。
姓氏.en: Her surname is very special; I've never heard of it.

安逸.zh: 年轻人不要太追求安逸，应该多努力。
安逸.en: Young people shouldn't pursue comfort too much; they should work hard.

安逸.zh: 虽然现在工作很安逸，但我觉得没什么挑战。
安逸.en: Although the job is comfortable now, I feel it lacks challenge.

安逸.zh: 大城市虽然机会多，但小城市更安逸。
安逸.en: Big cities have more opportunities, but small cities are more comfortable.

安逸.zh: 退休后他终于可以享受安逸的时光了。
安逸.en: After retirement, he can finally enjoy comfortable time.

出台.zh: 政府最近出台了一系列环保措施。
出台.en: The government recently introduced a series of environmental measures.

出台.zh: 因为房价太高，相关部门出台了限购政策。
出台.en: Because house prices are too high, relevant departments introduced purchase restrictions.

出台.zh: 这位歌手一出台，观众就欢呼起来。
出台.en: As soon as the singer came on stage, the audience cheered.

出台.zh: 学校出台了新的校规，大家要注意遵守。
出台.en: The school introduced new rules; everyone should follow them.

牲畜.en: These livestock need to be fed.

牲畜.zh: 牧民们赶着牲畜去水草丰富的地方。
牲畜.en: The herders drive the livestock to places with abundant water and grass.

牲畜.zh: 因为干旱，很多牲畜都渴死了。
牲畜.en: Because of the drought, many livestock died of thirst.

牲畜.zh: 他家里养了很多牲畜，比如牛和羊。
牲畜.en: His family keeps a lot of livestock, such as cows and sheep.

牲畜.zh: 不要虐待牲畜，它们也是生命。
牲畜.en: Don't abuse livestock; they are also lives.

强项.zh: 说到做饭，那可不是我的强项。
强项.en: When it comes to cooking, that's not my strong point.

强项.zh: 虽然英语不是我的强项，但我会努力学。
强项.en: Although English is not my strong point, I will study hard.

强项.zh: 每个运动员都有自己的强项和弱项。
强项.en: Every athlete has their own strengths and weaknesses.

强项.zh: 他的强项是沟通，所以很适合做销售。
强项.en: His strength is communication, so he is very suitable for sales.

光盘.zh: 我昨天买了一张新电影的光盘。
光盘.en: I bought a new movie DVD yesterday.

光盘.zh: 现在很少有人用光盘了，都用U盘。
光盘.en: Now few people use CDs; they all use USB drives.

光盘.zh: 这些旧光盘可以回收吗？
光盘.en: Can these old CDs be recycled?

光盘.zh: 他把光盘放进电脑里，结果读不出来。
光盘.en: He put the CD into the computer, but it couldn't read it.

朦胧.en: This morning it's a bit hazy.

朦胧.zh: 她的记忆已经很朦胧了，记不清细节。
朦胧.en: Her memory is already very hazy; she can't remember details.

朦胧.zh: 月光下的景色特别朦胧，像画一样。
朦胧.en: The scenery under moonlight is especially hazy, like a painting.

朦胧.zh: 他对未来的感觉有点朦胧。
朦胧.en: His feeling about the future is a bit hazy.

立足.en: You need to establish yourself first.

立足.zh: 在这个行业立足需要很多经验和人脉。
立足.en: To get a foothold in this industry requires a lot of experience and connections.

立足.zh: 他靠自己的努力在这里立足了。
立足.en: He relied on his own efforts to stand here.
Without money it's hard to get a foothold.

立足.zh: 我们必须立足现实，不能空想。
立足.en: We must base ourselves on reality, not daydream.

买不起.en: This is too expensive; I can't afford it.

买不起.zh: 现在房价这么高，普通人都买不起。
买不起.en: Now housing prices are so high, ordinary people can't afford to buy.

买不起.zh: 她看中了一个包，但是买不起。
买不起.en: She liked a bag, but can't afford it.

买不起.zh: 他叹了口气说，这房子我买不起。
买不起.en: He sighed and said, I can't afford this house.

钉子.en: There's a nail on the wall.

钉子.zh: 他用锤子把钉子敲进去了。
这个钉子有点松了，要加固一下。
钉子.en: This nail is a bit loose; it needs to be tightened.
Be careful not to step on a nail.

钉子.zh: 他是个钉子户，死活不搬。
钉子.en: He's a stubborn holdout; absolutely won't move.

上头.en: The book is placed on top.

上头.zh: 他喝了几杯酒就上头了。
上头.en: He drank a few cups and got tipsy.

上头.zh: 那个东西在柜子的上头。
上头.en: That thing is on top of the cabinet.
This song gets more addictive the more you listen.

打捞.en: They are salvaging the sunken ship.

打捞.zh: 救援队正在打捞落水的游客。
打捞.en: The rescue team is fishing out the tourists who fell into the water.

打捞.zh: 这些文物是从河里打捞上来的。
打捞.en: These artifacts were salvaged from the river.
They fished out a cell phone.

子孙.en: He hopes to have many descendants.

子孙.zh: 我们应该为子孙保护好环境。
子孙.en: We should protect the environment for future generations.

子孙.zh: 他的子孙都在国外生活。

子孙.en: This is passed down from ancestors to descendants.
He doesn't want his descendants to suffer again.

施压.en: The boss is putting pressure on him.

施压.zh: 公司对员工施压要求加班。
施压.en: The company is pressuring employees to work overtime.

施压.zh: 别给我施压，我自己会决定。
施压.en: Don't put pressure on me; I'll decide myself.
They are trying to apply pressure.

施压.zh: 家长不应该对孩子施压太大。
施压.en: Parents should not put too much pressure on children.

交接.zh: 新老员工需要进行工作交接。
交接.en: New and old employees need to do a work handover.

交接.zh: 他们交接完文件就走了。
交接.en: They finished handing over the documents and left.

拍戏.en: He is currently shooting a film in Hengdian.

拍戏.zh: 拍戏虽然很累，但是很有意思。
拍戏.en: Although filming is very tiring, it's also very interesting.

拍戏.zh: 她因为拍戏受伤了，现在在家休息。
拍戏.en: She got injured while filming and is now resting at home.

拍戏.zh: 很多演员觉得拍戏比想象中辛苦多了。
拍戏.en: Many actors find filming much harder than they imagined.

耗费.zh: 这个项目耗费了大量资金。
耗费.en: This project consumed a huge amount of funds.

耗费.zh: 写论文耗费了我很多精力。
耗费.en: Writing the thesis drained a lot of my energy.

耗费.zh: 他每天耗费两小时在通勤上。
耗费.en: He spends two hours every day on commuting.

耗费.zh: 因为设备老化，耗费的电越来越多。
耗费.en: Because the equipment is aging, it consumes more and more electricity.

耗费.zh: 我们不应该耗费时间在无谓的争吵上。
耗费.en: We shouldn't waste time on pointless arguments.

大笔.en: He spent a large amount of money on a house.

大笔.zh: 公司最近收到了一笔大笔投资。
大笔.en: The company recently received a large investment.

大笔.zh: 为了治病，他们家欠了大笔债。
大笔.en: To treat the illness, their family owes a huge debt.

大笔.zh: 虽然收入不错，但他没有大笔存款。
大笔.en: Although his income is good, he doesn't have a large amount of savings.

大笔.zh: 政府拨了一笔大笔资金用于灾后重建。
大笔.en: The government allocated a large sum of money for post-disaster reconstruction.

福气.zh: 你真有福气，嫁了个好老公。
福气.en: You are truly fortunate to have married a good husband.

福气.zh: 能吃到妈妈做的饭是种福气。
福气.en: Being able to eat mom's cooking is a blessing.

福气.zh: 他虽然有钱，但我觉得他没福气。
福气.en: Although he has money, I think he lacks good fortune.

福气.zh: 有福气的人往往懂得知足。
福气.en: Fortunate people often know how to be content.

福气.zh: 大家都说这孩子有福气，生下来就健健康康的。
福气.en: Everyone says this child is blessed, born healthy and strong.

受苦.en: She is willing to suffer for her children.

受苦.zh: 年轻时候受苦不一定是坏事。
受苦.en: Suffering in youth is not necessarily a bad thing.

受苦.zh: 他从小受苦，所以特别珍惜现在的生活。
受苦.en: He suffered since childhood, so he especially cherishes his current life.

受苦.zh: 我不忍心看着父母继续受苦。
受苦.en: I can't bear to watch my parents continue to suffer.

明媚.en: The weather is really bright and lovely today.

明媚.zh: 阳光明媚的午后，我们去公园散步。
明媚.en: On a bright and sunny afternoon, we went for a walk in the park.

明媚.zh: 她的笑容像明媚的阳光一样温暖。
明媚.en: Her smile is as warm as bright sunshine.

明媚.zh: 虽然天气明媚，但我心情不好。
明媚.en: Although the weather is bright, I'm in a bad mood.

明媚.zh: 春天的田野格外明媚，让人心情舒畅。
明媚.en: The spring fields are especially bright and beautiful, making people feel relaxed.

家政.zh: 家政服务现在越来越普及了。
家政.en: Housekeeping services are becoming more and more common now.

家政.zh: 我朋友做家政工作，收入还不错。
家政.en: My friend works in housekeeping and earns pretty well.

家政.zh: 因为工作太忙，他们请了家政来打扫卫生。
家政.en: Because they are too busy with work, they hired a housekeeper to clean.

家政.zh: 好的家政人员很难找，需要提前预约。
家政.en: Good housekeepers are hard to find, so you need to book in advance.

胡闹.zh: 小孩子不懂事，总爱胡闹。
胡闹.en: Kids don't understand things and always like to fool around.

胡闹.zh: 他喝醉了在街上胡闹，被警察带走了。
胡闹.en: He got drunk and caused trouble on the street, and was taken away by the police.

胡闹.zh: 这件事很重要，不是胡闹的时候。
胡闹.en: This matter is very important; it's not the time for fooling around.

胡闹.zh: 你们再这样胡闹下去，老师会生气的。
胡闹.en: If you keep messing around like this, the teacher will get angry.

践踏.en: His dignity was ruthlessly trampled upon.

践踏.zh: 战争践踏了无数平民的生命。
践踏.en: War trampled on the lives of countless civilians.

践踏.zh: 这些法律保护公民权利不被践踏。
践踏.en: These laws protect citizens' rights from being violated.

践踏.zh: 我们不能容忍任何人践踏我们的底线。
践踏.en: We cannot tolerate anyone crossing our bottom line.

用意.en: What is his intention in doing this?

用意.zh: 我说这些话的用意是想帮你。
用意.en: My intention in saying these words is to help you.

用意.zh: 虽然他的话不好听，但用意是好的。
用意.en: Although his words were unpleasant, his intention was good.

用意.zh: 她送礼物给你，用意很明显。
用意.en: She gave you a gift; her intention is very clear.

用意.zh: 老板的用意是让我们多学点东西，别误会。
用意.en: The boss's intention is to let us learn more, so don't misunderstand.

埋藏.zh: 他把秘密埋藏在心里很久了。
埋藏.en: He buried the secret in his heart for a long time.

埋藏.zh: 这些化石埋藏在地下几千年了。
埋藏.en: These fossils have been buried underground for thousands of years.

埋藏.zh: 她埋藏了那段痛苦的回忆，不想再提起。
埋藏.en: She buried that painful memory and didn't want to mention it again.

埋藏.zh: 因为地震，很多文物被埋藏在废墟下面。
埋藏.en: Because of the earthquake, many cultural relics were buried under the rubble.

埋藏.zh: 虽然我们埋藏了矛盾，但问题还是没解决。
埋藏.en: Although we buried the conflict, the problem still hasn't been resolved.

迁移.zh: 每年冬天，这些鸟都会向南迁移。
迁移.en: Every winter, these birds migrate south.

迁移.zh: 工厂从城市迁移到了郊区。
迁移.en: The factory moved from the city to the suburbs.

迁移.zh: 随着气候变暖，许多物种开始向高海拔迁移。
迁移.en: As the climate warms, many species are starting to migrate to higher altitudes.

迁移.zh: 他们决定把公司总部迁移到上海。
迁移.en: They decided to relocate the company headquarters to Shanghai.

迁移.zh: 由于城市规划，这个村子整体迁移到了附近的新区。
迁移.en: Due to urban planning, the whole village was relocated to a nearby new area.

路段.en: There was a car accident on the road ahead.
Please slow down on the construction section.

路段.zh: 因为下雪，山区路段已经封闭了。
路段.en: Due to snow, the mountain road section has been closed.

流向.en: This river eventually flows into the sea.

流向.zh: 我们需要调查资金的流向。
流向.en: We need to investigate the flow of funds.

流向.zh: 改变河流的流向会影响生态环境。
流向.en: Changing the river's flow direction can affect the ecological environment.

流向.zh: 调查显示，人口主要向大城市流向。
流向.en: The survey shows that the population mainly flows toward big cities.

流向.zh: 你必须顺着市场的流向来做决策。
流向.en: You have to make decisions according to the market flow.

估算.zh: 我估算了一下，大概需要三天。
估算.en: I estimated it and it'll probably take three days.

估算.zh: 专家估算这次地震造成的损失很大。
估算.en: Experts estimate that the losses from this earthquake are huge.

估算.zh: 你能帮我估算一下装修的费用吗？
估算.en: Can you help me estimate the cost of renovation?

估算.zh: 根据初步估算，今年公司利润会增长10%。
估算.en: According to preliminary estimates, the company's profits will grow by 10% this year.

估算.zh: 虽然只是估算，但数据应该相差不大。
估算.en: Although it's just an estimate, the data should not differ much.

清澈.zh: 她的眼睛清澈得像湖水一样。
清澈.en: Her eyes are as clear as a lake.
The sky is exceptionally clear after the rain.

清澈.zh: 溪水清澈见底，能看到小鱼在游。
清澈.en: The stream is so clear that you can see the bottom and little fish swimming.

清澈.zh: 虽然河水很清澈，但水温还是有点凉。
清澈.en: Although the river water is very clear, the temperature is still a bit cold.

官僚.zh: 这种官僚作风让人受不了。
官僚.en: This kind of bureaucratic style is unbearable.

官僚.zh: 公司里官僚气氛很重，效率很低。
官僚.en: The company has a heavy bureaucratic atmosphere and low efficiency.

官僚.zh: 我们需要减少官僚程序，加快审批速度。
官僚.en: We need to reduce bureaucratic procedures and speed up approvals.

官僚.zh: 虽然他是官僚出身，但做事还挺务实。
官僚.en: Although he comes from a bureaucratic background, he is quite pragmatic in doing things.

费劲.en: Don't bother; just take a taxi.
He climbed up to the sixth floor with great effort.

费劲.zh: 这道题太费劲了，我算了好久。
费劲.en: This problem is too laborious; I've been calculating for a long time.

费劲.zh: 虽然很费劲，但他还是坚持把箱子搬了上去。
费劲.en: Although it was very strenuous, he still insisted on carrying the box up.

光环.en: She seems to have a halo on her head.

光环.zh: 明星的光环并不代表一切。
光环.en: A star's halo doesn't mean everything.

光环.zh: 他走出了父亲的光环，闯出了自己的路。
光环.en: He stepped out of his father's halo and carved out his own path.

光环.zh: 这个城市的光环吸引了无数游客。
光环.en: The city's aura attracts countless tourists.

光环.zh: 去掉名校的光环，他其实就是一个普通人。
光环.en: Take off the halo of a prestigious school, and he's actually just an ordinary person.

没劲.zh: 他最近总是觉得很没劲。
没劲.en: He's been feeling very listless lately.

没劲.zh: 别老说没劲的话，开心点。
没劲.en: Don't always say boring things; cheer up.

没劲.zh: 下雨天待在家里，确实有点没劲。
没劲.en: Staying at home on a rainy day is indeed a bit boring.

搬迁.zh: 我们下个月要搬迁到新办公室。
搬迁.en: We are moving to a new office next month.

搬迁.zh: 因为房租太贵，他们决定搬迁到郊区。
搬迁.en: Because the rent is too expensive, they decided to move to the suburbs.

搬迁.zh: 工厂搬迁后，员工们都很不方便。
搬迁.en: After the factory moved, the employees found it very inconvenient.

搬迁.zh: 这次搬迁计划得提前通知所有住户。
搬迁.en: This relocation plan requires notifying all residents in advance.

搬迁.zh: 公司搬迁过程中丢了不少重要文件。
搬迁.en: The company lost a lot of important documents during the move.

花纹.en: The pattern on this cloth is very special.

花纹.zh: 我喜欢这种传统的蓝色花纹。
花纹.en: I like this traditional blue pattern.

花纹.zh: 她的裙子上有漂亮的花纹和亮片。
花纹.en: Her dress has beautiful patterns and sequins.

花纹.zh: 这个瓷碗上的花纹是手工画的。
花纹.en: The pattern on this porcelain bowl is hand-painted.

花纹.zh: 地毯上的花纹虽然简单，但看起来很舒服。
花纹.en: Although the pattern on the carpet is simple, it looks very comfortable.

黑马.zh: 这次比赛他是一匹黑马。
黑马.en: He was a dark horse in this competition.

黑马.zh: 没人想到那支新球队会成为联赛的黑马。
黑马.en: No one expected that new team to become the dark horse of the league.

黑马.zh: 这个演员以前默默无闻，现在成了影坛黑马。
黑马.en: This actor was unknown before, but now he's a dark horse in the film industry.

黑马.zh: 今年选举中出了一匹黑马，打败了所有老对手。
黑马.en: A dark horse emerged in this year's election, defeating all old rivals.

黑马.zh: 她以黑马之姿夺得冠军，让很多人惊讶。
黑马.en: She won the championship as a dark horse, surprising many people.

胡思乱想.en: Stop overthinking and go to sleep.

胡思乱想.zh: 他总是一个人胡思乱想，结果把自己吓到了。
胡思乱想.en: He always lets his imagination run wild alone, and ends up scaring himself.

胡思乱想.zh: 你整天胡思乱想，对事情一点帮助都没有。
胡思乱想.en: You're overthinking all day, and it doesn't help at all.

胡思乱想.zh: 她因为失眠，晚上容易胡思乱想一些不好的事情。
胡思乱想.en: Because of insomnia, she easily has wild thoughts about bad things at night.

胡思乱想.zh: 其实事情没那么复杂，你别胡思乱想了。
胡思乱想.en: Actually, things aren't that complicated. Don't let your imagination run wild.

寺庙.en: We are going to the temple to burn incense this weekend.

寺庙.zh: 这座寺庙建于唐朝，历史悠久。
寺庙.en: This temple was built in the Tang Dynasty and has a long history.

寺庙.zh: 每年春节，很多游客都会来这个寺庙祈福。
寺庙.en: Every Spring Festival, many tourists come to this temple to pray for blessings.

寺庙.zh: 寺庙里的和尚每天清晨都会念经。
寺庙.en: The monks in the temple chant sutras every morning.

寺庙.zh: 他喜欢在寺庙待着，因为那里很安静。
寺庙.en: He likes to stay at the temple because it's very quiet there.

患病.zh: 他最近患病了，需要休息。
患病.en: He recently fell ill and needs rest.

患病.zh: 她患病之后，生活变得很困难。
患病.en: After she fell ill, life became very difficult for her.

高昂.en: The price of this bag is too high.

高昂.zh: 听到胜利的消息，大家的情绪都非常高昂。
高昂.en: Upon hearing the news of victory, everyone's spirits were very high.

高昂.zh: 高昂的房租让很多年轻人负担不起。
高昂.en: The high rent makes it unaffordable for many young people.

高昂.zh: 他们高昂的斗志感染了全场观众。
高昂.en: Their high morale infected the entire audience.

高昂.zh: 因为医疗费用高昂，他不得不向亲戚借钱。
高昂.en: Because the medical costs were exorbitant, he had to borrow money from relatives.

其后.zh: 他先去了北京，其后又去了上海。
其后.en: He first went to Beijing, and then went to Shanghai.

其后.zh: 我们先是吃饭，其后去看了一场电影。
其后.en: We first had dinner, and then went to see a movie.

其后.zh: 公司裁了一批人，其后业绩反而变好了。
其后.en: The company laid off a batch of people, and afterward performance actually improved.

其后.zh: 他把房子卖了，其后就再也没回来过。
其后.en: He sold the house, and after that he never came back.

其后.zh: 事故发生时他不在现场，其后才听说。
其后.en: He wasn't at the scene when the accident happened; he only heard about it afterward.

无理.zh: 他刚才说的话太无理了。
无理.en: What he just said was extremely unreasonable.

无理.zh: 这个客人因为一点小事就大吵大闹，真是无理。
无理.en: This customer made a big fuss over a small matter; it's really unreasonable.

无理.zh: 你这种无理的要求，我们没办法满足。
无理.en: We cannot satisfy such an unreasonable demand from you.

无理.zh: 他态度无理，惹得大家都生气了。
无理.en: His unreasonable attitude made everyone angry.

无理.zh: 虽然对方无理，但我们还是要保持礼貌。
无理.en: Even though the other party is unreasonable, we still need to remain polite.

侵权.zh: 这家公司侵权了，被告上法庭。
侵权.en: This company infringed on rights and was taken to court.

侵权.zh: 他们未经允许使用我的照片，这属于侵权。
侵权.en: They used my photos without permission; this constitutes infringement.

侵权.zh: 很多小网站因为侵权问题被罚款。
侵权.en: Many small websites were fined for copyright infringement.

侵权.zh: 他起诉对方侵权，要求赔偿损失。
侵权.en: He sued the other party for infringement and demanded compensation for losses.

侵权.zh: 在网络上转载别人的文章要小心，避免侵权。
侵权.en: Be careful when reposting others' articles online to avoid infringement.

像样.en: This piece of clothing is quite decent.

像样.zh: 他做的菜虽然简单，但还挺像样的。
像样.en: Although his cooking is simple, it's still pretty presentable.
Your painting is really not up to par!

像样.zh: 他穿得像个样子，但说话不像样。
像样.en: He dresses decently, but his speech is not proper.

像样.zh: 我希望能做出一个像样的项目来。
像样.en: I hope to create a decent project.

字体.zh: 我喜欢用黑体字体写报告。
字体.en: I like to use the bold font for writing reports.

字体.zh: 你换一个字体试试，可能更好看。
字体.en: Try changing the font; it might look better.

字体.zh: 手机里有很多免费字体可以下载。
字体.en: There are many free fonts you can download on your phone.

字体.zh: 因为字体太小，我看不清屏幕。
字体.en: Because the font is too small, I can't see the screen clearly.

铸造.zh: 工厂正在铸造一批新零件。
铸造.en: The factory is casting a batch of new parts.

铸造.zh: 他的性格是在艰苦中铸造出来的。
铸造.en: His character was forged through hardship.

铸造.zh: 这种工艺可以铸造非常精细的模型。
铸造.en: This technique can cast very detailed models.

铸造.zh: 他们用传统方法铸造了一口大钟。
铸造.en: They used traditional methods to cast a large bell.

冒犯.zh: 对不起，我不是故意冒犯你。
冒犯.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

冒犯.zh: 他说话太直，经常冒犯别人。
冒犯.en: He speaks too bluntly and often offends others.

冒犯.zh: 如果你觉得我冒犯了，请直接告诉我。
冒犯.en: If you feel I've offended you, please tell me directly.

冒犯.zh: 我不想冒犯任何人，但必须说实话。
冒犯.en: I don't want to offend anyone, but I have to tell the truth.

冒犯.zh: 你刚才那句话有点冒犯人了。
冒犯.en: What you just said was a bit offensive.

由衷.zh: 我由衷地感谢你的帮助。
由衷.en: I sincerely thank you for your help.

由衷.zh: 她由衷地为他感到高兴。
由衷.en: She is genuinely happy for him.

由衷.zh: 这是我由衷的建议，希望你考虑。
由衷.en: This is my heartfelt advice; I hope you'll consider it.

由衷.zh: 听了你的故事，我由衷佩服。
由衷.en: After hearing your story, I truly admire you.

由衷.zh: 他由衷地希望大家都平安。

就诊.en: I went to see a doctor this morning.

就诊.zh: 医院规定就诊前要先挂号。
就诊.en: The hospital requires you to register before seeing a doctor.

就诊.zh: 他因为咳嗽严重，所以去门诊就诊。
就诊.en: Because his cough was severe, he went to the outpatient clinic.

就诊.zh: 就诊时记得带身份证和医保卡。
就诊.en: Remember to bring your ID and health insurance card when seeing a doctor.

就诊.zh: 这家诊所的就诊环境很好。
就诊.en: The consultation environment at this clinic is very good.

浸泡.en: The clothes need to soak for half an hour.

浸泡.zh: 把豆子浸泡一晚上再煮。
浸泡.en: Soak the beans overnight before cooking.

浸泡.zh: 他喜欢在热水中浸泡双脚放松。
浸泡.en: He likes to soak his feet in hot water to relax.

浸泡.zh: 浸泡时间太长，衣服都褪色了。
浸泡.en: The soaking time was too long, and the clothes faded.

浸泡.zh: 这种药需要浸泡后才能服用。
浸泡.en: This medicine needs to be soaked before taking.

三维.zh: 他们用三维打印技术制作零件。
三维.en: They use 3D printing technology to make parts.

三维.zh: 我喜欢看三维电影，效果特别震撼。
三维.en: I like watching 3D movies; the effect is especially stunning.

三维.zh: 三维设计在游戏行业非常常见。
三维.en: 3D design is very common in the gaming industry.

三维.zh: 因为有了三维扫描，修复文物更容易了。
三维.en: Because of 3D scanning, restoring cultural relics has become easier.

下决心.en: I finally made up my mind to lose weight.

下决心.zh: 他下决心要学一门新技能。
下决心.en: He decided to learn a new skill.

下决心.zh: 下决心之后，行动就变得简单了。
下决心.en: After making up your mind, taking action becomes simple.

下决心.zh: 她一直犹豫，最后下决心辞职。
下决心.en: She hesitated for a long time, but finally decided to quit.

下决心.zh: 你下决心了吗？别再拖了。
下决心.en: Have you made up your mind? Don't put it off any longer.

动弹.en: He is so tired he can't move.

动弹.zh: 别动，让我拍张照你再动弹。
动弹.en: Don't move, let me take a photo and then you can move.

动弹.zh: 受伤后他的腿完全动弹不得。
动弹.en: After the injury, his leg was completely immobile.

动弹.zh: 我在座位上坐了一下午，几乎没动弹。
动弹.en: I sat in the seat all afternoon, barely moving.

动弹.zh: 你稍微动弹一下，我给你整理衣服。
动弹.en: Move a little bit, and I'll straighten your clothes for you.

自然界.zh: 自然界有很多神奇的动物。
自然界.en: There are many amazing animals in nature.

自然界.zh: 我们要保护自然界，不要乱扔垃圾。
自然界.en: We need to protect nature and not litter.

自然界.zh: 自然界的变化常常影响我们的生活。
自然界.en: Changes in nature often affect our lives.

自然界.zh: 虽然人类很强大，但还是离不开自然界。
自然界.en: Although humans are powerful, we still cannot live without nature.

自然界.zh: 他喜欢观察自然界中的小鸟和花草。
自然界.en: He likes to observe the birds and flowers in nature.

交锋.en: The two teams face off tonight.

交锋.zh: 他们首次交锋就打得难分难解。
交锋.en: Their first encounter was a very close match.

交锋.zh: 辩论会上双方交锋了好几个回合。
交锋.en: The two sides went several rounds of debate in the discussion.

交锋.zh: 虽然两人观点不同，但交锋后反而更尊重对方。
交锋.en: Although they had different views, they respected each other more after the confrontation.

交锋.zh: 这次选举中两位候选人多次公开交锋。
交锋.en: The two candidates had multiple public debates during the election.

恰到好处.en: The saltiness of this dish is just right.

恰到好处.zh: 你的话说得恰到好处，大家都笑了。
恰到好处.en: Your words were perfectly timed; everyone laughed.

恰到好处.zh: 这件衣服的颜色和款式都恰到好处。
恰到好处.en: The color and style of this dress are just perfect.

恰到好处.zh: 他批评人总是恰到好处，不会让人难堪。
恰到好处.en: He always criticizes people just right, without embarrassing them.

恰到好处.zh: 虽然预算不多，但安排得恰到好处，活动很成功。
恰到好处.en: Although the budget was small, it was arranged perfectly, and the event was very successful.

藏匿.en: That cat is hiding in the bushes.

藏匿.zh: 警方在仓库里发现了藏匿的毒品。
藏匿.en: The police found the hidden drugs in the warehouse.

藏匿.zh: 他藏匿了很久才敢出来。
藏匿.en: He hid for a long time before daring to come out.

藏匿.zh: 为了躲避追捕，他藏匿在一个偏僻的山村。
藏匿.en: To avoid capture, he hid in a remote mountain village.

无关紧要.en: This matter is of no importance.

无关紧要.zh: 别为那些无关紧要的小事生气。
无关紧要.en: Don't get angry over trivial matters.

无关紧要.zh: 细节虽然无关紧要，但也要检查一下。
无关紧要.en: Although the details are not important, we should still check them.

无关紧要.zh: 对于他来说，钱反而是无关紧要的东西。
无关紧要.en: To him, money is actually an unimportant thing.

无关紧要.zh: 考试时别把时间浪费在无关紧要的题目上。
无关紧要.en: Don't waste time on unimportant questions during the exam.

尺度.en: You need to have a sense of proportion in doing things.
The scale of this drawing is wrong.
You need to be mindful of the limits when joking.

尺度.zh: 这个问题的尺度很大，需要认真讨论。
尺度.en: The scope of this issue is large and requires serious discussion.

尺度.zh: 虽然自由很重要，但也要把握好尺度。
尺度.en: Although freedom is important, you still need to find the right balance.

梳理.en: She combs her hair every day.
I need to sort out my thoughts.

梳理.zh: 他正在梳理公司的财务问题。
梳理.en: He is sorting out the company's financial issues.

梳理.zh: 先把数据梳理清楚，再做分析。
梳理.en: First organize the data clearly, then do the analysis.

梳理.zh: 经过一天的梳理，他终于找到了问题的根源。
梳理.en: After a day of sorting, he finally found the root of the problem.

攀升.en: Housing prices have risen rapidly this year.

攀升.zh: 他的声望在业界持续攀升。
攀升.en: His reputation in the industry keeps rising.

攀升.zh: 随着经济好转，就业率也开始攀升。
攀升.en: As the economy improves, the employment rate has also started to rise.

攀升.zh: 股票价格在短短一个月内攀升了百分之二十。
攀升.en: The stock price rose by 20% in just one month.

心得.zh: 读完这本书我有很多心得。
心得.en: After reading this book, I gained a lot of insights.

心得.zh: 他写了一份学习心得报告。
心得.en: He wrote a report on his learning experience.

心得.zh: 每次旅行后她都会写心得。
心得.en: She writes about her reflections after every trip.

心得.zh: 这次培训让我收获了很多实用的心得。
心得.en: This training gave me a lot of practical insights.

高额.en: He owes a large amount of debt.

高额.zh: 这个项目需要高额投资。
高额.en: This project requires a high amount of investment.

高额.zh: 高额罚款让他非常头疼。
高额.en: The hefty fine gave him a huge headache.

高额.zh: 他们为这件事付出了高额的代价。
高额.en: They paid a high price for this matter.

高额.zh: 虽然奖金很高额，但竞争也非常激烈。
高额.en: Although the bonus is very high, the competition is also extremely fierce.

转达.zh: 请帮我把这话转达给他。
转达.en: Please help me relay this message to him.
I will pass on your greetings.

转达.zh: 他让我转达，会议改到明天了。
转达.en: He asked me to convey that the meeting has been moved to tomorrow.

转达.zh: 你直接跟他说吧，转达容易出错。
转达.en: Just tell him directly; relaying it could lead to mistakes.

转达.zh: 虽然我没见到他，但已经通过邮件转达了你的意思。
转达.en: Although I didn't see him, I already conveyed your intent via email.

僵局.en: The negotiation has reached a deadlock.

僵局.zh: 这个僵局需要第三方调解。
僵局.en: This deadlock requires a third party to mediate.

僵局.zh: 双方谁也不让步，僵局很难打破。
僵局.en: Neither side is willing to compromise, so it's hard to break the deadlock.

僵局.zh: 我们先休息一下，也许能打破这个僵局。
僵局.en: Let's take a break first; maybe we can break this deadlock.

僵局.zh: 要不是他提出新方案，僵局可能到现在都解不开。
僵局.en: If he hadn't proposed a new plan, the deadlock might still be unresolved now.

黏.en: Rice balls taste sticky and chewy.

黏.zh: 地上撒了糖，走起来黏黏的。
黏.en: The ground is covered with sugar, making it sticky to walk on.

黏.zh: 这种面团太黏了，手上全是。
黏.en: This dough is too sticky; it's all over my hands.

黏.zh: 虽然天气很热，但他的手心还是黏黏的。
黏.en: Even though the weather is hot, his palms are still sticky.

倡导.zh: 我们应该倡导健康的生活方式。
倡导.en: We should advocate a healthy lifestyle.

倡导.zh: 很多明星都在倡导环保理念。
倡导.en: Many celebrities are promoting environmental protection concepts.

倡导.zh: 他不仅倡导垃圾分类，还带头示范。
倡导.en: He not only advocates for waste sorting but also leads by example.

定向.en: This project is a targeted recruitment.

定向.zh: 我们需要做一次定向越野训练。
定向.en: We need to do an orienteering training session.

定向.zh: 这种奖学金是定向给贫困生的。
定向.en: This scholarship is specifically for students from low-income families.

定向.zh: 公司给他安排了定向培养计划。
定向.en: The company arranged a targeted training plan for him.

定向.zh: 虽然没指明方向，但这次调研是有定向目标的。
定向.en: Although the direction wasn't specified, this investigation has a targeted objective.

私立.zh: 他女儿在一所私立幼儿园上学。
私立.en: His daughter attends a private kindergarten.

私立.zh: 公立和私立各有优缺点。
私立.en: Public and private each have their pros and cons.

私立.zh: 虽然私立大学学费贵，但教学资源通常更好。
私立.en: Although private universities have high tuition, their teaching resources are often better.

相当于.zh: 这个相当于那个的两倍。
相当于.en: This is equivalent to twice that.

相当于.zh: 他一个人的工作量相当于三个人。
相当于.en: His workload alone is equivalent to three people's.

相当于.zh: 这一百元相当于他们一天的伙食费。
相当于.en: This one hundred yuan is equivalent to their daily food expenses.

相当于.zh: 跑五公里相当于消耗了三百卡路里。
相当于.en: Running five kilometers is equivalent to burning three hundred calories.

相当于.zh: 虽然职位不同，但他的权力相当于副经理。
相当于.en: Although his position is different, his authority is equivalent to that of a deputy manager.

私营.zh: 私营的加油站价格更便宜。
他在一家私营公司做会计。
私营.en: He works as an accountant at a private company.

私营.zh: 现在很多私营医院服务很好。
私营.en: Now many private hospitals offer good service.

私营.zh: 虽然利润高，但私营小企业风险也大。
私营.en: Although profits are high, small private businesses also face great risks.

吊销.zh: 这家店的营业执照被吊销了。
吊销.en: This store's business license was revoked.

吊销.zh: 因为酒驾，他的驾照吊销了半年。
吊销.en: Due to drunk driving, his license was revoked for six months.

吊销.zh: 卫生不合格，餐厅被吊销了许可证。
吊销.en: Due to poor hygiene, the restaurant's permit was revoked.

吊销.zh: 如果继续违规，公司可能会被吊销经营资格。
吊销.en: If violations continue, the company may have its business qualifications revoked.

定做.en: I want to have a bookshelf custom-made.
Custom-made curtains fit the size better.

定做.zh: 他喜欢定做皮鞋，因为合脚。
定做.en: He likes custom-made leather shoes because they fit well.

定做.zh: 这个戒指是定做的，上面刻了名字。
定做.en: This ring is custom-made, with a name engraved on it.

遏制.zh: 政府采取措施遏制房价上涨。
遏制.en: The government took measures to curb rising housing prices.

遏制.zh: 我们必须遏制这种不良风气。
遏制.en: We must curb this unhealthy trend.

遏制.zh: 虽然疫情很难遏制，但大家都很配合。
遏制.en: Although the epidemic is hard to contain, everyone is cooperating.

遏制.zh: 新政策有效遏制了污染物的排放。
遏制.en: The new policy effectively curbed the emission of pollutants.

遏制.zh: 如果不及时遏制，问题会越来越严重。
遏制.en: If not curbed in time, the problem will get worse.

老乡.zh: 老乡见老乡，两眼泪汪汪。
老乡.en: When fellow townsmen meet, tears fill their eyes.

老乡.zh: 我老乡在这家饭店工作。
老乡.en: My fellow townsman works at this restaurant.

老乡.zh: 在异乡遇到老乡，感觉特别亲切。
老乡.en: Meeting a fellow townsman in a foreign land feels especially warm.

老乡.zh: 老乡帮我找了一份工作，我很感激。
老乡.en: A fellow townsman helped me find a job, and I'm very grateful.

老乡.zh: 虽然我们不是老乡，但相处得跟兄弟一样。
老乡.en: Although we are not from the same hometown, we get along like brothers.

稳固.zh: 我们的关系越来越稳固了。
稳固.en: Our relationship is becoming more and more stable.

稳固.zh: 公司需要稳固的现金流才能发展。
稳固.en: The company needs a stable cash flow to develop.

稳固.zh: 地基打得深，房子才能稳固。
稳固.en: Only with a deep foundation can the house be stable.

稳固.zh: 经过多次调整，他的病情已经稳固了。
稳固.en: After many adjustments, his condition has stabilized.

少有.en: This kind of weather is rare in the south.

少有.zh: 像这么便宜的机票，真是少有。
少有.en: Airfare this cheap is really rare.

少有.zh: 她平时很少发脾气，这次生气确实少有。
少有.en: She rarely loses her temper, so this anger is indeed unusual.

少有.zh: 能这样坚持十年的人，实在少有。
少有.en: Someone who can persist like this for ten years is truly rare.

索取.zh: 不要只索取，要懂得付出。
索取.en: Don't just take; know how to give.
He demanded compensation from the company.

索取.zh: 孩子总是向父母索取爱和关注。
索取.en: Children always seek love and attention from their parents.

索取.zh: 大自然被过度索取，环境已经恶化了。
索取.en: Nature has been excessively exploited, and the environment has deteriorated.

索取.zh: 有些人只知道索取，却从不回报。
索取.en: Some people only know how to take but never give back.

延缓.zh: 这场雨延缓了比赛的进行。
延缓.en: The rain delayed the progress of the game.

延缓.zh: 吃药可以缓解症状，但不能延缓病情。
延缓.en: Medicine can relieve symptoms but cannot delay the disease.

延缓.zh: 为了延缓衰老，她坚持每天运动。
延缓.en: To delay aging, she insists on exercising every day.

延缓.zh: 由于资金问题，工程被延缓了三个月。
延缓.en: Due to funding issues, the project was delayed by three months.

延缓.zh: 政府决定延缓这项政策的实施时间。
延缓.en: The government decided to postpone the implementation of this policy.

主体.en: Students are the main body of the school.

主体.zh: 这次活动的主体是环保宣传。
主体.en: The main theme of this event is environmental awareness.

主体.zh: 合同的主体部分已经谈好了。
主体.en: The main part of the contract has been negotiated.

主体.zh: 在经济发展中，中小企业是重要的主体。
主体.en: In economic development, small and medium enterprises are important entities.

主体.zh: 主体工程已经完工，剩下一些细节。
主体.en: The main project has been completed, leaving only some details.

恭维.en: He always likes to flatter people.

恭维.zh: 别恭维我了，我会骄傲的。
恭维.en: Don't flatter me, or I'll get proud.

恭维.zh: 她说的话都是恭维，别当真。
恭维.en: What she said was all flattery; don't take it seriously.

恭维.zh: 客户恭维了几句，但我知道只是客气话。
恭维.en: The client said a few flattering words, but I knew they were just being polite.

恭维.zh: 真诚的夸奖和虚伪的恭维，很容易分辨。
恭维.en: Sincere praise and false flattery are easy to tell apart.

财经.en: He likes to watch financial news.

财经.zh: 这家公司是财经领域的巨头。
财经.en: This company is a giant in the financial field.

财经.zh: 我大学学的专业是财经管理。
财经.en: I majored in financial management in college.

财经.zh: 最近财经市场波动很大，投资要谨慎。
财经.en: The financial market has been very volatile lately; invest cautiously.

财经.zh: 他经常在财经杂志上发表文章。
财经.en: He often publishes articles in financial magazines.

路灯.zh: 这盏路灯不亮，需要修理。
路灯.en: This street light isn't working; it needs repair.

路灯.zh: 深夜的路灯下，只有几个行人。
路灯.en: Under the street lights late at night, there are only a few pedestrians.

路灯.zh: 为了防止交通事故，政府加装了更多路灯。
路灯.en: To prevent traffic accidents, the government installed more street lights.

路灯.zh: 小时候我们常在路灯下玩游戏。
路灯.en: When we were kids, we often played games under the street lights.

抨击.zh: 记者在文章里猛烈抨击了政府的新政策。
抨击.en: The journalist strongly attacked the government's new policy in the article.

抨击.zh: 虽然很多人支持他，但他仍然遭到抨击。
抨击.en: Although many people support him, he still faces criticism.

抨击.zh: 他的言论遭到社会各界的一致抨击。
抨击.en: His remarks were unanimously criticized by all sectors of society.

抨击.zh: 如果你不改变做法，肯定会受到抨击。
抨击.en: If you don't change your approach, you will definitely be criticized.

荒.zh: 他说的笑话有点荒，大家都没笑。
荒.en: The joke he told was a bit absurd; nobody laughed.

荒.zh: 因为长期没人打理，花园已经变得很荒了。
荒.en: Because no one has taken care of it for a long time, the garden has become very overgrown.

荒.zh: 小时候我们经常在荒山上玩耍。
荒.en: When we were young, we often played on the barren mountain.

荒.zh: 这件事听起来很荒，但却是真的。
荒.en: This sounds absurd, but it's true.

实物.zh: 他们奖励了实物而不是现金。
实物.en: They awarded physical goods instead of cash.

实物.zh: 我们需要看实物才能决定是否购买。
实物.en: We need to see the actual item before deciding whether to buy it.

实物.zh: 虽然网上有图片，但我想看实物。
实物.en: Although there are pictures online, I want to see the real thing.

实物.zh: 投资实物比投资股票更安全。
实物.en: Investing in physical assets is safer than investing in stocks.

摇篮.en: The child fell asleep in the cradle.

摇篮.zh: 这个公司是很多创业者的摇篮。
摇篮.en: This company is a cradle for many entrepreneurs.

摇篮.zh: 古典音乐常常被称为文明的摇篮。
摇篮.en: Classical music is often called the cradle of civilization.

摇篮.zh: 他轻轻摇晃摇篮，孩子很快就安静了。
摇篮.en: He gently rocked the cradle, and the child soon calmed down.

摇篮.zh: 大学不仅是知识的殿堂，也是梦想的摇篮。
摇篮.en: University is not only a temple of knowledge, but also a cradle of dreams.

昔日.zh: 昔日的好友现在成了陌生人。
昔日.en: A former close friend has now become a stranger.

昔日.zh: 这里昔日是一片森林，现在变成了城市。
昔日.en: This place used to be a forest, but now it has become a city.

昔日.zh: 他昔日是学校里的风云人物，如今默默无闻。
昔日.en: He was a big shot at school in the past, but now he is unknown.

昔日.zh: 看到老照片，我回想起昔日的美好时光。
昔日.en: Seeing the old photos, I recall the good times of the past.

昔日.zh: 虽然昔日辉煌不再，但他依然乐观。
昔日.en: Although his past glory is gone, he remains optimistic.

谈到.zh: 谈到这个问题，大家都很激动。
谈到.en: When it comes to this issue, everyone gets excited.

谈到.zh: 在会议上，他多次谈到环保的重要性。
谈到.en: At the meeting, he repeatedly talked about the importance of environmental protection.

谈到.zh: 我们一边喝茶一边谈到未来的计划。
谈到.en: We talked about future plans while drinking tea.

谈到.zh: 谈到收入时，他显得有些尴尬。
谈到.en: When talking about income, he seemed a bit embarrassed.

当务之急.zh: 当务之急是找到失踪的孩子。
当务之急.en: The top priority is to find the missing child.

当务之急.zh: 目前当务之急是解决资金短缺问题。
当务之急.en: Currently, the urgent matter is to solve the funding shortage.

当务之急.zh: 在项目开始前，当务之急是组建团队。
当务之急.en: Before the project starts, the top priority is to form a team.

当务之急.zh: 虽然有很多问题需要处理，但当务之急是安全。
当务之急.en: Although there are many issues to handle, the top priority is safety.

当务之急.zh: 他们一致认为当务之急是改善服务质量。
当务之急.en: They all agreed that the urgent task is to improve service quality.

入场券.en: I bought a ticket for tomorrow.

入场券.zh: 这张入场券可以带一个人进去。
入场券.en: This admission ticket allows one person to enter.

入场券.zh: 他花了高价才买到一张入场券。
入场券.en: He paid a high price to get an admission ticket.

入场券.zh: 在门口，他出示了入场券才被允许进入。
入场券.en: At the door, he showed his admission ticket before being allowed in.

入场券.zh: 对年轻人来说，学历是进入好公司的入场券。
入场券.en: For young people, a degree is a ticket to enter good companies.

灵通.zh: 这位记者非常灵通，总能拿到独家新闻。
灵通.en: This journalist is very well-connected and always gets exclusive news.

灵通.zh: 因为在行业里人脉广，他对内幕消息很灵通。
灵通.en: Because he has a wide network in the industry, he is very well-informed about inside news.

灵通.zh: 要想在股市赚钱，必须消息灵通。
灵通.en: To make money in the stock market, you must be well-informed.

灵通.zh: 他虽然不是领导，但比领导还灵通。
灵通.en: Although he is not a leader, he is even more well-informed than the leader.

受骗.zh: 他因为贪小便宜而受骗。
受骗.en: He was deceived because he was greedy for small gains.

受骗.zh: 很多老人容易受骗，需要多提醒他们。
受骗.en: Many elderly people are easily deceived; we need to remind them more.

受骗.zh: 她没想到自己会受骗，直到发现账户空了。
受骗.en: She didn't expect to be deceived until she found her account empty.

受骗.zh: 如果遇到可疑电话，一定要小心别受骗。
受骗.en: If you encounter a suspicious call, be careful not to be deceived.

涮.en: Let's go have hotpot with lamb.
He rinsed the chopsticks before eating.

涮.zh: 这家店的牛肉特别嫩，涮几秒就能吃。
涮.en: The beef at this restaurant is very tender; you can eat it after blanching for a few seconds.

涮.zh: 我涮了青菜和豆腐，蘸了芝麻酱。
涮.en: I blanched some greens and tofu, then dipped them in sesame sauce.

涮.zh: 虽然天气很热，但我们还是想吃涮锅。
涮.en: Even though it's very hot, we still want to eat hotpot.

勾结.zh: 警方发现他和黑帮有勾结。
勾结.en: The police found he had collusion with the gang.

勾结.zh: 这两个公司勾结起来抬高物价。
勾结.en: These two companies colluded to raise prices.

勾结.zh: 如果官员和商人勾结，老百姓就会吃亏。
勾结.en: If officials collude with businessmen, the common people will suffer.

勾结.zh: 他因为勾结外人出卖公司机密被抓了。
勾结.en: He was caught for colluding with outsiders to sell company secrets.

时节.en: Spring is the season for flower viewing.

时节.zh: 中秋时节，月亮又圆又亮。
时节.en: During the Mid-Autumn season, the moon is round and bright.

时节.zh: 现在正是吃螃蟹的好时节。
时节.en: Now is the perfect season to eat crabs.

时节.zh: 每到雨季时节，这里就容易发洪水。
时节.en: Every rainy season, this place is prone to flooding.

时节.zh: 虽然已经过了收成的时节，地里还有不少庄稼。
时节.en: Although the harvest season has passed, there are still quite a few crops in the field.

辞去.en: He resigned from the manager position.
I plan to quit this job.

辞去.zh: 她因为身体原因辞去了董事职务。
辞去.en: She resigned from the director position due to health reasons.

辞去.zh: 辞去高薪工作去创业，需要很大勇气。
辞去.en: Quitting a high-paying job to start a business takes a lot of courage.

辞去.zh: 他辞去了所有职务，专心照顾家人。
辞去.en: He resigned from all positions to focus on taking care of his family.

宫廷.en: There were many rules in ancient palaces.

宫廷.zh: 这部电视剧讲的是宫廷斗争。
宫廷.en: This TV series is about palace intrigues.

宫廷.zh: 宫廷里的厨师做的菜非常精致。
宫廷.en: The dishes made by the palace chefs are very exquisite.

宫廷.zh: 她从小就梦想住在宫廷里当公主。
宫廷.en: She dreamed of living in the palace as a princess since childhood.

宫廷.zh: 虽然宫廷生活看似风光，其实很压抑。
宫廷.en: Although palace life seems glamorous, it is actually very oppressive.

评定.zh: 老师正在评定考试成绩。
评定.en: The teacher is evaluating the exam results.

评定.zh: 这次评定结果下周公布。
评定.en: The evaluation results will be announced next week.

评定.zh: 公司每年都会对员工进行绩效评定。
评定.en: The company conducts performance evaluations for employees every year.

评定.zh: 专家们正在评定这个项目的可行性。
评定.en: Experts are evaluating the feasibility of this project.

评定.zh: 如果评定不合格，就得重新培训。
评定.en: If the evaluation is not passed, you will have to undergo retraining.

良性.zh: 我们要建立良性循环的经济模式。
良性.en: We need to establish a virtuous cycle economic model.

良性.zh: 良性竞争能促进公司进步。
良性.en: Healthy competition can promote company progress.

良性.zh: 医生说这只是良性增生，不用担心。
良性.en: The doctor said it's just a benign hyperplasia, no need to worry.

良性.zh: 如果市场处于良性状态，投资者就会更有信心。
良性.en: If the market is in a healthy state, investors will be more confident.

火药.zh: 火药是中国古代四大发明之一。
火药.en: Gunpowder is one of the four great inventions of ancient China.

火药.zh: 这个仓库里存放了大量火药。
火药.en: A large amount of gunpowder is stored in this warehouse.

火药.zh: 烟花里含有火药，燃放时要小心。
火药.en: Fireworks contain gunpowder, so be careful when setting them off.

火药.zh: 他的脾气像火药一样，一点就着。
火药.en: His temper is like gunpowder, ready to explode at the slightest provocation.

火药.zh: 古代人用火药制作武器和烟花。
火药.en: Ancient people used gunpowder to make weapons and fireworks.

图形.zh: 你能把这个图形复制一遍吗？
图形.en: Can you copy this shape once?

图形.zh: 设计师用了许多几何图形来装饰墙面。
图形.en: The designer used many geometric shapes to decorate the wall.

图形.zh: 电脑软件可以自动生成各种复杂图形。
图形.en: Computer software can automatically generate various complex graphics.

图形.zh: 如果图形不对称，看起来就会不舒服。
图形.en: If the shape is asymmetrical, it will look uncomfortable.

更衣室.en: The changing room is on the left on the second floor.

更衣室.zh: 请不要在更衣室里玩手机。
更衣室.en: Please don't play with your phone in the changing room.

更衣室.zh: 这家健身房的更衣室非常干净。
更衣室.en: The changing room of this gym is very clean.

更衣室.zh: 她走进更衣室换上了泳衣。
更衣室.en: She went into the changing room and changed into her swimsuit.

更衣室.zh: 因为更衣室太小，大家都在排队等着用。
更衣室.en: Because the changing room is too small, everyone is lining up to use it.

主页.zh: 你打开浏览器，先看主页。
主页.en: Open your browser and look at the homepage first.

主页.zh: 我把这个网站的主页设成了百度。
主页.en: I set the homepage of this website to Baidu.

主页.zh: 虽然主页设计得不错，但加载太慢了。
主页.en: Although the homepage design is nice, it loads too slowly.

主页.zh: 手机的主页上可以放常用的App。
主页.en: You can put commonly used apps on the phone's home screen.

主页.zh: 因为主页改版了，所以很多用户找不到登录入口。
主页.en: Because the homepage was redesigned, many users can't find the login entrance.

作废.zh: 旧合同到期后自动作废。
作废.en: The old contract automatically becomes void after it expires.

作废.zh: 如果你不按时确认，订单就会作废。
作废.en: If you don't confirm on time, the order will be cancelled.

作废.zh: 因为系统升级，原来的优惠券全部作废。
作废.en: Because of the system upgrade, all the previous coupons became invalid.

作废.zh: 虽然收据丢了，但发票不会因此作废。
作废.en: Although the receipt is lost, the invoice won't become invalid because of that.

新房.en: We just bought a new house.

新房.zh: 这对新人的新房装修得很漂亮。
新房.en: The newlyweds' new house is decorated very nicely.

新房.zh: 因为旧房太小，他们决定换一套新房。
新房.en: Because the old house was too small, they decided to change to a new house.

新房.zh: 新房的位置很好，离地铁站只有五分钟。
新房.en: The new house has a great location, only five minutes from the subway station.

新房.zh: 虽然贷款压力大，但住进新房还是很开心。
新房.en: Although the mortgage pressure is high, moving into the new house is still very happy.

承载.zh: 这座桥能承载重型卡车。
承载.en: This bridge can bear heavy trucks.

承载.zh: 他的记忆承载了太多痛苦。
承载.en: His memory carries too much pain.

承载.zh: 这个平台承载着数百万用户的信任。
承载.en: This platform bears the trust of millions of users.

承载.zh: 如果楼板承载不了，就会出安全问题。
承载.en: If the floor cannot bear the load, there will be a safety issue.

承载.zh: 虽然包装箱很小，但它能承载十公斤的重量。
承载.en: Although the box is small, it can carry ten kilograms of weight.

功率.en: This air conditioner has a high power output.

功率.zh: 你查一下微波炉的功率是多少瓦。
功率.en: Check how many watts the microwave's power is.

功率.zh: 如果功率不够，电器可能带不动。
功率.en: If the power is insufficient, the appliance may not work properly.

功率.zh: 因为功率太大，所以电费涨了不少。
功率.en: Because the power is too high, the electricity bill has increased a lot.

功率.zh: 虽然音箱体积小，但它的功率输出很惊人。
功率.en: Although the speaker is small, its power output is impressive.

国有.zh: 那家工厂现在是国有企业在经营。
国有.en: That factory is now operated by a state-owned enterprise.

国有.zh: 国有企业的改革一直备受关注。
国有.en: The reform of state-owned enterprises has always been a focus of attention.

国有.zh: 如果土地是国有的，就不能随意买卖。
国有.en: If the land is state-owned, it cannot be bought and sold freely.

国有.zh: 虽然有些国有公司效率不高，但也在慢慢改善。
国有.en: Although some state-owned companies are not efficient, they are gradually improving.

碰巧.zh: 我碰巧遇到了小学同学。
碰巧.en: I happened to run into my elementary school classmate.
That day happened to be her birthday.

碰巧.zh: 我们碰巧坐同一班地铁。
碰巧.en: We happened to be on the same subway train.

碰巧.zh: 因为我碰巧带了伞，所以没被淋湿。
碰巧.en: Because I happened to bring an umbrella, I didn't get wet.

碰巧.zh: 如果你碰巧路过那家店，帮我买杯咖啡。
碰巧.en: If you happen to pass by that store, buy me a cup of coffee.

导向.en: This arrow points to the right.
The direction of public opinion is very important.

导向.zh: 这个政策导向会鼓励更多创新。
导向.en: This policy direction will encourage more innovation.

导向.zh: 如果导向不明确，大家就容易走弯路。
导向.en: If the direction is not clear, people tend to take detours.

导向.zh: 虽然市场导向很重要，但不能完全依赖它。
导向.en: Although market orientation is important, we cannot rely entirely on it.

欠缺.en: He still lacks a bit of experience.

欠缺.zh: 这个计划在细节上有所欠缺。
如果知识欠缺，就得多学习。
欠缺.en: If you lack knowledge, you need to study more.

欠缺.zh: 因为资金欠缺，项目不得不暂停。
欠缺.en: Because of a shortage of funds, the project had to be suspended.

欠缺.zh: 虽然他的能力很强，但沟通技巧还欠缺一些。
欠缺.en: Although his ability is strong, he still lacks some communication skills.

猩猩.en: There are three gorillas in the zoo.

猩猩.zh: 这只猩猩会用手语交流。
猩猩.en: This gorilla can communicate using sign language.

猩猩.zh: 猩猩的智力跟人类小孩差不多。
猩猩.en: Gorillas' intelligence is similar to that of human children.

猩猩.zh: 如果猩猩感到威胁，它会拍打胸口。
猩猩.en: If a gorilla feels threatened, it will beat its chest.

猩猩.zh: 虽然猩猩看起来很凶猛，但它们其实很温和。
猩猩.en: Although gorillas look fierce, they are actually very gentle.

交替.zh: 白天和黑夜交替出现，形成了昼夜循环。
交替.en: Day and night alternate, forming the cycle of day and night.

交替.zh: 他们俩交替着说话，谁也不让谁。
交替.en: They two took turns speaking, neither giving in.

交替.zh: 季节交替的时候，天气变化很大。
交替.en: When seasons change, the weather varies a lot.

交替.zh: 如果你累了，我们可以交替做这个工作。
交替.en: If you're tired, we can alternate doing this work.

媒介.zh: 互联网已经成为最重要的信息传播媒介。
媒介.en: The Internet has become the most important medium for information dissemination.

媒介.zh: 语言是人与人沟通的主要媒介。
媒介.en: Language is the main medium for human communication.

媒介.zh: 这个广告通过多种媒介进行推广。
媒介.en: This ad is promoted through multiple media.

媒介.zh: 电视作为一种媒介，影响力很大。
媒介.en: TV, as a medium, has great influence.

迟疑.zh: 面对那个问题，他迟疑了很久才回答。
迟疑.en: Facing that question, he hesitated a long time before answering.

迟疑.zh: 别再迟疑了，赶紧做决定吧。
迟疑.en: Don't hesitate anymore, hurry up and make a decision.

迟疑.zh: 她迟疑着要不要告诉他真相。
迟疑.en: She hesitated whether to tell him the truth.

迟疑.zh: 我迟疑的原因是害怕失败。
迟疑.en: The reason I hesitated is fear of failure.

着重.zh: 在报告中，他着重指出了几个关键问题。
着重.en: In the report, he emphasized several key issues.

着重.zh: 我们应该着重培养孩子的独立思考能力。
着重.en: We should focus on cultivating children's independent thinking ability.

着重.zh: 老师着重提醒我们考试要注意时间。
着重.en: The teacher emphasized reminding us to watch the time during exams.

着重.zh: 这个项目着重于提高效率。
着重.en: This project focuses on improving efficiency.

惋惜.zh: 他错过了这么好的机会，真令人惋惜。
惋惜.en: He missed such a good opportunity, it's really a pity.

惋惜.zh: 我们为他的离去感到惋惜。
惋惜.en: We feel sorry for his departure.

惋惜.zh: 听到那个消息，她惋惜地叹了口气。
惋惜.en: Hearing that news, she sighed regretfully.

惋惜.zh: 这么年轻就去世了，实在让人惋惜。
惋惜.en: Dying so young is truly regrettable.

价位.zh: 这家餐厅的价位比较适中，适合普通消费者。
价位.en: This restaurant's price range is moderate, suitable for ordinary consumers.

价位.zh: 我们想找价位在三千左右的手机。
价位.en: We want to find a phone in the price range around 3000.

价位.zh: 不同品牌的汽车价位差别很大。
价位.en: Different brands of cars have huge price differences.

价位.zh: 这款产品的价位偏高，但质量很好。
价位.en: This product's price is on the high side, but quality is good.

缠绕.en: Vines wrap around the tree trunk.

缠绕.zh: 她的头发被风扇缠绕住了，很疼。
缠绕.en: Her hair got tangled in the fan, very painful.

缠绕.zh: 这些问题一直缠绕在我心头。
缠绕.en: These problems have been lingering in my mind.
That snake coiled around the branch.

缠绕.zh: 他试图摆脱缠绕他的烦恼。
缠绕.en: He tried to get rid of the worries entangling him.

汇聚.en: Streams converge into a big river.

汇聚.zh: 来自全国各地的志愿者汇聚在一起帮助灾区。
汇聚.en: Volunteers from all over the country gathered to help the disaster area.

汇聚.zh: 大家的意见汇聚成了最终的方案。
汇聚.en: Everyone's opinions converged into the final plan.

汇聚.zh: 这条路上汇聚了很多小商店。
汇聚.en: This road gathers many small shops.

汇聚.zh: 人才汇聚的地方往往发展更快。
汇聚.en: Places where talent gathers often develop faster.

撰写.zh: 她花了一个月时间撰写这份报告。
撰写.en: She spent a month writing this report.

撰写.zh: 这本书是由多位专家共同撰写的。
撰写.en: This book was co-written by multiple experts.

撰写.zh: 记者正在撰写关于这次事件的新闻稿。
撰写.en: The reporter is writing a press release about this incident.

撰写.zh: 他擅长撰写商业计划书。
撰写.en: He is good at writing business plans.

宣泄.en: He needs to vent his emotions.

宣泄.zh: 运动是一种很好的宣泄压力的方式。
宣泄.en: Exercise is a good way to vent stress.

宣泄.zh: 她通过画画来宣泄内心的不满。
宣泄.en: She uses painting to vent her inner dissatisfaction.

宣泄.zh: 不要压抑自己，适当宣泄有益健康。
宣泄.en: Don't suppress yourself; appropriate venting is good for health.

宣泄.zh: 他在日记里宣泄了所有的愤怒。
宣泄.en: He vented all his anger in his diary.

上岗.zh: 新员工培训完才能上岗。
上岗.en: New employees can only start working after training.

上岗.zh: 她上岗第一天就遇到了麻烦。
上岗.en: She ran into trouble on her first day on the job.

上岗.zh: 因为没通过考核，他暂时不能上岗。
上岗.en: Because he didn't pass the assessment, he can't start working for now.

上岗.zh: 虽然已经上岗了，但他还需要老员工带着。
上岗.en: Although he's already started working, he still needs an experienced colleague to guide him.

教养.zh: 父母很重视孩子的教养。
教养.en: Parents place great importance on their children's upbringing.

教养.zh: 她的教养让她从不说脏话。
教养.en: Her upbringing keeps her from ever swearing.

教养.zh: 虽然家境不好，但孩子很有教养。
教养.en: Even though the family is poor, the child is very well raised.

教养.zh: 一个人的教养往往体现在细节上。
教养.en: A person's upbringing is often reflected in the details.

透支.en: I've almost overdrawn this month's salary.

透支.zh: 他信用卡透支了五千块。
透支.en: He overdrew his credit card by five thousand yuan.

透支.zh: 长期熬夜是在透支身体健康。
透支.en: Staying up late for a long time is draining your health.

透支.zh: 别透支你的精力，明天还有考试。
透支.en: Don't overexert your energy; there's an exam tomorrow.

透支.zh: 如果继续透支信用卡，你会陷入债务。
透支.en: If you keep overdrawing your credit card, you'll fall into debt.

杂技.zh: 孩子们喜欢看杂技表演。

杂技.en: She started practicing acrobatics since she was little.

杂技.zh: 这个杂技演员能同时抛五个球。
杂技.en: This acrobat can juggle five balls at once.

杂技.zh: 昨晚的杂技节目太精彩了，观众一直鼓掌。
杂技.en: Last night's acrobatic performance was so amazing that the audience kept applauding.

杂技.zh: 他不仅会杂技，还会魔术和舞蹈。
杂技.en: He not only does acrobatics but also knows magic and dance.

秃.en: He's getting a bit bald on top.

秃.zh: 这只猫尾巴上的毛都秃了。
秃.en: The fur on this cat's tail has all fallen out.

秃.zh: 压力太大，他头发快秃光了。
秃.en: Too much stress is making his hair almost completely fall out.

秃.zh: 冬天树都秃了，光秃秃的不好看。
秃.en: In winter, the trees are bare, looking all bald and ugly.

秃.zh: 虽然年纪不大，但他已经秃了顶。
秃.en: Although he's not old, he's already bald on top.

同年.en: The two of them were born in the same year.

同年.zh: 我和他是同年参加工作的。
同年.en: He and I started working in the same year.

同年.zh: 同年毕业的同学现在发展各不同。
同年.en: Classmates who graduated the same year now have different career paths.

同年.zh: 他们同年结婚，但一个离婚了。
同年.en: They got married in the same year, but one of them is divorced.

同年.zh: 我和爸爸的同事是同年，但看起来年轻很多。
同年.en: My dad's colleague was born the same year as me, but looks much younger.

展览会.en: There's a calligraphy and painting exhibition tomorrow.
The exhibition was packed with people.

展览会.zh: 这个展览会展出很多现代艺术品。
展览会.en: This exhibition displays many modern artworks.

展览会.zh: 我们公司每年都参加电子产品展览会。
展览会.en: Our company attends the electronics exhibition every year.

展览会.zh: 因为疫情，今年的展览会推迟到下半年了。
展览会.en: Due to the pandemic, this year's exhibition has been postponed to the second half of the year.

液晶.zh: 这台液晶电视画面很清晰。
液晶.en: The picture on this LCD TV is very clear.

液晶.zh: 我家的电脑是液晶显示屏。
液晶.en: My computer at home has an LCD screen.

液晶.zh: 液晶屏幕坏了，需要换一个。
液晶.en: The LCD screen is broken and needs to be replaced.

液晶.zh: 现在的手机大多用液晶或OLED屏。
液晶.en: Most phones nowadays use LCD or OLED screens.

液晶.zh: 老式的液晶电视比新款的重很多。
液晶.en: Old LCD TVs are much heavier than the new models.

响亮.en: His voice is very loud and clear.

响亮.zh: 一阵响亮的掌声从观众席传来。
响亮.en: A burst of loud applause came from the audience.

响亮.zh: 那个口号喊得十分响亮。
响亮.en: That slogan was shouted very loudly.

响亮.zh: 虽然个子小，但他的回答特别响亮。
响亮.en: Although he is small, his answer was especially loud and clear.

响亮.zh: 他取得了响亮的名声，全城都知道他。
响亮.en: He gained a resounding reputation; the whole town knows him.

附带.en: Buying a phone comes with a charger.

附带.zh: 这份合同附带一些条款。
附带.en: This contract comes with some additional terms.
The dinner comes with a dessert.

附带.zh: 他买了房子，附带一个地下车库。
附带.en: He bought a house that comes with an underground garage.

附带.zh: 这个服务是免费的，但不附带任何保修。
附带.en: This service is free, but it doesn't come with any warranty.

咀嚼.zh: 他一边咀嚼食物，一边思考问题。
咀嚼.en: He chews his food while thinking about a problem.

咀嚼.zh: 我习惯慢慢咀嚼，这样对胃好。
咀嚼.en: I am used to chewing slowly; it's good for the stomach.

咀嚼.zh: 她咀嚼了半天才咽下去。
咀嚼.en: She chewed for a long time before swallowing.

咀嚼.zh: 你这句话我需要好好咀嚼一下。
咀嚼.en: I need to chew on (ponder) what you said.

土匪.en: That village used to have bandits.

土匪.zh: 土匪抢走了他们的粮食和钱。
土匪.en: The bandits robbed them of their grain and money.

土匪.zh: 他爷爷当年被土匪抓去做苦力。
土匪.en: His grandfather was caught by bandits and forced into hard labor.

土匪.zh: 电影里演的土匪都很凶残。
土匪.en: The bandits portrayed in movies are all very cruel.

土匪.zh: 以前这里土匪很多，但现在已经安全了。
土匪.en: There used to be many bandits here, but now it's safe.

开发商.zh: 这个楼盘是哪个开发商建的？
开发商.en: Which developer built this housing project?
The developer promised to deliver the house next year.

开发商.zh: 听说那个开发商资金链断了。
开发商.en: I heard that developer's capital chain broke.

开发商.zh: 业主们跟开发商打官司。
开发商.en: The homeowners are suing the developer.

开发商.zh: 开发商为了赚钱，把绿地都盖成房子了。
开发商.en: In order to make money, the developer built houses on all the green space.

更正.zh: 我需要更正一下刚才说的话。
更正.en: I need to correct what I just said.

更正.zh: 请把错误的地方更正过来。
他更正了报告中的几个数据。
更正.en: He corrected several data points in the report.

更正.zh: 如果你发现错误，请及时更正。
更正.en: If you find an error, please correct it promptly.

更正.zh: 这篇文章发出来之后，编辑连夜更正了。
更正.en: After the article was published, the editor corrected it overnight.

风水.en: Our house has good feng shui.

风水.zh: 他请了个大师来看风水。
风水.en: He hired a master to look at feng shui.

风水.zh: 这房子的风水格局不太好。
风水.en: The feng shui layout of this house is not great.

风水.zh: 有些人对风水特别迷信。
风水.en: Some people are especially superstitious about feng shui.

风水.zh: 他说这里的风水能影响人的运气。
风水.en: He says the feng shui here can affect people's luck.

磨难.zh: 这些磨难让他变得更坚强。
人生难免会遇到各种磨难。
她从小就在磨难中长大。
磨难.en: She grew up amidst hardships from a young age.

磨难.zh: 经过那么多磨难，他终于成功了。
磨难.en: After so many hardships, he finally succeeded.

幸存.zh: 他在这次地震中幸存了。

幸存.en: The survivors were sent to the hospital.

幸存.zh: 他居然能从那么大的灾难中幸存。
幸存.en: He actually survived such a big disaster.

乃至.zh: 他喜欢各种运动，乃至极限运动。
乃至.en: He likes all kinds of sports, even extreme sports.

乃至.zh: 这个品牌在国内有名，乃至国外都知道。
乃至.en: This brand is famous domestically, and even known abroad.

乃至.zh: 他连小事都记得，乃至几十年前的事。
乃至.en: He remembers even small things, even things from decades ago.

乃至.zh: 这件事影响很大，乃至改变了整个行业。
乃至.en: This incident had a huge impact, even changing the entire industry.

乃至.zh: 他不仅帮助朋友，乃至陌生人他也愿意帮忙。
乃至.en: He not only helps friends, but is even willing to help strangers.

乞讨.zh: 很多乞丐在火车站附近乞讨。
乞讨.en: Many beggars beg near the train station.

乞讨.zh: 她不忍心看到老人乞讨，所以给了点钱。
乞讨.en: She couldn't bear to see the old man begging, so she gave some money.
The life of begging is very hard.

剧团.en: This theater company is very famous.

剧团.zh: 他们剧团明天要来演出。
剧团.en: Their troupe is coming to perform tomorrow.

剧团.zh: 我小时候参加过学校剧团。
剧团.en: I participated in the school drama troupe when I was little.

剧团.zh: 那个剧团演的话剧特别好看。
剧团.en: The plays performed by that troupe are especially good.

剧团.zh: 他们剧团在全国各地巡演。
剧团.en: Their troupe tours around the country.

耸.zh: 那座高楼耸立在市中心。
耸.en: That tall building stands towering in the city center.

耸.zh: 听到这个消息，他耸了一下肩膀。
耸.en: He shrugged his shoulders upon hearing the news.

耸.zh: 虽然问题很难，但他只是耸耸肩，没说话。
耸.en: Although the problem was hard, he just shrugged and didn't speak.

耸.zh: 远处耸立着一座古老的塔。
耸.en: An ancient tower stands towering in the distance.

转折.en: The plot has a big twist.

转折.zh: 这件事成了他人生的重要转折点。
转折.en: This event became an important turning point in his life.

转折.zh: 故事的转折让人意想不到。
转折.en: The twist in the story was unexpected.

转折.zh: 虽然开始很顺利，但后来出现了转折。
转折.en: Although it started smoothly, there was a turn later.

转折.zh: 我们需要找到这个问题的转折点。
转折.en: We need to find the turning point of this problem.

跨国.zh: 他们正在处理跨国贸易的税务问题。
跨国.en: They are handling tax issues of cross-border trade.
International marriages are becoming more common.

跨国.zh: 因为业务需要，我们经常处理跨国合作。
跨国.en: Due to business needs, we often handle cross-border cooperation.

跨国.zh: 这个项目涉及多个跨国团队。
跨国.en: This project involves multiple multinational teams.

山路.en: This mountain road is hard to walk.

山路.zh: 我们沿着蜿蜒的山路开车上去。
山路.en: We drove up along the winding mountain road.
Wild flowers bloom on both sides of the mountain road.

山路.zh: 因为下雨，山路变得很滑。
山路.en: Because of rain, the mountain road became slippery.

山路.zh: 走过这段山路就能看到村子了。
山路.en: After walking this mountain path, you can see the village.

总和.en: The sum of five and three is eight.

总和.zh: 这些数字的总和超过了一千。
总和.en: The sum of these numbers exceeds one thousand.

总和.zh: 你计算一下所有费用的总和。
总和.en: Calculate the total of all expenses.

总和.zh: 虽然每个项目很小，但它们的总和很大。
总和.en: Although each item is small, their total is large.

总和.zh: 我们需要知道这个月的销售总和。
总和.en: We need to know the total sales for this month.

章程.zh: 我们的社团章程规定每两年改选一次。
章程.en: Our club's constitution stipulates elections every two years.

章程.zh: 修改章程需要全员投票。
章程.en: Amending the charter requires a full vote.

章程.zh: 如果你不清楚规则，可以查看章程。
章程.en: If you are not clear about the rules, you can check the charter.

章程.zh: 这个协会的章程很详细。
章程.en: The constitution of this association is very detailed.

劳累.zh: 最近工作太多，我觉得很劳累。
劳累.en: Recently there is too much work, I feel very fatigued.
Don't overwork yourself, take a rest.

劳累.zh: 虽然劳累，但他还是坚持完成了任务。
劳累.en: Although tired, he still insisted on completing the task.

劳累.zh: 他因为长期劳累，身体出了点问题。
劳累.en: Due to long-term fatigue, he has some health issues.

刑法.en: This is stipulated by criminal law.

刑法.zh: 他因为违反刑法被判了三年刑。
刑法.en: He was sentenced to three years for violating criminal law.

刑法.zh: 学习刑法对律师很重要。
刑法.en: Studying criminal law is important for lawyers.

刑法.zh: 如果情节严重，可能触犯刑法。
刑法.en: If the situation is serious, it may violate criminal law.

刑法.zh: 这部刑法典经过了多次修订。
刑法.en: This criminal code has undergone many revisions.

口子.en: Got a cut on the hand.

口子.zh: 墙上的口子需要修补一下。
口子.en: The opening in the wall needs to be repaired.
There is a tear in the clothing.

口子.zh: 虽然口子不大，但流血了。
口子.en: Although the cut is not big, it bled.

口子.zh: 这个口子用胶带封住了。
口子.en: This opening was sealed with tape.

体质.zh: 经常锻炼可以增强体质。
体质.en: Regular exercise can strengthen your constitution.

体质.zh: 她体质比较弱，容易感冒。
体质.en: She has a weak constitution and catches colds easily.

体质.zh: 因为体质不同，每个人对药物的反应也不一样。
体质.en: Due to different constitutions, everyone's reaction to medicine is different.
We need to pay attention to improving our physique.

算数.en: This math problem is very simple.
He was really good at arithmetic when he was a kid.

算数.zh: 你算数这么差，怎么当会计？
算数.en: With such poor arithmetic skills, how can you be an accountant?

算数.zh: 虽然我算数不好，但买菜还是够用的。
算数.en: Even though I'm not good at arithmetic, it's enough for grocery shopping.

算数.zh: 老师让我们回家多练习算数，明天要考试。
算数.en: The teacher told us to practice arithmetic more at home because there's a test tomorrow.

阻拦.en: The police blocked the crowd from entering.

阻拦.zh: 他想冲过去，但被朋友阻拦了。
阻拦.en: He wanted to rush over, but his friend stopped him.

阻拦.zh: 这件事没人能阻拦，你放弃吧。
阻拦.en: No one can stop this matter, just give up.

阻拦.zh: 虽然我尽力阻拦，可他还是去了。
阻拦.en: Although I tried my best to stop him, he still went.

丛.en: There is a cat in the bush.

丛.zh: 他在书丛中找那本旧书。
丛.en: He is looking for that old book among the stacks of books.

丛.zh: 花丛里飞出来很多蝴蝶。
丛.en: Many butterflies flew out from the flower bush.

丛.zh: 因为草丛太密，我们差点迷路。
丛.en: Because the grass was too thick, we almost got lost.

取笑.zh: 同学们总是取笑他的口音。
取笑.en: Classmates always make fun of his accent.

取笑.zh: 你这么取笑别人，太过分了。
取笑.en: It's too much for you to mock others like this.

取笑.zh: 虽然他们取笑他，但他并不在意。
取笑.en: Although they made fun of him, he didn't care.

取笑.zh: 我知道你是开玩笑，但别老取笑我的衣服。
取笑.en: I know you're joking, but don't keep making fun of my clothes.

子弟.en: He is a son of our village.
These soldiers of the people are very brave.
The school is full of children from rich families.

子弟.zh: 作为石油工人的子弟，他很自豪。
子弟.en: As the child of an oil worker, he is very proud.

子弟.zh: 他虽然是穷人家的子弟，但志向很远大。
子弟.en: Although he is from a poor family, his ambitions are lofty.

动荡.en: That year society was turbulent and restless.

动荡.zh: 经历了这么多动荡，他依然坚强。
动荡.en: Having experienced so much turmoil, he is still strong.

动荡.zh: 这段动荡的时期终于过去了。
动荡.en: This period of turmoil has finally passed.

动荡.zh: 因为政治动荡，很多人都离开了国家。
动荡.en: Because of political instability, many people left the country.

嗜好.en: He doesn't have any bad habits.

嗜好.zh: 抽烟喝酒是他的两大嗜好。
嗜好.en: Smoking and drinking are his two major vices.

嗜好.zh: 除了工作，他唯一的嗜好就是钓鱼。
嗜好.en: Besides work, his only hobby is fishing.

嗜好.zh: 每个人都有自己的嗜好，只要不过度就行。
嗜好.en: Everyone has their own hobbies, as long as they don't overdo it.

沿途.en: The scenery along the way is beautiful.

沿途.zh: 我们沿途拍了很多照片。
沿途.en: We took many photos along the way.
There are many small villages along the road.

沿途.zh: 他沿途一直跟我讲他的故事。
沿途.en: He kept telling me his stories all along the way.

沿途.zh: 因为沿途堵车，我们晚到了两个小时。
沿途.en: Because of traffic jams along the way, we arrived two hours late.

腥.en: This fish smells a bit fishy.
I don't like the fishy smell.
There is a smell of blood in the kitchen.

腥.zh: 你闻闻，这虾是不是不新鲜？有腥味。
腥.en: Smell this shrimp, is it not fresh? It has a fishy odor.

腥.zh: 虽然鱼很腥，但加点姜和酒就能去腥。
腥.en: Although the fish is very fishy, adding some ginger and wine can remove the smell.

外汇.en: The foreign exchange market is very volatile.
China has a large foreign exchange reserve.

外汇.zh: 我想换点外汇，出国旅游用。
外汇.en: I want to exchange some foreign currency for traveling abroad.

外汇.zh: 因为汇率变化，他炒外汇亏了不少钱。
外汇.en: Because of exchange rate changes, he lost a lot of money trading foreign exchange.

重播.zh: 明天早上六点重播昨晚的新闻。
重播.en: They will rebroadcast last night's news at six tomorrow morning.

重播.zh: 虽然已经重播了，但我还是想看直播。
重播.en: Although it has already been replayed, I still want to watch the live broadcast.

重播.zh: 这个节目太火了，电视台决定再重播一次。
重播.en: This show is so popular that the TV station decided to replay it once more.

重播.zh: 别急，等重播的时候我录下来给你。
重播.en: Don't worry, I'll record it for you when it's replayed.

摘要.zh: 这篇论文的摘要写得很好。
摘要.en: The abstract of this paper is well written.

摘要.zh: 看完整本书后，我写了一个详细的摘要。
摘要.en: After finishing the whole book, I wrote a detailed summary.

摘要.zh: 新闻摘要每天早晨都会推送到手机上。
摘要.en: News digests are pushed to my phone every morning.

摘要.zh: 虽然摘要很短，但它包含了所有关键点。
摘要.en: Although the summary is short, it contains all the key points.

唤起.zh: 这首歌唤起了我的回忆。
唤起.en: This song brings back my memories.

唤起.zh: 他的演讲唤起了大家的爱国热情。
唤起.en: His speech aroused everyone's patriotic passion.

唤起.zh: 这部纪录片唤起了人们对环保的关注。
唤起.en: This documentary raised people's attention to environmental protection.

唤起.zh: 如果你看这张照片，它会唤起你的回忆。
唤起.en: If you look at this photo, it will evoke your memories.

和睦.zh: 只有大家和睦，工作才能顺利开展。
和睦.en: Only if everyone is harmonious can work proceed smoothly.

和睦.zh: 这个社区的氛围非常和睦，大家互相帮助。
和睦.en: The atmosphere in this community is very harmonious; everyone helps each other.

和睦.zh: 虽然性格不同，但他们的关系一直很和睦。
和睦.en: Although their personalities differ, their relationship has always been harmonious.

天主教.zh: 这个城市有很多天主教堂。
天主教.en: This city has many Catholic churches.

天主教.zh: 圣诞节是天主教的重要节日。
天主教.en: Christmas is an important holiday for Catholicism.

天主教.zh: 虽然我不信天主教，但我觉得教堂很美。
天主教.en: Although I don't believe in Catholicism, I think churches are beautiful.

毅力.zh: 没有毅力的话，很难坚持减肥。
毅力.en: Without perseverance, it's hard to stick to a diet.

毅力.zh: 他靠毅力完成了马拉松比赛。
毅力.en: He completed the marathon through perseverance.

毅力.zh: 虽然训练很苦，但他凭借毅力坚持了下来。
毅力.en: Although the training was tough, he persevered with determination.

去处.en: Do you have a place to go?
I haven't decided where to go for the holiday yet.

去处.zh: 这家咖啡店是我的周末常去处。
去处.en: This coffee shop is my usual weekend hangout.

去处.zh: 他失业后一直找不到合适的去处。
去处.en: After losing his job, he couldn't find a suitable place to go.

去处.zh: 因为城市太拥挤，很多人都寻找清静的去处。
去处.en: Because the city is too crowded, many people look for quiet places.

慌乱.en: He was so flustered he couldn't speak.

慌乱.zh: 遇到紧急情况，千万不要慌乱。
慌乱.en: Never panic when encountering an emergency.
In her panic, she forgot to bring the keys.

慌乱.zh: 虽然出了点意外，但他并没有慌乱。
慌乱.en: Although there was a small accident, he didn't panic.

爱戴.zh: 这位老师深受学生爱戴。
爱戴.en: This teacher is deeply loved and respected by students.

爱戴.zh: 因为他的正直，大家都很爱戴他。
爱戴.en: Because of his integrity, everyone loves and respects him.

爱戴.zh: 老总统虽然退休了，依然受到人民的爱戴。
爱戴.en: Although the old president retired, he is still loved and respected by the people.

爱戴.zh: 他不仅能力出众，而且深受同事爱戴。
爱戴.en: He is not only highly capable but also deeply loved and respected by his colleagues.

功力.en: This cup of tea is quite potent.

功力.zh: 他的绘画功力让所有人都佩服。
修炼了十年，他的功力大增。
功力.en: After ten years of practice, his skill greatly increased.

功力.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他的功力依然不减。
功力.en: Although he is old, his skill hasn't diminished.

霸道.zh: 你别这么霸道，也要听听别人的意见。
霸道.en: Don't be so domineering; you should also listen to others' opinions.

霸道.zh: 虽然他很霸道，但大家还是听他的。
霸道.en: Although he is domineering, everyone still listens to him.

霸道.zh: 在公司里，他那种霸道的作风让很多人不舒服。
霸道.en: In the company, his domineering style makes many people uncomfortable.

仓促.zh: 因为时间仓促，我们没来得及准备礼物。
仓促.en: Because time was short, we didn't have time to prepare gifts.

仓促.zh: 他仓促地吃完早饭就出门了。
仓促.en: He hastily finished breakfast and went out.

仓促.zh: 虽然行程很仓促，但我们玩得很开心。
仓促.en: Although the trip was rushed, we had a lot of fun.

诚挚.en: Thank you for your sincere wishes.

诚挚.zh: 我诚挚地邀请你来参加我的婚礼。
诚挚.en: I sincerely invite you to my wedding.

诚挚.zh: 她那份诚挚的感情让所有人都感动了。
我们需要进行一次诚挚的对话。
诚挚.en: We need to have a sincere conversation.

粗鲁.en: Don't be so rude to old people.

粗鲁.zh: 他那种粗鲁的行为让服务员很不高兴。
粗鲁.en: His rude behavior made the waiter very unhappy.

粗鲁.zh: 虽然他很粗鲁，但心地其实不坏。
粗鲁.en: Although he is rude, he actually has a good heart.

粗鲁.zh: 在公共场合大声喊叫是很粗鲁的。
粗鲁.en: Shouting loudly in public is very rude.

照常.zh: 虽然下大雨，比赛还是照常进行。
照常.en: Although it rained heavily, the match still went on as usual.
He as usual gets up early to run every day.

照常.zh: 因为停电了，今天不能照常营业。
照常.en: Because of the power outage, we cannot operate as usual today.

瓷.en: This bowl is made of porcelain.

瓷.zh: 小心，别把瓷花瓶打碎了。
瓷.en: Be careful, don't break the porcelain vase.

瓷.zh: 我家有一套很漂亮的瓷茶具。
瓷.en: My family has a very beautiful porcelain tea set.

瓷.zh: 景德镇以生产高质量的瓷而闻名。
瓷.en: Jingdezhen is famous for producing high-quality porcelain.

瓷.zh: 这个瓷盘上的花纹很精致。
瓷.en: The patterns on this porcelain plate are very delicate.

堆积.en: Documents piled up like a mountain.
Work has piled up too much.

堆积.zh: 因为下雨，路上的落叶堆积了很多。
堆积.en: Because of the rain, a lot of leaves accumulated on the road.

堆积.zh: 桌子上的书堆积在一起，都快掉下来了。
堆积.en: The books on the table are piled up and almost falling.

堆积.zh: 他出差了一周，回来发现邮件堆积了一大堆。
堆积.en: He was on a business trip for a week and came back to find a pile of emails.

慌张.zh: 他慌张地跑进来，说外面出事了。
慌张.en: He ran in flustered, saying something happened outside.

慌张.zh: 遇到这种情况，千万不要慌张。
考试的时候，他一慌张什么都想不起来了。
慌张.en: During the exam, he panicked and couldn't remember anything.

致富.en: Hard work can make you rich.
Our village became rich by planting fruit trees.
Many people become rich through starting businesses.

致富.zh: 他写了一本关于如何致富的书。
致富.en: He wrote a book about how to get rich.

致富.zh: 虽然致富不容易，但坚持努力总会有回报。
致富.en: Although getting rich is not easy, persistence will always pay off.

无话可说.zh: 我们之间已经无话可说了。
无话可说.en: There is nothing left to say between us.

无话可说.zh: 面对他的质疑，他无话可说。
无话可说.en: Faced with his doubts, he had nothing to say.

无话可说.zh: 看完这部电影，我感动得无话可说。
无话可说.en: After watching this movie, I was so moved that I had nothing to say.

无话可说.zh: 她的表现太完美了，我简直无话可说。
无话可说.en: Her performance was so perfect that I was speechless.

不起眼.zh: 这家店不起眼，但味道很好。
不起眼.en: This shop is unremarkable, but the food is good.

不起眼.zh: 他在公司里是个不起眼的小角色。
不起眼.en: He is an insignificant minor role in the company.

不起眼.zh: 你别看它不起眼，价格可不便宜。
不起眼.en: Don't think it's insignificant; the price is not cheap.

不起眼.zh: 虽然这礼物不起眼，但心意很重。
不起眼.en: Although this gift is unremarkable, the sentiment is strong.

不起眼.zh: 那本书放在一个不起眼的角落里。
不起眼.en: That book is placed in an inconspicuous corner.

工作量.zh: 我的工作量增加了不少。
工作量.en: My workload has increased a lot.

工作量.zh: 因为工作量太大，他经常加班。
工作量.en: Because the workload is too heavy, he often works overtime.

工作量.zh: 这家公司的工作量分配很不合理。
工作量.en: The workload distribution in this company is very unreasonable.

工作量.zh: 如果工作量少一点，我就能休息了。
工作量.en: If the workload were lighter, I could rest.

凑合.en: Let's make do with this meal.
My phone is still passable to use.

凑合.zh: 虽然工资不高，但生活还能凑合。
凑合.en: Although the salary is not high, life is still manageable.

凑合.zh: 这个工作先凑合着干，等找到好的再换。
凑合.en: Make do with this job for now, and switch when you find a better one.

凑合.zh: 衣服虽然旧了，但凑合穿没问题。
凑合.en: The clothes are old, but it's fine to make do wearing them.

破旧.zh: 他穿着一件破旧的衬衫。
破旧.en: He is wearing a shabby shirt.

破旧.zh: 那辆自行车又破旧又生锈。
破旧.en: That bicycle is both shabby and rusty.

破旧.zh: 虽然家具很破旧，但他舍不得扔。
破旧.en: Although the furniture is shabby, he can't bear to throw it away.

破旧.zh: 村子里的破旧房屋都已经拆掉了。
破旧.en: The shabby houses in the village have all been demolished.

顶多.en: At most wait another five minutes.
This bag is worth at most a hundred bucks.

顶多.zh: 我顶多能帮你搬两个箱子。
顶多.en: I can at most help you move two boxes.

顶多.zh: 他顶多三十岁，看着却很老。
顶多.en: He is at most thirty years old, but looks very old.

顶多.zh: 如果堵车，顶多晚到半小时。
顶多.en: If there's a traffic jam, at most arrive half an hour late.

印章.zh: 这份文件需要公司印章。
印章.en: This document needs the company seal.

印章.zh: 他的印章不小心弄丢了。
因为印章不清晰，合同作废了。
印章.en: Because the seal was unclear, the contract became invalid.

印章.zh: 你去办公室拿个印章过来。
印章.en: Go to the office and get a stamp.

绿灯.en: Go when you see the green light.
The green light is ahead, hurry across.

绿灯.zh: 老板给这个项目开了绿灯。
绿灯.en: The boss gave the green light to this project.

绿灯.zh: 如果绿灯亮了，你就直行。
绿灯.en: If the green light is on, you go straight.

绿灯.zh: 他们等了很久才等到绿灯。
绿灯.en: They waited a long time before getting the green light.

承包.en: This land has been contracted out.

承包.zh: 公司承包了整栋楼的装修。
承包.en: The company contracted the renovation of the entire building.

承包.zh: 因为价格低，他们承包了这个项目。
承包.en: Because the price was low, they contracted this project.
Do you want to contract this cafeteria?

职能.en: The function of the HR department is recruitment.

职能.zh: 各部门的职能分工很清楚。
职能.en: The division of functions among departments is very clear.

职能.zh: 这个职位的职能包括管理团队。
职能.en: The functions of this position include managing the team.

职能.zh: 虽然职能相同，但薪资不一样。
职能.en: Although the functions are the same, the salaries are different.

职能.zh: 公司的职能调整后，效率提高了。
职能.en: After the company's functions were adjusted, efficiency increased.

波浪.en: The waves on the sea are big.
Waves are lapping against the shore.
The small boat is rocking in the waves.

波浪.zh: 因为刮风，波浪越来越高了。
波浪.en: Because of the wind, the waves are getting higher.

波浪.zh: 孩子们喜欢在波浪里玩耍。
波浪.en: Children like to play in the waves.

半路.zh: 我们半路遇到大雨，只好找个地方躲雨。
半路.en: We encountered heavy rain halfway and had to find a place to take shelter.

半路.zh: 虽然他已经出发了，但半路又回来了。
半路.en: Although he had already left, he came back halfway.

半路.zh: 这辆车半路抛锚了，我们等了两个小时。
半路.en: The car broke down halfway, and we waited for two hours.

半路.zh: 他做事总是半路放弃，所以很难成功。
半路.en: He always gives up halfway, so it's hard for him to succeed.

定金.en: Pay half of the deposit first.

定金.zh: 我们付了定金之后，店家却关门了。
定金.en: After we paid the deposit, the store closed down.

定金.zh: 如果你改变主意，定金可能不退。
定金.en: If you change your mind, the deposit may not be refunded.

定金.zh: 买房时定金和首付是两个概念，别搞混了。
定金.en: When buying a house, the deposit and down payment are two different concepts, don't mix them up.

定金.zh: 他为了留住那辆车，付了五千块定金。
定金.en: He paid a deposit of five thousand yuan to hold that car.

提防.en: You should be wary of thieves.

提防.zh: 出门在外要提防陌生人搭讪。
提防.en: When out, be wary of strangers striking up conversations.

提防.zh: 虽然她看起来很友好，但你还是要提防点。
提防.en: Although she looks friendly, you still need to be a bit cautious.

提防.zh: 最近网上诈骗很多，大家一定要提防。
提防.en: There are many online scams lately, everyone must be vigilant.

提防.zh: 提防那些承诺高回报的投资，多半是骗局。
提防.en: Beware of investments that promise high returns, most are scams.

黑手.en: There is a hidden hand behind it.

黑手.zh: 这件事肯定有黑手在操控。
黑手.en: There must be a hidden hand manipulating this matter.

黑手.zh: 大家都怀疑是那个黑手搞的鬼。
黑手.en: Everyone suspects it was that hidden hand playing tricks.

黑手.zh: 他总觉得有人在背后伸黑手，破坏他的事业。
黑手.en: He always feels someone is pulling strings behind the scenes to sabotage his career.

黑手.zh: 警方正在调查是谁在幕后充当黑手。
黑手.en: The police are investigating who is acting as the hidden hand behind the scenes.

侵占.zh: 他家建围墙占了邻居的地，属于侵占行为。
侵占.en: His family built a wall that encroached on the neighbor's land, which is an act of encroachment.

侵占.zh: 如果对方侵占你的权益，你可以起诉。
侵占.en: If the other party infringes on your rights, you can sue.

侵占.zh: 这个公司非法侵占员工加班费，被告上法庭了。
侵占.en: This company illegally withheld employees' overtime pay and was taken to court.

侵占.zh: 历史上很多国家曾试图侵占别国领土。
侵占.en: Historically, many countries have tried to occupy other nations' territories.

观摩.en: We went to observe the competition.

观摩.zh: 这次活动主要是让新员工观摩老员工的工作流程。
观摩.en: This activity mainly lets new employees observe the work process of senior employees.

观摩.zh: 通过观摩别人的表演，我学到了很多技巧。
观摩.en: By observing others' performances, I learned a lot of techniques.

观摩.zh: 学校组织我们到工厂观摩实际生产。
观摩.en: The school organized us to visit the factory to observe actual production.

观摩.zh: 他经常去美术馆观摩大师的画作，提高自己的审美。
观摩.en: He often goes to the art gallery to observe masterpieces and improve his aesthetic sense.

过道.zh: 在过道里请保持安静，不要影响别人。
过道.en: Please keep quiet in the hallway and don't disturb others.

过道.zh: 我们家的过道两边挂满了照片。
过道.en: Both sides of our hallway are covered with photos.

过道.zh: 他把行李箱放在过道中间，别人都没法走了。
过道.en: He put his suitcase in the middle of the aisle, blocking others.

过道.zh: 过道尽头的那个房间是储物间。
过道.en: The room at the end of the hallway is the storage room.

相通.zh: 客厅和餐厅是相通的，空间显得很大。
相通.en: The living room and dining room are connected, making the space seem large.

相通.zh: 虽然他们住得很近，但思想却不相通。
相通.en: Although they live close, their thoughts don't connect.

相通.zh: 这两条管道是相通的，所以水会流过去。
相通.en: These two pipes are connected, so water will flow through.

相通.zh: 我们俩心意相通，不用说话就知道对方想什么。
相通.en: We two are of one mind, we know what the other is thinking without speaking.

得当.zh: 处理这件事要方式得当，不然容易引发矛盾。
得当.en: This matter needs to be handled properly, otherwise it may cause conflict.

得当.zh: 只要你安排得当，时间完全够用。
得当.en: As long as you arrange it properly, the time is completely sufficient.

得当.zh: 这个方案虽然不错，但执行时还得注意方法得当。
得当.en: Although this plan is good, you still need to pay attention to proper methods during execution.

得当.zh: 她在会上发言措辞得当，赢得了大家的认可。
得当.en: Her speech at the meeting was appropriately worded and won everyone's approval.

偏远.zh: 那个地方太偏远，连手机信号都没有。
偏远.en: That place is so remote that there is no cell phone signal.

偏远.zh: 虽然住得偏远，但环境特别好。
偏远.en: Although it's remote, the environment is particularly good.

偏远.zh: 他选择在偏远的山区支教，一待就是三年。
偏远.en: He chose to teach in a remote mountain area and stayed for three years.

偏远.zh: 这家餐厅位置偏远，但味道很棒，很多人专程开车过去。
偏远.en: This restaurant is located in a remote area, but the food is great, and many people drive there specifically.

忙活.en: She's been bustling about at home all day.

忙活.zh: 我忙活了一上午，终于把饭做好了。
忙活.en: I was busy all morning and finally finished cooking.
Stop busying yourself, take a rest first.

忙活.zh: 他一边忙活一边跟我聊天。
忙活.en: He chatted with me while busying himself.

忙活.zh: 虽然很忙活，但我觉得很充实。
忙活.en: Although I'm very busy, I feel fulfilled.

一天到晚.en: He plays on his phone from morning till night.

一天到晚.zh: 妈妈一天到晚都在忙家务。
一天到晚.en: Mom is busy with housework all day long.

一天到晚.zh: 你一天到晚光想着玩，也不学习。
一天到晚.en: You're thinking about playing all day and don't study.

一天到晚.zh: 这家店一天到晚都有人排队。
一天到晚.en: There are people lining up at this shop all day long.

一天到晚.zh: 我一天到晚坐在办公室，腰都疼了。
一天到晚.en: I sit in the office all day and my back hurts.

带路.en: Can you lead the way for me?

带路.zh: 他主动给我们带路去火车站。
带路.en: He voluntarily guided us to the train station.

带路.zh: 要不是你带路，我肯定迷路了。
带路.en: If it weren't for you leading the way, I'd definitely be lost.

带路.zh: 这个导游带路特别细心，每个地方都介绍。
带路.en: This tour guide is very attentive in leading the way, introducing every place.
You lead the way, and I'll follow you.

精细.en: This piece of clothing has fine workmanship.

精细.zh: 他做事非常精细，从不出错。
精细.en: He is very meticulous in his work and never makes mistakes.

精细.zh: 这种手工艺品需要精细的雕刻技术。
精细.en: This kind of handicraft requires fine carving skills.

精细.zh: 虽然活很小，但要求特别精细。
精细.en: Although the job is small, the requirements are especially precise.

精细.zh: 她把菜切得很精细，每块都一样大。
精细.en: She cuts the vegetables very finely, each piece the same size.

行家.zh: 她做菜很厉害，算是个行家。
行家.en: She's great at cooking; she can be considered an expert.

行家.zh: 在画画方面，我根本不是行家。
行家.en: When it comes to painting, I'm no expert at all.

行家.zh: 你要想买好茶，得找个行家帮忙。
行家.en: If you want to buy good tea, you need to find an expert to help.

行家.zh: 他虽然年轻，但已经是行家了。
行家.en: Although he is young, he is already an expert.

墨水.en: My pen is out of ink.

墨水.zh: 他肚子里有点墨水，写文章不错。
墨水.en: He has some learning in him and writes articles well.

墨水.zh: 墨水洒在桌布上，洗不掉了。
墨水.en: The ink spilled on the tablecloth and won't wash off.

墨水.zh: 你得多喝点墨水，才能写出好作文。
墨水.en: You need to study more (literally 'drink more ink') to write good essays.

墨水.zh: 这种打印机用的是专用墨水。

格局.en: This apartment has a good layout.

格局.zh: 他公司的格局太小，发展不起来。
格局.en: His company's vision is too small; it can't develop.

格局.zh: 这个房间的格局很有意思，有阳台。
格局.en: The layout of this room is quite interesting; it has a balcony.

格局.zh: 你要打开格局，别只盯着眼前。
格局.en: You need to broaden your perspective, not just focus on the present.

格局.zh: 虽然格局变了，但我们的目标没变。
格局.en: Although the overall situation has changed, our goal hasn't.

好心人.en: There are many kind-hearted people in the world.

好心人.zh: 多亏了一位好心人，我的钱包找回来了。
好心人.en: Thanks to a kind person, I got my wallet back.

好心人.zh: 你真是个好心人，谢谢帮忙。
好心人.en: You're such a kind-hearted person, thanks for your help.

好心人.zh: 虽然他是个好心人，但有时候太容易相信别人。
好心人.en: Although he's a kind person, sometimes he trusts others too easily.

好心人.zh: 在街上问路，总能遇到好心人。
好心人.en: When asking for directions on the street, you always meet kind people.

咽喉.zh: 这条河是城市的咽喉要道。
咽喉.en: This river is a strategic artery of the city.

咽喉.zh: 他吃东西太急，卡住咽喉了。
咽喉.en: He ate too quickly and choked on his throat.

咽喉.zh: 咽喉发炎的话，要多喝水。
咽喉.en: If your throat is inflamed, you should drink more water.

咽喉.zh: 这个路口是交通咽喉，经常堵车。
咽喉.en: This intersection is a traffic bottleneck and often gets congested.

敬爱.en: We all respect and love him.

敬爱.zh: 同学们很敬爱这位老师。
敬爱.en: The students deeply respect and love this teacher.

敬爱.zh: 因为他为人正直，大家都很敬爱他。
