敬爱.en: Because he is upright, everyone respects and loves him.

敬爱.zh: 虽然我已经毕业了，但我依然敬爱我的导师。
敬爱.en: Although I've graduated, I still respect and love my advisor.

看护.en: He took leave to nurse his mother at home.

看护.zh: 看护病人需要很多耐心。
看护.en: Caring for patients requires a lot of patience.

看护.zh: 因为奶奶摔伤了，所以请了一个看护。
看护.en: Because grandma fell and got hurt, we hired a nurse.

看护.zh: 虽然看护工作很辛苦，但他从未抱怨过。
看护.en: Although nursing work is hard, he has never complained.

点缀.zh: 墙上挂了几幅画作为点缀。
点缀.en: A few paintings on the wall serve as decoration.

点缀.zh: 生日蛋糕用水果点缀了一下。
点缀.en: The birthday cake was decorated with fruit.

点缀.zh: 如果加点小饰品，房间会更有点缀。
点缀.en: If you add some small ornaments, the room will be more decorated.

点缀.zh: 虽然房间不大，但她的装饰点缀得很温馨。
点缀.en: Although the room is small, her decorations make it cozy.

礼堂.en: A meeting is being held in the auditorium.

礼堂.zh: 毕业典礼在学校大礼堂举行。
礼堂.en: The graduation ceremony is held in the school auditorium.

礼堂.zh: 这个礼堂能容纳上千人。
礼堂.en: This auditorium can hold over a thousand people.

礼堂.zh: 因为下雨，所以活动改在礼堂里办了。
礼堂.en: Because it rained, the event was moved to the auditorium.

礼堂.zh: 礼堂的灯光和音响设备都非常先进。
礼堂.en: The lighting and sound equipment in the auditorium are very advanced.

作物.en: This year's crop harvest is good.

作物.zh: 农民们正在地里种新作物。
作物.en: Farmers are planting new crops in the fields.

作物.zh: 气候干旱会影响作物生长。
虽然雨水不多，但作物长得还可以。
作物.en: Although there isn't much rain, the crops are growing okay.

作物.zh: 这片土地适合种多种作物，比如玉米和麦子。
作物.en: This land is suitable for growing various crops, such as corn and wheat.

抠.en: He is too stingy, never treats others.
Don't pick your nose, it's unhygienic.

抠.zh: 她抠了点墙上的漆下来。
抠.en: She scraped off a bit of paint from the wall.

抠.zh: 如果这么抠门，朋友会越来越少的。
抠.en: If you are so stingy, you'll have fewer and fewer friends.

抠.zh: 他抠了一下午才把那个螺丝弄出来。
抠.en: He dug for an entire afternoon to get that screw out.

合乎.zh: 他的做法不合乎道德标准。
合乎.en: His actions do not conform to moral standards.
This statement is not in line with common sense.

合乎.zh: 因为不合乎规定，所以被拒绝了。
合乎.en: Because it didn't meet the regulations, it was rejected.

合乎.zh: 这些产品完全合乎国家标准，可以放心使用。
合乎.en: These products fully comply with national standards and can be used with confidence.

觉醒.zh: 经历了失败，他终于觉醒了。
觉醒.en: After experiencing failure, he finally woke up.

觉醒.zh: 年轻人的环保意识正在觉醒。
觉醒.en: Young people's environmental awareness is awakening.

觉醒.zh: 如果大家不觉醒，问题会更加严重。
觉醒.en: If everyone doesn't wake up, the problem will become more serious.

觉醒.zh: 这部电影唤起了很多人的觉醒意识。
觉醒.en: This movie aroused many people's awakening consciousness.

家禽.zh: 农贸市场里卖各种家禽。
家禽.en: The farmers market sells various poultry.

家禽.zh: 家禽的饲料需要精心搭配。
因为禽流感，所以家禽价格下跌了。
家禽.en: Because of bird flu, poultry prices have dropped.

家禽.zh: 他每天都要给家禽喂食和打扫圈舍。
家禽.en: He feeds the poultry and cleans their coops every day.

岳父.en: My father-in-law really likes the dishes I cook.

岳父.zh: 周末我和岳父一起去钓鱼。
岳父.en: On weekends I go fishing with my father-in-law.

岳父.zh: 虽然岳父话不多，但他很关心我们。
岳父.en: Although my father-in-law doesn't talk much, he cares about us.

岳父.zh: 岳父岳母都住在上海，我们常去看他们。
岳父.en: Both my father-in-law and mother-in-law live in Shanghai; we often go visit them.

选用.zh: 这次比赛将选用最强选手。
选用.en: This competition will select the strongest players.

选用.zh: 设计师选用了蓝色为主色调。
选用.en: The designer chose blue as the main color.

选用.zh: 如果选用这种方案，成本会降低很多。
选用.en: If we choose this plan, the cost will be much lower.

选用.zh: 学校选用了新的教材来配合改革。
选用.en: The school selected new textbooks to align with the reform.

动身.en: We set out for Shanghai tomorrow.

动身.zh: 他收拾好行李，就立刻动身了。
动身.en: He packed his luggage and set off immediately.

动身.zh: 因为天气不好，我们决定晚一点动身。
动身.en: Because the weather is bad, we decided to set off later.

动身.zh: 你打算什么时候动身去机场？
动身.en: When do you plan to set out for the airport?

动身.zh: 她动身之前给我打了个电话。
动身.en: She called me before setting out.

督促.en: The teacher urges us to study.

督促.zh: 妈妈每天都督促我早点睡觉。
督促.en: Mom urges me to go to bed early every day.

督促.zh: 虽然没人督促，他还是完成了任务。
督促.en: Although no one urged him, he still completed the task.

督促.zh: 老板督促员工加快进度。
督促.en: The boss urged the employees to speed up.

督促.zh: 你需要有人督促才能坚持锻炼。
督促.en: You need someone to urge you to keep exercising.

滞留.en: We were stranded at the airport due to heavy rain.

滞留.zh: 因为签证问题，他在国外滞留了两周。
滞留.en: Because of visa issues, he was stranded abroad for two weeks.

滞留.zh: 如果航班取消，旅客可能会滞留很久。
滞留.en: If the flight is canceled, passengers may be stranded for a long time.

滞留.zh: 这场大雪导致很多车辆滞留在高速公路上。
滞留.en: This heavy snow caused many cars to be stranded on the highway.

滞留.zh: 他滞留在车站，不知道该怎么办。
滞留.en: He was stranded at the station, not knowing what to do.

颓废.en: He has been very dispirited lately.

颓废.zh: 失恋之后，他变得非常颓废，什么都不想做。
颓废.en: After losing love, he became very dejected and didn't want to do anything.

颓废.zh: 虽然生活有挫折，但也不能一直颓废下去。
颓废.en: Although life has setbacks, you can't stay dispirited forever.

颓废.zh: 这种颓废的生活方式对健康不好。
颓废.en: This decadent lifestyle is bad for health.

颓废.zh: 她看到朋友这么颓废，心里很难过。
颓废.en: Seeing her friend so dejected, she felt very sad.

时而.en: The weather is sometimes sunny, sometimes rainy.

时而.zh: 他工作时很认真，时而也会开开玩笑。
时而.en: He is very serious at work, and sometimes also jokes around.

时而.zh: 我时而想出去走走，时而又想待在家里。
时而.en: Sometimes I want to go out for a walk, and sometimes I want to stay at home.

时而.zh: 她的心情时而好，时而坏，让人捉摸不定。
时而.en: Her mood is sometimes good, sometimes bad, unpredictable.

时而.zh: 这种鸟时而飞高，时而飞低，很好看。
时而.en: This bird sometimes flies high, sometimes low, very beautiful.

盛开.en: The roses in the garden are in full bloom.

盛开.zh: 春天来了，各种花朵在公园里盛开。
盛开.en: Spring has come, all kinds of flowers are blooming in the park.

盛开.zh: 虽然已经是秋天，但菊花依然盛开。
盛开.en: Although it is already autumn, the chrysanthemums are still in full bloom.

盛开.zh: 樱花盛开的季节，很多游客去武汉大学赏花。
盛开.en: During the season when cherry blossoms are in full bloom, many tourists go to Wuhan University to enjoy the flowers.

盛开.zh: 她就像一朵盛开的向日葵，充满阳光。
盛开.en: She is like a blooming sunflower, full of sunshine.

柱子.zh: 大厅里有四根巨大的柱子支撑着屋顶。
柱子.en: There are four huge pillars in the hall supporting the roof.

柱子.zh: 虽然柱子看起来很旧，但依然很坚固。
柱子.en: Although the pillar looks old, it is still very solid.

柱子.zh: 他把头撞到了柱子上，疼得直叫。
柱子.en: He hit his head on the pillar and cried out in pain.

柱子.zh: 这个建筑的设计很有特色，柱子都是雕刻过的。
柱子.en: The design of this building is very distinctive; all the pillars are carved.

周密.zh: 经过周密的准备，他们成功举办了活动。
周密.en: After thorough preparation, they successfully held the event.

周密.zh: 只有考虑周密，才能避免出错。
周密.en: Only by considering thoroughly can you avoid mistakes.

周密.zh: 警方进行了周密的调查，终于找到了线索。
周密.en: The police conducted a thorough investigation and finally found clues.

周密.zh: 他的演讲内容很周密，每个细节都讲到了。
周密.en: His speech content was very thorough; he covered every detail.

偷窥.zh: 他躲在窗帘后面偷窥邻居在做什么。
偷窥.en: He hid behind the curtain to peep at what the neighbor was doing.

偷窥.zh: 如果你一直偷窥别人，会让人觉得很不舒服。
偷窥.en: If you keep peeping at others, it will make people feel very uncomfortable.

偷窥.zh: 这种行为属于偷窥，是违法的。
偷窥.en: This behavior constitutes peeping, which is illegal.

偷窥.zh: 她发现有人在偷窥她，立刻报了警。
偷窥.en: She found someone peeping at her and immediately called the police.

机智.en: He is very quick-witted, reacting quickly.

机智.zh: 在紧急情况下，他表现得很机智，成功救出了小孩。
机智.en: In an emergency, he showed great resourcefulness and successfully rescued the child.

机智.zh: 虽然遇到了难题，但他凭借机智解决了。
机智.en: Although he encountered a difficult problem, he solved it with his quick wit.

机智.zh: 这个回答非常机智，大家都笑了。
机智.en: That answer was very witty; everyone laughed.

机智.zh: 她机智地避开了那个尴尬的问题。
机智.en: She cleverly avoided that embarrassing question.

农作物.en: The crop harvest is good this year.

农作物.zh: 农民最关心农作物的价格。
农作物.en: Farmers care most about crop prices.

农作物.zh: 因为干旱，今年的农作物减产了。
农作物.en: Because of the drought, this year's crops have reduced in yield.

农作物.zh: 这片土地适合种各种农作物。
农作物.en: This land is suitable for growing various crops.

农作物.zh: 如果雨水充足，农作物就能长得好。
农作物.en: If there is enough rain, the crops will grow well.

必不可少.zh: 水是生活中必不可少的。
手机现在成了必不可少的工具。
必不可少.en: Mobile phones have become an essential tool now.

必不可少.zh: 对于这次旅行，地图是必不可少的。
必不可少.en: For this trip, a map is absolutely necessary.

必不可少.zh: 做这道菜，酱油和盐必不可少。
必不可少.en: For this dish, soy sauce and salt are essential.

必不可少.zh: 要想学好中文，练习口语必不可少。
必不可少.en: To learn Chinese well, practicing speaking is indispensable.

新式.zh: 他买了一辆新式电动车。
新式.en: He bought a new-style electric scooter.
New-style phones have very powerful features.

新式.zh: 我们公司推出了新式产品。
新式.en: Our company launched a new-style product.

新式.zh: 这种新式教学方法很受欢迎。
新式.en: This new teaching method is very popular.

倘若.zh: 倘若你来了，记得通知我。
倘若.en: If you come, remember to let me know.

倘若.zh: 倘若天气不好，我们就取消活动。
倘若.en: If the weather is bad, we'll cancel the event.

倘若.zh: 倘若没有你的帮助，我很难完成。
倘若.en: Without your help, it would be hard for me to finish.

倘若.zh: 倘若明天有雨，比赛就会推迟。
倘若.en: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be postponed.

倘若.zh: 倘若你想学，我可以教你。
倘若.en: If you want to learn, I can teach you.

烟囱.en: The factory chimney is emitting black smoke.
The old house has a big chimney.

烟囱.zh: 烟囱里冒出的烟污染空气。
烟囱.en: The smoke from the chimney pollutes the air.

烟囱.zh: 冬天烟囱里的烟很常见。
烟囱.en: Smoke from chimneys is common in winter.

烟囱.zh: 因为环保要求，很多烟囱被拆了。
烟囱.en: Due to environmental requirements, many chimneys have been dismantled.

素食.zh: 这家餐厅提供素食菜单。
素食.en: This restaurant offers a vegetarian menu.
For health reasons, I choose vegetarian food.

素食.zh: 素食也可以做得很好吃。
素食.en: Vegetarian food can also be made delicious.

素食.zh: 我朋友是素食主义者，只吃素食。
素食.en: My friend is a vegetarian and only eats plant-based food.

报废.en: The old computer was sent for scrapping.

报废.zh: 机器用了太久，只能报废。
报废.en: The machine has been used too long, it can only be scrapped.

报废.zh: 因为事故，他的车直接报废了。
报废.en: Due to the accident, his car was written off directly.

报废.zh: 这些报废的零件需要回收处理。
报废.en: These scrapped parts need to be recycled and processed.

试点.en: This city will first run a pilot.

试点.zh: 新政策在几个学校试点。
试点.en: The new policy is being piloted in a few schools.

试点.zh: 试点成功后，会推广到全国。
试点.en: After the pilot succeeds, it will be rolled out nationwide.

试点.zh: 我们公司今年在三个城市试点新系统。
试点.en: Our company is piloting a new system in three cities this year.

试点.zh: 这个试点项目得到了大家的支持。
试点.en: This pilot project has received everyone's support.

纺织.en: There are many textile factories here.
The textile industry is a traditional sector.

纺织.zh: 她在一家纺织公司工作。
纺织.en: She works at a textile company.

纺织.zh: 因为技术进步，纺织行业变化很大。
纺织.en: Because of technological progress, the textile industry has changed a lot.

纺织.zh: 这个地区的纺织产业带动了经济发展。
纺织.en: The textile industry in this region has driven economic development.

丑恶.zh: 这种丑恶嘴脸让人恶心。
丑恶.en: This kind of ugly face is disgusting.

丑恶.zh: 社会上总有一些丑恶的事情。
丑恶.en: There are always some ugly things in society.

丑恶.zh: 虽然外表不错，但他的内心很丑恶。
丑恶.en: Although his appearance is good, his heart is very ugly.

闹事.en: Don't cause trouble in the store.

闹事.zh: 他喝醉了就喜欢在酒吧闹事，真让人头疼。
闹事.en: He likes to cause trouble in bars when drunk, it's really a headache.

闹事.zh: 昨天有人在广场闹事，警察很快就来了。
闹事.en: Yesterday someone made a scene in the square, and the police came quickly.

闹事.zh: 你要是再闹事，我就叫保安了。
闹事.en: If you cause trouble again, I'll call security.

闹事.zh: 那些球迷输了比赛就开始闹事。
闹事.en: Those fans started causing trouble after losing the game.

年薪.zh: 他换了工作以后，年薪翻了一倍。
年薪.en: After changing jobs, his annual salary doubled.

年薪.zh: 这家公司提供的年薪很有竞争力。
年薪.en: The annual salary this company offers is very competitive.

年薪.zh: 虽然年薪很高，但工作压力也很大。
年薪.en: Although the annual salary is high, the work pressure is also great.

年薪.zh: 她的年薪包括奖金和补贴。
年薪.en: Her annual salary includes bonuses and allowances.

梯子.en: He climbed the ladder to change the light bulb.

梯子.zh: 这个梯子不太稳，你要小心。
梯子.en: This ladder is not very stable, be careful.

梯子.zh: 如果梯子不够高，你就去拿个更长的。
梯子.en: If the ladder isn't tall enough, go get a longer one.

梯子.zh: 我们家用的是伸缩梯子，很方便。
梯子.en: Our household uses an extendable ladder, very convenient.

剧目.zh: 这个剧院这个月会上演三部经典剧目。
剧目.en: This theater will perform three classic plays this month.

剧目.zh: 我喜欢看京剧里的传统剧目。
剧目.en: I like watching traditional operas in Beijing opera.

剧目.zh: 虽然剧目很多，但票已经卖完了。
剧目.en: Although there are many plays, tickets are sold out.

剧目.zh: 学校话剧社正在排练一个新剧目。
剧目.en: The school drama club is rehearsing a new play.

纪念馆.en: Let's go visit the memorial hall.

纪念馆.zh: 这个纪念馆里陈列了很多历史照片。
纪念馆.en: This memorial hall displays many historical photos.
Lu Xun Memorial Hall is in Shanghai.

纪念馆.zh: 如果你对历史感兴趣，一定要去那个纪念馆看看。
纪念馆.en: If you are interested in history, you must go see that memorial hall.

纪念馆.zh: 纪念馆免费开放，但需要提前预约。
纪念馆.en: The memorial hall is free but requires advance reservation.

家用.zh: 他们家用的都是环保材料。
家用.en: Their household uses only eco-friendly materials.

家用.zh: 这台机器是家用的，不是工业用的。
家用.en: This machine is for household use, not industrial.

家用.zh: 虽然它是家用的，但质量很好。
家用.en: Although it's for household use, the quality is good.

家用.zh: 家用医疗设备越来越普及了。
家用.en: Household medical devices are becoming more popular.

准许.en: The teacher permitted him to take leave.

准许.zh: 未经准许，不得进入实验室。
准许.en: No entry into the lab without permission.

准许.zh: 爸爸准许我周末出去玩。
准许.en: Dad allowed me to go out to play on the weekend.

准许.zh: 如果家长准许，我们可以去露营。
准许.en: If parents permit, we can go camping.

准许.zh: 公司不准许员工在工作时间用手机。
准许.en: The company does not permit employees to use phones during work hours.

盖子.en: The lid of the pot is a bit loose.

盖子.zh: 这个瓶子的盖子拧不开。
盖子.en: The lid of this bottle won't unscrew.

盖子.zh: 你打开盖子以后，记得再拧紧。
盖子.en: After you open the lid, remember to tighten it again.

盖子.zh: 垃圾桶的盖子坏了，需要换一个。
盖子.en: The lid of the trash can is broken, needs to be replaced.

看管.en: You are responsible for watching the luggage.

看管.zh: 他每天在工地看管设备。
看管.en: He watches over the equipment at the construction site every day.

看管.zh: 这个孩子需要大人看管。
因为没人看管，小狗跑出去了。
看管.en: Because no one was looking after it, the puppy ran out.

看管.zh: 图书馆里有很多书需要看管。
看管.en: There are many books in the library that need to be looked after.

时时.en: You must always pay attention to safety.

时时.zh: 他时时提醒自己不要犯同样的错误。
时时.en: He constantly reminds himself not to make the same mistake.

时时.zh: 开车时要时时看后视镜。
时时.en: When driving, always check the rearview mirror.

时时.zh: 虽然很忙，他时时记挂着家里。
时时.en: Although very busy, he always thinks about home.

时时.zh: 老师要求我们时时保持桌面整洁。
时时.en: The teacher requires us to keep our desks tidy at all times.

简陋.zh: 虽然条件简陋，但我们很开心。
简陋.en: Although the conditions are basic, we are very happy.

简陋.zh: 那个简陋的帐篷根本挡不住风。
简陋.en: That crude tent can't block the wind at all.

简陋.zh: 他们住在简陋的工棚里，每天早起晚归。
简陋.en: They live in a simple construction shed, waking up early and returning late every day.

简陋.zh: 设备虽然简陋，但功能很全。
简陋.en: The equipment is basic, but it's fully functional.

重叠.en: These two pieces of paper overlap.

重叠.zh: 他们的工作内容有重叠。
因为会议时间重叠，所以我只能选一个。
重叠.en: Because the meeting times overlap, I can only choose one.

重叠.zh: 图像重叠在一起就看不清楚了。
重叠.en: When images overlap, you can't see clearly.

只管.en: If you have any difficulties, just say so.
He only cares about himself, not others.

只管.zh: 既然你决定了，就只管去做吧。
只管.en: Since you've decided, just go ahead and do it.

只管.zh: 他做事只管结果，不管过程。
只管.en: He only cares about the result, not the process.

压倒.en: The advantage has overwhelmed the opponent.

压倒.zh: 虽然压力很大，但没把我压倒。
压倒.en: Although the pressure is great, it didn't overwhelm me.

压倒.zh: 在选举中，他得票数压倒其他候选人。
压倒.en: In the election, his vote count overwhelmed the other candidates.

曰.zh: 古人曰：三人行，必有我师。
曰.en: The ancients said: 'When three walk together, there is always my teacher.'

曰.zh: 虽然他说了很多，但我只记得他曰了一句。
曰.en: Although he said a lot, I only remember one sentence he said.
The book says: 'A gentleman is open and poised.'

嫌弃.en: She looks down on my clothing.

嫌弃.zh: 虽然条件差点，但我不会嫌弃。
嫌弃.en: Although the conditions are a bit poor, I won't disdain them.

嫌弃.zh: 他总是嫌弃别人做得不好。
嫌弃.en: He always complains that others don't do well.

嫌弃.zh: 大家都不嫌弃他穷，愿意和他交朋友。
嫌弃.en: No one despises him for being poor; they are willing to be friends with him.

基层.en: He works at the grassroots level.
We should go to the grassroots more often to see things.

基层.zh: 从基层做起，才能了解实际情况。
基层.en: Starting from the grassroots is the only way to understand the real situation.

基层.zh: 虽然基层条件不好，但积累了很多经验。
基层.en: Although the grassroots conditions are not good, I gained a lot of experience.

栽培.en: The teacher is very dedicated to nurturing students.

栽培.zh: 他感谢领导的栽培和指导。
栽培.en: He thanked the leadership for their training and guidance.

栽培.zh: 经过多年栽培，这片树林长得很好。
栽培.en: After years of cultivation, this forest has grown very well.

灌溉.en: You need to water the vegetables every day.
This river is used to irrigate farmland.

灌溉.zh: 因为干旱，灌溉成了大问题。
灌溉.en: Because of the drought, irrigation has become a big problem.

灌溉.zh: 他们用滴灌技术灌溉果园，效率很高。
灌溉.en: They use drip irrigation technology to water the orchard, which is very efficient.

归结.en: The problem boils down to one point.
It ultimately comes down to the people involved.

归结.zh: 这些原因归结起来只有一条。
归结.en: These reasons boil down to just one.

归结.zh: 所有矛盾都归结为利益冲突。
归结.en: All conflicts are reduced to conflicts of interest.

归结.zh: 无论怎么说，最后归结到一句话：加油。
归结.en: No matter how you put it, it all comes down to one phrase: keep going.

平日.en: He is always late on weekdays.

平日.zh: 平日工作很累，所以周末我总想休息。
平日.en: Work is tiring on weekdays, so I always want to rest on weekends.

平日.zh: 他平日不喝酒，但今天破例了。
平日.en: He doesn't drink on ordinary days, but today is an exception.

平日.zh: 虽然平日生活很单调，但我挺喜欢。
平日.en: Although daily life is monotonous, I kind of like it.

平日.zh: 平日这个时候我都在睡觉。
平日.en: At this time on ordinary days, I'm always sleeping.

参见.en: Refer to page ten of the manual.

参见.zh: 详细步骤参见后面的附录。
参见.en: For detailed steps, see the appendix at the back.

参见.zh: 如果你不懂，可以参见网上的教程。
参见.en: If you don't understand, you can refer to the online tutorial.

参见.zh: 具体规定参见公司手册。
参见.en: For specific regulations, refer to the company handbook.

参见.zh: 操作前请参见安全指南。
参见.en: Before operating, please refer to the safety guide.

向导.zh: 我们请了一个当地向导带路。
向导.en: We hired a local guide to lead the way.

向导.zh: 如果没有向导，很容易迷路。
向导.en: Without a guide, it's easy to get lost.

向导.zh: 向导告诉我们前面有一条小河。
向导.en: The guide told us there is a small river ahead.

向导.zh: 这次旅行多亏了那个向导，不然我们肯定走错路。
向导.en: This trip was all thanks to that guide, otherwise we would have certainly taken the wrong path.

无家可归.zh: 冬天有很多无家可归的人需要帮助。
无家可归.en: In winter, many homeless people need help.

无家可归.zh: 那场大火让他无家可归了。
我经常看到无家可归的猫在街上徘徊。
无家可归.en: I often see homeless cats wandering on the streets.

无家可归.zh: 虽然他现在无家可归，但依然很乐观。
无家可归.en: Although he is homeless now, he is still very optimistic.

锤子.zh: 需要用锤子把钉子钉进去。
锤子.en: You need to use a hammer to drive the nail in.

锤子.zh: 我听到锤子敲打的声音。
锤子.en: I heard the sound of a hammer striking.
He picked up the hammer to fix the table.

锤子.zh: 没有锤子，这个架子装不了。
锤子.en: Without a hammer, this shelf cannot be assembled.

敷衍.zh: 他做事总是敷衍了事，老板很不满意。
敷衍.en: He always does things perfunctorily, and the boss is very dissatisfied.

敷衍.zh: 虽然很累，但他没有敷衍工作。
敷衍.en: Although he was very tired, he didn't slack off at work.

敷衍.zh: 她问我问题，我只敷衍了几句。
敷衍.en: She asked me questions, and I only gave perfunctory replies.

敷衍.zh: 对待学习不能敷衍，要认真才行。
敷衍.en: You can't be perfunctory with studying; you have to be serious.

恳求.zh: 她恳求妈妈再给她一次机会。
恳求.en: She begged her mom for another chance.

恳求.zh: 他用恳求的眼神看着我。
恳求.en: He looked at me with pleading eyes.

恳求.zh: 我恳求你们不要这么做。
恳求.en: I beg you not to do this.

恳求.zh: 无论我怎么恳求，他都不答应。
恳求.en: No matter how much I begged, he wouldn't agree.

批发.zh: 买得多的话可以走批发价。
批发.en: If you buy a lot, you can get the wholesale price.
He is in the wholesale clothing business.

批发.zh: 我们批发了一箱水果回来。
批发.en: We bought a box of fruit wholesale.

批发.zh: 零售价和批发价差很多。
批发.en: There's a big difference between retail and wholesale prices.

可贵.en: This kind of spirit is very valuable.

可贵.zh: 在困难的时候还能坚持，这很可贵。
可贵.en: Persisting even in difficult times is truly commendable.

可贵.zh: 他的诚实品格十分可贵。
可贵.en: His honest character is very admirable.
Friendship is a very precious treasure.

可贵.zh: 虽然花了很多时间，但经验非常可贵。
可贵.en: Although it took a lot of time, the experience is very valuable.

松弛.zh: 放假后我的生活节奏变得松弛多了。
松弛.en: After the holiday, my life rhythm became much more relaxed.

松弛.zh: 他最近管理很松弛，员工都懒散了。
松弛.en: His management has been lax lately, and the employees have become lazy.

松弛.zh: 泡个热水澡能让身体松弛下来。
松弛.en: Taking a hot bath can help your body relax.

松弛.zh: 虽然看起来很松弛，但其实他内心很紧张。
松弛.en: Although he looks very relaxed on the surface, he's actually very nervous inside.

路途.zh: 路途很远，你要小心开车。
路途.en: The road is very long, you need to drive carefully.

路途.zh: 虽然路途辛苦，但看到风景就值得了。
路途.en: Although the journey is tough, it's worth it once you see the scenery.

路途.zh: 这次出差路途不算远，坐高铁三个小时就到。
路途.en: This business trip isn't that far; it takes only three hours by high-speed rail.

路途.zh: 他们一路上说说笑笑，感觉路途也没那么长了。
路途.en: They chatted and laughed the whole way, so the journey didn't feel so long.

路途.zh: 路途上记得多带点水和零食，免得饿肚子。
路途.en: Remember to bring plenty of water and snacks on the trip, so you won't go hungry.

运算.zh: 这种运算很简单，小学生都会做。
运算.en: This kind of calculation is very simple; even elementary school students can do it.

运算.zh: 电脑的运算速度比人脑快很多。
运算.en: Computers' calculation speeds are much faster than the human brain.

运算.zh: 他用了五分钟就完成了复杂的数学运算。
运算.en: He finished the complex mathematical calculation in five minutes.

运算.zh: 如果你把数据输进去，系统会自动进行运算。
运算.en: If you input the data, the system will automatically perform the calculation.

运算.zh: 这个程序需要大量运算，所以对电脑配置要求很高。
运算.en: This program requires a lot of computation, so it demands high computer specifications.

张贴.en: There are many advertisements posted on the wall.

张贴.zh: 请不要在电梯里随意张贴小广告。
张贴.en: Please don't post small ads randomly in the elevator.

张贴.zh: 学校门口张贴了明天的考试通知。
张贴.en: The exam notice for tomorrow has been posted at the school gate.

张贴.zh: 他们在社区公告栏张贴了寻人启事。
张贴.en: They posted a missing person notice on the community bulletin board.

张贴.zh: 按规定，所有海报都要在指定区域张贴，不能乱贴。
张贴.en: According to the rules, all posters must be posted in designated areas; no random posting.

湿润.en: It just rained, so the air is very humid.

湿润.zh: 这种面霜能让皮肤保持湿润。
湿润.en: This kind of cream can keep the skin moist.

湿润.zh: 春天来了，气候变得温暖又湿润。
湿润.en: Spring has arrived; the weather has become warm and humid.

湿润.zh: 如果你觉得房间太干，可以放一台加湿器让空气湿润一些。
湿润.en: If you find the room too dry, you can put a humidifier to make the air more moist.

湿润.zh: 她的眼睛湿润了，可能是因为太感动了。
湿润.en: Her eyes got moist; maybe it was because she was too moved.

外企.en: He works at a foreign company.

外企.zh: 外企的工资一般比私企高一些。
外企.en: Salaries at foreign companies are generally higher than at private companies.

外企.zh: 很多年轻人想去外企工作，因为能锻炼英语。
外企.en: Many young people want to work in foreign companies because they can practice English.

外企.zh: 她在好几家外企干过，经验非常丰富。
外企.en: She has worked at several foreign companies, so she is very experienced.

外企.zh: 虽然外企压力大，但晋升机会也更多一些。
外企.en: Although foreign companies are stressful, there are more promotion opportunities.

致辞.zh: 校长在毕业典礼上致辞。
致辞.en: The principal gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.

致辞.zh: 欢迎你上台致辞，说说你的感受。
致辞.en: Welcome to the stage to give a speech and share your feelings.

致辞.zh: 他的致辞很简短，但大家都听得很认真。
致辞.en: His speech was very short, but everyone listened attentively.

致辞.zh: 婚礼上，新郎的父亲致辞感谢各位来宾。
致辞.en: At the wedding, the groom's father gave a speech thanking all the guests.

致辞.zh: 开幕式先由主办方致辞，然后才开始表演。
致辞.en: At the opening ceremony, the organizer gave a speech first, and then the performance began.

文盲.zh: 他爷爷是个文盲，不识字。
文盲.en: His grandfather is illiterate; he can't read.

文盲.zh: 现在中国的文盲率已经很低了。
文盲.en: The illiteracy rate in China is now very low.

文盲.zh: 虽然没上过学，但他不是文盲，自己学了很多字。
文盲.en: Although he never went to school, he is not illiterate; he taught himself many characters.

文盲.zh: 政府一直在努力消除文盲，提高全民教育水平。
文盲.en: The government has been working hard to eliminate illiteracy and raise the education level of the whole population.

文盲.zh: 在偏远山区，还有一些老年人是文盲，不会写自己的名字。
文盲.en: In remote mountainous areas, there are still some elderly people who are illiterate and can't write their own names.

瓦解.zh: 这个组织很快就瓦解了。
敌人内部的矛盾导致他们最后瓦解。
瓦解.en: The internal conflicts among the enemy led to their eventual collapse.

瓦解.zh: 谣言传开后，团队的信任感彻底瓦解了。
瓦解.en: After the rumor spread, the team's trust completely collapsed.

瓦解.zh: 如果没有团结，再强的队伍也会慢慢瓦解。
瓦解.en: Without unity, even the strongest team will gradually fall apart.

瓦解.zh: 公司管理混乱，员工士气低落，整个体系正在瓦解。
瓦解.en: The company's management is chaotic, employee morale is low, and the whole system is disintegrating.

腐朽.en: This piece of wood has already rotted.

腐朽.zh: 腐朽的制度迟早会被淘汰。
腐朽.en: Decadent systems will be eliminated sooner or later.

腐朽.zh: 不要跟那些思想腐朽的人走得太近。
腐朽.en: Don't get too close to people with decayed thinking.

腐朽.zh: 老房子因为常年没人住，门窗都腐朽不堪。
腐朽.en: Because the old house has been uninhabited for years, the doors and windows are all rotten.

腐朽.zh: 一个社会如果腐败盛行，就会从内部开始腐朽。
腐朽.en: If corruption is rampant in a society, it will begin to decay from within.

深信.en: I firmly believe you will succeed.

深信.zh: 大家都深信他说的话是真的。
深信.en: Everyone firmly believes that what he said is true.

深信.zh: 虽然遇到了困难，但我深信前途是光明的。
深信.en: Although I've encountered difficulties, I firmly believe the future is bright.

深信.zh: 她深信只要努力，就没有做不成的事。
深信.en: She firmly believes that as long as you work hard, there is nothing you can't achieve.

深信.zh: 我从不深信那些没有证据的传言，还是眼见为实。
深信.en: I never firmly believe in rumors without evidence; seeing is believing.

据此.en: Based on this, we canceled the trip.
Based on this, it will rain tomorrow.

据此.zh: 警方据此抓住了嫌疑人。
据此.en: The police caught the suspect based on this.

据此.zh: 数据有误，据此得出的结论不可靠。
据此.en: The data is wrong, so the conclusion based on this is unreliable.

据此.zh: 他提供了证据，我们据此做出了决定。
据此.en: He provided evidence, and we made a decision based on this.

厄运.en: He has been having a streak of bad luck recently.

厄运.zh: 希望你能躲过这场厄运。
厄运.en: I hope you can avoid this misfortune.

厄运.zh: 厄运突然降临，他失去了工作。
厄运.en: Misfortune suddenly struck; he lost his job.

厄运.zh: 别灰心，厄运总会过去的。
厄运.en: Don't lose heart; bad luck will pass.

厄运.zh: 虽然遇到了厄运，但他依然乐观面对生活。
厄运.en: Although he encountered misfortune, he still faces life optimistically.

误差.zh: 测量结果存在一定误差。
误差.en: There is some error in the measurement results.

误差.zh: 实验误差在允许范围之内。
误差.en: The experimental error is within the allowable range.

误差.zh: 因为计算误差，预算超支了。
误差.en: Due to a calculation error, the budget went over.

误差.zh: 虽然仪器很精密，但依然会有微小误差。
误差.en: Although the instrument is very precise, there are still tiny errors.

后遗症.en: Coughing is an aftereffect of a cold.

后遗症.zh: 这次手术没有留下后遗症。
疫情的后遗症影响了经济。
后遗症.en: The aftereffects of the pandemic affected the economy.

后遗症.zh: 他车祸后留下了严重的后遗症。
后遗症.en: He had serious aftereffects after the car accident.

后遗症.zh: 虽然病好了，但心理后遗症很难消除。
后遗症.en: Although he recovered, the psychological aftereffects are hard to eliminate.

力求.en: He strives to win the competition.

力求.zh: 公司力求提供最好的服务。
力求.en: The company strives to provide the best service.

力求.zh: 她力求每件事都做到位，所以很累。
力求.en: She strives to do everything properly, so she's very tired.

力求.zh: 在设计中，我们力求简洁又实用。
力求.en: In the design, we strive for simplicity and practicality.

接力.en: We participated in a relay race.
He passed the baton to me.

接力.zh: 大家接力完成这个任务，效率很高。
接力.en: Everyone did the task in relay, and it was very efficient.

接力.zh: 在接力项目中，团队合作最重要。
接力.en: In relay events, teamwork is the most important.

消遣.en: What do you do for fun on weekends?

消遣.zh: 看书是一种很好的消遣方式。
消遣.en: Reading is a good way to pass the time.

消遣.zh: 他除了工作，几乎没有其他消遣。
消遣.en: Apart from work, he has almost no other pastimes.

消遣.zh: 旅行既能放松心情，也是一种不错的消遣。
消遣.en: Traveling can both relax your mind and is a good pastime.

忠心.en: Dogs are very loyal to their owners.
The subordinates are very loyal to the general.

忠心.zh: 他用自己的行动证明了自己的忠心。
忠心.en: He proved his loyalty through his actions.

忠心.zh: 虽然公司遇到困难，但他依然保持忠心耿耿。
忠心.en: Although the company encountered difficulties, he remained utterly loyal.

含糊.en: His answer was vague and unclear.

含糊.zh: 别含糊其辞，直接告诉我结果。
含糊.en: Don't speak ambiguously; just tell me the result.

含糊.zh: 在原则问题上，我们绝不含糊。
含糊.en: On matters of principle, we never compromise.

情谊.en: The friendship between us is deep.

情谊.zh: 这份情谊我会永远珍惜。
情谊.en: I will always cherish this friendship.

情谊.zh: 多年的情谊不是说断就断的。
情谊.en: Years of friendship cannot be ended just like that.

情谊.zh: 他帮我渡过难关，这份情谊我记在心里。
情谊.en: He helped me through difficulties; I will remember this friendship.

情谊.zh: 虽然相隔两地，但我们之间的情谊从未改变。
情谊.en: Although we are far apart, the friendship between us has never changed.

造假.en: This shop was caught for counterfeiting.

造假.zh: 他因为造假文凭被公司开除了。
造假.en: He was fired by the company for forging a diploma.

造假.zh: 网上有很多造假的信息，千万别信。
造假.en: There is a lot of fake information online, don't believe it.

造假.zh: 造假的行为一旦发现，后果很严重。
造假.en: Once counterfeiting is discovered, the consequences are serious.

造假.zh: 他们造假卖假药，害了不少人。
造假.en: They made and sold fake medicine, harming many people.

谎话.zh: 他说的都是谎话，你别当真。
谎话.en: Everything he said was lies, don't take it seriously.

谎话.zh: 小孩子经常说谎话，但大人要耐心引导。
谎话.en: Children often tell lies, but adults should guide them patiently.

谎话.zh: 她发现丈夫一直在说谎话，非常伤心。
谎话.en: She found out her husband had been lying all along, and was very sad.

谎话.zh: 谎话总有被拆穿的一天。
谎话.en: Lies will always be exposed one day.

虚幻.zh: 网络世界很虚幻，别太沉迷。
虚幻.en: The online world is very unreal, don't get too obsessed.

虚幻.zh: 他追求的是虚幻的爱情，不是现实。
虚幻.en: What he pursues is an illusory love, not reality.

虚幻.zh: 虚幻的承诺让人容易受伤。
不要把虚幻当成真实，否则会失望。
虚幻.en: Don't mistake illusion for reality, otherwise you'll be disappointed.

泻.en: He ate something bad and has been having diarrhea.

泻.zh: 吃了这个药，肚子泻得厉害。
泻.en: After taking this medicine, he had severe diarrhea.

泻.zh: 泻肚子的时候要多喝水。
泻.en: When you have diarrhea, you should drink more water.

泻.zh: 他因为食物中毒又吐又泻。
泻.en: He was both vomiting and having diarrhea due to food poisoning.

会诊.en: The doctors are having a consultation.

会诊.zh: 这个病例需要多科室会诊。
会诊.en: This case requires a multi-department consultation.

会诊.zh: 会诊结果明天才能出来。
会诊.en: The consultation results won't be out until tomorrow.

会诊.zh: 医院组织了专家会诊，讨论手术方案。
会诊.en: The hospital organized an expert consultation to discuss the surgical plan.

会诊.zh: 经过会诊，他们决定采用新疗法。
会诊.en: After the consultation, they decided to adopt a new treatment.

攀登.en: They are climbing a snowy mountain.

攀登.zh: 攀登珠峰需要很大勇气。
攀登.en: Climbing Mount Everest requires great courage.

攀登.zh: 科学的高峰值得我们去攀登。
攀登.en: The peak of science is worth our climbing.

攀登.zh: 他从小就喜欢攀登，长大后成了登山家。
攀登.en: He loved climbing since childhood and became a mountaineer when he grew up.

攀登.zh: 攀登过程中遇到了暴风雪，非常危险。
攀登.en: During the climb, they encountered a blizzard, which was very dangerous.

沼泽.en: The swamp is very dangerous, don't go there.

沼泽.zh: 他们不小心走进了沼泽，动弹不得。
沼泽.en: They accidentally walked into a swamp and couldn't move.

沼泽.zh: 这片沼泽里有很多野生动物。
沼泽.en: There are many wild animals in this swamp.

沼泽.zh: 因为下雨，沼泽变得更难走了。
沼泽.en: Because of the rain, the swamp became even harder to traverse.

诱发.en: This medicine may induce an allergic reaction.

诱发.zh: 长期熬夜容易诱发心脏病。
诱发.en: Staying up late for a long time can easily trigger heart disease.

诱发.zh: 环境变化诱发了这场灾难。
他的坏习惯诱发了胃病，不得不注意。
诱发.en: His bad habits induced stomach problems, so he had to pay attention.

颠簸.zh: 飞机颠簸得厉害，我有点晕。
颠簸.en: The plane was bumpy, and I felt a bit dizzy.

颠簸.zh: 长途颠簸让他非常疲惫。
颠簸.en: The long bumpy ride made him very tired.

颠簸.zh: 车子在颠簸的山路上行驶了三个小时。
颠簸.en: The car drove on the bumpy mountain road for three hours.

颠簸.zh: 虽然一路颠簸，但风景很美。
颠簸.en: Although the journey was bumpy, the scenery was beautiful.

歪曲.zh: 他故意歪曲了我的意思。
报道歪曲了真相，很不负责。
歪曲.en: The report distorted the truth and was very irresponsible.

歪曲.zh: 歪曲历史的人会受到谴责。
歪曲.en: Those who distort history will be condemned.

歪曲.zh: 你要听原话，不要被人歪曲误导。
歪曲.en: You should listen to the original words and not be misled by distortion.

生平.zh: 这是他生平第一次出国。
生平.en: This is the first time in his life going abroad.

生平.zh: 他生平最讨厌说谎的人。
生平.en: He hates liars more than anything in his life.

生平.zh: 我从来没听过这么奇怪的生平故事。
生平.en: I've never heard such a strange life story.

生平.zh: 虽然我们相处时间不长，但他的生平让我很敬佩。
生平.en: Although we didn't spend much time together, his life experience makes me admire him.

生平.zh: 这本书记录了一位普通人的生平，却感动了无数读者。
生平.en: This book records the life of an ordinary person, yet it has moved countless readers.

动不动.en: He gets angry at the slightest thing.
Kids cry and fuss over nothing.

动不动.zh: 你别动不动就否定别人的想法。
动不动.en: Don't dismiss other people's ideas so easily.

动不动.zh: 他最近压力很大，动不动就跟人吵架。
动不动.en: He's under a lot of pressure lately, and he picks fights with people over nothing.

动不动.zh: 要是她动不动就请假，老板肯定会不高兴。
动不动.en: If she takes leave at the drop of a hat, the boss will surely be unhappy.

知识分子.zh: 知识分子要有社会责任感。
知识分子.en: Intellectuals should have a sense of social responsibility.

知识分子.zh: 他来自一个知识分子家庭。
知识分子.en: He comes from an intellectual family.

知识分子.zh: 那个年代的很多知识分子都选择了出国留学。
知识分子.en: Many intellectuals of that era chose to study abroad.

知识分子.zh: 虽然他学历很高，但他从不觉得自己是高级知识分子。
知识分子.en: Although he has a high degree, he never considers himself a high-level intellectual.

知识分子.zh: 在讨论公共话题时，知识分子应该理性发言。
知识分子.en: When discussing public issues, intellectuals should speak rationally.

突如其来.en: This news came out of the blue.

突如其来.zh: 一场突如其来的大雨把我们困在家里。
突如其来.en: A sudden heavy rain trapped us at home.

突如其来.zh: 他面对突如其来的问题，一时不知怎么回答。
突如其来.en: Faced with the sudden question, he didn't know how to answer for a moment.

突如其来.zh: 这次辞职虽然突如其来，但我其实早就想好了。
突如其来.en: Although this resignation came suddenly, I had actually thought about it for a long time.

突如其来.zh: 突如其来的疫情打乱了所有人的计划。
突如其来.en: The sudden pandemic disrupted everyone's plans.

疑点.en: This case has too many suspicious points.

疑点.zh: 他的解释听起来有很多疑点。
疑点.en: His explanation sounds full of loopholes.

疑点.zh: 警方发现了一个关键疑点。
疑点.en: The police found a key suspicious point.

疑点.zh: 如果你觉得有疑点，我们就再查一遍。
疑点.en: If you think there are doubts, let's check again.

疑点.zh: 那个证人说的话前后矛盾，疑点很多。
疑点.en: What the witness said is contradictory; there are many suspicious points.

固然.zh: 他固然聪明，但不够努力。
固然.en: He is admittedly smart, but not hardworking enough.

固然.zh: 钱固然重要，健康更重要。
固然.en: Money is admittedly important, but health is more important.

固然.zh: 工作固然要紧，但也要注意休息。
固然.en: Work is certainly important, but you also need to rest.

固然.zh: 这件衣服固然好看，就是太贵了。
固然.en: This dress is admittedly pretty, but it's too expensive.

固然.zh: 他经验固然丰富，可是缺乏创新精神。
固然.en: He is admittedly experienced, but he lacks innovative spirit.

嗅觉.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.

嗅觉.zh: 他的政治嗅觉非常敏锐。
嗅觉.en: His political acumen is very sharp.

嗅觉.zh: 感冒的时候嗅觉会变差。
嗅觉.en: Your sense of smell gets worse when you have a cold.

嗅觉.zh: 作为记者，他有着很好的商业嗅觉。
嗅觉.en: As a journalist, he has a great business sense.

嗅觉.zh: 这种香水能刺激人的嗅觉，让人感到放松。
嗅觉.en: This perfume can stimulate the sense of smell and make people feel relaxed.

安眠药.en: He only fell asleep after taking sleeping pills.

安眠药.zh: 医生建议她不要长期吃安眠药。
安眠药.en: The doctor advised her not to take sleeping pills long-term.

安眠药.zh: 最近失眠严重，我打算去买点安眠药。
安眠药.en: I've been having severe insomnia lately, so I plan to buy some sleeping pills.

安眠药.zh: 安眠药虽然有用，但副作用也不小。
安眠药.en: Although sleeping pills are effective, they have considerable side effects.

安眠药.zh: 他因为压力太大，半夜起来偷吃安眠药。
安眠药.en: Because of too much stress, he got up in the middle of the night and secretly took sleeping pills.

千方百计.zh: 他千方百计想讨好老板。
千方百计.en: He tries every possible way to please the boss.

千方百计.zh: 公司千方百计留住核心员工。
千方百计.en: The company does everything to retain key employees.

千方百计.zh: 为了拿到这个项目，他们千方百计地想办法。
千方百计.en: To get this project, they tried every possible means.

千方百计.zh: 她千方百计地减肥，却总是失败。
千方百计.en: She tried every method to lose weight but kept failing.

千方百计.zh: 虽然困难重重，他仍在千方百计地寻找解决办法。
千方百计.en: Despite the numerous difficulties, he is still trying every possible way to find a solution.

接班人.zh: 公司正在培养年轻的接班人。
接班人.en: The company is training young successors.

接班人.zh: 老厂长已经找好了合适的接班人。
接班人.en: The old factory director has already found a suitable successor.

接班人.zh: 他想让自己的儿子成为公司的接班人。
接班人.en: He wants his son to become the company's successor.

接班人.zh: 一个好的领导人应该提前培养自己的接班人。
接班人.en: A good leader should cultivate their own successor in advance.

连夜.en: He rushed to the hospital that night.

连夜.zh: 因为第二天要考试，她连夜复习功课。
连夜.en: Because she had an exam the next day, she studied all night.

连夜.zh: 我们连夜出发，终于在天亮前到达。
连夜.en: We set off that night and finally arrived before dawn.

连夜.zh: 工厂连夜加班，把订单赶出来了。
连夜.en: The factory worked overtime all night to finish the order.

连夜.zh: 听到消息后，他连夜开车回了老家。
连夜.en: After hearing the news, he drove back to his hometown that night.

拐杖.en: Grandpa can't do without his cane.

拐杖.zh: 他摔伤了腿，现在走路得用拐杖。
拐杖.en: He hurt his leg, so now he needs a crutch to walk.

拐杖.zh: 这根拐杖是木头做的，很结实。
拐杖.en: This cane is made of wood and is very sturdy.

拐杖.zh: 老人拄着拐杖慢慢地过马路。
拐杖.en: The old man crossed the street slowly with his cane.

拐杖.zh: 我买了一根新拐杖送给奶奶。
拐杖.en: I bought a new cane for my grandma.

军舰.en: A warship is anchored at sea.

军舰.zh: 昨天我们去港口参观了一艘巨大的军舰。
军舰.en: Yesterday we visited a huge warship at the port.

军舰.zh: 军舰上的水兵排列得很整齐。
军舰.en: The sailors on the warship stood in neat rows.

军舰.zh: 那艘军舰正在执行巡逻任务。
军舰.en: That warship is on a patrol mission.

军舰.zh: 电视新闻里播放了军舰演习的画面。
军舰.en: The TV news showed footage of warship drills.

幻影.zh: 他在沙漠里看到了海市蜃楼的幻影。
幻影.en: He saw a mirage phantom in the desert.

幻影.zh: 她总觉得有个幻影跟着她。
幻影.en: She always feels like there's a phantom following her.

幻影.zh: 那些美好的回忆如今都成了幻影。
幻影.en: Those beautiful memories have now become illusions.

幻影.zh: 别把幻影当成现实，要清醒一点。
幻影.en: Don't mistake an illusion for reality; be a bit more sober.

醒悟.zh: 听了妈妈的劝告，她这才醒悟过来。
醒悟.en: After hearing her mom's advice, she then came to realize.

醒悟.zh: 直到失去了机会，他才醒悟自己错了。
醒悟.en: Only after losing the chance did he realize he was wrong.

醒悟.zh: 经历了那么多，他总算醒悟了。
醒悟.en: After experiencing so much, he finally woke up.

醒悟.zh: 老师的一番话让我彻底醒悟了。
醒悟.en: The teacher's words made me fully realize.

次日.en: The next day we went to the Great Wall.

次日.zh: 他当天没来，直到次日才露面。
次日.en: He didn't come that day; he only showed up the next day.

次日.zh: 次日早晨，天还没亮她就起床了。
次日.en: The next morning, she got up before dawn.

次日.zh: 比赛在次日晚上七点开始。
次日.en: The match starts at 7 p.m. the next day.

次日.zh: 他先去了北京，次日又飞往上海。
次日.en: He first went to Beijing, then flew to Shanghai the next day.

落实.zh: 公司的新政策还没有完全落实。
落实.en: The company's new policy hasn't been fully implemented yet.

落实.zh: 我们要把责任落实到每个人身上。
落实.en: We need to assign responsibility to each person.

落实.zh: 政府正在落实新的环保措施。
落实.en: The government is implementing new environmental measures.

落实.zh: 他答应的事总是不落实。
落实.en: He always fails to follow through on what he promises.

摆动.en: The branches sway in the wind.

摆动.zh: 钟摆不停地左右摆动，非常有规律。
摆动.en: The pendulum swings left and right constantly, very regular.

摆动.zh: 她走路时手臂自然地摆动。
摆动.en: Her arms swing naturally when she walks.

摆动.zh: 旗帜在广场上随风摆动。
摆动.en: The flag sways in the wind on the square.

摆动.zh: 那只小狗高兴得尾巴直摆动。
摆动.en: The little dog wagged its tail happily.

实况.en: The match has a live broadcast.

实况.zh: 今晚八点有球赛的实况直播。
实况.en: There's a live broadcast of the ball game at 8 p.m. tonight.

实况.zh: 大家都通过手机看实况。
实况.en: Everyone watched the live broadcast on their phones.

实况.zh: 记者发回了现场的实况报道。
实况.en: The reporter sent back live coverage from the scene.

实况.zh: 听他的描述，好像实况比新闻更惨。
实况.en: From his description, it seems the actual situation is worse than the news.

禁不住.zh: 听到这个笑话，大家都禁不住大笑起来。
禁不住.en: Hearing this joke, everyone couldn't help laughing out loud.

禁不住.zh: 这座桥禁不住那么重的卡车。
禁不住.en: This bridge can't withstand such heavy trucks.

禁不住.zh: 她看到感人场面，禁不住流下眼泪。
禁不住.en: She saw the touching scene and couldn't help shedding tears.

禁不住.zh: 他太累了，禁不住靠在墙上睡着了。
禁不住.en: He was so tired that he couldn't help leaning against the wall and falling asleep.

田野.en: There are many flowers in the field.

田野.zh: 我们周末去田野里散步，空气特别好。
田野.en: We go for a walk in the fields on weekends, the air is really good.

田野.zh: 虽然田野很广阔，但是没有人耕种。
田野.en: Although the fields are vast, no one cultivates them.

田野.zh: 秋天的田野一片金黄，非常漂亮。
田野.en: The fields in autumn are golden and very beautiful.

田野.zh: 他从小在田野里长大，所以很熟悉农活。
田野.en: He grew up in the fields, so he is very familiar with farm work.

接送.en: I pick up and drop off my child at school every day.

接送.zh: 公司有班车接送员工上下班。
接送.en: The company has a shuttle bus to pick up and drop off employees.

接送.zh: 因为下雨，所以我开车接送朋友。
接送.en: Because it rained, I drove to pick up and drop off my friend.

接送.zh: 他负责接送客人去机场。
接送.en: He is responsible for picking up and dropping off guests at the airport.

接送.zh: 学校安排大巴接送学生参加活动。
接送.en: The school arranged a bus to pick up and drop off students for the activity.

凄凉.zh: 冬天的荒原看起来非常凄凉。
凄凉.en: The winter wasteland looks very bleak.

凄凉.zh: 虽然城市很热闹，但这个地方却十分凄凉。
凄凉.en: Although the city is bustling, this place is very desolate.

凄凉.zh: 他走后，房间里显得很凄凉。
凄凉.en: After he left, the room felt quite desolate.

凄凉.zh: 听到这个消息，她的笑容变得凄凉。
凄凉.en: Hearing the news, her smile turned bleak.

摧残.zh: 长期的压力摧残了他的健康。
摧残.en: Long-term stress has wrecked his health.

摧残.zh: 战争不仅摧残了家园，还伤害了人心。
摧残.en: War not only devastates homes but also hurts people's hearts.

摧残.zh: 毒品会摧残人的身体和意志。
摧残.en: Drugs can destroy a person's body and will.

摧残.zh: 那场大火摧残了整个森林。
摧残.en: That big fire devastated the entire forest.

汇集.zh: 这次会议汇集了很多专家。
汇集.en: This conference brought together many experts.

汇集.zh: 我们把信息汇集到一起，然后分析。
汇集.en: We gather the information together and then analyze it.

汇集.zh: 图书馆汇集了各类书籍。
汇集.en: The library collects all kinds of books.

汇集.zh: 来自各地的志愿者汇集在这里。
汇集.en: Volunteers from all over gather here.

抢夺.zh: 两人为了资源抢夺起来。
抢夺.en: The two started fighting over resources.

抢夺.zh: 因为利益冲突，他们互相抢夺客户。
抢夺.en: Due to conflicts of interest, they snatch customers from each other.

抢夺.zh: 歹徒在街上抢夺手机，被警察抓住了。
抢夺.en: The thug snatched a phone on the street and was caught by the police.

旨在.zh: 这次活动旨在宣传环保。
旨在.en: This event aims to promote environmental protection.

旨在.zh: 这个项目旨在提高人们的生活质量。
旨在.en: This project aims to improve people's quality of life.

旨在.zh: 教育的目的旨在培养独立思考的能力。
旨在.en: The purpose of education is to cultivate independent thinking.
The new policy aims to reduce poverty.

旨在.zh: 这个实验旨在验证我们的假设。
旨在.en: This experiment aims to verify our hypothesis.

界定.en: This boundary is hard to define.

界定.zh: 我们需要明确界定每个人的职责。
界定.en: We need to clearly define everyone's responsibilities.

界定.zh: 虽然法律有规定，但很多情况仍难以界定。
界定.en: Although the law has provisions, many situations are still hard to define.

界定.zh: 学术上对这个概念没有统一的界定。
界定.en: Academically, there is no unified definition of this concept.

界定.zh: 他们用时间轴来界定项目的阶段。
界定.en: They use a timeline to define the phases of the project.

出发点.zh: 这次旅行的出发点是北京。
出发点.en: The starting point of this trip is Beijing.

出发点.zh: 他做事总是以自己的利益为出发点。
出发点.en: He always acts with his own interests as the starting point.

出发点.zh: 从教育公平的出发点来考虑这个问题。
出发点.en: Consider this issue from the starting point of educational equity.

出发点.zh: 研究工作的出发点是为了解决实际问题。
出发点.en: The starting point of research work is to solve practical problems.

螺丝.zh: 你需要用螺丝刀拧紧螺丝。
螺丝.en: You need to tighten the screw with a screwdriver.

螺丝.zh: 因为螺丝掉了，所以桌子有点摇晃。
螺丝.en: Because a screw fell off, the table is a bit wobbly.

螺丝.zh: 这盒子里有很多螺丝和螺母。
螺丝.en: This box has many screws and nuts.

螺丝.zh: 他在修理自行车时丢了一颗螺丝。
螺丝.en: He lost a screw while fixing his bike.

炉子.en: The water on the stove is boiling.

炉子.zh: 冬天的时候，我们家里生了一个炉子取暖。
炉子.en: In winter, we light a stove at home for warmth.

炉子.zh: 你帮我把炉子关掉，汤已经煮好了。
炉子.en: Help me turn off the stove, the soup is done.

炉子.zh: 因为炉子坏了，所以今天没法做饭。
炉子.en: Because the stove is broken, we can't cook today.

炉子.zh: 这个老炉子烧煤，不太环保。
炉子.en: This old stove burns coal, not very eco-friendly.

新陈代谢.zh: 随着年龄增长，人的新陈代谢会变慢。
新陈代谢.en: As we age, people's metabolism slows down.

新陈代谢.zh: 多喝水不仅帮助新陈代谢，还对皮肤好。
新陈代谢.en: Drinking more water not only helps metabolism but also is good for skin.

新陈代谢.zh: 感冒时新陈代谢也会受影响。
新陈代谢.en: When you have a cold, metabolism is also affected.

新陈代谢.zh: 新陈代谢是身体维持生命的基本过程。
新陈代谢.en: Metabolism is a basic process for the body to maintain life.

果园.en: There is an orchard behind his house.

果园.zh: 秋天的时候，果园里到处是成熟的苹果。
果园.en: In autumn, the orchard is full of ripe apples.

果园.zh: 我们去了果园摘水果，然后做了果酱。
果园.en: We went to the orchard to pick fruit, and then made jam.

果园.zh: 这个果园种了很多种果树。
果园.en: This orchard grows many kinds of fruit trees.

果园.zh: 果园的工人正在给树浇水。
果园.en: The workers in the orchard are watering the trees.

力争.en: We must strive for first place.

力争.zh: 比赛中他力争拿到最好的成绩。
力争.en: In the competition, he strived to get the best result.

力争.zh: 虽然很难，但我们还是力争完成任务。
力争.en: Although it's difficult, we still strive to complete the task.

力争.zh: 公司力争在年底前推出新产品。
力争.en: The company strives to launch new products before the end of the year.

力争.zh: 他力争说服父母同意他的决定。
力争.en: He strives to convince his parents to agree with his decision.

英明.zh: 历史上很多英明的君主都懂得用人。
英明.en: In history, many wise monarchs knew how to employ people.

英明.zh: 多亏了你的英明领导，我们才成功。
英明.en: Thanks to your wise leadership, we succeeded.

英明.zh: 他觉得自己的选择非常英明。
英明.en: He feels his choice is very wise.

英明.zh: 老师的建议很英明，我听了之后进步很大。
英明.en: The teacher's advice was very wise; after listening, I improved a lot.

实话实说.zh: 实话实说，我不太喜欢这个方案。
实话实说.en: To be honest, I don't really like this plan.

实话实说.zh: 如果你实话实说，大家反而会更信任你。
实话实说.en: If you speak frankly, people will trust you more instead.

实话实说.zh: 咱们都实话实说，别拐弯抹角。
实话实说.en: Let's all speak frankly, no beating around the bush.

实话实说.zh: 实话实说虽然有时候伤人，但长期看是好的。
实话实说.en: Speaking frankly sometimes hurts, but in the long run it's good.

各式各样.zh: 商场里有各式各样的衣服。
各式各样.en: The mall has all kinds of clothes.

各式各样.zh: 这家餐厅提供各式各样的甜点，非常受欢迎。
各式各样.en: This restaurant offers various desserts, very popular.

各式各样.zh: 他收集了各式各样的邮票，而且都很珍贵。
各式各样.en: He collected all kinds of stamps, and they are all precious.

各式各样.zh: 同学们来自各式各样的家庭背景。
各式各样.en: The classmates come from all kinds of family backgrounds.

各式各样.zh: 派对上有各式各样的游戏给孩子们玩。
各式各样.en: At the party, there are all kinds of games for the children to play.

或多或少.zh: 我们或多或少都有点紧张。
或多或少.en: We are all more or less nervous.

或多或少.zh: 每个人在生活中都会或多或少遇到困难。
或多或少.en: Everyone will encounter difficulties more or less in life.

或多或少.zh: 虽然结果不同，但大家或多或少都学到了东西。
或多或少.en: Although the results differ, everyone more or less learned something.

或多或少.zh: 这次考试或多或少影响了他的心情。
或多或少.en: This exam more or less affected his mood.

或多或少.zh: 他的演讲或多或少改变了我对这件事的看法。
或多或少.en: His speech more or less changed my view on this matter.

捶.zh: 她轻轻捶了捶我的背，帮我放松。
捶.en: She gently pounded my back to help me relax.

捶.zh: 他一边捶胸口一边说对不起。
捶.en: He pounded his chest while saying sorry.

捶.zh: 用锤子捶钉子时要小心。
捶.en: Be careful when pounding nails with a hammer.

捶.zh: 他捶了捶腿，走了太远的路。
捶.en: He pounded his legs after walking too far.

爆竹.zh: 春节的时候，街上到处是爆竹声。
爆竹.en: During Spring Festival, the streets are full of firecracker noise.

爆竹.zh: 因为禁止放爆竹，今年过年安静了很多。
爆竹.en: Because firecrackers are banned, this New Year is much quieter.

爆竹.zh: 他买了一盒爆竹准备过年。
爆竹.en: He bought a box of firecrackers for the New Year.

爆竹.zh: 爆竹的声音吓到了我家的小狗。
爆竹.en: The sound of firecrackers scared my little dog.

填充.zh: 我用泡沫填充了包裹的空隙。
填充.en: I filled the gaps in the package with foam.

填充.zh: 先把表格填充好，然后再交上去。
填充.en: First fill out the form completely, then submit it.

填充.zh: 他的生活被工作填充得满满的。
填充.en: His life is completely filled with work.

填充.zh: 这个洞需要用沙子填充。
填充.en: This hole needs to be filled with sand.

法人.en: This company is a legal person.

法人.zh: 法人代表需要签署这份合同。
法人.en: The legal representative needs to sign this contract.

法人.zh: 因为他是法人，所以他要承担法律责任。
法人.en: Because he is the legal person, he bears legal responsibility.

法人.zh: 注册公司时必须提供法人信息。
法人.en: When registering a company, you must provide legal person information.
A legal person has independent property rights.

一动不动.en: He sat there without moving at all.

一动不动.zh: 那只猫盯着老鼠，一动不动地待了很久。
一动不动.en: That cat stared at the mouse, staying still for a long time.

一动不动.zh: 虽然外面很吵，但他还是一动不动地看书。
一动不动.en: Although it was noisy outside, he still read without moving.

一动不动.zh: 拍照的时候请保持一动不动。
一动不动.en: When taking a photo, please keep completely still.

诱饵.zh: 警察用假钞票当诱饵抓住了小偷。
诱饵.en: The police used fake banknotes as bait to catch the thief.

诱饵.zh: 这个优惠只是诱饵，其实条件很苛刻。
诱饵.en: This offer is just bait; actually, the conditions are very strict.

诱饵.zh: 钓鱼时要选择合适的诱饵。
诱饵.en: When fishing, you need to choose the right bait.
Don't be fooled by this bait.

顺心.en: Recently everything has been going smoothly.

顺心.zh: 我希望你每天都能顺心如意。
顺心.en: I hope you can have everything go your way every day.

顺心.zh: 虽然工作很累，但只要顺心我就满足了。
顺心.en: Although work is tiring, as long as things go smoothly, I'm satisfied.

顺心.zh: 生活不可能总是顺心的。

筛.zh: 他用筛子把沙子里的石头筛出来。
筛.en: He used a sieve to sift out the stones from the sand.

筛.zh: 你先筛面粉，然后再加水搅拌。
筛.en: First sift the flour, then add water and stir.

相约.en: We agreed to meet at the café.

相约.zh: 周末我们相约一起去爬山。
相约.en: This weekend we agreed to go hiking together.

相约.zh: 既然已经相约了，就不要迟到。
相约.en: Since we have already agreed to meet, don't be late.
They agreed to meet again ten years later.
We agreed to meet next time.

羞耻.zh: 做这种事你难道不觉得羞耻吗？
羞耻.en: Don't you feel ashamed doing such things?

羞耻.zh: 虽然别人嘲笑他，但他并没有感到羞耻。
羞耻.en: Although others laughed at him, he didn't feel ashamed.

羞耻.zh: 偷东西是一种羞耻的行为。

羞耻.en: A sense of shame is very important.

血栓.zh: 长期坐着容易形成血栓。
血栓.en: Sitting for long periods easily leads to blood clots.

血栓.zh: 因为血管里有血栓，所以他需要吃药。
血栓.en: Because there is a blood clot in the blood vessel, he needs to take medicine.
After surgery, you need to prevent blood clots.

交情.zh: 虽然认识很多年，但我们的交情一般。
交情.en: Although we've known each other for many years, our friendship is just so-so.

交情.zh: 因为交情好，所以他愿意帮忙。
交情.en: Because they have a good friendship, he is willing to help.

交情.zh: 借钱这种事很考验交情。
交情.en: Lending money really tests a friendship.
If you don't have a friendship, don't bother that person.

洁净.zh: 洁净的环境能让人心情愉快。
洁净.en: A clean environment can make people feel happy.

洁净.zh: 他把厨房打扫得特别洁净。
洁净.en: He cleaned the kitchen especially spotless.

洁净.zh: 虽然用了很多清洁剂，但杯子还是不够洁净。
洁净.en: Although he used a lot of detergent, the glasses are still not clean enough.

洁净.zh: 这家医院保持得很洁净，连地板都发亮。
洁净.en: This hospital is kept very clean, even the floors are shiny.

连任.en: He successfully was re-elected as chairman.

连任.zh: 这次选举中，校长连任的可能性很大。
连任.en: In this election, the principal's chances of re-election are very high.

连任.zh: 如果连任，他会继续推动教育改革。
连任.en: If re-elected, he will continue to promote education reform.

连任.zh: 因为业绩突出，总经理宣布再次连任。
连任.en: Because of outstanding performance, the general manager announced his re-election.

连任.zh: 连任两届后，他决定不再参加下一次竞选。
连任.en: After serving two consecutive terms, he decided not to run in the next election.

应酬.zh: 今晚有个应酬，我去不了。
应酬.en: I have a social engagement tonight, so I can't go.

应酬.zh: 他每天都要应付很多应酬。
应酬.en: He has to deal with many social engagements every day.

应酬.zh: 我不喜欢那些无聊的应酬。
应酬.en: I don't like those boring social activities.

应酬.zh: 为了合同，他不得不参加各种应酬。
应酬.en: For the contract, he had to attend all kinds of social events.

应酬.zh: 应酬太多，他连周末都休息不了。
应酬.en: With too many social engagements, he can't even rest on weekends.

偏差.en: The data has a slight deviation.

偏差.zh: 实验结果出现了很大的偏差。
偏差.en: There was a large deviation in the experimental results.

偏差.zh: 只要调整一下，偏差就能纠正。
偏差.en: As long as we adjust a bit, the deviation can be corrected.

偏差.zh: 因为测量有偏差，我们得重新做一次。
偏差.en: Because there was a deviation in the measurement, we have to do it again.

偏差.zh: 他的解释跟事实有偏差，你别全信。
偏差.en: His explanation deviates from the facts, don't believe it all.

稻草.en: There is a straw on the ground.

稻草.zh: 最后一根稻草压垮了骆驼。
稻草.en: The last straw broke the camel's back.

稻草.zh: 他像抓住救命稻草一样抓住了这个机会。
稻草.en: He seized this opportunity like a drowning man grasping at a straw.

稻草.zh: 天冷了，稻草可以用来铺床。
稻草.en: When it's cold, straw can be used to make a bed.

吝啬.en: He is a very stingy person.

吝啬.zh: 别那么吝啬，请我吃顿饭吧。
吝啬.en: Don't be so stingy, treat me to a meal.

吝啬.zh: 他对朋友很大方，对自己却很吝啬。
吝啬.en: He is generous to friends but very stingy with himself.

吝啬.zh: 吝啬的老板连加班费都不肯给。
吝啬.en: The stingy boss won't even pay overtime.

吝啬.zh: 虽然他家很有钱，但在生活上非常吝啬。
吝啬.en: Although his family is rich, he is very stingy in daily life.

惊动.zh: 这件事惊动了整个公司。
惊动.en: This matter alarmed the whole company.

惊动.zh: 一点小动静就惊动了保安。
惊动.en: A small noise alerted the security guard.

惊动.zh: 为了不惊动对方，我们悄悄行动。
惊动.en: In order not to alert the other side, we acted quietly.

惊动.zh: 他的一声尖叫惊动了所有邻居。
惊动.en: His scream alarmed all the neighbors.

凶狠.zh: 他恶狠狠瞪了我一眼，眼神很凶狠。
凶狠.en: He gave me a fierce glare, his eyes very vicious.

凶狠.zh: 那个歹徒的手段非常凶狠。
凶狠.en: That criminal's methods were extremely ruthless.

凶狠.zh: 教练训练时很凶狠，但对学生很好。
凶狠.en: The coach is tough during training, but he is good to the students.

凶狠.zh: 他说话的语气凶狠，让人不敢反驳。
凶狠.en: He spoke in a fierce tone, making people afraid to argue.

陨石.zh: 陨石撞击地球的频率不高。
陨石.en: The frequency of meteorites hitting Earth is not high.

陨石.zh: 科学家在研究这块陨石的成分。
陨石.en: Scientists are studying the composition of this meteorite.
The meteorite crater has become a tourist attraction.

陨石.zh: 听说那块陨石来自火星。
陨石.en: I heard that meteorite came from Mars.

急躁.en: When he is impatient, he easily makes mistakes.

急躁.zh: 急躁的性格让他吃了不少亏。
急躁.en: His impatient nature has caused him many losses.

急躁.zh: 这件事急不来，越急躁越办不好。
急躁.en: This matter can't be rushed; the more impatient you are, the worse it goes.

急躁.zh: 遇到问题时，要冷静，不要急躁。
急躁.en: When encountering a problem, stay calm, don't be impatient.

偏向.en: Don't be too biased towards him.

偏向.zh: 他在这件事上明显有偏向。
偏向.en: He is clearly biased in this matter.

偏向.zh: 虽然他说自己很公正，但实际还是有偏向。
偏向.en: Although he says he is fair, in reality he still has biases.

偏向.zh: 我觉得你在这件事上的偏向太明显了。
偏向.en: I think your bias in this matter is too obvious.

偏向.zh: 家长在教育孩子时不能有偏向。
偏向.en: Parents should not show favoritism when educating children.

间隙.zh: 利用工作间隙休息一下。
间隙.en: Take a break during the work break.

间隙.zh: 两栋楼之间有一个小间隙。
间隙.en: There is a small gap between the two buildings.

间隙.zh: 他在比赛间隙喝了几口水。
间隙.en: He drank some water during the match interval.

间隙.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但他还是利用间隙看了几页书。
间隙.en: Although time was tight, he still used the gap to read a few pages.

间隙.zh: 我们可以在会议间隙聊一下这个问题。
间隙.en: We can talk about this issue during the meeting break.

抗衡.zh: 小公司很难与大企业抗衡。
抗衡.en: Small companies can hardly compete with big corporations.

抗衡.zh: 他的实力足以抗衡对手。
抗衡.en: His strength is enough to rival the opponent.

抗衡.zh: 这家公司已经能跟国际巨头抗衡了。
抗衡.en: This company can already compete with international giants.

抗衡.zh: 虽然我们规模小，但依然可以跟大品牌抗衡。
抗衡.en: Although we are small, we can still compete with big brands.

抗衡.zh: 这两支球队实力相当，完全能互相抗衡。
抗衡.en: These two teams are evenly matched and can fully contend with each other.

存折.zh: 我把存折放在抽屉里了。
存折.en: I put the bankbook in the drawer.

存折.zh: 去银行取钱记得带存折。
存折.en: Remember to bring your bankbook when you go to withdraw money.

存折.zh: 现在很少有人用存折了，都用银行卡。
存折.en: Now few people use bankbooks; everyone uses bank cards.

存折.zh: 虽然存折不太方便，但有些老人还是喜欢用。
存折.en: Although bankbooks are not very convenient, some elderly still prefer them.

存折.zh: 我妈妈还保留着十几年前的旧存折。
存折.en: My mother still keeps an old bankbook from over ten years ago.

担负.zh: 他担负着全家的生活费。
担负.en: He bears the living expenses of the whole family.
This task is for you to take on.

担负.zh: 公司会担负你出差的全部费用。
担负.en: The company will cover all your business trip expenses.

担负.zh: 虽然责任重大，但他还是勇敢地担负了起来。
担负.en: Although the responsibility was heavy, he bravely shouldered it.

担负.zh: 作为队长，他担负了很多压力。
担负.en: As the captain, he bears a lot of pressure.

狼狈.en: He got caught in the rain and looked very disheveled.

狼狈.zh: 那次旅行我们搞得狼狈极了。
狼狈.en: We ended up in a real mess on that trip.

狼狈.zh: 他摔了一跤，样子非常狼狈。
狼狈.en: He took a fall and looked very embarrassed.

狼狈.zh: 虽然计划失败了，但他并不显得狼狈。
狼狈.en: Although the plan failed, he didn't seem flustered.

狼狈.zh: 他们狼狈的样子被拍了下来，传到了网上。
狼狈.en: Their embarrassing appearance was captured and spread online.

俄语.en: I can speak a little Russian.
Her major in college is Russian.

俄语.zh: 这家公司需要招聘俄语翻译。
俄语.en: This company needs to hire a Russian translator.

俄语.zh: 虽然俄语很难学，但他还是坚持下来了。
俄语.en: Although Russian is hard to learn, he still persisted.

俄语.zh: 他看了一部俄语电影，完全听不懂。
俄语.en: He watched a Russian movie and couldn't understand a thing.

在职.en: She performed well during her tenure.

在职.zh: 很多在职人员选择晚上上课。
在职.en: Many working people choose to take classes in the evening.

在职.zh: 虽然他已经辞职了，但在职时的经验很有用。
在职.en: Although he has resigned, the experience from his time in the job is very useful.

在职.zh: 公司为在职员工提供免费午餐。
在职.en: The company provides free lunch for current employees.

违约.en: He breached the contract this time.

违约.zh: 合同签了就不能随便违约。
违约.en: Once the contract is signed, you cannot casually break it.

违约.zh: 如果一方违约，要赔偿损失。
违约.en: If one party defaults, they must compensate for the losses.

违约.zh: 虽然合同中写明了违约条款，但他还是没遵守。
违约.en: Although the contract clearly stated the breach clause, he still didn't comply.

违约.zh: 这家公司因为违约被起诉了。
违约.en: This company was sued for breach of contract.

躲藏.en: He is hiding under the bed.
Small animals are good at hiding.
The kids are playing hide and seek.

躲藏.zh: 虽然警察在搜查，但罪犯躲藏得很好。
躲藏.en: Although the police are searching, the criminal is hiding very well.

躲藏.zh: 他听到脚步声，赶紧躲藏了起来。
躲藏.en: He heard footsteps and quickly hid himself.

银幕.en: A movie is playing on the screen.

银幕.zh: 我第一次在大银幕上看这部电影，感觉很震撼。
银幕.en: I watched this movie on the big screen for the first time, and it felt amazing.

银幕.zh: 虽然银幕不大，但画质非常清晰。
银幕.en: Although the screen is not big, the picture quality is very clear.

银幕.zh: 他从小就想登上银幕成为演员。
银幕.en: He has wanted to step onto the screen and become an actor since childhood.

银幕.zh: 现在的银幕技术越来越先进了。
银幕.en: Screen technology nowadays is getting more advanced.

无所事事.zh: 放假的时候，我常常感到无所事事。
无所事事.en: During holidays, I often feel like I have nothing to do.

无所事事.zh: 因为失业了，他每天无所事事，心情很不好。
无所事事.en: Because he lost his job, he has nothing to do every day and feels very unhappy.

无所事事.zh: 别总是无所事事，找点事情做吧。
无所事事.en: Don't always be idle; find something to do.

无所事事.zh: 年轻人不应该整天无所事事，浪费青春。
无所事事.en: Young people shouldn't be idle all day, wasting their youth.

感触.zh: 这次旅行让我很有感触。
感触.en: This trip gave me a lot of feelings.

感触.zh: 看到老照片，我感触很深。
感触.en: Seeing old photos, I felt deeply moved.

感触.zh: 虽然事情已经过去了，但我还是有很多感触。
感触.en: Although it's over, I still have many feelings.

感触.zh: 听完他的故事，大家都有很多感触。
感触.en: After hearing his story, everyone had many reflections.

感触.zh: 每次回到母校，我都有不一样的感触。
感触.en: Every time I return to my alma mater, I have different feelings.

盛行.en: Pop music is very prevalent now.

盛行.zh: 这种穿搭风格在年轻人中非常盛行。
盛行.en: This style of dressing is very popular among young people.

盛行.zh: 虽然网购很盛行，但有些人还是喜欢去实体店。
盛行.en: Although online shopping is prevalent, some people still like going to physical stores.

盛行.zh: 这个季节流感盛行，大家要注意身体。
盛行.en: This season flu is rampant; everyone should take care.

盛行.zh: 以前这种习俗很盛行，现在很少见了。
盛行.en: This custom used to be very prevalent, but now it's rare.

替身.en: He works as a stunt double for a celebrity.

替身.zh: 电影里的危险镜头都是替身演员完成的。
替身.en: The dangerous scenes in the movie were all done by stunt doubles.

替身.zh: 因为演员受伤了，导演只好找了一个替身。
替身.en: Because the actor was injured, the director had to find a substitute.

替身.zh: 他不想一直做别人的替身，想演自己的角色。
替身.en: He doesn't want to always be someone else's substitute; he wants to play his own role.

替身.zh: 有时候替身比主角还要辛苦。
替身.en: Sometimes the stunt double works harder than the lead actor.

抒情.zh: 他喜欢听抒情的音乐来放松心情。
抒情.en: He likes to listen to lyric music to relax.

抒情.zh: 虽然这首歌很抒情，但歌词有点悲伤。
抒情.en: Although this song is very lyrical, the lyrics are a bit sad.

抒情.zh: 这种抒情的电影很适合一个人看。
抒情.en: This kind of lyrical movie is suitable for watching alone.

抒情.zh: 她用了很多抒情的句子来表达自己的感情。
抒情.en: She used many lyrical sentences to express her feelings.

不正之风.zh: 公司里出现了一些不正之风，需要整顿。
不正之风.en: Some unhealthy trends have appeared in the company, requiring rectification.

不正之风.zh: 如果大家都容忍不正之风，社会会越来越乱。
不正之风.en: If everyone tolerates bad practices, society will become more chaotic.

不正之风.zh: 这种送礼的不正之风应该被制止。
不正之风.en: This unhealthy trend of gift-giving should be stopped.

不正之风.zh: 他们严厉打击行业内的不正之风。
不正之风.en: They crack down hard on unhealthy trends in the industry.

真挚.zh: 我感谢她对我真挚的关心和帮助。
真挚.en: I thank her for her sincere care and help to me.

真挚.zh: 虽然我们认识不久，但她的友谊很真挚。
真挚.en: Although we haven't known each other long, her friendship is sincere.

真挚.zh: 真挚的感情不需要太多语言。
真挚.en: Sincere feelings don't need many words.

真挚.zh: 他用真挚的话语打动了所有人。
真挚.en: He moved everyone with his sincere words.

交集.zh: 我们两个圈子的交集很少。
交集.en: Our two circles have little overlap.

交集.zh: 我和他的生活几乎没有交集。
交集.en: He and I have almost no intersection in our lives.

交集.zh: 虽然我们住在同一个城市，但我们的社交圈没什么交集。
交集.en: Although we live in the same city, our social circles have no overlap.

交集.zh: 这次会议让不同领域的人有了交集。
交集.en: This meeting allowed people from different fields to intersect.

交集.zh: 他们的兴趣爱好有很多交集。
交集.en: Their hobbies and interests have a lot of overlap.

糟蹋.zh: 他喝醉了，把整个房间都糟蹋了。
糟蹋.en: He got drunk and ruined the whole room.

糟蹋.zh: 如果你不好好利用这个机会，就是在糟蹋它的价值。
糟蹋.en: If you don't make good use of this opportunity, you're wasting its value.
These books were ruined by the rain.

糟蹋.zh: 他们乱扔垃圾，把公园糟蹋得不成样子。
糟蹋.en: They littered everywhere, ruining the park terribly.

打猎.zh: 周末我们一起去山里打猎吧。
打猎.en: Let's go hunting in the mountains this weekend.

打猎.zh: 虽然打猎很累，但是很有趣。
打猎.en: Although hunting is tiring, it's very interesting.

打猎.zh: 他在森林里打猎时遇到了一只熊。
打猎.en: He encountered a bear while hunting in the forest.

打猎.zh: 现在很多人打猎只是为了娱乐。
打猎.en: Now many people hunt just for fun.

痛心.en: This matter makes me very distressed.

痛心.zh: 看到孩子受伤，父母非常痛心。
痛心.en: Seeing their child injured, the parents were heartbroken.

痛心.zh: 他因为自己的错误而感到痛心。
痛心.en: He feels distressed because of his own mistake.

痛心.zh: 说起那次失败，他至今还很痛心。
痛心.en: Speaking of that failure, he is still very distressed.

痛心.zh: 对环境破坏，我们感到痛心。
痛心.en: We feel distressed about environmental damage.

告辞.en: It's getting late, I'll take my leave.

告辞.zh: 吃完饭，他站起来向主人告辞。
告辞.en: After dinner, he stood up and said goodbye to the host.

告辞.zh: 因为明天要早起，所以我就先告辞了。
告辞.en: Because I have to get up early tomorrow, I'll take my leave now.

告辞.zh: 告辞前，他再三表示感谢。
告辞.en: Before leaving, he expressed his gratitude repeatedly.
She finished speaking and then left after saying goodbye.

理睬.zh: 我叫了他好几声，他都没理睬。
理睬.en: I called him several times, but he didn't acknowledge me.

理睬.zh: 虽然我向他道歉，但他还是不理睬。
理睬.en: Although I apologized to him, he still ignores me.

理睬.zh: 这些谣言你不要理睬就好。
她从不理睬那些无聊的评论。
理睬.en: She never pays attention to those boring comments.

效益.zh: 公司今年的经济效益比去年提高了不少。
效益.en: The company's economic benefits this year have increased a lot compared to last year.

效益.zh: 如果管理得好，效益就会增加。
效益.en: If managed well, the benefits will increase.

效益.zh: 我们需要考虑社会效益和经济效益。
效益.en: We need to consider social benefits and economic benefits.

效益.zh: 投资这个项目能带来长期效益。
效益.en: Investing in this project can bring long-term benefits.

害虫.en: These pests ate all the vegetables.

害虫.zh: 农民用农药来消灭田里的害虫。
害虫.en: Farmers use pesticides to eliminate pests in the fields.

害虫.zh: 因为害虫太多，今年的收成不好。
害虫.en: Because there are too many pests, this year's harvest is poor.

害虫.zh: 蚊子是夏天常见的害虫。
害虫.en: Mosquitoes are common pests in summer.

害虫.zh: 我们要保护益虫，消灭害虫。
害虫.en: We should protect beneficial insects and eliminate pests.

提炼.zh: 原油经过加工可以提炼出汽油。
提炼.en: Crude oil can be refined into gasoline through processing.

提炼.zh: 科学家从植物中提炼出有效的药物成分。
提炼.en: Scientists extract effective medicinal ingredients from plants.

提炼.zh: 他善于从生活经验中提炼智慧。
提炼.en: He is good at extracting wisdom from life experience.

提炼.zh: 这个厂专门提炼稀有金属。
提炼.en: This factory specializes in refining rare metals.

停滞.zh: 因为疫情，很多行业陷入停滞。
停滞.en: Because of the pandemic, many industries have come to a standstill.

停滞.zh: 如果不改革，企业就会停滞不前。
停滞.en: If there is no reform, the company will stagnate.

停滞.zh: 谈判停滞了几个月，终于有了进展。
停滞.en: The negotiations stalled for months and finally made progress.

停滞.zh: 他的事业一度停滞，后来重新起步。
停滞.en: His career once stagnated, but later started anew.

摆平.zh: 他靠关系把麻烦摆平了。
摆平.en: He used connections to sort out the trouble.

摆平.zh: 只要钱到位，什么都能摆平。
摆平.en: As long as the money is in place, anything can be settled.

摆平.zh: 警察很快摆平了那场纠纷。
摆平.en: The police quickly resolved that dispute.

摆平.zh: 你别担心，我帮你摆平这件事。
摆平.en: Don't worry, I'll help you sort this out.

屡.en: He refuses to mend his ways despite repeated warnings.

屡.zh: 他屡次迟到，老板很生气。
屡.en: He is late repeatedly, and the boss is very angry.

屡.zh: 尽管屡次警告，他仍然犯错。
屡.en: Despite repeated warnings, he still makes mistakes.

屡.zh: 这个球队屡败屡战，值得敬佩。
屡.en: This team repeatedly loses but keeps fighting, which is admirable.

屡.zh: 他屡屡获得奖学金，非常优秀。
屡.en: He repeatedly wins scholarships; he is very excellent.

清静.zh: 我喜欢在清静的地方看书。
清静.en: I like to read in a quiet place.

清静.zh: 周末的公园很清静，适合散步。
清静.en: The park is very quiet on weekends, perfect for a walk.

清静.zh: 搬到郊区以后，生活变得清静多了。
清静.en: After moving to the suburbs, life became much quieter.

清静.zh: 虽然城市很喧嚣，但我的书房里却很清静。
清静.en: Although the city is noisy, my study is very quiet.

喘息.zh: 工作太忙了，连喘息的时间都没有。
喘息.en: Work is so busy that there's no time to even breathe.

喘息.zh: 爬到山顶后，我们都坐下来喘息。
喘息.en: After climbing to the top, we all sat down to catch our breath.

喘息.zh: 项目结束后，我终于可以喘息几天了。
喘息.en: After the project ended, I finally had a few days to catch my breath.

转折点.en: This is a turning point in life.

转折点.zh: 那次比赛成了他的转折点。
转折点.en: That competition became a turning point for him.

转折点.zh: 这个发现是科学史上的转折点。
转折点.en: This discovery is a turning point in the history of science.

转折点.zh: 辞职以后，我找到了真正的转折点。
转折点.en: After quitting my job, I found the real turning point.

转折点.zh: 虽然过程很艰难，但那次失败却是他的转折点。
转折点.en: Although the process was hard, that failure was a turning point for him.

恰巧.en: I happened to be there too.
He happened to bring an umbrella.

恰巧.zh: 我去找她，恰巧她不在家。
恰巧.en: I went to see her, but she happened not to be home.

恰巧.zh: 我们恰巧坐了同一趟车。
恰巧.en: We happened to take the same train.

恰巧.zh: 那天我出门晚，恰巧错过了那班车。
恰巧.en: I left late that day and happened to miss that bus.

管教.en: She is very strict with her children.

管教.zh: 管教方式要适当，不能太严厉。
管教.en: The way of disciplining should be appropriate, not too harsh.

管教.zh: 父母应该学会如何正确地管教孩子。
管教.en: Parents should learn how to discipline their children correctly.

管教.zh: 虽然爱孩子很重要，但适当的管教也必不可少。
管教.en: Although loving children is important, appropriate discipline is also essential.

合计.zh: 大家合计合计怎么解决这个问题。
合计.en: Let's all put our heads together on how to solve this problem.

合计.zh: 这三项费用合计五千元。
合计.en: The total of these three expenses is five thousand yuan.

合计.zh: 她合计了一下，觉得这个方案不划算。
合计.en: She calculated and thought this plan wasn't cost-effective.

小溪.zh: 我们沿着小溪走了一个小时。
小溪.en: We walked along the stream for an hour.

小溪.zh: 这条小溪的水是从山上流下来的。
小溪.en: The water in this stream comes from the mountain.

小溪.zh: 夏天的时候，孩子们喜欢在小溪里玩水。
小溪.en: In summer, children like to play in the stream.

专人.en: This matter is handled by a designated person.
Need to find a specialist for repair.

专人.zh: 公司派了专人处理投诉。
专人.en: The company assigned a specific person to handle complaints.

专人.zh: 贵重物品要交给专人保管。
专人.en: Valuables should be kept by a designated person.

专人.zh: 这次活动有专人负责接待嘉宾。
专人.en: There is a dedicated person responsible for receiving guests at this event.

天分.en: She has a talent for painting.

天分.zh: 光有天分还不够，还要努力。
天分.en: Talent alone is not enough; you also need hard work.

天分.zh: 这孩子从小就对音乐有天分。
天分.en: This child has had a talent for music since childhood.

天分.zh: 虽然他有天分，但他从不骄傲。
天分.en: Although he has talent, he is never arrogant.

重创.en: The accident dealt a heavy blow to the company.

重创.zh: 这场台风给农业带来了重创。
重创.en: The typhoon caused severe damage to agriculture.

重创.zh: 经济危机重创了多个行业。
重创.en: The economic crisis severely hit multiple industries.

重创.zh: 虽然疫情重创了旅游市场，但大家仍在努力恢复。
重创.en: Although the pandemic severely damaged the tourism market, everyone is still working hard to recover.

频频.en: He nodded frequently to show agreement.

频频.zh: 最近他频频迟到，老板很不高兴。
频频.en: He has been late frequently recently, and the boss is unhappy.

频频.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但她还是频频出门散步。
频频.en: Although it was very cold, she still went out for walks frequently.

频频.zh: 发布会上，记者们频频举手提问。
频频.en: At the press conference, reporters frequently raised their hands to ask questions.

频频.zh: 她频频发消息给我，但我都没时间回。
频频.en: She keeps sending me messages, but I have no time to reply.

缅怀.zh: 清明时节，人们去扫墓缅怀亲人。
缅怀.en: During the Qingming Festival, people visit graves to remember their loved ones.

缅怀.zh: 他写了一篇文章来缅怀逝去的父亲。
缅怀.en: He wrote an article to remember his deceased father.

缅怀.zh: 虽然已经过去很多年，我们依然深深缅怀他。
缅怀.en: Although many years have passed, we still deeply cherish his memory.

缅怀.zh: 老同学们聚在一起，缅怀当年的校园生活。
缅怀.en: Old classmates gathered to reminisce about their school days.

拆迁.en: This old city area is going to be demolished.

拆迁.zh: 因为拆迁，他们不得不搬家找新房子。
拆迁.en: Because of the demolition, they had to move and find a new house.

拆迁.zh: 政府给了拆迁户一笔补偿金。
拆迁.en: The government gave the relocated households a sum of compensation.

拆迁.zh: 拆迁工作进展顺利，大部分居民已经搬走。
拆迁.en: The demolition work is going smoothly, and most residents have already moved out.

拆迁.zh: 听说那边要拆迁了，租金都涨了不少。
拆迁.en: I heard that area is going to be demolished, so the rent has gone up quite a bit.

取而代之.zh: 旧系统将被新系统取而代之。
取而代之.en: The old system will be replaced by the new one.

取而代之.zh: 如果你不努力，别人就会取而代之。
取而代之.en: If you don't work hard, someone else will take your place.

取而代之.zh: 智能手机已经逐渐取代了传统相机，取而代之成为主流。
取而代之.en: Smartphones have gradually replaced traditional cameras, becoming the mainstream.

取而代之.zh: 他辞职后，公司派了新人取而代之。
取而代之.en: After he resigned, the company sent a new person to replace him.

取而代之.zh: 这家小店被连锁超市取而代之，生意差了很多。
取而代之.en: This small shop was taken over by a chain supermarket, and business got much worse.

后裔.en: He is a descendant of Confucius.

后裔.zh: 这些贵族后裔依然保留着很多传统习俗。
后裔.en: These descendants of nobility still maintain many traditional customs.

后裔.zh: 据说他是某个古代皇帝的后裔。
后裔.en: It is said that he is a descendant of some ancient emperor.

后裔.zh: 虽然他是名门后裔，但从不高傲自大。
后裔.en: Although he is a descendant of a famous family, he is never arrogant.

后裔.zh: 很多海外华人都是当年移民的后裔。
后裔.en: Many overseas Chinese are descendants of immigrants from long ago.

饱满.zh: 这些谷粒颗颗饱满，收成不错。
饱满.en: Each grain is plump, and the harvest is good.

饱满.zh: 虽然工作很忙，她仍然保持饱满的热情。
饱满.en: Although work is very busy, she still maintains full enthusiasm.

饱满.zh: 运动员们以饱满的状态参加了比赛。
饱满.en: The athletes participated in the competition in excellent condition.

饱满.zh: 他演讲时声音洪亮，情绪饱满，很有感染力。
饱满.en: When he spoke, his voice was loud, his emotions were full, and it was very engaging.

稀罕.en: This kind of fruit is very rare.

稀罕.zh: 我才不稀罕他的礼物呢。
稀罕.en: I don't care about his gift at all.

稀罕.zh: 这么稀罕的东西你是怎么找到的？
稀罕.en: How did you find such a rare thing?

稀罕.zh: 他觉得自己很了不起，其实没人稀罕他。
稀罕.en: He thinks he's great, but actually nobody values him.

稀罕.zh: 现在智能手机不稀罕了，几乎人人都有。
稀罕.en: Smartphones are not rare now, almost everyone has one.

汹涌.en: The waves are surging and roaring.

汹涌.zh: 街上人流汹涌，非常热闹。
汹涌.en: The street is crowded with surging people, very lively.

汹涌.zh: 河水汹涌地冲垮了堤坝。
汹涌.en: The river surged and broke the dam.

汹涌.zh: 虽然心里波涛汹涌，但他表面上很平静。
汹涌.en: Although his heart was churning, he remained calm on the surface.

汹涌.zh: 暴雨过后，山洪汹涌而下，十分危险。
汹涌.en: After the heavy rain, mountain torrents surged down, very dangerous.

一家人.zh: 他把我当成一家人看待。
虽然吵了架，但终究是一家人，还是会和好。
一家人.en: Although we had a fight, we are still family and will make up.

一家人.zh: 他们住在一起，看起来就像一家人一样。
一家人.en: They live together and seem just like a family.

坚持不懈.zh: 只要你坚持不懈，就一定会成功。
坚持不懈.en: As long as you persevere, you will surely succeed.

坚持不懈.zh: 她坚持不懈地学习中文，现在已经说得很好。
坚持不懈.en: She persistently studied Chinese, and now she speaks it very well.

坚持不懈.zh: 减肥需要坚持不懈的努力，不能三天打鱼两天晒网。
坚持不懈.en: Losing weight requires persistent effort; you can't work by fits and starts.

坚持不懈.zh: 科学家们坚持不懈地研究，终于找到了解决方案。
坚持不懈.en: The scientists persistently researched and finally found a solution.

尖端.zh: 这家公司的技术很尖端。
虽然价格高，但它的尖端设计确实吸引人。
尖端.en: Although the price is high, its cutting-edge design is really attractive.

尖端.zh: 他总说要做最尖端的研究。
尖端.en: He always says he wants to do the most cutting-edge research.
The tip of the pencil is broken.

尖端.zh: 我们需要引进更多尖端设备来提高效率。
尖端.en: We need to import more cutting-edge equipment to improve efficiency.

气压.zh: 今天气压很低，可能会下雨。
气压.en: The air pressure is very low today, it might rain.

气压.zh: 开车前要检查轮胎的气压。
气压.en: Check the tire pressure before driving.

气压.zh: 高气压通常带来晴朗的天气。
气压.en: High pressure usually brings clear weather.

气压.zh: 因为气压变化太大，他觉得不舒服。
气压.en: Because the air pressure changed too much, he felt unwell.

气压.zh: 登山时要注意气压的变化。
气压.en: Pay attention to changes in air pressure when climbing mountains.

限定.zh: 这个优惠限定会员才能用。
限定.en: This offer is limited to members only.

限定.zh: 考试时间限定为两小时。
限定.en: The exam time is limited to two hours.

限定.zh: 数量有限，每人限定买一个。
限定.en: Limited quantity, each person can only buy one.

限定.zh: 虽然限定人数，但大家还是抢着报名。
限定.en: Although the number of people is limited, everyone still rushed to sign up.

限定.zh: 他限定自己每天只能玩一小时游戏。
限定.en: He limits himself to only one hour of gaming per day.

心里话.en: I want to tell you something from the heart.

心里话.zh: 喝醉后，他把心里话全说了出来。
心里话.en: After getting drunk, he blurted out all his innermost thoughts.

心里话.zh: 我们互相交换心里话，感情更深了。
心里话.en: We exchanged our innermost thoughts and our bond deepened.

心里话.zh: 虽然不好意思，但我还是想告诉他我的心里话。
心里话.en: Even though I'm shy, I still want to tell him what's on my mind.

少不了.en: Eating dumplings is an essential part of the New Year.
You can't be absent from this gathering.
A charger is indispensable when traveling on business.

少不了.zh: 他出差虽然很忙，但还是少不了要给我打电话。
少不了.en: Even though he's very busy on a business trip, he still inevitably calls me.

少不了.zh: 办婚礼少不了要花很多钱。
少不了.en: A wedding inevitably costs a lot of money.

念念不忘.en: He can't get over his first love.

念念不忘.zh: 我至今对那次旅行念念不忘。
念念不忘.en: To this day, I still can't forget that trip.

念念不忘.zh: 她念念不忘小时候吃过的糖葫芦。
念念不忘.en: She always remembers the candied hawthorn sticks she ate as a child.

念念不忘.zh: 虽然分手很久了，但他还是念念不忘。
念念不忘.en: Even though they broke up long ago, he still can't forget her.

念念不忘.zh: 那个好心的陌生人让我念念不忘。
念念不忘.en: I can't forget that kind stranger.

乌云.en: There are many dark clouds in the sky.

乌云.zh: 突然乌云密布，要下雨了。
乌云.en: Suddenly the sky was covered with dark clouds, it's going to rain.

乌云.zh: 虽然现在有乌云，但很快就会放晴的。
乌云.en: Although there are dark clouds now, it will clear up soon.

乌云.zh: 他的心情就像天上的乌云一样沉重。
乌云.en: His mood is as heavy as the dark clouds in the sky.

竟敢.en: How dare you lie to me!
He actually dared to sleep in class.
The thief actually dared to commit a crime in broad daylight.

竟敢.zh: 她竟敢顶撞老板，胆子真大。
竟敢.en: She actually dared to talk back to the boss, what audacity.
He actually dares to do such a thing?

贝壳.en: There are many seashells on the beach.

贝壳.zh: 我捡了一个漂亮的贝壳。
贝壳.en: I picked up a beautiful seashell.

贝壳.zh: 贝壳可以用来做手工艺品。
贝壳.en: Seashells can be used to make handicrafts.

贝壳.zh: 小时候我喜欢收集贝壳。
贝壳.en: When I was little, I liked collecting seashells.

贝壳.zh: 他在海边找贝壳找了一上午。
贝壳.en: He spent the whole morning looking for seashells at the seaside.

橙汁.en: I want to drink a glass of orange juice.
Please give me a glass of iced orange juice.
Drinking orange juice in the morning is good for your health.
This bottle of orange juice is freshly squeezed.

橙汁.zh: 虽然橙汁很健康，但我更喜欢喝咖啡。
橙汁.en: Although orange juice is healthy, I prefer drinking coffee.

绷带.en: My hand is wrapped in a bandage.

绷带.zh: 他摔了一跤，腿上包了绷带。
绷带.en: He fell and had his leg wrapped in a bandage.

绷带.zh: 医生给我换了绷带，说明天就能拆了。
绷带.en: The doctor changed my bandage and said it could be removed tomorrow.

绷带.zh: 虽然伤口不深，但我还是贴了绷带防止感染。
绷带.en: Although the wound isn't deep, I still put on a bandage to prevent infection.

绷带.zh: 你带绷带了吗？运动的时候容易受伤。
绷带.en: Did you bring a bandage? It's easy to get hurt during sports.

萧条.en: The economy has been very depressed recently.

萧条.zh: 这条街的店铺都关了，显得很萧条。
萧条.en: All the shops on this street are closed, making it look desolate.

萧条.zh: 因为市场萧条，很多公司都在裁员。
萧条.en: Because of the market slump, many companies are laying off workers.

萧条.zh: 萧条时期，大家花钱都比较谨慎。
萧条.en: During a recession, people are more cautious with their spending.

架势.en: His posture looks like he's about to fight.

架势.zh: 你摆出这个架势，是想吓唬谁啊？
架势.en: Putting on that pose, who are you trying to scare?

架势.zh: 看她那架势，今天非赢不可。
架势.en: Judging by her stance, she is determined to win today.

架势.zh: 他摆出一副很懂的架势，结果什么都答不上来。
架势.en: He put on a know-it-all attitude but ended up not answering anything.

架势.zh: 别看他架势挺大，其实心里很紧张。
架势.en: Despite his imposing demeanor, he's actually very nervous inside.

内地.zh: 我老家在内地的一个小城市。
内地.en: My hometown is a small city in inland China.

内地.zh: 沿海城市比内地发展得快。
内地.en: Coastal cities develop faster than inland areas.

内地.zh: 他从小生活在内地，很少见过海。
内地.en: He grew up in the inland region and rarely saw the sea.

内地.zh: 内地和沿海的消费水平还是差挺多的。
内地.en: There's quite a difference in consumption levels between inland and coastal areas.

内地.zh: 这次旅行我们打算去内地看看，体验一下不一样的生活。
内地.en: This trip we plan to go to the inland region to experience a different lifestyle.

先天.zh: 她先天视力不好，从小戴眼镜。
先天.en: She has poor eyesight from birth and has worn glasses since childhood.

先天.zh: 有些能力靠先天，但更多靠后天努力。
先天.en: Some abilities depend on innate factors, but more rely on hard work.

先天.zh: 他唱歌好听，先天条件就不错。
先天.en: He sings well; his natural talent is already good.

先天.zh: 虽然先天不足，但他通过训练取得了很好的成绩。
先天.en: Despite congenital deficiencies, he achieved great results through training.

无动于衷.zh: 听到这个消息，他无动于衷。
无动于衷.en: He remained unmoved upon hearing the news.

无动于衷.zh: 别人都哭了，她却无动于衷。
无动于衷.en: Others were crying, but she remained indifferent.

无动于衷.zh: 我讲了那么久，他竟然无动于衷。
无动于衷.en: I talked for so long, yet he was completely indifferent.

无动于衷.zh: 面对她的道歉，他只是无动于衷地看了她一眼。
无动于衷.en: In response to her apology, he just gave her an indifferent look.

无动于衷.zh: 不管我怎么劝他，他都无动于衷，真让人着急。
无动于衷.en: No matter how much I tried to persuade him, he remained unmoved, which is really worrying.

记号.en: I made a mark on the book.

记号.zh: 你在这里画个记号，方便以后找。
记号.en: Draw a mark here to make it easier to find later.

记号.zh: 他用的记号特别明显，一眼就能看到。
记号.en: The mark he made is very conspicuous and can be seen at a glance.

记号.zh: 为了防止拿错，我给自己的行李做了记号。
记号.en: To avoid picking up the wrong one, I marked my luggage.

记号.zh: 你在每个文件上都做个记号，这样就不会搞混了。
记号.en: Make a mark on each file so you won't mix them up.

溜达.en: I went out for a stroll.

溜达.zh: 晚饭后我们到河边溜达溜达。
溜达.en: After dinner, we took a stroll by the river.

溜达.zh: 他没事就爱在小区里溜达。
溜达.en: He likes to wander around the neighborhood when he has nothing to do.

溜达.zh: 周末别一直宅着，出去溜达一下对身体好。
溜达.en: Don't stay at home all weekend; going out for a walk is good for your health.

溜达.zh: 我溜达到公园的时候，遇到了一个老朋友。
溜达.en: When I strolled to the park, I ran into an old friend.

参谋.zh: 你帮我参谋一下这件衣服怎么样。
参谋.en: Give me your advice on this piece of clothing.

参谋.zh: 买手机之前，他让我帮他参谋。
参谋.en: Before buying a phone, he asked me to give him advice.

参谋.zh: 这个方案我不太确定，想请同事参谋参谋。
参谋.en: I'm not sure about this plan; I want to ask my colleague for advice.

参谋.zh: 他经验丰富，遇到问题可以找他参谋。
参谋.en: He is experienced; you can consult him when you encounter problems.

参谋.zh: 选学校是个大事，多找几个人参谋一下比较稳妥。
参谋.en: Choosing a school is a big deal; it's safer to get advice from several people.

保鲜.en: Leftovers should be kept in the fridge to stay fresh.
This food container has good quality for keeping things fresh.

保鲜.zh: 水果用保鲜膜包一下，能放更久。
保鲜.en: Wrap the fruit in plastic wrap to keep it fresh longer.

保鲜.zh: 蔬菜不保鲜的话，第二天就蔫了。
保鲜.en: If vegetables aren't kept fresh, they wilt the next day.

保鲜.zh: 我买了个新的保鲜盒，专门用来装切好的水果。
保鲜.en: I bought a new food container specifically for cut fruit.

淌.en: Rainwater drips down along the eaves.

淌.zh: 因为天气太热，他一边干活一边淌汗。
淌.en: Because the weather is too hot, he sweats while working.

淌.zh: 别哭了，眼泪一直淌，眼睛都红了。
淌.en: Don't cry, tears keep flowing, your eyes are red.

淌.zh: 看到亲人，他激动得淌下眼泪。
淌.en: Seeing his family, he was so emotional that tears flowed.

售票.en: The ticket office has a long line.
