售票.zh: 网上售票很方便，不用排队。
售票.en: Online ticket sales are convenient, no need to queue.

售票.zh: 请问售票窗口几点开门？
售票.en: May I ask what time the ticket window opens?

售票.zh: 虽然车站售票人多，但机器也能买。
售票.en: Although there are many people selling tickets at the station, machines can also buy.
He sells tickets at the cinema.

感叹.en: He sighed that time passes too fast.

感叹.zh: 看到老照片，她忍不住感叹岁月如梭。
感叹.en: Seeing old photos, she couldn't help sighing that time flies.

感叹.zh: 大家都感叹他的变化真大。
感叹.en: Everyone exclaims how much he has changed.

感叹.zh: 虽然成功来得晚，但他感叹努力没有白费。
感叹.en: Although success came late, he sighed that the effort was not wasted.

感叹.zh: 听完这个故事，我深受感叹。
感叹.en: After listening to this story, I was deeply moved.

碑.zh: 这块碑有一千年历史了。
碑.en: This stele has a thousand-year history.

碑.zh: 公园里立着一块纪念英雄的石碑。
碑.en: In the park stands a stone tablet commemorating heroes.

碑.zh: 墓碑上刻着他的名字和出生日期。
碑.en: On the tombstone are engraved his name and birth date.

碑.zh: 为了纪念那场战争，人们建了一座碑。
碑.en: To commemorate that war, people built a monument.
The inscription on the stele is already blurry.

传记.en: This biography is very well written.

传记.zh: 我喜欢读名人的传记，了解他们的人生。
传记.en: I like reading biographies of famous people to understand their lives.

传记.zh: 他的传记里记录了许多不为人知的故事。
传记.en: His biography records many unknown stories.

传记.zh: 虽然传记是真实的，但作者添加了一些想象。
传记.en: Although biographies are factual, the author added some imagination.

传记.zh: 最近出版了一本关于科学家的传记。
传记.en: Recently a biography about a scientist was published.

爽快.zh: 她爽快地答应了我的请求。
爽快.en: She readily agreed to my request.

爽快.zh: 吃完饭喝杯冰水真爽快。
爽快.en: After a meal, drinking a glass of ice water is really refreshing.

爽快.zh: 既然你问了，我就爽快地告诉你吧。
爽快.en: Since you asked, I'll tell you straightforwardly.

爽快.zh: 他做事从不拖泥带水，非常爽快。
爽快.en: He never drags things out, very straightforward.

下棋.zh: 他每天晚饭后都和爷爷下棋。
下棋.en: He plays chess with his grandpa every day after dinner.

下棋.zh: 下棋需要动脑筋和耐心。
下棋.en: Playing chess requires thinking and patience.

下棋.zh: 虽然输了，但他觉得下棋很有意思。
下棋.en: Although he lost, he found playing chess very interesting.

下棋.zh: 公园里有两个老人在下棋。
下棋.en: In the park, two old men are playing chess.

捧场.en: Thank you all for coming to support.

捧场.zh: 他的新店开业，很多朋友都去捧场。
捧场.en: When his new store opened, many friends went to show support.

捧场.zh: 今晚的演出，希望你能来捧场。
捧场.en: Tonight's performance, hope you can come to support.

捧场.zh: 虽然我不懂戏，但为了朋友我还是去捧场了。
捧场.en: Although I don't understand opera, I still went to support for my friend.

捧场.zh: 老板让我在会议上多给他捧场。
捧场.en: The boss told me to support him more during the meeting.

言辞.zh: 在这场辩论中，他的言辞非常有力。
言辞.en: In this debate, his words were very powerful.

言辞.zh: 她说话言辞得体，大家都喜欢。
言辞.en: She speaks appropriately, everyone likes her.

言辞.zh: 尽管他言辞激烈，但出发点是好的。
言辞.en: Although his words were fierce, his intentions were good.

言辞.zh: 我不想用太激烈的言辞评论这件事。
言辞.en: I don't want to use too strong words to comment on this matter.

倔强.zh: 这孩子倔强得很，谁说都不听。
倔强.en: This child is very stubborn, won't listen to anyone.

倔强.zh: 再倔强的人也有服软的时候。
倔强.en: Even the most stubborn person has moments of giving in.

倔强.zh: 虽然他知道自己错了，但还是很倔强不道歉。
倔强.en: Although he knows he's wrong, he is still stubborn and won't apologize.

倔强.zh: 她倔强地抬起头，不肯流泪。
倔强.en: She stubbornly raised her head, refusing to shed tears.

血脉.zh: 我们血脉相连，永远是一家人。
血脉.en: We are connected by blood, always a family.

血脉.zh: 他身体里流淌着运动健将的血脉。
血脉.en: He has the blood of an athlete flowing in his veins.

血脉.zh: 虽然他们不住在一起，但血脉亲情谁也割不断。
血脉.en: Although they don't live together, blood ties can never be cut.

血脉.zh: 这部戏讲的是家族血脉传承的故事。
血脉.en: This play is about the story of family lineage and inheritance.

血脉.zh: 我们虽然分开了，可血脉里那种默契还是存在。
血脉.en: Even though we are apart, the tacit understanding in our blood still exists.

煤炭.zh: 这里以前是个煤炭大矿。
煤炭.en: This used to be a big coal mine.

煤炭.zh: 去年煤炭价格涨得很厉害。
煤炭.en: Coal prices rose sharply last year.

煤炭.zh: 很多工厂还在用煤炭发电。
煤炭.en: Many factories still use coal to generate electricity.

煤炭.zh: 煤炭资源越来越少，我们要想办法节约。
煤炭.en: Coal resources are getting scarcer, so we need to find ways to conserve.

煤炭.zh: 他爸爸以前是挖煤炭的工人，特别辛苦。
煤炭.en: His father used to be a coal miner, and it was really hard work.

名著.zh: 《红楼梦》是中国四大名著之一。
名著.en: "Dream of the Red Chamber" is one of China's four great classical novels.

名著.zh: 这本名著我读了三遍还没腻。
名著.en: I've read this classic three times and still haven't gotten tired of it.

名著.zh: 老师让我们暑假读两本外国名著。
名著.en: The teacher asked us to read two foreign classics during summer vacation.

名著.zh: 虽然名著很难懂，但看完了很有收获。
名著.en: Although classics are hard to understand, you gain a lot after finishing them.

名著.zh: 他从小就对世界名著特别感兴趣。
名著.en: He has been very interested in world classics since he was a child.

枪毙.zh: 那个罪犯最后被枪毙了。
枪毙.en: That criminal was finally executed by firing squad.

枪毙.zh: 电影里枪毙的镜头拍得很真实。
枪毙.en: The execution scene in the movie was filmed very realistically.

枪毙.zh: 这个方案太不靠谱，直接被老板枪毙了。
枪毙.en: This plan was too unreliable and was directly shot down by the boss.

枪毙.zh: 在古代，犯了重罪的人会被公开枪毙。
枪毙.en: In ancient times, people who committed serious crimes would be publicly executed by firing squad.

枪毙.zh: 他提出的建议被领导当场枪毙，一句话都没说。
枪毙.en: His suggestion was immediately rejected by the leader without a single word.

瞧不起.zh: 别瞧不起人，他很有本事的。
瞧不起.en: Don't look down on people; he's very capable.

瞧不起.zh: 她总觉得别人瞧不起她。
瞧不起.en: She always feels that others look down on her.

瞧不起.zh: 他因为学历低，经常被同事瞧不起。
瞧不起.en: Because of his low education, he is often looked down upon by colleagues.

瞧不起.zh: 虽然我工资不高，但你也别瞧不起我的工作。
瞧不起.en: Even though my salary isn't high, don't look down on my job.

瞧不起.zh: 那些瞧不起农民的人，根本不懂粮食有多珍贵。
瞧不起.en: Those who look down on farmers have no idea how precious food is.

大体.zh: 这个方案大体上没问题。

大体.en: I generally agree with what you said.

大体.zh: 他们两个人的意见大体一致。
大体.en: The opinions of the two of them are largely the same.

大体.zh: 虽然细节还要改，但大体方向是对的。
大体.en: Although details need to be revised, the general direction is correct.

大体.zh: 这篇文章的内容大体上还算完整，只缺个结尾。
大体.en: The content of this article is mostly complete, just missing an ending.

大惊小怪.zh: 一点小事，别大惊小怪的。
大惊小怪.en: It's just a small thing, don't make a fuss.

大惊小怪.zh: 他看到蟑螂就大惊小怪地叫起来。
大惊小怪.en: He saw a cockroach and started making a big fuss and screaming.

大惊小怪.zh: 孩子受点伤很正常，你用不着大惊小怪。
大惊小怪.en: It's normal for kids to get a little hurt; you don't need to make a big deal out of it.

大惊小怪.zh: 不过是手机没电了，你何必这么大惊小怪？
大惊小怪.en: It's just that the phone battery died; why are you making such a fuss?

大惊小怪.zh: 别大惊小怪的，这只是个小测试，不是真的考试。
大惊小怪.en: Don't make a fuss; this is just a small quiz, not a real exam.

渔民.zh: 台风来了，渔民们都把船收好了。
渔民.en: When the typhoon came, the fishermen all put away their boats.

渔民.zh: 渔民的生活很辛苦，经常要早起出海。
渔民.en: The life of fishermen is very hard; they often have to go out to sea early.

渔民.zh: 为了保护海洋资源，政府帮助渔民转行了。
渔民.en: To protect marine resources, the government helped fishermen change careers.

渔民.zh: 这个村庄的渔民世代靠打鱼为生。
渔民.en: The fishermen in this village have lived by fishing for generations.

财力.en: Our company has limited financial resources.

财力.zh: 他家里财力雄厚，根本不愁钱。
财力.en: His family is financially strong; they never worry about money.

财力.zh: 这个项目需要很大的财力支持。
财力.en: This project requires a lot of financial support.

财力.zh: 虽然他有财力，但不愿意投资这种小生意。
财力.en: Although he has the financial means, he is unwilling to invest in such a small business.

财力.zh: 政府财力不足，只能优先修路而不是建公园。
财力.en: The government's financial resources are insufficient, so it can only prioritize building roads over parks.

核能.en: Nuclear energy is a clean energy source.

核能.zh: 很多国家在大力发展核能发电。
核能.en: Many countries are vigorously developing nuclear power generation.

核能.zh: 核能虽然效率高，但安全风险也很大。
核能.en: Although nuclear energy is highly efficient, the safety risks are also great.

核能.zh: 他们正在研究用核能来制造火箭燃料。
核能.en: They are researching how to use nuclear energy to make rocket fuel.

核能.zh: 核能利用得好，可以解决很多能源问题。
核能.en: If nuclear energy is used well, it can solve many energy problems.

史无前例.zh: 这次疫情是史无前例的。
他创造了史无前例的世界纪录。
史无前例.en: He set an unprecedented world record.

史无前例.zh: 公司遇到了史无前例的危机，我们得想别的办法。
史无前例.en: The company is facing an unprecedented crisis, so we have to think of other ways.

史无前例.zh: 这场洪水史无前例，很多人失去了家园。
史无前例.en: This flood is unprecedented, and many people lost their homes.

史无前例.zh: 虽然我们遇到了史无前例的困难，但是大家都没有放弃。
史无前例.en: Although we encountered unprecedented difficulties, none of us gave up.

迁徙.zh: 这几年很多人从农村迁徙到城市。
迁徙.en: In recent years, many people have migrated from rural areas to cities.

迁徙.zh: 因为气候变暖，一些动物的迁徙路线发生了变化。
迁徙.en: Because of global warming, the migration routes of some animals have changed.

迁徙.zh: 古代的游牧民族经常迁徙，寻找更好的牧场。
迁徙.en: Ancient nomads often migrated to find better pastures.

迁徙.zh: 如果我们不保护环境，将来会有更多的物种被迫迁徙。
迁徙.en: If we don't protect the environment, more species will be forced to migrate in the future.

高峰期.en: The subway is especially crowded during peak hours.

高峰期.zh: 为了避免高峰期，我一般提前半小时出门。
高峰期.en: To avoid peak hours, I usually leave half an hour earlier.

高峰期.zh: 每年春节前后都是客运高峰期，票很难买。
高峰期.en: Around the Spring Festival is the peak period for passenger transport, and tickets are hard to buy.

高峰期.zh: 虽然现在是高峰期，但是路上比想象中顺畅一些。
高峰期.en: Even though it's peak time, the traffic is smoother than expected.

扎实.en: You need to lay a solid foundation.

扎实.zh: 那个老师讲课很扎实，每个细节都讲得很清楚。
扎实.en: That teacher's lectures are thorough, explaining every detail clearly.

扎实.zh: 因为平时训练扎实，他考试时一点也不紧张。
扎实.en: Because he trained solidly, he wasn't nervous at all during the exam.

扎实.zh: 虽然这个方案看起来不错，但数据还不够扎实，需要再核实一下。
扎实.en: Although this plan looks good, the data isn't solid enough, so we need to verify it again.

壁画.en: The Dunhuang murals are very famous.

壁画.zh: 这幅壁画已经保存了一千年。
壁画.en: This mural has been preserved for a thousand years.

壁画.zh: 考古学家在洞里发现了一组精美的壁画。
壁画.en: Archaeologists discovered a set of exquisite murals in the cave.

壁画.zh: 因为年代久远，很多壁画的颜色已经脱落了。
壁画.en: Due to age, the colors of many murals have faded.

壁画.zh: 如果你去参观莫高窟，一定要看看里面的壁画。
壁画.en: If you visit the Mogao Caves, you must see the murals inside.

眼界.zh: 他眼界很高，一般的东西看不上。
眼界.en: He has high standards and doesn't care for ordinary things.

眼界.zh: 多读书可以让你眼界更宽，想法也更全面。
眼界.en: Reading more can broaden your horizons and make your thinking more comprehensive.

眼界.zh: 这个展览让我大开眼界，原来艺术可以这么有趣。
眼界.en: This exhibition opened my eyes—turns out art can be so interesting.

眼界.zh: 虽然他在小城市长大，但是眼界一点都不窄。
眼界.en: Although he grew up in a small city, his horizons are not narrow at all.

缴费.en: Please pay the fee before the end of the month.

缴费.zh: 现在缴费可以用手机支付。
缴费.en: Now you can pay fees using mobile payment.

缴费.zh: 如果你忘了缴费，可能会被停机。
缴费.en: If you forget to pay, your service might be suspended.

缴费.zh: 去银行缴费比较麻烦，我一般都在网上交。
缴费.en: Going to the bank to pay is troublesome, so I usually do it online.

肖像.zh: 这幅肖像是他年轻时候画的。
肖像.en: This portrait was painted when he was young.

肖像.zh: 没有经过允许，不能随便用别人的肖像。
肖像.en: You cannot use someone else's portrait without permission.

肖像.zh: 画家花了一整年才完成这幅肖像。
肖像.en: The painter spent a whole year completing this portrait.

肖像.zh: 虽然这张肖像很逼真，但是感觉少了一点神韵。
肖像.en: Although this portrait is very lifelike, it feels a bit lacking in spirit.

肖像.zh: 她在画廊里看到自己的肖像时，激动得说不出话来。
肖像.en: When she saw her own portrait in the gallery, she was too excited to speak.

不景气.en: The economy has been sluggish recently.

不景气.zh: 因为行业不景气，很多公司都倒闭了。
不景气.en: Because the industry is in a slump, many companies have closed.

不景气.zh: 虽然市场不景气，但他们还是坚持创新。
不景气.en: Although the market is depressed, they still persist in innovation.

不景气.zh: 在生意不景气的时候，最重要的是控制成本。
不景气.en: When business is bad, the most important thing is to control costs.

不景气.zh: 如果经济一直不景气，我们可能要重新考虑投资计划。
不景气.en: If the economy remains sluggish, we may have to reconsider our investment plans.

得失.en: You should take personal gains and losses lightly.

得失.zh: 这次比赛得失都很正常。
得失.en: In this competition, both winning and losing are normal.

得失.zh: 他太在意一时的得失，反而错过了更大的机会。
得失.en: He cares too much about immediate gains and losses, and instead misses bigger opportunities.

得失.zh: 不管结果如何，重要的是从得失中吸取经验。
得失.en: No matter the outcome, the important thing is to learn from the gains and losses.

得失.zh: 如果只计较眼前的得失，很难把事业做大。
得失.en: If you only care about immediate gains and losses, it's hard to grow a business.

过问.zh: 他从来不过问家里的事。
过问.en: He never concerns himself with family matters.

过问.zh: 如果老师过问，你就说是我让你做的。
过问.en: If the teacher asks about it, just say I told you to do it.

过问.zh: 既然你已经辞职了，公司的事就别再过问了。
过问.en: Since you've resigned, don't interfere in company matters anymore.

过问.zh: 邻居吵架，我们最好不要过问太多。
过问.en: When neighbors quarrel, we'd better not get too involved.

小贩.en: The street vendor is selling fruit.

小贩.zh: 那个小贩的煎饼特别好吃。
小贩.en: That vendor's pancakes are especially delicious.

小贩.zh: 小贩们一大早就出来摆摊了。
小贩.en: The vendors set up their stalls early in the morning.

小贩.zh: 城管来了，小贩们赶紧收摊跑了。
小贩.en: When the city inspectors came, the vendors quickly packed up and ran.

小贩.zh: 虽然是个小贩，但他靠自己的劳动养活了全家。
小贩.en: Even though he's a street vendor, he supports his whole family with his own labor.

超前.en: This idea is too ahead of its time.
His design style is very forward-looking.

超前.zh: 你这种消费观念太超前了，小心还不上钱。
超前.en: Your concept of spending is way too advanced; be careful you can't pay it back.

超前.zh: 那个年代他的理论显得非常超前。
超前.en: In that era, his theories seemed extremely avant-garde.

超前.zh: 虽然技术上很超前，但市场还没准备好接受它。
超前.en: Although it's technologically ahead of its time, the market isn't ready to accept it yet.

解体.zh: 苏联解体后各国独立了。
解体.en: After the Soviet Union dissolved, each country became independent.

解体.zh: 这个联盟很快就会解体。
解体.en: This alliance will soon break apart.

解体.zh: 公司内部矛盾太大，最后只能解体。
解体.en: The internal conflicts in the company were too great, and in the end it had to dissolve.

解体.zh: 那台旧机器已经解体了，没法修。
解体.en: That old machine has fallen apart and can't be repaired.

解体.zh: 由于经营不善，这个帝国最终解体了。
解体.en: Due to mismanagement, this empire eventually disintegrated.

窃取.en: He tried to steal company secrets.

窃取.zh: 黑客通过漏洞窃取了大量用户数据。
窃取.en: Hackers exploited vulnerabilities to steal a large amount of user data.

窃取.zh: 这种行为属于窃取他人劳动成果。
窃取.en: This kind of behavior amounts to stealing others' labor achievements.

窃取.zh: 为了保护隐私，要防止个人信息被窃取。
窃取.en: To protect privacy, you must prevent personal information from being stolen.

祭祀.zh: 清明节很多人去祭祀祖先。
祭祀.en: Many people go to worship their ancestors during Qingming Festival.

祭祀.zh: 祭祀活动在早上六点开始。
祭祀.en: The sacrificial ceremony starts at six in the morning.

祭祀.zh: 他们用鲜花和水果来祭祀神灵。
祭祀.en: They use flowers and fruits to offer sacrifices to the gods.

祭祀.zh: 每年这个时候，村里都会举行大型祭祀仪式。
祭祀.en: Every year at this time, the village holds a large sacrificial ritual.

祭祀.zh: 祭祀不仅是一种传统，更是一种对先人的怀念。
祭祀.en: Sacrificial rites are not only a tradition but also a way to remember one's ancestors.

现成.en: The food is ready, eat up.
Don't just expect things ready-made; do it yourself.

现成.zh: 超市里有现成的饺子皮卖。
现成.en: The supermarket sells ready-made dumpling wrappers.

现成.zh: 他懒得做饭，就买了现成的盒饭。
现成.en: He was too lazy to cook, so he bought a ready-made boxed meal.

现成.zh: 这份报告有现成的模板，你直接套用就行。
现成.en: This report has a ready-made template; you can just use it directly.

天平.en: Both sides of the scale need to be balanced.

天平.zh: 他用手里的天平称药材。
天平.en: He used the scale in his hand to weigh the herbs.

天平.zh: 法律是维护社会正义的天平。
天平.en: The law is the balance that maintains social justice.

天平.zh: 在心里放上一架天平，好好衡量一下得失。
天平.en: Put a scale in your heart and carefully weigh the gains and losses.

天平.zh: 那架老天平虽然旧了，但称东西还是很准。
天平.en: That old scale, though worn, still weighs things very accurately.

下山.en: They only came down the mountain at noon.
The path down the mountain is harder to walk than the way up.

下山.zh: 太阳快下山了，我们得赶紧。
下山.en: The sun is about to set; we need to hurry.

下山.zh: 老和尚每天早晚都要下山去挑水。
下山.en: The old monk goes down the mountain every morning and evening to fetch water.

下山.zh: 雪后下山要特别小心，路面很滑。
下山.en: Going down the mountain after snow requires extra caution; the road is very slippery.

问世.en: This new phone will be released next month.

问世.zh: 他的第一本书终于问世了。
问世.en: His first book has finally been published.

问世.zh: 这款疫苗问世后，挽救了无数生命。
问世.en: After this vaccine came out, it saved countless lives.

问世.zh: 新科技产品问世前都会经过严格测试。
问世.en: New technology products undergo rigorous testing before they are launched.

问世.zh: 那部电影问世已经二十年了，依然很受欢迎。
问世.en: That movie came out twenty years ago and is still very popular.

自信心.zh: 虽然失败了，但他的自信心没受影响。
自信心.en: Although he failed, his self-confidence was not affected.

自信心.zh: 她因为缺乏自信心而放弃了比赛。
自信心.en: She gave up the competition because she lacked self-confidence.

自信心.zh: 自信心是成功的重要因素。
自信心.en: Self-confidence is an important factor for success.

上流.en: He was born into upper-class society.

上流.zh: 这条河的上流水质很好。
上流.en: The water quality upstream of this river is very good.

上流.zh: 在上流圈子里，大家都很注重礼仪。
上流.en: In upper-class circles, everyone pays great attention to etiquette.

上流.zh: 虽然他很穷，但总想装出上流的样子。
上流.en: Although he is poor, he always tries to act like upper class.
She likes to live an upper-class life.

吃力.en: Climbing this mountain is very strenuous.
He finds learning Chinese very difficult.

吃力.zh: 这项任务对我来说太吃力了。
吃力.en: This task is too exhausting for me.

吃力.zh: 我跑完步觉得特别吃力。
吃力.en: After running, I feel extremely tired.

吃力.zh: 虽然吃力，但他还是坚持下来了。
吃力.en: Although it was tough, he still persevered.

赤字.en: The company has a deficit this month.
The government wants to reduce the fiscal deficit.

赤字.zh: 预算出现了很大的赤字。
赤字.en: There is a large deficit in the budget.

赤字.zh: 因为赤字太大，公司不得不裁员。
赤字.en: Because the deficit was too large, the company had to lay off staff.

赤字.zh: 我们得想办法弥补这个赤字。
赤字.en: We need to find a way to make up for this deficit.

公证.en: This document needs to be notarized.
We go to the notary office to handle the formalities.

公证.zh: 遗嘱必须经过公证才有效。
公证.en: A will must be notarized to be valid.

公证.zh: 公证之后，合同就生效了。
公证.en: After notarization, the contract takes effect.

公证.zh: 他找了一位公证人来证明。
公证.en: He found a notary to certify it.

辫子.zh: 别总抓别人的辫子不放。
辫子.en: Don't always seize on others' faults.

辫子.zh: 虽然她不喜欢辫子，但妈妈非要她扎。
辫子.en: Although she doesn't like braids, her mother insists on having her tie one.
She coiled her braid on her head.

气色.en: He's been looking very pale lately.
Rest well, and your complexion will improve.
She has a rosy complexion and is very healthy.

气色.zh: 如果你气色不好，就应该多休息。
气色.en: If you look unwell, you should rest more.

口罩.en: Remember to wear a mask when going out.

口罩.zh: 我买了一些一次性口罩。

口罩.en: He took the subway wearing a mask.

口罩.zh: 因为疫情，口罩成了必需品。
口罩.en: Because of the pandemic, masks became essential.

抵消.zh: 如果这两项能抵消，那我们就不亏了。
抵消.en: If these two items can offset each other, then we won't lose.

抵消.zh: 他的功劳抵消不了他的错误。
抵消.en: His merits cannot offset his mistakes.

抵消.zh: 我们要想办法抵消成本。
抵消.en: We need to find a way to offset the costs.

别致.en: This piece of clothing is very unique.
Her design style is very distinctive.

别致.zh: 这个咖啡馆装修得很别致。
别致.en: This cafe is decorated very uniquely.

别致.zh: 我收到了一份别致的礼物。
这家店虽然小，但东西很别致。
别致.en: Although this shop is small, the things in it are very distinctive.

演艺圈.en: The entertainment industry is very competitive.

演艺圈.zh: 他最近在演艺圈发展得不错。
演艺圈.en: He has been doing well in the entertainment industry lately.

演艺圈.zh: 很多年轻人梦想进入演艺圈，但是这条路并不容易。
演艺圈.en: Many young people dream of entering the entertainment industry, but this path is not easy.

演艺圈.zh: 她在演艺圈摸爬滚打了十年，终于有了名气。
演艺圈.en: She struggled in the entertainment industry for ten years and finally became famous.

演艺圈.zh: 演艺圈的八卦新闻总是吸引眼球。
演艺圈.en: Gossip news from the entertainment industry always catches people's attention.

赞叹.zh: 看到这幅画，他忍不住发出赞叹。
赞叹.en: Seeing this painting, he couldn't help but express admiration.

赞叹.zh: 观众对魔术师的表演赞叹不已。
赞叹.en: The audience was full of praise for the magician's performance.

赞叹.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但他的努力让我们赞叹。
赞叹.en: Although he lost the game, his effort made us admire him.

赞叹.zh: 这座建筑的宏伟设计令人赞叹。
赞叹.en: The magnificent design of this building is awe-inspiring.

里程碑.zh: 这次成功是他事业上的一个里程碑。
里程碑.en: This success is a milestone in his career.

里程碑.zh: 2020年对全世界来说是一个重要的里程碑。
里程碑.en: The year 2020 was an important milestone for the whole world.

里程碑.zh: 公司上市是一个里程碑式的事件。
里程碑.en: The company going public is a milestone event.

里程碑.zh: 从小学毕业到大学毕业，每个阶段都是成长的里程碑。
里程碑.en: From graduating elementary school to graduating college, each stage is a milestone of growth.

健壮.en: He is very strong and healthy.

健壮.zh: 坚持锻炼能让人保持健壮。
健壮.en: Persistent exercise can keep people strong and healthy.

健壮.zh: 虽然年纪大了，他看起来还是很健壮。
健壮.en: Although he is old, he still looks very sturdy.

健壮.zh: 那匹马肌肉健壮，跑得飞快。
健壮.en: That horse has strong muscles and runs very fast.

留神.en: You must be careful when crossing the street.

留神.zh: 这个地方路滑，你多留神。
留神.en: The road here is slippery, so be extra careful.

留神.zh: 他让我留神别被骗子骗了。
留神.en: He told me to watch out and not get cheated by scammers.

留神.zh: 留神听，老师说的重点很重要。
留神.en: Listen carefully, the key points the teacher said are very important.

甜头.en: He has tasted the benefits of making money.

甜头.zh: 第一次成功让他尝到了甜头。
甜头.en: His first success gave him a taste of the sweet rewards.

甜头.zh: 别被眼前的甜头迷惑了双眼。
甜头.en: Don't be fooled by the immediate gains.

甜头.zh: 她给了孩子一点甜头，孩子就乖乖听话了。
甜头.en: She gave the child a little treat, and the child obediently listened.

甜头.zh: 创业刚开始虽然辛苦，但后来甜头越来越多。
甜头.en: Starting a business was hard at first, but later the benefits kept increasing.

搭建.zh: 他们在院子里搭建了一个帐篷。
搭建.en: They set up a tent in the yard.
The workers are building the stage.

搭建.zh: 我们需要搭建一个临时仓库。
搭建.en: We need to set up a temporary warehouse.

搭建.zh: 这个平台为创业者搭建了交流的桥梁。
搭建.en: This platform has built a bridge for communication among entrepreneurs.

搭建.zh: 他们花了一下午时间搭建儿童游乐设施。
搭建.en: They spent an afternoon setting up children's play equipment.

质地.en: The texture of this clothing is very good.

质地.zh: 这种布料质地柔软舒适。
质地.en: This fabric is soft and comfortable in texture.

质地.zh: 我喜欢实木家具的质地。
质地.en: I like the texture of solid wood furniture.

质地.zh: 这块石头的质地很粗糙。
质地.en: The texture of this stone is very rough.

质地.zh: 她摸了摸丝绸，赞叹它的细致质地。
质地.en: She touched the silk and praised its fine texture.

成型.en: The dough has already been shaped.

成型.zh: 这个计划还在成型阶段。
成型.en: This plan is still in the shaping stage.

成型.zh: 雕塑师用粘土把人物形象成型。
成型.en: The sculptor shaped the figure out of clay.

成型.zh: 经过讨论，方案逐渐成型。
成型.en: After discussion, the plan gradually took shape.

成型.zh: 公司的管理制度已经基本成型。
成型.en: The company's management system has basically taken shape.

椰子.zh: 他打开椰子，吃里面的果肉。
椰子.en: He opened the coconut and ate the flesh inside.
Hainan's coconuts are big and sweet.

椰子.zh: 去热带旅游一定要尝尝当地的椰子饭。
椰子.en: When traveling to the tropics, you must try the local coconut rice.

公用.zh: 公用电话现在很少见了。
公用.en: Public telephones are rarely seen now.

公用.zh: 我们小区有个公用健身房，随便用。
公用.en: Our community has a public gym, you can use it freely.

公用.zh: 虽然这是公用的东西，但也要爱惜。
公用.en: Even though this is a public item, we still need to take care of it.

公用.zh: 公用自行车停在门口，谁都可以骑。
公用.en: The public bicycles are parked at the door, anyone can ride them.

舞厅.zh: 周末我们去舞厅跳舞吧。
舞厅.en: Let's go dancing at the dance hall this weekend.

舞厅.zh: 那个舞厅的音乐太吵了。
舞厅.en: The music at that dance hall is too loud.
He used to be a DJ at a dance hall.

舞厅.zh: 舞厅里人很多，我们找了个角落坐下。
舞厅.en: There were many people in the dance hall, so we found a corner to sit.

舞厅.zh: 虽然舞厅不大，但气氛特别好。
舞厅.en: Although the dance hall is not big, the atmosphere is really good.

歼灭.en: The enemy troops were completely annihilated.

歼灭.zh: 这次行动成功歼灭了一个犯罪团伙。
歼灭.en: This operation successfully wiped out a criminal gang.

歼灭.zh: 他们用了三天时间歼灭了大批害虫。
歼灭.en: They spent three days exterminating a large number of pests.

歼灭.zh: 如果计划顺利，我们就能歼灭所有威胁。
歼灭.en: If the plan goes smoothly, we can eliminate all threats.

歼灭.zh: 战场上，他们奋勇作战，最终歼灭了敌人。
歼灭.en: On the battlefield, they fought bravely and finally annihilated the enemy.

调试.en: He is debugging the newly bought sound system.

调试.zh: 程序员连续加班调试程序。
调试.en: The programmer worked overtime continuously to debug the program.

调试.zh: 机器出厂前都要经过仔细调试。
调试.en: The machines must be carefully debugged before leaving the factory.

调试.zh: 因为没调试好，系统一直出问题。
调试.en: Because it wasn't debugged properly, the system kept having problems.

悔恨.zh: 他悔恨自己说了那句话。
她悔恨当初没有好好学习。
悔恨.en: She regretted not studying hard back then.

悔恨.zh: 我现在悔恨也来不及了。
悔恨.en: It's too late for me to regret now.

悔恨.zh: 他悔恨交加，可是已经无法挽回。
悔恨.en: He was filled with regret and remorse, but it was already irreversible.

悔恨.zh: 每次想起这件事，她都感到深深的悔恨。
悔恨.en: Every time she thinks about this matter, she feels deep regret.

介于.zh: 这颜色介于蓝和绿之间。
介于.en: This color is between blue and green.

介于.zh: 他的成绩介于及格和优秀之间。
介于.en: His grades are between passing and excellent.

介于.zh: 这家餐厅的价格介于中档和高档之间。
介于.en: The prices at this restaurant are between mid-range and high-end.

介于.zh: 她的态度介于同意和拒绝之间，很难判断。
介于.en: Her attitude is between agreement and refusal, hard to tell.

介于.zh: 这个方案介于可行和不可行之间，需要再评估。
介于.en: This plan is between feasible and infeasible, needs further evaluation.

机灵.zh: 他机灵地躲开了那辆车。
小猴子特别机灵，一下就把香蕉抢走了。
机灵.en: The little monkey was very quick-witted and snatched the banana away instantly.

机灵.zh: 虽然她年纪小，但做事很机灵。
机灵.en: Although she is young, she is very astute in doing things.

机灵.zh: 他眼珠一转，机灵地想到了一个好主意。
机灵.en: He rolled his eyes and cleverly came up with a good idea.

品德.zh: 老师很重视学生的品德教育。
品德.en: Teachers attach great importance to students' moral education.

品德.zh: 一个人的品德比成绩更重要。
品德.en: A person's moral character is more important than grades.

品德.zh: 他不仅学习好，品德也很高尚。
品德.en: He not only studies well but also has noble moral character.

品德.zh: 我们选班长的时候，首先看的是品德。
品德.en: When we choose the class monitor, we first look at moral character.

刊物.zh: 这本刊物每月出版一次。
刊物.en: This publication comes out once a month.

刊物.zh: 他订了好几本学术刊物。
刊物.en: He subscribed to several academic journals.

刊物.zh: 图书馆里有各种各样的刊物。
刊物.en: There are all kinds of publications in the library.

刊物.zh: 这本新刊物很受欢迎，很快就卖光了。
刊物.en: This new publication is very popular and sold out quickly.

刊物.zh: 虽然纸质刊物越来越少，但有人还是喜欢看。
刊物.en: Although print publications are becoming fewer, some people still like to read them.

端正.en: You should sit with a proper posture.

端正.zh: 她态度端正，所以进步很快。
端正.en: She has a correct attitude, so she improves quickly.

端正.zh: 我们要端正学习态度，不能马虎。
端正.en: We need to correct our learning attitude and not be careless.

端正.zh: 虽然他犯了错，但认错态度很端正。
端正.en: Although he made a mistake, his attitude in admitting it was very proper.

互补.zh: 这两个方案可以互补，效果很好。
互补.en: These two plans can complement each other, the effect is good.

互补.zh: 我们俩的技能正好互补，一起合作很顺利。
互补.en: Our skills are exactly complementary, working together is very smooth.

互补.zh: 虽然他俩性格不同，但刚好互补。
互补.en: Although their personalities differ, they just complement each other.

互补.zh: 颜色搭配要互补才好看。
互补.en: Color matching needs to be complementary to look good.

领略.en: I appreciated the beauty of nature.

领略.zh: 这次旅行让我领略了当地的文化。
领略.en: This trip let me experience the local culture.

领略.zh: 在山上我们领略了壮观的日出。
领略.en: On the mountain we experienced the spectacular sunrise.

领略.zh: 只有亲自去才能领略它的魅力。
领略.en: Only by going in person can you appreciate its charm.

领略.zh: 听了他的故事，我领略到人生的不易。
领略.en: After hearing his story, I realized the difficulty of life.

回扣.zh: 公司规定不能收任何回扣。
回扣.en: Company rules forbid accepting any kickbacks.

回扣.zh: 这个交易里可能有回扣问题。
回扣.en: There may be a kickback issue in this deal.

回扣.zh: 供应商给了采购员一笔回扣。
回扣.en: The supplier gave the buyer a kickback.

回扣.zh: 因为回扣丑闻，他被开除了。
回扣.en: Due to the kickback scandal, he was fired.

次要.zh: 先把主要的事情做完，次要的再说。
次要.en: Finish the main things first, the secondary can wait.

次要.zh: 这次考试分数是次要的，学到知识才重要。
次要.en: The exam score is secondary, learning knowledge is important.

次要.zh: 在团队里，个人利益是次要的。
次要.en: In a team, personal interests are secondary.

次要.zh: 虽然钱很重要，但健康更重要，钱是次要的。
次要.en: Although money is important, health is more important, money is secondary.

冷落.zh: 大家都去聊天，把我冷落在一边。
冷落.en: Everyone went to chat, leaving me neglected aside.

冷落.zh: 不要因为工作而冷落家人。
冷落.en: Don't neglect family because of work.

冷落.zh: 他主动道歉，说上次冷落了我。
冷落.en: He proactively apologized, saying he neglected me last time.

冷落.zh: 如果总是冷落朋友，他们会离开你的。
冷落.en: If you always neglect friends, they will leave you.

安详.zh: 老人走得很安详，没有痛苦。
安详.en: The old man passed away peacefully, without pain.

安详.zh: 他脸上露出安详的笑容。
安详.en: A serene smile appeared on his face.

安详.zh: 在阳光里，小猫安详地躺着。
安详.en: In the sunlight, the kitten lies peacefully.

安详.zh: 虽然病了很久，但最后时刻很安详。
安详.en: Although ill for long, the final moment was peaceful.

执意.zh: 妈妈执意要给我做饭，我怎么劝都没用。
执意.en: Mom insisted on cooking for me, no matter how I persuaded.

执意.zh: 虽然大家反对，他执意这么做。
执意.en: Although everyone opposed, he insisted on doing this.

执意.zh: 她执意要自己开车，不让我送。
执意.en: She insisted on driving herself, not letting me drive her.

执意.zh: 你如果执意要去，我也不拦你。
执意.en: If you insist on going, I won't stop you.

官兵.en: The officers and soldiers are all very hardworking.

官兵.zh: 这支军队的官兵关系很融洽。
官兵.en: The relationship between officers and soldiers in this army is very harmonious.

官兵.zh: 灾区官兵正在全力救援。
官兵.en: Officers and soldiers in the disaster area are fully engaged in rescue.

官兵.zh: 阅兵式上，官兵们步伐整齐。
官兵.en: At the parade, the officers and soldiers marched in step.
When officers and soldiers are united, they can win battles.

赛跑.en: He always comes first in races.
The children are racing on the playground.

赛跑.zh: 赛跑的时候要注意呼吸节奏。
赛跑.en: When racing, pay attention to breathing rhythm.

赛跑.zh: 虽然我跑得慢，但我喜欢参加赛跑。
赛跑.en: Although I run slowly, I like to join races.

杠杆.zh: 利用金融杠杆可以放大收益。
杠杆.en: Using financial leverage can amplify returns.
In physics class, we learned the lever principle.

杠杆.zh: 这个工具就像一根杠杆。
杠杆.en: This tool is like a lever.

杠杆.zh: 如果使用杠杆，搬重物会轻松很多。
杠杆.en: If you use a lever, moving heavy objects will be much easier.

墓碑.en: The tombstone is engraved with his name.

墓碑.zh: 每次扫墓，我都会在墓碑前放一束花。
墓碑.en: Every time I visit the grave, I place a bouquet of flowers in front of the tombstone.

墓碑.zh: 那块墓碑已经很旧了，上面的字都看不清了。
墓碑.en: That tombstone is already very old, and the words on it are unreadable.

墓碑.zh: 电影里有一个墓碑的场景，特别恐怖。
墓碑.en: There is a scene with a tombstone in the movie, which is especially scary.

墓碑.zh: 虽然墓碑很朴素，但周围种满了鲜花。
墓碑.en: Although the tombstone is plain, the area around it is full of flowers.

鞭炮.en: Setting off firecrackers during the New Year is very lively.

鞭炮.zh: 小孩子最喜欢在除夕夜放鞭炮了。
鞭炮.en: Kids love setting off firecrackers on New Year's Eve.

鞭炮.zh: 因为噪音太大，城市里禁止放鞭炮。
鞭炮.en: Because the noise is too loud, firecrackers are banned in the city.

鞭炮.zh: 鞭炮的声音吓得小狗躲到床底下。
鞭炮.en: The sound of firecrackers scared the puppy into hiding under the bed.

鞭炮.zh: 我们买了鞭炮和烟花，准备庆祝新年。
鞭炮.en: We bought firecrackers and fireworks to celebrate the New Year.

涵盖.zh: 这本书涵盖了很多知识。
涵盖.en: This book covers a lot of knowledge.

涵盖.zh: 这次考试涵盖的内容非常广，需要好好复习。
涵盖.en: The content covered in this exam is very broad, so we need to review thoroughly.

涵盖.zh: 这个计划涵盖了所有部门的意见。
涵盖.en: This plan covers the opinions of all departments.

涵盖.zh: 他的演讲涵盖了从历史到科技的各个方面。
涵盖.en: His speech covered everything from history to technology.

涵盖.zh: 这份报告涵盖了我们讨论的所有问题。
涵盖.en: This report covers all the issues we discussed.

筐.zh: 她用筐装了很多水果去市场卖。
筐.en: She loaded a lot of fruit into a basket and went to sell it at the market.

筐.zh: 把脏衣服放进筐里，待会儿一起洗。
筐.en: Put the dirty clothes in the basket, and we'll wash them together later.

筐.zh: 爷爷用竹筐从地里把菜背回来。
筐.en: Grandpa carries the vegetables back from the fields using a bamboo basket.

筐.zh: 这个筐太小了，装不下这么多东西。
筐.en: This basket is too small to hold so many things.

专制.zh: 他非常专制，不听别人意见。
专制.en: He is very autocratic and doesn't listen to others' opinions.

专制.zh: 在那个专制的国家，人民没有言论自由。
专制.en: In that autocratic country, the people have no freedom of speech.

专制.zh: 专制统治下，老百姓的日子很难过。
专制.en: Under autocratic rule, the people's lives are very difficult.

专制.zh: 家长专制会让孩子失去自信心。
专制.en: Parental authoritarianism can cause children to lose self-confidence.

专制.zh: 历史上有许多专制的君主，最后都被推翻了。
专制.en: There have been many autocratic monarchs in history, and they were eventually overthrown.

放肆.en: You are being way too presumptuous!

放肆.zh: 在老师面前这么放肆，不太好吧。
放肆.en: Being so unruly in front of the teacher is probably not a good idea.

放肆.zh: 这孩子越来越放肆，得好好管管。
放肆.en: This child is getting more and more unruly; we need to discipline him properly.

放肆.zh: 他喝醉了，说话特别放肆。
放肆.en: He got drunk and spoke in a particularly presumptuous way.

放肆.zh: 虽然老板很生气，但他还是那么放肆。
放肆.en: Although the boss was very angry, he still acted so presumptuously.

私事.zh: 别打听别人的私事，这样很不礼貌。
私事.en: Don't pry into other people's private matters; it's very impolite.

私事.zh: 工作时间和私事要分清楚。
私事.en: You need to separate work hours from private matters.

私事.zh: 她从来不在公司谈自己的私事。
私事.en: She never talks about her private matters at the company.

私事.zh: 我们虽然是好朋友，但私事还是互相尊重比较好。
私事.en: Although we are good friends, it's better to respect each other's private matters.

元老.en: He is a senior member of the company.

元老.zh: 这位元老在公司干了几十年，很有威望。
元老.en: This senior member has worked at the company for decades and is very prestigious.

元老.zh: 元老们在会议上提出了很多建议。
元老.en: The senior members put forward many suggestions at the meeting.

元老.zh: 作为球队元老，他经常指导年轻队员。
元老.en: As a veteran of the team, he often coaches the younger players.

元老.zh: 虽然他已经退休了，但仍然是公司的元老。
元老.en: Although he has retired, he is still a senior figure in the company.

幸免.en: He luckily escaped the disaster this time.

幸免.zh: 在这次事故中，只有三个人幸免。
幸免.en: In this accident, only three people survived.

幸免.zh: 虽然灾难很大，但很多人幸免了。
幸免.en: Although the disaster was huge, many people managed to escape it.

幸免.zh: 那场火灾中，几乎没有人能幸免。
幸免.en: In that fire, almost no one could escape.

幸免.zh: 他开车时很小心，才幸免了一场车祸。
幸免.en: He drove very carefully and thus narrowly avoided a car accident.

紧凑.zh: 今天的会议安排得非常紧凑，一分钟都不浪费。
紧凑.en: Today's meeting is arranged very tightly, not wasting a single minute.

紧凑.zh: 这部电影情节紧凑，一点也不拖沓。
紧凑.en: The plot of this movie is compact, not dragging at all.

紧凑.zh: 这个房间虽然小，但布局很紧凑。
紧凑.en: Although this room is small, the layout is very compact.

紧凑.zh: 考试时间太紧凑了，我都来不及检查。
紧凑.en: The exam time was too tight, and I didn't have time to check.

低迷.en: The economy has been very sluggish recently.

低迷.zh: 因为市场低迷，公司决定裁员。
低迷.en: Because the market is sluggish, the company decided to lay off employees.

低迷.zh: 他的情绪一直很低迷，需要休息。
低迷.en: His mood has been very low; he needs rest.

低迷.zh: 虽然房价低迷，但买房的人还是不多。
低迷.en: Although housing prices are low, there still aren't many people buying houses.

低迷.zh: 低迷的天气让人不想出门。
低迷.en: The gloomy weather makes people not want to go out.

不定.zh: 他的想法总是不定，很难合作。
不定.en: His ideas are always uncertain, making it hard to cooperate.

不定.zh: 因为时间不定，我们没法提前计划。
不定.en: Because the time is uncertain, we can't plan ahead.
The price is not fixed; we need to wait for notice.

不定.zh: 她心情不定，别去打扰她。
不定.en: Her mood is unstable; don't disturb her.

公墓.zh: 清明节我们去公墓扫墓。
公墓.en: On Qingming Festival, we go to the cemetery to sweep tombs.

公墓.zh: 这个公墓环境很好，很多人选择这里。
公墓.en: This cemetery has a nice environment; many people choose it.

公墓.zh: 虽然公墓在郊区，但交通还算方便。
公墓.en: Although the cemetery is in the suburbs, transportation is still convenient.

公墓.zh: 公墓的管理费每年都要交。
公墓.en: The cemetery's management fee needs to be paid every year.

公墓.zh: 他父母合葬在城东的公墓。
公墓.en: His parents are buried together in the east city cemetery.

深思.zh: 他深思了很久才做出决定。
深思.en: He pondered for a long time before making a decision.

深思.zh: 经过深思，我决定换个工作。
深思.en: After deep thought, I decided to change jobs.

深思.zh: 别急着回答，先深思一下。
深思.en: Don't answer hastily; think it over first.
His words made me fall into deep thought.

发怒.en: When he gets angry, he is scary.

发怒.zh: 别因为小事发怒，对身体不好。
发怒.en: Don't get angry over small things; it's bad for your health.

发怒.zh: 她虽然发怒了，但还是保持理智。
发怒.en: Although she got angry, she still kept her rationality.

发怒.zh: 老板今天发怒了，大家小心点。
发怒.en: The boss got angry today; everyone be careful.

看得出.en: I can see that you are very tired.

看得出.zh: 从他的表情看得出他很不高兴。
看得出.en: From his expression, you can tell he is very unhappy.

看得出.zh: 虽然她没说话，但我看得出她在生气。
看得出.en: Although she didn't speak, I could tell she was angry.

看得出.zh: 这件衣服看得出是手工做的。
看得出.en: This piece of clothing can be seen to be handmade.

看得出.zh: 从成绩看得出他努力了。
看得出.en: From the grades, you can see that he worked hard.

稳重.en: He is a very steady person.

稳重.zh: 做领导一定要性格稳重才行。
稳重.en: To be a leader, one must have a steady personality.

稳重.zh: 虽然他年纪轻，但做事很稳重。
稳重.en: Although he is young, he acts very steadily.

稳重.zh: 找对象要找稳重踏实的。
稳重.en: When looking for a partner, look for someone steady and reliable.

殿堂.zh: 他们在大教堂的殿堂里举行婚礼。
殿堂.en: They held the wedding in the hall of the cathedral.

殿堂.zh: 这个博物馆的殿堂陈列着很多文物。
殿堂.en: The hall of this museum displays many artifacts.

殿堂.zh: 音乐厅的殿堂设计很特别。
殿堂.en: The hall of the concert hall is uniquely designed.

殿堂.zh: 他终于步入了艺术的殿堂。
殿堂.en: He finally stepped into the hall of art.

晚年.en: His later years are very happy.

晚年.zh: 她晚年喜欢在公园里散步聊天。
晚年.en: In her later years, she likes to walk and chat in the park.

晚年.zh: 虽然晚年身体不好，但他心态很好。
晚年.en: Although his health is poor in his later years, his mindset is good.

晚年.zh: 很多老人晚年都选择去养老院。
晚年.en: Many old people choose to go to nursing homes in their later years.

晚年.zh: 他晚年写了一本回忆录。
晚年.en: He wrote a memoir in his later years.

仇人.zh: 没想到他竟然和仇人成了朋友。
仇人.en: Unexpectedly, he became friends with his enemy.

仇人.zh: 因为以前有过矛盾，他们现在还是仇人。
仇人.en: Because of past conflicts, they are still enemies.
When enemies meet, their eyes blaze with hatred.

仇人.zh: 我不想把任何人当仇人。
仇人.en: I don't want to treat anyone as an enemy.

攻克.zh: 我们终于攻克了这个技术难题。
攻克.en: We finally overcame this technical problem.

攻克.zh: 经过三个月的努力，他们攻克了那座城堡。
攻克.en: After three months of effort, they conquered that castle.

攻克.zh: 只要团队齐心协力，再大的难关也能攻克。
攻克.en: As long as the team works together, even the biggest difficulties can be overcome.

攻克.zh: 他用了两年时间攻克了日语，现在说得非常流利。
攻克.en: He spent two years mastering Japanese, and now he speaks it very fluently.

攻克.zh: 虽然实验失败了很多次，但我们最终还是攻克了那个关键问题。
攻克.en: Although the experiment failed many times, we finally conquered that key problem.

沿岸.en: There are many fishing villages along the coast.

沿岸.zh: 台风过后，沿岸的房屋损坏严重。
沿岸.en: After the typhoon, houses along the coast were severely damaged.

沿岸.zh: 我们沿着河岸散步，看到沿岸开满了野花。
沿岸.en: We took a walk along the riverbank and saw wildflowers blooming all along the shore.

沿岸.zh: 因为环境污染，沿岸的旅游业受到了很大影响。
沿岸.en: Due to environmental pollution, tourism along the coast has been greatly affected.

沿岸.zh: 这条河沿岸的风景非常美，所以每年都有大量游客来拍照。
沿岸.en: The scenery along this river is very beautiful, so every year a large number of tourists come to take photos.

汇合.zh: 我们约好在广场汇合，然后一起出发。
汇合.en: We agreed to meet at the square and then set off together.

汇合.zh: 这三条主干道在市中心汇合，导致交通经常拥堵。
汇合.en: These three main roads converge in the city center, often causing traffic jams.

汇合.zh: 来自不同部门的意见最终汇合成了一份完整的方案。
汇合.en: Opinions from different departments finally merged into a complete plan.

汇合.zh: 他们在火车站汇合后，就坐上了开往北京的高铁。
汇合.en: After meeting at the train station, they boarded the high-speed train to Beijing.

物证.zh: 警方在现场找到了很多物证。
物证.en: The police found a lot of physical evidence at the scene.

物证.zh: 光靠人证不够，还需要物证才能定罪。
物证.en: Witness testimony alone is not enough; physical evidence is also needed to convict.

物证.zh: 他们把物证仔细地装进袋子里，准备送到实验室分析。
物证.en: They carefully put the physical evidence into bags, ready to be sent to the lab for analysis.

物证.zh: 虽然犯罪嫌疑人拒不承认，但物证清楚地证明了他就是凶手。
物证.en: Although the suspect refused to confess, the physical evidence clearly proved that he was the murderer.

坐落.en: This temple is located at the top of the mountain.

坐落.zh: 学校坐落在一个安静的小镇上。
坐落.en: The school is situated in a quiet small town.

坐落.zh: 那座古老的城堡坐落在一片茂密的森林之中。
坐落.en: That ancient castle lies in the middle of a dense forest.

坐落.zh: 我们的新公司办公楼坐落于市中心，交通非常便利。
坐落.en: Our new company office building is located in the city center, with very convenient transportation.

坐落.zh: 这座著名的图书馆坐落在一个公园旁边，环境优美，很受学生欢迎。
坐落.en: This famous library is situated next to a park, with a beautiful environment, and is very popular among students.

狭小.en: This room is too narrow and small.

狭小.zh: 他们的生活空间非常狭小。
狭小.en: Their living space is extremely cramped.

狭小.zh: 由于过道很狭小，两个人都没法并排走。
狭小.en: Because the hallway is very narrow, two people can't walk side by side.

狭小.zh: 他心里觉得机会很渺茫，但还是在狭小的缝隙中努力挣扎。
狭小.en: He felt the chances were slim, but he still struggled hard in the narrow gap.

狭小.zh: 在这座城市里，能提供给低收入家庭的住房面积往往非常狭小。
狭小.en: In this city, the housing area available to low-income families is often very cramped.

一刹那.zh: 烟花在夜空中绽放，一刹那照亮了整座城市。
一刹那.en: Fireworks bloomed in the night sky, illuminating the whole city for an instant.

一刹那.zh: 就在一刹那，我做出了一个决定，从此改变了人生。
一刹那.en: In that split second, I made a decision that changed my life from then on.

一刹那.zh: 那辆汽车冲过来的速度太快了，一刹那我就吓傻了。
一刹那.en: The car came speeding so fast that in an instant I was stunned with fear.

一刹那.zh: 他本来还在笑，但听到那个消息后，脸色一刹那变得煞白。
一刹那.en: He was still laughing, but after hearing that news, his face turned pale in an instant.

瘫.en: He was so tired that he collapsed onto the sofa.

瘫.zh: 听到这个消息，她整个人都瘫了。
瘫.en: Hearing the news, she was completely paralyzed.

瘫.zh: 跑完马拉松以后，我双腿发软，直接瘫在地上了。
瘫.en: After finishing the marathon, my legs went weak and I collapsed right onto the ground.

瘫.zh: 那位老人中风后半边身体瘫了，现在只能坐轮椅。
瘫.en: After the stroke, half of the old man's body was paralyzed, and now he can only use a wheelchair.

瘫.zh: 他本来站得好好的，突然感到一阵头晕，整个人瘫在了地上。
瘫.en: He was standing fine, but suddenly felt dizzy and collapsed onto the ground.

涌入.en: A large number of tourists poured into the scenic area.

涌入.zh: 洪水涌入村庄，人们急忙往高处跑。
涌入.en: Floodwater poured into the village, and people hurriedly ran to higher ground.

涌入.zh: 演唱会一开场，粉丝们就疯狂地涌入场地。
涌入.en: As soon as the concert started, fans crazily flooded into the venue.

涌入.zh: 因为公司宣布裁员，很多人同时涌入会议室询问情况。
涌入.en: Because the company announced layoffs, many people simultaneously flooded into the meeting room to ask about the situation.

涌入.zh: 新政策实施后，大量外资涌入国内市场，带动了经济快速发展。
涌入.en: After the new policy was implemented, a large amount of foreign capital flooded into the domestic market, driving rapid economic growth.

草率.zh: 他做事总是很草率，经常出错。
草率.en: He always does things carelessly and often makes mistakes.

草率.zh: 不要草率地下结论，应该先调查清楚再说。
草率.en: Don't jump to conclusions rashly; you should investigate thoroughly first.

草率.zh: 因为草率地签署了合同，公司后来损失了一大笔钱。
草率.en: Because they signed the contract hastily, the company later lost a large sum of money.

草率.zh: 你在做如此重要的决定之前，千万不能草率，要仔细考虑所有因素。
草率.en: Before making such an important decision, you absolutely cannot be hasty; you must carefully consider all factors.

隐约.en: I vaguely heard someone calling me.

隐约.zh: 远处的山在雾中隐约可见。
隐约.en: The distant mountains are faintly visible in the mist.

隐约.zh: 虽然天很暗，但我还是隐约看到了他的身影。
隐约.en: Although it was dark, I still vaguely saw his figure.

隐约.zh: 他隐约觉得这件事没那么简单。
隐约.en: He vaguely felt that this matter was not that simple.

隐约.zh: 窗外的歌声隐约传来，让人很放松。
隐约.en: The singing outside the window came faintly, making people relaxed.

霸占.zh: 那个游戏一直被高手霸占着。
霸占.en: That game has always been dominated by experts.

霸占.zh: 因为他一直霸占着电脑，所以弟弟很生气。
霸占.en: Because he kept hogging the computer, his brother was very angry.

霸占.zh: 那个球队霸占了冠军很多年。
霸占.en: That team has dominated the championship for many years.

霸占.zh: 别霸占着沙发，让妈妈也坐一下。
霸占.en: Don't hog the sofa, let mom sit too.

呼救.en: Someone is calling for help in the river.

呼救.zh: 听到有人呼救，他立刻跳下水。
呼救.en: Hearing someone calling for help, he immediately jumped into the water.

呼救.zh: 如果遇到危险，一定要大声呼救。
呼救.en: If you encounter danger, be sure to call for help loudly.

呼救.zh: 他大声呼救，但没人听见。
呼救.en: He shouted for help, but no one heard.

呼救.zh: 小孩子掉进水里，拼命呼救。
呼救.en: The child fell into the water and desperately called for help.

相提并论.zh: 这两件事不能相提并论。
相提并论.en: These two things cannot be mentioned in the same breath.

相提并论.zh: 他的水平和我完全不能相提并论。
相提并论.en: His level cannot be compared with mine at all.

相提并论.zh: 虽然他们都是歌手，但风格不同，不能相提并论。
相提并论.en: Although they are both singers, their styles are different, so they cannot be compared.

相提并论.zh: 别把我和他相提并论，我比他差远了。
相提并论.en: Don't compare me with him; I am far worse than him.

相提并论.zh: 这两个电影质量差太多，没法相提并论。
相提并论.en: The quality of these two movies differs too much; they cannot be compared.

笨拙.zh: 这只小熊走路的样子特别笨拙。
笨拙.en: This little bear looks especially clumsy when walking.

笨拙.zh: 虽然他说话很笨拙，但是心地很善良。
笨拙.en: Although he speaks awkwardly, he is very kind-hearted.

笨拙.zh: 我学跳舞的时候，手脚特别笨拙。
笨拙.en: When I learned to dance, my hands and feet were very clumsy.

笨拙.zh: 他笨拙地尝试着打开那个瓶子。
笨拙.en: He clumsily tried to open that bottle.

尤为.zh: 夏天的夜晚，这里的气候尤为凉爽。
尤为.en: In summer nights, the climate here is particularly cool.

尤为.zh: 这里的菜味道很好，尤其是那个鱼，尤为鲜美。
尤为.en: The food here tastes great, especially that fish, which is particularly delicious.

尤为.zh: 这个问题尤为重要，一定要认真对待。
尤为.en: This issue is particularly important; we must take it seriously.

尤为.zh: 她今天穿的衣服尤为漂亮。
尤为.en: The clothes she wore today are especially beautiful.

序幕.en: The prelude of the competition has begun.

序幕.zh: 这部电影的序幕拍得非常震撼。
序幕.en: The prologue of this movie was very shocking.

序幕.zh: 随着灯光暗下来，演出的序幕缓缓拉开。
序幕.en: As the lights dimmed, the prelude of the performance slowly began.

序幕.zh: 春天的到来，拉开了新一年的序幕。
序幕.en: The arrival of spring marks the beginning of a new year.

序幕.zh: 这场战争只是更大冲突的序幕。
序幕.en: This war is just the prelude to a larger conflict.

抄袭.zh: 这篇文章被发现有大量抄袭的内容。
抄袭.en: This article was found to have a lot of plagiarized content.

抄袭.zh: 因为抄袭，他被学校严重警告了。
抄袭.en: Because of plagiarism, he received a serious warning from the school.

抄袭.zh: 抄袭别人的作品是不道德的行为。
抄袭.en: Plagiarizing others' works is unethical behavior.

抄袭.zh: 这个设计师经常抄袭别人的创意。
抄袭.en: This designer often copies other people's ideas.

常理.en: This does not conform to common sense.

常理.zh: 按照常理，他应该先道歉才对。
常理.en: According to common sense, he should apologize first.

常理.zh: 虽然常理是这样，但有时候情况会不同。
常理.en: Although common sense says so, sometimes the situation is different.

常理.zh: 他做的事完全违背了常理。
常理.en: What he did completely goes against common sense.

常理.zh: 父母教育孩子要遵循常理。
常理.en: Parents educate their children to follow common sense.

气泡.en: There are many bubbles in the water.

气泡.zh: 可乐打开后会有很多气泡冒出来。
气泡.en: After opening a cola, many bubbles will come out.

气泡.zh: 因为杯子有气泡，所以看起来很奇怪。
气泡.en: Because there is a bubble in the glass, it looks strange.

气泡.zh: 这个气泡膜可以用来保护东西。
气泡.en: This bubble wrap can be used to protect things.

气泡.zh: 水烧开时，锅底会产生很多气泡。
气泡.en: When water boils, many bubbles form at the bottom of the pot.

桑拿.en: Let's go to the sauna this weekend.

桑拿.zh: 这桑拿房里温度太高了。
桑拿.en: The temperature in this sauna room is too high.

桑拿.zh: 他每次运动完都喜欢去桑拿放松。
桑拿.en: He likes to go to the sauna to relax after every workout.

桑拿.zh: 虽然桑拿很舒服，但待太久会头晕。
桑拿.en: Although the sauna is comfortable, staying too long can make you dizzy.

桑拿.zh: 这家酒店的桑拿设施特别干净，推荐去试试。
桑拿.en: The sauna facilities at this hotel are especially clean; I recommend trying them.

热气.en: Steam is rising from the pot.

热气.zh: 刚出锅的包子冒着热气，特别香。
热气.en: The freshly steamed buns are giving off steam and smell amazing.

热气.zh: 冬天喝一碗热汤，浑身都是热气。
热气.en: In winter, drinking a bowl of hot soup makes your whole body warm.

热气.zh: 他说话带着一股热气，显然刚运动完。
热气.en: He was speaking with a steamy breath, obviously just finished exercising.

委婉.zh: 你得委婉一点，别直接批评他。
委婉.en: You need to be a bit more tactful; don't criticize him directly.

委婉.zh: 虽然她没明说，但话里透着委婉的拒绝。
委婉.en: Although she didn't say it outright, her words implied a polite refusal.

委婉.zh: 老板委婉地提醒我注意工作态度。
委婉.en: The boss tactfully reminded me to pay attention to my work attitude.

坚韧.zh: 面对困难，他一直保持着坚韧的态度。
坚韧.en: He maintained a resilient attitude in the face of difficulties.

坚韧.zh: 她的性格特别坚韧，从来不会被挫折打倒。
坚韧.en: Her character is extremely resilient; she never gets knocked down by setbacks.

坚韧.zh: 虽然失败了多次，但他依然坚韧地继续尝试。
坚韧.en: Even after failing many times, he still stubbornly continued to try.

防盗.en: This neighborhood has good security measures.

防盗.zh: 我买了把防盗锁，出门就锁好。
防盗.en: I bought an anti-theft lock and lock up whenever I go out.

防盗.zh: 除了防盗窗，他还装了摄像头。
防盗.en: In addition to security bars on the windows, he also installed a camera.

防盗.zh: 出门旅游前，记得检查家里的防盗设备。
防盗.en: Before traveling, remember to check the security devices at home.

不见得.zh: 他嘴上答应，不见得真会做。
不见得.en: He agreed verbally, but that doesn't mean he'll actually do it.

不见得.zh: 大家都觉得简单，但我不见得这么认为。
不见得.en: Everyone thinks it's simple, but I don't necessarily think so.

不见得.zh: 这条路最近，但不见得最快。
不见得.en: This route is the shortest, but it might not be the fastest.

不解.zh: 我对他突然辞职感到不解。
不解.en: I'm puzzled by his sudden resignation.

不解.zh: 她解释了半天，我还是不解。
不解.en: She explained for a long time, but I still don't understand.

不解.zh: 大家都不解，为什么他那么做。
不解.en: Everyone is baffled as to why he did that.

阀门.en: The water pipe valve is broken.

阀门.zh: 记得关掉煤气阀门再出门。
阀门.en: Remember to turn off the gas valve before going out.

阀门.zh: 师傅说这个阀门需要定期检查。
阀门.en: The repairman said this valve needs regular inspection.

阀门.zh: 你先把总阀门关了，再换零件。
阀门.en: Turn off the main valve first, then replace the parts.

契机.zh: 他把失败当作成长的契机。
契机.en: He took failure as an opportunity for growth.

契机.zh: 这次会议成了合作的重要契机。
契机.en: This meeting became a crucial opportunity for cooperation.

契机.zh: 疫情反而成了他创业的契机。
契机.en: The pandemic ironically became an opportunity for him to start a business.

契机.zh: 如果能抓住这个契机，公司就能翻身。
契机.en: If we can seize this opportunity, the company can turn around.

对得起.en: The price is worth the quality.

对得起.zh: 你要对得起自己的努力。
对得起.en: You should be worthy of your own efforts.

对得起.zh: 他觉得自己对得起这份工资。
对得起.en: He feels he deserves this salary.

对得起.zh: 只要尽力了，就对得起所有人。
对得起.en: As long as you do your best, you'll have done right by everyone.

齐心协力.zh: 大家齐心协力才能成功。
只要我们齐心协力，就一定能完成任务。
齐心协力.en: As long as we work together, we can definitely complete the task.

齐心协力.zh: 这次比赛靠的是团队齐心协力。
齐心协力.en: This competition relies on the team working together.

齐心协力.zh: 他们齐心协力渡过了难关。
齐心协力.en: They worked together to get through the difficulty.

齐心协力.zh: 虽然困难很多，但大家齐心协力克服了。
齐心协力.en: Although there were many difficulties, everyone worked together to overcome them.

顺从.en: He is very obedient to his parents.

顺从.zh: 她总是顺从别人的意见，从不表达自己。
顺从.en: She always follows others' opinions and never expresses herself.

顺从.zh: 如果你一直顺从，他们就会得寸进尺。
顺从.en: If you always comply, they will take advantage.

顺从.zh: 他虽然心里不愿意，但表面上还是顺从了。
顺从.en: Although he was unwilling in his heart, he still complied on the surface.

休想.en: Don't even think about fooling me!

休想.zh: 没有我的允许，你休想离开这里。
休想.en: Without my permission, don't even think about leaving here.

休想.zh: 除非你先道歉，否则休想得到原谅。
休想.en: Unless you apologize first, don't even think about being forgiven.
Don't even think about such a good thing!

休想.zh: 我告诉你，你休想拿走一分钱。
休想.en: I'm telling you, don't even think about taking a single cent.

叹气.zh: 他一边叹气一边摇头说没办法。
叹气.en: He sighed and shook his head, saying there was no way.

凿.en: He uses a chisel to carve stone.

凿.zh: 工人们正在凿开这面墙。
凿.en: The workers are chiseling open this wall.

凿.zh: 因为石头太硬，他凿了很久才凿出一个洞。
凿.en: Because the stone was too hard, he chiseled for a long time to make a hole.
He chiseled a hole in the wood.

凿.zh: 古代人用凿子凿出文字。
凿.en: Ancient people used chisels to carve characters.

瓶颈.zh: 公司的发展现在处于瓶颈期。
瓶颈.en: The company's development is now in a bottleneck period.

瓶颈.zh: 如果不解决技术瓶颈，项目就无法推进。
瓶颈.en: If the technical bottleneck is not solved, the project cannot advance.
This bottleneck is hard to break through.

瓶颈.zh: 交通瓶颈导致这里经常堵车。
瓶颈.en: The traffic bottleneck causes frequent traffic jams here.

累计.zh: 这个月的累计销售额已经达到一百万。
累计.en: This month's cumulative sales have reached one million.

累计.zh: 由于连续加班，他累计了很多疲劳。
累计.en: Due to continuous overtime, he accumulated a lot of fatigue.

累计.zh: 累计积分可以兑换礼品。
累计.en: Cumulative points can be exchanged for gifts.

累计.zh: 从年初到现在，累计产量增加了百分之十。
累计.en: From the beginning of the year to now, cumulative production has increased by ten percent.

止步.zh: 游客到了这里就止步了。
因为前面危险，我们只能止步不前。
止步.en: Because it's dangerous ahead, we can only stop and not go forward.
His results stopped at the preliminary round.

止步.zh: 虽然很想继续，但现实让我不得不止步。
止步.en: Although I really want to continue, reality forces me to stop.

水龙头.zh: 请把水龙头关紧，别浪费水。
水龙头.en: Please tighten the faucet, don't waste water.

水龙头.zh: 我打开水龙头洗手，但水是凉的。
水龙头.en: I turned on the faucet to wash my hands, but the water was cold.

水龙头.zh: 厨房的水龙头需要换一个新的。
水龙头.en: The kitchen faucet needs to be replaced with a new one.

床位.en: The hospital doesn't have enough beds.

床位.zh: 这家酒店还有空床位吗？
床位.en: Does this hotel have any empty beds?

床位.zh: 因为床位紧张，很多病人只能住走廊。
床位.en: Because of the bed shortage, many patients can only stay in the hallway.

床位.zh: 宿舍里共六个床位，都住满了。
床位.en: There are six beds in the dormitory, all occupied.

征集.zh: 学校征集了很多学生的绘画作品来办展览。
征集.en: The school collected many students' paintings to hold an exhibition.

征集.zh: 这次活动征集志愿者，我已经报名了。
征集.en: This event is recruiting volunteers, and I've already signed up.

征集.zh: 虽然征集时间很短，但收到了很多回复。
征集.en: Although the solicitation period was short, we still received many responses.

征集.zh: 他们征集签名反对那个决定。
征集.en: They collected signatures to oppose that decision.

见效.zh: 他试了新方法，但暂时还没见效。
见效.en: He tried the new method, but it hasn't taken effect yet.

见效.zh: 这种减肥茶喝了一个月才见效。
见效.en: This weight-loss tea only showed results after drinking it for a month.

见效.zh: 如果按时吃药，三天就能见效。
见效.en: If you take the medicine on time, it will take effect in three days.

见效.zh: 这个政策已经实施了，但见效需要时间。
见效.en: This policy has been implemented, but it will take time to show results.

措手不及.en: This rain caught people off guard.

措手不及.zh: 他突然辞职，公司上下措手不及。
措手不及.en: His sudden resignation caught the whole company off guard.

措手不及.zh: 考试题目太难，我措手不及。
措手不及.en: The exam questions were too hard; I was caught off guard.

措手不及.zh: 因为没提前通知，大家全都措手不及。
措手不及.en: Because there was no advance notice, everyone was caught off guard.

措手不及.zh: 敌人偷袭，我们措手不及。
措手不及.en: The enemy launched a surprise attack, and we were unprepared.

拓宽.en: This road needs to be widened.

拓宽.zh: 旅游可以拓宽我们的视野。
公司决定拓宽业务范围。
拓宽.en: The company decided to broaden its business scope.

拓宽.zh: 他不仅学习专业知识，还通过阅读拓宽知识面。
拓宽.en: He not only studies professional knowledge but also broadens his knowledge through reading.

拓宽.zh: 政府计划拓宽那条狭窄的街道。
拓宽.en: The government plans to widen that narrow street.

罢休.zh: 如果得不到答案，他决不罢休。
罢休.en: If he doesn't get an answer, he will never stop.

罢休.zh: 这件事还没完，我不能罢休。
罢休.en: This matter isn't over yet; I can't let it go.

罢休.zh: 虽然失败了，但他不打算就此罢休。
罢休.en: Although he failed, he doesn't plan to stop there.

罢休.zh: 她一直追问，不得到回复不罢休。
罢休.en: She kept asking and wouldn't stop until she got a reply.

手帕.zh: 奶奶总是随身带一条干净的手帕。
手帕.en: Grandma always carries a clean handkerchief with her.

手帕.zh: 现在很少有人用布手帕了，都用纸巾。
手帕.en: Nowadays few people use cloth handkerchiefs; they all use tissues.

手帕.zh: 虽然现在纸巾很方便，但手帕更环保。
手帕.en: Although tissues are convenient now, handkerchiefs are more eco-friendly.
She wiped her tears with a handkerchief.

征收.en: The government levies personal income tax.

征收.zh: 这片地因为修路被征收了。
征收.en: This piece of land was expropriated for road construction.

征收.zh: 海关对进口商品征收关税。
征收.en: Customs levies tariffs on imported goods.

征收.zh: 如果逾期不缴，税务部门会征收滞纳金。
征收.en: If you fail to pay on time, the tax authorities will charge a late fee.

征收.zh: 村里征收土地用于建设学校。
征收.en: The village expropriated land to build a school.

小费.en: In China, you don't need to tip.

小费.zh: 这家餐厅的服务费已经包含小费了。
小费.en: The service charge at this restaurant already includes the tip.

小费.zh: 他给服务员留了十块钱小费。
小费.en: He left a ten-yuan tip for the waiter.

小费.zh: 虽然不强制，但有些人习惯给点小费。
小费.en: Although it's not mandatory, some people are used to giving a small tip.

小费.zh: 在国外吃饭通常要付小费。
小费.en: When eating abroad, you usually have to pay a tip.

稳健.zh: 这个投资方案比较稳健，风险不大。
稳健.en: This investment plan is relatively prudent, with little risk.

稳健.zh: 公司采取稳健的发展策略。
稳健.en: The company adopts a steady development strategy.

稳健.zh: 虽然市场波动大，但稳健的投资者不会慌张。
稳健.en: Although the market is volatile, steady investors won't panic.

稳健.zh: 他做事稳健，领导很放心。
稳健.en: He works steadily, and the leadership is very reassured.

社论.zh: 今天报纸的社论很精彩。
社论.en: Today's newspaper editorial is very excellent.

社论.zh: 这篇社论分析了当前的经济形势。
社论.en: This editorial analyzes the current economic situation.

社论.zh: 他每天都要读报社的社论。
社论.en: He reads the newspaper's editorial every day.

社论.zh: 虽然社论代表报社观点，但也不一定全对。
社论.en: Although editorials represent the newspaper's views, they may not be entirely correct.

社论.zh: 他们针对教育改革写了一篇社论。
社论.en: They wrote an editorial about education reform.

确凿.en: Are these pieces of evidence conclusive?

确凿.zh: 警方找到了确凿的证据，证明他不在现场。
确凿.en: The police found conclusive evidence proving he was not at the scene.

确凿.zh: 没有确凿的证据，我们不能随便下结论。
确凿.en: Without conclusive evidence, we cannot jump to conclusions.

确凿.zh: 他的话听起来很确凿，但我还是有点怀疑。
确凿.en: His words sound very certain, but I still have some doubts.

确凿.zh: 这个说法缺乏确凿的根据，别信。
确凿.en: This claim lacks solid basis, don't believe it.

历来.zh: 这里历来都是旅游旺季，人特别多。
历来.en: This place has always been a peak tourist season, extremely crowded.

历来.zh: 我们公司历来重视员工的培训，所以成长很快。
历来.en: Our company has always valued employee training, so it has grown quickly.

历来.zh: 她历来不喜欢吃辣的，今天却点了麻辣锅。
历来.en: She has never liked spicy food, but today she ordered a spicy hot pot.

历来.zh: 这个传统历来如此，很难改变。
历来.en: This tradition has always been like this; it's hard to change.

就任.en: He assumed the position of new principal yesterday.

就任.zh: 她下个月就要就任公司副总裁了。
就任.en: She is about to assume the role of vice president of the company next month.

就任.zh: 就任仪式上，他发表了简短的演讲。
就任.en: At the inauguration ceremony, he gave a brief speech.

就任.zh: 他刚就任就遇到了财政危机，压力很大。
就任.en: He encountered a financial crisis as soon as he took office, facing great pressure.

就任.zh: 这位CEO就任后，公司业绩明显提升。
就任.en: After this CEO took office, the company's performance significantly improved.

忘不了.zh: 那次旅行太美了，我永远忘不了。
忘不了.en: That trip was so beautiful; I'll never forget it.

忘不了.zh: 他忘不了小时候在乡下生活的日子。
忘不了.en: He can't forget the days he spent in the countryside as a child.

忘不了.zh: 就算过了这么多年，我还是忘不了她。
忘不了.en: Even after so many years, I still can't forget her.

忘不了.zh: 有些伤痛，一辈子都忘不了。
忘不了.en: Some pains, you can't forget in a lifetime.

淀粉.en: Potatoes contain a lot of starch.

淀粉.zh: 做这道菜需要加一点淀粉勾芡。
淀粉.en: This dish requires adding a bit of starch to thicken the sauce.

淀粉.zh: 淀粉吃多了容易长胖，要注意控制。
淀粉.en: Eating too much starch can easily make you gain weight; you need to control it.

淀粉.zh: 这个牌子的淀粉质量很好，做出来菜很嫩。
淀粉.en: This brand of starch is of good quality, making the dishes very tender.

淀粉.zh: 我不太吃米饭，因为淀粉含量太高。
淀粉.en: I don't eat much rice because its starch content is too high.

牵制.zh: 敌人的兵力被我们牵制住了。
牵制.en: The enemy's forces have been pinned down by us.

牵制.zh: 他故意用其他话题牵制我的注意力。
牵制.en: He deliberately used other topics to divert my attention.

牵制.zh: 这个项目需要大量资金，牵制了我们很多资源。
牵制.en: This project requires a lot of funds, tying up many of our resources.

牵制.zh: 双方互相牵制，谁也不敢先动手。
牵制.en: Both sides are checking each other; neither dares to make the first move.

牵制.zh: 不要让别人牵制你的决定，要自己做主。
牵制.en: Don't let others dictate your decisions; make your own choices.

达标.en: Has your weight reached the standard?

达标.zh: 这周业绩还没达标，大家要加油。
达标.en: This week's performance hasn't met the target yet; everyone needs to work harder.

达标.zh: 经过三个月的训练，他的成绩终于达标了。
达标.en: After three months of training, his scores finally met the standard.

达标.zh: 水质检测显示所有指标都达标，可以放心饮用。
达标.en: Water quality tests show all indicators meet the standard; it's safe to drink.

达标.zh: 如果这次不达标，我们就要重新制定计划。
达标.en: If we don't meet the standard this time, we'll have to remake the plan.

变迁.zh: 这个城市经历了巨大的变迁。
变迁.en: This city has undergone tremendous changes.

变迁.zh: 社会变迁影响了每个人的生活方式。
变迁.en: Social changes have affected everyone's lifestyle.

变迁.zh: 随着时代变迁，很多老手艺都失传了。
变迁.en: With the changes of the times, many old crafts have been lost.

变迁.zh: 他写了一本书，记录家乡几十年的变迁。
变迁.en: He wrote a book documenting decades of changes in his hometown.

变迁.zh: 这里十年间的变迁让人感叹不已。
变迁.en: The changes here over the past ten years are truly astonishing.

属性.zh: 这个文件的属性是只读。
我们需要先了解材料的属性再做决定。
属性.en: We need to first understand the properties of the material before making a decision.

属性.zh: 不同属性的商品要分开存放，以免混淆。
属性.en: Goods with different attributes should be stored separately to avoid confusion.

属性.zh: 他的性格属性偏内向，不太爱说话。
属性.en: His personality attributes lean towards introversion; he doesn't talk much.

属性.zh: 软件会自动检测图片的属性，比如大小和格式。
属性.en: The software automatically detects the image's attributes, such as size and format.

充沛.zh: 他精力充沛，从不觉得累。
充沛.en: He is full of energy and never feels tired.

充沛.zh: 这几天雨水充沛，庄稼长得很好。
充沛.en: There has been abundant rainfall these days, and the crops are growing well.

充沛.zh: 她精力充沛，工作到半夜也不困。
充沛.en: She is full of energy and doesn't feel sleepy even working until midnight.

充沛.zh: 充足的睡眠能让你第二天精力充沛。
充沛.en: Adequate sleep can make you energetic the next day.

充沛.zh: 这个地区阳光充沛，很适合种植太阳能。
充沛.en: This region has abundant sunshine, making it very suitable for solar energy.

简要.zh: 如果你时间紧，可以简要说明。
简要.en: If you're short on time, you can explain briefly.

简要.zh: 这份报告需要写得更简要一些。
简要.en: This report needs to be written more concisely.

简要.zh: 他简要回答后，就离开了会议室。
简要.en: After giving a brief answer, he left the meeting room.

自力更生.en: We need to rely on ourselves.

自力更生.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但他们依然自力更生。
自力更生.en: Although conditions were tough, they still relied on themselves.

自力更生.zh: 公司遇到困难后，决定自力更生。
自力更生.en: After the company encountered difficulties, it decided to be self-reliant.

自力更生.zh: 靠别人不如自力更生，这样心里才踏实。
自力更生.en: It's better to rely on yourself than on others; only then will you feel at ease.

阶梯.en: This is the ladder to success.
Knowledge is the ladder to progress.

阶梯.zh: 他顺着阶梯走到了楼顶。
阶梯.en: He walked up the stairs to the rooftop.

阶梯.zh: 因为楼梯坏了，我们只能走阶梯。
阶梯.en: Because the staircase was broken, we had to use the steps.

阶梯.zh: 社会阶梯需要一步一步往上爬。
阶梯.en: The social ladder needs to be climbed step by step.

藏品.zh: 他把自己最喜欢的藏品借给了展览。
藏品.en: He lent his favorite collectible to the exhibition.

藏品.zh: 因为藏品太多，他专门买了一个柜子放。
藏品.en: Because he had too many collectibles, he bought a cabinet specifically for them.

藏品.zh: 这件藏品是他爷爷留下来的。
藏品.en: This collectible was handed down by his grandfather.

毯子.zh: 晚上睡觉时，我喜欢盖一条厚毯子。
毯子.en: When sleeping at night, I like to cover myself with a thick blanket.

毯子.zh: 她带了一条毯子去野餐。
毯子.en: She brought a blanket to the picnic.

毯子.zh: 如果觉得冷，可以再加一条毯子。
毯子.en: If you feel cold, you can add another blanket.

港湾.en: The ship slowly sailed into the harbor.

港湾.zh: 每次回家，都感觉像回到了温暖的港湾。
港湾.en: Every time I go home, it feels like returning to a warm harbor.

港湾.zh: 母亲的怀抱是心灵的港湾。
港湾.en: A mother's embrace is a harbor for the soul.

港湾.zh: 为了避风，渔船都停在了港湾里。
港湾.en: To avoid the wind, the fishing boats all docked in the harbor.

中性.zh: 他在讨论中保持了中性的立场。
中性.en: He maintained a neutral stance in the discussion.

中性.zh: 这件衣服的颜色是中性的。
中性.en: The color of this clothing is neutral.

中性.zh: 中性风格的衣服男女都能穿。
中性.en: Neutral-style clothes can be worn by both men and women.

中性.zh: 在酸碱测试中，它显示出中性。
中性.en: In the acid-base test, it showed a neutral result.

忧愁.zh: 不要为过去的事情忧愁，要向前看。
忧愁.en: Don't worry about the past; look forward.

忧愁.zh: 虽然遇到了困难，但他没有因此忧愁。
忧愁.en: Although he encountered difficulties, he didn't become worried because of them.

忧愁.zh: 忧愁解决不了问题，行动起来吧。
忧愁.en: Worrying won't solve the problem; take action.

跳伞.en: He was very nervous on his first skydive.

跳伞.zh: 我们计划周末去海边跳伞。
跳伞.en: We plan to go skydiving at the beach this weekend.

跳伞.zh: 因为天气不好，跳伞活动取消了。
跳伞.en: Because of bad weather, the skydiving activity was canceled.

跳伞.zh: 跳伞时，他看到了美丽的风景。
跳伞.en: While skydiving, he saw beautiful scenery.

核电站.en: A nuclear power plant was built here.

核电站.zh: 核电站为城市提供电力。
核电站.en: Nuclear power plants provide electricity to cities.

核电站.zh: 政府严格监管核电站的安全运行。
核电站.en: The government strictly supervises the safe operation of nuclear power plants.

核电站.zh: 虽然核电站有风险，但能源效益很高。
核电站.en: Although nuclear power plants have risks, their energy efficiency is high.

核电站.zh: 很多人担心核电站的辐射问题。
核电站.en: Many people are worried about the radiation issue of nuclear power plants.

催促.zh: 老板催促我们尽快完成报告。
催促.en: The boss urged us to finish the report as soon as possible.

催促.zh: 妈妈一直在催促我快点吃饭。
催促.en: Mom kept urging me to eat quickly.

催促.zh: 虽然他很着急，但他没有催促别人。
催促.en: Although he was anxious, he didn't urge others.

催促.zh: 列车员催促乘客抓紧时间上车。
催促.en: The train attendant urged passengers to board quickly.

头条.zh: 这条新闻上了社交媒体头条。
头条.en: This news became the top headline on social media.
He always likes to read entertainment headlines.

头条.zh: 因为那条新闻太劲爆，所以直接上了头条。
头条.en: Because that news was so explosive, it directly made the headlines.

头条.zh: 报纸的头条是一起重大事故。
头条.en: The newspaper's headline was about a major accident.

唯独.zh: 大家都来了，唯独他没来。
这家店的东西都很好吃，唯独那个蛋糕太甜了。
唯独.en: Everything in this shop is delicious, except that cake is too sweet.

唯独.zh: 他什么都愿意做，唯独不想加班。
唯独.en: He is willing to do anything, except he doesn't want to work overtime.

唯独.zh: 虽然其他人都同意，唯独我持反对意见。
唯独.en: Although everyone else agreed, I alone held a dissenting opinion.

唯独.zh: 她唯独对这件事特别坚持。
唯独.en: She is particularly persistent about this matter alone.

自始至终.en: He didn't speak from beginning to end.

自始至终.zh: 我自始至终都支持你的决定。
自始至终.en: I have supported your decision from beginning to end.

自始至终.zh: 这部电影自始至终都很精彩。
自始至终.en: This movie was exciting from beginning to end.

自始至终.zh: 虽然过程很曲折，但他自始至终没有放弃。
自始至终.en: Although the process was tortuous, he never gave up from beginning to end.

自始至终.zh: 她自始至终都相信自己是正确的。
自始至终.en: She believed she was right from beginning to end.

回升.en: The temperature has started to rise again.

回升.zh: 股市最近有所回升，投资者都很开心。
回升.en: The stock market has rebounded recently, and investors are very happy.

回升.zh: 经济回升还需要一段时间。
回升.en: The economic recovery will take some time.

回升.zh: 虽然之前跌了很多，但现在房价正在回升。
回升.en: Although it dropped a lot before, housing prices are now rebounding.

孝顺.en: He is very filial to his parents.

孝顺.zh: 孝顺是中华民族的传统美德。
孝顺.en: Filial piety is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation.

孝顺.zh: 她经常回家看父母，非常孝顺。
孝顺.en: She often goes home to see her parents, very filial.

孝顺.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他依然很孝顺。
孝顺.en: Although he is very busy with work, he is still very filial.

孝顺.zh: 我觉得孝顺不只是给钱，还要多陪伴。
孝顺.en: I think filial piety is not just giving money, but also spending more time with them.

宽广.zh: 他的胸怀非常宽广，从不计较小事。
宽广.en: His mind is very broad, never caring about small matters.

宽广.zh: 草原非常宽广，一眼望不到边。
宽广.en: The grassland is very vast, you can't see the edge at a glance.

宽广.zh: 因为心胸宽广，所以他朋友很多。
宽广.en: Because he is broad-minded, he has many friends.

宽广.zh: 这本书让我们看到了更宽广的世界。
宽广.en: This book shows us a broader world.

嘱咐.en: Mom told me to come home early.

嘱咐.zh: 医生嘱咐他要多休息，少熬夜。
嘱咐.en: The doctor advised him to rest more and stay up less.

嘱咐.zh: 临走前，父亲嘱咐了我很多话。
嘱咐.en: Before leaving, my father told me many words of advice.

嘱咐.zh: 虽然他已经记住了，但我还是再三嘱咐。
嘱咐.en: Although he already remembered, I still repeatedly exhorted him.

嘱咐.zh: 老师嘱咐学生们考试时要仔细检查。
嘱咐.en: The teacher exhorted the students to check carefully during the exam.

胸怀.zh: 一个人要有宽广的胸怀。
胸怀.en: A person should have a broad mind.
She is open-minded and never hides anything.

胸怀.zh: 虽然他受到了批评，但他胸怀宽广，没有生气。
胸怀.en: Although he was criticized, he was broad-minded and didn't get angry.

胸怀.zh: 我们要有胸怀天下的气度。
胸怀.en: We need to have a mind that embraces the world.

学说.zh: 达尔文的进化论是一个重要学说。
学说.en: Darwin's theory of evolution is an important theory.

学说.zh: 他研究了这个学说的历史。
学说.en: He studied the history of this theory.

学说.zh: 虽然这个学说很流行，但我并不完全同意。
学说.en: Although this theory is very popular, I don't completely agree.

学说.zh: 很多学说都需要实验来证明。
学说.en: Many theories need experiments to prove.

并购.zh: 这次并购涉及好多资金。
并购.en: This merger involves a lot of money.

并购.zh: 他们正在谈并购的事情，但还没定下来。
并购.en: They are discussing the merger, but it hasn't been finalized yet.

并购.zh: 两家公司并购以后，业绩反而更差了。
并购.en: After the two companies merged, performance actually got worse.

并购.zh: 虽然并购能扩大规模，但风险也不小。
并购.en: Although mergers can expand scale, the risks are also significant.

抵触.en: He has some resistance in his heart.

抵触.zh: 别抵触新的工作流程，试试再说。
抵触.en: Don't resist the new workflow, just try it first.

抵触.zh: 她对加班很抵触，所以辞职了。
抵触.en: She was very resistant to overtime, so she quit.

抵触.zh: 如果大家抵触这个政策，那就需要重新考虑。
抵触.en: If everyone is opposed to this policy, then it needs to be reconsidered.

退休金.zh: 退休金每个月都会按时发。
退休金.en: The pension is paid on time every month.

退休金.zh: 我爸退休金涨了，他很开心。
退休金.en: My dad's pension increased, and he's very happy.

退休金.zh: 除了退休金，他还有一点存款。
退休金.en: Besides the pension, he also has some savings.

退休金.zh: 她担心退休金太少，不够养老。
退休金.en: She worries that the pension is too little to support her in old age.

避难.en: They went to the mountains to take refuge.

避难.zh: 地震的时候，大家赶紧避难。
避难.en: During the earthquake, everyone hurried to take shelter.

避难.zh: 这里以前是防空洞，用来避难的。
避难.en: This used to be an air-raid shelter for taking refuge.

避难.zh: 因为战争，很多人逃到邻国避难。
避难.en: Because of the war, many people fled to neighboring countries for refuge.

避难.zh: 台风来了，我们得找个安全的地方避难。
避难.en: A typhoon is coming, we need to find a safe place to take shelter.

矛头.en: The blame was pointed at him.

矛头.zh: 大家把矛头对准了领导。
矛头.en: Everyone directed the criticism at the leader.

矛头.zh: 媒体的矛头一直对着那家公司。
矛头.en: The media has been directing its attacks at that company.

矛头.zh: 别把矛头都对着我，这事不是我一个人的错。
矛头.en: Don't point all the blame at me; this isn't solely my fault.

矛头.zh: 他本来想转移矛头，结果反而更引人怀疑。
矛头.en: He tried to divert the blame, but it only made him more suspicious.

太极.en: I practice Tai Chi every morning.

太极.zh: 公园里很多人在练太极。
太极.en: Many people in the park are practicing Tai Chi.

太极.zh: 他打太极的动作很标准。
太极.en: His Tai Chi movements are very precise.

太极.zh: 太极对身体很好，尤其是对老年人。
太极.en: Tai Chi is very good for the body, especially for the elderly.

太极.zh: 她学了三年太极，现在可以教别人了。
太极.en: She has studied Tai Chi for three years and can now teach others.

唾液.en: Don't spit saliva randomly; it's very unhygienic.

唾液.zh: 唾液检测可以查出很多疾病。
唾液.en: Saliva tests can detect many diseases.

唾液.zh: 说话的时候，唾液会溅出来，要小心。
唾液.en: When talking, saliva can spray out, so be careful.

甘心.en: I'm not willing to give up like this.

甘心.zh: 他甘心做一辈子普通员工吗？
甘心.en: Is he content to be an ordinary employee forever?

甘心.zh: 输了比赛，他心里很不甘心。
甘心.en: After losing the match, he felt very unwilling to accept it.

甘心.zh: 她甘心了？不可能！她不是那种人。
甘心.en: She's reconciled to it? Impossible! She's not that kind of person.

甘心.zh: 虽然失败了，但他不甘心，还在努力。
甘心.en: Although he failed, he isn't reconciled and is still working hard.

转眼.en: In the blink of an eye, ten years passed.
In a flash, the child grew up.

转眼.zh: 刚才还在，转眼就不见了。
转眼.en: It was here just now, and then it disappeared in an instant.

转眼.zh: 转眼又到年底了，时间真快。
转眼.en: In the blink of an eye, it's the end of the year again; time flies.

清真寺.zh: 这条街上有一座清真寺。
清真寺.en: There is a mosque on this street.

清真寺.zh: 清真寺里禁止大声喧哗。
清真寺.en: Loud noise is prohibited inside the mosque.

清真寺.zh: 每天早晨，清真寺都会播放祷告声。
清真寺.en: Every morning, the mosque broadcasts the call to prayer.

清真寺.zh: 游客可以在特定时间参观清真寺。
清真寺.en: Tourists can visit the mosque at specific times.

进修.zh: 我打算明年去北京进修汉语。
进修.en: I plan to go to Beijing next year for further study in Chinese.

进修.zh: 公司派他去国外进修了一年，回来就升职了。
进修.en: The company sent him abroad for a year of advanced training, and he got promoted right after returning.

进修.zh: 进修期间他认识了很多新朋友。
进修.en: He made many new friends during his advanced study period.

进修.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他还是坚持去进修。
进修.en: Although work is very busy, he still insists on pursuing further training.

进修.zh: 这次进修机会难得，你要好好珍惜。
进修.en: This training opportunity is rare; you should cherish it.

媲美.zh: 这座山的风景可以媲美黄山。
媲美.en: The scenery of this mountain can rival that of Huangshan.

媲美.zh: 他的厨艺好到能跟大厨媲美。
媲美.en: His cooking skills are so good they can rival a master chef's.

媲美.zh: 这件衣服的质量虽然贵，但能媲美名牌。
媲美.en: The quality of this clothing, though expensive, can match that of famous brands.

媲美.zh: 这家小店的蛋糕味道媲美五星级酒店。
媲美.en: The cake at this small shop tastes as good as that of a five-star hotel.

媲美.zh: 她的歌声优美，简直可以媲美专业歌手。
媲美.en: Her singing is beautiful and can practically rival that of professional singers.

盘算.zh: 他一直在盘算怎么省钱。
盘算.en: He's been figuring out how to save money.

盘算.zh: 我盘算了一下，发现这样不划算。
盘算.en: I calculated it and found that this is not cost-effective.

盘算.zh: 别以为我不知道你在盘算什么事。
盘算.en: Don't think I don't know what you're scheming about.

盘算.zh: 她盘算着周末去爬山，结果下雨了。
盘算.en: She was planning to go hiking on the weekend, but it ended up raining.

盘算.zh: 老板盘算来盘算去，最后还是决定加薪。
盘算.en: The boss weighed the pros and cons over and over, and finally decided to give a raise.

纽扣.en: He helped me sew the button back on.

纽扣.zh: 这件衬衫的纽扣是金色的，很漂亮。
纽扣.en: The buttons on this shirt are gold-colored and very pretty.

纽扣.zh: 扣子系错了，最上面的纽扣和第二个扣眼没对齐。
纽扣.en: The buttons are buttoned wrong; the top button doesn't align with the second buttonhole.

纽扣.zh: 你去超市的时候帮我买几个纽扣。
纽扣.en: When you go to the supermarket, help me buy a few buttons.

平坦.zh: 虽然山路不平坦，但我们坚持走到了山顶。
平坦.en: Although the mountain path was not smooth, we persisted to the top.

平坦.zh: 平坦的地面适合孩子学走路。
平坦.en: Flat ground is suitable for children learning to walk.

平坦.zh: 人生不会一直平坦，总有波折。
平坦.en: Life isn't always smooth; there are always ups and downs.

平坦.zh: 新修的高速公路非常平坦，开车很舒服。
平坦.en: The newly built highway is very smooth, making driving very comfortable.

权衡.zh: 你要权衡利弊再做决定。
权衡.en: You need to weigh the pros and cons before making a decision.

权衡.zh: 这件事得好好权衡一下。
权衡.en: This matter needs to be carefully weighed.

权衡.zh: 他在权衡之后选择了离家近的工作。
权衡.en: After weighing his options, he chose a job close to home.

权衡.zh: 我权衡了各种因素，最终还是决定辞职。
权衡.en: I weighed various factors and ultimately decided to resign.

权衡.zh: 做买卖必须权衡风险和收益。
权衡.en: Doing business requires weighing risks and returns.

新潮.en: This piece of clothing is very trendy.

新潮.zh: 他总喜欢穿新潮的鞋子。
新潮.en: He always likes to wear trendy shoes.

新潮.zh: 年轻人追新潮的东西，老年人看不懂。
新潮.en: Young people chase trendy things; old people don't understand it.

新潮.zh: 这种发型现在特别新潮，很多人都剪。
新潮.en: This hairstyle is especially trendy now, and many people are getting it.

新潮.zh: 虽然新潮的衣服好看，但不一定适合每个人。
新潮.en: Although trendy clothes look good, they may not suit everyone.

庄重.zh: 在这种场合要穿得庄重点。
庄重.en: On such occasions you should dress more formally.

庄重.zh: 他说话总是很庄重，从不开玩笑。
庄重.en: He always speaks seriously and never jokes.

庄重.zh: 会议开始时，主持人做了庄重的致辞。
庄重.en: At the start of the meeting, the host gave a solemn address.

庄重.zh: 虽然平时很搞笑，关键时刻他显得非常庄重。
庄重.en: Although he is usually funny, at critical moments he appears very solemn.

势必.en: Doing this will inevitably lead to failure.

势必.zh: 如果不下雨，干旱势必加剧。
势必.en: If it doesn't rain, the drought will inevitably worsen.

势必.zh: 他那么贪心，势必会吃大亏。
势必.en: He is so greedy that he is bound to suffer a great loss.

势必.zh: 公司裁员的话，势必有很多人失业。
势必.en: If the company lays off staff, many people will inevitably lose their jobs.

势必.zh: 再不努力，你势必会被别人超过。
势必.en: If you don't work hard anymore, you are bound to be surpassed by others.

刺绣.zh: 这件衣服上有精美的刺绣。
刺绣.en: This garment has exquisite embroidery on it.

刺绣.zh: 我妈妈教会了我刺绣这门手艺。
刺绣.en: My mom taught me the craft of embroidery.

刺绣.zh: 刺绣是中国传统艺术，值得传承。
刺绣.en: Embroidery is a traditional Chinese art and is worth passing down.

刺绣.zh: 她花了一个月时间完成了一幅刺绣作品。
刺绣.en: She spent a month completing an embroidery piece.

学士.zh: 他拿到了文学学士学位。
学士.en: He got a Bachelor of Arts degree.

学士.zh: 我弟弟还在读学士，没毕业呢。
学士.en: My younger brother is still studying for a bachelor's degree and hasn't graduated yet.

学士.zh: 虽然他是学士学历，但工作经验很丰富。
学士.en: Although he has a bachelor's degree, he has rich work experience.

学士.zh: 这个职位要求至少学士学位，你符合条件吗？
学士.en: This position requires at least a bachelor's degree—do you meet the requirements?

学士.zh: 她一边工作一边读学士，非常辛苦。
学士.en: She's working and studying for a bachelor's degree at the same time, which is very tough.

举重.zh: 举重运动员需要很强的核心力量。
举重.en: Weightlifters need a very strong core.

举重.zh: 我昨天去健身房练举重，现在胳膊酸死了。
举重.en: I went to the gym for weightlifting yesterday, and now my arms are sore as hell.

举重.zh: 虽然举重看起来简单，但动作不对很容易受伤。
举重.en: Although weightlifting looks simple, doing it with wrong form can easily cause injury.

举重.zh: 他为了比赛天天练举重，连周末都不休息。
举重.en: He trains weightlifting every day for the competition, not even taking weekends off.

愈来愈.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

愈来愈.zh: 他的中文说得愈来愈好。
愈来愈.en: His Chinese is getting better and better.

愈来愈.zh: 因为工作压力大，他愈来愈不想出门。
愈来愈.en: Because of high work pressure, he increasingly doesn't want to go out.

愈来愈.zh: 智能手机的功能愈来愈多，但价格也愈来愈贵。
愈来愈.en: Smartphones have more and more features, but the prices are also getting more and more expensive.

愈来愈.zh: 她发现自己的记忆力愈来愈差，决定去看医生。
愈来愈.en: She found her memory getting worse and worse, so she decided to see a doctor.

清凉.en: This water is really cool and refreshing.

清凉.zh: 夏天喝杯清凉的柠檬水最爽了。
清凉.en: Drinking a glass of cool lemonade in summer is the best.

清凉.zh: 山里的风吹过来，感觉特别清凉舒服。
清凉.en: The wind from the mountains blows over, feeling especially cool and comfortable.

清凉.zh: 虽然空调很凉，但我还是喜欢自然的清凉感。
清凉.en: Although the air conditioner is very cold, I still prefer a natural cool feeling.

清凉.zh: 她把西瓜放在冰箱里冰了一会儿，吃起来特别清凉解暑。
清凉.en: She put the watermelon in the fridge for a while, and when eaten, it's especially cool and refreshing to beat the heat.

裂痕.en: There is a crack on the wall.

裂痕.zh: 他们的感情出现了裂痕。
裂痕.en: A rift has appeared in their relationship.

裂痕.zh: 因为误会，两人之间的裂痕越来越深。
裂痕.en: Because of misunderstandings, the rift between the two is getting deeper and deeper.

裂痕.zh: 这个杯子摔过，底部有一条细小的裂痕。
裂痕.en: This cup has been dropped, and there is a tiny crack on the bottom.

裂痕.zh: 虽然他们表面上和好了，但心里的裂痕还在。
裂痕.en: Although they have apparently made up, the rift in their hearts still remains.

心想事成.zh: 新年到了，我祝大家心想事成。
心想事成.en: The New Year has arrived, I wish everyone all their wishes come true.

心想事成.zh: 只要努力，你就能心想事成。
心想事成.en: As long as you work hard, you can achieve your wishes.

心想事成.zh: 考试前她紧张得要命，我送她一句“心想事成”鼓励她。
心想事成.en: Before the exam, she was extremely nervous, so I said 'may all your wishes come true' to encourage her.

心想事成.zh: 他总说运气好才能心想事成，其实付出才有回报。
心想事成.en: He always says that good luck is needed for wishes to come true, but actually, you get returns only after putting in effort.

集资.en: They are raising funds to build a school.

集资.zh: 小区业主集资修了个新大门。
集资.en: The community homeowners raised funds to build a new gate.

集资.zh: 因为政府拨款不够，学校只能靠集资购买设备。
集资.en: Because government funding was insufficient, the school had to rely on fundraising to buy equipment.

集资.zh: 他通过网上平台集资，为山区孩子买了学习用品。
集资.en: He raised funds through an online platform to buy school supplies for children in the mountainous areas.

集资.zh: 虽然集资很顺利，但怎么合理使用这笔钱是个问题。
集资.en: Although the fundraising went smoothly, how to use the money wisely is a question.

公立.en: This is a public elementary school.

公立.zh: 公立医院的费用比私立便宜很多。
公立.en: Public hospitals are much cheaper than private ones.

公立.zh: 很多人觉得公立学校的教学质量不如私立的好。
公立.en: Many people think that the teaching quality of public schools is not as good as that of private schools.

公立.zh: 他选择了离家近的公立幼儿园，因为接送方便。
公立.en: He chose a public kindergarten near home because it's convenient for drop-off and pickup.

公立.zh: 虽然公立大学学费低，但竞争也非常激烈。
公立.en: Although public universities have low tuition fees, the competition is also very fierce.

缩水.en: This piece of clothing shrank after washing.

缩水.zh: 今年的预算缩水了不少。
缩水.en: This year's budget has shrunk quite a bit.

缩水.zh: 因为布料不好，裤子洗几次就严重缩水了。
缩水.en: Because the fabric is poor, the pants shrank severely after a few washes.

缩水.zh: 虽然他的收入缩水了，但生活质量没有下降太多。
缩水.en: Although his income has shrunk, his quality of life hasn't dropped too much.

缩水.zh: 这羊毛衫只能用冷水洗，不然肯定会缩水。
缩水.en: This wool sweater can only be washed in cold water, otherwise it will definitely shrink.

动工.en: Construction of the new bridge has already started.

动工.zh: 这个楼盘动工半年了还没盖好。
动工.en: This real estate project started construction half a year ago and still hasn't been built.

动工.zh: 因为资金问题，地铁项目迟迟没有动工。
动工.en: Due to funding issues, the subway project has been delayed from starting construction.

动工.zh: 他们选了个好日子正式动工，希望一切顺利。
动工.en: They chose an auspicious day to officially start construction, hoping everything goes smoothly.

动工.zh: 虽然批文下来了，但征地还没解决，所以没办法动工。
