动工.en: Although the approval has come through, the land acquisition hasn't been resolved yet, so construction cannot start.

遛.zh: 我每天早上都去公园遛狗。
遛.en: I walk my dog in the park every morning.

遛.zh: 吃完晚饭，我们出去遛了一圈。
遛.en: After dinner, we went out for a stroll.

遛.zh: 他遛完狗就回家做饭了。
遛.en: After walking the dog, he went home to cook.

遛.zh: 周末我特别喜欢在河边遛弯儿，看看风景。
遛.en: On weekends I especially like to stroll by the river and enjoy the scenery.

遛.zh: 虽然今天下雨，但我还是坚持去遛了狗。
遛.en: Although it rained today, I still insisted on walking the dog.

迟迟.zh: 他迟迟没有回复我的消息。
迟迟.en: He took a long time to reply to my message.

迟迟.zh: 火车迟迟不到，我们都很着急。
迟迟.en: The train was delayed for a long time, and we were all anxious.

迟迟.zh: 为什么你迟迟不肯告诉我们真相？
迟迟.en: Why have you been delaying telling us the truth?

迟迟.zh: 因为快递迟迟没到，所以我只好重新下单了。
迟迟.en: Because the delivery took so long, I had to place a new order.

迟迟.zh: 她迟迟不肯答应他的求婚，他心里很不安。
迟迟.en: She kept putting off accepting his marriage proposal, and he felt very uneasy.

水壶.en: I left my water bottle in the classroom.

水壶.zh: 出门前别忘了灌满水壶。
水壶.en: Don't forget to fill your water bottle before going out.

水壶.zh: 这个水壶保温效果特别好，冬天用很合适。
水壶.en: This thermos has excellent heat retention, perfect for winter use.

水壶.zh: 他把水壶放在炉子上烧开水。
水壶.en: He put the kettle on the stove to boil water.

水壶.zh: 如果你去爬山，一定要带个大水壶。
水壶.en: If you go hiking, be sure to bring a large water bottle.

演播室.zh: 演播室里有很多灯光设备。
演播室.en: There are many lighting devices in the studio.

演播室.zh: 节目是在三号演播室录制的。
演播室.en: The show was recorded in Studio 3.

演播室.zh: 观众们在演播室外面排队等候入场。
演播室.en: The audience lined up outside the studio waiting to enter.

演播室.zh: 因为演播室信号出了问题，直播延迟了十分钟。
演播室.en: Due to a signal problem in the studio, the live broadcast was delayed by ten minutes.

演播室.zh: 这个新演播室装修得挺高级的，音响效果很棒。
演播室.en: This new studio is quite luxuriously decorated and has great acoustics.

花卉.zh: 春天是观赏花卉的好季节。
花卉.en: Spring is a great season for viewing flowers.

花卉.zh: 她家阳台上种了很多花卉。
花卉.en: She grows many flowers and plants on her balcony.

花卉.zh: 这个公园每年都会举办花卉展览。
花卉.en: This park holds a flower exhibition every year.

花卉.zh: 除了常见的玫瑰和百合，我还喜欢一些热带花卉。
花卉.en: Besides common roses and lilies, I also like some tropical flowers.

花卉.zh: 他专门学习过花卉栽培技术，现在自己开了个花店。
花卉.en: He studied floriculture techniques and now runs his own flower shop.

兴建.zh: 这里正在兴建一座大型商场。
兴建.en: A large shopping mall is being built here.

兴建.zh: 政府计划在郊区兴建新的学校。
兴建.en: The government plans to build new schools in the suburbs.

兴建.zh: 为了缓解交通压力，他们决定兴建一条地铁。
兴建.en: To ease traffic congestion, they decided to build a subway line.

兴建.zh: 去年开始兴建的体育馆预计明年完工。
兴建.en: The gymnasium, whose construction started last year, is expected to be completed next year.

兴建.zh: 虽然兴建公园花了不少钱，但市民们都很支持。
兴建.en: Although building the park cost a lot, the citizens were very supportive.

口令.zh: 班长喊口令，大家开始做操。
口令.en: The squad leader gave the command, and everyone started doing exercises.

口令.zh: 这个系统的口令必须包含数字和字母。
口令.en: The password for this system must contain numbers and letters.

口令.zh: 如果你忘了口令，可以点这里重置。
口令.en: If you forget your password, you can click here to reset it.

口令.zh: 每次换岗的时候，哨兵都要核对新的口令。
口令.en: Every time the shift changes, the sentry has to verify the new password.

心肠.zh: 她心肠特别好，总是帮助别人。
心肠.en: She is very kind-hearted and always helps others.

心肠.zh: 你别看他样子凶，其实心肠很软。
心肠.en: Don't be fooled by his fierce look; he actually has a soft heart.

心肠.zh: 这个老板心肠太硬，从来不体谅员工。
心肠.en: This boss is too hard-hearted and never considers the employees.

心肠.zh: 他心肠热，听说朋友有困难就马上帮忙。
心肠.en: He is warm-hearted; as soon as he hears a friend is in trouble, he helps right away.

心肠.zh: 虽然她嘴上不饶人，但心肠特别好，大家都喜欢她。
心肠.en: Although she is sharp-tongued, she has a very good heart, and everyone likes her.

贬低.zh: 他喜欢用贬低别人来抬高自己。
贬低.en: He likes to put others down to elevate himself.

贬低.zh: 你这样贬低他的努力，他会很难过的。
贬低.en: If you belittle his efforts like this, he will be very upset.

贬低.zh: 虽然竞争对手经常贬低我们的产品，但我们依然有信心。
贬低.en: Although competitors often disparage our products, we remain confident.

贬低.zh: 她从不贬低任何人，因为她知道每个人都不容易。
贬低.en: She never belittles anyone because she knows everyone has a hard time.

无故.en: He skipped class today without reason.

无故.zh: 你无故发火，大家都很莫名其妙。
无故.en: You got angry for no reason, and everyone was puzzled.

无故.zh: 公司不能无故开除员工，否则要赔偿。
无故.en: The company cannot fire employees without cause, otherwise compensation is required.

无故.zh: 她无故缺席了会议，经理很不高兴。
无故.en: She missed the meeting for no reason, and the manager was very unhappy.

无故.zh: 如果你无故迟到太多次，可能会被扣工资。
无故.en: If you are late too many times without reason, your salary may be deducted.

作对.zh: 他老是跟我作对，真让人烦。
作对.en: He always opposes me, it's really annoying.

作对.zh: 为什么你总是要和我作对？
作对.en: Why do you always have to oppose me?

作对.zh: 如果你们继续作对，最后谁都没好处。
作对.en: If you continue to oppose each other, in the end nobody benefits.
I don't want to oppose you.

大幅度.zh: 这次改革大幅度提高了生产效率。
大幅度.en: This reform has greatly improved production efficiency.

大幅度.zh: 因为疫情，旅游收入大幅度减少。
大幅度.en: Due to the epidemic, tourism revenue has decreased significantly.

大幅度.zh: 公司不仅增加了员工，还大幅度提升了工资。
大幅度.en: The company not only increased staff but also substantially raised wages.

反问.en: He asked me a rhetorical question.

反问.zh: 你这是在反问我还是真的不懂？
反问.en: Are you asking me rhetorically or do you really not understand?

反问.zh: 老师用反问的方式启发我们。
反问.en: The teacher used rhetorical questions to inspire us.
Don't always answer with a rhetorical question.

反问.zh: 如果你不同意，直接说就好，不用反问。
反问.en: If you disagree, just say it directly, no need for a rhetorical question.

菩萨.en: She has a heart like a Bodhisattva.
There are several Bodhisattva statues in the temple.
Pray to the Bodhisattva to bless you with safety.

菩萨.zh: 老人常去烧香拜佛，求菩萨保佑家人。
菩萨.en: The old man often goes to burn incense and worship Buddha, praying to the Bodhisattva to bless his family.

就地.en: Let's solve it on the spot.

就地.zh: 遇到问题要就地处理，不要拖延。
就地.en: When encountering problems, handle them on the spot, don't delay.

就地.zh: 这个项目需要就地取材。
就地.en: This project needs to use local materials.

就地.zh: 因为情况紧急，我们只能就地开个短会。
就地.en: Because the situation is urgent, we can only hold a short meeting on the spot.

二手车.zh: 二手车市场现在很火爆。
二手车.en: The used car market is very hot right now.

二手车.zh: 这辆二手车性价比很高。
二手车.en: This used car has great value for money.
Don't buy a used car that's too old.

二手车.zh: 虽然钱不多，但我还是选了辆不错的二手车。
二手车.en: Although I don't have much money, I still chose a decent used car.

胆怯.zh: 面试时不要胆怯，要自信一点。
胆怯.en: Don't be timid during the interview, be more confident.
She is never timid in the face of difficulties.

胆怯.zh: 虽然心里胆怯，但他还是站了出来。
胆怯.en: Although he felt timid inside, he still stepped forward.

刺耳.zh: 他说的话很刺耳，让人不舒服。
刺耳.en: His words were very harsh and made people uncomfortable.
The siren sound is very piercing.

刺耳.zh: 虽然他说的是实话，但语气太刺耳了。
刺耳.en: Although what he said was true, his tone was too harsh.

狭隘.zh: 这条路非常狭隘，只能走一辆车。
狭隘.en: This road is very narrow, only one car can pass.

狭隘.zh: 别那么狭隘，多听听别人的意见。
狭隘.en: Don't be so narrow-minded, listen to others' opinions more.

狭隘.zh: 因为心胸狭隘，他很难交到朋友。
狭隘.en: Because he is narrow-minded, he finds it hard to make friends.

命题.zh: 老师负责这次的命题工作。
命题.en: The teacher is responsible for setting the exam questions this time.

命题.zh: 我们需要讨论这个哲学命题。
命题.en: We need to discuss this philosophical proposition.

命题.zh: 如果命题太难，学生可能会考不好。
命题.en: If the questions are too difficult, students may not do well on the exam.

瘟疫.zh: 以前没有疫苗的时候，瘟疫很容易传播。
瘟疫.en: When there were no vaccines, epidemics spread easily.

瘟疫.zh: 虽然瘟疫已经控制住了，但我们还是要小心。
瘟疫.en: Although the epidemic is under control, we still need to be careful.
Many people died in the plague that year.

瘟疫.zh: 大家都害怕瘟疫会卷土重来。
瘟疫.en: Everyone is afraid that the plague will come back.

早年.en: He was very poor in his early years.

早年.zh: 我早年住在乡下，后来才搬来城市。
早年.en: I lived in the countryside in my early years and only moved to the city later.

早年.zh: 虽然早年条件不好，但他很努力。
早年.en: Although conditions were not good in his early years, he worked very hard.

早年.zh: 她早年的梦想是当一名医生。
早年.en: Her dream in her early years was to become a doctor.

早年.zh: 这些照片记录了他早年的生活。
早年.en: These photos document his early life.

山脉.en: This mountain range is very high.

山脉.zh: 我们开车穿过了一条长长的山脉。
山脉.en: We drove through a long mountain range.

山脉.zh: 因为山脉挡住了气流，所以这边很干燥。
山脉.en: Because the mountain range blocks the airflow, this side is very dry.

山脉.zh: 中国的山脉很多，比如喜马拉雅山脉。
山脉.en: China has many mountain ranges, such as the Himalayas.

山脉.zh: 山脉里有很多野生动物。
山脉.en: There are many wild animals in the mountain range.

淡水.en: I need to drink fresh water.

淡水.zh: 这个湖里的水是淡水，可以直接喝。
淡水.en: The water in this lake is fresh water and can be drunk directly.

淡水.zh: 如果没有淡水，我们就无法生存。
淡水.en: Without fresh water, we cannot survive.

淡水.zh: 地球上的淡水资源越来越少了。
淡水.en: Fresh water resources on Earth are becoming increasingly scarce.
Fish are divided into saltwater fish and freshwater fish.

罪魁祸首.zh: 这次事故的罪魁祸首是司机的疲劳驾驶。
罪魁祸首.en: The main cause of this accident was the driver's fatigue.

罪魁祸首.zh: 虽然大家都有责任，但他的疏忽是罪魁祸首。
罪魁祸首.en: Although everyone has some responsibility, his negligence is the main culprit.

罪魁祸首.zh: 科学家发现这种病毒才是罪魁祸首。
罪魁祸首.en: Scientists discovered that this virus is the real culprit.

罪魁祸首.zh: 别怪别人，你自己才是罪魁祸首。
罪魁祸首.en: Don't blame others; you yourself are the culprit.

据悉.en: It is reported that he resigned.

据悉.zh: 据悉，这个项目将在下个月启动。
据悉.en: It is reported that the project will launch next month.

据悉.zh: 据悉，由于天气原因，航班取消了。
据悉.en: It is reported that the flight was canceled due to weather.

据悉.zh: 据悉，这次比赛有来自十多个国家的选手。
据悉.en: It is reported that there are contestants from more than ten countries in this competition.

据悉.zh: 据悉，公司正在考虑裁员。
据悉.en: It is reported that the company is considering layoffs.

款待.zh: 主人用丰盛的晚餐款待了所有客人。
款待.en: The host treated all the guests to a lavish dinner.

款待.zh: 虽然我们只是路过，但他们依然盛情款待。
款待.en: Although we were just passing by, they still received us with great hospitality.

款待.zh: 感谢你的款待，我们玩得很开心。
款待.en: Thank you for your hospitality; we had a great time.

款待.zh: 这次款待让我印象深刻。
款待.en: This hospitality left a deep impression on me.

修长.zh: 那个模特身材修长，非常适合走秀。
修长.en: That model has a slender figure, perfect for the runway.

修长.zh: 虽然她个子不高，但双腿很修长。
修长.en: Although she is not tall, her legs are very long and slender.

修长.zh: 他修长的身材在人群中很突出。
修长.en: His slender physique stands out in the crowd.

修长.zh: 小提琴家的手指修长而灵活。
修长.en: The violinist's fingers are slender and agile.

名次.zh: 这次考试的名次很快就公布了。
名次.en: The exam rankings were announced quickly.

名次.zh: 虽然他的名次不高，但他进步了很多。
名次.en: Although his ranking is not high, he has improved a lot.

名次.zh: 我们队的名次从第五升到了第二。
名次.en: Our team's ranking went from fifth to second.

名次.zh: 比赛结束后，大家都很关心自己的名次。
名次.en: After the competition, everyone was very concerned about their rankings.

惯性.zh: 汽车突然刹车，因为惯性，人往前倒。
惯性.en: When the car brakes suddenly, people lurch forward due to inertia.

惯性.zh: 由于惯性，我们很难改变旧习惯。
惯性.en: Due to inertia, it's hard for us to change old habits.

惯性.zh: 他惯性思维太强了，总用老办法。
惯性.en: His habitual thinking is too strong; he always uses old methods.

惯性.zh: 坐车时系安全带可以防止惯性带来的伤害。
惯性.en: Wearing a seatbelt in the car can prevent injuries caused by inertia.

休养.zh: 医生让我好好休养几天。
休养.en: The doctor told me to rest well for a few days.

休养.zh: 她病了以后，一直在家里休养。
休养.en: After she got sick, she has been recovering at home.

休养.zh: 这个月我打算去乡下休养一段时间。
休养.en: This month I plan to go to the countryside to recuperate for a while.

休养.zh: 虽然手术很成功，但他还需要休养三个月。
休养.en: Although the surgery was successful, he still needs three months to recover.

休养.zh: 你最近太累了，不如请个假好好休养一下。
休养.en: You've been too tired lately, why not take a leave and rest well.

结冰.zh: 冬天路上容易结冰，开车要小心。
结冰.en: In winter, roads are prone to freezing, so drive carefully.

结冰.zh: 水管结冰了，我们得想办法解冻。
结冰.en: The water pipe has frozen; we need to find a way to thaw it.

结冰.zh: 如果气温降到零下，湖面就会结冰。
结冰.en: If the temperature drops below zero, the lake will freeze.

结冰.zh: 因为昨晚太冷，水池里的水都结冰了。
结冰.en: Because it was so cold last night, the water in the pool has all frozen.

凉爽.zh: 秋天到了，天气变得很凉爽。
凉爽.en: Autumn has arrived, and the weather has become very cool.

凉爽.zh: 晚上出去散步，风吹过来很凉爽。
凉爽.en: Going for a walk in the evening, the wind feels very cool.

凉爽.zh: 我喜欢凉爽的天气，不喜欢太热。
凉爽.en: I like cool weather, I don't like it too hot.

凉爽.zh: 虽然白天很热，但晚上还挺凉爽的。
凉爽.en: Although it's hot during the day, it's still quite cool in the evening.

庆贺.en: Everyone celebrates the New Year together.

庆贺.zh: 今晚我们要办个派对庆贺生日。
庆贺.en: Tonight we're having a party to celebrate a birthday.

庆贺.zh: 他升职了，同事们一起庆贺他。
庆贺.en: He got promoted, and his colleagues celebrated with him.

庆贺.zh: 比赛赢了以后，大家互相庆贺。
庆贺.en: After winning the match, everyone congratulated each other.

庆贺.zh: 我们订了个蛋糕来庆贺结婚纪念日。
庆贺.en: We ordered a cake to celebrate our wedding anniversary.

标示.zh: 这个标签标示了生产日期。
标示.en: This label indicates the production date.

标示.zh: 地图上用红色标示了景点位置。
标示.en: The map marks the locations of scenic spots in red.

标示.zh: 出口处有绿色标示，很容易找到。
标示.en: There is a green sign at the exit, making it easy to find.

标示.zh: 说明书上标示了每个按钮的功能。
标示.en: The manual indicates the function of each button.

昼夜.en: The temperature difference between day and night here is large.

昼夜.zh: 他昼夜不停地工作，身体都累垮了。
昼夜.en: He worked day and night without rest, and his body broke down.
In spring, the lengths of day and night are about the same.

昼夜.zh: 医院里有护士昼夜照顾病人。
昼夜.en: In the hospital, nurses take care of patients day and night.

昼夜.zh: 虽然昼夜温差大，但白天阳光很好。
昼夜.en: Although the temperature difference between day and night is large, the daytime sunshine is good.

下意识.zh: 他下意识地摸了摸口袋。
听到声音，她下意识地回头看。
下意识.en: Hearing a sound, she subconsciously turned her head to look.

下意识.zh: 我下意识地躲开了那个球。
紧张的时候，人会下意识地咬嘴唇。
下意识.en: When nervous, people subconsciously bite their lips.

下意识.zh: 虽然他没说话，但我下意识觉得他不太高兴。
下意识.en: Although he didn't speak, I subconsciously felt he wasn't very happy.

返还.en: The deposit will be returned upon checkout.

返还.zh: 如果商品有问题，可以全额返还。
返还.en: If there's a problem with the product, you can get a full refund.

返还.zh: 他收到快递后把多付的钱返还给了卖家。
返还.en: After receiving the package, he returned the overpaid money to the seller.

返还.zh: 公司要求员工返还多余的差旅费用。
返还.en: The company asked employees to return the excess travel expenses.

发酵.en: Making wine requires a fermentation process.

发酵.zh: 酸奶是通过牛奶发酵做成的。
发酵.en: Yogurt is made by fermenting milk.

发酵.zh: 温度太低的话，面团发酵会很慢。
发酵.en: If the temperature is too low, the dough will ferment very slowly.

发酵.zh: 这个想法在团队里发酵了一段时间才变成计划。
发酵.en: This idea fermented in the team for a while before becoming a plan.

同期.zh: 今年同期销量比去年高。
同期.en: Sales in the same period this year are higher than last year.

同期.zh: 我们是同期入学的同学。
同期.en: We are classmates who enrolled in the same period.

同期.zh: 同期上映的电影有好几部。
同期.en: Several movies are being released in the same period.

同期.zh: 和去年同期相比，今年游客增加了不少。
同期.en: Compared to the same period last year, the number of tourists has increased a lot.

同期.zh: 他们两个是同期进入公司的，关系很好。
同期.en: The two of them joined the company in the same period and have a good relationship.

兼容.zh: 这个软件兼容所有系统。
兼容.en: This software is compatible with all systems.

兼容.zh: 新买的手机必须兼容我的旧充电器。
兼容.en: The new phone must be compatible with my old charger.

兼容.zh: 虽然这款游戏很老，但它兼容最新的显卡。
兼容.en: Although this game is very old, it is compatible with the latest graphics card.

兼容.zh: 我们公司开发的配件兼容多种品牌。
兼容.en: The accessories our company develops are compatible with multiple brands.

兼容.zh: 为了兼容不同设备，软件需要经常更新。
兼容.en: To be compatible with different devices, the software needs regular updates.

界线.zh: 朋友之间也要有明确的界线。
界线.en: There should be clear boundaries even between friends.
That river is the boundary between two provinces.

界线.zh: 开玩笑的时候要注意界线，不要过分。
界线.en: When joking, pay attention to the boundaries and don't go too far.

界线.zh: 工作和生活的界线越来越模糊了。
界线.en: The line between work and life is getting blurrier.

祥和.en: The holiday atmosphere is very peaceful.

祥和.zh: 春节时家里充满了祥和的氛围。
祥和.en: During Spring Festival, the home is full of a peaceful atmosphere.

祥和.zh: 老人喜欢住在乡下，因为那里生活祥和。
祥和.en: Old people like living in the countryside because life there is peaceful.

祥和.zh: 虽然外面很吵，但屋里却一片祥和。
祥和.en: Although it's noisy outside, inside the house it's all peaceful.

祥和.zh: 大家坐在一起喝茶聊天，气氛非常祥和。
祥和.en: Everyone sat together drinking tea and chatting, the atmosphere was very peaceful.

和蔼.zh: 邻居老爷爷总是笑眯眯的，特别和蔼。
和蔼.en: The old grandfather next door is always smiling, very kind.

和蔼.zh: 那位医生说话很和蔼，病人都不紧张了。
和蔼.en: That doctor speaks very kindly, and the patients are no longer nervous.

和蔼.zh: 虽然经理看起来严肃，但其实他对员工很和蔼。
和蔼.en: Although the manager looks serious, he is actually very kind to employees.

和蔼.zh: 她是一位和蔼的长辈，孩子们都喜欢她。
和蔼.en: She is a kind elder, and children all like her.

奥秘.zh: 科学家们一直在探索生命的奥秘。
奥秘.en: Scientists have been exploring the mysteries of life.

奥秘.zh: 这本书揭示了海底世界的奥秘。
奥秘.en: This book reveals the mysteries of the underwater world.

奥秘.zh: 人类至今没有完全解开大脑的奥秘。
奥秘.en: Humans have not yet fully uncovered the mysteries of the brain.

奥秘.zh: 他对古埃及的奥秘非常感兴趣，所以看了很多书。
奥秘.en: He is very interested in the mysteries of ancient Egypt, so he has read many books.

繁重.zh: 他的工作非常繁重，常常加班到深夜。
繁重.en: His work is very heavy, and he often works overtime late into the night.

繁重.zh: 因为家务繁重，她请了一个钟点工。
繁重.en: Because the housework is heavy, she hired a part-time cleaner.

繁重.zh: 虽然训练很繁重，但运动员们都坚持下来了。
繁重.en: Although the training is very heavy, the athletes all persisted.

繁重.zh: 繁重的学业让他几乎没有时间休息。
繁重.en: The heavy schoolwork leaves him almost no time to rest.

钻研.en: He likes to study technology intensively.

钻研.zh: 为了写好论文，他花了三个月钻研这个课题。
钻研.en: To write a good thesis, he spent three months delving into this topic.

钻研.zh: 老师鼓励我们多钻研不懂的问题。
钻研.en: The teacher encourages us to delve deeper into questions we don't understand.

钻研.zh: 他整天待在实验室钻研新材料。
钻研.en: He stays in the lab all day studying new materials intensively.

钻研.zh: 虽然问题很难，但只要钻研下去就会有结果。
钻研.en: Although the problem is difficult, as long as you keep delving into it, there will be results.

友人.en: He is a friend of many years.

友人.zh: 昨天我和几位友人一起去爬山了。
友人.en: Yesterday I went hiking with a few friends.

友人.zh: 这位日本友人中文说得非常好。
友人.en: This Japanese friend speaks Chinese very well.

友人.zh: 他在旅途中结识了不少外国友人。
友人.en: He made many foreign friends during his travels.

友人.zh: 虽然我们不常见面，但我和那位友人一直保持联系。
友人.en: Although we don't meet often, I have kept in touch with that friend.

采矿.zh: 这个地区禁止非法采矿活动。
采矿.en: Illegal mining activities are prohibited in this area.

采矿.zh: 他爷爷以前在煤矿采矿，吃了不少苦。
采矿.en: His grandfather used to mine coal and suffered a lot.

采矿.zh: 由于安全措施不到位，采矿事故时有发生。
采矿.en: Due to inadequate safety measures, mining accidents occur from time to time.

采矿.zh: 新技术让深海采矿成为可能。
采矿.en: New technology makes deep-sea mining possible.

通俗.en: This book is very easy to understand.

通俗.zh: 他用通俗的语言解释了复杂的问题。
通俗.en: He explained the complex problem in plain language.

通俗.zh: 这首歌的歌词通俗易懂，所以很受欢迎。
通俗.en: The lyrics of this song are easy to understand, so it's very popular.

通俗.zh: 虽然内容很深，但教授讲得很通俗。
通俗.en: Although the content is deep, the professor explained it in a very accessible way.

通俗.zh: 科普文章应该写得通俗一些，让更多人看懂。
通俗.en: Popular science articles should be written in a more accessible way so that more people can understand.

烘.zh: 把面包放进烤箱烘一下。
烘.en: Bake the bread in the oven for a bit.

烘.zh: 冬天太冷了，用暖气烘烘手再打字。
烘.en: Winter is too cold, warm your hands by the heater before typing.

烘.zh: 因为下雨了，衣服烘不干，所以只能用烘干机。
烘.en: Because it rained, the clothes won't dry by air, so I have to use a dryer.

烘.zh: 这个蛋糕需要烘四十分钟。
烘.en: This cake needs to bake for 40 minutes.

烘.zh: 烘咖啡豆的时候，香味会飘满整个屋子。
烘.en: When roasting coffee beans, the aroma fills the whole room.

大宗.zh: 最近有一批大宗货物从港口运往内地。
大宗.en: Recently, a batch of bulk goods was shipped from the port to inland areas.

大宗.zh: 虽然是小本生意，但我们也偶尔接大宗订单。
大宗.en: Although it's a small business, we occasionally take large orders.

大宗.zh: 大宗商品价格波动很大。
大宗.en: Bulk commodity prices fluctuate a lot.

大宗.zh: 这家银行专门为大宗交易提供融资服务。
大宗.en: This bank provides financing services specifically for large transactions.

伙食.zh: 这个月的伙食费花得有点多，得省着点。
伙食.en: This month's meal expenses are a bit high, need to save.

伙食.zh: 因为食堂换了厨师，伙食质量明显提高了。
伙食.en: Because the cafeteria changed chefs, the meal quality has improved significantly.

伙食.zh: 我们学校的伙食太差了。
出差的时候，单位报销伙食补贴，不用自己花钱。
伙食.en: When on business trips, the company reimburses meal allowances, so you don't have to spend your own money.

地下水.en: The groundwater here is very clean.

地下水.zh: 过度抽取地下水会导致地面下沉。
地下水.en: Over-extraction of groundwater can cause land subsidence.

地下水.zh: 因为干旱，农民只能打井抽取地下水来灌溉。
地下水.en: Because of drought, farmers have to drill wells to extract groundwater for irrigation.

地下水.zh: 地下水污染是个大问题。
地下水.en: Groundwater pollution is a big problem.

地下水.zh: 专家建议减少使用化肥，以保护地下水资源。
地下水.en: Experts recommend reducing fertilizer use to protect groundwater resources.

辞退.en: He was fired by the boss.

辞退.zh: 因为公司业绩不好，上个月辞退了好几名员工。
辞退.en: Because the company's performance was poor, they fired several employees last month.

辞退.zh: 虽然工作很努力，但还是因为迟到被辞退了。
辞退.en: Although he worked hard, he was still fired for being late.

辞退.zh: 无故辞退员工是违法的。
辞退.en: Firing employees without cause is illegal.

辞退.zh: 她主动辞职，而不是被公司辞退。
辞退.en: She resigned voluntarily, rather than being fired by the company.

口碑.en: This shop has a good reputation.

口碑.zh: 这款手机的口碑不错，很多人都推荐。
口碑.en: This phone has a good reputation; many people recommend it.

口碑.zh: 虽然价格贵了点，但口碑好，所以还是很多人买。
口碑.en: Although the price is a bit high, the reputation is good, so many people still buy it.
Word-of-mouth is more important than advertising.

口碑.zh: 我们靠口碑做宣传，客户介绍新客户。
口碑.en: We rely on word-of-mouth for promotion; customers refer new customers.

衬托.zh: 黑色衬托出她的白皮肤。
衬托.en: Black sets off her white skin.

衬托.zh: 这幅画用浅色背景衬托主体的鲜艳色彩。
衬托.en: This painting uses a light background to set off the bright colors of the main subject.

衬托.zh: 因为有了绿叶的衬托，红花才显得更加美丽。
衬托.en: Because of the green leaves as a foil, the red flowers appear more beautiful.

衬托.zh: 她的笑容衬托出她的善良。
衬托.en: Her smile sets off her kindness.

衬托.zh: 在演讲中，适当的幽默可以衬托出观点的深刻性。
衬托.en: In a speech, appropriate humor can highlight the depth of the viewpoint.

精简.en: The company decided to streamline staff.

精简.zh: 这篇文章太长了，需要精简一下内容。
精简.en: This article is too long; the content needs to be streamlined.

精简.zh: 为了提高效率，我们精简了工作流程，去掉了很多不必要的步骤。
精简.en: To improve efficiency, we streamlined the workflow and removed many unnecessary steps.

精简.zh: 经过精简后，这个部门的员工人数减少了三分之一。
精简.en: After streamlining, the number of employees in this department was reduced by one third.

抢眼.zh: 在人群中，那个穿红色衣服的人最抢眼。
抢眼.en: Among the crowd, the person in red is the most eye-catching.

抢眼.zh: 虽然设计简单，但颜色搭配很抢眼，让人印象深刻。
抢眼.en: Although the design is simple, the color matching is striking and impressive.

抢眼.zh: 这个广告设计非常抢眼。
抢眼.en: This advertisement design is very eye-catching.

抢眼.zh: 电影里的特效场景特别抢眼，观众都看呆了。
抢眼.en: The special effects scenes in the movie were particularly striking; the audience was stunned.

搁置.zh: 因为资金不足，项目暂时搁置了。
搁置.en: Because of insufficient funds, the project has been temporarily shelved.

搁置.zh: 虽然大家都很想推进，但问题太多，只能先搁置讨论。
搁置.en: Although everyone wants to push forward, there are too many issues, so we have to shelve the discussion for now.
Don't put the problem aside and ignore it.

搁置.zh: 我们搁置了争议，先完成最紧急的任务。
搁置.en: We shelved the dispute and first completed the most urgent tasks.

远见.zh: 因为老板有远见，公司才能发展得这么好。
远见.en: Because the boss has foresight, the company has been able to develop so well.

远见.zh: 有远见的人会提前做准备。
远见.en: People with foresight prepare in advance.

远见.zh: 他当初的投资很有远见，现在赚了不少钱。
远见.en: His investment back then showed great foresight, and now he's made a lot of money.

远见.zh: 没有远见的人很难成功。
远见.en: People without foresight find it hard to succeed.

反之.zh: 他喜欢热闹，反之我喜静。
反之.en: He likes excitement; conversely, I prefer quiet.

反之.zh: 学习要努力，反之就会落后。
反之.en: You must study hard; otherwise you'll fall behind.

反之.zh: 如果你认真工作，反之则可能被辞退。
反之.en: If you work hard, conversely you might get fired.

反之.zh: 有的人越忙越精神，反之越闲越累。
反之.en: Some people get more energetic the busier they are; on the contrary, they get more tired the more idle they are.

反之.zh: 他总批评别人，反之自己做得更差。
反之.en: He always criticizes others, but on the contrary, he does even worse himself.

感染力.zh: 这首歌的感染力特别强。
感染力.en: This song has a particularly strong appeal.

感染力.zh: 他的演讲很有感染力，大家都被打动了。
感染力.en: His speech was very compelling, and everyone was moved.

感染力.zh: 一个演员的感染力能决定观众是否入戏。
感染力.en: An actor's charisma can determine whether the audience gets into the story.

感染力.zh: 她的热情很有感染力，朋友都喜欢她。
感染力.en: Her enthusiasm is infectious, and her friends all like her.

蔑视.en: He always looks down on the poor.
This attitude is a form of contempt.

蔑视.zh: 他看别人的眼神充满了蔑视。
蔑视.en: His gaze at others is full of disdain.

蔑视.zh: 她虽然有钱，但从不蔑视任何人。
蔑视.en: Although she is rich, she never despises anyone.

蔑视.zh: 我不喜欢他那种蔑视的语气。
蔑视.en: I don't like his tone of contempt.

航运.en: The shipping industry is currently in a slump.

航运.zh: 航运是国际贸易的重要部分。
航运.en: Shipping is an important part of international trade.

航运.zh: 因为疫情，全球航运受到了很大影响。
航运.en: Due to the pandemic, global shipping has been greatly affected.

航运.zh: 这条航线主要用来航运货物。
航运.en: This route is mainly used for shipping goods.

航运.zh: 他爸爸在航运公司上班。
航运.en: His father works at a shipping company.

真是的.en: Oh, come on, it's raining again.

真是的.zh: 真是的，你怎么又迟到了？
真是的.en: Seriously, why are you late again?

真是的.zh: 真是的，我明明关好门了，怎么又开了？
真是的.en: Oh for crying out loud, I clearly closed the door, why is it open again?

真是的.zh: 真是的，这孩子太调皮了。
真是的.en: Gosh, this kid is too mischievous.

真是的.zh: 真是的，我都说了两遍了你还没记住。
真是的.en: Honestly, I've said it twice and you still haven't remembered.

争气.en: You need to try harder and make us proud.
He did well on this exam and lived up to expectations.

争气.zh: 父母都希望孩子能争气，出人头地。
争气.en: Parents all hope their children will be ambitious and achieve success.

争气.zh: 她不甘落后，一直很争气地努力。
争气.en: She refuses to fall behind and always strives hard to live up to expectations.

争气.zh: 不争气的话，别人会看不起。
争气.en: If you don't measure up, others will look down on you.

敬重.zh: 因为他为人正直，大家都敬重他。
敬重.en: Because he is an upright person, everyone respects him.

敬重.zh: 敬重长辈是中华民族的传统美德。
敬重.en: Respecting elders is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation.

敬重.zh: 他虽然年轻，但很敬重老人。
敬重.en: Although he is young, he greatly respects the elderly.

祸害.en: He is nothing but a menace.

祸害.zh: 这个坏习惯会祸害你的一生。
祸害.en: This bad habit will ruin your life.

祸害.zh: 大家都不想跟那个祸害一起共事。
祸害.en: No one wants to work with that troublemaker.
Drugs are a scourge on society.

外行.en: I'm a layman, I don't understand.

外行.zh: 外行看热闹，内行看门道。
外行.en: Laymen watch the excitement, experts watch the craft.

外行.zh: 虽然他是外行，但学得很快。
外行.en: Although he is an amateur, he learns quickly.

外行.zh: 你说的话一听就是外行水平。
外行.en: What you said clearly shows you're at an amateur level.

外行.zh: 别跟外行争论专业问题。
外行.en: Don't argue about professional matters with a layman.

后盾.zh: 有父母做后盾，我很有安全感。
后盾.en: Having my parents as backup makes me feel very secure.

后盾.zh: 公司有强大的后盾，所以不怕竞争。
后盾.en: The company has strong backing, so it's not afraid of competition.

后盾.zh: 他是我最坚实的后盾，无论发生什么。
后盾.en: He is my most solid support, no matter what happens.

后盾.zh: 如果没有朋友当后盾，我可能早就放弃了。
后盾.en: If I didn't have friends as backup, I might have given up long ago.

后盾.zh: 创业的时候，家人的后盾特别重要。
后盾.en: When starting a business, the support from family is especially important.

本钱.en: Not enough capital to do business.

本钱.zh: 健康是最大的本钱，一定要珍惜。
本钱.en: Health is the greatest asset; you must cherish it.

本钱.zh: 他拿全部本钱去投资，风险太大。
本钱.en: He invested all his capital, the risk is too high.

本钱.zh: 年轻就是本钱，可以多尝试不同的事情。
本钱.en: Youth is capital; you can try many different things.

本钱.zh: 虽然经验不足，但他的热情就是本钱。
本钱.en: Although lacking experience, his enthusiasm is his capital.

诧异.zh: 听到这个消息，他十分诧异。
诧异.en: Hearing this news, he was very astonished.

诧异.zh: 她诧异地看着我，好像不认识我一样。
诧异.en: She looked at me in astonishment, as if she didn't know me.

诧异.zh: 大家对他的行为感到很诧异，因为他平时不是这样的。
诧异.en: Everyone was astonished by his behavior because he wasn't usually like this.

诧异.zh: 我诧异的是，他居然连这么简单的问题都不懂。
诧异.en: What surprised me was that he didn't even understand such a simple question.

诧异.zh: 老师诧异地问：“你昨天怎么没来上课？”
诧异.en: The teacher asked in surprise, 'Why didn't you come to class yesterday?'

外援.en: This team needs to hire a foreign player.
Relying on foreign aid is not a long-term solution.

外援.zh: 公司发展太快，不得不引进外援。
外援.en: The company is growing too fast and has to bring in outside help.

外援.zh: 这次比赛他们请了两个外援，实力提升不少。
外援.en: They invited two foreign players for this match, greatly improving their strength.

外援.zh: 虽然有了外援，但本土球员也需要努力。
外援.en: Although there are foreign players, local players also need to work hard.

无济于事.en: Regretting now is of no help.
Just talking without doing is useless.

无济于事.zh: 你生气也解决不了问题，无济于事。
无济于事.en: Getting angry won't solve the problem; it's useless.

无济于事.zh: 他试了很多方法，但都无济于事。
无济于事.en: He tried many methods, but none of them worked.

无济于事.zh: 这时候发脾气完全无济于事，不如冷静下来想办法。
无济于事.en: Losing your temper now is completely useless; better calm down and think of a solution.

力所能及.en: I will do what is within my power.

力所能及.zh: 帮助别人要力所能及，别太勉强。
力所能及.en: When helping others, do what you can; don't overdo it.

力所能及.zh: 他捐出自己力所能及的一笔钱。
力所能及.en: He donated an amount within his ability.

力所能及.zh: 虽然工作很忙，我还是会抽时间做力所能及的志愿活动。
力所能及.en: Although work is busy, I still make time for volunteer activities within my capability.

力所能及.zh: 每个人只要在力所能及的范围内出一份力，社会就会更好。
力所能及.en: As long as everyone contributes within their ability, society will be better.

透彻.zh: 他把问题分析得很透彻。
透彻.en: He analyzed the problem very thoroughly.

透彻.zh: 这本书我读了三遍才算透彻理解。
透彻.en: I read this book three times to thoroughly understand it.

透彻.zh: 要想学透一个知识，必须透彻研究。
透彻.en: To truly master a subject, you must study it thoroughly.

透彻.zh: 他说的话虽然简单，但道理讲得很透彻。
透彻.en: What he said was simple, but he explained the reasoning very thoroughly.

透彻.zh: 只有彻底了解客户需求，才能做出透彻的市场分析。
透彻.en: Only by thoroughly understanding customer needs can one make a thorough market analysis.

遇上.en: I encountered heavy rain when I went out today.

遇上.zh: 我在超市遇上了老朋友。
遇上.en: I ran into an old friend at the supermarket.

遇上.zh: 如果遇上困难，一定要跟家人说。
遇上.en: If you encounter difficulties, be sure to tell your family.

遇上.zh: 没想到在这个小地方能遇上这么有趣的人。
遇上.en: I didn't expect to meet such an interesting person in this small place.

遇上.zh: 他运气不好，总遇上倒霉的事。
遇上.en: He has bad luck and always encounters unlucky things.

当之无愧.zh: 这道菜味道一流，当之无愧的招牌菜。
当之无愧.en: This dish tastes excellent; it's truly a signature dish.

当之无愧.zh: 你这次的成绩，当之无愧是全班第一。
当之无愧.en: Your grades this time are well-deserved as the top of the class.

当之无愧.zh: 她为团队付出了很多，这个荣誉她当之无愧。
当之无愧.en: She contributed a lot to the team; she truly deserves this honor.

当之无愧.zh: 这个奖项颁给他，完全是当之无愧的。
当之无愧.en: This award given to him is completely well-deserved.

俗话.zh: 俗话说，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
俗话.en: As the saying goes, the early bird catches the worm.
As the saying goes, illness enters through the mouth.

俗话.zh: 有一句俗话叫“远亲不如近邻”。
俗话.en: There is a saying, 'A close neighbor is better than a distant relative.'

俗话.zh: 俗话常说，心急吃不了热豆腐。
俗话.en: As the saying often goes, 'Haste makes waste.'

俗话.zh: 这句俗话告诉我们，做人要懂得感恩。
俗话.en: This saying tells us that one should know to be grateful.

水利.en: Water conservancy projects are very important.

水利.zh: 我们村的水利设施修好了。
水利.en: Our village's irrigation facilities have been repaired.

水利.zh: 因为水利搞得好，今年庄稼没旱着。
水利.en: Because the irrigation was well managed, the crops didn't suffer drought this year.

水利.zh: 政府投了很多钱在水利建设上。
水利.en: The government invested a lot of money in water conservancy construction.

水利.zh: 水利不仅影响农业，也关系到城市用水。
水利.en: Water conservancy affects not only agriculture but also urban water supply.

奖赏.en: The boss gave him a reward.

奖赏.zh: 这次比赛的奖赏是一台电脑。
奖赏.en: The prize for this competition is a computer.

奖赏.zh: 如果你完成任务，就会得到奖赏。
奖赏.en: If you complete the task, you will receive a reward.

奖赏.zh: 奖赏不是最重要的，学习经验才重要。
奖赏.en: The reward isn't the most important thing; learning experience is.

奖赏.zh: 他因为救了人，获得了政府的特殊奖赏。
奖赏.en: He received a special reward from the government for saving someone.

真假.en: It's hard to tell if this news is true or false.

真假.zh: 你要学会分辨真假朋友。
真假.en: You need to learn to distinguish genuine friends from fake ones.

真假.zh: 我分不清这个包的真假。
真假.en: I can't tell whether this bag is authentic or fake.

真假.zh: 网上信息真假混杂，要小心。
真假.en: Online information is a mix of truth and falsehood, so be careful.

真假.zh: 虽然他说是真的，但我觉得真假还得再查查。
真假.en: Although he says it's true, I think we still need to check whether it's real or not.

源源不断.en: Customers keep coming in an endless stream.

源源不断.zh: 资金源源不断涌入这个项目。
源源不断.en: Funds are continuously pouring into this project.

源源不断.zh: 因为需求大，订单源源不断。
源源不断.en: Because demand is high, orders keep coming in.

源源不断.zh: 她每天都能收到源源不断的礼物。
源源不断.en: She receives a constant stream of gifts every day.

源源不断.zh: 只要水源不断，泉水就源源不断流出。
源源不断.en: As long as the water source is not cut off, the spring will flow continuously.

受罪.en: He works overtime every day; it's really suffering.

受罪.zh: 为了考试熬夜，真是不受罪才怪。
受罪.en: Staying up late for exams, it's no wonder you suffer.

受罪.zh: 既然选择了这行，就别怕受罪。
受罪.en: Since you chose this field, don't be afraid of suffering.

受罪.zh: 她生病了还得上班，真是受罪。
受罪.en: She has to go to work even when sick—what a misery.

湖泊.zh: 我们开车去附近的湖泊玩。
湖泊.en: We drove to a nearby lake to have fun.

湖泊.zh: 湖泊里的鱼越来越少了。
湖泊.en: The fish in the lake are越来越少.

湖泊.zh: 由于污染，很多湖泊都变脏了。
湖泊.en: Due to pollution, many lakes have become dirty.

湖泊.zh: 西藏有很多美丽的湖泊，比如纳木错。
湖泊.en: Tibet has many beautiful lakes, such as Namtso.

托付.zh: 他把孩子托付给邻居照顾。
托付.en: He entrusted his child to the neighbor's care.

托付.zh: 既然你信任我，我就托付给你了。
托付.en: Since you trust me, I'll entrust it to you.

托付.zh: 这件重要的任务，只能托付给你了。
托付.en: This important task can only be entrusted to you.

托付.zh: 她把所有存款都托付给了理财公司。
托付.en: She entrusted all her savings to the wealth management company.

列举.en: The teacher listed a few examples.

列举.zh: 在报告里，他列举了很多数据。
列举.en: In the report, he listed a lot of data.

列举.zh: 为了说服大家，他列举了三条证据。
列举.en: To convince everyone, he listed three pieces of evidence.

列举.zh: 你不要光说，具体列举出来看看。
列举.en: Don't just talk; list them out specifically and let's see.

波及.zh: 这场风暴波及了三个省。

波及.en: The price increase has affected many industries.
The pandemic has spread over a wide area.

波及.zh: 因为火灾，附近店铺都受到了波及。
波及.en: Because of the fire, nearby shops were also affected.

波及.zh: 虽然只是小问题，但波及的后果很严重。
波及.en: Although it's just a small issue, the consequences it affected are serious.

求证.en: I need to verify this information.
He verified the result with an expert.

求证.zh: 这件事得找当事人求证才行。
求证.en: We need to verify this matter with the person involved.

求证.zh: 在发布之前，一定要先求证事实。
求证.en: Before publishing, you must verify the facts.

求证.zh: 他反复求证，才敢相信这是真的。
求证.en: He verified it repeatedly before he dared to believe it was true.

素描.zh: 老师让我们带铅笔和纸来画素描。
素描.en: The teacher asked us to bring pencils and paper to draw sketches.

素描.zh: 这幅素描虽然简单，但很有感觉。
素描.en: This sketch is simple but has feeling.

素描.zh: 因为时间不够，我只画了张简单的素描。
素描.en: Because time was short, I only drew a simple sketch.

素描.zh: 他的素描作品在展览上很受欢迎。
素描.en: His sketch works were very popular at the exhibition.

公事.zh: 他出差去北京是为了办公事。
公事.en: He went to Beijing on a business trip for official business.

公事.zh: 既然是公事，我们就得认真对待。
公事.en: Since it's official business, we have to take it seriously.

公事.zh: 别老跟我谈公事，休息一下。
公事.en: Don't always talk to me about business, take a break.

公事.zh: 这件公事需要老板签字才行。
公事.en: This official matter requires the boss's signature.

烘干.zh: 下雨了，我把衣服放进烘干机里。
烘干.en: It's raining, I put the clothes in the dryer.

烘干.zh: 因为急着出门，我用烘干机把衬衫烘干了。
烘干.en: Because I was in a hurry to go out, I dried the shirt with the dryer.

烘干.zh: 这个机器可以烘干水果，做成干果。
烘干.en: This machine can dry fruit to make dried fruit.

烘干.zh: 洗完澡后记得把毛巾烘干。
烘干.en: After shower, remember to dry the towel.

详尽.zh: 他给我们做了详尽的说明，大家就明白了。
详尽.en: He gave us a detailed explanation, and everyone understood.

详尽.zh: 虽然报告很详尽，但有些地方还是不清楚。
详尽.en: Although the report is detailed, some parts are still unclear.

详尽.zh: 你要把计划写得详尽一点，避免出错。
详尽.en: You need to write the plan in more detail to avoid mistakes.

详尽.zh: 这个地图很详尽，连小路都标出来了。
详尽.en: This map is very detailed, even marking small roads.

请示.en: This matter needs to ask the manager for instructions.

请示.zh: 我不能擅自决定，得先请示一下领导。
请示.en: I can't decide on my own, I need to ask the leader first.

请示.zh: 如果你不确定，最好先请示上级再做。
请示.en: If you're not sure, better ask your superior first before doing it.

请示.zh: 他请示了老板之后才签了合同。
请示.en: He asked the boss for instructions before signing the contract.

请示.zh: 这种小事情不用请示，你自己拿主意吧。
请示.en: For such small matters, no need to ask for instructions, you decide yourself.

虚荣.zh: 她买名牌包只是为了满足虚荣心。
虚荣.en: She buys designer bags just to satisfy her vanity.

虚荣.zh: 他虽然很虚荣，但人其实不坏。
虚荣.en: Although he is very vain, he is actually not a bad person.

虚荣.zh: 我不喜欢那些虚荣的人，太假了。
虚荣.en: I don't like those vain people, too fake.

虚荣.zh: 不要因为虚荣而欠下一堆债。
虚荣.en: Don't incur a lot of debt because of vanity.

焰火.en: The fireworks at night are really beautiful.

焰火.zh: 春节那天，我们全家去看焰火表演。
焰火.en: On Spring Festival, our whole family went to watch the fireworks show.

焰火.zh: 虽然焰火很漂亮，但放完后空气会变差。
焰火.en: Although fireworks are beautiful, the air gets worse after they are set off.

焰火.zh: 城市里禁止放焰火，防止火灾。
焰火.en: Fireworks are banned in the city to prevent fires.

焰火.zh: 小朋友们看到焰火都开心地叫起来。
焰火.en: The children screamed with joy when they saw the fireworks.

索性.zh: 反正来不及了，我索性就明天再去。
索性.en: Since it's too late anyway, I'll just go tomorrow.

索性.zh: 既然他不在，我索性不等了。
索性.en: Since he's not here, I'll simply not wait.

索性.zh: 我们索性把剩下的菜都吃完吧。
索性.en: Let's just finish all the remaining dishes.

索性.zh: 她索性把头发剪短了，换了个新发型。
索性.en: She simply cut her hair short and got a new hairstyle.

彻夜.zh: 为了赶论文，我彻夜没睡。
彻夜.en: To finish the paper, I didn't sleep all night.

彻夜.zh: 因为明天要考试，他彻夜复习。
彻夜.en: Because of tomorrow's exam, he studied all night.

彻夜.zh: 邻居家彻夜放音乐，吵得我睡不着。
彻夜.en: The neighbors played music all night, keeping me awake.

彻夜.zh: 救援队彻夜工作，终于找到了失踪的人。
彻夜.en: The rescue team worked all night and finally found the missing person.

整治.zh: 政府花了大力气整治城市环境。
整治.en: The government spent a lot of effort to improve the urban environment.

整治.zh: 虽然整治工程很麻烦，但效果显著。
整治.en: Although the renovation project is troublesome, the results are significant.

整治.zh: 他们开始整治交通秩序，乱停车少了。
整治.en: They started to rectify traffic order, and illegal parking decreased.

整治.zh: 老街区经过整治后，变得干净整洁。
整治.en: After renovation, the old neighborhood became clean and tidy.

渊源.zh: 这两件事有很深的渊源。
渊源.en: These two matters have deep origins.

渊源.zh: 虽然他们来自不同国家，但文化渊源很相似。
渊源.en: Although they come from different countries, their cultural origins are very similar.

渊源.zh: 我和他其实没什么渊源，只是同事而已。
渊源.en: Actually, I have no connection with him, just colleagues.

渊源.zh: 因为历史渊源，这两个家族一直关系很好。
渊源.en: Because of historical connections, these two families have always had good relations.

渊源.zh: 你知道吗，这道菜和法国菜还有渊源呢。
渊源.en: You know, this dish has ties to French cuisine.

并列.en: The two of them tied for first place.

并列.zh: 这次比赛，他们并列获得了金牌。
并列.en: In this competition, they tied for the gold medal.

并列.zh: 两个名字并列写在名单上。
并列.en: The two names were written side by side on the list.

并列.zh: 虽然成绩相同，但他们并不是并列冠军。
并列.en: Although scores are the same, they are not co-champions.

并列.zh: 在排行榜上，这两首歌并列第三。
并列.en: On the chart, these two songs are tied for third.

交界.en: This is the border of two provinces.

交界.zh: 他们住在两个城市的交界处，上班很方便。
交界.en: They live at the border of two cities, very convenient for commuting.

交界.zh: 这条河是两国的自然交界。
交界.en: This river is the natural boundary between two countries.

交界.zh: 因为地处三省交界，这里的方言很复杂。
交界.en: Because it's located at the junction of three provinces, the dialects here are very complex.

交界.zh: 在沙漠和绿洲的交界，能看到奇特风景。
交界.en: At the border of desert and oasis, you can see peculiar scenery.

写照.en: This is a portrayal of life.

写照.zh: 这部电影是那个时代真实的写照。
写照.en: This movie is a true portrayal of that era.

写照.zh: 他的画作是城市变迁的写照。
写照.en: His paintings are a reflection of urban changes.

写照.zh: 虽然有点夸张，但这确实是他性格的写照。
写照.en: Although a bit exaggerated, this is indeed a portrayal of his personality.

写照.zh: 这张照片就是他们爱情的写照。
写照.en: This photo is a portrayal of their love.

鼓动.en: Don't incite him to do bad things.

鼓动.zh: 他一直在鼓动大家参加抗议活动。
鼓动.en: He has been inciting everyone to join the protest.
She encouraged me to quit my job and start a business.

鼓动.zh: 虽然他很热心，但我不喜欢他鼓动别人冒险。
鼓动.en: Although he is enthusiastic, I don't like him encouraging others to take risks.

鼓动.zh: 网上有人鼓动大家购买这种产品。
鼓动.en: Online, someone is inciting people to buy this product.

解围.en: Thank you for helping me out.

解围.zh: 在会议上他替我解围，我很感激。
解围.en: He helped me out at the meeting, I'm very grateful.

解围.zh: 她不知道怎么回答，还好有人解围。
解围.en: She didn't know how to answer, luckily someone saved her.

解围.zh: 因为气氛很尴尬，他主动说笑话来解围。
解围.en: Because the atmosphere was awkward, he proactively told a joke to rescue the situation.

解围.zh: 他每次遇到困难，兄弟都会来解围。
解围.en: Every time he encounters trouble, his brother comes to rescue him.

倒卖.zh: 现在打击倒卖火车票的行为很严厉。
倒卖.en: Now the crackdown on scalping train tickets is very strict.

倒卖.zh: 他靠倒卖古董赚了很多钱。
倒卖.en: He made a lot of money by illegally reselling antiques.

倒卖.zh: 虽然利润高，但倒卖彩票是违法的。
倒卖.en: Although the profit is high, scalping lottery tickets is illegal.

倒卖.zh: 有人在网上倒卖限量版球鞋。
倒卖.en: Some people are scalping limited edition sneakers online.

喜庆.zh: 过年的时候，到处都是一片喜庆的气氛。
喜庆.en: During Chinese New Year, everywhere is full of festive atmosphere.

喜庆.zh: 他们穿着喜庆的红色衣服。
虽然婚礼很简单，但气氛很喜庆。
喜庆.en: Although the wedding was simple, the atmosphere was very joyful.

喜庆.zh: 家里挂满了喜庆的装饰。
喜庆.en: The house is full of festive decorations.

基准.zh: 公司以客户满意度作为考核基准。
基准.en: The company uses customer satisfaction as the evaluation benchmark.

基准.zh: 这个数据是计算的基础基准。
基准.en: This data is the basic benchmark for calculation.

基准.zh: 虽然市场变化很快，但我们仍以这个基准来定价。
基准.en: Although the market changes quickly, we still use this benchmark for pricing.

基准.zh: 国际标准是我们制定产品的基准。
基准.en: International standards are the benchmark for our product development.

警钟.zh: 这次失败给我们敲响了警钟。
警钟.en: This failure sounded an alarm for us.

警钟.zh: 环境污染的问题已经敲响了警钟。
警钟.en: The problem of environmental pollution has sounded an alarm.

警钟.zh: 如果再不采取措施，警钟会一直响个不停。
警钟.en: If we don't take measures, the alarm will keep ringing.

警钟.zh: 这次事故为所有司机敲响了警钟。
警钟.en: This accident sounded an alarm for all drivers.

朗诵.zh: 她每天晚上都要朗诵课文。
朗诵.en: She recites the text every evening.

朗诵.zh: 我喜欢听老师朗诵散文，因为很有感情。
朗诵.en: I like listening to the teacher recite essays because it's very emotional.

朗诵.zh: 这次朗诵比赛他得了第一名，大家都为他高兴。
朗诵.en: He won first place in this recitation competition, and everyone was happy for him.

朗诵.zh: 虽然她有点紧张，但还是把这首词朗诵得很动人。
朗诵.en: Although she was a bit nervous, she still recited this poem very touchingly.

显赫.en: This general comes from a prominent background.

显赫.zh: 他虽然出身显赫，但为人很谦虚。
显赫.en: Although he comes from a prominent family, he is very modest.

显赫.zh: 在那个年代，他们家算是非常显赫的望族了。
显赫.en: In that era, his family was considered a very prominent clan.

显赫.zh: 他取得了显赫的成就，却从不炫耀。
显赫.en: He achieved illustrious accomplishments, but never boasts about them.

窍门.en: There are many little tricks in cooking.

窍门.zh: 他教了我一个换轮胎的窍门，特别实用。
窍门.en: He taught me a trick for changing tires that is especially useful.

窍门.zh: 如果你掌握了窍门，这件事做起来就快多了。
窍门.en: If you master the knack, this task will be much faster.

窍门.zh: 学习外语的窍门就是多说多练，没有捷径。
窍门.en: The key to learning a foreign language is to speak and practice more; there are no shortcuts.

燕子.en: In spring, the swallows fly back.
There's a swallow's nest under the eaves.

燕子.zh: 燕子每年冬天都会飞到南方去。
燕子.en: Every winter, swallows fly to the south.

燕子.zh: 那只燕子衔来树枝，正在筑巢呢。
燕子.en: That swallow is carrying twigs and building a nest.

燕子.zh: 小时候我总爱看燕子低飞，因为那意味着要下雨了。
燕子.en: When I was young, I always liked watching swallows fly low because it meant it was going to rain.

如愿以偿.zh: 考上大学后，她算是如愿以偿了。
如愿以偿.en: After being admitted to university, she had her wish fulfilled.

如愿以偿.zh: 他努力了三年，终于如愿以偿地当上了飞行员。
如愿以偿.en: He worked hard for three years and finally achieved his wish of becoming a pilot.

如愿以偿.zh: 这次旅行虽然很累，但看到了极光，也算如愿以偿。
如愿以偿.en: Although this trip was very tiring, seeing the aurora borealis fulfilled my wish.

如愿以偿.zh: 她一直想拥有一只猫，这个月终于如愿以偿领养了一只。
如愿以偿.en: She always wanted to have a cat, and this month she finally got her wish and adopted one.

就医.zh: 如果发烧超过三天，一定要及时就医。
就医.en: If the fever lasts more than three days, be sure to see a doctor promptly.

就医.zh: 这家医院环境很好，很多人选择来此就医。
就医.en: This hospital has a good environment; many people choose to come here for treatment.

就医.zh: 他因为腹痛难忍，半夜就去医院就医了。
就医.en: He went to the hospital for treatment in the middle of the night because of unbearable abdominal pain.

就医.zh: 虽然只是小伤，但为了避免感染，还是建议尽快就医。
就医.en: Although it's just a minor injury, it's still recommended to see a doctor as soon as possible to avoid infection.

熄火.zh: 他踩离合的时候熄火了。
熄火.en: He stalled when he stepped on the clutch.

熄火.zh: 老张的车在半路上熄火了，他只好打电话求助。
熄火.en: Old Zhang's car stalled on the way, so he had to call for help.

熄火.zh: 炉子里的火已经熄火了，得重新点。
熄火.en: The fire in the stove has gone out; it needs to be re-lit.

熄火.zh: 因为没油了，发动机在高速上突然熄火，太危险了。
熄火.en: Because it ran out of fuel, the engine suddenly stalled on the highway; it was too dangerous.

缴纳.en: Please pay the tuition on time.

缴纳.zh: 每个月都要缴纳水电费。
缴纳.en: You have to pay the utility bills every month.

缴纳.zh: 他们公司每年都要缴纳大笔税款。
缴纳.en: Their company has to pay a large amount of taxes every year.

缴纳.zh: 如果你逾期未缴纳罚款，会被加收滞纳金。
缴纳.en: If you fail to pay the fine on time, a late fee will be added.

缴纳.zh: 现在很多费用都可以在网上缴纳，方便多了。
缴纳.en: Now many fees can be paid online, which is much more convenient.

歌颂.zh: 他在文章里歌颂了母爱。
歌颂.en: In his essay, he extolled maternal love.

歌颂.zh: 这首歌歌颂了那些默默奉献的志愿者。
歌颂.en: This song sings the praises of those selfless volunteers.

歌颂.zh: 他们写了许多作品来歌颂英雄的事迹。
歌颂.en: They wrote many works to extol the deeds of heroes.

歌颂.zh: 虽然这部电影歌颂了爱情，但我觉得情节有点老套。
歌颂.en: Although this movie sings the praises of love, I think the plot is a bit cliché.

强加.zh: 别把你的想法强加给我。
强加.en: Don't impose your ideas on me.

强加.zh: 家长不该把自己的梦想强加给孩子。
强加.en: Parents shouldn't impose their own dreams on their children.

强加.zh: 他总喜欢把责任强加在别人身上。
强加.en: He always likes to impose responsibility on others.

强加.zh: 这种制度是强加给人民的，大家都不满意。
强加.en: This system was imposed on the people, and everyone is dissatisfied.

强加.zh: 你不想去就算了，我不会强加任何要求给你。
强加.en: If you don't want to go, that's fine; I won't impose any requirements on you.

迁就.zh: 为了大家方便，我只好迁就一下。
迁就.en: For everyone's convenience, I had to accommodate a bit.

迁就.zh: 他从来不愿意迁就别人，所以朋友很少。
迁就.en: He never wants to accommodate others, so he has few friends.
This kind of thing cannot be casually accommodated.

迁就.zh: 虽然我不喜欢这个安排，但还是决定迁就一下。
迁就.en: Although I don't like this arrangement, I still decided to accommodate.

团员.en: He is an excellent league member.

团员.zh: 我们班的团员都参加了这次志愿活动。
团员.en: All the league members in our class participated in this volunteer activity.
League members should take the lead.

团员.zh: 这次会议只有团员才能参加，其他人不行。
团员.en: This meeting is only for league members, others cannot attend.

团员.zh: 他刚加入共青团，成了一名新团员。
团员.en: He just joined the Communist Youth League and became a new member.

推论.zh: 根据这些证据，我们可以得出一个合理的推论。
推论.en: Based on these evidences, we can reach a reasonable inference.

推论.zh: 他的推论听起来很有道理，但实际未必正确。
推论.en: His inference sounds reasonable, but it may not be correct in reality.

推论.zh: 你得出这个推论的时候，有没有考虑过其他可能性？
推论.en: When you made this inference, did you consider other possibilities?

空隙.zh: 两辆车之间的空隙太小，我过不去。
空隙.en: The gap between the two cars is too small, I can't get through.

空隙.zh: 他利用工作的空隙休息了一会儿。
空隙.en: He used a break in work to rest for a while.
There is a gap in the wall.

空隙.zh: 在会议的空隙，他出去打了个电话。
空隙.en: During a break in the meeting, he went out to make a phone call.

怨言.en: He has no complaints at all.

怨言.zh: 她虽然很累，但一句怨言都没有。
怨言.en: Although she was very tired, she didn't utter a single complaint.

怨言.zh: 大家对加班这件事怨言很多。
怨言.en: Everyone has a lot of complaints about working overtime.

怨言.zh: 他默默做了所有工作，从不说怨言。
怨言.en: He silently did all the work, never complaining.

陈列.zh: 这些文物在博物馆陈列。
陈列.en: These artifacts are displayed in the museum.

陈列.zh: 商店橱窗里陈列着最新款的手机。
陈列.en: The latest mobile phones are displayed in the shop window.

陈列.zh: 这个展厅陈列了很多书法作品。
陈列.en: This exhibition hall displays many calligraphy works.
The goods are displayed very neatly.

陈列.zh: 为了吸引顾客，他们把商品陈列得特别漂亮。
陈列.en: To attract customers, they displayed the goods particularly beautifully.

一连.en: He sneezed three times in a row.

一连.zh: 我们一连下了好几天雨，都没法出门。
一连.en: We had rain for several consecutive days, couldn't go out.

一连.zh: 他一连考了五次才通过。
一连.en: He took the exam five times in a row before passing.
She ate three bowls of rice in a row.

一连.zh: 这周我一连加了四天班，累坏了。
一连.en: This week I worked overtime for four consecutive days, exhausted.

查处.en: The illegal case has been investigated and dealt with.

查处.zh: 有关部门正在查处这家公司的偷税行为。
查处.en: Relevant departments are investigating and dealing with this company's tax evasion.

查处.zh: 这次查处行动非常严厉，很多人被罚款。
查处.en: This investigation and punishment action was very strict, many people were fined.

查处.zh: 违规行为必须严肃查处。
查处.en: Violations must be seriously investigated and dealt with.

查处.zh: 接到举报后，执法部门迅速查处了那家黑店。
查处.en: After receiving the report, law enforcement quickly investigated and shut down that shady shop.

拉拢.en: He wants to win me over to join them.

拉拢.zh: 为了竞选，他一直在拉拢中间选民。
拉拢.en: For the election, he has been trying to win over swing voters.

拉拢.zh: 他靠请客吃饭来拉拢同事关系。
拉拢.en: He uses treating coworkers to meals to win them over.

拉拢.zh: 别试图拉拢他，他很有原则。
拉拢.en: Don't try to win him over, he is very principled.

拉拢.zh: 对方公司想用高薪拉拢我们的技术人员。
拉拢.en: The other company wants to use high salaries to poach our technical staff.

告示.en: A notice was posted at the door.

告示.zh: 小区的告示栏里写着停水通知。
告示.en: The notice board in the community has a water outage notice.

告示.zh: 他看了一眼告示就走了。
告示.en: He glanced at the notice and left.

告示.zh: 公司发了一则告示，提醒大家注意安全。
告示.en: The company issued a notice reminding everyone to pay attention to safety.

干事.zh: 他是我们部门的干事，负责日常事务。
干事.en: He is the secretary of our department, responsible for daily affairs.

干事.zh: 新来的干事很认真，大家都很喜欢他。
干事.en: The new secretary is very conscientious, and everyone likes him.

干事.zh: 作为学生会干事，他经常组织活动。
干事.en: As a student union secretary, he often organizes activities.

干事.zh: 这个干事做事麻利，效率很高。
干事.en: This secretary works quickly and efficiently.

干事.zh: 我们选他当干事，因为他有经验。
干事.en: We elected him as secretary because he has experience.

世代.en: Their family has been doctors for generations.

世代.zh: 这个村庄世代以种茶为生。
世代.en: This village has lived on tea farming for generations.

世代.zh: 世代相传的手艺快失传了。
世代.en: The craft passed down through generations is about to be lost.

世代.zh: 他们家族世代居住在这里，从没有搬过。
世代.en: Their family has lived here for generations and never moved.

世代.zh: 虽然世代务农，但他想出去闯一闯。
世代.en: Although his family has been farmers for generations, he wants to go out and explore.

造福.zh: 这个项目造福了全村的人。
造福.en: This project has benefited the entire village.

造福.zh: 科学家们努力造福人类。

造福.en: Building this road will benefit future generations.

造福.zh: 这项政策旨在造福百姓，改善生活。
造福.en: This policy aims to benefit the people and improve their lives.

造福.zh: 他们希望新技术能造福更多贫困地区。
造福.en: They hope the new technology can benefit more impoverished areas.

不懈.zh: 他一直不懈地追求梦想。
不懈.en: He has been unremittingly pursuing his dream.

不懈.zh: 经过不懈的努力，他终于成功了。
不懈.en: Through unremitting efforts, he finally succeeded.

不懈.zh: 她的不懈精神值得学习。
不懈.en: Her unremitting spirit is worth learning from.

不懈.zh: 我们要坚持不懈，才能取得好成绩。
不懈.en: We must persevere unremittingly to achieve good results.

不懈.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，他都不懈奋斗。
不懈.en: No matter what difficulties he encounters, he fights unremittingly.

宽阔.zh: 他的心胸很宽阔，从不计较。
宽阔.en: He is broad-minded and never fusses over things.
This grassland is vast and boundless.

宽阔.zh: 新修的广场非常宽阔，可以容纳很多人。
宽阔.en: The newly built square is very spacious and can hold many people.

宽阔.zh: 虽然房间不大，但窗户让视野很宽阔。
宽阔.en: Although the room is small, the windows give a broad view.

拨通.en: I dialed and got through to his phone.
It took several tries to get through.
Did you get through? No one answered.

拨通.zh: 他拨通客服电话后等了很久。
拨通.en: He waited a long time after getting through to customer service.

拨通.zh: 因为信号不好，我拨通好几次才成功。
拨通.en: Because the signal was bad, I tried several times before successfully getting through.

叫好.zh: 他的表演赢得大家叫好。
叫好.en: His performance won applause from everyone.

叫好.zh: 魔术师一出手，全场叫好。
叫好.en: As soon as the magician performed, the whole audience cheered.

叫好.zh: 这部新电影口碑很好，观众纷纷叫好。
叫好.en: This new movie has a good reputation, and audiences are cheering.

叫好.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但球迷还是为他的努力叫好。
叫好.en: Although the game was lost, the fans still cheered for his efforts.

药方.en: The doctor gave me a prescription.

药方.zh: 这个药方很有效，吃几天就好了。
药方.en: This prescription is very effective; I got better after a few days.

药方.zh: 中药方子一般比较复杂。
药方.en: Traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions are generally quite complex.

药方.zh: 他拿着药方去药店抓药。
药方.en: He took the prescription to the pharmacy to get the medicine.

药方.zh: 老中医根据我的症状开了这个药方。
药方.en: The old Chinese doctor prescribed this based on my symptoms.

泄密.en: He was fired for leaking secrets.

泄密.zh: 公司的重要文件不能泄密。
泄密.en: The company's important documents must not be leaked.

泄密.zh: 这次泄密事件影响很大。
泄密.en: This leak incident has had a big impact.

泄密.zh: 谁泄密了？一定要查清楚。
泄密.en: Who leaked the secret? We must get to the bottom of it.

泄密.zh: 为了防止泄密，他们加强了安保措施。
泄密.en: To prevent leaks, they strengthened security measures.

寓意.en: This story has a profound moral.

寓意.zh: 你知道这个成语的寓意吗？
寓意.en: Do you know the implied meaning of this idiom?
The dove in the painting symbolizes peace.

寓意.zh: 这部电影的寓意是珍惜眼前人。
寓意.en: The message of this movie is to cherish the people in front of you.

寓意.zh: 他讲了一个寓言，希望我们能明白其中的寓意。
寓意.en: He told a fable, hoping we would understand its moral.

高调.en: He always does things in a high-profile way.

高调.zh: 她不喜欢高调的生活，只想安静过日子。
高调.en: She doesn't like a high-profile life; she just wants to live quietly.

高调.zh: 别这么高调，小心惹麻烦。
高调.en: Don't be so loud, or you might get into trouble.

高调.zh: 虽然他很高调，但大家都很喜欢他。
高调.en: Although he is high-profile, everyone still likes him.

高调.zh: 他高调宣布了辞职的消息。
高调.en: He loudly announced the news of his resignation.

烹调.en: He likes to cook for himself.

烹调.zh: 烹调这道菜需要很多耐心。
烹调.en: Cooking this dish requires a lot of patience.

烹调.zh: 妈妈教我怎么烹调海鲜汤。
烹调.en: Mom taught me how to cook seafood soup.

烹调.zh: 除了烹调，他对其他家务都不感兴趣。
烹调.en: Apart from cooking, he is not interested in any other housework.

烹调.zh: 这家餐厅的烹调手法很特别。
烹调.en: The cooking technique at this restaurant is very special.

顺势.en: He took the opportunity to lie down on the sofa.

顺势.zh: 看到机会，他顺势提出了自己的要求。
顺势.en: Seeing the opportunity, he took the chance to make his request.
Only by going with the flow can you succeed.

顺势.zh: 她顺着他的话顺势说了下去。
顺势.en: She followed his words and continued naturally.

顺势.zh: 既然大家都不反对，我就顺势同意了。
顺势.en: Since no one objected, I went ahead and agreed.

投掷.en: He threw the javelin with force.

投掷.zh: 在比赛中，投掷距离最远的人获胜。
投掷.en: In the competition, the person who throws the farthest wins.

投掷.zh: 他练习投掷手臂已经酸痛了。
投掷.en: His arm is already sore from practicing throwing.

投掷.zh: 投掷时要注意姿势，否则容易受伤。
投掷.en: When throwing, pay attention to your posture, otherwise you might get hurt.

上调.en: The company decided to raise wages.
I heard oil prices are going up.

上调.zh: 今年租金上调了百分之十。
上调.en: This year the rent increased by ten percent.

上调.zh: 因为成本增加，产品价格不得不小幅上调。
上调.en: Due to increased costs, product prices had to be raised slightly.

上调.zh: 老板说下个月开始上调奖金。
上调.en: The boss said bonuses will be raised starting next month.

挂念.zh: 妈妈一直挂念着在外地读书的我。
挂念.en: Mom has always been worried about me studying in another city.

挂念.zh: 别挂念，我会照顾好自己的。
挂念.en: Don't worry, I'll take care of myself.

挂念.zh: 虽然分开很久，但她仍然挂念着老朋友。
挂念.en: Although they've been apart for a long time, she still misses her old friend.

挂念.zh: 看到照片，我又开始挂念起家乡。
挂念.en: Seeing the photo, I started missing my hometown again.

放水.en: He intentionally went easy during the game.
The swimming pool is draining water for cleaning today.
Don't go easy on me, compete seriously.

放水.zh: 他考试放水，故意让同桌抄。
放水.en: He went easy on the test and deliberately let his deskmate copy.

放水.zh: 为了公平，裁判不能对任何选手放水。
放水.en: For fairness, the referee cannot go easy on any contestant.

电讯.en: This telecom message is very important.
He reads telecom news every day.
The company mainly does telecommunications business.

电讯.zh: 电讯技术的发展改变了我们的生活。
电讯.en: The development of telecommunications technology has changed our lives.

电讯.zh: 昨天收到一封电讯，说航班取消了。
电讯.en: Yesterday I received a telegram saying the flight was canceled.

坝.en: The flood destroyed the embankment dam.

坝.zh: 他们在河上修建了一座大坝。
坝.en: They built a large dam on the river.

坝.zh: 大坝可以发电，也能防洪。
坝.en: A dam can generate electricity and also prevent floods.

坝.zh: 坝上的风景非常漂亮，很多人去拍照。
坝.en: The scenery on the dam is very beautiful, and many people go there to take photos.

解析.zh: 这个公式需要仔细解析。
你可以帮我解析一下这个句子吗？
解析.en: Can you help me parse this sentence?

解析.zh: 解析数据时，他发现了一个错误。
解析.en: While analyzing the data, he found an error.

解析.zh: 除了解析文本，还要注意语境。
解析.en: In addition to analyzing the text, you also need to pay attention to the context.

算账.zh: 他总喜欢算账，连几分钱都算清楚。
算账.en: He always likes to calculate, even counting every cent.

算账.zh: 等吃完饭，我们再算账也不迟。
算账.en: After we finish eating, it's not too late to settle the bill.

算账.zh: 你这么做，小心我以后跟你算账。
算账.en: If you do this, be careful I'll get even with you later.

算账.zh: 每个月月底我都要算账，看看花了多少钱。
算账.en: At the end of each month, I have to calculate expenses and see how much I spent.

绿地.en: This green space is really big.

绿地.zh: 城市里应该多建一些绿地，让空气更好。
绿地.en: There should be more green spaces in the city to improve the air.

绿地.zh: 虽然市中心很繁华，但缺少绿地。
绿地.en: Although the city center is bustling, it lacks green space.

绿地.zh: 周末我们去公园的绿地野餐吧。
绿地.en: Let's have a picnic on the grass in the park this weekend.

绿地.zh: 小区的绿地被改造成了停车场，真可惜。
绿地.en: The green space in the community was turned into a parking lot, what a pity.

愚昧.zh: 愚昧无知的人往往容易被骗。
愚昧.en: Ignorant and uneducated people are often easily deceived.

愚昧.zh: 因为愚昧，他们相信了那些谣言。
愚昧.en: Because of ignorance, they believed those rumors.

愚昧.zh: 这种愚昧的观念早就该淘汰了。
愚昧.en: This kind of ignorant concept should have been eliminated long ago.

愚昧.zh: 她不是愚昧，只是没接受过教育。
愚昧.en: She's not ignorant, just never had education.

一言不发.en: He sat there without saying a word.

一言不发.zh: 她听完消息后，一言不发地离开了房间。
一言不发.en: After hearing the news, she left the room without saying a word.

一言不发.zh: 尽管大家都在讨论，他却一言不发。
一言不发.en: Although everyone was discussing, he didn't say a word.

一言不发.zh: 老师问他问题，他只是一言不发地摇头。
一言不发.en: The teacher asked him a question, and he just shook his head without a word.

一言不发.zh: 整场会议他都是一言不发，气氛很尴尬。
一言不发.en: Throughout the entire meeting, he didn't say a word, and the atmosphere was awkward.

诸如此类.zh: 他喜欢收集邮票、硬币诸如此类的小东西。
诸如此类.en: He likes collecting stamps, coins, and small things like that.

诸如此类.zh: 你要学会拒绝，诸如此类的无理要求不要答应。
诸如此类.en: You need to learn to refuse; don't agree to unreasonable requests like that.

诸如此类.zh: 他总是迟到、早退，诸如此类的坏习惯很多。
诸如此类.en: He is always late, leaves early, and has many bad habits like that.

诸如此类.zh: 诸如此类的例子，我还能举出很多。
诸如此类.en: I can give many more examples of this kind.

门路.zh: 找工作需要门路，光靠自己很难。
门路.en: Finding a job requires connections; it's hard by yourself.

门路.zh: 他虽然没学历，但门路很多，所以混得不错。
门路.en: Although he has no degree, he has many connections, so he's doing well.
To do business, you first have to figure out the ropes.

门路.zh: 他找到了买便宜机票的门路。
门路.en: He found a way to buy cheap airplane tickets.

字迹.zh: 他的字迹工整，一看就是个认真的人。
字迹.en: His handwriting is neat, and you can tell he's a careful person.

字迹.zh: 虽然年代久远，但信上的字迹依然清晰。
字迹.en: Although it's been a long time, the handwriting on the letter is still clear.

字迹.zh: 警察根据字迹找到了嫌疑人。
字迹.en: The police found the suspect based on the handwriting.

字迹.zh: 你写的字迹太乱，我根本看不清。
字迹.en: Your handwriting is too messy; I can't read it at all.

推移.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们的关系越来越淡。
推移.en: As time goes by, their relationship fades more and more.

推移.zh: 随着季节推移，天气变得越来越冷。
推移.en: As the seasons change, the weather gets colder.

推移.zh: 社会的推移带来了很多变化。
推移.en: The passage of society has brought many changes.

推移.zh: 别担心，事情会随着时间推移而好转。
推移.en: Don't worry, things will improve with the passage of time.

死心.zh: 他试了三次都失败，终于死心了。
死心.en: He tried three times and failed, finally giving up.

死心.zh: 如果你不让我死心，我就会一直等下去。
死心.en: If you don't make me give up, I'll keep waiting.

死心.zh: 她对那份工作已经死心了。
死心.en: She has given up hope on that job.

死心.zh: 你最好早点死心，别浪费时间和精力。
死心.en: You'd better give up early, don't waste time and energy.

犹豫不决.zh: 她犹豫不决，不知道该选哪个专业。
犹豫不决.en: She is indecisive, not knowing which major to choose.

犹豫不决.zh: 因为他犹豫不决，错过了最好的机会。
犹豫不决.en: Because he hesitated, he missed the best opportunity.

犹豫不决.zh: 别犹豫不决了，快做决定吧。
犹豫不决.en: Stop hesitating, make a decision quickly.

犹豫不决.zh: 面对两个offer，他犹豫不决了好几天。
犹豫不决.en: Facing two job offers, he hesitated for several days.

燃气.en: Do you use gas at home?

燃气.zh: 我家的燃气灶坏了，得找人修。
燃气.en: My gas stove broke, I need to get someone to fix it.

燃气.zh: 因为燃气泄漏很危险，所以一定要定期检查。
燃气.en: Because gas leaks are very dangerous, you must check regularly.

燃气.zh: 这个小区已经通燃气了，很方便。
燃气.en: This neighborhood already has gas connected, it's very convenient.

燃气.zh: 用燃气做饭比用电快多了。
燃气.en: Cooking with gas is much faster than with electricity.

洽谈.zh: 经过多次洽谈，双方终于达成了协议。
洽谈.en: After many negotiations, both parties finally reached an agreement.

洽谈.zh: 虽然洽谈很顺利，但我们还需要再考虑一下。
洽谈.en: Although the negotiation went smoothly, we still need to think it over.

洽谈.zh: 这次洽谈关系到公司的未来。
洽谈.en: This negotiation concerns the future of the company.

洽谈.zh: 他正在和客户洽谈新项目的细节。
洽谈.en: He is negotiating details of the new project with the client.

人文.zh: 这个城市有很丰富的人文资源。
人文.en: This city has very rich cultural and human resources.

人文.zh: 除了自然科学，我对人文也很感兴趣。
人文.en: Besides natural sciences, I'm also interested in humanities.

人文.zh: 了解当地的人文风俗能帮我们更好地旅行。
人文.en: Understanding local human customs helps us travel better.

人文.zh: 这所大学的人文专业在全国很有名。
人文.en: This university's humanities program is very famous nationwide.

口才.zh: 做销售需要很好的口才。
口才.en: Being in sales requires very good speaking skills.

口才.zh: 虽然他有口才，但内容不充实。
口才.en: Although he is eloquent, his content is not substantial.

口才.zh: 她的口才让她在辩论赛中脱颖而出。
口才.en: Her eloquence made her stand out in the debate competition.

口才.zh: 多练习演讲可以提高口才。
口才.en: Practicing speeches more can improve your eloquence.

脱口而出.zh: 听到这个问题，他脱口而出说不知道。
脱口而出.en: Upon hearing this question, he blurted out that he didn't know.

脱口而出.zh: 我本想保持沉默，但话却脱口而出。
脱口而出.en: I intended to stay silent, but the words just blurted out.

脱口而出.zh: 别什么都脱口而出，先想一想再说。
脱口而出.en: Don't just blurt out everything, think before you speak.

脱口而出.zh: 她看到礼物时脱口而出“哇，真漂亮！”。
脱口而出.en: When she saw the gift, she blurted out 'Wow, so beautiful!'

周旋.zh: 在复杂的局面中，他很会周旋。
周旋.en: In complex situations, he knows how to maneuver well.

周旋.zh: 为了拿到合同，他不得不和客户周旋。
周旋.en: To get the contract, he had to maneuver with the client.

周旋.zh: 她在职场中周旋于各个部门之间。
周旋.en: She maneuvers between various departments in the workplace.

周旋.zh: 与其到处周旋，不如直接解决问题。
周旋.en: Instead of maneuvering all around, it's better to solve the problem directly.

遗物.zh: 她在整理母亲遗物时发现了旧照片。
遗物.en: While sorting her mother's belongings, she found old photos.

遗物.zh: 虽然这些遗物不值钱，但很有纪念意义。
遗物.en: Although these relics are not valuable, they are very meaningful.

遗物.zh: 他决定把爷爷的遗物捐给博物馆。
遗物.en: He decided to donate his grandfather's relics to the museum.

遗物.zh: 每件遗物都承载着一段回忆。
遗物.en: Each relic carries a piece of memory.

伊斯兰教.zh: 伊斯兰教有特殊的饮食规定。
因为朋友是伊斯兰教徒，所以我们要尊重他们的习俗。
伊斯兰教.en: Because our friend is Muslim, we need to respect their customs.

伊斯兰教.zh: 伊斯兰教是世界上最主要的宗教之一。
伊斯兰教.en: Islam is one of the world's major religions.

伊斯兰教.zh: 她最近在学习伊斯兰教的历史。
伊斯兰教.en: She has been studying the history of Islam recently.

专著.zh: 这本专著研究了中国古代文化。
专著.en: This monograph studies ancient Chinese culture.

专著.zh: 虽然专著内容专业，但普通读者也能看懂。
专著.en: Although the monograph's content is professional, ordinary readers can understand it too.

专著.zh: 她的专著在学术界引起了很大反响。
专著.en: Her monograph caused a great response in academia.

专著.zh: 写一本专著需要花费很多时间和精力。
专著.en: Writing a monograph takes a lot of time and effort.

消沉.en: He has been very depressed lately.

消沉.zh: 考试失败后，他变得很消沉。
消沉.en: After failing the exam, he became very dejected.

消沉.zh: 虽然遇到挫折，但他没有一直消沉下去。
消沉.en: Although he encountered setbacks, he didn't stay dejected forever.

消沉.zh: 她消沉了好几天，终于想通了。
消沉.en: She was down for several days, but finally came to terms with it.

消沉.zh: 朋友的支持让他走出了消沉的情绪。
消沉.en: His friends' support helped him get out of his depressed mood.

仅次于.en: His score is second only to mine.

仅次于.zh: 这家公司的规模仅次于行业巨头，发展很快。
仅次于.en: The scale of this company is second only to the industry giant, and it's growing fast.

仅次于.zh: 在亚洲，日本的经济实力仅次于中国。
仅次于.en: In Asia, Japan's economic strength is second only to China.

仅次于.zh: 虽然他的名气仅次于老板，但权力不大。
仅次于.en: Although his fame is second only to the boss, he doesn't have much power.

仅次于.zh: 这个城市的房价仅次于北京，非常高。
仅次于.en: The housing prices in this city are second only to Beijing, very high.

通畅.zh: 吃了这个药后，我的呼吸变得通畅多了。
通畅.en: After taking this medicine, my breathing became much smoother.

通畅.zh: 只要信号通畅，视频会议就没问题。
通畅.en: As long as the signal is smooth, the video conference will be fine.

通畅.zh: 下水道终于通畅了，不再堵了。
通畅.en: The sewer is finally clear, no longer blocked.

通畅.zh: 他的思路很通畅，写文章很快。
通畅.en: His train of thought is very smooth, he writes articles quickly.

肆无忌惮.zh: 这些人在公共场所肆无忌惮地大声喧哗。
肆无忌惮.en: These people are making noise unscrupulously in public places.

肆无忌惮.zh: 因为没人管，他们就更加肆无忌惮了。
肆无忌惮.en: Because no one is in charge, they become even more unscrupulous.

肆无忌惮.zh: 她肆无忌惮地批评别人的缺点，让人很不舒服。
肆无忌惮.en: She unscrupulously criticizes others' shortcomings, making people very uncomfortable.

肆无忌惮.zh: 在网络发言也要注意，不能肆无忌惮。
肆无忌惮.en: When speaking online, you also need to be careful, not be unscrupulous.

历时.zh: 这次比赛历时两个月，终于结束了。
历时.en: This competition lasted two months and finally ended.

历时.zh: 虽然历时很长，但大家都很满意结果。
历时.en: Although it took a long time, everyone was satisfied with the result.

历时.zh: 他历时一年写完了这部小说。
历时.en: He spent a year writing this novel.

历时.zh: 这次旅行历时一周，我们去了很多地方。
历时.en: This trip lasted a week; we went to many places.

纵横.en: He has been active in the business world for many years.

纵横.zh: 这个城市的地铁线路纵横交错，非常方便。
纵横.en: The subway lines in this city crisscross, very convenient.

纵横.zh: 他虽然年轻，但在政界已经纵横自如。
纵横.en: Although young, he already moves freely in politics.

纵横.zh: 这些河流纵横在平原上，灌溉了农田。
纵横.en: These rivers crisscross the plain, irrigating the farmland.

纵横.zh: 他在棋坛纵横十几年，无人能敌。
纵横.en: He has dominated the chess world for over a decade, unmatched.

载体.en: Language is the carrier of culture.

载体.zh: 互联网成了信息传播的主要载体。
载体.en: The internet has become the main carrier of information dissemination.

载体.zh: 这本书不仅是知识的载体，也是情感的寄托。
载体.en: This book is not only a carrier of knowledge but also an emotional sustenance.

载体.zh: 纸币是商品交换的载体之一。
载体.en: Paper money is one of the carriers of commodity exchange.

载体.zh: 病毒可以通过空气作为载体传播。
载体.en: Viruses can spread through air as a carrier.

个案.en: This is just an exceptional case.

个案.zh: 我们不能因为一个个案就否定整个团队。
个案.en: We cannot deny the entire team because of one individual case.

个案.zh: 虽然这是个案，但也值得重视。
个案.en: Although this is an individual case, it's worth paying attention to.

个案.zh: 警察在调查这个个案，暂时没有结果。
个案.en: The police are investigating this case, no results yet.

个案.zh: 每个患者的治疗方案都要根据个案来定。
个案.en: Each patient's treatment plan should be determined based on individual cases.

茎.en: The stem of this flower is very thick.

茎.zh: 植物的茎负责输送水分和养分。
茎.en: The stem of a plant is responsible for transporting water and nutrients.

茎.zh: 虽然叶子枯萎了，但茎还是绿色的。
茎.en: Although the leaves withered, the stem is still green.

茎.zh: 这种蔬菜的茎也可以吃。
茎.en: The stem of this vegetable is also edible.

茎.zh: 他把花茎剪短了，插在花瓶里。
茎.en: He cut the flower stem short and put it in a vase.

成家.zh: 很多年轻人现在不愿意太早成家。
成家.en: Many young people now are unwilling to start a family too early.

成家.zh: 虽然事业重要，但成家也是人生大事。
成家.en: Although career is important, starting a family is also a major life event.

成家.zh: 她成家后就把重心放在家庭上了。
成家.en: After starting a family, she shifted her focus to the family.

成家.zh: 在古代，男子二十岁左右就要成家。
成家.en: In ancient times, men would start a family around age twenty.

调和.en: They need to reconcile the conflict.

调和.zh: 这个调料能很好地调和各种味道。
调和.en: This seasoning can blend various flavors well.

调和.zh: 虽然两人意见不合，但经理出面调和他们。
调和.en: Although the two disagree, the manager steps in to mediate them.

调和.zh: 饮食要均衡，注意调和营养。
调和.en: Diet should be balanced, pay attention to blending nutrition.

调和.zh: 色彩搭配需要调和，不能太突兀。
调和.en: Color matching needs to be harmonious, not too abrupt.

油腻.zh: 这个菜太油腻了，我吃不下。
油腻.en: This dish is too greasy; I can't eat it.

油腻.zh: 他头发油腻腻的，好像几天没洗。
油腻.en: His hair is greasy, as if he hasn't washed it for days.

油腻.zh: 夏天少吃油腻的东西，对身体好。
油腻.en: Eat less greasy food in summer; it's good for your health.

油腻.zh: 虽然炸鸡很香，但吃多了会觉得油腻。
油腻.en: Although fried chicken is delicious, eating too much will make you feel greasy.

油腻.zh: 你最近的饮食太油腻了，建议多吃点蔬菜。
油腻.en: Your diet has been too oily lately; I suggest eating more vegetables.

迟缓.zh: 老人走路有些迟缓，需要人扶着。
迟缓.en: The old man walks a bit slowly and needs someone to support him.

迟缓.zh: 网络信号不好，视频加载特别迟缓。
迟缓.en: The network signal is poor, so the video loads very slowly.

迟缓.zh: 由于资金问题，工程的进展非常迟缓。
迟缓.en: Due to funding issues, the progress of the project is very slow.

迟缓.zh: 他虽然年纪大了，但思维一点也不迟缓。
迟缓.en: Although he is old, his thinking is not slow at all.

稀奇.zh: 动物园里来了只白色的孔雀，很稀奇。
稀奇.en: A white peacock came to the zoo; it's very rare.

稀奇.zh: 现在智能手机不稀奇，谁都有。
稀奇.en: Smartphones are not rare anymore; everyone has one.

稀奇.zh: 他讲了个稀奇的见闻，大家都听呆了。
稀奇.en: He told a strange story, and everyone was stunned.

稀奇.zh: 这种花在当地很常见，但在北方就稀奇了。
稀奇.en: This flower is common locally, but it's rare in the north.

迎面.en: A cold wind blew right into my face.

迎面.zh: 我刚出门，就迎面碰见邻居。
迎面.en: As soon as I went out, I ran into my neighbor face to face.

迎面.zh: 他迎面走来，笑着跟我打招呼。
迎面.en: He walked towards me and greeted me with a smile.

迎面.zh: 开车时注意迎面来的车辆，安全第一。
迎面.en: When driving, watch out for oncoming vehicles; safety first.

迎面.zh: 跑完步后，迎面喝了一大杯水，感觉很爽。
迎面.en: After running, I drank a big glass of water directly, and it felt great.

威信.en: He has great authority in the company.

威信.zh: 老师要是偏心，就会失去威信。
威信.en: If a teacher is partial, they will lose their prestige.

威信.zh: 他做事公平，所以在同事中威信很高。
威信.en: He is fair in his work, so he has high prestige among colleagues.

威信.zh: 这个领导言行不一，早就没有威信了。
威信.en: This leader's words don't match his actions; he lost his authority long ago.

威信.zh: 新来的经理想靠打压员工建立威信，结果没人服他。
威信.en: The new manager tried to build authority by suppressing employees, but no one respects him.

五星级.zh: 我们住了一晚五星级酒店，服务特别好。
五星级.en: We stayed one night at a five-star hotel, and the service was excellent.

五星级.zh: 五星级餐厅的菜虽然贵，但味道确实好。
五星级.en: Although the food at five-star restaurants is expensive, it really tastes good.

五星级.zh: 他出差从来只住五星级酒店，太奢侈了。
五星级.en: He only stays in five-star hotels on business trips; it's too extravagant.

五星级.zh: 这个度假村不是五星级的，但环境比五星级还舒服。
五星级.en: This resort is not five-star, but the environment is more comfortable than a five-star one.

一目了然.en: This table is clear at a glance.

一目了然.zh: 他把重点标红了，看起来一目了然。
一目了然.en: He marked the key points in red, making it clear at a glance.

一目了然.zh: 你把这个数据做成图表，大家就能一目了然了。
一目了然.en: If you make this data into a chart, everyone can see it at a glance.

一目了然.zh: 说明书写得太复杂，根本不是一目了然。
一目了然.en: The manual is too complicated to be clear at a glance.

一目了然.zh: 这个网站的导航设计得很好，功能分区一目了然。
一目了然.en: This website's navigation is well designed, with functional areas clear at a glance.

火速.zh: 公司失火了，大家火速撤离。
火速.en: The company caught fire, and everyone evacuated immediately.

火速.zh: 收到命令后，部队火速出发了。
火速.en: After receiving the order, the troops set off at top speed.

火速.zh: 医院接到急救电话，火速派出了救护车。
火速.en: The hospital received an emergency call and dispatched an ambulance immediately.

火速.zh: 老板要求我们火速完成这个任务，不能有任何拖延。
火速.en: The boss asked us to complete this task immediately, with no delay.

举足轻重.en: He plays a crucial role in the team.

举足轻重.zh: 这个项目对公司的发展举足轻重。
举足轻重.en: This project is of vital importance to the company's development.

举足轻重.zh: 教育在一个国家的未来中举足轻重。
举足轻重.en: Education plays a pivotal role in a country's future.

举足轻重.zh: 别小看这个职位，它在整个流程中举足轻重。
举足轻重.en: Don't underestimate this position; it is crucial in the entire process.

举足轻重.zh: 虽然他只是个助理，但在这个团队里举足轻重。
举足轻重.en: Although he is just an assistant, he is pivotal in this team.

大纲.zh: 演讲之前，他先列了一个大纲。
大纲.en: Before the speech, he made an outline.

大纲.zh: 这个教学大纲需要根据学生情况调整。
大纲.en: This teaching syllabus needs to be adjusted according to the students' situation.

大纲.zh: 写作前最好有大纲，不然容易跑题。
大纲.en: It's best to have an outline before writing, otherwise you can easily go off topic.

大纲.zh: 公司发布了新一年的工作大纲，所有人都要遵守。
大纲.en: The company released the work outline for the new year, and everyone must follow it.

亮丽.en: Today's sky is really bright and beautiful.

亮丽.zh: 她穿了一条亮丽的裙子。
亮丽.en: She wore a bright and beautiful dress.

亮丽.zh: 这束花颜色很亮丽，而且香味也特别好闻。
亮丽.en: This bouquet of flowers has bright colors, and the scent is also particularly pleasant.

亮丽.zh: 虽然城市很繁华，但山里的景色更亮丽自然。
亮丽.en: Although the city is bustling, the mountain scenery is brighter and more natural.

亮丽.zh: 新装修的客厅亮丽又时尚，朋友来了都夸好看。
亮丽.en: The newly renovated living room is bright and stylish; friends all complimented it when they came.

舒畅.en: After taking a shower, I feel really comfortable.

舒畅.zh: 今天心情特别舒畅，因为天气很好。
舒畅.en: Today I'm in a particularly good mood because the weather is nice.

舒畅.zh: 在公园里散步，呼吸新鲜空气，整个人都舒畅多了。
舒畅.en: Taking a walk in the park and breathing fresh air makes me feel much more relaxed.

舒畅.zh: 他说完那些话以后，心里总算舒畅了。
舒畅.en: After he said those words, he finally felt at ease.

舒畅.zh: 工作压力大的时候，听听音乐能让心情变得舒畅一些。
舒畅.en: When work pressure is high, listening to music can make your mood a bit more relaxed.

应有尽有.zh: 这家超市东西应有尽有。
应有尽有.en: This supermarket has everything you could want.

应有尽有.zh: 那个商场很大，品牌应有尽有。
应有尽有.en: That mall is huge, with all kinds of brands available.

应有尽有.zh: 他家的厨房设备齐全，厨具应有尽有。
应有尽有.en: His kitchen is fully equipped with all kinds of cookware.

应有尽有.zh: 虽然房间不大，但家具和电器应有尽有，住着很方便。
应有尽有.en: Although the room is not big, it has all the furniture and appliances, making it very convenient to live in.

应有尽有.zh: 新开的图书馆藏书丰富，从小说到专业书籍应有尽有。
应有尽有.en: The newly opened library has a rich collection, from novels to professional books, everything you need.

验收.en: The project will be inspected and accepted tomorrow.

验收.zh: 他们正在验收新买的设备。
验收.en: They are checking and accepting the newly purchased equipment.

验收.zh: 等验收合格以后，房子才能正式交付使用。
验收.en: Only after the inspection passes can the house be officially handed over for use.

验收.zh: 这批货需要先验收再付款，这是公司的规定。
验收.en: This batch of goods needs to be inspected before payment; that's the company's rule.

验收.zh: 验收的时候发现了一些小问题，所以推迟了交房时间。
验收.en: Some minor issues were found during the inspection, so the handover of the house was delayed.

威风.en: He looks very imposing in his military uniform.

威风.zh: 那只老虎走路的样子真威风。
威风.en: That tiger has a really majestic way of walking.

威风.zh: 虽然个子不高，但他说起话来特别有威风。
威风.en: Although he is not tall, he speaks with great authority.

威风.zh: 旧时的将军骑着马，举着旗子，看起来十分威风。
威风.en: In old times, generals riding horses and holding flags looked very awe-inspiring.

威风.zh: 他在公司里是领导，平时挺威风的，不过对员工很客气。
威风.en: He is a leader in the company, usually quite imposing, but he is very polite to employees.

镶嵌.zh: 戒指上镶嵌了一颗钻石。
镶嵌.en: A diamond is set into the ring.

镶嵌.zh: 这座建筑的外墙镶嵌着金色装饰。
镶嵌.en: The exterior wall of this building is inlaid with gold decorations.

镶嵌.zh: 她那条项链上镶嵌了很多小珍珠，看起来很精致。
镶嵌.en: Her necklace is inlaid with many small pearls, looking very exquisite.

镶嵌.zh: 设计师把彩色玻璃镶嵌在窗户上，形成了美丽图案。
镶嵌.en: The designer inlaid colored glass into the windows, forming beautiful patterns.

镶嵌.zh: 虽然宝石很小，但镶嵌工艺很讲究，所以整体效果特别好。
镶嵌.en: Although the gemstones are small, the inlay craftsmanship is very meticulous, so the overall effect is particularly good.

无忧无虑.zh: 小孩子总是无忧无虑的。
真怀念小时候无忧无虑的日子。
无忧无虑.en: I really miss the carefree days of childhood.

无忧无虑.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他心态好，每天过得无忧无虑。
无忧无虑.en: Although work is very busy, he has a good attitude and lives each day without worries.

无忧无虑.zh: 在农村生活节奏慢，老人每天种花养鸟，无忧无虑。
无忧无虑.en: Life in the countryside is slow; the elderly plant flowers and raise birds every day, carefree.

无忧无虑.zh: 她最大的愿望就是一家人健康平安，无忧无虑地生活。
无忧无虑.en: Her biggest wish is for her family to be healthy and safe, living without worries.

气派.zh: 他开了一辆很气派的豪华车。
气派.en: He drives a very impressive luxury car.

气派.zh: 婚礼办得很气派，请了很多人来参加。
气派.en: The wedding was held in a grand style, with many people invited.

气派.zh: 虽然这家餐厅不大，但装修很有气派，像高级酒店一样。
气派.en: Although this restaurant is not big, the decoration is very grand, like a high-end hotel.

气派.zh: 新开的文化中心外观气派，里面设施也很先进，大家都去参观。
气派.en: The newly opened cultural center has a grand appearance with advanced facilities inside; everyone goes to visit.

固有.en: This is an inherent characteristic of the culture.

固有.zh: 每个人都有固有的性格，很难完全改变。
固有.en: Everyone has an inherent personality that is hard to completely change.

固有.zh: 虽然科技发展了，但某些传统观念是固有存在的。
固有.en: Although technology has developed, some traditional concepts inherently exist.

固有.zh: 这个地区固有的风俗习惯，外来的游客应该尊重。
固有.en: Visitors should respect the inherent customs and habits of this region.

固有.zh: 语言中的固有表达方式反映了当地人的思维方式。
固有.en: The inherent expressions in a language reflect the way local people think.

似曾相识.zh: 那个人我觉得似曾相识。
似曾相识.en: I feel like I've seen that person before.

似曾相识.zh: 这个场景让我有似曾相识的感觉。
似曾相识.en: This scene gives me a sense of déjà vu.

似曾相识.zh: 虽然第一次来这个地方，但总觉得似曾相识，好像梦里来过。
似曾相识.en: Although it's my first time here, I always feel a sense of familiarity, as if I've been here in a dream.

似曾相识.zh: 听到这首歌，我产生了一种似曾相识的回忆。
似曾相识.en: Hearing this song, I had a memory that felt familiar.

似曾相识.zh: 他的笑容让我觉得似曾相识，但一时想不起在哪见过。
似曾相识.en: His smile made me feel familiar, but I couldn't recall where I had seen it.

朴实.zh: 这家餐厅装修得很朴实，但菜很好吃。
朴实.en: This restaurant is decorated very simply, but the food is delicious.

朴实.zh: 虽然她穿得很朴实，但气质特别好。
朴实.en: Although she dresses very plainly, her temperament is very good.

朴实.zh: 他说话很朴实，从来不夸张。
朴实.en: He speaks very plainly and never exaggerates.

朴实.zh: 我喜欢这种朴实的生活，没有太多花哨的东西。
朴实.en: I like this simple life, without too many fancy things.

呼啸.zh: 火车呼啸着从隧道里冲了出来。
呼啸.en: The train rushed out of the tunnel with a roar.

呼啸.zh: 外面狂风呼啸，我不敢出门。
呼啸.en: The wind is howling outside, so I dare not go out.

呼啸.zh: 赛车呼啸而过，声音震耳欲聋。
呼啸.en: The racing car whizzed by with a deafening sound.

呼啸.zh: 暴风雨来临时，海浪呼啸着拍打岸边。
呼啸.en: When the storm came, the waves roared and crashed against the shore.

担子.zh: 作为家里的顶梁柱，他肩上的担子不轻。
担子.en: As the pillar of the family, the burden on his shoulders is not light.

担子.zh: 老板把这么重要的项目交给我，我觉得担子很重。
担子.en: The boss entrusted me with such an important project, and I feel the burden is heavy.

担子.zh: 她一个人照顾三个孩子，担子真的很大。
担子.en: She takes care of three children alone, and the burden is really heavy.

担子.zh: 既然你接下了这个任务，就要扛起这个担子。
担子.en: Since you have taken on this task, you must bear the burden.

喧闹.zh: 我不喜欢喧闹的环境，更喜欢安静的地方。
喧闹.en: I don't like noisy environments, I prefer quiet places.

喧闹.zh: 孩子们在操场上喧闹地跑来跑去。
喧闹.en: The children are running around noisily on the playground.

喧闹.zh: 虽然市场里很喧闹，但这也是一种生活气息。
喧闹.en: Although the market is very noisy, it also has a sense of life.

喧闹.zh: 派对太喧闹了，我们换个地方聊天吧。
喧闹.en: The party is too noisy, let's change places to chat.

随处可见.en: This kind of flower can be seen everywhere.

随处可见.zh: 在这个城市里，共享单车随处可见。
随处可见.en: In this city, shared bikes can be seen everywhere.

随处可见.zh: 现在低头族随处可见，大家都在看手机。
随处可见.en: Nowadays, phone addicts can be seen everywhere, everyone is looking at their phones.

随处可见.zh: 街边的小吃摊随处可见，很方便。
随处可见.en: Street food stalls can be seen everywhere, very convenient.
