随处可见.zh: 因为广告牌随处可见，所以大家很容易记住这个品牌。
随处可见.en: Because billboards can be seen everywhere, people easily remember this brand.

俗话说.zh: 俗话说，早睡早起身体好。
俗话说.en: As the saying goes, early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy.

俗话说.zh: 俗话说得好，失败是成功之母，你别灰心。
俗话说.en: As the saying goes, failure is the mother of success, don't lose heart.

俗话说.zh: 俗话说，远亲不如近邻，我们要和邻居搞好关系。
俗话说.en: As the saying goes, a close neighbor is better than a distant relative, we should get along with neighbors.

俗话说.zh: 俗话说，天下没有不散的筵席，我们总会再见的。
俗话说.en: As the saying goes, all good things must come to an end, we will meet again.

俗话说.zh: 俗话说，一寸光阴一寸金，我们要珍惜时间。
俗话说.en: As the saying goes, time is gold, we should cherish time.

对白.zh: 电影里的对白很自然，就像平时聊天一样。
对白.en: The dialogue in the movie is very natural, just like everyday conversation.

对白.zh: 他背台词的时候，对白记得特别熟。
对白.en: When he memorizes lines, he remembers the dialogue very well.

对白.zh: 这部话剧的对白既幽默又感人。
对白.en: The dialogue in this play is both humorous and touching.

对白.zh: 我觉得他们俩在剧中的对白特别有趣。
对白.en: I think the dialogue between the two of them in the show is especially interesting.

礼节.zh: 去别人家做客时，带点小礼物是一种礼节。
礼节.en: When visiting someone's home, bringing a small gift is a courtesy.

礼节.zh: 在正式场合，我们需要注意餐桌礼节。
礼节.en: In formal occasions, we need to pay attention to table manners.

礼节.zh: 虽然他是外国人，但对中国的礼节非常尊重。
礼节.en: Although he is a foreigner, he respects Chinese etiquette very much.

礼节.zh: 握手时看着对方的眼睛，这是一种基本的社交礼节。
礼节.en: Looking into the other person's eyes when shaking hands is a basic social etiquette.

调侃.zh: 朋友之间互相调侃很正常，但要注意分寸。
调侃.en: It's normal for friends to tease each other, but you need to know the limits.

调侃.zh: 他说话很幽默，总能恰到好处地调侃一下。
调侃.en: He speaks humorously and always manages to tease just right.

调侃.zh: 你不要老是调侃他的口音，他会不高兴的。
调侃.en: Don't keep teasing him about his accent, he will get upset.

调侃.zh: 在节目里，主持人经常调侃嘉宾来活跃气氛。
调侃.en: On the show, the host often teases the guests to liven up the atmosphere.

一心一意.zh: 谈恋爱的时候，要一心一意对待对方。
一心一意.en: When in a relationship, you should treat the other person wholeheartedly.

一心一意.zh: 他做事总是三心二意，不像我弟弟那样一心一意。
一心一意.en: He always does things half-heartedly, unlike my younger brother who is wholehearted.

一心一意.zh: 为了考上理想的大学，她一心一意地复习。
一心一意.en: In order to get into her ideal university, she reviewed wholeheartedly.

一心一意.zh: 我希望你能一心一意地把这个项目做好，不要分心。
一心一意.en: I hope you can focus wholeheartedly on this project and not get distracted.

本着.zh: 本着公平的原则，我们分了这笔钱。
本着.en: Based on the principle of fairness, we divided this money.

本着.zh: 他本着互相帮助的精神，主动留下来加班。
本着.en: He stayed overtime voluntarily, guided by the spirit of mutual help.

本着.zh: 咱们做事要本着良心，不能为了钱什么都干。
本着.en: We should act according to our conscience and not do anything for money.

本着.zh: 公司本着对客户负责的态度，免费更换了产品。
本着.en: The company, acting with a sense of responsibility toward customers, replaced the product for free.

本着.zh: 虽然条件艰苦，但他本着坚持到底的信念，终于完成了任务。
本着.en: Despite the tough conditions, he held on to the belief of persevering to the end and finally completed the task.

败坏.zh: 他到处说假话，名声都败坏了。
败坏.en: He lies everywhere, and his reputation is ruined.

败坏.zh: 这种酒放太久，味道已经败坏了。
败坏.en: This wine has been stored too long; the taste has gone bad.

败坏.zh: 别让这些谣言败坏了我们之间的信任。
败坏.en: Don't let these rumors ruin the trust between us.

败坏.zh: 几个坏学生败坏了整个班级的风气。
败坏.en: A few bad students have corrupted the entire class atmosphere.

败坏.zh: 他为了利益不择手段，完全败坏了家族的名声。
败坏.en: He stopped at nothing for profit, completely disgracing the family's reputation.

骨干.en: He is the backbone of our team.

骨干.zh: 公司培养了一批年轻骨干。
骨干.en: The company has trained a group of young core members.

骨干.zh: 这次项目全靠几个骨干在撑着。
骨干.en: This project is全靠 a few key members holding it up.

骨干.zh: 作为技术骨干，他经常加班解决难题。
骨干.en: As a technical backbone, he often works overtime to solve difficult problems.

骨干.zh: 这些骨干员工不仅能力强，而且责任心也很强。
骨干.en: These core employees not only have strong abilities but also a strong sense of responsibility.

机舱.zh: 空姐正在机舱里发餐食。
机舱.en: The flight attendant is serving meals in the cabin.

机舱.zh: 飞机起飞前请检查机舱行李架。
机舱.en: Please check the overhead bins in the cabin before takeoff.

机舱.zh: 他坐在机舱最后一排，靠着窗户。
机舱.en: He sat in the last row of the cabin, by the window.

机舱.zh: 因为气流不稳，机舱里响起乘客的尖叫声。
机舱.en: Because of turbulence, screams from passengers echoed through the cabin.

荣获.zh: 这部电影荣获了三项大奖。
荣获.en: This film won three major awards.

荣获.zh: 她凭借出色的表演荣获最佳女主角。
荣获.en: She won Best Actress for her outstanding performance.

荣获.zh: 公司在环保方面荣获了国家级表彰。
荣获.en: The company received national recognition for environmental protection.

荣获.zh: 虽然竞争激烈，但他最终还是荣获了冠军。
荣获.en: Although the competition was fierce, he ultimately won the championship.

健美.en: She has a fit and toned body.

健美.zh: 他每天去健身房练健美。
健美.en: He goes to the gym every day to work on bodybuilding.

健美.zh: 健美比赛上，选手们展示了肌肉线条。
健美.en: At the bodybuilding competition, the contestants showed off their muscle definition.

健美.zh: 除了健美，她还喜欢练瑜伽保持柔韧。
健美.en: Besides bodybuilding, she also likes yoga to maintain flexibility.

健美.zh: 长期坚持锻炼让他的体形变得非常健美。
健美.en: Long-term consistent exercise has made his physique very fit and muscular.

官僚主义.zh: 这家公司的官僚主义很严重。
官僚主义.en: The bureaucracy in this company is very serious.

官僚主义.zh: 办个证件要跑好几趟，真是官僚主义。
官僚主义.en: Having to go back and forth several times to get a certificate is really bureaucratic.

官僚主义.zh: 为了对付官僚主义，他们简化了审批流程。
官僚主义.en: To combat bureaucracy, they simplified the approval process.

官僚主义.zh: 如果继续搞官僚主义，工作效率永远提不高。
官僚主义.en: If bureaucracy continues, work efficiency will never improve.

乞求.en: He is begging for alms on the roadside.

乞求.zh: 她用乞求的眼神看着我。
乞求.en: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

乞求.zh: 孩子乞求妈妈再给一颗糖。
乞求.en: The child begged Mom for one more candy.

乞求.zh: 他跪在地上乞求原谅，但没有人理他。
乞求.en: He knelt on the ground begging for forgiveness, but no one paid attention.

乞求.zh: 我不想乞求任何人，我只靠自己的努力。
乞求.en: I don't want to beg anyone; I rely only on my own efforts.

标致.zh: 他女朋友是个很标致的姑娘。
标致.en: His girlfriend is a very handsome girl.

标致.zh: 这家店的装修风格很标致，让人眼前一亮。
标致.en: The decor style of this shop is quite elegant and eye-catching.

标致.zh: 那个小男孩五官长得很标致，像个小明星。
标致.en: That little boy has very delicate features, like a little star.

巫婆.en: Witches are always evil in stories.

巫婆.zh: 村里有个老巫婆，会算命。
巫婆.en: There's an old witch in the village who tells fortunes.

巫婆.zh: 童话里的巫婆把公主变成了青蛙。
巫婆.en: The witch in the fairy tale turned the princess into a frog.

巫婆.zh: 她打扮得像个巫婆，把小孩都吓哭了。
巫婆.en: She dressed up like a witch and scared the children into crying.

巫婆.zh: 别信那个巫婆的话，她只是骗钱而已。
巫婆.en: Don't believe what that witch says; she's just scamming money.

预赛.en: When does the preliminary competition start?

预赛.zh: 他虽然在预赛里表现很好，但决赛没发挥好。
预赛.en: Although he performed well in the preliminaries, he didn't do well in the finals.

预赛.zh: 预赛的对手很强，我们要认真准备。
预赛.en: The opponents in the preliminaries are very strong, we need to prepare carefully.

预赛.zh: 这次比赛预赛和决赛的规则不太一样。
预赛.en: The rules for the preliminaries and finals in this competition are a bit different.

预赛.zh: 我们队预赛赢了，希望决赛也能赢。
预赛.en: Our team won the preliminaries, hope we can also win the finals.

下级.zh: 作为下级，你要服从上级的安排。
下级.en: As a subordinate, you must follow your superior's arrangements.

下级.zh: 这个下级员工做事很认真。
下级.en: This junior employee is very serious in his work.

下级.zh: 因为他是下级，所以不能直接提意见。
下级.en: Because he is a subordinate, he can't directly give opinions.

下级.zh: 我当了三年下级，终于升职了。
下级.en: I was a subordinate for three years, and finally got promoted.

资历.zh: 在这家公司，资历比能力更重要。
资历.en: At this company, seniority is more important than ability.

资历.zh: 虽然你资历比我老，但也不能随便批评我。
资历.en: Although you are more senior than me, you can't just criticize me casually.

资历.zh: 他的资历虽然不够，但能力很强。
资历.en: Although his seniority is insufficient, he is very capable.

资历.zh: 招聘的时候，我们更看重资历。
资历.en: When recruiting, we value seniority more.

冲撞.zh: 开车时突然冲撞护栏，太危险了。
冲撞.en: Suddenly crashing into the guardrail while driving is too dangerous.

冲撞.zh: 你说话这么冲，很容易冲撞别人。
冲撞.en: You speak so bluntly, it's easy to offend others.

冲撞.zh: 因为他的态度太差，所以经常冲撞客户。
冲撞.en: Because his attitude is too bad, he often offends clients.

冲撞.zh: 这次冲撞事故导致两人受伤。
冲撞.en: This collision accident caused two people to be injured.

贬值.zh: 二手房买完就贬值，所以要慎重。
贬值.en: Second-hand houses depreciate right after purchase, so be cautious.

贬值.zh: 因为经济不好，很多国家的货币都在贬值。
贬值.en: Because of the bad economy, the currencies of many countries are depreciating.

贬值.zh: 这种手机贬值很快，建议你别买。
贬值.en: This type of phone depreciates quickly; I suggest you don't buy it.

贬值.zh: 虽然新车开起来很舒服，但贬值太快了。
贬值.en: Although a new car is comfortable to drive, it depreciates too quickly.

奠定.zh: 他这次成功奠定了自己在公司的地位。
奠定.en: This success of his established his position in the company.

奠定.zh: 良好的习惯为成功奠定了坚实的基础。
奠定.en: Good habits lay a solid foundation for success.

奠定.zh: 这一战奠定了他们夺冠的格局。
奠定.en: This battle established their pattern of winning the championship.

奠定.zh: 如果我们现在努力，就能为未来奠定好基础。
奠定.en: If we work hard now, we can lay a good foundation for the future.

含蓄.zh: 中国人表达感情通常比较含蓄。
含蓄.en: Chinese people usually express emotions in a relatively reserved way.

含蓄.zh: 他说话很含蓄，你要仔细琢磨。
含蓄.en: He speaks very implicitly; you need to think carefully.

含蓄.zh: 因为性格含蓄，她很少直接说喜欢。
含蓄.en: Because of her reserved personality, she rarely says she likes something directly.

含蓄.zh: 这首诗写得很含蓄，需要慢慢品味。
含蓄.en: This poem is written in a very implicit style, needing to be savored slowly.

热气球.en: The hot air balloon has taken off.

热气球.zh: 我们坐热气球看日出，特别浪漫。
热气球.en: We watched the sunrise from a hot air balloon; it was very romantic.

热气球.zh: 热气球比赛吸引了很多人来观看。
热气球.en: The hot air balloon race attracted many people to watch.

热气球.zh: 如果天气好的话，热气球就能升空。
热气球.en: If the weather is good, the hot air balloon can ascend.

热气球.zh: 虽然我没坐过热气球，但很想试试。
热气球.en: Although I have never ridden a hot air balloon, I really want to try it.

挟持.zh: 劫匪挟持了一名乘客当人质。
挟持.en: The robber took a passenger hostage.

挟持.zh: 警察成功解救被挟持的银行职员。
挟持.en: The police successfully rescued the bank employee who was held hostage.

挟持.zh: 因为被挟持，他不得不听从歹徒的命令。
挟持.en: Because he was hijacked, he had to obey the gangster's orders.

挟持.zh: 在电影里，主角被坏人挟持到荒岛。
挟持.en: In the movie, the protagonist was kidnapped by the bad guys to a deserted island.

增值.zh: 这几年黄金增值很快，很多人投资。
增值.en: Gold has been appreciating quickly in recent years, so many people invest in it.

增值.zh: 这个地区的房产一直在增值，值得购买。
增值.en: Real estate in this area has been appreciating steadily; it's worth buying.

增值.zh: 如果你买了这个基金，几年后它就会增值。
增值.en: If you buy this fund, it will appreciate in value after a few years.

增值.zh: 学好一门外语，能为你的能力增值。
增值.en: Learning a foreign language well can increase the value of your abilities.

鲁莽.en: He is too reckless in doing things.

鲁莽.zh: 别这么鲁莽，先想想后果。
鲁莽.en: Don't be so reckless; think about the consequences first.

鲁莽.zh: 他虽然很鲁莽，但心地善良。
鲁莽.en: Although he is reckless, he has a kind heart.

鲁莽.zh: 他因为鲁莽的决定，把工作都丢了。
鲁莽.en: He lost his job because of a reckless decision.

鲁莽.zh: 鲁莽驾驶很容易出事故。
鲁莽.en: Reckless driving easily leads to accidents.

倚.en: He leaned against the wall and smoked.

倚.zh: 她倚在窗边看外面的风景。
倚.en: She leaned by the window to look at the scenery outside.

倚.zh: 老人家倚着拐杖在公园里慢慢散步。
倚.en: The old man slowly walked in the park, leaning on his cane.

倚.zh: 他虽然倚着墙，但还是站不稳。
倚.en: Although he leaned against the wall, he still couldn't stand steadily.

打喷嚏.zh: 他打喷嚏的时候要捂住嘴。
打喷嚏.en: He should cover his mouth when he sneezes.

打喷嚏.zh: 因为过敏，她一直打喷嚏。
打喷嚏.en: Because of allergies, she keeps sneezing.

打喷嚏.zh: 在公共场合打喷嚏很不礼貌。
打喷嚏.en: Sneezing in public is very rude.

打喷嚏.zh: 如果你打喷嚏，记得用手肘挡住。
打喷嚏.en: If you sneeze, remember to block it with your elbow.

理事.en: He is a director of our company.
The directors are having a meeting to discuss.

理事.zh: 新选出的理事明天就职。
理事.en: The newly elected director will take office tomorrow.

理事.zh: 这个理事负责财务方面的工作。
理事.en: This director is responsible for financial work.

理事.zh: 虽然他是理事，但从不摆架子。
理事.en: Although he is a director, he never puts on airs.

搁浅.en: The negotiations stalled because of disagreements.

搁浅.zh: 那艘货轮在浅滩搁浅了。
搁浅.en: That cargo ship ran aground on the shoal.

搁浅.zh: 项目因为资金问题搁浅了。
搁浅.en: The project stalled due to funding issues.

搁浅.zh: 由于天气恶劣，他们的计划搁浅了。
搁浅.en: Due to bad weather, their plan was stranded.

杜绝.en: We must put an end to waste.

杜绝.zh: 我们必须杜绝这种坏习惯。
杜绝.en: We must eliminate this bad habit.

杜绝.zh: 公司必须采取措施杜绝腐败。
杜绝.en: The company must take measures to eliminate corruption.

杜绝.zh: 只有加强管理才能杜绝漏洞。
杜绝.en: Only by strengthening management can we eliminate loopholes.

杜绝.zh: 如果我们不杜绝浪费，资源会越来越少。
杜绝.en: If we don't eradicate waste, resources will become fewer and fewer.

招标.zh: 这个项目已经公开招标了。
招标.en: This project has already been publicly bid.

招标.zh: 因为这次招标很重要，所以大家都很重视。
招标.en: Because this bid invitation is very important, everyone takes it seriously.

招标.zh: 很多公司都参与了这次招标。
招标.en: Many companies participated in this bid invitation.

招标.zh: 招标文件需要仔细阅读。
招标.en: The bidding documents need to be read carefully.

停业.zh: 因为疫情，很多餐馆停业了。
停业.en: Many restaurants closed due to the pandemic.

停业.zh: 他们决定暂时停业装修。
停业.en: They decided to temporarily close for renovations.

停业.zh: 那家超市已经停业一个月了。
停业.en: That supermarket has been closed for a month.

停业.zh: 这家店虽然停业了，但还会重新开张。
停业.en: Although this shop has closed, it will reopen again.

高龄.en: He is already of advanced age.

高龄.zh: 这位高龄老人身体很好。
高龄.en: This elderly person is in good health.

高龄.zh: 高龄产妇需要注意安全。
高龄.en: Elderly pregnant women need to pay attention to safety.

高龄.zh: 爷爷虽然高龄，但精神很好。
高龄.en: Although Grandpa is old, he is in good spirits.

高龄.zh: 因为母亲高龄，他决定回家照顾她。
高龄.en: Because his mother is of advanced age, he decided to go home and take care of her.

红火.zh: 虽然竞争激烈，但他们的生意依然红火。
红火.en: Although competition is fierce, their business is still flourishing.

红火.zh: 他们的网店做得非常红火。
红火.en: Their online store is doing very well.

红火.zh: 因为口碑好，生意越来越红火。
红火.en: Because of good word of mouth, business is getting more and more prosperous.

红火.zh: 春节前后，年货市场很红火。
红火.en: Around the Spring Festival, the New Year goods market is very busy.

检讨.zh: 因为迟到，他必须在会上做检讨。
检讨.en: Because he was late, he had to do a self-criticism at the meeting.
You need to seriously examine yourself.

检讨.zh: 虽然很难，但他还是认真检讨了错误。
检讨.en: Although it was hard, he still seriously examined his mistakes.

检讨.zh: 我觉得你应该先检讨一下自己的态度。
检讨.en: I think you should first examine your own attitude.

哀求.en: He begged her not to leave.

哀求.zh: 孩子哀求妈妈再买一个玩具。
哀求.en: The child begged his mom to buy one more toy.

哀求.zh: 虽然很丢脸，但他还是哀求老板给他一次机会。
哀求.en: Although it was embarrassing, he still begged the boss to give him a chance.

哀求.zh: 她跪在地上哀求警察放过她的丈夫。
哀求.en: She knelt on the ground begging the police to let her husband go.

拟定.zh: 公司正在拟定新的发展计划。
拟定.en: The company is formulating a new development plan.

拟定.zh: 如果大家同意，我们就按拟定的方案执行。
拟定.en: If everyone agrees, we'll execute according to the formulated plan.

拟定.zh: 他负责拟定这次会议的议程安排。
拟定.en: He is responsible for drawing up the agenda for this meeting.

目瞪口呆.zh: 看到那个惊人的消息，大家都目瞪口呆。
目瞪口呆.en: Seeing that shocking news, everyone was dumbfounded.

目瞪口呆.zh: 因为结果太意外，他整个人目瞪口呆说不出话。
目瞪口呆.en: Because the result was too unexpected, he was completely dumbfounded and couldn't speak.

目瞪口呆.zh: 魔术师的表演让观众目瞪口呆，全场鸦雀无声。
目瞪口呆.en: The magician's performance left the audience stunned, the whole place silent.

派别.en: There are many factions in the company.

派别.zh: 这个政党内部有不同派别在争斗。
派别.en: Within this political party, different factions are fighting.
Which faction does he belong to?

派别.zh: 虽然大家同属一个组织，但派别之间的矛盾很深。
派别.en: Although everyone belongs to the same organization, the conflicts between factions are deep.

派别.zh: 艺术界里不同的派别有着完全不同的风格。
派别.en: Different schools in the art world have completely different styles.

才干.zh: 公司需要更多有才干的年轻人。
才干.en: The company needs more capable young people.
Competence is more important than education.

才干.zh: 虽然他不善言辞，但他的才干让所有人佩服。
才干.en: Although he is not good at speaking, his ability impresses everyone.

才干.zh: 这次项目正好展示了他的领导才干。
才干.en: This project just showed his leadership ability.

裁缝.zh: 我找裁缝帮我改一下裙子。
裁缝.en: I asked the tailor to alter my skirt.

裁缝.zh: 虽然这件衣服很贵，但裁缝的手工不值这个价。
裁缝.en: Although this clothes is expensive, the tailor's workmanship is not worth the price.

裁缝.zh: 老裁缝做了几十年衣服，手艺非常精湛。
裁缝.en: The old tailor has been making clothes for decades, his skill is superb.

时事.en: I like watching current affairs news.

时事.zh: 他对国际时事非常了解。
时事.en: He knows a lot about international current affairs.

时事.zh: 因为工作忙，我很少关注时事。
时事.en: Because I'm busy with work, I rarely pay attention to current affairs.

时事.zh: 学校每周都会组织讨论时事的活动。
时事.en: The school organizes current affairs discussion activities every week.

化肥.en: Farmers use chemical fertilizer to farm.

化肥.zh: 使用太多化肥会污染土壤。
化肥.en: Using too much chemical fertilizer will pollute the soil.
This kind of chemical fertilizer is very effective.

化肥.zh: 虽然化肥能提高产量，但长期使用对土地不好。
化肥.en: Although chemical fertilizer can increase yield, long-term use is bad for the land.

化肥.zh: 今年化肥价格涨了不少，农民负担加重了。
化肥.en: This year the price of chemical fertilizer has risen a lot, increasing the burden on farmers.

门铃.en: Go see who is ringing the doorbell.

门铃.zh: 因为家里没装门铃，客人只能敲门。
门铃.en: Because there is no doorbell installed at home, guests can only knock.

门铃.zh: 我买了一个带摄像头的新门铃。
门铃.en: I bought a new doorbell with a camera.

雄厚.en: This company has very strong financial resources.

雄厚.zh: 虽然对手实力雄厚，但我们还是赢了。
雄厚.en: Although the opponent had strong capabilities, we still won.

雄厚.zh: 他家的背景雄厚，所以找工作很容易。
雄厚.en: His family background is powerful, so finding a job is easy for him.

雄厚.zh: 那个国家的军事实力非常雄厚。
雄厚.en: That country's military strength is very formidable.

雄厚.zh: 因为技术力量雄厚，他们能快速开发新产品。
雄厚.en: Because their technical strength is robust, they can quickly develop new products.

回忆录.en: He is writing his own memoir.

回忆录.zh: 这本回忆录记录了他的一生。
回忆录.en: This memoir records his entire life.

回忆录.zh: 她的回忆录里写了很多有趣的故事。
回忆录.en: Her memoir contains many interesting stories.

回忆录.zh: 我读过那位作家的回忆录。
回忆录.en: I have read that writer's memoir.

回忆录.zh: 退休后他打算出一本回忆录。
回忆录.en: After retirement, he plans to publish a memoir.

贴切.zh: 你用的那个词不太贴切。
贴切.en: The word you used is not very appropriate.

贴切.zh: 我觉得“狐狸”这个形容对她来说很贴切。
贴切.en: I think the description 'fox' is very fitting for her.

贴切.zh: 虽然说得简单，但非常贴切。
贴切.en: Although said simply, it's very appropriate.

贴切.zh: 他找了一个很贴切的例子来解释这个问题。
贴切.en: He found a very apt example to explain this problem.

饱和.en: Saturated fat is not good for health.

饱和.zh: 因为游客太多，景区已经饱和了。
饱和.en: Because there are too many tourists, the scenic area is already saturated.

饱和.zh: 我们需要避免让资源达到饱和状态。
饱和.en: We need to avoid letting resources reach a saturated state.

饱和.zh: 这个行业竞争激烈，几乎饱和了。
饱和.en: This industry is fiercely competitive and almost saturated.

扩建.en: The school is expanding the playground.

扩建.zh: 因为学生增多，他们决定扩建教学楼。
扩建.en: Because the number of students increased, they decided to expand the teaching building.

扩建.zh: 这个机场计划明年扩建。
扩建.en: This airport plans to expand next year.

扩建.zh: 工厂扩建后产量会翻倍。
扩建.en: After the factory expansion, output will double.

扩建.zh: 小区扩建了一个儿童游乐区。
扩建.en: The community expanded and added a children's play area.

松树.en: There are many pine trees on the mountain.
This pine tree has grown especially tall.
In winter, pine trees are still green.
I like the smell of pine trees.

松树.zh: 院子里的那棵松树已经一百年了。
松树.en: That pine tree in the yard is already a hundred years old.

一成不变.en: Life cannot stay the same forever.

一成不变.zh: 他每天都做一样的事，太一成不变了。
一成不变.en: He does the same thing every day; it's too monotonous.

一成不变.zh: 虽然制度是一成不变的，但我们可以改变方法。
一成不变.en: Although the system is fixed, we can change the methods.

一成不变.zh: 这个世界没有一成不变的东西。
一成不变.en: There is nothing in this world that is unchanging.

一成不变.zh: 她不喜欢一成不变的生活，总想尝试新鲜事物。
一成不变.en: She doesn't like a monotonous life and always wants to try new things.

养殖.en: He farms pearls by the sea.

养殖.zh: 这家公司专门做水产养殖。
因为技术先进，他们的养殖效率很高。
养殖.en: Because of advanced technology, their farming efficiency is very high.

养殖.zh: 养殖业是当地的重要经济来源。
养殖.en: Aquaculture is an important economic source for the local area.

养殖.zh: 今年他们开始养殖新品种的鱼。
养殖.en: This year they started farming a new breed of fish.

私有.en: This piece of land is privately owned.

私有.zh: 私有财产受到法律保护。
私有.en: Private property is protected by law.

私有.zh: 他们把国有企业变成了私有企业。
私有.en: They turned state-owned enterprises into private enterprises.

私有.zh: 私有化和公有化各有优缺点。
私有.en: Privatization and public ownership each have pros and cons.

私有.zh: 这家公司原来是国有，后来转为私有。
私有.en: This company was originally state-owned, and later turned private.

牡丹.en: Is the peony China's national flower?
This peony has bloomed really beautifully.

牡丹.zh: 春天公园里的牡丹特别受欢迎。
牡丹.en: In spring, the peonies in the park are very popular.

牡丹.zh: 他送了我一幅画有牡丹的国画。
牡丹.en: He gave me a Chinese painting with peonies.
Luoyang is famous for its peony festival.

伤残.en: He lost a leg due to a work injury.

伤残.zh: 这次事故导致多人伤残。
伤残.en: This accident caused multiple casualties and disabilities.

伤残.zh: 政府为伤残人士提供了很多福利。
伤残.en: The government provides many benefits for disabled people.

伤残.zh: 他虽然身体伤残，但心态非常积极。
伤残.en: Although he is physically disabled, his attitude is very positive.

伤残.zh: 伤残保险可以帮助家庭减轻经济压力。
伤残.en: Disability insurance can help families reduce financial pressure.

诀窍.en: Are there any tricks to cooking?

诀窍.zh: 他教了我一个背单词的诀窍。
诀窍.en: He taught me a trick for memorizing words.

诀窍.zh: 学语言的诀窍就是多听多说。
诀窍.en: The secret to learning a language is to listen and speak more.

诀窍.zh: 这个游戏通关的诀窍是要先收集道具。
诀窍.en: The trick to beating this game is to collect items first.

诀窍.zh: 他分享了一个快速入睡的诀窍，非常管用。
诀窍.en: He shared a trick for falling asleep quickly, and it works really well.

省略.en: This part of the content can be omitted.

省略.zh: 为了节省时间，我们省略了开场白。
省略.en: To save time, we skipped the opening remarks.

省略.zh: 写报告时不要省略重要数据。
省略.en: Don't omit important data when writing the report.

省略.zh: 他把中间的故事省略了，直接说了结果。
省略.en: He omitted the middle part of the story and directly told the outcome.

省略.zh: 合同里有些细节被省略了，但问题不大。
省略.en: Some details were omitted from the contract, but it's not a big problem.

庸俗.zh: 他总喜欢看那些庸俗的电视剧。
庸俗.en: He always likes to watch those vulgar TV shows.

庸俗.zh: 我觉得这种打扮很庸俗，不太适合你。
庸俗.en: I think this outfit is quite tacky and not very suitable for you.

庸俗.zh: 虽然票房很高，但这部电影内容很庸俗。
庸俗.en: Although the box office is high, the content of this movie is very vulgar.

庸俗.zh: 她不想跟那些庸俗的人打交道，所以换了工作。
庸俗.en: She didn't want to deal with those vulgar people, so she changed jobs.

次序.zh: 这些文件的次序不能弄乱。
次序.en: The order of these files must not be messed up.

次序.zh: 考试的时候要注意答题的次序。
次序.en: During the exam, pay attention to the order of answering questions.

次序.zh: 我们先把事情的轻重次序理清楚再行动。
次序.en: Let's first clarify the order of priority before taking action.

次序.zh: 他把书按出版次序摆放在书架上。
次序.en: He arranged the books on the shelf in order of publication.

自由自在.zh: 放假了，终于自由自在了。
自由自在.en: It's vacation, finally free and unrestrained.

自由自在.zh: 小鸟在天空自由自在地飞翔。
自由自在.en: Birds fly freely in the sky.

自由自在.zh: 他喜欢自由自在的生活，不想被约束。
自由自在.en: He likes a carefree life and doesn't want to be constrained.

自由自在.zh: 退休以后，他想去哪里就去哪里，自由自在的。
自由自在.en: After retirement, he can go wherever he wants, free and easy.

自由自在.zh: 小时候我们总在田野里自由自在地玩耍。
自由自在.en: When we were young, we always played freely in the fields.

靠拢.en: Everyone move a bit closer to the center.

靠拢.zh: 两国的观点正逐渐靠拢。
靠拢.en: The views of the two countries are gradually converging.

靠拢.zh: 我们公司正在向行业标准靠拢。
靠拢.en: Our company is moving closer to industry standards.

靠拢.zh: 他性格内向，不喜欢跟别人靠拢。
靠拢.en: He is introverted and doesn't like to get close to others.

靠拢.zh: 为了拍照，大家靠拢一些，别站得太散。
靠拢.en: For the photo, everyone move closer together, don't stand too far apart.

绝技.zh: 这位师傅的雕刻绝技令人惊叹。
绝技.en: This master's carving skill is amazing.

绝技.zh: 他在舞台上表演了自己的拿手绝技。
绝技.en: He performed his signature stunt on stage.

绝技.zh: 听说这位厨师有一手做拉面的绝技。
绝技.en: I heard this chef has a special skill for making pulled noodles.

绝技.zh: 他练了十年才学会这套拳法的绝技。
绝技.en: He practiced for ten years to master the unique technique of this boxing style.

瘸.en: He walks with a slight limp.
That dog is lame in one leg.

瘸.zh: 他摔了一跤，现在腿瘸了。
瘸.en: He fell and now his leg is lame.

瘸.zh: 虽然腿瘸了，但他依然坚持运动。
瘸.en: Even though his leg is lame, he still insists on exercising.

瘸.zh: 老人瘸着腿慢慢走过马路。
瘸.en: The old man limped slowly across the road.

背诵.en: The teacher asked us to recite the text.
He recites ancient poems very fluently.

背诵.zh: 明天要考试，我得赶紧背诵这些公式。
背诵.en: I have an exam tomorrow, so I need to quickly memorize these formulas.

背诵.zh: 她花了一个小时背诵演讲稿。
背诵.en: She spent an hour memorizing the speech.

背诵.zh: 虽然很难，但他还是把整篇《论语》背诵下来了。
背诵.en: Even though it was difficult, he still managed to recite the entire Analects.

疏通.zh: 下水道堵了，得找人疏通。
疏通.en: The sewer is clogged; we need to find someone to unclog it.

疏通.zh: 他帮我疏通了一下关系，事情就好办了。
疏通.en: He helped me smooth things over with connections, and then it was easy to handle.

疏通.zh: 因为路上堵车，警察在十字路口疏通交通。
疏通.en: Because of a traffic jam, the police were directing traffic at the intersection.

疏通.zh: 我们得先疏通一下管道，不然水漫出来了。
疏通.en: We need to unclog the pipe first, or the water will overflow.

疏通.zh: 她说话很委婉，慢慢疏通了我们之间的矛盾。
疏通.en: She spoke tactfully and gradually resolved the conflict between us.

空荡荡.zh: 房间里空荡荡的，什么都没有。
空荡荡.en: The room is completely empty, with nothing in it.

空荡荡.zh: 放学后，校园里空荡荡的，很安静。
空荡荡.en: After school, the campus is empty and very quiet.

空荡荡.zh: 虽然节日过去了，但心里还是空荡荡的。
空荡荡.en: Although the holiday is over, I still feel empty inside.

空荡荡.zh: 他走后，我感觉整颗心都空荡荡的。
空荡荡.en: After he left, I felt like my whole heart was hollow.

空荡荡.zh: 那个大商场夜里空荡荡的，一个人影都没有。
空荡荡.en: That big mall is empty at night, not a single person in sight.

愈演愈烈.en: Their argument is getting more intense.

愈演愈烈.zh: 如果不控制，疫情会愈演愈烈。
愈演愈烈.en: If not controlled, the epidemic will get worse.

愈演愈烈.zh: 这个公司的内部矛盾愈演愈烈，最后分裂了。
愈演愈烈.en: The internal conflicts in this company escalated and eventually split it apart.

愈演愈烈.zh: 因为没人管，街上的噪音问题愈演愈烈。
愈演愈烈.en: Because no one manages it, the noise problem on the street is getting worse.

愈演愈烈.zh: 网上对这件事的讨论愈演愈烈，越来越激烈。
愈演愈烈.en: The online discussion about this matter is escalating and becoming more intense.

周转.zh: 公司资金周转有点困难。
周转.en: The company is having some difficulty with cash flow.

周转.zh: 我需要点时间周转一下手里的现金。
周转.en: I need some time to cycle the cash I have on hand.

周转.zh: 这个月开销太大，资金周转不过来了。
周转.en: This month's expenses are too high, and the cash flow can't keep up.

周转.zh: 因为进货太多，仓库货物周转很慢。
周转.en: Because we stocked too much, the warehouse inventory turnover is very slow.

周转.zh: 他向朋友借钱，暂时把资金周转开了。
周转.en: He borrowed money from a friend to temporarily manage the cash flow.

万无一失.zh: 这个计划必须万无一失。
出发前要检查三遍，确保万无一失。
万无一失.en: Check three times before leaving to make sure everything is foolproof.

万无一失.zh: 如果每个细节都做到位，那就万无一失了。
万无一失.en: If every detail is done right, then it will be foolproof.

万无一失.zh: 虽然准备了很久，但还是不敢说万无一失。
万无一失.en: Even though I've prepared for a long time, I still can't say it's foolproof.

万无一失.zh: 做手术前，医生反复核对信息，为了万无一失。
万无一失.en: Before surgery, the doctor double-checks the information to ensure nothing goes wrong.

荒凉.zh: 沙漠里一片荒凉，看不到人烟。
荒凉.en: The desert is a vast desolation with no sign of human habitation.

荒凉.zh: 以前的村子很热闹，现在变得特别荒凉。
荒凉.en: The village used to be lively, but now it's become very desolate.

荒凉.zh: 虽然他住在大城市，但心里总觉得很荒凉。
荒凉.en: Even though he lives in a big city, he always feels desolate inside.

荒凉.zh: 因为没人耕种，那片土地越来越荒凉。
荒凉.en: Because no one farms it, that piece of land is becoming more and more desolate.

容颜.zh: 她虽然年纪大了，但容颜依旧美丽。
容颜.en: Although she is older, her appearance is still beautiful.

容颜.zh: 再好的容颜也经不起时间的摧残。
容颜.en: Even the best looks cannot withstand the ravages of time.

容颜.zh: 他望着镜子里的自己，感叹容颜易老。
容颜.en: He looked at himself in the mirror and lamented how quickly youth fades.

容颜.zh: 她每天化妆，就是为了保持年轻的容颜。
容颜.en: She puts on makeup every day just to maintain a youthful appearance.

关税.en: Imported goods are subject to tariffs.

关税.zh: 两国之间的关税谈判很艰难。
关税.en: The tariff negotiations between the two countries are very tough.

关税.zh: 因为关税提高了，这些商品价格涨了。
关税.en: Because tariffs have increased, the prices of these goods have gone up.

关税.zh: 政府降低了部分商品的关税以促进贸易。
关税.en: The government lowered tariffs on some goods to boost trade.

关税.zh: 如果关税太高，很多小公司就会倒闭。
关税.en: If tariffs are too high, many small companies will go bankrupt.

工商界.en: People from the business and industrial circles have donated one after another.

工商界.zh: 这位企业家在工商界很有名气。
工商界.en: This entrepreneur is very famous in business circles.

工商界.zh: 工商界代表参加了这次经济发展会议。
工商界.en: Representatives from the business community attended this economic development meeting.

工商界.zh: 虽然经济不好，但工商界依然充满信心。
工商界.en: Although the economy is bad, the business community remains confident.

工商界.zh: 因为政策利好，工商界对明年很乐观。
工商界.en: Because of favorable policies, the business community is optimistic about next year.

趋于.en: Housing prices are趋于稳定. (Note: '趋于' can be translated as 'tending to' or 'becoming')

趋于.zh: 他的态度逐渐趋于缓和。
趋于.en: His attitude is gradually becoming more moderate.

趋于.zh: 随着时间推移，两人的关系趋于正常。
趋于.en: As time goes by, the relationship between the two is becoming normal.

趋于.zh: 因为政府调控，物价趋于平稳。
趋于.en: Due to government regulation, prices are tending to remain stable.

趋于.zh: 虽然问题很多，但情况总体趋于好转。
趋于.en: Although there are many problems, the situation overall is tending to improve.

吉普.zh: 他开了一辆吉普去上班。
吉普.en: He drove a jeep to work.

吉普.zh: 这辆吉普性能很好，适合越野。
吉普.en: This jeep has great performance and is suitable for off-roading.

吉普.zh: 我们租了一辆吉普，打算穿越沙漠。
吉普.en: We rented a jeep and planned to cross the desert.

吉普.zh: 我爸爸的那辆老吉普开了十几年了。
吉普.en: My dad's old jeep has been driven for over ten years.

吉普.zh: 虽然吉普很耗油，但跑山路确实稳。
吉普.en: Although the jeep consumes a lot of fuel, it is really stable on mountain roads.

一经.zh: 这个方案一经批准就立刻执行。
一经.en: Once this plan is approved, it will be executed immediately.

一经.zh: 密码一经设置，请勿遗忘。
一经.en: Once the password is set, please do not forget it.

一经.zh: 他一旦答应的事情，一经承诺就一定做到。
一经.en: Once he promises something, he will definitely follow through.

一经.zh: 这些数据一经录入，系统会自动保存。
一经.en: Once the data is entered, the system will save it automatically.

一经.zh: 产品一经售出，概不退换。
一经.en: Once the product is sold, no returns or exchanges are allowed.

嘈杂.zh: 这里太嘈杂了，我们换个地方吧。
嘈杂.en: It's too noisy here, let's change places.

嘈杂.zh: 施工现场声音嘈杂，我根本没法专心。
嘈杂.en: The construction site is so noisy that I can't concentrate at all.

嘈杂.zh: 虽然街道很嘈杂，但她依然在看书。
嘈杂.en: Although the street was noisy, she was still reading.

嘈杂.zh: 半夜突然听到嘈杂的吵闹声，把我吵醒了。
嘈杂.en: I was woken up by sudden noisy shouts in the middle of the night.

嘈杂.zh: 市场里人声嘈杂，连打电话都听不清。
嘈杂.en: The market was so noisy that I couldn't even hear clearly on the phone.

耕地.zh: 这块耕地今年种了玉米。
耕地.en: This farmland grew corn this year.

耕地.zh: 农民在耕地上辛勤劳作了一整天。
耕地.en: The farmer worked hard on the farmland all day.

耕地.zh: 为了保护耕地，村里禁止随意建房。
耕地.en: To protect farmland, the village prohibits building houses randomly.

耕地.zh: 这几年很多耕地被用来盖工厂了。
耕地.en: In recent years, a lot of farmland has been used to build factories.

耕地.zh: 如果耕地长期不翻，土壤会变得很硬。
耕地.en: If farmland is not plowed for a long time, the soil will become very hard.

衔接.zh: 这两段路衔接得不太顺。
衔接.en: These two sections of the road don't connect smoothly.

衔接.zh: 课程之间的衔接很重要，不能断档。
衔接.en: The connection between courses is very important and shouldn't have gaps.

衔接.zh: 新老员工的工作交接衔接得很好。
衔接.en: The handover between new and old employees was well connected.

衔接.zh: 这个句子和上一段内容的衔接不太自然。
衔接.en: The connection between this sentence and the previous paragraph is not very natural.

衔接.zh: 为了让前后剧情衔接得更流畅，导演加了一场戏。
衔接.en: To make the plot connect more smoothly, the director added a scene.

凭证.zh: 这张发票是唯一的购买凭证。
凭证.en: This invoice is the only proof of purchase.

凭证.zh: 没有凭证，公司不能给你报销。
凭证.en: Without a voucher, the company cannot reimburse you.

凭证.zh: 他把所有凭证都保存得很好，以防万一。
凭证.en: He kept all the vouchers very well, just in case.

凭证.zh: 你签收的时候要记得拿凭证。
凭证.en: When you sign for delivery, remember to get the receipt.

错位.zh: 他的肩膀错位了，需要复位。
错位.en: His shoulder is dislocated and needs to be reset.

错位.zh: 这两块拼图错位了，拼不上。
错位.en: These two puzzle pieces are misaligned and won't fit together.

错位.zh: 齿轮发生错位，机器就停了。
错位.en: When the gears are misaligned, the machine stops.

错位.zh: 因为时间错位，我们错过了会议。
错位.en: Because of the time mismatch, we missed the meeting.

错位.zh: 照片里他的牙齿看起来有点错位。
错位.en: In the photo, his teeth look a bit misaligned.

测算.zh: 帮我测算一下这个房间的面积。
测算.en: Help me calculate the area of this room.

测算.zh: 科学家测算出这颗行星到地球的距离。
测算.en: Scientists calculated the distance from this planet to Earth.

测算.zh: 我们通过GPS测算出了行进速度。
测算.en: We calculated the travel speed using GPS.

测算.zh: 如果不经过精确测算，这个项目风险很大。
测算.en: Without precise calculation, this project is very risky.

测算.zh: 他测算了一下，发现预算超了不少。
测算.en: He did the math and found the budget was way over.

四面八方.zh: 人们从四面八方赶来参加活动。
四面八方.en: People came from all directions to attend the event.

四面八方.zh: 烟花从四面八方升起，非常壮观。
四面八方.en: Fireworks rose from all directions, very spectacular.

四面八方.zh: 声音从四面八方传来，让人分不清方向。
四面八方.en: Sounds came from all around, making it hard to tell direction.

四面八方.zh: 为了找到他，我们派出了四面八方的人手。
四面八方.en: To find him, we sent people in all directions.

四面八方.zh: 消息一传开，四面八方的亲友都来帮忙。
四面八方.en: Once the news spread, relatives and friends from all over came to help.

息息相关.zh: 健康和饮食习惯息息相关。
息息相关.en: Health is closely related to eating habits.

息息相关.zh: 空气质量与我们每个人的生活息息相关。
息息相关.en: Air quality is closely linked to everyone's life.

息息相关.zh: 公司的命运和员工的努力息息相关。
息息相关.en: The company's fate is closely tied to the employees' efforts.

息息相关.zh: 这两个地区的经济息息相关，互相影响。
息息相关.en: The economies of these two regions are closely interconnected and affect each other.

息息相关.zh: 家长的态度和孩子的成长息息相关。
息息相关.en: Parents' attitudes are closely related to children's growth.

供暖.en: Heating is very important in winter.

供暖.zh: 我们小区今年提前开始供暖了。
供暖.en: Our neighborhood started heating early this year.

供暖.zh: 因为管道坏了，这栋楼供暖停了三天。
供暖.en: Because the pipes broke, heating in this building was off for three days.

供暖.zh: 虽然已经三月了，但供暖还没停。
供暖.en: Although it's already March, the heating hasn't stopped yet.

供暖.zh: 北方城市供暖季通常从十一月开始。
供暖.en: The heating season in northern cities usually starts in November.

闺女.zh: 我闺女今年刚上小学一年级。
闺女.en: My daughter just started first grade this year.

闺女.zh: 老张的闺女不但长得漂亮，而且学习也好。
闺女.en: Old Zhang's daughter is not only pretty but also studies well.

闺女.zh: 闺女，帮妈妈拿一下那个杯子。
闺女.en: Sweetie, help mom get that cup.

闺女.zh: 村里人都说她是个孝顺的好闺女。
闺女.en: Everyone in the village says she is a filial and good daughter.

名利.en: He doesn't care about fame and fortune.

名利.zh: 很多人为了名利拼命工作，最后身体垮了。
名利.en: Many people work themselves to the bone for fame and fortune, and end up ruining their health.

名利.zh: 虽然他很有才华，但他从不追逐名利。
名利.en: Although he is very talented, he never chases fame and fortune.

名利.zh: 在这个圈子里，名利来得快去得也快。
名利.en: In this circle, fame and fortune come and go quickly.

名利.zh: 名利这东西，得到容易守住难。
名利.en: Fame and fortune are easy to get but hard to keep.

兜售.en: Someone is peddling fake goods on the street.

兜售.zh: 这些商贩在景区门口兜售各种纪念品。
兜售.en: These vendors are hawking various souvenirs at the entrance of the scenic spot.

兜售.zh: 他们不仅兜售商品，还推销保险。
兜售.en: They not only peddle goods but also sell insurance.

兜售.zh: 我不喜欢那种上门兜售的方式。
兜售.en: I don't like that door-to-door peddling approach.

兜售.zh: 网上兜售的课程质量参差不齐。
兜售.en: The quality of courses peddled online varies widely.

跳槽.zh: 我朋友一年内跳槽三次，现在工资翻倍了。
跳槽.en: My friend changed jobs three times in a year, and now his salary has doubled.

跳槽.zh: 因为对薪资不满，他决定跳槽去另一家公司。
跳槽.en: Because he was dissatisfied with his salary, he decided to switch to another company.

跳槽.zh: 跳槽太频繁对职业生涯其实不利。
跳槽.en: Changing jobs too often is actually bad for your career.

跳槽.zh: 年底很多人都有跳槽的打算。
跳槽.en: Many people plan to change jobs at the end of the year.

祖宗.en: We must not forget our ancestors.

祖宗.zh: 清明时节，我们要祭拜祖宗。
祖宗.en: During the Qingming Festival, we pay respects to our ancestors.

祖宗.zh: 虽然时代变了，但祖宗的规矩不能丢。
祖宗.en: Although times have changed, we cannot abandon the rules of our ancestors.

祖宗.zh: 这棵老树是祖宗种下的。
祖宗.en: This old tree was planted by our ancestors.

祖宗.zh: 别拿祖宗的话来压我，现在不一样了。
祖宗.en: Don't use our ancestors' words to pressure me; times are different now.

剔除.zh: 面试时，人事部门剔除了一些不合格的简历。
剔除.en: During the interview process, HR removed some unqualified resumes.

剔除.zh: 我们需要仔细筛查，剔除那些虚假信息。
剔除.en: We need to carefully screen and eliminate false information.

剔除.zh: 做菜时要把鱼刺剔除干净。
剔除.en: When cooking, you need to remove the fish bones thoroughly.

剔除.zh: 管理层决定剔除这个过时的制度。
剔除.en: Management decided to abolish this outdated system.

队形.zh: 军训时，我们练习变换队形。
队形.en: During military training, we practiced changing formations.

队形.zh: 因为有人插队，队形全乱了。
队形.en: Because someone cut in line, the formation was completely messed up.

队形.zh: 在广场舞中，队形整齐很重要。
队形.en: In square dancing, having a neat formation is very important.

队形.zh: 拍照时，大家按高矮排好队形。
队形.en: When taking photos, everyone lined up in formation by height.

惨痛.zh: 那场事故给他带来了惨痛的经历。
惨痛.en: That accident brought him a painful experience.

惨痛.zh: 尽管付出了惨痛的代价，但他终于明白了。
惨痛.en: Although he paid a painful price, he finally understood.

惨痛.zh: 历史告诉我们惨痛的教训不能忘记。
惨痛.en: History tells us that painful lessons must not be forgotten.

惨痛.zh: 回想起那段惨痛的往事，她忍不住流泪。
惨痛.en: Recalling that painful memory, she couldn't help crying.

取缔.en: This black market was shut down.

取缔.zh: 政府最近取缔了好几个非法传销组织。
取缔.en: The government recently banned several illegal pyramid schemes.

取缔.zh: 因为噪音扰民，那个夜市被依法取缔了。
取缔.en: Because of noise disturbing residents, that night market was legally shut down.

取缔.zh: 取缔无证经营是城管的主要工作之一。
取缔.en: Shutting down unlicensed businesses is one of the main tasks of urban management.

取缔.zh: 学校取缔了校园周边的无照摊贩。
取缔.en: The school banned unlicensed vendors around the campus.

牢骚.en: Stop complaining and get to work.

牢骚.zh: 他今天牢骚特别多，是不是遇到什么烦心事了？
牢骚.en: He's got a lot of complaints today. Did something bother him?

牢骚.zh: 她一边做饭一边发牢骚，说家里太乱了。
牢骚.en: She was cooking and complaining at the same time, saying the house was too messy.

牢骚.zh: 你要是总这么爱发牢骚，朋友都会受不了的。
牢骚.en: If you always complain like this, your friends won't be able to stand it.

牢骚.zh: 虽然工作很累，但他很少发牢骚，总是默默做完。
牢骚.en: Although the work is tiring, he rarely complains and just quietly gets it done.

总而言之.zh: 总而言之，这件事不能拖了。
总而言之.en: In short, this matter cannot be delayed.

总而言之.zh: 他讲了半天，总而言之就是不同意。
总而言之.en: He talked for a long time, but in short, he disagreed.

总而言之.zh: 总而言之，这次旅行虽然累，但很开心。
总而言之.en: All in all, this trip was tiring but very enjoyable.

总而言之.zh: 你要注意安全、带好证件、按时回来，总而言之，别让我们担心。
总而言之.en: You need to pay attention to safety, bring your documents, and come back on time — in a word, don't make us worry.

总而言之.zh: 说了这么多，总而言之就是一句话：你得对自己负责。
总而言之.en: After all that talk, it basically comes down to one sentence: you have to be responsible for yourself.

实事求是.zh: 我们必须实事求是地分析问题。
实事求是.en: We must analyze the problem realistically and truthfully.

实事求是.zh: 他这个人很实在，说话总是实事求是。
实事求是.en: He is a very down-to-earth person and always speaks based on facts.

实事求是.zh: 报告要实事求是，不能夸大也不能缩小。
实事求是.en: The report must be factual, neither exaggerating nor downplaying.

实事求是.zh: 老师要求我们写作文时实事求是，不要编故事。
实事求是.en: The teacher asked us to be factual in our essays and not make up stories.

实事求是.zh: 虽然结果不太好，但我们要实事求是地总结原因。
实事求是.en: Although the result wasn't good, we need to realistically summarize the reasons.

波澜.en: There wasn't a single ripple on the lake.

波澜.zh: 他的内心掀起了巨大的波澜。
波澜.en: A huge surge of emotion rose in his heart.

波澜.zh: 这场演讲在观众中引起了不小的波澜。
波澜.en: This speech stirred up quite a stir among the audience.

波澜.zh: 生活不可能一直风平浪静，总会有一些波澜。
波澜.en: Life can't always be calm and smooth; there will always be some ups and downs.

波澜.zh: 他表面很平静，其实心里早已波澜起伏。
波澜.en: He appeared calm on the surface, but inside his emotions were already churning.

夹子.zh: 她用夹子把头发固定住了。
夹子.en: She used a hair clip to hold her hair in place.

夹子.zh: 这种夹子夹力很大，适合夹厚文件。
夹子.en: This kind of clip has a strong grip and is suitable for thick documents.

夹子.zh: 你桌上那个蓝色的夹子能借我用一下吗？
夹子.en: Can I borrow that blue clip on your desk?

夹子.zh: 晾衣服的时候记得用夹子夹好，不然会被风吹掉。
夹子.en: Remember to use clothespins when hanging clothes, otherwise they'll be blown off by the wind.

单方面.zh: 公司不能单方面更改合同。
单方面.en: The company cannot unilaterally change the contract.

单方面.zh: 你不能单方面做决定，得跟我们商量一下。
单方面.en: You can't make a decision unilaterally; you need to discuss it with us.

单方面.zh: 这次合作失败了，因为对方单方面终止了协议。
单方面.en: This cooperation failed because the other party unilaterally terminated the agreement.

单方面.zh: 他单方面认为都是别人的错，这很不公平。
单方面.en: He unilaterally thinks it's all someone else's fault, which is very unfair.

顽皮.zh: 那只小猫特别顽皮，总爱抓沙发。
顽皮.en: That kitten is very mischievous and loves to scratch the sofa.
He is naughty, but very smart.

顽皮.zh: 老师拿那个顽皮的男生一点办法也没有。
顽皮.en: The teacher has no way to deal with that naughty boy.

顽皮.zh: 小时候我特别顽皮，经常把家里搞得乱七八糟。
顽皮.en: When I was little, I was very mischievous and often made a mess at home.

无可奈何.en: I can't do anything about it either.

无可奈何.zh: 面对这种情况，他感到无可奈何。
无可奈何.en: Facing this situation, he felt helpless.

无可奈何.zh: 她无可奈何地叹了口气。
孩子死活不肯吃药，妈妈无可奈何。
无可奈何.en: The child absolutely refused to take medicine, and the mother was at a loss.

无可奈何.zh: 虽然我很想帮他，但力不从心，只能无可奈何地摇摇头。
无可奈何.en: Although I really wanted to help him, I couldn't, so I could only shake my head helplessly.

伺机.en: He has been waiting for an opportunity to get revenge.

伺机.zh: 小偷伺机偷走了她的钱包。
伺机.en: The thief seized the opportunity and stole her wallet.

伺机.zh: 这只猫躲在角落里，伺机扑向老鼠。
伺机.en: The cat hid in the corner, waiting for a chance to pounce on the mouse.

伺机.zh: 对手一直在伺机反击，我们不能放松警惕。
伺机.en: The opponent has been waiting for a chance to counterattack; we must not let our guard down.

伺机.zh: 他假装离开，实则伺机潜入大楼。
伺机.en: He pretended to leave, but in fact was waiting for an opportunity to sneak into the building.

定为.zh: 这次会议定为明天上午。
定为.en: This meeting is scheduled for tomorrow morning.
The exam time is set for next Monday.

定为.zh: 他们把每年的五月定为公司庆典日。
定为.en: They designated May every year as the company's celebration day.

定为.zh: 经过讨论，活动地点定为市中心广场。
定为.en: After discussion, the event location was set as the central square.

定为.zh: 新产品的售价暂时定为一百元。
定为.en: The price of the new product is tentatively set at 100 yuan.

滔滔不绝.zh: 他一说起足球就滔滔不绝。
滔滔不绝.en: He talks endlessly once he starts about football.

滔滔不绝.zh: 她讲故事时滔滔不绝，大家都听得入迷了。
滔滔不绝.en: She told the story nonstop, and everyone was fascinated.

滔滔不绝.zh: 虽然他很累，但一谈到旅游经历就滔滔不绝地说起来。
滔滔不绝.en: Even though he was tired, he talked endlessly about his travel experiences once he started.

滔滔不绝.zh: 那个推销员滔滔不绝地介绍产品，我根本插不上话。
滔滔不绝.en: That salesman talked endlessly about the product, and I couldn't get a word in.

滔滔不绝.zh: 老王特别健谈，每次聚会都滔滔不绝地讲他年轻时的故事。
滔滔不绝.en: Lao Wang is very talkative; at every gathering he rambles on about his youth stories.

夹杂.zh: 他的话里夹杂着很多英文词。
夹杂.en: His speech is mixed with many English words.

夹杂.zh: 这次比赛夹杂了专业和业余选手。
夹杂.en: This competition includes both professional and amateur players.

夹杂.zh: 雨声里夹杂着雷声，听起来有点吓人。
夹杂.en: The sound of rain is mixed with thunder, which sounds a bit scary.

夹杂.zh: 她的普通话很标准，只有偶尔会夹杂一点南方口音。
夹杂.en: Her Mandarin is very standard, only occasionally mixed with a slight southern accent.

夹杂.zh: 这袋米里夹杂了一些石子，吃之前要仔细挑一下。
夹杂.en: This bag of rice is mixed with some small stones, so you need to pick them out carefully before cooking.

雪上加霜.zh: 丢了工作，又生病了，真是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.en: Lost my job and then got sick—it's really adding insult to injury.

雪上加霜.zh: 本来生意就不好，现在房租又涨了，简直是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.en: Business was already bad, and now the rent has gone up—it's just making things worse.

雪上加霜.zh: 他考试没考好，回家又被父母骂了一顿，真是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.en: He did poorly on the exam, and then got scolded by his parents at home—what a double blow.

雪上加霜.zh: 球队已经连输三场了，主力球员又受伤，这简直是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.en: The team has already lost three in a row, and now the key player is injured—that's just pouring salt on the wound.

雪上加霜.zh: 最近经济不景气，很多公司裁员，对刚毕业的学生来说真是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.en: The economy has been down recently, and many companies are laying off staff—it's really adding to the difficulties for fresh graduates.

轻型.zh: 这款轻型跑车很受欢迎。
轻型.en: This lightweight sports car is very popular.

轻型.zh: 他开了一家轻型机械修理店。
轻型.en: He runs a light machinery repair shop.

轻型.zh: 这辆自行车是轻型材料做的，骑起来很轻松。
轻型.en: This bicycle is made of lightweight materials, so it's easy to ride.

轻型.zh: 医生建议她做轻型运动，比如散步或瑜伽。
轻型.en: The doctor suggested she do light exercises, like walking or yoga.

轻型.zh: 我们公司主要生产轻型建筑材料，适合装修小户型房子。
轻型.en: Our company mainly produces lightweight building materials, suitable for renovating small apartments.

谜团.zh: 这个谜团一直没人能解开。
谜团.en: No one has been able to solve this mystery.

谜团.zh: 他为什么要辞职，至今还是个谜团。
谜团.en: Why he resigned is still a mystery.

谜团.zh: 警方正在努力调查那起失踪案的谜团。
谜团.en: The police are working hard to investigate the mystery of that missing person case.

谜团.zh: 这些古建筑的建造方法，对现代人来说是一个谜团。
谜团.en: The construction methods of these ancient buildings are a mystery to modern people.

谜团.zh: 关于那笔钱的去向，公司里有很多谜团，谁也说不清楚。
谜团.en: There are many mysteries in the company about where that money went, and no one can explain clearly.

弊端.zh: 长期吃外卖的弊端就是营养不均衡。
弊端.en: The downside of eating takeout long-term is unbalanced nutrition.

弊端.zh: 手机虽然方便，但也有不少弊端，比如容易上瘾。
弊端.en: Although mobile phones are convenient, they also have many drawbacks, such as being addictive.

弊端.zh: 那种管理方式的弊端越来越明显，员工抱怨很多。
弊端.en: The drawbacks of that management style are becoming more and more obvious, with many employee complaints.

弊端.zh: 如果只看短期利益，就会忽略长期发展的弊端。
弊端.en: If you only focus on short-term gains, you'll overlook the drawbacks for long-term development.

出厂.zh: 这辆车刚出厂，还是全新的。
出厂.en: This car just left the factory; it's brand new.

出厂.zh: 每一批产品出厂前都要经过严格检查。
出厂.en: Every batch of products must undergo strict inspection before leaving the factory.

出厂.zh: 这台冰箱出厂的时候贴了合格标签，但用了两天就坏了。
出厂.en: This refrigerator had a quality label when it left the factory, but it broke down after two days of use.

出厂.zh: 这批手机出厂时系统版本比较旧，需要自己更新。
出厂.en: These phones had an older system version when they left the factory, so you need to update them yourself.

出厂.zh: 我们公司规定，所有成品必须在下个月十号之前出厂。
出厂.en: Our company stipulates that all finished products must be shipped out of the factory before the 10th of next month.

推卸.zh: 这件事你别想推卸给我。
推卸.en: Don't even think about shifting this matter onto me.

推卸.zh: 出了问题时，他第一反应就是推卸责任。
推卸.en: When something goes wrong, his first reaction is to shift the blame.

推卸.zh: 作为项目经理，你不能把错误都推卸到下属头上。
推卸.en: As the project manager, you can't push all the mistakes onto your subordinates.

推卸.zh: 明明是他自己没做好，却想方设法推卸给别人。
推卸.en: Clearly he didn't do it well himself, yet he tries every way to shift the blame to others.

家喻户晓.zh: 这个品牌已经家喻户晓了。
家喻户晓.en: This brand is already household famous.

家喻户晓.zh: 他的故事在我们家乡家家户户都家喻户晓。
家喻户晓.en: His story is known in every household in my hometown.

家喻户晓.zh: 那部电视剧里有一句台词现在家喻户晓。
家喻户晓.en: There is a line from that TV series that is now known to every household.

家喻户晓.zh: 在中国，长城是家喻户晓的旅游景点。
家喻户晓.en: In China, the Great Wall is a tourist attraction known to every household.

家喻户晓.zh: 虽然他不是明星，但在我们这一带，他的名气已经家喻户晓了。
家喻户晓.en: Although he's not a celebrity, his fame is known to every household in our area.

职业病.en: He has a serious occupational disease.

职业病.zh: 当老师的很容易得咽喉炎这种职业病。
职业病.en: Teachers easily get pharyngitis, which is an occupational disease.

职业病.zh: 他做会计十几年了，得了颈椎病，算是职业病了。
职业病.en: He has been an accountant for over a decade and developed cervical spine issues, which is an occupational disease.

职业病.zh: 职业病防治很重要，公司每年都会组织体检。
职业病.en: Prevention and control of occupational diseases are very important; the company organizes physical exams every year.

职业病.zh: 他总是不自觉地说口头禅，其实这也算一种职业病。
职业病.en: He unconsciously uses catchphrases all the time; actually, that's also a kind of occupational habit.

特邀.en: He is a specially invited guest of mine.

特邀.zh: 这次活动特邀了几位专家。
特邀.en: This event specially invited a few experts.

特邀.zh: 她被特邀去参加那个国际会议。
特邀.en: She was specially invited to attend that international conference.

特邀.zh: 公司特邀了一位知名设计师来做分享。
特邀.en: The company specially invited a well-known designer to give a talk.

特邀.zh: 虽然我没报名，但主办方特邀我上台发言。
特邀.en: Although I didn't sign up, the organizer specially invited me to speak on stage.

继而.en: He coughed first, then got a fever.

继而.zh: 雨停了，继而太阳出来了。
继而.en: The rain stopped, and then the sun came out.

继而.zh: 我们先讨论方案，继而决定下一步。
继而.en: We first discussed the plan, then decided on the next step.

继而.zh: 她听完笑话愣了一下，继而哈哈大笑。
继而.en: She was stunned for a moment after hearing the joke, then burst out laughing.

继而.zh: 一开始大家都沉默，继而有人开始小声议论。
继而.en: At first everyone was silent, then people started whispering.

谜底.en: What is the answer to this riddle?

谜底.zh: 大家猜了半天，谜底其实很简单。
谜底.en: Everyone guessed for a long time, but the answer was actually very simple.

谜底.zh: 电影最后一刻才揭晓谜底。
谜底.en: The movie only revealed the answer at the very last moment.

谜底.zh: 他一直在隐瞒真相，最后谜底让人大吃一惊。
谜底.en: He had been hiding the truth, and the final answer shocked everyone.

谜底.zh: 如果你想知道谜底，就认真听我讲完这个故事。
谜底.en: If you want to know the answer, listen carefully to the end of this story.

感慨.en: He sighed emotionally about how fast time flies.

感慨.zh: 看到老照片，她忍不住感慨。
感慨.en: Seeing old photos, she couldn't help feeling emotional.

感慨.zh: 人生无常，他常常感慨万千。
感慨.en: Life is unpredictable, and he often has all sorts of emotions.

感慨.zh: 听完他的经历，我感慨人生真是不容易。
感慨.en: After hearing his story, I felt that life is really not easy.

感慨.zh: 老朋友聚会时，大家都感慨这些年变化太大了。
感慨.en: When old friends got together, everyone sighed about how much things had changed over the years.

应邀.en: He attended the wedding upon invitation.
I was invited to his place for dinner.

应邀.zh: 那位教授应邀来我校做讲座。
应邀.en: That professor came to our school to give a lecture upon invitation.

应邀.zh: 她应邀在开幕式上表演了一段舞蹈。
应邀.en: She performed a dance at the opening ceremony upon invitation.

应邀.zh: 虽然很忙，他还是应邀出席了那个聚会。
应邀.en: Although he was very busy, he still attended that party upon invitation.

绝招.zh: 他有个绝招叫“鲤鱼打挺”。
绝招.en: He has a special move called 'carp leap'.

绝招.zh: 做这个菜，我的绝招是多放点醋。
绝招.en: My secret trick for this dish is to add more vinegar.

绝招.zh: 每次比赛最后，他都会使出压轴绝招。
绝招.en: At the end of every competition, he pulls out his ultimate move.

绝招.zh: 你别急，我还有一个绝招没拿出来呢。
绝招.en: Don't worry, I still have one more trick up my sleeve.

绝招.zh: 他教了我几个谈判的绝招，特别管用。
绝招.en: He taught me a few negotiation tricks, and they work really well.

惊慌失措.zh: 别惊慌失措，我们慢慢想办法。
惊慌失措.en: Don't panic; let's figure it out slowly.

惊慌失措.zh: 着火时大家惊慌失措，挤成一团。
惊慌失措.en: When the fire broke out, everyone panicked and crowded together.

惊慌失措.zh: 他第一次上台演讲，紧张得惊慌失措。
惊慌失措.en: He was so nervous during his first speech on stage that he panicked.

惊慌失措.zh: 遇到危险要保持冷静，千万不要惊慌失措。
惊慌失措.en: Stay calm when facing danger; never panic.

送行.en: I went to the airport to see him off.
All of my friends came to the station to see me off.

送行.zh: 他出国那天，家人都在门口送行。
送行.en: The day he went abroad, his family were all at the door seeing him off.

送行.zh: 我们吃了顿饭给他送行，气氛很舍不得。
送行.en: We had a meal to see him off, and the atmosphere was full of reluctance.

送行.zh: 虽然只是短暂离别，她还是坚持去送行。
送行.en: Even though it was just a short goodbye, she insisted on seeing him off.

过境.zh: 这个国家不允许非法过境。
过境.en: This country does not allow illegal transit.

过境.zh: 我们只是过境，不用办签证。
过境.en: We are just transiting, so we don't need a visa.

过境.zh: 台风过境之后，城市一片狼藉。
过境.en: After the typhoon passed through, the city was a mess.

过境.zh: 他开车从广东过境到香港，花了一个小时。
过境.en: He drove from Guangdong across the border into Hong Kong, which took an hour.

冷门.zh: 那部电影成了今年的冷门佳作。
冷门.en: That movie became an underrated gem this year.

冷门.zh: 这次比赛爆了个大冷门，冠军是新人。
冷门.en: The competition had a major upset; the champion was a newcomer.

冷门.zh: 他专找冷门景点，人少景美。
冷门.en: He specifically looks for off-the-beaten-path spots, with fewer people and beautiful scenery.

冷门.zh: 别看这个行业冷门，其实利润很高。
冷门.en: Don't think this industry is unpopular; actually, its profit margins are very high.

岳母.zh: 我岳母今天来家里吃饭。
岳母.en: My mother-in-law is coming to our house for dinner today.

岳母.zh: 虽然岳母很严格，但她其实特别关心我们。
岳母.en: Although my mother-in-law is very strict, she actually cares about us a lot.

岳母.zh: 每次见到岳母，她都会问我工作怎么样。
岳母.en: Every time I see my mother-in-law, she asks me how work is going.

岳母.zh: 我岳母做的菜比外面餐厅还好吃。
岳母.en: The food my mother-in-law cooks is even better than restaurants.

岳母.zh: 我岳母特别喜欢花，我每个月都给她买一束。
岳母.en: My mother-in-law really likes flowers, so I buy her a bouquet every month.

留念.zh: 我们在这里拍张照留念吧。
留念.en: Let's take a photo here as a souvenir.

留念.zh: 毕业的时候大家都会在校园里拍照留念。
留念.en: When graduating, everyone takes photos on campus to remember the occasion.

留念.zh: 这个礼物是我留给你的留念。
留念.en: This gift is for you to remember me by.

留念.zh: 虽然我们已经分开很久了，但这封信我一直留着留念。
留念.en: Although we've been apart for a long time, I've kept this letter as a memento.

留念.zh: 每次旅行我都会买个小东西留念。
留念.en: Every time I travel, I buy a small souvenir to remember the trip.

大面积.zh: 这次火灾烧了大面积森林。
大面积.en: This fire burned a large area of forest.

大面积.zh: 最近大面积停电，很多人都没法上班。
大面积.en: Recently there was a large-scale power outage, and many people couldn't go to work.

大面积.zh: 这块田地大面积种了玉米。
大面积.en: This field is planted with corn over a large area.

大面积.zh: 因为天气不好，大面积航班都被取消了。
大面积.en: Because of bad weather, a large number of flights have been cancelled.

大面积.zh: 这种病会大面积传播，要小心。
大面积.en: This disease can spread over a large area, so be careful.

大款.en: His dad is a rich guy.

大款.zh: 那个大款一口气买了三辆车，真有钱。
大款.en: That tycoon bought three cars in one go—he's really rich.

大款.zh: 她嫁了个大款，整天不用上班。
大款.en: She married a rich man and doesn't have to work all day.

大款.zh: 虽然他是大款，但为人很低调。
大款.en: Although he's loaded, he's very low-key.

大款.zh: 现在很多大款都喜欢投资房地产。
大款.en: Nowadays many rich people like to invest in real estate.

萌芽.en: The seeds are starting to sprout.

萌芽.zh: 孩子们对科学的兴趣刚刚萌芽，需要好好培养。
萌芽.en: The children's interest in science is just sprouting and needs to be nurtured.

萌芽.zh: 爱情的萌芽总是很美好的。
萌芽.en: The budding of love is always beautiful.

萌芽.zh: 如果发现问题在萌芽状态就解决，就不会这么麻烦了。
萌芽.en: If you solve the problem while it's still budding, it won't be so troublesome.

萌芽.zh: 春天来了，树木都开始萌芽。
萌芽.en: Spring has come, and the trees are starting to bud.

楷模.zh: 雷锋一直是中国人学习的楷模。
楷模.en: Lei Feng has always been a role model for Chinese people to learn from.

楷模.zh: 老师用优秀学生作为楷模来鼓励大家。
楷模.en: The teacher uses outstanding students as role models to encourage everyone.

楷模.zh: 虽然他已经很成功了，但依然谦虚，真是楷模。
楷模.en: Although he is already very successful, he remains humble—truly a role model.

楷模.zh: 这位科学家是年轻人的楷模。
楷模.en: This scientist is a role model for young people.

一把手.en: He is the top boss of the company.

一把手.zh: 我们单位的一把手今天来我们部门视察了。
一把手.en: The big boss of our organization came to inspect our department today.

一把手.zh: 这件事必须请示一把手才能决定。
一把手.en: We must consult the top leader to decide on this matter.

一把手.zh: 因为一把手不在，所以会议推迟了。
一把手.en: Because the top leader wasn't there, the meeting was postponed.

一把手.zh: 他是我们项目的一把手，所有事都他说了算。
一把手.en: He is the head of our project; everything is decided by him.

彩电.en: My family bought a new color TV.

彩电.zh: 现在彩电很便宜，但很少有人看了，都用手机。
彩电.en: Color TVs are cheap now, but few people watch them—they all use phones.

彩电.zh: 这台彩电用了十年还没坏。
彩电.en: This color TV has been used for ten years and still hasn't broken.

彩电.zh: 虽然家里有彩电，但爸爸还是喜欢用电脑看新闻。
彩电.en: Although we have a color TV at home, Dad still prefers watching news on the computer.

彩电.zh: 以前的彩电是那种大屁股的，现在都是液晶的。
彩电.en: Old color TVs were the big bulky ones; now they're all LCD.

稳妥.en: This plan is very safe and reliable.

稳妥.zh: 为了稳妥起见，我们还是再多检查一遍。
稳妥.en: To be on the safe side, let's check one more time.

稳妥.zh: 他做事一向很稳妥，交给他放心。
稳妥.en: He always does things prudently, so you can trust him with it.

稳妥.zh: 虽然慢一点，但这种方法更稳妥。
稳妥.en: Although it's a bit slower, this method is more reliable.

稳妥.zh: 投资要选稳妥的方式，别太冒险。
稳妥.en: You should choose a safe way to invest, don't take too many risks.

不慎.zh: 我不慎把杯子打碎了，真的很抱歉。
不慎.en: I inadvertently broke the cup—I'm really sorry.
Driving carelessly can easily lead to accidents.

不慎.zh: 因为不慎走漏了消息，计划全泡汤了。
不慎.en: Because the news was carelessly leaked, the whole plan fell through.

不慎.zh: 他打字时不慎删除了重要文件。
不慎.en: He accidentally deleted an important file while typing.

减免.en: This month's electricity bill is reduced.

减免.zh: 政府给小微企业减免了部分税收，帮他们渡过难关。
减免.en: The government reduced some taxes for small businesses to help them through difficulties.

减免.zh: 因为疫情，房东给我们减免了一个月房租。
减免.en: Because of the pandemic, the landlord reduced our rent for one month.

减免.zh: 如果你提前付款，我们可以减免一些手续费。
减免.en: If you pay in advance, we can waive some handling fees.

减免.zh: 学校减免了贫困生的学费，还提供了生活费补助。
减免.en: The school waived tuition for poor students and provided living allowances.

转载.en: This article has been widely reposted.

转载.zh: 他在微博上转载了一条新闻，但没有注明来源。
转载.en: He reposted a news article on Weibo but didn't cite the source.

转载.zh: 虽然转载很方便，但一定要尊重原创者的版权。
转载.en: Although reposting is convenient, you must respect the original author's copyright.

转载.zh: 我转载了朋友拍的一张照片，大家都说好看。
转载.en: I shared a photo my friend took, and everyone said it was nice.

转载.zh: 很多公众号靠转载热门文章来吸引粉丝。
转载.en: Many official accounts rely on reposting popular articles to attract followers.

就餐.zh: 这家餐厅环境很好，适合朋友一起就餐聊天。
就餐.en: This restaurant has a great ambiance, suitable for dining and chatting with friends.

就餐.zh: 因为客人多，我们建议您提前预定就餐位置。
就餐.en: Because there are many customers, we suggest you reserve a dining spot in advance.

就餐.zh: 在飞机上就餐时，空姐会提供饮料和餐食。
就餐.en: When dining on the plane, the flight attendant provides drinks and meals.

就餐.zh: 学校食堂的就餐时间是从中午十一点到一点。
就餐.en: The school cafeteria's dining hours are from 11 am to 1 pm.

印证.zh: 新的证据印证了警方之前的猜测，凶手就是他。
印证.en: The new evidence confirmed the police's previous guess that the murderer was him.

印证.zh: 虽然我们早有预感，但调查结果印证了我们的担心。
印证.en: Although we had a feeling, the investigation results confirmed our worries.

印证.zh: 她的话跟监控录像完全吻合，印证了她不在场。
印证.en: Her words completely matched the surveillance footage, confirming she was not present.

印证.zh: 这次实验的数据印证了科学家的理论。
印证.en: The data from this experiment confirmed the scientist's theory.

吸纳.en: The company is recruiting new talent.

吸纳.zh: 这个项目需要吸纳更多的投资才能顺利启动。
吸纳.en: This project needs to absorb more investment to start smoothly.

吸纳.zh: 如果社团想发展，就要积极吸纳不同专业的成员。
吸纳.en: If the club wants to grow, it must actively recruit members from different majors.

吸纳.zh: 海绵能迅速吸纳水分，保持干燥。
吸纳.en: Sponges can quickly absorb water and keep things dry.

吸纳.zh: 银行通过发行理财产品来吸纳社会闲散资金。
吸纳.en: Banks absorb idle social funds by issuing wealth management products.

破除.en: We need to break down superstitions.

破除.zh: 只有破除陈旧观念，社会才能进步。
破除.en: Only by eliminating outdated ideas can society progress.

破除.zh: 为了促进公平竞争，必须破除行业垄断和壁垒。
破除.en: To promote fair competition, we must break down industry monopolies and barriers.

破除.zh: 他努力破除自己内心的恐惧，终于站在台上演讲。
破除.en: He worked to break down his inner fear and finally stood on stage to give a speech.

破除.zh: 这项改革旨在破除官僚主义，提高办事效率。
破除.en: This reform aims to eliminate bureaucracy and improve efficiency.

可想而知.en: It is conceivable that he is very angry.

可想而知.zh: 他连饭都没吃就走了，当时的心情可想而知。
可想而知.en: He left without even eating, so his mood at that time is imaginable.

可想而知.zh: 这么冷的天还要在外面站岗，他们的辛苦可想而知。
可想而知.en: On such a cold day they have to stand guard outside, so their hardship is unimaginable.

可想而知.zh: 如果连基础都不会，考试结果可想而知。
可想而知.en: If you don't even know the basics, the exam result is foreseeable.

可想而知.zh: 看到孩子受伤，父母的心痛可想而知。
可想而知.en: Seeing the child injured, the parents' heartache is understandable.

心酸.zh: 看到老人独自在街上卖菜，我心里一阵心酸。
心酸.en: Seeing the old man selling vegetables alone on the street, I felt a pang of sadness.

心酸.zh: 虽然她笑着说没事，但我知道她心里很心酸。
心酸.en: Although she smiled and said it's okay, I know she felt sad inside.

心酸.zh: 回忆起那段艰难的日子，他忍不住心酸落泪。
心酸.en: Recalling those difficult days, he couldn't help but feel sad and shed tears.

心酸.zh: 电影里的离别场景特别让人心酸。
心酸.en: The farewell scene in the movie is particularly heart-wrenching.

折射.zh: 水里的筷子看起来像是折射了。
折射.en: The chopsticks in water look refracted.

折射.zh: 他的言行折射出他内心的焦虑和不安全感。
折射.en: His words and actions reflect his inner anxiety and insecurity.

折射.zh: 这些数据不仅反映了现状，也折射出未来的趋势。
折射.en: These data not only reflect the current situation but also indicate future trends.

折射.zh: 阳光透过三棱镜折射出七彩光芒。
折射.en: Sunlight refracts through a prism into a rainbow of colors.

折射.zh: 这部剧折射了当代年轻人的生活压力和梦想。
折射.en: This drama reflects the life pressure and dreams of contemporary young people.

预兆.en: This is not a good omen.

预兆.zh: 早上看到乌鸦，老人们说这是不吉利的预兆。
预兆.en: Seeing a crow in the morning, old folks say it's an unlucky omen.

预兆.zh: 虽然没有明显的预兆，但他总觉得会出事。
预兆.en: Although there was no obvious sign, he felt something bad would happen.

预兆.zh: 连续几天阴雨，可能是台风来临的预兆。
预兆.en: Several days of continuous rain might be a sign of an approaching typhoon.

预兆.zh: 她做了一夜噩梦，觉得这是不好的预兆。
预兆.en: She had nightmares all night and felt it was a bad omen.

暂且.zh: 这件事暂且放一放，以后再说。
暂且.en: Let's put this aside for now and discuss it later.

暂且.zh: 你暂且住在我家，等找到房子再搬。
暂且.en: Stay at my place for now, move out when you find a place.

暂且.zh: 虽然问题很多，但暂且先解决最紧急的。
暂且.en: Although there are many problems, let's solve the most urgent ones for now.

暂且.zh: 我暂且不回答你，等我查清楚再说。
暂且.en: I won't answer you for now; I'll reply after I check it out.

劝告.en: I advise you not to go.
The doctor advised him to rest more.

劝告.zh: 朋友劝告我别冲动，但我没听。
劝告.en: My friend advised me not to act impulsively, but I didn't listen.

劝告.zh: 老师经常劝告我们要好好学英语。
劝告.en: The teacher often advises us to study English well.

劝告.zh: 虽然他不听劝告，但我还是想再说一次。
劝告.en: Although he doesn't listen to advice, I still want to say it again.

稠.zh: 汤煮得太稠了，加点水吧。
稠.en: The soup is too thick; add some water.

稠.zh: 我喜欢喝稠一点的豆浆。
稠.en: I like soy milk that's a bit thicker.

稠.zh: 这个酱汁很稠，适合蘸东西吃。
稠.en: This sauce is very thick, suitable for dipping.

稠.zh: 牛奶放太多了，面糊变得很稠。
稠.en: Too much milk made the batter very thick.

旺季.en: It's the peak tourist season now.
Airfare is very expensive during peak season.

旺季.zh: 这家酒店在旺季很难订到房间。
旺季.en: This hotel is hard to book during peak season.

旺季.zh: 旺季的时候，景区人山人海。
旺季.en: During peak season, the scenic spots are packed with people.

旺季.zh: 我一般选择淡季出行，避开旺季。
旺季.en: I usually travel in the off-season to avoid peak season.

压榨.zh: 公司总是压榨我们，加班不给钱。
压榨.en: The company always squeezes us, working overtime without pay.

压榨.zh: 他靠压榨农民赚了很多钱。
压榨.en: He made a lot of money by exploiting farmers.

压榨.zh: 这种工作压榨了员工的健康。
压榨.en: This kind of job squeezes the health of employees.

及早.en: You should prepare as soon as possible.
Problems should be solved as soon as possible.
If you're sick, see a doctor as soon as possible.

及早.zh: 机票及早订会比较便宜。
为了健康，他决定及早戒烟。
及早.en: For health reasons, he decided to quit smoking as soon as possible.

领事.en: I need to contact the Chinese consul.
He went to the consulate to apply for a visa.

领事.zh: 领事先生帮我们解决了问题。
领事.en: The consul helped us solve the problem.

领事.zh: 如果你在国外丢了护照，可以找当地领事。
领事.en: If you lose your passport abroad, you can contact the local consul.

记忆犹新.en: That event is still fresh in my memory.

记忆犹新.zh: 十年前的事，我至今记忆犹新。
记忆犹新.en: Things from ten years ago are still fresh in my memory.

记忆犹新.zh: 第一次见面的场景，我记忆犹新。
记忆犹新.en: The scene of our first meeting is still fresh in my memory.

记忆犹新.zh: 他说的话我记忆犹新，永远忘不了。
记忆犹新.en: His words are still fresh in my memory; I'll never forget them.

记忆犹新.zh: 虽然过了很多年，但那天的细节我记忆犹新。
记忆犹新.en: Although many years have passed, I still have vivid memories of that day's details.

日复一日.en: Day after day, life is very monotonous.

日复一日.zh: 她日复一日地练习钢琴。
日复一日.en: She practices the piano day after day.

日复一日.zh: 这种日子日复一日，让我觉得很无聊。
日复一日.en: This kind of life, day after day, makes me feel bored.

日复一日.zh: 日复一日地重复同样的事情，真的很累。
日复一日.en: Repeating the same thing day after day is really tiring.

莲子.en: There are lotus seeds in this soup.
Lotus seed porridge is good for the stomach.

莲子.zh: 夏天喝碗莲子汤很清凉。
莲子.en: Having a bowl of lotus seed soup in summer is very refreshing.

莲子.zh: 我买了一些干莲子，准备炖银耳汤。
莲子.en: I bought some dried lotus seeds and plan to make white fungus soup.

风浪.en: The wind and waves at sea are big.

风浪.zh: 他经历了很多风浪，但从不放弃。
风浪.en: He has experienced many storms but never gives up.

风浪.zh: 虽然遇到了风浪，我们还是顺利完成了任务。
风浪.en: Although we encountered stormy waves, we still completed the task smoothly.

风浪.zh: 生活中难免有风浪，关键是怎么面对。
风浪.en: Life inevitably has storms; the key is how to face them.

风浪.zh: 因为风浪太大，船没法出海。
风浪.en: Because the wind and waves were too strong, the boat couldn't go out to sea.

儒学.en: He has studied Confucianism for many years.

儒学.zh: 儒学对中国传统文化有很深的影响。
儒学.en: Confucianism has a deep influence on traditional Chinese culture.

儒学.zh: 很多韩国人也对儒学非常感兴趣。
儒学.en: Many Koreans are also very interested in Confucianism.

儒学.zh: 我觉得儒学里的“仁”很重要。
儒学.en: I think the 'ren' in Confucianism is very important.

儒学.zh: 虽然儒学历史悠久，但现代人仍然在学习它。
儒学.en: Although Confucianism has a long history, modern people still study it.

双边.zh: 两国正在加强双边贸易合作。
双边.en: The two countries are strengthening bilateral trade cooperation.

双边.zh: 这次会谈主要讨论双边安全问题。
双边.en: This meeting mainly discusses bilateral security issues.

双边.zh: 双边协议已经正式签署了。
双边.en: The bilateral agreement has been officially signed.

双边.zh: 如果双方都努力，双边关系会越来越好。
双边.en: If both sides work hard, the bilateral relationship will get better.

考量.zh: 做决定前要仔细考量各种因素。
考量.en: Before making a decision, you need to carefully consider various factors.

考量.zh: 他的考量主要基于成本。
考量.en: His consideration is mainly based on cost.

考量.zh: 时间也是重要的考量之一。
考量.en: Time is also one of the important considerations.

考量.zh: 因为安全考量，我们改变了计划。
考量.en: Due to safety considerations, we changed the plan.

扫除.en: We need to sweep the room.

扫除.zh: 大家一起动手扫除院子里的落叶。
扫除.en: Everyone worked together to sweep the leaves in the yard.

扫除.zh: 这个政策能扫除不少障碍。
扫除.en: This policy can eliminate many obstacles.

扫除.zh: 节前家家户户都会大扫除。
扫除.en: Before the festival, every household does a thorough cleaning.

扫除.zh: 不仅要注意卫生扫除，还要注意个人防护。
扫除.en: Not only pay attention to cleaning for hygiene, but also personal protection.

专柜.en: This brand has a special counter.

专柜.zh: 我在化妆品专柜买了新口红。
专柜.en: I bought a new lipstick at the cosmetics counter.

专柜.zh: 百货大楼的一楼是珠宝专柜。
专柜.en: The first floor of the department store is jewelry counters.

专柜.zh: 专柜的服务员态度特别好。
专柜.en: The service staff at the counter are very friendly.

专柜.zh: 如果你找不到，可以去问专柜的店员。
专柜.en: If you can't find it, you can ask the staff at the counter.

猛然.zh: 听到消息，他猛然回头看了一眼。
猛然.en: Hearing the news, he suddenly turned his head and looked.

猛然.zh: 汽车猛然刹车，吓了我一跳。
猛然.en: The car suddenly braked, scaring me.

猛然.zh: 她猛然想起钥匙忘在家里了。
猛然.en: She suddenly remembered she left her keys at home.

猛然.zh: 正在走路时，他猛然发现前面有个坑。
猛然.en: While walking, he suddenly discovered a pit ahead.

略微.zh: 这道菜略微有点辣，但很好吃。
略微.en: This dish is slightly spicy but very tasty.

略微.zh: 我只需要略微修改一下就行了。
略微.en: I just need to make a slight modification.

略微.zh: 虽然只略微迟到了几分钟，但也不太好。
略微.en: Although only a few minutes late, it's not good.

不得而知.zh: 他为什么突然辞职，我们不得而知。
不得而知.en: Why he suddenly resigned, we cannot know.

不得而知.zh: 这件事的结果至今不得而知。
不得而知.en: The result of this matter is still unknown.

不得而知.zh: 真相如何，外人不得而知。
不得而知.en: What the truth is, outsiders cannot know.

不得而知.zh: 虽然有很多猜测，但实际情况不得而知。
不得而知.en: Although there are many guesses, the actual situation is unknown.

停放.zh: 请把自行车停放到指定区域。
停放.en: Please park bicycles in the designated area.
You can park electric scooters downstairs.

停放.zh: 机场有大型停车场供旅客停放汽车。
停放.en: The airport has a large parking lot for travelers to park cars.

停放.zh: 如果你要停放汽车，需要先交费。
停放.en: If you want to park a car, you need to pay first.

韵味.en: This song has a lot of charm.

韵味.zh: 她的画充满了古典韵味。
韵味.en: Her paintings are full of classical charm.

韵味.zh: 这种茶喝起来有独特的韵味。
韵味.en: This tea has a unique flavor when you drink it.

韵味.zh: 虽然歌词简单，但唱出来很有韵味。
韵味.en: Although the lyrics are simple, it sounds very appealing when sung.

韵味.zh: 老房子虽然破旧，但保留了很多韵味。
韵味.en: The old house is shabby, but it retains a lot of charm.

默默无闻.zh: 这位作家默默无闻了很多年。
默默无闻.en: This writer was obscure for many years.

默默无闻.zh: 他在公司里默默无闻地工作。
默默无闻.en: He works quietly and unnoticed in the company.

默默无闻.zh: 虽然默默无闻，但他的贡献很大。
默默无闻.en: Although he is obscure, his contributions are great.

默默无闻.zh: 很多默默无闻的人其实做了很多好事。
默默无闻.en: Many unknown people actually do a lot of good deeds.

隔阂.en: There is a rift between them.
Talking more can eliminate the estrangement.

隔阂.zh: 父母和孩子之间难免有隔阂。
隔阂.en: There is inevitably a generation gap between parents and children.

隔阂.zh: 因为误会，他俩产生了隔阂。
隔阂.en: They developed a rift because of a misunderstanding.

隔阂.zh: 如果大家多沟通，隔阂就会慢慢消失。
隔阂.en: If everyone communicates more, the rift will gradually disappear.

柿子.zh: 秋天是吃柿子的好季节。
柿子.en: Autumn is a good season to eat persimmons.

柿子.zh: 我在路边买了一袋柿子。
柿子.en: I bought a bag of persimmons by the roadside.

柿子.zh: 柿子熟了以后要赶紧吃，不然会坏。
柿子.en: Once persimmons are ripe, eat them quickly or they'll go bad.

当即.en: I decided right away not to go.

当即.zh: 看到情况不对，他当即停下了车。
当即.en: Seeing that something was wrong, he stopped the car immediately.

当即.zh: 老板听了这个方案，当即拍板。
当即.en: After hearing the plan, the boss made a final decision on the spot.

当即.zh: 医生检查后当即开了药。
当即.en: The doctor prescribed medicine right after the examination.

冰雹.en: The hail damaged all the crops.

冰雹.zh: 这场冰雹来得太突然了。
天气预报说今天可能有冰雹。
冰雹.en: The weather forecast says there might be hail today.

冰雹.zh: 冰雹砸在车顶上，声音很大。
冰雹.en: The hail hit the car roof, making a loud noise.

耐性.en: He has no patience to wait.

耐性.zh: 教小孩需要很大的耐性。
耐性.en: Teaching children requires a lot of patience.

耐性.zh: 这份工作考验人的耐性。
耐性.en: This job tests a person's patience.

耐性.zh: 钓鱼需要耐性，不能着急。
耐性.en: Fishing requires patience; you can't rush.

耐性.zh: 他对客户很有耐性，从不发火。
耐性.en: He is very patient with clients and never gets angry.

疙瘩.en: I have a pimple on my face.

疙瘩.zh: 他心里有个疙瘩没解开。
疙瘩.en: He has a knot in his heart that hasn't been resolved.

疙瘩.zh: 这个绳子打了个死疙瘩。
疙瘩.en: This rope has a knot that won't come undone.

疙瘩.zh: 我胳膊上被蚊子咬了个疙瘩。
疙瘩.en: I have a mosquito bite lump on my arm.

疙瘩.zh: 如果你心里有疙瘩，就说出来。
疙瘩.en: If you have a knot in your heart, just say it out.

顺路.en: I'll give you a ride since it's on my way.
I'll stop by the supermarket on my way home from work.

顺路.zh: 你回家顺路吗？帮我带杯咖啡。
顺路.en: Is it on your way home? Bring me a coffee.
He picked up the package on the way.

顺路.zh: 如果顺路的话，我们一起去吧。
顺路.en: If it's on the way, let's go together.

把柄.en: He has a hold on me.

把柄.zh: 别让别人抓到你的把柄。
把柄.en: Don't let others get leverage over you.
The handle of this knife is broken.

把柄.zh: 他做事很小心，不给人留把柄。
把柄.en: He is very careful in his actions and leaves no handles for others.

把柄.zh: 如果你有把柄在别人手上，就会很被动。
把柄.en: If someone has a hold on you, you'll be very passive.

有效期.zh: 这个优惠券有效期到月底。
有效期.en: This coupon is valid until the end of the month.

有效期.zh: 你买之前记得看一下产品的有效期，过期就不能用了。
有效期.en: Remember to check the expiration date of the product before buying; if it's expired, you can't use it.

有效期.zh: 护照的有效期还有两年，不用担心。
有效期.en: The passport is still valid for two years, so don't worry.

有效期.zh: 虽然看起来还能用，但有效期已经过了，所以别吃。
有效期.en: Although it looks usable, the expiration date has passed, so don't eat it.

有效期.zh: 药品的有效期一般印在包装上。
有效期.en: The expiration date of medicine is usually printed on the packaging.

久违.en: Long time no see, old classmate!

久违.zh: 好久不见，这真是一次久违的聚会。
久违.en: Long time no see, this is a truly long-awaited gathering.

久违.zh: 这种久违的感觉让我很怀念。
久违.en: This long-missed feeling makes me nostalgic.

久违.zh: 因为工作太忙，我们久违地一起吃了顿饭。
久违.en: Because work was too busy, we finally had a meal together after a long time.

久违.zh: 听到他的声音，有种久违的亲切感。
久违.en: Hearing his voice gave me a sense of long-missed familiarity.

务实.en: He is very pragmatic and never indulges in wishful thinking.

务实.zh: 在决策时，我们需要更加务实一些，别光谈理想。
务实.en: When making decisions, we need to be more pragmatic and not just talk about ideals.

务实.zh: 务实的态度让他赢得了大家的信任。
务实.en: His pragmatic attitude earned everyone's trust.

务实.zh: 虽然计划很美好，但我们要务实一点，先解决眼前问题。
务实.en: Although the plan is wonderful, we need to be practical and solve the immediate problems first.

务实.zh: 他提出的方案非常务实，大家都同意。
务实.en: The plan he proposed is very pragmatic, and everyone agreed.

情理.zh: 他生气也是情理之中的事，你别怪他。
情理.en: His anger is only to be expected, don't blame him.

情理.zh: 你的要求不太合乎情理，我需要再想想。
情理.en: Your request isn't very reasonable; I need to think it over.

情理.zh: 按理说，他应该帮忙，但情理上我理解他不愿意。
情理.en: Logically, he should help, but emotionally I understand his reluctance.

情理.zh: 这个结果出乎情理之外，谁也没想到。
情理.en: This result is beyond reason; nobody expected it.

面目全非.en: This place is already completely unrecognizable.

面目全非.zh: 几年没回来，老家变得面目全非，我都认不出了。
面目全非.en: After a few years away, my hometown has changed beyond recognition; I can't even recognize it.

面目全非.zh: 一场大火让整栋楼面目全非。
面目全非.en: A big fire left the entire building unrecognizable.

面目全非.zh: 因为装修，原来的房间面目全非，连布局都改了。
面目全非.en: Because of the renovation, the original room was completely transformed, even the layout was changed.

面目全非.zh: 他的脸被划伤后，几乎面目全非。
面目全非.en: After his face was cut, it was almost unrecognizable.

暗地里.zh: 他暗地里帮她准备生日惊喜。
暗地里.en: He secretly prepared a birthday surprise for her.

暗地里.zh: 表面上他们很友好，暗地里却在竞争。
暗地里.en: On the surface they are friendly, but secretly they are competing.

暗地里.zh: 我暗地里观察了很久，才确定他没说谎。
暗地里.en: I secretly observed for a long time before confirming he wasn't lying.

暗地里.zh: 虽然他说没关系，但暗地里还是很不高兴。
暗地里.en: Although he said it was fine, he was still unhappy deep down.

暗地里.zh: 别在暗地里搞小动作，有话当面说。
暗地里.en: Don't play tricks behind the scenes; say it to my face.

风气.en: This kind of atmosphere is very bad.

风气.zh: 最近公司里学习风气很浓，大家都在考证书。
风气.en: Recently, the learning atmosphere in the company is strong; everyone is getting certified.

风气.zh: 我们要抵制不良风气，从自己做起。
风气.en: We should resist bad trends and start with ourselves.

风气.zh: 如果大家都这么做，就会形成一种攀比的风气。
风气.en: If everyone does this, it will create a trend of comparison.

风气.zh: 学校里读书风气越来越好了。
风气.en: The reading atmosphere at school is getting better and better.

座谈.en: There is a discussion meeting this afternoon.

座谈.zh: 我们要开一个座谈会，讨论一下员工的建议。
座谈.en: We're going to hold a discussion meeting to talk about employee suggestions.

座谈.zh: 座谈会上，大家畅所欲言。
座谈.en: At the discussion meeting, everyone spoke freely.

座谈.zh: 因为时间有限，座谈会只持续了一个小时。
座谈.en: Because time was limited, the discussion meeting only lasted an hour.

座谈.zh: 这次座谈会有很多专家参加。
座谈.en: Many experts participated in this discussion meeting.

依托.zh: 他依托父母的支持创业。
依托.en: He started his business relying on his parents' support.

依托.zh: 这个项目主要依托于当地政府的政策扶持。
依托.en: This project mainly relies on the local government's policy support.

依托.zh: 我们不能总依托别人，要学会独立。
依托.en: We can't always depend on others; we need to learn to be independent.

依托.zh: 虽然公司规模小，但依托先进技术发展很快。
依托.en: Although the company is small, it grows quickly by relying on advanced technology.

依托.zh: 这个平台依托大数据来推荐内容。
依托.en: This platform relies on big data to recommend content.

境遇.zh: 他现在的境遇比以前好多了，终于稳定下来。
境遇.en: His situation now is much better than before; he's finally settled down.

境遇.zh: 面对同样的境遇，每个人的反应都不一样。
境遇.en: Facing the same circumstances, everyone reacts differently.

境遇.zh: 虽然境遇艰难，但他从未放弃努力。
境遇.en: Although his circumstances were tough, he never gave up trying.

境遇.zh: 我们要理解不同人的不同境遇。
境遇.en: We need to understand different people's different circumstances.

陡.zh: 这个山坡太陡了，我有点害怕。
陡.en: This hillside is too steep, I'm a bit scared.

陡.zh: 路突然变陡，开车要小心。
陡.en: The road suddenly gets steep, drive carefully.

陡.zh: 楼梯很陡，老人上下不太方便。
陡.en: The stairs are very steep, it's inconvenient for the elderly to go up and down.

陡.zh: 因为坡度太陡，所以他骑自行车只能推着走。
陡.en: Because the slope was too steep, he could only push his bike.

陡.zh: 虽然山路很陡，但我们还是坚持爬到了山顶。
陡.en: Although the mountain path was steep, we persisted and reached the summit.

荒诞.zh: 这个故事太荒诞了，没人会相信。
荒诞.en: This story is too absurd, no one would believe it.

荒诞.zh: 他的想法简直荒诞不经。
电影里那些荒诞的情节反而让我觉得很有意思。
荒诞.en: Those absurd plot points in the movie actually made me find it interesting.

荒诞.zh: 如果以为不努力就能成功，那真是荒诞的想法。
荒诞.en: If you think you can succeed without effort, that's a ridiculous notion.

荒诞.zh: 虽然这个提议听起来很荒诞，但仔细想想也有点道理。
荒诞.en: Although this proposal sounds absurd, it actually makes some sense if you think about it carefully.

推算.zh: 你能推算一下明天几点下雨吗？
推算.en: Can you predict what time it will rain tomorrow?

推算.zh: 根据这些数据，我们可以推算出结果。
推算.en: Based on these data, we can calculate the result.

推算.zh: 他推算了好几次，终于得出了正确答案。
推算.en: He calculated several times and finally got the correct answer.

推算.zh: 专家推算，这次地震的震级大约在六级左右。
推算.en: Experts estimate that the magnitude of this earthquake is around 6.

推算.zh: 虽然推算出的日期不准确，但大致范围还是有参考价值的。
推算.en: Although the calculated date is not accurate, the general range is still useful for reference.

周折.en: This matter involved a lot of trouble.

周折.zh: 经过一番周折，我们终于找到了钥匙。
周折.en: After some twists and turns, we finally found the keys.

周折.zh: 办签证的过程很周折，跑了三趟才办好。
周折.en: The visa process was very complicated; it took three trips to get it done.

周折.zh: 虽然中间有些周折，但最后结果还不错。
周折.en: Although there were some setbacks along the way, the final result was not bad.

周折.zh: 他们为了买这套房子费了很多周折，换了三个中介。
周折.en: They went through a lot of trouble to buy this house, switching between three agents.

流域.en: The Yangtze River basin has a highly developed economy.

流域.zh: 这片流域的污染问题需要重视。
流域.en: The pollution problem in this river basin needs attention.

流域.zh: 黄河流域是中华文明的发源地之一。
流域.en: The Yellow River basin is one of the cradles of Chinese civilization.

流域.zh: 科学家正在研究整个流域的生态系统变化。
流域.en: Scientists are studying ecological system changes across the entire river basin.

流域.zh: 因为上游建了水库，下游流域的农业用水得到了保障。
流域.en: Because a reservoir was built upstream, agricultural water in the downstream basin has been secured.

卷子.en: The teacher is grading the exam papers.
The exam paper this time was very difficult.

卷子.zh: 他把卷子翻来覆去检查了好几遍。
卷子.en: He went over the exam paper again and again, checking it several times.

卷子.zh: 发卷子的时候，我心里特别紧张。
卷子.en: When the papers were handed out, I was extremely nervous.

卷子.zh: 虽然卷子上的题目我都会，但时间不够还是没写完。
卷子.en: Although I knew all the questions on the paper, I didn't finish because I ran out of time.

启迪.zh: 这本书给了我很多启迪。
启迪.en: This book gave me a lot of inspiration.

启迪.zh: 老师的讲话很有启迪性。
启迪.en: The teacher's speech was very inspiring.

启迪.zh: 他的经历启迪了我要勇敢追梦。
启迪.en: His experience inspired me to bravely pursue my dreams.

启迪.zh: 这部纪录片对年轻人的思想有很好的启迪作用。
启迪.en: This documentary has a great enlightening effect on young people's thinking.

启迪.zh: 那次对话虽然简短，却对我的未来产生了深刻的启迪。
启迪.en: Although that conversation was brief, it profoundly enlightened my future.

劳务.zh: 他做的是劳务派遣工作。
劳务.en: He works as a dispatched laborer.

劳务.zh: 这家公司专门提供劳务服务。
劳务.en: This company specializes in providing labor services.

劳务.zh: 劳务市场的竞争越来越激烈了。
劳务.en: Competition in the labor market is becoming more intense.

劳务.zh: 他们签了一份劳务合同，明确了双方的责任。
劳务.en: They signed a labor contract that clarified the responsibilities of both parties.

劳务.zh: 因为公司缺人手，所以临时雇了一些劳务工来帮忙。
劳务.en: Because the company was short-staffed, they temporarily hired some laborers to help.

不言而喻.zh: 这件事的重要性不言而喻。
不言而喻.en: The importance of this matter is self-evident.

不言而喻.zh: 健康的身体对每个人来说都不言而喻。
不言而喻.en: Good health goes without saying for everyone.

不言而喻.zh: 他那么努力，成功是不言而喻的。
不言而喻.en: He works so hard; his success is self-evident.

不言而喻.zh: 空气和水对人类的重要性不言而喻，但很多人还是不懂得珍惜。
不言而喻.en: The importance of air and water to humans is self-evident, yet many people still don't know how to cherish them.

不言而喻.zh: 在这个行业里，经验的价值不言而喻，学历反而没那么重要了。
不言而喻.en: In this industry, the value of experience is self-evident, while academic qualifications are less important.

筹办.en: They are preparing for the wedding.

筹办.zh: 公司筹办了一场大型年会。
筹办.en: The company organized a large annual meeting.

筹办.zh: 筹办这次活动需要很多资金。
筹办.en: Preparing for this event requires a lot of funding.

筹办.zh: 他负责筹办校庆的各项事宜，忙得不可开交。
筹办.en: He is in charge of organizing all the matters for the school anniversary, extremely busy.

筹办.zh: 虽然筹办过程很辛苦，但看到大家玩得开心就觉得值得。
筹办.en: Although the preparation process was hard, seeing everyone have a good time made it worth it.

爱惜.en: You should take good care of your body.

爱惜.zh: 他很爱惜这本书，因为是他妈妈送的。
爱惜.en: He treasures this book because his mother gave it to him.
