爱惜.zh: 我们应该爱惜水资源，不要浪费。
爱惜.en: We should cherish water resources and not waste them.

爱惜.zh: 虽然时间不多，但他很爱惜每一分钟。
爱惜.en: Although time is short, he cherishes every minute.

爱惜.zh: 她非常爱惜自己的头发，从不染烫。
爱惜.en: She takes great care of her hair and never dyes or perms it.

僧人.en: That monk chants scriptures every day.

僧人.zh: 寺庙里有一位年老的僧人正在打坐。
僧人.en: There is an elderly monk meditating in the temple.

僧人.zh: 虽然僧人平时不说话，但他很友善。
僧人.en: Although the monk usually doesn't speak, he is very kind.

僧人.zh: 这位僧人在山里住了二十年了。
僧人.en: This monk has lived in the mountains for twenty years.

僧人.zh: 游客们看见一位僧人正在扫地。
僧人.en: The tourists saw a monk sweeping the floor.

画展.en: Is there an art exhibition tomorrow?

画展.zh: 我朋友邀请我去看他的个人画展。
画展.en: My friend invited me to his solo art exhibition.

画展.zh: 因为画展很受欢迎，所以门票早就卖完了。
画展.en: Because the art exhibition was very popular, tickets sold out early.

画展.zh: 这个画展展出了很多现代艺术作品。
画展.en: This art exhibition features many modern artworks.

画展.zh: 她第一次办画展，来了很多人。
画展.en: She held her first art exhibition, and many people came.

抱负.zh: 年轻人应该有自己的抱负，并为之努力。
抱负.en: Young people should have their own ambitions and work towards them.

抱负.zh: 虽然他的抱负很大，但他一步一步在实现。
抱负.en: Although his ambitions are big, he is achieving them step by step.

抱负.zh: 她的抱负是成为一名科学家。
抱负.en: Her ambition is to become a scientist.

抱负.zh: 毕业后，他为了实现抱负去了北京。
抱负.en: After graduation, he went to Beijing to realize his ambitions.

膳食.en: The meals here are pretty good.

膳食.zh: 医生建议我注意膳食均衡，多吃蔬菜。
膳食.en: The doctor advised me to pay attention to a balanced diet and eat more vegetables.

膳食.zh: 因为工作太忙，他的膳食很不规律。
膳食.en: Because he is too busy with work, his meals are very irregular.

膳食.zh: 学校食堂的膳食种类很丰富。
膳食.en: The school cafeteria has a wide variety of meals.

膳食.zh: 这份膳食计划适合减肥的人。
膳食.en: This meal plan is suitable for people trying to lose weight.

勇往直前.zh: 遇到困难时，我们要勇往直前，不要退缩。
勇往直前.en: When we face difficulties, we should forge ahead courageously and not retreat.

勇往直前.zh: 既然选择了这条路，就要勇往直前走下去。
勇往直前.en: Since you chose this path, you must keep forging ahead courageously.

勇往直前.zh: 他的性格就是勇往直前，从不害怕失败。
勇往直前.en: His personality is to forge ahead courageously, never afraid of failure.

勇往直前.zh: 在比赛中，他勇往直前，最终获得了冠军。
勇往直前.en: In the competition, he forged ahead courageously and ultimately won the championship.

下海.en: He went into business last year.

下海.zh: 很多老师辞职下海去做生意了。
下海.en: Many teachers quit their jobs to go into business.

下海.zh: 虽然风险很大，但他还是决定下海创业。
下海.en: Although the risk is high, he still decided to go into business and start a venture.

下海.zh: 他下海三年，赚了不少钱。
下海.en: He has been in business for three years and made a lot of money.

下海.zh: 这个渔民每天下海捕鱼。
下海.en: This fisherman goes out to sea every day to catch fish.

扎根.en: He has settled down in the countryside.

扎根.zh: 很多年轻人选择去西部扎根发展。
扎根.en: Many young people choose to settle in the west to develop.

扎根.zh: 他决定在这里扎根，因为喜欢这里的生活。
扎根.en: He decided to settle here because he likes the life here.

扎根.zh: 这棵大树已经扎根很深了。
扎根.en: This big tree has taken deep roots.

扎根.zh: 她在教育事业上扎根了十年。
扎根.en: She has been deeply rooted in education for ten years.

山寨.zh: 我不喜欢买山寨产品，质量没有保证。
山寨.en: I don't like buying knockoff products; the quality is not guaranteed.

山寨.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但山寨货很容易坏。
山寨.en: Although the price is cheap, knockoff goods break easily.

山寨.zh: 他们去了一个很漂亮的山寨旅游。
山寨.en: They went to a very beautiful mountain village for a trip.

山寨.zh: 这个牌子经常被山寨模仿。
山寨.en: This brand is often copied by knockoff makers.

悬殊.en: There is a huge disparity in strength.

悬殊.zh: 这场比赛双方实力悬殊，结果很明显。
悬殊.en: In this match, the two sides have a huge disparity in strength, so the result is obvious.

悬殊.zh: 因为收入悬殊太大，社会问题也很多。
悬殊.en: Because the income disparity is too large, there are also many social problems.

悬殊.zh: 他们俩的年龄悬殊了二十岁。
悬殊.en: The age gap between them is twenty years.

悬殊.zh: 贫富悬殊是一个全球性问题。
悬殊.en: The wealth disparity is a global issue.

稀少.en: This kind of bird is very rare.

稀少.zh: 因为下雨，街上行人稀少。
稀少.en: Because of the rain, there are few pedestrians on the street.

稀少.zh: 虽然这种植物很稀少，但它的药用价值很高。
稀少.en: Although this plant is rare, its medicinal value is high.

稀少.zh: 在这个地区，淡水鱼类非常稀少。
稀少.en: In this region, freshwater fish are very scarce.

稀少.zh: 由于人口稀少，这里的学校都关门了。
稀少.en: Due to sparse population, the schools here have all closed.

名贵.zh: 他收藏了很多名贵的字画和瓷器。
名贵.en: He collects many precious calligraphy works and porcelains.

名贵.zh: 这瓶酒不仅名贵，而且口感极佳。
名贵.en: This bottle of wine is not only precious but also tastes excellent.

名贵.zh: 这种木材非常名贵，常用于制作高档家具。
名贵.en: This kind of wood is very precious, often used for making high-end furniture.

名贵.zh: 她戴了一条名贵的珍珠项链。
名贵.en: She wore a precious pearl necklace.

启蒙.zh: 这本书是我的启蒙老师。
启蒙.en: This book was my enlightenment teacher.

启蒙.zh: 这位老师是我的音乐启蒙老师。
启蒙.en: This teacher was my music enlightenment teacher.

启蒙.zh: 因为小时候的启蒙教育，我后来爱上了科学。
启蒙.en: Because of the enlightenment education in my childhood, I later fell in love with science.

启蒙.zh: 父母是孩子的第一任启蒙老师。
启蒙.en: Parents are the first enlightenment teachers of children.

启蒙.zh: 他五岁开始接受钢琴启蒙。
启蒙.en: He started piano enlightenment at age five.

耳目一新.zh: 这个设计让人耳目一新。
这家餐厅的装修风格让我耳目一新。
耳目一新.en: The decoration style of this restaurant feels refreshing to me.

耳目一新.zh: 虽然剧情老套，但演员的表演让人耳目一新。
耳目一新.en: Although the plot is cliché, the actors' performances are refreshing.

耳目一新.zh: 他的新歌风格独特，令人耳目一新。
耳目一新.en: His new song has a unique style, which is refreshing.

耳目一新.zh: 这种教学方法让人耳目一新，学生都很喜欢。
耳目一新.en: This teaching method is refreshing, and students all like it.

焦躁.zh: 等了一个小时还没来，他开始焦躁起来。
焦躁.en: After waiting an hour without arrival, he started getting anxious.

焦躁.zh: 因为考试临近，他变得非常焦躁。
焦躁.en: Because the exam is near, he has become very anxious.

焦躁.zh: 听到这个消息，她心里很焦躁。
焦躁.en: Hearing this news, she felt very anxious.

焦躁.zh: 焦躁的情绪会影响你的判断。
焦躁.en: Anxious emotions will affect your judgment.

枢纽.en: This city is a transportation hub.

枢纽.zh: 上海是中国的经济枢纽之一。
枢纽.en: Shanghai is one of China's economic hubs.

枢纽.zh: 作为铁路枢纽，这里每天有大量列车经过。
枢纽.en: As a railway hub, a large number of trains pass through here every day.

枢纽.zh: 这个机场是亚洲重要的航空枢纽。
枢纽.en: This airport is an important aviation hub in Asia.

枢纽.zh: 枢纽的作用是连接各个方向。
枢纽.en: The role of a hub is to connect all directions.

针锋相对.en: The two are at odds with each other.

针锋相对.zh: 在辩论赛上，双方观点针锋相对。
针锋相对.en: In the debate competition, the views of both sides were diametrically opposed.

针锋相对.zh: 虽然他们针锋相对，但私下关系还不错。
针锋相对.en: Although they oppose each other, their personal relationship is okay.

针锋相对.zh: 这两家公司一直针锋相对地竞争。
针锋相对.en: These two companies have been in tit-for-tat competition.

针锋相对.zh: 他们的意见针锋相对，谁也说服不了谁。
针锋相对.en: Their opinions are opposite; neither can convince the other.

勘探.zh: 这个队伍正在山里勘探矿产资源。
勘探.en: This team is prospecting for mineral resources in the mountains.

勘探.zh: 因为发现了新矿，勘探工作就开始了。
勘探.en: Because a new deposit was discovered, the prospecting work began.

勘探.zh: 地质学家用先进设备进行勘探。
勘探.en: Geologists use advanced equipment for prospecting.

勘探.zh: 经过多年勘探，他们终于找到了金矿。
勘探.en: After years of prospecting, they finally found a gold mine.

枯竭.en: The water source has dried up.

枯竭.zh: 这个地区的石油资源快要枯竭了。
枯竭.en: The oil resources in this region are nearly exhausted.

枯竭.zh: 如果过度开采，资源很快就会枯竭。
枯竭.en: If overexploited, resources will soon be depleted.

枯竭.zh: 他的创作灵感似乎枯竭了。
枯竭.en: His creative inspiration seems to have dried up.

枯竭.zh: 地下水枯竭会导致严重的生态问题。
枯竭.en: Depletion of groundwater can cause serious ecological problems.

生怕.en: I am afraid of being late.

生怕.zh: 她走路很小心，生怕摔倒。
生怕.en: She walks very carefully, afraid of falling.

生怕.zh: 他生怕出错，每个数字都检查了好几遍。
生怕.en: He was afraid of making mistakes, so he checked each number several times.

生怕.zh: 我生怕打扰他休息，就没打电话。
生怕.en: I was afraid of disturbing his rest, so I didn't call.

生怕.zh: 妈妈生怕孩子着凉，给他多穿了一件衣服。
生怕.en: Mom was afraid the child would catch cold, so she put an extra piece of clothing on him.

答辩.en: I have my thesis defense tomorrow.
He answered very well during the defense.

答辩.zh: 因为准备充分，所以答辩很顺利。
答辩.en: Because I was well-prepared, the defense went smoothly.

答辩.zh: 毕业答辩通过后，大家都松了一口气。
答辩.en: Everyone breathed a sigh of relief after passing the graduation defense.

答辩.zh: 虽然答辩很紧张，但我还是坚持下来了。
答辩.en: Although the defense was nerve-wracking, I still managed to get through it.

止咳.zh: 如果咳嗽不止，可以试试这个止咳方子。
止咳.en: If your cough won't stop, you can try this cough remedy.

止咳.zh: 医生给我开了止咳的药，让我每天吃三次。
止咳.en: The doctor prescribed me cough medicine and told me to take it three times a day.

止咳.zh: 他咳嗽得很厉害，止咳糖浆也没太大用。
止咳.en: He coughed really badly, and the cough syrup didn't help much.

使唤.en: Stop ordering me around all the time.
She always bosses others around to do the work.

使唤.zh: 虽然他是领导，但也不能随便使唤人。
使唤.en: Even though he's the boss, he can't just order people around.

使唤.zh: 我累了一天，回家还要被使唤去做饭。
使唤.en: I was tired all day, and when I got home I was still ordered to cook.

使唤.zh: 他使唤弟弟帮他拿东西，弟弟很不高兴。
使唤.en: He ordered his little brother to get something for him, and the brother was unhappy.

流转.zh: 这些土地可以流转给农民。
流转.en: These lands can be transferred to farmers.

流转.zh: 因为资金流转不畅，公司遇到了困难。
流转.en: Because the capital circulation was not smooth, the company ran into trouble.

流转.zh: 村里的土地流转后，大家收入增加了不少。
流转.en: After the village land was transferred, everyone's income increased quite a bit.

流转.zh: 水在自然界不断流转，形成一个循环。
流转.en: Water continuously circulates in nature, forming a cycle.

有朝一日.zh: 他说有朝一日要环游世界。
有朝一日.en: He said he would travel around the world one day.

有朝一日.zh: 虽然现在很难，但有朝一日一切都会好起来的。
有朝一日.en: Although it's hard now, one day everything will get better.

有朝一日.zh: 我希望能有朝一日回到母校看看老师。
有朝一日.en: I hope that one day I can go back to my alma mater to see the teachers.

有朝一日.zh: 有朝一日你也会明白，这些经历都是财富。
有朝一日.en: One day you will also understand that these experiences are treasures.

包庇.en: You can't cover up for bad people.

包庇.zh: 他因为包庇朋友被批评了。
包庇.en: He was criticized for covering up for his friend.

包庇.zh: 如果包庇下属犯错，自己也会承担责任。
包庇.en: If you cover up for a subordinate's mistake, you'll also bear the responsibility.

包庇.zh: 她包庇了弟弟的偷窃行为，结果两人都受到了惩罚。
包庇.en: She covered up for her brother's theft, and as a result both were punished.

包庇.zh: 法律不允许任何人包庇罪犯。
包庇.en: The law does not allow anyone to harbor criminals.

粗略.zh: 他粗略地算了一下成本。
虽然只是粗略检查，但问题已经很明显了。
粗略.en: Although it was only a rough check, the problem was already obvious.

粗略.zh: 你先粗略读一遍，然后再仔细研究细节。
粗略.en: First, skim through it once, then study the details carefully.

粗略.zh: 她粗略估计了一下人数，大概有两百个。
粗略.en: She roughly estimated the number of people, about two hundred.

眼色.en: It's important to act by reading people's cues.

眼色.zh: 她使了个眼色，我就知道该走了。
眼色.en: She gave me a look, and I knew it was time to leave.

眼色.zh: 在领导面前要会看眼色，别乱说话。
眼色.en: In front of the boss, you need to read the room and not say random things.

眼色.zh: 虽然他没说话，但我从他的眼色里读出了不满。
眼色.en: Although he didn't speak, I could read dissatisfaction from his expression.

公顷.en: This piece of land is two hectares.

公顷.zh: 这个公园有一百公顷，走起来很累。
公顷.en: This park is one hundred hectares, so walking around is tiring.

公顷.zh: 他家承包了十公顷稻田，收成不错。
公顷.en: His family contracted ten hectares of rice paddies, and the harvest was good.

公顷.zh: 虽然只有一公顷，但种了各种水果。
公顷.en: Although it's only one hectare, they planted various fruits.

弱势.zh: 她在公司里处于弱势地位。
弱势.en: She is in a disadvantaged position in the company.

弱势.zh: 因为资金不足，小公司一直处于弱势。
弱势.en: Because of insufficient funds, small companies have always been at a disadvantage.

弱势.zh: 社会应该多关注弱势儿童的教育问题。
弱势.en: Society should pay more attention to the education of disadvantaged children.

弱势.zh: 虽然他是弱势一方，但并没有放弃争取权利。
弱势.en: Although he is the weaker party, he hasn't given up fighting for his rights.

提心吊胆.zh: 他提心吊胆地等着考试成绩。
提心吊胆.en: He waited for the exam results with great anxiety.

提心吊胆.zh: 别提心吊胆了，事情已经解决了。
提心吊胆.en: Don't be so nervous, the matter has already been resolved.

提心吊胆.zh: 这几天我提心吊胆，生怕被发现。
提心吊胆.en: These past few days I've been on tenterhooks, afraid of being found out.

提心吊胆.zh: 她提心吊胆地走过那条黑巷子，然后才松了口气。
提心吊胆.en: She walked through that dark alley with her heart in her mouth, and then finally relaxed.

提心吊胆.zh: 虽然他没犯错，但看到老板脸色不好还是提心吊胆的。
提心吊胆.en: Even though he didn't make a mistake, seeing the boss's bad expression still made him anxious.

垫子.zh: 这个垫子坐起来很舒服。
垫子.en: This cushion is very comfortable to sit on.

垫子.zh: 我在椅子上放了一个软垫子。
垫子.en: I put a soft cushion on the chair.

垫子.zh: 瑜伽垫子太薄了，膝盖有点疼。
垫子.en: The yoga mat is too thin, my knees hurt a bit.

垫子.zh: 小狗喜欢趴在门口的垫子上晒太阳。
垫子.en: The puppy likes to lie on the doormat and bask in the sun.

垫子.zh: 你帮我把沙发垫子换一下，这个有点脏了。
垫子.en: Could you help me change the sofa cushion? This one is a bit dirty.

插图.zh: 这本书的插图非常精美。
插图.en: The illustrations in this book are very exquisite.

插图.zh: 老师让我们给作文配上插图。
插图.en: The teacher asked us to add illustrations to our essays.

插图.zh: 这本绘本每页都有一幅彩色插图。
插图.en: Each page of this picture book has a colorful illustration.

插图.zh: 我觉得课文里的插图能帮助理解内容。
插图.en: I think the illustrations in the text can help understand the content.

插图.zh: 他翻到第三页，指着插图说这就是故事的主角。
插图.en: He turned to page three and pointed at the illustration, saying this was the main character of the story.

衍生.zh: 这个词是从拉丁语衍生出来的。
衍生.en: This word is derived from Latin.

衍生.zh: 很多衍生品市场风险很高。
衍生.en: Many derivatives markets are very risky.

衍生.zh: 这个游戏衍生出了很多周边产品。
衍生.en: This game has spawned many peripheral products.

衍生.zh: 他们公司主要做金融衍生品交易。
衍生.en: Their company mainly engages in financial derivatives trading.

衍生.zh: 这部小说后来衍生出一部电影和一部电视剧。
衍生.en: This novel later gave rise to a movie and a TV series.

轻蔑.zh: 别用那种轻蔑的眼神看我。
轻蔑.en: Don't look at me with that contemptuous gaze.

轻蔑.zh: 她对这种说法嗤之以鼻，满脸轻蔑。
轻蔑.en: She sneered at this statement, with a face full of contempt.

轻蔑.zh: 虽然他很有钱，但对待穷人却充满了轻蔑。
轻蔑.en: Although he is very rich, he treats the poor with contempt.

轻蔑.zh: 他轻蔑地挥了挥手，表示不屑于回答这个问题。
轻蔑.en: He waved his hand contemptuously, indicating he was not willing to answer the question.

情怀.en: He is a person with deep feelings.

情怀.zh: 这家小店的装修很有怀旧情怀。
情怀.en: The decoration of this small shop has a nostalgic sentiment.

情怀.zh: 创业不能只靠情怀，还要有实力。
情怀.en: Starting a business can't rely only on passion; you also need ability.

情怀.zh: 他写这首诗是为了表达对故乡的情怀。
情怀.en: He wrote this poem to express his feelings for his hometown.

情怀.zh: 老一辈人那种家国情怀，我们年轻人应该学习。
情怀.en: The sense of patriotism of the older generation is something we young people should learn from.

谦逊.en: He is very humble and never shows off.

谦逊.zh: 虽然得了奖，他依然保持谦逊的态度。
谦逊.en: Even though he won the award, he still maintained a humble attitude.

谦逊.zh: 她谦逊地说自己只是运气好而已。
谦逊.en: She humbly said that she was just lucky.

谦逊.zh: 一个真正有学问的人，往往是非常谦逊的。
谦逊.en: A truly learned person is often very modest.

利害.zh: 这件事关系重大，利害分明。
利害.en: This matter is of great importance, with clear pros and cons.

利害.zh: 我们必须权衡一下双方的利害关系。
利害.en: We must weigh the interests of both sides.

利害.zh: 别只顾眼前，要想想长远的利害。
利害.en: Don't just focus on the present; think about the long-term pros and cons.

利害.zh: 在商业合作中，搞清楚彼此的利害很重要。
利害.en: In business cooperation, it's important to understand each other's interests.

利害.zh: 他分析了一遍这个方案的利害得失。
利害.en: He analyzed the advantages, disadvantages, gains, and losses of this plan.

倡议.en: He advocated that everyone save water.

倡议.zh: 这个倡议得到了很多人的支持。
倡议.en: This initiative has received support from many people.

倡议.zh: 学校发出了垃圾分类的倡议书。
倡议.en: The school issued a proposal for garbage classification.

倡议.zh: 我们倡议每周少开一天车，减少污染。
倡议.en: We propose driving one less day a week to reduce pollution.

倡议.zh: 她的倡议虽然很好，但实施起来并不容易。
倡议.en: Although her proposal was very good, it was not easy to implement.

谋求.zh: 他在谋求一份更好的工作。
谋求.en: He is seeking a better job.

谋求.zh: 这家公司正谋求海外上市。
谋求.en: This company is seeking to go public overseas.

谋求.zh: 双方正在谋求和平解决争端。
谋求.en: The two sides are seeking a peaceful resolution to the dispute.

谋求.zh: 我们不能只谋求个人利益，也要考虑集体。
谋求.en: We should not only seek personal benefits, but also consider the collective.

谋求.zh: 他通过不断学习来谋求职业上的发展。
谋求.en: He seeks career development through continuous learning.

变故.zh: 因为公司发生变故，他不得不辞职。
变故.en: Because of a sudden change at the company, he had to resign.

变故.zh: 谁也没想到这场变故会来得这么快。
变故.en: No one expected this misfortune to come so quickly.

变故.zh: 虽然遇到了变故，但他们还是坚持完成了任务。
变故.en: Although they encountered an unexpected change, they still persisted in completing the task.

变故.zh: 这次变故让他们的旅行计划全泡汤了。
变故.en: This unforeseen event completely ruined their travel plans.

凑巧.zh: 我们凑巧在机场碰见了。
凑巧.en: We bumped into each other at the airport by coincidence.

凑巧.zh: 那天凑巧我也去了那家餐厅，就遇到他了。
凑巧.en: It happened that I also went to that restaurant that day, so I ran into him.

凑巧.zh: 你来得真凑巧，我们正要开始吃饭。
凑巧.en: You came at just the right moment; we were about to start eating.

凑巧.zh: 凑巧的是，我们俩买了同一本书。
凑巧.en: Coincidentally, the two of us bought the same book.

凑巧.zh: 这次比赛能赢完全是因为凑巧。
凑巧.en: Winning this competition was entirely due to luck.

免不了.zh: 第一次上台免不了紧张。
免不了.en: You can't help being nervous the first time you go on stage.

免不了.zh: 刚学新技能，免不了会犯一些错误。
免不了.en: When you first learn a new skill, you're bound to make some mistakes.

免不了.zh: 只要是人，就免不了会犯错。
免不了.en: As long as you're human, you're inevitably going to make mistakes.

免不了.zh: 朋友之间吵架免不了，但别太计较。
免不了.en: Fighting between friends is unavoidable, but don't take it too seriously.

免不了.zh: 长途旅行免不了会感到疲劳。
免不了.en: Long trips inevitably make you feel tired.

天长地久.zh: 没有什么是真的天长地久，珍惜现在才重要。
天长地久.en: Nothing truly lasts forever; cherishing the present is what matters.

天长地久.zh: 虽然他们说过要天长地久，但最后还是分开了。
天长地久.en: Although they said they'd be together forever, they ended up separating.

天长地久.zh: 爱情不一定要天长地久，真心就好。
天长地久.en: Love doesn't have to be everlasting; sincerity is enough.

天长地久.zh: 她总希望自己的婚姻能天长地久。
天长地久.en: She always hoped her marriage would last forever.

芬芳.en: Bursts of fragrance come from the garden.

芬芳.zh: 这种花的芬芳让我想起了小时候的家。
芬芳.en: The fragrance of this flower reminds me of my childhood home.

芬芳.zh: 雨后空气清新，还带着泥土的芬芳。
芬芳.en: After the rain, the air is fresh and carries the scent of soil.

芬芳.zh: 茶香芬芳，喝一口就很放松。
芬芳.en: The tea has a fragrant aroma; one sip is very relaxing.

芬芳.zh: 那瓶香水的芬芳太浓了，我不太喜欢。
芬芳.en: The fragrance of that perfume is too strong; I don't really like it.

投射.en: The light is projected onto the wall.

投射.zh: 他把自己对父母的怨恨投射到了同事身上。
投射.en: He projected his resentment towards his parents onto his coworkers.

投射.zh: 阳光透过窗户投射在地板上，很美。
投射.en: The sunlight streams through the window onto the floor, very beautiful.

投射.zh: 这部电影投射了导演对童年的回忆。
投射.en: This movie projects the director's memories of childhood.

投射.zh: 不要把自己的情绪投射给别人。
投射.en: Don't project your emotions onto others.

存心.zh: 你存心跟我过不去是不是？
存心.en: Are you deliberately trying to make things difficult for me?

存心.zh: 他虽然是存心捣乱，但也没造成太大损失。
存心.en: Although he was deliberately causing trouble, it didn't do much damage.

存心.zh: 她说那句话是存心让你难堪。
存心.en: She said that on purpose to embarrass you.

存心.zh: 这件事我真不是存心要瞒着你的。
存心.en: I really didn't intend to hide this from you.

诬陷.en: He was falsely accused of stealing.

诬陷.zh: 为了抢功劳，他竟然诬陷同事说谎。
诬陷.en: In order to take credit, he actually framed his colleague for lying.

诬陷.zh: 如果没有证据，就不要随便诬陷别人。
诬陷.en: If there's no evidence, don't casually accuse others.

诬陷.zh: 她因为被诬陷入狱，后来才真相大白。
诬陷.en: She was imprisoned because she was framed; later the truth came out.

诬陷.zh: 这种诬陷别人的行为太可耻了。
诬陷.en: This kind of behavior of framing others is too shameful.

疗养.zh: 他去海边疗养了几个月。
疗养.en: He went to the seaside for a few months of recuperation.

疗养.zh: 医生建议他换个环境好好疗养一段时间。
疗养.en: The doctor advised him to change his environment and recuperate properly for a while.

疗养.zh: 因为身体不好，他打算去山里疗养。
疗养.en: Because of poor health, he plans to go to the mountains to convalesce.

疗养.zh: 这家疗养院的环境很好，适合老人。
疗养.en: The environment at this nursing home is very good, suitable for the elderly.

疗养.zh: 工作压力太大，我想请个假去疗养。
疗养.en: Work pressure is too high; I want to take leave and go recuperate.

落成.en: The new library was completed yesterday.

落成.zh: 这座大桥落成后，两岸交通方便多了。
落成.en: After this bridge was completed, transportation between the two banks became much more convenient.

落成.zh: 等了三年，这个项目终于落成了。
落成.en: After waiting three years, this project is finally completed.

落成.zh: 学校的新教学楼落成典礼很隆重。
落成.en: The inauguration ceremony for the school's new teaching building was very grand.

落成.zh: 体育馆落成那天，很多人来参观。
落成.en: On the day the gymnasium was completed, many people came to visit.

中型.zh: 我们公司需要一辆中型车。
中型.en: Our company needs a medium-sized car.

中型.zh: 这家餐厅是中型的，适合家庭聚会。
中型.en: This restaurant is medium-sized, suitable for family gatherings.

中型.zh: 中型企业在这个城市发展得很快。
中型.en: Medium-sized enterprises are developing very fast in this city.

中型.zh: 他买了一台中型冰箱，放在厨房里。
中型.en: He bought a medium-sized refrigerator and put it in the kitchen.

中型.zh: 虽然只是中型活动，但参加的人很多。
中型.en: Although it's just a medium-sized event, a lot of people attended.

论述.zh: 这篇文章的论述不够清楚。
论述.en: The argument in this article is not clear enough.

论述.zh: 在会议上，他详细论述了这个问题。
论述.en: At the meeting, he discussed this issue in detail.

论述.zh: 我不同意你的论述，因为证据不足。
论述.en: I disagree with your argument because the evidence is insufficient.

论述.zh: 老师让我们写一篇论述文，分析原因。
论述.en: The teacher asked us to write an argumentative essay analyzing the reasons.

浓郁.en: This cup of coffee has a rich flavor.

浓郁.zh: 花园里花香浓郁，让人心情很好。
浓郁.en: The garden has a rich floral fragrance, making people feel good.

浓郁.zh: 她身上散发着浓郁的香水味。
浓郁.en: She exudes a strong perfume scent.

浓郁.zh: 这部电影有浓郁的中国文化气息。
浓郁.en: This movie has a strong Chinese cultural atmosphere.

浓郁.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但火锅的汤底很浓郁。
浓郁.en: Although the weather is very cold, the hot pot broth is very rich.

脱节.en: His ideas are out of touch with reality.

脱节.zh: 这个计划跟实际情况完全脱节。
脱节.en: This plan is completely disconnected from the actual situation.

脱节.zh: 由于沟通不畅，各部门之间有些脱节。
脱节.en: Due to poor communication, there is some disconnect between departments.

脱节.zh: 理论和实践不能脱节，要结合起来。
脱节.en: Theory and practice must not be disconnected; they should be combined.

脱节.zh: 我感觉自己跟这个时代脱节了。
脱节.en: I feel out of touch with this era.

不由得.en: Seeing him, I couldn't help but smile.

不由得.zh: 听到这个消息，她不由得哭了起来。
不由得.en: Hearing this news, she couldn't help but cry.

不由得.zh: 天气这么热，不由得让人想开空调。
不由得.en: It's so hot that one can't help wanting to turn on the air conditioner.

不由得.zh: 他一开口，我就不由得紧张起来。
不由得.en: As soon as he spoke, I couldn't help but get nervous.

不由得.zh: 想起往事，我不由得叹了口气。
不由得.en: Thinking of the past, I couldn't help but sigh.

辞典.zh: 我查了一下辞典，找到了这个词。
辞典.en: I looked up the dictionary and found this word.

辞典.zh: 他送我一本法语辞典，我很喜欢。
辞典.en: He gave me a French dictionary, and I really like it.

辞典.zh: 用辞典学习新单词是个好方法。
辞典.en: Using a dictionary to learn new words is a good method.

辞典.zh: 虽然现在有手机辞典，但我还是喜欢纸质辞典。
辞典.en: Although there are mobile dictionaries now, I still prefer paper dictionaries.

沉淀.zh: 水里的杂质慢慢沉淀了。
沉淀.en: The impurities in the water slowly settled.

沉淀.zh: 时间久了，感情会沉淀下来。
红酒需要沉淀一下再喝。
沉淀.en: Red wine needs to settle a bit before drinking.

沉淀.zh: 经过沉淀，他的想法变得更加成熟。
沉淀.en: After settling, his ideas became more mature.

沉淀.zh: 这个知识需要时间沉淀才能理解。
沉淀.en: This knowledge needs time to settle before it can be understood.

难处.zh: 每个人都有自己的难处。
他最近遇到了很多难处。
难处.en: He has encountered a lot of difficulties recently.

难处.zh: 我知道你工作上有难处，但要坚持。
难处.en: I know you have difficulties at work, but you have to persevere.

难处.zh: 如果有什么难处，尽管跟我说。
难处.en: If you have any difficulties, feel free to tell me.

难处.zh: 他们不理解我的难处，只是一味批评。
难处.en: They don't understand my difficulties and just keep criticizing.

黑心.zh: 黑心商家卖假货，应该被惩罚。
黑心.en: Unscrupulous merchants sell fake goods and should be punished.

黑心.zh: 我们买东西要小心黑心卖家。
黑心.en: We need to be careful of unscrupulous sellers when buying things.

黑心.zh: 他为了赚钱，做了很多黑心事。
黑心.en: To make money, he did many unscrupulous things.

黑心.zh: 这种黑心食品对身体有害，千万别买。
黑心.en: This kind of unscrupulous food is harmful to health; don't buy it.

荆棘.en: The road is overgrown with thorns.

荆棘.zh: 虽然前路有荆棘，但我们不怕。
荆棘.en: Although there are thorns ahead, we are not afraid.

荆棘.zh: 他穿过荆棘丛，终于到达了目的地。
荆棘.en: He went through the thicket of thorns and finally reached his destination.

荆棘.zh: 创业的路上充满了荆棘，需要勇气。
荆棘.en: The road to entrepreneurship is full of thorns and requires courage.

赔钱.en: This store has been losing money all along.

赔钱.zh: 你那个项目要是搞不好，肯定得赔钱。
赔钱.en: If your project isn't handled well, you'll definitely lose money.

赔钱.zh: 虽然打折活动吸引了很多顾客，但公司其实在赔钱卖。
赔钱.en: Although the discount event attracted many customers, the company is actually selling at a loss.

赔钱.zh: 我们得想办法止损，不能再这么赔钱下去了。
赔钱.en: We need to find a way to stop the losses; we can't keep losing money like this.

蕴藏.zh: 这片土地蕴藏着丰富的矿产。
蕴藏.en: This land contains abundant mineral resources.

蕴藏.zh: 她的心里蕴藏着巨大的能量。
这个地区蕴藏的石油资源还没被完全开发。
蕴藏.en: The oil resources contained in this region haven't been fully exploited yet.

蕴藏.zh: 别看他平时不说话，身体里蕴藏的力量可大了。
蕴藏.en: Although he usually doesn't talk much, the power contained in his body is huge.

蕴藏.zh: 每个孩子都蕴藏着无限的潜力，关键是家长怎么引导。
蕴藏.en: Every child contains infinite potential; the key is how parents guide them.

河畔.en: We took a walk by the riverside.

河畔.zh: 那家咖啡馆就在河畔，风景特别好。
河畔.en: That café is right by the riverside, and the view is especially nice.

河畔.zh: 傍晚的时候，很多人在河畔跑步或者钓鱼。
河畔.en: In the evening, many people jog or fish by the riverside.

河畔.zh: 他们找了一个河畔的小亭子坐下来聊天。
河畔.en: They found a small pavilion by the riverside and sat down to chat.

河畔.zh: 河畔新开了一家餐厅，听说味道不错，但价格有点贵。
河畔.en: A new restaurant opened by the riverside; I heard the food is good, but the price is a bit high.

日趋.en: His condition is becoming increasingly stable.

日趋.zh: 随着科技发展，生活日趋便利。
日趋.en: With the development of technology, life is becoming more and more convenient.

日趋.zh: 两国关系日趋紧张，大家都担心会出事。
日趋.en: The relations between the two countries are growing increasingly tense, and everyone is worried something might happen.

日趋.zh: 环保意识日趋增强，越来越多的人开始垃圾分类。
日趋.en: Environmental awareness is growing day by day, and more and more people are starting to sort their garbage.

日趋.zh: 竞争日趋激烈，公司必须不断创新才能生存下去。
日趋.en: Competition is becoming increasingly fierce; companies must keep innovating to survive.

破例.zh: 老板今天破例让我早下班。
破例.en: The boss made an exception today and let me leave work early.

破例.zh: 他平时不喝酒，但这次破例喝了一杯。
破例.en: He usually doesn't drink, but this time he made an exception and had a glass.

破例.zh: 这家店从来不收信用卡，但看你是老顾客就破例一次。
破例.en: This store never accepts credit cards, but since you're a regular customer, they'll make an exception this once.

破例.zh: 学校规定不能带手机，但特殊情况可以破例申请。
破例.en: The school rule says no cell phones, but under special circumstances you can apply for an exception.

破例.zh: 她平时很严格的，今天居然破例让我们多休息了十分钟。
破例.en: She's usually very strict, but today she actually made an exception and let us rest an extra ten minutes.

阅历.zh: 他阅历丰富，见过很多世面。
阅历.en: He has rich experience and has seen a lot of the world.

阅历.zh: 年轻人阅历不够，容易上当受骗。
阅历.en: Young people lack life experience and are easily deceived.

阅历.zh: 多出去走走，能增加你的阅历。
阅历.en: Traveling more can increase your life experience.

阅历.zh: 虽然她年纪不大，但阅历已经比同龄人深多了。
阅历.en: Although she's not old, her life experience is already much deeper than her peers.

阅历.zh: 一个人的阅历决定了他看问题的深度。
阅历.en: A person's life experience determines the depth of their perspective on issues.

灵巧.zh: 这只小猫动作非常灵巧。
灵巧.en: This kitten's movements are very nimble.

灵巧.zh: 她灵巧地躲过了那辆车。
这个机器人设计得很灵巧，能完成各种精细动作。
灵巧.en: This robot is designed very nimbly and can perform all kinds of fine movements.

灵巧.zh: 别看他块头大，其实手指特别灵巧，做手工活一流。
灵巧.en: Despite his large build, his fingers are actually very nimble, and he's excellent at handicrafts.

走投无路.en: He has reached a dead end.

走投无路.zh: 那个骗子被警察追得走投无路，只好自首。
走投无路.en: The swindler was chased by the police until he had no way out and had to turn himself in.

走投无路.zh: 要不是走投无路，我也不会来求你帮忙。
走投无路.en: If I weren't desperate, I wouldn't have come to ask you for help.

走投无路.zh: 公司破产后，他走投无路，只能回老家种地。
走投无路.en: After the company went bankrupt, he had no way out and could only go back to his hometown to farm.

走投无路.zh: 很多年轻人被高利贷逼得走投无路，最后走上了歪路。
走投无路.en: Many young people are driven to despair by loan sharks and end up going down the wrong path.

指教.zh: 我是新手，还请大家多指教。
指教.en: I'm a beginner; please everyone give me your advice.

指教.zh: 这篇文章写得不好，希望您能指教一下。
指教.en: This article isn't well written; I hope you can give me some guidance.

指教.zh: 在您的指教下，我的进步很快。
指教.en: Under your guidance, I've improved quickly.

指教.zh: 初来乍到，不懂的地方很多，请各位前辈多多指教。
指教.en: I'm new here and there's a lot I don't understand; please, seniors, give me plenty of advice.

能人.zh: 公司里能人很多，竞争很激烈。
能人.en: There are many capable people in the company, so competition is fierce.

能人.zh: 我们团队需要一个能人来解决这个技术难题。
能人.en: Our team needs a capable person to solve this technical problem.

能人.zh: 别看他不爱说话，其实是个能人，什么都会修。
能人.en: Although he doesn't talk much, he's actually a capable person who can fix anything.

能人.zh: 所谓能人，就是既能吃苦又有脑子的人。
能人.en: A so-called capable person is someone who can both endure hardship and use their head.

淡化.zh: 他试图淡化自己的错误，但大家心里都清楚。
淡化.en: He tried to downplay his mistakes, but everyone knew clearly.

淡化.zh: 公司想要淡化这次危机的负面影响。
淡化.en: The company wants to downplay the negative impact of this crisis.

淡化.zh: 虽然他说得轻描淡写，但问题没法淡化。
淡化.en: Although he said it lightly, the problem can't be downplayed.

淡化.zh: 海水淡化技术越来越成熟了。
淡化.en: Seawater desalination technology is becoming more mature.

遮盖.zh: 他用手遮盖住脸上的伤疤。
遮盖.en: He covered the scar on his face with his hand.

遮盖.zh: 虽然他想遮盖真相，但纸包不住火。
遮盖.en: Although he wants to conceal the truth, paper can't wrap fire.

遮盖.zh: 窗帘遮盖了大部分阳光。
遮盖.en: The curtains cover most of the sunlight.

利索.en: He does things quickly and neatly.

利索.zh: 她利索地收拾好行李就出门了。
利索.en: She neatly packed her luggage and went out.
This young man is really agile.

利索.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他动作依然很利索。
利索.en: Although old, his movements are still quick.

利索.zh: 你说话利索点儿，别吞吞吐吐的。
利索.en: Speak clearly and quickly, don't stammer.

兴高采烈.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地跑出去。
他兴高采烈地跟大家分享好消息。
兴高采烈.en: He shared the good news with everyone joyfully.

兴高采烈.zh: 全家人兴高采烈地庆祝生日。
兴高采烈.en: The whole family celebrated the birthday joyfully.

兴高采烈.zh: 比赛赢了，大家兴高采烈地又唱又跳。
兴高采烈.en: Won the game, everyone joyfully sang and danced.

兴高采烈.zh: 她一听说要去旅游，就兴高采烈地收拾东西。
兴高采烈.en: As soon as she heard about the trip, she packed joyfully.

残缺.zh: 那个古董花瓶有一处残缺。
残缺.en: That antique vase has a damaged part.

残缺.zh: 他的身体有残缺，但意志很强。
残缺.en: He has a physical disability, but strong will.

残缺.zh: 虽然这本书残缺了几页，但内容依然精彩。
残缺.en: Although this book is missing a few pages, the content is still wonderful.

残缺.zh: 残缺的家庭也会充满爱。
残缺.en: An incomplete family can also be full of love.

有条不紊.zh: 她把工作计划安排得有条不紊。
有条不紊.en: She arranged the work plan in an orderly manner.
The site is managed in an orderly manner.

有条不紊.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但他还是有条不紊地完成每项任务。
有条不紊.en: Although time was tight, he still completed each task methodically.

有条不紊.zh: 这个团队工作有条不紊，效率很高。
有条不紊.en: This team works methodically and efficiently.

兴旺.zh: 近年来旅游业发展兴旺。
兴旺.en: In recent years, tourism has been thriving.
Having a large family is a traditional concept.

兴旺.zh: 自从开了网店，生意越来越兴旺。
兴旺.en: Since opening an online store, business has become more and more prosperous.

兴旺.zh: 那个小镇因为新工厂而变得兴旺。
兴旺.en: That town became prosperous because of the new factory.

大街小巷.zh: 大街小巷都挂满了灯笼。
大街小巷.en: All streets and alleys are hung with lanterns.

大街小巷.zh: 春节时大街小巷都热热闹闹的。
大街小巷.en: During Spring Festival, streets and alleys are bustling.

大街小巷.zh: 他的歌声传遍了大街小巷。
大街小巷.en: His singing spread through every street and alley.

大街小巷.zh: 虽然下了雨，但大街小巷依然有很多人。
大街小巷.en: Although it rained, many people were still on the streets.

大街小巷.zh: 这个小城的大街小巷我都走遍了。
大街小巷.en: I have walked every street and alley in this small city.

退步.zh: 最近他学习退步了很多。
退步.en: Recently his studies have regressed a lot.

退步.zh: 不能因为一点成绩就退步。
退步.en: Can't regress because of a little achievement.
If you don't work hard, you will fall behind.

退步.zh: 这个公司技术退步了，客户都不满意。
退步.en: This company's technology has regressed, and customers are dissatisfied.

第一手.zh: 如果你想了解真相，最好获得第一手证据。
第一手.en: If you want to know the truth, it's best to get firsthand evidence.

第一手.zh: 这个报告基于第一手数据。
第一手.en: This report is based on firsthand data.

着落.en: I still don't have a job yet.

着落.zh: 你找到房子的着落了吗？
着落.en: Have you found a place to live?

着落.zh: 这次旅行的事已经有着落了，别担心。
着落.en: The travel arrangements are settled now, don't worry.

着落.zh: 如果你不努力，未来就没着落。
着落.en: If you don't work hard, you'll have no future.

着落.zh: 他一直在找新项目，可到现在也没什么着落。
着落.en: He's been looking for a new project, but so far nothing has come of it.

岔.en: There's a fork in the road ahead.
Don't keep changing the subject when you talk.

岔.zh: 我们走到岔道口时，不知道该选哪条路。
岔.en: When we reached the fork, we didn't know which road to take.

岔.zh: 他故意打岔，不想让我们讨论那件事。
岔.en: He deliberately interrupted, not wanting us to discuss that matter.

岔.zh: 这条路有个小岔，通向后面的村子。
岔.en: This road has a small branch that leads to the village behind.

赶赴.en: He hurried to Beijing for a meeting.
The rescue team rushed to the disaster area overnight.

赶赴.zh: 你明天要赶赴机场，记得早点儿出发。
赶赴.en: You need to rush to the airport tomorrow, remember to leave early.

赶赴.zh: 他接到电话后立刻赶赴现场处理问题。
赶赴.en: After receiving the call, he immediately rushed to the scene to handle the issue.

赶赴.zh: 为了参加婚礼，她特意从上海赶赴广州。
赶赴.en: She specially traveled from Shanghai to Guangzhou to attend the wedding.

相比之下.zh: 相比之下，他还是更喜欢这里。
相比之下.en: In comparison, he still prefers this place.

相比之下.zh: 这家店的东西贵，相比之下那家便宜多了。
相比之下.en: The things at this store are expensive; in comparison, that one is much cheaper.

相比之下.zh: 虽然两人都很优秀，但相比之下，小王更细心。
相比之下.en: Although both are excellent, in comparison, Xiao Wang is more careful.

相比之下.zh: 相比之下，我觉得夏天比冬天好过一些。
相比之下.en: In comparison, I think summer is a bit easier to get through than winter.

相比之下.zh: 同样价格，相比之下这个牌子的质量更好。
相比之下.en: At the same price, this brand's quality is better in comparison.

乡亲.zh: 他是我们村里的老乡亲。
乡亲.en: He is an old fellow villager of ours.

乡亲.zh: 回到老家，乡亲们都很热情地招呼我。
乡亲.en: When I returned to my hometown, the fellow villagers warmly greeted me.

乡亲.zh: 这些乡亲们世世代代都住在这里。
乡亲.en: These fellow villagers have lived here for generations.

乡亲.zh: 每逢过节，乡亲们都会聚在一起庆祝。
乡亲.en: Every festival, the fellow villagers gather together to celebrate.

出具.zh: 学校可以出具成绩单吗？
出具.en: Can the school issue a transcript?

出具.zh: 你需要让医院出具一份健康证明。
出具.en: You need to have the hospital issue a health certificate.

出具.zh: 公司出具了正式的录用通知书。
出具.en: The company issued a formal offer letter.

出具.zh: 报名时，必须出具相关原件和复印件。
出具.en: When registering, you must provide the relevant original documents and copies.

凶恶.zh: 他凶恶的眼神吓得我不敢说话。
凶恶.en: His fierce glare scared me speechless.

凶恶.zh: 虽然长得很凶恶，但他其实很善良。
凶恶.en: Although he looks fierce, he is actually very kind.

凶恶.zh: 那个凶恶的歹徒最终被抓住了。
凶恶.en: That vicious criminal was finally caught.

凶恶.zh: 老师凶恶地批评了他，但也是为了他好。
凶恶.en: The teacher criticized him harshly, but it was for his own good.

根基.en: The foundation of the house must be well laid.
In scholarship, it's important to lay a solid foundation.

根基.zh: 这个公司根基很稳，不会轻易倒闭。
根基.en: This company has a solid foundation and won't easily go bankrupt.

根基.zh: 从小教育就是人生的根基，不能忽视。
根基.en: Education from childhood is the foundation of life and cannot be ignored.

根基.zh: 虽然起步晚，但他的技术根基非常扎实。
根基.en: Although he started late, his technical foundation is very solid.

隐性.zh: 隐性成本往往容易被忽略。
隐性.en: Hidden costs are often easily overlooked.

隐性.zh: 一些隐性收入没有上报，这是违法的。
隐性.en: Some unreported hidden income is illegal.

隐性.zh: 他的性格里有隐性的自卑。
隐性.en: There is a hidden inferiority in his personality.

隐性.zh: 这种病毒有隐性携带者，很难发现。
隐性.en: This virus has asymptomatic carriers, making it hard to detect.

霍乱.zh: 以前霍乱很可怕，现在好多了。
霍乱.en: Cholera used to be terrible, but it's much better now.

霍乱.zh: 他因为喝了不干净的水得了霍乱。
霍乱.en: He contracted cholera because he drank unclean water.

霍乱.zh: 霍乱在历史上多次爆发。
霍乱.en: Cholera has broken out many times in history.

霍乱.zh: 医生警告说，夏天要注意预防霍乱。
霍乱.en: The doctor warned that we should take precautions against cholera in summer.

打磨.zh: 这块石头需要打磨一下。
打磨.en: This stone needs to be polished a bit.

打磨.zh: 因为表面太粗糙，所以得反复打磨。
打磨.en: Because the surface is too rough, it needs to be polished repeatedly.

打磨.zh: 他花了一年打磨自己的演讲技巧。
打磨.en: He spent a year polishing his speaking skills.

打磨.zh: 这件木器经过打磨后光滑得像镜子一样。
打磨.en: After being polished, this wooden item is as smooth as a mirror.

打磨.zh: 你把那个边打磨两遍就好了。
打磨.en: You just need to sand that edge twice.

空难.en: There was a plane crash yesterday.

空难.zh: 虽然空难很少见，但每次都很严重。
空难.en: Although plane crashes are rare, each one is very serious.

空难.zh: 那场空难是因为机械故障造成的。
空难.en: That plane crash was caused by a mechanical failure.

空难.zh: 她每次看空难的新闻都会哭。
空难.en: She cries every time she sees news about a plane crash.

空难.zh: 空难发生后，航空公司加强了安全检查。
空难.en: After the plane crash, the airline strengthened its safety inspections.

梳子.zh: 这把梳子是木头的，用着很舒服。
梳子.en: This comb is made of wood and feels very comfortable to use.

梳子.zh: 因为梳子太脏，所以她洗了一下。
梳子.en: Because the comb was too dirty, she washed it.

梳子.zh: 她每天用梳子梳头一百下。
梳子.en: She combs her hair a hundred times every day.

梳子.zh: 如果你没有梳子，可以用手指代替。
梳子.en: If you don't have a comb, you can use your fingers instead.

俘获.zh: 这首歌俘获了很多人的心。
俘获.en: This song has captured many people's hearts.

俘获.zh: 敌军俘获了我们的一个侦察兵。
俘获.en: The enemy captured one of our scouts.

俘获.zh: 她的表演一下子就俘获了全场观众。
俘获.en: Her performance instantly captivated the entire audience.

俘获.zh: 虽然他们很努力，但还是没俘获那只野兽。
俘获.en: Although they tried hard, they still didn't capture the beast.

俘获.zh: 这个品牌用独特的风格俘获了年轻人的市场。
俘获.en: This brand has captured the youth market with its unique style.

木匠.en: My grandfather used to be a carpenter.

木匠.zh: 那个木匠做的桌子特别结实。
木匠.en: The table that carpenter made is especially sturdy.

木匠.zh: 因为木匠生病了，所以工期要推迟。
木匠.en: Because the carpenter is sick, the construction schedule will be delayed.

木匠.zh: 他找了两个木匠来装修新家。
木匠.en: He hired two carpenters to renovate his new home.

木匠.zh: 这个木匠花了十年才学会这门手艺。
木匠.en: It took this carpenter ten years to learn this craft.

邮编.zh: 寄包裹的时候一定要写对邮编。
邮编.en: You must write the correct postal code when sending a package.

邮编.zh: 因为邮编写错了，所以快递被退回来了。
邮编.en: Because the postal code was wrong, the package was returned.

邮编.zh: 那个老地址的邮编我已经忘了。
邮编.en: I've already forgotten the postal code for that old address.

邮编.zh: 你可以在网上查一下每个城市的邮编。
邮编.en: You can look up the postal code for each city online.

封建.zh: 他家里的思想特别封建。
封建.en: The thinking in his family is very feudal.
The feudal era is long gone.

封建.zh: 虽然社会进步了，但有些封建观念还在。
封建.en: Although society has progressed, some feudal ideas still remain.

封建.zh: 她受不了那些封建规矩，搬出去住了。
封建.en: She couldn't stand those feudal rules and moved out.

封建.zh: 现在还有人说这种话，真是太封建了。
封建.en: It's so feudal that someone still says things like that nowadays.

窘迫.en: He felt extremely embarrassed at that time.

窘迫.zh: 这个问题问得我十分窘迫。
窘迫.en: This question made me very awkward.

窘迫.zh: 因为没钱交房租，他生活很窘迫。
窘迫.en: Because he couldn't afford the rent, his life was very strained.

窘迫.zh: 虽然心里很窘迫，但他还是勉强笑了笑。
窘迫.en: Although he felt very awkward inside, he still forced a smile.

窘迫.zh: 那次演讲忘词了，他窘迫得不知道该怎么办。
窘迫.en: He forgot his lines during that speech and was so embarrassed that he didn't know what to do.

通红.en: His face was bright red from the cold.
Her face turned bright red with anger.

通红.zh: 因为喝了太多酒，他的脸变得通红。
通红.en: His face turned bright red because he drank too much.

通红.zh: 太阳下山时，天空一片通红。
通红.en: When the sun set, the sky was all bright red.

通红.zh: 那个小孩在太阳下跑了一圈，脸晒得通红。
通红.en: That child ran around in the sun and his face got sunburned red.

常态.zh: 加班对他们来说是常态。
常态.en: Working overtime is normal for them.

常态.zh: 虽然开始不习惯，但后来就成了常态。
常态.en: Although it was uncomfortable at first, it later became the norm.

常态.zh: 熬夜现在成了很多年轻人的生活常态。
常态.en: Staying up late has now become a normal part of many young people's lives.

常态.zh: 他每天跑步已经是一种常态了。
常态.en: His daily running has become a regular routine.

世故.zh: 他这人太世故了，我不喜欢。
世故.en: He is too worldly-wise; I don't like it.

世故.zh: 她虽然年轻，但说话做事很世故。
世故.en: Although she is young, she speaks and acts very sophisticatedly.

世故.zh: 我觉得做人不能太世故，要保留一点真诚。
世故.en: I think one shouldn't be too worldly-wise; one should keep some sincerity.

世故.zh: 他看起来很世故，其实内心很单纯。
世故.en: He seems very sophisticated, but actually he is simple inside.

世故.zh: 在这种公司里，你要是太世故反而容易被排挤。
世故.en: In a company like this, if you are too sophisticated, you might actually be ostracized.

推选.en: Everyone elected him as class monitor.

推选.zh: 我们推选小李去参加比赛。
推选.en: We nominated Xiao Li to participate in the competition.

推选.zh: 经过投票，大家推选她担任组长。
推选.en: After voting, everyone elected her as team leader.

推选.zh: 这次会议推选了新的委员会成员。
推选.en: This meeting elected new committee members.

推选.zh: 如果大家信任我，就推选我当代表吧。
推选.en: If everyone trusts me, then elect me as the representative.

扫兴.zh: 他临时有事不来，真扫兴。
扫兴.en: He can't come due to something unexpected; what a bummer.

扫兴.zh: 下雨了，我们的野餐计划泡汤了，好扫兴。
扫兴.en: It rained, so our picnic plan fell through; such a disappointment.

扫兴.zh: 本来玩得很开心，他一句话把大家都弄扫兴了。
扫兴.en: We were having a great time, but one word from him ruined everyone's mood.

扫兴.zh: 虽然输了比赛，但大家都没有扫兴，反而互相鼓励。
扫兴.en: Even though we lost the game, nobody was discouraged; instead we encouraged each other.

深奥.zh: 他讲的理论很深奥，我完全听不懂。
深奥.en: The theory he explained is very profound; I totally couldn't understand it.

深奥.zh: 别把问题说得那么深奥，简单点讲。
深奥.en: Don't make the problem so abstruse; explain it simply.

深奥.zh: 哲学虽然深奥，但很有意思。
深奥.en: Philosophy, though profound, is very interesting.

深奥.zh: 他喜欢研究那些深奥的宇宙问题。
深奥.en: He likes to study those profound questions about the universe.

出息.en: This child really has a future.

出息.zh: 你长大了要有出息才行。
出息.en: You need to have a bright future when you grow up.

出息.zh: 他工作后变得很有出息，父母很骄傲。
出息.en: He has become very successful after working; his parents are very proud.

出息.zh: 别整天玩游戏，能有什么出息？
出息.en: Don't play games all day; what future will you have?

出息.zh: 虽然出身普通，但他靠努力闯出了出息。
出息.en: Although he came from an ordinary background, he made a promising future through hard work.

逞强.en: Don't try to show off your strength; take a rest.

逞强.zh: 他明明不行，还要逞强去做。
逞强.en: He obviously can't do it, yet he still insists on acting tough.

逞强.zh: 你逞强只会让自己更累。
逞强.en: Acting tough will only make you more tired.

逞强.zh: 他逞强喝了三瓶酒，结果醉了。
逞强.en: He tried to show off by drinking three bottles of wine, and ended up drunk.

逞强.zh: 既然受伤了就好好休息，别逞强去运动。
逞强.en: Since you're injured, rest well and don't be stubborn about exercising.

扩充.en: The company plans to expand its workforce.

扩充.zh: 他一直在扩充自己的知识面。
扩充.en: He has been expanding his knowledge base.

扩充.zh: 我们需要扩充仓库，不然放不下货物。
扩充.en: We need to expand the warehouse, otherwise we can't fit the goods.

扩充.zh: 因为业务增长，团队今年又扩充了十个人。
扩充.en: Due to business growth, the team expanded by ten people this year.

扩充.zh: 他建议扩充图书馆的藏书量，以便学生阅读。
扩充.en: He suggested expanding the library's collection to facilitate student reading.

没落.zh: 曾经的帝国如今彻底没落了。
没落.en: The once great empire has now completely declined.

没落.zh: 传统手工艺正在慢慢没落。
他不想看到家族事业走向没落。
没落.en: He doesn't want to see the family business decline.

没落.zh: 随着科技发展，一些旧行业逐渐没落了。
没落.en: With the development of technology, some old industries have gradually declined.

恩惠.en: He has given me many favors.
I will not forget your kindness.

恩惠.zh: 他受了别人的恩惠，总想报答。
恩惠.en: He has received favors from others and always wants to repay them.

恩惠.zh: 这点恩惠不算什么，你别放在心上。
恩惠.en: This small favor is nothing; don't take it to heart.

恩惠.zh: 她一直铭记那位老师的恩惠，毕业后常去看望。
恩惠.en: She always remembers the teacher's kindness and often visits after graduation.

一丝不苟.zh: 这位工匠一丝不苟地雕刻每一件作品。
一丝不苟.en: This craftsman carves every piece meticulously.

一丝不苟.zh: 他对工作一丝不苟，从不马虎。
一丝不苟.en: He is meticulous in his work and never sloppy.

一丝不苟.zh: 虽然任务简单，但她仍然一丝不苟地完成。
一丝不苟.en: Even though the task was simple, she still completed it meticulously.

一丝不苟.zh: 老师批改作业一丝不苟，连标点符号都不放过。
一丝不苟.en: The teacher corrects homework meticulously, not even missing a punctuation mark.

够呛.zh: 今天考试够呛，题目太难了。
够呛.en: Today's exam was tough, the questions were too hard.

够呛.zh: 你让他三天做完这个项目，够呛啊。
够呛.en: Asking him to finish this project in three days is really pushing it.

够呛.zh: 他感冒了，嗓子疼得够呛，连话都说不出来。
够呛.en: He caught a cold and his throat hurt so badly he couldn't even speak.

够呛.zh: 这么晚还堵车，到家得够呛了。
够呛.en: With traffic jams so late, it'll be a real pain to get home.

够呛.zh: 我觉得他这次考试及格够呛，因为他根本没复习。
够呛.en: I think he'll barely pass this exam because he didn't study at all.

旁观.zh: 大家都在帮忙，你却在一旁旁观。
旁观.en: Everyone is helping, but you're just standing by watching.

旁观.zh: 遇到这种事，我们不能只是旁观，要出手相助。
旁观.en: When something like this happens, we can't just look on; we need to lend a hand.

旁观.zh: 他喜欢旁观别人吵架，觉得很有意思。
旁观.en: He likes to watch other people argue; he finds it very interesting.

旁观.zh: 作为朋友，你忍心旁观她一个人难过吗？
旁观.en: As a friend, can you bear to stand by while she's upset alone?

旁观.zh: 我们不应该袖手旁观，而应该主动去解决问题。
旁观.en: We shouldn't sit idly by; instead we should take the initiative to solve the problem.

扭头.en: He turned his head and glanced at me.

扭头.zh: 她听到有人叫她，立刻扭头过去。
扭头.en: She heard someone call her and immediately turned her head.

扭头.zh: 我正想说话，他扭头就走了，根本不听。
扭头.en: I was about to speak, but he turned his head and left, refusing to listen.

扭头.zh: 别扭头，我帮你把头发整理一下。
扭头.en: Don't turn your head, let me fix your hair.

扭头.zh: 他生气地扭头看向窗外，一句话也不说。
扭头.en: He angrily turned his head to look out the window, not saying a word.

雄伟.zh: 天安门的建筑很雄伟，吸引了无数游客。
雄伟.en: The architecture of Tiananmen is magnificent, attracting countless tourists.

雄伟.zh: 长城的雄伟壮观让人惊叹不已。
雄伟.en: The grandeur of the Great Wall leaves people in awe.

雄伟.zh: 站在雄伟的雪山脚下，我感到自己很渺小。
雄伟.en: Standing at the foot of the majestic snowy mountain, I felt very small.

雄伟.zh: 这座大桥的设计雄伟又现代，成为城市的地标。
雄伟.en: The design of this bridge is both majestic and modern, making it a city landmark.

崇敬.zh: 人们对这位科学家充满了崇敬之情。
崇敬.en: People are filled with admiration for this scientist.

崇敬.zh: 他那种无私奉献的精神，让我从心底里崇敬他。
崇敬.en: His spirit of selfless dedication makes me respect him from the bottom of my heart.

崇敬.zh: 在人民心中，这位英雄一直受到崇敬。
崇敬.en: This hero has always been held in reverence in the hearts of the people.

崇敬.zh: 我对那些为国家默默付出的人怀有深深的崇敬。
崇敬.en: I hold deep respect for those who silently contribute to the country.

磁盘.zh: 我的电脑磁盘空间不够了。
磁盘.en: My computer's disk space is running low.

磁盘.zh: 请把文件保存到磁盘里。
磁盘.en: Please save the file to the disk.

磁盘.zh: 这个磁盘已经坏了，数据都读不出来。
磁盘.en: This disk is already damaged, and the data can't be read.

磁盘.zh: 你需要清理一下磁盘，不然系统会变得很慢。
磁盘.en: You need to clean up the disk, otherwise the system will become very slow.

沧桑.en: The old man's face is etched with the vicissitudes of life.

沧桑.zh: 这座城市经历了百年沧桑，依然美丽。
沧桑.en: This city has gone through a century of changes and is still beautiful.

沧桑.zh: 他的一生充满沧桑，从穷小子变成了大老板。
沧桑.en: His life was full of ups and downs, going from a poor kid to a big boss.

沧桑.zh: 看着这些老照片，我感受到时间的沧桑。
沧桑.en: Looking at these old photos, I feel the passage of time and its changes.

沧桑.zh: 经历了那么多沧桑之后，他变得特别沉稳。
沧桑.en: After going through so many vicissitudes, he became especially composed.

劝阻.zh: 我劝他别去，但他不听我的劝阻。
劝阻.en: I advised him not to go, but he didn't listen to my dissuasion.

劝阻.zh: 朋友劝阻我不要买这么贵的包。
劝阻.en: My friend advised me not to buy such an expensive bag.

劝阻.zh: 他执意要走，任凭我们怎么劝阻都没用。
劝阻.en: He insisted on leaving, and no matter how we tried to dissuade him, it was useless.

劝阻.zh: 你应该劝阻他，不要做那么危险的事。
劝阻.en: You should advise him not to do something so dangerous.

劝阻.zh: 大家纷纷劝阻，但他还是坚持自己的决定。
劝阻.en: Everyone tried to dissuade him, but he still stuck to his decision.

屹立.zh: 这座雕像屹立在广场中央。
屹立.en: This statue stands erect in the center of the square.

屹立.zh: 黄山上的松树在风中屹立不倒。
屹立.en: The pine trees on Mount Huangshan stand firm against the wind.

屹立.zh: 尽管困难重重，这个公司依然屹立在行业中。
屹立.en: Despite numerous difficulties, this company still stands firmly in the industry.

屹立.zh: 古老的长城屹立了几千年，见证了历史。
屹立.en: The ancient Great Wall has stood for thousands of years, witnessing history.

屹立.zh: 在暴风雨中，灯塔依然屹立，为船只指引方向。
屹立.en: In the storm, the lighthouse still stands tall, guiding the ships.

注释.en: There are quite a few annotations in the book.

注释.zh: 请在这个句子旁边加上注释。
注释.en: Please add a note next to this sentence.

注释.zh: 老师用红笔写了注释，帮助我们理解课文。
注释.en: The teacher wrote annotations in red ink to help us understand the text.

注释.zh: 这本古籍的注释非常详细，适合初学者阅读。
注释.en: The annotations in this ancient book are very detailed, suitable for beginners.

注释.zh: 你在读这本书的时候，别忘了看底下的注释。
注释.en: When you read this book, don't forget to look at the notes at the bottom.

沉稳.en: He is very steady in handling things.

沉稳.zh: 她虽然年轻，但性格特别沉稳。
沉稳.en: Although she is young, her personality is very composed.

沉稳.zh: 在紧急情况下，他表现得十分沉稳。
沉稳.en: In an emergency, he performed very calmly.

沉稳.zh: 经理说话很沉稳，大家都愿意听他的。
沉稳.en: The manager speaks in a steady tone, so everyone is willing to listen to him.

沉稳.zh: 你要是想成功，就得学会沉稳面对问题。
沉稳.en: If you want to succeed, you need to learn to face problems with composure.

惊心动魄.zh: 这部电影太惊心动魄了。
昨天那场车祸真是惊心动魄。
惊心动魄.en: The car accident yesterday was really hair-raising.

惊心动魄.zh: 他讲了一个惊心动魄的冒险故事。
惊心动魄.en: He told a thrilling adventure story.

惊心动魄.zh: 比赛最后五分钟，场面惊心动魄。
惊心动魄.en: The last five minutes of the game were breathtaking.

惊心动魄.zh: 虽然经历惊心动魄，但他最后安全回来了。
惊心动魄.en: Although he went through a harrowing experience, he came back safely in the end.

单薄.en: This piece of clothing has very thin fabric.

单薄.zh: 他身材单薄，看起来没什么力气。
单薄.en: He is slim and looks not very strong.

单薄.zh: 你的理由太单薄了，没法说服我。
单薄.en: Your reasoning is too weak; it can't convince me.

单薄.zh: 这本书内容单薄，没什么新意。
单薄.en: This book has thin content and not much originality.

失业率.en: The unemployment rate dropped this year.

失业率.zh: 这个城市的失业率很高。
失业率.en: This city has a high unemployment rate.

失业率.zh: 政府想了很多办法降低失业率。
失业率.en: The government has tried many ways to lower the unemployment rate.

失业率.zh: 虽然经济不好，但失业率并没有上升太多。
失业率.en: Although the economy is bad, the unemployment rate hasn't risen much.

失业率.zh: 年轻人失业率比中年人高，这让人担心。
失业率.en: The unemployment rate among young people is higher than among middle-aged people, which is worrying.

一味.zh: 他总是一味地指责别人。
一味.en: He always blames others without considering anything else.

一味.zh: 你不能一味追求速度，而忽略了质量。
一味.en: You can't just pursue speed while ignoring quality.

一味.zh: 她一味地省钱，生活过得很辛苦。
一味.en: She blindly saves money and lives a very hard life.

一味.zh: 如果一味地退让，对方只会越来越过分。
一味.en: If you keep giving in, the other side will only become more excessive.

跟上.zh: 我需要跟上大家的进度。
跟上.en: I need to keep up with everyone's progress.

跟上.zh: 社会发展太快，老人很难跟上。
跟上.en: Society develops so fast that old people find it hard to keep up.

跟上.zh: 为了跟上潮流，她每个月都买新衣服。
跟上.en: To keep up with trends, she buys new clothes every month.

和气.en: He is a very amiable person.
The boss is very kind to the employees.

和气.zh: 大家说话和气一点，别吵架。
和气.en: Everyone speak more gently; don't argue.

和气.zh: 他和气地拒绝了我们的邀请。
做生意讲究和气生财，不要总发脾气。
和气.en: In business, harmony brings wealth; don't always lose your temper.

座右铭.zh: 我的座右铭是“永不放弃”。
你的人生座右铭是什么？
这句话一直是我的座右铭。
座右铭.en: This sentence has always been my motto.

座右铭.zh: 他把“天道酬勤”当作自己的座右铭。
座右铭.en: He takes "Heaven rewards diligence" as his motto.

插嘴.zh: 大人说话，小孩子不要插嘴。
插嘴.en: When adults are talking, children shouldn't interrupt.

插嘴.zh: 他总喜欢在别人说话时插嘴。
插嘴.en: He always likes to interrupt when others are speaking.

插嘴.zh: 对不起，我插嘴一下，这个问题我知道。
插嘴.en: Sorry to interrupt, but I know the answer to this question.

插嘴.zh: 开会的时候，请尽量不要插嘴。
插嘴.en: During the meeting, please try not to interrupt.

敬酒.zh: 在酒桌上，敬酒要有礼貌。
敬酒.en: At the dinner table, toasting should be done politely.

敬酒.zh: 他敬酒的时候不小心洒了酒。
敬酒.en: He accidentally spilled the wine while toasting.

公仆.en: He is a public servant of the people.

公仆.zh: 作为一名公仆，他始终把百姓的利益放在第一位。
公仆.en: As a public servant, he always puts the interests of the people first.

公仆.zh: 公仆应该廉洁奉公，不能以权谋私。
公仆.en: Public servants should be honest and not use power for personal gain.

公仆.zh: 我觉得真正的公仆不是做表面文章，而是真心办实事。
公仆.en: I think a true public servant doesn't just pay lip service but genuinely does practical things.

公仆.zh: 当官就要当公仆，别总想着自己享福。
公仆.en: Being an official means being a public servant, not always thinking about your own comfort.

袖手旁观.en: Don't just stand by and watch!

袖手旁观.zh: 朋友有困难，你不能袖手旁观。
袖手旁观.en: You can't stand idly by when a friend is in trouble.

袖手旁观.zh: 看到有人欺负小孩，他不想袖手旁观。
袖手旁观.en: Seeing someone bully a child, he didn't want to look on indifferently.

袖手旁观.zh: 大家都在帮忙，你却袖手旁观，这样不好吧？
袖手旁观.en: Everyone is helping, but you're just standing by—that's not good, is it?

袖手旁观.zh: 如果每个人都袖手旁观，这个社会就没人情味了。
袖手旁观.en: If everyone just stands by, this society will lose its human touch.

拘束.en: Don't be too formal, sit wherever you like.

拘束.zh: 第一次去他家，我有点拘束。
拘束.en: The first time I went to his house, I felt a bit ill at ease.

拘束.zh: 大家都很随和，你不用那么拘束。
拘束.en: Everyone is very easygoing, you don't need to be so constrained.

拘束.zh: 在陌生人面前，她总是很拘束，放不开。
拘束.en: She always feels very awkward in front of strangers and can't relax.

拘束.zh: 虽然我们是第一次见面，但不用拘束，就当自己家一样。
拘束.en: Even though we're meeting for the first time, don't be formal—make yourself at home.

力不从心.en: Getting older, my abilities don't match my wishes.

力不从心.zh: 我想帮忙，可是力不从心。
力不从心.en: I want to help, but I'm not able to.

力不从心.zh: 工作太多，感觉力不从心。
力不从心.en: Too much work, I feel overwhelmed.

力不从心.zh: 他不是不想做，只是力不从心。
力不从心.en: It's not that he doesn't want to do it, he just can't.

力不从心.zh: 孩子想考好大学，但学习上力不从心，需要辅导。
力不从心.en: The child wants to get into a good college, but struggles academically and needs tutoring.

飙升.zh: 这段时间物价飙升，钱都不够用了。
飙升.en: Prices have skyrocketed recently, and I don't have enough money.

飙升.zh: 他的名气最近突然飙升。
飙升.en: His popularity has suddenly skyrocketed lately.

飙升.zh: 因为天气太热，用电量飙升。
飙升.en: Because the weather is so hot, electricity usage has shot up.

飙升.zh: 他没想到股票价格会飙升得这么快。
飙升.en: He didn't expect stock prices to soar so quickly.

缩影.zh: 这个村子是中国的缩影。
缩影.en: This village is a microcosm of China.

缩影.zh: 这家小店是整个行业的一个缩影。
缩影.en: This small shop is a microcosm of the entire industry.

缩影.zh: 电影里的故事就是社会的缩影。
缩影.en: The story in the movie is an epitome of society.

缩影.zh: 从这栋楼能看出一座城市的缩影。
缩影.en: You can see a microcosm of a city from this building.

缩影.zh: 他的一生可以说是那个时代的缩影。
缩影.en: His life can be said to be an epitome of that era.

完备.en: The facilities here are very complete.

完备.zh: 这套系统功能非常完备。
完备.en: This system has very comprehensive functions.

完备.zh: 我们需要一个更完备的方案。
完备.en: We need a more thorough plan.

完备.zh: 虽然条件不完备，但我们还是成功了。
完备.en: Even though the conditions weren't perfect, we still succeeded.

完备.zh: 这个学校的教学设备相当完备，学生学得很方便。
完备.en: This school's teaching equipment is quite comprehensive, making it very convenient for students.

停泊.en: The boat is moored at the dock.

停泊.zh: 这艘货轮停泊在港口三天了。
停泊.en: This cargo ship has been berthed at the port for three days.
Many fishing boats are anchored by the seaside.

停泊.zh: 游艇停泊在私人码头，看起来很漂亮。
停泊.en: The yacht is moored at a private dock and looks very beautiful.

停泊.zh: 因为风浪太大，船只暂时不能停泊。
停泊.en: Due to the high waves, the vessel cannot anchor for now.

闲话.zh: 她最喜欢在背后说人闲话。
闲话.en: She loves gossiping about people behind their backs.

闲话.zh: 这些闲话你听听就算了，别当真。
闲话.en: Just take these rumors with a grain of salt, don't take them seriously.

闲话.zh: 我们聚在一起就是聊些闲话，没什么正事。
闲话.en: When we get together, we just chat idly, nothing serious.

闲话.zh: 背后说闲话不是好习惯，容易伤人。
闲话.en: Gossiping behind someone's back is not a good habit and can hurt people.

较劲.en: The two of them are always competing.

较劲.zh: 别跟他较劲，他脾气不好。
较劲.en: Don't go head-to-head with him, he has a bad temper.

较劲.zh: 这两个公司一直在较劲。
较劲.en: These two companies have been vying with each other.

较劲.zh: 在学习上，他们互相较劲，共同进步。
较劲.en: In studies, they challenge each other and improve together.

较劲.zh: 明明没实力，却非要跟别人较劲，何必呢？
较劲.en: Clearly not strong enough, yet insists on competing with others—why bother?

公职.zh: 他一直在争取一个公职。
公职.en: He has been striving for a public office position.

公职.zh: 很多人觉得公职工作比较稳定。
公职.en: Many people think public office jobs are relatively stable.

公职.zh: 她辞去公职后，自己开了家小店。
公职.en: After resigning from public office, she opened a small shop herself.

公职.zh: 公职人员的选拔越来越透明了。
公职.en: The selection of public officials is becoming more transparent.

公职.zh: 虽然公职收入不高，但福利很好。
公职.en: Although the salary for public office is not high, the benefits are good.

修路.zh: 门口在修路，出门不太方便。
修路.en: They are repairing the road at the entrance, so it's not very convenient to go out.

修路.zh: 修路期间，这条街禁止停车。
修路.en: During road construction, parking is prohibited on this street.

修路.zh: 因为修路，我们绕了很远的路。
修路.en: Because of road construction, we took a long detour.

修路.zh: 政府计划明年开始修路。
修路.en: The government plans to start road construction next year.

修路.zh: 修路工程大概要持续三个月。
修路.en: The road construction project will probably last three months.

自理.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，生活不能完全自理。
自理.en: Grandma is old and cannot fully take care of herself.

自理.zh: 他从小就培养自理能力。
自理.en: He cultivated self-care skills from a young age.

自理.zh: 住院期间，她连基本自理都做不到。
自理.en: During her hospitalization, she couldn't even manage basic self-care.

自理.zh: 虽然身体不舒服，但他坚持自理生活。
自理.en: Although he felt unwell, he insisted on taking care of himself.

直观.en: Showing with pictures is more intuitive.

直观.zh: 直观的方法更容易让人理解。
直观.en: Intuitive methods are easier for people to understand.

直观.zh: 他的讲解非常直观，我一听就明白了。
直观.en: His explanation was very intuitive; I understood it as soon as I heard it.

直观.zh: 数据可视化可以提供直观的信息。
直观.en: Data visualization can provide intuitive information.

格格不入.en: He feels out of place here.

格格不入.zh: 她的想法和大家格格不入。
格格不入.en: Her ideas are incompatible with everyone else's.

格格不入.zh: 在这个圈子里，我总觉得自己格格不入。
格格不入.en: In this circle, I always feel like I don't fit in.

格格不入.zh: 他那种保守风格和现代公司格格不入。
格格不入.en: His conservative style is out of tune with the modern company.

格格不入.zh: 虽然努力融入，但依然格格不入。
格格不入.en: Although he tried hard to fit in, he still felt out of place.

打搅.en: Sorry to bother you for a moment.
I don't want to disturb your rest.
A meeting is in progress, please don't disturb.

打搅.zh: 他突然打搅，让我很尴尬。
打搅.en: His sudden interruption made me very embarrassed.

打搅.zh: 如果没事，我就不打搅您了。
打搅.en: If there's nothing, I'll stop bothering you.

游船.en: We took a pleasure boat to the center of the lake.
The scenery from the pleasure boat is beautiful.
Many people come to ride the pleasure boat on weekends.

游船.zh: 这艘游船可以容纳一百人。
游船.en: This pleasure boat can hold a hundred people.

游船.zh: 沿着河岸有许多游船码头。
游船.en: There are many pleasure boat docks along the riverbank.

照办.zh: 你吩咐的事我一定照办。
照办.en: I will definitely do as you instructed.

照办.zh: 他要求我们照办，不要质疑。
照办.en: He demanded that we obey without questioning.

照办.zh: 只要是合理的命令，我们都照办。
照办.en: As long as the order is reasonable, we will follow it.

照办.zh: 老板怎么说，你就怎么照办。
照办.en: Do exactly as the boss says.

合情合理.en: His request is reasonable and fair.

合情合理.zh: 她提出的方案合情合理。
合情合理.en: The plan she proposed is reasonable.

合情合理.zh: 只要合情合理，我们都会支持。
合情合理.en: As long as it's reasonable, we will support it.

合情合理.zh: 虽然严格，但处罚是合情合理的。
合情合理.en: Although strict, the punishment is fair and reasonable.

豁出去.en: I'm going all out this time.
To win, he decided to risk everything.

豁出去.zh: 反正已经这样了，豁出去试试。
豁出去.en: It's already like this anyway, so I'll just go for it.

豁出去.zh: 他豁出去了，把全部积蓄投进去。
豁出去.en: He threw caution to the wind and invested all his savings.

豁出去.zh: 她豁出去，当面指责了那个经理。
豁出去.en: She went all out and openly criticized that manager.

百分比.zh: 工资涨了百分之五，这个百分比算合理。
百分比.en: The salary increased by 5%, this percentage is reasonable.

百分比.zh: 虽然只有很小百分比的人反对，但我们还是重视。
百分比.en: Although only a small percentage of people oppose, we still take it seriously.

百分比.zh: 因为百分比很低，所以大家没太在意。
百分比.en: Because the percentage is very low, everyone didn't pay much attention.

百分比.zh: 调查显示的百分比让我很惊讶。
百分比.en: The percentage shown in the survey surprised me.

效仿.zh: 很多公司开始效仿他们的成功模式。
效仿.en: Many companies started to imitate their successful model.

效仿.zh: 如果你觉得这个方法好，可以效仿，但要注意修改。
效仿.en: If you think this method is good, you can imitate it, but pay attention to modifications.

效仿.zh: 学生们喜欢效仿偶像的穿着。
效仿.en: Students like to imitate their idols' dressing.

效仿.zh: 他不应该效仿别人的坏习惯。
效仿.en: He shouldn't imitate others' bad habits.

和平共处.zh: 不同文化之间要学会和平共处。
和平共处.en: Different cultures need to learn to coexist peacefully.

和平共处.zh: 虽然观点不同，但我们可以和平共处。
和平共处.en: Although views differ, we can coexist peacefully.

和平共处.zh: 动物和人类应该和平共处。
和平共处.en: Animals and humans should coexist peacefully.

和平共处.zh: 邻居之间需要互相尊重，才能和平共处。
和平共处.en: Neighbors need to respect each other to achieve peaceful coexistence.

恩人.zh: 我永远不会忘记你的恩人身份。
恩人.en: I will never forget your status as my benefactor.

恩人.zh: 因为他是我的恩人，所以我一直很感激他。
恩人.en: Because he is my benefactor, I have always been grateful to him.

恩人.zh: 那位老人是我们全家的恩人。
恩人.en: That old man is the benefactor of our whole family.

恩人.zh: 找到当年的恩人是他最大的心愿。
恩人.en: Finding the benefactor from back then is his biggest wish.

发起人.zh: 谁是这次活动的发起人？
发起人.en: Who is the initiator of this event?

发起人.zh: 作为项目的发起人，他付出了很多努力。
发起人.en: As the initiator of the project, he put in a lot of effort.

发起人.zh: 不仅发起人很积极，参与者也很热情。
发起人.en: Not only the initiator is active, but the participants are also enthusiastic.

发起人.zh: 这个俱乐部的发起人是我大学同学。
发起人.en: The initiator of this club is my college classmate.

发起人.zh: 发起人需要负责整个计划的执行。
发起人.en: The initiator needs to be responsible for the execution of the whole plan.

恭敬.en: He is very respectful to elders.

恭敬.zh: 学生恭敬地向老师鞠躬问好。
恭敬.en: The student respectfully bowed and greeted the teacher.

恭敬.zh: 虽然心里不服，但他表面上还是很恭敬。
恭敬.en: Although unconvinced inside, he still appeared respectful on the surface.

恭敬.zh: 在这种场合，说话要恭敬一些。
恭敬.en: On such occasions, one should speak more respectfully.

海藻.zh: 这片海藻长得太茂盛了，快遮住阳光了。
海藻.en: This patch of seaweed has grown too lush, almost blocking the sunlight.

海藻.zh: 虽然海藻看起来不好看，但味道还不错。
海藻.en: Although seaweed looks unattractive, its taste is not bad.

海藻.zh: 很多护肤品里都加了海藻提取物。
海藻.en: Many skincare products include seaweed extract.
Fishermen make a living by collecting seaweed.

紧缩.en: Fiscal policy needs to be tightened.

紧缩.zh: 公司最近在紧缩开支，减少不必要的开销。
紧缩.en: The company has been tightening expenses recently, cutting unnecessary costs.

紧缩.zh: 因为经济不好，很多家庭都开始紧缩预算。
紧缩.en: Because the economy is bad, many families have started to tighten budgets.
He felt a tightening in his chest.

紧缩.zh: 紧缩的货币政策影响了贷款。
紧缩.en: The tightened monetary policy affected loans.

功臣.en: He is a major contributor to the company.

功臣.zh: 这次成功离不开每位功臣的努力。
功臣.en: This success cannot be separated from the efforts of every contributor.

功臣.zh: 虽然他是功臣，但也不能居功自傲。
功臣.en: Although he is a contributor, he shouldn't be arrogant about his achievements.

功臣.zh: 历史上的功臣往往被后人铭记。
功臣.en: Historical contributors are often remembered by later generations.

功臣.zh: 妈妈是我们家的大功臣，把一切打理得井井有条。
功臣.en: Mom is the great contributor of our family, keeping everything in order.

上火.en: Have you been having internal heat lately?

上火.zh: 吃太多辣椒容易上火，要少吃点。
上火.en: Eating too much chili can cause internal heat, eat less.

上火.zh: 因为天气干燥，我最近老上火。
上火.en: Because the weather is dry, I've been getting internal heat often.

上火.zh: 别生气，上火对身体不好。
上火.en: Don't get angry; getting upset is bad for health.

上火.zh: 他牙疼，医生说是因为上火了。
上火.en: He has toothache; the doctor said it's due to internal heat.

成问题.zh: 他们这样做事迟早会成问题的。
成问题.en: Doing things this way will become a problem sooner or later.

成问题.zh: 电脑一直死机，成问题了，得修一下。
成问题.en: The computer keeps crashing, that's a problem; it needs to be fixed.

成问题.zh: 如果你不按时吃饭，健康早晚成问题。
成问题.en: If you don't eat on time, your health will become a problem sooner or later.

成问题.zh: 虽然现在没事，但长期看资金肯定会成问题。
成问题.en: Even though it's fine now, in the long run the funding will certainly become a problem.

起跑线.en: Don't lose at the starting line.

起跑线.zh: 每个孩子的起跑线都不一样。
起跑线.en: Every child's starting line is different.

起跑线.zh: 起跑线上大家都在拼命往前冲。
起跑线.en: At the starting line, everyone is desperately pushing forward.

起跑线.zh: 虽然家境不好，但他没输在起跑线上。
起跑线.en: Although his family background is poor, he didn't lose at the starting line.

起跑线.zh: 教育公平意味着让所有孩子站在同一条起跑线上。
起跑线.en: Educational equity means letting all children stand on the same starting line.

水落石出.en: The truth will eventually come to light.

水落石出.zh: 别急，等调查完就水落石出了。
水落石出.en: Don't worry, after the investigation is finished, everything will be clear.

水落石出.zh: 这个谜底终于水落石出了。
水落石出.en: The answer to this mystery has finally come to light.

水落石出.zh: 他坚持查下去，果然水落石出了。
水落石出.en: He persisted in investigating, and sure enough, the truth came out.

水落石出.zh: 虽然现在有很多猜测，但事情早晚会水落石出的。
水落石出.en: Although there are many guesses now, the matter will eventually become clear.

发源地.zh: 这里是茶文化的发源地之一。
发源地.en: This is one of the birthplaces of tea culture.

发源地.zh: 黄河是中华文明的发源地。
发源地.en: The Yellow River is the cradle of Chinese civilization.

发源地.zh: 这个小镇是那种独特面食的发源地。
发源地.en: This small town is the birthplace of that unique type of noodle dish.

顺理成章.zh: 他努力了，成功也顺理成章。
顺理成章.en: He worked hard, so success came naturally.

顺理成章.zh: 既然你同意了，那就顺理成章了。
顺理成章.en: Since you agreed, it's only logical.

顺理成章.zh: 她经验丰富，升职是顺理成章的事。
顺理成章.en: With her rich experience, her promotion is a natural progression.

顺理成章.zh: 只要提前准备，事情就会顺理成章地完成。
顺理成章.en: As long as you prepare in advance, things will be completed smoothly.

顺理成章.zh: 两人相处久了，在一起也就顺理成章了。
顺理成章.en: After spending a long time together, it's only natural that they got together.

继父.en: My stepfather treats me very well.

继父.zh: 她从小就跟继父一起生活。
继父.en: She has lived with her stepfather since she was little.

继父.zh: 继父虽然不是亲生的，但很照顾我。
继父.en: Even though my stepfather is not biological, he takes good care of me.

继父.zh: 他继父去世后，他继承了那家小店。
继父.en: After his stepfather passed away, he inherited that small shop.

继父.zh: 我朋友和他继父的关系比亲生的还好。
继父.en: My friend's relationship with his stepfather is even better than with his biological father.

焕发.zh: 老城区又焕发了新的活力。
焕发.en: The old city has revived with new vitality.

焕发.zh: 休息几天后，他整个人都焕发出精神。
焕发.en: After a few days of rest, he radiated energy all over.

焕发.zh: 这个品牌通过改革焕发了青春。
焕发.en: This brand regained its youth through reform.

焕发.zh: 春天来了，万物都焕发出勃勃生机。
焕发.en: Spring has arrived, and all things are bursting with vitality.

恩赐.en: This is not a gift from anyone.
Being alive is a gift in itself.

恩赐.zh: 他把成功归功于上天的恩赐。
恩赐.en: He attributes his success to a gift from heaven.

恩赐.zh: 这份工作不是别人的恩赐，是你自己争取来的。
恩赐.en: This job is not a gift from someone else; you earned it yourself.

恩赐.zh: 不要把这当成理所当然的恩赐，要懂得珍惜。
恩赐.en: Don't take this as a natural gift; you should learn to cherish it.

遭殃.en: When the flood came, the crops suffered.

遭殃.zh: 要是继续这样，大家都要遭殃。
遭殃.en: If this continues, everyone will suffer.

遭殃.zh: 政策一变，小商贩们就遭殃了。
遭殃.en: Once the policy changed, the small vendors suffered.

遭殃.zh: 他乱扔垃圾，结果邻居跟着遭殃。
遭殃.en: He littered carelessly, and as a result, the neighbors suffered too.

遭殃.zh: 那次事故导致整个村子都遭殃了。
遭殃.en: That accident caused the entire village to suffer.

纵观.zh: 纵观全局，这个方案最好。
纵观.en: Looking at the overall situation, this plan is the best.

纵观.zh: 纵观历史，和平来之不易。
纵观.en: Throughout history, peace has not come easily.

纵观.zh: 纵观整个行业，他的能力很突出。
纵观.en: Taking a broad view of the entire industry, his abilities stand out.

纵观.zh: 纵观一生，他做过很多有意义的事。
纵观.en: Looking back over his life, he has done many meaningful things.

纵观.zh: 纵观这次比赛，我们队的表现还算稳定。
纵观.en: Looking at this competition as a whole, our team's performance was fairly stable.

招揽.en: He solicits customers on the street.

招揽.zh: 为了招揽更多客人，这家餐厅推出了优惠活动。
招揽.en: To attract more customers, this restaurant launched a promotion.

招揽.zh: 公司用免费试用招揽新用户。
招揽.en: The company uses free trials to attract new users.

招揽.zh: 虽然价格不高，但还是要靠广告招揽生意。
招揽.en: Although the price is low, you still need ads to solicit business.

招揽.zh: 他站在门口招揽路过的人进店看看。
招揽.en: He stood at the door inviting passersby to come in and look.

追悼会.en: The memorial service will be held tomorrow.

追悼会.zh: 他的追悼会来了很多亲朋好友。
追悼会.en: Many friends and family came to his memorial service.

追悼会.zh: 因为疫情，追悼会只邀请了少数人。
追悼会.en: Because of the pandemic, only a few people were invited to the memorial service.

追悼会.zh: 在追悼会上，大家默哀了三分钟。
追悼会.en: At the memorial service, everyone observed three minutes of silence.

追悼会.zh: 追悼会结束后，家属向宾客致谢。
追悼会.en: After the memorial service, the family thanked the guests.

助威.en: We go to cheer for the team.

助威.zh: 比赛时，观众大声助威，气氛很热烈。
助威.en: During the game, the audience cheered loudly, the atmosphere was lively.

助威.zh: 虽然客场作战，但球迷们还是远道而来为他们助威。
助威.en: Although playing away, fans still traveled far to cheer for them.

助威.zh: 他站在跑道边为朋友助威。
助威.en: He stood by the track to cheer for his friend.

助威.zh: 同学们一起喊口号给运动员助威。
助威.en: Classmates shouted slogans together to cheer on the athletes.

转学.en: He will transfer schools next month.

转学.zh: 因为搬家，孩子不得不转学去新学校。
转学.en: Because of moving, the child had to transfer to a new school.

转学.zh: 如果成绩不好，可以考虑转学吗？
转学.en: If grades are not good, can we consider transferring schools?

转学.zh: 她转学后很快就交到了新朋友。
转学.en: After transferring, she quickly made new friends.

转学.zh: 转学手续需要家长亲自办理。
转学.en: The transfer procedures need to be handled by parents in person.

调剂.zh: 这个专业没录取，我被调剂到另一个专业了。
调剂.en: I wasn't admitted to this major, I was adjusted to another major.

调剂.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他会看电影来调剂心情。
调剂.en: Although work is busy, he watches movies to adjust his mood.

调剂.zh: 医生建议用药调剂血压。
调剂.en: The doctor suggests using medicine to regulate blood pressure.

调剂.zh: 周末去郊游一下，调剂一下紧张的生活。
调剂.en: Go on an outing on the weekend to add some variety to the tense life.

原装.zh: 买手机最好买原装配件，质量有保障。
原装.en: It's best to buy original accessories for the phone, quality is guaranteed.

原装.zh: 虽然价格贵一点，但原装零件更耐用。
原装.en: Although a bit more expensive, original parts are more durable.

原装.zh: 这个电脑是原装的，没有拆过。
原装.en: This computer is original, never opened.
He likes to collect original models.

还款.en: You have to repay every month.

还款.zh: 贷款买房后，他每个月按时还款。
还款.en: After taking a mortgage to buy a house, he repays on time every month.

还款.zh: 因为失业，他暂时没法还款。
还款.en: Because of unemployment, he temporarily can't repay.

还款.zh: 提前还款可以减少利息。
她还清了最后一笔还款，松了一口气。
还款.en: She paid off the last installment and breathed a sigh of relief.

开明.zh: 开明的老师允许学生提出不同意见。
开明.en: An open-minded teacher allows students to express different opinions.

开明.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他的思想很开明。
开明.en: Although old, his thinking is very open-minded.

开明.zh: 这家公司的管理方式非常开明。
开明.en: This company's management style is very open.

开明.zh: 她开明的态度让大家都愿意和她交流。
开明.en: Her open-minded attitude makes everyone willing to communicate with her.

靶子.zh: 练习射击时，要把靶子放在安全位置。
靶子.en: When practicing shooting, place the target in a safe position.

靶子.zh: 他成了大家批评的靶子，心里很难受。
靶子.en: He became the target of everyone's criticism, feeling very upset.

靶子.zh: 这个广告把年轻人作为主要靶子。
飞镖比赛里，靶子分成很多环。
靶子.en: In dart competition, the target is divided into many rings.

气馁.zh: 虽然失败了，但他一点也不气馁。
气馁.en: Although he failed, he was not discouraged at all.

气馁.zh: 遇到挫折时，不要轻易气馁。
气馁.en: When encountering setbacks, don't easily get discouraged.

气馁.zh: 她因为成绩不好而感到气馁。
气馁.en: She felt discouraged because of poor grades.

气馁.zh: 大家鼓励他，让他不要气馁。
气馁.en: Everyone encouraged him not to be discouraged.

零星.zh: 晚上能看到零星几颗星星。
零星.en: You can see a few scattered stars at night.

零星.zh: 他家里只有零星几件家具。
零星.en: He only has a few pieces of furniture scattered around his house.

零星.zh: 虽然下了零星小雨，但我们还是出去了。
零星.en: Although there were a few scattered raindrops, we still went out.

零星.zh: 公园里零星地开着几朵花，显得很冷清。
零星.en: A few flowers are scattered in the park, making it look quite deserted.

零星.zh: 这次活动只有零星几个人参加，效果不太好。
零星.en: Only a handful of people attended the event, so it wasn't very effective.

奔赴.en: He rushed to the front line.
The rescue team rushed to the disaster area overnight.

奔赴.zh: 为了梦想，他奔赴上海打拼。
奔赴.en: For his dream, he rushed to Shanghai to work hard.

奔赴.zh: 听到消息后，他立刻奔赴现场。
奔赴.en: After hearing the news, he immediately rushed to the scene.

奔赴.zh: 我们奔赴各地收集资料，终于完成了报告。
奔赴.en: We rushed to various places to collect data and finally completed the report.

滨海.en: They live in a coastal neighborhood.

滨海.zh: 滨海公园的海风很舒服。
滨海.en: The sea breeze at the coastal park is very comfortable.

滨海.zh: 这个滨海小镇风景特别美。
滨海.en: This coastal town has especially beautiful scenery.

滨海.zh: 我们沿着滨海公路开车，一路都是海景。
滨海.en: We drove along the coastal highway, with ocean views the whole way.

口哨.zh: 他用口哨叫来了出租车。
口哨.en: He whistled to call a taxi.

口哨.zh: 我听到远处传来口哨声。
口哨.en: I heard a whistling sound coming from afar.

口哨.zh: 她一边走路一边吹口哨，看起来很开心。
口哨.en: She was walking and whistling, looking very happy.

受惊.zh: 她受惊后躲到了角落里。
受惊.en: After being startled, she hid in the corner.

受惊.zh: 突然的响声让鸟儿受惊飞走了。
受惊.en: The sudden noise startled the birds and they flew away.

受惊.zh: 别突然大喊，兔子容易受惊。
受惊.en: Don't shout suddenly; rabbits get scared easily.

受惊.zh: 小狗受惊后一直发抖，我们慢慢安抚它。
受惊.en: The puppy kept trembling after being startled, so we slowly calmed it down.

来年.en: Come back next spring to enjoy the flowers.
I hope for a good harvest next year.

来年.zh: 今年种下的树，来年就能结果了。
来年.en: The trees planted this year will bear fruit next year.

来年.zh: 如果今年努力，来年一定会有进步。
来年.en: If you work hard this year, you will definitely improve next year.

孤零零.zh: 他一个人孤零零地站着。
那栋房子孤零零地在山顶。
孤零零.en: That house sits all alone on the hilltop.

孤零零.zh: 老人在公园里孤零零地坐着。
孤零零.en: The old man sat alone in the park.

孤零零.zh: 她孤零零地走在街上，心里很难受。
孤零零.en: She walked alone on the street, feeling very upset.

孤零零.zh: 虽然有很多人，但他还是觉得孤零零的。
孤零零.en: Even though there were many people, he still felt lonely.

探亲.en: He went home to visit his family.

探亲.zh: 春节很多人回老家探亲。
探亲.en: Many people go back to their hometowns to visit family during Spring Festival.
She goes to visit her family every summer vacation.

探亲.zh: 趁着假期，我们一起去探亲。
探亲.en: Let's take advantage of the holiday and go visit our families together.

探亲.zh: 他坐了几天的火车，就是为了回家探亲。
探亲.en: He took a train for several days just to go home and visit his family.

卖弄.en: He always likes to show off his knowledge.

卖弄.zh: 她喜欢在朋友面前卖弄才艺。
卖弄.en: She likes to show off her talents in front of friends.

卖弄.zh: 他卖弄了一下他的新手机。
卖弄.en: He showed off his new phone a bit.

卖弄.zh: 这种卖弄只会让别人反感。
卖弄.en: This kind of showing off only turns people off.

卖弄.zh: 他虽然很有知识，但从不在人前卖弄。
卖弄.en: Although he is very knowledgeable, he never shows off in front of others.

比试.en: Tomorrow the two of them will compete in a race.
You need to set the rules before the competition.

比试.zh: 他想跟我比试围棋，我答应了。
比试.en: He wanted to have a Go match with me, and I agreed.

比试.zh: 比试不在乎输赢，重在参与。
比试.en: In a competition, it's not about winning or losing but about participating.

大名鼎鼎.zh: 他是个大名鼎鼎的作家。
这家餐厅的大名鼎鼎的招牌菜是红烧肉。
大名鼎鼎.en: This restaurant's famous signature dish is red braised pork.

大名鼎鼎.zh: 虽然大名鼎鼎，但他非常谦虚。
大名鼎鼎.en: Although he is famous, he is very modest.
That is the famous Forbidden City.

大名鼎鼎.zh: 他因为那部电影而变得大名鼎鼎。
大名鼎鼎.en: He became famous because of that movie.

根治.en: This disease is hard to cure completely.

根治.zh: 要根治这个问题，需要从根源上解决。
根治.en: To root out this problem, we need to solve it from the source.

根治.zh: 他希望通过手术根治这个病。
根治.en: He hopes to cure this disease completely through surgery.
Can this pollution be completely fixed?

根治.zh: 如果不好好治疗，这个慢性病很难根治。
根治.en: If not treated properly, this chronic disease is hard to cure completely.

好家伙.zh: 好家伙，你居然把整盘菜都吃完了！
好家伙.en: Good heavens, you actually finished the whole plate!

好家伙.zh: 好家伙，他居然一个人完成了全部工作！
好家伙.en: Good heavens, he actually finished all the work alone!

就近.zh: 我们就近找个地方吃饭。
就近.en: Let's find a place nearby to eat.

就近.zh: 如果来不及去医院，可以就近找个诊所看看。
就近.en: If you don't have time to go to the hospital, you can find a clinic nearby.
He went to a nearby elementary school.

就近.zh: 我们就近找了一家旅馆住下。
就近.en: We found a nearby hotel to stay.

就近.zh: 因为时间紧迫，他们决定就近解决晚饭。
就近.en: Because time was tight, they decided to have dinner nearby.

老实说.en: To be honest, I don't like him.

老实说.zh: 老实说，我觉得这个方案不太可行。
老实说.en: To be honest, I think this plan is not very feasible.

老实说.zh: 老实说，我没想到你会这么快就完成。
老实说.en: To be honest, I didn't expect you to finish so quickly.

老实说.zh: 老实说，这个问题比我预想的更复杂。
老实说.en: Honestly, this problem is more complicated than I expected.

一事无成.en: He accomplished nothing in his life.

一事无成.zh: 如果总是半途而废，最后只会一事无成。
一事无成.en: If you always give up halfway, you'll end up accomplishing nothing.

一事无成.zh: 他不想再这么一事无成地混下去了。
一事无成.en: He doesn't want to drift along accomplishing nothing anymore.

一事无成.zh: 他虽然努力了很久，但最后还是一事无成。
一事无成.en: Although he worked hard for a long time, he still ended up accomplishing nothing.

翻天覆地.zh: 改革开放后，生活翻天覆地。
翻天覆地.en: After reform and opening up, life changed dramatically.

翻天覆地.zh: 要不是亲眼看到，我真不敢相信这里变化翻天覆地。
翻天覆地.en: If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn't believe the changes were so dramatic.

翻天覆地.zh: 科技的发展让世界翻天覆地。
翻天覆地.en: The development of technology has turned the world upside down.

逐年.en: Temperatures are rising year by year.

逐年.zh: 他的收入逐年增加，生活越来越好。
逐年.en: His income increases year by year, and life is getting better.

逐年.zh: 这个城市的交通拥堵问题逐年恶化。
逐年.en: This city's traffic congestion problem is worsening year by year.
Tourist numbers rise year by year.

逐年.zh: 虽然房价逐年上涨，但买房的人还是很多。
逐年.en: Although housing prices rise year by year, there are still many people buying houses.

条理.zh: 写文章要注意条理清晰，别让人看不懂。
条理.en: When writing an article, pay attention to clear logic, don't let people fail to understand.

条理.zh: 他的计划条理分明，很容易执行。
条理.en: His plan is well-organized and easy to execute.
Do things in an orderly manner.

条理.zh: 老师教我们如何有条理地整理笔记。
条理.en: The teacher taught us how to organize notes in an orderly way.

火候.en: When stir-frying, pay attention to the heat.

火候.zh: 这道菜的火候掌握得刚刚好，非常好吃。
火候.en: The heat for this dish was just right, very delicious.

火候.zh: 他做事很有火候，不紧不慢的。
火候.en: He does things with good timing, neither rushed nor slow.
The heat needs to be higher.

火候.zh: 教练说他的技术已经到了火候，可以参赛了。
火候.en: The coach said his skill has reached the right level, he can compete.

波折.zh: 这件事经历了很多波折。
波折.en: This matter went through many twists and turns.

波折.zh: 虽然过程有波折，但结果还不错。
波折.en: Although the process had ups and downs, the outcome was not bad.

波折.zh: 他们俩的感情经历了不少波折。
波折.en: Their relationship has experienced quite a few setbacks.

波折.zh: 创业路上波折不断，但他从没放弃。
波折.en: There were constant twists and turns on the entrepreneurial road, but he never gave up.

波折.zh: 因为遇到一些波折，我们的计划推迟了。
波折.en: Because we encountered some setbacks, our plan was delayed.

见义勇为.zh: 他见义勇为，救了那个孩子。
见义勇为.en: He acted bravely to save that child.

见义勇为.zh: 见义勇为是值得表扬的行为。
见义勇为.en: Acting courageously for justice is a praiseworthy act.

见义勇为.zh: 那个小伙子见义勇为，抓住了小偷。
见义勇为.en: That young man bravely stepped in and caught the thief.

见义勇为.zh: 如果每个人都敢见义勇为，社会会更安全。
见义勇为.en: If everyone dared to act bravely for justice, society would be safer.

见义勇为.zh: 他因为见义勇为被市政府表彰了。
见义勇为.en: He was commended by the city government for his courageous act.

品行.zh: 他品行很好，大家都喜欢他。
品行.en: He has good character; everyone likes him.

品行.zh: 老师很看重学生的品行。
品行.en: Teachers value students' moral conduct very much.

品行.zh: 一个人的品行比能力更重要。
品行.en: A person's moral character is more important than their ability.
He has upright conduct and never lies.

品行.zh: 虽然成绩一般，但他的品行值得学习。
品行.en: Although his grades are average, his moral character is worth learning from.

合资.zh: 他们合资开了一家餐厅。
合资.en: They jointly invested to open a restaurant.

合资.zh: 这家公司是中外合资的。
合资.en: This company is a Sino-foreign joint venture.

合资.zh: 我们打算合资买一套设备。
合资.en: We plan to jointly invest in buying a set of equipment.

合资.zh: 因为资金不够，我们决定合资办厂。
合资.en: Because we didn't have enough funds, we decided to set up a factory with joint investment.

合资.zh: 合资项目需要双方都同意才能推进。
合资.en: A joint venture project requires agreement from both sides to move forward.

顺应.zh: 我们要顺应时代的变化。
顺应.en: We must go along with the changes of the times.

顺应.zh: 这个政策顺应了老百姓的需求。
顺应.en: This policy conforms to the needs of the common people.

顺应.zh: 顺应自然规律才能活得健康。
顺应.en: Only by following the laws of nature can you live healthily.

顺应.zh: 公司必须顺应市场趋势，不然会被淘汰。
顺应.en: Companies must adapt to market trends, otherwise they will be eliminated.

顺应.zh: 他不太会顺应别人的意见，总是很固执。
顺应.en: He is not good at going along with others' opinions and is always stubborn.

紧缺.en: Face masks are in short supply now.

紧缺.zh: 疫情期间物资非常紧缺。
紧缺.en: During the pandemic, supplies were very scarce.

紧缺.zh: 技术人才在这个行业特别紧缺。
紧缺.en: Technical talent is especially in short supply in this industry.

紧缺.zh: 因为电力紧缺，工厂只能轮流开工。
