紧缺.en: Due to a power shortage, factories can only operate in shifts.

紧缺.zh: 虽然资金紧缺，但他还是坚持把项目做完了。
紧缺.en: Although funds were tight, he still insisted on finishing the project.

挖苦.zh: 你别挖苦我了，我知道我错了。
挖苦.en: Stop sarcastically mocking me; I know I was wrong.

挖苦.zh: 他说话总爱挖苦人，很讨厌。
挖苦.en: He always likes to make sarcastic remarks; it's very annoying.

挖苦.zh: 朋友之间开开玩笑可以，但别挖苦。
挖苦.en: It's okay to joke among friends, but don't be sarcastic.

挖苦.zh: 她挖苦了我几句，我气得没说话。
挖苦.en: She made a few sarcastic remarks at me, and I was so angry I didn't speak.

挖苦.zh: 虽然他是开玩笑，但那话听起来像挖苦。
挖苦.en: Although he was joking, those words sounded like sarcasm.

苦练.en: He practices piano hard every day.

苦练.zh: 经过三年苦练，他终于成功了。
苦练.en: After three years of hard practice, he finally succeeded.

苦练.zh: 运动员苦练了几个月，就为了这场比赛。
苦练.en: The athletes trained hard for months just for this competition.

苦练.zh: 要想学好一门手艺，必须苦练基本功。
苦练.en: To master a craft, you must practice the basics diligently.

苦练.zh: 她苦练英语口语，现在说得很流利。
苦练.en: She worked hard on her spoken English, and now she speaks very fluently.

怨气.zh: 你别把怨气撒到我身上。
怨气.en: Don't take your resentment out on me.

怨气.zh: 加班太多，员工们怨气很大。
怨气.en: With too much overtime, the employees are very resentful.

怨气.zh: 他因为没得到奖金，心里一直有怨气。
怨气.en: Because he didn't get the bonus, he has been harboring resentment.

怨气.zh: 如果你有怨气，就直接说出来，别憋着。
怨气.en: If you have grievances, just speak them out directly; don't hold them in.

焦距.en: This photo's focus wasn't set properly.

焦距.zh: 拍人像时焦距要准，不然会模糊。
焦距.en: When taking portraits, the focus must be accurate, otherwise it will be blurry.

焦距.zh: 他调整了焦距，终于拍清楚了远处的山。
焦距.en: He adjusted the focus and finally got a clear shot of the distant mountain.

焦距.zh: 相机自动对焦，但有时候焦距会跑偏。
焦距.en: The camera auto-focuses, but sometimes the focus drifts off.

洋溢.zh: 她全身洋溢着青春活力。
洋溢.en: She is full of youthful energy.

洋溢.zh: 大厅里洋溢着欢乐的气氛。
洋溢.en: The hall is filled with a joyful atmosphere.

洋溢.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但大家的热情依然洋溢。
洋溢.en: Although the weather is cold, everyone's enthusiasm is still overflowing.

洋溢.zh: 整个会场洋溢着热烈的掌声和笑声。
洋溢.en: The entire venue was filled with warm applause and laughter.

洋溢.zh: 孩子们的脸上都洋溢着天真的笑容。
洋溢.en: The children's faces are filled with innocent smiles.

立方.en: This box is one cubic meter.

立方.zh: 我们需要计算这个立方体的体积。
立方.en: We need to calculate the volume of this cube.

立方.zh: 水一立方米的重量是一吨。
立方.en: One cubic meter of water weighs one ton.

立方.zh: 虽然看起来不大，但这个立方空间其实能装很多东西。
立方.en: Although it doesn't look big, this cubic space can actually hold a lot.

立方.zh: 他买了一个两立方米的冰箱。

难为情.zh: 当着大家的面唱歌，我觉得很难为情。
难为情.en: Singing in front of everyone makes me feel very embarrassed.

难为情.zh: 他因为说错话而难为情地低下了头。
难为情.en: He lowered his head in embarrassment because he said the wrong thing.

难为情.zh: 你不用难为情，大家都是朋友。
难为情.en: You don't need to be embarrassed, we're all friends.

难为情.zh: 虽然我很想帮忙，但实在难为情开口。
难为情.en: Although I really want to help, I'm too embarrassed to speak up.

泥潭.en: The car got stuck in the mud.

泥潭.zh: 他小心地绕过那个泥潭。
泥潭.en: He carefully went around that mud puddle.

泥潭.zh: 这个项目已经陷入了泥潭，很难推进了。
泥潭.en: This project has gotten bogged down and is hard to push forward.

泥潭.zh: 雨后路上到处都是泥潭。
泥潭.en: After the rain, there were mud puddles everywhere on the road.

泥潭.zh: 我不想让自己的生活也陷入泥潭。
泥潭.en: I don't want my life to get stuck in a quagmire either.

何苦.zh: 他何苦为了这点小事生气？
何苦.en: Why does he get angry over such a small matter?

何苦.zh: 既然已经过去了，你又何苦再提呢？
何苦.en: Since it's already passed, why bring it up again?

何苦.zh: 你何苦这么拼命，身体要紧啊。
何苦.en: Why push yourself so hard? Your health matters.

何苦.zh: 我不想让她难做，何苦呢？
何苦.en: I don't want to put her in a difficult position—why bother?

巴不得.en: I can't wait to go home right now.
He can't wait for class to end early.

巴不得.zh: 天气这么热，我巴不得整天待在空调房里。
巴不得.en: It's so hot that I wish I could stay in the air-conditioned room all day.

巴不得.zh: 她巴不得立刻见到你，但是没时间。
巴不得.en: She can't wait to see you right away, but she doesn't have time.

巴不得.zh: 我巴不得明天就是周末。
巴不得.en: I wish tomorrow were the weekend.

大体上.zh: 这个计划大体上没问题。
虽然有些细节不够完美，但大体上还是不错的。
大体上.en: Although some details aren't perfect, overall it's pretty good.

大体上.zh: 大体上他的说法是正确的。
大体上.en: Generally speaking, his statement is correct.

大体上.zh: 我们大体上完成了任务，只剩最后一步。
大体上.en: We have basically completed the task, with only the last step left.

宝库.en: The library is a treasure house of knowledge.

宝库.zh: 这座古城是一个文化宝库。
宝库.en: This ancient city is a cultural treasure trove.

宝库.zh: 他的脑子里仿佛装着一个宝库，什么都知道。
宝库.en: His mind seems to contain a treasure trove; he knows everything.

宝库.zh: 大自然是一个无穷的宝库。
宝库.en: Nature is an infinite treasure house.

宝库.zh: 虽然这本书很旧，但它里面藏着一个宝库般的信息。
宝库.en: Although this book is old, it contains a treasure trove of information.

忌讳.en: It's taboo to talk loudly while eating.

忌讳.zh: 我们这里最忌讳提到那件事。
忌讳.en: Here, mentioning that matter is the biggest taboo.

忌讳.zh: 虽然他没有明说，但我知道这是他的忌讳。
忌讳.en: Although he didn't say it outright, I know it's his taboo.

忌讳.zh: 做生意的人通常忌讳说“亏”字。
忌讳.en: People in business usually avoid saying the word 'loss'.

宏观.zh: 我们从宏观角度看问题。
宏观.en: We look at the problem from a macro perspective.

宏观.zh: 宏观经济学研究的是整体经济。
宏观.en: Macroeconomics studies the economy as a whole.

宏观.zh: 虽然细节很重要，但宏观方向更不能忽略。
宏观.en: Although details are important, the macro direction cannot be ignored.

宏观.zh: 这个政策在宏观上是有利的。
宏观.en: This policy is favorable on a macro level.

宏观.zh: 我们需要先从宏观上把握这个项目的框架。
宏观.en: We need to first grasp the framework of this project from a macro perspective.

神态.zh: 看到成绩单时，她的神态一下子变了。
神态.en: When she saw the report card, her expression suddenly changed.

神态.zh: 虽然嘴上说没事，但他的神态出卖了他。
神态.en: Although he said it was fine, his demeanor betrayed him.

神态.zh: 那个警察的神态特别严肃。
神态.en: That policeman's expression is especially serious.

神态.zh: 从她的神态来看，好像不太高兴。
神态.en: Judging from her expression, she doesn't seem very happy.

省事.zh: 用这个软件可以省事不少。
省事.en: Using this software can save a lot of trouble.

省事.zh: 为了省事，我直接叫了外卖。
省事.en: To save trouble, I just ordered takeout.

省事.zh: 别偷懒，省事不一定省心。
省事.en: Don't be lazy; saving trouble doesn't always save worry.

省事.zh: 虽然省事，但质量可能会差一些。
省事.en: Although it's convenient, the quality might be a bit worse.

首创.en: This is the company's pioneering product.

首创.zh: 他首创了这种教学方法。
这项技术在国内是首创的。
首创.en: This technology is the first of its kind in the country.

首创.zh: 我们团队首创了一个全新的模式。
首创.en: Our team pioneered a brand new model.

首创.zh: 虽然有人模仿，但首创精神值得尊敬。
首创.en: Although some imitate, the pioneering spirit is worthy of respect.

导火索.zh: 那件事是这场争吵的导火索。
导火索.en: That incident was the trigger for this quarrel.

导火索.zh: 导火索往往是一件小事。
导火索.en: The trigger is often something trivial.

导火索.zh: 经济问题成了这次冲突的导火索。
导火索.en: Economic issues became the trigger for this conflict.

导火索.zh: 如果不及时处理，这个矛盾可能会成为导火索。
导火索.en: If not handled in time, this conflict could become the trigger.

磨合.en: A new car needs to be broken in.
The two of them are still in the adjustment phase.

磨合.zh: 团队经过磨合，合作越来越顺了。
磨合.en: After the team adjusted, cooperation became smoother.

磨合.zh: 别急，婚姻需要慢慢磨合。
磨合.en: Don't rush; marriage needs gradual adjustment.

磨合.zh: 刚开始可能有摩擦，磨合久了就好了。
磨合.en: There may be friction at first, but after a long adjustment it will be fine.

交响乐.zh: 今晚有场交响乐音乐会。

交响乐.en: The momentum of a symphony is magnificent.

交响乐.zh: 他从小学习交响乐指挥。
交响乐.en: He has been learning symphony conducting since childhood.

交响乐.zh: 虽然听不懂，但交响乐真的很震撼。
交响乐.en: Although I don't understand it, the symphony is really impressive.

形形色色.en: There are all kinds of people on the street.

形形色色.zh: 这个网站提供形形色色的课程。
形形色色.en: This website offers a wide variety of courses.

形形色色.zh: 生活中我们会遇到形形色色的困难。
形形色色.en: In life, we encounter all kinds of difficulties.

形形色色.zh: 超市里卖形形色色的零食。
形形色色.en: The supermarket sells all kinds of snacks.

形形色色.zh: 形形色色的观点都可以讨论。
形形色色.en: All kinds of viewpoints can be discussed.

投奔.en: He went to live with his relatives.

投奔.zh: 失业后，他只好投奔朋友。
投奔.en: After losing his job, he had to go to a friend for help.

投奔.zh: 很多人投奔大城市寻找机会。
投奔.en: Many people go to big cities seeking opportunities.

投奔.zh: 她无路可走，只能投奔我们。
投奔.en: She had no other option and had to come to us for shelter.

投奔.zh: 如果遇到困难，你可以投奔我。
投奔.en: If you encounter difficulties, you can come to me for help.

飘扬.en: The national flag flutters in the wind.
Colorful flags are waving on the square.
Her hair flutters in the wind.

飘扬.zh: 雪白的校服在校园里飘扬着。
飘扬.en: The white school uniforms were fluttering around the campus.

飘扬.zh: 听到国歌时，看着旗帜飘扬，他很激动。
飘扬.en: When he heard the national anthem and watched the flag flutter, he was very moved.

瓜子.en: I like to crack sunflower seeds.

瓜子.zh: 过年时家里总备着瓜子。
瓜子.en: During Chinese New Year, we always have sunflower seeds at home.

瓜子.zh: 一边聊天一边嗑瓜子，很惬意。
瓜子.en: Chatting while cracking sunflower seeds is very pleasant.
Sunflower seeds are a must-have for watching TV dramas.
Don't throw sunflower seed shells on the ground.

旱.en: Northern regions often suffer from droughts.

旱.zh: 因为连续三个月没下雨，庄稼都旱死了。
旱.en: Because it hasn't rained for three months straight, the crops have all died from drought.

旱.zh: 如果今年再旱下去，水库就快没水了。
旱.en: If the drought continues this year, the reservoir will soon run out of water.

旱.zh: 虽然下了点雨，但还是解决不了旱情。
旱.en: Although it rained a little, it still can't solve the drought situation.

谈起.zh: 一谈起足球，他就特别兴奋。
谈起.en: Whenever soccer is brought up, he gets very excited.

谈起.zh: 昨天我们谈起小时候的事，大家都笑了。
谈起.en: Yesterday we talked about childhood things, and everyone laughed.

谈起.zh: 既然谈起了这个话题，我们就好好聊聊吧。
谈起.en: Since we've brought up this topic, let's have a good chat about it.

谈起.zh: 每次谈起他，她都会忍不住叹气。
谈起.en: Every time she talks about him, she can't help sighing.

画册.en: This picture album is very beautiful.

画册.zh: 我买了一本关于动物的画册。
画册.en: I bought a picture album about animals.

画册.zh: 他送给我一本很厚的画册，里面都是名画。
画册.en: He gave me a very thick art book, full of famous paintings.

画册.zh: 虽然画册很贵，但我还是买下来了。
画册.en: Although the picture album was expensive, I still bought it.

画册.zh: 小孩子的画册通常颜色很鲜艳。
画册.en: Children's picture books usually have very bright colors.

调控.en: Housing prices need to be regulated.

调控.zh: 为了更好地调控市场，他们出台了很多新政策。
调控.en: In order to better regulate the market, they introduced many new policies.

调控.zh: 因为经济过热，所以央行开始调控利率。
调控.en: Because the economy is overheating, the central bank has started to regulate interest rates.

调控.zh: 这套系统可以自动调控室内温度。
调控.en: This system can automatically regulate the indoor temperature.

指手画脚.en: Stop making gestures and criticizing over there.

指手画脚.zh: 他总喜欢对别人指手画脚。
指手画脚.en: He always likes to boss others around.

指手画脚.zh: 你自己都不会做，就别对我指手画脚了。
指手画脚.en: You can't even do it yourself, so stop bossing me around.

指手画脚.zh: 虽然他是领导，但也不该随便指手画脚。
指手画脚.en: Although he's the boss, he shouldn't just give orders arbitrarily.

指手画脚.zh: 大家都在忙，只有他在旁边指手画脚。
指手画脚.en: Everyone is busy, only he is standing around giving orders.

开发区.en: The development zone has built many factories.

开发区.zh: 这个开发区吸引了很多投资。
开发区.en: This development zone has attracted a lot of investment.

开发区.zh: 我们公司搬到开发区那边去了，上班更远了。
开发区.en: Our company moved to the development zone area, so commuting is farther now.

开发区.zh: 因为开发区的政策好，所以企业都愿意来。
开发区.en: Because the development zone has good policies, companies are willing to come.

开发区.zh: 开发区里新开了一家很大的商场。
开发区.en: A very large shopping mall has newly opened in the development zone.

辞呈.zh: 老板还没批准她的辞呈。
辞呈.en: The boss hasn't approved her resignation letter yet.

辞呈.zh: 昨天他写了辞呈，准备下个月离职。
辞呈.en: Yesterday he wrote his resignation letter, planning to leave next month.

辞呈.zh: 既然已经决定了，那就早点把辞呈交上去吧。
辞呈.en: Since you've already decided, you might as well hand in your resignation letter early.

辞呈.zh: 她的辞呈被经理退回来了。
辞呈.en: Her resignation letter was returned by the manager.

泄气.zh: 轮胎泄气了，得去修一下。
泄气.en: The tire has a leak; I need to get it fixed.

泄气.zh: 虽然考试没考好，但他一点也不泄气。
泄气.en: Although he didn't do well on the exam, he wasn't discouraged at all.

泄气.zh: 如果遇到困难就泄气，那什么事都做不成。
泄气.en: If you get discouraged whenever you encounter difficulties, you won't accomplish anything.

泄气.zh: 这句话很泄气，大家听了都不高兴。
泄气.en: This sentence is very discouraging; everyone who heard it was unhappy.

嘲弄.en: Don't mock him; he's very upset.

嘲弄.zh: 他们用那种语气说话，明显是在嘲弄我。
嘲弄.en: They spoke in that tone, clearly mocking me.

嘲弄.zh: 虽然他只是开玩笑，但那种嘲弄让人很不舒服。
嘲弄.en: Although he was just joking, that kind of mockery makes people very uncomfortable.

嘲弄.zh: 小明的嘲弄让新同学很尴尬。
嘲弄.en: Xiao Ming's ridicule made the new classmate very embarrassed.

倾销.en: That company is suspected of dumping.

倾销.zh: 低价倾销会破坏市场秩序。
倾销.en: Low-price dumping will disrupt market order.

倾销.zh: 政府调查了外国产品的倾销行为。
倾销.en: The government investigated the dumping practices of foreign products.

倾销.zh: 因为倾销太严重，所以国内企业都受到了影响。
倾销.en: Because the dumping was so severe, domestic companies were all affected.

倾销.zh: 他们为了抢占市场，不惜倾销产品。
倾销.en: In order to capture market share, they didn't hesitate to dump their products.

来龙去脉.zh: 请告诉我这件事的来龙去脉。
来龙去脉.en: Please tell me the whole story of this matter.

来龙去脉.zh: 先把事情的来龙去脉搞清楚再说。
来龙去脉.en: First clarify the ins and outs of the matter before speaking.

来龙去脉.zh: 他讲了整件事的来龙去脉，我才明白。
来龙去脉.en: He explained the whole background of the incident, and then I understood.

来龙去脉.zh: 如果你不了解来龙去脉，就别乱下结论。
来龙去脉.en: If you don't understand the full context, don't jump to conclusions.

来龙去脉.zh: 这个案件很复杂，需要仔细分析来龙去脉。
来龙去脉.en: This case is very complex and requires careful analysis of the whole story.

身不由己.zh: 在那种环境下，我真是身不由己。
身不由己.en: In that environment, I really had no choice.

身不由己.zh: 她身不由己地往后退了两步。
身不由己.en: She involuntarily stepped back two paces.

身不由己.zh: 很多事身不由己，只能顺其自然。
身不由己.en: Many things are beyond our control; we just have to let them be.

身不由己.zh: 他身不由己地加入了队伍，因为大家都去了。
身不由己.en: He joined the team involuntarily because everyone else was going.

不平.zh: 地上有块不平的地方，小心别摔倒。
不平.en: There's an uneven spot on the ground, be careful not to fall.

不平.zh: 对于这种不公平的待遇，他感到愤愤不平。
不平.en: He felt indignant about this unfair treatment.

不平.zh: 虽然受了委屈，但他没有表现出任何不平。
不平.en: Even though he was wronged, he showed no resentment.

难说.en: This matter is hard to say.

难说.zh: 明天会不会下雨还很难说。
难说.en: It's still hard to say whether it will rain tomorrow.

难说.zh: 结果怎么样，现在很难说。
难说.en: It's hard to tell what the outcome will be right now.

难说.zh: 他的态度会不会变，真的很难说。
难说.en: It's really hard to say whether his attitude will change.

难说.zh: 虽然看起来很顺利，但未来难说啊。
难说.en: Although it looks smooth now, the future is uncertain.

纪实.zh: 他写的纪实小说非常真实。
纪实.en: The documentary novel he wrote is very realistic.

纪实.zh: 那个节目是纪实风格的，没有剧本。
纪实.en: That show is in a documentary style, without a script.

纪实.zh: 纪实摄影需要抓住最真实的瞬间。
纪实.en: Documentary photography needs to capture the most genuine moments.

纪实.zh: 这本书用纪实的手法描写了战争。
纪实.en: This book describes the war using a documentary approach.

层出不穷.zh: 最近的问题层出不穷，让人头疼。
层出不穷.en: Problems keep popping up recently, which is a headache.

层出不穷.zh: 网络上的骗局层出不穷，要小心。
层出不穷.en: Online scams keep emerging in endless streams, so be careful.

层出不穷.zh: 各种新技术层出不穷，科技发展真快。
层出不穷.en: Various new technologies are emerging one after another; technology is developing so fast.

层出不穷.zh: 娱乐圈的新人层出不穷，竞争很激烈。
层出不穷.en: New faces keep appearing in the entertainment industry, and competition is fierce.

市场经济.zh: 在市场经济里，价格由供需决定。
市场经济.en: In a market economy, prices are determined by supply and demand.

市场经济.zh: 市场经济鼓励竞争和创新。
市场经济.en: The market economy encourages competition and innovation.

市场经济.zh: 很多人认为市场经济最有效率。
市场经济.en: Many people believe the market economy is the most efficient.

市场经济.zh: 从计划经济转向市场经济是个大变革。
市场经济.en: Shifting from a planned economy to a market economy was a major transformation.

独唱.en: She has a solo performance tonight.
He sang a pop song as a solo.

独唱.zh: 这次音乐会安排了三个独唱节目。
独唱.en: This concert has three solo performances scheduled.

独唱.zh: 独唱比合唱更需要自信。
独唱.en: Solo singing requires more confidence than group singing.

独唱.zh: 她从小就喜欢独唱，不爱和别人一起唱。
独唱.en: She has loved singing solos since childhood and doesn't like singing with others.

就座.zh: 他走进教室，找了个空位就座。
就座.en: He walked into the classroom, found an empty seat, and sat down.

就座.zh: 会议马上开始，请各位就座。
就座.en: The meeting is about to start; please take your seats.

就座.zh: 她等所有人都就座后才开始说话。
就座.en: She didn't start speaking until everyone was seated.

就座.zh: 我们到得晚，只能在后排就座。
就座.en: We arrived late, so we could only sit in the back row.

穴位.zh: 按摩太阳穴这个穴位很舒服。
穴位.en: Massaging the acupoint at the temples feels very relaxing.

穴位.zh: 中医有很多穴位对应不同的器官。
穴位.en: Traditional Chinese medicine has many acupoints corresponding to different organs.

穴位.zh: 他学会了找穴位给自己按摩。
穴位.en: He learned how to locate acupoints to massage himself.

穴位.zh: 按对穴位能缓解疲劳，但按错了可能没用。
穴位.en: Pressing the right acupoint can relieve fatigue, but pressing the wrong one might be ineffective.

硬朗.zh: 他八十岁了，走路还这么硬朗。
硬朗.en: He is eighty years old, yet he still walks so firmly.

硬朗.zh: 这棵老树虽然年纪大，但枝干依然硬朗。
硬朗.en: Although this old tree is aged, its branches are still sturdy.

硬朗.zh: 她说话的声音很硬朗，一点都不像生病的样子。
硬朗.en: Her speaking voice is very strong, not at all like someone who is sick.

硬朗.zh: 这座桥虽然建了很多年，但结构还是很硬朗。
硬朗.en: Although this bridge was built many years ago, its structure is still solid.

绕行.zh: 因为修路，我们只好绕行了一条小巷子。
绕行.en: Because of road construction, we had to take a detour through a small alley.

绕行.zh: 你要是想避开堵车，就得从环岛绕行。
绕行.en: If you want to avoid traffic jams, you have to go around the roundabout.

绕行.zh: 司机说前面有事故，建议大家绕行。
绕行.en: The driver said there was an accident ahead and advised everyone to detour.

绕行.zh: 虽然绕行多花了十分钟，但路上风景不错。
绕行.en: Although the detour took an extra ten minutes, the scenery along the way was nice.

开场白.en: His opening remarks were very interesting.

开场白.zh: 演讲的开场白太长了，听众都快睡着了。
开场白.en: The opening remarks of the speech were too long; the audience almost fell asleep.

开场白.zh: 他先说了几句开场白，然后才开始正式介绍。
开场白.en: He said a few opening remarks first, and then began the formal introduction.

开场白.zh: 这个节目的开场白每次都一样，没什么新意。
开场白.en: The opening remarks of this show are the same every time, not very creative.

开场白.zh: 虽然开场白很简短，但一下子抓住了大家的注意力。
开场白.en: Although the opening remarks were very brief, they immediately captured everyone's attention.

交纳.en: Please pay the property management fee on time.

交纳.zh: 他忘了交纳水电费，结果被停了水。
交纳.en: He forgot to pay the water and electricity bills, and as a result, his water was cut off.

交纳.zh: 每年这个时候都要交纳养老保险。
交纳.en: Every year at this time, you have to pay the pension insurance.

交纳.zh: 如果逾期不交纳罚款，会被加收滞纳金。
交纳.en: If you fail to pay the fine on time, a late fee will be added.

交纳.zh: 她通过手机银行交纳了所有账单，方便多了。
交纳.en: She paid all the bills through mobile banking, which was much more convenient.

告状.zh: 弟弟跑去跟妈妈告状了。
告状.en: My little brother ran off to tattle to Mom.

告状.zh: 你别老是去老师那儿告状，自己先想办法。
告状.en: Don't always go tattle to the teacher; try to solve it yourself first.

告状.zh: 因为邻居太吵，他决定去居委会告状。
告状.en: Because the neighbors were too noisy, he decided to complain to the neighborhood committee.

告状.zh: 她因为合同纠纷准备去法院告状。
告状.en: She is preparing to sue in court over a contract dispute.

告状.zh: 如果问题解决不了，我们只能找上司告状了。
告状.en: If the problem can't be resolved, we'll have no choice but to complain to the boss.

过半.en: More than half of the task is done.

过半.zh: 投票结果显示，支持率已经过半。
过半.en: The voting results show that the approval rate has exceeded half.

过半.zh: 路程过半的时候，我们停下来休息了一会儿。
过半.en: When more than half of the journey was done, we stopped to rest for a while.

过半.zh: 虽然准备时间已经过半，但他还有很多内容没复习。
过半.en: Although more than half of the preparation time has passed, he still has a lot of content to review.

立交桥.zh: 这个立交桥的设计很复杂，我经常走错路。
立交桥.en: The design of this overpass is very complicated; I often take the wrong way.

立交桥.zh: 新建的立交桥大大缓解了交通拥堵。
立交桥.en: The newly built overpass has greatly alleviated traffic congestion.

立交桥.zh: 如果你上了立交桥，就要一直开到出口才能下来。
立交桥.en: If you get on the overpass, you have to drive all the way to the exit to get off.

立交桥.zh: 虽然立交桥很方便，但晚上开车上去有点怕迷路。
立交桥.en: Although the overpass is very convenient, driving on it at night is a bit scary for fear of getting lost.

百科全书.zh: 他小时候最爱看百科全书，学到了很多知识。
百科全书.en: When he was a child, he loved reading encyclopedias and learned a lot of knowledge.

百科全书.zh: 现在网上就有百科全书，不用买纸质书了。
百科全书.en: Nowadays there are encyclopedias online, so you don't need to buy paper books.

百科全书.zh: 这套百科全书内容很全面，从天文到地理都有。
百科全书.en: This set of encyclopedias is very comprehensive, covering everything from astronomy to geography.

百科全书.zh: 虽然百科全书知识很丰富，但有些信息可能过时了。
百科全书.en: Although encyclopedias are rich in knowledge, some information might be outdated.

请柬.zh: 请柬上写着婚礼下午六点开始。
请柬.en: The invitation says the wedding starts at six in the evening.

请柬.zh: 他亲手把请柬送到每一位朋友手里。
请柬.en: He personally handed the invitation to every friend.

请柬.zh: 因为是正式晚宴，请柬要求穿正装出席。
请柬.en: Because it's a formal dinner, the invitation requires formal attire.

请柬.zh: 如果请柬弄丢了，可以打电话给主办方确认信息。
请柬.en: If you lose the invitation, you can call the organizer to confirm the information.

说白了.en: To put it bluntly, he just doesn't want to come.

说白了.zh: 这事儿说白了就是钱的问题。
说白了.en: This matter, frankly speaking, is a money problem.

说白了.zh: 你说了这么多，说白了就是嫌我太慢。
说白了.en: You said so much; to put it bluntly, you just think I'm too slow.

说白了.zh: 他那些话听起来很客气，说白了都是在敷衍。
说白了.en: His words sound very polite, but frankly speaking, they are all brush-offs.

说白了.zh: 虽然他说得有道理，但说白了还是有点自私。
说白了.en: Although what he said makes sense, to be blunt, it's still a bit selfish.

吃苦.en: He has endured hardship since childhood.

吃苦.zh: 虽然工作很苦，但他不怕吃苦。
吃苦.en: Although the work is hard, he is not afraid of hardship.
How can you succeed without enduring hardship?

不难.zh: 做蛋糕其实不难，但需要耐心。
不难.en: Making cake is actually not difficult, but needs patience.

不难.zh: 只要你认真学，其实不难。
不难.en: As long as you study seriously, it's actually not difficult.
This matter is not difficult for me.

不难.zh: 学会骑自行车不难，多练几次就行。
不难.en: Learning to ride a bike is not difficult, just practice a few times.

惊天动地.zh: 他做了件惊天动地的事。
虽然不是什么惊天动地的大事，但我觉得很有意义。
惊天动地.en: Although it's not an earth-shattering big thing, I think it's meaningful.

惊天动地.zh: 那场演出真是惊天动地，全场都沸腾了。
惊天动地.en: That performance was truly earth-shattering, the whole audience was boiling.

惊天动地.zh: 别总想着做惊天动地的事，平凡也很好。
惊天动地.en: Don't always think about doing earth-shattering things, ordinary is also good.

通车.en: The subway opens to traffic today.
The new bridge is open to traffic.

通车.zh: 这条路通车以后，去机场方便多了。
通车.en: After this road opens to traffic, going to the airport is much more convenient.

通车.zh: 等了三年，这条高铁终于通车了。
通车.en: After waiting three years, this high-speed rail finally opened.
The opening ceremony was very grand.

珍视.zh: 他非常珍视家人给他的每一个建议。
珍视.en: He really cherishes every suggestion his family gives him.

珍视.zh: 我们应该珍视水资源，不要浪费。
珍视.en: We should cherish water resources, don't waste.

珍视.zh: 虽然礼物不贵，但我很珍视你的心意。
珍视.en: Although the gift is not expensive, I cherish your intention.

鲜美.en: Seafood is really fresh and tasty.

鲜美.zh: 他做的菜味道鲜美，大家都很喜欢。
鲜美.en: The dishes he cooks taste delicious, everyone likes them.

鲜美.zh: 这种蘑菇炖汤特别鲜美，你一定要试试。
鲜美.en: This kind of mushroom stew soup is particularly delicious, you must try it.

鲜美.zh: 虽然是素菜，但口感鲜美，不输肉。
鲜美.en: Although it's a vegetable dish, the taste is delicious, not inferior to meat.

胆小鬼.zh: 他连虫子都怕，真是个胆小鬼。
胆小鬼.en: He is even afraid of bugs, what a coward.

胆小鬼.zh: 胆小鬼才不敢尝试新事物。
胆小鬼.en: Only cowards dare not try new things.

胆小鬼.zh: 虽然有人说他是胆小鬼，但他其实很勇敢。
胆小鬼.en: Although some people say he is a coward, he is actually very brave.

起劲.zh: 虽然很累，但他还是干得特别起劲。
起劲.en: Although very tired, he still worked very energetically.

起劲.zh: 他们讨论得越来越起劲，完全忘了时间。
起劲.en: They discussed more and more energetically, completely forgot the time.

起劲.zh: 孩子看动画片看得可起劲了。
起劲.en: The child is watching cartoons very enthusiastically.

症结.en: Where is the crux of the problem?
This is the crux of the matter.

症结.zh: 他们争吵的症结在于缺乏沟通。
症结.en: The crux of their quarrel is lack of communication.

症结.zh: 只有找到症结，才能解决问题。
症结.en: Only by finding the crux can we solve the problem.

症结.zh: 业绩不好的症结是团队合作不够。
症结.en: The crux of poor performance is insufficient teamwork.

断断续续.zh: 这雨断断续续下了好几天。
断断续续.en: This rain has been falling intermittently for several days.

断断续续.zh: 因为网络断断续续，视频会议很不顺利。
断断续续.en: Because the network is intermittent, the video meeting went poorly.

断断续续.zh: 他断断续续学了三年中文，现在能说一点。
断断续续.en: He studied Chinese intermittently for three years, now can speak a bit.

水槽.zh: 厨房的水槽有点漏水，我明天找人修。
水槽.en: The kitchen sink is leaking a bit, I'll find someone to fix it tomorrow.

水槽.zh: 洗碗的时候别把菜叶子倒进水槽里。
水槽.en: Don't pour vegetable scraps into the sink when washing dishes.

水槽.zh: 因为水槽太脏了，所以我打算用漂白剂洗一下。
水槽.en: Because the sink is too dirty, I plan to clean it with bleach.

水槽.zh: 这个不锈钢水槽用了十年还很新。
水槽.en: This stainless steel sink still looks new after ten years of use.

滞后.zh: 这里的网络一直滞后，视频都打不开。
滞后.en: The internet here is always lagging, videos won't even load.

滞后.zh: 他的技术水平明显滞后于同龄人。
滞后.en: His skill level clearly lags behind his peers.

滞后.zh: 由于政策滞后，很多问题没能及时解决。
滞后.en: Due to policy delays, many problems couldn't be solved in time.

滞后.zh: 经济发展太快，基础设施有些滞后了。
滞后.en: The economy is developing too fast, and infrastructure is somewhat lagging behind.

仿制.zh: 那家工厂专门仿制名牌手表。
仿制.en: That factory specializes in copying brand-name watches.

仿制.zh: 仿制的产品虽然便宜，但质量很差。
仿制.en: Counterfeit products are cheap, but their quality is very poor.

仿制.zh: 因为仿制技术太厉害，正品都卖不出去了。
仿制.en: Because the imitation technology is so good, authentic products can't be sold anymore.

仿制.zh: 他买了一件仿制的古玩，被骗了。
仿制.en: He bought a counterfeit antique and got scammed.

本分.en: A person should be dutiful and honest.

本分.zh: 他做事很本分，从来不占便宜。
本分.en: He does his work dutifully and never takes advantage of others.

本分.zh: 做好自己的本分工作就行了。
本分.en: Just do your own duty well.

本分.zh: 虽然能力一般，但他很本分，老板喜欢他。
本分.en: Although his ability is average, he is very dutiful, so his boss likes him.

本分.zh: 你只要尽到本分，别管别人怎么说。
本分.en: Just fulfill your duty, don't care what others say.

统筹.en: We need overall planning and coordination.

统筹.zh: 这个项目需要统筹考虑资金和人力。
统筹.en: This project requires comprehensive consideration of funds and manpower.

统筹.zh: 统筹全局才能做出正确决定。
统筹.en: Only by coordinating the whole situation can we make the right decision.

统筹.zh: 因为部门太多，必须有人来统筹协调。
统筹.en: Because there are too many departments, someone must come to coordinate.

统筹.zh: 他负责统筹这次活动的所有细节。
统筹.en: He is responsible for coordinating all the details of this event.

文雅.zh: 那个男生虽然长得帅，但一点也不文雅。
文雅.en: That guy is handsome, but not elegant at all.

文雅.zh: 在长辈面前要表现得文雅一点。
文雅.en: You should behave more elegantly in front of elders.

文雅.zh: 他不仅文雅，而且很有才华。
文雅.en: He is not only elegant but also very talented.

文雅.zh: 我喜欢那种文雅又幽默的人。
文雅.en: I like people who are both elegant and humorous.

一干二净.zh: 他把冰箱里的食物吃得一干二净。
一干二净.en: He ate all the food in the fridge cleanly.

一干二净.zh: 小偷把家里偷得一干二净。
一干二净.en: The thief stole everything from the house.

一干二净.zh: 因为太饿了，他把饭菜扫得一干二净。
一干二净.en: Because he was so hungry, he polished off the meal completely.

一干二净.zh: 你最好把这件事忘得一干二净。
一干二净.en: You'd better forget this matter completely.

尼龙.en: This bag is made of nylon.

尼龙.zh: 尼龙袜子穿久了容易起球。
尼龙.en: Nylon socks tend to pill after wearing them for a long time.

尼龙.zh: 登山绳都是用尼龙做的，很结实。
尼龙.en: Climbing ropes are all made of nylon, very sturdy.

尼龙.zh: 虽然尼龙便宜，但不如棉布舒服。
尼龙.en: Although nylon is cheap, it's not as comfortable as cotton.

尼龙.zh: 他买了一件尼龙面料的冲锋衣。
尼龙.en: He bought a nylon fabric waterproof jacket.

笛子.en: He can play the bamboo flute.

笛子.zh: 我小时候学过几年笛子。
笛子.en: I learned to play the flute for a few years when I was a child.

笛子.zh: 公园里有人在吹笛子，很好听。
笛子.en: Someone is playing the bamboo flute in the park, it sounds beautiful.

笛子.zh: 虽然笛子很小，但声音能传很远。
笛子.en: Although the flute is small, its sound can travel far.

笛子.zh: 他买了一根新笛子，准备上台表演。
笛子.en: He bought a new bamboo flute and is preparing to perform on stage.

年限.en: This product has a service life.

年限.zh: 房子的产权年限是七十年。
年限.en: The property rights of the house have a term of 70 years.

年限.zh: 驾照的有效年限是六年。
年限.en: The validity period of a driver's license is six years.

年限.zh: 因为超过保修年限，维修要花钱。
年限.en: Because it's beyond the warranty period, repairs will cost money.

年限.zh: 你买的保险年限越长，保费越贵。
年限.en: The longer the insurance term you buy, the more expensive the premium.

送别.zh: 明天我去机场送别朋友。
送别.en: Tomorrow I'm going to the airport to see off my friend.

送别.zh: 送别的时候，她哭得很伤心。
送别.en: At the farewell, she cried very sadly.

送别.zh: 虽然送别很伤感，但我们还是要笑着离开。
送别.en: Although farewells are sad, we still have to leave with a smile.

送别.zh: 每次送别家人，我都会觉得心里空空的。
送别.en: Every time I see off my family, I feel empty inside.

送别.zh: 他专门从外地赶回来参加同学的送别会。
送别.en: He came back from another city specifically to attend his classmate's farewell party.

华裔.zh: 她是美国华裔，中文说得不错。
华裔.en: She is a Chinese American and speaks Chinese well.

华裔.zh: 很多华裔科学家在海外取得了很大的成就。
华裔.en: Many ethnic Chinese scientists have achieved great success abroad.

华裔.zh: 虽然他是华裔，但对中国文化非常感兴趣。
华裔.en: Although he is of Chinese descent, he is very interested in Chinese culture.

华裔.zh: 那家餐厅的老板是华裔，做的菜很地道。
华裔.en: The owner of that restaurant is ethnic Chinese, and the food is very authentic.

华裔.zh: 这次活动邀请了不少当地华裔社区的代表参加。
华裔.en: This event invited many representatives from the local Chinese community to attend.

趁早.zh: 这件事你最好趁早决定。
趁早.en: You'd better decide on this matter as soon as possible.

趁早.zh: 如果你想去，趁早买票吧。
趁早.en: If you want to go, buy the tickets early.

趁早.zh: 他劝我趁早放弃这个不切实际的想法。
趁早.en: He advised me to give up this unrealistic idea while there's still time.

趁早.zh: 趁早把作业做完，晚上就能出去玩了。
趁早.en: Finish your homework early, then you can go out and play in the evening.

劲头.zh: 最近学习劲头很大，每天都学到很晚。
劲头.en: Recently, my study enthusiasm is high, and I study until late every day.

劲头.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但大家锻炼的劲头一点没减。
劲头.en: Although it's very cold, everyone's enthusiasm for exercise hasn't diminished at all.

劲头.zh: 刚开始工作的时候，他劲头特别足。
劲头.en: When he first started working, he was full of drive.

劲头.zh: 如果一直保持这个劲头，肯定能成功。
劲头.en: If you keep up this momentum, you will definitely succeed.

寒暄.zh: 我们见面后先寒暄了几句。
寒暄.en: We exchanged a few pleasantries after meeting.

寒暄.zh: 他不喜欢跟人寒暄，觉得浪费时间。
寒暄.en: He doesn't like making small talk, thinking it's a waste of time.

寒暄.zh: 一进门，大家就开始互相寒暄。
寒暄.en: As soon as they entered, everyone started exchanging greetings.

寒暄.zh: 简单的寒暄之后，我们直接进入了正题。
寒暄.en: After a brief exchange of pleasantries, we got straight to the point.

寒暄.zh: 在正式开会之前，大家寒暄了大概十分钟。
寒暄.en: Before the formal meeting started, everyone chatted for about ten minutes.

时隔.zh: 时隔多年，我们又见面了。
时隔.en: After many years, we met again.

时隔.zh: 时隔三个月，他终于康复出院了。
时隔.en: After a lapse of three months, he finally recovered and left the hospital.

时隔.zh: 时隔两年再回到母校，感觉变化很大。
时隔.en: Returning to my alma mater after two years, I felt a lot had changed.

时隔.zh: 虽然时隔很久，但我仍然记得那天的情景。
时隔.en: Although it's been a long time, I still remember the scene that day.

时隔.zh: 时隔一周，他再次发邮件询问项目进展。
时隔.en: After a week, he emailed again to ask about the project's progress.

继母.en: His stepmother is very kind to him.

继母.zh: 很多人对继母有偏见，但其实她非常善良。
继母.en: Many people have prejudice against stepmothers, but actually she is very kind.

继母.zh: 虽然她是继母，但对待孩子就像亲生的一样。
继母.en: Although she is a stepmother, she treats the children as if they were her own.

继母.zh: 他从小和继母一起生活，感情很深。
继母.en: He has lived with his stepmother since childhood, and they have a deep bond.

继母.zh: 继母总是默默付出，从来不计较什么。
继母.en: The stepmother always gives silently and never complains about anything.

威望.en: He has high prestige in the village.

威望.zh: 这位老教授在学术界威望很高。
威望.en: This old professor has great prestige in the academic world.

威望.zh: 作为领导，他在员工中树立了很高的威望。
威望.en: As a leader, he has established high prestige among the employees.

威望.zh: 他虽然年轻，但凭借能力赢得了大家的威望。
威望.en: Although he is young, he has earned everyone's respect through his ability.

威望.zh: 在那个社区，他的威望甚至超过了当地官员。
威望.en: In that community, his prestige even surpassed that of local officials.

伯父.zh: 伯父每年春节都会给我们发红包。
伯父.en: My uncle gives us red envelopes every Spring Festival.

伯父.zh: 昨天我陪伯父去医院做了检查。
伯父.en: Yesterday I accompanied my uncle to the hospital for a checkup.

伯父.zh: 伯父虽然年纪大了，但身体一直很硬朗。
伯父.en: Although my uncle is old, he has always been in good health.

伯父.zh: 我的伯父是个退休教师，特别喜欢下棋。
伯父.en: My uncle is a retired teacher who especially likes playing chess.

意料之外.zh: 这个结果出乎意料之外。
他的突然来访完全在我意料之外。
意料之外.en: His sudden visit was completely unexpected.

意料之外.zh: 这次考试能及格，真是意料之外的事。
意料之外.en: Passing this exam was really unexpected.

意料之外.zh: 虽然在意料之外，但大家都接受了这个事实。
意料之外.en: Although it was unexpected, everyone accepted the fact.

意料之外.zh: 她的成功并非意料之外，而是长期努力的结果。
意料之外.en: Her success was not unexpected; it was the result of long-term effort.

超车.zh: 前面那辆车开得太慢，我们超车吧。
超车.en: That car ahead is driving too slowly, let's overtake it.

超车.zh: 高速上超车一定要打转向灯。
超车.en: You must use your turn signal when overtaking on the highway.

超车.zh: 虽然赶时间，但雨天最好不要超车。
超车.en: Even if you're in a hurry, it's best not to overtake in the rain.

超车.zh: 他刚拿到驾照，还不太敢超车。
超车.en: He just got his driver's license and is still a bit afraid to overtake.

超车.zh: 那个司机为了超车差点撞到旁边的车，太危险了。
超车.en: That driver almost hit the car next to him while overtaking—it was really dangerous.

抹杀.zh: 不能因为他犯了一个错就抹杀他所有的功劳。
抹杀.en: You can't erase all his contributions just because he made one mistake.

抹杀.zh: 历史事实是抹杀不了的。
虽然他有缺点，但你不能完全抹杀他的努力。
抹杀.en: Even though he has shortcomings, you can't completely negate his efforts.

抹杀.zh: 这种偏见会抹杀很多人的机会。
抹杀.en: This kind of prejudice can destroy many people's opportunities.

抹杀.zh: 如果我们只关注缺点，就会抹杀掉他的优点。
抹杀.en: If we only focus on the flaws, we will obliterate his strengths.

盆地.zh: 四川盆地是中国四大盆地之一。
盆地.en: The Sichuan Basin is one of China's four major basins.

盆地.zh: 这个盆地四面环山，气候很湿润。
盆地.en: This basin is surrounded by mountains on all sides, and the climate is very humid.

盆地.zh: 盆地里的城市夏天特别热。
盆地.en: Cities in basins get especially hot in the summer.

盆地.zh: 我们开车翻过那座山，就看到一个很大的盆地。
盆地.en: We drove over that mountain and saw a huge basin.

盆地.zh: 因为盆地地形，这里的雾霾不容易散去。
盆地.en: Because of the basin topography, the smog here doesn't disperse easily.

无可厚非.zh: 他选择辞职去创业，这也无可厚非。
无可厚非.en: He chose to quit his job to start a business—that's understandable.

无可厚非.zh: 年轻人喜欢追潮流，无可厚非。
无可厚非.en: It's no big deal that young people like to follow trends.

无可厚非.zh: 虽然他的做法不太完美，但动机是好的，无可厚非。
无可厚非.en: Although his approach wasn't perfect, his intentions were good, so it's hard to blame him.

无可厚非.zh: 她想多花时间陪家人，这个想法无可厚非。
无可厚非.en: She wants to spend more time with her family—there's nothing wrong with that.

无可厚非.zh: 每个人都有不同的生活方式，只要不伤害别人，就无可厚非。
无可厚非.en: Everyone has a different lifestyle—as long as it doesn't hurt others, it's acceptable.

基本功.zh: 学跳舞要先练好基本功。
基本功.en: To learn dancing, you must first practice the basic skills.

基本功.zh: 他的基本功很扎实，所以弹钢琴特别好听。
基本功.en: His basic skills are very solid, so he plays the piano beautifully.

基本功.zh: 没有扎实的基本功，做复杂的动作很容易受伤。
基本功.en: Without solid basic skills, it's easy to get injured doing complex moves.

基本功.zh: 老师一直强调基本功的重要性。
基本功.en: The teacher always emphasizes the importance of basic skills.

基本功.zh: 不管是武术还是书法，都得先花时间练基本功。
基本功.en: Whether it's martial arts or calligraphy, you have to spend time practicing the fundamentals first.

算盘.zh: 他打着自己的小算盘，想占便宜。
算盘.en: He's playing his own little game, trying to get an advantage.

算盘.zh: 老会计还在用算盘记账。
算盘.en: The old accountant still uses an abacus to keep the books.

算盘.zh: 你心里那点算盘我早就看穿了。
算盘.en: I saw through your little scheme long ago.

算盘.zh: 算盘打得太精反而容易吃亏。
算盘.en: If you're too calculating, you might end up losing out.

算盘.zh: 他一边打算盘一边写数字，动作非常熟练。
算盘.en: He was clicking the abacus while writing numbers, his movements very smooth.

适量.zh: 喝酒要适量，不然伤身体。
适量.en: Drink alcohol in moderation, otherwise it harms your health.

适量.zh: 做菜的时候放盐适量就好，别太多。
适量.en: Add a moderate amount of salt when cooking, not too much.

适量.zh: 医生建议每天适量运动。
适量.en: The doctor recommends moderate exercise every day.

适量.zh: 护肤品用适量就够了，涂太多反而不好。
适量.en: Use skincare products in the right amount—applying too much is actually bad.

适量.zh: 虽然喜欢吃辣的，但也要注意适量，不然胃受不了。
适量.en: Even if you love spicy food, you still need to be moderate, or your stomach can't handle it.

刺骨.zh: 冬天的寒风刺骨，出门要穿厚一点。
刺骨.en: The winter wind is biting cold; wear thicker clothes when going out.

刺骨.zh: 河水冰凉刺骨，他不敢下水。
刺骨.en: The river water was piercingly cold; he didn't dare go in.

刺骨.zh: 虽然温度只有零下十度，但加上风感觉格外刺骨。
刺骨.en: Even though it's only minus ten degrees, with the wind it feels especially biting.

刺骨.zh: 她泡在刺骨的冷水里，浑身发抖。
刺骨.en: She soaked in the bone-chilling cold water, shivering all over.

刺骨.zh: 北方的冬天不止冷，风还特别刺骨。
刺骨.en: Winter in the north is not just cold—the wind is also very piercing.

麻辣.zh: 这碗麻辣烫又麻又辣，吃得过瘾。
麻辣.en: This bowl of spicy hot pot is both numbing and spicy—so satisfying.

麻辣.zh: 我不太能吃麻辣，每次吃完都流鼻涕。
麻辣.en: I can't handle very spicy and numbing food—my nose runs every time.

麻辣.zh: 四川的麻辣火锅很有名，你一定要试试。
麻辣.en: Sichuan's spicy and numbing hot pot is very famous; you must try it.

麻辣.zh: 这家店卖麻辣小龙虾，生意特别好。
麻辣.en: This shop sells spicy and numbing crawfish, and business is booming.

麻辣.zh: 他喜欢那种又麻又辣的感觉，所以总是点最麻辣的菜。
麻辣.en: He loves that numbing and spicy feeling, so he always orders the spiciest dishes.

叮嘱.zh: 妈妈反复叮嘱我要带伞。
叮嘱.en: Mom repeatedly reminded me to bring an umbrella.

叮嘱.zh: 医生叮嘱他少喝酒多休息。
叮嘱.en: The doctor urged him to drink less and rest more.

叮嘱.zh: 临走前，爸爸叮嘱我路上小心。
叮嘱.en: Before I left, my dad cautioned me to be careful on the road.

叮嘱.zh: 她叮嘱孩子做完作业才能看电视。
叮嘱.en: She told the child firmly that he can only watch TV after finishing homework.

叮嘱.zh: 老师叮嘱大家考试前一定要把准考证带好。
叮嘱.en: The teacher reminded everyone to bring their admission ticket before the exam.

馋.en: I get hungry just looking at hotpot.

馋.zh: 你做的蛋糕太香了，把我都看馋了。
馋.en: The cake you made smells so good, you've made me crave it.

馋.zh: 他特别馋那个新开的烤肉店，一直想去吃。
馋.en: He's really craving that newly opened barbecue place and keeps wanting to go.

馋.zh: 别在我面前吃零食了，我正减肥呢，越看越馋。
馋.en: Stop eating snacks in front of me—I'm on a diet, and the more I see, the more I crave them.

馋.zh: 虽然我不饿，但闻到烤红薯的味道还是馋得不行。
馋.en: Even though I'm not hungry, the smell of roasted sweet potatoes still makes me irresistibly crave them.

再接再厉.zh: 这次考得不错，再接再厉。
再接再厉.en: You did well on this exam; keep up the good work.

再接再厉.zh: 项目第一阶段完成了，大家再接再厉。
再接再厉.en: The first phase of the project is done; let's continue to make further efforts.

再接再厉.zh: 虽然赢了比赛，教练还是让我们再接再厉。
再接再厉.en: Even though we won the game, the coach still told us to keep pushing forward.

再接再厉.zh: 你的进步很明显，不过还得再接再厉才能赶上别人。
再接再厉.en: Your improvement is obvious, but you still need to keep striving to catch up with others.

再接再厉.zh: 这次演讲反响不错，希望你能再接再厉，下次讲得更好。
再接再厉.en: The speech this time got good feedback; I hope you can keep it up and do even better next time.

全长.en: This tunnel has a total length of eight kilometers.

全长.zh: 马拉松全长大约四十二公里。
全长.en: A marathon is about forty-two kilometers in total length.

全长.zh: 这座桥全长两千三百米，是附近最长的桥。
全长.en: This bridge has a total length of 2,300 meters and is the longest bridge nearby.

全长.zh: 那条铁路全长五百多公里，穿过好几个城市。
全长.en: That railway is over five hundred kilometers in total length, passing through several cities.

全长.zh: 这段河的全长虽然不算长，但风景特别美。
全长.en: Although the total length of this river section isn't very long, the scenery is especially beautiful.

遮挡.en: Use curtains to block the sunlight.
The big tree is blocking the view of the house.

遮挡.zh: 他用手遮挡了一下刺眼的灯光。
遮挡.en: He used his hand to shield his eyes from the glaring light for a moment.

遮挡.zh: 前排的人太高了，把我的视线完全遮挡了。
遮挡.en: The people in the front row are too tall, completely blocking my view.

遮挡.zh: 防晒霜不能完全遮挡紫外线，还得打伞。
遮挡.en: Sunscreen can't completely block UV rays; you still need to use an umbrella.

刁难.en: He always likes to make things difficult for newcomers.

刁难.zh: 面试官故意刁难我，问了好多奇怪的问题。
刁难.en: The interviewer deliberately tried to trip me up by asking a lot of weird questions.

刁难.zh: 别因为一点小错就刁难员工，这样不好。
刁难.en: Don't pick on employees over small mistakes; that's not good.

刁难.zh: 客户一直在刁难我们，说这个方案不行那个也不好。
刁难.en: The client has been giving us a hard time, saying this plan won't work and that one isn't good either.

刁难.zh: 他以为我会被这些问题刁难住，结果我都答上来了。
刁难.en: He thought I would be stumped by these tricky questions, but I answered them all.

领事馆.en: I need to go to the consulate to apply for a visa.

领事馆.zh: 领事馆的工作人员态度很好。
领事馆.en: The staff at the consulate have a very good attitude.

领事馆.zh: 护照丢了，得赶紧去领事馆补办。
领事馆.en: I lost my passport, so I need to go to the consulate to get a replacement quickly.

领事馆.zh: 那个国家的领事馆就在市中心，走路就能到。
领事馆.en: That country's consulate is right in the city center; you can walk there.

领事馆.zh: 如果你在国外遇到麻烦，可以联系当地的中国领事馆。
领事馆.en: If you run into trouble abroad, you can contact the local Chinese consulate.

外籍.zh: 我们公司有几个外籍员工。
外籍.en: Our company has a few foreign employees.

外籍.zh: 这所学校招收外籍学生。
他虽然是外籍，但中文说得非常好。
外籍.en: Even though he is a foreign national, he speaks Chinese very well.

外籍.zh: 招聘启事上写着欢迎外籍人士应聘。
外籍.en: The job posting says foreign nationals are welcome to apply.

外籍.zh: 很多外籍教师在中国教英语，生活得很开心。
外籍.en: Many foreign teachers teach English in China and live very happily.

航天员.en: He wants to be an astronaut when he grows up.

航天员.zh: 中国航天员在太空站工作了六个月。
航天员.en: Chinese astronauts worked on the space station for six months.

航天员.zh: 航天员出舱的时候，大家都特别紧张。
航天员.en: When the astronauts did a spacewalk, everyone was very nervous.

航天员.zh: 这次任务有三名航天员，其中一位是女性。
航天员.en: This mission has three astronauts, one of whom is female.

航天员.zh: 航天员在太空中要面对很多挑战，比如失重和辐射。
航天员.en: Astronauts face many challenges in space, such as weightlessness and radiation.

不以为然.zh: 他对这个建议不以为然。
大家都觉得很好，只有她一个人不以为然。
不以为然.en: Everyone thought it was great, but she alone didn't think so.

不以为然.zh: 听了他的解释，我还是不以为然。
不以为然.en: After hearing his explanation, I still wasn't convinced.

不以为然.zh: 老板对那个方案不以为然，觉得太冒险了。
不以为然.en: The boss didn't think much of that plan, considering it too risky.

不以为然.zh: 别人夸他聪明，他却总是不以为然，觉得自己还差得远。
不以为然.en: When others praised him for being smart, he always disagreed, feeling he still had a long way to go.

翻番.zh: 如果销量能翻番，我们就发奖金。
翻番.en: If sales can double, we'll give out bonuses.

猖狂.zh: 最近小偷特别猖狂，大家要小心。
猖狂.en: Thieves have been especially rampant recently, everyone should be careful.

猖狂.zh: 虽然他很猖狂，但早晚会吃亏。
猖狂.en: Although he is arrogant, he will suffer sooner or later.

猖狂.zh: 那个人说话很猖狂，没人喜欢他。
猖狂.en: That person speaks arrogantly, nobody likes him.

猖狂.zh: 如果你继续这么猖狂，迟早会惹麻烦。
猖狂.en: If you continue to be this arrogant, you will get into trouble sooner or later.

哆嗦.en: She is shivering from the cold.

哆嗦.zh: 听到这个消息，他吓得直哆嗦。
哆嗦.en: Hearing the news, he trembled with fear.

哆嗦.zh: 因为太紧张，他的腿一直哆嗦。
哆嗦.en: Because he was too nervous, his legs kept trembling.

哆嗦.zh: 风太大了，我全身都在哆嗦。
哆嗦.en: The wind is too strong, my whole body is shivering.

哆嗦.zh: 他说话时声音哆嗦，好像很害怕。
哆嗦.en: His voice trembled when he spoke, as if he was very scared.

振兴.en: We need to revitalize the rural economy.

振兴.zh: 政府出台了很多政策来振兴传统文化。
振兴.en: The government has introduced many policies to revitalize traditional culture.

振兴.zh: 通过科技创新，我们才能振兴工业。
振兴.en: Only through technological innovation can we revitalize industry.

振兴.zh: 大家一起努力，振兴我们的家乡。
振兴.en: Let's work together to revitalize our hometown.

振兴.zh: 这个计划是为了振兴当地的旅游业。
振兴.en: This plan is to revitalize the local tourism industry.

奋勇.zh: 在困难面前，我们要奋勇拼搏。
奋勇.en: In the face of difficulties, we must strive courageously.

奋勇.zh: 虽然敌人强大，但战士们依然奋勇作战。
奋勇.en: Although the enemy was strong, the soldiers still fought valiantly.

奋勇.zh: 她奋勇救出了落水的小孩。
奋勇.en: She bravely rescued the child who fell into the water.

奋勇.zh: 我们应该学习他们奋勇争先的精神。
奋勇.en: We should learn from their spirit of striving to be first.

壮丽.zh: 日出时的景色非常壮丽，令人难忘。
壮丽.en: The sunrise scenery is magnificent and unforgettable.

壮丽.zh: 虽然山峰险峻，但山顶的景色壮丽无比。
壮丽.en: Although the mountain peaks are steep, the view from the top is incomparably magnificent.

壮丽.zh: 这部电影展现了祖国的大好河山，十分壮丽。
壮丽.en: This film showcases the beautiful rivers and mountains of our country, very magnificent.

壮丽.zh: 站在长城上，能看到壮丽的风景。
壮丽.en: Standing on the Great Wall, you can see magnificent scenery.

沸沸扬扬.en: This matter has caused an uproar.

沸沸扬扬.zh: 关于他的传闻，整个公司都沸沸扬扬的。
沸沸扬扬.en: Rumors about him have the whole company buzzing.

沸沸扬扬.zh: 因为那个谣言，网上已经沸沸扬扬了。
沸沸扬扬.en: Because of that rumor, it's already a big noise online.

沸沸扬扬.zh: 考试作弊的事在学校里传得沸沸扬扬。
沸沸扬扬.en: The cheating incident has been widely discussed in the school.

沸沸扬扬.zh: 他们离婚的消息在朋友圈里沸沸扬扬。
沸沸扬扬.en: The news of their divorce has been all over social media.

贫富.en: The gap between rich and poor is huge.

贫富.zh: 这个城市贫富分化越来越严重。
贫富.en: The divide between rich and poor in this city is getting worse.

贫富.zh: 虽然贫富不同，但人人平等。
贫富.en: Although people differ in wealth, everyone is equal.

贫富.zh: 教育可以缩小贫富差距。
贫富.en: Education can narrow the gap between rich and poor.

贫富.zh: 我们要关注贫富之间的不平衡问题。
贫富.en: We need to pay attention to the imbalance between rich and poor.

疲惫不堪.en: He is utterly exhausted from tiredness.

疲惫不堪.zh: 工作了一整天，我感觉疲惫不堪。
疲惫不堪.en: After working all day, I feel completely exhausted.

疲惫不堪.zh: 因为连续加班，他早已疲惫不堪了。
疲惫不堪.en: Because of continuous overtime, he was already exhausted.

疲惫不堪.zh: 长途旅行后，大家都疲惫不堪。
疲惫不堪.en: After the long journey, everyone was exhausted.

疲惫不堪.zh: 她虽然疲惫不堪，但还是坚持完成了任务。
疲惫不堪.en: Although she was exhausted, she still persevered and completed the task.

诉苦.en: He always likes to complain about his hardships.

诉苦.zh: 别老是跟我诉苦，我也没办法。
诉苦.en: Stop complaining to me all the time, I can't do anything either.

诉苦.zh: 虽然生活很难，但我不喜欢向别人诉苦。
诉苦.en: Although life is hard, I don't like to complain to others.

诉苦.zh: 她每次打电话都跟妈妈诉苦。
诉苦.en: Every time she calls, she complains to her mom.

诉苦.zh: 与其在这里诉苦，不如想解决办法。
诉苦.en: Instead of complaining here, it's better to think of a solution.

土生土长.zh: 我是土生土长的北京人。
他土生土长在农村，对这里很熟悉。
土生土长.en: He was born and raised in the countryside, very familiar with this place.

土生土长.zh: 虽然去了大城市，但他还是土生土长的性格。
土生土长.en: Although he went to the big city, he still has the character of a native-born person.

土生土长.zh: 这些水果都是土生土长的，没有农药。
土生土长.en: These fruits are all locally grown, no pesticides.

土生土长.zh: 她不是土生土长的，所以不太了解当地文化。
土生土长.en: She is not a native, so she doesn't know much about the local culture.

生疏.zh: 好久没弹钢琴，手法有点生疏。
生疏.en: I haven't played piano for a long time, so my technique is a bit rusty.

生疏.zh: 虽然我们以前是好朋友，但现在见面都觉得生疏。
生疏.en: Although we used to be good friends, now meeting feels awkward and distant.

生疏.zh: 这个单词我学过，但因为不常用，已经生疏了。
生疏.en: I learned this word before, but since I don't use it often, it's become unfamiliar.

生疏.zh: 刚到一个新地方，对这里的环境还很生疏。
生疏.en: Having just arrived at a new place, I'm still unfamiliar with the environment here.

敦促.en: He urged me to hurry up.

敦促.zh: 老师敦促我们按时交作业。
敦促.en: The teacher urged us to hand in homework on time.

敦促.zh: 老板敦促员工加快进度，别耽误项目。
敦促.en: The boss urged the staff to speed up and not delay the project.

敦促.zh: 由于工期紧张，经理多次敦促大家加班。
敦促.en: Due to the tight schedule, the manager urged everyone to work overtime many times.

敦促.zh: 政府敦促市民接种疫苗，保护健康。
敦促.en: The government urged citizens to get vaccinated to protect their health.

迸发.zh: 听到这个消息，他迸发出热烈的掌声。
迸发.en: Hearing this news, he burst into warm applause.

迸发.zh: 看到胜利的那一刻，全场迸发出欢呼声。
迸发.en: At the moment of victory, the whole venue erupted in cheers.

迸发.zh: 他的创作灵感不断迸发，写出了很多好歌。
迸发.en: His creative inspiration kept bursting forth, and he wrote many good songs.

迸发.zh: 压力太大时，情绪容易瞬间迸发出来。
迸发.en: When stress is too high, emotions can easily burst out instantly.

孝敬.en: He is very filial to his parents.

孝敬.zh: 子女应该孝敬长辈，这是传统美德。
孝敬.en: Children should respect their elders; this is a traditional virtue.

孝敬.zh: 他用自己的工资给父母买了房子，真是很孝敬。
孝敬.en: He used his salary to buy a house for his parents; that's truly filial.

孝敬.zh: 孝敬老人不光是给钱，更重要的是陪伴。
孝敬.en: Being filial to the elderly is not just about giving money; more importantly, it's about companionship.

孝敬.zh: 每逢过年，他都会孝敬爷爷奶奶一些礼物。
孝敬.en: Every Chinese New Year, he shows filial piety by giving gifts to his grandparents.

素养.en: His cultural accomplishment is very high.

素养.zh: 老师注意培养学生的综合素养。
素养.en: Teachers focus on cultivating students' comprehensive qualities.

素养.zh: 一个人的素养体现在日常行为中。
素养.en: A person's quality is reflected in their daily behavior.

素养.zh: 他不仅专业能力强，而且人文素养也很好。
素养.en: He not only has strong professional skills but also has good humanistic qualities.

素养.zh: 提高公民的法治素养是社会进步的关键。
素养.en: Improving citizens' legal literacy is key to social progress.

每逢.en: On festive occasions, one misses one's family more.

每逢.zh: 每逢周末，他都会去爬山。
每逢下雨，这条路就变得很滑。
每逢.en: Every time it rains, this road becomes very slippery.

每逢.zh: 她每逢生日就会收到很多礼物。
每逢.en: Every year on her birthday, she receives many gifts.

每逢.zh: 每逢考试前，他都会复习到很晚。
每逢.en: Before every exam, he reviews until very late.

出任.en: He assumed the role of general manager of the company.

出任.zh: 她去年出任了学校校长。
出任.en: She became the school principal last year.

出任.zh: 经过选举，他出任了新的职务。
出任.en: After the election, he took up a new post.

出任.zh: 他愿意出任这个项目的负责人。
出任.en: He is willing to take on the role of project leader.

出任.zh: 出任这个职位需要很多经验。
出任.en: Taking on this position requires a lot of experience.

出道.en: She made her debut at eighteen.

出道.zh: 这个歌手出道十年了，依然很红。
出道.en: This singer has been in the industry for ten years and is still very popular.

出道.zh: 他出道时唱了一首情歌，立刻走红。
出道.en: When he debuted, he sang a love song and became famous instantly.

出道.zh: 很多偶像练习生出道后很受欢迎。
出道.en: Many idol trainees become very popular after debuting.

出道.zh: 她出道比较晚，但实力很强。
出道.en: She debuted relatively late, but she is very talented.

鸟巢.en: The Bird's Nest is a landmark in Beijing.

鸟巢.zh: 小鸟在树上搭了一个鸟巢。
鸟巢.en: A little bird built a nest in the tree.

鸟巢.zh: 我们去鸟巢看了奥运会开幕式。
鸟巢.en: We went to the Bird's Nest to watch the Olympic opening ceremony.

鸟巢.zh: 那个鸟巢里还有几只小鸟。
鸟巢.en: There are still a few baby birds in that nest.

鸟巢.zh: 鸟巢的设计非常独特，吸引了很多游客。
鸟巢.en: The design of the Bird's Nest is very unique, attracting many tourists.

接二连三.en: Bad things happened one after another.

接二连三.zh: 他接二连三地收到了好消息。
接二连三.en: He received good news one after another.

接二连三.zh: 考试接二连三地来，让人喘不过气。
接二连三.en: Exams come one after another, making it hard to breathe.

接二连三.zh: 公司接二连三地推出新产品，销量很好。
接二连三.en: The company launched new products in succession, and sales were good.

接二连三.zh: 她接二连三地打了好几个喷嚏。
接二连三.en: She sneezed several times in a row.

独身.zh: 虽然年纪不小了，但他还是选择独身生活。
独身.en: Although not young, he still chooses to live single.

独身.zh: 独身的人也可以过得很精彩。
独身.en: Single people can also live a wonderful life.

独身.zh: 因为我喜欢自由，所以一直保持独身。
独身.en: Because I like freedom, I have remained single.

独身.zh: 她不是不想结婚，只是暂时享受独身。
独身.en: It's not that she doesn't want to marry, she just enjoys being single for now.

共性.zh: 虽然性格不同，但这两姐妹有不少共性。
共性.en: Although personalities differ, the two sisters have many common traits.

共性.zh: 由于文化背景相似，这两个国家的风俗有很多共性。
共性.en: Due to similar cultural backgrounds, the customs of these two countries have many commonalities.

共性.zh: 人类和动物之间其实存在很多共性。
共性.en: There are actually many commonalities between humans and animals.

共性.zh: 找共性有助于我们理解彼此。
共性.en: Finding commonalities helps us understand each other.

一概.zh: 对于不符合条件的申请，我们一概不予考虑。
一概.en: For applications that do not meet the conditions, we will not consider them at all.

一概.zh: 不管是谁，违反规定一概受罚。
一概.en: No matter who, violating the rules will be punished uniformly.

一概.zh: 他对于流言蜚语一概不理。
这些意见我们一概接受不了。
一概.en: We cannot accept any of these opinions.

亲和力.zh: 作为一名老师，亲和力比严厉更重要。
亲和力.en: As a teacher, approachability is more important than strictness.

亲和力.zh: 因为她有很强的亲和力，所以大家都喜欢和她聊天。
亲和力.en: Because she has strong approachability, everyone likes to chat with her.

亲和力.zh: 亲和力强的人更容易交到朋友。
亲和力.en: People with strong affinity make friends more easily.

亲和力.zh: 领导如果没有亲和力，下属会感到压力。
亲和力.en: If a leader lacks approachability, subordinates will feel stressed.

供奉.zh: 这个寺庙里供奉着一尊古老的佛像。
供奉.en: An ancient Buddha statue is enshrined in this temple.

供奉.zh: 以前人们供奉龙王祈求雨水，但现在很少见了。
供奉.en: In the past, people worshipped the Dragon King for rain, but now it's rare.

供奉.zh: 逢年过节，他们都会去庙里供奉香火。
供奉.en: During festivals, they go to the temple to offer incense.

供奉.zh: 据说这座山供奉着山神，村民每年都来祭拜。
供奉.en: It is said that this mountain enshrines a mountain god, and villagers come to worship every year.

尾气.zh: 城市里的尾气污染越来越严重了。
尾气.en: Exhaust pollution in cities is getting worse.

尾气.zh: 如果你开车，尾气会对环境造成影响。
尾气.en: If you drive, exhaust will have an impact on the environment.

尾气.zh: 尾气检测不合格的车不能上路。
尾气.en: Cars that fail exhaust inspection cannot be driven.

尾气.zh: 电动车的尾气排放为零。
尾气.en: Electric vehicles have zero exhaust emissions.

状元.en: He got the top score in the college entrance exam.

状元.zh: 每个家长都希望自己的孩子能成为状元。
状元.en: Every parent hopes their child can become the top scholar.

状元.zh: 虽然他是高考状元，但大学里依然很努力。
状元.en: Although he was the top scorer, he still works hard in college.

状元.zh: 今年的理科状元来自一所普通中学。
状元.en: This year's top science student comes from an ordinary high school.

状元.zh: 在古代，考上状元是光宗耀祖的事。
状元.en: In ancient times, becoming the top scholar was a glory to the family.

节俭.zh: 虽然家里有钱，但她依然保持节俭的习惯。
节俭.en: Although her family is rich, she still maintains thrifty habits.

节俭.zh: 因为从小父母教育要节俭，所以他不乱花钱。
节俭.en: Because his parents taught him to be thrifty since childhood, he doesn't waste money.

节俭.zh: 节俭是一种美德，但不能过于吝啬。
节俭.en: Thrift is a virtue, but you can't be too stingy.

节俭.zh: 这家餐厅的菜量很足，很节俭的人也不会觉得浪费。
节俭.en: The portions at this restaurant are generous, so even thrifty people won't feel wasteful.

悦耳.zh: 清晨的鸟叫声非常悦耳，让人心情舒畅。
悦耳.en: The chirping of birds in the early morning is very melodious, making people feel relaxed.

悦耳.zh: 虽然歌词简单，但旋律很悦耳。
悦耳.en: Although the lyrics are simple, the melody is pleasant.

悦耳.zh: 他说话的声音低沉悦耳，很有磁性。
悦耳.en: His voice is deep and pleasant, very magnetic.

悦耳.zh: 这首钢琴曲听起来十分悦耳。
悦耳.en: This piano piece sounds very melodious.

激化.zh: 如果不及时处理，双方的矛盾会越来越激化。
激化.en: If not handled in time, the conflict between the two sides will become increasingly intense.

激化.zh: 由于沟通不畅，他们的分歧被激化了。
激化.en: Due to poor communication, their differences were intensified.

激化.zh: 这个政策可能会激化社会矛盾。
激化.en: This policy may intensify social conflicts.

激化.zh: 他的愤怒情绪不断激化，最后爆发了。
激化.en: His anger kept intensifying, and finally erupted.

内行.zh: 他修车很内行，一看就知道问题在哪。
内行.en: He is very knowledgeable about car repair and can spot the problem at a glance.

内行.zh: 这事儿你得问内行，别自己瞎折腾。
内行.en: You should ask an expert about this, don't mess around on your own.

内行.zh: 虽然学了很久，但他在摄影方面还算不上内行。
内行.en: Although he has studied for a long time, he is still not an expert in photography.

内行.zh: 她做饭特别内行，连刀工都像专业厨师一样。
内行.en: She is very skilled at cooking, even her knife skills are like a professional chef's.

内行.zh: 因为他是内行，所以大家遇到技术问题都来找他帮忙。
内行.en: Because he is an expert, everyone comes to him for help with technical problems.

屡次.zh: 他屡次迟到，老板很不高兴。
屡次.en: He has been late repeatedly, and the boss is very unhappy.

屡次.zh: 我屡次提醒他注意安全，他还是出了事故。
屡次.en: I repeatedly reminded him to pay attention to safety, but he still had an accident.

屡次.zh: 这家公司屡次获奖，产品质量确实过硬。
屡次.en: This company has won awards repeatedly, and the product quality is indeed excellent.

屡次.zh: 屡次失败之后，他终于找到了正确的方法。
屡次.en: After repeated failures, he finally found the right method.

屡次.zh: 虽然屡次被拒绝，但他还是没有放弃申请。
屡次.en: Although he has been rejected repeatedly, he still hasn't given up applying.

声势.zh: 这场游行声势很大，吸引了很多路人。
声势.en: This parade is very grand and attracts many passersby.

声势.zh: 他说话总爱造声势，其实没什么真本事。
声势.en: He always likes to make a big show when speaking, but actually has no real ability.

声势.zh: 公司为了新产品上市，提前做了声势浩大的宣传。
声势.en: The company did a massive publicity campaign in advance for the new product launch.

声势.zh: 别看他们声势这么猛，最后不一定能赢。
声势.en: Don't be fooled by their strong momentum, they may not necessarily win in the end.

声势.zh: 对方球队声势不小，我们得拿出最好的状态应对。
声势.en: The opposing team has a lot of momentum, we need to be in our best form to deal with them.

窟窿.zh: 墙上有个大窟窿，得尽快补上。
窟窿.en: There is a big hole in the wall, and it needs to be patched up soon.

窟窿.zh: 他花钱太大手大脚，账上出了不少窟窿。
窟窿.en: He spends money too freely, leaving many deficits in the accounts.

窟窿.zh: 袜子破了两个窟窿，该买新的了。
窟窿.en: The socks have two holes; it's time to buy new ones.

窟窿.zh: 补了预算窟窿之后，公司才勉强能运转下去。
窟窿.en: Only after filling the budget gap could the company barely keep operating.

窟窿.zh: 路面上有个窟窿，晚上骑车很容易摔倒。
窟窿.en: There is a hole in the road, and it's easy to fall when cycling at night.

错综复杂.zh: 这件事关系错综复杂，一时说不清楚。
错综复杂.en: This matter has complex relationships and can't be explained clearly in a moment.

错综复杂.zh: 他们俩的感情关系错综复杂，外人很难理解。
错综复杂.en: Their emotional relationship is intricate and hard for outsiders to understand.

错综复杂.zh: 这座城市的地铁线路错综复杂，第一次来很容易迷路。
错综复杂.en: The subway lines in this city are a maze, and first-timers easily get lost.

错综复杂.zh: 案情错综复杂，警方花了好几个月才破案。
错综复杂.en: The case was extremely complicated, and it took the police months to solve it.

错综复杂.zh: 在国际贸易中，各种利益关系错综复杂，需要谨慎处理。
错综复杂.en: In international trade, various interest relationships are intricate and require careful handling.

魄力.zh: 他做事很有魄力，说干就干。
魄力.en: He is very decisive in doing things, taking action immediately.

魄力.zh: 当领导就要有魄力，不能优柔寡断。
魄力.en: A leader must have boldness and not be indecisive.

魄力.zh: 她敢于改革，展现出了巨大的魄力。
魄力.en: She dares to reform, showing tremendous boldness.

魄力.zh: 这个方案太大胆了，一般人没有这个魄力去执行。
魄力.en: This plan is too bold; ordinary people don't have the guts to execute it.

魄力.zh: 虽然风险很高，但他凭借魄力和眼光最终成功了。
魄力.en: Although the risk was high, he succeeded by relying on his boldness and insight.

逾期.zh: 你的签证已经逾期了，得赶紧去续签。
逾期.en: Your visa has expired; you need to renew it quickly.

逾期.zh: 图书逾期不还会产生罚款。
逾期.en: Returning library books late will incur a fine.

逾期.zh: 信用卡账单逾期会影响个人信用记录。
逾期.en: Overdue credit card bills will affect your personal credit record.

逾期.zh: 合同逾期未签，双方的合作就算自动取消了。
逾期.en: If the contract is not signed before the deadline, the cooperation between the two parties will be automatically canceled.

逾期.zh: 他因为逾期缴纳学费，被学校警告了。
逾期.en: He was warned by the school because he paid tuition late.

风貌.zh: 这个古镇保留了原来的风貌，很值得一看。
风貌.en: This ancient town has preserved its original style and is worth a visit.

风貌.zh: 改革后城市风貌大变样，到处都是高楼大厦。
风貌.en: After the reform, the city's appearance changed dramatically, with high-rises everywhere.

风貌.zh: 新一代青年展现出了积极向上的精神风貌。
风貌.en: The new generation of youth shows a positive and uplifting spirit.

风貌.zh: 这片老城区风貌独特，吸引了很多摄影师。
风貌.en: This old city area has a unique style, attracting many photographers.

风貌.zh: 我们要保护历史文化遗产，让传统风貌延续下去。
风貌.en: We must protect historical and cultural heritage so that the traditional style continues.

供求.zh: 今年水果供求平衡，价格很稳定。
供求.en: The supply and demand of fruit are balanced this year, and prices are stable.

供求.zh: 口罩的供求关系紧张，大家都在抢购。
供求.en: The supply and demand for masks are tight, and everyone is panic buying.

供求.zh: 公司根据市场供求调整了生产计划。
供求.en: The company adjusted its production plan based on market supply and demand.

供求.zh: 这种商品的供求矛盾越来越突出，需要政府干预。
供求.en: The contradiction between supply and demand for this product is becoming increasingly prominent, requiring government intervention.

年迈.zh: 奶奶年迈了，走路不太方便。
年迈.en: Grandma is old and has trouble walking.

年迈.zh: 他年迈的父母住在乡下，他经常回去看他们。
年迈.en: His elderly parents live in the countryside, and he often goes back to visit them.

年迈.zh: 虽然年迈，但爷爷每天早上还坚持散步。
年迈.en: Although advanced in years, Grandpa still insists on taking a walk every morning.

年迈.zh: 年迈的教授依然坚持给学生上课，令人敬佩。
年迈.en: The elderly professor still insists on teaching students, which is admirable.

年迈.zh: 社区为年迈的居民提供了很多便利服务。
年迈.en: The community provides many convenient services for elderly residents.

睡袋.en: This sleeping bag is very warm.

睡袋.zh: 去露营别忘了带上你的睡袋。
睡袋.en: Don't forget to bring your sleeping bag when camping.

睡袋.zh: 我新买的睡袋又轻又保暖。
睡袋.en: My new sleeping bag is both lightweight and warm.

睡袋.zh: 虽然睡袋小，但是很舒服。
睡袋.en: Although the sleeping bag is small, it is very comfortable.

睡袋.zh: 晚上冷，把睡袋拉链拉好。
睡袋.en: It's cold at night, zip up your sleeping bag.

神气.zh: 别那么神气，下次你也会输。
神气.en: Don't be so cocky, you'll lose next time.

神气.zh: 她穿上新裙子，神气极了。
神气.en: She put on her new dress and looked very proud.

神气.zh: 虽然赢了比赛，但他一点也不神气。
神气.en: Although he won the game, he wasn't cocky at all.

神气.zh: 小孩子穿上军装，神气得很。
神气.en: Children look very spirited in military uniforms.

勤快.zh: 你姐姐比你还勤快，每天早起打扫。
勤快.en: Your sister is even more hardworking than you, she gets up early to clean every day.

勤快.zh: 这么勤快的员工，老板一定喜欢。
勤快.en: A hardworking employee like this, the boss must like him.

勤快.zh: 因为勤快，他很快就升职了。
勤快.en: Because he was diligent, he got promoted quickly.

勤快.zh: 别嫌我勤快，多干活没坏处。
勤快.en: Don't complain that I'm too hardworking, doing more work doesn't hurt.

冷气.en: The air conditioning is too strong.

冷气.zh: 夏天开冷气，别忘了定时。
冷气.en: When you turn on the air conditioning in summer, don't forget to set the timer.

冷气.zh: 这个房间的冷气有点问题。
冷气.en: There's something wrong with the air conditioning in this room.

冷气.zh: 虽然外面很热，但冷气别开太大。
冷气.en: Although it's hot outside, don't turn the air conditioning up too high.

冷气.zh: 坐地铁冷气很足，记得带外套。
冷气.en: The air conditioning on the subway is very strong, remember to bring a jacket.

佳肴.zh: 过年时，桌上摆满各种佳肴。
佳肴.en: During the New Year, the table is full of various delicacies.

佳肴.zh: 你做的佳肴比餐厅还好吃。
佳肴.en: The delicious food you make tastes better than restaurant food.

佳肴.zh: 虽然只是家常菜，但都是佳肴。
佳肴.en: Although they are just home-cooked dishes, they are all fine cuisine.

佳肴.zh: 朋友来家里，我准备了佳肴招待。
佳肴.en: When friends came over, I prepared fine dishes to treat them.

精妙.zh: 他的计划虽然简单，但十分精妙。
精妙.en: His plan, though simple, is very clever.

精妙.zh: 这幅画的细节非常精妙。
精妙.en: The details of this painting are extremely subtle.

精妙.zh: 因为构思精妙，这个作品得了奖。
精妙.en: Because of its exquisite conception, this work won an award.

精妙.zh: 魔术师的表演真是精妙绝伦。
精妙.en: The magician's performance was truly superb.

生硬.zh: 你别说话那么生硬，会伤人的。
生硬.en: Don't speak so stiffly, it can hurt people.

生硬.zh: 这个翻译太生硬了，不自然。
生硬.en: This translation is too stiff, not natural.

生硬.zh: 虽然他的建议没错，但语气太生硬。
生硬.en: Although his suggestion was correct, his tone was too harsh.

生硬.zh: 初学英语时发音很生硬。
生硬.en: When first learning English, pronunciation is very unnatural.

供不应求.en: This product is in short supply.

供不应求.zh: 最近口罩供不应求，很难买到。
供不应求.en: Recently masks are in short supply and hard to buy.

供不应求.zh: 演唱会门票供不应求，抢都抢不到。
供不应求.en: Concert tickets are in short supply, you can't even grab them.

供不应求.zh: 因为质量好，所以商品供不应求。
供不应求.en: Because the quality is good, the goods are in short supply.

供不应求.zh: 新出的手机供不应求，大家都在排队。
供不应求.en: The newly released phone is in short supply, everyone is lining up.

乖巧.zh: 她的小狗特别乖巧，从不乱叫。
乖巧.en: Her little dog is especially well-behaved and never barks randomly.

乖巧.zh: 乖巧的学生老师都喜欢。
虽然年纪小，但很乖巧懂事。
乖巧.en: Although young, she is very well-behaved and sensible.
Your daughter is both well-behaved and pretty.

邻国.en: Japan is a neighboring country of China.

邻国.zh: 我们和邻国的关系一直很好。
邻国.en: Our relationship with neighboring countries has always been good.

邻国.zh: 去邻国旅游很方便，坐飞机就到。
邻国.en: Traveling to a neighboring country is very convenient, you can get there by plane.

邻国.zh: 因为邻国发生疫情，边境关闭了。
邻国.en: Because an epidemic broke out in a neighboring country, the border was closed.

邻国.zh: 邻国的文化跟我们很相似。
邻国.en: The culture of neighboring countries is very similar to ours.

避暑.en: Let's go to the mountains to escape the heat.

避暑.zh: 夏天很多人去海边避暑。
避暑.en: In summer, many people go to the seaside to escape the heat.

避暑.zh: 这个避暑山庄风景特别好。
避暑.en: This summer resort has especially beautiful scenery.

避暑.zh: 每年暑假我们都去乡下避暑，因为那里凉快。
避暑.en: Every summer vacation we go to the countryside to escape the heat because it's cool there.

避暑.zh: 避暑最好的方法就是待在空调房里。
避暑.en: The best way to escape the heat is to stay in an air-conditioned room.

元宵节.en: We eat tangyuan on Lantern Festival.

元宵节.zh: 元宵节晚上我们去赏花灯。
元宵节.en: On Lantern Festival evening we go to admire the lanterns.

元宵节.zh: 今年元宵节正好是周末，可以出去玩了。
元宵节.en: This year Lantern Festival happens to be on a weekend, so we can go out and have fun.

元宵节.zh: 元宵节的时候，街上到处都是灯笼。
元宵节.en: During Lantern Festival, the streets are full of lanterns.

元宵节.zh: 虽然元宵节很热闹，但我更喜欢在家休息。
元宵节.en: Although Lantern Festival is very lively, I prefer to rest at home.

绝缘.en: The wires need to be wrapped with insulating material.

绝缘.zh: 他跟这件事完全绝缘了。
绝缘.en: He is completely disconnected from this matter.

绝缘.zh: 这个手套是绝缘的，可以安全操作。
绝缘.en: These gloves are insulated, so you can operate safely.

绝缘.zh: 因为工作太忙，他几乎跟社交绝缘了。
绝缘.en: Because he's too busy with work, he's almost completely isolated from social life.

绝缘.zh: 塑料可以用来做绝缘体。
绝缘.en: Plastic can be used as an insulator.

万万.en: You absolutely must not go there.
You absolutely must not be careless about this matter.

万万.zh: 我万万没想到他会这么做。
万万.en: I never expected he would do this.

万万.zh: 开车的时候，万万不能分心。
万万.en: When driving, you absolutely must not get distracted.

万万.zh: 这次考试万万要小心，别粗心犯错。
万万.en: You absolutely must be careful in this exam and not make careless mistakes.

看热闹.en: Don't just watch the excitement, come and help.

看热闹.zh: 街上有人吵架，很多人围观看热闹。
看热闹.en: Some people are arguing on the street, and many are gathered around watching the excitement.

看热闹.zh: 他最喜欢看热闹，哪里有动静就往哪跑。
看热闹.en: He loves to watch the excitement; wherever there's commotion, he runs over.

看热闹.zh: 看热闹的人比当事人还多。
看热闹.en: There are more people watching the excitement than the people involved.

看热闹.zh: 我只是路过看热闹，没想到被卷进去了。
看热闹.en: I was just passing by to watch the excitement, but unexpectedly I got dragged into it.

苗头.en: I can see a sign of it.

苗头.zh: 这个苗头不太好，得注意。
苗头.en: This sign is not good; we need to pay attention.

苗头.zh: 他最近有点苗头，好像要辞职。
苗头.en: There have been some signs lately that he might quit his job.

苗头.zh: 只要发现有不好的苗头，就要及时处理。
苗头.en: As soon as you notice any bad signs, you should deal with them promptly.

苗头.zh: 从她的话里，我嗅到了一丝苗头。
苗头.en: From her words, I sensed a hint of something.

浩劫.zh: 那场战争给人们带来了浩劫。
浩劫.en: That war brought catastrophe to the people.

浩劫.zh: 很多文化遗产在那次浩劫中消失了。
浩劫.en: Many cultural heritages disappeared in that catastrophe.

浩劫.zh: 幸好我们提前做了准备，才避免了这场浩劫。
浩劫.en: Fortunately, we prepared in advance and thus avoided this catastrophe.

浩劫.zh: 人类历史上的浩劫提醒我们要珍惜和平。
浩劫.en: The catastrophes in human history remind us to cherish peace.

缤纷.en: The garden is full of colorful flowers.
The holiday fireworks are colorful and splendid.

缤纷.zh: 她的生活过得缤纷有趣，让人羡慕。
缤纷.en: Her life is colorful and interesting, making people envious.

缤纷.zh: 商场里商品缤纷，让人眼花缭乱。
缤纷.en: The mall has a dazzling array of colorful products.

段落.zh: 每个段落开头要空两格。
段落.en: Indent two spaces at the beginning of each paragraph.

段落.zh: 你写的这个段落有点长，可以分一下。
段落.en: The paragraph you wrote is a bit long; you can split it.

段落.zh: 他读完了第一个段落，就明白了大概意思。
段落.en: After finishing the first paragraph, he understood the general idea.

段落.zh: 写作文时，段落之间要有逻辑联系。
段落.en: When writing an essay, there should be logical connections between paragraphs.

作息.en: You need to have a regular schedule.

作息.zh: 他的作息时间很不健康。
作息.en: His work-rest schedule is very unhealthy.

作息.zh: 保持良好作息对身体好。
作息.en: Maintaining a good schedule is good for your health.

作息.zh: 因为熬夜，我的作息完全乱了。
作息.en: Because of staying up late, my schedule is completely messed up.

作息.zh: 大学生应该养成固定的作息习惯。
作息.en: College students should develop a fixed daily routine.

畅谈.zh: 咱们找个时间畅谈一下。
畅谈.en: Let's find a time to have a good chat.

畅谈.zh: 昨晚我和老朋友畅谈了很久。
畅谈.en: Last night I talked freely with an old friend for a long time.

畅谈.zh: 他们一边喝茶一边畅谈人生理想。
畅谈.en: They chatted freely about life ideals while drinking tea.

畅谈.zh: 虽然好久没见，但一见面就畅谈到深夜。
畅谈.en: Although we hadn't seen each other for a long time, we talked freely until late at night once we met.

畅谈.zh: 在聚会上大家畅谈各自的旅行经历，气氛特别轻松。
畅谈.en: At the party everyone chatted freely about their travel experiences, and the atmosphere was very relaxed.

热腾腾.zh: 刚出锅的饺子热腾腾的。
热腾腾.en: The freshly boiled dumplings are steaming hot.

热腾腾.zh: 冬天喝一碗热腾腾的汤特别舒服。
热腾腾.en: Drinking a bowl of steaming hot soup in winter is especially comfortable.

热腾腾.zh: 妈妈端上来一笼热腾腾的包子。
热腾腾.en: Mom brought out a steamer basket of steaming hot buns.

热腾腾.zh: 外面下着雪，屋里有一杯热腾腾的咖啡真好。
热腾腾.en: It's snowing outside, and it's really nice to have a steaming hot coffee inside.

热腾腾.zh: 他一进门就闻到了热腾腾的饭菜香，顿时觉得饿了。
热腾腾.en: As soon as he entered the door, he smelled the steaming hot food and immediately felt hungry.

喧哗.en: Please do not make noise in the library.

喧哗.zh: 隔壁房间太喧哗了，我睡不着。
喧哗.en: The next room is too noisy, I can't sleep.

喧哗.zh: 街上传来一阵喧哗声，不知道发生了什么。
喧哗.en: A burst of noise came from the street, I wonder what happened.

喧哗.zh: 虽然市场里很喧哗，但我喜欢那种热闹的气氛。
喧哗.en: Although the market is very noisy, I like that lively atmosphere.

喧哗.zh: 大家突然停止喧哗，因为老师走进了教室。
喧哗.en: Everyone suddenly stopped making noise because the teacher walked into the classroom.

富含.en: This fruit is rich in vitamin C.

富含.zh: 菠菜富含铁，对健康很好。
富含.en: Spinach is rich in iron, which is good for health.
Deep-sea fish are rich in Omega-3 fatty acids.

富含.zh: 黑巧克力富含抗氧化剂，但也不要吃太多。
富含.en: Dark chocolate is rich in antioxidants, but don't eat too much either.

富含.zh: 这个地区的土壤富含矿物质，所以农作物长得特别好。
富含.en: The soil in this area is rich in minerals, so the crops grow particularly well.

不了了之.zh: 那件事最后不了了之了。
他们吵了一架，然后事情就不了了之。
不了了之.en: They had a quarrel, and then the matter was left unsettled.

不了了之.zh: 这个计划因为缺资金，最后不了了之。
不了了之.en: This plan ended up being abandoned due to lack of funds.

不了了之.zh: 本来想认真讨论，结果大家都不说话，就不了了之了。
不了了之.en: We originally wanted to discuss seriously, but in the end nobody spoke, so it fizzled out.

不了了之.zh: 他提了好几个建议，但都没人跟进，全部不了了之。
不了了之.en: He made several suggestions, but no one followed up, and they all came to nothing.

祭奠.zh: 清明节我们去祭奠祖先。
祭奠.en: On Qingming Festival we go to pay respects to our ancestors.

祭奠.zh: 他在墓前献花祭奠逝去的朋友。
祭奠.en: He laid flowers in front of the grave to commemorate his deceased friend.

祭奠.zh: 每年这个时候，人们都会祭奠烈士。
祭奠.en: Every year at this time, people honor the martyrs.

祭奠.zh: 虽然亲人已经离世多年，但家人依然按时祭奠。
祭奠.en: Although the relative passed away many years ago, the family still holds memorial ceremonies on time.

祭奠.zh: 为了祭奠这场灾难的遇难者，广场上举行了默哀仪式。
祭奠.en: To commemorate the victims of this disaster, a moment of silence was held in the square.

换位.en: You two swap seats for a bit.
You need to learn to think from others' perspectives.

换位.zh: 上课时老师让我们前后排换位讨论。
换位.en: In class, the teacher had us swap seats between front and back rows for discussion.

换位.zh: 如果换位一下，你可能也会做出同样的决定。
换位.en: If you put yourself in his shoes, you might also make the same decision.

换位.zh: 他们俩换位之后，矛盾反而少了很多。
换位.en: After they swapped positions, the conflicts actually decreased a lot.

整数.en: This number is not an integer.
Please round the result to an integer.

整数.zh: 我今天存了一笔整数，刚好一万块。
整数.en: I deposited a round number today, exactly ten thousand yuan.

整数.zh: 超市价格经常是9.9，很少出现整数。
整数.en: Supermarket prices are often 9.9, integers rarely appear.

整数.zh: 数学题要求把所有答案写成整数或分数。
整数.en: The math problem requires writing all answers as integers or fractions.

第一线.zh: 医生永远站在抗疫第一线。
第一线.en: Doctors always stand on the front line of fighting epidemics.

第一线.zh: 他多年工作在教学第一线。
第一线.en: He has worked on the front line of teaching for many years.

第一线.zh: 记者常常需要冲到新闻第一线。
第一线.en: Journalists often need to rush to the front line of news.

第一线.zh: 消防员总是冲在火灾第一线，非常勇敢。
第一线.en: Firefighters always charge to the front line of fires; they are very brave.

第一线.zh: 作为警察，他多次在第一线处理紧急事件。
第一线.en: As a police officer, he has handled emergency incidents on the front line many times.

传人.zh: 他是这门手艺的唯一传人。
传人.en: He is the only inheritor of this craft.

传人.zh: 这位老师傅想找一个可靠的传人。
传人.en: This master craftsman wants to find a reliable successor.

传人.zh: 传统武术的传人越来越少。
传人.en: The inheritors of traditional martial arts are becoming fewer and fewer.

传人.zh: 作为家族技艺的传人，他感到责任重大。
传人.en: As the inheritor of the family skill, he feels a great responsibility.

传人.zh: 他虽然不是直系传人，但学得比谁都用心。
传人.en: Although he is not a direct inheritor, he studies more diligently than anyone.

赞许.zh: 虽然他没说出口，但我能感觉到他的赞许。
赞许.en: Although he didn't say it out loud, I could feel his approval.

赞许.zh: 老师对学生的进步表示赞许。
赞许.en: The teacher expressed approval of the student's progress.

赞许.zh: 他的努力得到了大家的赞许。
听到这些赞许的话，他反而有点不好意思了。
赞许.en: Hearing these words of praise, he became a bit shy instead.

饶恕.zh: 我犯了这么大的错，你能饶恕我吗？
饶恕.en: I made such a big mistake, can you forgive me?

饶恕.zh: 他已经知道错了，你就饶恕他这一次吧。
饶恕.en: He already knows he was wrong, just forgive him this once.

饶恕.zh: 虽然他伤害了我，但我还是选择饶恕他。
饶恕.en: Although he hurt me, I still chose to forgive him.

饶恕.zh: 如果你能饶恕我的过失，我会非常感激。
饶恕.en: If you can forgive my mistake, I will be very grateful.

蓬勃.zh: 这几年，他的事业做得蓬勃向上。
蓬勃.en: In recent years, his career has been thriving.

蓬勃.zh: 春天来了，万物一片蓬勃生机。
蓬勃.en: Spring has arrived, everything is full of vigorous life.

蓬勃.zh: 因为政策支持，这个行业蓬勃发展起来了。
蓬勃.en: Because of policy support, this industry has developed vigorously.

蓬勃.zh: 看到公司这么蓬勃发展的势头，大家都很有干劲。
蓬勃.en: Seeing the company's vigorous development momentum, everyone is full of drive.

竣工.zh: 这个项目预计下个月竣工。
竣工.en: This project is expected to be completed next month.

竣工.zh: 机场扩建工程已经顺利竣工。
竣工.en: The airport expansion project has been successfully completed.

竣工.zh: 虽然天气不好，但工程还是按时竣工了。
竣工.en: Although the weather was bad, the project was still completed on time.

竣工.zh: 新体育场竣工后，将举办一场大型运动会。
竣工.en: After the new stadium is completed, a large sports event will be held.

水温.en: The water temperature is just right, you can take a shower.

水温.zh: 泡茶的时候水温不能太高。
水温.en: When brewing tea, the water temperature should not be too high.

水温.zh: 这个游泳池的水温有点凉。
水温.en: The water temperature in this pool is a bit cold.

水温.zh: 如果你觉得水温太烫，就加点冷水。
水温.en: If you think the water temperature is too hot, add some cold water.

水温.zh: 我用手试了试鱼缸的水温，感觉正好合适。
水温.en: I tested the water temperature of the fish tank with my hand and felt it was just right.

涵义.en: The meaning of this word is very profound.

涵义.zh: 要理解这句话的真正涵义并不容易。
涵义.en: It's not easy to understand the true meaning of this sentence.

涵义.zh: 这首诗的涵义需要仔细琢磨。
涵义.en: The meaning of this poem requires careful pondering.

涵义.zh: 虽然字面很简单，但它的涵义很丰富。
涵义.en: Although the wording is simple, its meaning is very rich.

涵义.zh: 他说的每个字都有特殊的涵义，你要自己体会。
涵义.en: Every word he says has a special meaning, you need to figure it out yourself.

占卜.en: She likes to use tarot cards for divination.

占卜.zh: 很多人去寺庙里求签占卜运势。
占卜.en: Many people go to temples to draw lots and divine their fortune.

占卜.zh: 我不太相信占卜这种东西。
占卜.en: I don't really believe in divination or things like that.

占卜.zh: 她为了知道未来，特意去找人占卜。
占卜.en: She specifically went to someone for divination to know the future.

占卜.zh: 在古代，人们遇到大事都会先占卜一下吉凶。
占卜.en: In ancient times, people would first divine the auspiciousness of major events.

燃放.en: During the New Year, you set off firecrackers.

燃放.zh: 市区禁止燃放烟花爆竹。
燃放.en: Fireworks and firecrackers are prohibited in the urban area.

燃放.zh: 他们晚上在河边燃放烟花庆祝。
燃放.en: They set off fireworks by the river in the evening to celebrate.

燃放.zh: 因为污染问题，很多地方不允许燃放鞭炮了。
燃放.en: Due to pollution issues, many places no longer allow setting off firecrackers.

燃放.zh: 小朋友们都喜欢看别人燃放烟花，觉得特别好看。
燃放.en: Children all love watching others set off fireworks, thinking they look especially beautiful.

甚至于.zh: 他累得甚至于说不出话。
甚至于.en: He was so tired that he couldn't even speak.

甚至于.zh: 他太高兴了，甚至于跳了起来。
甚至于.en: He was so happy that he even jumped up.

甚至于.zh: 这个解释太复杂，甚至于专家都很难理解。
甚至于.en: This explanation is too complicated, so much so that even experts find it hard to understand.

甚至于.zh: 他不仅自己不学习，甚至于还影响别人。
甚至于.en: He not only doesn't study himself, but even affects others.

甚至于.zh: 她工作非常努力，甚至于周末也不休息，一直在加班。
甚至于.en: She works very hard, to the extent that she doesn't even rest on weekends and works overtime all the time.

客运.en: The passenger bus departed on time.

客运.zh: 春运期间客运量非常大。
客运.en: During the Spring Festival travel season, the passenger volume is very high.

客运.zh: 这家公司主营客运和货运业务。
客运.en: This company mainly engages in passenger and freight transport services.

客运.zh: 由于天气原因，客运航班延误了。
客运.en: Due to weather reasons, the passenger flight was delayed.

客运.zh: 新建的高铁站大大提高了本地的客运能力。
客运.en: The newly built high-speed rail station has greatly improved the local passenger transport capacity.

夜校.zh: 他每天晚上去夜校上课。
夜校.en: He goes to night school every evening.

夜校.zh: 虽然白天工作很累，但她还是坚持上夜校。
夜校.en: Although she's tired from work during the day, she still insists on attending night school.

夜校.zh: 她在夜校学会了电脑编程。
夜校.en: She learned computer programming at night school.

夜校.zh: 因为没考上大学，他选择了读夜校。
夜校.en: Because he didn't get into university, he chose to attend night school.

夜校.zh: 夜校的课程比我想象的还要实用。
夜校.en: The courses at night school are even more practical than I imagined.

轮换.zh: 我们轮换开车，不容易累。
轮换.en: We take turns driving, so we don't get tired easily.

轮换.zh: 公司实行轮换制度，每个人都要值班。
轮换.en: The company implements a rotation system, and everyone has to be on duty.

轮换.zh: 这几个岗位需要定期轮换。
轮换.en: These positions need to be rotated regularly.

轮换.zh: 如果大家轮换着做家务，就不会有人抱怨了。
轮换.en: If everyone takes turns doing chores, no one will complain.

轮换.zh: 教练让队员轮换上场，保持体力。
轮换.en: The coach let the players rotate in and out to conserve energy.

棱角.en: This stone has sharp edges and corners.

棱角.zh: 他年轻时很有棱角，现在变得圆滑了。
棱角.en: He had a lot of edges when he was young, but now he's become smooth.

棱角.zh: 把桌子的棱角包起来，以免孩子撞到。
棱角.en: Cover the edges of the table so the child doesn't bump into them.

棱角.zh: 经过社会的打磨，他的棱角渐渐被磨平了。
棱角.en: After being tempered by society, his edges gradually wore off.

棱角.zh: 虽然她说话有棱角，但心地其实很善良。
棱角.en: Although her words are sharp, she actually has a kind heart.

贮藏.zh: 地窖里贮藏了很多白菜。
贮藏.en: The cellar stores a lot of cabbages.

贮藏.zh: 这些粮食要妥善贮藏，防止发霉。
贮藏.en: These grains need to be properly stored to prevent mold.

贮藏.zh: 他们把过冬的食物都贮藏起来了。
贮藏.en: They stored up all the food for winter.

贮藏.zh: 如果你不低温贮藏，牛奶很快就会变质。
贮藏.en: If you don't store it at low temperature, the milk will spoil quickly.

贮藏.zh: 这家酒庄贮藏的红酒年份都很久远。
贮藏.en: The red wines stored in this winery have very old vintages.

切身.zh: 这关系到你的切身利益。
只有经历过，才有切身体会。
切身.en: Only by experiencing it can you have a personal understanding.

切身.zh: 作为一个癌症患者，我对此有切身的感受。
切身.en: As a cancer patient, I have personal feelings about this.

切身.zh: 你不考虑员工的切身需求，他们怎么会努力工作？
切身.en: If you don't consider the employees' personal needs, how can they work hard?

切身.zh: 房价上涨是很多人切身的痛点。
切身.en: The rise in housing prices is a personal pain point for many people.

全文.zh: 请阅读合同全文再签字。
全文.en: Please read the full contract before signing.

全文.zh: 这篇文章的全文可以在网上找到。
全文.en: The full text of this article can be found online.

全文.zh: 因为时间有限，我只看了摘要，没读全文。
全文.en: Due to limited time, I only read the abstract, not the full text.

全文.zh: 他把演讲稿的全文发到了群里。
全文.en: He sent the full text of the speech to the group chat.

全文.zh: 如果你想引用，最好先核实一下全文的意思。
全文.en: If you want to quote, it's best to first verify the meaning of the full text.

相依为命.en: The mother and son depend on each other for survival.

相依为命.zh: 自从父母去世后，兄妹俩相依为命。
相依为命.en: After their parents died, the brother and sister depended on each other.

相依为命.zh: 在这座城市里，我们两个朋友相依为命。
相依为命.en: In this city, we two friends rely on each other to get by.

相依为命.zh: 老人和他的狗相依为命，感情很深。
相依为命.en: The old man and his dog depend on each other; their bond is deep.

相依为命.zh: 虽然生活很苦，但一家人相依为命，也就熬过来了。
相依为命.en: Although life was hard, the family depended on each other and managed to get through.

赞不绝口.zh: 大家对她的手艺赞不绝口。
赞不绝口.en: Everyone was full of praise for her craftsmanship.

赞不绝口.zh: 他吃了这道菜后赞不绝口。
赞不绝口.en: He was full of praise after eating this dish.

赞不绝口.zh: 游客们对这里的风景赞不绝口。
赞不绝口.en: The tourists were full of praise for the scenery here.

赞不绝口.zh: 老师看了他的作文，赞不绝口。
赞不绝口.en: The teacher read his essay and was full of praise.

赞不绝口.zh: 这部电影口碑很好，观众们都赞不绝口。
赞不绝口.en: This movie has a great reputation; audiences are all praising it endlessly.

服气.en: I am convinced of his ability.

服气.zh: 如果你不服气，可以再比一次。
服气.en: If you're not convinced, we can compete again.

服气.zh: 虽然我不服气，但不得不承认他说得对。
服气.en: Although I'm not happy about it, I have to admit he's right.

服气.zh: 这么难的问题他一下子解决了，大家都很服气。
服气.en: He solved such a difficult problem instantly, and everyone was impressed and convinced.

俗语.en: As the saying goes, 'A fall into a pit, a gain in your wit.'

俗语.zh: 很多俗语都来自老百姓的生活经验。
