俗语.en: Many common sayings come from the life experiences of ordinary people.

俗语.zh: 如果你不懂这句俗语，我可以解释给你听。
俗语.en: If you don't understand this saying, I can explain it to you.

俗语.zh: 他喜欢用俗语来说明道理，别人一听就懂。
俗语.en: He likes to use common sayings to illustrate points, so others understand immediately.

标榜.en: He always boasts about how great he is.

标榜.zh: 虽然他一直标榜自己很环保，但从来不分类垃圾。
标榜.en: Although he always claims to be environmentally friendly, he never sorts garbage.

标榜.zh: 这家公司标榜产品质量最好，其实也不怎么样。
标榜.en: This company advertises that its product quality is the best, but it's actually not that great.
Stop boasting about yourself; nobody believes you.

标榜.zh: 她喜欢标榜自己认识很多名人，其实都是假的。
标榜.en: She likes to flaunt that she knows many celebrities, but it's all fake.

玄机.en: There's a hidden meaning in these words.

玄机.zh: 他说的每句话都藏着玄机，你要仔细听。
玄机.en: Every word he says hides some mystery; you need to listen carefully.

玄机.zh: 这个问题的玄机在于数字的顺序。
玄机.en: The trick to this question lies in the order of the numbers.

玄机.zh: 我看了半天也没看出这幅画的玄机在哪里。
玄机.en: I stared at this painting for a long time but couldn't figure out its hidden meaning.

衣裳.en: How much is this piece of clothing?

衣裳.zh: 她今天穿的衣裳搭配得很漂亮。
衣裳.en: The outfit she's wearing today matches very beautifully.

衣裳.zh: 出门前记得换件干净的衣裳。
衣裳.en: Remember to change into clean clothes before going out.

衣裳.zh: 我翻遍了衣柜也没找到那件红色的衣裳。
衣裳.en: I searched through the entire wardrobe but couldn't find that red garment.

鞭策.zh: 老师的批评是对我们的鞭策，不是为了打击我们。
鞭策.en: The teacher's criticism is meant to motivate us, not to discourage us.

鞭策.zh: 我一直用这个目标鞭策自己努力。
鞭策.en: I've been using this goal to push myself to work hard.
Failure is also a form of motivation.

鞭策.zh: 这本书里有很多名言能鞭策你不断前进。
鞭策.en: This book contains many quotes that can spur you to keep moving forward.

境外.en: He has lived abroad for a long time.

境外.zh: 这些商品都是从境外进口的，价格比较贵。
境外.en: These goods are all imported from abroad, so they're relatively expensive.
When traveling abroad, you need to pay attention to safety.

境外.zh: 由于疫情，境外人员入境需要隔离十四天。
境外.en: Due to the pandemic, people entering from abroad need to quarantine for fourteen days.

姑且.en: I'll trust you for the time being, just this once.

姑且.zh: 这件事我们姑且放一放，先处理别的。
姑且.en: Let's put this matter aside for now and deal with other things first.

姑且.zh: 姑且不论对错，他的态度很有问题。
姑且.en: Setting aside whether it's right or wrong, his attitude is very problematic.
Let's just give it a try for now.

姑且.zh: 既然找不到更好的办法，我们就姑且用这个方案吧。
姑且.en: Since we can't find a better solution, let's tentatively use this plan.

拜见.en: Tomorrow I'm going to pay a visit to my teacher.

拜见.zh: 他专程从外地赶来拜见这位老教授。
拜见.en: He came all the way from another city to pay his respects to this old professor.

拜见.zh: 第一次拜见岳父岳母，他有点紧张。
拜见.en: He was a bit nervous meeting his parents-in-law for the first time.
When are you going to visit?

拜见.zh: 按照习俗，新媳妇要拜见公婆。
拜见.en: According to tradition, the new bride must pay respects to her parents-in-law.

敢情.zh: 我说怎么这么眼熟，敢情是老同学。
敢情.en: I was wondering why you looked so familiar; it turns out you're an old classmate.

敢情.zh: 敢情他早就知道了，就瞒着我。
敢情.en: So he already knew all along and just kept it from me.

敢情.zh: 原来你也会做饭，敢情以前是装的啊。
敢情.en: So you can cook too—turns out you were just pretending before.

攻读.en: He is pursuing a doctoral degree.

攻读.zh: 她一边工作一边攻读法律硕士，非常辛苦。
攻读.en: She is working while studying for a master's degree in law; it's very tough.

攻读.zh: 我打算攻读计算机专业。
攻读.en: I plan to major in computer science.
What field are you specializing in?

攻读.zh: 他花了五年时间攻读经济学，终于毕业了。
攻读.en: He spent five years studying economics and finally graduated.

归纳.zh: 先把每个段落的意思归纳出来，再写总结。
归纳.en: First, summarize the meaning of each paragraph, then write a conclusion.

归纳.zh: 从这些现象可以归纳出一个规律。
归纳.en: From these phenomena, we can deduce a pattern.

归纳.zh: 老师让我们把课文的内容归纳成几句话。
归纳.en: The teacher asked us to summarize the content of the text into a few sentences.

不免.zh: 看到这一幕，我不免有些伤感。
不免.en: Seeing this scene, I couldn't help feeling a bit sad.

不免.zh: 第一次上台，心里不免紧张。
不免.en: The first time on stage, I can't help being nervous.

不免.zh: 听到这个消息，大家不免议论纷纷。
不免.en: Hearing this news, everyone couldn't help discussing it.

不免.zh: 虽然知道是假的，但我还是不免有点失望。
不免.en: Although I know it's fake, I still can't help feeling a little disappointed.

不免.zh: 年纪大了，走路不免慢一些。
不免.en: Getting older, you can't help walking a bit slower.

慈祥.zh: 那位老爷爷看起来特别慈祥。
慈祥.en: That old grandfather looks especially kind.

慈祥.zh: 老师用慈祥的目光看着我们。
慈祥.en: The teacher looked at us with kind eyes.

慈祥.zh: 邻居家的老太太总是慈祥地跟小孩说话。
慈祥.en: The old lady next door always speaks kindly to children.

慈祥.zh: 虽然他长得严肃，其实内心很慈祥。
慈祥.en: Although he looks serious, he is actually very kind-hearted.

过硬.zh: 产品质量必须过硬才行。
没有过硬的本领，很难找到好工作。
过硬.en: Without solid skills, it's hard to find a good job.

过硬.zh: 这家公司的技术团队素质很过硬。
过硬.en: The technical team of this company has very strong capabilities.

怠慢.zh: 工作再忙也不能怠慢客户。
怠慢.en: No matter how busy work is, you can't neglect customers.

怠慢.zh: 他觉得自己被怠慢了，很不高兴。
怠慢.en: He felt he was neglected and was very upset.

怠慢.zh: 第一次来我家，千万别怠慢人家。
怠慢.en: Since it's their first time at my place, don't treat them poorly.

怠慢.zh: 周末加班可以，但不能怠慢家人。
怠慢.en: Working overtime on weekends is fine, but you can't neglect your family.

荡漾.en: Ripples are spreading on the lake.
Her singing lingers in my ears.

荡漾.zh: 风吹过，麦田里一片荡漾。
荡漾.en: The wind blew, and the wheat field rippled.

荡漾.zh: 幸福的笑容在他脸上荡漾开来。
荡漾.en: A happy smile spread across his face.

荡漾.zh: 小船在清澈的湖水中轻轻荡漾。
荡漾.en: The small boat gently swayed in the clear lake water.

形影不离.zh: 我和弟弟从小形影不离。
形影不离.en: My younger brother and I have been inseparable since childhood.

形影不离.zh: 那对情侣总是形影不离地在一起。
形影不离.en: That couple is always together, inseparable.

形影不离.zh: 自从养了这只狗，我们几乎形影不离。
形影不离.en: Since I got this dog, we are almost inseparable.

形影不离.zh: 他们俩是好朋友，上学放学都形影不离。
形影不离.en: They are good friends, inseparable going to and from school.

揣测.zh: 我揣测他可能不会来了。
揣测.en: I suspect he might not come.

揣测.zh: 没有证据，就不要随意揣测。
揣测.en: Without evidence, don't make random conjectures.

揣测.zh: 大家对他的动机有很多揣测。
揣测.en: There are many conjectures about his motives.

揣测.zh: 她总是喜欢揣测别人的心思。
揣测.en: She always likes to guess what others are thinking.

正月.en: During the first lunar month, people visit relatives and friends.

正月.zh: 我们正月十五去看花灯。
正月.en: We go to see lanterns on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month.

正月.zh: 正月是一年里最热闹的时候。
正月.en: The first lunar month is the liveliest time of the year.

正月.zh: 按照习俗，正月里不能剪头发。
正月.en: According to custom, you can't cut hair during the first lunar month.

正月.zh: 今年正月我打算回老家过年。
正月.en: This year during the first lunar month, I plan to go back to my hometown for the New Year.

把关.en: Product quality must be strictly controlled.

把关.zh: 他负责最后的把关工作。
把关.en: He is responsible for the final quality check.

把关.zh: 每个环节都要有专人把关。
把关.en: Every step should have someone in charge of checking.

把关.zh: 出版前编辑会仔细把关。
把关.en: The editor will carefully check before publication.

把关.zh: 安全测试必须严格把关，不能出错。
把关.en: Safety tests must be strictly controlled, no mistakes allowed.

茅台酒.en: My dad loves to drink Moutai.

茅台酒.zh: 这瓶茅台酒是朋友送的。
茅台酒.en: This bottle of Moutai was a gift from a friend.

茅台酒.zh: 过年的时候，家里开了一瓶茅台酒。
茅台酒.en: During the New Year, we opened a bottle of Moutai at home.

茅台酒.zh: 他收藏了好几瓶老茅台酒，特别珍贵。
茅台酒.en: He has collected several bottles of aged Moutai, which are very precious.

苦力.en: He earns money by doing manual labor.
There used to be many coolies at the docks.

苦力.zh: 这份工作就是干苦力，太累了。
苦力.en: This job is just hard labor, it's too tiring.

苦力.zh: 虽然他学历不高，但从不觉得做苦力丢人。
苦力.en: Although he is not highly educated, he never feels ashamed of doing manual labor.

苦力.zh: 我们不应该歧视那些靠苦力生活的人。
苦力.en: We should not discriminate against those who make a living through manual labor.

哺乳.zh: 哺乳期的妈妈要注意营养。
哺乳.en: Mothers during breastfeeding should pay attention to nutrition.

哺乳.zh: 她每天要哺乳好几次，很辛苦。
哺乳.en: She has to breastfeed several times a day, it's very tiring.

哺乳.zh: 很多公共场所都设有哺乳室。
哺乳.en: Many public places have nursing rooms.

哺乳.zh: 医生建议纯母乳喂养到六个月，然后继续哺乳到两岁。
哺乳.en: Doctors recommend exclusive breastfeeding for six months, then continue breastfeeding until two years old.

光碟.zh: 我买了一张新电影的光碟。
光碟.en: I bought a DVD of a new movie.

光碟.zh: 现在很少有人用光碟了，都看线上。
光碟.en: Few people use discs anymore; everyone watches online.

光碟.zh: 他收藏了很多音乐光碟。
光碟.en: He has a large collection of music CDs.

光碟.zh: 你把光碟放进电脑里试试。
光碟.en: Try putting the disc into the computer.

恍然大悟.zh: 听他解释后，我恍然大悟。
恍然大悟.en: After listening to his explanation, I suddenly realized.

恍然大悟.zh: 看到那个标志，我才恍然大悟走错了路。
恍然大悟.en: Seeing that sign, I suddenly realized I was on the wrong road.

恍然大悟.zh: 这道题我做了很久，突然恍然大悟。
恍然大悟.en: I worked on this problem for a long time, then suddenly it clicked.

恍然大悟.zh: 老师一点拨，他恍然大悟，原来这么简单。
恍然大悟.en: With a little hint from the teacher, he suddenly realized it was so simple.

恍然大悟.zh: 直到钱包丢了，他才恍然大悟自己太大意。
恍然大悟.en: Only after losing his wallet did he suddenly realize he had been too careless.

谢绝.en: He politely declined the other party's kindness.
This store does not allow bringing your own drinks.

谢绝.zh: 因为身体原因，他谢绝了所有应酬。
谢绝.en: Due to health reasons, he declined all social engagements.

谢绝.zh: 我们谢绝了他们的礼物，觉得太贵重。
谢绝.en: We politely refused their gift, thinking it was too valuable.

遇险.en: He encountered danger while mountain climbing.
If you encounter danger at sea, call for help immediately.

遇险.zh: 救援队及时赶到，遇险人员都获救了。
遇险.en: The rescue team arrived in time, and all those in danger were saved.

遇险.zh: 那次旅行我们差点遇险，想想都后怕。
遇险.en: We almost encountered danger on that trip; thinking about it still scares me.

遇险.zh: 如果遇险，请保持冷静，等待救援。
遇险.en: If you encounter danger, please stay calm and wait for rescue.

不相上下.zh: 这两个队实力不相上下。
不相上下.en: These two teams are evenly matched in strength.

不相上下.zh: 我和他的成绩不相上下。
不相上下.en: My grades and his are comparable.

不相上下.zh: 这两款手机性能不相上下，很难选。
不相上下.en: These two phone models have similar performance, hard to choose.

不相上下.zh: 他们俩在比赛中表现不相上下，最后平局。
不相上下.en: They performed equally well in the match, ending in a tie.

不相上下.zh: 虽然年纪不同，但他们的经验不相上下。
不相上下.en: Although they are different in age, their experience is comparable.

少林寺.zh: 他暑假去少林寺学武术。
少林寺.en: He went to Shaolin Temple during summer break to learn martial arts.

少林寺.zh: 少林寺在河南登封，很有名。
少林寺.en: Shaolin Temple is in Dengfeng, Henan, and is very famous.

少林寺.zh: 很多电影都拍过少林寺的故事。
少林寺.en: Many movies have told stories about Shaolin Temple.

少林寺.zh: 我一直想去少林寺看看真正的功夫。
少林寺.en: I have always wanted to go to Shaolin Temple to see real kung fu.

少林寺.zh: 他们去少林寺旅游，还看了武僧表演。
少林寺.en: They traveled to Shaolin Temple and also watched a monk performance.

红润.zh: 小孩的脸蛋红润润的，很可爱。
红润.en: The child's cheeks are rosy and very cute.

红润.zh: 他每天运动，所以脸色红润。
红润.en: He exercises every day, so his complexion is rosy.

红润.zh: 她生病好了以后，脸色变得红润了。
红润.en: After recovering from illness, her complexion became rosy.

红润.zh: 多吃水果能让皮肤红润有光泽。
红润.en: Eating more fruit can make your skin rosy and glowing.

未知数.zh: 他能不能考上大学还是个未知数。
未知数.en: Whether he can get into college is still uncertain.

未知数.zh: 这件事充满了未知数，谁也不敢保证。
未知数.en: This matter is full of unknowns; nobody can guarantee anything.

未知数.zh: 未来是个未知数，我们要勇敢面对。
未知数.en: The future is an unknown; we must face it bravely.

未知数.zh: 数学题里有几个未知数，需要求解。
未知数.en: There are several unknowns in the math problem that need to be solved.

爆满.zh: 餐厅周末经常爆满，最好提前订位。
爆满.en: Restaurants are often packed on weekends; it's best to book ahead.

爆满.zh: 演唱会爆满，连站票都卖光了。
爆满.en: The concert was completely full; even standing tickets were sold out.

爆满.zh: 因为打折，商场里人爆满，挤都挤不动。
爆满.en: Because of the sale, the mall was so crowded you couldn't move.

爆满.zh: 新开的网红店天天爆满，我们改天再去吧。
爆满.en: The new trendy store is packed every day; let's go another day.

骨气.en: Although he is poor, he has great moral backbone.

骨气.zh: 遇到困难不要低头，骨气很重要。
骨气.en: Don't bow down when facing difficulties; backbone is important.

骨气.zh: 他那份骨气让我特别佩服。
骨气.en: I really admire his sense of dignity.

骨气.zh: 为了骨气，他宁愿辞职也不道歉。
骨气.en: To preserve his integrity, he would rather resign than apologize.

冒昧.en: May I ask, what is your surname?
Calling like that is too presumptuous.

冒昧.zh: 冒昧打扰您，请问会议室怎么走？
冒昧.en: Sorry to bother you, could you tell me how to get to the conference room?

冒昧.zh: 我知道这样问很冒昧，但这事真的很重要。
冒昧.en: I know it's presumptuous to ask, but this is really important.

冒昧.zh: 冒昧给您发邮件，希望没有打扰到您。
冒昧.en: I take the liberty of emailing you; I hope I'm not disturbing you.

庙会.en: We go to the temple fair during Spring Festival.

庙会.zh: 庙会上有很多小吃和玩具。
庙会.en: There are lots of snacks and toys at the temple fair.

庙会.zh: 今年庙会比往年热闹多了。
庙会.en: This year's temple fair is much more lively than previous years.

庙会.zh: 小时候我最喜欢逛庙会，因为能买糖葫芦。
庙会.en: When I was little, I loved going to temple fairs because I could buy sugar-coated hawthorns.

庙会.zh: 庙会快结束了，我们抓紧时间去看看吧。
庙会.en: The temple fair is almost over; let's hurry and go take a look.

下期.en: When will the next episode air?

下期.zh: 这个连载的下期要等一个月。
下期.en: We'll have to wait a month for the next installment of this series.

下期.zh: 下期杂志会有你的采访。
下期.en: The next issue of the magazine will have your interview.

下期.zh: 如果喜欢这个视频，别忘了看下期。
下期.en: If you like this video, don't forget to watch the next one.

下期.zh: 课程分三期，下期讲语法和写作。
下期.en: The course is divided into three parts; the next one covers grammar and writing.

退让.zh: 在这件事上我们不能退让。
退让.en: We cannot compromise on this matter.

退让.zh: 为了和平，双方都做出了退让。
退让.en: For the sake of peace, both sides made concessions.

退让.zh: 他性格很强硬，从来不懂得退让。
退让.en: He has a very tough personality and never knows how to yield.

退让.zh: 既然你退让了，那我也退一步。
退让.en: Since you have given way, I'll also take a step back.

枣.en: My grandma likes to cook porridge with dates.

枣.zh: 你买的是鲜枣还是干枣？
枣.en: Did you buy fresh or dried jujubes?

枣.zh: 过年家里会摆一盘枣，寓意早生贵子。
枣.en: During Chinese New Year, we put out a plate of dates, symbolizing having a baby soon.

枣.zh: 新疆的枣又大又甜，特别好吃。
枣.en: Xinjiang dates are big and sweet, extremely delicious.

伯伯.zh: 我爸爸的哥哥就是我的伯伯。
伯伯.en: My father's older brother is my uncle.

伯伯.zh: 李伯伯每次来都给我带好吃的。
伯伯.en: Every time Uncle Li comes, he brings me delicious food.

伯伯.zh: 过年时我们去伯伯家拜年，特别热闹。
伯伯.en: During Chinese New Year, we go to Uncle's house to pay New Year's visit; it's very lively.

辽阔.en: The Inner Mongolia grasslands are vast.

辽阔.zh: 祖国地大物博，幅员辽阔。
辽阔.en: Our country is vast and rich in resources.

辽阔.zh: 站在山顶望去，视野非常辽阔。
辽阔.en: Looking out from the mountaintop, the view is very expansive.

辽阔.zh: 新疆幅员辽阔，开车一天都到不了另一个城市。
辽阔.en: Xinjiang is so vast that you can't reach another city even after driving all day.

辽阔.zh: 他梦想去辽阔的大海航行。
辽阔.en: He dreams of sailing on the vast ocean.

酿造.zh: 蜂蜜需要蜜蜂慢慢酿造。
酿造.en: Honey needs to be slowly brewed by bees.

酿造.zh: 他们用传统方法酿造酱油。
酿造.en: They use traditional methods to brew soy sauce.

酿造.zh: 这种醋是用粮食酿造的，味道很香。
酿造.en: This vinegar is made from grains; it has a rich aroma.

酿造.zh: 好的葡萄酒需要时间酿造，不能着急。
酿造.en: Good wine takes time to ferment; you can't rush it.

翻来覆去.en: He tossed and turned and couldn't sleep.

翻来覆去.zh: 我昨晚翻来覆去想了很久。
翻来覆去.en: I tossed and turned thinking for a long time last night.

翻来覆去.zh: 别翻来覆去说同一件事，烦死了。
翻来覆去.en: Stop going on and on about the same thing, it's so annoying.

翻来覆去.zh: 虽然已经很晚了，但她翻来覆去就是睡不着。
翻来覆去.en: Although it was already very late, she tossed and turned and just couldn't fall asleep.

翻来覆去.zh: 他翻来覆去地检查了好几遍，才放心。
翻来覆去.en: He checked over and over again several times before he felt reassured.

操劳.zh: 为了这个家，爸爸操劳了一辈子。
操劳.en: Dad worked hard his whole life for this family.

操劳.zh: 他一边工作一边照顾孩子，实在很操劳。
操劳.en: He works and takes care of the kids at the same time, it's really exhausting.

操劳.zh: 你年纪大了，别再那么操劳了。
操劳.en: You're getting older, don't work so hard anymore.

操劳.zh: 看到母亲这么操劳，我心里很难受。
操劳.en: Seeing my mother work so hard makes me feel really bad.

试用期.en: The probation period is three months.

试用期.zh: 这份工作试用期工资比较低。
试用期.en: The salary during the probation period for this job is relatively low.

试用期.zh: 虽然通过了试用期，但压力还是很大。
试用期.en: Although I passed the probation period, the pressure is still high.

试用期.zh: 公司在试用期结束前会评估你的表现。
试用期.en: The company will evaluate your performance before the probation period ends.

试用期.zh: 试用期里我学到了很多东西。
试用期.en: I learned a lot during the probation period.

礁石.zh: 那片海域有很多暗礁石，很危险。
礁石.en: That sea area has many hidden reefs; it's very dangerous.

礁石.zh: 因为礁石太多，船只能慢慢开。
礁石.en: Because there are too many reefs, the boat can only go slowly.

礁石.zh: 海浪拍打着礁石，发出很大的声音。
礁石.en: The waves crash against the rocks, making a loud sound.

礁石.zh: 这个岛周围全是礁石，没法登岸。
礁石.en: This island is surrounded by rocks; there's no way to land.

筹措.zh: 为了开公司，他四处筹措资金。
筹措.en: He went around raising funds to start a company.

筹措.zh: 如果筹措不到钱，项目就得停下来。
筹措.en: If we can't raise the money, the project will have to stop.

筹措.zh: 我们得想办法筹措一下费用。
筹措.en: We need to find a way to raise the fees.

筹措.zh: 他筹措了好几个月，终于凑够了首付。
筹措.en: He raised money for several months and finally scraped together the down payment.

不像话.zh: 他居然迟到两个小时，真不像话。
不像话.en: He actually arrived two hours late, that's really outrageous.

不像话.zh: 不仅不帮忙，还捣乱，简直不像话。
不像话.en: Not only does he not help, he even causes trouble, that's just unreasonable.

不像话.zh: 这么大的事你都不说一声，太不像话了吧。
不像话.en: You didn't even mention such a big thing, that's really not acceptable.

不像话.zh: 小孩子这么没礼貌，家长也太不像话了。
不像话.en: The kid is so rude, the parents are really out of line too.

兼任.zh: 除了教学，他还兼任班主任。
兼任.en: Besides teaching, he also serves as the homeroom teacher.

兼任.zh: 因为她能力很强，所以公司让她兼任项目经理。
兼任.en: Because she is very capable, the company let her also serve as project manager.

兼任.zh: 他兼任会计和出纳，不太合适。
兼任.en: It's not really appropriate for him to be both the accountant and the cashier.

兼任.zh: 这个职务由总经理兼任。
兼任.en: This position is concurrently held by the general manager.

差额.zh: 报名人数和录取人数差额很大。
差额.en: There's a big gap between the number of applicants and the number admitted.

差额.zh: 如果差额补不上，这个活动就得取消。
差额.en: If the deficit can't be made up, this event will have to be canceled.

差额.zh: 这次选举的差额比例是百分之二十。
差额.en: The margin ratio for this election is twenty percent.

差额.zh: 我们需要先支付定金，剩下的差额再分期付。
差额.en: We need to pay a deposit first, and pay the remaining balance in installments.

食宿.en: The company provides food and lodging.

食宿.zh: 这次出差，食宿都由对方负责。
食宿.en: For this business trip, the other party is responsible for food and lodging.

食宿.zh: 除了工资，还包食宿，福利不错。
食宿.en: Besides salary, it also includes food and lodging; the benefits are pretty good.

食宿.zh: 学校为留学生安排食宿。
食宿.en: The school arranges food and lodging for international students.

食宿.zh: 旅游团费用里包含了食宿。
食宿.en: The tour package fee includes food and lodging.

要强.zh: 他从小就非常要强，什么都要争第一。
要强.en: He has been very ambitious since childhood; he always wants to be number one.

要强.zh: 虽然身体不好，但他还是很要强，不肯休息。
要强.en: Although his health is poor, he is still very determined and refuses to rest.

要强.zh: 太要强了也不好，有时候会累坏自己。
要强.en: Being too strong-willed isn't good either; sometimes it can wear you out.

要强.zh: 你太要强了，偶尔示弱也没关系。
要强.en: You're too competitive; it's okay to show weakness once in a while.

逊色.zh: 他的画比我的逊色多了。
逊色.en: His painting is far inferior to mine.

逊色.zh: 虽然她唱得不错，但和专业歌手一比还是有点逊色。
逊色.en: Although she sings well, she still falls a bit short compared to professional singers.

逊色.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道很好，但服务就逊色一些。
逊色.en: The food at this restaurant is great, but the service is somewhat lacking.

逊色.zh: 新款手机的性能很强大，旧款就显得逊色了。
逊色.en: The new phone's performance is very powerful, making the old model look inferior.

逊色.zh: 他的英语口语很流利，但写作方面就逊色不少。
逊色.en: His spoken English is fluent, but he is much weaker in writing.

敌视.zh: 他总是一副敌视的态度。
敌视.en: He always has a hostile attitude.

敌视.zh: 两国之间不应互相敌视，而应加强合作。
敌视.en: The two countries should not be hostile to each other, but should strengthen cooperation.

敌视.zh: 她对新同事没有敌视，反而很友好。
敌视.en: She doesn't feel hostile towards the new colleague; instead, she's very friendly.

敌视.zh: 如果你用敌视的眼光看别人，别人也会同样对你。
敌视.en: If you look at others with hostility, they will treat you the same way.

敌视.zh: 虽然他们竞争激烈，但彼此并没有敌视的情绪。
敌视.en: Although they are in fierce competition, there is no hostility between them.

出丑.zh: 他喝多了，在聚会上出丑了。
出丑.en: He drank too much and made a fool of himself at the party.

出丑.zh: 我不想在大家面前出丑，所以提前准备了。
出丑.en: I don't want to embarrass myself in front of everyone, so I prepared in advance.

出丑.zh: 别开这种玩笑，会让他当众出丑的。
出丑.en: Don't make that kind of joke; it will embarrass him in public.

出丑.zh: 他本想表现自己，结果反而出丑了。
出丑.en: He wanted to show off, but ended up embarrassing himself instead.

野餐.zh: 周末我们去公园野餐吧。
野餐.en: Let's go for a picnic in the park this weekend.

野餐.zh: 今天的天气很适合野餐。
野餐.en: Today's weather is perfect for a picnic.

野餐.zh: 他们带了水果和三明治去河边野餐。
野餐.en: They brought fruits and sandwiches for a picnic by the river.

野餐.zh: 野餐时别忘了带防蚊喷雾。
野餐.en: Don't forget to bring mosquito repellent when going for a picnic.

野餐.zh: 我们计划在山顶野餐，但突然下起了雨。
野餐.en: We planned to have a picnic on the hilltop, but it suddenly started raining.

着力.zh: 他着力改善公司的服务质量。
着力.en: He is focusing on improving the company's service quality.

着力.zh: 政府着力解决环境污染问题。
着力.en: The government is putting effort into solving environmental pollution.

着力.zh: 这篇报道着力描写了灾区的情况。
着力.en: This report focuses on describing the situation in the disaster area.

着力.zh: 他们团队着力研发新技术，取得了突破。
着力.en: Their team concentrated on developing new technology and achieved a breakthrough.

着力.zh: 不要处处着力，先集中做好一件事。
着力.en: Don't try to put effort everywhere; first focus on doing one thing well.

笨重.en: This box is too heavy and bulky.

笨重.zh: 老式电脑非常笨重，携带很不方便。
笨重.en: Old-fashioned computers are very bulky and inconvenient to carry.

笨重.zh: 虽然这件家具看起来很笨重，但其实很结实。
笨重.en: Although this piece of furniture looks clunky, it is actually very sturdy.

笨重.zh: 他穿着一双笨重的靴子，走路很慢。
笨重.en: He was wearing heavy boots and walked very slowly.

笨重.zh: 搬家时最麻烦的就是那些笨重的家电。
笨重.en: The most troublesome things when moving are those bulky appliances.

起哄.en: Stop making a ruckus; let him finish speaking.

起哄.zh: 同学们在旁边起哄，让他表演节目。
起哄.en: The classmates were ragging him on the side, asking him to perform.

起哄.zh: 他一唱歌，底下就有人起哄。
起哄.en: As soon as he started singing, some people in the audience started jeering.

起哄.zh: 大家不要起哄，这样很不尊重人。
起哄.en: Everyone, don't heckle; this is very disrespectful.

起哄.zh: 看到有人吵架，有些人不但不劝，反而在旁边起哄。
起哄.en: When they saw people arguing, instead of mediating, some even jeered on the sidelines.

纲领.zh: 这个政党提出了新的行动纲领。
纲领.en: This political party proposed a new action program.

纲领.zh: 公司的纲领明确了未来的发展方向。
纲领.en: The company's guiding principles clarify the future direction of development.

纲领.zh: 我们需要一个详细的纲领来指导工作。
纲领.en: We need a detailed platform to guide the work.

纲领.zh: 这份纲领涵盖了经济、教育等多个领域。
纲领.en: This outline covers multiple fields such as economy and education.

纲领.zh: 纲领虽然简单，但执行起来并不容易。
纲领.en: Although the program is simple, it is not easy to implement.

归根到底.en: In the final analysis, health is the most important.

归根到底.zh: 他为什么生气？归根到底还是因为你不尊重他。
归根到底.en: Why is he angry? Ultimately, it's because you don't respect him.

归根到底.zh: 学习方法有很多，但归根到底要靠自己努力。
归根到底.en: There are many learning methods, but in the end, it comes down to your own effort.

归根到底.zh: 这个问题虽然复杂，但归根到底就是一个选择问题。
归根到底.en: Although this problem is complicated, at bottom it is a matter of choice.

归根到底.zh: 我们争论了半天，归根到底就是钱的问题。
归根到底.en: We argued for a long time, but fundamentally it's a money issue.

耗时.zh: 写论文太耗时了，我花了整整一个月。
耗时.en: Writing a thesis is too time-consuming; I spent a whole month on it.

耗时.zh: 做家务很耗时，但也没办法。
耗时.en: Doing housework is time-consuming, but there's no way around it.

耗时.zh: 这个软件能帮我们节省耗时的工作。
耗时.en: This software can help us save time-consuming work.

耗时.zh: 虽然过程很耗时，但结果令人满意。
耗时.en: Although the process was time-consuming, the result was satisfactory.

空想.en: Don't just daydream all day, take action.

空想.zh: 光有空想没有计划，很难实现目标。
空想.en: Just having fantasies without a plan makes it hard to achieve goals.

空想.zh: 他总是在空想，却从不付出努力。
空想.en: He always daydreams but never puts in effort.

空想.zh: 如果你只是空想而不去尝试，那你永远都不会知道结果。
空想.en: If you only fantasize without trying, you'll never know the result.

立功.zh: 因为他在项目中立功，所以得到了晋升。
立功.en: Because he made contributions in the project, he got a promotion.
Everyone wants to make contributions and receive awards.

珍稀.zh: 大熊猫是中国的珍稀动物，需要保护。
珍稀.en: Giant pandas are rare animals in China and need protection.

珍稀.zh: 虽然这种药材很珍稀，但它的疗效确实很好。
珍稀.en: Although this medicinal herb is rare, its efficacy is indeed very good.

珍稀.zh: 我们需要采取措施来保护这些珍稀的自然资源。
珍稀.en: We need to take measures to protect these rare natural resources.

眼红.zh: 他看到别人成功就眼红。
眼红.en: He gets jealous when he sees others succeed.

眼红.zh: 别眼红别人的成绩，自己努力才是关键。
眼红.en: Don't envy others' achievements; your own effort is key.

眼红.zh: 虽然我有点眼红他的好运气，但我还是真心祝福他。
眼红.en: Although I'm a bit envious of his good luck, I still sincerely wish him well.
She envies her friend's new bag.

眼红.zh: 大家眼红他的高收入，却没看到他背后的辛苦。
眼红.en: Everyone envies his high income, but doesn't see the hard work behind it.

遗愿.zh: 他临终前留下了一个遗愿，希望家人能帮他实现。
遗愿.en: Before he died, he left a last wish, hoping his family could help him realize it.

遗愿.zh: 为了实现奶奶的遗愿，我们全家一起去了她的故乡。
遗愿.en: To fulfill grandma's last wish, our whole family went to her hometown together.
Her last wish is to donate organs.

遗愿.zh: 他花了十年时间，终于完成了祖父的遗愿。
遗愿.en: He spent ten years and finally fulfilled his grandfather's last wish.

下调.en: The bank lowered the interest rate.

下调.zh: 由于需求减少，公司决定下调产品价格。
下调.en: Due to decreased demand, the company decided to lower product prices.

下调.zh: 虽然油价下调了，但生活成本依然很高。
下调.en: Although oil prices have been lowered, the cost of living is still high.
This year's tuition has not been reduced.

下调.zh: 政府宣布下调部分商品的进口关税。
下调.en: The government announced a reduction in import tariffs on some goods.

野营.zh: 他们计划在湖边野营，顺便钓鱼。
野营.en: They plan to camp by the lake and also go fishing.

野营.zh: 因为天气不好，我们取消了这次野营活动。
野营.en: Because the weather was bad, we canceled this camping trip.

野营.zh: 第一次野营的时候，我什么都不懂，闹了很多笑话。
野营.en: When I first went camping, I knew nothing and made a lot of funny mistakes.

富足.zh: 虽然物质上很富足，但精神上却很空虚。
只要心态好，即使不富足也能过得开心。
富足.en: As long as you have a good attitude, you can be happy even if not affluent.

富足.zh: 这个地区资源富足，人们不需要为基本生活担忧。
富足.en: This region has abundant resources; people don't need to worry about basic living.

特例.zh: 一般情况下不允许请假，但今天算特例。
特例.en: Normally leave is not allowed, but today is a special case.

特例.zh: 因为他是残疾人，所以公司把他当作特例来处理。
特例.en: Because he is disabled, the company treated him as a special case.
Don't always use exceptions as an excuse.

特例.zh: 虽然规则很严格，但每个特例都有它的理由。
特例.en: Although the rules are strict, every special case has its reason.

共同体.en: Community with a shared future for mankind.

共同体.zh: 构建人类命运共同体是中国的倡议。
共同体.en: Building a community with a shared future for mankind is China's initiative.

共同体.zh: 在这个全球化的时代，各国都是命运共同体。
共同体.en: In this era of globalization, all countries are a community of shared destiny.

共同体.zh: 我们是一个利益共同体。
共同体.en: We are a community of shared interests.

共同体.zh: 要解决气候变化问题，全球需要形成一个真正的共同体。
共同体.en: To solve the climate change problem, the world needs to form a true community.

热泪盈眶.zh: 看到孩子成功，她热泪盈眶。
热泪盈眶.en: Seeing her child succeed, she was moved to tears.

热泪盈眶.zh: 他听到这个消息，不禁热泪盈眶。
热泪盈眶.en: He couldn't help but have tears in his eyes when he heard the news.

热泪盈眶.zh: 婚礼上父亲把女儿交给新郎时，热泪盈眶。
热泪盈眶.en: At the wedding, the father was teary-eyed when he gave his daughter away to the groom.

热泪盈眶.zh: 虽然她努力忍住，但最后还是热泪盈眶。
热泪盈眶.en: Although she tried hard to hold back, she ended up with tears in her eyes.

热泪盈眶.zh: 老兵重逢时，每个人都热泪盈眶，场面十分感人。
热泪盈眶.en: When the veterans reunited, everyone was in tears, and the scene was very touching.

挎.en: She went out with her bag on her arm.

挎.zh: 他肩上挎着一个大背包。
挎.en: He carried a large backpack over his shoulder.

挎.zh: 妈妈挎着菜篮子去市场买菜。
挎.en: Mom went to the market with a basket on her arm to buy groceries.

挎.zh: 那个女孩喜欢挎着男朋友的胳膊走路。
挎.en: That girl likes to walk arm in arm with her boyfriend.

挎.zh: 他左手挎着相机，右手拿着水杯。
挎.en: He carried a camera on his left arm and held a water bottle in his right hand.

半途而废.en: Don't give up halfway when learning something.

半途而废.zh: 他做什么事都容易半途而废。
半途而废.en: He tends to give up halfway in whatever he does.

半途而废.zh: 既然开始了，就别半途而废。
半途而废.en: Since you've started, don't quit halfway.

半途而废.zh: 这次健身计划他坚持了三个月，没有半途而废。
半途而废.en: This time he stuck with the fitness plan for three months and didn't give up halfway.

半途而废.zh: 虽然困难很多，但她并没有半途而废，最终成功了。
半途而废.en: Although there were many difficulties, she didn't give up halfway and finally succeeded.

熏陶.en: He grew up with an artistic influence.

熏陶.zh: 家庭熏陶对他影响很大。
熏陶.en: The family influence had a big impact on him.

熏陶.zh: 在老师的熏陶下，他爱上了读书。
熏陶.en: Under the teacher's influence, he fell in love with reading.

熏陶.zh: 音乐熏陶能培养孩子的审美能力。
熏陶.en: Musical influence can cultivate a child's aesthetic sense.

熏陶.zh: 她出生在一个书香门第，长期受文化熏陶，气质很好。
熏陶.en: She was born into a scholarly family, and after long-term cultural influence, she has a very refined temperament.

后顾之忧.en: The worries about the future have been resolved.

后顾之忧.zh: 他担心家里有后顾之忧。
后顾之忧.en: He is worried about having troubles at home.

后顾之忧.zh: 公司提供宿舍，员工没有后顾之忧。
后顾之忧.en: The company provides dormitories, so employees have no worries.

后顾之忧.zh: 政府帮我们解决了孩子的上学问题，再没有后顾之忧了。
后顾之忧.en: The government helped us solve the problem of our children's schooling, so there are no more worries.

后顾之忧.zh: 只要家人健康，他在外面工作就没有后顾之忧。
后顾之忧.en: As long as his family is healthy, he has no worries when working away from home.

埋没.zh: 在那个时代，很多天才被埋没了。
埋没.en: In that era, many geniuses were buried.

埋没.zh: 如果没人发现，他的能力可能会被埋没一辈子。
埋没.en: If no one discovers him, his abilities might be buried for a lifetime.

埋没.zh: 她不想让孩子们的梦想埋没在平凡的生活里。
埋没.en: She doesn't want her children's dreams to be buried in an ordinary life.

无不.zh: 听到这个消息，众人无不震惊。
无不.en: Upon hearing the news, everyone was shocked.

无不.zh: 他的演讲精彩极了，听众无不感动。
无不.en: His speech was so wonderful that every listener was moved.

无不.zh: 去过那里的人，无不赞叹风景之美。
无不.en: Everyone who has been there praises the beauty of the scenery.

无不.zh: 公司里上上下下，无不佩服她的能力。
无不.en: From top to bottom in the company, everyone admires her abilities.

拄.en: The old man walks with a cane.
He stood up leaning on the table.

拄.zh: 奶奶拄着我的手慢慢下楼。
拄.en: Grandma went downstairs slowly, leaning on my hand.

拄.zh: 他腿受伤了，只能拄着双拐移动。
拄.en: His leg was injured, so he could only move with crutches.

拄.zh: 爷爷虽然年纪大了，但拄着拐杖还能走很远。
拄.en: Although Grandpa is old, he can still walk a long way with a cane.

外贸.zh: 这家公司主营外贸业务。
外贸.en: This company mainly does foreign trade.

外贸.zh: 最近外贸订单减少了很多。
外贸.en: Recently, foreign trade orders have decreased a lot.

外贸.zh: 她大学学的是外贸专业，毕业后进了进出口公司。
外贸.en: She studied foreign trade in college and joined an import-export company after graduation.

外贸.zh: 因为汇率波动，外贸企业的利润受到了影响。
外贸.en: Due to exchange rate fluctuations, the profits of foreign trade companies have been affected.

根深蒂固.zh: 重男轻女的思想在农村根深蒂固。
根深蒂固.en: The idea of preferring sons over daughters is deeply ingrained in rural areas.

根深蒂固.zh: 他对家乡的偏见根深蒂固，很难改变。
根深蒂固.en: His prejudice against his hometown is deep-rooted and hard to change.

根深蒂固.zh: 虽然时代变了，但有些传统习惯依然根深蒂固。
根深蒂固.en: Although times have changed, some traditional customs are still deeply rooted.

根深蒂固.zh: 经过几代人的努力，这种落后的观念才不再根深蒂固。
根深蒂固.en: After the efforts of several generations, this backward concept is no longer deeply entrenched.

评论员.zh: 那位评论员说得很有道理。
虽然他只是个评论员，但分析很到位。
评论员.en: Although he is just a commentator, his analysis is very accurate.

评论员.zh: 体育评论员正在解说比赛。
评论员.en: The sports commentator is explaining the game.

评论员.zh: 很多评论员对这件事发表了看法。
评论员.en: Many commentators expressed their opinions on this matter.

评论员.zh: 我特别喜欢这个政治评论员的节目。
评论员.en: I really like this political commentator's show.

循序渐进.en: Learning should be step by step.

循序渐进.zh: 只要你循序渐进地练，肯定能进步。
循序渐进.en: As long as you practice step by step, you will definitely improve.

循序渐进.zh: 我们得循序渐进地推进这个项目。
循序渐进.en: We need to advance this project step by step.

循序渐进.zh: 老师教我们循序渐进地写作文。
循序渐进.en: The teacher taught us to write essays step by step.

循序渐进.zh: 减肥不能急，要循序渐进才健康。
循序渐进.en: You can't rush weight loss; it's healthy only if done step by step.

刹那.en: At that instant, he woke up.

刹那.zh: 车祸发生的刹那，他吓坏了。
刹那.en: The moment the accident happened, he was terrified.

刹那.zh: 虽然只是刹那的犹豫，却错过了机会。
刹那.en: Although it was just a moment of hesitation, he missed the opportunity.

刹那.zh: 烟花绽放的刹那，所有人都欢呼起来。
刹那.en: The instant the fireworks burst, everyone cheered.

刹那.zh: 那一刹那，我突然明白了她的意思。
刹那.en: In that instant, I suddenly understood what she meant.

公费.en: He went abroad at public expense.

公费.zh: 这次培训是公费的，你不用掏钱。
公费.en: This training is at public expense, you don't need to pay.

公费.zh: 公费旅游的机会可不多。
公费.en: Opportunities for publicly funded travel are rare.

公费.zh: 他考上了公费研究生，家里很高兴。
公费.en: He was admitted to a publicly funded graduate program, and his family was very happy.

公费.zh: 虽然这次出差是公费，但工作很辛苦。
公费.en: Although this business trip is at company expense, the work is very hard.

猎犬.en: This hunting dog is very smart.
The hunter went into the mountains with his hunting dog.

猎犬.zh: 猎犬的嗅觉比普通狗强很多。
猎犬.en: A hunting dog's sense of smell is much stronger than an ordinary dog's.

猎犬.zh: 他家养了两只猎犬，专门用来打猎。
猎犬.en: He keeps two hunting dogs at home, specifically for hunting.

猎犬.zh: 虽然猎犬很凶猛，但对主人很忠诚。
猎犬.en: Although hunting dogs are fierce, they are very loyal to their owners.

造价.en: The cost of building this bridge is very high.

造价.zh: 因为材料涨价，造价也提高了。
造价.en: Because materials have risen in price, the construction cost has also increased.

造价.zh: 这栋楼的造价超出预算好几倍。
造价.en: The construction cost of this building is several times over budget.

造价.zh: 他们正在计算新项目的造价。
造价.en: They are calculating the construction cost of the new project.

造价.zh: 虽然造价高，但质量有保障。
造价.en: Although the cost is high, the quality is guaranteed.

分寸.zh: 他做事很有分寸，不会过分。
分寸.en: He does things with a good sense of measure and never goes too far.
You also need to be mindful of boundaries when joking.

分寸.zh: 虽然你生气了，但说话还是得分寸。
分寸.en: Even if you are angry, you still need to watch your words.

分寸.zh: 她处理人际关系很有分寸，大家都喜欢她。
分寸.en: She handles interpersonal relationships with great tact, and everyone likes her.

忠贞.en: He is very faithful in love.

忠贞.zh: 即使在困难时，她也保持忠贞。
忠贞.en: Even in difficult times, she remained loyal.

忠贞.zh: 忠贞不渝的感情让人羡慕。
忠贞.en: A love that is unwavering in loyalty is enviable.

忠贞.zh: 他发誓会忠贞于自己的国家。
忠贞.en: He swore to be loyal to his country.

忠贞.zh: 虽然分离多年，他对妻子依然忠贞。
忠贞.en: Although separated for many years, he remained faithful to his wife.

污蔑.zh: 没有证据就不要污蔑别人。
他因为被人污蔑而丢了工作。
污蔑.en: He lost his job because he was slandered.

污蔑.zh: 那些谣言纯粹是污蔑，别相信。
污蔑.en: Those rumors are pure slander, don't believe them.

污蔑.zh: 我不想污蔑任何人，但事实就是如此。
污蔑.en: I don't want to slander anyone, but the facts are what they are.

谜语.en: This riddle is really hard to guess.

谜语.zh: 他说了一个谜语让大家猜。
谜语.en: He told a riddle for everyone to guess.

谜语.zh: 猜谜语能锻炼思维，很有意思。
谜语.en: Guessing riddles can exercise your mind and is very interesting.

谜语.zh: 虽然谜语很简单，但我还是没猜出来。
谜语.en: Although the riddle was simple, I still couldn't figure it out.

多功能.zh: 我家买了一个多功能沙发。
多功能.en: My family bought a multifunctional sofa.

多功能.zh: 这个厨房电器是多功能的，可以做很多菜。
多功能.en: This kitchen appliance is multifunctional, so it can cook many dishes.

多功能.zh: 因为是多功能打印机，所以能复印、扫描和传真。
多功能.en: Because it's a multifunctional printer, it can copy, scan, and fax.

苦笑.zh: 听到这个消息，他苦笑不语。
苦笑.en: Hearing this news, he smiled wryly and said nothing.

苦笑.zh: 面对失败，他苦笑一声，继续努力。
苦笑.en: Facing failure, he gave a bitter smile and kept trying.

苦笑.zh: 虽然输了比赛，他还是苦笑祝贺对方。
苦笑.en: Although he lost the game, he still smiled wryly and congratulated the opponent.

按理说.en: By rights, he should have arrived.
Logically, this matter is not hard to handle.

按理说.zh: 按理说他应该知道答案，但他却不知道。
按理说.en: Logically he should know the answer, but he doesn't.

按理说.zh: 按理说，这种错误不该犯，可还是发生了。
按理说.en: Logically, such a mistake shouldn't happen, yet it did.

休眠.zh: 这个软件在休眠状态耗电很少。
休眠.en: This software consumes very little power in sleep mode.

休眠.zh: 休眠功能可以帮我们省电。
休眠.en: The sleep function can help us save electricity.

休眠.zh: 当系统长时间不用，它会自动休眠。
休眠.en: When the system is not used for a long time, it will automatically go to sleep.

照例.en: In the morning, I as usual drink coffee.

照例.zh: 放学后，我们照例去球场打球。
照例.en: After school, we as usual went to the court to play ball.

照例.zh: 照例，他先检查了邮箱再开始工作。
照例.en: As usual, he checked his email before starting work.

照例.zh: 虽然今天是周末，他还是照例早起。
照例.en: Although it's the weekend, he still got up early as usual.

心安理得.en: I do things with a clear conscience.
He earned money, and felt at ease.

心安理得.zh: 只要没作弊，我就心安理得。
心安理得.en: As long as I didn't cheat, I feel clear conscience.

心安理得.zh: 他觉得自己没错，所以心安理得。
心安理得.en: He feels he was not wrong, so his conscience is clear.

心安理得.zh: 尽管别人批评他，他仍心安理得。
心安理得.en: Although others criticized him, he still felt at ease.

船舶.en: Many ships are docked at the port.

船舶.zh: 这些船舶都要定期检查。
船舶靠岸后，船员可以休息。
船舶.en: After the ship docks, the crew can rest.

船舶.zh: 因为风浪大，船舶延迟出发。
船舶.en: Because of high waves, the ship's departure was delayed.

船舶.zh: 船舶运输是国际贸易的重要方式。
船舶.en: Ship transportation is an important method of international trade.

衰弱.en: The old man is getting weaker.

衰弱.zh: 生病后，他的体力变得衰弱。
衰弱.en: After illness, his physical strength became weak.

衰弱.zh: 心脏衰弱会导致呼吸困难。
衰弱.en: A weak heart can cause breathing difficulty.

衰弱.zh: 尽管年纪大，他并不衰弱。
衰弱.en: Although old, he is not feeble.

不翼而飞.en: My phone disappeared without a trace.

不翼而飞.zh: 钱包放在桌上，却不见了，好像不翼而飞。
不翼而飞.en: The wallet was on the table, then gone, as if it vanished.

不翼而飞.zh: 他刚买的自行车，第二天就不翼而飞。
不翼而飞.en: His newly bought bicycle disappeared the next day.

不翼而飞.zh: 文件明明在这里，怎么就不翼而飞了？
不翼而飞.en: The file was clearly here, how did it disappear?

不翼而飞.zh: 放在抽屉里的钱，居然不翼而飞。
不翼而飞.en: The money in the drawer unexpectedly vanished.

免职.en: Because of corruption, he was dismissed.

免职.zh: 政府宣布免职多名官员。
免职.en: The government announced the dismissal of several officials.

免职.zh: 他工作失误，结果被免职了。
免职.en: He made a mistake at work, and as a result was dismissed.

无微不至.en: Mom takes care of me meticulously.

无微不至.zh: 他工作虽忙，但对家人照顾无微不至。
无微不至.en: He is busy with work, but his care for family is meticulous.

无微不至.zh: 这家酒店服务无微不至，连牙刷都准备了。
无微不至.en: The service at this hotel is meticulous, even providing toothbrushes.

无微不至.zh: 她对他无微不至，可他却不领情。
无微不至.en: She is meticulous in her care for him, but he doesn't appreciate it.

吹捧.en: He likes to boast about himself.

吹捧.zh: 他们一个劲儿吹捧领导，真让人受不了。
吹捧.en: They keep flattering the leader, it's really unbearable.

吹捧.zh: 网上很多人吹捧这部电影。
吹捧.en: Many people online are boosting this movie.

吹捧.zh: 他虽然被吹捧得很高，但实际能力一般。
吹捧.en: Although he is highly flattered, his actual ability is average.

篇幅.en: If it's too long, no one will read it.

篇幅.zh: 因为篇幅有限，我只写了几件事情。
篇幅.en: Due to limited space, I only wrote a few things.

篇幅.zh: 虽然篇幅不长，但内容很丰富。
篇幅.en: Although not long, the content is rich.

篇幅.zh: 这篇论文的篇幅比我预想的要长。
篇幅.en: The length of this paper is longer than I expected.

牵头.en: This event is led by him.

牵头.zh: 公司让我牵头这个新项目。
牵头.en: The company let me lead this new project.

牵头.zh: 虽然由他牵头，但大家都很配合。
这次合作由两家公司共同牵头。
牵头.en: This cooperation is jointly led by two companies.

表率.en: Teachers should be role models for students.

表率.zh: 父母是孩子最好的表率。
表率.en: Parents are the best role models for children.

表率.zh: 领导要以身作则，做大家的表率。
表率.en: Leaders should set an example and be a role model for everyone.

表率.zh: 他不但学习好，还是同学们的表率。
表率.en: He not only studies well but also is a role model for classmates.

徐徐.en: He slowly walked onto the stage.

徐徐.zh: 列车徐徐启动，驶离了车站。
徐徐.en: The train started slowly and left the station.

徐徐.zh: 随着音乐的响起，幕布徐徐拉开。
徐徐.en: With the music playing, the curtain slowly rises.

徐徐.zh: 夕阳徐徐落下，天空一片金黄。
徐徐.en: The setting sun slowly descends, the sky golden.

一晃.en: Ten years have passed in a flash.

一晃.zh: 一晃我来上海都三年了。
一晃.en: In a flash, I've been in Shanghai for three years.

一晃.zh: 小时候的事一晃就忘了。
一晃.en: Childhood things are forgotten in a flash.

一晃.zh: 虽然觉得没过多久，但一晃已经五年了。
一晃.en: Although it feels not long, five years have passed in a flash.

污秽.zh: 这些污秽的东西必须清理掉。
污秽.en: These filthy things must be cleaned out.

污秽.zh: 这里环境污秽，而且气味难闻。
污秽.en: The environment here is filthy and smells bad.

没辙.en: I really can't do anything about this matter.

没辙.zh: 没办法，我现在真的没辙了。
没辙.en: No way, I really have no idea now.

没辙.zh: 他试了很多方法，最后还是没辙。
没辙.en: He tried many methods, but finally had no way.

没辙.zh: 虽然想了各种办法，但最后还是没辙。
没辙.en: Although I thought of various ways, still no solution in the end.

秀丽.zh: 这座小城风景秀丽，吸引了很多游客。
秀丽.en: This small town has beautiful scenery, attracting many tourists.

秀丽.zh: 她长得非常秀丽，而且性格很好。
秀丽.en: She looks very beautiful and has a good personality.

秀丽.zh: 虽然风景秀丽，但游客太多了。
秀丽.en: Although the scenery is beautiful, there are too many tourists.

司空见惯.zh: 这种事我早就司空见惯了。
司空见惯.en: I've long been used to this kind of thing.

司空见惯.zh: 堵车在这里已经司空见惯，大家都习惯了。
司空见惯.en: Traffic jams are a common sight here, everyone's used to it.

司空见惯.zh: 他虽然觉得奇怪，但别人却司空见惯。
司空见惯.en: He found it strange, but others saw it as normal.

司空见惯.zh: 熬夜加班对我们来说真是司空见惯的事。
司空见惯.en: Working late nights is a common occurrence for us.

司空见惯.zh: 这种套路在娱乐圈司空见惯，没什么好惊讶的。
司空见惯.en: This kind of routine is common in the entertainment industry, nothing to be surprised about.

风风雨雨.zh: 我们一起经历了那么多风风雨雨。
风风雨雨.en: We've been through so many ups and downs together.

风风雨雨.zh: 风风雨雨几十年，他们还是那么恩爱。
风风雨雨.en: After decades of hardships, they are still so much in love.

风风雨雨.zh: 不管遇到什么风风雨雨，我都会陪着你。
风风雨雨.en: No matter what storms come, I'll be with you.

风风雨雨.zh: 这个公司能撑到今天，全靠大家共同面对风风雨雨。
风风雨雨.en: This company survived until today only because everyone faced the hardships together.

风风雨雨.zh: 人生总会有风风雨雨，重要的是保持乐观的心态。
风风雨雨.en: Life always has its ups and downs; the important thing is to stay optimistic.

耐用.zh: 他买的背包特别耐用，用了五年都没坏。
耐用.en: The backpack he bought is extremely durable; it's been five years and it's still not broken.

耐用.zh: 虽然不是新款，但这块手表非常耐用。
耐用.en: Although it's not a new model, this watch is very durable.

耐用.zh: 塑料餐具不如不锈钢的耐用，但便宜很多。
耐用.en: Plastic utensils aren't as durable as stainless steel ones, but they're much cheaper.

耐用.zh: 如果你想买一台耐用的冰箱，我推荐这个牌子。
耐用.en: If you want to buy a durable refrigerator, I recommend this brand.

内向.zh: 他小时候特别内向，见人就脸红。
内向.en: He was very introverted as a child and would blush when meeting people.

内向.zh: 虽然她看起来很内向，但其实很会聊天。
内向.en: Although she seems very introverted, she's actually good at chatting.

内向.zh: 内向的人往往更喜欢独处，不太爱参加聚会。
内向.en: Introverted people often prefer solitude and don't like attending parties much.

内向.zh: 别因为孩子内向就着急，每个人都有不同的性格。
内向.en: Don't rush just because your child is introverted; everyone has a different personality.

纵然.en: Even if you fail, don't give up.

纵然.zh: 纵然有千般困难，我们也得坚持下去。
纵然.en: Even if there are a thousand difficulties, we have to persevere.

纵然.zh: 他纵然再忙，也会抽空陪家人吃顿饭。
纵然.en: Even if he's very busy, he still makes time to have a meal with his family.

纵然.zh: 纵然你不喜欢这份工作，也该认真完成分内的事。
纵然.en: Even if you don't like this job, you should still finish your own tasks seriously.

纵然.zh: 纵然知道结果不好，我还是想试一试。
纵然.en: Even though I know the result might not be good, I still want to give it a try.

喜怒哀乐.zh: 人生有喜怒哀乐才完整。
喜怒哀乐.en: Life is complete only with joys and sorrows.

喜怒哀乐.zh: 他把所有的喜怒哀乐都写在日记里。
喜怒哀乐.en: He writes all his emotions in his diary.

喜怒哀乐.zh: 朋友就是能分享你喜怒哀乐的人。
喜怒哀乐.en: Friends are people who can share your joys and sorrows.

喜怒哀乐.zh: 音乐能表达出人类所有的喜怒哀乐。
喜怒哀乐.en: Music can express all of human emotions.

喜怒哀乐.zh: 这部电影拍得很真实，把普通人的喜怒哀乐都表现出来了。
喜怒哀乐.en: This film is very realistic; it portrays the joys and sorrows of ordinary people.

并行.en: These two roads are being built in parallel.

并行.zh: 学习与实践应该并行，才能进步更快。
并行.en: Learning and practice should go hand in hand to make faster progress.

并行.zh: 这个软件可以同时处理多个并行任务。
并行.en: This software can handle multiple parallel tasks at the same time.

并行.zh: 他们俩的观点并行不悖，没必要非争个对错。
并行.en: Their opinions run parallel without conflict; there's no need to argue about right or wrong.

并行.zh: 在高速公路上，车辆并行行驶容易出事故。
并行.en: Driving side by side on the highway can easily cause accidents.

骏马.en: There is a fine horse on the grassland.

骏马.zh: 他骑着一匹骏马飞驰而过。
骏马.en: He rode past on a magnificent horse.

骏马.zh: 这匹骏马在比赛中跑得最快。
骏马.en: This fine horse ran the fastest in the race.

骏马.zh: 古代将军都渴望拥有一匹千里骏马。
骏马.en: Ancient generals all longed to own a swift horse.

骏马.zh: 他画了一幅骏马图，栩栩如生。
骏马.en: He painted a picture of a fine horse, vivid and lifelike.

兴隆.en: This shop is doing very good business.

兴隆.zh: 祝您生意兴隆，财源广进！
兴隆.en: Wishing you prosperous business and abundant wealth!

兴隆.zh: 新开的火锅店每天排队，生意非常兴隆。
兴隆.en: The newly opened hotpot restaurant has queues every day; business is booming.

兴隆.zh: 虽然价格贵了点，但顾客依然很多，生意很是兴隆。
兴隆.en: Although the price is a bit high, there are still many customers, and business is very prosperous.

兴隆.zh: 这条街的商铺现在越来越兴隆，跟以前完全不一样了。
兴隆.en: The shops on this street are becoming more and more prosperous now, completely unlike before.

查获.en: The police seized a batch of counterfeit liquor.

查获.zh: 海关查获了大量走私物品。
查获.en: Customs seized a large amount of smuggled goods.

查获.zh: 这次行动查获了好几部被盗手机。
查获.en: This operation seized several stolen mobile phones.

查获.zh: 警方在仓库里查获了非法枪支。
查获.en: The police found illegal firearms in the warehouse.

查获.zh: 他们根据线报查获了一个制毒窝点。
查获.en: Based on a tip-off, they raided and seized a drug manufacturing site.

鉴赏.zh: 这幅画值得好好鉴赏一下。
鉴赏.en: This painting is worth appreciating carefully.

鉴赏.zh: 他请我鉴赏他新买的古董花瓶。
鉴赏.en: He asked me to appraise the antique vase he just bought.

鉴赏.zh: 因为我不懂书法，所以不敢随便鉴赏。
鉴赏.en: Since I don't understand calligraphy, I dare not casually critique it.

鉴赏.zh: 周末我们一起去博物馆鉴赏那些瓷器吧。
鉴赏.en: Let's go to the museum this weekend to appreciate those porcelains.

鉴赏.zh: 虽然我学过一点，但鉴赏古画还是需要很多经验。
鉴赏.en: Although I've studied a bit, appreciating ancient paintings still requires a lot of experience.

挂钩.en: Salaries should be linked to prices.

挂钩.zh: 这个挂钩很结实，可以挂大衣。
挂钩.en: This hook is very sturdy; you can hang a coat on it.

挂钩.zh: 房价跟地段挂钩，市中心当然贵很多。
挂钩.en: House prices are tied to location; the city center is naturally much more expensive.

挂钩.zh: 墙上有个挂钩，你把钥匙挂上去就行。
挂钩.en: There's a hook on the wall; just hang your keys on it.

挂钩.zh: 他们决定把奖金跟业绩直接挂钩，这样更公平。
挂钩.en: They decided to directly link bonuses to performance, which is fairer.

独立自主.en: She has been independent and self-reliant since childhood.

独立自主.zh: 这个国家一直坚持独立自主的外交政策。
独立自主.en: This country has always adhered to an independent foreign policy.

独立自主.zh: 独立自主的孩子往往更能面对困难。
独立自主.en: Children who are independent are often better able to face difficulties.

独立自主.zh: 我不想靠父母，我想独立自主地生活。
独立自主.en: I don't want to rely on my parents; I want to live independently.

独立自主.zh: 虽然公司给了很多支持，但他们还是希望团队能独立自主地做决定。
独立自主.en: Although the company gave a lot of support, they still hope the team can make decisions independently.

灼热.en: The sand in the desert is scorching hot.

灼热.zh: 他端着那杯烫茶，手指感到一阵灼热。
灼热.en: He held the hot tea and felt a burning heat on his fingers.

灼热.zh: 夏天太阳晒得路面灼热，连鞋底都快化了。
灼热.en: The summer sun makes the road so scorching that even the soles of shoes nearly melt.

灼热.zh: 因为火势太猛，隔着很远都能感觉到灼热的气浪。
灼热.en: Because the fire was so fierce, you could feel the scorching heat waves even from far away.

灼热.zh: 她看着他的目光中带着灼热的爱意，让人不敢直视。
灼热.en: Her gaze at him carried a burning love that made people dare not look directly.

壮烈.zh: 这部电影讲了一个壮烈的爱情故事。
壮烈.en: This movie tells a tragic and heroic love story.

壮烈.zh: 战士们用壮烈的方式保卫了家乡。
壮烈.en: The soldiers defended their homeland in a heroic and tragic way.

壮烈.zh: 虽然结局很壮烈，但他一点都不后悔。
壮烈.en: Although the ending was heroic and tragic, he had no regrets at all.

壮烈.zh: 历史上有很多壮烈的事迹值得我们永远记住。
壮烈.en: There are many heroic and tragic deeds in history that we should always remember.

微观.en: The microscopic world is very fascinating.

微观.zh: 这个研究是从微观层面分析市场。
微观.en: This study analyzes the market from a micro level.

微观.zh: 微观经济学和宏观经济学是两个不同的方向。
微观.en: Microeconomics and macroeconomics are two different fields.

微观.zh: 用显微镜才能看到这些微观的生物。
微观.en: You need a microscope to see these microscopic organisms.

微观.zh: 我们不能只关注宏观数据，也要看看微观的具体情况。
微观.en: We shouldn't only focus on macro data; we also need to look at the micro specifics.

过意不去.zh: 让你等我这么久，真过意不去。
过意不去.en: I feel really sorry for making you wait so long.

过意不去.zh: 他帮我搬了那么多东西，我心里很过意不去。
过意不去.en: He helped me carry so many things; I feel very apologetic.

过意不去.zh: 上次麻烦你太多次了，我一直觉得过意不去。
过意不去.en: I troubled you too many times last time, and I've been feeling guilty about it.

过意不去.zh: 你送这么贵的礼物，我真过意不去。
过意不去.en: You gave such an expensive gift; I really feel bad.

过意不去.zh: 因为是我不小心弄坏的，所以特别过意不去。
过意不去.en: Because I accidentally broke it, I feel especially sorry.

缆车.en: Let's take the cable car up the mountain.

缆车.zh: 这个景区的缆车排队要一个多小时。
缆车.en: The cable car line at this scenic spot takes over an hour.

缆车.zh: 下雪的时候坐缆车看风景特别美。
缆车.en: Taking the cable car to see the scenery when it snows is especially beautiful.

缆车.zh: 因为风太大，今天的缆车暂时停运了。
缆车.en: The cable car has been temporarily suspended today due to strong winds.

缆车.zh: 他们修建了一条新的缆车线路，方便游客上山。
缆车.en: They built a new cable car route to make it easier for tourists to go up the mountain.

嫁妆.zh: 她妈妈准备了很多嫁妆。
嫁妆.en: Her mother prepared a lot of dowry.

嫁妆.zh: 现在的嫁妆跟以前不一样了。
嫁妆.en: Dowry nowadays is different from before.

嫁妆.zh: 她家给的嫁妆包括一套房子和一辆车。
嫁妆.en: Her family's dowry includes a house and a car.

嫁妆.zh: 因为嫁妆的事，两家闹得不太愉快。
嫁妆.en: The two families had a bit of unpleasantness over the dowry.

嫁妆.zh: 有些地方还保留着送嫁妆的传统习俗。
嫁妆.en: Some places still keep the traditional custom of giving a dowry.

倾家荡产.en: He nearly lost everything from stock trading.

倾家荡产.zh: 那场火灾让他们倾家荡产。
倾家荡产.en: That fire cost them everything they had.

倾家荡产.zh: 为了治病，他几乎倾家荡产。
倾家荡产.en: He almost went bankrupt trying to get medical treatment.

倾家荡产.zh: 赌博的人最后往往倾家荡产。
倾家荡产.en: People who gamble often end up losing everything.

倾家荡产.zh: 他不听劝告，结果投资失败，搞得倾家荡产。
倾家荡产.en: He didn't listen to advice, and ended up bankrupt from a failed investment.

不亦乐乎.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他周末打游戏打得还不亦乐乎。
不亦乐乎.en: Although work is busy, he still plays games to his heart's content on weekends.

不亦乐乎.zh: 孩子们在公园里跑得不亦乐乎。
不亦乐乎.en: The children ran joyfully in the park.

不亦乐乎.zh: 因为赢了比赛，大家庆祝得不亦乐乎。
不亦乐乎.en: Because they won the match, everyone celebrated heartily.

不亦乐乎.zh: 她聊天聊得不亦乐乎，完全忘了时间。
不亦乐乎.en: She chatted away merrily, completely forgetting the time.

挨家挨户.en: The police asked door to door.

挨家挨户.zh: 推销员挨家挨户地卖东西，但很少有人买。
挨家挨户.en: Salesmen go door to door selling things, but few people buy.

挨家挨户.zh: 因为停电，工作人员挨家挨户通知居民。
挨家挨户.en: Because of the power outage, workers notified residents door to door.

挨家挨户.zh: 他挨家挨户送快递，累得不行。
挨家挨户.en: He delivered packages door to door, extremely tired.

挨家挨户.zh: 志愿者们挨家挨户宣传环保知识。
挨家挨户.en: Volunteers promote environmental knowledge door to door.

佳节.zh: 中秋佳节，我们全家团圆。
佳节.en: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, our whole family reunites.

佳节.zh: 重阳佳节，适合登高望远。
佳节.en: The Double Ninth Festival is suitable for climbing high and looking far.

佳节.zh: 春节期间，家家户户都庆祝佳节。
佳节.en: During the Spring Festival, every family celebrates the holiday.

佳节.zh: 虽然平时很忙，但佳节一定要回家看看。
佳节.en: Although usually busy, during festivals one must go home to visit.

佳节.zh: 端午佳节，大家都会吃粽子。
佳节.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, everyone eats zongzi.

松绑.en: The government loosens restrictions on enterprises.

松绑.zh: 新政策给中小企业松绑，让它们更容易发展。
松绑.en: New policies loosen restrictions on small and medium enterprises, making it easier for them to develop.

松绑.zh: 如果不想被束缚，就要学会给自己松绑。
松绑.en: If you don't want to be bound, you need to learn to unbind yourself.

松绑.zh: 市场改革给经济松绑，带来了活力。
松绑.en: Market reforms loosened restrictions on the economy, bringing vitality.

松绑.zh: 妈妈终于给孩子松绑，让他自己玩。
松绑.en: Mom finally untied the child, letting him play on his own.

伤脑筋.en: This problem is really a headache.

伤脑筋.zh: 怎么安排时间最合理，这件事让我很伤脑筋。
伤脑筋.en: How to arrange time most reasonably, this matter gives me a headache.

伤脑筋.zh: 因为预算有限，所以选址特别伤脑筋。
伤脑筋.en: Because the budget is limited, choosing the location is particularly troublesome.

伤脑筋.zh: 孩子不爱学习，父母很伤脑筋。
伤脑筋.en: Children don't like studying, parents are worried.

伤脑筋.zh: 电脑突然坏了，修起来很伤脑筋。
伤脑筋.en: The computer suddenly broke, fixing it is a headache.

月票.en: I bought a monthly subway pass.

月票.zh: 用月票坐公交比单次买票便宜很多。
月票.en: Using a monthly bus pass is much cheaper than buying single tickets.

月票.zh: 虽然月票价格不低，但每天通勤的话很划算。
月票.en: Although the monthly pass price is not low, it's cost-effective if commuting daily.

月票.zh: 他的月票过期了，需要重新充值。
月票.en: His monthly pass expired, needs to recharge.

月票.zh: 月票可以无限次乘坐，非常方便。
月票.en: The monthly pass allows unlimited rides, very convenient.

无精打采.zh: 因为昨晚没睡好，所以她一整天都无精打采。
无精打采.en: Because she didn't sleep well last night, she was listless all day.

无精打采.zh: 虽然天气很好，但他还是无精打采地坐在那里。
无精打采.en: Although the weather is nice, he still sits there listlessly.

无精打采.zh: 考试没考好，他无精打采地回了家。
无精打采.en: He didn't do well on the exam, so he went home listlessly.

无精打采.zh: 别总是无精打采的，出去运动一下。
无精打采.en: Don't always be listless, go out and exercise.

瓜分.zh: 几个大公司瓜分了市场份额，小企业很难生存。
瓜分.en: Several large companies carved up the market share, making it hard for small businesses to survive.

瓜分.zh: 因为利益冲突，他们决定瓜分这块地皮。
瓜分.en: Because of conflict of interest, they decided to carve up this piece of land.

瓜分.zh: 战争结束后，胜利国瓜分了战败国的领土。
瓜分.en: After the war, the victorious countries divided the territory of the defeated country.

瓜分.zh: 朋友几个瓜分了蛋糕，每人一块。
瓜分.en: A few friends divided the cake, each got a piece.

文人.zh: 古代文人常常聚在一起吟诗作对。
文人.en: Ancient literati often gathered to compose poems and couplets.

文人.zh: 虽然他是商人，但他也喜欢和文人交朋友。
文人.en: Although he is a businessman, he also likes to befriend literati.

文人.zh: 这次活动邀请了很多文人参加。
文人.en: This event invited many literati to participate.

文人.zh: 文人墨客都喜欢在西湖边寻找灵感。
文人.en: Literati and poets like to find inspiration by West Lake.

冗长.zh: 他的演讲冗长乏味，听众都快睡着了。
冗长.en: His speech was long and tedious, the audience almost fell asleep.

冗长.zh: 虽然内容很重要，但报告过于冗长，需要精简。
冗长.en: Although the content is important, the report is too lengthy and needs to be streamlined.

冗长.zh: 开会时最怕遇到冗长的发言。
冗长.en: In meetings, the most feared thing is encountering long-winded speeches.

冗长.zh: 这部电影节奏缓慢，情节冗长，不好看。
冗长.en: This film has a slow pace and long-winded plot, not good to watch.

红薯.en: Roasted sweet potatoes smell especially good in winter.
My mom made porridge with sweet potatoes.

红薯.zh: 红薯可以蒸着吃，也可以烤着吃。
红薯.en: Sweet potatoes can be steamed or roasted.

红薯.zh: 他小时候家里穷，经常只吃红薯。
红薯.en: When he was a child, his family was poor and often ate only sweet potatoes.

边远.en: That is a remote small town.
He teaches in a remote mountain area.

边远.zh: 这个边远村庄交通很不方便。
边远.en: This remote village has very inconvenient transportation.

边远.zh: 虽然边远，但那里的风景特别美。
边远.en: Although it's remote, the scenery there is especially beautiful.

边远.zh: 很多年轻人不愿意去边远地区工作。
边远.en: Many young people are unwilling to work in remote areas.

寓言.en: 'The Fox and the Grapes' is a fable.

寓言.zh: 这个寓言告诉我们不要自欺欺人。
寓言.en: This fable tells us not to deceive ourselves.

寓言.zh: 小时候妈妈经常给我讲寓言。
寓言.en: When I was little, my mom often told me fables.

寓言.zh: 每个寓言都有深刻的人生道理。
寓言.en: Every fable contains profound life lessons.

椭圆.zh: 她画了一个很标准的椭圆。
椭圆.en: She drew a very standard ellipse.

椭圆.zh: 椭圆形的桌子适合开会用。
椭圆.en: An oval table is suitable for meetings.

椭圆.zh: 我分不清椭圆和圆形有什么区别。
椭圆.en: I can't tell the difference between an ellipse and a circle.

爱不释手.en: I can't put this book down.
She can't put down her new phone.

爱不释手.zh: 这个小玩具孩子爱不释手。
爱不释手.en: The child can't let go of this little toy.

爱不释手.zh: 他送我的礼物我真是爱不释手。
爱不释手.en: I really can't put down the gift he gave me.

爱不释手.zh: 因为故事太精彩，我读得爱不释手。
爱不释手.en: Because the story was so exciting, I couldn't stop reading.

误区.en: Many people have misconceptions about weight loss.

误区.zh: 认为吃鸡蛋胆固醇高是一个误区。
误区.en: Thinking that eating eggs raises cholesterol is a misconception.

误区.zh: 我们要避免走入这个误区。
误区.en: We need to avoid falling into this misunderstanding.

误区.zh: 学习英语最大的误区就是只背单词不练口语。
误区.en: The biggest misconception in learning English is only memorizing words without practicing speaking.

气魄.en: He has great boldness in doing things.
A leader must have grand vision.
His speech was full of spirit.

气魄.zh: 长城的气魄让所有游客都感到震撼。
气魄.en: The imposing grandeur of the Great Wall amazes all visitors.

底子.en: She has a good foundation in English.
The base of this wall wasn't done well.
He has a solid foundation in math.
This base is thin and prone to cracking.

底子.zh: 因为底子好，她学新东西很快。
底子.en: Because she has a good foundation, she learns new things quickly.

摇摇欲坠.zh: 旧房子的屋顶摇摇欲坠。
摇摇欲坠.en: The roof of the old house is about to collapse.

摇摇欲坠.zh: 那个架子摇摇欲坠，快修理一下吧。
摇摇欲坠.en: That shelf is on the verge of falling; fix it quickly.

摇摇欲坠.zh: 他的身体太弱了，走路都摇摇欲坠。
摇摇欲坠.en: He is so weak that he totters when walking.

摇摇欲坠.zh: 经过暴风雨后，这棵大树已经摇摇欲坠了。
摇摇欲坠.en: After the storm, this big tree is ready to fall.

艳丽.en: Her dress is very bright and beautiful.
The flowers in spring bloom very gorgeously.
The peacock's feathers are extremely colorful.

艳丽.zh: 她喜欢穿颜色艳丽的外套。
艳丽.en: She likes to wear brightly colored coats.

艳丽.zh: 这幅画的色彩虽然艳丽，但不俗气。
艳丽.en: Although the colors of this painting are bright, they are not vulgar.

辛酸.zh: 想起这些辛酸的往事，我忍不住流泪。
辛酸.en: Thinking about these bitter memories, I couldn't help but cry.

辛酸.zh: 虽然生活辛酸，但他一直很坚强。
辛酸.en: Although life is bitter, he has always been strong.

辛酸.zh: 这部电影讲述了辛酸的家庭故事。
辛酸.en: This movie tells a poignant family story.

辛酸.zh: 每次提到那段辛酸的日子，他都沉默不语。
辛酸.en: Every time he talks about those bitter days, he falls silent.

海运.en: Sea freight is much cheaper than air freight.

海运.zh: 这批货物是通过海运从上海到汉堡的。
海运.en: This batch of goods was shipped by sea from Shanghai to Hamburg.

海运.zh: 因为海运时间长，我们得提前发货。
海运.en: Because sea shipping takes a long time, we have to ship early.

海运.zh: 他从事海运工作已经十年了。
海运.en: He has been working in the maritime shipping industry for ten years.

海运.zh: 最近海运价格涨了不少，让出口商很头疼。
海运.en: Recently, sea freight prices have risen a lot, giving exporters a headache.

一声不吭.en: He left without saying a word.

一声不吭.zh: 我问了好几次，他都是一声不吭。
一声不吭.en: I asked several times, but he remained silent.

一声不吭.zh: 面对指责，她一声不吭，只是低着头。
一声不吭.en: Faced with the accusation, she didn't say a word, just lowered her head.

一声不吭.zh: 他一声不吭地吃完饭，然后回房间了。
一声不吭.en: He ate his meal in silence and then went back to his room.

一声不吭.zh: 在会议上，他全程一声不吭，大家都觉得奇怪。
一声不吭.en: During the whole meeting, he didn't say a word, and everyone found it strange.

封顶.en: This building has already topped out.
The company has a cap on bonuses.

封顶.zh: 虽然房价有封顶政策，但还是很难买到房。
封顶.en: Although there is a price cap policy on housing, it's still hard to buy a house.

封顶.zh: 比赛报名人数封顶一百人。
封顶.en: The competition registration is capped at 100 people.

封顶.zh: 这款游戏等级封顶是六十级。
封顶.en: The level cap for this game is level 60.

长足.zh: 他的中文有了长足进步。
长足.en: His Chinese has made great progress.

长足.zh: 经过一年的训练，她的成绩取得了长足发展。
长足.en: After a year of training, her performance has achieved substantial development.

长足.zh: 随着科技发展，医疗技术有了长足提升。
长足.en: With the development of technology, medical technology has made great improvements.

长足.zh: 这个项目在短短三个月内就有了长足进展。
长足.en: This project made significant progress in just three months.

长足.zh: 虽然起步晚，但公司已经获得了长足进步。
长足.en: Although it started late, the company has already made great progress.

斟酌.zh: 我们需要仔细斟酌这个方案。
斟酌.en: We need to carefully deliberate on this plan.

斟酌.zh: 经过反复斟酌，他决定接受这份工作。
斟酌.en: After repeated deliberation, he decided to accept the job.

斟酌.zh: 发言之前，请先斟酌用词。
斟酌.en: Before speaking, please weigh your words.

斟酌.zh: 在做出最终决定前，他斟酌了所有可能的结果。
斟酌.en: Before making the final decision, he considered all possible outcomes.

功底.en: His calligraphy foundation is very solid.

功底.zh: 这位演员的台词功底非常扎实。
功底.en: This actor's line delivery skills are very solid.

功底.zh: 因为功底好，他学新东西很快。
功底.en: Because he has a good foundation, he learns new things quickly.

功底.zh: 练好基本功底是成为专业选手的第一步。
功底.en: Mastering the basic skills is the first step to becoming a professional.

功底.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但她的舞蹈功底依然出色。
功底.en: Although she is older, her dance foundation is still excellent.

盛产.zh: 这个地方盛产优质茶叶。
盛产.en: This place is rich in high-quality tea.

盛产.zh: 云南盛产鲜花，很多都出口到国外。
盛产.en: Yunnan abounds in flowers, many of which are exported abroad.

盛产.zh: 因为盛产石油，这个国家非常富裕。
盛产.en: Because it is rich in oil, this country is very wealthy.

盛产.zh: 这一带盛产水果，尤其是荔枝和龙眼。
盛产.en: This area is rich in fruits, especially lychee and longan.

退却.zh: 在敌人面前，他从未退却过。
退却.en: He never retreated in front of the enemy.

退却.zh: 虽然风险很大，但我们不能退却。
退却.en: Although the risk is great, we cannot retreat.

退却.zh: 看到对方人多，他有点退却了。
退却.en: Seeing that the other side had many people, he flinched a bit.

退却.zh: 面对压力，他选择了坚持而不是退却。
退却.en: Faced with pressure, he chose to persist rather than retreat.

凯歌.zh: 比赛结束时，他们高唱凯歌。
凯歌.en: At the end of the match, they sang songs of victory.

凯歌.zh: 胜利的凯歌响彻整个体育场。
凯歌.en: The victory song echoed throughout the stadium.

凯歌.zh: 在凯歌声中，我们迎来了新的冠军。
凯歌.en: Amid the victory songs, we welcomed the new champion.

凯歌.zh: 军队奏着凯歌回到了家乡。
凯歌.en: The army returned to their hometown playing victory songs.

凯歌.zh: 这次夺冠的凯歌，让所有队员激动不已。
凯歌.en: The victory song of this championship made all the team members extremely excited.

引人入胜.zh: 他的演讲引人入胜，大家都听得很认真。
引人入胜.en: His speech was fascinating, and everyone listened very attentively.

引人入胜.zh: 那个故事开头就引人入胜，让我一口气读完。
引人入胜.en: That story was captivating from the start, and I finished it in one go.

引人入胜.zh: 这部电影情节精彩，非常引人入胜。
引人入胜.en: This movie has a wonderful plot and is very engaging.

引人入胜.zh: 这个游戏的设计引人入胜，难怪这么多人玩。
引人入胜.en: The design of this game is so captivating, no wonder so many people play it.

凸显.en: The red color highlights her temperament.

凸显.zh: 这个设计凸显了产品的特点。
凸显.en: This design highlights the product's features.

凸显.zh: 在照片里，她的笑容凸显出来。
凸显.en: In the photo, her smile stands out.

凸显.zh: 这个矛盾凸显了问题的严重性。
凸显.en: This conflict highlights the seriousness of the problem.

凸显.zh: 新政策凸显了政府对环保的重视。
凸显.en: The new policy highlights the government's emphasis on environmental protection.

急功近利.en: You can't be too eager for quick success when doing things.

急功近利.zh: 他总是一副急功近利的样子。
急功近利.en: He always seems to be in a hurry for quick gains.

急功近利.zh: 急功近利的心态容易导致失败。
急功近利.en: A mindset of seeking quick success often leads to failure.

急功近利.zh: 很多公司急功近利，忽略了长远发展。
急功近利.en: Many companies are shortsighted and neglect long-term development.

急功近利.zh: 与其急功近利，不如脚踏实地慢慢来。
急功近利.en: Instead of being eager for quick success, it's better to be down-to-earth and take it slow.

铲子.en: He dug a hole with a shovel.
The shovel is in the garage.

铲子.zh: 我买了一把新铲子，用来铲雪。
铲子.en: I bought a new shovel to clear snow.

铲子.zh: 没有铲子，我们怎么挖土呢？
铲子.en: Without a shovel, how can we dig the soil?

商贩.en: There are many street vendors on the road.

商贩.zh: 商贩们一大早就开始摆摊。
商贩.en: Vendors start setting up their stalls early in the morning.

商贩.zh: 城管来了，商贩赶紧收摊。
商贩.en: The city inspectors came, and the vendors hurriedly packed up.

商贩.zh: 虽然商贩很辛苦，但收入还不错。
商贩.en: Although vendors work hard, their income is not bad.

以身作则.zh: 作为领导，他以身作则，从不迟到。
以身作则.en: As a leader, he leads by example and is never late.

以身作则.zh: 如果老师能够以身作则，学生也会跟着学。
以身作则.en: If teachers can set an example, students will follow suit.

以身作则.zh: 他以身作则，赢得了大家的尊重。
以身作则.en: He led by example and earned everyone's respect.

赤道.zh: 赤道附近的国家全年都很热。
赤道.en: Countries near the equator are hot all year round.

赤道.zh: 科学家在赤道附近做研究。
赤道.en: Scientists are doing research near the equator.

赤道.zh: 因为赤道地区阳光直射，所以气温很高。
赤道.en: Because the equatorial region receives direct sunlight, the temperature is very high.

丘陵.en: Hilly areas are suitable for growing tea.
The car is driving through the hills.

丘陵.zh: 我们翻过了一座丘陵，看到了村庄。
丘陵.en: We crossed a hill and saw a village.

丘陵.zh: 丘陵地形的道路弯弯曲曲，开车要小心。
丘陵.en: The roads in hilly terrain are winding, so drive carefully.

地势.zh: 这个城市地势很低，容易积水。
地势.en: This city has low terrain and is prone to flooding.

地势.zh: 因为地势险要，所以易守难攻。
地势.en: Because the terrain is strategically difficult, it is easy to defend and hard to attack.

地势.zh: 我们根据地势选择了露营的地点。
地势.en: We chose the camping spot based on the terrain.

要领.en: Have you grasped the key points?
The key to cooking is the heat control.

要领.zh: 学游泳的要领是放松身体。
要领.en: The key to learning to swim is relaxing the body.

要领.zh: 他很快就领悟了动作的要领。
要领.en: He quickly grasped the essentials of the movement.

要领.zh: 这本书把写作的要领讲得很清楚。
要领.en: This book explains the essentials of writing very clearly.

附和.zh: 他只会附和别人，没有主见。
附和.en: He just echoes others and has no opinions of his own.

附和.zh: 大家都同意，我也只好附和了一下。
附和.en: Everyone agreed, so I just went along with it.

附和.zh: 虽然我不同意，但为了不扫兴，还是附和了几句。
附和.en: Although I disagreed, I still chimed in with a few words so as not to spoil the fun.

附和.zh: 别总是附和老板，也要有自己的想法。
附和.en: Don't always parrot the boss; you should have your own ideas.

附和.zh: 她附和着笑了几声，其实心里很不以为然。
附和.en: She laughed along with them, but actually she didn't think so at all.

历代.en: Emperors of successive dynasties all lived here.

历代.zh: 这本书记录了历代名人的故事。
历代.en: This book records stories of famous people throughout the ages.

历代.zh: 历代文人墨客都喜欢游山玩水，留下许多诗篇。
历代.en: Literati of past generations loved to travel the mountains and waters, leaving behind many poems.

历代.zh: 历代传承下来的手艺不能丢。
历代.en: The crafts passed down through generations cannot be lost.

历代.zh: 虽然朝代更迭，历代的艺术品依然流传至今。
历代.en: Although dynasties changed, the artworks of successive eras still survive to this day.

外币.zh: 出国旅游要换一些外币。
外币.en: You need to exchange some foreign currency when traveling abroad.

外币.zh: 银行可以兑换各种外币。
外币.en: The bank can exchange various foreign currencies.

外币.zh: 他去美国前，特意换了两千美元的外币。
外币.en: Before going to the US, he specifically exchanged two thousand dollars' worth of foreign currency.

外币.zh: 外币汇率每天都在变化。
外币.en: Foreign exchange rates change every day.

外币.zh: 如果你有外币，可以去银行存起来。
外币.en: If you have foreign currency, you can deposit it at the bank.

发扬光大.zh: 我们要把传统文化发扬光大。
发扬光大.en: We must carry forward and promote traditional culture.

发扬光大.zh: 他努力把公司的创新精神发扬光大。
发扬光大.en: He strives to carry forward the company's innovative spirit.

发扬光大.zh: 这种优良作风应该在我们团队里发扬光大。
发扬光大.en: This fine work style should be promoted within our team.

发扬光大.zh: 只有不断学习，才能把技艺发扬光大。
发扬光大.en: Only by continuous learning can we develop and promote the craft.

发扬光大.zh: 她希望把家族的事业发扬光大，但谈何容易。
发扬光大.en: She hopes to expand the family business, but that's easier said than done.

失传.en: This skill has already been lost.

失传.zh: 很多古老的配方都失传了。
失传.en: Many ancient recipes have been lost.

失传.zh: 由于没有人继承，这项技艺面临失传的危险。
失传.en: Because no one has inherited it, this craft is in danger of being lost.

失传.zh: 失传的技术很难再复原。
失传.en: Lost techniques are very hard to restore.

失传.zh: 虽然有些传统已经失传，但我们可以通过记录保留历史。
失传.en: Although some traditions have been lost, we can preserve history through records.

无足轻重.zh: 这件事无足轻重，别担心。
无足轻重.en: This matter is insignificant, don't worry.

无足轻重.zh: 他在团队里只是个无足轻重的小角色。
无足轻重.en: He is just an insignificant minor figure in the team.

无足轻重.zh: 虽然他的话听起来无足轻重，但仔细想想很有道理。
无足轻重.en: Although his words sound trivial, they make a lot of sense when you think about it.

无足轻重.zh: 别把那些无足轻重的细节看得太重。
无足轻重.en: Don't take those insignificant details too seriously.

无足轻重.zh: 对于大局来说，这点失误无足轻重。
无足轻重.en: For the bigger picture, this mistake is of no importance.

订立.zh: 双方订立了友好合作协议。
订立.en: The two parties concluded a friendly cooperation agreement.

订立.zh: 在开始合作前，我们先要订立明确的规则。
订立.en: Before starting cooperation, we need to set clear rules.

订立.zh: 他们订立了婚约，准备明年结婚。
订立.en: They got engaged, planning to marry next year.

订立.zh: 经过协商，双方订立了新的条款。
订立.en: After negotiation, the two parties established new terms.

味精.en: Use a bit less MSG when cooking.

味精.zh: 很多人觉得味精对身体不好。
味精.en: Many people think MSG is bad for health.

味精.zh: 他炒菜时总会加一点味精提鲜。
味精.en: He always adds a little MSG when stir-frying to enhance the flavor.

味精.zh: 这种汤没有放味精，味道也很鲜。
味精.en: This soup has no MSG, but it still tastes very fresh.

味精.zh: 虽然味精能增加鲜味，但也不要过量使用。
味精.en: Although MSG can enhance umami, don't use too much of it.

亏本.en: This business deal ended up losing money.

亏本.zh: 他们因为管理不善而亏本。
亏本.en: They lost money due to poor management.

亏本.zh: 如果价格再降，我们就要亏本卖了。
亏本.en: If the price drops further, we'll have to sell at a loss.

亏本.zh: 做亏本的买卖谁都不愿意。
亏本.en: Nobody wants to do a losing business.

亏本.zh: 他不想亏本，所以提高了售价。
亏本.en: He didn't want to lose money, so he raised the selling price.

两口子.en: The two of them have a very good relationship as a couple.
The couple next door are quarreling again.

两口子.zh: 我们两口子周末喜欢一起去爬山。
两口子.en: My spouse and I like to go hiking together on weekends.

两口子.zh: 两口子过日子要互相体谅。
两口子.en: A couple should be considerate of each other in daily life.

两口子.zh: 他们两口子开了一家小店，生意不错。
两口子.en: The couple runs a small shop, and business is pretty good.

合作社.zh: 我们村新开了一家合作社。
合作社.en: A new cooperative opened in our village.

合作社.zh: 合作社的成员大家一起分红。
合作社.en: The cooperative's members share dividends together.

合作社.zh: 因为加入了合作社，农民的收入更稳定了。
合作社.en: Because they joined the cooperative, the farmers' income is more stable.

合作社.zh: 这家合作社专门帮小农户卖农产品。
合作社.en: This cooperative specializes in helping small farmers sell agricultural products.

合作社.zh: 镇上好几家合作社都联合起来办了一个展销会。
合作社.en: Several cooperatives in the town joined forces to hold a trade fair.

竹竿.zh: 他用竹竿打树上的果子。
竹竿.en: He used a bamboo pole to knock down the fruit from the tree.

竹竿.zh: 这根竹竿太短了，够不着。
竹竿.en: This bamboo pole is too short to reach.

竹竿.zh: 爷爷拿竹竿晾衣服，结果断了。
竹竿.en: Grandpa used a bamboo pole to hang clothes, but it broke.

竹竿.zh: 我们拿几根竹竿搭了个架子种豆角。
竹竿.en: We used a few bamboo poles to build a trellis for growing beans.

竹竿.zh: 虽然竹竿看着细，但其实挺结实的。
竹竿.en: Although the bamboo pole looks thin, it's actually quite sturdy.

纬度.en: This city is at a high latitude.

纬度.zh: 不同纬度的气候差别很大。
纬度.en: Climates vary greatly at different latitudes.

纬度.zh: 你能在地图上标出这个地区的纬度吗？
纬度.en: Can you mark the latitude of this region on the map?

纬度.zh: 因为纬度低，这里全年都很热。
纬度.en: Because of the low latitude, it's hot here all year round.

纬度.zh: 飞机飞行时要考虑纬度和经度的变化。
纬度.en: When flying, the aircraft must consider changes in latitude and longitude.

勾画.zh: 你先勾画一个大概的轮廓。
勾画.en: First, sketch out a rough outline.

勾画.zh: 他几句话就勾画出了未来城市的模样。
勾画.en: He sketched the future city in just a few words.

勾画.zh: 老师让我们用线条勾画出小动物的外形。
勾画.en: The teacher asked us to outline the shape of a small animal with lines.

勾画.zh: 这篇文章勾画了主人公从贫穷到富有的经历。
勾画.en: This article outlines the protagonist's journey from poverty to wealth.

勾画.zh: 他只用了一分钟就勾画出一张人脸，真的很厉害。
勾画.en: He sketched a human face in just one minute, which is really impressive.

换言之.zh: 他不喜欢，换言之，他拒绝了。
换言之.en: He doesn't like it; in other words, he refused.

换言之.zh: 你需要更多练习，换言之就是还不够熟练。
换言之.en: You need more practice; in other words, you're not yet proficient enough.

换言之.zh: 他迟到了半小时，换言之他不重视这次会议。
换言之.en: He was half an hour late, in other words, he doesn't take this meeting seriously.

换言之.zh: 这个方案成本太高，换言之我们负担不起。
换言之.en: This plan costs too much; in other words, we can't afford it.

换言之.zh: 他说他忙，换言之他不想帮忙。
换言之.en: He said he was busy; in other words, he didn't want to help.

胸有成竹.en: He was confident before the exam.

胸有成竹.zh: 别担心，我对这事胸有成竹。
胸有成竹.en: Don't worry, I'm confident about this matter.

胸有成竹.zh: 她胸有成竹地回答了所有问题。
胸有成竹.en: She answered all the questions with confidence.

胸有成竹.zh: 虽然对手很强，但他看起来胸有成竹。
胸有成竹.en: Although the opponent was strong, he looked very confident.

胸有成竹.zh: 准备了一个月，他现在胸有成竹地来面试了。
胸有成竹.en: After preparing for a month, he came to the interview with full confidence.

居高临下.zh: 从山顶居高临下看风景很美。
居高临下.en: Looking down from the mountaintop, the scenery is beautiful.

居高临下.zh: 他那种居高临下的态度让人很不舒服。
居高临下.en: His condescending attitude makes people very uncomfortable.

居高临下.zh: 敌人居高临下，我们进攻很困难。
居高临下.en: The enemy had the high ground, making our attack very difficult.

居高临下.zh: 别这么居高临下地跟我说话，我们是平等的。
居高临下.en: Don't talk to me so condescendingly; we are equals.

铺路.en: They are paving the road in the village.

铺路.zh: 这份工作为他以后创业铺路。
铺路.en: This job paves the way for his future entrepreneurship.

铺路.zh: 政府拨款为偏远山区铺路修桥。
铺路.en: The government allocated funds to pave roads and build bridges in remote mountainous areas.

铺路.zh: 他努力学习，为考上好大学铺路。
铺路.en: He studies hard to pave the way for getting into a good university.

胜出.zh: 经过三轮淘汰，只有一个人能胜出。
胜出.en: After three rounds of elimination, only one person can emerge victorious.

胜出.zh: 这次演讲比赛，小李胜出了。
胜出.en: Xiao Li won the speech contest this time.

胜出.zh: 虽然对手很强，但我们队还是胜出了。
胜出.en: Although the opponent was strong, our team still won.

老汉.en: That old man is selling vegetables by the roadside.

老汉.zh: 一位老汉牵着牛慢慢走过。
老汉.en: An old man led a cow walking slowly by.

老汉.zh: 老汉今年七十多了，身体还很硬朗。
老汉.en: The old man is over seventy this year, but he's still very robust.

老汉.zh: 村里的老汉们经常坐在一起下棋聊天。
老汉.en: The old men in the village often sit together playing chess and chatting.

老汉.zh: 那个满脸皱纹的老汉，是我小时候的邻居。
老汉.en: That old man with a wrinkled face was my neighbor when I was a child.

疏导.zh: 交通堵塞需要警察疏导。
疏导.en: Traffic jams need police to direct traffic.

疏导.zh: 她情绪不好，我花了一小时疏导她。
疏导.en: She was in a bad mood, I spent an hour calming her down.

疏导.zh: 这条河被疏导后，两岸的农田不再受淹。
疏导.en: After the river was dredged, the farmlands on both sides were no longer flooded.

疏导.zh: 心理医生帮她疏导了多年的压力，她现在轻松多了。
疏导.en: The psychologist helped her relieve years of stress, and she feels much lighter now.

疏导.zh: 如果你觉得心里憋得慌，找朋友聊聊天也能疏导一下。
疏导.en: If you feel stifled, chatting with a friend can also help you vent.

指南针.zh: 野外探险记得带上指南针。
指南针.en: Remember to bring a compass when exploring the wilderness.

指南针.zh: 手机没电了，还好我随身带了指南针。
指南针.en: My phone died, but luckily I had a compass with me.

指南针.zh: 在沙漠里没有指南针很容易迷路。
指南针.en: In the desert, it's easy to get lost without a compass.

指南针.zh: 古代的指南针是中国四大发明之一。
指南针.en: The ancient compass is one of China's four great inventions.

指南针.zh: 人生就像航海，理想就是我们的指南针。
指南针.en: Life is like sailing, and our ideals are the compass.

收复.en: The army successfully regained the lost territory.

收复.zh: 经过激烈战斗，他们终于收复了那座城市。
收复.en: After fierce fighting, they finally recaptured the city.

收复.zh: 政府计划用外交手段收复争议岛屿。
收复.en: The government plans to recover the disputed islands through diplomatic means.

收复.zh: 他觉得自己被裁员是暂时的，总有一天要收复自己的职位。
收复.en: He feels his layoff is temporary and one day he will reclaim his position.

收复.zh: 只要大家团结一心，我们一定能收复被侵占的土地。
收复.en: As long as we are united, we will surely recover the occupied land.

伯母.en: My aunt (father's elder brother's wife) cooks really well.

伯母.zh: 每年春节我都去伯母家拜年。
伯母.en: Every Spring Festival I go to my aunt's house for New Year's greetings.

伯母.zh: 伯母退休后爱上了跳广场舞。
伯母.en: After retiring, my aunt fell in love with square dancing.

伯母.zh: 我小时候伯母经常给我讲故事，我很喜欢她。
伯母.en: When I was little, my aunt often told me stories, and I really liked her.

串门.en: Neighbors often come over to visit.

串门.zh: 周末没事我就去朋友家串门聊天。
串门.en: On weekends, I go to friends' houses to chat and hang out.

串门.zh: 现在年轻人很少像以前那样随意串门了。
串门.en: Young people nowadays rarely drop by each other's homes as casually as before.

串门.zh: 她最喜欢串门，一有空就往别人家跑。
串门.en: She loves visiting people most; whenever she's free, she goes to someone's house.

串门.zh: 虽然我们住得近，但很久没串门了，该聚聚了。
串门.en: Although we live close, we haven't visited each other in a long time; we should get together.

触觉.en: Blind people have very sensitive touch.
This fabric feels very soft to the touch.

触觉.zh: 小孩子的触觉发育需要多接触不同材质。
触觉.en: Children's sense of touch needs to be developed by contact with different textures.

触觉.zh: 他通过触觉来判断硬币的真假。
触觉.en: He judges whether a coin is genuine by touch.

触觉.zh: 皮肤是人体最大的触觉器官。
触觉.en: The skin is the largest tactile organ of the human body.

伸缩.zh: 这根杆子可以自由伸缩。
伸缩.en: This pole can be extended and retracted freely.

伸缩.zh: 相机镜头能伸缩，拍照很方便。
伸缩.en: The camera lens can zoom in and out, making it convenient to take photos.

伸缩.zh: 这种桌子设计成可伸缩的，节省空间。
伸缩.en: This table is designed to be extendable, saving space.

伸缩.zh: 橡胶的特性就是弹性好，能伸缩。
伸缩.en: The characteristic of rubber is good elasticity; it can stretch and contract.

伸缩.zh: 他每天做拉伸运动，增加肌肉的伸缩能力。
伸缩.en: He does stretching exercises every day to increase muscle flexibility.

长征.zh: 红军长征走了两万五千里。
长征.en: The Red Army's Long March covered 25,000 li.

长征.zh: 爷爷经常给我们讲长征的故事。
长征.en: Grandpa often tells us stories about the Long March.

长征.zh: 长征精神激励了一代又一代中国人。
长征.en: The spirit of the Long March has inspired generations of Chinese people.

长征.zh: 虽然现在条件好了，但不能忘记长征的艰辛。
长征.en: Although conditions are better now, we must not forget the hardships of the Long March.

长征.zh: 我们计划来一次徒步长征，体验当年的艰辛。
长征.en: We plan to go on a hiking long march to experience the hardships of those days.

山川.en: China's mountains and rivers are magnificent.

山川.zh: 我喜欢画水墨画，尤其是山川题材。
山川.en: I like painting ink wash paintings, especially landscapes.

山川.zh: 徒步穿越这片山川需要很大的毅力。
山川.en: Hiking across these mountains and rivers requires great perseverance.

山川.zh: 站在山顶俯瞰，山川景色尽收眼底。
山川.en: Standing on the mountaintop, the scenery of mountains and rivers spreads out before your eyes.

山川.zh: 保护山川生态就是保护我们自己的家园。
山川.en: Protecting the ecology of mountains and rivers means protecting our own home.

养生.en: Young people also need to pay attention to health preservation.
Mom watches health programs every day.

养生.zh: 养生不是老年人的专利。
养生.en: Health preservation is not exclusive to the elderly.

养生.zh: 我最近开始研究养生，每天早睡早起。
养生.en: I've recently started studying health preservation, going to bed early and waking up early every day.

养生.zh: 中医养生讲究阴阳平衡，饮食有节。
养生.en: Traditional Chinese medicine health preservation emphasizes the balance of yin and yang and moderation in diet.

侧重.zh: 这个项目侧重用户体验。
我觉得你应该侧重练习写作，因为这是你的弱项。
侧重.en: I think you should focus on practicing writing, because it's your weak point.

侧重.zh: 虽然两个部分都重要，但课程更侧重实际操作。
侧重.en: Although both parts are important, the course emphasizes hands-on practice more.

挑拨.zh: 别挑拨我们之间的关系。

挑拨.en: He always likes to stir up trouble everywhere.

挑拨.zh: 她在中间挑拨，大家都不信她。
挑拨.en: She was sowing discord among us, and nobody believed her.

挑拨.zh: 那个人故意挑拨我和老板的矛盾，但我没上当。
挑拨.en: That person deliberately tried to create conflict between my boss and me, but I didn't fall for it.

挑拨.zh: 如果你继续这样挑拨离间，我们连朋友都没得做。
挑拨.en: If you keep sowing discord like this, we won't even be friends anymore.

拙劣.zh: 那种模仿十分拙劣，一眼就能看穿。
拙劣.en: That kind of imitation is very poor, and it's obvious at a glance.

拙劣.zh: 这个骗局设计得特别拙劣，根本没人信。
拙劣.en: This scam was designed so poorly that nobody believed it.

拙劣.zh: 虽然他的画画技术很拙劣，但那份心意还是让人感动。
拙劣.en: Although his painting skills are very crude, the thought behind it is still touching.

产值.en: This year's output value has grown rapidly.
This factory has a high output value.

产值.zh: 公司上半年的产值已经超过去年总和。
产值.en: The company's output value in the first half of the year has already surpassed last year's total.

产值.zh: 由于市场需求下降，这家企业的产值明显减少。
产值.en: Due to the decline in market demand, the output value of this enterprise has significantly decreased.

产值.zh: 虽然员工数量没变，但通过技术改进，产值翻了一倍。
产值.en: Although the number of employees hasn't changed, the output value has doubled through technological improvements.

深化.zh: 他们的合作关系深化了。

深化.en: Reforms need to be continuously deepened.

深化.zh: 通过这次对话，双方的了解进一步深化。
深化.en: Through this dialogue, the mutual understanding between the two sides has further deepened.

深化.zh: 公司计划深化与海外伙伴的合作，以开拓新市场。
深化.en: The company plans to deepen cooperation with overseas partners to explore new markets.

深化.zh: 这个课题还需要深化研究，才能得出可靠结论。
深化.en: This topic still needs further in-depth research before reliable conclusions can be drawn.

赡养.en: Supporting parents is a legal obligation.

赡养.zh: 他每个月都寄钱赡养老人。
赡养.en: He sends money every month to support the elderly.

赡养.zh: 很多年轻人觉得赡养压力很大。
赡养.en: Many young people feel that the pressure of supporting their parents is heavy.

赡养.zh: 虽然收入不高，她还是坚持赡养年迈的奶奶。
赡养.en: Although her income is low, she still insists on supporting her elderly grandmother.

赡养.zh: 子女不仅要在经济上赡养父母，也要多陪伴他们。
赡养.en: Children should not only financially support their parents but also spend more time with them.

深入人心.en: This concept is deeply rooted in people's hearts.

深入人心.zh: 环保理念已经深入人心。
