深入人心.en: The concept of environmental protection has already taken root in people's hearts.

深入人心.zh: 这部电影的角色塑造很成功，形象深入人心。
深入人心.en: The character development in this movie is very successful, and the images are deeply ingrained in people's minds.

深入人心.zh: 现在垃圾分类的知识越来越普及，环保意识深入人心。
深入人心.en: Now the knowledge of garbage sorting is becoming more widespread, and environmental awareness is deeply rooted in people's hearts.

深入人心.zh: 虽然那个广告创意很老，但它的口号却深入人心，大家都能背出来。
深入人心.en: Although that ad idea is very old, its slogan is deeply embedded in people's hearts, and everyone can recite it.

触目惊心.zh: 战争后的景象触目惊心。
触目惊心.en: The scene after the war was horrifying.

触目惊心.zh: 事故现场的画面触目惊心，让人久久无法平静。
触目惊心.en: The images from the accident scene were so shocking that it took a long time for people to calm down.

触目惊心.zh: 新闻报道里的污染情况触目惊心，大家都很担忧。
触目惊心.en: The pollution situation reported in the news was shocking, and everyone was very worried.

触目惊心.zh: 那部纪录片展示了触目惊心的现实，让我们不得不反思。
触目惊心.en: That documentary showed a shocking reality, forcing us to reflect.

阿拉伯语.zh: 他可以用阿拉伯语做简单的交流。
阿拉伯语.en: He can have simple conversations in Arabic.

阿拉伯语.zh: 我想看一部阿拉伯语的电影，但找不到字幕。
阿拉伯语.en: I want to watch a movie in Arabic, but I can't find subtitles.

阿拉伯语.zh: 因为工作需要，她最近开始认真学习阿拉伯语。
阿拉伯语.en: Because of work requirements, she recently started studying Arabic seriously.

孪生.zh: 这对孪生姐妹长得一模一样。
孪生.en: These twin sisters look exactly alike.

孪生.zh: 老师经常分不清那对孪生姐妹谁是谁。
孪生.en: The teacher often can't tell which is which between those twin sisters.

孪生.zh: 虽然他们是孪生兄弟，但性格完全相反。
孪生.en: Although they are twin brothers, their personalities are completely opposite.

孪生.zh: 那对孪生姐妹不仅长得像，连兴趣爱好都一样。
孪生.en: Those twin sisters not only look alike, but even their hobbies and interests are the same.

异想天开.zh: 你别异想天开了，这根本不可能。
异想天开.en: Stop being so fanciful; this is simply impossible.

异想天开.zh: 他总爱异想天开，觉得自己能一夜暴富。
异想天开.en: He always has wild ideas, thinking he can get rich overnight.

异想天开.zh: 虽然这个计划有点异想天开，但说不定能成功呢？
异想天开.en: Although this plan is a bit far-fetched, who knows if it might work?

异想天开.zh: 别整天异想天开了，先把眼前的工作做好吧。
异想天开.en: Stop daydreaming all day and get your current work done first.

异想天开.zh: 她提出的建议太异想天开，大家都不当真。
异想天开.en: Her suggestion was too fanciful; no one took it seriously.

晃荡.zh: 水桶晃荡了一下，洒出来不少。
晃荡.en: The bucket swayed a bit and spilled quite a lot.

晃荡.zh: 他每天在街上晃荡，也不去找工作。
晃荡.en: He wanders around the streets every day and doesn't look for a job.

晃荡.zh: 别在车上晃荡，小心摔着。
晃荡.en: Don't sway around on the bus; you might fall.

晃荡.zh: 酒杯里的酒晃荡得厉害，差点泼出来。
晃荡.en: The wine in the glass sloshed around violently, almost spilling.

晃荡.zh: 他晃荡着腿，一副悠闲的样子。
晃荡.en: He swung his legs around, looking completely carefree.

巴结.zh: 他总爱巴结老板，同事都不喜欢他。
巴结.en: He always tries to curry favor with the boss, and his colleagues don't like him.

巴结.zh: 别巴结我，我不吃这一套。
巴结.en: Don't try to flatter me; I'm not into that.

巴结.zh: 为了升职，他拼命巴结领导。
巴结.en: To get promoted, he desperately fawned over the leaders.

巴结.zh: 她从不巴结别人，靠自己的本事吃饭。
巴结.en: She never sucks up to others; she relies on her own abilities.

巴结.zh: 你越巴结他，他越看不起你。
巴结.en: The more you flatter him, the more he looks down on you.

与日俱增.zh: 我对他的信任与日俱增。
与日俱增.en: My trust in him grows day by day.

与日俱增.zh: 随着时间推移，他们的矛盾与日俱增。
与日俱增.en: As time goes on, their conflicts increase with each passing day.

与日俱增.zh: 这种压力与日俱增，让我快喘不过气了。
与日俱增.en: This pressure is growing day by day, and I'm almost out of breath.

与日俱增.zh: 她的人气在网络上与日俱增，粉丝越来越多。
与日俱增.en: Her popularity on the internet is increasing daily, with more and more fans.

与日俱增.zh: 他们之间的感情并没有变淡，反而与日俱增。
与日俱增.en: The feelings between them haven't faded; on the contrary, they've grown stronger each day.

韧性.zh: 这种材料的韧性很好，不容易断裂。
韧性.en: This material has great toughness and is not easy to break.

韧性.zh: 她虽然瘦小，但很有韧性，从不轻言放弃。
韧性.en: She's small and thin, but very resilient and never gives up easily.

韧性.zh: 创业需要韧性，否则很难坚持下去。
韧性.en: Starting a business requires tenacity; otherwise, it's hard to keep going.

韧性.zh: 这种面条韧性十足，嚼起来特别劲道。
韧性.en: These noodles are very chewy and have a great texture.

韧性.zh: 长期训练增加了他的心理韧性，遇事更冷静了。
韧性.en: Long-term training increased his mental resilience, making him calmer in the face of problems.

教条.zh: 做事别太教条，要灵活一点。
教条.en: Don't be too dogmatic; be a bit flexible.

教条.zh: 他总是一套教条，听都听烦了。
教条.en: He always spouts the same dogma; I'm tired of hearing it.

教条.zh: 这些教条早就过时了，没人再信了。
教条.en: These dogmas are long outdated; no one believes them anymore.

教条.zh: 他说话很教条，像在念课本一样。
教条.en: He speaks very dogmatically, as if reciting a textbook.

教条.zh: 不要盲目遵循教条，要根据实际情况判断。
教条.en: Don't blindly follow dogmas; judge based on the actual situation.

支流.zh: 主流文化之外，也有许多支流值得关注。
支流.en: Besides mainstream culture, there are many subcurrents worth paying attention to.

支流.zh: 我们沿着支流走，找到了一个安静的地方。
支流.en: We walked along the tributary and found a quiet spot.

支流.zh: 长江的支流众多，形成了庞大的水系。
支流.en: The Yangtze River has many tributaries, forming a vast water system.

支流.zh: 在学术讨论中，不要只关注主流，支流也可能带来启发。
支流.en: In academic discussions, don't only focus on the mainstream; tributaries might also bring inspiration.

哭笑不得.zh: 他的回答让我哭笑不得。
哭笑不得.en: His answer left me unsure whether to laugh or cry.

哭笑不得.zh: 看到孩子把脸画成这样，真是哭笑不得。
哭笑不得.en: Seeing the child's face painted like that, I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

哭笑不得.zh: 他讲了个冷笑话，全场人都哭笑不得。
哭笑不得.en: He told a lame joke, and everyone was left smiling helplessly.

哭笑不得.zh: 面对这种尴尬的局面，她只能哭笑不得。
哭笑不得.en: Faced with such an awkward situation, she could only give a wry smile.

哭笑不得.zh: 老板这个决定让人哭笑不得，不知道该怎么执行。
哭笑不得.en: The boss's decision was so absurd that it left us not knowing whether to laugh or cry about how to execute it.

心病.en: This matter has become a worry that preys on his mind.

心病.zh: 她总觉得自己有病，其实是心病。
心病.en: She always thinks she's sick, but it's actually a psychological issue.

心病.zh: 失恋后，她一直有心病，不敢再谈恋爱。
心病.en: After the breakup, she had a lingering sorrow and didn't dare to fall in love again.

心病.zh: 只有解开心病，才能真正快乐起来。
心病.en: Only by resolving that inner worry can one truly become happy.

心病.zh: 这个秘密藏在他心里太久，成了无法化解的心病。
心病.en: This secret has been hidden in his heart for too long, becoming an unresolved burden.

钳子.zh: 他用钳子夹住了那根铁丝。
钳子.en: He used pliers to grip that wire.

钳子.zh: 工具箱里有一把钳子和几把螺丝刀。
钳子.en: There's a pair of pliers and a few screwdrivers in the toolbox.

钳子.zh: 别用钳子夹电线，小心漏电。
钳子.en: Don't use pliers to clamp the wire; be careful of electric shock.

钳子.zh: 修理水管的时候，钳子帮了大忙。
钳子.en: When fixing the water pipe, the pliers were a great help.

操练.en: We drill for an hour every day.

操练.zh: 虽然下雨了，但他们还在操场操练。
操练.en: Although it's raining, they are still drilling on the field.

操练.zh: 新兵操练的时候非常认真。
操练.en: The new soldiers drill very seriously.

操练.zh: 教练让我们反复操练这个动作。
操练.en: The coach makes us practice this movement repeatedly.

操练.zh: 因为比赛快到了，队员们加紧操练。
操练.en: Because the competition is coming, the team is stepping up their drills.

心慌.en: I feel a bit nervous before exams.

心慌.zh: 他说话的时候声音发抖，明显心慌了。
心慌.en: His voice trembled when he spoke; he was clearly panicked.

心慌.zh: 看到她突然晕倒，我心里一阵心慌。
心慌.en: Seeing her suddenly faint, I felt a wave of panic.

心慌.zh: 如果你觉得心慌，就深呼吸一下。
心慌.en: If you feel anxious, take a deep breath.

兢兢业业.en: He has always been conscientious and diligent at work.

兢兢业业.zh: 这位老师兢兢业业教了几十年书。
兢兢业业.en: This teacher has taught diligently for decades.

兢兢业业.zh: 虽然职位不高，但他干得兢兢业业。
兢兢业业.en: Although his position is not high, he works diligently.

兢兢业业.zh: 老板很欣赏她兢兢业业的态度。
兢兢业业.en: The boss appreciates her dedicated attitude.

兢兢业业.zh: 我们做医生的一定要兢兢业业，不能马虎。
兢兢业业.en: As doctors, we must be conscientious and not be careless.

波涛.en: The sea is rough with waves.

波涛.zh: 听到这个消息，他心里波涛起伏。
波涛.en: Hearing this news, his heart was churning with emotion.

波涛.zh: 远处传来波涛拍打礁石的声音。
波涛.en: From afar came the sound of waves crashing against the rocks.

波涛.zh: 虽然海面看似平静，但水下波涛暗涌。
波涛.en: Although the sea looks calm, there are undercurrents below.

波涛.zh: 回忆起往事，她胸中波涛翻滚。
波涛.en: Recalling the past, she felt tumultuous emotions surging within.

殷勤.en: He is very attentive to guests.

殷勤.zh: 那位服务员殷勤地给我们倒茶。
殷勤.en: That waiter eagerly poured tea for us.

殷勤.zh: 别对他太殷勤，他会不习惯的。
殷勤.en: Don't be too attentive to him; he won't be used to it.

殷勤.zh: 她殷勤地帮我拿行李，让我很感动。
殷勤.en: She eagerly helped me with my luggage, which moved me.

殷勤.zh: 虽然他献殷勤，但女生并不领情。
殷勤.en: Although he tried to be attentive, the girl didn't appreciate it.

毅然.zh: 她毅然拒绝了那个提议。
他毅然辞去了高薪工作。
毅然.en: He resolutely quit his high-paying job.

毅然.zh: 尽管困难重重，他还是毅然决定出发。
毅然.en: Despite many difficulties, he resolutely decided to set off.

毅然.zh: 面对危险，他毅然冲了进去。
毅然.en: Facing danger, he resolutely rushed in.

毅然.zh: 她毅然选择了自己喜欢的专业。
毅然.en: She resolutely chose the major she liked.

菜市场.en: I go to the vegetable market to buy groceries.

菜市场.zh: 菜市场的东西比超市新鲜。
菜市场.en: Things at the vegetable market are fresher than at the supermarket.
The vegetable market is especially crowded on weekends.

菜市场.zh: 妈妈每天早上去菜市场讨价还价。
菜市场.en: Mom goes to the vegetable market every morning to bargain.

菜市场.zh: 菜市场门口有个卖水果的老大爷。
菜市场.en: There is an old man selling fruit at the entrance of the vegetable market.

争先恐后.zh: 孩子们争先恐后地跑出教室。
争先恐后.en: The children rushed out of the classroom.

争先恐后.zh: 打折的时候，顾客们争先恐后地抢购。
争先恐后.en: During the sale, customers scramble to buy.

争先恐后.zh: 公交车来了，人们争先恐后地上车。
争先恐后.en: When the bus came, people rushed to get on.

争先恐后.zh: 他说话总是争先恐后，从不给别人机会。
争先恐后.en: He always speaks eagerly before others, never giving anyone else a chance.

赫然.en: His name is conspicuously on the list.

赫然.zh: 走进房间，赫然看到墙上挂着一幅画。
赫然.en: Entering the room, I was struck by a painting hanging on the wall.

赫然.zh: 成绩单上赫然写着不及格。
赫然.en: The report card conspicuously showed a failing grade.

赫然.zh: 那座雕像赫然矗立在广场中央。
赫然.en: That statue stands conspicuously in the center of the square.

赫然.zh: 翻开报纸，赫然发现自己的照片在上面。
赫然.en: Opening the newspaper, I was startled to see my own photo in it.

威慑.zh: 核武器有强大的威慑力。
威慑.en: Nuclear weapons have a strong deterrent power.

威慑.zh: 他的眼神充满威慑，让人不敢直视。
威慑.en: His eyes were full of intimidation, making it hard to look directly at him.

威慑.zh: 警察巡逻能起到威慑作用。
威慑.en: Police patrols can serve as a deterrent.

威慑.zh: 这条法律对犯罪分子有威慑效果。
威慑.en: This law has a deterrent effect on criminals.

威慑.zh: 别用武力来威慑别人，那是没用的。
威慑.en: Don't use force to intimidate others; it's useless.

雷同.en: These two articles are too similar.

雷同.zh: 他们的设计虽然不同，但风格不能雷同。
雷同.en: Although their designs are different, the style cannot be identical.

雷同.zh: 因为观点太雷同，所以评委没给高分。
雷同.en: Because the views were too similar, the judges didn't give high scores.

雷同.zh: 我不想跟别人雷同，所以选了特别的颜色。
雷同.en: I don't want to be the same as others, so I chose a special color.

雷同.zh: 这部电影的情节和那部雷同，没什么新意。
雷同.en: The plot of this movie is identical to that one, no novelty.

出风头.en: He always likes to show off.

出风头.zh: 在公司会议上，他又在出风头，抢着发言。
出风头.en: At the company meeting, he was showing off again, rushing to speak.

出风头.zh: 虽然她很优秀，但从来不喜欢出风头。
出风头.en: Although she is excellent, she never likes to show off.

出风头.zh: 别为了出风头而做危险的事。
出风头.en: Don't do dangerous things just to show off.

出风头.zh: 每次聚会她都要唱歌出风头。
出风头.en: Every time at a party she sings to show off.

输家.en: There is no loser in this match.

输家.zh: 在商业竞争里，只有不断创新才不会成为输家。
输家.en: In business competition, only continuous innovation prevents becoming a loser.

输家.zh: 如果你不努力，最后就会变成输家。
输家.en: If you don't work hard, you'll end up being a loser.

输家.zh: 赌博没有赢家，只有输家。
输家.en: Gambling has no winners, only losers.

输家.zh: 他们打牌，输家请客吃饭。
输家.en: They played cards, the loser treats dinner.

正气.zh: 他一身正气，从不做亏心事。
正气.en: He is full of integrity and never does shameful things.

正气.zh: 虽然困难重重，但他依然保持正气。
正气.en: Although difficulties abound, he still maintains integrity.

正气.zh: 这个领导很正气，大家都很尊敬他。
正气.en: This leader is very upright, everyone respects him.

正气.zh: 社会需要弘扬正气，打击歪风邪气。
正气.en: Society needs to promote righteousness and fight against bad trends.

盛情.zh: 我们盛情邀请你参加明天的派对。
盛情.en: We warmly invite you to tomorrow's party.

盛情.zh: 因为他们的盛情，我不好意思拒绝。
盛情.en: Because of their great kindness, I was embarrassed to refuse.

盛情.zh: 盛情难却，我只好留下来了。
盛情.en: Hospitality is hard to refuse, so I had to stay.

盛情.zh: 她盛情地给我们准备了晚餐。
盛情.en: She warmly prepared dinner for us.

中庸.zh: 中庸之道强调平衡，不偏不倚。
中庸.en: The doctrine of the mean emphasizes balance, not leaning.

中庸.zh: 虽然有时需要果断，但平时还是中庸一点好。
中庸.en: Although sometimes decisiveness is needed, usually it's better to be moderate.

中庸.zh: 他不喜欢极端，凡事追求中庸。
中庸.en: He doesn't like extremes, pursues moderation in everything.

中庸.zh: 这种想法太中庸了，缺乏创新。
中庸.en: This idea is too moderate, lacking innovation.

阎王.en: If the King of Hell wants you dead at midnight... (common saying)

阎王.zh: 大家都说阎王殿里很可怕。
阎王.en: Everyone says the King of Hell's court is very scary.

阎王.zh: 虽然他不信鬼神，但提到阎王还是有点怕。
阎王.en: Although he doesn't believe in ghosts, he is still a bit scared when mentioning the King of Hell.
Don't talk as fierce as the King of Hell.

阎王.zh: 老人常说阎王是管生死的神。
阎王.en: Old people often say the King of Hell is the god in charge of life and death.

小康.zh: 我们现在过上了小康生活。
小康.en: We now live a well-off life.

小康.zh: 国家目标是让所有人都达到小康水平。
小康.en: The national goal is to have everyone reach a moderately prosperous level.

小康.zh: 虽然算不上富裕，但已经算小康了。
小康.en: Although not rich, it's already considered well-off.

小康.zh: 小康家庭一般都有车有房。
小康.en: Well-off families generally have a car and a house.

小康.zh: 从贫困到小康，我们努力了很多年。
小康.en: From poverty to moderate prosperity, we worked hard for many years.

叫板.en: He dares to challenge the boss.

叫板.zh: 这家新开的店直接跟老字号叫板。
叫板.en: This newly opened store directly challenges the established brand.

叫板.zh: 虽然实力不足，但他还是想叫板冠军。
叫板.en: Although he lacks strength, he still wants to challenge the champion.

叫板.zh: 别轻易跟那些大公司叫板，你会吃亏。
叫板.en: Don't easily challenge those big companies, you'll suffer.

叫板.zh: 他们俩在课堂上公开叫板，老师很生气。
叫板.en: They publicly challenged each other in class, the teacher was very angry.

异口同声.zh: 大家异口同声地答应了。
同学们异口同声地说这个计划很棒。
异口同声.en: The classmates unanimously said this plan is great.

异口同声.zh: 当问到谁最努力时，他们异口同声地提到了小王。
异口同声.en: When asked who worked hardest, they all mentioned Xiao Wang in unison.

异口同声.zh: 全家人异口同声反对他的决定。
异口同声.en: The whole family unanimously opposed his decision.

异口同声.zh: 观众们异口同声地叫好。
异口同声.en: The audience cheered with one voice.

成才.zh: 虽然家庭条件不好，但他还是努力成才了。
成才.en: Although his family conditions were poor, he still worked hard and succeeded.

成才.zh: 学习好不一定能成才，还要有品德。
成才.en: Good grades don't guarantee success; you also need character.
He set his mind to succeed from a young age.

成才.zh: 在学校里，老师鼓励我们成才。
成才.en: At school, teachers encourage us to succeed.

揣摩.en: I'm trying to figure out his meaning.

揣摩.zh: 你需要仔细揣摩领导说的话。
揣摩.en: You need to carefully ponder what the leader said.

揣摩.zh: 他揣摩了半天，还是没明白。
揣摩.en: He pondered for a long time, but still didn't understand.

揣摩.zh: 我一直在揣摩她为什么生气。
揣摩.en: I've been trying to figure out why she is angry.

乐谱.zh: 我买了一本贝多芬的乐谱。
虽然看不懂乐谱，但他弹得很好。
乐谱.en: Although he can't read music, he plays well.

乐谱.zh: 老师让我照着乐谱练习一下。
乐谱.en: The teacher told me to practice according to the score.
I forgot to bring the music score.

公安局.en: I went to the police station to report a case.

公安局.zh: 公安局就在这条街的尽头。
公安局.en: The police station is at the end of this street.

公安局.zh: 你要是丢了钱包，就去公安局。
公安局.en: If you lose your wallet, go to the police station.

公安局.zh: 他昨天被公安局叫去了。
公安局.en: He was called to the police station yesterday.
What time does the police station close?

袖珍.zh: 我买了一个袖珍收音机。
虽然它很袖珍，但功能齐全。
袖珍.en: Although it's very small, it's fully functional.

袖珍.zh: 这种袖珍电脑很方便携带。
袖珍.en: This kind of mini computer is easy to carry.
The miniature ones are also expensive.

密不可分.zh: 学习和实践是密不可分的。
因为工作关系，我们密不可分。
密不可分.en: Because of work, we are inseparable.

密不可分.zh: 这对双胞胎总是形影不离，密不可分。
密不可分.en: This pair of twins are always together, inseparable.

剪彩.en: The mayor came to cut the ribbon.

剪彩.zh: 新店开业那天请了很多明星来剪彩。
剪彩.en: On the opening day of the new store, many celebrities were invited to cut the ribbon.

剪彩.zh: 因为疫情，剪彩仪式推迟了。
剪彩.en: Because of the pandemic, the ribbon-cutting ceremony was postponed.

剪彩.zh: 这家商场明天举行剪彩活动。
剪彩.en: This mall will hold a ribbon-cutting event tomorrow.
The ribbon-cutting scene was very lively.

五花八门.en: The things here are all kinds.

五花八门.zh: 网上卖的衣服五花八门，挑都挑不完。
五花八门.en: The clothes sold online are so varied, you can't finish choosing.

五花八门.zh: 虽然菜的种类五花八门，但我只喜欢吃面。
五花八门.en: Although the dishes are varied, I only like eating noodles.

五花八门.zh: 他收藏的五花八门的小玩意儿。
五花八门.en: The various little trinkets he collects.

火辣辣.zh: 我的脸被晒得火辣辣地疼。
火辣辣.en: My face was sunburned and stinging hot.

火辣辣.zh: 虽然天气火辣辣的，但他还是出去跑步了。
火辣辣.en: Although the weather was scorching, he still went out for a run.

火辣辣.zh: 吃了一口辣椒，嘴里火辣辣的。
火辣辣.en: Took a bite of chili, mouth burning.

取经.en: I go to learn from him.

取经.zh: 他特意从外地来向师傅取经。
取经.en: He came specially from out of town to learn from the master.

取经.zh: 因为不懂怎么做，我就去请教老员工取经。
取经.en: Because I didn't know how to do it, I went to ask experienced colleagues for advice.

取经.zh: 这本书是创业者的取经指南。
取经.en: This book is a guide for entrepreneurs to learn from experience.
The path of learning is not easy.

口吃.en: He speaks with a slight stutter.

口吃.zh: 口吃的人唱歌时反而很流利。
口吃.en: People who stutter often sing fluently instead.

口吃.zh: 小时候我有口吃，后来慢慢改过来了。
口吃.en: I had a stutter when I was little, but I gradually overcame it.

口吃.zh: 他在面试时因为紧张口吃得厉害，但最后还是通过了。
口吃.en: He stuttered badly during the interview due to nervousness, but he still passed in the end.

口吃.zh: 虽然她有点口吃，可是演讲内容非常精彩。
口吃.en: Although she has a slight stutter, the content of her speech was very brilliant.

目不转睛.zh: 他目不转睛地看着屏幕。
目不转睛.en: He stared at the screen without blinking.

目不转睛.zh: 孩子目不转睛地盯着玩具店里的机器人。
目不转睛.en: The child stared intently at the robot in the toy store.

目不转睛.zh: 看电影时她目不转睛，完全被情节吸引了。
目不转睛.en: She watched the movie without blinking, completely absorbed by the plot.

目不转睛.zh: 观众们目不转睛地看着魔术师，想知道他到底怎么变的。
目不转睛.en: The audience stared fixedly at the magician, wondering how he did the trick.

目不转睛.zh: 小猫目不转睛地盯着一只蝴蝶，然后突然扑了上去。
目不转睛.en: The kitten stared unblinkingly at a butterfly, then suddenly pounced on it.

连绵.en: It has been overcast and rainy for days.

连绵.zh: 远处是连绵起伏的群山。
连绵.en: In the distance are rolling hills stretching endlessly.

连绵.zh: 连绵的大雪让交通变得非常困难。
连绵.en: The continuous heavy snow made traffic very difficult.

连绵.zh: 因为阴雨连绵，我们取消了户外烧烤的计划。
连绵.en: Because of the continuous rain, we canceled the outdoor barbecue plan.

连绵.zh: 这片草原连绵几百公里，一眼望不到边。
连绵.en: This grassland stretches for hundreds of kilometers without an end in sight.

惩处.zh: 公司对贪污行为进行了严厉惩处。
惩处.en: The company imposed severe punishment on embezzlement.

惩处.zh: 学校对考试作弊的学生给予了适当惩处。
惩处.en: The school gave appropriate punishment to students who cheated on exams.

惩处.zh: 如果再不改正错误，就会遭到更严厉的惩处。
惩处.en: If you don't correct your mistakes, you will face even harsher punishment.

惩处.zh: 法律对这类欺诈行为的惩处力度还不够大。
惩处.en: The legal punishment for this type of fraud is still not strong enough.

暴利.en: This industry can make huge profits.

暴利.zh: 疫情期间有人靠卖口罩获取暴利。
暴利.en: During the pandemic, some people made huge profits by selling masks.

暴利.zh: 政府正在打击房地产领域的暴利行为。
暴利.en: The government is cracking down on exorbitant profits in the real estate sector.

暴利.zh: 虽然投资这个项目有暴利，但风险也特别高。
暴利.en: Although investing in this project yields huge profits, the risks are also extremely high.

暴利.zh: 那些靠垄断市场赚取暴利的公司迟早会被调查。
暴利.en: Those companies that make excessive profits by monopolizing the market will be investigated sooner or later.

原汁原味.en: This dish is made with its original flavor.

原汁原味.zh: 我们想品尝原汁原味的四川火锅。
原汁原味.en: We want to taste the authentic Sichuan hot pot.

原汁原味.zh: 这部电影保留了原汁原味的小说情节。
原汁原味.en: This movie retains the original plot of the novel.

原汁原味.zh: 他坚持用传统方法制作原汁原味的豆腐。
原汁原味.en: He insists on using traditional methods to make authentic tofu.

原汁原味.zh: 虽然翻译得不错，但还是读原汁原味的外文小说更有感觉。
原汁原味.en: Although the translation is good, reading the original foreign novel in its authentic form feels better.

乳制品.zh: 我每天都会吃一些乳制品。
乳制品.en: I eat some dairy products every day.

乳制品.zh: 超市的乳制品区有很多选择。
乳制品.en: There are many choices in the dairy section of the supermarket.

乳制品.zh: 有些人因为乳糖不耐受不能吃乳制品。
乳制品.en: Some people cannot eat dairy products due to lactose intolerance.

乳制品.zh: 为了保证质量，这家乳制品厂采用了最新的灭菌技术。
乳制品.en: To ensure quality, this dairy factory uses the latest sterilization technology.

乳制品.zh: 早餐时我通常喝一杯牛奶，再吃点乳制品。
乳制品.en: For breakfast, I usually drink a glass of milk and eat some dairy products.

苦心.zh: 他的一片苦心没人理解。
苦心.en: No one understands his painstaking efforts.

苦心.zh: 老师苦心教导我们做人做事的道理。
苦心.en: The teacher took great pains to teach us the principles of life and work.

苦心.zh: 经过多年的苦心研究，他终于成功了。
苦心.en: After years of painstaking research, he finally succeeded.

苦心.zh: 父母苦心经营这家小店，才供我读完大学。
苦心.en: My parents painstakingly ran this small shop to support me through college.

苦心.zh: 虽然你觉得自己很委屈，但也要体谅领导的苦心。
苦心.en: Although you feel wronged, you should also understand the boss's painstaking intentions.

一揽子.zh: 政府推出了一个一揽子计划。
一揽子.en: The government introduced a package plan.

一揽子.zh: 公司提出了一个一揽子解决方案。
一揽子.en: The company proposed a comprehensive solution.

一揽子.zh: 这次改革包括一揽子经济措施。
一揽子.en: This reform includes a package of economic measures.

一揽子.zh: 为了振兴旅游业，当地出台了一揽子优惠政策。
一揽子.en: To revitalize tourism, the local government introduced a package of preferential policies.

一揽子.zh: 双方签署了一揽子合作协议，涉及贸易、教育和科技领域。
一揽子.en: The two sides signed a comprehensive cooperation agreement covering trade, education, and technology.

卫视.en: I like watching Hunan Satellite TV.

卫视.zh: 我家装了卫星电视，能收好多卫视台。
卫视.en: We have satellite TV at home, so we can receive many satellite channels.

卫视.zh: 昨晚卫视播了一部很好看的纪录片。
卫视.en: Last night, a satellite TV channel aired a very interesting documentary.

卫视.zh: 很多年轻人喜欢看卫视的综艺节目。
卫视.en: Many young people enjoy watching variety shows on satellite TV.

卫视.zh: 虽然有些卫视的节目很精彩，但广告实在太多了。
卫视.en: Although the programs on some satellite channels are exciting, there are way too many commercials.

浮躁.zh: 现在的年轻人容易浮躁，需要静下心来学习。
浮躁.en: Young people nowadays easily get restless; they need to calm down and study.

浮躁.zh: 你别那么浮躁，事情慢慢来。
浮躁.en: Don't be so impetuous; take things slowly.

浮躁.zh: 因为他性格浮躁，所以工作上总出错。
浮躁.en: Because he is impetuous, he often makes mistakes at work.

浮躁.zh: 考试前大家都很浮躁，静不下心复习。
浮躁.en: Before exams, everyone is restless and can't calm down to review.

精疲力竭.zh: 忙了一整天，我已经精疲力竭了。
精疲力竭.en: After working all day, I am exhausted.

精疲力竭.zh: 虽然精疲力竭，但他还是坚持完成了任务。
精疲力竭.en: Although exhausted, he still insisted on completing the task.

精疲力竭.zh: 跑完马拉松后，他精疲力竭地倒在地上。
精疲力竭.en: After finishing the marathon, he collapsed on the ground exhausted.

精疲力竭.zh: 她加班到半夜，回到家已经精疲力竭了。
精疲力竭.en: She worked overtime until midnight and was already exhausted when she got home.

廉洁.zh: 政府提倡廉洁办公，反对贪污腐败。
廉洁.en: The government promotes clean governance and opposes corruption.

廉洁.zh: 因为一直保持廉洁，他赢得了大家的尊重。
廉洁.en: Because he has always remained incorruptible, he earned everyone's respect.

廉洁.zh: 做人要廉洁，不能贪图小便宜。
廉洁.en: One must be honest, not greedy for petty gains.

廉洁.zh: 她家里很穷，但做人非常廉洁。
廉洁.en: Her family is very poor, but she is very honest.

柳树.en: There is a willow tree by the river.

柳树.zh: 春天来了，柳树的枝条都变绿了。
柳树.en: Spring has come; the willow branches have turned green.

柳树.zh: 我很喜欢柳树，因为它看起来很温柔。
柳树.en: I really like willow trees because they look very gentle.

柳树.zh: 柳树的叶子随风飘动，特别好看。
柳树.en: The willow leaves sway in the wind; they look very beautiful.

柳树.zh: 小时候我经常在柳树下玩耍。
柳树.en: When I was little, I often played under the willow tree.

欢声笑语.en: The classroom is full of joyful laughter.

欢声笑语.zh: 过年时家里总是充满欢声笑语。
欢声笑语.en: During Chinese New Year, the home is always full of joyful laughter.

欢声笑语.zh: 虽然大家很累，但聚会上依然欢声笑语不断。
欢声笑语.en: Although everyone was tired, the party was still filled with nonstop laughter and talk.

欢声笑语.zh: 孩子们在公园里欢声笑语地玩耍。
欢声笑语.en: The children are playing in the park with joyful laughter.

欢声笑语.zh: 这场演出带给观众许多欢声笑语。
欢声笑语.en: This performance brought the audience a lot of joyful laughter.

舵手.en: He is the helmsman of this ship.

舵手.zh: 一个好舵手能让船安全到达目的地。
舵手.en: A good helmsman can get the ship safely to the destination.

舵手.zh: 作为团队的舵手，他必须做出正确决定。
舵手.en: As the helmsman of the team, he must make the right decisions.
The captain let the old helmsman steer.

舵手.zh: 历史往往需要伟大的舵手来引领方向。
舵手.en: History often needs great helmsmen to guide the direction.

分外.zh: 他对待工作分外认真，从不马虎。
分外.en: He treats his work especially seriously, never slacking.

分外.zh: 因为天气很好，大家的心情也分外愉快。
分外.en: Because the weather was good, everyone's mood was especially cheerful.

分外.zh: 花草经过雨水冲刷，显得分外鲜艳。
分外.en: After being washed by rain, the flowers and plants look especially bright.

分外.zh: 他分外卖力，就是想得到老板的认可。
分外.en: He is putting in extra effort, just to get the boss's approval.

边疆.en: He is stationed at the border.

边疆.zh: 边疆地区的风景非常壮丽，但生活很艰苦。
边疆.en: The scenery in the border region is magnificent, but life is tough.

边疆.zh: 虽然边疆遥远，但士兵们依然坚守在那里。
边疆.en: Although the frontier is far away, the soldiers still hold their post there.

边疆.zh: 他从小就想保卫祖国的边疆。
边疆.en: Since childhood, he wanted to defend the motherland's border.

边疆.zh: 每年都有志愿者去边疆支教。
边疆.en: Every year there are volunteers who go to teach in border regions.

陡峭.zh: 陡峭的山路走起来非常费劲。
陡峭.en: Walking on a steep mountain path is very strenuous.

陡峭.zh: 因为山路太陡峭，我们只能慢慢往上爬。
陡峭.en: Because the mountain path is too steep, we could only climb up slowly.

陡峭.zh: 悬崖非常陡峭，让人看了害怕。
陡峭.en: The cliff is very steep, scary to look at.

陡峭.zh: 这一段楼梯特别陡峭，上下要小心。
陡峭.en: This section of stairs is especially steep; be careful going up and down.

酷似.zh: 这个雕像酷似真人，非常逼真。
酷似.en: This statue closely resembles a real person, very lifelike.

酷似.zh: 虽然他们不是双胞胎，但长相酷似。
酷似.en: Although they are not twins, they look very similar.

酷似.zh: 他的声音酷似那位著名歌手。
酷似.en: His voice closely resembles that famous singer.

酷似.zh: 这件仿品酷似真品，很难分辨。
酷似.en: This imitation closely resembles the genuine article; very hard to tell apart.

质朴.zh: 虽然她穿得很质朴，但气质很好。
质朴.en: Although she dresses simply, she has great poise.

质朴.zh: 因为你性格质朴，大家都很喜欢你。
质朴.en: Because you are simple and honest, everyone likes you.

质朴.zh: 这种质朴的风格让人感觉很舒服。
质朴.en: This plain style makes people feel very comfortable.

质朴.zh: 我喜欢质朴的乡村生活。
质朴.en: I like the simple country life.

亏待.zh: 老板从来没有亏待过我们这些员工。
亏待.en: The boss has never treated us employees unfairly.

亏待.zh: 如果你好好干，公司不会亏待你。
亏待.en: If you work hard, the company won't treat you badly.

亏待.zh: 他觉得自己被亏待了，所以辞职了。
亏待.en: He felt he was treated unfairly, so he quit.

亏待.zh: 别担心，我不会亏待朋友的。
亏待.en: Don't worry, I won't be unfair to friends.

酒楼.zh: 我们在那家酒楼订了包间吃饭。
酒楼.en: We booked a private room at that restaurant for dinner.

酒楼.zh: 虽然酒楼很贵，但菜确实好吃。
酒楼.en: Although the restaurant is expensive, the food is really delicious.

酒楼.zh: 前面有个酒楼，我们去试试？
酒楼.en: There's a restaurant ahead, shall we try it?

酒楼.zh: 这酒楼的服务态度很好。
酒楼.en: The service at this restaurant is very good.

辩证.en: We need to look at problems dialectically.

辩证.zh: 对这件事，我们应该采取辩证的态度。
辩证.en: We should adopt a dialectical attitude towards this matter.

辩证.zh: 虽然困难很多，但辩证来看也是机会。
辩证.en: Although there are many difficulties, dialectically speaking it's also an opportunity.
He speaks in a dialectical way, not extreme.
Learning to think dialectically is very important.

推敲.zh: 写文章时一定要反复推敲用词。
推敲.en: When writing an article, you must repeatedly polish the wording.

推敲.zh: 因为时间紧，我没来得及推敲。
推敲.en: Because time was tight, I didn't have time to deliberate.

推敲.zh: 他推敲了半天才做出决定。
推敲.en: He deliberated for a long time before making a decision.

推敲.zh: 这个方案还要再推敲一下。
推敲.en: This plan still needs some more deliberation.

广义.zh: 广义上来说，这都算是一种教育。
广义.en: In a broad sense, this counts as a form of education.

广义.zh: 虽然狭义上不是，但广义上可以这么理解。
广义.en: Although not in the narrow sense, in the broad sense it can be understood that way.

广义.zh: 广义相对论是爱因斯坦提出的。
广义.en: The general theory of relativity was proposed by Einstein.

广义.zh: 我们讨论的是广义的市场概念。
广义.en: We are discussing the broad concept of the market.

隐情.en: He seems to have something hidden.

隐情.zh: 你别问了，这里面一定有隐情。
隐情.en: Don't ask, there must be something hidden here.

隐情.zh: 虽然他不说，但我猜有隐情。
隐情.en: Although he won't say, I suspect there are hidden circumstances.

隐情.zh: 她总是避而不谈，说明有隐情。
隐情.en: She always avoids the topic, which means there's a hidden secret.

隐情.zh: 这件事背后有没有隐情？
隐情.en: Is there anything hidden behind this matter?

易拉罐.en: Throw the can into the trash bin.

易拉罐.zh: 我买了一箱易拉罐可乐。
易拉罐.en: I bought a case of canned cola.

易拉罐.zh: 他喝完易拉罐后随手就扔了。
易拉罐.en: After drinking the can, he tossed it away casually.

易拉罐.zh: 这种易拉罐的拉环很容易断。
易拉罐.en: The pull tab on this kind of can breaks easily.

接班.zh: 父亲退休后，儿子来接班。
接班.en: After the father retires, the son will take over.

接班.zh: 虽然还没正式接班，但已经在学习了。
接班.en: Although he hasn't officially taken over, he's already learning.

接班.zh: 我们公司需要培养接班人才。
接班.en: Our company needs to cultivate successors.

淡季.en: It's the off-season for tourism now.
Airfare is especially cheap during the off-season.

淡季.zh: 虽然淡季人少，但服务反而更好。
淡季.en: Although there are fewer people in the off-season, the service is actually better.

淡季.zh: 这家店的生意淡季也很忙。
淡季.en: This shop is busy even in the off-season.
Going to the beach in the off-season is very quiet.

浓重.zh: 这个房间的烟味很浓重。
浓重.en: The smoke smell in this room is very strong.

浓重.zh: 他的口音很浓重，一听就是南方人。
浓重.en: His accent is very thick; you can tell he's from the south.

浓重.zh: 今天早上的雾特别浓重，开车要小心。
浓重.en: This morning's fog is especially thick, drive carefully.

浓重.zh: 因为雾太浓重，飞机被迫推迟起飞。
浓重.en: Because the fog was too thick, the plane was forced to delay takeoff.

浓重.zh: 他说话时带着浓重的鼻音。
浓重.en: He spoke with a heavy nasal tone.

日新月异.zh: 这座城市的变化日新月异。
日新月异.en: The changes in this city are rapid.

日新月异.zh: 科技发展日新月异，我们要不断学习。
日新月异.en: Technology advances rapidly; we must keep learning.

日新月异.zh: 现在手机技术日新月异，每年都有新功能。
日新月异.en: Smartphone technology changes daily; there are new features every year.

日新月异.zh: 虽然这个行业日新月异，但基础技能还是很重要。
日新月异.en: Although this industry changes rapidly, basic skills are still important.

日新月异.zh: 社会日新月异，我们也要跟上步伐。
日新月异.en: Society changes rapidly; we must keep pace.

推辞.zh: 我邀请他吃饭，他客气地推辞了。
推辞.en: I invited him to dinner, and he politely declined.

推辞.zh: 她推辞了升职的机会，因为想多陪家人。
推辞.en: She declined the promotion opportunity because she wanted to spend more time with family.

推辞.zh: 虽然他很想去，但还是推辞了，因为那天有事。
推辞.en: Although he really wanted to go, he still declined because he had something that day.

志气.en: This young person is very ambitious.

志气.zh: 人不能没有志气，否则很难成功。
志气.en: A person cannot lack ambition; otherwise it's hard to succeed.

志气.zh: 她小时候就很有志气，想当科学家。
志气.en: She was ambitious as a child, wanting to become a scientist.

志气.zh: 他虽然家境贫寒，但志气很高，最终考上了大学。
志气.en: Although his family was poor, he had high ambition and eventually got into college.
Ambitious people are not afraid of difficulties.

提纲.zh: 演讲前，他先列了一个简单的提纲。
提纲.en: Before the speech, he first made a simple outline.

提纲.zh: 老师要求我们交一份作文提纲。
提纲.en: The teacher asked us to submit an essay outline.

提纲.zh: 因为时间不够，我只写了个提纲，没有详细内容。
提纲.en: Because time was insufficient, I only wrote an outline, no detailed content.

提纲.zh: 这个提纲很清晰，可以照着讲。
提纲.en: This outline is very clear; you can follow it to speak.

生命线.zh: 对于沙漠里的旅人来说，水源就是生命线。
生命线.en: For travelers in the desert, water sources are the lifeline.

生命线.zh: 这条公路是山区居民的生命线。
生命线.en: This highway is the lifeline for mountain residents.

生命线.zh: 虽然这条铁路很旧，但它仍然是当地的经济生命线。
生命线.en: Although this railway is old, it remains the economic lifeline of the area.

生命线.zh: 互联网现在成了很多人的生命线。
生命线.en: The internet has become a lifeline for many people.

夜以继日.zh: 为了赶项目，团队夜以继日地加班。
夜以继日.en: To meet the project deadline, the team worked overtime day and night.

夜以继日.zh: 她夜以继日地学习，终于通过了考试。
夜以继日.en: She studied day and night and finally passed the exam.

夜以继日.zh: 因为时间紧迫，我们只能夜以继日地准备。
夜以继日.en: Because time was tight, we could only prepare day and night.

夜以继日.zh: 医生夜以继日地抢救病人。
夜以继日.en: The doctor worked around the clock to save the patient.

郊游.en: Let's go on an outing this weekend.

郊游.zh: 春天到了，很多人喜欢去郊游踏青。
郊游.en: Spring has arrived; many people like to go on outings and enjoy the greenery.

郊游.zh: 这次郊游我们准备了烧烤和水果。
郊游.en: For this outing, we prepared barbecue and fruit.

郊游.zh: 虽然天气有点阴，但大家还是决定去郊游。
郊游.en: Although the weather is a bit cloudy, everyone still decided to go on the outing.

郊游.zh: 郊游的时候别忘了带伞。
郊游.en: Don't forget to bring an umbrella when going on an outing.

反差.zh: 这张照片里黑白反差非常明显。
反差.en: In this photo, the black-and-white contrast is very obvious.

反差.zh: 城市和乡村的生活反差让人感慨。
反差.en: The contrast between city and rural life makes people reflective.

反差.zh: 他平时很安静，但在舞台上却很活泼，反差很大。
反差.en: He is usually quiet but very lively on stage - a big contrast.

反差.zh: 温差反差太大，容易感冒。
反差.en: The temperature contrast is too large; it's easy to catch a cold.

茂盛.zh: 院子里的树长得很茂盛。
茂盛.en: The trees in the yard are very lush.

茂盛.zh: 春天来了，草地上的野花开得很茂盛。
茂盛.en: Spring came; the wildflowers on the meadow are blooming luxuriantly.

茂盛.zh: 他家的花园里植物茂盛，非常好看。
茂盛.en: The plants in his garden are lush and very beautiful.

茂盛.zh: 因为雨水充足，今年庄稼长得特别茂盛。
茂盛.en: Because of sufficient rain, this year's crops are growing especially lush.

茂盛.zh: 这片竹林茂盛得遮住了阳光。
茂盛.en: This bamboo forest is so lush that it blocks the sunlight.

励志.en: This inspirational book is very good.

励志.zh: 他讲了一个励志故事，大家都很感动。
励志.en: He told an inspirational story, and everyone was deeply moved.

励志.zh: 这部电影很励志，我看完后充满信心。
励志.en: This movie is very inspiring; I felt full of confidence after watching it.

励志.zh: 虽然生活很苦，但励志的话能给人力量。
励志.en: Although life is hard, inspirational words can give people strength.

励志.zh: 她喜欢看励志视频，每天给自己打气。
励志.en: She likes watching motivational videos to cheer herself up every day.

骇人听闻.zh: 这真是一个骇人听闻的消息。
报纸上报道了骇人听闻的交通事故，很多人受伤。
骇人听闻.en: The newspaper reported a horrifying traffic accident with many injured.

骇人听闻.zh: 他说的故事虽然骇人听闻，但其实是假的。
骇人听闻.en: Although the story he told was shocking, it was actually fake.

骇人听闻.zh: 这种骇人听闻的犯罪事件让整个社区都害怕。
骇人听闻.en: This kind of shocking crime scared the entire community.

骇人听闻.zh: 骇人听闻的新闻总是吸引眼球。

晶莹.en: The dewdrops are sparkling and clear.

晶莹.zh: 她的眼泪晶莹地挂在脸上，让人心疼。
晶莹.en: Her tears glistened on her face, making people feel sorry for her.

晶莹.zh: 水晶在灯光下显得晶莹，而且非常漂亮。
晶莹.en: The crystal looks sparkling under the light, and it's very beautiful.

晶莹.zh: 这串葡萄晶莹饱满，看起来很好吃。
晶莹.en: This bunch of grapes is plump and glistening; it looks delicious.
The snowflakes sparkle, like a fairy tale.

便道.en: Walking on the sidewalk is safer.

便道.zh: 车太多，我只好在便道上骑车。
便道.en: There were too many cars, so I had to ride my bike on the sidewalk.

便道.zh: 因为主路在修，所以大家只能走便道。
便道.en: Because the main road is under repair, everyone has to take the temporary road.

便道.zh: 他把车停在便道旁边，被罚了款。
便道.en: He parked his car next to the sidewalk and got a fine.
There are many pedestrians on the sidewalk.

追悼.zh: 大家怀着沉痛的心情追悼逝去的英雄。
追悼.en: Everyone mourned the fallen heroes with heavy hearts.

追悼.zh: 虽然追悼会很简短，但每个人的心里都很悲伤。
追悼.en: Although the memorial service was very brief, everyone felt deeply sad.

追悼.zh: 他写了一篇文章来追悼他的老朋友。
追悼.en: He wrote an article to mourn his old friend.

呼应.en: The front and back should correspond.

呼应.zh: 这篇文章的开头和结尾呼应得很好。
呼应.en: The beginning and end of this article echo each other well.

呼应.zh: 如果你有困难，我会呼应你的求助。
呼应.en: If you have difficulties, I will respond to your call for help.

呼应.zh: 他们的行动互相呼应，很快就完成了任务。
呼应.en: Their actions coordinated with each other, and they quickly completed the task.
The sound echoed in the valley.

两手.zh: 做事情要两手准备，一手抓学习，一手抓工作。
两手.en: You need to prepare two aspects: one for study, one for work.

两手.zh: 他两手拿着东西，没法开门。
两手.en: He was holding things in both hands and couldn't open the door.

两手.zh: 我们要两手抓，两手都要硬。
两手.en: We must grasp both aspects and make both strong.

出土.en: New cultural relics have been unearthed.

出土.zh: 考古学家在遗址里出土了很多古代陶器。
出土.en: Archaeologists unearthed many ancient pottery pieces at the site.

出土.zh: 这座青铜器出土后，专家研究了很久。
出土.en: After this bronze ware was unearthed, experts studied it for a long time.

出土.zh: 去年出土的佛像保存得很完整。
出土.en: The Buddha statue unearthed last year is very well preserved.
The seeds have emerged from the soil and sprouted.

不服.zh: 他输了比赛，但心里很不服气。
不服.en: He lost the match, but he was very unconvinced inside.

不服.zh: 虽然老师批评了他，但他并不服。
不服.en: Although the teacher criticized him, he didn't accept it.

不服.zh: 她不服老，天天跑步锻炼。
不服.en: She refuses to admit she's old and runs every day to exercise.
The referee made a call, and the players didn't accept it.

自相矛盾.zh: 他前后两次的说法自相矛盾，没人相信他。
自相矛盾.en: His two statements were contradictory, so no one believed him.

自相矛盾.zh: 如果计划自相矛盾，那就很难执行下去。
自相矛盾.en: If the plan is self-contradictory, it will be hard to carry out.

自相矛盾.zh: 这个广告的内容自相矛盾，消费者都看出来了。
自相矛盾.en: The content of this ad is contradictory; consumers all noticed it.

自满.zh: 他成绩好就自满，这样可不行。
自满.en: He gets complacent when he does well in exams, that won't do.

自满.zh: 人一旦自满就很难进步了。
自满.en: Once a person becomes self-satisfied, it's hard to improve.

自满.zh: 她虽然得了奖，但一点也没有自满。
自满.en: Although she won an award, she's not complacent at all.

自满.zh: 你要是再这么自满下去，迟早会吃亏的。
自满.en: If you keep being so self-satisfied, you'll suffer for it sooner or later.

自满.zh: 自满往往是失败的开始，所以我们要保持谦虚。
自满.en: Complacency is often the beginning of failure, so we must stay humble.

罢免.zh: 他因为失职被罢免了职务。
罢免.en: He was removed from his position due to dereliction of duty.

罢免.zh: 董事会决定罢免这个经理。
罢免.en: The board decided to dismiss the manager.

罢免.zh: 如果大家都不满意，就可以提议罢免他。
罢免.en: If everyone is dissatisfied, they can propose to remove him.

罢免.zh: 那个村长因为贪污被村民联名罢免了。
罢免.en: The village chief was jointly removed by the villagers for corruption.

罢免.zh: 公司上个月罢免了两位高管，引发了内部震动。
罢免.en: The company removed two executives last month, causing internal turmoil.

圣贤.zh: 古代圣贤的话到现在还有用。
圣贤.en: The words of ancient sages are still useful today.

圣贤.zh: 他不是圣贤，当然也会犯错。
圣贤.en: He is not a sage, so of course he can make mistakes.

圣贤.zh: 我们要多读圣贤书，学习做人的道理。
圣贤.en: We should read more books by sages and learn the principles of life.

圣贤.zh: 圣贤也并非完美无缺，只是比普通人更有智慧。
圣贤.en: Sages are not perfect either, just wiser than ordinary people.

圣贤.zh: 现在的社会，很少有人真正把圣贤的教导放在心上。
圣贤.en: In today's society, few people truly take the teachings of sages to heart.

脊梁.zh: 他挺直了脊梁，不肯低头。
脊梁.en: He straightened his spine and refused to bow his head.
A person's backbone must not bend.

脊梁.zh: 这些科学家才是国家的脊梁。
脊梁.en: These scientists are the backbone of the country.

脊梁.zh: 他年纪大了，脊梁都有些驼了。
脊梁.en: He is old, and his spine is a bit hunched.

脊梁.zh: 在困难面前，我们要挺起脊梁，不能退缩。
脊梁.en: In the face of difficulties, we must straighten our backs and not back down.

求学.en: He has had a spirit of seeking knowledge since childhood.

求学.zh: 我为了求学来到这个城市。
求学.en: I came to this city to pursue my studies.

求学.zh: 现在求学的方式比以前多多了。
求学.en: There are many more ways to pursue education now than before.

求学.zh: 她家境不好，但一直坚持求学。
求学.en: Her family is poor, but she has persistently pursued her studies.

求学.zh: 求学路上虽然辛苦，但收获也很大。
求学.en: Although the road to learning is hard, the rewards are great.

居民楼.en: This residential building has thirty floors.

居民楼.zh: 居民楼里住着很多老人。
居民楼.en: Many elderly people live in the residential building.

居民楼.zh: 我家就在那栋红色的居民楼里。
居民楼.en: My home is in that red residential building.

居民楼.zh: 小区里的居民楼都装了新的电梯。
居民楼.en: All the residential buildings in the neighborhood have installed new elevators.

居民楼.zh: 那座居民楼因为太旧，已经被拆掉了。
居民楼.en: That residential building was demolished because it was too old.

两栖.en: Frogs are a type of amphibian.

两栖.zh: 他发展了两栖业务，线上线下都做。
两栖.en: He developed an amphibious business, doing both online and offline.

两栖.zh: 两栖作战需要特殊的装备。
这种两栖车辆可以在水里和陆地上行驶。
两栖.en: This amphibious vehicle can travel on both water and land.

两栖.zh: 他既是演员又是歌手，算是个两栖艺人。
两栖.en: He is both an actor and a singer, so he's a dual-career artist.

帘子.en: This curtain is too dark in color.

帘子.zh: 风一吹，帘子就飘起来了。
帘子.en: When the wind blows, the curtain flutters up.

帘子.zh: 厨房的帘子该洗了，上面都是油渍。
帘子.en: The kitchen curtain needs washing, it's covered in grease stains.

帘子.zh: 他掀开帘子走进来，手里拿着一杯咖啡。
帘子.en: He lifted the curtain and walked in, holding a cup of coffee.

衰减.en: The signal attenuates when it reaches here.

衰减.zh: 随着年龄增长，他的体力在逐渐衰减。
衰减.en: As he ages, his physical strength gradually declines.

衰减.zh: 这种材料的性能会随着时间衰减。
衰减.en: The performance of this material will degrade over time.

衰减.zh: 声音在空气中传播时会衰减。
衰减.en: Sound attenuates when traveling through air.

衰减.zh: 虽然热情有所衰减，但他还是坚持完成了任务。
衰减.en: Although his enthusiasm has waned, he still insisted on completing the task.

宽厚.en: He is a very kind and generous person.
The boss has always been lenient with employees.

宽厚.zh: 他宽厚待人，所以朋友很多。
宽厚.en: He treats others with generosity, so he has many friends.

宽厚.zh: 他的肩膀宽厚，看起来很可靠。
宽厚.en: His shoulders are broad and thick, making him look reliable.

宽厚.zh: 宽厚是一种美德，但也要分清是非。
宽厚.en: Magnanimity is a virtue, but one must also distinguish right from wrong.

祖传.en: This is my family's ancestral secret recipe.

祖传.zh: 他家祖传的瓷器在拍卖会上卖了个好价钱。
祖传.en: The porcelain handed down from his ancestors sold for a good price at the auction.

祖传.zh: 这套祖传的家具虽然旧了，但很有价值。
祖传.en: This set of ancestral furniture is old but very valuable.

祖传.zh: 因为这是祖传的手艺，所以他一直坚持传承下去。
祖传.en: Because this is an ancestral craft, he has always insisted on passing it down.

祖传.zh: 他祖传的玉佩不小心摔碎了，他特别难过。
祖传.en: His ancestral jade pendant accidentally broke, and he was very sad.

艰苦奋斗.zh: 我们要艰苦奋斗才能成功。
艰苦奋斗.en: We must work hard to succeed.

艰苦奋斗.zh: 爷爷那一代人靠艰苦奋斗才换来今天的幸福生活。
艰苦奋斗.en: Grandfather's generation achieved today's happy life through hard struggle.

艰苦奋斗.zh: 公司创业初期，大家都艰苦奋斗，没日没夜地工作。
艰苦奋斗.en: In the early days of the company, everyone worked hard day and night.

艰苦奋斗.zh: 虽然条件很艰苦，但他们依然坚持艰苦奋斗。
艰苦奋斗.en: Although conditions were tough, they still persisted in hard struggle.

艰苦奋斗.zh: 教育我们要继承艰苦奋斗的精神。
艰苦奋斗.en: Education teaches us to inherit the spirit of hard struggle.

急转弯.zh: 前面有个急转弯，慢点开。
急转弯.en: There's a sharp turn ahead, drive slowly.

急转弯.zh: 这个政策急转弯让很多人措手不及。
急转弯.en: This sudden policy change caught many people off guard.

急转弯.zh: 开车遇到急转弯时一定要减速。
急转弯.en: When driving and encountering a sharp turn, be sure to slow down.

急转弯.zh: 因为路上有个急转弯，所以司机特别小心。
急转弯.en: Because there was a sharp turn on the road, the driver was especially careful.

急转弯.zh: 他的态度来了个急转弯，让我很意外。
急转弯.en: His attitude did a sudden turnaround, which surprised me.

拍板.en: The boss finally made the decision.

拍板.zh: 这个方案需要总经理亲自拍板才能执行。
拍板.en: This plan needs the general manager to make the final decision before implementation.

拍板.zh: 董事会还在讨论，没人敢拍板。
拍板.en: The board is still discussing, no one dares to make the final decision.

拍板.zh: 虽然大家意见不统一，但最后还是由他拍板。
拍板.en: Although opinions were not unified, he finally made the decision.

拍板.zh: 项目迟迟没有拍板，大家都很着急。
拍板.en: The project hasn't been finalized for a long time, everyone is anxious.

相对而言.en: Relatively speaking, this one is cheaper.

相对而言.zh: 相对而言，南方的冬天比北方暖和很多。
相对而言.en: Relatively speaking, winter in the south is much warmer than in the north.

相对而言.zh: 相对而言，他更喜欢一个人待着。
相对而言.en: Relatively speaking, he prefers to be alone.

相对而言.zh: 虽然两个方案都有缺点，但相对而言，第一个更好。
相对而言.en: Although both plans have drawbacks, relatively speaking, the first one is better.

相对而言.zh: 相对而言，大城市的机会更多一些。
相对而言.en: Relatively speaking, big cities offer more opportunities.

古今中外.en: Throughout history, there are many famous people.

古今中外.zh: 古今中外，关于爱情的故事数不胜数。
古今中外.en: There are countless stories about love throughout history and across the world.

古今中外.zh: 这本书介绍了古今中外的各种发明。
古今中外.en: This book introduces various inventions from ancient to modern times and from China to abroad.

古今中外.zh: 从古今中外的历史来看，战争总是带来灾难。
古今中外.en: Looking at history from ancient to modern and from China to abroad, war always brings disaster.

古今中外.zh: 古今中外的哲学家都在思考人生的意义。
古今中外.en: Philosophers throughout history and across the world have pondered the meaning of life.

计策.en: He came up with a good plan.

计策.zh: 诸葛亮用空城计这个计策吓退了敌人。
计策.en: Zhuge Liang used the empty fort strategy to scare off the enemy.

计策.zh: 这条计策虽然简单，但很有效。
计策.en: This scheme, though simple, is very effective.

计策.zh: 因为他临时想了个计策，才避免了损失。
计策.en: Because he came up with a plan on the spot, he avoided losses.

计策.zh: 商场上需要灵活运用各种计策。
计策.en: In business, you need to flexibly use various strategies.

挺拔.en: This tree grows very tall and straight.

挺拔.zh: 他挺拔的身姿在人群中格外显眼。
挺拔.en: His upright posture stands out conspicuously in the crowd.

挺拔.zh: 这座山峰挺拔入云，非常壮观。
挺拔.en: This mountain peak stands tall into the clouds, very magnificent.

挺拔.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他的身姿依然挺拔。
挺拔.en: Although old, his posture is still upright.

挺拔.zh: 书法家写的字挺拔有力，很有气势。
挺拔.en: The calligrapher's writing is upright and powerful, with great momentum.

惊诧.zh: 听到这个消息，他很惊诧。
惊诧.en: Hearing this news, he was astonished.

惊诧.zh: 大家对她的突然辞职感到十分惊诧。
惊诧.en: Everyone was very surprised by her sudden resignation.

惊诧.zh: 他的表现让所有人都惊诧不已。
因为从未见过这样的场面，他显得非常惊诧。
惊诧.en: Because he had never seen such a scene, he looked very astonished.

惊诧.zh: 孩子惊诧地看着魔术师的表演。
惊诧.en: The child watched the magician's performance in astonishment.

谈不上.en: I can't say I like him.

谈不上.zh: 我只是略懂一点，谈不上精通。
谈不上.en: I only know a little, far from being proficient.

谈不上.zh: 这顿饭谈不上美味，但也能吃饱。
谈不上.en: This meal can't be called delicious, but it fills the stomach.

谈不上.zh: 虽然有点经验，但谈不上专家。
谈不上.en: Although I have some experience, I'm far from an expert.

谈不上.zh: 他们的关系谈不上亲密，只是普通朋友。
谈不上.en: Their relationship can't be called close, just ordinary friends.

抚养费.en: He pays child support every month.

抚养费.zh: 离婚后，爸爸按时给妈妈抚养费。
抚养费.en: After the divorce, Dad gives Mom child support on time.

抚养费.zh: 虽然收入不高，但他从没拖欠过抚养费。
抚养费.en: Although his income is not high, he has never defaulted on child support.

抚养费.zh: 法院判决他必须支付抚养费。
抚养费.en: The court ruled that he must pay child support.

抚养费.zh: 她为了抚养费的事情和前任吵了好几次。
抚养费.en: She argued with her ex several times over child support.

牧民.en: The herders on the grassland work hard.

牧民.zh: 牧民们赶着羊群到水草丰富的地方去。
牧民.en: The herders drove the sheep to a place with abundant water and grass.

牧民.zh: 到了冬天，牧民会把牛羊赶回温暖的圈里。
牧民.en: In winter, herders drive the livestock back to warm pens.

牧民.zh: 这位牧民从小就在马背上长大。
牧民.en: This herder grew up on horseback since childhood.

牧民.zh: 政府给牧民提供了很多补贴和帮助。
牧民.en: The government provides many subsidies and help to herders.

接轨.en: We need to align with international standards.

接轨.zh: 这家公司的管理方式已经和世界接轨了。
接轨.en: This company's management has aligned with the world.

接轨.zh: 为了让教育接轨国际，学校引进了新教材。
接轨.en: To align education with international standards, the school introduced new textbooks.

接轨.zh: 中国高铁技术已经和全球市场接轨。
接轨.en: China's high-speed rail technology has integrated with the global market.

接轨.zh: 我们的法律体系需要尽快与国际接轨。
接轨.en: Our legal system needs to align with international standards as soon as possible.

腐化.zh: 他因为生活腐化被公司开除了。
腐化.en: He was fired by the company because of his corrupt lifestyle.

腐化.zh: 如果监督不到位，官员很容易腐化。
腐化.en: If supervision is inadequate, officials easily become corrupt.

腐化.zh: 这种腐化行为严重损害了社会公平。
腐化.en: This kind of corrupt behavior seriously harms social fairness.

腐化.zh: 腐化的风气必须彻底清除。
腐化.en: The corrupt atmosphere must be completely eliminated.

贫乏.zh: 他的词汇量太贫乏，写不出好文章。
贫乏.en: His vocabulary is too poor to write good articles.

贫乏.zh: 因为知识贫乏，他经常被人笑话。
贫乏.en: Because of his lack of knowledge, he is often laughed at.

贫乏.zh: 那个地区水资源特别贫乏。
贫乏.en: That region has particularly scarce water resources.

贫乏.zh: 精神生活贫乏比物质贫乏更可怕。
贫乏.en: Poverty of spiritual life is scarier than material poverty.

出访.en: The premier will visit Europe soon.

出访.zh: 他这次出访的主要目的是加强贸易合作。
出访.en: The main purpose of this visit is to strengthen trade cooperation.

出访.zh: 出访期间，双方签署了多项协议。
出访.en: During the visit, the two sides signed multiple agreements.

出访.zh: 这位艺术家多次出访海外进行文化交流。
出访.en: This artist has visited overseas many times for cultural exchanges.

出访.zh: 公司派他出访日本学习先进技术。
出访.en: The company sent him to Japan to learn advanced technology.

蚊帐.en: Hang the mosquito net properly at night.

蚊帐.zh: 虽然开了空调，但他还是习惯用蚊帐。
蚊帐.en: Although the AC is on, he still habitually uses a mosquito net.

蚊帐.zh: 奶奶帮我缝了一个新蚊帐。
蚊帐.en: Grandma sewed a new mosquito net for me.

蚊帐.zh: 在非洲，蚊帐是预防疟疾的重要工具。
蚊帐.en: In Africa, mosquito nets are important tools for preventing malaria.

温度计.zh: 用水银温度计量体温要小心别打碎。
温度计.en: Be careful not to break the mercury thermometer when measuring body temperature.

温度计.zh: 因为发烧了，他赶紧找温度计量体温。
温度计.en: Because he had a fever, he quickly found a thermometer to check his temperature.

温度计.zh: 这个电子温度计读数很准。
温度计.en: This electronic thermometer gives accurate readings.

温度计.zh: 烤箱里也要放一个温度计。
温度计.en: There should also be a thermometer in the oven.

作客.en: I went to a friend's house as a guest.

作客.zh: 昨天在他家作客，他妈妈做了很多菜。
作客.en: Yesterday while visiting his home, his mother cooked many dishes.

作客.zh: 虽然只是第一次作客，但我感觉很自在。
作客.en: Although it was my first visit, I felt at ease.

作客.zh: 他长期在外作客，很少回家。
作客.en: He has been a guest away from home for a long time, rarely returning.

作客.zh: 作客时记得带点小礼物表示礼貌。
作客.en: When visiting, remember to bring a small gift as politeness.

妨害.zh: 这种行为会妨害公共安全。
妨害.en: This behavior will endanger public safety.

妨害.zh: 如果噪音太大，就会妨害邻居休息。
妨害.en: If the noise is too loud, it will disturb the neighbors' rest.

妨害.zh: 他的做法严重妨害了公司利益。
妨害.en: His actions seriously harmed the company's interests.

妨害.zh: 你这样做妨害了大家的团结。
妨害.en: What you did harmed everyone's unity.

耍赖.zh: 玩游戏的时候，他总爱耍赖，大家都不爱跟他玩。
耍赖.en: When playing games, he always acts shamelessly, so nobody wants to play with him.

耍赖.zh: 输了就耍赖，这样不太好吧。
耍赖.en: It's not good to act shamelessly when you lose.

耍赖.zh: 虽然你不想付钱，但也不能耍赖啊。
耍赖.en: Although you don't want to pay, you can't act shamelessly.

耍赖.zh: 小孩子耍赖是常事，别太生气。
耍赖.en: Kids being unreasonable is common, don't be too angry.

持之以恒.zh: 减肥这件事，只有持之以恒才能看到效果。
持之以恒.en: For weight loss, only by persevering can you see results.

持之以恒.zh: 如果你能持之以恒地练习，钢琴一定能弹好。
持之以恒.en: If you can practice persistently, you will definitely play the piano well.

持之以恒.zh: 他持之以恒的精神值得我们学习。
持之以恒.en: His spirit of perseverance is worth learning from.

持之以恒.zh: 每天背单词，持之以恒就会进步。
持之以恒.en: Memorizing words every day with perseverance leads to progress.

家境.zh: 虽然他家境不好，但学习非常努力。
家境.en: Although his family is poor, he studies very hard.

家境.zh: 因为家境普通，所以他从小就懂得节约。
家境.en: Because his family is ordinary, he knew how to save since childhood.

家境.zh: 她家境富裕，但从来不炫耀。
家境.en: Her family is wealthy, but she never shows off.

家境.zh: 了解一个学生的家境有助于老师更好地帮助他。
家境.en: Understanding a student's family background helps the teacher to better help him.

慌忙.en: He ran out in a hurry.

慌忙.zh: 听到消息后，她慌忙收拾东西准备出发。
慌忙.en: After hearing the news, she hurriedly packed up to leave.

慌忙.zh: 因为时间来不及了，他慌忙吃了两口饭就出门了。
慌忙.en: Because there was no time, he hurriedly ate a couple bites and left.

慌忙.zh: 看到老师来了，他慌忙把手机藏起来。
慌忙.en: Seeing the teacher coming, he hurriedly hid his phone.

彬彬有礼.zh: 那个服务员彬彬有礼，让人感觉很舒服。
彬彬有礼.en: That waiter is very polite, making people feel comfortable.

彬彬有礼.zh: 虽然他是老板，但对待员工总是彬彬有礼。
彬彬有礼.en: Although he is the boss, he is always polite to employees.

彬彬有礼.zh: 第一次见面，他就显得彬彬有礼，很有教养。
彬彬有礼.en: At the first meeting, he appeared polite and well-bred.

彬彬有礼.zh: 在正式场合，我们要保持彬彬有礼的态度。
彬彬有礼.en: In formal occasions, we should maintain a polite attitude.

药材.en: These medicinal herbs are very precious.

药材.zh: 他去药店买了一些中药材来熬汤。
药材.en: He went to the pharmacy to buy some Chinese medicinal herbs to make soup.

药材.zh: 因为气候潮湿，这些药材需要放在干燥的地方保存。
药材.en: Because the climate is humid, these herbs need to be stored in a dry place.

药材.zh: 这家店专门卖野生药材，质量很好。
药材.en: This shop specializes in wild medicinal herbs, the quality is good.

药材.zh: 中医讲究药材的搭配和用量。
药材.en: Chinese medicine emphasizes the combination and dosage of medicinal herbs.

拉动.zh: 新政策拉动了当地旅游业的发展。
拉动.en: The new policy drove the development of local tourism.

拉动.zh: 消费不仅能改善生活，还能拉动内需。
拉动.en: Consumption can not only improve life but also drive domestic demand.

拉动.zh: 他用力拉动绳子，把箱子拖了上来。
拉动.en: He pulled the rope hard, dragging the box up.

拉动.zh: 出口是拉动国家经济的重要力量。
拉动.en: Exports are an important force driving the national economy.

秀美.zh: 江南的风景秀美，每年吸引大量游客。
秀美.en: The scenery of Jiangnan is beautiful, attracting a large number of tourists every year.

秀美.zh: 虽然城市很繁华，但我更喜欢乡村的秀美风光。
秀美.en: Although the city is bustling, I prefer the beautiful scenery of the countryside.

秀美.zh: 她的字写得秀美，像她的人一样。
秀美.en: Her handwriting is beautiful, like her person.

秀美.zh: 这座小镇的夜色非常秀美。
秀美.en: The night view of this small town is very beautiful.

出主意.zh: 遇到难题时，他总是能帮大家出主意。
出主意.en: When encountering difficulties, he can always help everyone come up with ideas.

出主意.zh: 既然你不知道怎么办，不如让朋友帮你出主意。
出主意.en: Since you don't know what to do, why not let friends give you ideas.

出主意.zh: 老板让大家一起出主意，解决这个问题。
出主意.en: The boss asked everyone to brainstorm ideas to solve this problem.

树荫.en: We cool off under the tree shade.

树荫.zh: 夏天的时候，大家都喜欢坐在树荫下聊天。
树荫.en: In summer, everyone likes to sit under the tree shade and chat.

树荫.zh: 因为太阳太大，所以我们在树荫里休息了一会儿。
树荫.en: Because the sun was too strong, we rested in the tree shade for a while.

树荫.zh: 这棵大树提供了很大一片树荫。
树荫.en: This big tree provides a large area of shade.

树荫.zh: 孩子们在树荫下玩耍，一点也不热。
树荫.en: The children are playing under the tree shade, not hot at all.

恼羞成怒.zh: 他恼羞成怒，摔门就走了。
恼羞成怒.en: He became furious with humiliation and slammed the door as he left.

恼羞成怒.zh: 老板被问得恼羞成怒，直接停了会议。
恼羞成怒.en: The boss, embarrassed and angry from being questioned, just stopped the meeting.

恼羞成怒.zh: 她本来只是开玩笑，没想到他居然恼羞成怒。
恼羞成怒.en: She was just joking, but unexpectedly he became angry with shame.

恼羞成怒.zh: 小王输了一局棋就恼羞成怒，把棋盘给掀了。
恼羞成怒.en: Xiao Wang lost one game of chess and flew into a rage, flipping the board over.

恼羞成怒.zh: 当众被揭穿谎言后，他恼羞成怒，开始攻击别人。
恼羞成怒.en: After being exposed for lying in public, he became angry and ashamed and started attacking others.

自私自利.zh: 他太自私自利了，从不考虑别人。
自私自利.en: He is too selfish, never considering others.

自私自利.zh: 自私自利的人很难交到真正的朋友。
自私自利.en: Selfish people find it hard to make real friends.

自私自利.zh: 她虽然能力很强，但因为自私自利，大家都不喜欢她。
自私自利.en: Although she is very capable, everyone dislikes her because she is selfish.

自私自利.zh: 你要是不改掉自私自利的毛病，以后会吃大亏。
自私自利.en: If you don't get rid of your selfish habits, you'll suffer big losses later.

自私自利.zh: 这次捐款他一分钱都没出，真是自私自利到了极点。
自私自利.en: He didn't contribute a single cent to this donation; it's the height of selfishness.

喜出望外.zh: 她收到礼物时喜出望外。
喜出望外.en: She was overjoyed when she received the gift.

喜出望外.zh: 考试通过了，他喜出望外，立刻打电话回家。
喜出望外.en: He passed the exam and was overjoyed, immediately calling home.

喜出望外.zh: 老李没想到儿子会回来过年，真是喜出望外。
喜出望外.en: Old Li never expected his son to come back for the New Year; he was pleasantly surprised.

喜出望外.zh: 我们原以为会下雨，结果晴天了，大家都喜出望外。
喜出望外.en: We thought it would rain, but it turned out sunny, and everyone was delighted.

喜出望外.zh: 她丢失的项链居然在旧衣服里找到了，让她喜出望外。
喜出望外.en: She found her lost necklace in some old clothes, which made her overjoyed.

股民.zh: 很多股民最近都亏了钱。
股民.en: Many stock investors have lost money recently.

股民.zh: 股民们都在关注明天的股市走向。
股民.en: Stock investors are all paying attention to tomorrow's market trends.

股民.zh: 作为一个老股民，他建议新手不要盲目跟风。
股民.en: As a seasoned stock investor, he advises newcomers not to blindly follow trends.

股民.zh: 今年行情不好，股民们的心情也跟着坐过山车。
股民.en: The market has been bad this year, and investors' moods have been on a roller coaster.

股民.zh: 政府出台新政策后，股民们对市场又恢复了信心。
股民.en: After the government introduced new policies, stock investors regained confidence in the market.

笼统.zh: 这个回答很笼统，没有具体信息。
笼统.en: This answer is very vague, with no specific information.

笼统.zh: 他给的方案太笼统了，我们需要更详细的计划。
笼统.en: The plan he gave is too general; we need a more detailed one.

笼统.zh: 别只笼统地说“大家都不错”，要具体指出来。
笼统.en: Don't just vaguely say 'everyone was good'; point out specifics.

笼统.zh: 虽然他的解释比较笼统，但大致方向是对的。
笼统.en: Although his explanation is rather vague, the general direction is correct.

吃喝玩乐.en: He only knows how to eat, drink, and have fun.

吃喝玩乐.zh: 大学四年不能光顾着吃喝玩乐。
吃喝玩乐.en: You can't just focus on eating, drinking, and having fun for all four years of college.

吃喝玩乐.zh: 周末我们几个朋友一起吃喝玩乐，很放松。
吃喝玩乐.en: This weekend a few friends and I ate, drank, and played together; it was very relaxing.

吃喝玩乐.zh: 他整天吃喝玩乐，工作一点不上心。
吃喝玩乐.en: He spends all day eating, drinking, and having fun, not taking work seriously at all.

吃喝玩乐.zh: 年轻人应该多学点东西，别把时间都花在吃喝玩乐上。
吃喝玩乐.en: Young people should learn more things instead of spending all their time on eating, drinking, and having fun.

了却.en: He wants to finish this worry once and for all.

了却.zh: 去一趟老家，了却了我多年的心愿。
了却.en: Making a trip to my hometown fulfilled a long-standing wish of mine.

了却.zh: 帮他把这件事做了，算是了却一个人情。
了却.en: Helping him handle this matter is a way to settle a favor.

了却.zh: 等这个项目结束了，就能了却我一直以来的压力。
了却.en: Once this project is finished, I can get rid of the pressure I've been carrying.

比比皆是.zh: 这种小吃街上比比皆是。
比比皆是.en: This kind of snack is found everywhere on the street.

比比皆是.zh: 现在用手机支付的人比比皆是。
比比皆是.en: People using mobile payments are now everywhere.

比比皆是.zh: 这种错误在初学者的作业中比比皆是。
比比皆是.en: This kind of mistake is common in beginners' homework.

比比皆是.zh: 旅游景点里卖纪念品的小店比比皆是。
比比皆是.en: Souvenir shops are everywhere in tourist spots.

比比皆是.zh: 在大城市里，共享单车比比皆是，很方便。
比比皆是.en: In big cities, shared bikes are everywhere, which is very convenient.

光缆.zh: 这里的网络靠光缆传输。
光缆.en: The internet here relies on fiber optic cables.

光缆.zh: 工人们正在铺设新的光缆。
光缆.en: Workers are laying new fiber optic cables.

光缆.zh: 光缆断了，整个小区都上不了网。
光缆.en: The fiber optic cable broke, and the whole neighborhood lost internet.

光缆.zh: 海底光缆把各大洲的通信连在了一起。
光缆.en: Submarine fiber optic cables connect communications across continents.

光缆.zh: 他们打算把旧电话线换成光缆，提高网速。
光缆.en: They plan to replace the old phone lines with fiber optic cables to increase internet speed.

落差.en: There is a great height difference between the top and foot of the mountain.

落差.zh: 理想和现实之间总会有落差。
落差.en: There is always a gap between ideals and reality.

落差.zh: 这个瀑布的落差有八十米。
落差.en: The drop of this waterfall is eighty meters.

落差.zh: 他工作后的心理落差挺大的，不太适应。
落差.en: He experienced a big psychological gap after starting work and hasn't adjusted well.

落差.zh: 两地工资水平落差太大，很多人选择去外地打工。
落差.en: The wage gap between the two places is too large, so many people choose to work elsewhere.

建树.zh: 他在科研领域很有建树。
建树.en: He has made great achievements in the field of scientific research.

建树.zh: 这位教授在经济学方面建树颇多，深受学生尊敬。
建树.en: This professor has made many contributions in economics and is deeply respected by students.

建树.zh: 虽然年轻，但他在艺术上已经有了不少建树。
建树.en: Although young, he has already made considerable achievements in art.

建树.zh: 她在教育行业工作了三十年，建树突出，获得了多项荣誉。
建树.en: She worked in education for thirty years, with outstanding achievements, and received multiple honors.

建树.zh: 他在公司管理上建树不少，所以很快就被提拔为副总。
建树.en: He made many achievements in company management, so he was quickly promoted to vice president.

马戏.zh: 孩子们喜欢看马戏表演。
这个马戏团的大象表演特别精彩。
马戏.en: The elephant show of this circus is particularly wonderful.

马戏.zh: 昨天我去看了一场马戏，小丑最搞笑。
马戏.en: Yesterday I went to see a circus, and the clown was the funniest.

马戏.zh: 马戏团的狮子虽然很凶猛，但训练师很专业。
马戏.en: Although the circus lions are fierce, the trainer is very professional.

马戏.zh: 她从小就梦想加入马戏团，当一名空中飞人。
马戏.en: She dreamed of joining the circus since childhood to become a trapeze artist.

刻不容缓.en: The rescue work cannot be delayed.

刻不容缓.zh: 环境问题刻不容缓，我们必须马上行动。
刻不容缓.en: Environmental issues are urgent, and we must act immediately.

刻不容缓.zh: 医生说要手术，病情刻不容缓。
刻不容缓.en: The doctor said surgery was needed because the condition was urgent.

刻不容缓.zh: 考虑到安全风险，修改方案刻不容缓。
刻不容缓.en: Considering the safety risks, revising the plan is urgent.

刻不容缓.zh: 这座桥随时可能倒塌，维修刻不容缓。
刻不容缓.en: This bridge could collapse at any moment, so repairs are urgent.

斧子.en: He split wood with an ax.

斧子.zh: 这把斧子很锋利，小心别伤到手。
斧子.en: This ax is very sharp, be careful not to cut your hand.

斧子.zh: 古人用斧子砍树建房子。
斧子.en: Ancient people used axes to cut trees and build houses.

斧子.zh: 他去仓库拿了一把斧子，准备修理木栅栏。
斧子.en: He went to the warehouse to get an ax to repair the wooden fence.

斧子.zh: 虽然斧子很重，但用起来很顺手。
斧子.en: Although the ax is heavy, it's easy to use.

这样一来.en: This makes it much more convenient.

这样一来.zh: 他提前出发，这样一来就不会迟到了。
这样一来.en: He left early, so he won't be late.

这样一来.zh: 你把窗户打开，这样一来屋里就通风了。
这样一来.en: You open the window, so the room gets ventilated.

这样一来.zh: 我们多买了一些水果，这样一来客人来了也有吃的。
这样一来.en: We bought more fruit, so there will be food when guests arrive.

这样一来.zh: 她每天运动一小时，这样一来身体越来越好了。
这样一来.en: She exercises for an hour every day, so her health is getting better.

急迫.zh: 事情很急迫，得赶紧处理。
急迫.en: The matter is urgent, we need to deal with it quickly.

急迫.zh: 病人的情况非常急迫，需要马上输血。
急迫.en: The patient's condition is very critical and needs an immediate blood transfusion.

急迫.zh: 他的语气很急迫，好像出了什么大事。
急迫.en: His tone was very urgent, as if something serious happened.

急迫.zh: 时间急迫，我们不能再等了。
急迫.en: Time is pressing, we can't wait any longer.

急迫.zh: 面对急迫的灾情，救援队立刻出发了。
急迫.en: Facing the urgent disaster, the rescue team set out immediately.

长期以来.zh: 他长期以来一直坚持锻炼。
长期以来.en: He has been exercising consistently for a long time.

长期以来.zh: 这里的水质问题长期以来没有得到解决。
长期以来.en: The water quality problem here has not been solved for a long time.

长期以来.zh: 她长期以来努力工作，终于得到了晋升。
长期以来.en: She worked hard for a long time and finally got promoted.

长期以来.zh: 虽然天气不好，但农民们长期以来习惯了这种生活。
长期以来.en: Although the weather is bad, farmers have long been used to this life.

长期以来.zh: 中国和非洲国家长期以来保持着友好的合作关系。
长期以来.en: China and African countries have maintained friendly cooperative relations for a long time.

海量.en: He has a huge collection of e-books.

海量.zh: 这个网站提供海量免费资源。
海量.en: This website provides massive free resources.

海量.zh: 因为硬盘里存了海量照片，所以空间不够了。
海量.en: Because the hard drive has a huge number of photos, there's no space left.

海量.zh: 大数据时代，我们每天要处理海量信息。
海量.en: In the era of big data, we have to process massive amounts of information every day.

海量.zh: 他虽然酒量不大，却总爱吹嘘自己海量。
海量.en: Although he doesn't drink much, he always boasts about his huge capacity for alcohol.

聘任.zh: 学校聘任了一位新老师。
聘任.en: The school hired a new teacher.

聘任.zh: 公司决定聘任他担任市场部经理。
聘任.en: The company decided to appoint him as marketing manager.

聘任.zh: 这家企业聘任了很多名校毕业生。
聘任.en: This enterprise has hired many graduates from prestigious universities.

聘任.zh: 由于他表现优秀，公司正式聘任他为高级工程师。
聘任.en: Due to his excellent performance, the company formally appointed him as a senior engineer.

聘任.zh: 研究院聘任了几位海外专家来指导项目。
聘任.en: The research institute hired several overseas experts to guide the project.

扫墓.en: We go to sweep the graves on Qingming Festival.

扫墓.zh: 每年春天，全家都会去给祖先扫墓。
扫墓.en: Every spring, the whole family goes to sweep the ancestors' graves.

扫墓.zh: 扫墓时，人们通常会带上鲜花和祭品。
扫墓.en: When sweeping tombs, people usually bring flowers and offerings.

扫墓.zh: 今天天气很好，我们一早就出发去扫墓了。
扫墓.en: The weather is nice today, so we set out early to sweep the graves.

扫墓.zh: 虽然外地工作很忙，但他每年都回乡扫墓。
扫墓.en: Although he is busy working in another city, he returns home every year to sweep the graves.

容光焕发.zh: 她今天容光焕发，特别漂亮。
容光焕发.en: She looks radiant today, especially beautiful.

容光焕发.zh: 休息了一个周末，他看起来容光焕发。
容光焕发.en: After resting for a weekend, he looks radiant.

容光焕发.zh: 虽然工作很累，但她一上台就容光焕发。
容光焕发.en: Although she was tired from work, she became radiant as soon as she stepped on stage.

容光焕发.zh: 你最近是不是健身了？整个人容光焕发的。
容光焕发.en: Have you been working out lately? You look totally radiant.

容光焕发.zh: 她收到礼物后，脸上立刻容光焕发，开心得不得了。
容光焕发.en: After receiving the gift, her face immediately lit up with radiance, she was extremely happy.

预售.en: Movie tickets go on presale today.

预售.zh: 这款手机预售已经突破一百万台。
预售.en: Presales for this phone have already exceeded one million units.

预售.zh: 我参加了演唱会的预售，抢到了前排座位。
预售.en: I joined the presale for the concert and got front row seats.

预售.zh: 双十一很多商品都会提前预售，价格更便宜。
预售.en: Many items go on presale before Double 11, with lower prices.

预售.zh: 因为预售太火爆，官方又加了一批货。
预售.en: Because the presale was so popular, the official added another batch of stock.

弄虚作假.zh: 他考试弄虚作假被抓住了。
弄虚作假.en: He was caught cheating on the exam.

弄虚作假.zh: 公司因为弄虚作假被罚款了。
弄虚作假.en: The company was fined for falsification.

弄虚作假.zh: 做科研不能弄虚作假，否则后果很严重。
弄虚作假.en: In scientific research, you must not falsify data, or the consequences will be serious.

弄虚作假.zh: 他为了升职弄虚作假，最后反而丢了工作。
弄虚作假.en: He falsified information to get a promotion, but ended up losing his job.

弄虚作假.zh: 这家店的产品宣传总是弄虚作假，我以后再也不会买了。
弄虚作假.en: This store's product promotions are always fraudulent; I won't buy from them again.

管理费.en: This community's management fee is very high.

管理费.zh: 我们每个月要交三百块管理费。
管理费.en: We pay three hundred yuan in management fees every month.

管理费.zh: 房东说管理费包括在房租里了。
管理费.en: The landlord said the management fee is included in the rent.

管理费.zh: 物业公司最近想提高管理费，业主们都在反对。
管理费.en: The property management company recently wants to raise the management fee, and the owners are all opposing it.

管理费.zh: 除了水电费，还要交一笔不低的管理费。
管理费.en: Besides utilities, I also have to pay a considerable management fee.

改版.en: This website has been redesigned recently.

改版.zh: 新改版的系统比以前好用多了。
改版.en: The new version of the system is much more user-friendly than before.

改版.zh: 杂志改版后，读者反馈还不错。
改版.en: After the magazine's redesign, reader feedback has been quite positive.

改版.zh: 他们决定把产品包装改版，吸引年轻人。
改版.en: They decided to redesign the product packaging to attract young people.

改版.zh: 这次改版增加了很多新功能，但界面还需要优化。
改版.en: This redesign added many new features, but the interface still needs optimization.

物美价廉.zh: 这个超市的东西物美价廉。
物美价廉.en: Things at this supermarket are cheap and good.

物美价廉.zh: 我想找一家物美价廉的餐厅吃饭。
物美价廉.en: I want to find a restaurant that offers good food at affordable prices.

物美价廉.zh: 网购虽然方便，但很难保证物美价廉。
物美价廉.en: Online shopping is convenient, but it's hard to guarantee both quality and low price.

物美价廉.zh: 这款手机性价比很高，真正做到了物美价廉。
物美价廉.en: This phone has great value for money, truly achieving high quality and low price.

物美价廉.zh: 朋友推荐了一家店，东西物美价廉，我经常去光顾。
物美价廉.en: A friend recommended a shop where things are good and cheap, so I often go there.

喜糖.en: Have some wedding candy, I got married!

喜糖.zh: 她带了一包喜糖来办公室分给大家。
喜糖.en: She brought a bag of wedding candy to the office to share with everyone.

喜糖.zh: 现在的喜糖包装越来越精致了。
喜糖.en: Nowadays, wedding candy packaging is getting more and more exquisite.

喜糖.zh: 参加婚礼回来，每个人都会收到一盒喜糖。
喜糖.en: After attending a wedding, everyone receives a box of wedding candy.

喜糖.zh: 我把喜糖放在桌上，同事们很快就抢光了。
喜糖.en: I put the wedding candy on the table, and my colleagues quickly grabbed it all.

下坠.zh: 飞机突然下坠，大家都吓坏了。
下坠.en: The plane suddenly dropped, and everyone was terrified.

下坠.zh: 他感觉身体在往下坠，意识逐渐模糊。
下坠.en: He felt his body falling, and his consciousness gradually blurred.

下坠.zh: 物体从高处下坠的速度会越来越快。
下坠.en: An object falling from a height will accelerate.

下坠.zh: 虽然气球破了，但它并没有立刻下坠，而是缓缓飘落。
下坠.en: Even though the balloon burst, it didn't drop immediately but floated down slowly.

自费.en: I'm paying for this trip myself.
He published this book at his own expense.

自费.zh: 公司不给报销，我只能自费买电脑。
自费.en: The company won't reimburse me, so I have to buy the computer with my own money.

自费.zh: 很多演员为了提升演技，会自费去上培训班。
自费.en: Many actors attend training courses at their own expense to improve their acting skills.

自费.zh: 这个项目是自费的，所以参与者需要交一笔费用。
自费.en: This program is self-funded, so participants need to pay a fee.

集邮.en: Stamp collecting is his biggest hobby.

集邮.zh: 他从小就开始集邮，现在已经有很多珍贵的邮票了。
集邮.en: He started stamp collecting as a child, and now has many valuable stamps.

集邮.zh: 现在集邮的人越来越少了，大家都玩手机了。
集邮.en: Nowadays, fewer people collect stamps; everyone is on their phones.

集邮.zh: 我在网上买了一套集邮册，准备把散落的邮票整理好。
集邮.en: I bought a stamp album online, planning to organize my scattered stamps.

探求.en: He has been seeking the truth.

探求.zh: 我们探求这个问题的答案。
探求.en: We are seeking the answer to this question.

探求.zh: 因为好奇，她不断探求新知识。
探求.en: Because of curiosity, she continuously seeks new knowledge.

探求.zh: 探求真相需要勇气和耐心。
探求.en: Seeking the truth requires courage and patience.

探求.zh: 很多人探求人生的意义，但答案各不相同。
探求.en: Many people seek the meaning of life, but the answers are different.

侍候.en: He is sick, I will attend to him.

侍候.zh: 她每天侍候年迈的父母。
侍候.en: She takes care of her elderly parents every day.

侍候.zh: 虽然工作累，但他还是细心侍候病人。
侍候.en: Although work is tiring, he still carefully attends to the patients.

侍候.zh: 侍候别人并不容易，需要耐心。
侍候.en: Attending to others is not easy; it requires patience.

侍候.zh: 她辞了工作，专门在家侍候奶奶。
侍候.en: She quit her job to stay home and take care of her grandmother.

得不偿失.en: Doing this is not worth it.

得不偿失.zh: 为了这点钱熬夜，得不偿失。
得不偿失.en: Staying up late for this little money is not worth it.

得不偿失.zh: 如果你盲目投资，很可能会得不偿失。
得不偿失.en: If you invest blindly, you are likely to get more loss than gain.

得不偿失.zh: 贪图便宜反而得不偿失。
得不偿失.en: Seeking bargains actually results in more loss than gain.

得不偿失.zh: 虽然他省了时间，但质量下降也算得不偿失。
得不偿失.en: Although he saved time, the drop in quality is also not worth it.

年画.en: During New Year, we put up New Year pictures.

年画.zh: 因为要过年，所以家里贴了年画。
年画.en: Because New Year is coming, we put up a New Year picture at home.
This New Year picture is very beautiful.

年画.zh: 春节前，很多商店都卖年画。
年画.en: Before Spring Festival, many stores sell New Year pictures.

年画.zh: 她买了几幅传统年画，准备送朋友。
年画.en: She bought several traditional New Year pictures, planning to give them to friends.

出山.en: He decided to come out of retirement to help.
The old professor finally came out of retirement.

出山.zh: 如果公司有困难，他会出山解决。
出山.en: If the company has difficulties, he will come out to solve them.

出山.zh: 这位导演已经退休，但为了好剧本又出山了。
出山.en: This director had retired, but for a good script he came out of retirement again.

出山.zh: 很多退休专家愿意出山传授经验。
出山.en: Many retired experts are willing to come out and share their experience.

贯通.en: He has a thorough understanding of both Chinese and Western cultures.

贯通.zh: 只要努力，就能贯通这门学问。
贯通.en: As long as you work hard, you can master this subject.

贯通.zh: 这条地铁线贯通了城市南北。
贯通.en: This subway line connects the north and south of the city.

贯通.zh: 他读书很多，所以能贯通各个学科。
贯通.en: He reads a lot, so he can have a thorough understanding of various subjects.

翠绿.zh: 春天来了，田野一片翠绿。
翠绿.en: Spring has come, the fields are all emerald green.

翠绿.zh: 她穿了一件翠绿色的裙子。
翠绿.en: She wore an emerald green dress.

翠绿.zh: 雨后，山上的树木显得格外翠绿。
翠绿.en: After the rain, the trees on the mountain look especially emerald green.

翠绿.zh: 因为颜色翠绿，所以这个手镯很受欢迎。
翠绿.en: Because the color is emerald green, this bracelet is very popular.

试行.en: Let's try out this plan first.
The company is piloting a new system.

试行.zh: 如果试行效果好，我们就全面推广。
试行.en: If the trial results are good, we will fully promote it.

试行.zh: 这个软件还在试行阶段。
试行.en: This software is still in the trial phase.

试行.zh: 虽然只是试行，但大家都很认真。
试行.en: Although it's just a trial, everyone is very serious.

优胜劣汰.zh: 因为优胜劣汰，所以我们要不断进步。
优胜劣汰.en: Because of survival of the fittest, we must keep improving.

优胜劣汰.zh: 自然界遵循优胜劣汰的法则。
优胜劣汰.en: Nature follows the law of survival of the fittest.

优胜劣汰.zh: 市场优胜劣汰，没有竞争力的公司就会倒闭。
优胜劣汰.en: The market has survival of the fittest; companies without competitiveness will go bankrupt.

优胜劣汰.zh: 优胜劣汰是自然规律，我们只能适应。
优胜劣汰.en: Survival of the fittest is a natural law; we can only adapt.

优胜劣汰.zh: 这场比赛体现了优胜劣汰的原则。
优胜劣汰.en: This competition embodies the principle of survival of the fittest.

审定.en: This plan needs to be examined and approved.
The budget has been reviewed and approved.

审定.zh: 所有稿件都要经过专家审定。
审定.en: All manuscripts must go through expert review.

审定.zh: 审定结果将在下周公布。
审定.en: The review results will be announced next week.

审定.zh: 因为需要反复审定，所以时间比较长。
审定.en: Because it requires repeated review, the time is relatively long.

陪葬.zh: 这些古董都是帝王的陪葬品。
陪葬.en: These antiques are all burial objects of emperors.

陪葬.zh: 他不想让公司为自己的错误陪葬。
陪葬.en: He doesn't want the company to be buried with his mistakes.

陪葬.zh: 古代贵族死后常有大量陪葬。
陪葬.en: Ancient nobles often had a large number of burial objects after death.

陪葬.zh: 虽然这个项目失败了，但没必要让整个团队陪葬。
陪葬.en: Even though this project failed, there's no need to let the whole team be buried with it.

陪葬.zh: 考古学家在墓穴里发现了许多陪葬的陶俑。
陪葬.en: Archaeologists found many buried pottery figurines in the tomb.

重合.zh: 我们的观点在这一点上重合了。
重合.en: Our views overlap on this point.

重合.zh: 他们的行程有一段时间是重合的。
重合.en: Their schedules overlap for a period of time.

重合.zh: 由于时间重合，我没办法同时参加两个会议。
重合.en: Because the times overlap, I can't attend both meetings at the same time.

重合.zh: 这两个三角形的面积并不重合。
重合.en: The areas of these two triangles do not overlap.

耐人寻味.zh: 结局耐人寻味，让人久久不能忘记。
耐人寻味.en: The ending is thought-provoking, leaving a lasting impression.

耐人寻味.zh: 这个电影最后的那个镜头特别耐人寻味。
耐人寻味.en: The last shot of this movie is especially thought-provoking.

耐人寻味.zh: 他说的话虽然简单，但仔细想想很耐人寻味。
耐人寻味.en: Although his words are simple, they are very thought-provoking upon reflection.

耐人寻味.zh: 她那条耐人寻味的短信让我猜了一整天。
耐人寻味.en: Her thought-provoking text message kept me guessing all day.

天经地义.zh: 孝顺父母是天经地义的。
天经地义.en: Filial piety to parents is a matter of course.

天经地义.zh: 他觉得自己拿奖金是天经地义的事。
天经地义.en: He thinks it's only natural for him to get the bonus.

天经地义.zh: 在中国，尊老爱幼被认为是天经地义的。
天经地义.en: In China, respecting the elderly and loving the young is considered a matter of course.

天经地义.zh: 虽然他很累了，但觉得加班是天经地义的。
天经地义.en: Even though he was very tired, he felt it was only natural to work overtime.

天经地义.zh: 欠债还钱，天经地义，没什么好争论的。
天经地义.en: Paying back debts is a matter of course; there's nothing to argue about.

茂密.en: The trees in the forest are lush.

茂密.zh: 后山有一片茂密的竹林。
茂密.en: There is a dense bamboo forest behind the mountain.
Her hair is black and thick.

茂密.zh: 因为树木太茂密，阳光几乎照不进来。
茂密.en: Because the trees are so dense, sunlight almost can't get in.

茂密.zh: 他家门前有一棵茂密的大榕树。
茂密.en: There is a lush big banyan tree in front of his house.

纯朴.en: The people in this village are very simple and honest.
I like her simple and honest personality.

纯朴.zh: 山区里的孩子特别纯朴可爱。
纯朴.en: The children in the mountain area are especially simple, honest, and cute.

纯朴.zh: 他那种纯朴的笑容让人感觉很舒服。
纯朴.en: His simple and honest smile makes people feel very comfortable.

纯朴.zh: 虽然生活在大城市，但他始终保持着一颗纯朴的心。
纯朴.en: Even though he lives in a big city, he always maintains a simple and honest heart.

艰险.en: This road is very difficult and dangerous.
The climbing process was full of hardships and dangers.

艰险.zh: 他克服了重重艰险才到达终点。
艰险.en: He overcame many difficulties and dangers to reach the finish line.

艰险.zh: 这次探险虽然艰险，但收获很大。
艰险.en: Although this expedition was difficult and dangerous, the gains were great.

艰险.zh: 面对艰险的环境，他们依然没有放弃。
艰险.en: Facing the harsh and dangerous environment, they still did not give up.

久仰.zh: 久仰大名，今天终于见面了。
久仰.en: I've long admired your reputation; finally we meet today.
I've long heard of you; nice to meet you!

久仰.zh: 这位就是王教授吗？久仰了！
久仰.en: Is this Professor Wang? I've long admired you!

久仰.zh: 久仰你的才华，今天听你演讲真是荣幸。
久仰.en: I've long admired your talent; it's an honor to hear your speech today.

久仰.zh: 久仰您的大名，今天能见到您真是太高兴了。
久仰.en: I've long admired your great name; I'm so happy to meet you today.

卧铺.en: The sleeper carriage is very quiet.

卧铺.zh: 坐火车去北京还是卧铺舒服。
卧铺.en: Taking the train to Beijing is more comfortable with a sleeper.

卧铺.zh: 因为时间太长，我订了卧铺而不是硬座。
卧铺.en: Because the trip is too long, I booked a sleeper instead of a hard seat.

卧铺.zh: 现在网上买卧铺票很方便，不用去车站排队。
卧铺.en: It's very convenient to buy sleeper tickets online now; no need to queue at the station.

中国画.en: He likes to paint Chinese paintings.

中国画.zh: 这幅中国画是齐白石的作品。
中国画.en: This Chinese painting is a work by Qi Baishi.

中国画.zh: 中国画讲究意境而不是写实。
中国画.en: Chinese painting emphasizes artistic conception rather than realism.

中国画.zh: 我上周末去美术馆看了一个中国画展览。
中国画.en: I went to the art museum last weekend to see a Chinese painting exhibition.

中国画.zh: 她学中国画已经五年了，画得特别有韵味。
中国画.en: She has been learning Chinese painting for five years and paints with great charm.

恰如其分.zh: 虽然话不多，但每句都恰如其分。
恰如其分.en: Although he doesn't say much, every word is appropriate.

恰如其分.zh: 她的打扮恰如其分，既不太正式也不太随意。
恰如其分.en: Her attire is just right, neither too formal nor too casual.

恰如其分.zh: 我觉得你的建议恰如其分，完全可以采纳。
恰如其分.en: I think your suggestion is appropriate and can be fully adopted.

请帖.en: The invitation card is beautifully written.

请帖.zh: 你记得把请帖发给所有客人吗？
请帖.en: Did you remember to send the invitation cards to all guests?

请帖.zh: 因为时间紧迫，我们只发了电子请帖。
请帖.en: Because time was tight, we only sent electronic invitations.

请帖.zh: 请帖上写着婚礼在周六下午举行。
请帖.en: The invitation says the wedding is Saturday afternoon.

寥寥无几.zh: 虽然申请的人很多，但合格的寥寥无几。
寥寥无几.en: Although many applied, very few were qualified.

寥寥无几.zh: 这家店生意冷清，顾客寥寥无几。
寥寥无几.en: This shop is quiet, with very few customers.

寥寥无几.zh: 在这个小镇上，懂外语的人寥寥无几。
寥寥无几.en: In this small town, very few people know foreign languages.

佐料.en: Add some seasoning, it tastes better.

佐料.zh: 做火锅需要很多种不同的佐料。
佐料.en: Making hot pot needs many different kinds of condiments.

佐料.zh: 除了盐和酱油，我还喜欢放一些特别的佐料。
佐料.en: Besides salt and soy sauce, I also like to add some special seasonings.

佐料.zh: 这些佐料都是从国外进口的。
佐料.en: These seasonings are all imported from abroad.

夸耀.en: He always likes to boast about himself.

夸耀.zh: 她从不夸耀自己的财富，很低调。
夸耀.en: She never flaunts her wealth; she's very low-key.

夸耀.zh: 虽然他很有本事，但从不夸耀，这点我很欣赏。
夸耀.en: Although he is very capable, he never brags; I appreciate that.

夸耀.zh: 你夸耀的东西其实没那么厉害。
夸耀.en: What you're bragging about isn't actually that impressive.

猜谜.zh: 他喜欢在聚会上让大家猜谜。
猜谜.en: He likes to have everyone guess riddles at parties.

猜谜.zh: 因为猜谜能锻炼大脑，所以很多人喜欢玩。
猜谜.en: Because guessing riddles exercises the brain, many people like to play.

猜谜.zh: 这个谜语太难了，我猜谜水平不够。
猜谜.en: This riddle is too hard; my riddle-solving skill is insufficient.

拜会.zh: 明天我要去拜会一位老同学。
拜会.en: Tomorrow I'm going to visit an old classmate.
He came specially to visit you.

拜会.zh: 我打算下周去拜会我的导师。
拜会.en: I plan to visit my advisor next week.

拜会.zh: 虽然只是初次拜会，但他给我留下了很好的印象。
拜会.en: Although it was just a first visit, he left a good impression on me.

拜会.zh: 这次拜会是为了讨论合作事宜。
拜会.en: This visit is to discuss cooperation matters.

一举两得.en: This kills two birds with one stone.
This plan achieves two things at once.

一举两得.zh: 跑步听音乐，既锻炼身体又放松心情，一举两得。
一举两得.en: Running while listening to music both exercises the body and relaxes the mind – killing two birds with one stone.

一举两得.zh: 我顺便去超市买东西，省得再跑一趟，一举两得。
一举两得.en: I'll go to the supermarket on the way, saving an extra trip – two birds with one stone.

一举两得.zh: 这个活动既能学习又能交朋友，真是一举两得。
一举两得.en: This activity allows learning and making friends; it's truly killing two birds with one stone.

温习.en: I need to review my lessons.

温习.zh: 考试前一定要温习所有知识点。
温习.en: Before the exam, you must review all the knowledge points.

温习.zh: 虽然学过一遍，但还要温习才能记住。
温习.en: Even though I've studied it once, I still need to review to remember.

温习.zh: 他每天晚上都会温习当天学的内容。
温习.en: He reviews what he learned that day every evening.

伸张.zh: 他努力伸张自己的权利。
伸张.en: He strives to assert his rights.

伸张.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个伸张正义的故事。
伸张.en: This movie tells a story of upholding justice.

伸张.zh: 只有通过法律，才能有效地伸张正义。
伸张.en: Only through law can justice be effectively upheld.

伸张.zh: 他站出来伸张正义，赢得了大家的尊重。
伸张.en: He stood up to uphold justice and earned everyone's respect.

老字号.zh: 这家老字号的面很好吃。
老字号.en: The noodles at this time-honored brand are delicious.

老字号.zh: 虽然这家店是老字号，但价格却很实惠。
老字号.en: Although this shop is a time-honored brand, the prices are very reasonable.

老字号.zh: 我特别喜欢去老字号买点心。
老字号.en: I especially like to go to time-honored brands to buy pastries.

老字号.zh: 很多老字号都开在市中心。
老字号.en: Many time-honored brands are located in the city center.

老字号.zh: 他推荐的那家老字号，据说已经有上百年历史了。
老字号.en: The time-honored brand he recommended is said to have over a hundred years of history.

须知.zh: 参加活动前请先阅读须知。
须知.en: Before participating in the activity, please read the notice first.

须知.zh: 考试须知里写明了不能带手机。
须知.en: The exam notice clearly states that mobile phones are not allowed.

须知.zh: 如果你不清楚规定，最好先看看安全须知。
须知.en: If you are not clear about the rules, better first look at the safety notice.

须知.zh: 这份入住须知你必须签字确认。
须知.en: You must sign to confirm this check-in notice.

熙熙攘攘.zh: 周末的市场熙熙攘攘，很热闹。
熙熙攘攘.en: The weekend market is bustling and very lively.

熙熙攘攘.zh: 虽然广场上熙熙攘攘，但我还是找到了他。
熙熙攘攘.en: Although the square was bustling, I still found him.

熙熙攘攘.zh: 游客们熙熙攘攘地挤在门口。
熙熙攘攘.en: The tourists bustled and crowded at the entrance.

熙熙攘攘.zh: 节假日的时候，这个景点总是熙熙攘攘，人山人海。
