熙熙攘攘.en: During holidays, this scenic spot is always bustling and packed with people.

香油.en: Add some sesame oil to the cold dish.

香油.zh: 做汤的时候滴几滴香油更香。
香油.en: When making soup, add a few drops of sesame oil for more fragrance.

香油.zh: 我妈妈喜欢用香油拌面。
香油.en: My mother likes to mix noodles with sesame oil.

香油.zh: 那瓶香油是纯手工榨的。
香油.en: That bottle of sesame oil is hand-pressed.

香油.zh: 如果你想让菜更香，可以最后淋一点香油。
香油.en: If you want the dish to be more fragrant, you can drizzle a little sesame oil at the end.

僵化.zh: 公司管理制度太僵化，需要改革。
僵化.en: The company's management system is too rigid and needs reform.

僵化.zh: 长期不学习，脑子就会僵化。
僵化.en: If you don't study for a long time, your mind will become rigid.

僵化.zh: 这种僵化的教学模式让学生失去了兴趣。
僵化.en: This rigid teaching model makes students lose interest.

僵化.zh: 虽然制度有些僵化，但也是为了安全考虑。
僵化.en: Although the system is a bit rigid, it is also for safety considerations.

平价.zh: 这家店卖的都是平价商品。
平价.en: This store sells all affordable goods.
We have launched affordable set meals.

平价.zh: 这家平价的餐厅味道却很好。
为了吸引顾客，商场搞了一个平价促销活动。
平价.en: To attract customers, the mall held an affordable promotion event.

滑梯.en: The children are playing on the slide.
There is a big slide in the park.

滑梯.zh: 弟弟从滑梯上滑下来，笑得很开心。
滑梯.en: My little brother slid down the slide, laughing happily.

滑梯.zh: 这个滑梯太高了，小孩子有点害怕。
滑梯.en: This slide is too high, little kids are a bit scared.

滑梯.zh: 如果你想玩滑梯，记得排队不要推挤。
滑梯.en: If you want to play on the slide, remember to line up and don't push.

死心塌地.en: He is completely devoted to following her.

死心塌地.zh: 我对这份工作死心塌地。
死心塌地.en: I am completely devoted to this job.

死心塌地.zh: 就算失败，他也死心塌地做这件事。
死心塌地.en: Even if he fails, he is dead set on doing this.

死心塌地.zh: 她死心塌地地爱着那个男人。
死心塌地.en: She is wholeheartedly in love with that man.

死心塌地.zh: 自从加入这个团队，他就死心塌地地努力付出。
死心塌地.en: Since joining this team, he has devoted himself wholeheartedly to hard work.

无可奉告.en: I have no comment on this matter.

无可奉告.zh: 记者问了很多次，他都回答无可奉告。
无可奉告.en: The reporter asked many times, and he answered 'no comment' every time.

无可奉告.zh: 关于案件细节，警方表示无可奉告。
无可奉告.en: Regarding the details of the case, the police said no comment.

无可奉告.zh: 老板让我对这个问题保持无可奉告。
无可奉告.en: The boss told me to keep no comment on this issue.

无可奉告.zh: 如果你问的是公司内部机密，那我只能无可奉告了。
无可奉告.en: If you're asking about company internal secrets, then I can only say no comment.

簇拥.zh: 记者簇拥在门口等待消息。
簇拥.en: Reporters crowded at the door waiting for news.

簇拥.zh: 他被一群人簇拥着走出来了。
簇拥.en: He came out surrounded by a group of people.

簇拥.zh: 孩子们簇拥着老师要糖果。
簇拥.en: Children crowded around the teacher asking for candy.

簇拥.zh: 虽然被很多人簇拥着，但他依然很淡定。
簇拥.en: Although surrounded by many people, he remained calm.

网点.zh: 这个银行网点周末也开门。
网点.en: This bank branch is also open on weekends.

网点.zh: 我们公司在全国有上百个服务网点。
网点.en: Our company has hundreds of service outlets nationwide.

网点.zh: 你去最近的快递网点把包裹寄了吧。
网点.en: Go to the nearest courier outlet and send the package.

网点.zh: 虽然网点不多，但每个都提供全面服务。
网点.en: Although there aren't many outlets, each one offers full services.

网点.zh: 他跑了好几个网点才办成这件事。
网点.en: He went to several branches before getting this done.

撤换.zh: 领导决定撤换项目经理。
撤换.en: The boss decided to replace the project manager.

撤换.zh: 因为表现不好，他被撤换了岗位。
撤换.en: He was removed from his post due to poor performance.

撤换.zh: 公司突然撤换供应商，让大家都措手不及。
撤换.en: The company suddenly replaced the supplier, catching everyone off guard.

撤换.zh: 如果设备故障，我们会立即撤换。
撤换.en: If the equipment malfunctions, we will replace it immediately.

撤换.zh: 他们撤换了好几次方案，最后还是用原来的。
撤换.en: They changed the plan several times, but ended up using the original one.

搀.zh: 奶奶腿不好，走路需要人搀。
搀.en: Grandma's legs are bad, she needs someone to support her when walking.

搀.zh: 我搀着老人慢慢过了马路。
搀.en: I helped the elderly person slowly cross the street.

搀.zh: 他喝多了，朋友赶紧搀住他。
搀.en: He drank too much, his friend quickly steadied him.
Don't hold me up, I can walk by myself!

搀.zh: 她摔倒了，我过去把她搀起来。
搀.en: She fell, and I went over to help her up.

欢聚.en: The whole family gathers joyfully during the New Year.

欢聚.zh: 朋友们欢聚在餐厅庆祝生日。
欢聚.en: Friends gathered happily at the restaurant to celebrate the birthday.

欢聚.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我们还是抽空欢聚了一次。
欢聚.en: Even though work was busy, we still found time to get together happily.

欢聚.zh: 多年不见的老同学欢聚在一起，有说不完的话。
欢聚.en: Old classmates who hadn't seen each other for years gathered joyfully, having endless things to talk about.

欢聚.zh: 这次欢聚让我们都想起了大学时光。
欢聚.en: This happy gathering reminded us all of our college days.

出毛病.en: My phone is acting up again.

出毛病.zh: 车子在半路出毛病，真麻烦。
出毛病.en: The car broke down halfway, what a hassle.

出毛病.zh: 这台电脑经常出毛病，该换了。
出毛病.en: This computer frequently has problems; it's time to replace it.

出毛病.zh: 要是机器出毛病，你马上叫维修师傅来。
出毛病.en: If the machine malfunctions, call the repairman immediately.

出毛病.zh: 他最近身体出毛病，得好好休息。
出毛病.en: He's been having health problems lately and needs to rest well.

大棚.zh: 冬天大棚里种了很多蔬菜。
大棚.en: Many vegetables are grown in greenhouses in winter.

大棚.zh: 这个大棚草莓又大又甜。
大棚.en: The strawberries from this greenhouse are big and sweet.

大棚.zh: 农民用大棚技术来提高产量。
大棚.en: Farmers use greenhouse technology to increase yield.

大棚.zh: 虽然外面下雪，大棚里却暖洋洋的。
大棚.en: Even though it's snowing outside, it's warm inside the greenhouse.

大棚.zh: 他们建了好几个大棚来种反季节水果。
大棚.en: They built several greenhouses to grow off-season fruits.

概况.zh: 请你简单介绍一下公司概况。
概况.en: Please briefly introduce the company overview.

概况.zh: 这份报告里有市场概况的数据。
概况.en: This report contains data on the market overview.

概况.zh: 他先讲了一下项目概况，然后讨论细节。
概况.en: He first gave an overview of the project, then discussed details.

概况.zh: 关于这个地区的人口概况，你知道多少？
概况.en: How much do you know about the demographic overview of this area?

概况.zh: 面试时考官问了我的教育概况。
概况.en: During the interview, the examiner asked about my educational background.

耳熟能详.en: Everyone is very familiar with this song.

耳熟能详.zh: 这个故事在中国几乎耳熟能详。
耳熟能详.en: This story is almost a household tale in China.

耳熟能详.zh: 他的名字在我们行业里耳熟能详。
耳熟能详.en: His name is well-known in our industry.

耳熟能详.zh: 虽然道理耳熟能详，但真正做到的没几个。
耳熟能详.en: Although the principle is widely known, few actually practice it.

耳熟能详.zh: 那些广告词已经耳熟能详，连小孩都会背。
耳熟能详.en: Those advertising slogans are so familiar that even children can recite them.

起程.zh: 我们明天早上七点起程。
起程.en: We depart at seven tomorrow morning.

起程.zh: 他匆匆收拾行李，准备起程去北京。
起程.en: He quickly packed his luggage, ready to depart for Beijing.

起程.zh: 因为天气不好，起程时间推迟了。
起程.en: The departure time was delayed due to bad weather.

起程.zh: 你起程之前记得给我打个电话。
起程.en: Remember to call me before you set off.

起程.zh: 他们起程时下着大雨，但还是出发了。
起程.en: It was raining heavily when they departed, but they still set off.

顾不得.zh: 他顾不得吃饭就跑去上班了。
顾不得.en: He didn't have time to eat and rushed to work.

顾不得.zh: 我顾不得多解释，赶紧上了车。
顾不得.en: I didn't have time to explain much and quickly got in the car.

顾不得.zh: 她顾不得自己的安全，跳进水里救人。
顾不得.en: She disregarded her own safety and jumped into the water to save someone.

顾不得.zh: 那时候大家都顾不得休息，只想快点完成任务。
顾不得.en: At that time, no one could afford to rest; they just wanted to finish the task quickly.

顾不得.zh: 他顾不得外面下雨，直接冲了出去。
顾不得.en: He didn't care about the rain outside and rushed out directly.

讥笑.zh: 他总喜欢讥笑同学，结果没人愿意和他做朋友。
讥笑.en: He always likes to ridicule his classmates, and as a result, no one wants to be friends with him.

讥笑.zh: 你这样讥笑他，他心里肯定很难受。
讥笑.en: If you ridicule him like this, he must feel very upset inside.

讥笑.zh: 别人有困难时，我们不应该讥笑，而应该帮助。
讥笑.en: When others have difficulties, we should not ridicule them but help them.

讥笑.zh: 她因为被讥笑而变得很自卑。
讥笑.en: She became very insecure because she was ridiculed.

清脆.en: Her voice is very crisp and clear.

清脆.zh: 清晨，窗外传来一阵清脆的鸟叫声。
清脆.en: In the early morning, a burst of crisp bird songs came from outside the window.

清脆.zh: 这个铃铛的声音真清脆，一听就让人心情好。
清脆.en: The sound of this bell is really crisp; just hearing it puts you in a good mood.

清脆.zh: 他说话的声音清脆有力，大家都爱听他讲课。
清脆.en: His speaking voice is crisp and powerful, and everyone loves listening to his lectures.

清脆.zh: 孩子清脆的笑声在院子里回荡。
清脆.en: The child's crisp laughter echoed in the courtyard.

瞻仰.zh: 我们去瞻仰烈士纪念碑。
瞻仰.en: We went to pay respects at the martyrs' monument.

瞻仰.zh: 每年清明节，很多人去烈士陵园瞻仰革命先烈。
瞻仰.en: Every Qingming Festival, many people visit the martyrs' cemetery to pay homage to revolutionary martyrs.

瞻仰.zh: 他专程来到故居，瞻仰这位伟人的遗迹。
瞻仰.en: He made a special trip to the former residence to pay tribute to the relics of this great man.

瞻仰.zh: 瞻仰完这些历史文物，我对先辈更加敬佩了。
瞻仰.en: After viewing these historical artifacts with reverence, I admire our ancestors even more.

瞻仰.zh: 游客们静静地排队瞻仰遗容，表达哀思。
瞻仰.en: Tourists quietly lined up to pay their last respects to the deceased, expressing their grief.

耸立.en: The skyscraper towers in the city center.

耸立.zh: 这座古老的佛塔已经在这里耸立了上千年。
耸立.en: This ancient Buddhist pagoda has stood towering here for over a thousand years.

耸立.zh: 群山耸立，气势非常壮观。
耸立.en: The mountains tower imposingly, presenting a magnificent scene.

耸立.zh: 新建的电视塔高高耸立，成为城市新地标。
耸立.en: The newly built TV tower stands tall, becoming a new landmark of the city.

耸立.zh: 即使经历了地震，那座石塔依然耸立不倒。
耸立.en: Even after experiencing an earthquake, that stone pagoda still stands tall and unshaken.

掉队.zh: 学习上如果他再不努力，就要掉队了。
掉队.en: If he doesn't work harder in his studies, he will fall behind.

掉队.zh: 队伍走得太快，有几个小朋友掉队了。
掉队.en: The group walked too fast, and a few children fell behind.

掉队.zh: 别担心，我会等你，不会让你掉队的。
掉队.en: Don't worry, I'll wait for you and won't let you fall behind.

掉队.zh: 他因为生病休学一年，回来之后明显掉队了。
掉队.en: He took a year off school due to illness, and after returning, he was clearly falling behind.

恩情.zh: 父母的恩情，我们一辈子都报答不完。
恩情.en: The kindness of our parents can never be fully repaid in a lifetime.

恩情.zh: 他对我的恩情，我永远都不会忘记。
恩情.en: I will never forget the kindness he showed me.

恩情.zh: 这份恩情太重了，我不知道怎么感谢才好。
恩情.en: This kindness is too great; I don't know how to thank you enough.

恩情.zh: 滴水之恩当涌泉相报，何况这么大的恩情。
恩情.en: Even a drop of kindness should be repaid like a gushing spring, let alone such great kindness.

商贾.en: In ancient times, merchants gathered here.

商贾.zh: 这座城市自古以来就是商贾聚集之地。
商贾.en: This city has been a gathering place for merchants since ancient times.

商贾.zh: 商贾们通过丝绸之路进行贸易往来。
商贾.en: Merchants conducted trade through the Silk Road.

商贾.zh: 他虽然出身商贾之家，却一心只想读书。
商贾.en: Although he was born into a merchant family, he was only interested in studying.

商贾.zh: 如今商贾地位提高，但诚信经营仍是最重要的。
商贾.en: Nowadays, the status of merchants has risen, but honest business practices remain the most important.

治学.en: He is very rigorous in his scholarly research.

治学.zh: 这位教授治学数十载，成果丰硕。
治学.en: This professor has engaged in scholarly research for decades and has achieved fruitful results.

治学.zh: 治学之道，贵在坚持与求真。
治学.en: The way of scholarly research lies in perseverance and the pursuit of truth.

治学.zh: 他治学态度十分认真，从不抄袭他人。
治学.en: His attitude toward scholarly research is very serious, and he never plagiarizes others.

治学.zh: 治学不仅需要天赋，更需要勤奋和毅力。
治学.en: Scholarly research requires not only talent but also diligence and perseverance.

大同小异.en: These two plans are largely the same with minor differences.

大同小异.zh: 他们两个人的观点大同小异，没有本质区别。
大同小异.en: Their views are mostly the same with minor differences; there is no essential distinction.

大同小异.zh: 这些手机功能大同小异，选哪个都差不多。
大同小异.en: The features of these phones are pretty much the same; picking any one is about the same.

大同小异.zh: 虽然写法不同，但意思大同小异。
大同小异.en: Although the wording differs, the meaning is largely the same.

大同小异.zh: 各国文化虽有差异，但在基本道德上大同小异。
大同小异.en: Although cultures vary from country to country, they are mostly similar in basic morals.

磋商.en: The two parties are consulting on the details.

磋商.zh: 经过多轮磋商，两国终于达成了协议。
磋商.en: After multiple rounds of consultations, the two countries finally reached an agreement.

磋商.zh: 我们需要就合作方案进行磋商。
磋商.en: We need to hold consultations on the cooperation plan.

磋商.zh: 这件事还需要进一步磋商，不能急着决定。
磋商.en: This matter requires further consultation; we can't rush to a decision.

磋商.zh: 在正式签约前，双方律师进行了多次磋商。
磋商.en: Before officially signing the contract, the lawyers of both sides held multiple consultations.

折合.zh: 这顿饭折合下来每人一百块。
折合.en: This meal works out to 100 yuan per person.

折合.zh: 一美元折合多少人民币？
折合.en: How many Chinese yuan is one US dollar equivalent to?

折合.zh: 我们算了一下，折合人民币大概五千。
折合.en: We calculated it and it's equivalent to about five thousand RMB.

折合.zh: 他出国留学，折合成本得准备好几十万。
折合.en: He went abroad to study; the equivalent cost is preparing several hundred thousand.

折合.zh: 这个老房子的面积折合下来才五十平米。
折合.en: The area of this old house works out to only 50 square meters.

奸诈.zh: 那个人太奸诈了，千万别信他。
奸诈.en: That person is too treacherous, never trust him.

奸诈.zh: 他不像表面那么老实，其实特别奸诈。
奸诈.en: He's not as honest as he seems; in fact, he's very deceitful.

奸诈.zh: 这种奸诈的手段，也就只有他能想出来。
奸诈.en: Only he could come up with such a treacherous trick.

奸诈.zh: 他虽然聪明，但奸诈得让人不敢接近。
奸诈.en: Although he is smart, he is so deceitful that people dare not approach him.

奸诈.zh: 商人如果太奸诈，迟早会失去所有客户。
奸诈.en: If a businessman is too deceitful, he will eventually lose all his customers.

开垦.zh: 他们计划开垦那片荒地。
开垦.en: They plan to reclaim that wasteland.

开垦.zh: 农民们用了十年才开垦出这片农田。
开垦.en: It took the farmers ten years to cultivate this farmland.

开垦.zh: 这片山林开垦后种上了果树。
开垦.en: After reclaiming this mountain forest, they planted fruit trees.

开垦.zh: 在开垦新土地之前，要先做好水土保持。
开垦.en: Before reclaiming new land, you must first do soil and water conservation.

开垦.zh: 政府鼓励大家开垦荒地，但也要注意环保。
开垦.en: The government encourages people to reclaim wasteland, but also to pay attention to environmental protection.

一应俱全.zh: 新家装修好了，家具电器一应俱全。
一应俱全.en: The new house is renovated, with all furniture and appliances available.

一应俱全.zh: 我们去露营，帐篷睡袋一应俱全。
一应俱全.en: We went camping, with tents and sleeping bags all provided.

一应俱全.zh: 这家酒店设施很全，健身房游泳池一应俱全。
一应俱全.en: This hotel has full facilities, with gym and swimming pool everything.

一应俱全.zh: 他开的小卖部虽然不大，但日用百货一应俱全。
一应俱全.en: Although his small convenience store is not big, it has all daily necessities.

主题歌.zh: 我喜欢这部电影的主题歌。
主题歌.en: I like the theme song of this movie.

主题歌.zh: 这个动画片的主题歌小朋友都会唱。
主题歌.en: All the kids can sing the theme song of this cartoon.

主题歌.zh: 他们请了知名歌手来演唱奥运会的主题歌。
主题歌.en: They invited a famous singer to sing the Olympic theme song.

主题歌.zh: 主题歌一响起来，我就想起了剧里的情节。
主题歌.en: As soon as the theme song started, I remembered the plot of the drama.

主题歌.zh: 虽然这部电视剧不好看，但它的主题歌特别好听。
主题歌.en: Although this TV series is not good, its theme song is very pleasant to listen to.

学堂.en: There used to be a small school in the village.

学堂.zh: 爷爷小时候在私塾学堂念过书。
学堂.en: Grandpa studied in a private school when he was young.

学堂.zh: 这个学堂虽然旧，但很有历史感。
学堂.en: Although this school is old, it has a strong sense of history.

学堂.zh: 旧时的学堂里，先生会拿戒尺打手心。
学堂.en: In old-fashioned schools, the teacher would hit palms with a ruler.

学堂.zh: 我们村新修了一所学堂，孩子们不用跑远路了。
学堂.en: Our village built a new school, so children don't have to travel far.

太极拳.zh: 爷爷每天早起打太极拳。
太极拳.en: Grandpa does Tai Chi every morning.

太极拳.zh: 公园里很多老人在练太极拳。
太极拳.en: Many elderly people practice Tai Chi in the park.

太极拳.zh: 太极拳的动作很慢，但能锻炼身体。
太极拳.en: Tai Chi movements are very slow, but they can exercise the body.

太极拳.zh: 她学了三年的太极拳，现在动作特别标准。
太极拳.en: She has studied Tai Chi for three years, and now her movements are very standard.

太极拳.zh: 我打算报个班学太极拳，因为能放松身心。
太极拳.en: I plan to sign up for a Tai Chi class because it can relax the mind and body.

防疫.en: Epidemic prevention is very important recently.

防疫.zh: 社区里做了很多防疫宣传工作。
防疫.en: The community has done a lot of epidemic prevention publicity work.

防疫.zh: 出门戴口罩是基本的防疫措施。
防疫.en: Wearing a mask when going out is a basic epidemic prevention measure.

防疫.zh: 防疫期间，大家都要配合测体温。
防疫.en: During the epidemic prevention period, everyone must cooperate with temperature checks.

防疫.zh: 为了加强防疫，学校每天都要消毒教室。
防疫.en: To strengthen epidemic prevention, the school disinfects classrooms every day.

素不相识.en: He and I are total strangers.

素不相识.zh: 虽然我们素不相识，但他帮了我大忙。
素不相识.en: Although we were strangers, he helped me a lot.

素不相识.zh: 一个素不相识的人突然跟我打招呼。
素不相识.en: A complete stranger suddenly said hello to me.

素不相识.zh: 素不相识的人，怎么好意思开口借钱？
素不相识.en: How can a total stranger have the nerve to ask for money?

素不相识.zh: 在网络世界，我们可能跟对方素不相识，但也要注意礼貌。
素不相识.en: In the online world, we may be total strangers to each other, but we still need to be polite.

重中之重.zh: 当前，防疫工作是重中之重。
重中之重.en: Currently, epidemic prevention is the top priority.

重中之重.zh: 学习汉语，听说能力是重中之重。
重中之重.en: When learning Chinese, listening and speaking abilities are the top priority.

重中之重.zh: 在企业发展中，人才培养是重中之重。
重中之重.en: In the development of an enterprise, talent training is the top priority.

重中之重.zh: 虽然很多项目都要做，但质量把控是重中之重。
重中之重.en: Although many projects need to be done, quality control is the top priority.

谋害.en: He is suspected of plotting against a colleague.

谋害.zh: 警方正在调查这起谋害案。
谋害.en: The police are investigating this murder plot.

谋害.zh: 他为了财产谋害了自己的亲哥哥。
谋害.en: He plotted to murder his own brother for the inheritance.

谋害.zh: 虽然他没有直接动手，但确实参与了谋害计划。
谋害.en: Although he didn't act directly, he did participate in the murder plot.

谋害.zh: 电影里那个反派一直在暗中谋害主角。
谋害.en: In the movie, the villain has been secretly plotting to kill the protagonist.

面面俱到.en: She is thorough in everything she does.

面面俱到.zh: 这个计划虽然面面俱到，但执行起来很难。
面面俱到.en: Although this plan is comprehensive, it is hard to execute.

面面俱到.zh: 服务员的态度很好，照顾得很面面俱到。
面面俱到.en: The waiter's attitude is great, providing very thorough service.

面面俱到.zh: 一场成功的活动需要面面俱到的准备。
面面俱到.en: A successful event requires thorough preparation in every aspect.

面面俱到.zh: 他说话总是面面俱到，不会得罪任何人。
面面俱到.en: He always covers all aspects when speaking, offending no one.

呼风唤雨.en: He can wield great influence in the company.

呼风唤雨.zh: 在这个行业里，他简直可以呼风唤雨。
呼风唤雨.en: In this industry, he can practically call the shots.

呼风唤雨.zh: 别以为当了领导就能呼风唤雨。
呼风唤雨.en: Don't think that being a leader means you can control everything.

呼风唤雨.zh: 他虽然只是个经纪人，但在娱乐圈却能呼风唤雨。
呼风唤雨.en: Although he is just an agent, he wields immense power in the entertainment industry.

呼风唤雨.zh: 他靠着自己的能力和人脉，在这个地方呼风唤雨。
呼风唤雨.en: With his own ability and connections, he dominates this place.

括号.en: Write the answer in the parentheses.

括号.zh: 这段话里的括号部分需要补充说明。
括号.en: The part in parentheses in this paragraph needs further explanation.

括号.zh: 请把错误的词语用括号括起来。
括号.en: Please put the incorrect words in parentheses.

括号.zh: 引用原文时，省略的内容要用括号标注。
括号.en: When quoting the original text, use parentheses to mark omitted content.

括号.zh: 这个公式里的括号不能去掉，否则意思就变了。
括号.en: The parentheses in this formula cannot be removed, or the meaning will change.

精打细算.en: Mom is very good at budgeting.

精打细算.zh: 为了省钱，她每个月的开销都精打细算。
精打细算.en: To save money, she carefully budgets her monthly expenses.

精打细算.zh: 旅游的时候也要精打细算，不然钱不够用。
精打细算.en: When traveling, you also need to budget carefully, or you'll run out of money.

精打细算.zh: 他虽然收入不高，但因为精打细算，日子过得不错。
精打细算.en: Although his income is low, he lives well because he budgets carefully.

精打细算.zh: 这家公司之所以能盈利，全靠老板精打细算。
精打细算.en: This company can turn a profit entirely because the boss is frugal and meticulous.

一筹莫展.en: He is anxious and at his wit's end.

一筹莫展.zh: 面对这个难题，大家都一筹莫展。
一筹莫展.en: Faced with this difficult problem, everyone is at a loss.

一筹莫展.zh: 电脑突然坏了，他对着屏幕一筹莫展。
一筹莫展.en: The computer suddenly broke, and he was at a loss staring at the screen.

一筹莫展.zh: 如果到时候还是找不到解决办法，我们真的就一筹莫展了。
一筹莫展.en: If we still can't find a solution by then, we'll really be stuck.

一筹莫展.zh: 在那种紧急情况下，连经验丰富的老师傅也一筹莫展。
一筹莫展.en: In that emergency, even the experienced master was at a complete loss.

砂糖.en: Please add a spoonful of granulated sugar.

砂糖.zh: 做蛋糕时，砂糖和面粉的比例很重要。
砂糖.en: When making a cake, the ratio of sugar to flour is important.

砂糖.zh: 咖啡里放点砂糖更好喝。
砂糖.en: Adding a little granulated sugar to coffee makes it taste better.

砂糖.zh: 这种饼干用的是红糖，不是白砂糖。
砂糖.en: This kind of cookie uses brown sugar, not white granulated sugar.

砂糖.zh: 砂糖用完了，我得去超市买一袋。
砂糖.en: We've run out of granulated sugar; I need to go buy a bag at the supermarket.

潜移默化.zh: 环境会潜移默化影响人。
父母的言行对孩子有潜移默化的作用。
潜移默化.en: Parents' words and actions have an imperceptible influence on children.

潜移默化.zh: 长期看高质量的书籍，会潜移默化提升你的修养。
潜移默化.en: Reading high-quality books over time will subtly improve your character.

潜移默化.zh: 好的习惯是慢慢养成的，靠的是潜移默化。
潜移默化.en: Good habits are formed slowly, through imperceptible influence.

潜移默化.zh: 广告对我们的消费观念有潜移默化的影响。
潜移默化.en: Advertisements have a subtle influence on our consumption concepts.

富强.en: A prosperous and strong country brings happiness to its people.

富强.zh: 我们这一代人要努力让祖国变得更加富强。
富强.en: Our generation must work hard to make the motherland more prosperous and strong.

富强.zh: 只有教育才能让国家真正富强起来。
富强.en: Only education can truly make a country prosperous and strong.

富强.zh: 历史上没有一个国家是靠掠夺而长久富强的。
富强.en: Historically, no country has achieved lasting prosperity and strength through plunder.

富强.zh: 他们希望自己的家乡能像沿海城市一样富强。
富强.en: They hope their hometown can become as prosperous and strong as the coastal cities.

目中无人.zh: 自从升职以后，他就变得目中无人。
目中无人.en: Since getting promoted, he has become arrogant and looked down on others.

目中无人.zh: 目中无人的人往往交不到真朋友。
目中无人.en: Arrogant people often fail to make real friends.

目中无人.zh: 他虽然很有才华，但因为目中无人，同事都不喜欢他。
目中无人.en: Although he is very talented, his colleagues don't like him because he is arrogant.

目中无人.zh: 你说话的语气那么目中无人，谁会愿意帮你？
目中无人.en: With such an arrogant tone, who would be willing to help you?

函授.en: I signed up for a correspondence course.

函授.zh: 因为工作太忙，我选择了函授学习。
函授.en: Because I'm too busy with work, I chose distance learning.

函授.zh: 她通过函授拿到了大学文凭。
函授.en: She got a university diploma through correspondence.

函授.zh: 现在很多函授课程都在网上进行。
函授.en: Many correspondence courses are now conducted online.

函授.zh: 虽然函授很方便，但需要很强的自制力。
函授.en: Although correspondence is convenient, it requires strong self-discipline.

历届.zh: 历届毕业生都回来参加校庆。
历届.en: All previous graduates came back for the school anniversary.

历届.zh: 这个展览展出了历届获奖作品。
历届.en: This exhibition displays award-winning works from all previous sessions.

历届.zh: 历届总统中，他算是最受欢迎的。
历届.en: Among all past presidents, he is considered the most popular.

历届.zh: 学校整理了历届学生的优秀论文。
历届.en: The school compiled outstanding theses from previous cohorts of students.

历届.zh: 虽然历届比赛都很激烈，但今年尤其精彩。
历届.en: Although all previous competitions were intense, this year's was especially exciting.

痴心.zh: 她对他的痴心感动了所有人。
痴心.en: Her devoted love for him moved everyone.

痴心.zh: 你别痴心妄想了，那是不可能的。
痴心.en: Don't be wishful thinking; that's impossible.

痴心.zh: 虽然他拒绝了她，她还是痴心不改。
痴心.en: Even though he rejected her, she remained infatuated.

痴心.zh: 因为痴心，她等了十年才结婚。
痴心.en: Because of her devotion, she waited ten years to get married.

竞相.en: Major media outlets are competing to report.

竞相.zh: 商家们竞相推出新产品。
竞相.en: Businesses are launching new products in competition.

竞相.zh: 学生们竞相报名参加这个比赛。
竞相.en: Students are vying to sign up for this competition.

竞相.zh: 由于市场火爆，公司竞相投资这个领域。
竞相.en: Because the market is booming, companies are rushing to invest in this field.

竞相.zh: 虽然风险很大，但很多人仍竞相尝试。
竞相.en: Although the risk is high, many people still compete to try.

无所作为.zh: 再这样无所作为，公司就倒闭了。
无所作为.en: If we keep being inactive like this, the company will go bankrupt.

无所作为.zh: 年轻人不该无所作为，要努力奋斗。
无所作为.en: Young people should not be idle; they must strive hard.

无所作为.zh: 因为领导无所作为，团队士气很低落。
无所作为.en: Because the leader is ineffective, team morale is very low.

无所作为.zh: 虽然想帮忙，但能力有限，只能无所作为。
无所作为.en: Although I want to help, my ability is limited, so I can only remain inactive.

纲要.en: This is the outline of the meeting.

纲要.zh: 政府发布了新的发展纲要。
纲要.en: The government released a new development outline.

纲要.zh: 他写了一份详细的课程纲要。
纲要.en: He wrote a detailed course outline.

纲要.zh: 这个纲要包含了所有重要章节。
纲要.en: This outline includes all important chapters.

纲要.zh: 虽然纲要很简单，但内容很丰富。
纲要.en: Although the outline is simple, the content is rich.

豪迈.en: He speaks in a very bold manner.

豪迈.zh: 这首诗充满了豪迈的气概。
豪迈.en: This poem is full of heroic spirit.

豪迈.zh: 他豪迈地宣布了创业计划。
豪迈.en: He boldly announced his entrepreneurial plan.

豪迈.zh: 虽然失败过，但他依然很豪迈。
豪迈.en: Even though he has failed, he remains magnanimous.

豪迈.zh: 在困难面前，他表现出了豪迈的态度。
豪迈.en: In the face of difficulties, he showed a heroic attitude.

成群结队.zh: 游客们成群结队地涌入景区。
成群结队.en: Tourists flood into the scenic area in crowds.

成群结队.zh: 放学后，孩子们成群结队地回家。
成群结队.en: After school, children go home in groups.

成群结队.zh: 因为天气好，大家都成群结队出去玩了。
成群结队.en: Because the weather is nice, everyone went out in groups to have fun.

成群结队.zh: 虽然天黑，他们还是成群结队地去探险。
成群结队.en: Although it was dark, they still went exploring in groups.

旭日.en: The rising sun in the east.
We got up early to see the rising sun.

旭日.zh: 旭日的光芒洒满了大地。
旭日.en: The light of the rising sun spreads across the land.

旭日.zh: 在海边看旭日是一件很浪漫的事。
旭日.en: Watching the rising sun by the sea is a very romantic thing.

旭日.zh: 虽然昨晚下过雨，今天旭日依然很美。
旭日.en: Even though it rained last night, the rising sun is still beautiful today.

争光.en: He brings honor to the country.

争光.zh: 运动员们努力为祖国争光。
争光.en: The athletes strive to win glory for the motherland.

争光.zh: 她想在比赛中争光，所以训练很刻苦。
争光.en: She wants to win glory in the competition, so she trains very hard.

争光.zh: 虽然压力很大，但他们还是为团队争光了。
争光.en: Although the pressure was great, they still brought honor to the team.

外向.en: She is very extroverted and likes to make friends.

外向.zh: 我虽然性格外向，但有时候也需要独处。
外向.en: Although I am extroverted, sometimes I also need to be alone.

外向.zh: 外向的人通常比较擅长社交。
外向.en: Extroverted people are usually better at socializing.

外向.zh: 他不算外向，不过跟熟人话挺多的。
外向.en: He's not very extroverted, but he talks a lot with people he knows.

外向.zh: 找工作时，外向的性格可能会有优势。
外向.en: When looking for a job, an extroverted personality might be an advantage.

呜咽.zh: 听到坏消息后，她忍不住呜咽起来。
呜咽.en: After hearing the bad news, she couldn't help but sob.

呜咽.zh: 那只小狗受伤了，一直在角落里呜咽。
呜咽.en: That little dog was injured and kept whimpering in the corner.

呜咽.zh: 他努力控制情绪，但还是发出了呜咽声。
呜咽.en: He tried to control his emotions, but still let out a sob.

呜咽.zh: 夜深人静时，她独自呜咽着思念家乡。
呜咽.en: In the dead of night, she sobbed alone, missing her hometown.

回落.zh: 最近气温有所回落，没那么热了。
回落.en: The temperature has dropped recently; it's not that hot anymore.

回落.zh: 股市大幅上涨后，今天开始回落。
回落.en: After a sharp rise, the stock market started to fall back today.

回落.zh: 虽然前几天疫情反弹，但现在已经回落了。
回落.en: Although the epidemic rebounded a few days ago, it has now subsided.

回落.zh: 暴雨过后，河水水位逐渐回落到正常水平。
回落.en: After the heavy rain, the river water level gradually dropped back to normal.

此起彼伏.zh: 音乐会现场欢呼声此起彼伏。
此起彼伏.en: Cheers echoed continuously at the concert.

此起彼伏.zh: 海浪此起彼伏，非常壮观。
此起彼伏.en: The waves rose and fell continuously, very spectacular.

此起彼伏.zh: 讨论时大家的意见此起彼伏，很难统一。
此起彼伏.en: During the discussion, opinions kept coming up, making it hard to reach a consensus.

此起彼伏.zh: 山谷里回荡着此起彼伏的鸟鸣声。
此起彼伏.en: The valley echoed with the continuous chirping of birds.

宽泛.en: The meaning of this word is very broad.

宽泛.zh: 这个问题的范围太宽泛了，不好回答。
宽泛.en: This question is too broad in scope, hard to answer.

宽泛.zh: 他对历史的概念理解比较宽泛。
宽泛.en: His understanding of the concept of history is quite broad.

宽泛.zh: 法律的定义有时很宽泛，需要具体解释。
宽泛.en: Legal definitions are sometimes very broad and require specific interpretation.

宽泛.zh: 虽然规则很宽泛，但具体执行时还要看情况。
宽泛.en: Although the rules are broad, the actual implementation depends on the situation.

汪洋.en: Before us is a vast expanse of water.

汪洋.zh: 洪水过后，村子变成了汪洋。
汪洋.en: After the flood, the village turned into a vast ocean.

汪洋.zh: 站在海边，感觉像置身汪洋之中。
汪洋.en: Standing by the sea, it feels like being in the middle of an ocean.

汪洋.zh: 船在汪洋大海上航行，四周看不到陆地。
汪洋.en: The ship sailed on the vast ocean, with no land in sight.

汪洋.zh: 他的悲伤像汪洋一样深不见底。
汪洋.en: His sadness is as deep and boundless as an ocean.

灵机一动.zh: 他灵机一动，想出了办法。
灵机一动.en: He had a brainwave and came up with a solution.

灵机一动.zh: 考试时我灵机一动，写出了答案。
灵机一动.en: During the exam, I had a sudden inspiration and wrote down the answer.

灵机一动.zh: 看到那个广告，她灵机一动有了主意。
灵机一动.en: Seeing that ad, she had a brainstorm and got an idea.

灵机一动.zh: 我正发愁呢，突然灵机一动想到了解决方案。
灵机一动.en: I was worrying, then suddenly had a flash of insight and thought of a solution.

灵机一动.zh: 他灵机一动，把旧衣服改成了环保袋。
灵机一动.en: He had a brainwave and turned old clothes into eco-friendly bags.

聚精会神.en: He is reading a book with great concentration.

聚精会神.zh: 学生们聚精会神地听老师讲课。
聚精会神.en: The students are listening to the teacher attentively.

聚精会神.zh: 我聚精会神地盯着屏幕，生怕错过细节。
聚精会神.en: I stared at the screen intently, afraid to miss any details.

聚精会神.zh: 她聚精会神地弹钢琴，完全没注意到我进来。
聚精会神.en: She was playing the piano with full concentration and didn't notice me come in.

聚精会神.zh: 工作时需要聚精会神，不能分心。
聚精会神.en: When working, you need to concentrate and not get distracted.

划时代.zh: 这是一个划时代的发明。
互联网的诞生是划时代的大事。
划时代.en: The birth of the internet was a monumental event.

划时代.zh: 那次会议做出了划时代的决定。
划时代.en: That meeting made an epoch-making decision.

划时代.zh: 他的理论被认为是划时代的贡献。
划时代.en: His theory is considered an epoch-making contribution.

划时代.zh: 智能手机的出现是划时代的，改变了人们的生活。
划时代.en: The emergence of smartphones was epoch-making, changing people's lives.

驰名.en: This brand is famous both at home and abroad.

驰名.zh: 他的画作在艺术界驰名。
驰名.en: His paintings are renowned in the art world.

驰名.zh: 这家餐厅的烤鸭驰名全国。
驰名.en: This restaurant's roast duck is famous nationwide.

驰名.zh: 他是一位驰名世界的科学家。
虽然产品驰名，但价格也很昂贵。
驰名.en: Although the product is well-known, its price is also very high.

踏上.zh: 他终于踏上了回家的路。
踏上.en: He finally set foot on the road home.

踏上.zh: 我们踏上这片土地时，心情很激动。
踏上.en: When we stepped onto this land, we were very excited.

踏上.zh: 她踏上舞台的那一刻，全场都安静了。
踏上.en: The moment she stepped onto the stage, the whole audience fell silent.

踏上.zh: 虽然困难很多，但他还是勇敢地踏上了创业这条路。
踏上.en: Although there were many difficulties, he bravely embarked on the path of entrepreneurship.

踏上.zh: 春天来了，我们决定踏上一次说走就走的旅行。
踏上.en: Spring has come, and we decided to embark on a spontaneous trip.

因人而异.zh: 这件事因人而异，没有标准答案。
因人而异.en: This matter varies from person to person; there is no standard answer.

因人而异.zh: 学习效果因人而异，不能一概而论。
因人而异.en: Learning outcomes vary from person to person, so you can't generalize.

因人而异.zh: 对幸福的定义因人而异，所以不必强求一致。
因人而异.en: The definition of happiness varies from person to person, so there's no need to force uniformity.

因人而异.zh: 每个人对辣味的接受程度因人而异，点菜时要问清楚。
因人而异.en: Everyone's tolerance for spiciness varies, so ask clearly when ordering.

因人而异.zh: 睡眠时间需求因人而异，有些人睡六个小时就够了。
因人而异.en: Sleep duration needs vary from person to person; some people only need six hours.

旷课.zh: 老师警告他不要再旷课。
旷课.en: The teacher warned him not to skip class again.

旷课.zh: 他经常旷课去打游戏，最后成绩一落千丈。
旷课.en: He often skipped class to play games, and his grades plummeted.

旷课.zh: 如果你旷课太多，可能会被取消考试资格。
旷课.en: If you skip too many classes, you might be disqualified from the exam.

亭子.en: There is a small pavilion in the park.
We took shelter from the rain in the pavilion.

亭子.zh: 那个亭子建在湖边，风景很好。
亭子.en: That pavilion is built by the lake, and the scenery is beautiful.

亭子.zh: 老人喜欢在亭子里下棋聊天。
亭子.en: The elderly like to play chess and chat in the pavilion.

亭子.zh: 这个亭子虽然不大，但是很精致。
亭子.en: Although this pavilion is not big, it is very delicate.

不利于.en: Staying up late is very bad for your skin.

不利于.zh: 这种做法不利于长期发展。
不利于.en: This approach is not beneficial for long-term development.

不利于.zh: 负面情绪不利于工作效率。
不利于.en: Negative emotions are detrimental to work efficiency.

不利于.zh: 如果总是批评孩子，反而不利于他们的成长。
不利于.en: If you always criticize children, it actually hinders their growth.

稍候.en: Please wait a moment; I'll be right there.
Wait a moment; it will be ready soon.
Please wait a moment; I'll check for you.

稍候.zh: 系统正在更新，请稍候再试。
稍候.en: The system is updating; please wait and try again.

稍候.zh: 稍候一下，我要接个电话。
稍候.en: Wait a moment; I need to take a call.

义工.en: He does volunteer work on weekends.

义工.zh: 很多学生报名当了义工。
义工.en: Many students signed up to be volunteers.

义工.zh: 她在养老院做义工已经三年了。
义工.en: She has been volunteering at a nursing home for three years.

义工.zh: 这次活动需要二十名义工帮忙。
义工.en: This event needs twenty volunteers to help.

义工.zh: 做义工不仅能帮助别人，还能丰富自己的经历。
义工.en: Volunteering not only helps others but also enriches your own experience.

蕴涵.zh: 这句话蕴涵着深刻的道理。
蕴涵.en: This sentence contains a profound truth.

蕴涵.zh: 他的眼神蕴涵着复杂的情感。
这个故事蕴涵了丰富的人生哲理。
蕴涵.en: This story contains rich life philosophies.

蕴涵.zh: 简单的话语往往蕴涵着无穷的力量。
蕴涵.en: Simple words often contain infinite power.

蕴涵.zh: 文化传统中蕴涵着许多值得我们学习的智慧。
蕴涵.en: Cultural traditions contain much wisdom worth learning.

难能可贵.zh: 在困难面前不放弃，这种精神难能可贵。
难能可贵.en: Not giving up in the face of difficulties—this spirit is truly commendable.

难能可贵.zh: 她小小年纪就这么懂事，真是难能可贵。
难能可贵.en: She is so mature at such a young age; that is really commendable.

难能可贵.zh: 愿意在别人需要时伸出援手，这种行为难能可贵。
难能可贵.en: Being willing to lend a hand when others need it—such behavior is admirable.

难能可贵.zh: 他能坚持每天跑步十年，这份毅力难能可贵。
难能可贵.en: He has stuck to running every day for ten years—this perseverance is truly commendable.

不约而同.zh: 我们俩不约而同地笑了。
不约而同.en: We both laughed at the same time without prior arrangement.

不约而同.zh: 大家不约而同地鼓起了掌。
不约而同.en: Everyone clapped spontaneously at the same time.

不约而同.zh: 今天我和朋友不约而同穿了同款T恤。
不约而同.en: Today, my friend and I coincidentally wore the same T-shirt.

不约而同.zh: 几个同事不约而同地提出了辞职。
不约而同.en: Several colleagues unexpectedly submitted resignations at the same time.

不约而同.zh: 看到那个场景，我们不约而同地想起了小时候的事。
不约而同.en: Seeing that scene, we all thought of childhood memories at the same moment.

古朴.zh: 这座古镇保留了很多古朴的建筑。
古朴.en: This ancient town has preserved many simple and unsophisticated buildings.

古朴.zh: 我喜欢这种古朴的风格，感觉很自然。
古朴.en: I like this simple and unsophisticated style; it feels very natural.

古朴.zh: 虽然家具很古朴，但住起来特别舒服。
古朴.en: Although the furniture is simple and unsophisticated, it's very comfortable to live with.

古朴.zh: 这个村子里的石桥看起来非常古朴，有上百年的历史了。
古朴.en: The stone bridge in this village looks very simple and unsophisticated, and it's over a hundred years old.

古朴.zh: 她穿了一件古朴的旗袍，搭配那木质的发簪，很有韵味。
古朴.en: She wore a simple and unsophisticated cheongsam, paired with that wooden hairpin, which was quite charming.

出难题.en: Don't make things difficult for me.

出难题.zh: 他总爱在开会的时候出难题，让大家下不来台。
出难题.en: He always likes to throw out tough problems during meetings, embarrassing everyone.

出难题.zh: 这个客户太挑剔了，老是在细节上出难题。
出难题.en: This client is too picky, always making things difficult on the details.

出难题.zh: 如果你不想合作，那就别硬撑着，何必互相出难题呢？
出难题.en: If you don't want to cooperate, then don't force it. Why make things difficult for each other?

亡羊补牢.zh: 现在亡羊补牢还来得及。
亡羊补牢.en: It's not too late to lock the stable door after the horse has bolted.

亡羊补牢.zh: 虽然出了问题，但亡羊补牢也不算晚。
亡羊补牢.en: Even though there's a problem, it's not too late to take corrective measures.

亡羊补牢.zh: 这次失败后，我们要亡羊补牢，加强管理。
亡羊补牢.en: After this failure, we need to lock the stable door after the horse has bolted and strengthen management.

亡羊补牢.zh: 其实只要肯亡羊补牢，很多错误都可以挽回。
亡羊补牢.en: In fact, as long as you are willing to take corrective action, many mistakes can be remedied.

亡羊补牢.zh: 别光后悔了，与其自责不如亡羊补牢，想想下一步怎么做。
亡羊补牢.en: Don't just regret; instead of blaming yourself, it's better to lock the stable door and think about what to do next.

哺育.en: Mother nurtured us as we grew up.

哺育.zh: 这片土地哺育了世世代代的人。
哺育.en: This land has nurtured generations of people.

哺育.zh: 小燕子每天都要找食物来哺育幼鸟。
哺育.en: The swallow has to find food every day to feed its chicks.

哺育.zh: 老师像园丁一样哺育着祖国的花朵。
哺育.en: Teachers, like gardeners, nurture the flowers of our country.

哺育.zh: 大自然是人类赖以生存的母亲，她哺育了我们的一切。
哺育.en: Nature is the mother that humans rely on for survival; she has nurtured everything for us.

按说.en: He should have arrived by now, normally speaking.

按说.zh: 按说今天不会下雨，所以我没带伞。
按说.en: It shouldn't rain today, by all accounts, so I didn't bring an umbrella.

按说.zh: 按说你已经复习过了，考试应该没问题才对。
按说.en: Normally, since you've reviewed, the exam should be no problem.

按说.zh: 按说这个工作不难，但我做起来总觉得不顺。
按说.en: This job ought to be easy, but I always feel it's not going smoothly.

按说.zh: 按说他是个老实人，可这次怎么说了谎呢？
按说.en: He's usually an honest person, so how come he lied this time?

欣欣向荣.zh: 春天来了，万物欣欣向荣。
欣欣向荣.en: Spring is here, and everything is thriving.

欣欣向荣.zh: 这几年家乡的经济欣欣向荣。
欣欣向荣.en: In recent years, my hometown's economy has been booming.

欣欣向荣.zh: 小公司发展得欣欣向荣，很快就搬进了新大楼。
欣欣向荣.en: The small company is thriving and soon moved into a new building.

欣欣向荣.zh: 看着孩子们一张张笑脸，校园里一片欣欣向荣的景象。
欣欣向荣.en: Looking at the smiling faces of the children, the campus presents a scene of thriving vitality.

欣欣向荣.zh: 虽然市场大环境不好，但这家店却经营得欣欣向荣。
欣欣向荣.en: Although the overall market environment is not good, this store is operating prosperously.

心急如焚.zh: 他心急如焚地等着结果。
心急如焚.en: He waited anxiously for the results.

心急如焚.zh: 女儿还没回家，妈妈心急如焚。
心急如焚.en: The daughter hasn't come home yet, and the mother is extremely worried.

心急如焚.zh: 火车快开了，他还没到，我真是心急如焚。
心急如焚.en: The train is about to leave, and he hasn't arrived yet; I'm really on tenterhooks.

心急如焚.zh: 看到病人情况恶化，医生心急如焚，立刻安排了手术。
心急如焚.en: Seeing the patient's condition worsen, the doctor was frantic with worry and immediately arranged surgery.

心急如焚.zh: 别心急如焚了，我们已经报警，很快就会有消息的。
心急如焚.en: Don't be so anxious; we've already called the police, and there will be news soon.

官吏.zh: 历史上有很多清正廉洁的官吏被百姓爱戴。
官吏.en: In history, many upright and honest officials were loved by the people.

官吏.zh: 这个制度要求官吏必须以身作则，为民服务。
官吏.en: This system requires that officials must lead by example and serve the people.

官吏.zh: 当时很多官吏都在私下里做一些见不得人的交易。
官吏.en: At that time, many officials were secretly engaging in shady deals.

次品.en: There are many defective products in this batch.

次品.zh: 我们要求退货，因为全是次品。
次品.en: We request a return because they are all defective.

次品.zh: 厂家承诺如果发现次品，可以免费更换。
次品.en: The manufacturer promises that if defective products are found, they can be replaced for free.

次品.zh: 质检员正在检查每一个零件，防止次品流到市场上。
次品.en: The quality inspector is checking every part to prevent defective products from reaching the market.

次品.zh: 虽然价格便宜，但都是次品，用不了多久就坏了。
次品.en: Although the price is cheap, they are all defective goods and will break down soon.

备课.en: The teacher is preparing a lesson.

备课.zh: 今天晚上我得备课，没时间出去玩。
备课.en: I have to prepare lessons tonight and have no time to go out.

备课.zh: 为了上好这节课，她备课备到了深夜。
备课.en: To teach this class well, she prepared the lesson until late at night.

备课.zh: 新老师经验不足，每次备课都要花很长时间。
备课.en: The new teacher lacks experience and spends a long time preparing each lesson.

备课.zh: 备课不仅要准备内容，还要想想怎么让学生更容易理解。
备课.en: Preparing a lesson not only involves preparing the content, but also thinking about how to make it easier for students to understand.

走后门.zh: 现在很多家长为了孩子上学喜欢走后门。
走后门.en: Nowadays many parents like to use connections for their children's schooling.

走后门.zh: 她虽然成绩一般，但因为走后门进了那家公司。
走后门.en: Although her grades were average, she got into that company through backdoor channels.

走后门.zh: 走后门办事虽然快，但心里总不踏实。
走后门.en: Getting things done through the backdoor is fast, but it always feels uneasy.

走后门.zh: 他这次升职全靠走后门，同事们都看不起他。
走后门.en: He got promoted entirely through backdoor deals, and his colleagues look down on him.

守株待兔.en: You can't just wait for luck to come.

守株待兔.zh: 机会要主动争取，不能守株待兔。
守株待兔.en: Opportunities must be actively pursued, not waited for passively.

守株待兔.zh: 他每天在家睡觉，以为钱会自己来，真是守株待兔。
守株待兔.en: He sleeps at home every day thinking money will come by itself — that's really waiting for luck.

守株待兔.zh: 与其守株待兔，不如自己出去找找机会。
守株待兔.en: Rather than waiting for luck, you might as well go out and look for opportunities yourself.

守株待兔.zh: 老板批评他守株待兔，从来不去开拓新客户。
守株待兔.en: The boss criticized him for just waiting around and never developing new clients.

改为.en: I changed my name to Xiaoming.

改为.zh: 这个计划需要改为更简单的版本。
改为.en: This plan needs to be changed to a simpler version.

改为.zh: 由于天气原因，活动时间改为明天下午。
改为.en: Due to weather, the event time has been changed to tomorrow afternoon.

改为.zh: 原来的规定太严格了，我们改为每周一次检查。
改为.en: The original rules were too strict, so we changed them to a weekly inspection.

改为.zh: 他建议把会议地点改为离公司近一点的酒店。
改为.en: He suggested changing the meeting venue to a hotel closer to the company.

落户.en: He settled in Shanghai last year.

落户.zh: 很多年轻人想在北上广落户。
落户.en: Many young people want to settle in Beijing, Shanghai, or Guangzhou.

落户.zh: 这家公司在我们这里落户后，带动了经济发展。
落户.en: After this company settled here, it boosted the local economy.

落户.zh: 她为了孩子上学，想办法在学区落户。
落户.en: She found a way to settle in the school district for her child's education.

落户.zh: 虽然在大城市落户不容易，但他还是坚持下来了。
落户.en: Although settling in a big city is not easy, he still persisted.

怜惜.zh: 他很怜惜那只受伤的小猫。
怜惜.en: He felt pity for the injured kitten.

怜惜.zh: 看到她哭得那么伤心，我心里满是怜惜。
怜惜.en: Seeing her cry so sadly, my heart was full of compassion.

怜惜.zh: 他从不怜惜自己的体力，总是拼命工作。
怜惜.en: He never spares his own strength, always working desperately.

怜惜.zh: 老人对流浪儿充满了怜惜，给他买了吃的。
怜惜.en: The old man was full of pity for the homeless child and bought him food.

怜惜.zh: 虽然她很可怜，但你过度怜惜反而会让她更脆弱。
怜惜.en: Although she is pitiful, excessive pity from you will only make her more fragile.

师长.en: We should respect our teachers and elders.

师长.zh: 他从小就是个听师长话的好孩子。
师长.en: He has been a good kid who listens to his teachers and elders since childhood.

师长.zh: 在部队里，他把老兵都当做自己的师长。
师长.en: In the army, he regarded the veterans as his mentors.

师长.zh: 这次演讲邀请了多位资深师长来指导。
师长.en: This speech invited several senior mentors to provide guidance.

师长.zh: 她不仅成绩好，而且很懂礼貌，经常主动问候师长。
师长.en: She not only has good grades but is also polite, often greeting her teachers and elders actively.

出神.en: He was spacing out during class.

出神.zh: 别出神了，快把作业写完。
出神.en: Stop daydreaming and finish your homework quickly.

惨白.en: His face turned pale from fright.

惨白.zh: 她生病后脸色惨白，一点血色都没有。
惨白.en: After falling ill, her face was deathly pale with no color.

惨白.zh: 听到噩耗时，他的嘴唇变得惨白。
惨白.en: Upon hearing the bad news, his lips turned pale.

惨白.zh: 灯光下她的皮肤显得惨白，像纸一样。
惨白.en: Under the light, her skin looked deathly pale, like paper.

惨白.zh: 他从急诊室出来，脸上惨白得吓人。
惨白.en: He came out of the emergency room with a frighteningly pale face.

碧绿.en: In spring, the fields are a lush green.

碧绿.zh: 湖水碧绿得像一块翡翠。
碧绿.en: The lake water is as green as an emerald.

碧绿.zh: 她穿着一条碧绿的裙子，很显眼。
碧绿.en: She wore a bright green dress that stood out.

碧绿.zh: 雨后的竹子更加碧绿，充满了生机。
碧绿.en: After the rain, the bamboo became even greener, full of life.

碧绿.zh: 这家店卖的茶叶泡出来汤色碧绿，香气扑鼻。
碧绿.en: The tea sold at this shop has a bright green color when brewed and a rich aroma.

不辞而别.en: He left last night without saying goodbye.

不辞而别.zh: 她不辞而别，让大家都很担心。
不辞而别.en: She left without saying goodbye, making everyone worry.

不辞而别.zh: 我没想到他会不辞而别，连个消息都没留。
不辞而别.en: I didn't expect him to leave without a word, not even leaving a message.

不辞而别.zh: 朋友不辞而别，他伤心了好几天。
不辞而别.en: His friend left without saying goodbye, and he was sad for days.

不辞而别.zh: 如果你不辞而别，公司可能会扣你工资。
不辞而别.en: If you leave without notice, the company might deduct your pay.

清明.en: We visited the graves on Qingming Festival.

清明.zh: 清明天气很好，适合出去走走。
清明.en: The weather is clear and bright, perfect for a walk.

清明.zh: 虽然清明假期很短，但我还是回了老家。
清明.en: Although the Qingming holiday is short, I still went back to my hometown.

清明.zh: 清明前后种瓜点豆，农民们开始忙了。
清明.en: Around Qingming, farmers start planting melons and beans.

清明.zh: 今年清明没下雨，我们全家去郊游了。
清明.en: It didn't rain this Qingming, so our whole family went on an outing.

骤然.zh: 暴雨骤然来临，大家赶紧躲进屋里。
骤然.en: The rainstorm suddenly came, and everyone quickly hid inside.

骤然.zh: 听到这个消息，她骤然停下了脚步。
骤然.en: Upon hearing the news, she abruptly stopped walking.

骤然.zh: 本来还好好的，气氛却骤然紧张起来。
骤然.en: It was fine just now, but the atmosphere suddenly became tense.

哗然.en: The whole audience was in an uproar.
His words caused an uproar among the audience.

哗然.zh: 消息传出后，舆论一片哗然。
哗然.en: After the news broke, public opinion was in an uproar.

哗然.zh: 老师宣布取消考试时，教室里顿时哗然。
哗然.en: When the teacher announced the cancellation of the exam, the classroom immediately erupted.

哗然.zh: 因为价格突然翻倍，顾客们哗然不满。
哗然.en: Because the price suddenly doubled, the customers were in an uproar and dissatisfied.

忙乱.en: In the rush, I forgot to bring my keys.

忙乱.zh: 早上出门太忙乱，连手机都忘拿了。
忙乱.en: I was so flustered leaving in the morning that I even forgot my phone.

忙乱.zh: 过节那天厨房里一片忙乱。
忙乱.en: The kitchen was a mess of activity on the holiday.

忙乱.zh: 搬家的时候忙乱得很，很多东西都找不到了。
忙乱.en: It was very chaotic during the move, and many things couldn't be found.

忙乱.zh: 他做事总是慌慌张张，忙乱中容易出错。
忙乱.en: He's always flustered when doing things, and easily makes mistakes in the chaos.

美中不足.zh: 这房子美中不足是太小。
美中不足.en: The fly in the ointment is that this house is too small.

美中不足.zh: 旅行很开心，美中不足是天气太热。
美中不足.en: The trip was great, but the only drawback was the hot weather.

美中不足.zh: 这家餐厅菜很好吃，美中不足是服务太慢。
美中不足.en: The food at this restaurant is delicious, but the service is too slow.

美中不足.zh: 电影情节不错，美中不足是结尾有点仓促。
美中不足.en: The movie plot is good, but the ending feels a bit rushed.

美中不足.zh: 他各方面都很优秀，美中不足就是太内向。
美中不足.en: He excels in every aspect, but the only shortcoming is being too introverted.

不假思索.zh: 听到问题，她不假思索地回答了。
不假思索.en: Upon hearing the question, she answered without thinking.

不假思索.zh: 看到老人跌倒，他不假思索地跑过去扶。
不假思索.en: Seeing an old man fall, he ran over to help without a second thought.

不假思索.zh: 我问她愿不愿意帮忙，她竟不假思索地拒绝了。
不假思索.en: When I asked if she would help, she refused without hesitation.

不假思索.zh: 平时练得多了，上场时才能不假思索地发挥。
不假思索.en: With enough practice, you can perform spontaneously without thinking during the performance.

豁达.en: He is a very open-minded person.

豁达.zh: 遇到挫折时，他表现得非常豁达。
豁达.en: When facing setbacks, he showed great magnanimity.

豁达.zh: 她性格豁达，从来不跟人斤斤计较。
豁达.en: She has a generous personality and never nitpicks with others.

豁达.zh: 虽然失败了，但他豁达地笑了笑，说没关系。
豁达.en: Even though he failed, he smiled magnanimously and said it was okay.

豁达.zh: 人生要想快乐，就得学会豁达一点。
豁达.en: To be happy in life, you have to learn to be more open-minded.

防盗门.en: My home has a security door.

防盗门.zh: 出门前记得把防盗门锁好。
防盗门.en: Remember to lock the security door before leaving.

防盗门.zh: 这种防盗门质量很好，很安全。
防盗门.en: This type of security door is of good quality and very safe.

防盗门.zh: 新换的防盗门带指纹锁，方便多了。
防盗门.en: The newly installed security door has a fingerprint lock, which is much more convenient.

防盗门.zh: 邻居家的防盗门被撬了，大家都很紧张。
防盗门.en: The security door of the neighbor's house was pried open, and everyone was very nervous.

见外.en: Don't be so formal with me.

见外.zh: 大家都是朋友，别这么见外。
见外.en: We're all friends, don't be so distant.

见外.zh: 来我家就像自己家一样，千万别见外。
见外.en: Make yourself at home, don't be a stranger.

见外.zh: 送这点小礼物你就收下吧，要不然就见外了。
见外.en: Just accept this small gift, or else you'll make me feel you're being too polite.

见外.zh: 你帮了我这么大的忙，我请吃饭是应该的，你别见外。
见外.en: You helped me so much, it's only right that I treat you to a meal, don't be so polite.

烦闷.en: I've been feeling very restless lately.

烦闷.zh: 下雨天待在家里让人烦闷。
烦闷.en: Staying home on a rainy day makes one feel gloomy.

烦闷.zh: 工作不顺心，他整天都很烦闷。
烦闷.en: His work isn't going well, so he's been feeling frustrated all day.

烦闷.zh: 连续加了三天班，心里特别烦闷。
烦闷.en: After working overtime for three days straight, I feel especially irritable.

烦闷.zh: 出去走走散散心，别老闷在家里烦闷。
烦闷.en: Go out for a walk to clear your mind, don't stay cooped up at home feeling miserable.

借条.en: Don't forget to write an IOU.

借条.zh: 他给我写了一张借条，说明年还钱。
借条.en: He wrote me an IOU saying he'll pay back next year.

借条.zh: 借条要保管好，不然说不清楚。
借条.en: You should keep the IOU safe, otherwise it's hard to clarify.

借条.zh: 虽然我们是朋友，但借条还是得写。
借条.en: Even though we're friends, we still need to write an IOU.
Do you have an IOU on you?

前无古人.zh: 他的成就真是前无古人，大家都很佩服。
前无古人.en: His achievement is truly unprecedented; everyone admires him.

前无古人.zh: 虽然前无古人，但后来者可以学习。
前无古人.en: Although it's unprecedented, later generations can learn from it.

前无古人.zh: 这个计划前无古人，风险很大。
前无古人.en: This plan is unprecedented and very risky.

前无古人.zh: 他说自己做的事前无古人，我有点怀疑。
前无古人.en: He says what he did is unprecedented, but I have my doubts.

朝夕相处.en: We spent three years together day and night.

朝夕相处.zh: 因为朝夕相处，我们成了最好的朋友。
朝夕相处.en: Because we spent so much time together, we became best friends.

朝夕相处.zh: 虽然朝夕相处，但有时也会吵架。
朝夕相处.en: Even though we're together all the time, we sometimes argue.

朝夕相处.zh: 和她朝夕相处，我学会了耐心。
朝夕相处.en: Living with her day and night taught me patience.

朝夕相处.zh: 同事们朝夕相处，感情自然很深。
朝夕相处.en: Colleagues who spend every day together naturally have deep bonds.

诞辰.zh: 纪念孔子诞辰的活动很隆重。
诞辰.en: The event commemorating Confucius's birthday was very grand.

诞辰.zh: 虽然是他诞辰，但他不想办派对。
诞辰.en: Although it's his birthday, he doesn't want to throw a party.

诞辰.zh: 学校举办了庆祝校长的诞辰晚会。
诞辰.en: The school held a party to celebrate the principal's birthday.

碍事.en: This box is really in the way.

碍事.zh: 你站在这里太碍事了，请让一下。
碍事.en: You're blocking the way here—please move aside.

碍事.zh: 如果这个东西碍事，我们就搬走吧。
碍事.en: If this thing is in the way, let's move it.
Don't put the chair here; it's obstructive.

碍事.zh: 他把桌子挪开，因为觉得它碍事。
碍事.en: He moved the table away because he thought it was in the way.

混浊.en: The river water is very murky.

混浊.zh: 因为下雨，河水变得很混浊。
混浊.en: Because of the rain, the river became muddy.

混浊.zh: 虽然水混浊，但过滤后还能喝。
混浊.en: Even though the water is muddy, it can still be drunk after filtering.

混浊.zh: 这杯水太混浊了，我不敢喝。
混浊.en: This glass of water is too cloudy; I don't dare drink it.

混浊.zh: 鱼缸的水变混浊了，需要换一下。
混浊.en: The water in the fish tank has turned cloudy; it needs to be changed.

僻静.zh: 找了一个僻静的角落，我们坐下来聊天。
僻静.en: We found a quiet corner and sat down to chat.

僻静.zh: 虽然地方僻静，但晚上不太安全。
僻静.en: Although the place is quiet, it's not very safe at night.

僻静.zh: 我喜欢僻静的地方读书。
僻静.en: I like to read in secluded places.

僻静.zh: 这家咖啡馆位置僻静，适合约会。
僻静.en: This café is in a quiet spot, perfect for a date.

小曲.zh: 下班路上我喜欢哼几首小曲。
小曲.en: On my way home from work, I like to hum a few ditties.

小曲.zh: 因为心情好，他边走边唱小曲。
小曲.en: Because he was in a good mood, he sang a tune as he walked.
Do you know how to sing this little song?

小曲.zh: 爷爷没事就爱哼些老歌小曲。
小曲.en: Grandpa loves to hum old songs and ditties when he's free.

纵深.zh: 我们要研究问题的纵深层面。
纵深.en: We need to study the depth of the issue.

纵深.zh: 不仅看表面，还要考虑纵深发展。
纵深.en: Don't just look at the surface; also consider deep development.
Defense in depth is a military term.

纵深.zh: 这个项目需要更纵深的分析。
纵深.en: This project requires a more in-depth analysis.

萌发.en: The seeds are beginning to sprout.

萌发.zh: 春天来了，万物萌发新芽。
萌发.en: Spring has come, and all things are sprouting new buds.

萌发.zh: 自从读了那本书，我心里萌发了创业的想法。
萌发.en: Since reading that book, the idea of starting a business sprouted in my mind.

萌发.zh: 他心中萌发了对音乐的热爱。
萌发.en: A love for music sprouted in his heart.

堤坝.zh: 因为前几天的大雨，堤坝需要加固。
堤坝.en: Because of the heavy rain a few days ago, the dam needs reinforcement.

堤坝.zh: 这座堤坝是去年修建的。
堤坝.en: This dam was built last year.

堤坝.zh: 他们正在检查堤坝，防止洪水。
堤坝.en: They are inspecting the dam to prevent flooding.
Many trees are planted on both sides of the dam.

月初.en: I have a business trip at the beginning of the month.

月初.zh: 这个项目月初就要开始，得抓紧。
月初.en: This project starts at the beginning of the month, so we need to hurry.
Are you attending the meeting at the beginning of the month?

月初.zh: 虽然现在是月初，但工作已经很多了。
月初.en: Although it's only the beginning of the month, work is already heavy.
We get paid at the beginning of the month.

风和日丽.en: It's fine and clear, perfect for going out.

风和日丽.zh: 周末天气风和日丽，我们一起去爬山吧。
风和日丽.en: The weather this weekend is fine and clear, let's go hiking together.

风和日丽.zh: 虽然昨天刮风，但今天风和日丽。
风和日丽.en: Although it was windy yesterday, today is fine and clear.

风和日丽.zh: 这样的风和日丽很难得。
风和日丽.en: Such fine and clear weather is rare.

学艺.en: He has been learning the craft for three years.

学艺.zh: 他从小就喜欢学艺，现在成了师傅。
学艺.en: He liked learning crafts since childhood, and now he's a master.
Learning a craft requires patience and persistence.

学艺.zh: 为了学艺，他去了很多地方。
学艺.en: He went to many places to learn the craft.
His path of learning the craft was very hard.

洗涤剂.zh: 这种洗涤剂去油效果很好。
洗涤剂.en: This detergent is very effective at removing grease.
We've run out of detergent, remember to buy some.

洗涤剂.zh: 虽然洗涤剂很贵，但洗得干净。
洗涤剂.en: Although the detergent is expensive, it cleans well.
Don't put the detergent in the kitchen.

连年.en: He has won the championship for consecutive years.

连年.zh: 因为连年干旱，农民损失很大。
连年.en: Because of consecutive years of drought, farmers suffered great losses.
This company has been profitable for consecutive years.

连年.zh: 虽然连年亏损，但他没放弃。
连年.en: Although he had losses for consecutive years, he didn't give up.

连年.zh: 连年的努力终于有了回报。
连年.en: Years of consecutive effort finally paid off.

大有可为.zh: 只要努力，年轻人就大有可为。
大有可为.en: As long as you work hard, young people have great prospects.

大有可为.zh: 人工智能领域大有可为。
大有可为.en: The field of artificial intelligence has great prospects.

大有可为.zh: 虽然竞争激烈，但这里大有可为。
大有可为.en: Although competition is fierce, there are great prospects here.
He thinks starting a business has great prospects.

偏方.zh: 奶奶有一个治咳嗽的偏方。
偏方.en: Grandma has a folk remedy for coughs.
Don't use folk remedies recklessly, they might harm you.

偏方.zh: 虽然偏方有时有效，但最好看医生。
偏方.en: Although folk remedies sometimes work, it's best to see a doctor.
This folk remedy has been passed down in the family.

底蕴.en: This city has depth and heritage.

底蕴.zh: 他的知识底蕴很深厚，让人佩服。
底蕴.en: His depth of knowledge is profound and admirable.

底蕴.zh: 文化底蕴需要慢慢积累。
底蕴.en: Cultural depth needs to be accumulated slowly.

底蕴.zh: 虽然外表普通，但内涵底蕴丰富。
底蕴.en: Although it looks ordinary, its inner depth is rich.
This old shop has a lot of heritage.

增收.en: The company plans to increase income.

增收.zh: 为了增收，他们开发了新产品。
增收.en: To increase income, they developed new products.

增收.zh: 增收的同时也要控制成本。
增收.en: While increasing income, we must also control costs.

增收.zh: 今年农民增收了不少，因为粮价高。
增收.en: This year farmers increased their income a lot because grain prices are high.
Increasing income is this year's goal.

畜牧.en: His family mainly does animal husbandry.

畜牧.zh: 因为气候干旱，这里的畜牧发展很困难。
畜牧.en: Because of the dry climate, animal husbandry here is very difficult to develop.

畜牧.zh: 他大学学的畜牧专业，现在在牧场工作。
畜牧.en: He studied animal husbandry in college and now works on a ranch.

畜牧.zh: 这个地区以畜牧为主，农民养牛养羊。
畜牧.en: This region relies mainly on animal husbandry; farmers raise cattle and sheep.

依依不舍.zh: 毕业时，大家依依不舍，互相拥抱。
依依不舍.en: At graduation, everyone was reluctant to part and hugged each other.

依依不舍.zh: 每次离开家，妈妈都依依不舍地送我。
依依不舍.en: Every time I leave home, my mother sees me off reluctantly.

依依不舍.zh: 看到朋友依依不舍的样子，我心里也很难过。
依依不舍.en: Seeing my friend's reluctant look, I felt sad too.

可乘之机.en: Don't give him an opportunity to exploit.

可乘之机.zh: 出门要锁好门，免得给小偷可乘之机。
可乘之机.en: Lock the door when you go out, so as not to give thieves an opportunity.
He has been looking for an opportunity to exploit.

可乘之机.zh: 如果我们不团结，敌人就会找到可乘之机。
可乘之机.en: If we are not united, the enemy will find an opportunity to exploit.

可乘之机.zh: 你这种粗心大意，容易给别人可乘之机。
可乘之机.en: Your carelessness easily gives others an opportunity to exploit.

一鼓作气.en: Let's finish it all in one go.

一鼓作气.zh: 一鼓作气把剩下的工作都完成了。
一鼓作气.en: We completed the remaining work all in one go.

一鼓作气.zh: 他跑步一鼓作气冲到了终点。
一鼓作气.en: He ran all the way to the finish line in one go.

一鼓作气.zh: 趁着大家状态好，咱们一鼓作气解决这个问题。
一鼓作气.en: While everyone is in good shape, let's solve this problem in one go.

一鼓作气.zh: 别停下来，一鼓作气爬上山顶。
一鼓作气.en: Don't stop; climb to the top of the mountain in one go.

害臊.zh: 第一次上台演讲，他有点害臊。
害臊.en: He was a bit shy giving his first speech on stage.

害臊.zh: 她听见这话立马害臊了。
害臊.en: She immediately felt shy upon hearing that.

害臊.zh: 小孩子在生人面前容易害臊，多锻炼就好了。
害臊.en: Children easily feel shy around strangers; more practice will help.
He was so embarrassed that his face turned red.

东张西望.zh: 他在街上东张西望，好像在找什么人。
东张西望.en: He was looking around on the street, as if searching for someone.
What are you looking around for?

东张西望.zh: 考试时东张西望会被当作作弊。
东张西望.en: Looking around during an exam will be considered cheating.

东张西望.zh: 小朋友到了新环境总是东张西望的。
东张西望.en: Children always look around when they are in a new environment.

络绎不绝.en: Tourists come in an endless stream.

络绎不绝.zh: 春节庙会上人山人海，络绎不绝。
络绎不绝.en: The Spring Festival temple fair was packed with people coming and going.

络绎不绝.zh: 前来参观的人络绎不绝。
络绎不绝.en: Visitors come in a continuous stream.

络绎不绝.zh: 这家店生意真好，顾客络绎不绝。
络绎不绝.en: This shop has great business; customers come in an endless stream.

络绎不绝.zh: 山路上的车流络绎不绝，非常壮观。
络绎不绝.en: The traffic on the mountain road was continuous, a magnificent sight.

物流.zh: 现在网购发达，物流服务也越来越好。
物流.en: Now online shopping is developed, and logistics services are getting better.
He works at a logistics company.

物流.zh: 因为疫情，很多物流都延误了。
物流.en: Due to the pandemic, many logistics have been delayed.

物流.zh: 这个地区物流不发达，送货很慢。
物流.en: Logistics in this area are underdeveloped, and deliveries are slow.

挂失.en: My card has been reported lost.

挂失.zh: 发现钱包丢了，我马上去银行挂失。
挂失.en: When I found my wallet was lost, I immediately went to the bank to report it lost.
If you forget your password, you can report it lost.

挂失.zh: 身份证丢了要尽快挂失，不然有风险。
挂失.en: If you lose your ID card, report it lost as soon as possible, otherwise there is risk.

挂失.zh: 他打电话给银行挂失信用卡。
挂失.en: He called the bank to report his credit card lost.

硕果.zh: 经过多年努力，他的研究终于结出硕果。
硕果.en: After years of hard work, his research finally bore fruitful results.
In autumn, the orchard is full of ripe fruit on the branches.

硕果.zh: 这次项目的成功是大家合作的硕果。
硕果.en: The success of this project is the fruitful result of everyone's cooperation.

秧歌.zh: 春节的时候，街上很多人扭秧歌。
秧歌.en: During Spring Festival, many people twist yangge on the streets.

秧歌.zh: 她参加了社区的秧歌队，每天排练。
秧歌.en: She joined the community yangge team and rehearses every day.

秧歌.zh: 虽然我不会扭秧歌，但我觉得特别热闹。
秧歌.en: Although I can't dance yangge, I think it's very lively.

秧歌.zh: 广场上大妈们正在跳秧歌，旁边围了一圈人。
秧歌.en: The aunties are dancing yangge in the square, with a crowd watching around them.

红眼.en: Don't be jealous of others' achievements.

红眼.zh: 他得了红眼病，正在滴眼药水。
红眼.en: He got pink eye and is putting in eye drops.

红眼.zh: 她一看人家升职就红眼，太小心眼了。
红眼.en: She gets jealous as soon as someone gets promoted—too narrow-minded.

红眼.zh: 红眼航班虽然便宜，但坐起来很累。
红眼.en: Red-eye flights are cheap but very tiring to take.

红眼.zh: 你红眼也没用，人家是靠自己努力换来的。
红眼.en: Being jealous won't help; they earned it through their own hard work.

畏缩.en: Don't shrink back when facing difficulties.

畏缩.zh: 他说话总是畏畏缩缩的，没自信。
畏缩.en: He always speaks timidly and lacks confidence.

畏缩.zh: 要是你总是畏缩不前，机会就没了。
畏缩.en: If you always hesitate and hold back, you'll miss the opportunity.

畏缩.zh: 那只小猫看到陌生人就畏缩在角落里。
畏缩.en: That little cat shrinks into the corner when it sees strangers.

畏缩.zh: 他虽然害怕失败，但没有因此畏缩，还是勇敢地试了。
畏缩.en: Although he feared failure, he didn't shrink back and bravely gave it a try.

多心.zh: 她说话总爱多心，别在意。
多心.en: She tends to be oversensitive when speaking; don't mind her.

多心.zh: 我没别的意思，是你自己多心了。
多心.en: I didn't mean anything else; you're the one being paranoid.

多心.zh: 朋友之间别那么多心，不然相处很累。
多心.en: Don't be so suspicious among friends, or it'll be exhausting to get along.

多心.zh: 他多心以为我在批评他，其实我只是提了个建议。
多心.en: He wrongly thought I was criticizing him, but I was just giving a suggestion.

杂乱无章.en: His room is messy and disorganized.

杂乱无章.zh: 那篇作文写得杂乱无章，老师看不下去了。
杂乱无章.en: That essay was so messy and incoherent that the teacher couldn't stand it.

杂乱无章.zh: 书桌上堆满了杂乱无章的文件，我得好好整理一下。
杂乱无章.en: The desk is piled with messy documents; I need to tidy it up.

杂乱无章.zh: 虽然他的思路杂乱无章，但最后结论还挺有意思的。
杂乱无章.en: Although his train of thought was messy, the final conclusion was quite interesting.

杂乱无章.zh: 施工现场杂乱无章，工具到处乱放，很容易出事故。
杂乱无章.en: The construction site is chaotic and disorganized, with tools lying around everywhere—it's easy to have an accident.

举世闻名.zh: 这家餐厅的烤鸭举世闻名。
举世闻名.en: This restaurant's roast duck is world-famous.

举世闻名.zh: 故宫是一座举世闻名的历史建筑。
举世闻名.en: The Forbidden City is a world-famous historical building.

举世闻名.zh: 这位科学家的发明举世闻名，影响了无数人。
举世闻名.en: This scientist's invention is world-famous and has influenced countless people.

举世闻名.zh: 虽然这个小村子不大，但它的陶瓷工艺举世闻名。
举世闻名.en: Although this small village is not big, its ceramic craftsmanship is world-famous.

愁眉苦脸.en: He has a worried frown all day long.

愁眉苦脸.zh: 别总是愁眉苦脸，开心点。
愁眉苦脸.en: Don't always pull a long face; cheer up.

愁眉苦脸.zh: 考试没考好，她愁眉苦脸地回家了。
愁眉苦脸.en: She went home with a worried frown because she didn't do well on the exam.

愁眉苦脸.zh: 你愁眉苦脸也没用，不如想想怎么解决。
愁眉苦脸.en: Frowning won't help; better think about how to solve it.

愁眉苦脸.zh: 一听说要加班，同事们个个愁眉苦脸的。
愁眉苦脸.en: As soon as they heard about overtime, all the colleagues looked gloomy.

粗心大意.en: He is too careless in doing things.
Being careless in exams will cost you points.

粗心大意.zh: 因为粗心大意，他忘了带钥匙出门。
粗心大意.en: Because of carelessness, he forgot to bring his keys when going out.

粗心大意.zh: 这份合同很重要，千万别粗心大意。
粗心大意.en: This contract is very important; don't be careless.

粗心大意.zh: 你粗心大意地写错了地址，结果快递寄到了别人家。
粗心大意.en: You carelessly wrote the wrong address, so the package was delivered to someone else's house.

争分夺秒.en: They are working against the clock.

争分夺秒.zh: 高考前大家都在争分夺秒复习。
争分夺秒.en: Everyone is racing against time to study before the college entrance exam.

争分夺秒.zh: 救援人员争分夺秒地寻找幸存者。
争分夺秒.en: The rescuers are working against the clock to find survivors.

争分夺秒.zh: 为了准时交货，工人们争分夺秒赶工。
争分夺秒.en: To deliver on time, the workers are racing against the clock to meet the deadline.

争分夺秒.zh: 最后一分钟他还在改稿子，真是争分夺秒。
争分夺秒.en: He was still revising the manuscript in the last minute—truly racing against time.

龙舟.en: People row dragon boats during the Dragon Boat Festival.
Let's go watch the dragon boat race.

龙舟.zh: 龙舟上的鼓手敲得特别起劲。
龙舟.en: The drummer on the dragon boat beats very energetically.

龙舟.zh: 今年我参加了龙舟队，训练了一个月。
龙舟.en: This year I joined a dragon boat team and trained for a month.

龙舟.zh: 河两岸站满了看龙舟的人，呐喊声震天响。
龙舟.en: Both banks of the river were packed with people watching the dragon boats, and the cheers were deafening.

垂头丧气.zh: 考试没考好，他垂头丧气。
垂头丧气.en: He didn't do well on the exam and became dejected.

垂头丧气.zh: 虽然失败了，但他并没有垂头丧气，而是继续努力。
垂头丧气.en: Although he failed, he didn't get dejected but kept working hard.

垂头丧气.zh: 别因为一点小事就垂头丧气，打起精神来！
垂头丧气.en: Don't get dejected over a small matter; cheer up!

垂头丧气.zh: 看到球队输了，球迷们都垂头丧气地离开了球场。
垂头丧气.en: Seeing the team lose, the fans left the stadium dejectedly.

垂头丧气.zh: 他垂头丧气地走进办公室，一句话也没说。
垂头丧气.en: He walked into the office dejectedly without saying a word.

弊病.zh: 我们需要找出当前管理中的弊病，才能改进。
弊病.en: We need to identify the drawbacks in current management in order to improve.

弊病.zh: 虽然这个方法很流行，但它也有明显的弊病。
弊病.en: Although this method is popular, it also has obvious drawbacks.

弊病.zh: 教育体制的弊病影响了学生的发展。
弊病.en: The drawbacks of the education system affect students' development.

弊病.zh: 这些弊病如果不解决，问题会越来越严重。
弊病.en: If these drawbacks are not resolved, the problems will become more serious.

不敢当.en: You are too kind; I don't deserve it.

不敢当.zh: 这么多夸奖我真的不敢当，我只是做了分内的事。
不敢当.en: So much praise—I really don't deserve it; I just did my duty.

不敢当.zh: 您说我是专家，实在不敢当，我还在学习呢。
不敢当.en: You call me an expert—I really don't deserve it; I'm still learning.

不敢当.zh: 面对大家的表扬，他连连摆手说不敢当。
不敢当.en: Facing everyone's praise, he repeatedly waved his hands saying he didn't deserve it.

不敢当.zh: 老师说我的成绩进步很大，我觉得不敢当。
不敢当.en: The teacher said my grades improved greatly, but I feel I don't deserve it.

任重道远.en: Our goal is a heavy responsibility and a long road.

任重道远.zh: 要实现这个计划，真是任重道远啊。
任重道远.en: To realize this plan is truly a heavy responsibility and a long road.

任重道远.zh: 虽然我们已经取得了一些成绩，但未来仍然任重道远。
任重道远.en: Although we have achieved some results, the future still holds a heavy responsibility and a long road.

任重道远.zh: 环保事业任重道远，需要大家共同努力。
任重道远.en: The cause of environmental protection is a heavy responsibility and a long road, requiring everyone's joint efforts.

任重道远.zh: 教育的改革任重道远，不能急于求成。
任重道远.en: The reform of education is a heavy responsibility and a long road; we cannot rush for quick results.

化纤.en: This piece of clothing is made of synthetic fiber.

化纤.zh: 我更喜欢纯棉的，化纤穿着不舒服。
化纤.en: I prefer pure cotton; synthetic fiber feels uncomfortable to wear.

化纤.zh: 虽然化纤便宜，但我还是觉得天然面料好。
化纤.en: Although synthetic fiber is cheap, I still think natural fabrics are better.

化纤.zh: 这种化纤面料耐穿又容易清洗。
化纤.en: This synthetic fiber fabric is durable and easy to wash.

化纤.zh: 化纤制品在高温下容易变形。
化纤.en: Synthetic fiber products are prone to deformation under high heat.

东道主.zh: 这次会议由中国做东道主。
东道主.en: This conference is hosted by China.

东道主.zh: 作为东道主，我们一定要好好招待客人。
东道主.en: As the host, we must treat the guests well.

东道主.zh: 既然我们是东道主，就应该准备好一切。
东道主.en: Since we are the host, we should prepare everything.

东道主.zh: 奥运会的东道主国家花了大量资金建设场馆。
东道主.en: The host country of the Olympics spent a lot of money building venues.

东道主.zh: 你这次来，我这个东道主带你到处逛逛。
东道主.en: Since you came this time, I as the host will show you around.

壮胆.en: Drink some wine to embolden yourself.

壮胆.zh: 他叫上朋友一起去壮胆。
壮胆.en: He called friends to go along to boost his courage.

壮胆.zh: 虽然害怕，但他还是壮胆走进了黑暗的房间。
壮胆.en: Although scared, he emboldened himself and entered the dark room.

壮胆.zh: 第一次上台演讲，她喝口水想壮壮胆。
壮胆.en: For her first speech on stage, she drank some water to embolden herself.
Don't be afraid; I'll go with you to boost your courage.

世袭.zh: 古代很多官职都是世袭的，比如皇帝。
世袭.en: In ancient times, many positions were hereditary, such as the emperor.

世袭.zh: 虽然现在不世袭了，但有些家族仍保留传统。
世袭.en: Although it's not hereditary now, some families still retain the tradition.

世袭.zh: 世袭制度在现代社会已经很少见了。
世袭.en: The hereditary system is rarely seen in modern society.

世袭.zh: 他们家族的财富是世袭来的，并非自己挣的。
世袭.en: Their family wealth is inherited, not earned by themselves.

农历.en: Spring Festival is based on the lunar calendar.

农历.zh: 农历八月十五是中秋节。
农历.en: The 15th day of the 8th lunar month is Mid-Autumn Festival.

农历.zh: 虽然我们平时用公历，但传统节日都用农历。
农历.en: Although we usually use the solar calendar, traditional festivals all follow the lunar calendar.

农历.zh: 农历新年是中国人最重要的节日。
农历.en: Lunar New Year is the most important festival for Chinese people.

农历.zh: 妈妈总记得农历的节气，比如立春。
农历.en: Mom always remembers the lunar calendar's solar terms, like Beginning of Spring.

珍重.zh: 你要走了，多珍重自己的身体。
珍重.en: You're leaving; take good care of your health.

珍重.zh: 虽然我们分开了，但我会珍重这段友谊。
珍重.en: Although we are apart, I will treasure this friendship.

珍重.zh: 离别时，他握紧我的手说了一声“珍重”。
珍重.en: At parting, he gripped my hand and said, 'Take care.'

珍重.zh: 这些老照片我一直珍重地保存着。
珍重.en: I have always treasured and kept these old photos.

夸夸其谈.zh: 他整天夸夸其谈，却一件事也做不成。
夸夸其谈.en: He brags all day long but can't get anything done.

夸夸其谈.zh: 别听他夸夸其谈，他说的都是空话。
夸夸其谈.en: Don't listen to his bluster; it's all empty talk.

夸夸其谈.zh: 那个经理喜欢夸夸其谈，员工们都觉得他不可靠。
夸夸其谈.en: That manager likes to boast, and the employees all think he's unreliable.

夸夸其谈.zh: 与其夸夸其谈，不如动手做点实事。
夸夸其谈.en: Instead of boasting, it's better to actually do something practical.

夸夸其谈.zh: 他在会上夸夸其谈了一个小时，最后也没提出任何方案。
夸夸其谈.en: He bragged for an hour at the meeting but ended up not proposing any plan.

下乡.zh: 他去年下乡支教了一年。
下乡.en: He went to the countryside to teach for a year last year.

下乡.zh: 我们公司组织了一次下乡扶贫活动。
下乡.en: Our company organized a poverty alleviation activity in the countryside.

下乡.zh: 爷爷年轻时曾下乡插队，吃了不少苦。
下乡.en: When Grandpa was young, he went to the countryside to settle, enduring a lot of hardship.

下乡.zh: 这次下乡调研让我们了解了农村的真实情况。
下乡.en: This field research in the countryside helped us understand the real situation in rural areas.

下乡.zh: 虽然下乡条件艰苦，但大家都觉得很充实。
下乡.en: Although the conditions in the countryside were tough, everyone felt fulfilled.

举世瞩目.en: This achievement has attracted worldwide attention.

举世瞩目.zh: 奥运会的开幕式举世瞩目。
举世瞩目.en: The Olympic opening ceremony captured the world's attention.

举世瞩目.zh: 我国航天事业的发展举世瞩目，很多国家都来学习经验。
举世瞩目.en: The development of our country's aerospace industry has drawn global attention, and many countries come to learn from our experience.

举世瞩目.zh: 那位科学家的发现举世瞩目，并因此获得了诺贝尔奖。
举世瞩目.en: That scientist's discovery attracted worldwide attention and won him the Nobel Prize.

举世瞩目.zh: 近年来，中国在人工智能领域的进步举世瞩目，但挑战也不少。
举世瞩目.en: In recent years, China's progress in the field of artificial intelligence has been globally recognized, but there are also many challenges.

弘扬.zh: 这个活动旨在弘扬雷锋精神。
弘扬.en: This activity aims to promote the spirit of Lei Feng.

弘扬.zh: 学校经常举办讲座，弘扬科学精神和创新意识。
弘扬.en: The school often holds lectures to promote scientific spirit and innovative awareness.

弘扬.zh: 他写了一本书，专门弘扬家乡的民俗文化。
弘扬.en: He wrote a book specifically to promote the folk culture of his hometown.

弘扬.zh: 弘扬正能量是每个公民的责任，尤其是在网络上。
弘扬.en: Promoting positive energy is the responsibility of every citizen, especially online.

走漏.zh: 消息走漏了，大家都知道了。
走漏.en: The news leaked, and everyone knows now.

走漏.zh: 这次计划走漏了风声，不得不取消。
走漏.en: The plan was leaked, so we had to cancel it.

走漏.zh: 公司内部文件走漏后，股价大跌。
走漏.en: After the company's internal documents leaked, the stock price plummeted.

走漏.zh: 他怀疑是有人故意走漏了谈判细节。
走漏.en: He suspects that someone deliberately leaked the details of the negotiations.

走漏.zh: 虽然保密措施很严格，但信息还是走漏了出去。
走漏.en: Even though the confidentiality measures were strict, the information still leaked out.

同人.zh: 我喜欢看这部动漫的同人漫画。
同人.en: I like reading doujinshi comics of this anime.

同人.zh: 他画了很多游戏角色的同人图。
同人.en: He drew a lot of fan art of game characters.

同人.zh: 这个网站专门发布各种小说的同人作品。
同人.en: This website specializes in publishing fan works of various novels.

同人.zh: 我们几个同人作者打算一起出一本合集。
同人.en: A few of us fan creators plan to put out a collection together.

同人.zh: 同人创作虽然不盈利，但能表达对原作的热爱。
同人.en: Although fan creation is not for profit, it can express love for the original work.

刚毅.zh: 面对困难，她表现出刚毅的一面。
刚毅.en: Facing difficulties, she showed a resilient side.

刚毅.zh: 父亲是个刚毅的人，从不轻易放弃。
刚毅.en: Father is a tough person who never gives up easily.

刚毅.zh: 她的眼神里透出一种刚毅，让人感到安心。
刚毅.en: Her eyes showed a kind of fortitude that made people feel at ease.

刚毅.zh: 经过这次磨练，他变得更加刚毅和成熟。
刚毅.en: After this ordeal, he became more resolute and mature.

化险为夷.en: He turned danger into safety by using his wits.

化险为夷.zh: 多亏了医生，她才化险为夷。
化险为夷.en: Thanks to the doctor, she managed to turn the crisis around.

化险为夷.zh: 那次车祸后，他奇迹般地化险为夷，只受了轻伤。
化险为夷.en: After that car accident, he miraculously turned danger into safety and only suffered minor injuries.

化险为夷.zh: 在登山过程中遇到雪崩，队长冷静指挥，最终化险为夷。
化险为夷.en: During the mountain climbing, they encountered an avalanche, but the captain calmly directed and ultimately turned danger into safety.

化险为夷.zh: 虽然谈判陷入僵局，但首席代表一句话就化险为夷。
化险为夷.en: Although the negotiations reached a deadlock, the chief representative turned the situation around with just one sentence.

联欢.zh: 公司每年都举办春节联欢活动。
联欢.en: The company holds a Spring Festival celebration every year.

联欢.zh: 我们班和隔壁班一起搞了一次联欢会。
联欢.en: Our class and the neighboring class held a joint party.

联欢.zh: 联欢会上大家唱歌跳舞，玩得很开心。
联欢.en: At the party, everyone sang and danced, having a great time.

联欢.zh: 这次社区联欢吸引了上百名居民前来参加。
联欢.en: This community gathering attracted over a hundred residents to participate.

俊俏.zh: 那个小伙子生得一副俊俏模样。
俊俏.en: That young man has a handsome appearance.

俊俏.zh: 他穿着一身俊俏的西装，看起来精神极了。
俊俏.en: He wore a sharp suit and looked extremely energetic.

俊俏.zh: 这姑娘不仅俊俏，而且聪明能干。
俊俏.en: This girl is not only pretty but also smart and capable.

俊俏.zh: 画中的女子面容俊俏，仿佛真人一般。
俊俏.en: The woman in the painting has a beautiful face, as if she were real.

刮风.zh: 今天刮风，别骑自行车了。
刮风.en: It's windy today, don't ride a bike.

刮风.zh: 外面刮风了，记得关窗户。
刮风.en: It's windy outside, remember to close the window.

刮风.zh: 虽然刮风了，但我们还是要去公园散步。
刮风.en: Although it's windy, we still want to go for a walk in the park.

刮风.zh: 刮风的时候，沙子很容易吹进眼睛里。
刮风.en: When it's windy, sand can easily blow into your eyes.

刮风.zh: 天气预报说明天刮风，所以我打算待在家里。
刮风.en: The weather forecast says it will be windy tomorrow, so I plan to stay home.

走过场.zh: 这次检查只是走过场，别紧张。
走过场.en: This inspection is just a formality, don't be nervous.

走过场.zh: 他开会时什么也没说，就是走过场。
走过场.en: He didn't say anything at the meeting, just went through the motions.

走过场.zh: 很多培训都是走过场，根本没学到东西。
走过场.en: Many trainings are just going through the motions, you don't learn anything.

走过场.zh: 如果工作只是走过场，那还有什么意义？
走过场.en: If work is just a formality, what's the point?

走过场.zh: 别以为随便走过场就能应付得了审核。
走过场.en: Don't think you can get away with just going through the motions for the audit.

成心.zh: 你不是成心让我难堪吧？
成心.en: You're not deliberately embarrassing me, are you?

成心.zh: 他成心不接电话，就是不想去。
成心.en: He deliberately didn't answer the phone because he didn't want to go.

成心.zh: 你成心跟我过不去是不是？
成心.en: Are you deliberately making things difficult for me?

成心.zh: 她成心把杯子打碎了，然后假装是意外。
成心.en: She deliberately broke the cup and then pretended it was an accident.

成心.zh: 我知道你不是成心这么做的，但下次小心点。
成心.en: I know you didn't do it on purpose, but be more careful next time.

扣人心弦.zh: 比赛最后几分钟扣人心弦。
扣人心弦.en: The last few minutes of the match were gripping.

扣人心弦.zh: 他的演讲扣人心弦，大家都听入迷了。
扣人心弦.en: His speech was so captivating that everyone was mesmerized.

扣人心弦.zh: 这本书的情节扣人心弦，我熬夜看完了。
扣人心弦.en: The plot of this book is so gripping that I stayed up all night to finish it.

扣人心弦.zh: 虽然结局扣人心弦，但我还是猜到了凶手是谁。
扣人心弦.en: Although the ending was thrilling, I still guessed who the murderer was.

光明磊落.en: One should be open and aboveboard.

光明磊落.zh: 他做事一向光明磊落，从不暗地里使坏。
光明磊落.en: He always acts openly and honestly, never doing anything underhanded.

光明磊落.zh: 如果你问心无愧，就该光明磊落地面对所有人。
光明磊落.en: If you have a clear conscience, you should face everyone openly and honestly.

光明磊落.zh: 我喜欢他这个人，因为他光明磊落，从不耍心机。
光明磊落.en: I like him as a person because he is open and honest, never playing tricks.

光明磊落.zh: 在公司里，光明磊落的行为能赢得大家的信任。
光明磊落.en: In the company, honest and upright behavior can earn everyone's trust.

千钧一发.zh: 千钧一发之际，他跳进了河里。
千钧一发.en: At the critical moment, he jumped into the river.

千钧一发.zh: 火车进站时他还在铁轨上，真是千钧一发。
千钧一发.en: He was still on the tracks when the train arrived; it was a close call.

千钧一发.zh: 就在千钧一发的时候，消防员救出了孩子。
千钧一发.en: At the very last moment, the firefighter rescued the child.

千钧一发.zh: 幸亏他及时刹车，否则就撞上了，真是千钧一发。
千钧一发.en: Luckily he braked in time, otherwise he would have crashed; it was a hair's breadth.

千钧一发.zh: 那场手术千钧一发，但医生最终还是成功了。
千钧一发.en: That surgery was extremely critical, but the doctor succeeded in the end.

酌情.en: The teacher can add points at their discretion.
Please handle it according to the specific situation.

酌情.zh: 对于迟到的情况，我们会酌情考虑。
酌情.en: We will consider the latecomers on a case-by-case basis.

酌情.zh: 罚款金额可根据收入酌情减免。
酌情.en: The penalty amount can be reduced or waived at discretion based on income.

酌情.zh: 如果你有困难，我们可以酌情延长还款期限。
酌情.en: If you have difficulties, we can extend the repayment period at our discretion.

千变万化.zh: 天气千变万化，很难预测。
千变万化.en: The weather is ever-changing and hard to predict.

千变万化.zh: 他的情绪千变万化，让人捉摸不透。
千变万化.en: His moods change constantly and are hard to figure out.

千变万化.zh: 在这个行业里，市场需求千变万化。
千变万化.en: In this industry, market demands change constantly.

千变万化.zh: 魔术表演千变万化，观众看得眼花缭乱。
千变万化.en: The magic show was full of changes, dazzling the audience.

千变万化.zh: 虽然计划千变万化，但我们的目标始终不变。
千变万化.en: Although plans change constantly, our goal remains the same.

朝气蓬勃.en: Young people are full of vitality, it's great.

朝气蓬勃.zh: 这所学校的学生个个朝气蓬勃。
朝气蓬勃.en: The students at this school are all full of energy.

朝气蓬勃.zh: 她朝气蓬勃的样子感染了所有人。
虽然他已经四十岁了，但看起来还是朝气蓬勃。
朝气蓬勃.en: Although he is forty, he still looks full of life.

朝气蓬勃.zh: 春天的花园里，花草树木都显得朝气蓬勃。
朝气蓬勃.en: In the spring garden, the plants and trees all look vibrant.

一个劲儿.zh: 她一个劲儿地道歉，我觉得没必要。
一个劲儿.en: She kept apologizing, but I didn't think it was necessary.

一个劲儿.zh: 别一个劲儿地催我，我知道了。
一个劲儿.en: Don't keep rushing me, I get it.

一个劲儿.zh: 小孩一个劲儿地哭，我也不知道怎么办。
一个劲儿.en: The child kept crying, and I didn't know what to do.

一个劲儿.zh: 他一个劲儿地问我问题，我都烦死了。
一个劲儿.en: He kept asking me questions, and I was so annoyed.

斩钉截铁.zh: 他斩钉截铁地拒绝了那个提议。
老板斩钉截铁地说，这个方案不能再改了。
斩钉截铁.en: The boss said decisively that this plan cannot be changed anymore.

斩钉截铁.zh: 她回答问题时总是斩钉截铁，从不犹豫。
斩钉截铁.en: She always answers questions firmly and without hesitation.

斩钉截铁.zh: 虽然大家都劝他再想想，但他还是斩钉截铁地决定了辞职。
斩钉截铁.en: Although everyone advised him to think it over, he still resolutely decided to resign.

斩钉截铁.zh: 这件事必须斩钉截铁地处理，不能拖泥带水。
斩钉截铁.en: This matter must be handled decisively, without any hesitation.

搞鬼.en: Stop playing tricks behind the scenes!

搞鬼.zh: 我觉得有人在搞鬼，不然怎么会这么巧？
搞鬼.en: I think someone is up to something, otherwise how could it be such a coincidence?

搞鬼.zh: 他老是偷偷摸摸的，肯定又在搞鬼。
搞鬼.en: He's always sneaking around, definitely up to some mischief again.

搞鬼.zh: 考试分数突然变了，一定是系统搞鬼了。
搞鬼.en: The exam scores suddenly changed; the system must have malfunctioned.

搞鬼.zh: 你别以为我不知道你在搞鬼，我早就看出来了。
搞鬼.en: Don't think I don't know you're playing tricks; I've seen through it long ago.

诚心诚意.zh: 我诚心诚意地向你道歉。
他是诚心诚意来帮忙的，你别误会。
诚心诚意.en: He came to help with sincere intentions; don't misunderstand.

诚心诚意.zh: 她诚心诚意地邀请我去她家做客，我不好意思拒绝。
诚心诚意.en: She earnestly invited me to her home, and I felt too embarrassed to refuse.

诚心诚意.zh: 如果你诚心诚意想学，我可以教你。
诚心诚意.en: If you genuinely want to learn, I can teach you.

诚心诚意.zh: 他做事总是诚心诚意的，所以大家都信任他。
诚心诚意.en: He always does things sincerely, so everyone trusts him.

瑰宝.en: This painting is a national treasure.

瑰宝.zh: 敦煌莫高窟是人类文化的瑰宝。
瑰宝.en: The Mogao Caves in Dunhuang are a treasure of human culture.

瑰宝.zh: 这些古籍是图书馆里的瑰宝，必须好好保护。
瑰宝.en: These ancient books are treasures in the library and must be well protected.

瑰宝.zh: 中医传统知识是中华民族的瑰宝，值得传承。
瑰宝.en: Traditional Chinese medicine knowledge is a treasure of the Chinese nation, worth passing down.

瑰宝.zh: 虽然那块玉石不算很大，但它在收藏家眼里就是个瑰宝。
瑰宝.en: Although that piece of jade is not very large, it is a treasure in the eyes of collectors.

立方米.zh: 这个水箱能装两立方米的水。
立方米.en: This water tank can hold two cubic meters of water.

立方米.zh: 工人说需要五立方米的沙子才能填平那个坑。
立方米.en: The worker said it would take five cubic meters of sand to fill that pit.

立方米.zh: 一立方米的木材大概有多重？
立方米.en: How much does one cubic meter of wood roughly weigh?

立方米.zh: 他们计算了一下，整个仓库的容积是八百立方米。
立方米.en: They calculated that the volume of the entire warehouse is eight hundred cubic meters.

立方米.zh: 如果你要买混凝土，记得告诉师傅需要多少立方米。
立方米.en: If you want to buy concrete, remember to tell the worker how many cubic meters you need.

公开信.zh: 他写了一封公开信给校长。
公开信.en: He wrote an open letter to the principal.

公开信.zh: 这封公开信在网络上引起了很大反响。
公开信.en: This open letter caused a huge response online.

公开信.zh: 几位学者联名发表了一封公开信，呼吁保护环境。
公开信.en: Several scholars jointly published an open letter calling for environmental protection.

公开信.zh: 公司CEO通过公开信向全体员工道歉。
公开信.en: The company's CEO apologized to all employees through an open letter.

公开信.zh: 那封公开信的内容被很多媒体转载了。
公开信.en: The content of that open letter was reposted by many media outlets.

说不上.zh: 这个菜说不上好吃，但也不难吃。
说不上.en: This dish can't be called delicious, but it's not bad either.

说不上.zh: 他为什么生气，我也说不上来。
说不上.en: I can't really explain why he's angry.

说不上.zh: 我们俩说不上是朋友，只是认识而已。
说不上.en: We can't really be called friends; we just know each other.

说不上.zh: 这部电影说不上多精彩，但消磨时间还不错。
说不上.en: This movie isn't particularly exciting, but it's okay to kill time.

说不上.zh: 她的工作说不上轻松，但收入还算可以。
说不上.en: Her job can't be called easy, but the income is acceptable.

天伦之乐.zh: 退休后他享受着天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.en: After retirement, he enjoys the happiness of family life.

天伦之乐.zh: 周末和家人一起吃饭，真是天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.en: Having dinner with family on weekends is truly the joy of family reunion.

天伦之乐.zh: 老人最盼望的就是儿孙绕膝的天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.en: What the elderly most look forward to is the joy of having children and grandchildren around.

天伦之乐.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但他从不放弃和家人团聚的天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.en: Although he is very busy with work, he never gives up the happiness of family gatherings.

天伦之乐.zh: 对很多人来说，简简单单的天伦之乐比什么都重要。
天伦之乐.en: For many people, the simple joy of family life is more important than anything else.

带头人.zh: 他是我们团队的带头人。
带头人.en: He is the leader of our team.

带头人.zh: 这个项目的带头人经验非常丰富。
带头人.en: The leader of this project is very experienced.

带头人.zh: 作为技术带头人，他经常给大家培训新知识。
带头人.en: As a technical leader, he often trains everyone on new knowledge.

带头人.zh: 村里选出了新的致富带头人。
带头人.en: The village elected a new leader to help people get rich.

带头人.zh: 如果没有一个好的带头人，这个研究很难进行下去。
带头人.en: Without a good leader, this research will be difficult to carry on.

一技之长.zh: 他有一技之长，不愁找不到工作。
一技之长.en: He has a skill, so he doesn't worry about finding a job.

一技之长.zh: 学一门一技之长，比什么都强。
一技之长.en: Learning a skill is better than anything else.

一技之长.zh: 年轻人应该趁早培养一技之长。
一技之长.en: Young people should cultivate a skill early.

一技之长.zh: 靠着一技之长，他在大城市站稳了脚跟。
一技之长.en: Relying on his skill, he established himself in the big city.
