一技之长.zh: 虽然学历不高，但他凭一技之长开了自己的店。
一技之长.en: Although his education is not high, he opened his own shop with his skill.

欠条.zh: 他借钱的时候给我打了个欠条。
欠条.en: He wrote me an IOU when he borrowed money.

欠条.zh: 欠条上写清楚了还款日期。
欠条.en: The repayment date is clearly written on the IOU.

欠条.zh: 虽然他写了欠条，但他还是忘了还钱。
欠条.en: Although he wrote an IOU, he still forgot to pay back the money.

欠条.zh: 这张欠条已经过期了，不能用了。
欠条.en: This IOU has expired and is no longer valid.

见闻.en: I saw and heard a lot on this trip.

见闻.zh: 他把旅途中的见闻都记在日记里。
见闻.en: He recorded all his experiences from the journey in his diary.

见闻.zh: 听爷爷讲他年轻时的见闻很有趣。
见闻.en: Listening to Grandpa talk about his experiences when he was young is very interesting.

见闻.zh: 因为见闻广博，所以他总能说出新奇的事。
见闻.en: Because he has broad experiences, he can always tell novel things.

见闻.zh: 这本书里记录了很多关于异国的见闻。
见闻.en: This book records many experiences about foreign countries.

同舟共济.zh: 遇到困难时，大家应该同舟共济。
同舟共济.en: When encountering difficulties, everyone should work together.

同舟共济.zh: 公司现在需要所有人同舟共济。
同舟共济.en: The company now needs everyone to pull together.

同舟共济.zh: 虽然我们来自不同部门，但必须同舟共济渡过难关。
同舟共济.en: Although we come from different departments, we must work together to get through the tough times.

同舟共济.zh: 在这个项目上，我们只能同舟共济了。
同舟共济.en: On this project, we have no choice but to work together.

自强不息.en: He has always been striving for self-improvement.

自强不息.zh: 他从小就学会了自强不息的精神。
自强不息.en: He learned the spirit of continuous self-improvement from a young age.

自强不息.zh: 靠着自强不息，他最后成功了。
自强不息.en: Relying on constant self-improvement, he finally succeeded.

自强不息.zh: 即使失败了，我们也要自强不息继续努力。
自强不息.en: Even if we fail, we must still strive to improve and keep working hard.

自强不息.zh: 学校鼓励学生要有自强不息的品格。
自强不息.en: The school encourages students to have a character of continuous self-improvement.

堆砌.en: Don't pile up so many words.

堆砌.zh: 他的文章堆砌了很多华丽的辞藻。
堆砌.en: His article is full of piled-up flowery language.

堆砌.zh: 这些石头堆砌得不太整齐。
堆砌.en: These stones are not piled up very neatly.

堆砌.zh: 虽然堆砌了很多形容词，但内容很空洞。
堆砌.en: Although it piles up many adjectives, the content is very hollow.

堆砌.zh: 她喜欢在花园里堆砌各种形状的石头。
堆砌.en: She likes to pile up stones of various shapes in the garden.

序言.zh: 这本书的序言写得很好。
序言.en: The preface of this book is well written.

序言.zh: 老师让我为他的新书写一篇序言。
序言.en: The teacher asked me to write a preface for his new book.

序言.zh: 序言里介绍了作者的写作背景。
序言.en: The preface introduces the author's writing background.

序言.zh: 如果你没时间看整本书，至少读一下序言。
序言.en: If you don't have time to read the whole book, at least read the preface.

序言.zh: 这篇序言是作者的朋友写的。
序言.en: This preface was written by a friend of the author.

旗袍.zh: 参加宴会时她特意穿了一件红色旗袍。
旗袍.en: She deliberately wore a red cheongsam to the banquet.

旗袍.zh: 旗袍是中国传统的服饰之一。
旗袍.en: The cheongsam is one of China's traditional garments.

旗袍.zh: 虽然旗袍很好看，但穿起来不太方便。
旗袍.en: Although the cheongsam looks nice, it's not very convenient to wear.

旗袍.zh: 她定做了一件绣花旗袍，准备结婚时穿。
旗袍.en: She had an embroidered cheongsam custom-made, planning to wear it at her wedding.

说情.zh: 他犯了错，但我不想替他说情。
说情.en: He made a mistake, but I don't want to intercede for him.

说情.zh: 因为朋友说情，老板才原谅了他。
说情.en: It was only because a friend pleaded for him that the boss forgave him.

说情.zh: 如果他去说情，也许老师会宽限几天。
说情.en: If he goes to plead, maybe the teacher will give a few more days.

说情.zh: 他妈妈去学校给他说情，希望不要开除他。
说情.en: His mother went to school to plead for him, hoping they wouldn't expel him.

见多识广.en: He is a well-traveled and knowledgeable person.

见多识广.zh: 经常旅行的人通常见多识广。
见多识广.en: People who travel often are usually experienced and knowledgeable.

见多识广.zh: 爷爷见多识广，什么事都知道。
见多识广.en: Grandpa is experienced and knowledgeable; he knows everything.

见多识广.zh: 因为他见多识广，所以我喜欢跟他聊天。
见多识广.en: Because he is experienced and knowledgeable, I like chatting with him.

见多识广.zh: 作为一个记者，他需要见多识广才能写得好。
见多识广.en: As a journalist, he needs to be well-informed to write well.

精益求精.en: He constantly strives for perfection in his work.

精益求精.zh: 做菜也要有精益求精的态度。
精益求精.en: Cooking also requires an attitude of constantly striving for improvement.

精益求精.zh: 他的画技还在精益求精中。
精益求精.en: His painting skills are still being refined.

精益求精.zh: 虽然已经很好了，但他还是精益求精地改进。
精益求精.en: Although it's already very good, he still makes improvements to strive for perfection.

精益求精.zh: 这家公司一直秉持精益求精的理念。
精益求精.en: This company has always upheld the philosophy of constantly striving for perfection.

耻笑.en: Don't mock him; he works very hard too.

耻笑.zh: 大家不要因为他的口音而耻笑他。
耻笑.en: Don't ridicule him because of his accent.

耻笑.zh: 她小时候常被同学耻笑，但现在很自信。
耻笑.en: She was often laughed at by classmates as a child, but now she's very confident.

耻笑.zh: 无论别人怎么耻笑，他都坚持做自己。
耻笑.en: No matter how others mock him, he insists on being himself.

耻笑.zh: 你那样耻笑别人，真的很不礼貌。
耻笑.en: It's really impolite to ridicule others like that.

跑龙套.en: He only plays a minor role in the crew.

跑龙套.zh: 我刚开始演戏时，就是跑龙套的。
跑龙套.en: When I first started acting, I was just a bit player.

跑龙套.zh: 别瞧不起跑龙套，那是积累经验的好方法。
跑龙套.en: Don't look down on being a minor role; it's a good way to gain experience.

跑龙套.zh: 他跑龙套跑了三年，终于当上了主角。
跑龙套.en: He played minor roles for three years and finally got the lead role.

跑龙套.zh: 在职场中，很多人都是从跑龙套开始的。
跑龙套.en: In the workplace, many people start out doing minor tasks.

从容不迫.zh: 面对危机，她依然从容不迫。
从容不迫.en: Facing the crisis, she remained calm and composed.

从容不迫.zh: 他从容不迫地解答了所有问题。
从容不迫.en: He answered all the questions calmly and unhurriedly.

从容不迫.zh: 虽然时间很紧，但他还是从容不迫地完成了任务。
从容不迫.en: Even though time was tight, he still finished the task calmly.

从容不迫.zh: 我喜欢他那种从容不迫的态度。
从容不迫.en: I like his calm and unhurried attitude.

稠密.zh: 城市的中心人口很稠密。
稠密.en: The city center has a dense population.

稠密.zh: 这里的树木长得太稠密，阳光都照不进来。
稠密.en: The trees here are so dense that sunlight can't get through.

稠密.zh: 由于人口稠密，这个地方交通很拥挤。
稠密.en: Due to the dense population, traffic in this area is very congested.

稠密.zh: 他画了一幅线条稠密的画。
稠密.en: He painted a picture with dense lines.

长达.en: This road is as long as ten kilometers.
The meeting lasted as long as three hours.

长达.zh: 他写了一封长达五页的信。
长达.en: He wrote a letter as long as five pages.

长达.zh: 这段隧道长达八公里，开车要十分钟。
长达.en: This tunnel is eight kilometers long, and it takes ten minutes to drive through.

长达.zh: 他的演讲长达一小时，大家都有点坐不住了。
长达.en: His speech lasted an hour, and everyone was getting restless.

洪亮.en: His voice is loud and clear.

洪亮.zh: 主持人用洪亮的声音宣布结果。
洪亮.en: The host announced the results in a loud, clear voice.

洪亮.zh: 他唱歌时嗓音洪亮，全场都听得很清楚。
洪亮.en: When he sings, his voice is so clear that everyone in the hall can hear.

洪亮.zh: 虽然年纪大了，但他的嗓音依然洪亮。
洪亮.en: Even though he's old, his voice is still loud and clear.

洪亮.zh: 那个号角声特别洪亮，传得很远。
洪亮.en: The horn sound was especially loud and clear and carried far.

峰回路转.en: Things suddenly took a turn for the better.

峰回路转.zh: 别放弃，也许很快就会峰回路转。
峰回路转.en: Don't give up; maybe things will turn around soon.

峰回路转.zh: 他原本以为没希望了，结果峰回路转。
峰回路转.en: He originally thought there was no hope, but then things changed for the better.

峰回路转.zh: 这部电影的情节峰回路转，非常精彩。
峰回路转.en: The plot of this movie has many twists and turns; it's very exciting.

峰回路转.zh: 生意遇到困难时，峰回路转来了个大客户。
峰回路转.en: When the business was struggling, things took a turn and a big client came.

嬉笑.en: The children are laughing and playing in the yard.

嬉笑.zh: 她们一边吃饭一边嬉笑。
课堂上不要嬉笑打闹，要认真听讲。
嬉笑.en: Don't giggle and fool around in class; listen carefully.

嬉笑.zh: 我听到远处传来一阵嬉笑声。
嬉笑.en: I heard a burst of giggles from afar.

嬉笑.zh: 他们嬉笑着跑开了，留下我一个人。
嬉笑.en: They ran off laughing, leaving me alone.

鹤立鸡群.en: He stands out from the crowd like a crane among chickens.

鹤立鸡群.zh: 她的才华让她在同学中鹤立鸡群。
鹤立鸡群.en: Her talent makes her stand out among her classmates.

鹤立鸡群.zh: 他个子很高，在任何地方都鹤立鸡群。
鹤立鸡群.en: He's very tall and stands out wherever he goes.

鹤立鸡群.zh: 在这个团队里，他的能力简直是鹤立鸡群。
鹤立鸡群.en: In this team, his ability is truly outstanding.

鹤立鸡群.zh: 她不仅漂亮，而且聪明，在选秀中鹤立鸡群。
鹤立鸡群.en: She's not only beautiful but also smart, standing out in the talent show.

风沙.en: There's a lot of wind and sand today.

风沙.zh: 北方春天常有风沙天气。
风沙.en: Northern areas often have sandstorm weather in spring.

风沙.zh: 出门记得戴口罩，外面风沙太大了。
风沙.en: Remember to wear a mask when going out; the wind and sand are too strong.

风沙.zh: 因为风沙，航班被延误了。
风沙.en: The flight was delayed due to the sandstorm.

风沙.zh: 这片地区风沙肆虐，人们不得不搬走。
风沙.en: This area is plagued by sandstorms, and people have to move away.

大大咧咧.zh: 她这个人总是大大咧咧的。
大大咧咧.en: She is always careless and easygoing.

大大咧咧.zh: 他虽然大大咧咧，但做事很靠谱。
大大咧咧.en: Although he is careless, he is reliable in doing things.

大大咧咧.zh: 别看他大大咧咧的样子，其实心里很清楚。
大大咧咧.en: Don't be fooled by his careless appearance; he knows what's going on.

大大咧咧.zh: 我室友大大咧咧的，经常找不到钥匙。
大大咧咧.en: My roommate is so careless that he often can't find his keys.

大大咧咧.zh: 她大大咧咧地把杯子打碎了。

标点.zh: 写作文要注意标点符号。
标点.en: Pay attention to punctuation when writing essays.

标点.zh: 他写的句子一个标点都没有。
标点.en: His sentences don't have a single punctuation mark.

标点.zh: 中文的标点和英文不一样。
标点.en: Chinese punctuation is different from English punctuation.

标点.zh: 因为没加标点，那句话意思全变了。
标点.en: Because there was no punctuation, the meaning of that sentence completely changed.

标点.zh: 老师教我们如何正确使用标点。
标点.en: The teacher taught us how to use punctuation correctly.

喜洋洋.zh: 过年的时候大家喜洋洋的。
喜洋洋.en: Everyone is joyful during the Chinese New Year.

喜洋洋.zh: 听到这个消息，他喜洋洋地笑了。
喜洋洋.en: Hearing the news, he smiled joyfully.

喜洋洋.zh: 整个节日气氛喜洋洋的。
喜洋洋.en: The whole holiday atmosphere is cheerful.

喜洋洋.zh: 虽然输了比赛，但大家还是喜洋洋的。
喜洋洋.en: Although they lost the game, everyone was still cheerful.

喜洋洋.zh: 孩子们拿着红包，个个喜洋洋的。
喜洋洋.en: The children, holding red envelopes, were all beaming with joy.

假使.zh: 假使你明天不来，记得告诉我。
假使.en: If you don't come tomorrow, remember to tell me.

假使.zh: 假使下雨，活动就取消了。
假使.en: If it rains, the event will be canceled.

假使.zh: 假使能重来，我会选择不同的路。
假使.en: If I could do it over, I would choose a different path.

假使.zh: 假使你不喜欢，我们可以换个地方。
假使.en: If you don't like it, we can change the place.

假使.zh: 假使他没撒谎，那这件事就是真的。
假使.en: If he didn't lie, then this matter is true.

讲学.zh: 这位教授常去国外讲学。
讲学.en: This professor often goes abroad to give lectures.

讲学.zh: 他今年在北京大学讲学。
讲学.en: He is giving lectures at Peking University this year.

讲学.zh: 他受邀去哈佛讲学三个月。
讲学.en: He was invited to lecture at Harvard for three months.

讲学.zh: 除了讲学，他还写了几本书。
讲学.en: Besides giving lectures, he has also written a few books.

讲学.zh: 那次讲学吸引了很多学生来听。
讲学.en: That lecture attracted many students to come and listen.

学子.zh: 高考是千万学子的重要时刻。
学子.en: The college entrance exam is an important moment for millions of students.

学子.zh: 这所学校培养了许多优秀学子。
学子.en: This school has nurtured many outstanding students.

学子.zh: 海外学子纷纷回国发展。
学子.en: Overseas students are returning to China for development.

学子.zh: 作为学子，我们应该努力学习。
学子.en: As students, we should study hard.

学子.zh: 在这个毕业季，学子们依依不舍地告别校园。
学子.en: During this graduation season, students bid farewell to the campus with reluctance.

籍贯.en: Where is your place of origin?
His place of origin is Shandong.

籍贯.zh: 填表格时要写清楚籍贯。
籍贯.en: When filling out forms, make sure to write your place of origin clearly.

籍贯.zh: 虽然出生在北京，但籍贯是湖南。
籍贯.en: Although born in Beijing, his place of origin is Hunan.

籍贯.zh: 很多人对自己的籍贯不太了解。
籍贯.en: Many people don't know much about their own place of origin.

工整.zh: 这份报告的排版很工整。
工整.en: The layout of this report is very neat.

工整.zh: 他写字非常工整，像印刷的一样。
工整.en: His handwriting is so neat it looks printed.

工整.zh: 虽然写得快，但字依然工整。
工整.en: Although he writes fast, his characters are still neat.

工整.zh: 老师要求作业必须工整清晰。
工整.en: The teacher requires homework to be neat and clear.

荷花.en: The lotus flowers bloom in summer.
There is a lotus pond in the park.
The lotus emerges from mud but remains unstained.

荷花.zh: 我们去年夏天去看了荷花。
荷花.en: We went to see the lotus flowers last summer.

荷花.zh: 因为下雨，荷花瓣上都是水珠。
荷花.en: Because it rained, the lotus petals were covered with water droplets.

提速.en: The train has sped up again.
This software needs to be sped up.

提速.zh: 为了节省时间，我们必须提速。
提速.en: To save time, we must speed up.

提速.zh: 公司要求生产线的效率提速。
提速.en: The company requires the efficiency of the production line to be increased.

提速.zh: 由于交通拥堵，公交车很难再提速。
提速.en: Due to traffic congestion, it's hard for buses to speed up further.

变幻莫测.zh: 天气变幻莫测，出门要带伞。
变幻莫测.en: The weather is unpredictable, so bring an umbrella when going out.

变幻莫测.zh: 股市变幻莫测，投资一定要小心风险。
变幻莫测.en: The stock market is unpredictable, so you must be careful with risks when investing.

变幻莫测.zh: 虽然天气变幻莫测，但我们还是决定去爬山。
变幻莫测.en: Although the weather is unpredictable, we still decided to go hiking.

变幻莫测.zh: 他的脾气变幻莫测，让人很难相处。
变幻莫测.en: His mood is unpredictable, making him hard to get along with.

变幻莫测.zh: 人生变幻莫测，谁也说不准明天会发生什么。
变幻莫测.en: Life is unpredictable; no one can say what will happen tomorrow.

求医.en: He is sick and seeking medical treatment.

求医.zh: 为了治好这个病，他到处求医问药。
求医.en: To cure this disease, he went everywhere seeking medical advice and medicine.

求医.zh: 因为病情复杂，他决定去大城市求医。
求医.en: Because his condition is complicated, he decided to seek medical treatment in a big city.

求医.zh: 老人家身体不舒服，子女赶紧带他去求医。
求医.en: The elderly man felt unwell, so his children quickly took him to see a doctor.

求医.zh: 求医过程很辛苦，但终于找到了好医生。
求医.en: The process of seeking medical treatment was hard, but he finally found a good doctor.

理直气壮.zh: 他理直气壮地反驳了对方的观点。
理直气壮.en: He refuted the other person's opinion with confidence and righteousness.

理直气壮.zh: 既然你没有做错，就可以理直气壮地说话。
理直气壮.en: Since you did nothing wrong, you can speak assertively.

理直气壮.zh: 虽然对方很强势，但他仍然理直气壮地坚持自己的立场。
理直气壮.en: Although the other party was very aggressive, he still firmly stood his ground with confidence.

理直气壮.zh: 做错了事就别想理直气壮地辩解。
理直气壮.en: If you did something wrong, don't try to justify it with a bold front.

理直气壮.zh: 她理直气壮地要求老板给她加薪。
理直气壮.en: She confidently and righteously demanded a raise from her boss.

称心如意.zh: 找了很久才买到一件称心如意的衣服。
称心如意.en: I searched for a long time before buying a piece of clothing that was completely to my liking.

称心如意.zh: 如果你觉得不称心如意，我们可以再换一个。
称心如意.en: If you don't find it satisfactory, we can swap it for another one.

称心如意.zh: 生活不可能事事都称心如意。
称心如意.en: Life can't have everything go exactly as you wish.

称心如意.zh: 他终于找到了一份称心如意的工作。
称心如意.en: He finally found a job that suits him perfectly.

由此可见.en: From this, we can see that he is very hardworking.

由此可见.zh: 他连续加班一个月，由此可见他对工作的重视。
由此可见.en: He worked overtime for a whole month; from this we can see how much he values his job.

由此可见.zh: 考试成绩很好，由此可见他平时学习很用功。
由此可见.en: His exam results were very good; from this we can see that he studies very diligently.

由此可见.zh: 没有人反对这个方案，由此可见大家都同意。
由此可见.en: No one objected to this plan; from this we can see that everyone agrees.

由此可见.zh: 他每天都练习弹琴，由此可见他对音乐的热爱。
由此可见.en: He practices the piano every day; from this we can see his love for music.

沿线.en: There are many shops along the subway line.

沿线.zh: 高铁沿线经过好几个美丽的城市。
沿线.en: The high-speed rail line passes through several beautiful cities along the way.

沿线.zh: 如果沿着公路沿线走，就能看到风景。
沿线.en: If you walk along the roadside, you can see the scenery.

沿线.zh: 这个地铁站沿线都是居民区。
沿线.en: The area along this subway station is all residential neighborhoods.

沿线.zh: 河岸沿线种了很多柳树。
沿线.en: Many willow trees are planted along the riverbank.

水货.zh: 这个手机是水货，便宜很多。
水货.en: This phone is a grey market import, much cheaper.

水货.zh: 他买的水货相机用了没多久就坏了。
水货.en: The gray market camera he bought broke down shortly after he used it.

水货.zh: 虽然价格低，但水货没有保修，风险很大。
水货.en: Although the price is low, grey market goods have no warranty and are very risky.

水货.zh: 别找那个水货修电脑，他技术不行。
水货.en: Don't get that incompetent guy to fix the computer; his skills are no good.

水货.zh: 市场上卖的水货手表外观和正品一样。
水货.en: The counterfeit watches sold on the market look just like the genuine ones.

勉励.zh: 老师勉励学生好好学习。
勉励.en: The teacher encouraged the students to study hard.

勉励.zh: 考试前，父母勉励我要放轻松。
勉励.en: Before the exam, my parents encouraged me to relax.

勉励.zh: 同事升职了，我勉励他继续努力。
勉励.en: My colleague got promoted, and I encouraged him to keep working hard.

勉励.zh: 他失败时，朋友勉励他不要放弃。
勉励.en: When he failed, his friends encouraged him not to give up.

勉励.zh: 教练在比赛前勉励队员们全力以赴。
勉励.en: The coach encouraged the team to give it their all before the match.

树梢.en: A little bird is perched on the treetop.

树梢.zh: 风吹动树梢，叶子沙沙作响。
树梢.en: The wind moves the treetops, making the leaves rustle.

树梢.zh: 月亮挂在树梢上，夜晚很宁静。
树梢.en: The moon hangs on the treetops, and the night is very quiet.

树梢.zh: 猫爬到了树梢，下不来了。
树梢.en: The cat climbed to the top of the tree and can't come down.

树梢.zh: 从树梢可以看到远处的山。
树梢.en: From the treetops, you can see the mountains in the distance.

矿藏.en: This region is rich in mineral resources.

矿藏.zh: 国家一直在勘探新的矿藏资源。
矿藏.en: The country has been exploring new mineral resources.

矿藏.zh: 由于矿藏有限，我们需要合理开采。
矿藏.en: Because mineral resources are limited, we need to mine them responsibly.

矿藏.zh: 海底矿藏的开采技术还不成熟。
矿藏.en: The technology for mining seabed mineral deposits is not yet mature.

矿藏.zh: 这座山下面藏着丰富的矿藏。
矿藏.en: There are abundant mineral deposits hidden beneath this mountain.

火暴.zh: 这家新开的火锅店生意特别火暴。
火暴.en: This newly opened hotpot restaurant's business is extremely booming.

火暴.zh: 他脾气火暴，动不动就发火。
火暴.en: He has a fiery temper and gets angry easily.

火暴.zh: 那个歌手的演唱会门票卖得特别火暴。
火暴.en: That singer's concert tickets sold extremely well.

火暴.zh: 因为性格火暴，他在公司里得罪了不少人。
火暴.en: Because of his fiery personality, he offended many people in the company.

火暴.zh: 最近这种手机在年轻人中特别火暴，几乎人手一部。
火暴.en: Recently this type of phone has become extremely popular among young people, almost everyone has one.

综上所述.zh: 综上所述，这个方案还是可行的。
综上所述.en: To sum up, this plan is still feasible.

综上所述.zh: 综上所述，我们应该选择更环保的方法。
综上所述.en: To sum up, we should choose a more environmentally friendly method.

综上所述.zh: 综上所述，他的观点虽然新颖，但缺乏实际依据。
综上所述.en: To sum up, although his viewpoint is novel, it lacks practical basis.

综上所述.zh: 综上所述，这次实验的结果并不能支持原来的假设。
综上所述.en: To sum up, the results of this experiment cannot support the original hypothesis.

综上所述.zh: 综上所述，公司今年的业绩下滑主要由市场环境变化导致。
综上所述.en: To sum up, the company's performance decline this year is mainly caused by changes in the market environment.

旋涡.en: The small boat was sucked into the whirlpool.

旋涡.zh: 他陷入了舆论的旋涡，很难脱身。
旋涡.en: He fell into the whirlpool of public opinion and found it hard to escape.

旋涡.zh: 河水在桥下形成了一个大旋涡。
旋涡.en: The river formed a large whirlpool under the bridge.

旋涡.zh: 别让自己被那些是非的旋涡困住。
旋涡.en: Don't let yourself be trapped in the whirlpool of those disputes.

旋涡.zh: 政治斗争的旋涡让很多人身不由己。
旋涡.en: The whirlpool of political struggle made many people lose control of themselves.

一年到头.zh: 他一年到头都在外面打工。
一年到头.en: He works away from home all year round.

一年到头.zh: 这里一年到头都是夏天。
一年到头.en: It's summer here all year round.

一年到头.zh: 她一年到头都在忙，很少休息。
一年到头.en: She is busy all year round and rarely rests.

一年到头.zh: 农民一年到头在地里干活，非常辛苦。
一年到头.en: Farmers work in the fields all year round, which is very hard.

一年到头.zh: 虽然一年到头都很累，但他觉得生活很有意义。
一年到头.en: Although he is tired all year round, he feels life is meaningful.

漠然.zh: 他对别人的困难总是漠然置之。
漠然.en: He is always indifferent to other people's difficulties.

漠然.zh: 听到这个消息，他表情漠然。
漠然.en: Upon hearing the news, his expression was indifferent.

漠然.zh: 她漠然地看了我一眼，然后走开了。
漠然.en: She gave me an indifferent look and then walked away.

漠然.zh: 面对批评，他表现得十分漠然，好像完全不在乎。
漠然.en: Facing criticism, he acted very indifferent, as if he didn't care at all.

漠然.zh: 你不能对这种不公平的事情漠然视之。
漠然.en: You cannot be indifferent to such unfair matters.

一言一行.zh: 父母的一言一行都影响着孩子。
一言一行.en: Parents' every word and deed influences their children.

一言一行.zh: 作为公众人物，他的一言一行都被关注。
一言一行.en: As a public figure, his every word and deed is watched.

一言一行.zh: 在面试时，你的一言一行都很重要。
一言一行.en: During the interview, your every word and deed is important.

一言一行.zh: 老师的一言一行都在教学生怎么做人。
一言一行.en: The teacher's every word and deed teaches students how to be a person.

一言一行.zh: 他做事很谨慎，注意自己的一言一行。
一言一行.en: He is very cautious and pays attention to his every word and deed.

沉甸甸.zh: 这个背包沉甸甸的，里面装了好多书。
沉甸甸.en: This backpack is heavy; it's full of books.

沉甸甸.zh: 收到录取通知书的那一刻，他心里沉甸甸的。
沉甸甸.en: The moment he received the admission letter, his heart felt heavy.

沉甸甸.zh: 妈妈递给我一个沉甸甸的信封。
沉甸甸.en: Mom handed me a heavy envelope.

沉甸甸.zh: 果实沉甸甸地挂在枝头，今年又是丰收年。
沉甸甸.en: The fruits hang heavily on the branches; it's another bumper year.

沉甸甸.zh: 他手里拿着沉甸甸的奖杯，激动得说不出话来。
沉甸甸.en: He held the heavy trophy in his hands and was too excited to speak.

半边天.en: Women hold up half the sky.

半边天.zh: 在公司里，女同事撑起了半边天。
半边天.en: In the company, female colleagues hold up half the sky.

半边天.zh: 这个行业的成绩离不开半边天的贡献。
半边天.en: The achievements of this industry are inseparable from the contributions of half the sky (women).

半边天.zh: 她靠自己的努力证明了女人也能撑起半边天。
半边天.en: She proved through her own efforts that women can also hold up half the sky.

半边天.zh: 现在很多家庭里，妻子也顶了半边天，经济独立。
半边天.en: Now in many families, wives also hold up half the sky and are financially independent.

足智多谋.zh: 他足智多谋，总能想到好办法。
足智多谋.en: He is resourceful and always comes up with good ideas.

足智多谋.zh: 诸葛亮是历史上足智多谋的人物。
足智多谋.en: Zhuge Liang is a resourceful figure in history.

足智多谋.zh: 面对危机，他表现得足智多谋。
足智多谋.en: Facing the crisis, he acted resourcefully.

足智多谋.zh: 队长足智多谋，带领大家走出了困境。
足智多谋.en: The team leader was resourceful and led everyone out of trouble.

足智多谋.zh: 他不仅勇敢，而且足智多谋，是个难得的将领。
足智多谋.en: He is not only brave but also resourceful—a rare general.

似是而非.zh: 这个说法似是而非，不能轻信。
似是而非.en: This statement is specious; don't take it lightly.

似是而非.zh: 他提出的理由似是而非，根本站不住脚。
似是而非.en: The reasons he gave are specious and totally untenable.

似是而非.zh: 网上很多健康知识听起来似是而非，其实不科学。
似是而非.en: Many health tips online sound plausible but are actually unscientific.

似是而非.zh: 这种似是而非的理论很容易误导年轻人。
似是而非.en: This kind of specious theory can easily mislead young people.

似是而非.zh: 老师一眼就看出了他答案里似是而非的地方。
似是而非.en: The teacher saw at a glance the specious parts in his answer.

人次.en: Today's number of visitors is very small.

人次.zh: 这次活动有五百人次参加。
因为免费开放，昨天的人次超过了两千。
人次.en: Because it was free, the number of visitors yesterday exceeded two thousand.

人次.zh: 虽然天气不好，但观展人次还是很多。
人次.en: Although the weather was bad, the number of exhibition visitors was still high.

人次.zh: 这个月总人次比上个月增加了百分之十。
人次.en: The total number of person-times this month increased by 10% compared to last month.

改邪归正.en: He finally turned over a new leaf.

改邪归正.zh: 他决定改邪归正，不再偷东西。
改邪归正.en: He decided to reform and stop stealing.

改邪归正.zh: 在朋友的帮助下，他改邪归正，开始努力工作。
改邪归正.en: With his friend's help, he turned over a new leaf and started working hard.

改邪归正.zh: 虽然他以前混过，但现在改邪归正了。
改邪归正.en: Although he used to hang out with a bad crowd, he has now reformed.

改邪归正.zh: 警察劝他早点改邪归正，重新做人。
改邪归正.en: The police advised him to reform as soon as possible and start anew.

劳驾.en: Excuse me, please let me through.

劳驾.zh: 劳驾，您能帮我拍张照片吗？
劳驾.en: Excuse me, could you take a photo for me?

劳驾.zh: 劳驾，如果方便的话，请把窗户关上。
劳驾.en: Excuse me, if it's convenient, please close the window.

劳驾.zh: 劳驾，请问地铁站在哪儿？
劳驾.en: Excuse me, where is the subway station?

劳驾.zh: 劳驾，麻烦您递一下那个杯子。
劳驾.en: Excuse me, could you please pass me that cup?

敬而远之.en: I keep a respectful distance from people like this.

敬而远之.zh: 因为他太爱吹牛，大家都对他敬而远之。
敬而远之.en: Because he likes to brag too much, everyone keeps their distance from him.

敬而远之.zh: 虽然他是领导，但大家对他都敬而远之。
敬而远之.en: Although he is the boss, everyone keeps a respectful distance from him.

敬而远之.zh: 我对那些不诚实的人总是敬而远之。
敬而远之.en: I always steer clear of dishonest people.

敬而远之.zh: 她性格太强势，同事们都敬而远之。
敬而远之.en: Her personality is too domineering, so her colleagues keep their distance.

磁卡.zh: 现在都用手机支付，很少用磁卡了。
磁卡.en: Nowadays everyone uses mobile payments, magnetic cards are rarely used.

磁卡.zh: 虽然我有磁卡，但密码忘记了。
磁卡.en: Although I have the magnetic card, I forgot the password.

磁卡.zh: 这张磁卡可以刷开门禁。
磁卡.en: This magnetic card can swipe to open the access gate.

磁卡.zh: 出门别忘了带磁卡和钥匙。
磁卡.en: Don't forget to bring your magnetic card and keys when you go out.

柏树.en: There is a cypress tree growing in the yard.

柏树.zh: 墓地周围种了很多柏树，显得很庄重。
柏树.en: Many cypress trees are planted around the cemetery, giving it a solemn look.

柏树.zh: 因为柏树四季常青，所以很多人喜欢种在院子里。
柏树.en: Because cypress trees stay green all year round, many people like to plant them in their yards.

柏树.zh: 这棵柏树已经有上百年历史了。
柏树.en: This cypress tree is over a hundred years old.

柏树.zh: 柏树的叶子有一股特殊的香味。
柏树.en: Cypress leaves have a special fragrance.

贺电.en: He received a congratulatory message from his boss.

贺电.zh: 公司成立十周年，收到了很多贺电。
贺电.en: On the tenth anniversary of the company's founding, we received many congratulatory messages.

贺电.zh: 虽然不能到场，但发来了贺电表示祝贺。
贺电.en: Although they couldn't be there in person, they sent a congratulatory message to express their wishes.

贺电.zh: 这份贺电来自海外友人的祝福。
贺电.en: This congratulatory message is a blessing from an overseas friend.

贺电.zh: 贺电内容简短但很真诚。
贺电.en: The content of the congratulatory message was brief but very sincere.

娇气.en: She is too pampered and delicate.

娇气.zh: 这点苦都吃不了，你也太娇气了。
娇气.en: You can't even bear this little hardship, you're way too fragile.

娇气.zh: 虽然她是独生女，但一点也不娇气。
娇气.en: Although she is an only child, she is not at all pampered.

娇气.zh: 别这么娇气，摔一下没什么大不了的。
娇气.en: Don't be so delicate; a little fall is no big deal.

娇气.zh: 现在的孩子越来越娇气了。
娇气.en: Children nowadays are getting more and more pampered.

农民工.zh: 很多农民工在城市打工。
农民工.en: Many migrant workers work in the cities.

农民工.zh: 这些农民工为城市建设付出了很多。
农民工.en: These migrant workers have contributed a lot to urban construction.

农民工.zh: 虽然工作辛苦，但农民工们很勤劳。
农民工.en: Although the work is hard, the migrant workers are very hardworking.

农民工.zh: 春节前夕，农民工都赶着回家过年。
农民工.en: Just before the Spring Festival, migrant workers hurry home to celebrate the New Year.

农民工.zh: 我们应该尊重每一位农民工的付出。
农民工.en: We should respect the contributions of every migrant worker.

锦旗.en: The hospital received a silk banner.

锦旗.zh: 为了感谢警察的帮助，他们送了一面锦旗。
锦旗.en: To thank the police for their help, they presented a silk banner.

锦旗.zh: 因为医生救了孩子，家长特意送来锦旗。
锦旗.en: Because the doctor saved the child, the parents specially sent a silk banner.
The wall is covered with various silk banners.

锦旗.zh: 这面锦旗是对我们工作的肯定。
锦旗.en: This silk banner is an affirmation of our work.

多边.zh: 多边合作能解决很多问题。
多边.en: Multilateral cooperation can solve many problems.

多边.zh: 他们正在谈多边贸易协议。
多边.en: They are negotiating a multilateral trade agreement.

多边.zh: 虽然双边关系重要，但多边框架更稳定。
多边.en: Although bilateral relations are important, multilateral frameworks are more stable.

多边.zh: 我觉得多边谈判比双边更复杂，但也更公平。
多边.en: I think multilateral negotiations are more complex than bilateral ones, but also fairer.

锲而不舍.zh: 锲而不舍的精神值得学习。
锲而不舍.en: The spirit of perseverance is worth learning.

锲而不舍.zh: 他锲而不舍地练了三年钢琴。
锲而不舍.en: He practiced the piano persistently for three years.

锲而不舍.zh: 创业需要锲而不舍，不然很容易放弃。
锲而不舍.en: Starting a business requires perseverance, otherwise it's easy to give up.

锲而不舍.zh: 虽然失败了很多次，但他还是锲而不舍地尝试。
锲而不舍.en: Although he failed many times, he still kept trying persistently.

祖籍.zh: 你知道他的祖籍在哪儿吗？
祖籍.en: Do you know where his ancestral hometown is?

祖籍.zh: 虽然他出生在上海，但祖籍是广东。
祖籍.en: Although he was born in Shanghai, his ancestral home is Guangdong.

祖籍.zh: 很多人会问你的祖籍，因为这对他们很重要。
祖籍.en: Many people will ask about your ancestral hometown because it's important to them.

祖籍.zh: 她的祖籍在湖南，但她从来没回去过。
祖籍.en: Her ancestral home is in Hunan, but she has never been back.

浮力.en: Wood has great buoyancy in water.
Buoyancy is very important when swimming.

浮力.zh: 浮力让船能漂在水面上。
浮力.en: Buoyancy allows ships to float on water.

浮力.zh: 如果你在水里放松，浮力会把你托起来。
浮力.en: If you relax in the water, buoyancy will lift you up.

浮力.zh: 这个游泳圈浮力不够，得换个大的。
浮力.en: This swim ring doesn't have enough buoyancy; we need to get a bigger one.

能耗.en: This air conditioner has low energy consumption.

能耗.zh: 新车的能耗比旧车小很多。
能耗.en: The new car's energy consumption is much lower than the old one.

能耗.zh: 为了降低能耗，我们换了LED灯泡。
能耗.en: To reduce energy consumption, we switched to LED bulbs.

能耗.zh: 工厂能耗太高，老板正在想办法。
能耗.en: The factory's energy consumption is too high, and the boss is trying to find a solution.

能耗.zh: 如果你注意能耗，每个月能省不少电费。
能耗.en: If you pay attention to energy consumption, you can save a lot on electricity bills each month.

犯愁.en: She's been worrying about work lately.

犯愁.zh: 别犯愁了，船到桥头自然直。
犯愁.en: Don't worry; everything will work out in the end.

犯愁.zh: 孩子成绩不好，父母很犯愁。
犯愁.en: The child's grades are poor, and the parents are very worried.

犯愁.zh: 他为了找房子犯愁了好几个星期。
犯愁.en: He worried for several weeks about finding an apartment.

脉络.en: The structure of this article is very clear.
The thread of his story is very messy.

脉络.zh: 你要先理清事情的脉络再下结论。
脉络.en: You need to sort out the context of the matter before drawing conclusions.

脉络.zh: 中医说人体有很多脉络。
脉络.en: Chinese medicine says there are many meridians in the human body.

脉络.zh: 虽然细节很多，但总体脉络还是能看出来的。
脉络.en: Although there are many details, the overall thread is still discernible.

津津有味.en: The children watched with great interest.

津津有味.zh: 她津津有味地读那本小说。
津津有味.en: She read that novel with great enjoyment.

津津有味.zh: 他们聊得津津有味，完全忘了时间。
津津有味.en: They chatted with great gusto, completely forgetting the time.

津津有味.zh: 虽然菜很简单，但他还是津津有味地吃完了。
津津有味.en: Although the food was very simple, he still finished it with relish.

泼冷水.en: Don't pour cold water on me.
He always likes to discourage others.

定心丸.zh: 他的承诺像一颗定心丸。
定心丸.en: His promise is like a reassuring pill.

定心丸.zh: 老板的话给我吃了定心丸。
定心丸.en: The boss's words gave me reassurance.

定心丸.zh: 考试前，老师的鼓励就是定心丸。
定心丸.en: Before the exam, the teacher's encouragement was a reassurance.

定心丸.zh: 只要听到他没事，我就吃了定心丸。
定心丸.en: As long as I hear that he's fine, I feel reassured.

沏.en: I'll brew a cup of tea for you.

沏.zh: 他每天早上都会沏一壶新茶。
沏.en: He brews a fresh pot of tea every morning.
Water is boiling, we can brew tea now.

沏.zh: 因为客人来了，我赶紧去沏茶。
沏.en: Because guests arrived, I hurried to brew tea.

沏.zh: 这茶叶不错，沏出来的味道很香。
沏.en: This tea leaf is good, the brewed flavor is very fragrant.

嫦娥.zh: 嫦娥奔月的故事很出名。
嫦娥.en: The story of Chang'e flying to the moon is famous.

嫦娥.zh: 中秋节的晚上，人们会讲嫦娥的故事。
嫦娥.en: On Mid-Autumn Festival evening, people tell the story of Chang'e.

嫦娥.zh: 虽然嫦娥只是传说，但很多人还是喜欢这个神话。
嫦娥.en: Although Chang'e is just a legend, many people still like this myth.

嫦娥.zh: 小朋友们最喜欢听嫦娥和玉兔的故事。
嫦娥.en: Kids most like hearing the story of Chang'e and the jade rabbit.

烘托.en: The background music sets off the atmosphere.

烘托.zh: 这幅画用暗色调烘托出人物的悲伤。
烘托.en: This painting uses dark tones to set off the character's sadness.

烘托.zh: 灯光烘托出浪漫的氛围。
烘托.en: The lighting sets off a romantic atmosphere.

烘托.zh: 她穿了一件红裙子，不但显眼，还烘托了她的肤色。
烘托.en: She wore a red dress, not only eye-catching but also setting off her skin tone.

烘托.zh: 电影里的雨景很好地烘托了主角的心情。
烘托.en: The rain scene in the movie effectively sets off the protagonist's mood.

不亚于.zh: 他的实力不亚于专业选手。
不亚于.en: His skill is not inferior to professional players.

不亚于.zh: 这家餐厅的味道不亚于五星级酒店。
不亚于.en: The taste of this restaurant is not inferior to five-star hotels.

不亚于.zh: 她的英语不亚于母语者。
不亚于.en: Her English is not inferior to native speakers.

不亚于.zh: 虽然他是新手，但他的表现不亚于老员工。
不亚于.en: Although he is a novice, his performance is not inferior to veteran employees.

不亚于.zh: 这款手机的性能不亚于最新款。
不亚于.en: The performance of this phone is not inferior to the latest model.

山岭.en: In the distance are continuous mountain ridges.

山岭.zh: 我们花了三天才翻过那片山岭。
山岭.en: It took us three days to cross that mountain range.
The mountain ridges are covered with pines.

山岭.zh: 因为山岭很高，所以从山顶能看到整个城市。
山岭.en: Because the mountain ridges are high, you can see the whole city from the top.

山岭.zh: 这片山岭风景很美，吸引了很多游客。
山岭.en: The scenery of this mountain range is beautiful, attracting many tourists.

勤俭.en: She is a diligent and thrifty person.

勤俭.zh: 爷爷奶奶那一代人特别勤俭，从不浪费。
勤俭.en: Grandparents' generation was especially diligent and thrifty, never wasting.

勤俭.zh: 虽然现在生活好了，但我们还是要保持勤俭的习惯。
勤俭.en: Although life is better now, we still need to maintain diligent and thrifty habits.

勤俭.zh: 他靠勤俭攒够了买房的钱。
勤俭.en: He saved enough money to buy a house through diligence and thrift.

踊跃.zh: 同学们踊跃报名参加比赛。
踊跃.en: Students eagerly signed up for the competition.

踊跃.zh: 这次募捐活动，大家都很踊跃捐款。
踊跃.en: In this fundraising event, everyone eagerly donated money.

踊跃.zh: 因为奖品很丰厚，所以员工们踊跃参与。
踊跃.en: Because the prizes are generous, employees eagerly participated.

踊跃.zh: 志愿者们踊跃报名去灾区帮忙。
踊跃.en: Volunteers eagerly signed up to help in the disaster area.

强占.zh: 这家公司试图强占竞争对手的市场份额。
强占.en: This company tried to forcibly seize the competitor's market share.
You cannot forcibly occupy others' belongings.

强占.zh: 由于他强占了公共区域，邻居们都很不满。
强占.en: Because he forcibly occupied the public area, the neighbors were very unhappy.

强占.zh: 历史上，侵略者常常强占领土。
强占.en: In history, invaders often forcibly occupied territories.

醇厚.zh: 他说话的语气很醇厚，给人一种可靠的感觉。
醇厚.en: His tone of voice is mellow, giving a reliable feeling.

醇厚.zh: 这款酱油经过长时间发酵，所以味道特别醇厚。
醇厚.en: This soy sauce is fermented for a long time, so the flavor is especially mellow.

醇厚.zh: 他的嗓音醇厚，唱起歌来很好听。
醇厚.en: His voice is mellow, making singing very pleasant.

丰硕.zh: 今年苹果结出了丰硕的果实。
丰硕.en: This year the apple tree yielded abundant fruit.

丰硕.zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于取得了丰硕的成果。
丰硕.en: After years of effort, he finally achieved abundant results.

丰硕.zh: 这次会议取得了丰硕的成果。
虽然过程很艰难，但最终我们获得了丰硕的收获。
丰硕.en: Although the process was difficult, in the end we gained abundant harvest.

丰硕.zh: 秋天是收获的季节，田野里一片丰硕的景象。
丰硕.en: Autumn is the harvest season, fields are a scene of abundance.

观感.en: The viewing experience of this movie is good.

观感.zh: 大家对那个新设计的观感很一致。
观感.en: Everyone's impression of that new design is very consistent.

观感.zh: 虽然房间不大，但整体观感很舒服。
观感.en: Although the room is not big, the overall feel is very comfortable.

观感.zh: 换了窗帘之后，客厅的观感完全不一样了。
观感.en: After changing the curtains, the living room looks completely different.

观感.zh: 如果你调整一下灯光，作品的观感会更好。
观感.en: If you adjust the lighting a bit, the artwork will look even better.

炉灶.en: The stove in the new home works well.

炉灶.zh: 厨房的炉灶该擦了，上面都是油。
炉灶.en: The kitchen stove needs cleaning, it's all greasy.

炉灶.zh: 他重新搭了个炉灶，准备开饭店。
炉灶.en: He set up a new kitchen, preparing to open a restaurant.

炉灶.zh: 我们换了个电磁炉灶，比燃气灶安全。
炉灶.en: We switched to an induction stove, which is safer than a gas stove.

炉灶.zh: 因为炉灶坏了，这几天我们只能叫外卖。
炉灶.en: Because the stove broke down, we have to order takeout these days.

改日.en: Let's talk another day; I have to go now.

改日.zh: 今天太忙了，改日请你吃饭。
改日.en: I'm too busy today; I'll treat you to a meal another day.

改日.zh: 改日有空的话，我们一起去爬山吧。
改日.en: If you're free another day, let's go hiking together.

改日.zh: 这个项目今天做不完，改日再继续。
改日.en: We can't finish this project today; let's continue another day.

改日.zh: 不好意思，我临时有事，改日再约你。
改日.en: Sorry, something came up; let's make plans another day.

错别字.zh: 这篇作文里错别字太多了。
错别字.en: There are too many typos in this essay.

错别字.zh: 写名字的时候注意别写错别字。
错别字.en: When writing your name, be careful not to make a typo.

错别字.zh: 他发消息经常有错别字，但不影响理解。
错别字.en: He often makes typos in messages, but it doesn't affect understanding.

错别字.zh: 老师让我们互相检查作业里的错别字。
错别字.en: The teacher asked us to check each other's homework for typos.

错别字.zh: 虽然只有几个错别字，但整篇文章的印象就差了。
错别字.en: Even though there are only a few typos, the overall impression of the whole article is worse.

侠义.en: He values chivalry and likes to help friends.

侠义.zh: 武侠小说里的人物都很有侠义精神。
侠义.en: Characters in wuxia novels all have a strong spirit of chivalry.

侠义.zh: 他虽然平时话不多，但做事特别侠义。
侠义.en: Although he doesn't talk much usually, he acts very chivalrously.

侠义.zh: 古代那些侠义之士，路见不平就会出手相助。
侠义.en: In ancient times, those chivalrous people would step up to help when they saw injustice.

侠义.zh: 现在的社会，像他这样有侠义心肠的人不多了。
侠义.en: In today's society, there aren't many people with such a chivalrous heart as him.

风土人情.zh: 我很喜欢当地的风土人情。
风土人情.en: I really like the local customs and people.

风土人情.zh: 这本书介绍了云南的风土人情。
风土人情.en: This book introduces the customs and culture of Yunnan.

风土人情.zh: 去国外旅游，最想体验的就是风土人情。
风土人情.en: When traveling abroad, what I most want to experience is the local customs and culture.

风土人情.zh: 每个地方的风土人情都不一样，很有意思。
风土人情.en: The customs and culture of each place are different, which is very interesting.

风土人情.zh: 如果你想了解这里的风土人情，最好跟当地人聊聊天。
风土人情.en: If you want to understand the local customs and culture, it's best to chat with the locals.

昌盛.en: Wish the motherland prosperity and flourishing.

昌盛.zh: 这个家族在清朝时期非常昌盛。
昌盛.en: This family was very prosperous during the Qing dynasty.

昌盛.zh: 只有社会安定，国家才能昌盛。
昌盛.en: Only with social stability can the country prosper.

昌盛.zh: 这座古城在唐朝达到了最昌盛的时期。
昌盛.en: This ancient city reached its most prosperous period during the Tang dynasty.

昌盛.zh: 经济昌盛的同时，我们也要注意环境保护。
昌盛.en: While the economy is flourishing, we also need to pay attention to environmental protection.

临街.en: This shop is on the street, easy to find.

临街.zh: 我的房间窗户临街，有点吵。
临街.en: My room's window faces the street, so it's a bit noisy.

临街.zh: 临街的店铺租金比巷子里贵很多。
临街.en: The rent for shops facing the street is much more expensive than those in the alley.

临街.zh: 因为房子临街，所以我们装了双层玻璃。
临街.en: Because the house faces the street, we installed double-glazed windows.

临街.zh: 他们租了一个临街的铺面卖奶茶，生意不错。
临街.en: They rented a storefront facing the street to sell milk tea, and business is good.

办学.zh: 这所学校办学很有特色。
办学.en: This school has a distinctive approach to education.

办学.zh: 他退休后回到家乡办学。
办学.en: After retiring, he returned to his hometown to run a school.

办学.zh: 我们公司捐了一笔钱支持山区办学。
办学.en: Our company donated a sum of money to support education in mountainous areas.

办学.zh: 私立学校办学灵活，但收费也高。
办学.en: Private schools are flexible in running education, but the fees are also high.

办学.zh: 政府鼓励社会力量参与办学，提高教育质量。
办学.en: The government encourages social forces to participate in running schools to improve educational quality.

相辅相成.en: These two theories complement each other.

相辅相成.zh: 理论与实践是相辅相成的。
相辅相成.en: Theory and practice complement each other.

相辅相成.zh: 音乐和舞蹈相辅相成，缺一不可。
相辅相成.en: Music and dance complement each other; neither can be missing.

相辅相成.zh: 在团队里，每个人的专长都是相辅相成的。
相辅相成.en: In a team, everyone's expertise complements each other.

相辅相成.zh: 经济发展和环境保护其实可以相辅相成，并不矛盾。
相辅相成.en: Economic development and environmental protection can actually complement each other; they are not contradictory.

建交.en: The two countries officially established diplomatic relations this year.

建交.zh: 我们和那个国家建交已经二十年了。
建交.en: It has been twenty years since we established diplomatic relations with that country.

建交.zh: 虽然两国建交时间不长，但合作很顺利。
建交.en: Although the two countries established diplomatic relations not long ago, cooperation has been smooth.

建交.zh: 建交以后，双方在贸易和旅游方面都有很大进步。
建交.en: After establishing diplomatic relations, both sides have made great progress in trade and tourism.

建交.zh: 听说他们建交的消息，大家都非常开心。
建交.en: Hearing the news that they established diplomatic relations, everyone was very happy.

分赃.zh: 他们分赃不均，吵了起来。
分赃.en: They argued because the spoils were divided unevenly.

分赃.zh: 这几个小偷在分赃的时候被警察抓住了。
分赃.en: These thieves were caught by the police while dividing the loot.

分赃.zh: 为了分赃的事情，他们差点打起来。
分赃.en: They almost came to blows over how to divide the spoils.

分赃.zh: 分赃不公是很多犯罪团伙内讧的原因。
分赃.en: Unequal division of spoils is the cause of many criminal gang infighting.

分赃.zh: 他们躲在废弃的工厂里分赃，结果被一网打尽。
分赃.en: They were dividing the loot in an abandoned factory and ended up being caught all at once.

繁体字.zh: 我认识简体字，但是繁体字不太会写。
繁体字.en: I can recognize simplified characters, but I'm not good at writing traditional characters.

繁体字.zh: 这本书是用繁体字印刷的，我看得有点慢。
繁体字.en: This book is printed in traditional characters, so I read a bit slowly.

繁体字.zh: 虽然现在多用简体字，但有些人仍然喜欢看繁体字。
繁体字.en: Although simplified characters are more commonly used now, some people still prefer to read traditional characters.

繁体字.zh: 他小时候在香港上学，所以繁体字写得很漂亮。
繁体字.en: He went to school in Hong Kong when he was young, so he writes traditional characters beautifully.

繁体字.zh: 学习书法的时候，老师建议我们先练繁体字。
繁体字.en: When learning calligraphy, the teacher suggested we practice traditional characters first.

勤工俭学.zh: 他靠勤工俭学读完大学。
勤工俭学.en: He went through college by working part-time to support his studies.

勤工俭学.zh: 很多留学生都会勤工俭学来减轻家庭负担。
勤工俭学.en: Many international students work part-time to study to reduce the burden on their families.

勤工俭学.zh: 勤工俭学虽然辛苦，但能学到很多社会经验。
勤工俭学.en: Although working part-time while studying is hard, you can gain a lot of social experience.

勤工俭学.zh: 她一边上课一边在餐厅打工，这就是勤工俭学的生活。
勤工俭学.en: She attends classes and works at a restaurant at the same time; that's the life of working one's way through school.

勤工俭学.zh: 学校提供了勤工俭学的岗位，帮助经济困难的同学。
勤工俭学.en: The school provides work-study positions to help students with financial difficulties.

头头是道.zh: 他讲得头头是道，大家都信了。
头头是道.en: He spoke so convincingly that everyone believed him.

头头是道.zh: 虽然年纪小，但他分析问题头头是道。
头头是道.en: Although he is young, he analyzes problems very logically.

头头是道.zh: 她说起化妆来头头是道，像个专业化妆师。
头头是道.en: She talks about makeup with great expertise, like a professional makeup artist.

头头是道.zh: 你别看他平时不说话，一聊起历史就头头是道。
头头是道.en: Don't be fooled by him being quiet usually; once he starts talking about history, he speaks with great clarity.

头头是道.zh: 他说的每一条理由都头头是道，让人无法反驳。
头头是道.en: Every reason he gave was well-argued and left no room for refutation.

外资.en: This company is a foreign-invested enterprise.

外资.zh: 近年来，外资在中国市场的投入越来越大了。
外资.en: In recent years, foreign investment in the Chinese market has been increasing.

外资.zh: 很多城市都出台了优惠政策来吸引外资。
外资.en: Many cities have introduced preferential policies to attract foreign capital.

外资.zh: 外资进入本地市场，既带来了机遇也带来了挑战。
外资.en: The entry of foreign capital into the local market brings both opportunities and challenges.

外资.zh: 他们靠外资起家，现在已经成为行业龙头了。
外资.en: They started with foreign investment and have now become industry leaders.

打岔.en: Don't interrupt; let me finish what I'm saying.

打岔.zh: 他老是在别人说话的时候打岔，很不礼貌。
打岔.en: He always interrupts when others are speaking, which is very rude.

打岔.zh: 我们正在讨论严肃的话题，你不要打岔。
打岔.en: We are discussing a serious topic; please don't butt in.

打岔.zh: 孩子总爱打岔，妈妈只好停下来听他说。
打岔.en: The child kept interrupting, so the mother had to stop and listen to him.

打岔.zh: 每次我想认真工作，他就在旁边打岔聊天。
打岔.en: Every time I try to focus on work, he interrupts and chats beside me.

知足常乐.zh: 知足常乐，别总跟别人比。
知足常乐.en: Happiness comes from contentment; don't always compare yourself to others.

知足常乐.zh: 他虽然收入不高，但知足常乐，日子过得很开心。
知足常乐.en: Although his income is not high, he is content with what he has and lives happily.

知足常乐.zh: 懂得知足常乐的人，往往更容易感受到幸福。
知足常乐.en: People who understand that contentment brings happiness often feel happiness more easily.

知足常乐.zh: 我爷爷总跟我说，知足常乐是长寿的秘诀。
知足常乐.en: My grandpa always tells me that contentment is the secret to a long life.

知足常乐.zh: 生活不需要太富裕，知足常乐就好。
知足常乐.en: Life doesn't need to be too wealthy; being content and happy is enough.

车轴.en: The axle of this car is broken.

车轴.zh: 车轴需要定期加润滑油，不然容易磨损。
车轴.en: The axle needs regular lubrication, otherwise it will wear out easily.

车轴.zh: 他在修车铺换了一个新车轴。
车轴.en: He replaced the axle with a new one at the repair shop.

车轴.zh: 车轮和车轴的关系很重要，直接影响行驶安全。
车轴.en: The relationship between the wheel and axle is very important, directly affecting driving safety.

车轴.zh: 老式马车用的车轴是木头做的，现在都用金属了。
车轴.en: The axles used in old-fashioned horse carriages were wooden, but now they are all made of metal.

国徽.zh: 国旗和国徽都是国家的象征。
国徽.en: The national flag and the national emblem are both symbols of the country.

国徽.zh: 法院门口悬挂着庄严的国徽。
国徽.en: A solemn national emblem is hung at the entrance of the courthouse.

国徽.zh: 他仔细地画了一枚国徽，准备参加比赛。
国徽.en: He carefully drew a national emblem, preparing for the competition.

国徽.zh: 每个国家的国徽设计都有自己的文化和历史背景。
国徽.en: The design of each country's national emblem has its own cultural and historical background.

国徽.zh: 在正式场合，国徽不能随便乱用，必须遵守规定。
国徽.en: On formal occasions, the national emblem cannot be used casually; regulations must be followed.

夺魁.en: He won first place in this competition.

夺魁.zh: 她为了夺魁，练习了整整三个月。
夺魁.en: She practiced for a full three months in order to win first place.

夺魁.zh: 虽然对手很强，但他最终还是夺魁了。
夺魁.en: Although the opponent was strong, he ended up winning first place.

夺魁.zh: 大家都没想到，新人居然能夺魁。
夺魁.en: No one expected that a newcomer could take the crown.

夺魁.zh: 他在全国大赛中夺魁，成了明星。
夺魁.en: He won first place in the national competition and became a star.

慰劳.zh: 妈妈做了很多菜慰劳我们。
慰劳.en: Mom cooked a lot of dishes to reward us.

慰劳.zh: 公司用奖金慰劳辛苦了一年的员工。
慰劳.en: The company used bonuses to reward employees who worked hard all year.

慰劳.zh: 因为项目成功了，老板请客慰劳大家。
慰劳.en: Because the project was successful, the boss treated everyone to a meal as a reward.

慰劳.zh: 他们买了很多水果去慰劳消防员。
慰劳.en: They bought a lot of fruit to show appreciation to the firefighters.

慰劳.zh: 慰劳一下自己吧，你太累了。
慰劳.en: Treat yourself a little; you are too tired.

半信半疑.en: I am half skeptical of what he said.

半信半疑.zh: 她听了这个消息，半信半疑地看了看我。
半信半疑.en: After hearing the news, she looked at me with skepticism.

半信半疑.zh: 虽然他说得很有道理，但我还是半信半疑。
半信半疑.en: Although what he said made sense, I was still half-doubting.

半信半疑.zh: 大家对他的计划半信半疑，不敢投资。
半信半疑.en: Everyone was skeptical of his plan and dared not invest.

半信半疑.zh: 你最好拿出证据，否则我们只能半信半疑。
半信半疑.en: You'd better show evidence, otherwise we can only be half-believing.

工科.zh: 工科专业通常要学很多数学。
工科.en: Engineering majors usually have to study a lot of math.

工科.zh: 我妹妹对工科感兴趣，所以选了电子工程。
工科.en: My sister is interested in engineering, so she chose electronic engineering.

工科.zh: 很多人觉得工科太难，但找工作容易。
工科.en: Many people think engineering is too hard, but finding a job is easy.

工科.zh: 他虽然是工科出身，但文学素养很高。
工科.en: Although he has an engineering background, he is very literate.

譬如说.zh: 譬如说，你可以先试试跑步。
譬如说.en: For example, you could try running first.

譬如说.zh: 我喜欢运动，譬如说游泳和篮球。
譬如说.en: I like sports, such as swimming and basketball.

譬如说.zh: 很多水果富含维生素，譬如说橙子和柠檬。
譬如说.en: Many fruits are rich in vitamins, for instance oranges and lemons.

譬如说.zh: 周末可以出去玩，譬如说去爬山或者看电影。
譬如说.en: You can go out on weekends, for example go hiking or watch a movie.

譬如说.zh: 他有很多爱好，譬如说摄影、画画和弹吉他。
譬如说.en: He has many hobbies, such as photography, painting, and playing guitar.

壮实.zh: 他每天锻炼，所以身体很壮实。
壮实.en: He exercises every day, so he has a strong physique.

壮实.zh: 那只小狗虽然小，但看起来挺壮实的。
壮实.en: That puppy is small but looks quite sturdy.

壮实.zh: 多吃点肉和蛋，才能长得壮实。
壮实.en: Eat more meat and eggs to grow up strong.

壮实.zh: 她男朋友又高又壮实，像个运动员。
壮实.en: Her boyfriend is tall and sturdy, like an athlete.

俯首.en: He bowed his head and admitted his mistake.

俯首.zh: 在老师面前，他俯首不语。
俯首.en: In front of the teacher, he bowed his head and said nothing.

俯首.zh: 他为了生存，不得不俯首听命。
俯首.en: To survive, he had to bow and obey.

俯首.zh: 面对强权，他选择俯首顺从。
俯首.en: Faced with powerful authority, he chose to bow and submit.

俯首.zh: 那只狗俯首贴耳地趴在地上。
俯首.en: That dog lay on the ground with its head bowed and ears down.

渣子.en: There are tea dregs at the bottom of the cup.

渣子.zh: 他把剩下的渣子都倒掉了。
渣子.en: He poured out all the remaining dregs.

渣子.zh: 那种人就是社会的渣子。
渣子.en: That kind of person is the scum of society.

渣子.zh: 吃了水果，别把渣子扔地上。
渣子.en: After eating fruit, don't throw the scraps on the floor.

渣子.zh: 他总觉得自己是渣子，其实不是。
渣子.en: He always thinks he's worthless, but he's not.

兆头.en: This is not a good omen.

兆头.zh: 看到彩虹，他们觉得是好兆头。
兆头.en: Seeing a rainbow, they thought it was a good sign.

兆头.zh: 早上出门看见喜鹊，是个好兆头。
兆头.en: Seeing a magpie when leaving in the morning is a good omen.

兆头.zh: 他连续打喷嚏，大家都说这是感冒的兆头。
兆头.en: He kept sneezing, and everyone said it was a sign of a cold.

兆头.zh: 别太迷信这些兆头，踏实做事最重要。
兆头.en: Don't be too superstitious about these omens; working steadily is most important.

讹诈.zh: 那个骗子用照片讹诈他。
讹诈.en: That scammer used photos to blackmail him.

讹诈.zh: 他们试图用秘密来讹诈老板。
讹诈.en: They tried to blackmail the boss with a secret.
If you encounter extortion, be sure to call the police.

讹诈.zh: 他因为害怕被讹诈，所以不敢声张。
讹诈.en: He was afraid of being blackmailed, so he didn't dare to speak out.

无恶不作.en: That bad person stops at no evil.

无恶不作.zh: 他从小偷小摸到抢劫，简直无恶不作。
无恶不作.en: From petty theft to robbery, he stops at no evil at all.

无恶不作.zh: 虽然他表面善良，但实际上无恶不作。
无恶不作.en: Although he seems kind on the surface, in fact he does every evil.

无恶不作.zh: 这个黑帮老大无恶不作，警察终于抓了他。
无恶不作.en: This gang leader did all kinds of evil; the police finally caught him.

无恶不作.zh: 听说那个地方有个无恶不作的恶霸。
无恶不作.en: I heard there is a bully who stops at no evil in that place.

水涨船高.en: Prices have risen; it's natural as water rises boat rises.

水涨船高.zh: 公司业绩好了，大家的奖金也水涨船高。
水涨船高.en: Company performance improved, everyone's bonuses rose accordingly.

水涨船高.zh: 因为房价上涨，租金也跟着水涨船高。
水涨船高.en: Because house prices rose, rent also went up accordingly.

水涨船高.zh: 他能力提升后，工资自然水涨船高。
水涨船高.en: After his ability improved, his salary naturally rose.

水涨船高.zh: 市场需求增加，产品价格水涨船高。
水涨船高.en: Market demand increased, product prices rose accordingly.

得天独厚.zh: 这个地区气候得天独厚。
得天独厚.en: This region has uniquely favorable climate.

得天独厚.zh: 她天生嗓音好，真是得天独厚的歌手。
得天独厚.en: She has a naturally good voice; truly a uniquely gifted singer.

得天独厚.zh: 虽然资源得天独厚，但他们没有好好利用。
得天独厚.en: Although they have uniquely abundant resources, they didn't use them well.

得天独厚.zh: 我们学校地理位置得天独厚，离海边很近。
得天独厚.en: Our school's location is uniquely favorable, very close to the sea.

得天独厚.zh: 他的家庭条件得天独厚，但他依然很努力。
得天独厚.en: His family conditions are uniquely favorable, yet he still works hard.

递增.en: The population increases year by year.

递增.zh: 这个城市的地价每年都在递增。
递增.en: Land prices in this city increase every year.

递增.zh: 随着经济发展，工资水平也在递增。
递增.en: With economic development, wage levels are also increasing progressively.

递增.zh: 他的学习成绩在递增，进步很明显。
递增.en: His academic scores are increasing progressively; the improvement is obvious.

递增.zh: 费用按月递增，注意预算。
递增.en: Expenses increase monthly; pay attention to your budget.

秉承.en: We adhere to honest business practices.

秉承.zh: 他一直秉承父亲的教导，勤奋工作。
秉承.en: He has always adhered to his father's teachings, working diligently.

秉承.zh: 公司秉承客户至上的理念，所以发展很快。
秉承.en: The company adheres to the customer-first philosophy, so it develops quickly.

秉承.zh: 这个学校秉承传统，重视品德教育。
秉承.en: This school adheres to tradition, emphasizing moral education.

秉承.zh: 秉承公平原则，我们处理了这个问题。
秉承.en: Adhering to the principle of fairness, we handled this issue.

华侨.en: Many overseas Chinese return to invest.

华侨.zh: 这个城市有不少华侨回来定居。
华侨.en: This city has quite a few overseas Chinese returning to settle.

华侨.zh: 虽然他们是华侨，但依然热爱祖国。
华侨.en: Although they are overseas Chinese, they still love their motherland.

华侨.zh: 华侨为家乡发展做出了很大贡献。
华侨.en: Overseas Chinese have made great contributions to hometown development.

华侨.zh: 他是一位成功的华侨企业家。
华侨.en: He is a successful overseas Chinese entrepreneur.

顾全大局.en: You must consider the overall situation.

顾全大局.zh: 他为了顾全大局，放弃了自己的利益。
顾全大局.en: To consider the overall situation, he gave up his own interests.

顾全大局.zh: 虽然很委屈，但为了顾全大局，他忍了。
顾全大局.en: Although very aggrieved, for the sake of the overall situation, he endured it.

顾全大局.zh: 做事不能只考虑自己，要顾全大局。
顾全大局.en: When doing things, you can't only consider yourself; you must consider the overall situation.

顾全大局.zh: 领导总是强调要顾全大局，不能斤斤计较。
顾全大局.en: The leader always emphasizes the need to consider the overall situation, not to haggle over every detail.

开天辟地.zh: 这是一个开天辟地的事件。
历史上第一次登月，真是开天辟地的大事。
开天辟地.en: The first moon landing in history was truly an epoch-making event.

开天辟地.zh: 自从有了互联网，世界仿佛开天辟地一般变了。
开天辟地.en: Since the internet appeared, the world has changed as if creating heaven and earth.

开天辟地.zh: 这项发明可以说是开天辟地的突破。
开天辟地.en: This invention can be called an epoch-making breakthrough.

开天辟地.zh: 开天辟地的传说在中国家喻户晓。
开天辟地.en: The legend of creation of heaven and earth is well-known in China.

无形中.en: She imperceptibly helped me a lot.

无形中.zh: 每天坚持运动，无形中就增强了体质。
无形中.en: Persisting in exercise every day imperceptibly strengthens the body.

无形中.zh: 虽然他没直接说，但无形中给了我们压力。
无形中.en: Although he didn't say directly, he virtually put pressure on us.

无形中.zh: 这种习惯无形中影响了你的生活。
无形中.en: This habit imperceptibly affects your life.

无形中.zh: 网络谣言无形中伤害了很多人。
无形中.en: Online rumors imperceptibly hurt many people.

远近闻名.en: This shop is famous far and wide.

远近闻名.zh: 他做的菜味道很好，在附近远近闻名。
远近闻名.en: His cooking tastes great; it's famous far and wide in the area.

远近闻名.zh: 因为服务好，这家酒店远近闻名。
远近闻名.en: Because of good service, this hotel is famous far and wide.

远近闻名.zh: 那个地方以美景远近闻名。
远近闻名.en: That place is famous far and wide for its beautiful scenery.

远近闻名.zh: 他是一位远近闻名的医生。
远近闻名.en: He is a doctor famous far and wide.

过奖.zh: 您过奖了，我还有很多不足。
过奖.en: You flatter me; I still have many shortcomings.

过奖.zh: 听到您这么夸我，我真是有点受宠若惊，您过奖了。
过奖.en: Hearing you praise me like this, I'm really overwhelmed—you flatter me.

过奖.zh: 别这么过奖，我会不好意思的。
过奖.en: Don't overpraise me like that; I'll get embarrassed.

过奖.zh: 大家都说过奖，其实我只是做了分内的事。
过奖.en: Everyone says I'm too modest, but I just did my duty.
You flatter me; I'm not that good.

钻空子.en: He always exploits loopholes to slack off.

钻空子.zh: 公司制度不完善，容易被人钻空子。
钻空子.en: The company's rules aren't perfect, so it's easy for people to take advantage of gaps.

钻空子.zh: 别想着钻空子，老实做事吧。
钻空子.en: Don't try to find loopholes; just do your work honestly.

恋恋不舍.en: He was reluctant to leave when it was time to go.

恋恋不舍.zh: 毕业那天，大家都恋恋不舍地离开了校园。
恋恋不舍.en: On graduation day, everyone left the campus with reluctance.

恋恋不舍.zh: 她看着窗外，一副恋恋不舍的样子。
恋恋不舍.en: She looked out the window, looking unwilling to part.

恋恋不舍.zh: 虽然要分别了，但我不会恋恋不舍，因为我们还会再见。
恋恋不舍.en: Even though we have to part, I won't be too reluctant because we will meet again.

恋恋不舍.zh: 我们恋恋不舍地告别了。

七嘴八舌.en: Everyone was discussing all at once.

七嘴八舌.zh: 老师一提问，学生们就七嘴八舌地回答。
七嘴八舌.en: As soon as the teacher asked a question, the students answered all at once.

七嘴八舌.zh: 别七嘴八舌的，一个一个说。
七嘴八舌.en: Don't all talk at once; speak one by one.

七嘴八舌.zh: 在会议上，大家七嘴八舌地提出各种意见，场面很热闹。
七嘴八舌.en: At the meeting, everyone was speaking all at once with various opinions, and it was quite lively.

七嘴八舌.zh: 他们七嘴八舌，吵得不行。
七嘴八舌.en: They were all talking at once, making a terrible racket.

众志成城.zh: 大家众志成城，克服困难。
众志成城.en: United as one, everyone overcame the difficulties.

众志成城.zh: 只要众志成城，没有过不去的坎儿。
众志成城.en: As long as we are united, there is no obstacle we can't overcome.

众志成城.zh: 灾区人民众志成城，重建家园。
众志成城.en: The people in the disaster area united together to rebuild their homes.

众志成城.zh: 面对疫情，全国人民众志成城，共克时艰。
众志成城.en: Facing the epidemic, the whole nation united as one to overcome the difficult times.
Unity is strength; nothing is unbreakable.

会意.zh: 看到她的眼神，我立刻会意了。
会意.en: I immediately understood when I saw her look.

会意.zh: 他冲我会意地眨了眨眼。
我们俩心照不宣，一个会意的眼神就够了。
会意.en: We had a tacit understanding; a knowing look was enough.

会意.zh: 听完他的话，我会意地点了点头。
会意.en: After hearing what he said, I nodded knowingly.

会意.zh: 他不用多说，我就能会意。
会意.en: He doesn't need to say much; I can understand without words.

说闲话.zh: 你们聚在一起就是爱说闲话。
说闲话.en: Whenever you get together, you love to gossip.

说闲话.zh: 与其说闲话，不如多花时间提升自己。
说闲话.en: Instead of gossiping, it's better to spend more time improving yourself.

急于求成.en: He is always impatient for quick results in everything he does.

急于求成.zh: 学习不能急于求成，要循序渐进。
急于求成.en: You can't be impatient for quick success in learning; you have to proceed step by step.

急于求成.zh: 越急于求成，反而越容易失败。
急于求成.en: The more you rush for success, the more likely you are to fail.

急于求成.zh: 很多创业者因为急于求成，最终把公司搞垮了。
急于求成.en: Many entrepreneurs ruined their companies because they were too eager for quick success.

急于求成.zh: 别那么急于求成，慢慢来。
急于求成.en: Don't be so impatient for results; take it slow.

博大精深.en: Chinese culture is vast and profound.

博大精深.zh: 中医理论博大精深，值得深入研究。
博大精深.en: The theory of traditional Chinese medicine is extensive and profound, worth in-depth study.

博大精深.zh: 汉字的学问真是博大精深。
博大精深.en: The knowledge of Chinese characters is truly extensive and profound.

博大精深.zh: 这本书展示了中华文明的博大精深，读来令人叹服。
博大精深.en: This book showcases the vastness and profundity of Chinese civilization, leaving readers in awe.
His knowledge is broad and profound.

积淀.zh: 这座城市有着深厚的历史积淀。
积淀.en: This city has a deep historical accumulation.
The accumulation of knowledge is very important.

积淀.zh: 多年的工作经验让他积累了深厚的专业积淀。
积淀.en: Years of work experience have allowed him to build up a deep professional foundation.
Art requires the accumulation of time.

逞能.en: Don't show off, you might get hurt.

逞能.zh: 他为了在朋友面前逞能，居然敢跳进河里。
逞能.en: He showed off in front of friends by daring to jump into the river.

逞能.zh: 明明不行还要逞能，结果把事情搞砸了。
逞能.en: He clearly can't do it but still shows off, and ends up messing things up.

逞能.zh: 虽然他很想逞能，但是大家都看出他没那个本事。
逞能.en: Although he wants to show off, everyone can see he doesn't have the skill.

逞能.zh: 开车时别逞能，安全最重要。
逞能.en: Don't show off while driving, safety is the most important thing.

喜酒.en: Going to a wedding feast tomorrow.

喜酒.zh: 下周末我表姐结婚，我们要去吃喜酒。
喜酒.en: My cousin is getting married next weekend, we're going to the wedding feast.

喜酒.zh: 喝喜酒的时候，大家都要敬新人一杯。
喜酒.en: At the wedding feast, everyone toasts the couple.

喜酒.zh: 虽然我不太喜欢热闹，但朋友的喜酒还是得去。
喜酒.en: Although I don't like crowds, I still have to go to my friend's wedding banquet.

喜酒.zh: 你准备包多少红包去喝喜酒？
喜酒.en: How much red packet are you preparing for the wedding feast?

交头接耳.en: They kept whispering to each other.

交头接耳.zh: 考试的时候，那两个学生交头接耳被老师发现了。
交头接耳.en: During the exam, those two students were whispering and got caught by the teacher.

交头接耳.zh: 开会时别交头接耳，注意听讲。
交头接耳.en: Don't whisper during the meeting, pay attention.

交头接耳.zh: 他们一边看表演一边交头接耳，好像在讨论什么。
交头接耳.en: They were watching the show and whispering, as if discussing something.

交头接耳.zh: 教室里交头接耳的声音渐渐大了起来。
交头接耳.en: The sound of whispering in the classroom gradually grew louder.

阔绰.en: He is very generous with money.

阔绰.zh: 那个老板请客吃饭，每次都特别阔绰。
阔绰.en: That boss treats people to dinner, always very lavish.

阔绰.zh: 他家里其实不富裕，但花钱却很阔绰。
阔绰.en: His family is actually not rich, but he spends money lavishly.

阔绰.zh: 虽然工资不高，但他对朋友总是很大方，显得很阔绰。
阔绰.en: Although his salary is not high, he is always generous to friends, appearing lavish.

阔绰.zh: 这个阔绰的富二代买了一辆跑车。
阔绰.en: This lavish rich second generation bought a sports car.

仙鹤.en: There is a crane in this painting.

仙鹤.zh: 仙鹤在中国文化里象征长寿和吉祥。
仙鹤.en: Cranes in Chinese culture symbolize longevity and good luck.

仙鹤.zh: 公园里养了几只仙鹤，很多游客拍照。
仙鹤.en: The park has several cranes, many tourists take photos.

仙鹤.zh: 虽然仙鹤很漂亮，但是它们很难在动物园里养好。
仙鹤.en: Although cranes are beautiful, they are hard to keep well in zoos.

仙鹤.zh: 传说中仙人骑着仙鹤飞走了。
仙鹤.en: Legend says immortals rode cranes and flew away.

有声有色.zh: 他讲故事讲得有声有色。
老师把历史事件说得有声有色，大家听得津津有味。
有声有色.en: The teacher described historical events vividly, everyone listened with great interest.

有声有色.zh: 这部电影拍得有声有色，特别吸引人。
有声有色.en: This movie is filmed vividly, very engaging.

有声有色.zh: 虽然情节很简单，但他演得有声有色，观众都鼓掌了。
有声有色.en: Although the plot was simple, he performed vividly, and the audience applauded.

有声有色.zh: 她描述旅行经历时有声有色，让我也想去看看。
有声有色.en: She described her travel experience vividly, making me want to go see it too.

左顾右盼.en: He looks left and right when crossing the street.

左顾右盼.zh: 面试的时候别左顾右盼，要直视考官。
左顾右盼.en: During an interview, don't glance around, look straight at the interviewer.

左顾右盼.zh: 她站在门口左顾右盼，好像在等人。
左顾右盼.en: She stood at the door looking around, as if waiting for someone.

左顾右盼.zh: 他一边走路一边左顾右盼，结果撞到了树上。
左顾右盼.en: He was walking while looking around, and ended up bumping into a tree.

左顾右盼.zh: 小偷在街上左顾右盼，寻找下手的机会。
左顾右盼.en: The thief glanced around on the street, looking for an opportunity to strike.

私房钱.en: How much secret money have you hidden?

私房钱.zh: 他偷偷存了一些私房钱，准备给老婆买礼物。
私房钱.en: He secretly saved some private money, planning to buy a gift for his wife.

私房钱.zh: 被发现藏私房钱，他只好老实交代。
私房钱.en: He was caught hiding private money, so he had to confess honestly.

私房钱.zh: 虽然她工资不高，但每月还是能挤出一点私房钱。
私房钱.en: Although her salary is not high, she can still squeeze out a little private money each month.

私房钱.zh: 很多男人都会藏点私房钱应急。
私房钱.en: Many men hide some private money for emergencies.

活期.en: I want to open a current account.

活期.zh: 活期存款的利息比定期低很多。
活期.en: The interest rate for demand deposits is much lower than for fixed deposits.

活期.zh: 他平时把钱放在活期里，方便取用。
活期.en: He usually keeps his money in a current account for easy access.

活期.zh: 虽然活期利息少，但胜在灵活随时能取。
活期.en: Although current account interest is low, it has the advantage of flexibility to withdraw anytime.

活期.zh: 我建议你把闲钱存成活期，别放太多在定期。
活期.en: I suggest you put your spare money into a current account, don't put too much in fixed deposits.

杠铃.zh: 健身房里很多人用杠铃练深蹲。
杠铃.en: Many people at the gym use barbells for squats.

杠铃.zh: 这个杠铃太重了，我举不起来。
杠铃.en: This barbell is too heavy, I can't lift it.

杠铃.zh: 他虽然力气不大，但还是坚持练杠铃。
杠铃.en: Although he is not very strong, he still persists in training with barbells.

杠铃.zh: 教练教我怎么正确握杠铃。
杠铃.en: The coach taught me how to hold the barbell correctly.

经度.en: Do you know what longitude is?

经度.zh: 在地图上，经度和纬度一起用。
经度.en: On a map, longitude and latitude are used together.

经度.zh: 导航的时候输入经度就能找到地方。
经度.en: When navigating, entering the longitude helps you find a place.

经度.zh: 这个城市的经度是东经116度。
经度.en: The longitude of this city is 116 degrees east.

经度.zh: 他们争论经度测量的问题，争得面红耳赤。
经度.en: They argued fiercely about the issue of longitude measurement, their faces red and ears burning.

面红耳赤.en: They argued until they were red in the face.
She blushed bright red from being praised.

面红耳赤.zh: 他俩为小事争得面红耳赤，最后都生气了。
面红耳赤.en: The two argued over a trivial matter until they were red-faced, and in the end both got angry.

面红耳赤.zh: 他一着急就面红耳赤，说话都结巴了。
面红耳赤.en: Whenever he gets anxious, his face turns red and he stammers.

面红耳赤.zh: 老师批评他时，他面红耳赤地低下头。
面红耳赤.en: When the teacher criticized him, he lowered his head, his face flushed.

废寝忘食.en: He studies so hard he forgets to eat and sleep.

废寝忘食.zh: 为了赶项目，他废寝忘食地工作。
废寝忘食.en: To meet the project deadline, he worked tirelessly, forgetting to eat and sleep.

废寝忘食.zh: 她看小说看得废寝忘食，连饭都不吃。
废寝忘食.en: She was so engrossed in the novel that she forgot to eat and sleep, even skipping meals.

废寝忘食.zh: 自从迷上编程，他就废寝忘食地学习。
废寝忘食.en: Ever since he got hooked on programming, he has studied obsessively, forgetting to eat and sleep.

废寝忘食.zh: 老王废寝忘食地研究，终于成功了。
废寝忘食.en: Old Wang devoted himself to research day and night, and finally succeeded.

任人宰割.en: We cannot allow ourselves to be pushed around.

任人宰割.zh: 当时国家弱小，只能任人宰割。
任人宰割.en: At that time, the country was weak and had to suffer exploitation.

任人宰割.zh: 如果不团结，我们就会任人宰割。
任人宰割.en: If we don't unite, we will be at the mercy of others.

任人宰割.zh: 在谈判中，我们绝不能任人宰割，要争取利益。
任人宰割.en: In the negotiations, we must not be passive victims; we need to fight for our interests.

任人宰割.zh: 他不想任人宰割，所以决定反抗。
任人宰割.en: He didn't want to be bullied anymore, so he decided to resist.

戈壁.en: Let's go play in the Gobi desert.

戈壁.zh: 他们开车穿过了戈壁滩。
戈壁.en: They drove across the Gobi desert.

戈壁.zh: 戈壁地区昼夜温差特别大。
戈壁.en: The temperature difference between day and night in the Gobi region is huge.

戈壁.zh: 在戈壁里行走，要小心迷路和缺水。
戈壁.en: When walking in the Gobi, you need to be careful about getting lost and running out of water.

戈壁.zh: 在戈壁旅行的时候，一定要带足够的水。
戈壁.en: When traveling in the Gobi, be sure to bring enough water.

捉迷藏.zh: 我小时候最爱玩捉迷藏。
捉迷藏.en: I loved playing hide-and-seek as a child.

捉迷藏.zh: 捉迷藏的时候，我躲在衣柜里。
捉迷藏.en: During hide-and-seek, I hid in the wardrobe.

捉迷藏.zh: 他们在公园里玩捉迷藏，玩得特别开心。
捉迷藏.en: They played hide-and-seek in the park and had a great time.

捉迷藏.zh: 别跟我玩捉迷藏了，有话直说。
捉迷藏.en: Stop playing hide-and-seek with me—just say what you mean.

喜闻乐见.en: This kind of show is widely loved.

喜闻乐见.zh: 相声是老百姓喜闻乐见的艺术。
喜闻乐见.en: Cross talk is an art form that the common people enjoy.

喜闻乐见.zh: 要创作更多群众喜闻乐见的作品。
喜闻乐见.en: We need to create more works that the public likes.

喜闻乐见.zh: 虽然内容简单，但大家喜闻乐见。
喜闻乐见.en: Even though the content is simple, people love it.

喜闻乐见.zh: 流行音乐是年轻人喜闻乐见的娱乐方式。
喜闻乐见.en: Pop music is a form of entertainment that young people enjoy.

诀别.en: That meeting turned out to be a final goodbye.

诀别.zh: 在机场，他和家人含泪诀别。
诀别.en: At the airport, he tearfully said a final goodbye to his family.

诀别.zh: 诀别之后，他们再也没见过面。
诀别.en: After that final parting, they never saw each other again.

诀别.zh: 战争让许多人与家人诀别，非常痛苦。
诀别.en: The war forced many people to say a final goodbye to their families, which was extremely painful.

禾苗.en: The rice seedlings in the field have grown taller.
A heavy rain saved the young rice plants.

禾苗.zh: 一场及时雨让干枯的禾苗重新焕发了生机。
禾苗.en: A timely rain revived the withered rice seedlings.

禾苗.zh: 春天到了，禾苗开始发芽。
禾苗.en: Spring has arrived, and the rice seedlings are starting to sprout.

禾苗.zh: 干旱的时候，禾苗都蔫了，大家很着急。
禾苗.en: During the drought, the rice seedlings all wilted, and everyone was worried.

门当户对.en: The two families are well-matched in social status.

门当户对.zh: 现在结婚不讲究门当户对了。
门当户对.en: Nowadays, people don't emphasize matching social status for marriage.

门当户对.zh: 父母总觉得门当户对很重要，但我不认同。
门当户对.en: My parents always think social status matching is important, but I don't agree.

门当户对.zh: 门当户对的婚姻可能更稳定。
门当户对.en: Marriages between families of similar status might be more stable.

门当户对.zh: 她想找门当户对的男朋友。
门当户对.en: She wants to find a boyfriend from a family of similar social standing.

一锅粥.zh: 早上喝了一锅粥，现在一点都不饿。
一锅粥.en: I had a pot of porridge this morning, so I'm not hungry at all now.

一锅粥.zh: 你把事情搞得跟一锅粥一样乱。
一锅粥.en: You've made the situation as messy as a pot of porridge.

一锅粥.zh: 厨房里还有一锅粥，你去热一下吃吧。
一锅粥.en: There's still a pot of porridge in the kitchen, go heat it up and eat.

一锅粥.zh: 本来计划得好好的，结果现在全成了一锅粥。
一锅粥.en: The plan was good, but now it's all a mess.

一锅粥.zh: 他讲话像一锅粥，我一句都没听明白。
一锅粥.en: His speech was like a pot of porridge, I didn't understand a single word.

川流不息.en: Traffic on the street flows continuously.

川流不息.zh: 这里游客川流不息，非常热闹。
川流不息.en: Tourists come and go here in an endless stream; it's very lively.

川流不息.zh: 地铁站里人群川流不息，大家都赶着上班。
川流不息.en: People are flowing continuously in the subway station, everyone rushing to work.

川流不息.zh: 虽然已经是深夜，但这条路的车辆依然川流不息。
川流不息.en: Although it's already late at night, traffic on this road is still nonstop.

川流不息.zh: 商场门口人流川流不息，促销活动吸引了好多顾客。
川流不息.en: The flow of people at the mall entrance is unceasing; the promotion has attracted many customers.

絮叨.zh: 你别再絮叨了，我知道该怎么做。
絮叨.en: Stop nagging, I know what to do.

絮叨.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，说话总是絮絮叨叨的。
絮叨.en: Grandma is old, and she always talks endlessly.

絮叨.zh: 他絮叨了半天，无非就是让我注意安全。
絮叨.en: He rambled on for ages, just telling me to be careful.

絮叨.zh: 我受不了她那么絮叨，一件事能说好几遍。
絮叨.en: I can't stand her nagging; she can repeat a thing several times.

絮叨.zh: 老师絮叨了一整节课，我们听得都快睡着了。
絮叨.en: The teacher droned on for the whole class, and we almost fell asleep.

廉政.zh: 政府大力推行廉政建设。
廉政.en: The government is vigorously promoting clean governance.

廉政.zh: 廉政是每个公务员的基本要求。
廉政.en: Integrity is a basic requirement for every civil servant.

廉政.zh: 最近廉政教育搞得很好，大家反响不错。
廉政.en: The recent integrity education has been well received.

廉政.zh: 他因为廉政问题被调查了。
廉政.en: He is under investigation for integrity issues.

廉政.zh: 只有坚持廉政，才能赢得老百姓的信任。
廉政.en: Only by upholding clean governance can we win the trust of the people.

杨树.en: There are many poplar trees planted on both sides of the road.

杨树.zh: 杨树一到春天就飘杨絮。
杨树.en: Poplar trees start to shed catkins in spring.

杨树.zh: 我家后院有一棵很高的杨树。
杨树.en: There is a very tall poplar tree in my backyard.

杨树.zh: 杨树长得特别快，几年就能长很高。
杨树.en: Poplar trees grow very fast and can get very tall in a few years.

杨树.zh: 秋天的时候，杨树的叶子全变黄了。
杨树.en: In autumn, the leaves of the poplar trees all turn yellow.

对弈.zh: 他们俩正在对弈，别打扰。
对弈.en: They are playing chess right now, don't disturb them.

对弈.zh: 爷爷喜欢找邻居对弈几局。
对弈.en: Grandpa likes to play a few games of chess with the neighbor.

对弈.zh: 对弈不仅能锻炼脑子，还能交朋友。
对弈.en: Playing chess not only exercises the mind but also helps make friends.

对弈.zh: 他棋艺高超，对弈很少输。
对弈.en: He is highly skilled at chess and rarely loses a game.

对弈.zh: 我们约好周末在公园对弈，你要来吗？
对弈.en: We've arranged to play chess in the park this weekend; do you want to come?

鸦雀无声.zh: 教室里鸦雀无声，老师很满意。
鸦雀无声.en: The classroom was dead silent, and the teacher was very pleased.

鸦雀无声.zh: 他一上台，全场立刻鸦雀无声。
鸦雀无声.en: As soon as he stepped onto the stage, the whole audience fell silent.

鸦雀无声.zh: 大家听到这个消息后，都鸦雀无声。
鸦雀无声.en: Everyone fell silent after hearing the news.

鸦雀无声.zh: 考场上鸦雀无声，只听见翻卷子的声音。
鸦雀无声.en: The exam room was utterly silent; only the sound of turning papers could be heard.

鸦雀无声.zh: 那个演讲太震撼了，结束后会场依然鸦雀无声。
鸦雀无声.en: That speech was so impactful that the hall remained silent even after it ended.

千军万马.zh: 他一个人顶得上千军万马。
千军万马.en: He alone is as powerful as a thousand troops.

千军万马.zh: 战场上千军万马，气势非常磅礴。
千军万马.en: On the battlefield, thousands of troops created a magnificent spectacle.

千军万马.zh: 他虽然没带千军万马，但一个人就解决了问题。
千军万马.en: Though he didn't bring a massive force, he solved the problem all by himself.

千军万马.zh: 这次考试感觉像千军万马过独木桥。
千军万马.en: This exam feels like thousands of troops crossing a single-plank bridge.

千军万马.zh: 那个游戏里千军万马的对战场景特别壮观。
千军万马.en: The battle scene with thousands of troops in that game is especially spectacular.

哄堂大笑.zh: 他讲了个笑话，全班哄堂大笑。
哄堂大笑.en: He told a joke, and the whole class burst into laughter.

哄堂大笑.zh: 主持人话音刚落，观众哄堂大笑。
哄堂大笑.en: As soon as the host finished speaking, the audience roared with laughter.

哄堂大笑.zh: 她的表情太逗了，惹得大家哄堂大笑。
哄堂大笑.en: Her expression was so funny that it made everyone laugh out loud.

哄堂大笑.zh: 本来很严肃的会议，他一句话就让全场哄堂大笑。
哄堂大笑.en: It was a serious meeting, but one sentence from him made the whole room laugh.

哄堂大笑.zh: 电影院里那段戏演得特别搞笑，我们几个都哄堂大笑。
哄堂大笑.en: That scene in the movie was hilarious; the few of us all burst into laughter.

纪要.zh: 会议纪要在周五百发给所有人。
纪要.en: The meeting minutes will be distributed to everyone by Friday.

纪要.zh: 你把今天的纪要整理一下发给我。
纪要.en: Please organize today's meeting minutes and send them to me.

纪要.zh: 这份纪要里记录了所有重要决定。
纪要.en: This summary records all the important decisions.

纪要.zh: 写纪要的时候要抓住重点，别啰嗦。
纪要.en: When writing the minutes, focus on key points and don't ramble.

纪要.zh: 我看了上次的纪要，但有些地方不清楚。
纪要.en: I read the minutes from last time, but some parts are unclear.

客流.en: The passenger flow has been very heavy recently.

客流.zh: 这个商场周末客流特别多。
客流.en: This mall has especially large crowds on weekends.

客流.zh: 因为节日活动，地铁站的客流增加了不少。
客流.en: Due to the holiday events, the passenger flow at the subway station increased a lot.

客流.zh: 虽然现在是淡季，但这里的客流依然不少。
客流.en: Although it's the off-season now, the passenger flow here is still considerable.

客流.zh: 为了应对高峰客流，车站加开了好几个窗口。
客流.en: To handle the peak passenger flow, the station opened several extra windows.

可歌可泣.en: This story is truly heroic and moving.

可歌可泣.zh: 那些英雄的事迹可歌可泣。
可歌可泣.en: The deeds of those heroes are worthy of praise and tears.

可歌可泣.zh: 电影里讲了一段可歌可泣的爱情故事。
可歌可泣.en: The movie tells a love story that is both inspiring and tragic.

可歌可泣.zh: 虽然过程很艰难，但他们的奋斗精神可歌可泣。
可歌可泣.en: Although the process was very difficult, their spirit of struggle is worthy of admiration.

可歌可泣.zh: 这本书描写了抗战时期可歌可泣的军民故事。
可歌可泣.en: This book describes the heroic and moving stories of soldiers and civilians during the war of resistance.

举世无双.en: This artwork is unmatched in the world.

举世无双.zh: 他的才华可以说是举世无双。
举世无双.en: His talent can be said to be unparalleled.

举世无双.zh: 这块宝石的纯度举世无双，非常珍贵。
举世无双.en: The purity of this gem is unparalleled and extremely precious.

举世无双.zh: 虽然科技发展了，但大自然的风景依然是举世无双的。
举世无双.en: Although technology has advanced, the scenery of nature remains unmatched.

举世无双.zh: 他设计的那座桥结构独特，堪称举世无双。
举世无双.en: The bridge he designed has a unique structure and can be called unparalleled.

盛气凌人.en: He speaks in an overbearing manner.

盛气凌人.zh: 那个经理总是盛气凌人的样子。
虽然她能力很强，但盛气凌人的态度让人很不舒服。
盛气凌人.en: Although she is very capable, her overbearing attitude makes people very uncomfortable.

盛气凌人.zh: 他刚升职就变得盛气凌人，大家都讨厌他。
盛气凌人.en: As soon as he got promoted, he became domineering, and everyone dislikes him.

盛气凌人.zh: 我不喜欢那种盛气凌人的领导，合作起来特别累。
盛气凌人.en: I don't like that kind of overbearing leader; it's very tiring to work with them.

心灵手巧.en: She is especially clever and deft.

心灵手巧.zh: 我妹妹心灵手巧，做什么都像。
心灵手巧.en: My younger sister is handy and can make anything look good.

心灵手巧.zh: 这个手工作品一看就知道作者心灵手巧。
心灵手巧.en: You can tell from this handmade work that the creator is clever and skillful.

心灵手巧.zh: 他虽然是个男孩，但心灵手巧，会织毛衣。
心灵手巧.en: Although he is a boy, he is dexterous and can knit sweaters.

心灵手巧.zh: 她心灵手巧，不仅会画画还会做各种小饰品。
心灵手巧.en: She is quick-witted and nimble-fingered; she can paint and make all kinds of small accessories.

马后炮.en: You are just a Monday morning quarterback.

马后炮.zh: 事情都结束了才说，真是马后炮。
马后炮.en: Saying it after everything is over is really too late.

马后炮.zh: 他总喜欢放马后炮，事后才给建议。
马后炮.en: He always likes to give belated advice after the fact.

马后炮.zh: 别在这马后炮了，之前怎么不说？
马后炮.en: Don't be a backseat driver now; why didn't you say it before?

马后炮.zh: 现在提意见已经是马后炮了，下次早点说吧。
马后炮.en: Offering suggestions now is too late; speak up earlier next time.

爱面子.en: He cares a lot about face.

爱面子.zh: 中国人普遍比较爱面子。
爱面子.en: Chinese people generally care a lot about saving face.

爱面子.zh: 她因为爱面子，不好意思承认错误。
爱面子.en: Because she cares about face, she is embarrassed to admit mistakes.

爱面子.zh: 他太爱面子了，明明没钱还要请客。
爱面子.en: He is too concerned about face; even though he has no money, he still treats others.

爱面子.zh: 虽然爱面子可以理解，但有时也会带来麻烦。
爱面子.en: Although caring about face is understandable, it can also cause trouble sometimes.

横七竖八.en: Books are piled haphazardly on the table.

横七竖八.zh: 地上横七竖八躺着几个人。
横七竖八.en: Several people are lying around on the ground in disorder.

横七竖八.zh: 他把衣服横七竖八扔在床上。
横七竖八.en: He threw his clothes all over the bed in a mess.

横七竖八.zh: 台风过后，树枝横七竖八地倒在地上。
横七竖八.en: After the typhoon, branches were scattered all over the ground.

横七竖八.zh: 房间里横七竖八放着各种杂物，连下脚的地方都没有。
横七竖八.en: The room is cluttered with all sorts of odds and ends, leaving no place to step.

孤陋寡闻.en: I am really ignorant and ill-informed.

孤陋寡闻.zh: 他总觉得自己孤陋寡闻。
孤陋寡闻.en: He always feels that he is ignorant and uninformed.

孤陋寡闻.zh: 我以前孤陋寡闻，没听过这个牌子。
孤陋寡闻.en: I was ignorant before and had never heard of this brand.

孤陋寡闻.zh: 因为孤陋寡闻，他闹了不少笑话。
孤陋寡闻.en: Because he is ignorant, he has made many embarrassing mistakes.

孤陋寡闻.zh: 多出去走走，免得别人说你孤陋寡闻。
孤陋寡闻.en: Go out more often so that others won't say you are ignorant.

赐教.zh: 这个问题我不懂，还望您赐教。
赐教.en: I don't understand this question; I hope you can instruct me.

赐教.zh: 关于这个难题，期待您的赐教。
赐教.en: Regarding this difficult problem, I look forward to your guidance.

赐教.zh: 晚辈才疏学浅，请前辈多多赐教。
赐教.en: I am shallow in learning; please give me more advice, senior.

赐教.zh: 初次见面，小弟有个疑问想请您赐教。
赐教.en: Nice to meet you; I have a question and would like to ask for your advice.

接济.en: He often helps his neighbors financially.

接济.zh: 虽然自己也不富裕，但他还是接济了那个孤儿。
接济.en: Although he himself is not rich, he still supported that orphan.

接济.zh: 她每个月都会寄钱回去接济父母。
接济.en: She sends money every month to support her parents.

接济.zh: 因为失业了，所以朋友一直在接济我。
接济.en: Because I lost my job, my friend has been supporting me.

接济.zh: 旧社会里，穷人靠接济过活。
接济.en: In the old society, the poor relied on relief to survive.

吵嘴.zh: 两个人因为小事吵嘴，后来很快就和好了。
吵嘴.en: The two quarreled over a small matter, but soon made up.

吵嘴.zh: 虽然夫妻偶尔吵嘴，但感情一直很好。
吵嘴.en: Although the couple occasionally bicker, their relationship has always been good.

吵嘴.zh: 邻居家天天吵嘴，声音很大。
吵嘴.en: The neighbors quarrel every day, very loudly.

师资.en: This school has a strong teaching staff.

师资.zh: 我们公司很重视师资培训，每年都安排很多课程。
师资.en: Our company places great emphasis on teacher training and arranges many courses every year.

师资.zh: 好的师资是教育质量的关键。
师资.en: Good teachers are the key to education quality.

师资.zh: 虽然学校环境一般，但师资非常好，所以很多家长愿意送孩子来。
师资.en: Although the school environment is average, the teaching staff is very good, so many parents are willing to send their children here.

师资.zh: 这个培训班的师资来自各大名校。
师资.en: The teaching staff of this training class come from various prestigious schools.

眉开眼笑.en: He heard and was all smiles.

眉开眼笑.zh: 收到录取通知书那天，她眉开眼笑，兴奋得跳了起来。
眉开眼笑.en: The day she received the admission letter, she beamed with joy and jumped up excitedly.

眉开眼笑.zh: 妈妈看到孩子考了一百分，立即眉开眼笑。
眉开眼笑.en: Mom saw the child got 100 points, and immediately beamed with joy.

眉开眼笑.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但看到观众鼓掌，他依然眉开眼笑。
眉开眼笑.en: Although he lost the competition, seeing the audience applaud, he still beamed with joy.

眉开眼笑.zh: 爷爷逗孙子玩，小家伙眉开眼笑。
眉开眼笑.en: Grandpa played with his grandson, and the little one beamed with joy.

斩草除根.zh: 对付这种害虫，我们要斩草除根，不能留后患。
斩草除根.en: To deal with this pest, we must eliminate it completely, leaving no future trouble.

斩草除根.zh: 做事情要彻底，最好斩草除根。
斩草除根.en: Do things thoroughly, better to eliminate the root cause.

斩草除根.zh: 如果不斩草除根，问题还会再出现。
斩草除根.en: If we don't eliminate the root cause, the problem will reappear.

斩草除根.zh: 他做事狠，总想斩草除根。
斩草除根.en: He is ruthless and always wants to destroy completely.

前赴后继.en: The soldiers advanced wave upon wave.

前赴后继.zh: 革命年代，无数英雄前赴后继，才换来今天的和平。
前赴后继.en: In the revolutionary era, countless heroes advanced wave upon wave, which brought today's peace.

前赴后继.zh: 科研人员前赴后继，攻克了好多难题。
前赴后继.en: Researchers advanced wave upon wave, solving many difficult problems.

前赴后继.zh: 虽然困难重重，但他们依然前赴后继地投入救援。
前赴后继.en: Although difficulties were numerous, they still advanced wave upon wave into the rescue.

前赴后继.zh: 这个家族几代人前赴后继，终于完成了这部巨著。
前赴后继.en: Generations of this family advanced wave upon wave, finally completing this masterpiece.

平常心.en: Keeping a calm mind is very important.

平常心.zh: 考试时不要紧张，用平常心对待就好。
平常心.en: Don't be nervous during the exam, just treat it with a normal attitude.

平常心.zh: 输赢都要有平常心，不能太在意。
平常心.en: Win or lose, you need a calm mind, don't care too much.

平常心.zh: 虽然这次机会很难得，但他还是用平常心去面对。
平常心.en: Although this opportunity is rare, he still faced it with a calm mind.

平常心.zh: 他做任何事都带着平常心，从不急躁。
平常心.en: He does everything with a calm mind, never impatient.

岂有此理.zh: 他居然骂老人，岂有此理！
岂有此理.en: He actually scolded an old person, how outrageous!

岂有此理.zh: 这样的服务态度，岂有此理！
如果你明明做错了还不承认，那就岂有此理了。
岂有此理.en: If you clearly did wrong but still don't admit it, that's outrageous.

岂有此理.zh: 老板拖欠工资还不道歉，岂有此理！
岂有此理.en: The boss withheld wages and didn't apologize, outrageous!

彩霞.en: There are rosy clouds on the horizon.

彩霞.zh: 傍晚时分，天空出现了美丽的彩霞。
彩霞.en: In the evening, beautiful rosy clouds appeared in the sky.
The rosy clouds reflected red all over the lake.

彩霞.zh: 因为天气晴朗，所以今天的彩霞格外好看。
彩霞.en: Because the weather was clear, today's rosy clouds were especially beautiful.

彩霞.zh: 她喜欢在阳台上看彩霞，特别放松。
彩霞.en: She likes to watch the rosy clouds on the balcony, very relaxing.

画龙点睛.en: This detail is the finishing touch.

画龙点睛.zh: 文章的最后一句话起到了画龙点睛的作用。
画龙点睛.en: The last sentence of the article served as the finishing touch.

画龙点睛.zh: 你的提议真是画龙点睛，大家都很认同。
画龙点睛.en: Your suggestion is really the finishing touch, everyone agrees.

画龙点睛.zh: 虽然他前面讲得一般，但结尾的总结画龙点睛，让人印象深刻。
画龙点睛.en: Although his earlier talk was average, the concluding summary was the finishing touch, leaving a deep impression.

画龙点睛.zh: 装修时，挂上这幅画就画龙点睛了。
画龙点睛.en: When decorating, hanging this painting added the finishing touch.

正版.zh: 这个软件是正版的，放心用。
正版.en: This software is genuine, feel free to use it.

正版.zh: 为了支持创作者，我从来只买正版书。
正版.en: To support the creators, I always buy only genuine books.

正版.zh: 虽然正版贵一些，但质量有保障，而且售后服务好。
正版.en: Although the genuine version is more expensive, the quality is guaranteed and after-sales service is good.

正版.zh: 你确定这是正版的卡吗？别买到假的了。
正版.en: Are you sure this is a genuine card? Don't buy a fake one.

正版.zh: 现在越来越多的人愿意为正版音乐付费，这是个好现象。
正版.en: Now more and more people are willing to pay for genuine music, which is a good phenomenon.

精练.zh: 他说话很精练，从不啰嗦。
精练.en: He speaks very concisely, never wordy.

精练.zh: 这篇文章写得太精练了，每个字都有用。
精练.en: This article is written very concisely, every word is useful.

精练.zh: 要想让报告精练，就得删掉那些重复的内容。
精练.en: To make the report concise, you need to delete the repetitive content.

精练.zh: 他的演讲虽然短，但非常精练，一下子就把重点说清楚了。
精练.en: His speech was short but very concise, making the key points clear right away.

精练.zh: 老师要求我们把总结写得精练一些，别写太多废话。
精练.en: The teacher asked us to write the summary more concisely, without too much fluff.

栋梁.zh: 他是公司的栋梁，少了他不行。
栋梁.en: He is the pillar of the company; it won't work without him.

栋梁.zh: 年轻一代是国家的栋梁，要好好培养。
栋梁.en: The younger generation is the pillar of the country; they need to be well cultivated.

栋梁.zh: 这些优秀的人才，将来都会成为社会的栋梁。
栋梁.en: These outstanding talents will all become pillars of society in the future.

栋梁.zh: 一个团队需要几个栋梁人物来支撑，否则很难发展。
栋梁.en: A team needs a few pillar figures to support it, otherwise it's hard to develop.

栋梁.zh: 家长都希望自己的孩子能成为栋梁之才，所以很重视教育。
