栋梁.en: Parents all hope their children can become pillars of talent, so they value education highly.

攻关.zh: 他们正在攻关一个技术难题。
攻关.en: They are tackling a technical problem.

攻关.zh: 这个项目需要大家一起攻关，才能按时完成。
攻关.en: This project requires everyone to work together to overcome difficulties in order to finish on time.

攻关.zh: 研发团队连续加班，就是为了攻关新产品的核心问题。
攻关.en: The R&D team worked overtime continuously just to tackle the core issue of the new product.

攻关.zh: 虽然攻关很辛苦，但成功后特别有成就感。
攻关.en: Although tackling difficulties is tough, it gives a great sense of achievement when you succeed.

攻关.zh: 我们要集中精力攻关，不能分心做别的事。
攻关.en: We need to focus on tackling the problem and not get distracted by other things.

走弯路.zh: 这件事我走弯路了，很后悔。
走弯路.en: I took a detour on this matter, and I regret it a lot.

走弯路.zh: 多听前辈的建议，能让你少走弯路。
走弯路.en: Listening to advice from seniors can help you avoid detours.

见仁见智.zh: 这个看法见仁见智，没有标准答案。
见仁见智.en: This view varies from person to person; there's no standard answer.

见仁见智.zh: 对于电影的好坏，大家见仁见智。
见仁见智.en: Opinions on whether a movie is good or bad vary from person to person.

见仁见智.zh: 关于怎么教育孩子，每个家长都见仁见智。
见仁见智.en: When it comes to how to raise children, every parent has their own opinion.

见仁见智.zh: 这道菜好不好吃，完全见仁见智，我觉得挺不错的。
见仁见智.en: Whether this dish is delicious or not is entirely subjective; I think it's pretty good.

见仁见智.zh: 对同一件事，不同的人见仁见智，所以不用强求一致。
见仁见智.en: Different people have different views on the same thing, so there's no need to insist on uniformity.

各抒己见.zh: 讨论时大家都各抒己见，气氛很热烈。
各抒己见.en: During the discussion, everyone expressed their own views, and the atmosphere was lively.

各抒己见.zh: 开会时领导让大家各抒己见，不要有顾虑。
各抒己见.en: At the meeting, the leader asked everyone to speak their minds freely without hesitation.

各抒己见.zh: 我们各抒己见，最后选了一个折中的方案。
各抒己见.en: We each expressed our own opinions, and finally chose a compromise plan.

各抒己见.zh: 在这个自由讨论的环节，同学们都各抒己见，非常精彩。
各抒己见.en: In this free discussion session, the students all expressed their own views, which was very exciting.

各抒己见.zh: 虽然大家各抒己见，但最终目标是一致的。
各抒己见.en: Although everyone expressed different opinions, the ultimate goal was the same.

发愣.zh: 他坐在那里发愣，不知道在想什么。
发愣.en: He sat there staring blankly, not knowing what he was thinking about.
Don't just stand there in a daze, come and help.

发愣.zh: 听到这个消息，他一下子发愣了。
发愣.en: Upon hearing this news, he suddenly went blank.

发愣.zh: 我问了他好几遍，他才从发愣中回过神来。
发愣.en: I asked him several times before he snapped out of his daze.

发愣.zh: 考试的时候发愣可不行，时间一下就过去了。
发愣.en: You can't stare blankly during an exam; time passes quickly.

国学.zh: 他最近在学国学，读了很多经典。
国学.en: He has been studying Chinese classics recently, reading many classics.

国学.zh: 爸爸喜欢国学，经常看《论语》和《道德经》。
国学.en: My dad likes Chinese classics and often reads the Analects and Tao Te Ching.

国学.zh: 现在很多学校都开设了国学课程，教孩子们传统文化。
国学.en: Nowadays many schools offer Chinese classics courses to teach children traditional culture.

国学.zh: 他对国学很有研究，特别是先秦诸子的思想。
国学.en: He has deep knowledge of Chinese classics, especially the thoughts of pre-Qin philosophers.

国学.zh: 学国学不仅能提高文化修养，还能学到很多做人的道理。
国学.en: Studying Chinese classics not only improves cultural refinement but also teaches many principles of life.

画蛇添足.zh: 这件事本来已经很好了，你别画蛇添足。
画蛇添足.en: This matter is already good enough; don't gild the lily.

画蛇添足.zh: 他最后加的那句话完全是画蛇添足。
画蛇添足.en: The sentence he added at the end was completely superfluous.

画蛇添足.zh: 写文章要简洁，不要画蛇添足，加没用的内容。
画蛇添足.en: When writing an article, keep it concise; don't add unnecessary content that gilds the lily.

画蛇添足.zh: 我觉得你的解释已经够清楚了，再补充就是画蛇添足。
画蛇添足.en: I think your explanation is already clear enough; adding more would be gilding the lily.

画蛇添足.zh: 本来很简单的事，他非要画蛇添足搞复杂了。
画蛇添足.en: It was a simple thing, but he insisted on gilding the lily and making it complicated.

酣睡.en: He slept soundly all night last night.

酣睡.zh: 因为太累了，他回家就酣睡了。
酣睡.en: Because he was too tired, he went home and slept soundly.

酣睡.zh: 外面很吵，但他仍然能酣睡。
酣睡.en: It's noisy outside, but he can still sleep soundly.

酣睡.zh: 我喝了热牛奶后，酣睡到天亮。
酣睡.en: After drinking warm milk, I slept soundly until dawn.

对联.en: Putting up couplets during Spring Festival is a custom.

对联.zh: 这幅对联的字写得很漂亮。
对联.en: The characters of this couplet are written very beautifully.

对联.zh: 他买了两副对联，一副送朋友。
对联.en: He bought two couplets, one to give to a friend.

对联.zh: 对联的内容通常都是吉祥话。
对联.en: The content of couplets is usually auspicious words.

茶道.en: Tea ceremony is not just a kind of culture.
Japanese tea ceremony is very famous.

茶道.zh: 他专门去学了茶道课程。
茶道.en: He specially studied a tea ceremony course.

茶道.zh: 茶道讲究的是心境和礼仪。
茶道.en: Tea ceremony emphasizes mindset and etiquette.

泰斗.en: He is a leading authority in academia.
People of the top level are rare.

泰斗.zh: 这位教授是医学界的泰斗。
泰斗.en: This professor is a leading authority in the medical field.

泰斗.zh: 很多人都称他为文坛泰斗。
泰斗.en: Many people call him a literary giant.

泰斗.zh: 他虽然年纪大了，但仍是泰斗。
泰斗.en: Although he is old, he is still a leading authority.

暴风骤雨.en: There is a violent storm outside.

暴风骤雨.zh: 暴风骤雨过后，空气很清新。
暴风骤雨.en: After the violent storm, the air is very fresh.

暴风骤雨.zh: 昨天晚上的暴风骤雨吓坏了孩子。
暴风骤雨.en: Last night's violent storm scared the children.

暴风骤雨.zh: 暴风骤雨突然来临，大家赶紧回家。
暴风骤雨.en: The violent storm suddenly came, everyone hurried home.

暴风骤雨.zh: 这场暴风骤雨持续了整整一个晚上。
暴风骤雨.en: This violent storm lasted a whole night.

瑞雪.en: A timely snow promises a good harvest.

瑞雪.zh: 这场瑞雪来得正是时候。
瑞雪.en: This timely snow came just at the right time.

瑞雪.zh: 农民们很喜欢冬天的瑞雪。
瑞雪.en: Farmers really like the timely snow in winter.

瑞雪.zh: 看到瑞雪，大家都觉得很吉利。
瑞雪.en: Seeing the timely snow, everyone feels it's auspicious.

瑞雪.zh: 孩子们在瑞雪里玩得很开心。
瑞雪.en: Children played happily in the timely snow.

一概而论.zh: 这个问题不能一概而论。
每个人的情况不同，别一概而论。
一概而论.en: Everyone's situation is different, don't generalize.

一概而论.zh: 我们不能对所有事情都一概而论。
虽然有些相似，但也不该一概而论。
一概而论.en: Although somewhat similar, we shouldn't generalize.

大雁.zh: 秋天能看到大雁排队飞过。
大雁.en: In autumn, you can see wild geese flying in formation.
Wild geese are a type of migratory bird.

大雁.zh: 天空中有一群大雁飞过。
大雁.en: A flock of wild geese is flying across the sky.

大雁.zh: 大雁每年都会迁徙到温暖的南方。
大雁.en: Wild geese migrate to the warm south every year.

经贸.en: Economic and trade cooperation is very important.

经贸.zh: 两国经贸往来日益频繁。
经贸.en: Economic and trade exchanges between the two countries are increasing.
He has been engaged in economic and trade work for many years.

经贸.zh: 今年的经贸形势不太乐观。
经贸.en: This year's economic and trade situation is not very optimistic.

经贸.zh: 他们正在谈经贸合作的项目。
经贸.en: They are discussing economic and trade cooperation projects.

潦草.zh: 这份报告写得太潦草了。
潦草.en: This report is written too sloppily.
Homework cannot be written too sloppily.

潦草.zh: 他的签名总是很潦草，看不清楚。
潦草.en: His signature is always very sloppy, hard to read.

潦草.zh: 因为赶时间，他写得很潦草。
潦草.en: Because he was in a hurry, he wrote sloppily.

互信.en: We need mutual trust between us.

互信.zh: 因为缺乏互信，他们的合作很快就失败了。
互信.en: Because of a lack of mutual trust, their cooperation quickly failed.
Mutual trust is the foundation of friendship.

互信.zh: 在团队里，互信能让工作更顺利。
互信.en: In a team, mutual trust can make work smoother.

互信.zh: 如果他们能建立互信，问题就好解决了。
互信.en: If they can build mutual trust, the problem will be easy to solve.

乔装.en: He disguised himself as an old man.

乔装.zh: 警察乔装成路人，混进了人群里。
乔装.en: The police disguised as passersby and blended into the crowd.
Stop disguising yourself, I recognize you.

乔装.zh: 为了不被发现，他乔装得特别仔细。
乔装.en: In order not to be discovered, he disguised himself very carefully.

乔装.zh: 她乔装打扮后，连妈妈都没认出来。
乔装.en: After she disguised herself, even her mother didn't recognize her.

大公无私.zh: 作为法官，他必须大公无私地判案。
大公无私.en: As a judge, he must judge cases impartially.

大公无私.zh: 大家都佩服他大公无私的精神。
如果他大公无私，就不会偏袒任何人。
大公无私.en: If he is selfless, he won't favor anyone.

网民.en: Many netizens like to scroll through videos.

网民.zh: 这件事在网上引起了网民的热议。
网民.en: This incident sparked heated discussion among netizens online.

网民.zh: 现在网民越来越关注食品安全了。
网民.en: Now netizens are paying more and more attention to food safety.

网民.zh: 因为网民数量很大，所以消息传得特别快。
网民.en: Because the number of netizens is huge, news spreads very quickly.

互访.en: The heads of state of the two countries frequently exchange visits.

互访.zh: 学校安排了一次互访活动，让学生们交流文化。
互访.en: The school arranged an exchange visit activity for students to exchange cultures.

互访.zh: 自从有了互访协议，两所大学合作更紧密了。
互访.en: Since the exchange visit agreement, the two universities have cooperated more closely.

互访.zh: 如果互访顺利，我们明年还会继续。
互访.en: If the exchange visits go smoothly, we will continue next year.

思前想后.zh: 他思前想后，还是决定去。
思前想后.en: He thought it over and decided to go anyway.

思前想后.zh: 我思前想后，觉得这个方案不太靠谱。
思前想后.en: I thought it over and felt that this plan is not reliable.

思前想后.zh: 别思前想后了，快做决定。
思前想后.en: Don't overthink it, make a decision quickly.

思前想后.zh: 她思前想后了很久，才答应他的请求。
思前想后.en: She thought it over for a long time before agreeing to his request.

思前想后.zh: 虽然思前想后很累，但总比冲动好。
思前想后.en: Although overthinking is tiring, it's better than being impulsive.

四合院.en: There are many siheyuan in Beijing.

四合院.zh: 他小时候住在四合院里，觉得特别热闹。
四合院.en: He lived in a siheyuan when he was young and found it very lively.

四合院.zh: 四合院是中国传统建筑。
四合院.en: The siheyuan is a traditional Chinese architecture.

四合院.zh: 我和朋友去参观了一座老四合院。
四合院.en: I visited an old siheyuan with a friend.

四合院.zh: 虽然四合院很美，但住起来不太方便。
四合院.en: Although siheyuan are beautiful, living in them is not very convenient.

娇惯.en: Don't spoil the child too much.

娇惯.zh: 她被父母娇惯坏了，什么都不会做。
娇惯.en: She was spoiled rotten by her parents and can't do anything.
Spoiling is bad for a child's development.

娇惯.zh: 因为从小被娇惯，他受不了任何挫折。
娇惯.en: Because he was spoiled from childhood, he can't handle any setbacks.

娇惯.zh: 如果继续这样娇惯，孩子以后会出问题。
娇惯.en: If you continue to spoil like this, the child will have problems later.

卡子.en: She has a hair clip in her hair.

卡子.zh: 过卡子的时候要出示身份证。
卡子.en: When passing the checkpoint, you need to show your ID.

卡子.zh: 我用卡子把文件固定在一起。
卡子.en: I used a clip to fasten the documents together.

卡子.zh: 因为路上有卡子，我们绕了远路。
卡子.en: Because there was a checkpoint on the road, we took a detour.

萍水相逢.zh: 我俩萍水相逢，却很投缘。
萍水相逢.en: We met by chance, but we hit it off.

萍水相逢.zh: 虽然只是萍水相逢，他却帮了我很多。
萍水相逢.en: Although we were just strangers meeting by chance, he helped me a lot.

萍水相逢.zh: 萍水相逢也是一种缘分。
萍水相逢.en: Meeting by chance is also a kind of fate.

萍水相逢.zh: 在旅途中，我和一个萍水相逢的人聊了很久。
萍水相逢.en: During the trip, I chatted for a long time with a person I met by chance.

萍水相逢.zh: 因为萍水相逢，所以更珍惜这份友情。
萍水相逢.en: Because we met by chance, we cherish this friendship more.

多劳多得.en: Our company rewards more work with more pay.

多劳多得.zh: 只要你努力，多劳多得是肯定的。
多劳多得.en: As long as you work hard, more work means more reward for sure.

多劳多得.zh: 在这个项目里，多劳多得的原则很公平。
多劳多得.en: In this project, the principle of more work for more pay is very fair.

多劳多得.zh: 虽然辛苦，但是多劳多得，值得。
多劳多得.en: Although it's hard, more work means more reward, so it's worth it.

多劳多得.zh: 他相信多劳多得，所以加班从不抱怨。
多劳多得.en: He believes in more pay for more work, so he never complains about overtime.

干戈.zh: 他们用谈判化解了干戈，避免了战争。
干戈.en: They resolved the conflict through negotiation and avoided war.

干戈.zh: 历史上很多干戈都是因为资源争夺。
干戈.en: Many conflicts in history were caused by competition for resources.

干戈.zh: 虽然干戈已息，但仇恨还在。
干戈.en: Although the conflict has subsided, the hatred remains.

干戈.zh: 我们希望能够永远不动干戈。
干戈.en: We hope that there will never be any conflict.

迷惑不解.zh: 对于这个结果，大家都很迷惑不解。
迷惑不解.en: Everyone was bewildered by this outcome.

迷惑不解.zh: 他为什么突然辞职，我迷惑不解。
迷惑不解.en: I'm confused as to why he suddenly resigned.

迷惑不解.zh: 虽然看了说明书，但我还是迷惑不解。
迷惑不解.en: Even after reading the instructions, I'm still confused.

迷惑不解.zh: 她的眼神让我迷惑不解，不知道怎么了。
迷惑不解.en: Her expression puzzled me; I didn't know what was wrong.

扑面而来.en: A burst of floral scent greeted me.

扑面而来.zh: 打开门，一股热浪扑面而来。
扑面而来.en: When I opened the door, a wave of heat hit me.

扑面而来.zh: 秋天的凉风扑面而来，很舒服。
扑面而来.en: The cool autumn breeze swept across my face, very pleasant.

扑面而来.zh: 当她走进房间，香水味扑面而来。
扑面而来.en: When she entered the room, the smell of perfume wafted over.

扑面而来.zh: 那种压迫感扑面而来，让我喘不过气。
扑面而来.en: That sense of pressure came rushing at me, making it hard to breathe.

冷酷无情.en: The boss is cold and ruthless.

冷酷无情.zh: 他对下属冷酷无情，没人喜欢他。
冷酷无情.en: He is cold and ruthless to his subordinates; no one likes him.

冷酷无情.zh: 这部电影的反派冷酷无情，让人害怕。
冷酷无情.en: The villain in this movie is cold and ruthless, really frightening.

冷酷无情.zh: 虽然她看起来很温柔，但实际冷酷无情。
冷酷无情.en: Although she seems gentle, she is actually cold and ruthless.

冷酷无情.zh: 在商场上，冷酷无情有时是必要的。
冷酷无情.en: In the business world, being cold and ruthless is sometimes necessary.

引经据典.en: He always quotes authoritative sources when speaking.

引经据典.zh: 教授在讲课时常引经据典，很有说服力。
引经据典.en: The professor often quotes classics in his lectures, making them very persuasive.

引经据典.zh: 她写文章喜欢引经据典，显得很有学问。
引经据典.en: She likes to cite authoritative sources in her writing, making her seem very knowledgeable.

引经据典.zh: 因为他是历史学家，所以发言总引经据典。
引经据典.en: Because he is a historian, his speeches are always filled with classical references.

引经据典.zh: 辩论时，他引经据典，对手无法反驳。
引经据典.en: During the debate, he quoted sources so well that his opponent couldn't refute him.

武侠.zh: 金庸的武侠小说影响了几代人。
武侠.en: Jin Yong's wuxia novels have influenced generations.

武侠.zh: 这部电影是一部经典的武侠片。
武侠.en: This movie is a classic wuxia film.

武侠.zh: 虽然我不爱运动，但我很喜欢武侠世界。
武侠.en: Although I don't like sports, I really enjoy the world of wuxia.

武侠.zh: 他的梦想是成为一个武侠高手。
武侠.en: His dream is to become a master of martial arts (a wuxia hero).

抚恤.zh: 事故后，公司对家属进行了抚恤。
抚恤.en: After the accident, the company provided compensation and comfort to the families.

抚恤.zh: 国家有专门的抚恤政策。
抚恤.en: The country has specific compensation policies.

抚恤.zh: 虽然抚恤了家属，但伤痛无法弥补。
抚恤.en: Although the families were compensated, the pain cannot be undone.

抚恤.zh: 这次抚恤金额很高，但依然不够。
抚恤.en: The amount of this compensation is high, but still not enough.

愚公移山.en: This story is called 'The Foolish Old Man Moves Mountains'.

愚公移山.zh: 愚公移山的精神值得我们学习。
愚公移山.en: The spirit of the Foolish Old Man moving mountains is worth learning from.

愚公移山.zh: 做事情要有愚公移山的毅力。
愚公移山.en: You need the perseverance of the Foolish Old Man moving mountains to accomplish things.

愚公移山.zh: 即使困难重重，也要有愚公移山的决心。
愚公移山.en: Even when faced with numerous difficulties, you must have the determination of the Foolish Old Man moving mountains.

愚公移山.zh: 他用愚公移山的精神完成了这个项目。
愚公移山.en: He completed this project with the spirit of the Foolish Old Man moving mountains.

通顺.zh: 你的文章写得很通顺，没什么问题。
通顺.en: Your article is very smooth and fluent; there are no problems.

通顺.zh: 把句子改一下，让它更通顺。
通顺.en: Revise the sentence to make it read more smoothly.

通顺.zh: 虽然意思明白，但表达不通顺。
通顺.en: Although the meaning is clear, the expression is not smooth.

通顺.zh: 他的中文很通顺，像母语一样。
通顺.en: His Chinese is very fluent, just like a native speaker.

歌咏.zh: 她喜欢歌咏，声音特别好听。
歌咏.en: She enjoys singing, and her voice is particularly beautiful.

歌咏.zh: 我们学校下周有个歌咏比赛，你要参加吗？
歌咏.en: Our school has a singing competition next week. Do you want to join?

歌咏.zh: 虽然他唱得一般，但他对歌咏的热情让我佩服。
歌咏.en: Although he doesn't sing well, his passion for singing impresses me.

歌咏.zh: 歌咏队的排练时间改到周五晚上，记得别迟到。
歌咏.en: The choir rehearsal time has been changed to Friday evening—don't be late.

歌咏.zh: 她从小学习歌咏，后来成了专业的歌手。
歌咏.en: She has studied singing since childhood and later became a professional singer.

桂花.zh: 桂花开了，整个院子都是香的。
桂花.en: The osmanthus flowers are blooming, and the whole yard is fragrant.

桂花.zh: 我妈妈做的桂花糕特别好吃，你要不要尝尝？
桂花.en: The osmanthus cake my mom makes is really delicious. Would you like to try some?

桂花.zh: 因为今年雨水多，桂花开得比往年更晚一些。
桂花.en: Because there was more rain this year, the osmanthus bloomed later than usual.

桂花.zh: 秋天走在街上，经常能闻到桂花的香味。
桂花.en: Walking on the street in autumn, you can often smell the fragrance of osmanthus.

桂花.zh: 她泡了一杯桂花茶，坐在窗边慢慢喝。
桂花.en: She made a cup of osmanthus tea and sat by the window sipping it slowly.

小卒.zh: 他觉得自己只是个无名小卒，没人会在意。
小卒.en: He thinks he's just a nobody and no one cares about him.

小卒.zh: 象棋里的小卒虽然走得慢，但过河后很厉害。
小卒.en: In chess, the pawn moves slowly, but it becomes powerful once it crosses the river.

小卒.zh: 别小看那些小卒，他们往往能发挥大作用。
小卒.en: Don't underestimate those pawns; they often play a big role.

小卒.zh: 在公司里他只是个小卒，但工作非常努力。
小卒.en: He's just a small fry in the company, but he works very hard.

小卒.zh: 虽然他是小卒出身，最后却成了公司的高管。
小卒.en: Although he started as a low-level employee, he eventually became a senior executive in the company.

出洋相.zh: 别穿那件衣服去聚会，很容易出洋相的。
出洋相.en: Don't wear that outfit to the party; it's easy to embarrass yourself.

出洋相.zh: 如果你不提前准备，到时候肯定会出洋相。
出洋相.en: If you don't prepare in advance, you'll definitely embarrass yourself.

恳切.zh: 他恳切地请求大家再给他一次机会。
恳切.en: He earnestly asked everyone to give him another chance.

恳切.zh: 她的语气很恳切，让我不忍心拒绝。
恳切.en: Her tone was so sincere that I couldn't bear to refuse.

恳切.zh: 我恳切地希望你能理解我的难处。
恳切.en: I sincerely hope you can understand my difficulties.

恳切.zh: 虽然他的态度很恳切，但老板还是没有同意。
恳切.en: Although his attitude was sincere, the boss still didn't agree.

恳切.zh: 他写的那封信非常恳切，读完之后我都感动了。
恳切.en: The letter he wrote was so earnest that I was moved after reading it.

便饭.zh: 今天就在我家吃顿便饭吧，别客气。
便饭.en: Just have a simple meal at my place today—don't be polite.

便饭.zh: 我做的都是家常便饭，希望你喜欢。
便饭.en: I've made just a home-style meal; I hope you like it.

便饭.zh: 虽然是便饭，但每个菜都特别用心。
便饭.en: Although it's a simple meal, every dish was made with great care.

便饭.zh: 朋友来了，我随便做了几个菜，算是便饭。
便饭.en: When my friend came, I casually made a few dishes—just a simple meal.

便饭.zh: 他不挑剔，一顿便饭就能吃得非常开心。
便饭.en: He's not picky; a simple meal can make him very happy.

赞叹不已.zh: 看到这幅画，大家都赞叹不已。
赞叹不已.en: Everyone was full of praise when they saw this painting.

赞叹不已.zh: 她的歌声让评委们赞叹不已。
赞叹不已.en: Her singing made the judges burst into admiration.

赞叹不已.zh: 观众对他的表演赞叹不已，掌声经久不息。
赞叹不已.en: The audience was full of praise for his performance, and the applause lasted a long time.

赞叹不已.zh: 这座建筑的宏伟让游客们赞叹不已。
赞叹不已.en: The magnificence of this building left tourists full of admiration.

赞叹不已.zh: 尝了一口他做的菜，大家纷纷赞叹不已。
赞叹不已.en: After tasting the dish he cooked, everyone couldn't stop praising it.

纵横交错.zh: 这座城市的路网纵横交错，很容易迷路。
纵横交错.en: The road network in this city is crisscrossed, making it easy to get lost.

纵横交错.zh: 地图上那些纵横交错的线条代表不同的河流。
纵横交错.en: The crisscrossing lines on the map represent different rivers.

纵横交错.zh: 老城区的小巷纵横交错，充满了生活气息。
纵横交错.en: The alleys in the old town are crisscrossed and full of life.

纵横交错.zh: 因为管道纵横交错，维修起来非常麻烦。
纵横交错.en: Because the pipes are crisscrossed, maintenance is very troublesome.

纵横交错.zh: 这些线索纵横交错，案情变得非常复杂。
纵横交错.en: These clues are intertwined, making the case very complicated.

节水.zh: 我们要养成节水的好习惯。
节水.en: We should develop good habits of water conservation.

节水.zh: 这个城市推行了很多节水措施。
节水.en: This city has implemented many water-saving measures.

节水.zh: 节水不仅可以省钱，还能保护环境。
节水.en: Saving water not only saves money but also protects the environment.

节水.zh: 他家的马桶是节水型的，冲起来水很少。
节水.en: The toilet in his home is a water-saving type; it uses very little water to flush.

节水.zh: 虽然节水重要，但也不能为了节水而影响正常生活。
节水.en: Although water conservation is important, it shouldn't affect normal life.

风餐露宿.zh: 他们一路上风餐露宿，非常辛苦。
风餐露宿.en: They endured wind and dew on the journey, eating in the open and sleeping rough—it was very hard.

风餐露宿.zh: 那些背包客经常风餐露宿，但乐在其中。
风餐露宿.en: Those backpackers often sleep outdoors and eat in the open, but they enjoy it.

风餐露宿.zh: 为了省钱，他选择风餐露宿，一路徒步旅行。
风餐露宿.en: To save money, he chose to live rough and travel on foot all the way.

风餐露宿.zh: 虽然风餐露宿的日子很苦，但回忆起来却很美好。
风餐露宿.en: Although the days of sleeping in the open and eating in the wind were hard, they are beautiful to look back on.

风餐露宿.zh: 战士们风餐露宿，坚守在边境线上。
风餐露宿.en: The soldiers endured the elements, staying on the border line.

怡然自得.zh: 退休以后，他住在乡下，生活得怡然自得。
怡然自得.en: After retiring, he lives in the countryside and lives contentedly.

怡然自得.zh: 看到她怡然自得的样子，我也觉得开心。
怡然自得.en: Seeing her contented look, I also feel happy.

怡然自得.zh: 爷爷在院子里种花，怡然自得。
怡然自得.en: Grandpa plants flowers in the yard, feeling content.

怡然自得.zh: 虽然他工作忙，但周末过得怡然自得。
怡然自得.en: Although he is busy with work, he spends weekends contentedly.

上期.zh: 这期杂志比上期好看多了。
上期.en: This issue of the magazine is much better than the last one.
Did you watch the last episode?

上期.zh: 上期考试的内容我复习了两遍。
上期.en: I reviewed the content from the last exam twice.

上期.zh: 我买了上期的彩票，但是没中。
上期.en: I bought the lottery ticket for the last draw, but didn't win.

上期.zh: 上期作业太难了，我做了好久才做完。
上期.en: The last homework was too difficult; I worked on it for a long time before finishing.

院士.zh: 李院士是著名的科学家。
院士.en: Academician Li is a famous scientist.

院士.zh: 今天我们请到了一位院士来演讲。
院士.en: Today we invited an academician to give a speech.

院士.zh: 这位院士在物理学领域做出了很大贡献。
院士.en: This academician has made great contributions in the field of physics.

院士.zh: 虽然他是院士，但为人非常谦虚。
院士.en: Although he is an academician, he is very humble.

院士.zh: 老院士已经退休了，但还经常来实验室。
院士.en: The old academician has retired, but still often comes to the lab.

苦尽甘来.en: He finally tasted happiness after hardship.

苦尽甘来.zh: 这些年他吃了很多苦，现在总算苦尽甘来了。
苦尽甘来.en: He has suffered a lot over the years, but now happiness has finally come.

苦尽甘来.zh: 等苦尽甘来的那一天，我们好好庆祝。
苦尽甘来.en: When the day of happiness after hardship comes, we'll celebrate well.

苦尽甘来.zh: 苦尽甘来，这句话说得真对。
苦尽甘来.en: 'Happiness comes after hardship' – that saying is really true.

苦尽甘来.zh: 只要坚持，总会苦尽甘来。
苦尽甘来.en: As long as you persist, happiness after hardship will come.

绘声绘色.zh: 他讲得绘声绘色，大家都听入迷了。
绘声绘色.en: He described it so vividly that everyone was fascinated.

绘声绘色.zh: 老师绘声绘色地讲了一个故事。
绘声绘色.en: The teacher vividly told a story.

绘声绘色.zh: 她把旅行经历描绘得绘声绘色。
绘声绘色.en: She vividly described her travel experiences.

绘声绘色.zh: 虽然没去过，但他讲得绘声绘色。
绘声绘色.en: Although he hasn't been there, he described it vividly.

绘声绘色.zh: 他的描述绘声绘色，让人身临其境。
绘声绘色.en: His vivid description made people feel like they were there.

馅儿.zh: 这个饺子的馅儿很好吃。
馅儿.en: The filling of this dumpling is delicious.

馅儿.zh: 我包饺子喜欢放猪肉白菜馅儿。
馅儿.en: When I make dumplings, I like to use pork and cabbage filling.

馅儿.zh: 你做的包子馅儿太咸了。
馅儿.en: The filling of the buns you made is too salty.

馅儿.zh: 虽然馅儿很好吃，但皮太厚了。
馅儿.en: Although the filling is delicious, the wrapper is too thick.

馅儿.zh: 妈妈调的馅儿味道总是刚刚好。
馅儿.en: The filling that Mom mixes always tastes just right.

三番五次.zh: 我三番五次提醒他，他还是忘了。
三番五次.en: I reminded him repeatedly, but he still forgot.

三番五次.zh: 老板三番五次强调这件事很重要。
三番五次.en: The boss repeatedly emphasized that this matter is very important.

三番五次.zh: 虽然我三番五次道歉，她也不原谅我。
三番五次.en: Although I apologized repeatedly, she still didn't forgive me.

三番五次.zh: 他三番五次地来找我，真烦人。
三番五次.en: He keeps coming to me over and over; it's really annoying.

忌口.en: You are sick, you need to watch your diet.

忌口.zh: 医生让我忌口，不能吃辣。
忌口.en: The doctor told me to avoid certain foods, no spicy food.

忌口.zh: 他虽然爱吃海鲜，但因为过敏只能忌口。
忌口.en: Although he loves seafood, he has to avoid it because of allergies.

忌口.zh: 忌口的时候，要特别注意调料。
忌口.en: When on a restricted diet, you need to pay special attention to seasonings.

忌口.zh: 妈妈总是不让我忌口，说没事。
忌口.en: Mom always doesn't let me avoid foods, saying it's fine.

温带.zh: 中国大部分地区属于温带。
温带.en: Most of China belongs to the temperate zone.
Temperate climate has four distinct seasons.

温带.zh: 这种植物只适合在温带生长。
温带.en: This plant only grows well in temperate zones.

温带.zh: 虽然热带很热，但温带更舒服。
温带.en: Although the tropics are hot, the temperate zone is more comfortable.

温带.zh: 温带地区的冬天有时也会下雪。
温带.en: In temperate regions, it sometimes snows in winter.

举一反三.en: He is good at learning by analogy.

举一反三.zh: 老师教了一个方法，他就举一反三用了。
举一反三.en: The teacher taught one method, and he applied it by analogy.

举一反三.zh: 学数学要举一反三，不能死记硬背。
举一反三.en: Learning math requires drawing inferences; rote memorization won't work.

举一反三.zh: 只要你能举一反三，这道题就不难。
举一反三.en: As long as you can draw inferences, this problem is not difficult.

举一反三.zh: 我举一反三的能力还需要加强。
举一反三.en: My ability to learn by analogy still needs improvement.

损人利己.zh: 他总做损人利己的事，没人愿意跟他合作。
损人利己.en: He always does things that harm others to benefit himself, so nobody wants to cooperate with him.

损人利己.zh: 做生意不能光想着损人利己，要双赢才行。
损人利己.en: In business, you can't just think about harming others for your own gain; you need a win-win situation.

损人利己.zh: 这种损人利己的做法，迟早会让人讨厌你。
损人利己.en: This kind of self-serving behavior that hurts others will eventually make people dislike you.

损人利己.zh: 他虽然赚了点钱，但名声坏了，因为手段太损人利己了。
损人利己.en: Although he made some money, his reputation was ruined because his methods were too harmful to others for his own benefit.

损人利己.zh: 咱们别学那些损人利己的人，做人还是得厚道一点。
损人利己.en: Let's not learn from those who harm others for their own gain; we should be more kindhearted as people.

野炊.zh: 周末我们去河边野炊吧。
野炊.en: Let's go have a picnic by the river this weekend.

野炊.zh: 野炊的时候记得带够水和吃的。
野炊.en: Remember to bring enough water and food when you go on a picnic.

野炊.zh: 上次野炊大家玩得很开心，还烤了红薯。
野炊.en: Last time we had a great time picnicking and even roasted sweet potatoes.

野炊.zh: 虽然天气预报说有雨，但我们还是坚持去野炊了。
野炊.en: Although the weather forecast said it would rain, we still insisted on going for a picnic.

野炊.zh: 野炊最好选在空旷又安全的地方，别靠近草丛。
野炊.en: It's best to choose an open and safe place for a picnic, and stay away from thick grass.

涝.zh: 今年雨水太多，好多地方都涝了。
涝.en: There has been too much rain this year, and many places are waterlogged.

涝.zh: 庄稼最怕涝，一涝就减产。
涝.en: Crops are most afraid of waterlogging; once flooded, yields drop.

涝.zh: 这个城市排水系统不好，一下雨就内涝。
涝.en: This city's drainage system is poor, so it gets waterlogged as soon as it rains.

涝.zh: 去年南方闹涝灾，很多农田都被淹了。
涝.en: Last year, there was a flood disaster in the south, and many farmlands were submerged.

涝.zh: 虽然今年没涝，但农民还是担心旱涝不均。
涝.en: Although there was no waterlogging this year, farmers still worry about uneven droughts and floods.

非金属.zh: 玻璃是一种非金属材料。
非金属元素在生活里很常见，比如碳和氧。
非金属.en: Non-metallic elements are very common in daily life, such as carbon and oxygen.

非金属.zh: 塑料和橡胶都属于非金属，用途特别广。
非金属.en: Plastic and rubber are both non-metals, with very wide applications.

非金属.zh: 老师让我们区分金属和非金属，我觉得挺容易的。
非金属.en: The teacher asked us to distinguish between metals and non-metals, and I think it's quite easy.

非金属.zh: 很多非金属材料虽然不导电，但隔热效果很好。
非金属.en: Although many non-metallic materials do not conduct electricity, they have good thermal insulation.

卤味.zh: 我最喜欢吃卤味，尤其是鸡爪。
卤味.en: I love eating braised snacks, especially chicken feet.

卤味.zh: 街口那家卤味店开了好多年了。
卤味.en: That braised snack shop at the street corner has been open for many years.

卤味.zh: 卤味的做法其实不难，关键是调料要配好。
卤味.en: The method for making braised snacks is actually not difficult; the key is to mix the spices well.

卤味.zh: 每次路过卤味摊，我都忍不住买点。
卤味.en: Every time I pass by the braised snack stall, I can't help buying some.

卤味.zh: 我们买了点卤味回家，晚上边看剧边吃。
卤味.en: We bought some braised snacks to take home, eating them while watching a show in the evening.

约定俗成.zh: 过年给红包是约定俗成的规矩。
约定俗成.en: Giving red envelopes during the New Year is a customary rule.

约定俗成.zh: 很多成语的用法都是约定俗成的，不能随便改。
约定俗成.en: The usage of many idioms is established by convention and cannot be changed arbitrarily.

约定俗成.zh: 他不太懂这里的约定俗成，所以闹了笑话。
约定俗成.en: He didn't understand the conventions here, so he made a fool of himself.

约定俗成.zh: 虽然法律规定没写，但大家约定俗成地都这么做。
约定俗成.en: Although it's not written in the law, everyone does it by common practice.

约定俗成.zh: 语言里的很多东西都是约定俗成的，没有为什么。
约定俗成.en: Many things in language are established by convention; there's no reason why.

无情无义.zh: 他太无情无义了，连朋友都骗。
无情无义.en: He is so heartless and ungrateful that he even cheats his friends.

无情无义.zh: 这种无情无义的人，还是早点断绝关系好。
无情无义.en: It's better to cut ties early with this kind of heartless and ungrateful person.

无情无义.zh: 你帮了他那么多，他却翻脸无情无义，真让人寒心。
无情无义.en: You helped him so much, but he turned against you heartlessly; it's really chilling.

无情无义.zh: 就算分手了，也不用做得这么无情无义吧。
无情无义.en: Even if you broke up, you don't have to be so heartless and ruthless.

无情无义.zh: 她哭着说丈夫无情无义，丢下她和孩子就走了。
无情无义.en: She cried and said her husband was heartless, leaving her and the child and walking away.

耿直.zh: 他这个人很耿直，说话从不拐弯。
耿直.en: He is a very straightforward person and never beats around the bush.

耿直.zh: 耿直的人虽然容易得罪人，但值得信任。
耿直.en: Straightforward people may easily offend others, but they are trustworthy.

耿直.zh: 我老板性格耿直，有什么说什么，挺好的。
耿直.en: My boss has a straightforward personality; he says what he thinks, which is quite good.

耿直.zh: 她太耿直了，有时候让人下不来台。
耿直.en: She is too blunt, and sometimes makes people feel embarrassed.

耿直.zh: 虽然大家都喜欢耿直的人，但说话还是得注意点方式。
耿直.en: Although everyone likes straightforward people, one still needs to be mindful of the way they speak.

顺差.zh: 中国对美国的贸易顺差很大。
顺差.en: China has a large trade surplus with the United States.

顺差.zh: 顺差太大容易引起贸易摩擦。
顺差.en: A too large trade surplus can easily cause trade friction.

顺差.zh: 这个国家靠出口石油一直保持顺差。
顺差.en: This country has maintained a trade surplus by exporting oil.

顺差.zh: 我们要平衡进出口，不能光追求顺差。
顺差.en: We need to balance imports and exports; we can't just pursue a surplus.

顺差.zh: 去年我国贸易顺差有所下降，但仍然是全球第一。
顺差.en: Last year, our country's trade surplus decreased somewhat, but it still ranks first globally.

东奔西走.zh: 他为了工作整天东奔西走。
东奔西走.en: He runs around all day for work.

东奔西走.zh: 爸妈为了养家东奔西走，特别辛苦。
东奔西走.en: My parents run around everywhere to support the family; it's really hard.

东奔西走.zh: 别东奔西走了，先坐下来好好商量一下。
东奔西走.en: Stop running around; let's sit down and discuss it properly first.

东奔西走.zh: 他东奔西走了一年，终于攒够了买房的钱。
东奔西走.en: He ran around for a whole year and finally saved enough money to buy a house.

东奔西走.zh: 自从当了销售，我天天东奔西走，腿都快跑断了。
东奔西走.en: Since I became a salesperson, I've been running around every day; my legs are almost worn out.

没说的.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道没说的，服务也好。
没说的.en: The food at this restaurant is beyond reproach, and the service is good too.

没说的.zh: 你帮了我这么大的忙，真是没说的。
没说的.en: You helped me so much, there's nothing to say but thanks.

没说的.zh: 虽然价格贵了点，但质量没说的。
没说的.en: Although the price is a bit high, the quality is unquestionable.
Their relationship is so good, nothing to say.

美滋滋.zh: 听到这个消息，他心里美滋滋的。
美滋滋.en: Hearing this news, he felt very happy inside.

美滋滋.zh: 你考上大学，你爸妈肯定美滋滋的。
美滋滋.en: You got into college, your parents must be overjoyed.

美滋滋.zh: 因为今天发了奖金，他美滋滋地去逛街了。
美滋滋.en: Because he got a bonus today, he went shopping happily.

美滋滋.zh: 吃完这顿大餐，大家都美滋滋的。
美滋滋.en: After this big meal, everyone was content.

怠工.zh: 因为工资问题，很多员工开始怠工。
怠工.en: Because of wage issues, many employees started to go slow.

怠工.zh: 他最近总在怠工，老板很不满意。
怠工.en: He's been slacking off recently, the boss is very dissatisfied.

怠工.zh: 虽然没罢工，但他们用怠工来表达不满。
怠工.en: Although they didn't strike, they used go-slow to express dissatisfaction.

怠工.zh: 别以为我不知道你在怠工。
怠工.en: Don't think I don't know you're slacking off.

单边.zh: 单边主义在国际上越来越不受欢迎。
他做了个单边的决定，没和任何人商量。
单边.en: He made a unilateral decision without consulting anyone.

单边.zh: 如果单边制裁继续，贸易战可能会升级。
单边.en: If unilateral sanctions continue, the trade war may escalate.

单边.zh: 这种单边行为会破坏合作。
单边.en: This kind of unilateral behavior will damage cooperation.

拉锁.zh: 这件衣服的拉锁不太顺滑。
拉锁.en: The zipper on this clothes is not very smooth.
Help me zip up the zipper.

拉锁.zh: 因为拉锁坏了，我只好换一条裤子。
拉锁.en: Because the zipper broke, I had to change pants.

拉锁.zh: 买包的时候注意拉锁的质量。
拉锁.en: When buying a bag, pay attention to the quality of the zipper.

没准儿.zh: 没准儿明天要下雨，你带把伞吧。
没准儿.en: It might rain tomorrow, bring an umbrella.

没准儿.zh: 虽然现在没消息，但没准儿一会儿就到了。
没准儿.en: Although there's no news now, maybe it will arrive in a while.

没准儿.zh: 你问问他，没准儿他知道答案。
没准儿.en: Ask him, maybe he knows the answer.

抑扬顿挫.zh: 老师朗诵课文时抑扬顿挫，很好听。
抑扬顿挫.en: When the teacher recited the text with cadence, it sounded very nice.

抑扬顿挫.zh: 他的演讲抑扬顿挫，吸引了很多听众。
抑扬顿挫.en: His speech was rhythmic and captivating to many listeners.

抑扬顿挫.zh: 虽然内容一般，但他抑扬顿挫的语调让人印象深刻。
抑扬顿挫.en: Although the content was average, his melodic tone was impressive.

抑扬顿挫.zh: 唱歌也要注意抑扬顿挫。
抑扬顿挫.en: When singing, you also need to pay attention to cadence.

藤椅.en: I like sitting on the rattan chair.

藤椅.zh: 爷爷坐在藤椅上晒太阳。
藤椅.en: Grandpa sits on the rattan chair basking in the sun.
This rattan chair is very comfortable.

藤椅.zh: 因为藤椅很轻，所以搬起来很方便。
藤椅.en: Because the rattan chair is light, it's convenient to move.

藤椅.zh: 夏天的傍晚，他常常躺在藤椅上乘凉。
藤椅.en: On summer evenings, he often lies on the rattan chair to cool off.

心眼儿.zh: 他这人没心眼儿，说话直来直去。
你多个心眼儿，别被骗了。
心眼儿.en: Be a bit more careful, don't get cheated.

心眼儿.zh: 虽然她心眼儿多，但人不坏。
心眼儿.en: Although she is cunning, she's not a bad person.

心眼儿.zh: 这孩子心眼儿实，从不撒谎。
心眼儿.en: This child is honest, never lies.

此致.en: At the end of the letter, it says 'Cizhi'.

此致.zh: 我在信尾写了“此致 敬礼”。
此致.en: I wrote 'Cizhi Jingli' at the end of the letter.

此致.zh: 此致是正式信函的结束语。
此致.en: Cizhi is a formal letter closing.

此致.zh: 因为这是一封正式信函，所以要用“此致”结尾。
此致.en: Because this is a formal letter, it should end with 'Cizhi'.

此致.zh: 他在邮件末尾用了“此致”，显得很礼貌。
此致.en: He used 'Cizhi' at the end of the email, which seemed very polite.

有的放矢.en: Studying should have a clear purpose.

有的放矢.zh: 他做事总是有的放矢，不会浪费时间。
有的放矢.en: He always does things with a clear goal, never wasting time.

有的放矢.zh: 广告要有的放矢，针对特定人群。
有的放矢.en: Advertisements need to be targeted at specific groups.

有的放矢.zh: 我们得先了解情况，才能有的放矢地解决问题。
有的放矢.en: We need to understand the situation first to solve problems effectively.

有的放矢.zh: 你说话要有的放矢，别东拉西扯。
有的放矢.en: You need to speak with a point, not ramble on.

概论.en: This is an introduction to philosophy.

概论.zh: 我选修了一门《社会学概论》的课。
概论.en: I took a course called 'Introduction to Sociology'.

概论.zh: 这本《经济学概论》写得通俗易懂。
概论.en: This 'Introduction to Economics' book is written in a simple and easy-to-understand way.

概论.zh: 他正在复习《法学概论》，准备考试。
概论.en: He is reviewing 'Introduction to Law' to prepare for the exam.

概论.zh: 老师让我们先读一遍概论，再讨论细节。
概论.en: The teacher asked us to read the introduction first, then discuss the details.

印刷术.zh: 印刷术是中国的四大发明之一。
印刷术.en: Printing is one of China's four great inventions.

印刷术.zh: 活字印刷术比雕版印刷术更高效。
印刷术.en: Movable type printing is more efficient than block printing.

印刷术.zh: 随着数字印刷术的发展，传统印刷业受到冲击。
印刷术.en: With the development of digital printing, the traditional printing industry has been impacted.

印刷术.zh: 中国古代的印刷术传播到了欧洲，影响了世界。
印刷术.en: Ancient Chinese printing spread to Europe and influenced the world.

印刷术.zh: 我最近在读一本关于印刷术历史的书。
印刷术.en: I've been reading a book about the history of printing.

经久不息.en: The applause lasted a long time.

经久不息.zh: 观众们报以经久不息的掌声。
经久不息.en: The audience responded with sustained applause.

经久不息.zh: 演唱会结束后，欢呼声经久不息。
经久不息.en: After the concert, the cheers went on and on.

经久不息.zh: 他的演讲精彩极了，台下掌声经久不息。
经久不息.en: His speech was so brilliant that the audience's applause was continuous.

经久不息.zh: 那个场景让我感动，掌声经久不息。
经久不息.en: That scene moved me, and the applause didn't stop.

沽名钓誉.zh: 有些网红为了出名，不惜沽名钓誉。
沽名钓誉.en: Some internet celebrities will do anything to gain fame, even fishing for it.

沽名钓誉.zh: 真正做学问的人，不会沽名钓誉。
沽名钓誉.en: True scholars do not fish for fame.

沽名钓誉.zh: 大家都能看出来，他做慈善是为了沽名钓誉。
沽名钓誉.en: Everyone can see that he does charity just to fish for fame.

沽名钓誉.zh: 不要做那种沽名钓誉的事，脚踏实地最重要。
沽名钓誉.en: Don't do things that fish for fame; staying grounded is the most important.

水灵灵.en: These grapes are fresh and juicy.

水灵灵.zh: 她的眼睛水灵灵的，特别好看。
水灵灵.en: Her eyes are bright and lively, very pretty.

水灵灵.zh: 刚摘的青菜水灵灵的，新鲜极了。
水灵灵.en: The freshly picked greens are crisp and extremely fresh.

水灵灵.zh: 水果摊上的樱桃水灵灵的，让人想买。
水灵灵.en: The cherries at the fruit stand look so juicy they make you want to buy them.

水灵灵.zh: 小姑娘皮肤水灵灵的，像剥了壳的鸡蛋。
水灵灵.en: The little girl's skin is smooth and fresh, like a peeled egg.

丢三落四.zh: 出门前检查一下，别丢三落四。
丢三落四.en: Check before you leave so you don't forget anything.

丢三落四.zh: 我这人记性不好，经常丢三落四。
丢三落四.en: I have a bad memory and often forget things.

丢三落四.zh: 她丢三落四的毛病什么时候能改改？
丢三落四.en: When will she fix her habit of being forgetful?

丢三落四.zh: 今天早上又丢三落四，把钥匙忘在家里了。
丢三落四.en: This morning I was forgetful again and left my keys at home.

沾光.zh: 我们去他家吃饭，他也跟着沾光。
沾光.en: We went to his place for a meal, and he got to benefit too.

沾光.zh: 这次项目成功了，我们大家都沾光了。
沾光.en: This project succeeded, and we all benefited from it.

沾光.zh: 你别总想着沾光，自己也得努力。
沾光.en: Don't always think about getting a free ride; you need to work hard too.

沾光.zh: 他借了你的车用，也算沾光了。
沾光.en: He borrowed your car, so he got some benefit from it.

简体字.en: This character is a simplified one.

简体字.zh: 我们学的是简体字，不是繁体字。
简体字.en: We learn simplified characters, not traditional ones.

简体字.zh: 在中国大陆，大家一般用简体字写字。
简体字.en: In mainland China, people usually write in simplified characters.

简体字.zh: 他习惯写简体字，繁体字写不好。
简体字.en: He is used to writing simplified characters and can't write traditional well.

简体字.zh: 这本书是用简体字出版的。
简体字.en: This book is published in simplified characters.

腊月.en: In the twelfth lunar month, everyone is busy preparing for the New Year.

腊月.zh: 腊月二十四，我们家要扫尘。
腊月.en: On the 24th of the twelfth lunar month, our family does the spring cleaning.

腊月.zh: 腊月是农历年最后一个月，很热闹。
腊月.en: The twelfth lunar month is the last month of the lunar year, and it's very lively.

腊月.zh: 老人说腊月结婚不吉利，所以很少有人选这个时候。
腊月.en: The elderly say it's unlucky to get married in the twelfth lunar month, so few choose this time.

腊月.zh: 腊月里的腊八粥特别香。
腊月.en: The Laba porridge in the twelfth lunar month is especially fragrant.

大包大揽.zh: 他总喜欢大包大揽，结果把自己累坏了。
大包大揽.en: He always likes to take on everything himself, and ends up exhausting himself.

大包大揽.zh: 别什么事都大包大揽，要学会分配任务。
大包大揽.en: Don't take on everything yourself; learn to delegate tasks.

大包大揽.zh: 虽然他很热心，但大包大揽反而让团队效率变低了。
大包大揽.en: Although he is enthusiastic, taking on everything actually reduces team efficiency.

大包大揽.zh: 她一个人大包大揽了所有家务，连周末都不休息。
大包大揽.en: She took on all the household chores by herself, not even resting on weekends.

大包大揽.zh: 这次项目你大包大揽可不行，得让其他人也参与进来。
大包大揽.en: You can't take on the whole project yourself this time; you need to let others join in.

朱红.zh: 这件衣服选朱红色很好看。
朱红.en: This piece of clothing looks great in vermillion.

朱红.zh: 故宫的城墙都是朱红色的，非常庄重。
朱红.en: The walls of the Forbidden City are all vermillion, very solemn.

朱红.zh: 他买了一支朱红色的钢笔，写字特别有感觉。
朱红.en: He bought a vermillion fountain pen, and writing with it feels special.

朱红.zh: 婚礼上新娘穿的旗袍是朱红色的，显得喜气洋洋。
朱红.en: The bride's cheongsam at the wedding was vermillion, looking very festive.

朱红.zh: 这幅画用了大量朱红和金色，看起来很有节日气氛。
朱红.en: This painting uses a lot of vermillion and gold, giving it a festive atmosphere.

由此看来.zh: 由此看来，他确实没有说谎。
由此看来.en: From this perspective, he really didn't lie.

由此看来.zh: 温度一直下降，由此看来冬天快到了。
由此看来.en: The temperature keeps dropping; from this it seems winter is coming.

由此看来.zh: 他连续迟到三次，由此看来他对这份工作不太认真。
由此看来.en: He has been late three times in a row; from this it seems he is not very serious about this job.

由此看来.zh: 大家都同意这个方案，由此看来你的提议很受欢迎。
由此看来.en: Everyone agrees with this plan; from this it seems your proposal is very popular.

由此看来.zh: 销售数据一直在涨，由此看来今年业绩应该不错。
由此看来.en: Sales data has been rising; from this it seems the performance this year should be good.

悲欢离合.en: Life always has joys and sorrows.

悲欢离合.zh: 这本书讲了一家人的悲欢离合。
悲欢离合.en: This book tells about the joys and sorrows of a family.

悲欢离合.zh: 经历了这么多悲欢离合，她变得更坚强了。
悲欢离合.en: After experiencing so many joys and sorrows, she has become stronger.

悲欢离合.zh: 电影里的悲欢离合让我忍不住流泪。
悲欢离合.en: The joys and sorrows in the movie made me can't help crying.

悲欢离合.zh: 朋友之间的悲欢离合是很正常的事，不用太难过。
悲欢离合.en: Joys and sorrows among friends are very normal; don't be too sad.

芦花.en: Reed flowers in autumn are especially beautiful.

芦花.zh: 河边长满了芦花，风一吹就飘起来。
芦花.en: The riverbank is full of reed flowers, which float up when the wind blows.

芦花.zh: 小时候我经常和伙伴们去摘芦花玩。
芦花.en: When I was a child, I often went to pick reed flowers with my friends to play.

芦花.zh: 她喜欢用芦花做装饰，放在花瓶里很别致。
芦花.en: She likes to use reed flowers as decoration; they look very unique in a vase.

芦花.zh: 夕阳下的芦花染上了一层金色，景色美极了。
芦花.en: The reed flowers under the sunset were dyed with a layer of gold; the scene was extremely beautiful.

节气.zh: 你知道今天是什么节气吗？
节气.en: Do you know what solar term it is today?

节气.zh: 立春是二十四节气中的第一个。
节气.en: Start of Spring is the first of the 24 solar terms.

节气.zh: 每个节气都有不同的习俗和饮食习惯。
节气.en: Each solar term has different customs and dietary habits.

节气.zh: 农民种地全靠节气来安排时间。
节气.en: Farmers rely entirely on solar terms to schedule their farming.

节气.zh: 到了霜降这个节气，天气就开始变冷了。
节气.en: When the solar term Frost's Descent arrives, the weather starts to get cold.

连滚带爬.zh: 他摔了一跤，连滚带爬地站起来。
连滚带爬.en: He fell down and scrambled back up.

连滚带爬.zh: 听到警报，大家连滚带爬地往外跑。
连滚带爬.en: Hearing the alarm, everyone scrambled to run outside.

连滚带爬.zh: 那只小狗连滚带爬地追着球跑。
连滚带爬.en: The little dog scrambled after the ball.

连滚带爬.zh: 山路太陡了，我们几乎是连滚带爬才下来的。
连滚带爬.en: The mountain path was so steep that we almost scrambled all the way down.

连滚带爬.zh: 他连滚带爬地躲过了那辆失控的车。
连滚带爬.en: He scrambled out of the way of that out-of-control car.

朝三暮四.zh: 他这个人朝三暮四，不可靠。
谈恋爱最怕遇到朝三暮四的人。
朝三暮四.en: In a relationship, the worst is to meet someone who is fickle.

朝三暮四.zh: 她换工作太频繁了，简直朝三暮四。
朝三暮四.en: She changes jobs too frequently; it's simply fickle.

朝三暮四.zh: 朝三暮四的人很难在事业上取得成功。
朝三暮四.en: Fickle people find it hard to succeed in their careers.

朝三暮四.zh: 如果你总是朝三暮四，朋友也会慢慢离开你的。
朝三暮四.en: If you are always fickle, friends will gradually leave you.

内需.zh: 拉动内需是当前经济重点。
内需.en: Boosting domestic demand is the current economic priority.

内需.zh: 政府出台了很多政策来刺激内需。
内需.en: The government has introduced many policies to stimulate domestic demand.

内需.zh: 内需不足会导致经济增速放缓。
内需.en: Insufficient domestic demand can lead to a slowdown in economic growth.

内需.zh: 扩大内需要提高老百姓的消费能力。
内需.en: Expanding domestic demand requires increasing people's purchasing power.

内需.zh: 疫情过后，内需正在慢慢恢复。
内需.en: After the pandemic, domestic demand is slowly recovering.

敦厚.en: He is an honest and sincere person.

敦厚.zh: 这家店的老板很敦厚，从不骗客人。
敦厚.en: The owner of this store is very honest and never cheats customers.

敦厚.zh: 她虽然话不多，但为人敦厚，大家都很信任她。
敦厚.en: Although she doesn't talk much, she is honest and sincere; everyone trusts her.

敦厚.zh: 敦厚的性格让他交到了很多真心的朋友。
敦厚.en: His honest and sincere personality has helped him make many true friends.

敦厚.zh: 在职场里，光有敦厚还不够，还得学会随机应变。
敦厚.en: In the workplace, being honest and sincere is not enough; you also need to learn to adapt.

禅杖.zh: 师父的禅杖放在角落里。
禅杖.en: The master's monk's staff is placed in the corner.

禅杖.zh: 他拿起禅杖，轻轻敲了一下地板。
禅杖.en: He picked up the monk's staff and gently tapped the floor.

禅杖.zh: 虽然禅杖很重，但他还是单手举了起来。
禅杖.en: Although the monk's staff is heavy, he still lifted it with one hand.

禅杖.zh: 庙里那根禅杖据说已经有几百年历史了。
禅杖.en: That monk's staff in the temple is said to be several hundred years old.

禅杖.zh: 每次做法事的时候，他都会把禅杖擦得干干净净。
禅杖.en: Every time he performs a ritual, he cleans the monk's staff thoroughly.

老伴儿.zh: 我老伴儿今天去买菜了。
老伴儿.en: My spouse went grocery shopping today.

老伴儿.zh: 她和老伴儿一起住了四十年。
老伴儿.en: She has lived with her spouse for forty years.

老伴儿.zh: 退休以后，我就和老伴儿到处旅游。
老伴儿.en: After retirement, I travel everywhere with my spouse.

老伴儿.zh: 虽然老伴儿有时候唠叨，但我知道他是为我好。
老伴儿.en: Although my spouse sometimes nags, I know it's for my own good.

老伴儿.zh: 邻居家的老两口感情特别好，老伴儿每天都陪她散步。
老伴儿.en: The old couple next door have a great relationship; her spouse accompanies her for a walk every day.

前仰后合.en: He laughed so hard he rocked back and forth.

前仰后合.zh: 看了那个小品，观众们前仰后合。
前仰后合.en: After watching that skit, the audience was rocking with laughter.

前仰后合.zh: 她讲了个笑话，大家笑得前仰后合，眼泪都出来了。
前仰后合.en: She told a joke, and everyone laughed so hard they were rocking back and forth with tears in their eyes.

前仰后合.zh: 虽然剧情有点老套，但那个搞笑片段还是让我前仰后合。
前仰后合.en: Although the plot was a bit cliché, that funny scene still made me rock with laughter.

前仰后合.zh: 别逗我了，我已经笑得前仰后合，再笑肚子就要疼了。
前仰后合.en: Stop making me laugh; I'm already rocking back and forth, and if I laugh more my stomach will hurt.

书橱.en: This bookcase is a bit old.

书橱.zh: 他把所有小说都放在书橱里。
书橱.en: He put all the novels in the bookcase.

书橱.zh: 新买的书橱很大，能装下几百本书。
书橱.en: The newly bought bookcase is very large, able to hold several hundred books.

书橱.zh: 书橱上面那层放的都是他最喜欢的诗集。
书橱.en: The top shelf of the bookcase is filled with his favorite poetry collections.

书橱.zh: 我想买一个玻璃门的书橱，这样灰尘就不会落进去了。
书橱.en: I want to buy a bookcase with a glass door so dust won't get inside.

红扑扑.zh: 跑完步回来，他脸上红扑扑的。
红扑扑.en: After running, his face was rosy.

红扑扑.zh: 小孩子在雪地里玩了一会儿，小脸蛋红扑扑的。
红扑扑.en: The child played in the snow for a while, and his little face was rosy.

红扑扑.zh: 冬天从外面回来，他的鼻子冻得红扑扑的，特别可爱。
红扑扑.en: Coming back from outside in winter, his nose was red from the cold, looking very cute.

红扑扑.zh: 她喝了一小杯酒，脸上立刻泛起红扑扑的颜色。
红扑扑.en: She drank a small glass of wine, and her face immediately turned a rosy color.

迭起.en: Applause arose wave after wave, and the atmosphere was lively.

迭起.zh: 电影情节高潮迭起，让人目不转睛。
迭起.en: The movie's plot had one climax after another, keeping viewers riveted.

迭起.zh: 比赛进行到最后一节，精彩场面迭起，观众都沸腾了。
迭起.en: As the game entered the final quarter, exciting scenes arose one after another, and the crowd erupted.

迭起.zh: 这场演唱会从开始到结束，欢呼声此起彼伏、高潮迭起。
迭起.en: From start to finish, the concert had cheers rising and falling, with climaxes arising repeatedly.

迭起.zh: 最近他的作品获奖的消息迭起，让他成了圈内热议的人物。
迭起.en: Recently, news of his works winning awards has come in waves, making him a hot topic in the industry.

船桨.en: The paddle fell into the water.

船桨.zh: 他用力划动船桨，小船飞快地前进。
船桨.en: He rowed hard with the paddle, and the boat moved forward quickly.

船桨.zh: 以前没有马达的时候，渔民全靠船桨划船。
船桨.en: In the past when there were no motors, fishermen relied entirely on paddles to row boats.

船桨.zh: 湖面上静悄悄的，只听见船桨拨水的声音。
船桨.en: The lake was quiet, with only the sound of paddles slicing through the water.

船桨.zh: 他买了新船桨，打算周末去湖上划船。
船桨.en: He bought new paddles and plans to go rowing on the lake this weekend.

槐树.en: This locust tree is very tall.

槐树.zh: 夏天我们在槐树下乘凉。
槐树.en: In summer we cool off under the locust tree.

槐树.zh: 老家的院子里有一棵上百年的槐树。
槐树.en: There is a centuries-old locust tree in the yard of my hometown.

槐树.zh: 槐树开花的时候，整个街道都是香味。
槐树.en: When the locust tree blooms, the whole street is filled with fragrance.

槐树.zh: 虽然槐树长得慢，但它的木材质地很坚硬。
槐树.en: Although locust trees grow slowly, their wood has a very hard texture.

大模大样.zh: 那只猫大模大样地躺在路中间。
大模大样.en: That cat lay right in the middle of the road as if it owned the place.

大模大样.zh: 他大模大样地坐在第一排，完全不管别人怎么看。
大模大样.en: He sat down in the front row very nonchalantly, completely ignoring what others thought.

大模大样.zh: 即使犯了错，他还是大模大样地不肯认错。
大模大样.en: Even after making a mistake, he still acted arrogant and refused to admit it.

大模大样.zh: 那个陌生人居然大模大样地进了我们公司，没人拦住他。
大模大样.en: That stranger actually waltzed right into our company, and nobody stopped him.

贺信.zh: 公司给每位员工发了新年贺信。
贺信.en: The company sent a New Year's congratulatory letter to every employee.

贺信.zh: 校长在毕业典礼上宣读了家长代表写的贺信。
贺信.en: The principal read aloud the congratulatory letter written by a parent representative at the graduation ceremony.

贺信.zh: 他写了一封热情洋溢的贺信，祝贺老朋友升职。
贺信.en: He wrote a warm and heartfelt congratulatory letter to his old friend on the promotion.

贺信.zh: 虽然只是简短的贺信，但字里行间充满了真诚的祝福。
贺信.en: Although it was just a brief congratulatory letter, between the lines it was filled with sincere wishes.

哗变.zh: 听说那艘军舰上发生了哗变。
哗变.en: I heard there was a mutiny on that warship.

哗变.zh: 士兵们因为不满待遇，居然策划哗变。
哗变.en: The soldiers, dissatisfied with their treatment, actually planned a mutiny.

哗变.zh: 历史上几次著名的哗变都改变了战争走向。
哗变.en: Several famous mutinies in history changed the course of wars.

哗变.zh: 如果长官再不改善条件，恐怕会引起哗变。
哗变.en: If the officer doesn't improve conditions soon, a mutiny might break out.

哗变.zh: 那次哗变被及时镇压了，但影响很大。
哗变.en: That mutiny was suppressed in time, but it had a big impact.

冰棍儿.zh: 天气太热了，我想吃根冰棍儿。
冰棍儿.en: It's too hot; I want to eat a popsicle.

冰棍儿.zh: 小时候我最喜欢绿豆味的冰棍儿。
冰棍儿.en: When I was little, I liked mung bean flavored popsicles the most.

冰棍儿.zh: 你帮我在冰箱里拿根冰棍儿，行吗？
冰棍儿.en: Can you get me a popsicle from the fridge?

冰棍儿.zh: 这种老式冰棍儿现在很难买到了。
冰棍儿.en: This kind of old-fashioned popsicle is hard to find nowadays.

冰棍儿.zh: 虽然天气冷，但他还是坚持吃了一根冰棍儿。
冰棍儿.en: Even though it was cold, he still insisted on eating a popsicle.

节衣缩食.zh: 为了买房，他们一直节衣缩食。
节衣缩食.en: They have been living frugally to buy a house.

节衣缩食.zh: 那几年我家节衣缩食才攒够了学费。
节衣缩食.en: In those years, my family scrimped and saved to afford tuition.

节衣缩食.zh: 他靠着节衣缩食，终于还清了所有债务。
节衣缩食.en: By living frugally, he finally paid off all his debts.

节衣缩食.zh: 父母节衣缩食供我读书，我很感激。
节衣缩食.en: My parents scrimped and saved to support my education, and I'm very grateful.

节衣缩食.zh: 其实没必要这么节衣缩食，生活质量也很重要。
节衣缩食.en: Actually, there's no need to be so frugal; quality of life is also important.

张灯结彩.zh: 春节时街上张灯结彩，特别热闹。
张灯结彩.en: During Spring Festival, the streets are decorated with lanterns and bunting, very lively.

张灯结彩.zh: 为了庆祝国庆，整个城市都张灯结彩。
张灯结彩.en: To celebrate National Day, the whole city was festooned with lanterns and decorations.

张灯结彩.zh: 婚礼现场张灯结彩，充满了喜庆气氛。
张灯结彩.en: The wedding venue was decorated with lanterns and bunting, full of joyous atmosphere.

张灯结彩.zh: 商场里张灯结彩，提醒人们圣诞节快到了。
张灯结彩.en: The mall is all decked out with lanterns, reminding people that Christmas is coming.

张灯结彩.zh: 他们张灯结彩，准备迎接远方来的客人。
张灯结彩.en: They decorated with lanterns and banners, preparing to welcome guests from afar.

电铃.zh: 下课电铃响了，学生们冲出教室。
电铃.en: The class bell rang, and students rushed out of the classroom.

电铃.zh: 你听见电铃响了吗？该去开门了。
电铃.en: Did you hear the doorbell? You should go open the door.

电铃.zh: 宿舍的电铃坏了，报修也没人管。
电铃.en: The dormitory bell is broken, and no one responds to the repair request.

电铃.zh: 早上电铃一响，我就立刻起床了。
电铃.en: As soon as the electric bell rang in the morning, I got up immediately.

电铃.zh: 这种老式电铃声音很大，整层楼都听得见。
电铃.en: This old-fashioned electric bell is very loud; you can hear it on the whole floor.

公函.zh: 收到一份公函，需要你签字。
公函.en: An official letter has arrived; it needs your signature.

公函.zh: 公司之间的合作事宜通常用公函沟通。
公函.en: Matters of cooperation between companies are usually communicated via official letters.

公函.zh: 这份公函的格式不太规范，要重新写。
公函.en: The format of this official letter is not standard; it needs to be rewritten.

公函.zh: 他花了一上午起草给上级单位的公函。
公函.en: He spent the whole morning drafting an official letter to the higher authority.

公函.zh: 所有公函必须存档，以便日后查阅。
公函.en: All official letters must be filed for future reference.

陶冶.zh: 多听古典音乐能陶冶情操。
陶冶.en: Listening to classical music can cultivate one's sentiments.

陶冶.zh: 读书可以陶冶性情，让人更平和。
陶冶.en: Reading can nurture one's temperament and make one calmer.

陶冶.zh: 他喜欢用书法来陶冶自己的心性。
陶冶.en: He likes to use calligraphy to cultivate his mind.

陶冶.zh: 旅行不仅能开阔眼界，还能陶冶心灵。
陶冶.en: Travel can not only broaden one's horizons but also nourish the soul.

陶冶.zh: 父母希望孩子从小接受艺术熏陶，陶冶品格。
陶冶.en: Parents hope their children receive artistic influence from a young age to cultivate character.

碰钉子.zh: 他去借钱，结果碰钉子了。
碰钉子.en: He went to borrow money and ended up being rebuffed.

碰钉子.zh: 第一次面试就碰钉子，他有点沮丧。
碰钉子.en: He hit a snag at his first interview and felt a bit frustrated.

碰钉子.zh: 别去求他了，你肯定会碰钉子。
碰钉子.en: Don't go ask him; you'll definitely be turned down.

碰钉子.zh: 他做事太冲动，经常碰钉子。
碰钉子.en: He acts too impulsively and often meets with setbacks.

各奔前程.zh: 毕业后同学们各奔前程了。
各奔前程.en: After graduation, classmates went their separate ways.

各奔前程.zh: 既然理念不同，不如各奔前程。
各奔前程.en: Since we have different ideas, we might as well go our own ways.

各奔前程.zh: 乐队解散后，成员们各奔前程。
各奔前程.en: After the band broke up, the members each pursued their own careers.

各奔前程.zh: 离婚后两人各奔前程，再也没有联系。
各奔前程.en: After the divorce, the two went their separate ways and never contacted each other again.

各奔前程.zh: 虽然舍不得，但我们都得各奔前程了。
各奔前程.en: Although reluctant, we all have to go our separate ways now.

别具匠心.zh: 这个园林设计别具匠心。
别具匠心.en: The design of this garden shows great ingenuity.

别具匠心.zh: 他的画作构图别具匠心，令人赞叹。
别具匠心.en: The composition of his painting is ingenious and admirable.

别具匠心.zh: 那座桥的造型别具匠心，是当地一景。
别具匠心.en: The design of that bridge is uniquely ingenious and a local attraction.

别具匠心.zh: 她给礼物包装得别具匠心，朋友非常惊喜。
别具匠心.en: She wrapped the gift in an ingenious way, and her friend was pleasantly surprised.

别具匠心.zh: 这家酒店的装修别具匠心，每个房间都不同。
别具匠心.en: The decoration of this hotel is uniquely creative; each room is different.

暖烘烘.en: The room is nice and warm, so comfortable.

暖烘烘.zh: 太阳晒得我身上暖烘烘的，都不想动了。
暖烘烘.en: The sun makes my body warm and cozy, I don't want to move.

暖烘烘.zh: 虽然外面很冷，但壁炉让客厅暖烘烘的。
暖烘烘.en: Although it's cold outside, the fireplace keeps the living room warm.

暖烘烘.zh: 刚出锅的包子暖烘烘的，咬一口真香。
暖烘烘.en: The freshly steamed buns are warm and fragrant when you bite into them.

暖烘烘.zh: 他递给我一杯热茶，手心立刻暖烘烘的。
暖烘烘.en: He handed me a cup of hot tea, and my palm immediately felt warm.

见钱眼开.zh: 他这人见钱眼开，没出息。
见钱眼开.en: He's the kind who gets excited at the sight of money, no ambition.

见钱眼开.zh: 别指望他能帮你，他见钱眼开，只认钱。
见钱眼开.en: Don't expect him to help you; he's money-grubbing and only cares about money.

见钱眼开.zh: 那个老板见钱眼开，什么生意都敢接。
见钱眼开.en: That boss is money-driven; he'll take any business deal.

见钱眼开.zh: 虽然她平时挺和气的，但一谈钱就见钱眼开。
见钱眼开.en: Although she's usually friendly, she becomes money-grubbing when it comes to money.

见钱眼开.zh: 他见钱眼开的性格让朋友们都远离了他。
见钱眼开.en: His money-grubbing nature made his friends stay away from him.

爱理不理.zh: 他对我爱理不理的，真让人生气。
爱理不理.en: He's ignoring me, which really makes me angry.

爱理不理.zh: 服务员爱理不理的态度，我下次不来了。
爱理不理.en: The waiter's indifferent attitude—I won't come here again.

爱理不理.zh: 最近他总爱理不理的，是不是我惹到他了？
爱理不理.en: He's been acting aloof lately—did I upset him?

爱理不理.zh: 我问了她好几遍，她爱理不理地回了一句。
爱理不理.en: I asked her several times, but she just replied indifferently.

爱理不理.zh: 你要是总爱理不理的，朋友都会走光的。
爱理不理.en: If you keep acting cold and distant, you'll lose all your friends.

奇花异草.zh: 这个花园里有很多奇花异草。
奇花异草.en: This garden has many exotic flowers and rare plants.

奇花异草.zh: 他喜欢收集各种奇花异草，家里像个植物园。
奇花异草.en: He loves collecting rare flowers and plants; his home is like a botanical garden.

奇花异草.zh: 山上的奇花异草吸引了无数游客来拍照。
奇花异草.en: The exotic flowers and rare plants on the mountain attract countless tourists to take photos.

奇花异草.zh: 春天到了，山野里开满了奇花异草，美极了。
奇花异草.en: Spring has arrived, and the mountains are full of exotic flowers — it's beautiful.

奇花异草.zh: 虽然那些奇花异草很漂亮，但有些有毒，不能乱碰。
奇花异草.en: Although those exotic plants are beautiful, some are poisonous, so don't touch them randomly.

有口无心.zh: 他说话有口无心，你别在意。
有口无心.en: He speaks without thinking; don't take it to heart.

有口无心.zh: 我知道她是有口无心的，不是故意伤害你。
有口无心.en: I know she said it without meaning it; she didn't intend to hurt you.

有口无心.zh: 他这个人有口无心，说完就忘了。
有口无心.en: He's the type who speaks carelessly and forgets right after.

有口无心.zh: 虽然她骂了几句，但我知道她有口无心，还是关心我的。
有口无心.en: Although she scolded me, I know she didn't mean it — she still cares about me.

有口无心.zh: 朋友之间吵架常有口无心，过去就好。
有口无心.en: Friends often say things without meaning it when arguing; it'll pass.

帐子.zh: 夏天睡觉要挂帐子，不然蚊子太多。
帐子.en: You need to hang a mosquito net in summer, otherwise there are too many mosquitoes.

帐子.zh: 这种老式帐子现在很少见了。
帐子.en: This old-style bed curtain is rarely seen nowadays.

帐子.zh: 他把帐子放下来，挡住外面的光。
帐子.en: He lowered the bed curtain to block the outside light.

帐子.zh: 我小时候总喜欢躲在帐子里玩手电筒。
帐子.en: When I was a kid, I loved hiding inside the mosquito net and playing with a flashlight.

帐子.zh: 帐子破了几个洞，得赶紧补一补。
帐子.en: The mosquito net has a few holes — it needs to be mended quickly.

深情厚谊.zh: 我们之间有着多年的深情厚谊。
深情厚谊.en: We share years of deep friendship and affection.

深情厚谊.zh: 这份深情厚谊，我会永远记在心里。
深情厚谊.en: This deep friendship, I will always keep in my heart.

深情厚谊.zh: 虽然分别多年，但我们的深情厚谊从未改变。
深情厚谊.en: Although we've been apart for years, our deep bond has never changed.

深情厚谊.zh: 他帮了我那么多，这份深情厚谊我无以为报。
深情厚谊.en: He helped me so much; I have no way to repay such deep friendship.

深情厚谊.zh: 战友之间的深情厚谊，旁人很难理解。
深情厚谊.en: The deep friendship between comrades-in-arms is hard for outsiders to understand.

半真半假.zh: 他说话半真半假，我都不敢信。
半真半假.en: He speaks half-truths; I don't dare believe him.

半真半假.zh: 这个故事半真半假，听个乐就行。
半真半假.en: This story is half true and half false — just take it as entertainment.

半真半假.zh: 她开玩笑时总带点半真半假的意思，让人猜不透。
半真半假.en: When she jokes, she always mixes truth and fiction, making it hard to read her.

半真半假.zh: 我知道他说的那些话半真半假，但也不想拆穿。
半真半假.en: I know what he said is only half true, but I don't want to call him out.

半真半假.zh: 这种半真半假的流言传得最快，最伤人。
半真半假.en: This kind of half-truth rumor spreads the fastest and hurts the most.

有两下子.zh: 他做饭有两下子，不信你尝尝。
有两下子.en: He's pretty good at cooking — just try it.

有两下子.zh: 没想到你还会修电脑，确实有两下子。
有两下子.en: I didn't know you could fix computers — you're really skilled.

有两下子.zh: 他在球场上确实有两下子，谁都防不住。
有两下子.en: He's really something on the court — no one can guard him.

有两下子.zh: 别小看他，他虽然年轻，但做事有两下子。
有两下子.en: Don't underestimate him — though young, he's got skills.

有两下子.zh: 她学外语特别快，看来语言方面真有两下子。
有两下子.en: She picks up foreign languages really fast — she's definitely talented with languages.

乘人之危.zh: 他乘人之危，把价格压得很低。
乘人之危.en: He took advantage of the situation and drove the price way down.

乘人之危.zh: 这种乘人之危的行为，太不道德了。
乘人之危.en: This kind of exploitation is really unethical.

乘人之危.zh: 朋友有困难应该帮忙，而不是乘人之危。
乘人之危.en: When a friend is in trouble, you should help, not take advantage.

乘人之危.zh: 他趁我急需钱用，乘人之危借机勒索。
乘人之危.en: He took advantage of my urgent need for money to extort me.

乘人之危.zh: 别乘人之危，等他缓过来再说。
乘人之危.en: Don't take advantage of him in his time of need; wait until he's better.

穿小鞋.en: The boss always gives me a hard time.

穿小鞋.zh: 就因为我说了实话，他就在工作上给我穿小鞋。
穿小鞋.en: Just because I told the truth, he made things difficult for me at work.

穿小鞋.zh: 她喜欢给人穿小鞋，大家都不喜欢她。
穿小鞋.en: She likes to make trouble for others, everyone dislikes her.

穿小鞋.zh: 虽然我没做错什么，但同事还是给我穿小鞋。
穿小鞋.en: Although I did nothing wrong, my colleague still gives me a hard time.
Be careful, don't let others make trouble for you.

酣畅.zh: 我们聊了一整夜，聊得非常酣畅。
酣畅.en: We talked all night, and it was very satisfying.

酣畅.zh: 他笑得那么酣畅，我也跟着开心。
酣畅.en: He laughed so heartily, I felt happy too.

酣畅.zh: 这场比赛他发挥得酣畅淋漓，所以赢了。
酣畅.en: In this game, he played with great abandon, so he won.
This wine is really satisfying to drink.

如醉如痴.zh: 那部电影太精彩了，我看得如醉如痴。
如醉如痴.en: That movie was so wonderful, I watched it completely absorbed.

如醉如痴.zh: 她读书读到如醉如痴，连饭都忘了吃。
如醉如痴.en: She reads with such absorption that she forgets to eat.

如醉如痴.zh: 因为音乐太美了，他整个人都如醉如痴。
如醉如痴.en: Because the music was so beautiful, he was completely entranced.

耳闻目睹.zh: 我耳闻目睹了整个过程。
这些年我耳闻目睹了很多不公平的事。
耳闻目睹.en: Over the years, I have witnessed many unfair things.

耳闻目睹.zh: 他耳闻目睹的一切让他很震惊。
耳闻目睹.en: Everything he saw and heard shocked him.

耳闻目睹.zh: 虽然我没亲身经历，但耳闻目睹已经让我很难过。
耳闻目睹.en: Although I didn't experience it personally, what I saw and heard already made me very sad.

耳闻目睹.zh: 耳闻目睹，不如亲身体验。
耳闻目睹.en: Seeing and hearing is not as good as personal experience.

万古长青.zh: 愿我们的友谊万古长青。
这种精神会万古长青，代代相传。
万古长青.en: This spirit will be eternal and passed down through generations.

万古长青.zh: 他们用生命换来了祖国的万古长青。
万古长青.en: They traded their lives for the eternal prosperity of the motherland.

万古长青.zh: 虽然时间流逝，但他们的爱情依然万古长青。
万古长青.en: Although time passes, their love remains everlasting.
The deeds of heroes are eternal.

一毛不拔.zh: 每次聚餐他都是一毛不拔，从来不请客。
一毛不拔.en: Every time we have a group meal, he is stingy and never treats.

一毛不拔.zh: 那个老板对员工一毛不拔，太抠门了。
一毛不拔.en: That boss is stingy with employees, too cheap.

一毛不拔.zh: 虽然他很有钱，但还是一毛不拔，真让人无语。
一毛不拔.en: Although he is very rich, he is still stingy, really speechless.
Don't count on him, he's tightfisted.

发愤图强.en: We must strive to become strong.

发愤图强.zh: 他高考失败后发愤图强，终于考上了好大学。
发愤图强.en: After failing the college entrance exam, he worked hard and finally got into a good university.

发愤图强.zh: 国家需要年轻人发愤图强。
发愤图强.en: The country needs young people to strive hard.

发愤图强.zh: 只有发愤图强，才能改变自己的命运。
发愤图强.en: Only by working hard can you change your own destiny.
She has always been striving hard.

默读.zh: 考试的时候，大家都在默读题目。
默读.en: During the exam, everyone was reading the questions silently.

默读.zh: 默读比朗读更容易理解内容。
默读.en: Silent reading is easier to understand content than reading aloud.

默读.zh: 因为图书馆很安静，所以大家都在默读。
默读.en: Because the library is very quiet, everyone is reading silently.
He likes to read the text silently.

纳闷儿.zh: 他突然不说话了，我觉得很纳闷儿。
纳闷儿.en: He suddenly stopped talking, I felt very puzzled.

纳闷儿.zh: 她为什么生气？我挺纳闷儿的。
纳闷儿.en: Why is she angry? I'm quite puzzled.

纳闷儿.zh: 明明说好了，他却没来，真让人纳闷儿。
纳闷儿.en: We clearly agreed, but he didn't come, really puzzling.

忍饥挨饿.zh: 那些难民忍饥挨饿，生活非常艰难。
忍饥挨饿.en: Those refugees endure hunger, life is very hard.

忍饥挨饿.zh: 为了省钱，他宁可忍饥挨饿。
忍饥挨饿.en: To save money, he would rather endure hunger.

忍饥挨饿.zh: 因为家里穷，他经常忍饥挨饿去上学。
忍饥挨饿.en: Because his family was poor, he often went to school hungry.
No one wants to suffer hunger.

山冈.zh: 我们爬上了那个小山冈。
山冈.en: We climbed up that small hill.

山冈.zh: 山冈上开满了野花，看起来特别漂亮。
山冈.en: The hill is covered with wildflowers, and it looks especially beautiful.

山冈.zh: 那个山冈背后有一片小树林。
山冈.en: There is a small forest behind that hill.

山冈.zh: 小时候我们经常在山冈上放风筝。
山冈.en: When we were kids, we often flew kites on the hill.

山冈.zh: 翻过这个山冈就能看到村子了。
山冈.en: Once you cross this hill, you'll see the village.

势不可当.zh: 他们的攻势势不可当，很快就赢了比赛。
势不可当.en: Their attack was irresistible, and they won the game quickly.

势不可当.zh: 年轻人创业的热情势不可当，谁也拦不住。
势不可当.en: The enthusiasm of young entrepreneurs is unstoppable; no one can hold it back.

势不可当.zh: 洪水势不可当，冲垮了堤坝。
势不可当.en: The flood was irresistible and broke the dam.

势不可当.zh: 她学习进步很快，势头势不可当。
势不可当.en: She is making rapid progress in her studies, and her momentum is unstoppable.

侃大山.zh: 我们几个老同学在咖啡馆侃大山。
侃大山.en: A few of us old classmates are chatting at the café.

侃大山.zh: 他特别喜欢跟朋友侃大山，一聊就是半天。
侃大山.en: He really enjoys chatting with friends, and once he starts, he talks for hours.

侃大山.zh: 别光顾着侃大山，工作还没做完呢。
侃大山.en: Don't just sit around chatting; the work isn't done yet.

侃大山.zh: 昨晚我们聚在一起侃大山，聊到凌晨两点。
侃大山.en: Last night we got together and chatted until 2 a.m.

侃大山.zh: 周末没事的时候，我就喜欢找朋友侃大山。
侃大山.en: When I have nothing to do on weekends, I like to find friends and chat.

不耻下问.zh: 他学习很认真，经常不耻下问。
不耻下问.en: He is very serious about learning and often asks questions without feeling ashamed.

不耻下问.zh: 作为领导，她能做到不耻下问，让人佩服。
不耻下问.en: As a leader, she is able to ask questions from subordinates, which earns admiration.

不耻下问.zh: 遇到不懂的问题，我们要不耻下问。
不耻下问.en: When we encounter something we don't understand, we should not be ashamed to ask.

不耻下问.zh: 他虽然是个老教授，却仍然不耻下问，向年轻人请教。
不耻下问.en: Although he is an old professor, he still asks questions humbly and learns from young people.

不耻下问.zh: 不耻下问是进步的关键，别怕丢面子。
不耻下问.en: Being humble enough to ask questions is the key to progress; don't be afraid of losing face.

爆冷门.en: This match had an unexpected result.

爆冷门.zh: 去年的冠军今年第一轮就输了，真是爆冷门。
爆冷门.en: Last year's champion lost in the first round this year; it's really a big upset.

爆冷门.zh: 股市经常爆冷门，很难预测。
爆冷门.en: The stock market often has surprises, making it hard to predict.

爆冷门.zh: 电影票房爆冷门，小成本片子反而大卖。
爆冷门.en: The movie's box office was a surprise; the low-budget film turned out to be a huge hit.

出口成章.zh: 他说话出口成章，特别有文采。
出口成章.en: He speaks eloquently and with great literary flair.

出口成章.zh: 老师讲课出口成章，学生都听得入迷。
出口成章.en: The teacher's lectures are so eloquent that the students are captivated.

出口成章.zh: 别看他平时不爱说话，一开口就出口成章。
出口成章.en: Although he usually doesn't talk much, once he speaks, his words are eloquent.

出口成章.zh: 她写文章出口成章，根本不用打草稿。
出口成章.en: When she writes an essay, the words flow so well that she doesn't even need a draft.

出口成章.zh: 演讲时他出口成章，赢得了满堂彩。
出口成章.en: During the speech, he was so eloquent that he won applause from the whole audience.

飞禽走兽.zh: 这片森林里有很多飞禽走兽。
飞禽走兽.en: There are many birds and beasts in this forest.

飞禽走兽.zh: 他喜欢拍摄野外的飞禽走兽。
飞禽走兽.en: He likes to photograph wild birds and beasts.

飞禽走兽.zh: 公园里虽然有人工湖，但飞禽走兽并不多。
飞禽走兽.en: Although there is an artificial lake in the park, there aren't many birds and beasts.

飞禽走兽.zh: 自然保护区里飞禽走兽自由生活，景象很壮观。
飞禽走兽.en: In the nature reserve, birds and beasts live freely, and the scene is magnificent.

飞禽走兽.zh: 小时候爷爷给我讲了很多关于飞禽走兽的故事。
飞禽走兽.en: When I was little, my grandpa told me many stories about birds and beasts.

饱经沧桑.zh: 这位老人饱经沧桑，脸上满是皱纹。
饱经沧桑.en: This old man has been through many vicissitudes; his face is full of wrinkles.

饱经沧桑.zh: 他的经历饱经沧桑，讲出来就是一部小说。
饱经沧桑.en: His experiences have been full of ups and downs; they could make a novel.

饱经沧桑.zh: 那个老房子已经饱经沧桑，快要倒塌了。
饱经沧桑.en: That old house has weathered many storms and is about to collapse.

饱经沧桑.zh: 她虽然饱经沧桑，但依然乐观向上。
饱经沧桑.en: Although she has experienced many hardships, she remains optimistic and positive.

饱经沧桑.zh: 饱经沧桑的人往往更懂得珍惜生活。
饱经沧桑.en: People who have been through many ups and downs often know better how to cherish life.

个头儿.zh: 他个头儿不高，但跑得很快。
个头儿.en: He is not tall, but he runs very fast.
This apple is really big in size.

个头儿.zh: 他们家的狗个头儿特别大，像头小狮子。
个头儿.en: Their dog is huge, like a little lion.

个头儿.zh: 虽然我俩年龄一样，但他个头儿比我高半头。
个头儿.en: Although we are the same age, he is half a head taller than me.

个头儿.zh: 买西瓜的时候，我喜欢挑个头儿大的。
个头儿.en: When buying watermelons, I like to pick the big ones.

括弧.en: Pay close attention to the words in parentheses.

括弧.zh: 写作文时，解释内容可以用括弧。
括弧.en: When writing an essay, you can use parentheses to explain content.

括弧.zh: 这个公式里的括弧千万别漏掉。
括弧.en: Don't leave out the parentheses in this formula.

括弧.zh: 他说话喜欢加个括弧，补充说明一下。
括弧.en: He likes to add a parenthetical remark when speaking, to give extra explanation.

括弧.zh: 在括号里（英文用括弧）标注了拼音。
括弧.en: Pinyin is marked inside the parentheses (using brackets in English).

造纸术.zh: 造纸术是中国古代四大发明之一。
造纸术.en: Paper-making is one of the four great inventions of ancient China.

造纸术.zh: 如果没有造纸术，我们现在的书可能还是竹简做的。
造纸术.en: Without paper-making, our books today might still be made of bamboo slips.

造纸术.zh: 你知道造纸术是谁发明的吗？
造纸术.en: Do you know who invented paper-making?

造纸术.zh: 虽然造纸术已经发明很久了，但现在的造纸技术还在不断改进。
造纸术.en: Although paper-making was invented a long time ago, paper-making technology is still being improved.

造纸术.zh: 造纸术的传播对世界文化发展影响很大。
造纸术.en: The spread of paper-making had a great impact on the development of world culture.

兜儿.en: I have no money in my pocket.

兜儿.zh: 他把钥匙放进了外套的兜儿里。
兜儿.en: He put the keys into the pocket of his coat.

兜儿.zh: 你兜儿里装的什么？这么鼓。
兜儿.en: What do you have in your pocket? It's so bulging.

兜儿.zh: 我出门忘记带钱包，兜儿里只有几块钱。
兜儿.en: I forgot to bring my wallet when I went out, and I only have a few yuan in my pocket.

兜儿.zh: 他在兜儿里摸索了半天，才找到那张票。
兜儿.en: He fumbled in his pocket for a long time before finding that ticket.

长效.zh: 长效避孕药需要每天按时服用。
长效.en: Long-acting birth control pills need to be taken on time every day.

长效.zh: 我们需要制定一个长效的解决方案。
长效.en: We need to formulate a long-term solution.

长效.zh: 这种肥料是长效的，一次施肥能管三个月。
长效.en: This fertilizer is long-acting; one application can last three months.

长效.zh: 长效管理比短期突击更重要。
长效.en: Long-term management is more important than short-term突击 (intensive efforts).

遂心.en: This matter was handled quite satisfactorily.

遂心.zh: 找工作不容易，想找个遂心的更难。
遂心.en: Finding a job is not easy, and finding one that suits you is even harder.
Have you been doing well lately?

遂心.zh: 虽然他努力了很久，但结果并不遂心。
遂心.en: Although he worked hard for a long time, the result was not satisfactory.

遂心.zh: 生活不可能事事都遂心，要学会调整心态。
遂心.en: Life can't always go your way; you need to learn to adjust your mindset.

敲边鼓.zh: 你别光敲边鼓，说点实际的。
敲边鼓.en: Don't just give sidelong support; say something practical.

敲边鼓.zh: 他在旁边敲边鼓，帮我说了几句好话。
敲边鼓.en: He chimed in from the sidelines, saying a few good words for me.

敲边鼓.zh: 我们需要有人敲边鼓，但主要还得靠自己。
敲边鼓.en: We need someone to back us up, but mainly we have to rely on ourselves.

敲边鼓.zh: 开会时，他一直在敲边鼓，支持我的提案。
敲边鼓.en: During the meeting, he kept backing me up, supporting my proposal.

敲边鼓.zh: 光靠敲边鼓没用，你得自己努力。
敲边鼓.en: Just having someone backing you up is useless; you have to work hard yourself.

刻舟求剑.zh: 你这是刻舟求剑，太死板了。
刻舟求剑.en: You're being too rigid, like carving a mark on the boat.

刻舟求剑.zh: 做事情不能刻舟求剑，要根据情况变化。
刻舟求剑.en: When doing things, you can't be rigid; you have to adapt to changes.

刻舟求剑.zh: 刻舟求剑的故事告诉我们不能墨守成规。
刻舟求剑.en: The story of carving a mark on the boat tells us not to stick to outdated rules.

刻舟求剑.zh: 现在市场变化这么快，你还用老办法，简直是刻舟求剑。
刻舟求剑.en: The market changes so fast now; using old methods is like carving a mark on the boat.

刻舟求剑.zh: 他那种刻舟求剑的想法，根本解决不了问题。
刻舟求剑.en: That rigid thinking of his can't solve the problem at all.

一长一短.en: These two ropes are one long and one short.

一长一短.zh: 他们俩一长一短地聊了很久。
一长一短.en: The two of them chatted about all sorts of things for a long time.

一长一短.zh: 别管他一长一短，先把事情做了。
一长一短.en: Don't worry about the ins and outs; just get the thing done first.

一长一短.zh: 大家坐在一起，一长一短地聊着家常。
一长一短.en: Everyone sat together, chatting about various family matters.

一长一短.zh: 这两条裙子一长一短，你选哪条？
一长一短.en: These two skirts are different lengths; which one do you choose?

鹏程万里.zh: 毕业后，他去了深圳，希望鹏程万里。
鹏程万里.en: After graduation, he went to Shenzhen, hoping for a great future.

鹏程万里.zh: 年轻人要有鹏程万里的志向。
鹏程万里.en: Young people should have ambitious aspirations.

鹏程万里.zh: 在这个新岗位上，我相信你能鹏程万里，大有作为。
鹏程万里.en: In this new position, I believe you can have a bright future and achieve great things.

鹏程万里.zh: 我们祝愿公司鹏程万里，生意兴隆。
鹏程万里.en: We wish the company a bright future and prosperous business.

闹着玩儿.zh: 我是闹着玩儿的，你别当真。
闹着玩儿.en: I was just joking; don't take it seriously.

闹着玩儿.zh: 他闹着玩儿地推了我一下，结果我摔倒了。
闹着玩儿.en: He jokingly pushed me, and I ended up falling.

闹着玩儿.zh: 这事儿可不是闹着玩儿的，要小心。
闹着玩儿.en: This is no joke; you need to be careful.

闹着玩儿.zh: 你们别闹着玩儿了，赶紧把作业写完。
闹着玩儿.en: Stop fooling around and finish your homework quickly.

闹着玩儿.zh: 我以为他是闹着玩儿，没想到他真的生气了。
闹着玩儿.en: I thought he was kidding, but unexpectedly he got really angry.

啰唆.en: Don't be so wordy; just get to the point.

啰唆.zh: 他说话太啰唆，每次都要讲半天。
啰唆.en: He's too long-winded; he talks for ages every time.

啰唆.zh: 妈妈虽然啰唆，但都是为我好。
啰唆.en: Although Mom is verbose, it's all for my own good.

啰唆.zh: 你写文章要注意简洁，不要啰唆。
啰唆.en: When writing an article, you should be concise and not wordy.

得意扬扬.zh: 他得了第一名，得意扬扬地走了。
得意扬扬.en: He got first place and walked away smugly.

得意扬扬.zh: 别得意扬扬的，下次考试你未必能赢。
得意扬扬.en: Don't be so cocky; you might not win the next exam.

得意扬扬.zh: 她听到表扬后，脸上露出得意扬扬的表情。
得意扬扬.en: After hearing the praise, she wore a smug expression on her face.

得意扬扬.zh: 虽然赢了比赛，但他并没有得意扬扬，反而很谦虚。
得意扬扬.en: Although he won the game, he didn't get cocky; instead, he was very humble.

得意扬扬.zh: 大家看他得意扬扬的样子，都觉得有点好笑。
得意扬扬.en: Everyone thought it was a bit funny when they saw him looking so pleased with himself.

随大溜.zh: 他没什么主见，总是随大溜。
随大溜.en: He has no opinions of his own and always follows the crowd.

随大溜.zh: 买东西别光随大溜，得看自己需要什么。
随大溜.en: Don't just follow the crowd when shopping; see what you actually need.

随大溜.zh: 大家都去旅游了，他也随大溜报了个团。
随大溜.en: Everyone was traveling, so he also followed the crowd and joined a tour group.

随大溜.zh: 虽然觉得不太对，但她还是随大溜投了赞成票。
随大溜.en: Although she felt it wasn't quite right, she still went along with the majority and voted yes.

随大溜.zh: 我不喜欢随大溜，我宁愿做自己喜欢的事。
随大溜.en: I don't like to follow the crowd; I prefer to do what I enjoy.

廉正.zh: 这位官员非常廉正，从不收礼。
廉正.en: This official is very honest and incorruptible; he never accepts gifts.

廉正.zh: 廉正是一名公务员最基本的素质。
廉正.en: Integrity is the most basic quality of a public servant.

廉正.zh: 公司要求所有员工保持廉正的工作作风。
廉正.en: The company requires all employees to maintain a work style of integrity.

廉正.zh: 群众都夸他廉正，是个难得的好官。
廉正.en: The public all praise him for his integrity; he is a rare good official.

廉正.zh: 只有坚持廉正，才能赢得人民的信任。
廉正.en: Only by upholding integrity can one win the trust of the people.

办不到.zh: 这件事太难了，我办不到。
办不到.en: This matter is too difficult; I can't do it.

办不到.zh: 他答应明天交稿，可我实在办不到。
办不到.en: He promised to submit the manuscript tomorrow, but I really can't make it.

办不到.zh: 想让我借钱给他？那绝对办不到。
办不到.en: Want me to lend him money? That's absolutely impossible.

办不到.zh: 你要求一天内完成这么多工作，根本办不到。
办不到.en: You're asking me to finish this much work in one day; it's simply impossible.

办不到.zh: 虽然我很想帮你，但这件事我真的办不到。
办不到.en: Although I really want to help you, I truly can't do this.

报亭.en: I'm going to the newsstand to buy a newspaper.

报亭.zh: 街角的报亭关门了，我们换个地方吧。
报亭.en: The newsstand on the corner is closed; let's go somewhere else.

报亭.zh: 他在报亭买了一本杂志和一瓶水。
报亭.en: He bought a magazine and a bottle of water at the newsstand.

报亭.zh: 现在报亭越来越少，大家都用手机看新闻了。
报亭.en: Now there are fewer and fewer newsstands; everyone reads news on their phones.

报亭.zh: 每天早上，他都会在报亭前停下来看看新出的报纸。
报亭.en: Every morning, he stops at the newsstand to look at the newly arrived newspapers.

别提了.en: Don't even mention it; today was so unlucky.

别提了.zh: 那件事别提了，想起来就烦。
别提了.en: Don't even mention that matter; it annoys me just thinking about it.

别提了.zh: 别提了，我昨天考试考砸了。
别提了.en: Don't even mention it; I totally failed my exam yesterday.

别提了.zh: 上次的旅行别提了，全程都在下雨。
别提了.en: Don't even mention the last trip; it rained the whole time.

别提了.zh: 他最近过得怎么样？——别提了，工作特别不顺利。
别提了.en: How has he been lately? — Don't even mention it; work has been going very badly.

不服气.en: Even if I lose, I don't accept it.

不服气.zh: 他对我有意见，心里一直不服气。
不服气.en: He has a grudge against me and has never been convinced.

不服气.zh: 她输了比赛，但表示不服气，要求再比一次。
不服气.en: She lost the match but said she didn't accept it and demanded a rematch.

不服气.zh: 看到别人拿奖，他有点不服气，觉得自己更努力。
不服气.en: Seeing others win awards, he felt a bit envious and unconvinced, thinking he worked harder.

不服气.zh: 虽然教练选了他，但其他队员都很不服气。
不服气.en: Although the coach chose him, the other team members were very resentful.

操控.zh: 他操控着无人机飞得很高。
操控.en: He controlled the drone and flew it very high.

操控.zh: 别想操控我的想法，我有自己的判断。
操控.en: Don't try to manipulate my thoughts; I have my own judgment.

操控.zh: 这台机器需要专业人士来操控。
操控.en: This machine requires a professional to operate it.

操控.zh: 幕后有人在操控整个事件，我们都被骗了。
操控.en: Someone behind the scenes was manipulating the whole incident; we were all deceived.

操控.zh: 家长不该过度操控孩子的生活，要学会放手。
操控.en: Parents shouldn't over-control their children's lives; they need to learn to let go.

茶馆儿.zh: 我们去茶馆儿喝杯茶吧。
茶馆儿.en: Let's go to a tea house for a cup of tea.

茶馆儿.zh: 胡同口有一家老字号的茶馆儿。
茶馆儿.en: There is an old-established tea house at the entrance of the alley.

茶馆儿.zh: 他喜欢在茶馆儿里跟朋友下棋聊天。
茶馆儿.en: He likes to play chess and chat with friends in the tea house.

茶馆儿.zh: 周末的茶馆儿总是很热闹，很多人来听相声。
茶馆儿.en: The tea house is always lively on weekends, with many people coming to listen to crosstalk.

茶馆儿.zh: 这家茶馆儿不仅茶好喝，点心也做得特别精致。
茶馆儿.en: This tea house not only has good tea but also makes particularly exquisite snacks.

吃不上.zh: 再晚一点就吃不上饭了。
吃不上.en: If we are any later, we won't get to eat.

吃不上.zh: 昨天没买到菜，全家差点吃不上晚饭。
吃不上.en: Yesterday we couldn't buy any vegetables, and the family almost had no dinner.

吃不上.zh: 他工作太忙，经常吃不上热饭。
吃不上.en: He is too busy with work and often can't have a hot meal.

吃不上.zh: 要是错过这趟车，连泡面都吃不上。
吃不上.en: If we miss this train, we won't even get to eat instant noodles.

吃不上.zh: 小时候家里穷，有时连一顿饱饭都吃不上。
吃不上.en: When I was a child, my family was poor, and sometimes we couldn't even have a full meal.

吹了.zh: 我跟她吹了，因为性格不合。
吹了.en: I broke up with her because our personalities didn't match.

吹了.zh: 那个项目吹了，老板很不高兴。
吹了.en: That project fell through, the boss was very upset.

吹了.zh: 听说他们的合作吹了，真可惜。
吹了.en: I heard their collaboration fell through, what a pity.
Don't wait anymore, this matter already fell through long ago.

从今以后.zh: 从今以后，我们要好好学汉语。
从今以后.en: From now on, we need to study Chinese well.

从今以后.zh: 从今以后，我再也不迟到了。
从今以后.en: From now on, I will never be late again.

从今以后.zh: 从今以后，你一个人要照顾好自己。
从今以后.en: From now on, you have to take good care of yourself alone.

从今以后.zh: 从今以后，咱们就是一家人了。
从今以后.en: From now on, we are family.

从今以后.zh: 从今以后，我会每天给你打电话。
从今以后.en: From now on, I will call you every day.

从早到晚.en: He works from morning till night.

从早到晚.zh: 妈妈从早到晚都在忙家务。
从早到晚.en: Mom is busy with housework from morning till night.

从早到晚.zh: 为了考试，他学习从早到晚。
从早到晚.en: For the exam, he studied from morning till night.

从早到晚.zh: 从早到晚，手机都不离手。
从早到晚.en: From morning till night, the phone never leaves the hand.

从早到晚.zh: 周末我就在家躺着，从早到晚。
从早到晚.en: On weekends I just lie at home from morning till night.

打盹儿.en: He secretly dozed off during the meeting.

打盹儿.zh: 坐车的时候，我经常打盹儿。
打盹儿.en: When riding the bus, I often doze off.

打盹儿.zh: 打盹儿一会儿，精神好多了。
打盹儿.en: Dozing for a while, I feel much more refreshed.

打盹儿.zh: 别在课堂上打盹儿，认真听讲。
打盹儿.en: Don't doze off in class, listen carefully.

大数据.zh: 公司用大数据分析用户习惯。
大数据.en: The company uses big data to analyze user habits.

大数据.zh: 现在很多行业都离不开大数据。
大数据.en: Now many industries can't do without big data.

大数据.zh: 大数据让我们的生活更方便。
大数据.en: Big data makes our lives more convenient.

大数据.zh: 学习大数据需要懂编程。
大数据.en: Learning big data requires understanding programming.

大腕儿.en: He is a big shot in the entertainment circle.

大腕儿.zh: 这次活动请了很多大腕儿。
大腕儿.en: This event invited many big shots.

大腕儿.zh: 那个大腕儿演技真的很好。
大腕儿.en: That big shot's acting is really good.

大腕儿.zh: 别以为自己是大腕儿就了不起。
大腕儿.en: Don't think you're a big shot and act arrogant.

大腕儿.zh: 大腕儿也有普通人的烦恼。
大腕儿.en: Big shots also have ordinary people's troubles.

点击率.en: This video has a high click rate.

点击率.zh: 标题党为了点击率乱写。
点击率.en: Clickbait writers write nonsense for click rates.

点击率.zh: 广告的点击率影响了收入。
点击率.en: The click rate of ads affects revenue.

点击率.zh: 提高点击率需要好内容。
点击率.en: To increase click rate, you need good content.

点击率.zh: 昨天那篇文章点击率破百万了。
点击率.en: That article yesterday broke one million click rate.

防汛.en: This year's flood control task is heavy.
The government strengthened flood control measures.
During flood control period, everyone should be careful.

防汛.zh: 为了防汛，他们修建了堤坝。
防汛.en: For flood control, they built a dam.

防汛.zh: 防汛工作关系到人民安全。
防汛.en: Flood control work relates to people's safety.

搞笑.en: He talks in a very funny way.

搞笑.zh: 那部电影太搞笑了，我笑死了。
搞笑.en: That movie was so funny, I laughed to death.

搞笑.zh: 搞笑艺人需要很多创意。
搞笑.en: Comedy performers need a lot of creativity.

公示.en: The list has been publicly announced.
The company announced new regulations publicly.
During the public announcement period, you can give feedback.

公示.zh: 这个结果需要公示七天。
公示.en: This result needs to be announced for seven days.
It takes effect only after the public announcement ends.

顾不上.zh: 他顾不上休息，继续工作。
顾不上.en: He couldn't afford to rest and kept working.

顾不上.zh: 她只顾着玩手机，顾不上跟我说话。
顾不上.en: She was so focused on her phone that she didn't have time to talk to me.

顾不上.zh: 今天太乱了，我根本顾不上收拾房间。
顾不上.en: It's so chaotic today that I simply can't spare time to tidy the room.

顾不上.zh: 虽然很累，但他顾不上抱怨，赶紧去接孩子。
顾不上.en: Although he was very tired, he didn't have time to complain and hurried to pick up the child.

后备箱.en: The trunk is full of luggage.

后备箱.zh: 你把东西放后备箱里吧。
后备箱.en: Put your stuff in the trunk.

后备箱.zh: 我的后备箱里常备一把伞。
后备箱.en: I always keep an umbrella in my trunk.

后备箱.zh: 他打开后备箱，拿出一个工具箱。
后备箱.en: He opened the trunk and took out a tool box.

后备箱.zh: 后备箱空间很大，能放下三个行李箱。
后备箱.en: The trunk is very spacious and can fit three suitcases.

忽高忽低.en: His grades fluctuate up and down.

忽高忽低.zh: 最近气温忽高忽低，容易感冒。
忽高忽低.en: The temperature has been fluctuating lately, making it easy to catch a cold.

忽高忽低.zh: 股票价格忽高忽低，让人很担心。
忽高忽低.en: Stock prices go up and down, which makes people worried.

忽高忽低.zh: 他的情绪忽高忽低，我们都不知道怎么安慰他。
忽高忽低.en: His mood swings up and down, and we don't know how to comfort him.

忽高忽低.zh: 这个信号忽高忽低，手机上网特别慢。
忽高忽低.en: The signal keeps fluctuating, so the mobile internet is very slow.

极少数.en: Very few people know the truth.

极少数.zh: 只有极少数学生能考满分。
极少数.en: Only a very small number of students can get full marks.

极少数.zh: 极少数情况下，我们会加班到很晚。
极少数.en: In very rare cases, we work late.

极少数.zh: 这种病极少数人能治好，但也不是没希望。
极少数.en: Very few people can be cured of this disease, but it's not hopeless.

极少数.zh: 虽然大多数人都同意，但极少数人还是反对这个计划。
极少数.en: Although most people agree, a very small number still oppose this plan.

接听.en: He is answering a customer's call.

接听.zh: 开会时不能接听私人电话。
接听.en: You can't answer personal calls during a meeting.

接听.zh: 我手机没电了，没法接听你的电话。
接听.en: My phone is dead, so I can't answer your call.

接听.zh: 她一边开车一边接听电话，这样很危险。
接听.en: She answers the phone while driving, which is very dangerous.

离谱儿.en: This price is way too outrageous!
What he said is a bit ridiculous.

离谱儿.zh: 你这么做也太离谱儿了吧？
离谱儿.en: Isn't what you did way too extreme?

离谱儿.zh: 他居然迟到了两个小时，真离谱儿。
离谱儿.en: He was two hours late, which is really outrageous.

离谱儿.zh: 这个故事编得太离谱儿，没人会相信。
离谱儿.en: This story is so far-fetched that no one will believe it.

咧嘴.zh: 她咧嘴一笑，露出两颗虎牙。
咧嘴.en: She grinned, showing two canine teeth.

咧嘴.zh: 辣椒太辣了，他吃得直咧嘴。
