咧嘴.en: The chili was so spicy that he grimaced while eating.

咧嘴.zh: 听到这个笑话，大家都咧嘴笑了。
咧嘴.en: Everyone grinned when they heard this joke.

领军.zh: 这家公司是行业领军企业。
领军.en: This company is a leading enterprise in the industry.

领军.zh: 他带领团队在技术上领军。
领军.en: He leads the team to take the lead in technology.

领军.zh: 中国在5G领域处于领军地位。
领军.en: China holds a leading position in the 5G field.

领军.zh: 这位科学家在人工智能研究方面领军全球。
领军.en: This scientist leads the world in AI research.

领军.zh: 作为领军人物，他经常出席国际会议。
领军.en: As a leading figure, he often attends international conferences.

聋人.en: Deaf people can also learn to speak.

聋人.zh: 这个学校专门招收聋人学生。
聋人.en: This school specifically enrolls deaf students.

聋人.zh: 很多聋人用手语交流，非常方便。
聋人.en: Many deaf people communicate using sign language, which is very convenient.

聋人.zh: 我们应该尊重聋人文化，不要歧视他们。
聋人.en: We should respect deaf culture and not discriminate against them.

沐浴露.en: This bottle of body wash is almost empty.

沐浴露.zh: 我喜欢用玫瑰味的沐浴露。
沐浴露.en: I like to use rose-scented body wash.

沐浴露.zh: 沐浴露和洗发水不能混着用。
沐浴露.en: Body wash and shampoo should not be used interchangeably.

沐浴露.zh: 新买的沐浴露泡沫很丰富，洗完皮肤很滑。
沐浴露.en: The newly bought body wash has rich foam and leaves skin smooth after washing.

沐浴露.zh: 你去超市的时候帮我带一瓶沐浴露回来。
沐浴露.en: When you go to the supermarket, please bring me a bottle of body wash.

哪知道.zh: 我本来想帮他，哪知道他根本不领情。
哪知道.en: I originally wanted to help him, who would have known he didn't appreciate it at all.

哪知道.zh: 约好八点见面，哪知道她迟到了一个小时。
哪知道.en: We agreed to meet at eight, but who would have known she was an hour late.

哪知道.zh: 以为今天会下雨，哪知道天气特别好。
哪知道.en: I thought it would rain today, but who would have known the weather would be so nice.

哪知道.zh: 他说他会来，哪知道临时又变卦了。
哪知道.en: He said he would come, but who would have known he changed his mind at the last minute.

哪知道.zh: 我复习了很久，哪知道考试题目这么简单。
哪知道.en: I studied for a long time, but who would have known the exam questions would be so easy.

难得一见.zh: 这种鸟在城里难得一见。
难得一见.en: This kind of bird is rarely seen in the city.

难得一见.zh: 今天难得一见的大晴天，我们出去走走吧。
难得一见.en: Today we have a rare sunny day, let's go out for a walk.

难得一见.zh: 他平时很忙，今天难得一见出现在聚会上。
难得一见.en: He's usually very busy, so it's rare to see him at a party today.

难得一见.zh: 这么漂亮的晚霞，真是难得一见的美景。
难得一见.en: Such a beautiful sunset is truly a rare sight.

难得一见.zh: 老张平时不爱说话，今天难得一见地讲了这么多故事。
难得一见.en: Old Zhang usually doesn't talk much, but today he rarely told so many stories.

难以想象.zh: 没有网络的生活难以想象。
难以想象.en: Life without the internet is hard to imagine.

难以想象.zh: 他一个人完成了这么多工作，真是难以想象。
难以想象.en: He finished so much work all by himself, it's really hard to imagine.

难以想象.zh: 如果明天世界末日，那情景难以想象。
难以想象.en: If tomorrow is doomsday, the scene is unimaginable.

难以想象.zh: 他们居然在三天内建好了这座桥，简直难以想象。
难以想象.en: They actually built this bridge in three days, it's simply unimaginable.

难以想象.zh: 在那种艰苦的条件下还能坚持学习，实在让人难以想象。
难以想象.en: Being able to persist in studying under such harsh conditions is truly hard to imagine.

人缘儿.zh: 他这人缘儿真好，大家都喜欢他。
人缘儿.en: He's really popular; everyone likes him.

人缘儿.zh: 她人缘儿不错，同事都愿意帮她。
人缘儿.en: She's well-liked; colleagues are willing to help her.

人缘儿.zh: 小张人缘儿差，没人愿意跟他合作。
人缘儿.en: Xiao Zhang is unpopular; no one wants to work with him.

人缘儿.zh: 新来的经理人缘儿很好，很快就融入了团队。
人缘儿.en: The new manager is very popular and quickly integrated into the team.

人缘儿.zh: 他因为人缘儿好，所以每次投票都能赢。
人缘儿.en: Because he's well-liked, he wins every vote.

如果说.zh: 如果说你不喜欢，那我们换一个。
如果说.en: If you say you don't like it, then let's change to another one.

如果说.zh: 如果说下雨，我们就不去公园了。
如果说.en: If it rains, we won't go to the park.

如果说.zh: 如果说实话，我觉得这个方案不太好。
如果说.en: To tell the truth, I think this plan is not very good.

如果说.zh: 如果说你有时间，我们可以一起去看电影。
如果说.en: If you have time, we can go watch a movie together.

如果说.zh: 如果说你想学中文，那我推荐你找个好老师。
如果说.en: If you want to learn Chinese, then I recommend you find a good teacher.

软实力.zh: 文化是一个国家的软实力。
软实力.en: Culture is a country's soft power.

软实力.zh: 除了经济，软实力也很重要。
软实力.en: Besides the economy, soft power is also very important.

软实力.zh: 中国这几年在提升自己的软实力。
软实力.en: China has been enhancing its soft power in recent years.

软实力.zh: 企业的软实力包括品牌和员工素质。
软实力.en: A company's soft power includes its brand and employee quality.

软实力.zh: 光靠军事不行，还得靠软实力来影响别人。
软实力.en: Relying solely on military force won't work; you also need soft power to influence others.

杀毒.en: My computer needs a virus scan.

杀毒.zh: 你记得定期给手机杀毒。
杀毒.en: Remember to regularly scan your phone for viruses.

杀毒.zh: 这个杀毒软件很好用，推荐给你。
杀毒.en: This antivirus software is very good; I recommend it to you.
After the virus scan, the computer is much faster.

杀毒.zh: 如果发现异常，马上杀毒检查一下。
杀毒.en: If you find anything unusual, immediately run a virus scan to check.

谁知道.en: Who knows the answer? Please raise your hand.

谁知道.zh: 他什么时候回来，谁知道呢。
谁知道.en: Who knows when he will come back.

谁知道.zh: 谁知道明天会不会下雨，天气预报也不准。
谁知道.en: Who knows if it will rain tomorrow; the weather forecast is unreliable.

谁知道.zh: 这件事谁知道真相，你告诉我。
谁知道.en: Who knows the truth about this matter? Tell me.

谁知道.zh: 谁知道他居然会辞职，大家都很惊讶。
谁知道.en: Who would have known he would quit; everyone was surprised.

时好时坏.en: His health is sometimes good, sometimes bad.

时好时坏.zh: 这里的网络信号时好时坏。
时好时坏.en: The network signal here is intermittent.

时好时坏.zh: 她心情时好时坏，很难捉摸。
时好时坏.en: Her mood is up and down, hard to predict.

时好时坏.zh: 这个月的业绩时好时坏，不稳定。
时好时坏.en: This month's performance has been up and down, unstable.

时好时坏.zh: 他的病情时好时坏，医生也说不好什么时候能好。
时好时坏.en: His condition fluctuates; even the doctor can't say when he'll recover.

受过.zh: 她受过高等教育，素质很高。
受过.en: She has received higher education and is very refined.

受过.zh: 这孩子没受过什么挫折，所以受不了打击。
受过.en: This child hasn't experienced much setback, so he can't handle blows.

受过.zh: 他因为受过伤，所以不能做剧烈运动。
受过.en: Because he has been injured, he can't do strenuous exercise.

双赢.zh: 我们找到一个双赢的办法。
只有双方都满意，才是真正的双赢。
双赢.en: Only when both sides are satisfied is it a true win-win.

双赢.zh: 这次谈判的结果是双赢，大家都挺高兴的。
双赢.en: The result of this negotiation was a win-win, and everyone was quite happy.

双赢.zh: 如果能把价格谈好，对我们两家公司都是双赢。
双赢.en: If we can negotiate a good price, it will be a win-win for both our companies.

说干就干.en: He's the type to act on the spot.

说干就干.zh: 既然决定了，我们就说干就干，别拖了。
说干就干.en: Since we've decided, let's just do it and not delay.

说干就干.zh: 他做事总是说干就干，从来不拖泥带水。
说干就干.en: He always acts promptly and never drags things out.

说干就干.zh: 昨天他说要学游泳，今天就报班了，真是说干就干。
说干就干.en: Yesterday he said he wanted to learn swimming, and today he signed up for a class—truly acting without hesitation.

说老实话.zh: 说老实话，我不太喜欢这个颜色。
说老实话.en: To be honest, I don't really like this color.

说老实话.zh: 说老实话，你最近是不是太累了？
说老实话.en: To be honest, have you been too tired lately?

说老实话.zh: 说老实话，我觉得这个方案不行。
说老实话.en: To be honest, I think this plan won't work.

说老实话.zh: 说老实话，我没想到你会这么生气。
说老实话.en: To be honest, I didn't expect you to be so angry.

说老实话.zh: 说老实话，这部电影确实很无聊，我们还是走吧。
说老实话.en: To be honest, this movie is really boring; let's just leave.

说起来.zh: 说起来，我也好久没见他了。
说起来.en: Speaking of which, I haven't seen him for a long time.

说起来.zh: 说起来，你上次推荐的餐厅真的很棒！
说起来.en: Speaking of which, the restaurant you recommended last time was really great!

说起来.zh: 这件事说起来话长，我们找个时间慢慢聊。
说起来.en: It's a long story; let's find time to chat slowly.

说起来.zh: 说起来，我小时候也特别喜欢那个动画片。
说起来.en: Speaking of which, I really liked that cartoon when I was a kid too.

说真的.zh: 说真的，我觉得你不该去。
说真的.en: Seriously, I think you shouldn't go.

说真的.zh: 说真的，这个价格已经很低了。
说真的.en: Seriously, this price is already very low.

说真的.zh: 说真的，我有点担心明天的考试。
说真的.en: Seriously, I'm a bit worried about tomorrow's exam.

说真的.zh: 说真的，如果你不喜欢，我们可以换一个。
说真的.en: Seriously, if you don't like it, we can switch to another one.

私家车.zh: 现在很多家庭都有私家车。
私家车.en: Nowadays many families have private cars.
He drives his private car to work every day.

私家车.zh: 私家车多了，交通就越来越堵。
私家车.en: With more private cars, traffic gets more and more congested.

私家车.zh: 因为我有私家车，所以周末经常出去玩儿。
私家车.en: Because I have a private car, I often go out on weekends.

私家车.zh: 相比坐公交，我还是喜欢开私家车，方便一些。
私家车.en: Compared to taking the bus, I still prefer driving my private car—it's more convenient.

搜救.en: The search and rescue team has already set out.

搜救.zh: 他们正在搜救失踪的游客。
搜救.en: They are searching for the missing tourists.

搜救.zh: 经过一整夜的搜救，终于找到了孩子。
搜救.en: After a whole night of search and rescue, they finally found the child.

搜救.zh: 这次搜救行动非常成功，救出了所有人。
搜救.en: This search and rescue operation was very successful; they rescued everyone.

搜救.zh: 虽然天气很恶劣，但搜救人员仍然在努力。
搜救.en: Although the weather was very bad, the search and rescue personnel were still working hard.

贪玩儿.en: This child is too fond of playing.

贪玩儿.zh: 你别那么贪玩儿，先写完作业。
贪玩儿.en: Don't be so playful; finish your homework first.

贪玩儿.zh: 小时候我特别贪玩儿，经常不回家吃饭。
贪玩儿.en: When I was little, I was very playful and often didn't come home for meals.

贪玩儿.zh: 他因为贪玩儿，考试又没考好。
贪玩儿.en: Because he's too playful, he didn't do well on the exam again.

贪玩儿.zh: 虽然她有点贪玩儿，但是学习的时候很认真。
贪玩儿.en: Although she is a bit playful, she is very serious when studying.

讨人喜欢.zh: 她笑起来特别讨人喜欢。
这孩子嘴甜，很讨人喜欢。
讨人喜欢.en: This child has a sweet mouth and is very likable.

讨人喜欢.zh: 他不光长得帅，性格也讨人喜欢。
讨人喜欢.en: He's not only handsome but also has a likable personality.

讨人喜欢.zh: 我觉得新来的同事挺讨人喜欢的，说话很和气。
讨人喜欢.en: I think the new colleague is quite likable; she speaks very kindly.

一卡通.en: I use the all-purpose card to take the subway.

一卡通.zh: 你的一卡通里还有钱吗？
一卡通.en: Is there still money on your all-purpose card?

一卡通.zh: 这张一卡通可以坐公交和地铁。
一卡通.en: This all-purpose card can be used for buses and the subway.

一卡通.zh: 我忘带一卡通了，只能买票。
一卡通.en: I forgot to bring my all-purpose card, so I have to buy a ticket.

一卡通.zh: 现在很多城市都有一卡通，非常方便。
一卡通.en: Now many cities have all-purpose cards, which are very convenient.

与时俱进.en: We need to keep up with the times.

与时俱进.zh: 公司必须与时俱进，才能在市场中生存。
与时俱进.en: The company must keep up with the times to survive in the market.

与时俱进.zh: 虽然新技术很复杂，但我们还是得与时俱进。
与时俱进.en: Although new technology is complex, we still have to keep up with the times.

与时俱进.zh: 这个软件每年更新，就是为了与时俱进。
与时俱进.en: This software updates every year just to keep up with the times.

与时俱进.zh: 他总说学习要与时俱进，不能停留在过去。
与时俱进.en: He always says that learning must keep pace with the times, not stay in the past.

原创.zh: 我喜欢看原创小说，不喜欢改编的。
原创.en: I like reading original novels, not adaptations.

原创.zh: 因为这是原创设计，所以价格比较贵。
原创.en: Because this is an original design, the price is relatively high.

原创.zh: 他们的节目都是原创内容，很有创意。
原创.en: Their programs are all original content, very creative.

原创.zh: 作为一个原创作者，他最怕别人抄袭。
原创.en: As an original author, he fears others plagiarizing the most.

正能量.en: He has a lot of positive energy.

正能量.zh: 多和充满正能量的人在一起，心情会变好。
正能量.en: Being around people full of positive energy will improve your mood.

正能量.zh: 虽然遇到了困难，但她依然传播正能量。
正能量.en: Although she encountered difficulties, she still spreads positive energy.

正能量.zh: 这部电影充满了正能量，适合全家看。
正能量.en: This movie is full of positive energy, suitable for the whole family.

正能量.zh: 在社交媒体上，我们应该多发一些正能量的话。
正能量.en: On social media, we should post more positive energy words.

追尾.zh: 高速上追尾事故很常见，要保持车距。
追尾.en: Rear-end collisions are common on highways; keep your distance.

追尾.zh: 因为前面突然刹车，我们差点追尾。
追尾.en: Because the car in front braked suddenly, we almost rear-ended.

追尾.zh: 昨天追尾了，还好人没事。
追尾.en: I had a rear-end collision yesterday, but fortunately no one was hurt.

追尾.zh: 追尾的责任通常是后面那辆车的司机。
追尾.en: The responsibility for a rear-end collision is usually the driver of the rear car.

着眼于.en: We should focus on the future.

着眼于.zh: 这个计划着眼于解决交通拥堵的问题。
着眼于.en: This plan aims to solve the traffic congestion problem.

着眼于.zh: 虽然眼前有困难，但我们还是着眼于长远发展。
着眼于.en: Although there are immediate difficulties, we still focus on long-term development.

着眼于.zh: 他着眼于细节，所以做得很好。
着眼于.en: He focuses on details, so he does well.

着眼于.zh: 公司决定着眼于新市场，而不是老客户。
着眼于.en: The company decided to focus on new markets instead of old customers.

做证.en: Are you willing to testify for me?

做证.zh: 他作为目击者，需要在法庭上做证。
做证.en: As a witness, he needs to testify in court.

做证.zh: 如果没有证据，就算有人做证也没用。
做证.en: Without evidence, even if someone testifies, it's useless.

做证.zh: 警察让他做证，描述当时的情况。
做证.en: The police asked him to testify and describe the situation.

做证.zh: 她因为不敢做证，最后案子不了了之。
做证.en: Because she dared not testify, the case ended up unresolved.
